zh_title: 基于波束图分析的DFT码本低复杂度近场波束训练
translation: 在高频段运行的极大规模天线阵列（ELAAs）促进了近场通信的发展，推动了波束训练设计。本文介绍了一种高效的近场波束训练方法，该方法利用了传统上用于远场用户（FUs）的离散傅里叶变换（DFT）码本。我们首先分析了接收波束图，并推导出了其宽度和中心波束增益作为用户位置函数的闭式表达式。在此基础上，我们提出了一种波束训练方法，该方法利用DFT波束的接收信号功率估计用户距离，计算复杂度为O(1)。仿真结果证实了我们方法的有效性，表明它能够以低复杂度进行近场波束训练，并具有高估计精度。值得注意的是，在多用户波束成形场景中，我们提出的方案比穷尽搜索方法实现了高达1.96 dB的信噪比（SNR）增益。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于DFT码本的低复杂度近场波束训练方法，通过分析波束图并利用接收信号功率估计用户距离，实现了高精度和显著的SNR增益。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将传统用于远场的DFT码本应用于近场通信的波束训练，并通过对波束图的深入分析，实现了O(1)的超低计算复杂度，同时保持了高精度和显著的性能增益。这对于未来极大规模天线阵列在近场通信中的实际部署具有重要意义，尤其是在资源受限的环境下。
motivation: 极大规模天线阵列（ELAAs）在高频段运行促进了近场通信的发展，推动了波束训练设计。现有的远场DFT码本需要适应近场用户，以解决近场通信中的波束训练问题。
method: 首先，分析接收波束图并推导出其宽度和中心波束增益作为用户位置函数的闭式表达式。然后，基于这些表达式，提出一种利用DFT波束的接收信号功率估计用户距离的波束训练方法。
results: 该方法具有O(1)的计算复杂度，实现了高估计精度。在多用户波束成形场景中，比穷尽搜索方法获得了高达1.96 dB的SNR增益。
conclusion: 所提出的方案能够以低复杂度进行近场波束训练，并保持高估计精度和显著的SNR增益。

title: A Real-Time Low-Cost Platform for Non-Contact Respiratory Rate Monitoring: A Comparative Evaluation of RGB Optical Flow and Time-of-Flight Depth Sensing
authors: Dominik Jasiówka, Patryk Ciężarek, Joanna Zysnawska, Ludwin Molina Arias
abstract: Respiratory rate (RR) is one of the earliest indicators of clinical deterioration, which makes its continuous measurement clinically valuable. In routine practice, however, RR is monitored almost exclusively with contact-based sensors, which require skin attachment, may alter natural breathing, and are poorly tolerated by vulnerable groups such as newborns and elderly patients. Non-contact sensing removes these constraints, with RGB video and depth imaging among its most accessible modalities. In this work, we present a low-cost, real-time platform based on a single multimodal sensor that provides both RGB and time-of-flight (ToF) data streams, implemented on a Raspberry Pi 5 edge device. The system integrates three RGB optical-flow pipelines, namely Farnebäck, Horn--Schunck, and Lucas--Kanade, together with a depth-based pipeline incorporating region-of-interest stabilization and distance-derived signal extraction, enabling the two modalities to be evaluated independently under the same experimental protocol. The proposed approach was evaluated on twelve healthy volunteers following a controlled protocol, including normal breathing, hyperventilation, and breath-holding, using a piezoresistive respiratory belt as a reference. RGB-based methods achieved lower RR estimation errors, with Lucas--Kanade attaining the lowest median MAE (3.83 BPM), whereas the ToF-based pipeline, although less accurate for RR estimation (median MAE 6.24 BPM), reached a higher apnea detection sensitivity (0.66 vs 0.51-0.55). These findings highlight the complementary strengths of both modalities and support their integration into unified low-cost platforms.
zh_title: 一种用于非接触式呼吸频率监测的实时低成本平台：RGB光流与飞行时间深度传感的比较评估
translation: 呼吸频率（RR）是临床恶化最早的指标之一，这使得其连续测量具有临床价值。然而，在常规实践中，RR几乎完全通过接触式传感器进行监测，这需要皮肤附着，可能会改变自然呼吸，并且易受新生儿和老年患者等脆弱群体的耐受性差。非接触式传感消除了这些限制，其中RGB视频和深度成像属于其最易获取的模态。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个基于单个多模态传感器（提供RGB和飞行时间（ToF）数据流）的低成本、实时平台，并在Raspberry Pi 5边缘设备上实现。该系统集成了三种RGB光流管道，即Farnebäck、Horn--Schunck和Lucas--Kanade，以及一个结合了感兴趣区域稳定和距离导出信号提取的基于深度的管道，使得两种模态可以在相同的实验协议下独立评估。所提出的方法在12名健康志愿者上进行了评估，遵循受控协议，包括正常呼吸、过度换气和屏气，并使用压阻式呼吸带作为参考。基于RGB的方法实现了较低的RR估计误差，其中Lucas--Kanade达到了最低的中位数MAE（3.83 BPM），而基于ToF的管道虽然在RR估计方面准确性较低（中位数MAE 6.24 BPM），但达到了更高的呼吸暂停检测敏感度（0.66 vs 0.51-0.55）。这些发现突出了两种模态的互补优势，并支持将它们整合到统一的低成本平台中。
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于单个多模态传感器（RGB和ToF）在树莓派5上实现的低成本、实时非接触式呼吸频率监测平台。研究比较了RGB光流和ToF深度传感在呼吸频率估计和呼吸暂停检测方面的性能，发现RGB在RR估计上更准确，而ToF在呼吸暂停检测上敏感度更高，二者具有互补优势。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将RGB光流和ToF深度传感两种非接触式模态集成到低成本的边缘设备上，并进行了对比评估。其重要性在于为临床上脆弱人群提供了更舒适、连续的呼吸监测解决方案。通过比较两种模态的优缺点，为未来多模态融合的非接触式监测系统设计提供了指导。
motivation: 呼吸频率是临床恶化的早期指标，连续测量具有临床价值。然而，传统接触式传感器存在需要皮肤接触、可能改变自然呼吸以及对新生儿和老年患者等脆弱人群耐受性差等局限性。非接触式传感可以消除这些限制。
method: 本文提出了一个基于单个多模态传感器（提供RGB和飞行时间（ToF）数据流）的低成本、实时平台，并在Raspberry Pi 5边缘设备上实现。该系统集成了三种RGB光流管道（Farnebäck、Horn--Schunck和Lucas--Kanade）和一个基于深度的管道（包含感兴趣区域稳定和距离导出信号提取）。该方法在12名健康志愿者上进行评估，遵循受控协议（包括正常呼吸、过度换气和屏气），并使用压阻式呼吸带作为参考。
results: 基于RGB的方法实现了较低的呼吸频率（RR）估计误差，其中Lucas--Kanade达到了最低的中位数MAE（3.83 BPM）。基于ToF的管道在RR估计方面准确性较低（中位数MAE 6.24 BPM），但达到了更高的呼吸暂停检测敏感度（0.66 vs 0.51-0.55）。
conclusion: 这些发现突出了RGB和ToF两种模态的互补优势，并支持将它们整合到统一的低成本平台中，以实现更全面的非接触式呼吸监测。

title: Performance Analysis of EDMA-NOMA Enhanced V-SWAN-Assisted ISAC Systems
authors: Arnav Hari, Sagnik Bhattacharyya, Keshav Singh, Meng-Lin Ku, Brijesh Kumbhani
abstract: This paper proposes a vertical segmented waveguide-enabled pinching antenna (V-SWAN)-assisted downlink non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)-integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) environmental division multiple access (EDMA) framework for simultaneously supporting multi-user communication and target sensing. In the proposed framework, multiple pinching antennas (PAs) are deployed along a segmented vertical dielectric waveguide to serve communication users (CUs), aerial users (AUs), and sensing target (ST). CUs are distributed on the ground, whereas AUs and ST are above the ground, where line-of-sight (LoS) and non-line-of-sight (NLoS) propagation conditions coexist. In particular, SWAN provides an effective platform for realizing EDMA by reducing the effective propagation distance and in-waveguide attenuation, thereby suppressing co-channel interference and enabling efficient multi-user transmission. The communication and sensing model are formulated, followed by the corresponding SINR expressions. We formulate the statistical characterizations for the combination of LoS and NLoS propagation for CUs, and LoS propagation for AUs and sensing channels for generalized multi-user, multi-PA scenarios. Based on these statistical characterizations, the segment outage and sensing outage probabilities are derived and evaluated for the generalized framework. The results show that the proposed framework outperforms the conventional H-SWAN and single vertical pinching antenna system (V-PASS) in terms of segment outage probability, sensing outage probability, and segment sum rate. Monte Carlo simulation results closely match the analytical results, validating the accuracy of the derived expressions. The results further highlight the impact of different system parameters on the performance of the proposed framework.
zh_title: EDMA-NOMA增强型V-SWAN辅助ISAC系统性能分析
translation: 本文提出了一种垂直分段波导辅助捏合天线（V-SWAN）辅助的下行非正交多址接入（NOMA）集成sensing与通信（ISAC）环境分多址（EDMA）框架，用于同时支持多用户通信和目标感知。在所提框架中，多个捏合天线（PAs）部署在分段垂直介质波导沿线，以服务通信用户（CUs）、空中用户（AUs）和感知目标（ST）。通信用户分布在地面上，而空中用户和感知目标位于地面上方，其中视距（LoS）和非视距（NLoS）传播条件共存。特别是，SWAN通过减少有效传播距离和波内衰减，为实现EDMA提供了有效平台，从而抑制同道干扰并实现高效的多用户传输。构建了通信和感知模型，随后推导了相应的SINR表达式。我们针对广义多用户、多PA场景，对CUs的LoS与NLoS传播组合、AUs及感知信道的LoS传播建立了统计特征表征。基于这些统计特征，推导并评估了该广义框架的段中断概率和感知中断概率。结果表明，所提框架在段中断概率、感知中断概率和段求和速率方面优于传统的H-SWAN和单垂直捏合天线系统（V-PASS）。蒙特卡洛仿真结果与分析结果高度吻合，验证了推导表达式的准确性。结果进一步突出了不同系统参数对所提框架性能的影响。
keywords: 垂直分段波导捏合天线 (V-SWAN)
tldr: 本文提出了一种新型的V-SWAN辅助EDMA-NOMA ISAC框架，实现了高效的多用户通信与目标感知，性能显著优于传统系统。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地结合了垂直分段波导捏合天线（V-SWAN）与EDMA-NOMA技术，用于实现集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统，显著提升了多用户通信和目标感知的性能。
motivation: 为了同时支持地面用户、空中用户和目标的通信与感知需求，并克服传统系统在传播距离、衰减和同道干扰方面的限制。
method: 提出了一种V-SWAN辅助的下行NOMA-ISAC EDMA框架，建立了通信和感知模型，推导了SINR表达式、统计特征以及段中断概率和感知中断概率，并通过蒙特卡洛仿真进行了验证。
results: 理论推导与蒙特卡洛仿真结果高度吻合，且该框架在段中断概率、感知中断概率和段求和速率方面表现优于传统的H-SWAN和单垂直捏合天线系统（V-PASS）。
conclusion: 提出的V-SWAN辅助EDMA-NOMA ISAC框架能够有效降低信道衰减和同道干扰，其性能优于传统的H-SWAN和V-PASS系统，并通过蒙特卡洛仿真验证了理论推导的准确性。

title: Refinements to precision-information imputation in meta-analysis of survival rates: Boundary correction and cross-study borrowing
authors: Kazushi Maruo, Yusuke Yamaguchi, Ryota Ishii, Hisashi Noma, Masahiko Gosho
abstract: Meta-analyses of survival rates require precision information, such as standard errors (SEs), which is often unreported. We previously proposed imputing missing SEs from reported survival rates, sample sizes, and risk-set sizes. The original method has two limitations. First, it replaces Kaplan--Meier estimates of 1 with 0.99 regardless of sample size. Second, when the risk-set size is unavailable, it uses the total event count as a fallback. The count is often unreported, and the fallback can also substantially overestimate SEs. We propose a sample-size-dependent boundary correction based on a pseudo-event and a method that borrows time-specific event information from studies with available risk-set sizes. In simulations, the boundary correction was more stable than fixed replacement, and borrowing reduced study-level SE imputation bias. Borrowing generally improved precision by retaining studies with missing SEs that lacked both risk-set sizes and event counts.
zh_title: 生存率荟萃分析中精确信息插补的改进：边界校正和跨研究借用
translation: 生存率的荟萃分析需要精确信息，例如标准误（SEs），但这些信息通常未报告。我们之前提出根据报告的生存率、样本量和风险集大小来插补缺失的标准误。原始方法有两个局限性。首先，它将Kaplan-Meier估计值1替换为0.99，而不考虑样本量。其次，当风险集大小不可用时，它使用总事件计数作为备用。该计数通常未报告，并且备用方法也可能显著高估标准误。我们提出了一种基于伪事件的样本量依赖性边界校正方法，以及一种从具有可用风险集大小的研究中借用时间特异性事件信息的方法。在模拟中，边界校正比固定替换更稳定，并且借用方法减少了研究层面的标准误插补偏差。借用方法通过保留那些缺失标准误、且同时缺乏风险集大小和事件计数的研究，通常提高了精度。
tldr: 本文提出了两种改进生存率荟萃分析中缺失标准误插补的方法：基于样本量的边界校正和跨研究借用时间特异性事件信息，以解决现有方法的局限性，并提高了插补的稳定性和精度。
ai_comments: 该论文解决了荟萃分析中一个常见的实际问题，即生存率标准误的缺失。其创新点在于提出了样本量依赖的边界校正和跨研究借用信息的方法，这对于提高荟萃分析结果的可靠性具有重要意义。这些改进使得更多的研究可以被纳入荟萃分析，并提升了插补结果的准确性。
motivation: 生存率荟萃分析需要精确信息（如标准误），但这些信息常未报告。先前的插补方法存在两个局限性：一是将Kaplan-Meier估计值1替换为0.99，不考虑样本量；二是当风险集大小不可用时，使用总事件计数作为备用，但该计数也常未报告，且可能高估标准误。
method: 本文提出了一种基于伪事件的样本量依赖性边界校正方法，以及一种从具有可用风险集大小的研究中借用时间特异性事件信息的方法。
results: 在模拟中，边界校正比固定替换更稳定，借用方法减少了研究层面的标准误插补偏差。借用方法通过保留那些缺失标准误、且同时缺乏风险集大小和事件计数的研究，通常提高了精度。
conclusion: 本文提出的样本量依赖性边界校正和跨研究借用方法有效改进了生存率荟萃分析中缺失标准误的插补，提高了插补的稳定性和精度。

title: From Very Fine Vertical Resolution to Range Super-Resolution on BIOMASS P-BAND SAR Data
authors: Yanghai Yu, Stefano Tebaldini, Yang Lei, Fabio Rocca
abstract: This paper demonstrates range super-resolution over arid regions using SAR tomography data with very fine vertical resolution from the European Space Agency's BIOMASS mission. As the first civilian spaceborne P-band SAR mission, BIOMASS is operating with a bandwidth limited to 6~MHz by International Telecommunication Union regulations, yielding a native slant-range resolution of approximately 25 m. The large spatial baseline data acquired during the commissioning phase in July and August 2025 provide a valuable opportunity to enhance range resolution based on the InSAR wavenumber shift principle. According to this principle, a wider effective bandwidth can be synthesized by combining complementary sub-bands of the ground reflectivity spectrum sampled across acquisitions at different look angles. Unlike existing literature, this paper offers a novel interpretation of this problem from the perspective of SAR tomography. Furthermore, the proposed method also accounts for residual topography errors. The range resolution enhancement performance is validated using all 20 available acquisitions from the July-August 2025 commissioning phase over Lop Nur, China, and Wadi al-Hayat, Libya, achieving spatial detail comparable to optical satellite imagery in a grid finer than 2 m. Furthermore, the reconstructed range spectrum of the central Libyan oasis exhibits an effective bandwidth exceeding 70 MHz. The point spread function (PSF) of a point like target in the scene demonstrates a slant-range resolution finer than 2.1 m, representing more than a twelvefold improvement over the native resolution.
comment: 5 pages, 7 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
zh_title: 从极高垂直分辨率到BIOMASS P波段SAR数据的距离超分辨率
translation: 本文展示了利用欧洲空间局BIOMASS任务具有极高垂直分辨率的SAR断层成像数据，在干旱地区实现距离超分辨率。作为第一个民用星载P波段SAR任务，BIOMASS受国际电信联盟法规限制，带宽被限制在6 MHz，原生斜距分辨率约为25米。2025年7月和8月调试阶段获取的大空间基线数据为基于InSAR波数位移原理增强距离分辨率提供了宝贵机会。根据该原理，通过组合在不同视角采集的地面反射率光谱的互补子带，可以合成更宽的有效带宽。与现有文献不同，本文从SAR断层成像的角度对该问题提供了新的解释。此外，所提出的方法还考虑了残余地形误差。利用中国罗布泊和利比亚瓦迪哈亚特2025年7-8月调试阶段的所有20景可用采集数据对距离分辨率增强性能进行了验证，实现了与小于2米网格的光学卫星影像相当的空间细节。此外，利比亚中部绿洲重建的距离光谱表现出超过70 MHz的有效带宽。场景中点状目标的点扩散函数（PSF）显示斜距分辨率优于2.1米，比原生分辨率提高了十二倍以上。
tldr: 本文利用BIOMASS P波段SAR数据和断层成像技术，通过波数位移原理成功将SAR图像的斜距分辨率提高了12倍以上，达到优于2.1米的水平。
ai_comments: 该论文展示了利用BIOMASS P波段SAR数据通过断层成像技术实现距离超分辨率的创新方法。通过将InSAR波数位移原理与SAR断层成像视角相结合，并有效处理残余地形误差，成功将分辨率提升了12倍以上，达到了与光学卫星影像相当的水平，具有重要的科学意义和应用价值。
motivation: 欧洲空间局BIOMASS任务的P波段SAR由于国际电信联盟法规限制，带宽被限制在6 MHz，导致原生斜距分辨率约为25米，无法满足高分辨率应用需求，因此需要开发距离超分辨率方法来增强分辨率。
method: 利用InSAR波数位移原理，结合SAR断层成像视角，组合不同观测角的地面反射率光谱子带合成更宽的有效带宽，并考虑了残余地形误差。
results: 在罗布泊和瓦迪哈亚特的使用20次 commissioning 阶段获取的数据验证中，实现了优于2米的精细网格空间细节，有效带宽超过70 MHz，点目标斜距分辨率优于2.1米，比原生分辨率提升了12倍以上。
conclusion: 本文成功验证了基于SAR断层成像和波数位移原理的P波段SAR距离超分辨率方法，显著克服了带宽限制，实现了优于2.1米的斜距分辨率。

title: The Illusion of an Automated German Census: Assessing the Feasibility of the 2031 Register-Based Census via Simulation
authors: R. Schnell, S. V. Weiand
abstract: The next German Census (2031) is planned to be the country's first fully register-based census, relying exclusively on administrative data sources. In addition to the population registers, ten further administrative registers are envisaged, covering a wide range of information, from driving licences to agricultural social insurance. This study simulates potential data-quality challenges in linking these registers using quasi-identifiers (QIDs), such as names and dates of birth. Using a synthetic population dataset (N=80,206,770), we systematically vary experimental factors related to register characteristics. Across the 1,458 experimental conditions studied, results vary considerably. Some plausible scenarios range from 500,000 to 1,000,000 false-negative linkage errors per linked register. These findings suggest that implementing an automated register-based census using the currently envisaged registers may prove challenging and could require substantial manual post-processing to achieve acceptable data quality.
zh_title: 自动化德国人口普查的幻觉：通过模拟评估2031年基于注册表人口普查的可行性
translation: 德国下一次人口普查（2031年）计划成为该国第一次完全基于注册表的人口普查，完全依赖行政数据源。除了人口注册表外，还计划使用其他十个行政注册表，涵盖从驾照到农业社会保险等广泛信息。本研究使用拟标识符（QIDs，如姓名和出生日期）模拟了链接这些注册表时潜在的数据质量挑战。利用合成人口数据集（N=80,206,770），我们系统地变化了与注册表特征相关的实验因子。在研究的1,458种实验条件中，结果差异相当大。一些合理的方案显示，每个链接的注册表会产生50万到1,000,000个假阴性链接错误。这些发现表明，使用目前设想的注册表来实现自动化的基于注册表的人口普查可能会遇到困难，并且可能需要大量的手工后处理才能达到可接受的数据质量。
tldr: 通过模拟德国2031年基于注册表的人口普查发现，利用现有的行政数据进行自动化数据链接会产生大量错误，完全自动化的目标面临巨大挑战。
ai_comments: 该论文揭示了德国计划于2031年实施的全注册人口普查在数据关联上面临的巨大挑战，强调了过度依赖自动化与当前行政数据质量之间的鸿沟，对政策制定具有重要的警示作用。
motivation: 评估德国计划在2031年进行的首次完全基于行政数据和注册表的人口普查在技术上的可行性，特别是通过模拟评估使用拟标识符链接多个注册表时可能面临的数据质量挑战。
method: 使用合成人口数据集（N=80,206,770），通过使用拟标识符（如姓名和出生日期）链接注册表，系统地变化与注册表特征相关的实验因子，共研究了1458种实验条件。
results: 在1458种实验条件下，结果差异显著。在某些合理的情况下，每个关联的注册表会出现50万到100万的假阴性链接错误。
conclusion: 实现一个完全自动化的基于注册的德国2031年人口普查面临重大挑战，很可能需要大量的人工后处理才能达到可接受的数据质量。

title: A new method of Ecological Inference based on the Cressie--Read power divergence
authors: Jose M. Pavía, Antonio Forcina
abstract: Ecological inference aims to estimate the bivariate association structure between a pair of variables from the row and column totals of a set of contingency tables. The paper introduces a new approach based on minimizing the Cressie--Read power divergence, applied to the estimation of vote transitions between two elections. It also outlines a Fisher scoring algorithm and derives the asymptotic distribution of the estimator.
zh_title: 基于Cressie-Read幂散度的新生态推断方法
translation: 生态推断旨在从一组列联表的行和列总计中估计一对变量之间的双变量关联结构。本文引入了一种基于极小化Cressie-Read幂散度的新方法，应用于两次选举之间投票转换的估计。它还概述了一种Fisher得分算法，并推导了估计量的渐近分布。
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用Cressie-Read幂散度极小化来解决生态推断和投票转换估计的新统计方法。
ai_comments: 该论文将统计学中的Cressie-Read幂散度极小化方法引入到生态推断中，并给出了相应的算法和渐近分布，具有较强的理论创新性。
motivation: 旨在解决生态推断问题，即如何通过列联表的行和列总计来估计成对变量之间的双变量关联结构，特别是针对两次选举之间的投票转换估计。
method: 提出了一种基于极小化Cressie-Read幂散度的方法来估计变量间的双变量关联结构，设计了Fisher得分算法，并推导了估计量的渐近分布。
results: 成功引入了基于Cressie-Read幂散度的方法，并导出了相应的Fisher得分算法和渐近分布。
conclusion: 提出了一种基于Cressie-Read幂散度的生态推断新方法，并为其提供了算法实现和理论分布支持。

title: Cutting Bus Service Without Cutting Access: Persistent Homology of Service Deserts and Timetable Reductions
authors: Fabiana Ferracina, Ayane Nakmura, Bala Krishnamoorthy, Hiroyasu Ando
abstract: Japanese bus operators are withdrawing service for lack of drivers, and the choice of which trips to withdraw determines who keeps a bus. We measure service at each stop from vehicle GPS and smart-card records, without timetables, and use persistent homology of walking and walking-plus-waiting time to find enclosed service deserts: pockets surrounded by service but beyond walking distance from it. Around Tsukuba, 35 such pockets lie more than 800m from any station or hourly stop. The 17 that are fully ringed by walkable service hold 18,446 residents. We compare two 2020 timetable reductions by Kanto Railway with random reductions and a heuristic frontier of same-size, capacity-feasible alternatives. At two and four buses an hour, both reductions protected service better than random reductions. No alternative found by the sweep dominates the state-of-emergency timetable. The summer timetable is dominated: it withdrew hourly service from 5,253 residents around stops with almost no morning riders, whereas same-size alternatives kept it for all of them at equal waiting. Averages hide a tail: under the actual timetables, 5.9% and 3.9% of residents are at stops whose expected wait rises by 10 minutes or more, against 0.5% and 0.3% in the alternatives, and capping the increase at 10 minutes at every served stop is feasible at the operator's sizes. If half the removed hours become paid hours saved, the labor saving of both reductions and their main alternatives fall short of the fare revenue on the removed trips.
zh_title: 削减公交服务而不削减出行：服务荒漠的持久同调和时刻表削减
translation: 日本的公交运营商因司机短缺而削减服务，而选择削减哪些班次决定了谁能继续使用公交。我们利用车辆GPS和智能卡记录（不依赖时刻表）测量每个站点的服务，并使用步行和步行加等待时间的持久同调来寻找封闭的服务荒漠：即被服务环绕但超出步行距离的区域。在筑波周边，有35个这样的区域距离任何车站或每小时一班的站点超过800米。其中17个完全被步行可达的服务环绕，居住着18,446名居民。我们将关东铁道2020年的两次时刻表削减与随机削减以及相同规模、容量可行的替代方案的启发式前沿进行了比较。在每小时两班和四班公交的情况下，两次削减都比随机削减更好地保护了服务。通过全面搜索发现，没有替代方案优于紧急状态时刻表。夏季时刻表被超越：它取消了早晨乘客几乎为零的站点周围5,253名居民的每小时服务，而相同规模的替代方案在等待时间相同的情况下为所有这些居民保留了服务。平均值隐藏了尾部效应：在实际时刻表下，5.9%和3.9%的居民在预期等待时间增加10分钟或更多的站点，而替代方案中这一比例为0.5%和0.3%。在每个服务站点将等待时间增加限制在10分钟以内，对于运营商的规模是可行的。如果一半的取消班次转化为节省的带薪工时，两次削减及其主要替代方案的劳动力节省均低于取消班次的票价收入。
tldr: 日本公交运营商因司机短缺而削减服务。本文利用持久同调识别“服务荒漠”，并分析实际时刻表削减与替代方案的对比影响，发现一些实际削减对居民的负面影响大于可行替代方案，且劳动力节省可能无法抵消收入损失。
ai_comments: 本文通过利用持久同调结合实际服务数据（GPS和智能卡记录）来量化“服务荒漠”，提供了一种创新方法，从而对可达性进行了更实际的评估。将实际服务削减与优化替代方案进行比较，对政策制定者具有重要意义，凸显了实现更优、更公平的服务削减的可能性。劳动力节省可能无法抵消收入损失的发现，为运营商在面临服务削减决策时提供了重要的经济洞察。该论文的优势在于其数据驱动的方法和对城市规划及公共交通政策的实际影响。
motivation: 由于司机短缺，日本公交运营商正在削减服务。选择削减哪些班次决定了谁能继续获得公交服务。研究动机是分析这些服务削减，以了解它们对出行可达性的影响，并找到更好的方法在不严重影响居民的情况下削减服务。
method: 作者使用车辆GPS和智能卡记录（不依赖时刻表）测量每个站点的服务。他们应用步行和步行加等待时间的持久同调来识别“封闭的服务荒漠”。随后，他们将关东铁道2020年的两次时刻表削减与随机削减以及相同规模、容量可行的替代方案的启发式前沿进行了比较。
results: 在筑波周边，发现了35个服务荒漠（距离任何车站或每小时一班的站点超过800米的区域）。其中17个完全被步行可达的服务环绕，居住着18,446名居民。两次实际时刻表削减（每小时两班和四班公交）都比随机削减更好地保护了服务。通过全面搜索，没有替代方案优于紧急状态时刻表。夏季时刻表被超越：它取消了早晨乘客几乎为零的站点周围5,253名居民的每小时服务，而相同规模的替代方案在等待时间相同的情况下为所有这些居民保留了服务。在实际时刻表下，5.9%和3.9%的居民在预期等待时间增加10分钟或更多的站点，而替代方案中这一比例为0.5%和0.3%。在每个服务站点将等待时间增加限制在10分钟以内，对于运营商的规模是可行的。如果一半的取消班次转化为节省的带薪工时，两次削减及其主要替代方案的劳动力节省均低于取消班次的票价收入。
conclusion: 实际的公交时刻表削减，特别是夏季时刻表，可能会不成比例地对居民产生负面影响，导致一小部分但显著比例的人口等待时间显著增加，即使存在可以维持更好服务的可行替代方案。此外，服务削减带来的劳动力节省可能无法抵消损失的票价收入。该研究强调了精心设计服务削减以保护出行可达性的重要性。

title: Shooting for Fit: Risk-Averse Stochastic Roster Construction from Bayesian Shot-Pattern Models
authors: Yue Yu, Cong Zhang, David Crandall, Guanyu Hu
abstract: Roster construction is a critical decision problem in professional basketball, requiring teams to balance player quality, player complementarity, and financial constraints under uncertainty. Existing roster optimization models primarily rely on individual player ratings and aggregate performance statistics, which provide limited information about how players' offensive contributions vary with their teammates. Recent advances in player-tracking technology have enabled statistical analyses of spatial shooting patterns, but these insights have rarely informed roster construction. We bridge this gap by developing a data-driven, risk-averse two-stage stochastic optimization framework for NBA roster construction. We first develop a Bayesian modeling framework that combines player statistics and spatial shot-chart data to identify player roles and estimate how teammate composition influences shot selection, shooting frequency, and scoring efficiency. The resulting model provides uncertainty-quantified offensive values for hypothetical five-player lineups, including combinations that have never played together. We then formulate roster construction as a two-stage stochastic mixed-integer program that optimizes player acquisitions under NBA salary-cap regulations while allowing lineup playing-time allocations to adapt to uncertain player roles. We evaluate the framework using 240 team-offseason decisions over eight seasons and two additional held-out seasons. The results demonstrate that incorporating spatial shooting compatibility substantially changes optimal roster decisions and improves predicted offensive performance relative to approaches based on individual player values. We further find that flexibility in allocating playing time across lineups absorbs much of the uncertainty about player roles.
zh_title: 追求契合：基于贝叶斯投篮模式模型的风险厌恶型随机阵容构建
translation: 职业篮球中的阵容构建是一个关键的决策问题，要求球队在不确定性下平衡球员素质、球员互补性和财务限制。现有的阵容优化模型主要依赖个人球员评分和总体表现统计，这些统计数据对于球员的进攻贡献如何随队友变化提供的信息有限。球员追踪技术的最新进展使得空间投篮模式的统计分析成为可能，但这些见解很少用于指导阵容构建。我们通过开发一个数据驱动的、风险厌恶的两阶段随机优化框架来构建NBA阵容，以此弥补这一空白。我们首先开发了一个贝叶斯建模框架，该框架结合了球员统计数据和空间投篮图数据，以识别球员角色并估计队友构成如何影响投篮选择、投篮频率和得分效率。由此产生的模型为假设的五人阵容提供了量化不确定性的进攻价值，包括从未一起打过球的组合。然后，我们将阵容构建表述为一个两阶段随机混合整数规划，在NBA工资帽法规下优化球员引进，同时允许阵容出场时间分配适应不确定的球员角色。我们利用八个赛季的240个球队休赛期决策以及两个额外的保留赛季对该框架进行了评估。结果表明，与基于个人球员价值的方法相比，结合空间投篮兼容性显著改变了最优阵容决策并改善了预测的进攻性能。我们进一步发现，跨阵容分配出场时间的灵活性吸收了很大一部分关于球员角色的不确定性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合空间投篮兼容性的NBA阵容构建与优化框架，能有效提升球队进攻表现并适应球员角色的不确定性。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将球员空间投篮模式（spatial shooting patterns）与风险厌恶型两阶段随机优化框架相结合，解决了职业篮球中长期存在的球员兼容性和阵容构建难题，在体育分析和运筹学交叉领域具有重要价值。
motivation: 现有的阵容优化模型主要依赖个人球员评分和总体表现统计，忽略了球员间进攻贡献随队友变化的互补性以及空间投篮模式的作用。
method: 开发了一个结合球员统计数据与空间投篮图数据的贝叶斯建模框架来估计进攻价值，并将其输入到一个针对NBA工资帽规则的两阶段随机混合整数规划模型中进行阵容优化。
results: 在240个球队休赛期决策及两个保留赛季上的评估表明，结合空间投篮兼容性显著改变了最优阵容决策，并优于基于个人价值的传统方法。
conclusion: 通过结合贝叶斯投篮模式模型与两阶段随机规划，本文提出的阵容构建框架能显著提升NBA球队的进攻表现，并有效应对球员角色不确定性。

title: Who Fills the Gap? Role Similarity and Teammates' Minutes When NBA Players Are Ruled Out
authors: Tianyu Guan, Yang Zhou
abstract: When a core player is ruled out before an NBA game, do teammates whose statistical role resembles that of the removed set (every rotation player ruled out, about three per case) play more? Using injury reports stamped at least six hours before tip-off and rosters reconstructed after the season, we study 2,441 team-games from 2023-24 to 2025-26 in which a core player was ruled out for a medical reason. Among teammates in the same game, one within-case standard deviation more similarity in role profile (three-point attempts, assists and rebounds per minute) goes with about 0.63 more minutes, holding reference minutes and headroom fixed (p < 0.0001); this compares teammates within a game, not the minutes gained because of the absence. The pattern holds in two earlier seasons and in exploratory within-player and without-and-with comparisons. Whether similarity adds to listed position is not settled. The association is small and yielded no statistically detectable reduction in the error of the retrospective minute forecasts we tested. Role coverage, how much of the missing minutes and roles the remaining rotation could restore, showed no consistent incremental association with team role output or the final margin.
zh_title: 谁来填补空缺？NBA球员缺席时角色相似性与队友上场时间
translation: 当一名核心球员在NBA比赛前被排除在外时，统计角色与被移除球员（每位轮换球员被排除在外，每种情况大约三名）相似的队友会上场更多时间吗？我们使用比赛前至少六小时盖章的伤病报告和赛季结束后重建的名单，研究了2023-24至2025-26赛季中2,441场球队比赛，其中一名核心球员因医疗原因被排除在外。在同一场比赛的队友中，角色特征（每分钟三分球尝试、助攻和篮板）相似度每增加一个案例内标准差，上场时间大约增加0.63分钟，同时保持参考上场时间和上限不变（p < 0.0001）；这比较的是同一场比赛中的队友，而不是因缺席而获得的分钟数。这种模式在两个早期赛季中也成立，并在探索性的球员内和有无对比中得到验证。相似性是否增加了列出的位置尚未确定。这种关联性很小，并且在我们测试的回顾性分钟预测的误差中没有产生统计上可检测到的减少。角色覆盖，即剩余轮换球员能恢复多少缺失的分钟和角色，与球队角色产出或最终分差没有一致的增量关联。
tldr: NBA球员缺席时，角色相似的队友会上场更多时间，但这种关联性较小，对比赛结果影响不明显。
ai_comments: 这项研究通过量化角色相似性与上场时间的关系，为NBA球队管理和球员轮换策略提供了新的视角。尽管发现的关联性较小，但其严谨的数据分析方法和跨赛季验证增加了结果的可靠性。研究的局限性在于未能确定角色相似性是否增加了列出的位置，且对比赛结果的影响不显著，这表明球员缺席后的替补策略可能更为复杂，不仅仅是简单的角色匹配。
motivation: 研究当NBA核心球员缺席比赛时，队友中与缺席球员统计角色（如三分球尝试、助攻和篮板每分钟）相似的球员是否会获得更多上场时间。
method: 使用2023-24至2025-26赛季的2,441场NBA球队比赛数据，这些比赛中核心球员因医疗原因缺席。数据来源于赛前至少六小时公布的伤病报告。通过比较同一场比赛中队友的角色相似性与上场时间的关系进行分析。
results: 角色相似度每增加一个案例内标准差，上场时间增加约0.63分钟（p < 0.0001）。这种模式在两个早期赛季中也成立。然而，这种关联性较小，未能显著降低回顾性分钟预测的误差，并且角色覆盖度与球队角色产出或最终分差没有一致的增量关联。
conclusion: 当NBA核心球员缺席时，与缺席球员角色相似的队友会上场更多时间，但这种关联性较小，对预测上场时间或比赛结果的影响不显著。

title: ENSO-linked redistribution of post-monsoon tropical cyclone energy between the Arabian Sea and the Bay of Bengal: 1982--2025
authors: Prashant Saini, Rishikesh Yadav, Sarita Azad
abstract: Tropical cyclones in the North Indian Ocean (NIO) form in two sub-basins, the Arabian Sea (AS) and the Bay of Bengal (BoB), which are usually studied separately, with their relationship to the El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO) treated as stationary. We develop a joint inter-basin statistical framework and apply it to 416 disturbances from quality-controlled IBTrACS best tracks for 1982--2025, with harmonised IMD and JTWC intensities, ERA5 and ERSSTv5. The framework tests whether ENSO changes the basin total or redistributes energy between the sub-basins, separates its effect on formation from that on intensification, attributes each sub-basin's response to environmental terms along individual tracks, and tests stationarity and the record length needed to detect trends. In October-December, ENSO redistributes rather than changes the total: for a one-standard-deviation increase in Niño-3.4 (about 1 $^\circ$C), accumulated cyclone energy (ACE) is multiplied by 1.89 in the AS and by 0.63 in the BoB, while the NIO total shows no detectable change (factor 0.99 [0.74, 1.32]). ENSO acts on intensification, with no detectable effect on formation: the odds that a cyclonic storm becomes very severe rise about fourfold in the AS and halve in the BoB, through lower vertical wind shear (VWS) over the AS and weaker low-level vorticity over the BoB. The relationship has changed: El Niño lowered total NIO energy in 1982--2003, but in 2004-2025 AS gains balanced BoB losses (change p = 0.016). Very severe storms and rapid intensification increased in the AS only, and no 15-year window detects this increase, so about three decades of data are needed. The post-monsoon IOD signal can hardly be separated from ENSO, and August Niño-3.4 gives modest skill for the AS-BoB partition but none for the basin total.
comment: 32 pages, 13 figures (2 in the appendix), 8 tables
zh_title: ENSO驱动的1982—2025年阿拉伯海与孟加拉湾季风后热带气旋能量重新分配
translation: 北印度洋（NIO）的热带气旋在阿拉伯海（AS）和孟加拉湾（BoB）两个子海盆形成，通常被单独研究，其与厄尔尼诺-南方涛动（ENSO）的关系被视为平稳的。我们开发了一个联合跨海盆统计框架，将其应用于1982-2005年期间具有协调的IMD和JTWC强度、ERA5和ERSSTv5的416个质量控制IBTrACS最佳路径扰动。该框架测试了ENSO是改变海盆总量还是在子海盆之间重新分配能量，将其对生成的影响与对强化的影响分离开来，将每个子海盆对沿各个路径的环境项的响应归因，并测试了平稳性以及检测趋势所需的记录长度。在10-12月，ENSO起到重新分配而不是改变总量作用：对于Niño-3.4增加一个标准差（约1 °C），阿拉伯海的累积气旋能量（ACE）乘以1.89，孟加拉湾乘以0.63，而NIO总量显示没有可检测到的变化（因子0.99 [0.74, 1.32]）。ENSO对强化起作用，对生成没有可检测到的影响：气旋风暴变得非常严重的几率在阿拉伯海增加了约四倍，在孟加拉湾减半，这是通过阿拉伯海较低的垂直风切变（VWS）和孟加拉湾较弱的低层涡度实现的。这种关系已经改变：厄尔尼诺在1982-2003年降低了NIO的总能量，但在2004-2025年，阿拉伯海的增加平衡了孟加拉湾的损失（变化p = 0.016）。极强风暴和快速增强仅在阿拉伯海增加，并且没有15年的窗口可以检测到这种增加，因此大约需要三十年的数据。季风后的IOD信号几乎无法与ENSO区分开来，8月的Niño-3.4对AS-BoB分区提供了一定的技巧，但对海盆总量没有提供。
tldr: ENSO通过重新分配阿拉伯海和孟加拉湾之间的热带气旋能量（而非改变北印度洋总量）来影响季风后的气旋活动，且这种关系随时间发生了变化。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地建立了一个联合跨海盆统计框架，揭示了ENSO对北印度洋两个子海盆（阿拉伯海和孟加拉湾）热带气旋能量的重新分配作用，而非改变总量，并指出了这种关系在不同时期的非平稳性。对于理解气候变化背景下的热带气旋动力学具有重要意义。
motivation: 北印度洋两个子海盆（阿拉伯海和孟加拉湾）通常被单独研究，其与ENSO的关系被视为平稳的。本研究旨在建立一个联合统计框架，探究ENSO是否以及如何影响这两个海盆的总能量或在它们之间重新分配能量。
method: 开发了一个联合跨海盆统计框架，应用质量控制的IBTrACS最佳路径数据（1982-2025年）、ERA5和ERSSTv5再分析资料，分析了ENSO对气旋生成与强化的影响、环境因子路径以及关系的平稳性。
results: 10-12月期间，Niño-3.4指数每增加一个标准差，阿拉伯海的累积气旋能量（ACE）乘以1.89，孟加拉湾乘以0.63，而北印度洋总量无显著变化；ENSO主要通过影响气旋强度（而非生成频率）起作用；1982-2003年与2004-2025年之间，ENSO与北印度洋能量的关系发生了显著变化。
conclusion: 在1982-2025年期间，ENSO在季风后对北印度洋热带气旋能量进行重新分配（而非改变总量），使阿拉伯海能量增加，孟加拉湾能量减少，且这种ENSO遥相关关系随时间发生了显著变化。

title: Atheism and Cross-Country National Cognitive Skills: Evidence from a Beta Regression Analysis
authors: Tatiene C. Souza, Francisco Cribari-Neto
abstract: This study performs a beta regression analysis to investigate how country-level cognitive skills---measured using harmonized large-scale international educational assessments and expressed on an IQ-type scale---are associated with the prevalence of atheism in 131 countries. We find that this association is nonlinear: at low levels of cognitive skills, increases are associated with lower expected levels of atheism, whereas beyond a threshold, they are associated with higher expected atheism rates. This turning point is estimated to occur at approximately 65 on the IQ-type scale. The strength and location of the relationship vary across regions. We estimate elasticities of expected atheism rates with respect to cognitive skills for all countries in the sample and introduce the concept of the atheism gap to identify countries where observed prevalence is substantially higher or lower than predicted by their conditioning variables.
zh_title: 无神论与跨国国民认知技能：来自Beta回归分析的证据
translation: 本研究进行了一项Beta回归分析，以调查国家层面的认知技能（使用统一的大规模国际教育评估衡量，并以IQ型量表表示）与131个国家无神论流行度之间的关联。我们发现这种关联是非线性的：在低认知技能水平下，认知技能的提高与较低的无神论预期水平相关，而超过一个阈值，则与较高的无神论预期水平相关。这个转折点估计出现在IQ型量表的大约65分。这种关系的强度和位置因地区而异。我们估计了样本中所有国家预期无神论率对认知技能的弹性，并引入了无神论差距的概念，以识别观察到的流行度显著高于或低于其调节变量预测的国家。
tldr: 本研究使用Beta回归分析发现，国家层面的认知技能与无神论的流行度之间存在非线性关联：在低认知技能水平下，认知技能的提高与较低的无神论预期水平相关；超过一个阈值（IQ分数约65），认知技能的提高则与较高的无神论预期水平相关。
ai_comments: 这项研究通过引入非线性分析和“无神论差距”概念，为理解国家层面认知技能与无神论之间的复杂关系提供了新的视角和分析工具，超越了简单的线性关联假设。其创新性在于发现了转折点效应和对区域差异的强调。
motivation: 本研究旨在调查国家层面的认知技能（通过统一的大规模国际教育评估衡量，并以IQ分数表示）与131个国家无神论流行度之间的关联。
method: 本研究采用Beta回归分析来调查认知技能与无神论流行度之间的关联。认知技能通过统一的大规模国际教育评估衡量，并以IQ类型量表表示。研究还计算了预期无神论率对认知技能的弹性，并引入了“无神论差距”的概念。
results: 研究发现认知技能与无神论流行度之间的关联是非线性的：在低认知技能水平下，认知技能的提高与较低的无神论预期水平相关；而超过一个阈值，则与较高的无神论预期水平相关。该转折点估计出现在IQ类型量表的大约65分。这种关系的强度和位置因地区而异。研究还估计了样本中所有国家预期无神论率对认知技能的弹性，并引入了无神论差距概念以识别观察到的流行度显著高于或低于其调节变量预测的国家。
conclusion: 认知技能与无神论流行度之间存在非线性的复杂关系，且这种关系具有地区差异性，并且可以通过“无神论差距”概念来识别特定国家的无神论流行度异常情况。

title: A Quantile-Based Framework for Bimodal Distribution Construction
authors: Dreamlee Sharma, Nikita Rawat
abstract: This study suggests a novel quantile-based framework to construct bimodal distribution which does not rely on mixture representations or closed-form probability density functions. This proposed approach induces bimodality by transforming the quantile density through a strictly positive modulation function so that it can preserve the support and tail behavior of a chosen baseline distribution with providing explicit control over modal structure. The method is shown to apply broadly across bounded, semi-bounded and unbounded distribution families which include power, reflected power, logistic, Weibull and generalized lambda distributions. Simulation studies and a real-data application were performed which have shown that the proposed construction yields smooth, interpretable and computationally stable bimodal models and it also provides a flexible alternative to classical mixture-based approaches. Also this framework allows gradual transitions between unimodal and bimodal shapes which make it well suited for modeling overlapping regimes which are commonly encountered in real-world data. This proposed methodology therefor offers a robust and interpretable tool for bimodal modeling without requiring latent class assumptions or complex estimation procedures.
zh_title: 基于分位数的双峰分布构建框架
translation: 本研究提出了一种新颖的基于分位数的框架来构建双峰分布，该框架不依赖于混合表示或闭式概率密度函数。该方法通过严格正的调制函数变换分位数密度来诱导双峰性，从而在保持所选基线分布的支撑集和尾部行为的同时，提供对模态结构的显式控制。研究表明，该方法广泛适用于有界、半有界和无界分布族，包括幂律分布、反射幂律分布、逻辑分布、威布尔分布和广义拉姆达分布。模拟研究和真实数据应用表明，所提出的构建方法产生了平滑、可解释且计算稳定的双峰模型，并且为经典的基于混合的方法提供了灵活的替代方案。此外，该框架允许单峰和双峰形状之间的逐渐过渡，使其非常适合对现实世界数据中常见的重叠机制进行建模。因此，该方法为双峰建模提供了一种稳健且可解释的工具，无需潜类假设或复杂的估计程序。
tldr: 提出了一种基于分位数的双峰分布构建框架，无需混合模型即可灵活生成平滑、可解释的双峰模型。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的基于分位数的双峰分布构建框架，摆脱了传统混合模型和闭式概率密度函数的限制，具有计算稳定、可解释性强且适用范围广的特点，为复杂数据的建模提供了优秀的替代方案。
motivation: 传统的双峰分布构建通常依赖于混合表示或闭式概率密度函数，存在需要潜类假设或复杂估计程序等局限性，因此需要开发一种更具灵活性且无需这些复杂假设的通用框架。
method: 通过严格正的调制函数变换分位数密度来诱导双峰性，从而在保持基线分布支撑集和尾部行为的同时，显式控制模态结构。
results: 模拟研究和真实数据应用表明，该方法能够生成平滑、可解释且计算稳定的双峰模型，支持单峰与双峰之间的渐变，非常适合建模重叠机制。
conclusion: 提出的基于分位数的框架能够有效构建双峰分布，平滑控制模态结构，且无需潜类假设，在模拟和实际数据应用中均表现出良好的性能和灵活性。

title: When precision exceeds fidelity: systematic error quantification for inference with misspecified simulators
authors: M. J. Yantovski-Barth, Hengyue Zhang, Nolan Smyth, Aristeidis Amvrosiadis, Martin Bureau, Yashar Hezaveh, Laurence Perreault-Levasseur
abstract: As scientific datasets grow in complexity and precision, the primary source of uncertainty in parameter inference shifts from measurement noise to systematic errors within the simulators themselves. In this setting, Bayesian evidence concentrates on whichever misspecified model best approximates the data. Evidence-weighted model averaging can then underestimate systematic uncertainty when one model component compensates for the misspecification of another component. We posit that in this case, the key question is how each model responds to discrepancies between simulator and data. We show that the local response of an inferred parameter to perturbations in the data --- the model's influence map --- can be estimated efficiently from forward evaluations of the simulator at existing posterior samples. Propagating discrepancy residuals through these influence maps enables individual sources of systematic bias to be isolated. Applied to independent observations used to infer the mass of a supermassive black hole, we find that the error is dominated by model systematics. We identify a simplification shared by all models, propagate the discrepancies through each model's influence map, and apply a first-order correction of the resulting biases. This substantially improves the cross-observation consistency of the inferred black-hole mass within each model while preserving the between-model spread that represents remaining systematics.
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, accepted to Sim2Science: ML with Imperfect Scientific Models at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
zh_title: 当精度超越保真度：误设模拟器推理的系统误差量化
translation: 随着科学数据集复杂性和精度的增长，参数推断的不确定性主要来源从测量噪声转变为模拟器自身的系统误差。在这种情况下，贝叶斯证据会集中在最能近似数据的错误指定模型上。当一个模型组件补偿另一个组件的错误指定时，证据加权模型平均可能会低估系统不确定性。我们认为，在这种情况下，核心问题是每个模型如何响应模拟器与数据之间的差异。我们证明，推断参数对数据扰动的局部响应（即模型的影响图）可以通过现有后验样本的模拟器前向评估来高效估计。通过这些影响图传播差异残差，可以隔离各个系统误差源。将其应用于推断超大质量黑洞质量的独立观测数据，我们发现误差受模型系统误差的主导。我们确定了所有模型共享的一个简化假设，通过每个模型的影响图传播差异，并对产生的偏差应用一阶修正。这在保持代表剩余系统误差的模型间离散度的同时，显著改善了每个模型内部推断黑洞质量的跨观测一致性。
tldr: 提出了一种利用影响图量化和修正误设模拟器引起的系统偏差的新方法，有效解决了复杂科学数据推断中的系统不确定性问题。
ai_comments: 该论文针对错配模拟器（misspecified simulators）下的系统误差量化问题，提出了一种基于影响图（influence map）的高效修正方法，对处理复杂科学数据中的模型偏差具有重要意义。
motivation: 随着科学数据复杂性和精度的提高，参数推断的主要不确定性来源从测量噪声转变为模拟器本身的系统误差，而在标准贝叶斯框架下证据加权模型平均可能会低估这种系统不确定性。
method: 提出通过现有后验样本的模拟器前向评估来高效估计模型的影响力图（即推断参数对数据扰动的局部响应），并利用这些影响图传播差异残差以隔离各个系统偏差源，进而应用一阶偏差修正。
results: 应用于超大质量黑洞质量推断的独立观测数据时，发现误差由模型系统性主观控制；通过提出修正方法，显著提高了每个模型内推断黑洞质量的跨观测一致性，并保留了代表剩余系统性的模型间离散度。
conclusion: 通过利用影响图传播差异残差，可以在参数推断中有效量化和纠正由模拟器错配引起的系统偏差，同时保持不同模型之间的变异性以反映未知的系统误差。

title: APEX: Agentic Platform for Ensemble eXploration
authors: Xiaodong Luo
abstract:
Ensemble-based methods provide a practical framework for history matching, prediction, and optimization of subsurface models. In methodological studies, however, performance is rarely assessed from a single run. Comparisons typically span cases, configurations, and random seeds, while each evaluation may require an expensive external simulator. Keeping such studies computationally bounded, auditable, and reproducible therefore requires more than implementing a numerical method: experiments must be validated before execution, computational costs estimated, repeated runs organized consistently, and configurations and outputs made traceable. To address these needs, we developed APEX (Agentic Platform for Ensemble eXploration), an open-source Python platform that provides a common framework for configuring, validating, executing, recording, and comparing ensemble-based experiments.
  APEX is organized around three concepts: an experiment defines what is executed, a run records a single execution, and a study coordinates and compares multiple experiments or runs. Experiments are specified through validated configurations, which can also be generated by a planner agent. Before execution, APEX estimates the maximum number of forward simulations required. If the estimate exceeds a user-defined threshold, submission is held for approval. Each run records provenance information, while studies repeat problems across variants and paired replicates and compare results using paired statistical analyses. Scientific and computational components, including methods, simulators, metrics, and optimizers, are implemented as plugins. A command line interface, Python client, REST service with a web interface, and tools for language model agents access these capabilities through a common service layer.
zh_title: APEX：用于集成探索的智能体平台
translation:
基于集成的方法为地下模型的历史拟合、预测和优化提供了实用的框架。然而，在方法学研究中，很少仅凭单次运行来评估性能。比较通常跨越多个案例、配置和随机种子，而每次评估可能都需要昂贵的外部模拟器。因此，要保持此类研究在计算上受限、可审计且可复现，仅仅实现数值方法是不够的：必须在执行前验证实验，估计计算成本，一致地组织重复运行，并使配置和输出具有可追溯性。为了满足这些需求，我们开发了APEX（Agentic Platform for Ensemble eXploration），这是一个开源的Python平台，为配置、验证、执行、记录和比较基于集成的实验提供了一个通用框架。
APEX围绕三个概念组织：实验定义了执行的内容，运行记录了单次执行，研究则协调并比较多个实验或运行。实验通过经过验证的配置进行指定，这些配置也可以由规划器智能体生成。在执行前，APEX会估计所需的正向模拟的最大数量。如果估计值超过用户定义的阈值，则暂停提交以等待批准。每次运行都会记录来源信息，而研究则跨变体和配对重复项重复问题，并使用配对统计分析来比较结果。科学和计算组件（包括方法、模拟器、指标和优化器）均作为插件实现。命令行接口、Python客户端、带有Web界面的REST服务以及语言模型智能体工具通过公共服务层访问这些功能。
tldr: APEX是一个开源的智能体驱动平台，专为地下模型中计算密集且复杂的集成实验提供高效的管理、验证与复现支持。
ai_comments: APEX作为一个开源的智能体驱动平台，系统性地解决了地下模型集成探索中计算成本高、可复现性差和实验管理繁琐的痛点，通过插件化架构和智能体集成展现了良好的灵活性与实用性。
motivation: 集成方法在地下模型研究中应用广泛，但单次运行无法全面评估性能，跨案例、配置和随机种子的大规模评估涉及高昂计算成本，且缺乏计算有界、可审计和可复现的统一实验管理工具。
method: 开发了名为APEX的开源Python平台，采用实验、运行和研究三个核心概念，基于插件化架构实现方法、模拟器等组件，并通过通用服务层支持命令行、Python客户端及语言模型智能体等多种访问方式。
results: 构建了一个能够进行配置验证、计算成本预估、运行溯源记录、配对统计分析以及智能体辅助配置生成的开源平台，实现了集成实验的高效组织与比较。
conclusion: APEX为地下模型及其他领域的集成方法研究提供了一个计算有界、可审计且可复现的统一实验平台。

title: The Last Expectation: Sampling Measurement Outcomes in Value of Information Analysis
authors: Lea Friedli, Iason Papaioannou, Daniel Straub
abstract: In decision-making under uncertainty, additional information can improve decisions but is often costly to acquire. The Value of Information (VoI) quantifies the expected benefit of different information-gathering strategies. The main computational burden in VoI analysis arises from evaluating the expected utility of a strategy over possible outcomes. As each outcome entails solving a computationally expensive optimization problem under uncertainty to determine the optimal decision, efficient estimation of this expectation is crucial. This work focuses on sampling-based estimation and investigates three classical variance-reduction techniques, namely control variates, stratified sampling, and importance sampling, as well as combinations thereof. In particular, we establish a connection between two common VoI formulations through a control variate framework and show how this relationship can be exploited to obtain more efficient VoI estimators. The methodology is assessed using three test cases. The first is an analytical example with a known reference solution, the second involves a fatigue reliability and the third a slope stability application. Our results demonstrate that the relative performance of the sampling methods depends strongly on the problem characteristics. However, suitable combinations of variance-reduction techniques consistently improve efficiency and provide stable VoI estimates across a range of scenarios.
zh_title: 最后的期望：信息价值分析中的测量结果抽样
translation: 在不确定性下的决策中，额外的信息可以改善决策但获取成本往往很高。信息价值（VoI）量化了不同信息收集策略的预期收益。VoI分析中的主要计算负担来自于评估策略在可能结果上的期望效用。由于每个结果都需要解决计算成本高昂的不确定性优化问题以确定最优决策，因此高效估计该期望至关重要。本工作聚焦于基于抽样的估计，并研究了三种经典的方差缩减技术，即控制变量法、分层抽样法和重要性抽样法，以及它们的组合。特别是，我们通过控制变量框架建立了两个常见VoI公式之间的联系，并展示了如何利用这种关系获得更高效的VoI estimators。通过三个测试案例对该方法进行了评估。第一个是具有已知参考解的解析示例，第二个涉及疲劳可靠性，第三个涉及边坡稳定性应用。我们的结果表明，抽样方法的相对性能很大程度上取决于问题特征。然而，方差缩减技术的合适组合始终可以提高效率，并在各种场景下提供稳定的VoI估计。
tldr: 本文探讨了方差缩减技术在信息价值（VoI）分析抽样估计中的应用，显著提升了不确定性决策中VoI计算的效率和稳定性。
ai_comments: 该论文通过将方差缩减技术应用于信息价值（VoI）分析中的期望测量结果采样，显著提高了复杂不确定性决策问题的计算效率，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。
motivation: 在不确定性下的决策中，信息价值（VoI）分析的主要计算负担来自于对可能结果的策略期望效用评估，而每个结果都需要求解计算成本高昂的不确定性优化问题，因此迫切需要高效的抽样估计方法。
method: 研究并结合了三种经典方差缩减技术（控制变量法、分层抽样法和重要性抽样法及其组合），并通过控制变量框架建立了两种常见VoI公式之间的联系。
results: 测试结果表明，虽然抽样方法的相对性能很大程度上取决于问题特征，但方差缩减技术的合适组合始终可以提高效率，并在多种场景下提供稳定的VoI估计。
conclusion: 适当组合方差缩减技术可以显著提高VoI估计的计算效率，并在各种场景下提供稳定的估计结果。

title: Simple, general strategies for correcting the upward bias of calibration summaries of prediction models
authors: Mohsen Sadatsafavi, Ramin Rezaeianzadeh, Hessam Sadatsafavi
abstract: For clinical prediction models, calibration across the spectrum of predicted values is often assessed via flexible calibration curves and associated scalar summaries such as the integrated calibration index (ICI). However, these scalar summaries tend to have a finite-sample upward bias, as they are based on the absolute value of an estimate whose sampling distribution can cross zero. We show the mechanism underlying this bias and quantify its magnitude as a function of the true calibration error and its variance. This mechanism motivates easily implementable methods for reducing the bias (plug-in and inversion methods, each applied locally or globally) that are applicable to any smoothing method that generates an estimate and its sampling variance for each point on the calibration curve. These methods are general in that 1) they can be used for different outcome types (continuous, binary, time-to-event, as well as counterfactual outcomes for models that predict treatment benefit), and 2) the resulting bias-adjusted calibration error curves yield bias-corrected estimates of other metrics such as quantile-based ones (e.g., E50 and E90). Focusing on ICI as an exemplary metric, numerical and case studies demonstrate that the upward bias can be substantial, especially when the sample is small and the true ICI is close to zero. Results show that the Global Inversion method removed the most bias, particularly when the bias was substantial, although it could slightly increase the mean absolute error if the bias was small.

zh_title: 纠正预测模型校准摘要向上偏倚的简单通用策略
translation: 对于临床预测模型，跨预测值范围的校准通常通过灵活的校准曲线以及相关的标量汇总（如综合校准指数（ICI））来评估。然而，这些标量汇总往往具有有限样本向上偏倚，因为它们基于其抽样分布可以跨越零的估计值的绝对值。我们展示了该偏倚背后的机制，并将其大小量化为真实校准误差及其方差的函数。这一机制激发了易于实现的纠偏方法（插入法和反演法，分别局部分别或全局应用），这些方法适用于任何为校准曲线上的每个点生成估计值及其抽样方差的平滑方法。这些方法具有通用性：1）它们可用于不同的结果类型（连续、二元、生存时间，以及预测治疗获益模型的反事实结果），2）由此产生的偏倚调整校准误差曲线可产生诸如基于分位数的指标（例如E50和E90）的偏倚校正估计值。以ICI作为典型指标，数值和案例研究表明，向上偏倚可能是巨大的，特别是当样本较小且真实ICI接近零时。结果表明，全局反演法消除了最多的偏倚，特别是当偏倚显著时，尽管如果偏倚较小，它可能会略微增加平均绝对误差。
tldr: 提出了一种简单通用的纠偏策略，能有效解决临床预测模型中校准度标量汇总（如综合校准指数ICI）的有限样本向上偏倚问题。
ai_comments: 该论文针对临床预测模型中校准度标量汇总（如综合校准指数ICI）存在的有限样本向上偏倚问题，提出了简单且通用的纠偏策略（插入法和反演法）。这些方法具有高度的通用性，适用于多种结果类型和平滑方法，并通过数值和案例研究验证了全局反演法在去除显著偏倚方面的有效性。创新点在于揭示了偏倚机制并提供了易于实现的通用纠偏方案。
motivation: 临床预测模型的校准度标量汇总（如综合校准指数ICI）由于基于其抽样分布可跨越零的估计值的绝对值，往往存在有限样本向上偏倚，因此需要简单且通用的策略来纠正这种偏倚。
method: 研究展示了偏倚机制并将其大小量化为真实校准误差及其方差的函数，在此基础上提出了易于实现的纠偏方法（局部或全局的插入法和反演法），适用于任何可生成估计值及其抽样方差的平滑方法。
results: 数值和案例研究表明，向上偏倚可能相当大，特别是在样本较小且真实ICI接近零时；其中全局反演法在去除偏倚方面效果最好，尤其是在偏倚显著时。
conclusion: 该研究提出的全局反演等校准摘要纠偏策略能有效减少有限样本带来的向上偏倚，提升临床预测模型性能评估的准确性。

title: The Look-Elsewhere Effect in Searches for New Physics: from Classical Methods to Machine Learning
authors: Gaia Grosso, Sergio Rodriguez-Benitez, Louis Lyons
abstract: The look-elsewhere effect (LEE) arises when the location of an effect in parameter space is not specified in advance: scanning many locations inflates the significance of the largest excess, and the local $p$-value must be corrected into a global one. A well-established framework, rooted in the work of Davies and operationalised for particle physics by Gross and Vitells, provides this correction for scans over continuous parameters. Some aspects, however, remain unsettled. The definition of "elsewhere" is ambiguous and ranges from a single distribution to an entire experimental programme. Moreover, the analytical shortcuts of the classical framework do not carry over to searches based on machine learning (ML), which are affected by an implicit post-selection bias that depends on the model's resolution and expressiveness. This review covers the LEE in searches for new physics at colliders, from its statistical foundations to these modern challenges. We discuss the corrections for continuous scans and for multiple discrete tests, illustrated with simple numerical examples, and the interaction between ML and the LEE, which we connect to the broader literature on selective inference. We highlight open problems, including the computational cost of empirical calibration for complex models and the development of analytical shortcuts for ML test statistics, and offer recommendations for reporting discovery significance in both classical and ML-based searches in particle physics.
zh_title: 寻找新物理中的视而不见效应：从经典方法到机器学习
translation: 视而不见效应（LEE）出现在效应在参数空间中的位置未提前指定的情况：扫描多个位置会夸大最大超额的显著性，因此必须将局部 $p$ 值修正为全局 $p$ 值。一个扎根于 Davies 工作并在粒子物理中由 Gross 和 Vitells 实现的成熟框架，为连续参数扫描提供了这种修正。然而，某些方面仍未解决。“其他地方”（elsewhere）的定义含糊不清，从单一分布到整个实验计划不等。此外，经典框架的解析捷径无法延续到基于机器学习（ML）的搜索中，后者受制于依赖于模型分辨率和表达能力的隐式后选择偏差。这篇综述涵盖了对撞机新物理搜索中的 LEE，从其统计基础到这些现代挑战。我们讨论了连续扫描和多个离散测试的修正，并通过简单的数值例子进行了说明，同时探讨了机器学习与 LEE 之间的相互作用，将其与关于选择性推断的更广泛文献联系起来。我们强调了开放性问题，包括复杂模型经验校准的计算成本以及为 ML 检验统计量开发解析捷径，并对粒子物理学中经典搜索和基于 ML 搜索的发现显著性报告提出了建议。
tldr: 本文综述了粒子物理学中从经典方法到机器学习的“视而不见效应”（LEE）的统计校正、挑战及未来建议。
ai_comments: 该综述聚焦于粒子物理学中寻找新物理时普遍存在的“视而不见效应”（LEE），不仅梳理了从戴维斯、格罗斯和维特尔斯等人的经典统计方法，还深入探讨了其在现代机器学习搜索方法中所面临的新挑战（如隐式后选择偏差），连接了选择性推断领域的文献，对未来的研究方向和报告标准提出了重要建议。
motivation: 在寻找新物理时，由于参数空间位置预先未设定，扫描多个位置会夸大最大超额的显著性（即视而不见效应LEE）。虽然经典的统计校正框架已存在，但其在机器学习搜索中的应用仍不成熟且面临隐式后选择偏差，因此需要对从经典方法到机器学习的LEE进行全面综述和探讨。
method: 本论文是一篇综述，探讨了连续扫描的统计校正、多重离散测试、机器学习与LEE的相互作用，并通过数值例子说明，结合了选择性推断的文献来分析模型分辨率和表达能力带来的后选择偏差。
results: 本文系统总结了连续扫描和多重离散测试的校正方法，阐明了机器学习与LEE的相互作用及选择性推断的联系，指出了复杂模型经验校准计算成本高、机器学习检验统计量缺乏解析捷径等开放性问题，并给出了报告发现显著性的建议。
conclusion: 本文综述了寻找新物理过程中的LEE效应，涵盖了从经典连续参数扫描到现代机器学习方法中的统计校正挑战，为粒子物理学界的显著性报告提供了基础理论与实践指导。

title: Functional nestedness of soil nematode communities across Europe: integrating morphological counts and eDNA reads
authors: Giuseppe Nicolosi, Michael Bonkowski, Carlo Febbi, Christian Mulder
abstract: 1. Soil nematodes occupy multiple trophic positions and contribute to key processes in soil food webs. Their communities vary across land uses and environmental conditions, yet it remains unclear whether these differences mainly reflect taxon replacement or nested patterns of taxon occurrence. 2. Here, we analysed two independent European datasets of soil nematode communities, SOB4ES, based on eDNA metabarcoding, and NemEu, based on morphological identification, to examine how genus composition varies across land uses. We partitioned community dissimilarity into turnover and nestedness-resultant components and compared sites under contrasting land uses with those sharing the same land use, while accounting for geographical and soil-related variation. We also assessed matrix-level nestedness, differences among trophic groups and associations between genus composition and environmental gradients. 3. In both datasets, genus turnover was consistently greater between contrasting land uses than within the same land use. Although the differences were modest, they remained significant after accounting for geographical distance and genus richness, whereas nestedness-resultant dissimilarity contributed little to land-use differentiation. These findings suggest that land-use-associated differences in European nematode communities are expressed primarily through changes in genus identity rather than nested patterns of taxon occurrence. 4. The consistency of this result across independently assembled datasets supports the broader relevance of taxonomic turnover for understanding soil biodiversity patterns across European land uses.

zh_title: 欧洲土壤线虫群落的功能嵌套性：整合形态学计数与eDNA测序数据
translation:
1. 土壤线虫占据多个营养级，对土壤食物网的关键过程做出贡献。它们的群落随土地利用和环境条件而变化，然而目前尚不清楚这些差异主要反映的是分类群替代还是嵌套的分类群出现模式。
2. 在这里，我们分析了两个独立的欧洲土壤线虫群落数据集：基于eDNA元条形码的SOB4ES数据集和基于形态学鉴定的NemEu数据集，以研究属组成如何随土地利用而变化。我们将群落相异性划分为周转和嵌套结果分量，在控制地理和土壤相关变异的同时，比较了不同土地利用类型下的样点与共享相同土地利用的样点。我们还评估了矩阵级嵌套性、营养群落间的差异以及属组成与环境梯度的关联。
3. 在这两个数据集中，不同土地利用之间的属周转始终大于相同土地利用内部的属周转。尽管差异不大，但在考虑了地理距离和属丰富度后，它们仍然显著，而嵌套结果相异性对土地利用分化的贡献很小。这些发现表明，欧洲线虫群落与土地利用相关的差异主要通过属身份的变化来表达，而不是通过分类群出现的嵌套模式。
4. 这一结果在独立组装的数据集中的一致性，支持了分类群周转对于理解欧洲土地利用下土壤生物多样性格局的广泛相关性。
tldr: 本研究通过分析欧洲两个土壤线虫数据集（eDNA和形态学），发现土地利用对土壤线虫群落的影响主要表现为物种周转（turnover）而非嵌套模式（nestedness）。
ai_comments: 该论文结合了传统的形态学计数与eDNA高通量测序两种独立的欧洲土壤线虫数据集，创新性地探讨了土地利用对土壤线虫群落功能嵌套性及物种周转的影响。结论对于理解欧洲土壤生物多样性格局具有重要意义，但由于嵌套性贡献较小，未来可进一步探讨其在微观功能层面的具体机制。
motivation: 土壤线虫在土壤食物网中发挥关键作用，其群落随土地利用和环境条件而变化，然而目前尚不清楚这些差异主要反映的是物种替代（taxon turnover）还是嵌套的物种出现模式（nested patterns）。
method: 分析了两个独立的欧洲土壤线虫群落数据集（基于eDNA元条形码的SOB4ES数据集和基于形态学鉴定的NemEu数据集）。将群落相异性划分为周转（turnover）和嵌套结果（nestedness-resultant）两个分量，在控制地理和土壤相关变异的同时，对比了不同土地利用类型之间与同种土地利用类型内部的属组成差异，并评估了矩阵级嵌套性、不同营养群落的差异以及属组成与环境梯度的关联。
results: 在两个数据集中，相较于相同土地利用类型内部，不同土地利用类型之间的属周转（genus turnover）始终更大。即使在控制了地理距离和丰富度之后，这种差异依然显著，而嵌套结果相异性对土地利用分化的贡献很小。不同营养群落和环境梯度也表现出一致的模式。
conclusion: 欧洲土地利用相关的线虫群落差异主要通过属水平的物种周转（taxon turnover）而非嵌套模式（nestedness）体现。这一发现在基于形态学和eDNA的两个独立数据集中均得到证实，突显了物种周转在理解土壤生物多样性空间格局中的核心作用。

title: Modeling time series of high-resolution spectra using the asymmetric Hilbert-Schmidt decomposition with application to radial velocity exoplanet searches
authors: Kevin Tao, Thomas Loredo, David Ruppert
abstract: We describe a framework for building low-rank separable expansions to model spectroscopic data from systems with time-varying spectra, in settings where the spectral dimension is finely sampled (in wavelength), but the temporal dimension is sparsely and possibly irregulary sampled. The motivating application is detection and characterization of small exoplanets, e.g., Earth-like planets around Sun-like stars. Such planets cannot be seen directly, but can be detected via the minute Doppler shifts of the host star spectrum due to the star's motion as the planet and star revolve around their mutual center of mass. Current instruments are reaching the precision necessary to detect the ~10 cm/s motions corresponding to an exo-Earth. But the small Doppler shifts from such low-amplitude orbital motion can be masked or mimicked by the effects of stellar activity on the surface of the host star. e.g., starspots (dark regions), faculae (bright filaments), etc. One technique astronomers have used to try to model the stellar activity component of the signal is PCA, applied to an ensemble of spectra collected over time. But PCA neglects the continuous function nature of a spectrum at a given time, and the continuous evolution of spectra over time. We address model building from a function approximation perspective, via the asymmetric Hilbert-Schmidt decomposition (HSD). This provides a PCA-like low-rank decomposition of a dynamic spectrum, but it explicitly accounts for time dependence, both estimating temporal basis functions, and accounting for irregular temporal sampling when estimating spectral basis functions. We show that HSD improves the fidelity of a fixed-order model of the dynamic spectrum of a Sun-like star with a starspot, with mean squared error for spectral basis functions many times smaller than achieved via PCA when spectra are randomly sampled sparsely and irregularly in time.
zh_title: 利用非对称希尔伯特-施密特分解的高分辨率光谱时间序列建模及其在视向速度系外行星搜索中的应用
translation: 我们描述了一个用于构建低秩可分离展开式的框架，以对具有时变光谱的系统中的光谱数据进行建模，适用于光谱维度采样精细（按波长），但时间维度稀疏且可能不规则采样的场景。 motivating的应用是小型系外行星的检测和表征，例如类太阳恒星周围的类地行星。此类行星无法直接看到，但可以通过行星和恒星绕其共同质心公转时恒星运动引起的微小多普勒频移来检测。当前仪器正在达到检测与类地行星相对应的~10厘米/秒运动所需的精度。但是，来自这种低振幅轨道运动的小多普勒频移可能会被宿主恒星表面的恒星活动效应（例如黑子、光斑等）所掩盖或模仿。天文学家用来模拟信号中恒星活动成分的一种技术是PCA，将其应用于随时间收集的光谱集合。但是PCA忽略了特定时间的谱的连续函数性质以及谱随时间的连续演化。我们从函数逼近的角度通过不对称希尔伯特-施密特分解（HSD）来解决模型构建问题。这提供了动态光谱的类PCA低秩分解，但它明确考虑了时间依赖性，既估计了时间基函数，又在估计光谱基函数时考虑了不规则的时间采样。我们表明，当光谱在时间上被随机稀疏且不规则采样时，HSD提高了具有黑子的类太阳恒星动态光谱的固定阶模型的保真度，光谱基函数的均方误差比PCA小很多倍。
keywords: 非对称希尔伯特-施密特分解
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于非对称希尔伯特-施密特分解（HSD）的光谱时间序列建模方法，有效克服了稀疏不规则采样下的恒星活动干扰，提升了系外行星的探测精度。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种基于非对称希尔伯特-施密特分解（HSD）的动态光谱低秩建模框架，有效解决了天文观测中时间维度稀疏且不规则采样的问题，对提高系外行星视向速度搜索的准确性具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的主成分分析（PCA）方法在处理高分辨率时间序列光谱时，忽略了光谱在特定时间的连续函数特性以及随时间的连续演化，无法很好地应对稀疏和不规则的时间采样，因此需要更优的模型来消除恒星活动对探测类地行星微弱多普勒频移的干扰。
method: 采用从函数逼近视角出发的非对称希尔伯特-施密特分解（HSD），构建低秩可分离展开式，以估计时间基函数并在估计谱基函数时处理不规则时间采样。
results: 研究表明，在恒星光谱进行随机、稀疏且不规则时间采样的情况下，HSD能够显著提升太阳活动模型的保真度，其谱基函数的均方误差远小于PCA方法。
conclusion: 与传统PCA相比，HSD在处理随机、稀疏且不规则采样的时间序列光谱时，能显著提高固定阶数动态光谱模型的保真度，并将谱基函数的均方误差降低数倍。

title: Large deviations for integrated exponentials of Gaussian Volterra processes - application to variance options
authors: Antoine Jacquier, Mugad Oumgari, Dan Pirjol, Lingjiong Zhu
abstract: We prove small-time large deviations for the normalised time integral of the exponential of a Gaussian Volterra process, and complement it with a central limit theorem and moderate deviations. As an application, we obtain short-maturity asymptotics for out-of-the-money and at-the-money variance options in rough volatility models, as well as implied volatility expansions which we validate numerically.
zh_title: 高斯伏尔泰进程积分指数的大偏差：在方差期权中的应用
translation: 我们证明了高斯伏尔泰进程指数的规范化时间积分的小时间大偏差，并辅之以中心极限定理和中偏差。作为一项应用，我们获得了粗糙波动率模型中出值和平值方差期权的短期渐近性，以及经过数值验证的隐含波动率展开。
tldr: 本文推导了高斯伏尔泰进程指数积分的大偏差、中心极限定理与中偏差，并解决了粗糙波动率模型中方差期权的短期渐近性问题。
ai_comments: 该论文深入研究了高斯伏尔泰进程指数积分的小时间大偏差，并成功将其应用到粗糙波动率模型的方差期权短期渐近性分析中，具有很高的理论价值和实际金融应用意义。
motivation: 为了解决粗糙波动率模型中方差期权短期渐近性及隐含波动率展开的计算和理论问题，深入理解高斯伏尔泰进程指数积分的渐近行为。
method: 利用大偏差理论、中心极限定理以及中偏差分析方法，推导高斯伏尔泰进程指数积分的渐近性质，并将其应用于期权定价模型。
results: 得到了高斯伏尔泰进程指数积分规范化时间积分的小时间大偏差、中心极限定理和中偏差，并进一步获得了粗糙波动率模型中实值和平值方差期权的短期渐近性及隐含波动率展开，并经数值验证。
conclusion: 本文证明了高斯伏尔泰进程指数积分的小时间大偏差、中心极限定理及中偏差，并将其成功应用于粗糙波动率模型中方差期权的短期渐近性分析。

title: Retirement Planning with Borrowing Constraints and Income Support
authors: Tae Ung Gang, Seyoung Park, Yong Hyun Shin
abstract: We study how pension income, its pledgeability, and government support that supplements effective consumption shape an irreversible retirement decision. In a continuous-time life-cycle model, a worker chooses consumption, risky investment, and the timing of retirement, subject to a tighter borrowing limit after retirement. When retirement reduces the utility value of a given level of effective consumption, immediate retirement can be optimal on a bounded wealth interval: a worker below the interval retires when wealth rises to its lower boundary, while a worker above it retires when wealth falls to its upper boundary. Two scalar boundary equations characterize these distinct entry points. Risky investment drops discretely upon retirement at either interior boundary, even when it rises with wealth along the low-wealth working branch. In our two-boundary baseline, greater income support lowers the lower retirement threshold and raises the upper one, whereas greater pension pledgeability shifts both thresholds downward. Finally, because the residuals of the boundary equations represent weighted tail integrals of the instantaneous gain from postponing retirement, we completely characterize the optimal retirement region across all levels of post-retirement quality of life.
zh_title: 带有借贷约束与收入支持的退休规划
translation: 我们研究了养老金收入、其可质押性以及补充有效消费的政府支持如何塑造不可逆的退休决策。在一个连续时间生命周期模型中，工人在退休后面临更严格的借贷限制，选择消费、风险投资和退休时机。当退休降低了给定有效消费水平的效用时，即时退休在有界的财富区间内可能是最优的：财富低于该区间的工人在财富上升到下边界时退休，而财富高于该区间的工人在财富下降到上边界时退休。两个标量边界方程刻画了这些不同的进入点。无论风险投资在低财富工作分支中如何随财富增长，它在任一内部边界退休时都会离散下降。在我们的双边界基准模型中，更大的收入支持会降低下退休阈值并提高上退休阈值，而更大的养老金可质押性则会将两个阈值都向下移动。最后，由于边界方程的残差代表了推迟退休瞬时收益的加权尾部积分，我们完全刻画了在所有退休后生活质量水平下的最优退休区域。
keywords: 连续时间生命周期模型
tldr: 本文利用连续时间生命周期模型研究了借贷约束、养老金及政府支持如何影响工人的不可逆退休决策和风险投资。
ai_comments: 该论文采用连续时间生命周期模型，深入探讨了养老金、借贷约束及政府收入支持对不可逆退休决策的影响，理论分析严谨，通过两个边界方程完整刻画了最优退休区域。
motivation: 研究养老金收入、其可质押性以及旨在补充有效消费的政府支持，是如何共同塑造不可逆退休决策的。
method: 构建了一个连续时间生命周期模型，其中工人在面对退休后更紧的借贷限制时，自主选择消费、风险投资以及退休时机，并利用两个标量边界方程来表征不同的退休进入点。
results: 当退休降低给定有效消费水平的效用时，即时退休在有界财富区间内可能成为最优选择（财富低于区间下限时财富上升触发退休，财富高于区间上限时财富下降触发退休）；更大的收入支持降低了低退休阈值并提高了高退休阈值，而更大的养老金可质押性则将两个阈值同时向下移动。
conclusion: 论文通过连续时间模型和边界方程分析，揭示了养老金可质押性、政府收入支持及借贷约束如何精细化地塑造劳动者的最优退休决策与风险投资行为。

title: Time-consistency of cash-subadditive risk measures: The infimal cocycle property
authors: Matteo Ferrari, Roger J. A. Laeven, Emanuela Rosazza Gianin, Marco Zullino
abstract: We characterize the time-consistency of convex, cash-subadditive dynamic risk measures in terms of their minimal penalty. The dual variables are conditional sub-probability densities, which factorize across an intermediate date in many ways, according to how the discount is allocated to the two periods. We introduce an infimal cocycle property, in which the penalty is the infimum over all such factorizations, and show that it is equivalent to time-consistency, with the infimum attained. This holds on $L^\infty$ under continuity from below, and on $L^p$, $p<\infty$, without continuity assumptions. In the cash-additive case it reduces to the classical cocycle property. For risk measures induced by BSDEs, it represents the dynamic programming principle of a stochastic control problem whose value is the penalty.
zh_title: 现金次可加风险度量的时间一致性：下确界上循环性质
translation: 我们通过最小罚函数刻画了凸的、现金次可加的动态风险度量的时间一致性。对偶变量是条件次概率密度，它们根据折扣分配到两个时期的方式，以多种方式在中间日期因子分解。我们引入了一个下确界上循环性质，其中罚函数是所有此类因子分解的下确界，并证明它等价于时间一致性，且下确界可以达到。这在满足自下连续性的 $L^\infty$ 空间上以及在没有连续性假设的 $L^p$ ($p<\infty$) 空间上均成立。在现金可加的情形下，它简化为了经典的上循环性质。对于由BSDE诱导的风险度量，它代表了一个随机控制问题的动态规划原理，其最优值即为罚函数。
tldr: 本文证明了下确界上循环性质是现金次可加动态风险度量具备时间一致性的充要条件。
ai_comments: 本文将经典的凸风险度量的时间一致性刻画从现金可加性推广到了现金次可加性，并引入了下确界上循环性质（infimal cocycle property），理论推导严谨且与倒向随机微分方程（BSDEs）及随机控制理论建立了深刻联系。
motivation: 研究现金次可加动态风险度量的时间一致性，并将其惩罚函数（minimal penalty）与经典的 cocycle property 在更广泛的框架下进行推广。
method: 利用对偶变量（条件次概率密度）及其跨越中间日期的因子分解，引入下确界上循环性质，并在 $L^\infty$ 和 $L^p$ 空间下进行数学刻画与证明。
results: 证明了下确界上循环性质等价于时间一致性且下确界可达；在现金可加情形下退化为经典上循环性质；对于由BSDEs诱导的风险度量，它代表了相应随机控制问题的动态规划原理。
conclusion: 下确界上循环性质是凸现金次可加动态风险度量具备时间一致性的充要条件。

title: Beyond Marginal Risk: ESG and Multidimensional Fragility in Equity Markets
authors: Minxuan Hu, Jiayu Yi, Ziheng Chen, Wenxi Sun, Qishi Zhan
abstract: Do ESG characteristics provide financial resilience beyond conventional risk, and is that inference stable to the financial state and ESG score being measured? We study a point-in-time panel of nonfinancial S&P 500 constituents from January 2019 through November 2025. Once ex ante return, volatility, and liquidity exposures are modeled explicitly, the broad downside-resilience pattern attenuates and none of the three primary marginal ESG $\times$ Down tests survives Holm adjustment under either conventional or wild-cluster-bootstrap inference. A post-primary exact decomposition then shows that the negative Return+RVOL coefficient is almost entirely allocated to observations that also breach the CHL trading-cost tail, while the mutually exclusive Return+RVOL-only component is essentially zero. Finally, a paired standardized comparison on an identical sample shows that MSCI's downstream Industry Adjusted Score and upstream Weighted Average Key Issue Score imply materially different fitted associations in adverse market states: at a 5% market decline, the difference is about one probability percentage point per score standard deviation. Sector-time, leave- one-month-out, and observed-change timing diagnostics preserve most of this contrast, although the result remains exploratory and inference is sensitive to multiplicity and market-state support. The evidence therefore favors a narrower interpretation of ESG resilience: the apparent association weakens once conventional risk is modeled, while the remaining relation depends on both the adverse state and the MSCI score field used to represent ESG.
comment: Withdrawn due to an accidental duplicate submission. This paper (arXiv:2611.20589) was unintentionally submitted as a new entry instead of a new version of our previous work (arXiv:2606.05631)
zh_title: 超越边际风险：权益市场中的ESG与多维脆弱性
translation: ESG特征是否能在常规风险之外提供财务韧性，并且这种推断在所测量的金融状态和ESG评分下是否稳定？我们研究了2019年1月至2025年11月非金融类标普500成份股的点对点面板数据。一旦显式建模了事前收益率、波动率和流动性暴露，广泛的下行韧性模式就会减弱，并且在常规推断或野生聚类自举推断下，三个主要的边际ESG×下行测试均无法在Holm调整后存活。随后的精确分解表明，负向的收益+已实现波动率系数几乎完全归因于同时也突破了CHL交易成本尾部的观测值，而互斥的“仅收益+已实现波动率”成分基本为零。最后，在相同样本上的配对标准化比较表明，MSCI下游的行业调整评分与上游的加权平均关键议题评分在不利市场状态下暗示了截然不同的拟合关联：在市场下跌5%时，每标准差评分的差异大约为一个概率百分点。行业-时间、留一月交叉验证以及观测变化时序诊断保留了大部分这种对比，尽管结果仍具探索性且推断对多重性和市场状态支持敏感。因此，证据倾向于对ESG韧性进行更狭义的解释：一旦对常规风险进行建模，表面的关联性就会减弱，而剩余的关系则取决于不利状态和用于代表ESG的MSCI评分字段。
tldr: 控制传统风险后，ESG的抗跌韧性显著减弱，且其表现高度依赖于不利市场状态及所选择的ESG评分指标。
ai_comments: 该论文通过严谨的计量经济学检验（如Holm校正、wild-cluster-bootstrap、精确分解等），探讨了ESG特征是否能提供超越传统风险的金融韧性。研究表明，控制传统风险后，ESG的抗跌韧性大打折扣，且其表现高度依赖于不利市场状态及所采用的ESG评分指标。这为理性看待ESG投资提供了重要的警示。
motivation: 探究ESG特征是否能提供超越传统风险的金融韧性，以及这种推论在不同的金融状态和所测量的ESG评分下是否具有稳定性。
method: 研究采用2019年1月至2025年11月非金融类S&P 500成份股的点对点面板数据，显式建模事前收益率、波动率和流动性暴露，并运用Holm调整、wild-cluster-bootstrap推断、精确分解以及配对标准化比较等方法进行检验。
results: 在显式建模传统风险后，广泛的下行韧性模式减弱，没有一个主要的边际ESG×下行测试在控制多重假设检验（Holm校正）后存活；同时，MSCI的行业调整评分和加权平均关键议题评分在不利市场状态下表现出实质性的差异。
conclusion: 控制传统风险后，ESG的抗跌韧性明显减弱，且剩余的关联性高度依赖于具体的不利市场状态以及所使用的MSCI评分字段。

title: Actionwave: A Systematic Benchmark for Waveform-Centric Clinical Prediction Across Care Scenarios
authors: Jie Peng, Davis Hobley, Song Wang, Zachary PlotkinB, Tianlong Chen
abstract: Continuous bedside waveforms record rapid physiological changes that can inform clinical decisions. Existing benchmarks examine selected prediction conditions, but it remains unclear how model advantages depend on signal duration, warning time, and available inputs across care settings. We introduce Actionwave, a benchmark for waveform-centric clinical prediction across intensive-care, operating-room, and emergency-department settings. Actionwave uses a common decision-time prediction interface and groups clinically grounded tasks by what is inferred and when. It varies conditions relevant to clinical use, including the warning required before an intervention. We compare diverse architectures and pretrained biosignal encoders under specified model-size and compute budgets. The protocol requires patient-level splits, strict information cutoffs, and comparisons that isolate individual modeling factors. Across 20 tasks and 1.4M task-labelled windows from source datasets, the experimental grids account for over 87,000 model fits. These comparisons identify task-specific choices and show why matched cohorts, unimodal controls, and explicit timing are necessary when interpreting waveform model performance.

title: Local subspace encoding for spectral prediction: from TabPFN to operator-adaptive calibration
authors: Gregory Beurier, Robin Reiter, Denis Cornet, Lauriane Rouan
abstract: TabPFN has already shown useful predictive performance on near-infrared spectra. RamanPFN subsequently proposed two spectral representations for tabular inference: Global Compositional Unmixing (GCU) and Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding (LVSE). We assess whether these representations also help on datasets assembled through the nirs4all ecosystem, and whether their value extends to classical calibration. We reanalyse completed experiments from a public spectral dataset catalogue. On a post-hoc subset of 61 matched numerical prediction tasks, after excluding ten class-code, metadata or semantically ambiguous targets, LVSE reduces RMSE relative to raw-spectrum TabPFN by 10.22%, 12.80% and 14.52% on average for checkpoints 2.5, 3 and 3.5, respectively, with median reductions of 4.99%, 4.74% and 7.82%. Across 76 classification datasets, weighted F1 increases by 2.22, 2.56 and 3.81 percentage points. The 2.5 classification procedure uses output coding on 15 datasets exceeding the checkpoint's native class limit. GCU alone is less reliable in this implementation. LVSE also improves PLS and Ridge in many cases, with median RMSE reductions of 4.75% and 1.89%. Adding LVSE candidates to an operator-adaptive model is feasible, but a separate 35-task panel derived from the public AOM benchmark shows only small median gains. These results motivate evaluating LVSE alongside existing representation choices. They do not establish that a selector choosing between raw and LVSE inputs will improve every task.
comment: 25 pages, 10 figures (including 3 supplementary figures). Evidence bundle: https://github.com/GBeurier/nirs4all-aom/releases/tag/lvse-gcu-evidence-v1

title: Validation Bias in Large Language Model Responses to Cancer Treatment Queries: A Factorial Cross-Sectional Study
authors: Ramez Kouzy, Saketh Vinjamuri, Sarah Ghalayini, Jack Gallifant, Shan Chen, Marielle Fis Loperana, Roxanna Attar-Olyaee, Danielle S. Bitterman
abstract: Large language model (LLM) chatbots are increasingly used by patients seeking cancer information, but their safety when users present evidence-misaligned beliefs about treatment remains uncharacterized. We hypothesized that LLMs exhibit validation bias, affirming rather than correcting such beliefs, and evaluated this with a 2x2x2 factorial design crossing conversation format (single-turn vs multi-turn), treatment type (evidence-based vs alternative), and query valence (positive vs negative). Framing was evidence-aligned (supporting evidence-based treatments or questioning alternative therapies) or evidence-misaligned (promoting alternative treatments or questioning evidence-based therapies). We analyzed 1,272 conversations (6,360 interactions) across 14 LLMs from 6 vendors, scored by an LLM judge (GPT-5-mini) validated against human annotation on a 6-dimension safety rubric. The primary outcome was the unsafe response rate, defined as a Weak classification or any critical failure. Evidence-misaligned framing increased unsafe response rates compared with evidence-aligned framing (14.4% vs 5.1%; OR 3.14, 95% CI 2.07-4.78; P < .001), and the association persisted after accounting for clustering by LLM. Among 429 conversations classified as Strong under evidence-aligned framing, 22.6% were downgraded in their paired evidence-misaligned counterpart. Multi-turn conversations had lower unsafe response rates than single-turn conversations (5.2% vs 14.7%; P < .001). Unsafe response rates varied by vendor from 1.8% to 36.8%. LLMs exhibited significant validation bias in oncology, with unsafe responses nearly tripling under evidence-misaligned framing. Evaluations limited to neutral, fact-seeking queries may overestimate real-world safety, and safety testing of medical AI systems should include evidence-misaligned user framing.

title: Instantiation of Human Values in Image Generation
authors: Maria-Teresa De Rosa Palmini, Piera Riccio, Noa Garcia, Eva Cetinic
abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models are increasingly embedded in everyday visual culture, yet little is known about how they translate abstract human values into visual scenes. We address this gap by introducing a framework, grounded in Schwartz's theory of basic human values, for studying value instantiation: the process by which ideals such as success, care, or freedom are visually realized. Using person-centered prompts from 70 positive and negative value items, we generate 28,000 images across four state-of-the-art T2I models. We identify visual prototypes, recurring combinations of subjects, actions, and settings, and use them to quantify how narrowly models instantiate these values and how this breadth compares with human descriptions of the same items. We then map these prototypes onto a taxonomy of social configurations spanning setting, sociality, mode of engagement, and social register, revealing what is systematically foregrounded or omitted. Our results show that T2I models produce far more concentrated representations than humans do when describing the same values. They default to a hyper-individualistic, adult-centric worldview, reproducing value-specific associations, such as achievement tied to formal institutional settings or hedonism rendered as affluent consumption, while marginalizing everyday labor, relational care, and non-adult perspectives. As a proof of concept, we show that these structural gaps can guide a steering method that diversifies outputs without modifying the original prompt.

title: DAGGER: Deployment-Free Quality Estimation for Generative AI Workflows
authors: Dimitrios Liakopoulos, Neeraja J. Yadwadkar
abstract: Estimating the quality of generative AI workflows is challenging because these workflows comprise multiple stages, and errors can propagate across them, making end-to-end performance depend not only on the accuracy of individual models but also on how their outputs affect downstream stages. Each stage can use one of many candidate models. Estimating end-to-end workflow quality by deploying and evaluating every resulting model configuration is therefore prohibitively expensive. As a result, existing approaches face a tradeoff between estimation cost and accuracy: inexpensive methods often produce unreliable quality estimates, while accurate methods require deploying and evaluating many workflow configurations. In this paper, we introduce DAGGER, a framework for estimating the quality of generative AI workflows without exhaustive deployment and profiling. DAGGER represents a workflow as a graph, in which nodes correspond to stages and edges capture how outputs from one stage affect subsequent stages. It then decomposes workflow quality into per-node accuracy terms and per-edge dependency terms. Using a novel analytical formulation and SVD-based matrix completion, DAGGER estimates workflow quality from sparse observations without executing every candidate workflow. We evaluate DAGGER on three generative AI workflows across three datasets. DAGGER estimates workflow quality with a median error of 6.8 percentage points while reducing profiling cost by 10.2$\times$ relative to BenchPress, a state-of-the-art baseline, and selects workflow configurations competitive with state-of-the-art frameworks such as LLMSelector.

title: The Date You Didn't Set: The System-Prompt Date as a Hidden Variable in LLM Evaluation
authors: Noureldin Zahran, Mohammed E. Fouda, Khaled N. Khasawneh
abstract: The system prompt of many instruction-tuned models carries a date, usually today's, filled in automatically for conversational and agentic requests alike, so an unchanged evaluation can send a different prompt each day. In this paper, we explore how much this hidden input changes evaluation outcomes. Across six instruction-tuned models and four benchmarks, with prompts, decoding, and configuration fixed, every model is affected: two plausible dates (2024--2026) switch a median $6.6\%$ of test items between correct and incorrect. Even rerunning the evaluation one day later flips about as many items as changing the batch size, although nothing in the setup was changed. In addition, using a grammar-constrained variant of Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) to search dates of any year, we find dates that cost the Llama-3.x models up to $36.5$ points of held-out accuracy. Beyond accuracy, switching to another plausible date alters LLM-judge verdicts and undoes $15$--$32\%$ of reproduced jailbreak successes on Llama-3.2-3B. Yet none of the eleven evaluation stacks we audit pins the date. With the date and the rest of the setup fixed, reruns reproduce byte-for-byte; we therefore recommend pinning, logging, and reporting the date.

title: Directly Maximizing On-policy Expected Accepted Length for Speculative Decoding
authors: Ziying Zhang, Yaqing Wang, Yong Liu, Quanming Yao
abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a lightweight draft model to propose tokens for verification by a target model. Draft training commonly optimizes token-level distribution alignment, but this does not directly optimize the length of the accepted prefix: once a draft token is rejected, all subsequent draft tokens are discarded. We propose FreDraft, an on-policy training method that directly maximizes the expected accepted length of drafts sampled from the current draft model. This objective accounts for first-rejection truncation and induces prefix-aware credit assignment, weighting each token by its contribution to the acceptance of the current and subsequent tokens. To optimize the objective efficiently, we analytically marginalize token-level acceptance rate, using the target model's vocabulary distribution to reduce gradient variance. We further redistribute part of this distribution-level gradient into an explicit penalty for sampled tokens whose probabilities are overestimated by the draft model, while preserving the expected gradient. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and target models show that FreDraft improves accepted length and decoding speedup over strong baselines, achieving faster on-policy training convergence.

title: INCLUDE-2.0: Disentangling Knowledge Gaps in Multilingual LLM Evaluation
authors: Angelika Romanou, Maria Grandury, Clara Meister, Negar Foroutan, Jabez Magomere, Anna Sotnikova, Hitesh Laxmichand Patel, Akshay Kumar Dubey, Alfonso Amayuelas, Amit Agarwal, Arion Das, Carlos Arriaga, Cheng Yu, Dalia Ali, David Quispe-Castillo, Fenal Ashokbhai Ilasariya, Francisco-Javier Rodrigo-Gines, Gonzalo Martinez, Gouthami Vadithya, Guido Ivetta, Javier Conde, Jorge Vallego, Juan J. Calderon G., Karan Gupta, Marcos J Gomez, Marvin M. Agüero-Torales, Mithil Bangera, Naira Paola Arnez Jordan, Oscar M. Cumbicus-Pineda, Priyaranjan Pattnayak, Reewos Erwin Talla Chumpitaz, Sahil Aggarwal, Sahil Raj, Shruti Jalan, Srikant Panda, Susana Zhou, Yeshil Bangera, Orestis Papakyriakopoulos, Scott A. Hale, Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad, Antoine Bosselut
abstract:
Current multilingual benchmarks cover only a fraction of the languages represented in modern pretraining corpora and often conflate language proficiency with the ability to answer questions grounded in specific regions and communities. We introduce INCLUDE-2.0, a large-scale benchmark for region-aware multilingual factual evaluation, which covers 91 languages from 86 countries (127 total language--country pairs), comprising over 220K curated samples drawn from native regional sources. Unlike existing benchmarks that often treat language as a proxy for region, IINCLUDE-2.0 distinguishes between questions whose answers are independent of context, vary by country, concern widely documented facts about a place, or depend on knowledge primarily expressed through local linguistic and cultural sources. Each item is annotated with its regional knowledge type and domain, and paired with an English translation, enabling controlled analysis of the relationship between language proficiency and possession of regional knowledge.
  Evaluating frontier and open-weight models on IINCLUDE-2.0, we find that aggregate multilingual accuracy masks substantial variation across regional knowledge types, languages, and regions. We find that frontier models perform worse on locally embedded knowledge than on widely documented facts about regions, with an average drop of ~14.5 points. We also show that for open-weight models, scale improves accuracy but does not reliably make performance invariant to whether a question is asked in English or its original language. INCLUDE-2.0 is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/epfl-nlp/include-2.0

title: scOPD: Routed On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM-Based Single-Cell Annotation
authors: Zhiyin Yu, Yuchen Mou, Songtao Huang, Shuaiyu Zhang, Xing Wei, Chunchun Chen, Wei Ye, Xiao Luo, Zhonghai Wu, Xiangchao Yan, Lei Bai, Shiyang Feng, Bo Zhang
abstract:
Motivation: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for single-cell annotation, but existing training methods mainly rely on scalar outcome rewards that provide limited supervision for intermediate biological reasoning. Batch-level annotation is particularly challenging because it requires jointly resolving local cell identities and a global one-to-one matching constraint, such that one local error can affect the entire assignment. Moreover, a single inference pass provides insufficient evidence for locating uncertain predictions. These limitations call for fine-grained reasoning supervision during training and uncertainty-aware refinement during inference.
  Results: To address these challenges, we propose scOPD, an on-policy self-distillation framework for LLM-based single-cell annotation. After reasoning fine-tuning, scOPD adaptively routes qualified rollouts to reward-based optimization, while erroneous rollouts receive privileged token-level supervision from successful sibling trajectories. During inference, rollout disagreement triggers constraint-aware pairwise refinement of uncertain assignments. Across CellPuzzles and four out-of-domain disease datasets, scOPD consistently improves the performance of diverse LLM backbones, achieving average cell-level and batch-level accuracies of 81.71% and 44.49% with Qwen3-8B.
  Availability and Implementation: Code and data are available at https://github.com/YuZhiyin/scOPD.

title: RECAP: Training Long-horizon LLM Agents with Context Compaction
authors: Yulun Jiang, Maria Brbic, Michael Moor
abstract: Context compaction enables large language model agents to tackle long-horizon tasks within limited context budgets by replacing interaction histories with compressed summaries. However, learning effective compaction jointly with the agent policy remains challenging, as summaries affect task success over many subsequent interactions. We introduce RECAP, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework based on the principle that a summary should preserve the behavior induced by the original interaction history. We formalize this principle with a behavior distortion objective that measures the divergence between the agent's subsequent behavior under compressed and original contexts. We show that the gradient of the distortion objective decomposes into two complementary learning signals: distortion-based reward for summary generation and self-distillation for subsequent actions. Experiments on Qwen3.5-4B show that RECAP consistently outperforms the task-reward-only RL baselines on both environments, leading to an absolute improvement of 4.6% and 4.3% on BrowseComp-plus and SWE-bench Verified, respectively. Ablations further highlight the value of jointly supervising summary generation and post-compaction behavior for RECAP.

title: Capability and Interpretability of Transformers on Multi-task Recurrence
authors: Xiamin Chen, Linyu Liu, Jiachen Hu, Pinyan Lu
abstract: Transformers are widely used in various language tasks, with limited understanding of their internal mechanisms. Motivated by the recurrent structure of many linguistic rules, we study the capability and interpretability of Transformers through a controlled family of linear recurrence tasks over finite cyclic groups. These tasks range from executing a single fixed rule to identifying a latent rule from context and switching between explicitly specified rules, with and without input masking. Through extensive experiments across different configurations, we find that switching specified rules is simpler than identifying latent rules for Transformers in general. We also identify how several key factors affect the generalization capability of Transformers, including the depth, width, and the algebraic structure of the linear recurrence. Curriculum training is extremely useful when the number of rules is large. With standard tools in mechanistic interpretability like linear probing and input patching, our study reveals how Transformers represent, identify, and execute multiple rules.
