zh_title: 在有限重叠和缺失伴侣链接下推广夫妻随机对照试验
translation: 我们研究了在试验中缺失某些夫妻类型且目标调查报告伴侣特征但未链接配偶的情况下，如何推广夫妻随机对照试验。在具有不受限制的伴侣特征项的可加性效应模型下，当妻子和丈夫的边际分布对试验支持图的每个连通分量赋予相等质量时，目标平均效应可被精确识别。当指定的交互作用在其围绕至少一个圈的交替对比度非零时，该交互作用可被识别。在没有链接的情况下，我们通过对与调查边际一致的配对方案进行优化来获得锐界。配偶优势比可以缩小二元交互作用的界。我们推导了指数患者设计的联合界，量化了常见捷径带来的偏差，并使用贝叶斯二元多层回归与后分层估计了效应和界。在基于3,826对健康与退休研究（HRS）夫妇和模拟试验结果的一个实例中，指数患者试验和未链接调查得出夫妻平均效应的识别集宽度为2.93毫米汞柱。链接调查将其缩小到2.38毫米汞柱。增加300对不患糖尿病的夫妇将未链接集缩小到0.28毫米汞柱，并在拟合模型下通过链接实现了点识别。
tldr: 本文解决了在缺少伴侣链接和部分群体缺失情况下，如何将夫妻随机对照试验结果推广到目标总体的问题，提出了图论识别条件、最优边界界定方法及贝叶斯估计框架。
ai_comments: 本文研究了在缺少夫妻链接和部分群体缺失的复杂数据结构下，如何将夫妻随机对照试验（CRT）的结果推广到目标总体。文章创新性地结合了图论支撑分析、无链接的最优边界界定以及贝叶斯多层回归与后分层（MRP）方法，方法严谨且应用实例清晰，对社会学和医学领域的因果推断具有重要价值。
motivation: 在实际的夫妻随机对照试验中，常常面临部分夫妻类型在试验中缺失（有限重叠）以及目标调查数据仅报告伴侣特征而没有明确将夫妻进行链接（缺少伴侣链接）的挑战，现有的因果推广方法无法直接应对这些复杂情况。
method: 在可加性效应模型下，利用图论分析支持图的连通分量与圈结构以研究识别性；在无链接情况下通过对与调查边际一致的配对方案进行优化来获得锐界（sharp bounds）；利用配偶优势比缩小二元交互作用的界；并通过贝叶斯二元多层回归与后分层（MRP）方法对效应和界进行估计。
results: 在实例分析中，通过3,826对健康与退休研究（HRS）夫妇和模拟试验结果，一个无链接的调查给出了2.93毫米汞柱宽的夫妻平均效应识别集，而链接调查将其缩小到2.38毫米汞柱；增加样本后可进一步显著缩小识别集甚至实现点识别。
conclusion: 在有限重叠和无伴侣链接的情况下，通过利用边际分布最优匹配和贝叶斯方法，可以有效识别和界定夫妻随机对照试验的目标平均效应，为处理复杂配对数据提供了强有力的统计工具。

title: Bayesian Learning of Spatially Heterogeneous Causal Structure in Spatial Transcriptomics
authors: Kyungwook Back, Junsouk Choi
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics preserves the location of each expression profile, making it possible to study how gene regulatory networks differ within a tissue. Across regions of a tissue, regulatory relationships may vary and even reverse direction, so identifying the causal relationships in a specific pathological region can provide insight into therapeutic targets. We propose SpaDAG, a Bayesian method for learning spatially varying causal directed acyclic graphs. By defining the graphs on a triangulation of the tissue, SpaDAG allows each edge to have its own spatial pattern and even to reverse direction across regions. We show that the graphs nonetheless remain fully identifiable, and develop an MCMC sampler that explores them efficiently by reversing an edge over an entire connected region in a single move. SpaDAG outperforms competing methods in simulations with and without direction reversals. In a section spanning a renal cell carcinoma and the adjacent kidney, SpaDAG finds largely different relationships in the two tissues, with those in the tumor concentrated on genes associated with therapeutic targets. Between two of these genes, it identifies a relationship whose direction reverses across the tumor boundary, generating hypotheses about their region-specific coupling. Supplementary materials and code for this article are available online.
comment: 37 pages, 7 figures. Supplementary Material (56 pages) and Supplementary Atlas (12 pages) are provided as ancillary files. Code: https://github.com/KyungWookBack/SpaDAG
zh_title: 空间转录组学中空间异质性因果结构的贝叶斯学习
translation: 空间转录组学保留了每个表达谱的位置，使得研究基因调控网络在组织内部的差异成为可能。在组织的不同区域中，调控关系可能会发生变化甚至方向逆转，因此识别特定病理区域中的因果关系可以为治疗靶点提供见解。我们提出了SpaDAG，一种用于学习空间变化的因果有向无环图的贝叶斯方法。通过在组织的三角剖分上定义图，SpaDAG允许每条边拥有其自身的空间模式，甚至跨区域反转方向。我们表明，这些图在理论上仍然是完全可识别的，并开发了一个MCMC采样器，通过在单次移动中反转整个连通区域的边来高效地探索它们。无论是否存在方向逆转，SpaDAG在模拟实验中的表现均优于竞争方法。在跨越肾细胞癌及相邻肾脏切片的分析中，SpaDAG在两种组织中发现了大不相同的关系，其中肿瘤中的关系主要集中在与治疗靶点相关的基因上。在这两个基因之间，它识别出了一种跨越肿瘤边界方向逆转的关系，从而产生了关于它们区域特异性偶联的假设。本文的补充材料和代码可在网上获取。
tldr: 本文提出了SpaDAG，一种创新的贝叶斯方法，用于高效推断空间转录组数据中随位置变化的基因因果调控网络，并成功应用于肾细胞癌组织分析。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将贝叶斯方法与空间转录组学结合，能够高效地学习空间异质性因果结构，并在肾细胞癌数据中成功识别出具有区域特异性的因果关系及方向逆转现象，为靶向治疗研究提供了新工具。
motivation: 组织内不同区域的基因调控关系可能存在差异甚至方向相反，传统的因果推断方法无法捕捉这种空间异质性，而识别特定病理区域的因果关系对于寻找治疗靶点至关重要。
method: 提出SpaDAG，一种基于组织三角剖分的贝叶斯方法，用于学习空间变化的因果有向无环图，并开发了一种高效的MCMC采样器，通过在单次移动中反转整个连通区域的边来探索图结构。
results: 在模拟实验中，SpaDAG的表现优于竞争方法；在肾细胞癌及邻近肾脏的切片分析中，SpaDAG发现两类组织中存在截然不同的基因关系，且肿瘤中的关系集中在治疗靶点相关基因上，成功识别出跨肿瘤边界方向逆转的因果关系。
conclusion: SpaDAG是一种有效的学习空间异质性因果结构的贝叶斯方法，在模拟和真实空间转录组数据中均表现优异，具有广泛的应用前景。

title: Differential Item Functioning: Methodological Advances in Detection, Identification, and Interpretation
authors: Gabriel Wallin, Qi Huang
abstract: Differential item functioning (DIF) occurs when an item's response distribution differs across groups for respondents at the same level of the construct. Separating DIF from group differences in the construct itself requires identifying assumptions. Conventional analyses compare observed groups on a common scale established through items assumed to be invariant. We distinguish four settings according to whether the groups are observed or latent and whether the common scale is fixed by prespecified restrictions or estimated from the data. For observed groups, we review observed-score and item response theory procedures, multiple-covariate and intersectional models, and recursive partitioning. When anchors are unknown, we compare empirical anchor selection, partial and approximate invariance, robust scaling, regularisation and sparsity-based identification by the assumptions each makes about the pattern of DIF. For latent groups, we discuss mixture models and the joint estimation of class membership and DIF. Further topics include ordinal and multidimensional models, inference after data-dependent selection, effect sizes, consequences for composite scores, and the sources of DIF. We conclude with open problems, including anchor-free identification when DIF is widespread and inference when latent classes and invariant items are selected jointly.
zh_title: 差异项目功能：检测、识别和解释的方法学进展
translation: 差异项目功能（DIF）是指在相同构念水平下，项目响应分布在不同组间存在差异。将DIF与构念本身的组间差异区分开来，需要识别假设。传统分析通过假定不变的项目建立共同量表，并比较观察到的组。我们根据组是观察到的还是潜在的，以及共同量表是通过预先指定限制固定还是从数据中估计，区分了四种设置。对于观察组，我们回顾了观察分数和项目反应理论程序、多协变量和交叉模型以及递归分区。当锚定项未知时，我们比较了经验锚定项选择、部分和近似不变性、稳健标度、正则化和基于稀疏性的识别方法，根据它们对DIF模式所做的假设。对于潜在组，我们讨论了混合模型以及类别成员和DIF的联合估计。其他主题包括序数和多维模型、数据依赖选择后的推断、效应量、对综合分数的影响以及DIF的来源。我们以开放性问题作结，包括当DIF广泛存在时的无锚定项识别，以及当潜在类别和不变项联合选择时的推断。
tldr: 本文综述了差异项目功能（DIF）检测、识别和解释的方法学进展，涵盖了观察组和潜在组的不同设置，以及在锚定项未知情况下的各种策略，并指出了未来的开放性问题。
ai_comments: 本文全面回顾了差异项目功能（DIF）领域的最新方法学进展，涵盖了从传统方法到新兴模型的广泛内容。其创新之处在于系统地区分了不同的分析设置，并详细比较了在锚定项未知情况下的多种识别策略。文章的重要性在于为研究者提供了DIF检测和解释的全面指南，并明确指出了该领域仍存在的挑战和未来的研究方向，特别是关于无锚定项识别和联合选择推断的开放性问题，这对于推动DIF研究的深入发展具有重要意义。
motivation: 差异项目功能（DIF）是指在相同能力水平下，项目响应分布在不同组间存在差异。将DIF与构念本身的组间差异区分开来，需要识别假设。本文旨在回顾和探讨DIF检测、识别和解释的各种方法学进展，以应对传统分析中依赖不变项的局限性。
method: 本文区分了四种设置：观察组或潜在组，以及共同量表是通过预先指定限制固定还是从数据中估计。对于观察组，综述了观察分数和项目反应理论程序、多协变量和交叉模型以及递归分区。当锚定项未知时，比较了经验锚定项选择、部分和近似不变性、稳健标度、正则化和基于稀疏性的识别方法。对于潜在组，讨论了混合模型以及类别成员和DIF的联合估计。其他主题包括序数和多维模型、数据依赖选择后的推断、效应量、对综合分数的影响以及DIF的来源。
conclusion: 本文总结了DIF研究中的开放性问题，包括当DIF广泛存在时的无锚定项识别，以及当潜在类别和不变项联合选择时的推断。

title: Rough log-normal stochastic volatility with quadratic drift: second-moment stability and the martingale property under positive correlation
authors: Artur Sepp, Parviz Rakhmonov
abstract: We extend the log-normal stochastic volatility model with quadratic drift to a fractional Volterra equation. The volatility has a unique global non-negative solution with finite moments on every finite horizon. With linear drift we derive the conditional first and second moments, expected integrated variance and conditional squared VIX. We give the exact threshold for a uniformly bounded second moment and the exponential growth rate above it. With positive quadratic damping the second moment is uniformly bounded for every admissible Hurst exponent and volatility of volatility. A separate bound on long-run expected integrated variance per unit time depends only on the drift parameters. Under the share measure the volatility beta offsets the quadratic damping. The price is a true martingale when damping covers beta. For a positive finite exponential mixture this condition is also necessary. The converse for a singular fractional kernel remains open. We illustrate calibration under positive correlation on observed Bitcoin and Ether option smiles and benchmark the simulation against exact moments. A marked order-flow construction relates multiplicative volatility noise to signed trade impacts arriving at a rate proportional to variance. A small state-dependent bias generates the quadratic drift. We establish a stopped diffusion limit for the constant kernel.
zh_title: 具有二次漂移的粗糙对数正态随机波动率：正相关下的二阶矩稳定性和鞅性质
translation: 我们将具有二次漂移的对数正态随机波动率模型扩展到分数阶Volterra方程。该波动率在每个有限时间范围内具有唯一且全局非负的解，并具有有限矩。在线性漂移下，我们推导了条件一阶和二阶矩、期望积分方差以及条件平方VIX。我们给出了二阶矩一致有界的精确阈值及其之上的指数增长率。在正二次阻尼下，对于每个容许的Hurst指数和波动率的波动率，二阶矩都是一致有界的。关于每单位时间的长期期望积分方差的独立界限仅取决于漂移参数。在股票测度下，波动率beta抵消了二次阻尼。当阻尼覆盖beta时，价格是一个真正的鞅。对于正有限指数混合，该条件也是必要的。奇异分数核的逆命题仍然悬而未决。我们展示了在观察到的比特币和以太坊期权微笑的正相关下的校准，并根据精确矩对模拟进行了基准测试。显著的订单流构建将乘法波动率噪声与以与方差成正比的速率到达的带符号交易冲击联系起来。小的状态相关偏差产生二次漂移。我们为常数核建立了一个停止扩散极限。
tldr: 本文将对数正态随机波动率模型扩展至带有二次漂移的分数阶Volterra方程，深入研究了其矩稳定性和在正相关下的鞅性质，并在加密货币期权上完成了校准应用。
ai_comments: 本文将粗糙对数正态随机波动率模型扩展至分数阶Volterra方程，创新性地结合了二次漂移项与正相关性，深入探讨了矩稳定性和鞅性质，并在加密货币期权微笑拟合中展示了实际应用价值。
motivation: 为了推广对数正态随机波动率模型，研究其在分数阶Volterra方程、二次漂移以及正相关性条件下的二阶矩稳定性和鞅性质。
method: 通过引入分数阶Volterra方程扩展对数正态随机波动率模型，推导条件一阶和二阶矩、期望积分方差及VIX，建立停扩散极限定理，并利用比特币和以太坊期权数据进行校准测试。
results: 在线性漂移下导出了矩和VIX的精确阈值及指数增长率；在正二次阻尼下证明了二阶矩对所有Hurst指数均一致有界；在阻尼覆盖beta的条件下证明了资产价格是真正的鞅，并成功校准了比特币和以太坊的期权微笑。
conclusion: 本文成功将对数正态SV模型扩展至具有二次漂移的分数阶Volterra方程，证明了其在特定条件下的矩稳定性和鞅性质，并通过比特币和以太坊期权数据验证了模型的有效性。

title: Dynamic Preference Logic of Preference Lifting
authors: Xiaochen Chang
abstract: In preference logic, preference is modeled as a binary relation between possible worlds. When we discuss preference relations between propositions, we also need to consider how to lift this relation between possible worlds to propositions. Here, propositions are usually represented by their extensions, that is, sets of possible worlds. There are several choices of lifting scheme: for example, one may require even the worst world in one set to be better than the best world in another, or merely require that every world in one set have some better world in the other. The framing effect in behavioral economics shows that the lifting scheme can change with the way a question is posed or with psychological factors. This paper proves that such changes cannot be reduced to changes in preferences between possible worlds. Accordingly, we treat the lifting scheme as an independent dimension of evaluation and use a hybrid language to describe switches between lifting schemes. We thereby present a language for preference logic with dynamic lifting and prove its soundness and completeness.
comment: dynamic preference logic; preference lifting; framing effect;
zh_title: 偏好提升的动态偏好逻辑
translation: 在偏好逻辑中，偏料被建模为可能世界之间的二元关系。当我们讨论命题之间的偏好关系时，我们还需要考虑如何将可能世界之间的这种关系提升为命题之间的关系。在这里，命题通常由其外延（即可能世界集合）来表示。提升方案有几种选择：例如，人们可以要求一个集合中最坏的世界也比另一个集合中最好的世界更好，或者仅仅要求一个集合中的每个世界在另一个集合中都有一个更好的世界。行为经济学中的框架效应表明，提升方案会随着问题的提出方式或心理因素而改变。本文证明，这种变化不能简化为可能世界之间偏好的变化。因此，我们将提升方案视为一个独立的评估维度，并使用混合语言来描述提升方案之间的转换。因此，我们提出了一种具有动态提升的偏好逻辑语言，并证明了其可靠性和完全性。
tldr: 本文将偏好提升方案视为独立维度，提出了一种新的动态偏好逻辑语言来捕捉偏好提升方案的切换，并证明了其可靠性和完全性。
ai_comments: 该论文首次将偏好提升方案视为独立的评估维度，并建立了一套动态偏好逻辑系统，证明了其可靠性与完全性，为行为经济学中的框架效应提供了一种新颖的逻辑建模方法。
motivation: 行为经济学中的框架效应表明，偏好提升方案会随着提问方式或心理因素而改变，本文旨在证明这种变化不能归约为可能世界之间偏好的变化，并为此建立相应的逻辑描述框架。
method: 将偏好提升方案视为独立的评估维度，采用混合语言来描述提升方案之间的切换，并建立动态偏好逻辑语言，证明其可靠性和完全性。
results: 证明了偏好提升方案的变化无法归约为可能世界间偏好的变化，并成功提出了带有动态提升的偏好逻辑语言，证明了该语言的可靠性与完全性。
conclusion: 本文成功证明了偏好提升方案的变化不能归约为可能世界之间偏好的变化，并提出了一种具有动态提升的偏好逻辑语言，证明了其可靠性和完全性。

title: Computing Weighted Set Covers with Heterogeneous Stochastic Oracles: Deadline-Constrained Token Complexity
authors: Jie Wang
abstract:
We study computation in which a probabilistic Turing machine (PTM) uses AI systems, abstracted as heterogeneous stochastic oracles (HSOs), to solve Weighted Set Cover. A pilot study shows that an LLM can outperform weighted greedy. HSOs differ in capabilities, response distributions, latencies, and token costs. We study how the PTM selects HSOs to obtain, by a deadline and with a required success probability, a full cover satisfying a prescribed weight threshold, and we analyze expected token cost.
  For queries requesting full covers, assuming independent call successes and uninformative failures, we characterize by linear programming the minimum expected token cost for every feasible success probability. An optimal policy randomizes over at most two preselected sequences of oracle batches. Among policies attaining maximum success probability, the expected cost reduction of two-batch selection relative to querying all oracles in one batch is nonnegative and submodular. We construct an FPTAS for near-optimal cost reduction under heterogeneous response-time bounds. Computing an optimal two-batch selection is NP-hard but admits a pseudopolynomial algorithm for positive integral expected token costs.
  For partial-cover responses, the PTM combines returned sets across batches and turns. Once their union covers the universe, it verifies total weight directly or obtains a guarantee from LP-dual tests on retained partial covers. We give one-turn probability, token-cost, and hardness results and adaptive token-cost bounds under per-batch assumptions. A constructed instance shows that residual-guided querying can reduce expected token cost by a factor linear in the number of possible residual subproblems.
zh_title: 计算具有异构随机预言机的加权集合覆盖：截止期限约束下的Token复杂度
translation:
我们研究了一种计算模型，其中概率图灵机（PTM）使用被抽象为异构随机预言机（HSOs）的AI系统来求解加权集合覆盖。一项试点研究表明，大语言模型可以优于加权贪婪算法。HSOs在能力、响应分布、延迟和token成本上各不相同。我们研究了PTM如何选择HSOs，以便在截止期限内以要求的成功概率获得满足规定权重阈值的完整覆盖，并分析了期望的token成本。
对于请求完整覆盖的查询，假设调用成功是独立的且失败是不具信息量的，我们通过线性规划表征了每个可行成功概率下的最小期望token成本。最优策略在至多两个预选的预言机批次序列上进行随机化。在达到最大成功概率的策略中，双批次选择相对于在一个批次中查询所有预言机的期望成本约简是非负且次模的。我们在异构响应时间边界下构建了一个用于近最优成本约简的FPTAS。计算最优的双批次选择是NP难的，但对于正整数期望token成本，它承认一个伪多项式算法。
对于部分覆盖响应，PTM跨批次和轮次组合返回的集合。一旦它们的并集覆盖了整个全集，它就会直接验证总权重，或者从保留的部分覆盖上的LP对偶测试中获得保证。我们给出了单轮概率、token成本和硬度结果，以及基于每批假设的自适应token成本界限。构造的一个实例表明，残差引导查询可以将期望token成本降低与可能残差子问题数量成线性关系的倍数。
tldr: 本文研究了如何利用异构AI预言机在截止期限内以最低的Token成本求解加权集合覆盖问题，并提供了理论保证和优化算法。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将概率图灵机与异构随机预言机（如大语言模型）结合，研究了带截止期限的加权集合覆盖问题，并在token复杂度和成本优化方面做出了深入的理论分析，对利用AI系统求解困难组合优化问题具有重要启示。
motivation: 随着大语言模型等异构随机预言机（HSOs）的发展，如何利用这些异构、具成本且有延迟的AI系统在截止期限和成功概率要求下高效求解NP难的加权集合覆盖问题，目前尚缺乏理论指导。
method: 采用线性规划（LP）表征最小期望token成本、构造FPTAS（全多项式时间近似方案）以实现异构响应时间约束下的近最优成本约简，并针对部分覆盖响应提出自适应token成本界限和残差引导查询策略。
results: 研究表明，最优策略最多在两个预选的预言机批次序列上进行随机化，双批次选择相对于单批次查询的成本减少是非负且次模的；同时证明了计算最优双批次选择是NP难的，但对于正整数期望token成本存在伪多项式算法，且残差引导查询可将期望token成本降低与剩余子问题数量呈线性关系的倍数。
conclusion: 论文通过线性规划、FPTAS和NP难度分析，为利用异构随机预言机求解加权集合覆盖问题提供了高效的策略和成本保证，证明了残差引导查询能显著降低token成本。

title: Proper Conflict-Free Coloring of Cocomparability, Co-Bipartite, and Distance-Hereditary Graphs
authors: Gautam K. Das, Kamal Santra
abstract: A proper conflict-free coloring is a proper vertex coloring in which every non-isolated vertex has a neighbor whose color occurs exactly once in its open neighborhood. We prove that deciding whether $ω(G)$ colors suffice is NP-complete on connected cocomparability graphs of diameter two and independence number three. The reduction supplies a partition into three cliques, a maximum clique, an optimal ordinary coloring, and a dominating edge. Every constructed graph needs either $ω(G)$ or $ω(G)+1$ PCF colors. The result also gives NP-completeness on AT-free graphs. For the co-bipartite subclass, we give a complete matching characterization and an $O(n^6)$-time algorithm for an optimal coloring. The cocktail-party graphs are exactly the co-bipartite graphs requiring two more colors than their ordinary chromatic number; every other co-bipartite graph needs at most one additional color. The matching method extends to all graphs with independence number at most two, giving an $O(n^6\log n)$-time optimization algorithm. Finally, for distance-hereditary graphs, we decide whether $k$ colors suffice in $O(n+m+nk^{10})$ time and compute an optimal coloring in $O(n^{11}+m)$ time without fixing the palette size. The algorithm uses a binary decomposition and groups colors according to five possible behaviors at the boundary of a subgraph.
zh_title: 余可比图、余二分图和距离遗传图的恰当无冲突着色
translation: 恰当无冲突着色是一种恰当的顶点着色，其中每个非孤立顶点都有一个邻居，其颜色在其开邻域中恰好出现一次。我们证明了在直径为二且独立数为三的连通余可比图上，决定是否需要 $\omega(G)$ 种颜色是 NP 完全的。该约简提供了一个分为三个团的划分、最大团、最优普通着色以及一个控制边。每个构造的图需要 $\omega(G)$ 或 $\omega(G)+1$ 种 PCF 颜色。该结果也给出了 AT-free 图上的 NP 完全性。对于余二分图子类，我们给出了一个完全匹配刻画和一个用于最优着色的 $O(n^6)$ 时间算法。鸡尾酒会图恰好是需要比普通色数多两种颜色的余二分图；所有其他余二分图最多需要一种额外的颜色。匹配方法扩展到了所有独立数至多为二的图，给出了一个 $O(n^6\log n)$ 时间的优化算法。最后，对于距离遗传图，我们在 $O(n+m+nk^{10})$ 时间内决定 $k$ 种颜色是否足够，并在不固定调色板大小的情况下在 $O(n^{11}+m)$ 时间内计算出最优着色。该算法使用了二分分解，并根据子图边界上的五种可能行为对颜色进行了分组。
tldr: 本文研究了多种图类上的恰当无冲突着色问题，证明了余可比图上的NP完全性，并为余二分图和距离遗传图提供了多项式时间的最优着色算法。
ai_comments: 该论文在图论和算法复杂度领域取得了重要进展，针对特定图类（如余可比图、余二分图和距离遗传图）的恰当无冲突着色问题给出了深入的复杂性分析和高效算法。创新点在于对不同图类分类讨论，既证明了NP完全性，又给出了多项式时间算法。
motivation: 探究在不同图类上判断和计算恰当无冲突着色（Proper Conflict-Free Coloring）所需的最小颜色数的计算复杂性与多项式时间算法。
method: 通过归纳约简证明NP完全性；运用匹配特征刻画和多项式时间算法（如O(n^6)和O(n^{11}+m)）求解特定图类；利用二叉分解和颜色行为分类处理距离遗传图。
results: 证明了在直径为2且独立数为3的连通余可比图及AT-free图上判断是否需要ω(G)种颜色是NP完全的；给出了余二分图的匹配特征和O(n^6)时间算法；给出了独立数不超过2的图的O(n^6 \log n)算法；设计了距离遗传图的最优着色算法。
conclusion: 本文完整探讨了多种图类上的恰当无冲突着色问题，证明了部分图类上的NP完全性，并为余二分图、独立数至多二的图以及距离遗传图设计了多项式时间的优化算法。

title: Adding One More Agent: How AI Team Size and Formation Shape Productivity and Diversity in Human-AI Brainstorming Teams
authors: Rong-Ching Chang, Hao-Chuan Wang
abstract: Generative AI has improved individual productivity, but whether adding a plurality of AI partners helps or hurts remains open. We crossed AI partnership (one versus two) with behavioral formation (calibrated to average human behavior versus customized by the participant) in a brainstorming experiment ($N$=168) with human-human dyads as reference. Two-AI rooms posted more ideas to the shared board, but human-authored ideas dropped substantially. With one AI partner, formation mattered: humans paired with an average-calibrated AI posted more than any other condition. With two, this effect vanished. Humans continued talking but converted fewer ideas into board posts. AI social talk predicted more human posts, while AI posting volume predicted fewer. AI presence increased global diversity of human-authored ideas, but only a second AI increased within-session differentiation. The number of AI partners and their formation can reshape what the human contributes; single-agent results do not generalize to multi-agent teams.
zh_title: 再添一智：AI团队规模与形成方式如何塑造人机头脑风暴团队的生产力与多样性
translation: 生成式AI提高了个人生产力，但增加多个AI伙伴是有助还是有害仍未可知。我们在头脑风暴实验（N=168）中交叉了AI伙伴关系（一个与两个）和行为形成（校准为平均人类行为与参与者定制），并以人-人双人组作为参考。双AI房间在共享白板上发布了更多想法，但人类撰写的想法大幅下降。对于一个AI伙伴，形成方式至关重要：与平均校准的AI配对的人类发布的内容比其他任何条件都多。对于两个AI，这种效应消失了。人类继续交流，但转化为白板帖子的想法减少了。AI的社会化对话预示着更多的人类发帖，而AI的发帖量预示着更少。AI的存在增加了人类原创想法的整体多样性，但只有第二个AI增加了会话内的差异性。AI伙伴的数量及其形成方式重塑了人类的贡献；单智能体结果无法泛化到多智能体团队。
tldr: 本研究通过实验发现，增加AI伙伴的数量和调整其行为会改变人类在头脑风暴中的贡献，证明单AI研究结果无法直接泛化到多AI团队。
ai_comments: 该研究揭示了多AI智能体团队在人机协作头脑风暴中的独特动态，表明单AI的实验结果无法简单泛化到多AI场景，对未来人机协作设计具有重要启示。
motivation: 尽管生成式AI提高了个人生产力，但关于增加多个AI伙伴是会促进还是阻碍协作效果，目前尚不明确。单AI的研究结果是否能泛化到多AI团队也需要探究。
method: 进行了一项包含168名参与者的头脑风暴实验，交叉对比了AI伙伴数量（一个与两个）和行为形成方式（校准为平均人类行为与参与者定制），并以人-人双人组作为参考。
results: 双AI房间发布了更多想法，但人类撰写的想法显著下降；单AI时形成方式很重要（平均校准的AI产出最高），但在双AI时此效果消失；AI的社会化对话预测更多人类发帖，而AI的发帖量预测较少；AI的存在增加了人类想法的全球多样性，但只有第二个AI增加了会话内的差异性。
conclusion: AI伙伴的数量和行为形成方式会根本性地重塑人类的贡献方式，单智能体结果不能直接推广到多智能体团队。

title: BitPrefill: W1.58A4 Tensor-Core Acceleration for Compute-Bound LLM Prefill
authors: Fang Chen, Xuming Chen, Sanmukh Kuppannagari, Gourav Datta
abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces large language model (LLM) inference cost, yet implementations optimized for memory-bound decode can leave compute-bound prefill on BF16 tensor cores. This gap matters for input-heavy workloads, including long-context and multimodal applications, where prefill can account for a substantial fraction of inference latency. We propose a W1.58A4 operator that quantizes weights to ternary values and activations to 4-bit, while executing the linear projection on native INT4 general matrix multiply (GEMM) tensor cores, turning prefill from a full-precision matrix multiply into a low-bit one. We deploy the operator for BitNet-b1.58 on a single RTX 4090 and a Jetson Orin Nano edge device, and report GEMM-kernel latency, end-to-end LLMs prefill latency, and task accuracy against bf16 and BitNet/BitBLAS baselines. Our proposed kernel achieves ~1.42x acceleration compared to the original BF16 prefill phase, with negligible reduction on model accuracy.
zh_title: BitPrefill：面向计算密集型大模型预填充的W1.58A4张量核加速
translation: 低比特量化降低了大语言模型（LLM）的推理成本，然而针对内存受限的解码阶段优化的实现，往往使计算受限的预填充阶段停留在BF16张量核上。对于输入密集型工作负载（包括长上下文和多模态应用），这种差距尤为重要，因为预填充可能占推理延迟的很大一部分。我们提出了一种W1.58A4算子，它将权重三值化，将激活值量化为4比特，同时在原生INT4通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）张量核上执行线性投影，将预填充从全精度矩阵乘法转变为低比特矩阵乘法。我们将该算子部署在单张RTX 4090和Jetson Orin Nano边缘设备上的BitNet-b1.58模型中，并报告了GEMM内核延迟、端到端LLM预填充延迟以及与bf16和BitNet/BitBLAS基线相比的任务准确率。与原始BF16预填充阶段相比，我们提出的内核实现了约1.42倍的加速，且模型准确率下降微乎其微。
tldr: 提出BitPrefill（W1.58A4算子），通过原生INT4张量核加速大模型预填充阶段，实现约1.42倍加速且几乎不损失精度。
ai_comments: 该论文针对大模型预填充阶段（Compute-Bound）在低比特量化下常回退至BF16张量核的痛点，提出了W1.58A4算子，利用原生INT4 GEMM硬件加速，实现了预填充阶段的显著加速且几乎不损失模型精度。创新点明确，对长文本和多模态应用具有重要价值。
motivation: 现有的低比特量化主要针对内存受限的解码阶段优化，往往导致计算密集的预填充阶段回退到BF16张量核，这在长文本和多模态等输入密集型任务中严重影响了推理延迟。
method: 提出一种W1.58A4算子，将权重三值化（ternary）、激活值量化为4比特，并在原生INT4通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）张量核上执行线性投影，同时在RTX 4090和Jetson Orin Nano边缘设备上进行部署评估。
results: 在单张RTX 4090和Jetson Orin Nano上验证显示，该内核相比原始BF16预填充阶段实现了约1.42倍的加速，且模型任务准确率几乎没有损失。
conclusion: BitPrefill成功实现了W1.58A4量化大模型在预填充阶段的高效张量核加速，在保持模型精度的同时大幅降低了计算延迟。

title: Testing Settlement Flags after Late Evidence and Process Restart
authors: Zengjian Liu, Tommy He, ELE Zhao, HongLiang Sun
abstract: A settlement flag can survive an application restart while the economic effects remain ambiguous. We define a contract linking the fixed plan, source admission at two cutoffs, identity-keyed ledger effects and post-invocation state. We generated 504 synthetic histories, ran each through a file implementation and a separately coded SQLite implementation, and observed 672 controlled process exits. The file implementation missed 54 same-identity payment-date conflicts, including 27 that credited cash early, and a monitor using run flags, artifact presence and purchase counts accepted all 54. The same contract distinguishes a purchase awaiting closure from a correct quote wait for a single writer on a running kernel and filesystem.
zh_title: 晚期证据和进程重启后结算标志的测试
translation: 结算标志在应用程序重启后可以存活，但其经济影响仍然模糊不清。我们定义了一个合约，它连接了固定计划、两个截止点的源准入、身份键控的账本效应以及调用后状态。我们生成了504个合成历史，将每个历史分别通过文件实现和单独编码的SQLite实现运行，并观察了672次受控进程退出。文件实现错过了54个相同身份的支付日期冲突，其中27个提前贷记了现金，而一个使用运行标志、人工制品存在和购买计数的监控器接受了所有这54个冲突。相同的合约能够区分等待关闭的购买和运行中的内核与文件系统上单个写入器的正确报价等待。
tldr: 本文研究了结算标志在应用重启后经济影响不明确的问题。通过定义合约、生成合成历史并在文件和SQLite实现中进行测试，发现文件实现存在支付日期冲突，但监控器能有效识别并接受这些冲突。
ai_comments: 这篇论文关注了在分布式系统或复杂应用中，关键状态（如结算标志）在系统重启后的一致性和准确性问题，尤其是在存在“晚期证据”的情况下。其创新之处在于通过定义一个严谨的“合约”来规范状态转换和效应，并通过对比不同实现和引入监控器来验证其鲁棒性。这对于确保金融交易或类似场景的数据完整性和业务逻辑正确性具有重要意义。
motivation: 结算标志在应用程序重启后可以存活，但其经济影响仍然模糊不清。
method: 定义了一个连接固定计划、两阶段来源准入、身份键控账本效应和调用后状态的合约。生成了504个合成历史，分别通过文件实现和单独编码的SQLite实现运行，并观察了672次受控进程退出。
results: 文件实现错过了54个相同身份的支付日期冲突，其中27个提前贷记了现金；一个使用运行标志、人工制品存在和购买计数的监控器接受了所有这54个冲突。相同的合约能够区分等待关闭的购买和运行中的内核与文件系统上单个写入器的正确报价等待。
conclusion: 通过定义的合约和监控器，可以有效识别并处理结算标志在进程重启后可能导致的支付日期冲突问题，确保经济效应的准确性。

title: On the loss landscape of the linear neural network: beyond critical points
authors: Antoine Lejay, Lionel Lenotre, Sa{ï}d Toubra
abstract: While the critical points of the loss landscape in linear neural networks have been extensively studied since the seminal work of Baldi \& Hornik in the late 1980s, a description of this landscape at an intermediate or global scale is still lacking. Such a characterization is crucial, particularly as a substantial body of literature indicates that gradient descent circumvents critical points. The present article introduces an intermediate structure, termed the critical thalweg, which encompasses all critical points and exhibits key geometric properties. Beyond providing a geometric proof of Baldi \& Hornik's results using simpler assumptions than the existing literature, this framework offers a global view of the loss landscape that can be easily visualized in a two-dimensional plane. Empirical observations suggest that gradient descent is attracted toward the critical thalweg, along which the loss continues to decrease to its global minimum.
zh_title: 论线性神经网络的损失地形：超越临界点
translation: 自Baldi & Hornik在20世纪80年代末的开创性工作以来，线性神经网络损失地形的临界点已被广泛研究，但目前仍缺乏对其在中间或全局尺度上的描述。这种刻画至关重要，特别是大量文献表明梯度下降会避开临界点。本文引入了一种被称为“临界谷线”（critical thalweg）的中间结构，它包含所有临界点并表现出关键的几何性质。除了在比现有文献更简单的假设下给出Baldi & Hornik结果的几何证明外，该框架还提供了一个可在二维平面中轻松可视化的损失地形全局视图。实证观察表明，梯度下降被吸引向临界谷线，并沿该谷线持续下降至其全局最小值。
tldr: 本文提出了‘临界谷线’的概念，用以刻画线性神经网络超越临界点的全局损失地形，并解释了梯度下降的收敛路径。
ai_comments: 本文引入了‘临界谷线（critical thalweg）’这一创新概念，突破了传统仅关注临界点的局限，为理解线性神经网络的损失地形提供了全新的全局和中间尺度视角，具有重要的理论和可视化价值。
motivation: 尽管线性神经网络损失地形的临界点已被广泛研究，但缺乏对中间或全局尺度损失地形的描述，且梯度下降算法通常会避开临界点，因此需要一种能提供全局视角并解释梯度下降行为的新框架。
method: 引入名为‘临界谷线（critical thalweg）’的中间几何结构，该结构包含所有临界点并具有关键几何性质，通过更简单的假设重新证明了Baldi & Hornik的结果，并在二维平面上对损失地形进行全局可视化。
results: 该框架不仅用更简单的假设给出了Baldi & Hornik结果的几何证明，还能在二维平面中轻松可视化损失地形的全局视图；同时，实验表明梯度下降会被吸引至临界谷线，并沿其持续下降至全局最小值。
conclusion: 本文通过引入临界谷线框架，不仅重新证明了Baldi & Hornik的经典结果，还为线性神经网络损失地形的全局结构和梯度下降动力学提供了强有力的几何解释。

title: Which Archived Results Survive a Rule Change? A Case Study in Revalidating Decisions
authors: Zengjian Liu, Tommy He, ELE Zhao, HongLiang Sun
abstract: A research workflow can retain a correct numerical result after the evidence or approval that supported its use has expired. Common incremental build methods identify reusable computations, while deciding what remains usable also requires knowing which policy justified each approval. We examined a recorded parser migration across 312 paired research records, replayed both parsers with the same inputs, applied a calculation-file omission to the complete cohort, and evaluated current proof in a GNU Make comparison. Treating the prior projections as current would change at least one field in 11 of 312 records, and controlled cases show that even matching values can lack a current proof. The study separates numerical recovery from applicable approval and sets out the conditions under which a maintained dependency graph can preserve both.
zh_title: 哪个归档结果能在规则变更中存活？重新验证决策的案例研究
translation: 在支持其使用的证据或批准过期后，研究工作流仍能保留正确的数值结果。常见的增量构建方法可以识别可重用的计算，而决定哪些内容仍然可用还需要知道是哪种政策证明了每次批准的合理性。我们检查了312对研究记录中记录的解析器迁移，使用相同的输入重放了两个解析器，对完整同类群应用了计算文件遗漏，并在GNU Make比较中评估了当前的证明。如果将先前的预测视为当前预测，将改变312条记录中至少1条记录的一个字段，且对照案例表明，即使是匹配的值也可能缺乏当前的证明。该研究将数值恢复与适用的批准区分开来，并阐明了维护依赖图以同时保存两者的条件。
tldr: 规则变更后，历史计算结果的数值正确并不意味着其仍具备合法的批准证明，本文通过案例研究提出了同时保留正确数值与有效批准的条件。
ai_comments: 本文探讨了规则变更后如何验证历史研究成果的有效性，强调了仅凭数值相等并不足以证明当前结果的合法性，对于科研工作流的可重复性和数据治理具有重要意义。
motivation: 在证据或支持其使用的批准过期后，研究工作流可能仍然保留正确的数值结果，但确定哪些结果仍然可用不仅需要识别可重用的计算，还需要了解证明每个批准的政策。
method: 检查了312对研究记录中的解析器迁移，重放了具有相同输入的解析器，对完整同类群应用了计算文件遗漏，并在GNU Make比较中评估了当前的证明。
results: 将先前的预测视为当前预测会改变312条记录中至少1条记录的一个字段，且对照案例表明，即使数值匹配也可能缺乏当前的证明。
conclusion: 研究成功区分了数值恢复与适用的批准，并确立了维护依赖图以同时保存两者的条件。

title: Puzzles, People, and Publications: Measuring Shared Significance in Crosswords from 1942 to 2024
authors: Danny Benett, Ashley M. A. Fehr, Calla Glavin Beauregard, Christopher M. Danforth, Peter Sheridan Dodds
abstract: Crossword puzzles are cultural objects that encode shared significance. We use interpretable, large-scale computational methods to analyze how crossword constructors, editors, and publications have adopted and adapted language to convey significance. Focusing on approximately 2.4 million crossword clue/answer pairs published in The New York Times between 1942 and 2024, we find shifting significance and differing editorial practices to be quantitatively measurable. By computationally measuring shared significance over time in crossword puzzle production, we are able to better understand cultural changes in the United States through the 20th and early 21st centuries.

title: How developers split roles among them and a coding agent and what "collaboration" means
authors: Linus Ververs, Helya Dadkhah, Lutz Prechelt
abstract:
Background: Coding agents such as Claude Code become more and more competent, so that their role in the development process can grow.
  Objective: How do developers characterize the role-split between them and their agent? How would they ideally want to collaborate with their agent?
  Methods: We perform a 3-step, mixed-methods study. We apply qualitative open coding to 2025 early adopters' blog articles; perform a quantitative survey of 2026 practitioners; develop and apply a method for coding-agent-supported open coding of survey freetext responses.
  Results: The 2025 practitioners have the agent work in supporting roles only. Accountability was firmly human. In 2026, both are fundamentally still true. Gradually, however, the role-split is now different, with much more agent involvement. The developers' notion of collaboration has three facets: Predominantly a separation into human-only, agent-only, and collaborative work steps, with defined conditions and goals. Second, accommodating personal preferences without engineering justification. Third, a holistic view of collaboration covering the entire development process.
  Conclusions: Defining one's role relative to the agent will need to be a recurring activity. The different views on collaboration are likely a source of friction and conflict for teams; future work should find out how to cope with that.
comment: 32 pages (plus 27 pages of appendices), 4 figures, 10 tables
zh_title: 开发者如何在他们与编码智能体之间分配角色以及“协作”意味着什么
translation:
背景：诸如Claude Code等编码智能体变得越来越有能力，使其在开发过程中的作用不断增强。
目标：开发者如何描述他们与智能体之间的角色分工？他们理想中希望如何与智能体进行协作？
方法：我们实施了一项三步混合方法研究。对2025年早期采用者的博客文章应用定性开放编码；对2026年从业者进行定量调查；开发并应用了一种利用编码智能体辅助对调查自由文本回答进行编码的方法。
结果：2025年的从业者仅让智能体担任支持角色，责任完全在人类。到2026年，这两点在根本上依然成立。然而，角色分工逐渐发生了变化，智能体的参与度大大增加。开发者对协作的概念包含三个方面：主要是分为仅限人类、仅限智能体以及协作的工作步骤，并具有明确的条件和目标；其次是适应没有工程学依据的个人偏好；第三是对涵盖整个开发过程的整体协作视角。
结论：定义自己相对于智能体的角色将是一项经常性的活动。对协作的不同看法很可能是团队摩擦和冲突的来源，未来的工作应该探讨如何应对这一问题。
tldr: 本研究通过混合方法分析了人机角色分工的演变及开发者对协作的定义，发现智能体参与度正逐渐加深，且协作观念呈现出多维特征。
ai_comments: 该研究通过混合方法探讨了开发者与日益强大的编码智能体之间的分工演变及对“协作”的理解，对于理解AI辅助软件工程的人机协作模式具有重要价值。
motivation: 随着Claude Code等编码智能体变得越来越强大，其在开发过程中的角色不断增长，亟需了解开发者如何描述人机角色分工以及他们理想中的协作方式。
method: 采用三步混合方法研究：首先对2025年早期采用者的博客文章进行定性开放编码；其次对2026年的从业者进行定量调查；最后开发并应用了一种编码智能体支持的调查自由文本响应编码方法。
results: 2025年从业者仅让智能体担任辅助角色，人类承担绝对责任；2026年这一基本事实虽未改变，但智能体参与度显著增加。开发者的协作观念包含三个方面：一是划分为人类专属、智能体专属和协作工作步骤并设定条件与目标；二是容纳无工程学依据的个人偏好；三是对整个开发过程的整体协作视角。
conclusion: 定义开发者与编码智能体的角色将是一个持续的过程，而对协作的不同理解可能会成为团队摩擦的根源，未来需要研究如何应对这一挑战。

title: Cohomological $k$-Equivalence Does Not Capture Graph Isomorphism
authors: Asterios Gkantzounis
abstract:
Ó Conghaile introduced cohomological $k$-equivalence $\equiv^{\mathbb{Z}}_k$, a refinement of equivalence in $k$-variable counting logic that is decidable in polynomial time for each fixed $k$: the local isomorphisms that survive must extend, in both directions, to compatible families of integer combinations of local isomorphisms. He asked whether, for every finite relational signature $σ$, some $k$ makes $\equiv^{\mathbb{Z}}_k$ coincide with isomorphism of $σ$-structures (Question 14 of his MFCS 2022 paper). We show that the answer is negative already for graphs: for every $k\ge 1$ there are finite simple graphs $A_k\not\cong B_k$ with $A_k\equiv^{\mathbb{Z}}_k B_k$.
  Every isomorphism of the pair would induce a permutation $g$ of a common index set $D$. One part of the graphs, over $\mathbb{F}_3$, admits exactly the even permutations, because $g$ acts by its sign on a nonzero class in the cokernel of the unsigned boundary map on subsets of $D$. A second part, over $\mathbb{F}_2$ and built on the Johnson graph $J(|D|,2)$, admits exactly the odd permutations. No set of at most $k$ vertices detects the parity: every local isomorphism of a common family is realised, with the same images, by permutations of both parities.
  We complement the main result with three observations. For the pair built from an index set of size $n$, the least width at which cohomological equivalence distinguishes the two graphs is $\log_4 n+O(1)$; so within this construction the doubly exponential size is unavoidable. The pairs are nevertheless distinguished in polynomial time by an explicit invariant that combines the class of the part over $\mathbb{F}_3$ with the parity of the part over $\mathbb{F}_2$. Finally, cohomological $2$-equivalence already distinguishes the coloured graphs with which Berkholz and Grohe show that no level of the Diophantine relaxation decides isomorphism.
comment: 21 pages. The ancillary files contain the code and the logs of the finite checks described in the appendix
zh_title: 上同调$k$-等价无法捕捉图同构
translation:
Ó Conghaile 引入了上同调 $k$-等价 $\equiv^{\mathbb{Z}}_k$，这是 $k$ 变量计数逻辑中等价性的一种精细化形式，对于每个固定的 $k$ 它可以在多项式时间内判定：存活的局部同构必须双向延伸为兼容的局部同构整数组合族。他询问对于每个有限关系签名 $\sigma$，是否存在某个 $k$ 使得 $\equiv^{\mathbb{Z}}_k$ 与 $\sigma$ 结构的同构相吻合（其 MFCS 2022 论文中的问题 14）。我们证明这个答案对于图来说已经是否定的：对于每个 $k\ge 1$，存在有限简单图 $A_k\not\cong B_k$ 且 $A_k\equiv^{\mathbb{Z}}_k B_k$。
该对图的任何同构都会导出公共索引集 $D$ 的置换 $g$。图的第一部分定义在 $\mathbb{F}_3$ 上，恰好容许偶置换，因为 $g$ 通过其符号作用在 $D$ 子集上无符号边界映射上同核的一个非零类上。第二部分定义在 $\mathbb{F}_2$ 上并基于 Johnson 图 $J(|D|,2)$，恰好容许奇置换。没有任何至多 $k$ 个顶点的集合能够检测出奇偶性：公共族的每个局部同构都可以通过两种奇偶性的置换以相同的像来实现。
我们用三个观察结果来补充主要结果。对于由大小为 $n$ 的索引集构造的图对，上同调等价区分这两个图所需的最小宽度为 $\log_4 n+O(1)$；因此在此构造中，双指数大小是不可避免的。尽管如此，该图对可以通过一个显式不变量在多项式时间内被区分，该不变量结合了 $\mathbb{F}_3$ 上部分的类与 $\mathbb{F}_2$ 上部分的奇偶性。最后，上同调 $2$-等价已经能够区分 Berkholz 和 Grohe 用于证明任何级别的丢番图松弛都不能决定同构的有色图。
tldr: 上同调$k$-等价无法捕捉图同构，否定了Ó Conghaile提出的公开问题。
ai_comments: 该论文否定了Ó Conghaile提出的关于上同调k-等价是否能捕捉图同构的公开问题，证明了即使对于图，上同调k-等价也无法捕捉同构，具有重要的理论价值。
motivation: 研究Ó Conghaile提出的公开问题：对于每个有限关系签名$\sigma$，是否存在某个$k$使得上同调$k$-等价与$\sigma$-结构的同构相吻合。
method: 构造了一对对于任意$k$都满足上同调$k$-等价但不同构的有限简单图。该构造利用了$\mathbb{F}_3$上的图部分（仅允许偶置换）和基于Johnson图的$\mathbb{F}_2$上的图部分（仅允许奇置换），并通过局部同构无法检测奇偶性的性质进行证明。
results: 证明了答案是否定的。对于任意$k\ge 1$，存在有限简单图$A_k$和$B_k$不同构但满足$A_k\equiv^{\mathbb{Z}}_k B_k$。此外，分析了区分该对图所需的最小宽度，并给出了一个能在多项式时间内区分该图对的显式不变量。
conclusion: 对于任意固定的k，上同调k-等价不能捕捉图同构，回答了Ó Conghaile提出的公开问题。

title: A posteriori estimates for inverse evolutionary problems
authors: Sergey Repin
abstract: The paper is focused on a posteriori error analysis of evolutionary problems, which are ill-posed in the sense of Hadamard. They may have no solutions and respective approximations may be highly unstable. For these problems, the a posteriori error estimation concept applicable to well-posed problems is not valid and requires a significant reformulation. A posteriori estimates of the functional type provide the basis for addressing this issue. They generate computable quantities that estimate the distance between a function (approximate solution to the inverse problem) and exact solution of a "close" well-posed initial boundary value problem associated with the same differential equation. The solution of this close problem exactly satisfies one part of the imposed conditions and the others are satisfied approximately with the accuracy $\eps$. This idea is elaborated for several evolutionary problems generated by the reaction-convection-diffusion equation: backward parabolic problem, problem with non-local time conditions, Cauchy parabolic problem, and parameter(s) identification problem. The estimates derived not only control the accuracy of approximate solutions, but also suggest a unified approach to calculating them numerically.

title: Model the Annotation, Not the Noise: Semantic Annotation-Channel Prompt Learning against Noisy Labels
authors: Zibin Geng, Yitong Bao, Jia Li, Xuefeng Jiang, Sheng Sun, Yuwei Wang, Min Liu
abstract: Parameter-efficient prompt learning has become a cornerstone for adapting pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs), yet it remains highly vulnerable to label noise in few-shot Web and retrieval scenarios. Existing noise robust methods typically rely on hard sample selection or deterministic label correction, which discard valuable semantic ambiguity and overlook how observed annotations are actually generated. To bridge this gap, we reformulate noisy prompt learning through the perspective of data generation, proposing SACP, a Semantic-aware Annotation Channel-based Prompt learning framework. Instead of suppressing noise heuristically, SACP decouples latent clean-label prediction from instance-dependent annotation generation. By integrating frozen VLM semantic priors with lightweight visual residuals, SACP constructs a structured annotation channel optimized via generalized expectation-maximization with soft posteriors. Furthermore, a posterior-aware memory is introduced to preserve label uncertainty during test-time inference. Extensive experiments across different synthetic benchmarks and the real-world noisy Food101N dataset demonstrate that SACP achieves state-of-the-art performance against its counterparts in different label noise patterns, especially under severe asymmetric noise.

title: One Behavior, Out of Order: Deterministic Execution and Parallel Simulation of ROS 2 Applications
authors: Chengzi Huang, Behnam Khodabandeloo, Duc Anh Nguyen, Chuanchao Gao, Wang Yi
abstract: System-level simulation is widely used to validate robotic applications before hardware deployment. However, Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2), a popular middleware for such applications, uses asynchronous publish-subscribe communication, which can make application behavior depend on scheduling and the platform. The behavior can then vary across runs and machines even with the same inputs. This nondeterminism makes faults hard to reproduce and tests unreliable. In this paper, we first give ROS 2 applications a lightweight coordination scheme in which every component, including event-driven ones, reads its inputs and writes its outputs at predefined time instants. By decoupling computation and communication, the scheme makes an application deterministic, that is, it always has one behavior for given inputs. Tests are thus repeatable, but for large applications they still take a long time. To speed up these tests, we then present an out-of-order parallel simulation algorithm. From the predefined read and write instants, it knows before the run which activations of components depend on which. It starts each activation as soon as those it depends on have finished. Finally, we implement the algorithm in a simulator that runs existing ROS 2 applications without any change to them or to ROS 2. We evaluate the simulator on industrial use cases and synthetic graphs. On the industrial use cases, it is up to 2.6 times faster than synchronous parallel simulation and needs an order of magnitude less memory for messages than asynchronous parallel simulation.

title: Latent Space Planning with Sequential Monte Carlo
authors: Hrishikesh Viswanath, Anindita Ghosh, Uttaran Bhattacharya, Aniket Bera
abstract: Planning with learned world models amounts to finding action sequences whose predicted rollouts reach a goal. Sampling-based planners often struggle at longer horizons, while gradient-based methods can become trapped in local minima. Meanwhile, model predictive path integral control (MPPI), a complementary approach, alternates between estimating an expectation under a cost-weighted distribution from samples and updating the plan from this estimate. Its samples, however, are drawn afresh at every iteration from a Gaussian proposal and reach the target distribution only through importance weights. Moreover, a target distribution favoring goal-reaching trajectories can be difficult to define directly, motivating a sequence of intermediate distributions. Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) provides a natural mechanism for evolving such a sequence through importance weighting and resampling. Motivated by this, we formulate latent-space planning as optimization guided by SMC, which moves a population of action sequences while a gradient-based optimizer updates the plan. Inspired by classical planning, we further introduce a PDE-derived cost-to-go that guides the evolution of the sample distribution using the structure of the latent state space. On navigation and manipulation tasks with visual and proprioceptive world models, our formulation outperforms gradient-based planners by $29$ and $50$, sampling-based planners by $35$ and MPPI by $7$ percentage points in average success rate, while succeeding in fewer iterations than gradient-based planners and within 4\% of MPPI.

title: Parasite Features: Causal Abstraction Through Spurious Pathways
authors: Denis Sutter, Qing Yao, Sasha Boguraev, Julian Minder, Antonio Di Maio, Thomas Hofmann, Kyle Mahowald, Tiago Pimentel
abstract: Causal Abstraction defines a notion of \emph{equivalence} between a neural network and an algorithm, thus serving as a powerful framework for mechanistic interpretability. In this paper, however, we show the existence of a class of \emph{spurious features} which straightforwardly pass such equivalence tests. Suppose there are two directions in a model's representation space where: (i) one discriminates the input based on some feature, and (ii) the other steers the model towards a certain output. Interpretability methods based on Causal Abstraction (e.g., Distributed Alignment Search) can \emph{spuriously} simulate these directions' combined behavior by leveraging pathways passing through them, giving the impression that the model implements this feature. In such cases, we say the method discovered a \defn{parasite feature}. Experimentally, we show that Distributed Alignment Search finds parasite features using linear alignment maps in two tasks: syntactic agreement and two-digit addition. Our paper highlights an important consideration for Causal Abstraction and contributes to the ongoing debate about best practices for mechanistic interpretability.

title: Forehead ROI Localization under Real-World Imaging Degradations via Cross-View Pseudo-Labeling
authors: Geetanjali Sharma, Gaurav Jaswal, Aditya Nigam, Raghavendra Ramachandra
abstract: Forehead region-of-interest (ROI) localization is important for forehead-creases biometrics, particularly when the lower face is occluded. However, localization remains challenging under varying image quality, pose, and illumination. We propose Confidence and Consistency Guided Pseudo-Labeling (CCGP), which adapts Grounding DINO using unlabeled facial images filtered by detection confidence and geometric consistency between original and horizontally flipped views, without modifying the detector architecture or loss. We evaluate CCGP on five external datasets and 350 images spanning seven imaging conditions. CCGP achieves the highest mean intersection over union (mIoU) on four of five external datasets, improving from 0.415 to 0.580 on RMFRD compared with supervised Grounding DINO. On the quality-stratified subset, the largest gains occur under blur (0.487 to 0.719) and low contrast (0.615 to 0.710). CCGP also outperforms conventional self-training on RMFRD (0.580 versus 0.551 mIoU). Despite a slight in-domain performance gap (0.861 vs. 0.866 mIoU) and challenges with off-angle poses, CCGP improves cross-dataset localization under challenging imaging conditions.

zh_title: 通过交叉视图伪标签实现真实世界图像退化下的额头ROI定位
translation: 额头感兴趣区域（ROI）定位对于额头皱纹生物识别很重要，尤其是在下半脸被遮挡时。然而，在图像质量、姿态和光照变化下，定位仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了置信度和一致性引导伪标签（CCGP）方法，该方法通过使用未标记的面部图像，并根据检测置信度和原始视图与水平翻转视图之间的几何一致性进行过滤，来适应Grounding DINO，而无需修改检测器架构或损失函数。我们在五个外部数据集和涵盖七种成像条件的350张图像上评估了CCGP。CCGP在五个外部数据集中的四个上实现了最高的平均交并比（mIoU），与监督式Grounding DINO相比，在RMFRD数据集上从0.415提高到0.580。在按质量分层的子集上，最大的增益出现在模糊（0.487提高到0.719）和低对比度（0.615提高到0.710）条件下。CCGP在RMFRD数据集上也优于传统的自训练方法（mIoU为0.580对0.551）。尽管在域内性能略有差距（0.861对0.866 mIoU），并且在偏角姿态下仍面临挑战，但CCGP改善了挑战性成像条件下的跨数据集定位。

title: Federated KPI Aggregation with Local Privacy Constraints and Coordinated OLAP Roll-Ups
authors: Felix Härer
abstract: Cross-organizational KPI analysis can require aggregated results from independently administered data warehouses without centralizing detailed records. To limit disclosure from small local groups, a site can require a minimum number of contributing records before releasing a KPI value for a group. If each site applies this rule independently, different local contributions may be suppressed and the combined KPI can become incomplete. This paper investigates whether OLAP granularity can be coordinated before local query results are released so that all sites satisfy their local minimum-cohort rules and contribute at the same analytical level. The proposed method selects the least-generalized common roll-up accepted by every site. Site agents coordinate current capabilities and approved local execution across independently administered sites, with privacy checks and aggregate computation remaining deterministic local functions. In a four-site prototype, coordinated roll-up retained all contributions and reproduced the corresponding centralized result, compared with 78.3% retained under independent suppression. A capability-change experiment showed fewer candidate checks and replies and no unsupported requests when current site-agent state was used. The results demonstrate the feasibility of federated KPI aggregation under local privacy constraints through coordinated granularity selection and agent-based coordination.

zh_title: 具有本地隐私约束和协调OLAP上卷的联邦KPI聚合
translation: 跨组织KPI分析可能需要来自独立管理的数据仓库的聚合结果，而无需集中详细记录。为了限制来自小型本地群组的信息泄露，站点可以在为群组发布KPI值之前要求最少数量的贡献记录。如果每个站点独立应用此规则，不同的本地贡献可能会被抑制，从而导致组合的KPI不完整。本文研究了是否可以在发布本地查询结果之前协调OLAP粒度，以便所有站点都满足其本地最小队列规则并在相同的分析级别做出贡献。所提出的方法选择每个站点都能接受的最小泛化公共上卷。站点代理在独立管理的站点之间协调当前能力和批准的本地执行，隐私检查和聚合计算保持为确定性的本地函数。在一个四站点的原型中，协调的上卷保留了所有贡献并重现了相应的集中式结果，而独立抑制下的保留率为78.3%。能力变更实验表明，当使用当前的站点代理状态时，候选检查和回复更少，并且没有不受支持的请求。结果证明了在本地隐私约束下，通过协调粒度选择和基于代理的协调来实现联邦KPI聚合的可行性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于代理协调的OLAP上卷方法，解决了跨组织联邦KPI聚合中因独立隐私限制导致数据丢失的问题。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种在本地隐私约束下进行联邦KPI聚合的方法，通过协调OLAP层级（Roll-Ups）避免了独立抑制导致的组合KPI不完整问题，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 跨组织KPI分析需要在不集中详细记录的情况下从独立管理的数据仓库中获取聚合结果，但各站点独立应用最少队列规则会导致本地贡献被抑制，组合KPI不完整。
method: 提出了一种选择所有站点都能接受的最小泛化公共上卷的方法，利用站点代理在独立管理的站点之间协调当前能力和批准的本地执行，隐私检查和聚合计算保持为确定性的本地函数。
results: 在四站点原型中，协调上卷保留了所有贡献并重现了中心化结果（而独立抑制仅保留了78.3%）；能力变更实验表明，使用当前站点代理状态时，候选检查和回复更少，且没有不受支持的请求。
conclusion: 通过协调的粒度选择和基于代理的协调，在满足本地隐私约束的同时实现联邦KPI聚合是完全可行且高效的。

title: SCATR-ITS: a scalable transformer for large-area individual tree segmentation from LiDAR point clouds
authors: Lassi Ruoppa, Verneri Seppänen, Antero Kukko, Juha Hyyppä
abstract: Individual tree segmentation (ITS) from LiDAR point clouds is one of the most widely studied segmentation tasks in forestry. Although deep learning methods define the state of the art on the majority of ITS benchmarks, their high computational complexity and long runtime currently prevent their adoption in large-scale operational workflows. In this work, we present SCATR-ITS, a scalable transformer model specifically designed for efficient ITS over large geographical areas. Based on the ForestFormer3D framework, SCATR-ITS transitions to superpoint-level processing to accelerate inference, with the superpoints constructed from learned embeddings. The architecture incorporates size-aware superpoint-level postprocessing, a dynamic query count module to handle high variation in forest structure, and a maximal input stride designed to minimize prediction redundancy. SCATR-ITS achieves accuracy on par with the state of the art on the FGI-EMIT and FOR-InstanceV2 datasets with an up to 8.5$\times$ higher inference speed. In addition, SCATR-ITS has a significantly lower GPU VRAM footprint during both training and inference, and exhibits excellent zero-shot generalization across multiple datasets. To demonstrate large-area ITS capabilities, SCATR-ITS is applied to a 142 km$^2$ region of Finnish national laser scanning data where it achieves an average throughput of 13.8 min/km$^2$, $\sim$18.6$\times$ faster than ForestFormer3D and approaching the speed of the unsupervised watershed algorithm, which it vastly outperforms in accuracy and segment quality. Overall, SCATR-ITS delivers state-of-the-art accuracy at speeds where operational-scale adoption becomes viable, paving the way toward countrywide deployment. The source code for SCATR-ITS and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/ruoppa/scatr_its.
zh_title: SCATR-ITS：一种用于LiDAR点云大区域单木分割的可扩展Transformer模型
translation: 基于LiDAR点云的单木分割（ITS）是林业中最广泛研究的分割任务之一。尽管深度学习方法在大多数ITS基准测试中代表了当前的技术前沿，但其高计算复杂度和长时间的运行阻碍了它们在大规模业务工作流中的采用。在这项工作中，我们提出了SCATR-ITS，这是一种专门设计用于大地理区域高效ITS的可扩展Transformer模型。基于ForestFormer3D框架，SCATR-ITS转变为超点级处理以加速推理，超点由学习到的嵌入构建。该架构结合了大小感知的超点级后处理、用于处理森林结构高度变化的动态查询模块，以及旨在最小化预测冗余的最大输入步幅。SCATR-ITS在FGI-EMIT和FOR-InstanceV2数据集上达到了与当前最先进技术相当的精度，推理速度提升高达8.5倍。此外，SCATR-ITS在训练和推理期间具有显着更低的GPU显存占用，并在多个数据集上表现出优异的零样本泛化能力。为了证明大区域ITS能力，SCATR-ITS被应用于芬兰国家激光扫描数据的142平方公里区域，实现了13.8分钟/平方公里的平均吞吐量，比ForestFormer3D快约18.6倍，接近无监督分水岭算法的速度，同时在精度和分割质量上远远超过后者。总体而言，SCATR-ITS以业务化规模应用可行的速度提供了最先进的精度，为全国范围的部署铺平了道路。SCATR-ITS的源代码和预训练权重可在https://github.com/ruoppa/scatr_its获取。
tldr: 提出了一种名为SCATR-ITS的可扩展Transformer模型，实现了LiDAR点云的大规模、高精度且超高速的单木分割。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将Transformer架构应用于大规模LiDAR点云单木分割（ITS），通过超点级处理、动态查询计数等技术在保持SOTA精度的同时大幅提升了推理速度和降低了显存占用，对实现国家尺度的森林资源清查具有重要意义。
motivation: 虽然深度学习方法在单木分割（ITS）基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，但其高计算复杂度和长时间的运行限制了其在大规模业务化工作流中的应用。
method: 基于ForestFormer3D框架，采用基于学习嵌入构建的超点级处理来加速推理；结合大小感知超点级后处理、用于处理复杂森林结构的动态查询计数模块，以及最小化预测冗余的最大输入步幅。
results: 在FGI-EMIT和FOR-InstanceV2数据集上达到了与当前最先进技术相当的精度，推理速度提高了多达8.5倍，GPU显存占用显著降低，并展现出优秀的零样本泛化能力；在142平方公里的芬兰国家激光扫描数据测试中，平均吞吐量达到13.8分钟/平方公里，比ForestFormer3D快约18.6倍。
conclusion: SCATR-ITS实现了高精度与高运行效率的平衡，为大范围乃至全国尺度的LiDAR单木分割业务化应用铺平了道路。

title: Littlestone Dimension and Its Dual
authors: Pooya Hatami, Chavdar Lalov
abstract: The dual Littlestone dimension of a concept class $\mathcal{H}\subseteq\{0,1\}^{\mathcal{X}}$, $\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H}):=\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H}^*)$, is the Littlestone dimension of the dual class $\mathcal{H}^*$, obtained by exchanging the roles of domain points and hypotheses. A classical result of Shelah implies that $\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})$ and $\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H})$ are finite simultaneously, and quantitative results of Hodges [Mathematika, 1981] imply the doubly exponential bound $\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})\le 2^{2^{O(\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H}))}}$. Malliaris and Moran [Trans. Amer. Math. Soc., 2024] asked whether this bound is optimal. We answer this by proving the improved bound \[ \operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})\le 2^{O(\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H})^2)}. \] An exponential dependence is necessary, as witnessed by the class of all binary hypotheses on a finite domain.
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, main theorem bound improved
translation: 概念类 $\mathcal{H}\subseteq\{0,1\}^{\mathcal{X}}$ 的对偶 Littlestone 维数 $\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H}):=\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H}^*)$ 是通过交换域中点和假设的角色所得到的对偶类 $\mathcal{H}^*$ 的 Littlestone 维数。Shelah 的一个经典结果表明 $\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})$ 和 $\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H})$ 是同时有穷的，而 Hodges [Mathematika, 1981] 的定量结果暗示了双重指数界限 $\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})\le 2^{2^{O(\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H}))}}$。Malliaris 和 Moran [Trans. Amer. Math. Soc., 2024] 提出了该界限是否最优的问题。通过证明改进的界限 $\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})\le 2^{O(\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H})^2)}$，我们回答了这个问题。对于有限域上所有二进制假设构成的类，指数依赖是必要的。
tldr: 本文将 Littlestone 维数与其对偶维数之间的双重指数界限改进为更紧的单指数界限，并证明了指数依赖的必要性。
ai_comments: 该论文解决了 Malliaris 和 Moran 提出的关于对偶 Littlestone 维数界限的开放性问题，将原先的双重指数界限改进为了单指数界限，并通过具体例子证明了指数依赖的必要性，具有重要的理论价值。
motivation: 回答 Malliaris 和 Moran 提出的关于对偶 Littlestone 维数双重指数界限是否最优的开放性问题。
method: 通过理论分析和数学证明，建立了概念类的 Littlestone 维数与其对偶维数之间的改进界限，并构造特定类验证了指数依赖的必要性。
results: 证明了改进的界限 $\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})\le 2^{O(\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H})^2)}$，并证明了指数依赖是不可避免的。
conclusion: 本文证明了 Littlestone 维数与其对偶维数之间存在改进的单指数界限 $\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})\le 2^{O(\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H})^2)}$，从而回答了一个开放性问题，并表明指数依赖是必要的。

title: Coherence by Construction: Synthesizing CTI Knowledge Graphs and the Formal Limits of Coherence Validation
authors: Tanzimul Alam Fahim, Mohammad Arif Hossain
abstract: Synthesizing relational training data such as knowledge graphs with a large language model typically emits structured objects one at a time, which keeps each object valid but leaves the relationships between them ungrounded. We study an alternative paradigm, generation by simulation: rather than describing a relational artifact, we simulate a process that produces it and take the artifact to be its causal record. Language-model agents propose intent and a deterministic referee resolves outcomes against an explicit world model, so a relation is emitted only when the event it represents occurs, making coherence a property of construction. We instantiate the paradigm for cyber threat intelligence knowledge graphs in the STIX 2.1 standard with three engines, among them an evolutionary engine applying language-model genetic operators to structured graph genomes, sharing a deterministic compiler that makes malformed and dangling output unrepresentable. We prove referential closure, causal grounding, and identifier stability, an ablation localizes each to the referee and world model rather than the policy, and two independent LLM judges reproduce the rubric's engine ranking. Our central result is cautionary, and we prove it: a validator reading any graph feature set a structure-matched random graph can reproduce is uninformative about coherence for a coherence-by-construction generator. Using Erdős-Rényi controls we realize the theorem four times, as structural separation, embedding transfer, inductive link prediction, and real-data augmentation each reward a triviality rather than coherence; we give the mechanism behind each and the conditions a valid benchmark must meet.
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures. Includes supplementary material (Sections S-I through S-X)
zh_title: 构造性相干：合成CTI知识图谱与相干性验证的形式化极限
translation: 使用大语言模型合成诸如知识图谱等关系型训练数据时，通常是一次输出一个结构化对象，这使得每个对象保持有效，但对象之间的关系却缺乏根据。我们研究了一种替代范式——通过模拟生成：我们不是描述一个关系型人工制品，而是模拟一个生产它的过程，并将该人工制品视为其因果记录。语言模型智能体提出意图，确定性裁判根据显式世界模型解析结果，因此只有在它所代表的事件发生时才会发出关系，从而使相干性成为构造的一个属性。我们在STIX 2.1标准下通过三个引擎实例化了这一范式用于网络威胁情报知识图谱，其中包括一个将语言模型遗传算子应用于结构图基因组的进化引擎，它们共享一个确定性的编译器，使得畸形和悬空的输出无法被表示。我们证明了引用闭包、因果基础和标识符稳定性，消融实验将这些特性定位在裁判和世界模型而非策略中，两个独立的大语言模型裁判重现了评分标准的引擎排名。我们的核心结果具有警示性，并且我们对此进行了证明：任何读取结构匹配随机图能够重现的图特征集的验证器，对于一个通过构造保证相干性的生成器来说，在相干性方面是无信息的。利用Erdős-Rényi对照，我们四次实现了该定理，即结构分离、嵌入迁移、归纳链接预测和真实数据增强都奖励了琐碎性而非相干性；我们给出了每个机制背后的原理以及有效基准必须满足的条件。
tldr: 提出了一种构造相干知识图谱的新模拟生成范式，并证明了传统结构验证方法对该类图无效的理论定理。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种通过模拟过程来构建网络威胁情报知识图谱的新范式，并通过构造保证了图的相干性。同时，论文给出了一个深刻的警示性理论结果：任何基于结构匹配随机图特征的验证器都无法有效区分相干性，这为未来的图生成与验证基准设计提供了重要的理论约束。
motivation: 大语言模型合成知识图谱等关系型训练数据时通常逐个生成结构化对象，这虽然保证了每个对象的有效性，但无法保证对象之间关系的根基性。为此，需要研究一种能够保证相干性的新范式。
method: 提出生成通过模拟（generation by simulation）范式，利用语言模型智能体提出意图，结合确定性裁判和显式世界模型在STIX 2.1标准下合成网络威胁情报知识图谱，包含一种应用遗传算子的进化引擎；并从理论上证明了引用闭包、因果基础和标识符稳定性。
results: 证明了引用闭包、因果基础和标识符稳定性；消融实验表明这些特性来源于裁判和世界模型；中心结果证明了基于结构匹配随机图特征的验证器在相干性上是无信息的，并通过Erdős-Rényi对照实验在四个方面证实了该定理。
conclusion: 通过模拟生成的“构造性相干”范式可以有效解决大语言模型生成关系数据的无根基问题，但现有的结构特征验证方法对该类生成图是无效的，必须设计满足新条件的有效基准。

title: Decomposing images in a PRISM: A Single-Source Multi-View Framework for Image Representation
authors: Eduardo Campos, Willam Cardoso, Diego Furtado, Solange Oliveira, Alneu Lopes
abstract: Multi-view learning has shown that combining complementary views can improve predictive performance, yet many datasets provide a single raw source of information. How can multiple useful views be constructed from one source? We propose PRISM (Plural Representations of Images via Structural Maps), a framework that transforms an image into representations with distinct inductive biases through explicit structural maps, together with a protocol for measuring what each view contributes. We evaluate PRISM-HD, a hand-designed instantiation of PRISM in which the constructed views are summarized through representation-specific descriptors, on three artistic and four non-artistic image datasets. Analyses at a fixed feature budget show that the gains of the structural views are not explained by feature dimensionality alone. PRISM-HD by itself outperforms WND-CHARM on all seven datasets. Moreover, PRISM-HD and Fisher Vector provide complementary predictive signals: their equal-weight combination improves over the better individual representation by 5--8 percentage points on the artistic datasets. When combined with fine-tuned deep networks through a fixed parameter-free fusion rule, the PRISM-based representation improves performance on four of seven datasets and leaves it statistically unchanged on the remaining three, indicating that the constructed views provide predictive signals that are complementary to learned deep representations.
zh_title: 在PRISM中分解图像：用于图像表示的单源多视图框架
translation: 多视图学习表明，结合互补的视图可以提高预测性能，然而许多数据集只提供单一的原始信息源。如何从一个源构建多个有用的视图？我们提出了PRISM（通过结构图的图像多元表示）框架，该框架通过显式结构图将图像转换为具有不同归纳偏置的表示，并配有一套用于衡量每个视图贡献的协议。我们在三个艺术和四个非艺术图像数据集上评估了PRISM-HD（PRISM的手工设计实例），其中构建的视图通过特定于表示的描述符进行总结。在固定特征预算下的分析表明，结构视图的增益不能仅仅用特征维度来解释。PRISM-HD本身在所有七个数据集上都优于WND-CHARM。此外，PRISM-HD和Fisher Vector提供了互补的预测信号：它们的等权重组合在艺术数据集上比表现更好的单一表示提高了5-8个百分点。当通过固定的无参数融合规则与微调的深度网络相结合时，基于PRISM的表示在七个数据集中的四个上提高了性能，在其余三个上保持统计学上的不变，这表明构建的视图提供了与学习到的深度表示相互补的预测信号。
tldr: 提出PRISM框架，将单张图像通过显式结构图分解为多个互补的多视图表示，有效提升了图像分类和预测性能。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种从单一图像源构建多视图的框架（PRISM），通过显式结构图转换图像以获得具有不同归纳偏置的表示。实验证明，该方法在艺术和非艺术数据集上均能提供与深度学习特征互补的强预测信号。
motivation: 多视图学习能够提升预测性能，但许多数据集仅提供单一的原始信息源，因此亟需探索如何从单一源构建多个有用的视图。
method: 提出PRISM框架，将图像通过显式结构图转换为具有不同归纳偏置的表示，并评估其手工设计实例PRISM-HD。
results: 在固定特征预算下，PRISM-HD在七个数据集上均优于WND-CHARM；与Fisher Vector或微调的深度网络结合时，能显著提升预测性能，证明了其预测信号的互补性。
conclusion: PRISM框架成功地从单源图像中构建出具有互补预测能力的多个结构视图，不仅自身表现优异，还能与传统特征及深度学习表示有效融合。

title: TOUMAII: A 4.5M-Pair Tool-Calling Preference Dataset and Its Source-Agnostic Generator
authors: Moritz Pötzsch, Andrea Gentilini, Lisa Rossgoderer, Tom Osterfeld, Kesava Prasad Sanjivi Arul, Swanand Ravindra Kadhe
abstract:
To autonomously execute multi-step tasks, enterprise agents must reliably interact with tools, call APIs, or query databases, making tool-calling a fundamental capability of AI models. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) optimises for producing the correct call, but never contrasts it with a plausible incorrect one. In an environment where even a minor formatting error can invalidate a call and an incorrect decision can derail the interaction, direct preference optimisation (DPO) targets exactly this contrast. DPO, therefore, requires preference pairs rather than plain demonstrations. For tool-calling, such data, especially in realistic multi-turn settings, remains extremely scarce. To address this scarcity, we introduce TOUMAII, a large-scale tool-calling preference dataset containing ~4.5M validated preference pairs, derived from Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M (apache-2.0) conversations. The dataset consists of multi- and single-turn interactions and includes parallel and sequential function calls. Additionally, we release TOUMAII-Gen, a synthetic data generation pipeline that consumes tool-calling SFT datasets and generates a preference dataset with naturally occurring model-generated tool-calling failure modes. To validate the effectiveness of our DPO data, we fine-tune a 3-billion-parameter model, achieving performance parity with other high-quality tool-calling preference datasets. Furthermore, we release a second small preference dataset derived from ToolACE (apache-2.0), showcasing the source-agnostic nature of our pipeline.
  We release the complete code and datasets: https://github.com/tum-ai/toumaii-gen and https://huggingface.co/collections/tum-ai/toumaii-generated-datasets
comment: Accepted to the 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET) at NeurIPS 2026. 27 pages, including 5 pages of main text, references, and appendices; 17 figures and 7 tables. Code: https://github.com/tum-ai/toumaii-gen. Datasets: https://huggingface.co/collections/tum-ai/toumaii-generated-datasets
zh_title: TOUMAII：一个450万对的工具调用偏好数据集及其源无关生成器
translation: 为了自主执行多步骤任务，企业智能体必须可靠地与工具交互、调用API或查询数据库，这使得工具调用成为AI模型的基本能力。监督微调（SFT）优化了正确调用的生成，但从未将其与貌似合理但错误的调用进行对比。在即使是微小的格式错误也会使调用失效、错误的决策也会破坏交互的环境中，直接偏好优化（DPO）正是针对这种对比。因此，DPO需要偏好对而不是单纯的示范。对于工具调用而言，此类数据（尤其是在现实的多轮设置中）仍然极其稀缺。为了解决这种稀缺性，我们推出了TOUMAII，这是一个大规模的工具调用偏好数据集，包含约450万个经过验证的偏好对，这些偏好对源自Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M（apache-2.0）对话。该数据集包含多轮和单轮交互，并包括并行和顺序函数调用。此外，我们发布了TOUMAII-Gen，这是一个合成数据生成管道，它消费工具调用SFT数据集，并生成包含自然发生的模型生成的工具调用失败模式的偏好数据集。为了验证我们的DPO数据的有效性，我们对一个30亿参数的模型进行了微调，实现了与其它高质量工具调用偏好数据集相当的性能。此外，我们发布了源自ToolACE（apache-2.0）的第二个小型偏好数据集，展示了我们管道的源无关特性。我们发布了完整的代码和数据集：https://github.com/tum-ai/toumaii-gen 和 https://huggingface.co/collections/tum-ai/toumaii-generated-datasets
tldr: 推出了包含450万对偏好数据的TOUMAII数据集及生成管道TOUMAII-Gen，有效提升了AI模型的工具调用能力。
ai_comments: 该论文针对企业级AI代理在工具调用（Tool-Calling）中高质量偏好数据匮乏的痛点，提出了包含450万对偏好数据的TOUMAII数据集以及通用的生成管道TOUMAII-Gen，能够有效通过DPO提升模型工具调用能力，具有很高的实用价值和开源贡献。
motivation: 企业级智能体需要可靠的工具调用能力来执行多步骤任务，传统的监督微调（SFT）无法对比错误调用，而直接偏好优化（DPO）所需的真实多轮工具调用偏好数据极其稀缺，因此需要大规模的工具调用偏好数据集及通用的生成方案。
method: 开发了TOUMAII-Gen合成数据生成管道，利用现有的工具调用SFT数据集生成包含自然发生的模型工具调用失败模式的偏好数据集，并构建了包含450万对验证偏好对的TOUMAII数据集，随后对30亿参数模型进行了DPO微调。
results: 微调后的30亿参数模型达到了与现有高质量工具调用偏好数据集相当的性能水平，并且通过另一个从ToolACE派生的小型数据集验证了该生成管道的源无关（source-agnostic）特性。
conclusion: 论文通过推出TOUMAII数据集和TOUMAII-Gen生成管道，有效解决了工具调用偏好数据稀缺的问题，实验证明了该数据集在提升模型工具调用能力方面的有效性。

title: Cross-Attack Robust Aggregation for Federated Learning
authors: Eyhab Al-Masri
abstract: Federated learning (FL) lets resource-constrained IoT and edge devices train a shared model without exchanging raw data, but compromised or faulty devices can poison the global model. Existing robust aggregators each fail in some regime: naive averaging (FedAvg) collapses under high-magnitude attacks, whereas distance- and statistics-based defenses (Krum, median, trimmed mean) sacrifice accuracy on non-IID data and remain vulnerable to stealthy attacks. We present FedTether, which reweights client updates by their deviation from a coordinatewise median through a robust, dead-zoned score applied as a server-side optimizer step. Across three datasets, three attack types, and Byzantine fractions up to 40%, FedTether is the only method top-tier in every regime: it matches FedAvg under stealthy attacks with no robustness tax, exceeds robust baselines by up to 42 accuracy points, and stays accurate where high-magnitude attacks reduce FedAvg to near-random. These properties persist at 50 clients under partial participation, with no shared data or validation set.
zh_title: 面向联邦学习的跨攻击鲁棒聚合方法
translation: 联邦学习（FL）允许资源受限的物联网和边缘设备在不交换原始数据的情况下训练共享模型，但受损或故障设备可能会对全局模型进行投毒。现有的鲁棒聚合器在某些情况下均会失效：朴素平均法（FedAvg）在高幅攻击下崩溃，而基于距离和统计的防御方法（Krum、中位数、截尾均值）则会牺牲非IID数据的准确性，且对隐蔽攻击依然脆弱。我们提出了FedTether，它通过应用稳健的、带死区的评分机制（作为服务器端优化步骤），根据客户端更新与坐标中位数的偏差对其进行重新加权。在三个数据集、三种攻击类型以及高达40%的拜占庭比例下，FedTether是唯一在每种情况下都处于顶尖的方法：它在隐蔽攻击下与FedAvg相匹配且没有鲁棒性税，比鲁棒基线高出多达42个准确率百分点，并在高幅攻击将FedAvg降至接近随机水平时保持准确性。这些特性在50个客户端且部分参与的情况下依然保持，且无需共享数据或验证集。
tldr: FedTether是一种新型联邦学习鲁棒聚合方法，能在不牺牲非IID数据准确率的前提下，有效抵御各种高幅和隐蔽的拜占庭攻击。
ai_comments: FedTether是一种新颖的联邦学习跨攻击鲁棒聚合方法，通过结合坐标中位数偏差和带有死区的评分机制，有效地平衡了鲁棒性与非IID数据下的准确性，解决了现有方法在不同攻击域下表现不一的痛点。
motivation: 现有的鲁棒聚合方法在面对不同攻击（如高幅攻击或隐蔽攻击）时各有缺陷，且在非IID数据上往往会牺牲准确率，因此需要一种能够跨攻击保持鲁棒性的通用聚合方法。
method: 提出FedTether，在服务器端优化步骤中应用稳健的、带死区的评分机制，根据客户端更新与坐标中位数的偏差重新为其加权。
results: 在多种数据集、攻击类型以及高达40%的拜占庭节点比例下，FedTether在所有测试场景中均表现优异，无鲁棒性税，且较传统鲁棒基线最高可提升42个准确率百分点。
conclusion: FedTether能够有效抵御多种类型的拜占庭攻击，在保持联邦学习隐私性的同时，实现了极高的鲁棒性与模型准确率。

title: INCISE: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation of Surgical Videos
authors: Yifan Xu, Bofang Zheng, Guangyu Meng, Nishchal Sapkota, Xianshi Ma, Xu Cao, Tianjiao Yu, Danny Z Chen
abstract: Surgical video analysis requires video object segmentation (VOS), yet existing methods are commonly based on pretrained model fine-tuning using a large number of expert labels. In-context segmentation (ICS) offers the promise of bypassing this high cost by segmenting a target video using a few annotated references, which are the sole source of surgical knowledge for a frozen model. However, existing ICS methods tend to draw such references at random, which concentrate on a few views that dominate a surgical video and can miss other objects of interest (e.g., transient instruments and small structures). To address these challenges, we propose INCISE, a training-free ICS framework for surgical videos. INCISE selects unlabeled frames from multiple surgical videos that jointly cover the local appearances of a target video, and then segments the target video using these references. With only 1.7% of training frames selected and annotated as references and no target video frame labeled, INCISE obtains 67.2% mean mIoU and outperforms the best SOTA fine-tuned method by 9.2 points. We hope INCISE can help establish ICS as a practical alternative to fine-tuning in surgical video analysis and other domains with a costly labeling burden.
zh_title: INCISE：手术视频的无需训练上下文分割
translation: 手术视频分析需要视频对象分割（VOS），然而现有方法通常基于使用大量专家标签的预训练模型微调。上下文分割（ICS）通过使用少量带注释的参考资料来分割目标视频，有望绕过这一高昂的成本，这些参考资料是冻结模型的唯一手术知识来源。然而，现有的ICS方法倾向于随机抽取这些参考资料，这些参考资料集中在支配手术视频的少数视图上，可能会错过其他感兴趣的对象（例如瞬态器械和微小结构）。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了INCISE，一个用于手术视频的无需训练的ICS框架。INCISE从多个手术视频中选择未标记的帧，这些帧共同覆盖目标视频的局部外观，然后使用这些参考资料分割目标视频。仅选择1.7%的训练帧并将其注释为参考资料且不标记目标视频帧，INCISE获得了67.2%的平均mIoU，并且比最佳SOTA微调方法高出9.2个百分点。我们希望INCISE能够帮助将ICS确立为微调的实用替代方案，用于手术视频分析和其他具有高标注负担的领域。
tldr: INCISE提出了一种无需训练的手术视频上下文分割方法，仅用极少量的参考帧标注便大幅超越了现有微调方法的性能。
ai_comments: 本文提出了一种无需训练的上下文手术视频分割框架INCISE，通过精心挑选多视频中的参考帧，显著降低了对手术视频标注的依赖，并超越了现有的微调SOTA方法，具有很高的实用价值和创新性。
motivation: 现有的手术视频对象分割（VOS）方法通常依赖于大量专家标注进行预训练模型微调，成本高昂。现有的上下文分割（ICS）方法随机抽取参考帧，往往会忽略瞬态器械和微小结构等目标。为此，需要一种更高效、能全面覆盖局部外观的无需训练框架。
method: 提出INCISE框架，从多个手术视频中选择无标签帧并进行标注作为参考，这些参考帧共同覆盖目标视频的局部外观，从而在冻结模型的情况下对目标视频进行分割。
results: 仅使用1.7%的训练帧作为参考帧且无需目标视频帧进行标注，INCISE取得了67.2%的平均mIoU，比最佳的SOTA微调方法高出9.2个百分点。
conclusion: INCISE证明了无需训练的上下文分割（ICS）在手术视频分析中可以作为一种实用且优于微调方法的替代方案，大幅降低了标注成本并提升了分割性能。

title: Learning under Bounded Manipulation for Quadratic Incentive Design
authors: Arda Güçlü, Subhonmesh Bose, Tamer Başar
abstract: We study a repeated quadratic incentive design game in which a leader learns a follower's private type from noisy observations of the follower's actions and uses her estimates in an affine incentive rule. The follower knows the leader's learning policy, which incorporates past observations to produce estimates of the follower's type, and can deviate from his myopic best response to influence the leader's future estimates. We ask how the follower's ability to manipulate these observations affects the leader's performance. Under a manipulation budget $C_T$ constraining the expected cumulative squared deviation of the follower's actions from his myopic best response, we establish a minimax regret rate of order $\max\{\log T, \min\{C_T,T\}\}$ for approximately rational followers. Our information-theoretic lower bound applies to a general class of causal estimation and manipulation policies for the leader and the follower. We provide a simple learning policy that achieves the lower bound. Finally, we show that under a fixed learning rule, increasing the manipulation budget of the follower can counterintuitively reduce the leader's regret.
zh_title: 二次激励设计下有界操纵的学习
translation: 我们研究了一个重复的二次激励设计博弈，其中领导者从追随者行动的噪声观测中学习追随者的私有类型，并在仿射激励规则中使用她的估计。追随者了解领导者的学习策略（该策略结合了过去的观测来生成对追随者类型的估计），并且可以偏离其短视最优反应来影响领导者未来的估计。我们探讨了追随者操纵这些观测的能力如何影响领导者的性能。在一个约束了追随者行动与其短视最优反应之间预期累积平方偏差的操纵预算 $C_T$ 下，我们为近似理性的追随者确立了 $\max\{\log T, \min\{C_T,T\}\}$ 阶的极小极大遗憾率。我们基于信息论的下限适用于领导者和追随者的一类一般性因果估计与操纵策略。我们提供了一个能够达到该下限的简单学习策略。最后，我们表明在固定的学习规则下，增加追随者的操纵预算可能会反直觉地减少领导者的遗憾。
tldr: 论文研究了追随者具有操纵行为下的二次激励设计学习问题，推导出了极小极大遗憾率，并发现增加操纵预算可能反直觉地降低遗憾。
ai_comments: 该论文在重复博弈和激励设计中引入了有限操纵的约束（通过累积偏差预算），创新性地建立了一个极小极大遗憾率，并揭示了增加操纵预算可能反而减少领袖遗憾的反直觉现象。对机制设计和在线学习具有重要意义。
motivation: 研究在重复二次激励设计博弈中，当追随者能够战略性地偏离其短视最优反应以影响领导者未来的估计时（即存在有界操纵能力），这种操纵能力如何影响领导者的性能。
method: 研究了一个领导者-追随者重复博弈模型，其中领导者采用仿射激励规则并通过含噪声的观测来学习追随者的私有类型，追随者具有累积平方偏差的有界操纵预算，并建立了一类因果估计与操纵策略的信息论下限，同时提出了一个匹配该下限的简单学习策略。
results: 建立了针对近似理性追随者的 $\max\{\log T, \min\{C_T,T\}\}$ 阶极小极大遗憾率，证明了该下限适用于通用的因果估计与操纵策略，提出了实现该下限的简单学习策略，并发现增加追随者的操纵预算有时会反直觉地降低领导者的遗憾。
conclusion: 在有限操纵预算下，论文确定了二次激励设计的最优遗憾阶，并发现了操纵预算与领袖遗憾之间的非单调反直觉关系。

title: Exploring Early Vulnerability Analysis via Automatic Identification of Vulnerability-Introducing Commits
authors: Weiliang Qi, Shu Wang, Youpeng Li, Ela Guo, Xinda Wang
abstract: Developing effective vulnerability analysis techniques requires high-quality datasets that capture how vulnerabilities appear and evolve in real software codebase. Existing datasets, however, typically label as vulnerable only the code immediately preceding vulnerability-fixing commits (VFCs), overlooking the earlier versions in which vulnerabilities were first introduced and subsequently evolved. This practice limits both dataset coverage and our understanding of whether current detectors can identify vulnerabilities during their early, latent stages. In this paper, we present three manually annotated datasets of vulnerability-introducing commits (VICs) based on recent CVEs and widely used open-source projects. We further propose D-SZZ, a data state-aware VIC identification framework that analyzes security-fixing patterns and performs vulnerability scope slicing to recover the semantics implied by a fix. Experimental results demonstrate that D-SZZ outperforms existing SZZ and LLM-based baselines in identifying VICs. In addition, we evaluate six representative vulnerability detectors and find that models trained only on pre-VFC code struggle with original vulnerabilities, while incorporating early-stage samples improves detection performance. We also show that D-SZZ improves downstream vulnerable-version identification, and use it to uncover 16 inaccurate affected-version records in the NVD, all of which were officially confirmed and updated.
comment: Accepted at the 42nd Annual Computer Security Applications Conference (ACSAC 2026)
zh_title: 通过自动识别引入漏洞的提交探索早期漏洞分析
translation: 开发有效的漏洞分析技术需要高质量的数据集，以捕捉漏洞在真实代码库中的出现和演化过程。然而，现有数据集通常仅将漏洞修复提交（VFC）前的代码标记为漏洞代码，忽略了最初引入漏洞及随后演化的早期版本。这种做法限制了数据集的覆盖范围，也阻碍了我们对当前检测器是否能在漏洞早期潜伏阶段识别它们的理解。在本文中，我们基于近期的 CVE 和广泛使用的开源项目，提出了三个关于引入漏洞提交（VIC）的手工标注数据集。我们进一步提出了 D-SZZ，一个数据状态感知的 VIC 识别框架，它通过分析安全修复模式并执行漏洞范围切片来恢复修复所隐含的语义。实验结果表明，D-SZZ 在识别 VIC 方面优于现有的 SZZ 和基于大模型的基线。此外，我们评估了六个具有代表性的漏洞检测器，发现仅在 pre-VFC 代码上训练的模型很难识别原始漏洞，而纳入早期阶段的样本可以提高检测性能。我们还表明，D-SZZ 改进了下游漏洞版本识别，并利用它发现了 NVD 中的 16 个不准确的影响版本记录，所有这些记录都已得到官方确认和更新。
tldr: 本文提出了 D-SZZ 框架来自动识别引入漏洞的提交（VIC），弥补了传统数据集忽视漏洞早期演化阶段的缺陷，并通过实验证明早期漏洞样本能显著提升检测器性能。

motivation: 现有的漏洞数据集通常仅将紧邻漏洞修复提交（VFC）之前的代码标记为漏洞代码，忽略了漏洞最初引入及演化的早期版本，这限制了数据集的覆盖范围以及对检测器早期漏洞识别能力的理解。
method: 提出三个基于近期 CVE 和开源项目的手工标注 VIC 数据集，并设计了 D-SZZ 框架（一种分析安全修复模式并执行漏洞范围切片的数据状态感知 VIC 识别框架）。
results: 实验表明，D-SZZ 在识别 VIC 方面优于现有的 SZZ 和大模型基线；将早期阶段样本纳入训练可提高检测性能；同时利用 D-SZZ 发现了 NVD 中 16 条不准确的影响版本记录，并全部得到官方确认和更新。

title: SparseHPS: A Unified Model for Human Pose and Shape across Depth Cameras and LiDARs
authors: Ilya Zaychuk
abstract: Recovering 3D human pose and shape from point clouds is central to motion capture, robotics and self-driving vehicles, because depth cameras and LiDARs sense a person directly in metric 3D and work under any lighting. However, current approaches are each tailored to one sensor type: point density differs by more than ten times between devices, public datasets are labeled with incompatible body models, and LiDAR approaches need long input sequences to offset sparse scans. In this work, we present SparseHPS, a novel sensor-agnostic network that recovers SMPL-X pose, shape and global translation from a human point cloud with one set of weights, for single frames and streams alike. Specifically, SparseHPS encodes the cloud with a LitePT backbone over sparse voxels, represents every joint by a learnable query decoded with one common head, localizes the body by voting over voxels, and draws temporal context from a causal memory of tokens from the seven preceding frames. A single model is trained on ten datasets that mix rendered clouds with real depth-camera and LiDAR captures, all converted to one body model. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art results on the SLOPER4D and FreeMotion LiDAR benchmarks, where SparseHPS lowers the root-relative joint error by 22% and 11%, respectively, compared with the strongest prior method, which needs 32 frames. On real Azure Kinect captures of held-out HuMMan subjects, SparseHPS attains a joint error of 34.7 mm. Moreover, the current frame alone already yields the bulk of this accuracy.
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://ghostlate.github.io/SparseHPS
zh_title: SparseHPS：跨深度相机与激光雷达的人体姿态与形状统一模型
translation: 从点云中恢复3D人体姿态和形状对于动作捕捉、机器人和自动驾驶至关重要，因为深度相机和激光雷达能够直接在度量3D空间中感知人体且不受光照限制。然而，当前的方法大多针对单一传感器类型量身定制：不同设备的点密度差异超过十倍，公开数据集标注了不兼容的身体模型，且激光雷达方法需要长输入序列来弥补稀疏扫描的不足。在这项工作中，我们提出了SparseHPS，这是一个新颖的、传感器无关的网络，它使用同一组权重从单帧或流式人体点云中恢复SMPL-X姿态、形状和全局平移。具体而言，SparseHPS通过基于稀疏体素的LitePT骨干网络编码点云，用可学习的查询表示每个关节并通过一个公共头部进行解码，通过体素投票定位身体，并从前七帧的因果记忆标记中提取时序上下文。单个模型在混合了渲染点云、真实深度相机和激光雷达捕获的十个数据集上进行训练，所有数据都转换为了统一的身体模型。实验表明，SparseHPS在SLOPER4D和FreeMotion LiDAR基准测试上取得了最先进的结果，与需要32帧的最强先前方法相比，根相对关节误差分别降低了22%和11%。在对HuMMan保留受试者的真实Azure Kinect捕获数据上，SparseHPS实现了34.7毫米的关节误差。此外，仅凭当前帧就已经获得了该精度的绝大部分。
tldr: 提出了一种名为SparseHPS的统一模型，能够仅用单一权重从不同密度（深度相机和LiDAR）的点云中准确恢复3D人体姿态和形状。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种统一的、传感器无关的3D人体姿态和形状恢复模型SparseHPS，能够同时处理深度相机和LiDAR等不同点密度和传感器的点云数据，具有很强的泛化能力和实时处理潜力。

method: 使用基于稀疏体素的LitePT骨干网络对点云进行编码，通过可学习查询表示关节并由公共头部解码，通过体素投票定位身体，并利用因果记忆模块整合前七帧的时序上下文。

title: DNN-Assisted Deterministic Policy Learning for Adaptive IRS-NOMA-OWC Networks
authors: Ahrar N. Hamad, Ahmad A. Qidan, Taisir E. H. El-Gorashi, Jaafar M. H. Elmirghani
abstract: Intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) has been considered a promising technology in optical wireless communication (OWC) networks due to its potential to overcome the line-of-sight (LoS) blockage issue and enhance coverage. In this paper, a dynamic IRS-assisted indoor non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)-OWC network is modeled, and an optimization problem is formulated to maximize the sum rate subject to the quality-of-service (QoS) requirements of multiple mobile users, by jointly optimizing the power allocation and the IRS mirror orientations, from which the user's decoding order is induced rather than being fixed. Since the problem is non-convex and the channel conditions vary with user mobility, conventional optimization methods may incur considerable computational overhead. Therefore, a two-stage deep neural network-deep reinforcement learning (DNN-DRL) framework is proposed. In the first stage, the DNN estimates the user's positions and orientations in real time, removing the need for perfect knowledge of the user state. In the second stage, a deterministic policy gradient (DPG)-based DRL algorithm uses these estimates to jointly optimize the power allocation and IRS mirror orientations, with the decoding order updated according to the resulting effective channel gains. The results show that the proposed framework approaches the performance upper bounds and outperforms standard DRL algorithms, conventional optimization methods, and deployments without IRS in terms of sum rate and fairness, while achieving faster convergence. Furthermore, online adaptation of the decoding order maintains higher QoS satisfaction than a fixed decoding order, particularly under high user mobility.
zh_title: 面向自适应IRS-NOMA-OWC网络的深度神经网络辅助确定性策略学习
translation: 智能反射表面（IRS）被认为是光无线通信（OWC）网络中一项很有前途的技术，因为其具有克服视距（LoS）阻塞问题和增强覆盖范围的潜力。本文构建了一个动态IRS辅助的室内非正交多址接入（NOMA）-OWC网络，并建立了一个优化问题，通过联合优化功率分配和IRS镜面朝向来最大化满足多个移动用户服务质量（QoS）要求的和速率，其中用户的解码顺序是由系统导出的而不是固定的。由于该问题是非凸的，且信道条件随用户移动性而变化，传统优化方法可能会产生相当大的计算开销。因此，提出了一种两阶段深度神经网络-深度强化学习（DNN-DRL）框架。在第一阶段，DNN实时估计用户的位置和方向，消除了对用户状态完美知识的需求。在第二阶段，基于确定性策略梯度（DPG）的DRL算法利用这些估计值来联合优化功率分配和IRS镜面朝向，并根据由此产生的有效信道增益更新解码顺序。结果表明，所提出的框架接近性能上限，在和速率和公平性方面优于标准DRL算法、传统优化方法以及无IRS部署，同时实现了更快的收敛速度。此外，解码顺序的在线自适应比固定解码顺序保持了更高的QoS满意度，特别是在高用户移动性情况下。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于DNN-DRL的两阶段框架，用于优化动态IRS辅助的NOMA-OWC网络中的和速率与用户QoS。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种结合深度神经网络与深度强化学习（DNN-DRL）的两阶段框架，用于解决动态IRS辅助的NOMA-OWC网络中的资源分配和优化问题。创新点在于通过DNN实时估计用户状态，并利用基于确定性策略梯度的DRL算法实现功率分配与IRS镜面朝向的联合优化，同时动态更新解码顺序，有效克服了传统优化方法计算开销大和固定解码顺序的局限性。
motivation: 为了克服光无线通信（OWC）网络中视距阻塞问题，并解决由于用户移动性导致传统优化方法在动态IRS辅助NOMA-OWC网络中计算开销巨大的问题。
method: 提出了一种两阶段DNN-DRL框架：第一阶段利用DNN实时估计用户的位置和方向；第二阶段采用基于确定性策略梯度（DPG）的DRL算法，根据估计值联合优化功率 allocation 和IRS镜面朝向，并动态更新解码顺序。
results: 实验结果表明，该框架接近性能上限，在和速率和公平性方面优于标准DRL算法、传统优化方法及无IRS部署，且收敛速度更快；在线自适应解码顺序比固定解码顺序能保持更高的QoS满意度。
conclusion: 提出的DNN-DRL两阶段框架能够有效解决动态IRS-NOMA-OWC网络中的联合优化问题，在保证QoS的同时显著提升了和速率与公平性，并具有更快的收敛速度。

title: FORTH: Grounding Tactile VLA Execution via Forward-Only Proxy-Control Pairing
authors: Junde Li, Wei-Han Yu, Xiangyi Chu, Yaoxin Li, Jiawei Xu, Ka-Fai Un, Pui-In Mak
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are widely credited with force control, operating on the unverified assumption that proxy loss minimization implies physical force grounding. In this work, we demonstrate that this assumption breaks down at three core deployment levels: frozen visual backbones discard contact geometry, downstream losses mask token-level gradient alignment, and discrete indicators trigger optimization collapse. To address these disconnections, we present FORTH, a forward-only measurement harness and execution framework that explicitly pairs the optimization objective at each level with its physical control observable. FORTH incorporates three grounded pillars: a layer-local, forward-only tactile encoder that preserves spatial contact geometry without backpropagation, a token-parallel zeroth-order adapter enabling activation-space updates, and SlipGuard, a continuous tactile verification gate that fires on incipient slip. On an elasto-plastic structural shell, FORTH's closed-loop gate peaks at 29 times lower grip force than a monotone reflex ramp, preventing structural crush where the baseline leaves permanent deformation. Furthermore, FORTH matches state-of-the-art execution performance with a 97.6% average success rate across three evaluated LIBERO suites, while reducing peak activation memory by 7.12 times compared to a backpropagated step on the same backbone. Enhanced perception enables deeper physical intelligence.
comment: The code and models are open-sourced at https://github.com/Jordanlllll/FORTH
zh_title: FORTH：通过前向代理-控制配对实现触觉VLA执行的接地
translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在力控制方面受到广泛赞誉，其运作建立在“代理损失最小化暗示物理力接地”这一未经证实的假设之上。在这项工作中，我们证明了该假设在三个核心部署级别上会失效：冻结的视觉骨干网丢弃了接触几何形状，下游损失掩盖了标记级的梯度对齐，以及离散指标触发了优化崩溃。为了解决这些断层，我们提出了FORTH（一个前向测量工具和执行框架），它明确地将每个级别的优化目标与其物理控制可观测量配对。FORTH包含三个有根基的支柱：一个层局域、纯前向的触觉编码器，它在没有反向传播的情况下保留了空间接触几何形状；一个启用激活空间更新的标记并行零阶适配器；以及SlipGuard，一个在初始滑移时触发的连续触觉验证门。在弹性塑性结构壳上，FORTH的闭环门控峰值夹持力比单调反射斜坡低29倍，在基线导致永久变形的地方防止了结构压碎。此外，FORTH在三个被评估的LIBERO套件中以97.6%的平均成功率匹配了最先进的执行性能，同时与同一骨干网上的反向传播步骤相比，将峰值激活内存减少了7.12倍。增强的感知能够实现更深层的物理智能。
tldr: 提出FORTH框架，通过纯前向的触觉编码与闭环验证，解决了VLA模型在力控上的失效问题，实现了低夹持力、高成功率和低显存开销的物理交互。
ai_comments: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中“代理损失最小化即等同于物理力接地”的虚假假设，提出了FORTH框架。创新点在于通过纯前向的触觉编码器、零阶激活空间适配器和SlipGuard闭环验证门，在避免反向传播的同时大幅提升了力控精度与物理安全性。该工作对具身智能中的触觉与VLA融合具有重要意义。
motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常依赖“代理损失最小化意味着物理力接地”这一未经证实的假设，但在冻结视觉骨干网、下游损失掩盖梯度对齐以及离散指标引发优化崩溃这三个核心部署级别上，该假设会失效。
method: 提出了FORTH框架，包含三个支柱：1）保持空间接触几何形状的层局域、纯前向触觉编码器；2）实现激活空间更新的标记并行零阶适配器；3）在初始滑移时触发的SlipGuard连续触觉验证门。
results: 在弹性塑性结构壳上，FORTH的闭环门控夹持力比单调反射斜坡低29倍，避免了结构压碎；在三个LIBERO套件中平均成功率达到97.6%，同时将峰值激活显存较反向传播步骤减少了7.12倍。

title: A Metamaterial Agentic Swarm: Coordinated Search for Discrete Mechanical Design
authors: Achuth Chandrasekhar, Alexander Zhao, Amir Barati Farimani
abstract: Designing discrete metamaterial assemblies is challenging because local unit-cell choices collectively determine the global elastic response. We present Metamaterial Agentic Swarm, an island-based portfolio of forty specialized numerical search agents for unit-cell selection in a pixel-resolved mechanical cloak. Five cooperating islands each contain eight agents responsible for global sampling, spatial proposals, mutation, learning, recombination, diversity, neighborhood exploration, and polishing. Islands maintain separate parents while exchanging evaluated assignments through an elite archive and recombination. The objective is the relative exterior displacement mismatch on a supplied observation mask. Candidate designs are scored by the mismatch in exterior displacement, computed with a symmetry-reduced finite-element model at full pixel resolution.
