abstract: Federated fine-tuning of foundation models with low-rank adapters (LoRA) is typically reconciled by averaging locally trained adapters. In cross-device settings, where participants hold heterogeneous data and join or leave asynchronously, averaging is poorly suited: locally trained adapters are not identifiable up to permutation, and averages of adapters trained on dissimilar data can be uninformative or unstable. We propose a simple idea called federated library-based adaptation (LEAN), which replaces averaging altogether. The server maintains a library of rank-1 basis pairs; participants check out random subsets, fine-tune them locally as a LoRA adapter, and check them back in, so that each pair is shuffled across sites and trained on many participants' data. Because no aggregation step is required, LEAN operates fully asynchronously and communicates only low-rank parameters. We prove that, in a synchronous setting, LEAN converges to a neighborhood of a stationary point, with the shuffle canceling data heterogeneity at first order. Across image and text fine-tuning benchmarks, LEAN outperforms averaging-based baselines in most settings with substantially less communication, and remains effective under heavy data heterogeneity, where averaging-based methods fail to reach nontrivial accuracy, and under heavy asynchrony, where they degrade substantially.
zh_title: LEAN：面向异步联邦微调的基于库的自适应方法
translation: 利用低秩适配器（LoRA）对基础模型进行联邦微调，通常通过平均本地训练的适配器来协调。在跨设备设置中，参与者拥有异构数据且异步加入或离开，这种平均方式并不适用：本地训练的适配器在排列上不可识别，且在不同数据上训练的适配器的平均值可能缺乏信息量或不稳定。我们提出了一种简单的思想，称为联邦库式自适应（LEAN），它完全取代了平均操作。服务器维护一个秩-1基对库；参与者借出随机子集，将其作为LoRA适配器进行本地微调并归还，从而使每个基对在不同站点间洗牌，并在许多参与者的数据上进行训练。由于不需要聚合步骤，LEAN可以完全异步运行，并且仅通信低秩参数。我们证明了在同步设置下，LEAN收敛到平稳点的邻域，其中洗牌在一阶上消除了数据异质性。在图像和文本微调基准测试中，LEAN在大多数设置下以大大减少的通信量优于基于平均的基线，并且在基于平均的方法无法达到非平凡准确率的严重数据异质性下，以及在基于平均的方法显著退化的严重异步性下，依然保持有效。
tldr: LEAN通过维护一个秩-1基对库并在参与者间进行异步借还与训练，取代了传统的模型平均方法，从而解决了联邦微调中的数据异质性和异步性难题。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种基于库的自适应方法LEAN，彻底摒弃了传统联邦微调中的模型平均步骤，有效解决了跨设备异步设置下的数据异质性和不可识别性问题，具有极高的实用价值和理论意义。
motivation: 在跨设备联邦微调中，数据异质性和异步参与导致传统的基于平均的方法（如平均LoRA适配器）表现不佳、不稳定甚至失效，因此需要一种无需聚合的替代方案。
method: 提出LEAN方法，服务器维护一个秩-1基对库，参与者随机借出子集、本地微调为LoRA适配器并归还，无需聚合步骤，完全异步运行。
results: 理论上证明了在同步设置下LEAN可收敛到驻点的邻域，且洗牌在一阶上消除了数据异质性；在图像和文本微调基准测试中，LEAN在多数设置下以更少通信量优于基于平均的基线，在重度数据异质性和异步性下依然保持高效。
conclusion: LEAN通过维护一个秩-1基对库并在参与者之间进行借还和洗牌，成功实现了异步联邦微调，克服了传统平均方法的局限性。

title: Realistic Robustness Evaluation of Tabular Data Driven Models
authors: Miguel Silva, Eva Maia, João Vitorino, Isabel Praça
abstract: The increasing adoption of Machine Learning (ML) models in high-stakes applications has raised critical concerns regarding their robustness against adversarial attacks. While extensive research has focused on adversarial example generation in image and text domains, the study of such examples in tabular data remains comparatively limited, despite its widespread use in real-world systems. This work introduces AURORA, a modular, open-source tool for evaluating the robustness of ML models on tabular data classification. It integrates multiple adversarial perturbation methods and evaluation metrics within a unified framework to systematically assess model behavior under adversarial conditions. Central to AURORA is its evaluation report, which focuses on robustness analysis by quantifying performance degradation, comparing the impact of different perturbation strategies, and identifying model vulnerabilities across features and input regions. The report is complemented by visual artifacts that facilitate the interpretability of robustness patterns. Additionally, AURORA incorporates a distance adjustment mechanism that penalizes implausible adversarial samples based on feature-level constraints, ensuring that the robustness assessment remains grounded in realistic perturbations and is therefore more reliable.
zh_title: 表格数据驱动模型的真实鲁棒性评估
translation: 在风险应用中越来越多地采用机器学习（ML）模型，引发了对其对抗攻击鲁棒性的关键担忧。虽然广泛的研究集中在图像和文本域的对抗样本生成上，但对表格数据中此类样本的研究相对有限，尽管它在现实世界系统中被广泛使用。本工作引入了AURORA，这是一个用于评估表格数据分类ML模型鲁棒性的模块化、开源工具。它在一个统一的框架内集成了多种对抗扰动方法和评估指标，以系统地评估对抗条件下的模型行为。AURORA的核心是其评估报告，该报告专注于鲁棒性分析，通过量化性能退化、比较不同扰动策略的影响以及识别特征和输入区域的漏洞。该报告辅以促进鲁棒性模式可解释性的视觉人工制品。此外，AURORA结合了一种距离调整机制，该机制根据特征级约束惩罚不可信的对抗样本，确保鲁棒性评估保持在现实的扰动基础上，从而更加可靠。
tldr: 本文提出了AURORA——一个针对表格数据机器学习模型的开源鲁棒性评估工具，它通过集成多种扰动方法和特征约束机制，提供了真实且可解释的漏洞分析。
ai_comments: 该论文针对表格数据提出了一种开源的鲁棒性评估工具AURORA，填补了表格数据对抗样本研究相对滞后的空白。创新点在于集成了多种扰动方法、引入了距离调整机制以确保扰动的真实性，并通过详细的报告和可视化增强了可解释性，对高风险应用中的模型安全评估具有重要意义。
motivation: 尽管机器学习模型在高风险应用中越来越普及，并且图像和文本领域的对抗攻击研究十分广泛，但表格数据驱动模型的鲁棒性研究相对有限，且缺乏真实可靠的评估工具。
method: 开发了AURORA这一模块化、开源的表格数据分类模型鲁棒性评估工具，集成了多种对抗扰动方法、评估指标、可视化组件以及用于惩罚不可信对抗样本的特征级距离调整机制。
results: AURORA能够系统地评估模型在对抗条件下的行为，通过量化性能退化、比较不同扰动策略、识别特征和输入区域的漏洞，生成可靠且具解释性的鲁棒性评估报告。
conclusion: AURORA通过提供一个集成化的、考虑特征级约束的评估框架，有效解决了表格数据驱动模型鲁棒性评估中缺乏真实性和标准化的痛点。

title: Specification-Grounded Adaptive Triage and Formal Invariant Exclusion Synthesis for Autonomous Silicon Coverage Closure
authors: Veni Mohan
abstract:
Closing the final 5%-15% of code and functional coverage remains a major schedule bottleneck in silicon tapeouts. Existing LLM-based coverage closure loops feed raw uncovered RTL lines or branches directly into iterative prompts, failing on industrial subsystems due to: (1) token and context explosion from querying thousands of correlated holes independently; (2) illegal stimulus that violates cross-signal invariants and yields dirty coverage; and (3) unsafe exclusion hallucination on structurally unreachable dead code.
  We present ARGUS (Autonomous Reachability & Guided Unified Stimulus), a specification-grounded, dual-regime coverage closure and formal exclusion synthesis engine. ARGUS mines microarchitectural specs and SystemVerilog Assertions into a formal Block Contract (C), then runs adaptive Macro-Clustering vs. Micro-Surgery triage gated by a per-module hole-density threshold (tau): dense modules collapse correlated holes into root-cause mode, FSM, and backpressure clusters, while sparse modules use AST and loop-domain reachability to separate reachable corners from provably unreachable invariants. Directed tests pair with bit-exact golden scoreboards, and unreachable invariants emit tool-native .el exclusions with formal proofs.
  Across five core benchmarks -- three open-source LowRISC OpenTitan IPs (uart_core, i2c_core, aes_cipher_core) and two commercial AI accelerator Tensor Layout Converter datapaths (53 SV modules, 376,127 coverage points) -- plus a 2,626-module industrial interconnect subsystem, ARGUS triages 2,626 modules in 0.265 s, cuts token usage by 27.2x to >180x, achieves zero dirty merges via 3-step sanity gating, and reaches 99.32%-100.0% effective coverage with 0 false exclusions across 21,071+ proven exclusions.
zh_title: 用于自主硅芯片覆盖率闭环的规范接地自适应分类与形式不变式排除综合
translation:
关闭最后5%-15%的代码和功能覆盖率仍然是芯片流片过程中的主要进度瓶颈。现有的基于LLM的覆盖率闭环将原始未覆盖的RTL行或分支直接输入到迭代提示中，在工业子 subsystem 上失败的原因是：(1)独立查询数千个相关漏洞导致的令牌和上下文爆炸；(2)违反交叉信号不变式并产生脏覆盖率的非法刺激；以及(3)对结构上不可达死代码的不安全排除幻觉。
我们提出了ARGUS（自主可达性与引导式统一激励），这是一个规范接地的双机制覆盖率闭环与形式排除综合引擎。ARGUS将微架构规范和SystemVerilog断言开采为形式化块契约（C），然后运行由每模块漏洞密度阈值（tau）门控的自适应宏聚类与微手术分类：密集模块将相关漏洞折叠为根本原因模式、FSM和背压集群，而稀疏模块使用AST和循环域可达性将可达角落与可证明不可达的不变式分离。定向测试与位精确黄金计分板配对，不可达不变式发出带有形式证明的工具原生.el排除项。
在五个核心基准测试（三个开源的LowRISC OpenTitan IP――uart_core、i2c_core、aes_cipher_core和两个商业AI加速器张量布局转换器数据路径（53个SV模块，376,127个覆盖点））以及一个2,626个模块的工业互连子系统上，ARGUS在0.265秒内对2,626个模块进行了分类，将令牌使用量减少了27.2倍到超过180倍，通过3步健全性门控实现了零脏合并，并达到了99.32%-100.0%的有效覆盖率，在21,071+个经过证实的排除项中实现了0个错误排除。
tldr: 提出了一种名为ARGUS的自动化引擎，通过规范驱动和形式化方法解决了大芯片设计中最后阶段的覆盖率收敛瓶颈，大幅减少了令牌开销并实现了零错误的死代码排除。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种规范接地的自适应分类与形式不变式排除综合引擎（ARGUS），有效解决了基于LLM的芯片覆盖率收敛中面临的上下文爆炸、非法激励和不安全排除等工业级难题，具有极高的工程实用价值和创新性。
motivation: 现有的基于LLM的芯片覆盖率收敛方法在处理工业级子系统时，面临由于独立查询数千个未覆盖漏洞导致的令牌和上下文爆炸、违反交叉信号不变式的非法刺激产生 dirty 覆盖率、以及结构上不可达死代码的不安全排除幻觉等严重瓶颈。
method: 提出ARGUS引擎，将微架构规范和SystemVerilog断言开采为形式化块契约，运行自适应宏聚类与微手术分类，结合抽象语法树、循环域可达性分析以及带位精确黄金计分板的定向测试。
results: 在多个开源和商业基准测试中，ARGUS在0.265秒内完成了2626个模块的分类，将令牌使用量减少了27.2倍到超过180倍，实现了99.32%至100.0%的有效覆盖率，且在21071个以上的经验证排除中实现了零错误排除。
conclusion: ARGUS引擎通过规范驱动、自适应分类以及形式化证明，成功解决了大规模芯片设计中的覆盖率收敛难题，实现了高覆盖率和零错误排除。

title: Connectivity-Constrained Linear System Realization: Feasibility and Realizable Sets
authors: Yaozhi Du, Jing Shuang
abstract: In this paper, we first study the problem of finding a state-space realization of a given transfer function that adheres to a given connectivity pattern (i.e., support). While variants of this problem have been studied in distributed and structured control, existing work typically focuses on connectivity patterns relating to some networked plant. In contrast, we are interested in arbitrary connectivity patterns, which are relevant to modeling problems in sensorimotor neuroscience. We show that this problem is equivalent to solving a system of multivariate polynomial equations, and can be solved exactly without relaxation or approximation. We then study the reverse problem: given a connectivity pattern, what transfer functions have a state-space realization that adheres to this pattern? In other words, what transfer functions can this pattern realize? A surprising finding is that any given pattern can realize nearly all transfer functions, or very few transfer functions. We provide rigorous results and algorithms for both problems, leveraging technical machinery from algebraic geometry. The efficacy of our approach is demonstrated in examples at the end of the paper.
zh_title: 连通性受限线性系统实现：可行性与可实现集
translation: 在本文中，我们首先研究了在给定连通性模式（即支持）下，寻找给定传递函数的状态空间实现问题。虽然该问题的变体已在分布式和结构化控制中得到研究，但现有工作通常侧重于与某些网络化设备相关的连通性模式。与此相反，我们对任意连通性模式感兴趣，这与感觉运动神经科学中的建模问题相关。我们表明，该问题等价于求解一个多元多项式方程组，并且可以在不进行松弛或近似的情况下精确求解。然后，我们研究了逆问题：给定一个连通性模式，哪些传递函数具有符合该模式的状态空间实现？换句话说，该模式可以实现哪些传递函数？一个令人惊讶的发现是，任何给定模式几乎可以实现所有传递函数，或者非常少的传递函数。我们利用代数几何的技术，为这两个问题提供了严格的结果和算法。我们方法的有效性在论文末尾的例子中得到了验证。
tldr: 本文研究了在给定连通性模式下，寻找传递函数的线性系统实现问题及其逆问题，并利用代数几何提供了严格的解决方案。
ai_comments: 本文将连通性受限的线性系统实现问题与代数几何相结合，提供了一种新颖且精确的求解方法，尤其是在处理任意连通性模式上，拓宽了现有研究的范围。其关于可实现集规模的发现（“几乎所有”或“非常少”）具有重要的理论意义，可能对理解系统结构与功能之间的关系提供新的视角。
motivation: 现有工作主要关注与网络化设备相关的连通性模式，而本文关注任意连通性模式，这与感觉运动神经科学中的建模问题相关，拓展了研究范围。
method: 将问题转化为求解多元多项式方程组，并利用代数几何的技术，实现了精确求解，避免了松弛或近似。
results: 研究发现第一个问题（给定传递函数和连通性模式，寻找实现）等价于求解多元多项式方程组，可以精确求解。对于逆问题（给定连通性模式，哪些传递函数可以被实现），一个惊人的发现是，任何给定模式几乎可以实现所有传递函数，或者非常少的传递函数。本文为这两个问题提供了严格的结果和算法。
conclusion: 本文为在任意连通性模式下，线性系统实现的可行性及其可实现集提供了严格的理论结果和算法，并揭示了连通性模式对可实现传递函数数量的极端影响。

title: Recovering from Averages: An Inverse Problem Perspective on Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
authors: Tina Torabi, Cheuk Hin Ho, Christoph Ortner, Ruo Ning Qiu
abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approximate the potential energy surface of atomistic systems from quantum-mechanical reference data and enable molecular simulation at near-ab-initio accuracy at a fraction of the cost. Since they are fitted to total energies and forces, it is not obvious what is estimated: the total energy or the many-body potentials from which it is assembled. Mathematically, this can be formulated as a question whether a function can be recovered from averages of its values over random clusters. We study it for a linear model of fixed correlation order in simplified statistical setting. We show that, in the population limit, the potential is identifiable in a natural weighted Sobolev space, and derive finite-sample recovery guarantees. Numerical experiments for pair, three-body, and four-body models support the theory.
zh_title: 从平均中恢复：机器学习原子间势的逆问题视角
translation: 机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）从量子力学参考数据中近似原子系统的势能面，从而能够以极小的一小部分成本实现接近第一性原理精度的分子模拟。由于它们是拟合总能量和力的，因此究竟估计的是总能量还是构成它的多体势并不显而易见。在数学上，这可以归结为一个问题：是否可以从随机团簇值的平均值中恢复一个函数。我们在简化的统计设置下研究了固定相关阶数的线性模型。我们证明了在总体极限下，势函数在一个自然的加权索伯列夫空间中是可识别的，并导出了有限样本恢复保证。二体、三体和四体模型的数值实验支持了该理论。
tldr: 该论文从逆问题的数学视角证明了机器学习原子间势可以从总体极限的平均能量和力中准确恢复出底层的多体势。
ai_comments: 该论文从逆问题的新视角探讨了机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）的可识别性，在数学上证明了在总体极限下可以通过平均值恢复多体势，为理解MLIPs的底层机制提供了坚实的理论基础。
motivation: 由于机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）是通过拟合总能量和力来训练的，因此拟合得到的究竟是总能量还是构成它的多体势并不明确。作者旨在从逆问题的角度，通过数学方法研究是否可以从随机团簇值的平均值中恢复出底层函数。
method: 在一个简化的统计设置下，针对固定相关阶数的线性模型进行了研究，利用逆问题理论推导了总体极限下的可识别性及有限样本恢复保证，并通过数值实验进行验证。
results: 证明了在总体极限下势函数是可识别的，推导出了有限样本恢复保证，并且针对二体、三体和四体模型的数值实验支持了理论发现。
conclusion: 在总体极限下，势函数在自然的加权索伯列夫空间中是可识别的，并且数值实验验证了理论的正确性。

title: A Unified Framework for Intelligent Cyber Attack Detection and Alert Correlation
authors: Miguel Silva, João Vitorino, Daniela Pinto, Eva Maia, Ivone Amorim, Isabel Praça
abstract: A Security Operations Center (SOC) plays a critical role in detecting, correlating, and responding to modern cyber threats. However, SOCs continue to face challenges related to alert overload, fragmented detection capabilities, and limited collaboration between analysts and automated systems. These issues often result in delayed incident response, analyst fatigue, and an increased risk of overlooking sophisticated, multi-stage attacks that unfold gradually across different layers of the network. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a unified framework for network traffic classification and alert correlation through the use of signature rules, machine learning, and sequential pattern mining algorithms. The solution was evaluated in a controlled testbed environment emulating realistic, multi-stage attack scenarios, including malware exploitation, lateral movement, reconnaissance, and data exfiltration. The obtained results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in detecting and correlating complex attack behaviors, while providing analysts with actionable insights in line with a human-in-the-loop approach to SOC operations.
zh_title: 智能网络攻击检测与告警关联的统一框架
translation: 安全运营中心（SOC）在检测、关联和响应现代网络威胁方面发挥着关键作用。然而，SOCs持续面临告警过载、检测能力碎片化以及分析师与自动化系统之间协作有限等挑战。这些问题常常导致事件响应延迟、分析师疲劳，并增加了忽视那些在网络不同层级逐渐展开的复杂多阶段攻击的风险。为了解决这些挑战，本文提出了一个统一框架，通过使用签名规则、机器学习和序列模式挖掘算法，实现网络流量分类和告警关联。该解决方案在一个受控测试平台环境中进行了评估，该环境模拟了真实的多阶段攻击场景，包括恶意软件利用、横向移动、侦察和数据渗漏。所获得的结果表明，所提出的框架在检测和关联复杂攻击行为方面是有效的，同时以“人机协作”的SOC操作方法为分析师提供了可操作的洞察。
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一框架，结合签名规则、机器学习和序列模式挖掘，旨在解决安全运营中心（SOC）面临的告警过载和检测碎片化问题，并有效检测和关联复杂多阶段网络攻击。
ai_comments: 该论文提出一个统一框架，整合多种技术（签名规则、机器学习、序列模式挖掘）以解决SOC面临的核心挑战，即告警过载和多阶段攻击检测。其创新点在于将这些技术集成到一个框架中，并通过“人机协作”理念增强分析师的洞察力，有望提高SOC的运营效率和对复杂威胁的响应能力。
motivation: 安全运营中心（SOC）面临告警过载、检测能力碎片化以及分析师与自动化系统协作有限等挑战，导致事件响应延迟、分析师疲劳，并可能忽略复杂的多阶段攻击。
method: 本文提出了一个统一框架，通过结合签名规则、机器学习和序列模式挖掘算法，实现网络流量分类和告警关联。该解决方案在一个模拟真实多阶段攻击场景的受控测试平台环境中进行了评估。
results: 实验结果表明，所提出的框架在检测和关联复杂攻击行为方面是有效的，并能为分析师提供可操作的洞察，符合“人机协作”的SOC操作方法。
conclusion: 该统一框架能够有效检测和关联复杂的网络攻击行为，并为安全运营中心（SOC）的分析师提供可操作的洞察，从而解决当前SOC面临的挑战。

title: Skill-JEPA: Learning Planner-Aligned Action Spaces for World Models
authors: Tomás Couso Coddou, Christ Devia, Rex G. Liu, Rodrigo Toro Icarte
abstract: World models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn from pixels to predict the outcome of actions in a latent space. To reach a goal, a planner samples many candidate action sequences, uses the model to predict where each one leads, and executes the best one. However, standard planners draw their candidates from a Gaussian, while the model has only seen the structured, state-dependent actions of its training data. Its predictions for such candidates are unreliable, and planning fails more often as goals move farther away. We propose Skill-JEPA, which learns an action space aligned with the planner. A variational autoencoder conditioned on the current state encodes short action sequences into latent skills with a standard Gaussian prior, and decodes them back into actions. The world model predicts the effect of skills rather than raw actions, and the planner searches over skills starting from that same Gaussian, so its candidates resemble the model's training data. Skill-JEPA adds a single module, trained end-to-end with the world model, and leaves the planner untouched, with no subgoals, hierarchy, or hand-designed skills. Across three JEPA world models and four benchmarks, average success on goals 80 steps away rises from 42% with raw actions to 62%; the gains grow with goal distance and hold across four planners. On AntMaze, a quadruped locomotion task, success on goals two maze cells away rises from 0.4% to 38%. This suggests that part of the difficulty of reaching distant goals lies in the action space, and can be removed without changing the planner.

title: Bayesian Optimal Stopping: Invincible Prophets and Achievable Philosophers
authors: Alireza AmaniHamedani, Ali Aouad, Senem Işık, Thomas Kesselheim, Amin Saberi
abstract:
We study Bayesian optimal stopping: a hidden world $H$ is drawn from $K$ worlds according to a known prior and determines the joint distribution of $n$ observations. A decision-maker selects one observation irrevocably to maximize its value, learning about the world as observations arrive. We compare algorithms against the Bayes-optimal online policy (the philosopher) and the offline optimum (the prophet).
  Our results show that the philosopher is achievable in that we find a $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximation of the Bayes-optimal policy that runs in time $\mathrm{poly}(|\mathcal{I}|^{\log^* |\mathcal{I}| + 1/\varepsilon} \cdot (1/\varepsilon)^{1/\varepsilon^2})$, where $|\mathcal{I}|$ is the size of the input. By contrast, the prophet is invincible and no algorithm can obtain a competitive ratio that substantially exceeds the worst-case guarantees. When the observations are conditionally independent and identically distributed given $H$, the secretary's rule is $1/e$-competitive. We show that no algorithm can guarantee a competitive ratio better than $1/e + 1/\mathrm{poly}(K)$ and this bound is attainable.
  Our approximation scheme builds on a primal improvement subroutine connecting the two benchmarks. Given an $α$-competitive algorithm against the prophet, we construct an algorithm with a strictly better approximation factor against the philosopher. We randomize between the baseline algorithm and a threshold algorithm based on dual martingales that exploit the Bayesian structure. Each improvement yields a tighter dual martingale, enabling repeated primal-dual updates. We approximate these martingales in polynomial time using importance-weighted Monte Carlo sampling. Dual martingales also establish our upper bound on the competitive ratio and may be useful for more general Bayesian online optimization problems.

title: $\mathcal{H}_\infty$ Grid-Forming Control in DC Microgrids
authors: Jovan Krajacic, Ognjen Stanojev, Mario Schweizer, Gabriela Hug
abstract: The growing share of DC-based generation, storage and loads has increased interest in DC microgrids. As a result, DC-bus voltage regulation and stability have become active research topics, with considerable effort directed at improving the transient performance of conventional droop control. Although numerous variants of droop algorithms have been proposed, many rely on increasingly complex control structures with multiple tuning parameters and measurements, thereby increasing the commissioning burden. Moreover, stable interaction with the surrounding microgrid is not guaranteed by design. To address these issues, this paper develops a passivity-constrained $\mathcal{H}_\infty$ synthesis method for the DC-bus voltage controller. The proposed $\mathcal{H}_\infty$ controller emulates the desired grid-forming behavior of the converter by minimizing the $\mathcal{H}_\infty$ error norm between device-level performance indices and their desired values, while additionally enforcing passivity during the optimization. The novel $\mathcal{H}_\infty$ control scheme is benchmarked in the frequency domain against representative droop-based and virtual-DC-machine algorithms from the literature, while experiments on a four-converter DC microgrid corroborate the frequency-domain analysis and validate the practical applicability of the algorithm.
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Power Electronics

title: Impact of Edge Software Evolution on Audio Tagging Models: An Empirical Study on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano
authors: Guillem Fustier-Castillo, Ruben Ribes-Serrano, Jordi Grau-Haro, Marta Garcia-Ballesteros, Javier Naranjo-Alcazar
abstract: Audio tagging is a fundamental task in machine listening, enabling the automatic identification of acoustic events in applications such as intelligent monitoring, industrial inspection, environmental sensing, and smart environments. As these applications increasingly migrate to edge platforms, deployment-oriented metrics such as latency, energy consumption, and resource utilization become critical alongside predictive performance. However, most existing studies evaluate audio tagging models under a single software environment, overlooking the potential impact of software stack evolution on deployment efficiency. This paper investigates how software ecosystem updates affect the execution characteristics of state-of-the-art audio tagging architectures on edge devices. We evaluate representative convolutional and Transformer-based models, including PANNs (CNN and ResNet variants), AST, and PaSST, on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano platform using two generations of NVIDIA's software ecosystem: JetPack 6.2 and JetPack 7.2. Under identical hardware conditions, we analyze inference latency, energy consumption, CPU/GPU utilization, and memory footprint across multiple inference backends and power modes. The results show that software stack evolution can substantially affect deployment performance. JetPack 7.2 reduces latency and energy consumption by more than 50% for several convolutional architectures when combined with TensorRT, while significantly increasing GPU utilization. In contrast, AST exhibits only marginal gains, whereas PaSST shows intermediate behavior. These findings demonstrate that software evolution is a critical factor in Edge AI evaluation and can alter the relative deployment efficiency of competing architectures. Consequently, software stack versions should be explicitly considered when benchmarking and selecting audio tagging models for embedded deployment.

title: Graph-XGB: A Hybrid GNN Framework for Outdoor-to-Indoor 5G Signal Reconstruction via Aerial-Only UAV RF Sensing
authors: David Hason Rudd, Eunkwang Shin, Nithiwat Pattrapong, Huan Huo, Xiangmeng Wang
abstract: Delivering robust In-Building Coverage (IBC) is critically impeded by severe Outdoor-to-Indoor (O2I) attenuation, a constraint that intensifies as deployments move from 5G mid-band towards mmWave and prospective 6G sub-THz carriers, where losses of 60-80 dB have been reported across modern building envelopes. While Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) offer scalable exterior RF sensing platforms, a fundamental inversion problem persists: interior 3D signal states cannot be directly sampled from constrained exterior flight paths. This paper proposes Graph-XGB, a hybrid inference framework that decouples spatial topology reasoning from non-linear signal regression to resolve this challenge. A modified SpiderGNN encoder, operating on a topology-aware graph constructed with a physically grounded Floor-Aware 3D Distance metric and Bridge Edge Guarantees, propagates UAV boundary measurements into 128-dimensional indoor embeddings. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) compresses these into a 10-dimensional manifold retaining 96.6% of embedding variance, fused with raw spatial features and decoded by independent, physics-tailored XGBoost regressors. This decoupling mitigates the optimization conflict between smoothly decaying path-loss signals and volatile interference-dependent metrics. Evaluated on a real-world 5G NR dataset of 613 verified nodes spanning the 10 floors of a single building, Graph-XGB attains the strongest accuracy among the architectures compared, with $R^2$ of 0.759 (RSSI) and 0.770 (RSRP), improvements of 35.5% and 64.9% over the SimpleGNN baseline, using no interior RF measurement as a model input; indoor observations enter only as training supervision, with evaluation on held-out internal nodes. Interference-dependent targets (RSRQ, SNR and CQI) remain bounded well below the path-loss metrics, delimiting the reach of purely spatial inference.
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Accepted manuscript of a chapter published in BESC 2026, Lecture Notes in Computer Science 17175 (Springer, 2027)

title: Neural Geometry as a Learning Signal
authors: Eric Todd, Tal Haklay, Nikhil Prakash, Matthew Finlayson, Michael Hanna, Fenil R. Doshi, Daniel Wurgaft, Thomas McGrath, Owen Lewis, David Bau, Jack Merullo, Ekdeep Singh Lubana, Matthew Kowal, Thomas Fel, Atticus Geiger
abstract: We investigate whether the geometric structure of neural representations can provide a sufficient learning signal for improving model behavior without any supervision on model outputs. First, we fine-tune Llama-3.1-8B to answer questions such as "What month is four months after June?" by supervising internal representations of the input month (June = 6) and offset (4), which are encoded with Fourier harmonics. Second, we fine-tune the model to predict line breaks in text wrapped to a fixed width by supervising an internal representation of the number of characters since the preceding newline, which is represented by a low-dimensional helical structure. In both tasks, we supervise a low-dimensional subspace of the residual stream using an idealized target structure, and find that internal geometric supervision achieves similar performance to standard fine-tuning (despite no supervision on outputs). Moreover, we find that simply patching in an ideal geometry is not sufficient to recover fine-tuning performance, and thus demonstrate geometric supervision provides beneficial effects beyond the representations it targets. Together, these findings show how mechanistic understanding of neural geometry can be leveraged to shape the behavior of neural networks.

title: Non-Expanding Gated Continued Fraction Architecture for Feedforward Layers in Language Models
authors: Amit Dhurandhar, Vijil Chenthamarakshan, Karthikeyan Natesan Ramamurthy, Dennis Wei, Rahul Nair
abstract: Recent work has shown that continued fraction inspired neural architectures (CoFrGeNets) can be highly parameter efficient yet performant for language modeling. In this work, we revisit continued fraction-based channel mixing with the goal of improving its performance and simplifying integration into standard pre-training protocols for language models. We achieve this by two simple yet critical contributions: i) we propose a novel non-expanding gated continued fraction inspired architectural component to replace feedforward layers in established language model architectures that may use vanilla multilayer perceptrons or gated linear units or (vanilla/gated) experts in mixture-of-experts (MoE) type architectures. ii) We propose a way to re-implement divisions -- the non-linearity in these architectures -- in terms of logarithms and exponentials. By experimenting on different language modeling architectures such as GPT-2, Llama-3, Mamba-2 and (nano) Llama-MoE we find that our proposed architecture performs similarly or significantly better than the continued fraction architecture proposed in prior work along with having higher throughput. In addition, our re-implementation of divisions makes training of deeper CoFrGeNets stable without the need for incremental training which was proposed in prior work as a means to stabilize training, but added notable complexity to existing large language model training implementations. Code is available at http://github.com/IBM/CoFrNets

title: Cross-Linguistic Distinctive-Feature Constraints on Segmental Triphones: Evidence for Contrastive Dispersion
authors: Leonardo Araújo
abstract: Natural speech reflects articulatory and perceptual constraints, yet how these pressures shape consecutive segment transitions across languages remains underexplored. We analyze adjacent distinctive-feature distances in token-weighted segmental triphones across 17 Universal Dependencies corpora spanning nine language families, transcribed into IPA and mapped to 24 PanPhon features using Hamming and cosine metrics. Natural sequences exhibit an intermediate-distance mode (8-10 features under Hamming, except Vietnamese; 0.28-0.38 under cosine). Against an unrestricted within-word shuffled baseline, natural words reject the inventory-only null (W = 0, p < 10-4), showing higher expected distance, narrower dispersion, and lower joint triphone entropy in all 17 languages. Under a stricter within-word consonant-vowel template baseline, expected distance and dispersion are no longer separated, whereas joint entropy remains lower in 16 languages (p = 1.07x10-4). Entropy decomposition reveals higher mutual information between incoming and outgoing transitions in all 17 languages and all nine families (W = 0, p < 10-4), demonstrating sequential coupling beyond syllable-template alternation. Word-level mean-SD correlations and directional asymmetries do not replicate cross-linguistically.

title: Explain Your Code: AI-Based Examination at Class Scale
authors: David Sarne, Shachar Sagi, Yossi Ben-Zion
abstract: Generative AI has weakened the link between working code and a student's understanding of it. Oral examination, the traditional test of that understanding, does not scale to large courses. We report the full-course deployment of a three-agent AI system that examines students on their own code. The first, the examiner, asks three questions anchored to specific lines of the submission, adapting difficulty to each answer, in a 16-minute text dialogue. The other two grade: a code reviewer that never sees the examination and a grader without direct access to the code. Authorship is assessed separately and is advisory. The system examined 247 students in an operating systems course (three exercises, 546 sittings, two examination languages). The grader's oral score was uncorrelated with the same submission's code quality score (Spearman rho = -0.073, 95% CI [-0.205, 0.063], n = 216) yet tracked degree grade point average (rho = 0.419, [0.294, 0.523], n = 214), while automated test scores sat at the ceiling. The mean of a student's two oral scores correlated with grade point average at 0.468 ([0.353, 0.568], n = 210), within the range of grades in three single-semester courses built on programming assignments. Model spend averaged at most $1.37 per sitting. In surveys, students began skeptical of the AI examination and rated it more favorably after sitting it twice. These results indicate that examining students on their own code is feasible at class scale, and that its score relates to academic standing where the code quality score does not.

title: Rethinking Full-Weight LoRA with Domain and Task Adapter Scaling for Question Answering over Portuguese Well Drilling Reports
authors: Luan B. Guerra, Diogo M. Paes, Marcelo N. Grimberg, Arnaldo C. Junior, Wallace Casaca, Lucas C. Ribas
abstract: Adapting large language models (LLMs) to specialized domains remains challenging, particularly for technical documents such as Portuguese well drilling reports, where annotated data are scarce and domain adaptation may compromise instruction-following capabilities. Although Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is widely used for parameter-efficient adaptation, its scaling after training remains insufficiently explored. This study investigates the impact of LoRA adapter scaling on question answering over Portuguese drilling reports using Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.1-8B. Domain-adaptive pretraining (DAPT) is performed either directly on instruction-tuned models or on their base counterparts, with subsequent adapter transfer, while task-specific adapters are trained on WellQuest, an open-source question-answering dataset derived from Portuguese drilling reports. The two adapters are also combined using complementary weights. Scaling factors ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 are evaluated across multiple training checkpoints using BERTScore. Results show that fractional scaling consistently improves DAPT performance over full-weight application, increasing F1 from 68.8\% to 71.9\% for Qwen2.5-7B and from 63.2\% to 68.5\% for Llama-3.1-8B. QA adapters perform best at high but fractional weights, while base-to-instruct transfer yields better results than direct DAPT on instruct-tuned models. Adapter merging provides a modest improvement for Llama-3.1-8B. Overall, these findings demonstrate that post-training adapter scaling can improve domain adaptation without additional data or training.

title: Weight-Space Programming Writes In-Context Learning and Matches Fine-Tuning in Language Models
authors: Konstantinos Skianis, Aristidis Likas
abstract: Weight-space programming is a frontier language model's recently reported ability to read and rewrite another network's weights without gradient descent. We investigate how examples can provide a weight update so that a weaker language model performs the task with nothing in the prompt, and study what it edits. Our experiments cover six tasks, four frontier editors and three families of weaker language models, without the editors being told anything about in-context learning (ICL). In most runs, the few-shot minus zero-shot residual is measured at the final prompt token, the ICL task vector, and write it into the weights, at its sparsest into near-silent MLP units keyed to the prompt format. Results reach the accuracy of ICL and of fine-tuning on the same examples, LoRA included, usually leaving perplexity untouched, with worse performance under changes of wording. We also qualify the comparison by counting unfinished runs, observing that one editor falls below fine-tuning; held only to the seen examples, without task pairs of their own, only the strongest editor has similar performance. Given a task and unlabelled inputs, that editor writes its own examples and does nearly as well on unseen items as with labels.

title: AROMA: Understanding AI Support For Mental Well-being through Role Theory
authors: Issac Ting, Ethan Pan, Koustuv Saha, Hua Shen, Kevin Chow, Vedant Das Swain
abstract: AI supporters for mental well-being are becoming more prevalent. When these AI supporters start acting in ways beyond their expected function it leads to relational harm. Standard approaches to evaluating such AI supporters are limited to inspecting their efficacy in narrow task-specific settings, which do not explain these discrepancies in expected and actual behavior. To address this gap, we propose the AROMA (A Role-Oriented Model of Analysis) framework to provide a common role taxonomy for different support contexts. We developed AROMA using a theory-informed annotation of over 7,515 conversations from 13 datasets and propose eight "Role States" based on observed-not prescribed-behavior. We show these Role States vary according to the context of support; depict unique structural and temporal characteristics of AI supporters vis-a-vis Humans; and inform novel AI support prompting strategy for better role alignment. This framework provides a new lens to understand AI support failures.

title: 3D Open-Vocabulary Detection via Visual Alignment and Generative Captions
authors: Thomas E. Huang, Alex Zihao Zhu, Hao Xiang, Tianyi Cai, Jingwei Ji, Yuliang Zou, Jiafan Yu, Xin Huang, Mingxing Tan
abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D object detection remains a significant challenge for outdoor scenes, with existing methods often struggling to effectively transfer the rich semantic knowledge from powerful 2D Vision-Language Models (VLMs) into a 3D context. We propose a novel, two-part framework for this task. First, we introduce a direct, object-level distillation method. We generate class-agnostic 3D proposals to source regions from the entire scene, without relying on any manual labels. We leverage a spatially-aware VLM to extract a semantic embedding from each proposal's projected 2D bounding box and supervise our 3D model to predict this embedding on a per-instance basis. Second, to enhance zero-shot capability and inject domain-specific information, we employ a powerful Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) as an image captioner to generate rich textual captions for each of these proposals. These captions are integrated into the training objective to directly align the 3D features with these rich semantics, creating a composite loss that combines direct feature distillation with caption-based semantic enrichment. Our experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach, establishing a new state of the art in 3D open-vocabulary detection on the Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes.
comment: Accepted to IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026

title: Contention-Aware Flexible Execution for Machine Learning Workloads
authors: Marco Kurzynski, Shaizeen Aga, Di Wu
abstract: Concurrent kernel execution is a ubiquitous paradigm in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) across both training and inference. That said, concurrency causes potential slowdown as concurrent kernels contend for limited GPU resources (cores, caches, memory bandwidth), which are shared between these kernels rather than exclusively available to one, as in isolated execution. This raises an important research question: to what extent does concurrency slow down kernel execution and how can it be mitigated. To answer this question, our work presents two studies. First, we characterize concurrent kernel execution extensively for the first time, to our knowledge. We conduct not just performance analysis of concurrent kernels but also memory behavior under concurrency on state-of-the-art AMD Instinct MI300X GPUs designed for datacenter AI, using the AMD-internal millisecond sampler. Based on the observations, we share insights on the slowdown along two dimensions (memory vs. compute bound, large vs. small kernels) to inform future optimizations. Second, we put the derived insights to use, aiming to deliver higher performance via targeted, flexible overlap of ML operators. Frameworks today make the simple decision of early-first for concurrent kernels, which is suboptimal. Noticing the opportunity that ML dataflow has inherent flexibility in which operators can be overlapped and how hardware resources can be allocated, we deduce simple heuristics to tune both overlap anchors and resource allocation for concurrent kernels to improve performance. We evaluate our proposed contention-aware flexible execution (termed CAFEML) across a variety of ML scenarios (inference decode, inference prefill, training) and demonstrate a speedup of up to 13% end-to-end with simple scheduling changes and no kernel rewrites.

title: A Sparsity Analysis of Traffic Forecasting Architectures: How Much Missing Data is Too Much?
authors: Mohamed Hamad, Bilal Mutahir, Mohamed Mabrok, Nizar Zorba, Hamid Saeedi, Halim Yanikomeroglu
abstract: Traffic forecasting models are typically evaluated under ideal conditions with complete data. This evaluation does not reflect the frequent sensor failures and communication outages common in real-world deployments. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of multivariate traffic prediction models to evaluate their performance under varying levels of sensor data loss during inference. We benchmark several architectural paradigms, including graph neural networks, attention-based Transformers, and selective state-space models, across sparsity levels ranging from zero to complete sensor loss, using two widely used multi-channel traffic benchmarks. To ensure consistent comparison across traffic variables, we use normalized metrics and define a usability threshold to identify when predictions become unreliable. Our results show a clear trade-off between baseline accuracy and robustness: models with the highest accuracy under full-data conditions often degrade most sharply as data becomes sparse, while less accurate models maintain more stable performance. These findings show that model selection should be based on the expected reliability of the sensor network rather than peak accuracy alone. This work provides a practical framework for assessing traffic forecasting models and highlights the importance of robustness in real-world applications.

title: Revisiting Generalized Median Estimators: Exact Bitwise Computation and Gray Code Acceleration
authors: Robin Nunkesser
abstract: Generalized median estimators evaluate the median of a symmetric kernel over all $M = \binom{n}{k}$ subsets of size $k$. Exhaustive evaluation was considered impractical even for $n = 29, k = 5$ ($M = 118,755$), prompting stochastic subsampling (Wilde and Grimshaw, 2013). We show that this barrier is computational, not combinatorial: storing all subsets requires $Θ(kM)$ space, whereas stateful enumeration uses $\mathcal{O}(k)$ auxiliary state and retains only $M$ kernel values. We combine two exhaustive traversals with three-way Quickselect and a deterministic median-of-medians fallback, giving worst-case $\mathcal{O}(M)$ selection. Gosper's successor takes $\mathcal{O}(k)$ kernel work per subset for $n < w$; a Revolving Door Gray code changes one element out and one in, enabling $\mathcal{O}(1)$ kernel updates between recalibrations and $\mathcal{O}(M + kM/P)$ total time. We derive floating-point error bounds for the location ($h_1$) and mean-centered sample variance ($h_2$) kernels and their resulting median. For $n = 29, k = 5$, our ANSI C implementation evaluates all $118,755$ subsets in $0.74$ ms and $0.71$ ms, respectively. A direct C sweep places the crossover with partial lexicographic unranking at approximately $18,000$-$23,000$ subsets ($15\%$-$19\%$ of $M$), below the $32,160$-$45,420$ subsets required by Wilde and Grimshaw's sequential approximation at $ε= 0.01$.
zh_title: 重新审视广义中位数估计器：精确的位计算和格雷码加速
translation: 广义中位数估计器评估了大小为 $k$ 的所有 $M = \binom{n}{k}$ 个子集上对称核的中位数。穷举评估甚至对于 $n = 29, k = 5$ ($M = 118,755$) 都被认为是不可行的，这促使了随机子抽样方法（Wilde 和 Grimshaw, 2013）。我们表明这个障碍是计算性的，而非组合性的：存储所有子集需要 $Θ(kM)$ 空间，而有状态枚举仅使用 $\mathcal{O}(k)$ 辅助状态并只保留 $M$ 个核值。我们将两种穷举遍历与三路快速选择和确定性中位数的中位数回退结合起来，实现了最坏情况下的 $\mathcal{O}(M)$ 选择。Gosper 后继在 $n < w$ 时每个子集需要 $\mathcal{O}(k)$ 的核工作；Revolving Door Gray code 允许一个元素出、一个元素入，从而在重新校准之间实现 $\mathcal{O}(1)$ 的核更新和 $\mathcal{O}(M + kM/P)$ 的总时间。我们推导了位置 ($h_1$) 和均值中心样本方差 ($h_2$) 核及其结果中位数的浮点误差界限。对于 $n = 29, k = 5$，我们的 ANSI C 实现分别在 $0.74$ ms 和 $0.71$ ms 内评估了所有 $118,755$ 个子集。直接的 C 扫描将与部分字典序逆排序的交叉点放置在大约 $18,000$-$23,000$ 个子集（$M$ 的 $15\%$-$19\%$），低于 Wilde 和 Grimshaw 的序列近似在 $ε=0.01$ 时所需的 $32,160$-$45,420$ 个子集。
tldr: 本文通过位计算和格雷码加速，实现了广义中位数估计器的精确、高效计算，解决了传统方法在大规模数据集上的计算瓶颈。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于证明了广义中位数估计器的穷举计算并非不可行，并通过巧妙的算法设计（如结合 Gray code 和优化的选择算法）显著提升了计算效率。其重要性在于为过去依赖随机抽样的方法提供了一个精确且高效的替代方案，特别是在对精度要求较高的场景下具有重要意义。
motivation: 传统的广义中位数估计器在处理大规模子集（如 $n=29, k=5$ 时 $M=118,755$）时被认为不切实际，需要随机子抽样，这表明存在计算瓶颈。
method: 本文证明计算瓶颈是计算而非组合问题。结合两种穷举遍历、三路快速选择和确定性中位数的中位数回退，实现最坏情况下的 $\mathcal{O}(M)$ 选择。使用 Gosper 后继和 Revolving Door Gray code，实现 $\mathcal{O}(1)$ 内核更新和 $\mathcal{O}(M + kM/P)$ 的总时间。推导了位置 ($h_1$) 和均值中心样本方差 ($h_2$) 内核及其结果中位数的浮点误差界限。使用 ANSI C 实现。
results: 对于 $n=29, k=5$，本文的 ANSI C 实现分别在 $0.74$ ms 和 $0.71$ ms 内评估了所有 $118,755$ 个子集。直接 C 扫描与部分字典序逆排序的交叉点约为 $18,000$-$23,000$ 个子集（$M$ 的 $15\%$-$19\%$），低于 Wilde 和 Grimshaw 在 $ε=0.01$ 时所需的 $32,160$-$45,420$ 个子集。
conclusion: 本文展示了广义中位数估计器的精确计算是可行的，并且比随机子抽样方法更高效，尤其是在子集数量较少但仍被认为难以处理的情况下。

title: LoCo-WAM: Test-Time Training as Long Context for World-Action Models
authors: Sheng Cheng, Deqian Kong
abstract: World-action models guide robot actions by predicting what happens next, but typically condition on a short observation history. Extending this history increases computation at every decision and can require a separately trained model. We introduce LoCo-WAM, which learns from the outcomes of its actions through test-time training while keeping the same short history length. It uses newly observed frames to update a low-rank adapter in the video expert, whose adapted predictions guide subsequent actions. The updates accumulate within each episode and are reset between episodes, allowing past observations to influence decisions after they leave the input window. LoCo-WAM thus learns from a longer stream of experience without expert action labels, additional data or meta-training. Experiments on two world-action models show improved task success across four simulation benchmarks. On RoboCasa GR-1, a model with 2.4,s of history matches one trained with 9.6,s, while a model with 4.8,s exceeds it by 4.8 percentage points. Our analysis shows that the updates improve prediction of upcoming frames, affect the action mainly through adaptation of the imagined future, and have an increasing effect on actions as the episode unfolds.
zh_title: LoCo-WAM：将测试时训练作为世界-动作模型的长上下文
translation: 世界-动作模型通过预测接下来会发生什么来指导机器人动作，但通常以短期的观测历史为条件。延长这个历史会增加每次决策的计算量，并且可能需要一个单独训练的模型。我们引入了LoCo-WAM，它通过测试时训练从其动作的结果中学习，同时保持相同的短历史长度。它使用新观察到的帧来更新视频专家中的低秩适配器，其适应性预测指导后续动作。更新在每个情节内累积，并在情节之间重置，从而允许过去的观察在它们离开输入窗口后影响决策。LoCo-WAM因此可以在没有专家动作标签、额外数据或元训练的情况下，从更长的经验流中学习。在两个世界-动作模型上的实验表明，在四个模拟基准测试中，任务成功率有所提高。在RoboCasa GR-1上，一个具有2.4秒历史的模型与一个训练有9.6秒历史的模型表现相当，而一个具有4.8秒历史的模型则超过它4.8个百分点。我们的分析表明，这些更新改善了对即将到来的帧的预测，主要通过想象未来的适应性影响动作，并且随着情节的展开，对动作的影响越来越大。
tldr: LoCo-WAM通过测试时训练，在保持短历史长度的同时，使世界-动作模型能够从更长的经验流中学习并提高任务成功率。
ai_comments: LoCo-WAM的创新之处在于其通过测试时训练实现长上下文学习，有效解决了世界-动作模型在处理长期依赖关系时的计算和训练成本问题。这种方法在不增加模型复杂度的前提下，提升了机器人决策的适应性和性能，对于资源受限的机器人系统具有重要意义。其通过低秩适配器更新而非完整模型重训练的策略，也体现了高效性和实用性。
motivation: 世界-动作模型通常依赖于短期的观测历史来指导机器人动作，但延长历史会增加计算量并可能需要单独训练模型。本文旨在解决如何在保持短历史长度的同时，让模型从更长的经验流中学习并提高性能。
method: LoCo-WAM引入了一种测试时训练方法。它通过在新观察到的帧来更新视频专家中的低秩适配器，从而从其动作结果中学习。这些更新在每个情节内累积，并在情节之间重置，允许过去的观察影响后续决策，即使它们离开了输入窗口。
results: LoCo-WAM在四个模拟基准测试中，使用两个世界-动作模型显示了任务成功率的提高。在RoboCasa GR-1上，一个具有2.4秒历史的模型与一个训练有素的9.6秒历史模型表现相当，而一个具有4.8秒历史的模型则超过了后者4.8个百分点。分析表明，更新改善了对即将到来的帧的预测，主要通过想象未来的适应性影响动作，并且随着情节的展开，对动作的影响越来越大。
conclusion: LoCo-WAM通过测试时训练，使世界-动作模型能够在不增加额外数据、专家动作标签或元训练的情况下，从更长的经验流中学习，从而显著提高了任务成功率和预测能力。

title: Coherent Moment Propagation: Epistemic Uncertainty for Pre-trained Robot Policies
authors: Miguel Saavedra-Ruiz, Anqi Li, Claudia D'Arpino, Alperen Degirmenci, Tucker Hermans, Fabio Ramos
abstract: Flow matching policies underpin the state-of-the-art in robot learning, with impressive results ranging from long-horizon planning to dexterous manipulation. However, they provide no measure of whether their predicted commands can be trusted, particularly in novel situations outside their training set. Epistemic uncertainty reflects uncertainty about the model's weights and quantifies this ignorance, but calculating it at inference time from a flow matching policy is not trivial. Actions are produced by an ODE solver, requiring uncertainty to be propagated through the entire integration process. BayesDiff addresses this problem for diffusion models by propagating the mean and variance of the state through the denoising chain under a last-layer Laplace posterior approximation, but it severely underestimates the epistemic uncertainty. In this paper we: i) prove that, for flow matching and diffusion ODEs, BayesDiff's total variance decays at rate $O(1/T)$ as the number of Euler steps $T$ used by the solver increases; ii) introduce Coherent Moment Propagation (CoMP), two recursions inspired by the extended and unscented Kalman filters that fix this problem by carrying the cross-covariance between state and weights; and iii) widen the last-layer posterior with observation embeddings the policy already computes, improving uncertainty estimates without retraining for CoMP and several test-time estimators alike. We demonstrate these benefits on three manipulation benchmarks with applications in failure detection and demonstration selection for fine-tuning, where CoMP corrects BayesDiff's variance collapse while matching or outperforming several uncertainty estimators.
zh_title: 相干矩传播：预训练机器人策略的认知不确定性
translation: 流匹配策略是机器人学习领域最先进的基础，在从长周期规划到灵巧操作等任务中取得了令人印象深刻的成果。然而，它们无法衡量其预测指令是否值得信任，特别是在训练集之外的新颖情况下。认知不确定性反映了模型权重的不确定性并量化了这种无知，但在推理时从流匹配策略计算它并非易事。动作是由ODE求解器产生的，需要将不确定性通过整个积分过程进行传播。BayesDiff通过在最后一层拉普拉斯后验近似下，在去噪链中传播状态的均值和方差来解决扩散模型的这个问题，但它严重低估了认知不确定性。在本文中，我们：i) 证明，对于流匹配和扩散ODE，BayesDiff的总方差随着求解器使用的Euler步数T的增加而以O(1/T)的速度衰减；ii) 引入相干矩传播（CoMP），这是一种受扩展卡尔曼滤波器和无迹卡尔曼滤波器启发的两种递归方法，通过携带状态和权重之间的交叉协方差来解决这个问题；iii) 通过策略已经计算的观测嵌入来拓宽最后一层后验，从而在不重新训练CoMP和几个测试时间估计器的情况下提高不确定性估计。我们在三个操作基准上展示了这些优势，应用于故障检测和用于微调的演示选择，其中CoMP纠正了BayesDiff的方差崩溃，同时匹配或优于多个不确定性估计器。
tldr: 当前机器人策略缺乏不确定性度量。本文提出CoMP，一种新的方法，用于估计流匹配策略中的认知不确定性，纠正了BayesDiff等现有方法的问题，并改进了不确定性估计。
ai_comments: 该论文解决了最先进机器人学习策略的一个关键限制，通过提供一种鲁棒的方法来量化认知不确定性。其创新之处在于CoMP递归方法能够正确传播交叉协方差，以及巧妙地利用现有观测嵌入来在不重新训练的情况下提高不确定性。这可能显著增强机器人在现实、不确定环境中部署的安全性和可靠性。
motivation: 流匹配策略在机器人学习中取得了最先进的成果，但它们无法衡量其预测指令是否值得信任，尤其是在训练集之外的新颖情况下。现有的BayesDiff方法严重低估了认知不确定性，其总方差以O(1/T)的速度衰减。
method: 本文证明了对于流匹配和扩散ODE，BayesDiff的总方差随着求解器使用的Euler步数T的增加而以O(1/T)的速度衰减。为此，提出了相干矩传播（CoMP），这是一种受扩展卡尔曼滤波器和无迹卡尔曼滤波器启发的两种递归方法，通过携带状态和权重之间的交叉协方差来解决这个问题。此外，通过策略已经计算的观测嵌入来拓宽最后一层后验，从而在不重新训练CoMP和几个测试时间估计器的情况下提高不确定性估计。
results: 这些优势在三个操作基准上得到了证明，应用于故障检测和用于微调的演示选择。CoMP纠正了BayesDiff的方差崩溃，同时匹配或优于多个不确定性估计器。
conclusion: CoMP通过传播交叉协方差并拓宽后验，有效解决了流匹配策略中认知不确定性的低估问题，从而为机器人学习应用提供了改进的不确定性估计。

title: Scoliosis5K: Multimodal Gait Analysis via Clip-Conditioned RGB-Silhouette Fusion
authors: Zizhao Peng, Zihan Wang, Zheng Lv, Yan Wang, Ping Li, Fengwei An
abstract: Color walking video records body boundary motion alongside clothing folds, surface appearance, and recording-environment cues. To examine what an explicit binary silhouette contributes to participant-level classification of scoliosis-related gait when a classifier already observes the paired color sequence, we construct Scoliosis5K, a multi-site collection of 4,998 corridor-walking sequences across 3,010 participant identifiers in which RGB person crops, binary silhouettes, and two-dimensional poses share each recording identifier and frame index. Our architecture uses each patch's pixel deviation from its clip mean to weight two low-rank query and value updates inside a pretrained RGB encoder, fusing the resulting video representation with a silhouette transformer sequence and regional kernel ridge scores extracted from one native-resolution RGB frame per window. Across 988 participants in five participant-disjoint cross-validation folds and three training seeds, the complete system reaches 83.77% accuracy and 79.91% macro-averaged F1, compared with 83.27% accuracy and 79.56% macro-F1 when the video RGB encoder remains frozen under identical inputs. Zeroing the silhouette vector at fixed weights shifts overall accuracy by only 0.10 percentage points while raising positive-category recall from 68.52% to 77.78% and lowering recall for both remaining categories. Macro-averaged AUROC is 0.950 across the cohort and 0.879 among participant pairs matched on acquisition site and recording-count group.
comment: 11 pages (8-page main paper and 3-page supplementary material), 3 figures, 12 tables
zh_title: Scoliosis5K：通过剪辑条件RGB-轮廓融合进行多模态步态分析
translation: 彩色行走视频记录了身体边界运动以及衣物褶皱、表面外观和记录环境线索。为了探究当分类器已经观察到配对的彩色序列时，显式二进制轮廓对脊柱侧弯相关步态的参与者级别分类有何贡献，我们构建了Scoliosis5K，这是一个多站点数据集，包含3,010名参与者的4,998个走廊行走序列，其中RGB人物裁剪、二进制轮廓和二维姿态共享每个记录标识符和帧索引。我们的架构使用每个补丁的像素偏差与其剪辑均值来加权预训练RGB编码器内的两个低秩查询和值更新，并将所得视频表示与轮廓Transformer序列以及从每个窗口的一个原生分辨率RGB帧中提取的区域核岭得分融合。在988名参与者的五折参与者不相交交叉验证和三个训练种子中，完整系统达到了83.77%的准确率和79.91%的宏平均F1分数，相比之下，当视频RGB编码器在相同输入下保持冻结时，准确率为83.27%，宏平均F1为79.56%。在固定权重下将轮廓向量置零，总体准确率仅移动0.10个百分点，同时将阳性类别的召回率从68.52%提高到77.78%，并降低了其余两个类别的召回率。队列的宏平均AUROC为0.950，在采集地点和记录计数组匹配的参与者对中为0.879。
tldr: Scoliosis5K是一个多站点数据集，用于脊柱侧弯相关的步态分析。该研究通过将RGB视频与二进制轮廓和二维姿态融合，构建了一个新的架构，实现了高准确度和F1分数，并探讨了显式二进制轮廓对分类的贡献。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于构建了一个大规模的Scoliosis5K数据集，并提出了一种新颖的多模态融合架构，结合了RGB视频、二进制轮廓和姿态信息进行脊柱侧弯相关的步态分析。通过量化二进制轮廓对分类性能，特别是召回率的贡献，该研究为理解不同模态信息在医疗诊断中的作用提供了有价值的见解。其方法具有较高的准确性和F1分数，表明了其在实际应用中的潜力。
motivation: 为了探究当分类器已经观察到配对的彩色序列时，显式二进制轮廓对脊柱侧弯相关步态的参与者级别分类有何贡献。
method: 研究构建了Scoliosis5K数据集，包含来自3,010名参与者的4,998个走廊行走序列，其中RGB人物裁剪、二进制轮廓和二维姿态共享记录标识符和帧索引。其架构使用每个补丁的像素偏差与其剪辑均值来加权预训练RGB编码器内的两个低秩查询和值更新，并将所得视频表示与轮廓Transformer序列以及从每个窗口的一个原生分辨率RGB帧中提取的区域核岭得分融合。
results: 在988名参与者的五折交叉验证和三个训练种子中，完整系统达到83.77%的准确率和79.91%的宏平均F1分数。当视频RGB编码器在相同输入下保持冻结时，准确率为83.27%，宏平均F1为79.56%。将轮廓向量在固定权重下置零，总体准确率仅移动0.10个百分点，同时将阳性类别的召回率从68.52%提高到77.78%，并降低了其余两个类别的召回率。队列的宏平均AUROC为0.950，在采集地点和记录计数组匹配的参与者对中为0.879。
conclusion: 研究表明，虽然显式二进制轮廓对整体准确率的直接提升有限，但它能显著提高阳性类别的召回率。多模态融合（RGB、轮廓、姿态）对于脊柱侧弯相关的步态分析是有效的，并能达到高分类性能。

title: Self-Supervised Learning with Recursive Quadrature Filters for Neural Time Series
authors: Mirko Morello, Shivang Rawat, David J. Heeger
abstract: We develop self-supervised methods for training Recursive Quadrature Filter (RQF) encoders on unlabeled time series. RQFs are biologically motivated, complex-valued temporal filters that form a special class of diagonal state-space models (SSMs). Each RQF acts as a band-pass filter whose selectivity is determined by two learnable parameters: its tuning frequency and bandwidth. We separately introduce a self-supervised learning objective based on prediction error; the encoder is trained so that its current state predicts its own future activity. In the windowed mode, the summary of the current window predicts the summary of a later window; in the dense mode, the state at the current timestep predicts future log-power. Each RQF encoder is pretrained on a dataset and then a readout (e.g., a task-specific classifier) is trained on the output of the RQF encoder, with the encoder either frozen or fully fine-tuned. For multichannel EEG and intracranial recordings, a shared encoder processes each channel separately, and a spatial readout combines the channel representations using electrode locations. Across four neural benchmarks using scalp or intracranial EEG, the pretrained RQF system performs close to the state of the art while using a small fraction of the parameters of the competing models. For example, a 110k-parameter RQF system achieves 0.9247 +/- 0.0022 test AUROC on 100-s TUAB segments, above SAMBA (0.9054) at the same context with 9 times as many parameters, and 0.9040 +/- 0.0019 on 10-s segments, comparable to EEG foundation models with 3.2M-369M parameters.
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 12 tables. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for the Brain and Body. Code: https://github.com/Sequel-Institute/rqf-ssl
zh_title: 神经时间序列的递归正交滤波器自监督学习
translation: 我们开发了用于在无标签时间序列上训练递归正交滤波器（RQF）编码器的自监督方法。RQF是受生物学启发的复值时间滤波器，形成一类特殊的对角状态空间模型（SSM）。每个RQF作为一个带通滤波器，其选择性由两个可学习参数决定：其调谐频率和带宽。我们独立引入了一个基于预测误差的自监督学习目标；编码器被训练使其当前状态预测其自身的未来活动。在窗口模式下，当前窗口的摘要预测后续窗口的摘要；在密集模式下，当前时间步的状态预测未来的对数功率。每个RQF编码器在一个数据集上进行预训练，然后在一个读出器（例如，一个任务特定的分类器）在RQF编码器的输出上进行训练，编码器可以被冻结或完全微调。对于多通道EEG和颅内记录，一个共享编码器单独处理每个通道，一个空间读出器使用电极位置组合通道表示。在四项使用头皮或颅内EEG的神经基准测试中，预训练的RQF系统性能接近最先进水平，同时使用的参数量仅为竞争模型的一小部分。例如，一个110k参数的RQF系统在100秒TUAB片段上实现了0.9247 +/- 0.0022的测试AUROC，高于相同上下文下参数量多9倍的SAMBA (0.9054)，并在10秒片段上实现了0.9040 +/- 0.0019，与参数量为3.2M-369M的EEG基础模型相当。
tldr: 开发了用于神经时间序列的自监督递归正交滤波器（RQF）编码器，在参数量远少于SOTA模型的情况下实现了接近SOTA的性能。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新点在于将生物学启发的递归正交滤波器与自监督学习相结合，有效利用无标签神经时间序列数据。其重要性体现在实现了参数效率高且性能接近或超越SOTA的模型，这对于资源受限的神经信号处理应用具有重要意义。该方法为开发轻量级且高效的神经信号分析工具提供了新途径。
motivation: 旨在开发处理无标签时间序列数据的自监督方法，并利用生物学启发的递归正交滤波器（RQF）来解决现有模型参数量大、效率低的问题。
method: 本文开发了用于在无标签时间序列上训练递归正交滤波器（RQF）编码器的自监督方法。RQF是生物学启发的复值时间滤波器，属于对角状态空间模型，每个RQF作为带通滤波器，其选择性由调谐频率和带宽决定。自监督学习目标基于预测误差，编码器被训练以使其当前状态预测未来的活动，包括窗口模式（当前窗口摘要预测后续窗口摘要）和密集模式（当前时间步状态预测未来对数功率）。RQF编码器预训练后，读出器在编码器输出上训练，编码器可冻结或微调。对于多通道记录，共享编码器独立处理通道，空间读出器结合表示。
results: 在四项使用头皮或颅内EEG的神经基准测试中，预训练的RQF系统性能接近最先进水平，同时使用的参数量仅为竞争模型的一小部分。例如，一个110k参数的RQF系统在100秒TUAB片段上实现了0.9247 +/- 0.0022的测试AUROC，优于相同上下文下参数量多9倍的SAMBA (0.9054)。在10秒片段上实现了0.9040 +/- 0.0019，与参数量为3.2M-369M的EEG基础模型相当。
conclusion: 本文提出的自监督递归正交滤波器（RQF）系统，在神经时间序列处理任务中，以显著更少的参数实现了与最先进模型相当甚至更优的性能，证明了其在效率和有效性方面的潜力。

title: CarrierKV: An Edge LLM Accelerator with Positional Carrier Decomposition for Low-Bit KV Cache
authors: Junyi Luo, Xinting Jiang, Ruichen Qi, Gregory Kielian, Quan Cheng, Mehdi Saligane
abstract: Long-context decoding on edge devices is limited by DRAM, because every generated token reads the whole, growing KV cache. 4-bit block-scaled formats such as NVFP4 reduce this traffic but degrade accuracy: on Qwen3-4B, NVFP4 lowers 32K RULER (seven tasks) from 92.6 to 79.4, and a Hadamard rotation lowers it further to 57.7. We observe that most of the key energy is a positional carrier, one per-head vector that rotary position embedding (RoPE) rotates with position. In NVFP4, it sets the shared scale of most key blocks and lowers the signal-to-quantization-noise ratio of the content by about 5 dB, nearly one bit, yet it depends only on that vector and the position. We therefore introduce positional carrier decomposition, which removes the carrier before RoPE and stores only the content residual. We design a KV path that rotates and quantizes keys only after this removal and computes each attention score directly on the 4-bit code. We also design a positional phase engine that regenerates the carrier's score term for one key per cycle. At the same cache size as NVFP4, CarrierKV raises 32K RULER on Qwen3-4B from 79.4 to 91.1 and lowers the 32K PG19 perplexity increase of NVFP4 by 1.8 to 5.9 times on four models, outperforming SageAttention and P3-LLM on all four. Its loss also stays nearly flat as the cache grows, while that of NVFP4 rises. In a 22 nm FDSOI process at 600 MHz, CarrierKV's hardware increases the area of the NVFP4 accelerator by 2.9% and the energy of a 20K-token reasoning request on Qwen3-4B by 0.12% at the same decode latency. On Qwen3-4B at 32K, CarrierKV has a better RULER score than FP8 keys (91.1 against 89.3) and uses 13.7% less energy per token. The decomposition also lowers the 32K perplexity increase of 3-bit TurboQuant keys on Qwen3-4B from 69.7 to 0.76.
zh_title: CarrierKV：一种用于低位KV缓存的带位置载波分解的边缘LLM加速器
translation: 边缘设备上的长上下文解码受到DRAM的限制，因为每个生成的token都会读取整个不断增长的KV缓存。NVFP4等4位块缩放格式减少了这种流量，但会降低准确性：在Qwen3-4B上，NVFP4将32K RULER（七项任务）从92.6降低到79.4，而Hadamard旋转将其进一步降低到57.7。我们观察到，大部分关键能量是位置载波，每个头部一个向量，旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）会随着位置旋转它。在NVFP4中，它设置了大多数关键块的共享比例，并将内容的信噪比降低了约5 dB，接近一位，但它仅取决于该向量和位置。因此，我们引入了位置载波分解，它在RoPE之前移除载波，并且只存储内容残差。我们设计了一个KV路径，在该移除之后才旋转和量化键，并直接在4位代码上计算每个注意力分数。我们还设计了一个位置相位引擎，每个周期为一个键重新生成载波的分数项。在与NVFP4相同的缓存大小下，CarrierKV将Qwen3-4B上的32K RULER从79.4提高到91.1，并将NVFP4在四种模型上的32K PG19困惑度增加降低了1.8到5.9倍，在所有四种模型上都优于SageAttention和P3-LLM。随着缓存的增长，它的损耗也几乎保持不变，而NVFP4的损耗则会上升。在600 MHz的22 nm FDSOI工艺中，CarrierKV的硬件将NVFP4加速器的面积增加了2.9%，在相同的解码延迟下，Qwen3-4B上20K token推理请求的能量增加了0.12%。在32K的Qwen3-4B上，CarrierKV的RULER分数优于FP8键（91.1对89.3），并且每个token的能耗降低了13.7%。该分解还将Qwen3-4B上3位TurboQuant键的32K困惑度增加从69.7降低到0.76。
tldr: CarrierKV通过位置载波分解，在边缘设备上实现了低位KV缓存，显著提升了长上下文LLM的准确性和能效。
ai_comments: 该论文通过对低位KV缓存中关键能量组成（特别是位置载波）的深入观察，提出了创新的位置载波分解方法。这一方法不仅有效解决了边缘设备上LLM长上下文解码的精度损失问题，还在硬件开销极小的情况下实现了显著的性能提升和能效优化。其对3位量化的成功应用也展示了该技术在超低位量化领域的巨大潜力，对推动边缘AI发展具有重要意义。
motivation: 边缘设备上的长上下文解码受DRAM限制，因为每个生成的token都需读取不断增长的KV缓存。现有4位块缩放格式（如NVFP4）虽减少流量但会降低准确性。研究观察到，大部分键能量是位置载波，它在NVFP4中降低了内容的信噪比约5 dB。
method: 本文引入了位置载波分解技术，在旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）之前移除载波并仅存储内容残差。设计了一个KV路径，在该移除之后才旋转和量化键，并直接在4位代码上计算注意力分数。同时设计了一个位置相位引擎，每个周期为一个键重新生成载波的分数项。
results: 在与NVFP4相同的缓存大小下，CarrierKV将Qwen3-4B上的32K RULER从79.4提高到91.1。它将NVFP4在四种模型上的32K PG19困惑度增加降低了1.8到5.9倍，并优于SageAttention和P3-LLM。其损耗随着缓存增长几乎保持不变，而NVFP4的损耗则上升。在硬件方面，CarrierKV的硬件面积增加了2.9%，能量增加了0.12%，但RULER分数优于FP8键（91.1对89.3），且每token能耗降低13.7%。该分解还将3位TurboQuant键的32K困惑度增加从69.7降低到0.76。
conclusion: CarrierKV通过位置载波分解有效解决了边缘设备上低位KV缓存的长上下文LLM精度下降问题，在实现更高准确性和能效的同时，硬件开销极小，并能支持超低位量化。

title: Staleness Deadlines for Motion Plans during Onboard Reasoning
authors: Hassan Iqbal
abstract: Language models may enable general autonomy in robot planning, but onboard their reasoning can run for most of a minute while the robot and nearby pedestrians keep moving. The robot must then decide how long to follow a plan that the pending answer may overturn. Here we present staleness deadlines, which hand that decision to the robot's clock. Calibrated prediction regions for pedestrians and deviation tubes for the robot set the deadline. When the language model answers, a graph planner rebuilds the route, which the robot adopts only after it passes the same clearance check against walls and predicted pedestrians. Exact binomial tests determine which prespecified budget-selection policies keep close calls, wrong decisions and late arrivals below their targets at each inference profile. Candidate policies either fix one budget or set each query's budget from how long the robot can continue its plan before it must brake. We study corridor signs that close routes and delivery requests whose destination the language model must infer. In 81,000 simulated missions with recorded Qwen3-4B answers, full reasoning cuts wrong decisions about twentyfold, and tracking until the deadline cuts late arrivals by up to 64%. The robot never collides while it moves, although pedestrians who never yield still walk into the stopped robot in 23% of offline and 32% of live missions. On a Jetson AGX Orin under perception load, short budgets fail the wrong-decision target, and full reasoning the lateness target. Between these extremes, a fixed-budget policy passes for corridor signs and per-query policies pass for deliveries. Live Orin runs match offline replay on all three losses in 24 of the 32 missions where either run records a loss. The deadline turns slower reasoning into measurable mission outcomes, which let designers test how much reasoning each inference profile can support.
zh_title: 板载推理中运动计划的陈旧性截止日期
translation: 语言模型可能使机器人规划实现通用自主性，但在板载推理过程中，机器人和附近的行人会持续移动，推理可能运行近一分钟。机器人必须决定遵循一个可能被待定答案推翻的计划多久。本文提出了陈旧性截止日期，将这个决策交给机器人的时钟。行人的校准预测区域和机器人的偏差管道设定了截止日期。当语言模型给出答案时，图规划器会重建路线，机器人仅在通过对墙壁和预测行人的相同间隙检查后才采纳该路线。精确二项式检验确定哪些预设的预算选择策略能将险情、错误决策和迟到控制在每个推理配置文件下的目标以下。候选策略要么固定一个预算，要么根据机器人在必须刹车前能继续执行其计划多久来设置每个查询的预算。我们研究了关闭路线的走廊标志和语言模型必须推断目的地的送货请求。在81,000次模拟任务中，记录了Qwen3-4B的答案，完整推理将错误决策减少约20倍，并且跟踪计划直到截止日期将迟到减少高达64%。机器人在移动时从未发生碰撞，尽管在23%的离线任务和32%的实时任务中，从不避让的行人仍然会撞上停止的机器人。在感知负载下的Jetson AGX Orin上，短预算未能达到错误决策目标，而完整推理未能达到迟到目标。在这些极端之间，固定预算策略适用于走廊标志，而按查询预算策略适用于送货。在32个任一运行记录损失的任务中，实时Orin运行在24个任务中与离线回放的所有三种损失匹配。截止日期将较慢的推理转化为可衡量的任务结果，这使设计人员能够测试每个推理配置文件可以支持多少推理。
tldr: 机器人使用语言模型规划时，环境动态变化导致计划过时。本文提出“陈旧性截止日期”机制，让机器人根据时间决定何时放弃旧计划，并通过实验验证其能显著减少错误决策和迟到。
ai_comments: 这项研究创新性地引入了“陈旧性截止日期”的概念，为机器人板载推理中处理计划时效性问题提供了一个量化框架。它解决了将慢速、复杂的语言模型推理整合到实时动态机器人操作中的关键挑战。通过将决策权交给时间而不是复杂的预测逻辑，简化了系统设计。同时，研究通过对比不同预算策略在特定任务场景下的表现，为实际系统部署提供了有价值的指导。然而，行人仍然会撞上停止的机器人这一结果，揭示了在完全动态、不可预测的人机交互中仍存在的挑战。
motivation: 机器人使用语言模型进行自主规划时，推理时间可能长达一分钟，而机器人和行人都在移动，导致计划可能迅速过时。机器人需要一个机制来决定在等待新计划时，可以遵循当前计划多久。
method: 本文引入“陈旧性截止日期”概念，该截止日期由行人的校准预测区域和机器人的偏差管道共同设定。当语言模型给出答案后，图规划器会重建路线，机器人仅在通过对墙壁和预测行人的间隙检查后才采纳新路线。使用精确二项式检验来确定预设的预算选择策略是否能将险情、错误决策和迟到控制在目标以下。测试了两种策略：固定预算和根据机器人在必须刹车前能继续执行其计划多久来设置每个查询的预算。
results: 在81,000次模拟任务中，完整推理将错误决策减少约20倍，跟踪计划直到截止日期将迟到减少高达64%。机器人在移动时从未发生碰撞，但行人仍会在23%的离线任务和32%的实时任务中撞上停止的机器人。在Jetson AGX Orin上，短预算未能达到错误决策目标，而完整推理未能达到迟到目标。在这些极端之间，固定预算策略适用于走廊标志任务，而按查询预算策略适用于送货任务。在32个有损失记录的任务中，实时Orin运行在24个任务中与离线回放的所有三种损失匹配。
conclusion: “陈旧性截止日期”将较慢的推理转化为可衡量的任务结果，使设计人员能够测试每个推理配置文件可以支持多少推理。

title: Testability of Homomorphism Inadmissibility: Property Testing Meets Database Theory
authors: Hubie Chen, Yuichi Yoshida
abstract:
In this paper, we utilize the perspective of property testing to consider the testability of relational database queries. A primary motivation is the desire to avoid reading an entire database to decide a property thereof. We focus on conjunctive queries, which are the most basic and heavily studied database queries. Each conjunctive query can be represented as a relational structure $\mathbf{A}$ such that deciding if the conjunctive query is satisfied by a relational structure $\mathbf{B}$ is equivalent to deciding if there exists a homomorphism from $\mathbf{A}$ to $\mathbf{B}$. We phrase our results in terms of homomorphisms.
  Precisely, we study, for each relational structure $\mathbf{A}$, the testability of homomorphism inadmissibility from $\mathbf{A}$. We consider algorithms that have oracle access to an input relational structure $\mathbf{B}$ and that distinguish, with high probability, the case where there is no homomorphism from $\mathbf{A}$ to $\mathbf{B}$, from the case where one needs to remove a constant fraction of tuples from $\mathbf{B}$ in order to suppress all such homomorphisms. We provide a complete characterization of the structures $\mathbf{A}$ from which one can test homomorphism inadmissibility with one-sided error by making a constant number of queries to $\mathbf{B}$. Our characterization shows that homomorphism inadmissibility from $\mathbf{A}$ is constant-query testable with one-sided error if and only if the core of $\mathbf{A}$ is $α$-acyclic. We also show that the injective version of the problem is constant-query testable with one-sided error if $\mathbf{A}$ is $α$-acyclic; this result generalizes existing results for testing subgraph-freeness in the general graph model.
comment: Version of an article that appeared in PODS '19
zh_title: 同态不可采纳性可测试性：属性测试与数据库理论的结合
translation:
在本文中，我们利用属性测试的视角来考虑关系数据库查询的可测试性。一个主要动机是希望避免读取整个数据库来判断其属性。我们专注于合取查询，这是最基本且被深入研究的数据库查询。每个合取查询都可以表示为一个关系结构 $\mathbf{A}$，这样判断合取查询是否被关系结构 $\mathbf{B}$ 满足就等价于判断是否存在从 $\mathbf{A}$ 到 $\mathbf{B}$ 的同态。我们以同态的形式表达我们的结果。
准确地说，我们研究了对于每个关系结构 $\mathbf{A}$，从 $\mathbf{A}$ 的同态不可采纳性（homomorphism inadmissibility）的可测试性。我们考虑的算法可以预言机访问输入关系结构 $\mathbf{B}$，并能以高概率区分两种情况：一种是从 $\mathbf{A}$ 到 $\mathbf{B}$ 不存在同态；另一种是需要从 $\mathbf{B}$ 中删除常数比例的元组才能抑制所有此类同态。我们提供了结构 $\mathbf{A}$ 的完整特征，使得从 $\mathbf{A}$ 的同态不可采纳性可以通过对 $\mathbf{B}$ 进行常数次查询以单边错误进行测试。我们的特征表明，当且仅当 $\mathbf{A}$ 的核心是 $\alpha$-无环的，从 $\mathbf{A}$ 的同态不可采纳性是常数查询可测试的（单边错误）。我们还表明，如果 $\mathbf{A}$ 是 $\alpha$-无环的，则问题的注入版本也是常数查询可测试的（单边错误）；这个结果推广了在通用图模型中测试子图无关性（subgraph-freeness）的现有结果。
tldr: 本文利用属性测试研究关系数据库查询的可测试性，特别是同态不可采纳性，并给出了常数查询可测试性的完整特征。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过将属性测试理论应用于数据库查询，提供了一种高效判断查询属性的方法，避免了全数据库扫描的巨大开销。其核心发现——同态不可采纳性可测试性与结构核心的α-无环性之间的等价关系，为数据库理论和属性测试交叉领域的研究提供了重要的理论基础和工具。
motivation: 主要动机是为了避免读取整个数据库来判断其属性，特别是在关系数据库查询（如合取查询）的背景下。
method: 论文采用属性测试的视角，将合取查询表示为关系结构A，其满足性等同于从A到B的同态是否存在。研究从A的同态不可采纳性（即不存在同态）的可测试性。算法通过预言机访问输入结构B，区分不存在同态和需要删除B中常数比例元组才能抑制同态的情况。
results: 提供了结构A的完整特征，使得从A的同态不可采纳性可以通过常数次查询B以单边错误进行测试。该特征表明，当且仅当A的核心是α-无环的，从A的同态不可采纳性是常数查询可测试的（单边错误）。此外，如果A是α-无环的，问题的注入版本也是常数查询可测试的（单边错误），此结果推广了通用图模型中测试子图无关性的现有成果。
conclusion: 当且仅当关系结构A的核心是α-无环时，其同态不可采纳性是常数查询可测试的，这为在不读取整个数据库的情况下判断查询属性提供了理论基础。

title: LLMs Memorize Their Own Hallucinations During Post-Training
authors: Anirudh Atmakuru, Tanya Goyal
abstract: Reasoning domains have shaped the post-training recipes of frontier models even though they are trained and deployed in domains beyond math and code. In this paper, we study the consequences of directly adopting reasoning-centric training recipes, e.g., the use of outcome-based rewards for reinforcement learning (RL), injection of "cognitive" behaviors such as proposing and backtracking from hypotheses in reasoning chains, etc., for knowledge tasks. We hypothesize that these decisions, while useful for reasoning, inadvertently encourage models to memorize hallucinations they themselves generate in their long reasoning chains when trained on knowledge tasks. To study this, we train models with standard post-training, extract their self-generated hallucinations during RL, and track memorization throughout the rest of training. Our experiments on six open models across two model families and two architectures confirm our hypothesis. We find that models' recall of hallucinations reinforced during training increases by 4.83% on average, compared to just 0.17% for self-hallucinations that receive no training signal. In fact, models even memorize false facts that they immediately retract in their reasoning; a backtracking template inherited from reasoning-centric training that has no benefit for knowledge recall. Furthermore, we find that memorization is strongest on the hardest training questions, and rewarding a hallucination makes the model less likely to abstain from it later (by 7.23% on average). Overall, our work identifies and systematically studies a previously unexamined pathway through which models learn hallucinations during training.
zh_title: 大语言模型在后训练期间会记忆它们自己的幻觉
translation: 推理领域塑造了前沿模型的后训练配方，尽管它们是在数学和代码之外的领域进行训练和部署的。在本文中，我们研究了直接采用以推理为中心的训练配方（例如，在强化学习中使用基于结果的奖励，在推理链中注入“认知”行为，如提出假设并从假设中回溯等）对知识任务的后果。我们假设，这些决策虽然对推理有用，但当在知识任务上进行训练时，会无意中鼓励模型记忆它们自己在长推理链中产生的幻觉。为了研究这一点，我们通过标准的后训练来训练模型，提取它们在强化学习期间自我生成的幻觉，并在整个训练过程中追踪记忆情况。我们在两个模型系列和两种架构的六个开源模型上的实验证实了我们的假设。我们发现，与仅收到0.17%训练信号的自我幻觉相比，模型对训练中被强化的幻觉的回忆平均增加了4.83%。事实上，模型甚至会记住它们在推理中立即撤回的虚假事实；这是一个从推理中心训练中继承下来的、对知识回忆没有好处的回溯模板。此外，我们发现记忆在最困难的训练问题上最强烈，并且对幻觉进行奖励会使模型在以后不太可能放弃它（平均减少7.23%）。总体而言，我们的工作识别并系统地研究了模型在训练过程中学习幻觉的一个此前未被检查的途径。
tldr: 大语言模型在将推理导向的后训练方法应用于知识任务时，会意外地记忆并强化它们自己产生的幻觉，导致幻觉现象加剧。
ai_comments: 该论文揭示了推理中心后训练范式（如RL）应用于知识任务时的负面副作用，证明了模型会无意中记忆自己产生的幻觉，为理解LLM幻觉来源提供了新的视角和重要见解。
motivation: 探究将原本针对数学和代码等推理领域的后训练方法（如基于结果的奖励、长推理链中的假设提出与回溯等）直接应用到知识类任务中时，会带来怎样的后果。
method: 通过对六个开源模型（涵盖两个模型系列和两种架构）进行标准后训练，提取其在强化学习过程中自我生成的幻觉，并跟踪整个训练过程中的记忆情况。
results: 实验表明，模型对训练中得到强化的幻觉的召回率平均增加了4.83%（而未获得训练信号的自我幻觉仅增加0.17%）；模型甚至会记忆其在推理链中立即撤回的虚假事实；且这种幻觉记忆在最难的训练问题上最为强烈，同时受到奖励会使模型后续减少拒绝该幻觉的倾向（平均下降7.23%）。
conclusion: 直接将面向推理的后训练策略应用于知识任务会导致模型严重记忆自身产生的幻觉，并降低其后续拒绝回答不确定问题的能力，这凸显了为不同任务设计差异化后训练策略的必要性。

title: FlowScope: 3D Scene Flow Pretraining Improves Surgical Robot Policies
authors: John J. Han, Adam Schmidt, Jingpei Lu, Zooey He, Muhammad Abdullah Jamal, Jie Ying Wu, Omid Mohareri
abstract: Imitation learning for surgical robots is limited by the cost of collecting demonstrations. Meanwhile, many robot-assisted procedures are recorded as stereo video, yet policies cannot learn from them directly; clinical video carries no action labels. We present FlowScope, which pretrains a surgical policy network on unlabeled clinical video by forecasting scene flow, the metric 3D motion of scene points, with labels computed by off-the-shelf stereo depth and optical flow models. We pretrain the trunk of an Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) on a dataset of 1,149 clinical procedures (1.35M clips) and discard the flow head afterward, so the deployed policy is a standard ACT with no added inference cost. On a real surgical robotic system, FlowScope raises needle pickup success from 54% to 90% and first-handover success on needle regrasp from 4% to 52% (full task: 2% to 14%) over training from scratch (n=50 trials each), and retains its gains with a generative flow-matching action head. Ablations indicate that metric 3D motion is the strongest pretraining signal among those tested; kinematics, 2D tracks, depth alone, and scale-free 3D flow, each paired with kinematics, yield smaller or no gains. Representation analyses suggest that scene-flow pretraining encodes metric needle depth more accurately, that kinematics pretraining increases reliance on the robot state, and that needle-depth probes follow the ordering of real-robot success where offline validation error does not.
zh_title: FlowScope：3D场景流预训练提升手术机器人策略
translation: 手术机器人的模仿学习受到收集演示成本的限制。同时，许多机器人辅助手术被记录为立体视频，但策略无法直接从中学到东西，因为临床视频没有动作标签。我们提出了FlowScope，它通过预测场景 flow（场景点的公制3D运动）在未标记的临床视频上预训练手术策略网络，标签由现成的立体深度和光流模型计算得出。我们在1,149个临床程序（1.35M剪辑）的数据集上预训练了动作分块变换器（ACT）的主干，之后丢弃了流头，因此部署的策略是一个标准的ACT，没有增加推理成本。在真实的手术机器人系统上，与从头开始训练相比（每个n=50次试验），FlowScope将针头拾取成功率从54%提高到90%，将针头重新抓取的第一次交接成功率从4%提高到52%（完整任务：从2%提高到14%），并通过生成流匹配动作头保持了其增益。消融表明，公制3D运动是我们测试的最强的预训练信号；运动学、2D轨迹、单独的深度和无尺度3D流与运动学配对，产生了更小或没有增益。表征分析表明，场景流预训练能更准确地编码公制针深，运动学预训练增加了对机器人状态的依赖，针深探针遵循真实机器人成功的顺序，而离线验证误差则不然。
tldr: 通过对无标注临床视频进行3D场景流预测预训练，无需增加推理成本即可大幅提升手术机器人的模仿学习成功率。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地利用了大量无标注的手术临床视频，通过预测场景流（3D运动）进行自监督预训练，显著提升了手术机器人的模仿学习性能，且在推理时没有任何额外开销。实验证明了3D几何与运动信息在手术机器人策略预训练中的关键作用。
motivation: 手术机器人的模仿学习受限于收集人类示范的高成本，而大量无动作标签的临床立体视频未被充分利用。
method: 利用现成的立体深度和光流模型计算标签，预训练动作分块Transformer（ACT）的网络主干以预测场景流（度量3D场景点运动），随后丢弃流预测头用于标准策略部署。
results: 在真实手术机器人系统上，FlowScope将针头拾取成功率从54%提升至90%，针头重新抓取的首次交接成功率从4%提升至52%，并且度量3D运动被证明是最有效的预训练信号。
conclusion: FlowScope通过3D场景流预训练无标注临床视频，显著提升了外科机器人的模仿学习策略（如针头抓取和交接成功率），且不增加推理成本。

title: Effectiveness of Synthetic Defects for Anomaly Detection in Industrial Small Load Carriers
authors: Vincent Wahyudi, Kuniko Paxton, Amila Akagić, Martin Storath, Dhavalkumar Thakker
abstract: Recent industrial anomaly detection methods use procedural noise to generate synthetic training defects. Their effectiveness in real-world settings and the impact of different noise generation methods have not been sufficiently investigated. We evaluate the effectiveness of training using synthetic defects for both supervised and unsupervised methods, the impact of different noise generation methods, and the differences in detection performance between benchmark datasets and a real-world small load carrier (SLC) dataset. Trained on synthetic defects only, a supervised classifier reaches 0.65 AUROC on real SLC defects, while three unsupervised methods using the same kind of noise (Perlin) reach 0.87--0.90. Except for SuperSimpleNet, which fails with the foreground-confined fractal Brownian motion (fBm) recipe, models trained with the custom recipe or with nine other noise types do not differ reliably from those trained with Perlin noise. Finally, results with synthetic defects on benchmark datasets do not carry over to the SLC dataset, possibly because the synthetic defects differ too much from the real ones (a larger angle in feature space). These results call for caution when training models on synthetic defect images.
zh_title: 合成缺陷用于工业小负载载具异常检测的有效性
translation: 近期的工业异常检测方法使用程序化噪声来生成合成训练缺陷。它们在真实世界环境中的有效性以及不同噪声生成方法的影响尚未得到充分研究。我们评估了使用合成缺陷进行训练对有监督和无监督方法的有效性、不同噪声生成方法的影响，以及基准数据集与真实小负载载具（SLC）数据集之间检测性能的差异。在仅使用合成缺陷训练的情况下，有监督分类器在真实的SLC缺陷上达到了0.65的AUROC，而使用同种噪声（Perlin）的三种无监督方法达到了0.87--0.90。除了SuperSimpleNet在前景限制的分形布朗运动（fBm）配方下失效外，使用自定义配方或另外九种噪声类型训练的模型与使用Perlin噪声训练的模型没有可靠的性能差异。最后，基准数据集上的合成缺陷结果并不能直接转移到SLC数据集上，这可能是因为合成缺陷与真实缺陷相差太大（特征空间中的夹角较大）。这些结果表明，在使用合成缺陷图像训练模型时需要谨慎。
tldr: 该论文评估了利用合成缺陷进行工业异常检测的效果，发现无监督方法表现较好，但基准数据集的结果无法很好地泛化到真实的小负载载具（SLC）数据集，呼吁在实际应用中对合成缺陷训练保持谨慎。
ai_comments: 该论文探讨了合成缺陷在工业小负载载具（SLC）异常检测中的实际效果，揭示了基准数据集结果难以直接泛化到真实复杂场景的问题，对工业异常检测的实际应用具有重要的警示和指导意义。
motivation: 当前工业异常检测方法常采用程序化噪声生成合成训练缺陷，但其在真实场景中的有效性以及不同噪声生成方法的影响尚未得到充分研究。
method: 评估了基于合成缺陷（如Perlin噪声、分形布朗运动等九种噪声类型）训练监督和无监督异常检测方法的有效性，并对比了基准数据集与真实SLC数据集之间的检测性能差异。
results: 监督分类器在真实SLC缺陷上仅达到0.65的AUROC，而三种使用Perlin噪声的无监督方法达到了0.87-0.90；除特定模型在特定噪声下失败外，大多数噪声类型对模型性能的影响无显著差异；基准数据集上的合成缺陷结果无法直接泛化到SLC数据集。
conclusion: 使用合成缺陷训练异常检测模型需谨慎，基准数据集的评估结果不能直接迁移到真实的SLC数据集，未来需要更贴近真实缺陷的合成方法。

title: SonoAtlasWorld: Anatomy-Grounded Ultrasound World Models for Wide-Range Scanning
authors: Zheyuan Zhang, Boris Mailhe, Hang Yu, Yikang Liu, Xiao Chen, Ankush Mukherjee, Terrence Chen, Shanhui Sun
abstract: Learning robotic ultrasound policies requires interactive environments for scalable data generation and repeatable evaluation, while exploration on real patients is limited by acquisition costs and safety constraints. Generative world models offer an alternative, but image history and probe actions alone do not ensure anatomical consistency across wide-range scans and changing acoustic windows. We introduce SonoAtlasWorld, an ultrasound world model built on anatomy as state. A persistent 3D anatomical asset extracted from computed tomography (CT) anchors each scan to a specific anatomy. Probe actions determine anatomical and acoustic visibility conditions for a causal ultrasound generator trained on clinical videos. Our three-stage pipeline combines anatomy-conditioned pretraining, causal conversion and long-rollout alignment. Inference optimizations achieve pose-to-ultrasound throughput of 81.2 FPS. To evaluate anatomical control beyond image similarity, we introduce the Action-Following Index (AFI), which measures normalized reconstruction gain over a static-prefix baseline. On 40 held-out 3D volumes, SonoAtlasWorld achieves liver and macro-organ AFI of 0.428 and 0.262, compared with at most 0.117 and 0.038 for the tested action- and geometry-conditioned methods. Long-rollout alignment reduces brightness drift by 3.46x at the end of 40 repeated scan cycles. SonoAtlasWorld also generates offline policy-training demonstrations and supports anatomically grounded closed-loop evaluation. Scaling the generated training data improves key-plane acquisition success from 48.2% to 81.2% on unseen anatomies in simulation, demonstrating its utility for robotic ultrasound policy learning.
comment: Interactive video demonstrations are available at: https://sonoatlasworld.github.io/SonoAtlasWorld
zh_title: SonoAtlasWorld：用于广域扫描的基于解剖学的超声世界模型
translation: 学习机器人超声策略需要用于可扩展数据生成和可重复评估的交互式环境，而在真实患者身上的探索受到采集成本和安全约束的限制。生成式世界模型提供了另一种选择，但仅靠图像历史和探头动作无法确保跨广域扫描和不断变化的声学窗口的解剖一致性。我们推出了 SonoAtlasWorld，这是一种以解剖学为状态构建的超声世界模型。从计算机断层扫描（CT）中提取的持久 3D 解剖资产将每次扫描锚定到特定的解剖结构。探头动作决定了在临床视频上训练的因果超声生成器的解剖和声学可见性条件。我们的三阶段流水线结合了解剖条件预训练、因果转换和长序列对齐。推理优化实现了 81.2 FPS 的姿态到超声吞吐量。为了评估超出图像相似性的解剖控制，我们引入了动作跟随指数（AFI），该指数测量相对于静态前缀基线的归一化重建增益。在 40 个留出的 3D 体积上，SonoAtlasWorld 的肝脏和大器官 AFI 分别达到 0.428 和 0.262，而测试的动作和几何条件方法的 AFI 分别最高为 0.117 和 0.038。长序列对齐将 40 次重复扫描循环结束时的亮度漂移降低了 3.46 倍。SonoAtlasWorld 还生成离线策略训练示范，并支持基于解剖学的闭环评估。扩展生成的训练数据使模拟中未见解剖结构的关键平面采集成功率从 48.2% 提高到 81.2%，证明了其在机器人超声策略学习中的效用。
tldr: 本文提出了 SonoAtlasWorld，一种基于解剖学状态的超声世界模型，能够生成具有解剖一致性的广域超声扫描，显著提升机器人超声策略的学习与评估能力。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了基于解剖学状态的超声世界模型 SonoAtlasWorld，解决了传统超声生成模型在广域扫描中缺乏解剖一致性的痛点。通过结合 CT 提取的 3D 解剖资产与因果超声生成器，实现了高帧率和出色的解剖学控制，对机器人超声策略的学习和评估具有重要价值。
motivation: 学习机器人超声策略需要交互式环境，但真实患者扫描受限于采集成本和安全约束；现有的生成式世界模型在广域扫描和改变声学窗口时无法保证解剖一致性，因此需要一个以解剖学为基础的超声世界模型来解决这一问题。
method: 提出了一个三阶段流水线，包括解剖条件预训练、因果转换和长序列对齐；利用从 CT 中提取的持久 3D 解剖资产锚定扫描，并结合基于临床视频训练的因果超声生成器来模拟探头动作对解剖和声学可见性的影响。
results: 在 40 个留出的 3D 体积上，肝脏和大器官的动作跟随指数（AFI）分别达到了 0.428 和 0.262（优于对比方法的 0.117 和 0.038）；长序列对齐将 40 次重复扫描循环结束时的亮度漂移减少了 3.46 倍；利用生成的训练数据可将未见解剖结构的关键平面采集成功率从 48.2% 提高到 81.2%。
conclusion: SonoAtlasWorld 成功构建了一个基于解剖学的超声世界模型，在广域扫描中保持了高度的解剖一致性，显著提升了机器人超声策略的学习效率和成功率。

title: How Long Will My Language Model Run? A Benchmark for Pre-Execution Runtime Prediction
authors: Ashish Molakalapalli, Kangda Wei, Haonan Duan, Alex Carter, Ruihong Huang
abstract: Researchers submitting deep learning jobs to shared GPU clusters need runtime estimates to request time limits, choose hardware, and budget compute. Large language models (LLMs) offer a tempting shortcut: describe the job and ask. We introduce PreRun, a benchmark for predicting deep learning training and inference runtime from information available before execution. PreRun contains 801 training and 1,884 inference records of language and vision models collected on a GPU cluster, paired with workload configurations and explicitly defined timing targets. It also includes 64 text-generation configurations measured under standardized conditions, each in three separate program launches. We compare three LLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, GPT-OSS-120B, and Claude Opus 5.5) with regression baselines and evaluate analytical estimates on a supported forward-pass subset. On 16 held-out generation configurations, the open-weight LLMs underestimate latency by 90-99% on average without examples. Claude's zero-shot mean absolute error is 4.5 times that of a Random Forest fit on 32 configurations. Five labeled examples substantially reduce Claude's generation error, but their benefit varies across timing targets. We will open-source our data and evaluation pipeline upon acceptance.
zh_title: 我的语言模型要运行多久？用于执行前运行时间预测的基准测试
translation: 向共享GPU集群提交深度学习作业的研究人员需要运行时间估计来请求时间限制、选择硬件和计算预算。大语言模型（LLMs）提供了一条诱人的捷径：描述作业并进行询问。我们引入了PreRun，这是一个用于从执行前可用信息预测深度学习训练和推理运行时间的基准。PreRun包含在GPU集群上收集的801个训练和1884个语言与视觉模型推理记录，并配有工作负载配置和明确定义的计时目标。它还包括在标准化条件下测量的64种文本生成配置，每种配置在三个独立的程序启动中进行测量。我们将三个LLMs（Qwen3.5-9B、GPT-OSS-120B和Claude Opus 5.5）与回归基准进行了比较，并在支持的前向传递子集上评估了分析估计。在16个保留的生成配置上，开源LLM在没有示例的情况下平均低估了90-99%的延迟。Claude的零样本平均绝对误差是基于32个配置拟合的随机森林的4.5倍。五个带标签的示例大大减少了Claude的生成误差，但它们的好处因计时目标而异。我们将在接受后开源我们的数据和评估管道。
tldr: 本文推出了PreRun基准测试以评估大语言模型预测深度学习作业运行时间的能力，发现零样本下LLMs表现较差且常严重低估延迟，而少量示例能改善这一情况。
ai_comments: 本文针对大语言模型集群作业的预执行运行时间预测这一实际痛点，提出了PreRun基准测试，并对LLM和传统回归基准进行了对比评估，具有很高的实用价值和对调度优化的指导意义。
motivation: 在共享GPU集群上提交深度学习任务的研究人员需要运行时间估计来申请时间限制、选择硬件和分配计算预算，而目前缺乏利用任务执行前信息进行准确运行时间预测的有效基准和方法。
method: 引入了名为PreRun的基准测试（包含801个训练和1884个推理记录），对比了三种大语言模型（Qwen3.5-9B、GPT-OSS-120B、Claude Opus 5.5）与回归基准（如随机森林）及分析估计方法的预测性能。
