abstract: Rigorously evaluating medical artificial intelligence (AI) requires testing open-ended clinical management across diverse presentations and stages of care. However, existing benchmarks rely on manual expert authoring, limiting coverage across conditions, conditional care pathways, and evolving guidelines. We develop an automated pipeline that extracts and verifies structured clinical criteria and branching decision trees from practice recommendations to generate scenarios spanning the care continuum, including nuanced presentations and practice variations across regions and guideline editions. Applied to 436 BMJ Best Practice clinical monographs (354 US, 82 International), this yields 3,200 scenarios spanning differential diagnosis, investigations, treatment, and complications, plus targeted suites for regional specificity (731 US/International pairs) and temporal freshness (630 scenarios). To grade responses, we develop a clinician-calibrated autorater that scores management plans on a 4-point rubric stratifying deviations by clinical severity. Across Gemini models, scaling improves adherence, while web search (+0.8 percentage points [pp] on average) and multi-sample synthesis (+2.2 pp) combine additively (+2.8 pp). In context, full monographs consistently trail condensed excerpts. On targeted suites, web search narrows international performance gaps (+4.2 pp) and improves adherence to newly updated guidance (+4.6 pp). In a study with Primary Care Physicians (n = 9) across 200 scenarios, AI assistance raises adherence from 50.5% to 70.0%, driven largely by fewer clinical omissions. Overall, our results demonstrate a scalable evaluation setup using an evidence-based corpus originally written to guide human clinical decision-making, and demonstrate its viability to assess medical AI and its assistance on clinician decision-making.

title: Fair Property Tax: Reducing Regressivity in Machine-Learning Valuation
authors: Nicolas Acevedo Villena, Haihao Lu, Michael Wagner, Timothy Sparer
abstract: Advanced machine-learning models are increasingly used for property valuation in tax assessment. Although these models can achieve high predictive accuracy, they may systematically assign higher valuation-to-sale ratios to lower-priced properties, a pattern known as regressivity. In collaboration with the Cook County Assessor's Office (CCAO), we develop and evaluate two training methods that substantially reduce this regressive pattern while maintaining price-scale predictive accuracy. The Direct method has been incorporated into CCAO's public residential valuation software. Retaining the LightGBM model class used at CCAO, we propose a Direct penalty on squared covariance between log valuation errors and log sale prices, and an observation-additive Surrogate that yields a weighted squared-error loss. We evaluate both methods in our implementation of the CCAO workflow, using seven chronological validation folds, a held-out test set, and a 2025-forward test set. Measured by the magnitude of price-related bias (PRB), regressivity falls by approximately 49% on held-out sales and 39% on 2025 sales at a Surrogate setting selected by cross-validation, relative to the same LightGBM model fitted without the penalty. Price-scale $R^2$ is essentially unchanged. Its small rise, from 0.893 to 0.897 on held-out sales and from 0.904 to 0.908 on 2025 sales, reflects overall valuation level. Log-price RMSE rises by 3.1% and 1.7%, respectively. Paired sale-bootstrap 90% intervals for the PRB reductions lie within about two percentage points of these estimates. In an additional eight-county benchmark, both methods reduce regressivity in every county, with higher log-price prediction error as the expected tradeoff. These findings demonstrate a practical way to reduce measured regressivity within an existing assessor workflow while preserving price-scale predictive performance.

title: Rethinking ANNS on Commodity PIM: PIM-Native Vector Search with Cooperative Filtering
authors: Dawei Guo, Yizou Chen, Fan Yang, Hui Li, Ming-Chang Yang
abstract: Approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) is a key primitive in modern data-intensive systems, and its memory-bound vector-scanning stage makes processing-in-memory (PIM) a promising acceleration platform. Existing PIM-based ANNS systems largely transplant CPU-oriented distance evaluation and top-$k$ selection onto PIM, introducing arithmetic- and state-heavy operations that poorly match lightweight, isolated PIM cores. To address these mismatches, we present PIVOT, a PIM-native vector search system with cooperative filtering, which thoroughly rethinks how ANNS should be executed on commodity PIM. First, PIVOT recasts PIM-side distance evaluation around binary quantization to exploit PIM-native bitwise operations, enabling LUT-free evaluation with low arithmetic cost and a small local-memory footprint. Second, PIVOT redesigns PIM-side candidate selection around threshold-guided cooperative filtering, using a survivor-mass model to derive a conservative threshold for CPU-side cluster filtering and PIM-side lower-bound filtering, thereby reducing output traffic and eliminating per-core top-$k$ state. PIVOT organizes these stages into a cooperative workflow that keeps query-global coordination and reranking on the CPU while assigning memory-intensive, data-parallel filtering to PIM. To efficiently realize this workflow and sustain high utilization across devices, PIVOT further generates configuration-specialized PIM kernels and pipelines CPU-side preparation and reranking with PIM-side filtering across query batches. Evaluations on real UPMEM hardware show that PIVOT filters out 99.3-99.7% of probed vectors and achieves up to $18.8\times$ and $10.2\times$ the QPS of CPU and prior PIM baselines, respectively. PIVOT also achieves higher recall than existing PIM systems and remains effective on high-dimensional embeddings.

title: Many Plans at Once: Diverse Top-Quality Planning in Continuous Time
authors: Mahyar Jahani-nasab, Hamid Rezatofighi, Mor Vered, Buser Say
abstract: Planners for physical systems usually return a single trajectory, which leaves no alternative when an unmodeled constraint invalidates the chosen route or downstream preferences change. A set of plans computed in advance provides ready-made alternatives and warm-starts for fast adaptation, but only if the plans are both low-cost and mutually distinct. Discrete planning addresses this with top-quality and diverse planning, but these ideas do not transfer to continuous time, where every valid trajectory has infinitely many valid near-copies, and existing trajectory planners converge to one or a few solutions. We present Many Plans at Once (MPAO), which treats every plan it finds as a reason to search elsewhere: it samples untrained neural networks whose outputs meet the boundary conditions by construction, trains corrections shared by networks from the same distribution, stores every validated plan, and adapts its sampling to what it has found, which makes it anytime. We define the goal by bringing the cost bound of top-quality planning and the distinctness threshold of diverse planning to continuous time. Under equal budgets against five baselines, MPAO is the only method that solves all 40 instances across four domains. On contact-rich manipulation, it is the only method with plans within 25% of the best known cost on one task, and returns about ten times as many such plans as the strongest baseline on the other two.

title: Loop-OPF: Solver-Informed Learning for Optimal Power Flow with Inference-Time Topology Adaptivity
authors: Mohamad Chehade, Hao Zhu
abstract: Learning for optimal power flow (OPF) has recently been advocated to accelerate OPF solutions by using a pre-trained neural network (NN) to predict directly from given inputs such as the load demand. However, existing learning-for-OPF methods largely fall short of ensuring the optimality and feasibility of their predictions. They also struggle to adapt at inference time to unseen topology scenarios, such as those caused by line or generator outages. This work puts forth Loop-OPF, a solver-informed NN that builds its layers from the iterations of the primal-dual hybrid gradient (PDHG) method. Under standard convexity and regularity conditions on DC-OPF, the resultant fixed-point output of Loop-OPF is thus optimal and feasible. To speed up PDHG across diverse OPF scenarios, Loop-OPF learns certain PDHG parameters in a self-supervised manner, without any OPF solution labels. We adopt the deep equilibrium (DEQ) framework for training so that the memory cost does not grow with the number of layers. As the grid topology enters every layer as an input, the same trained Loop-OPF directly adapts to unseen contingencies without retraining. Numerical tests on the IEEE 300-bus and PEGASE 1354-, 2869-, and 9241-bus networks have demonstrated the accuracy and topology adaptivity of the proposed Loop-OPF over competing learning-for-OPF methods.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Preprint. Code: https://github.com/MFHChehade/loop-opf

title: FoRe: A Force-Guided Framework for Autonomous Grasp Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Models
authors: Shuai Peng, Yongkai Liao, Yuxin Cheng, Haoyuan Wang, Jian Huang
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong performance in grasp-based manipulation, yet reliable recovery from local grasping failures remains challenging. Specifically, in pick-and-place tasks, policies may continue transport after a failed grasp instead of retrying, potentially reflecting overreliance on proprioceptive cues for stage progression and limited retry supervision. Existing recovery approaches typically rely on deployment-time guidance or demonstration augmentation. We introduce Force-guided Recovery (FoRe), a framework for autonomous recovery from local grasping failures. Using force feedback, FoRe partitions demonstrations into approach-grasp and transport-placement stages to train separate policies. To supplement limited retry supervision, FoRe then initializes a dedicated retry policy from the approach-grasp policy and refines it through local reinforcement learning (RL) from post-failure states. To avoid inappropriate stage progression, a controller combines force feedback with grasp-command status at inference to coordinate the stage policies, detect grasp failures, and invoke the retry policy. We also construct LIBERO-SUCTION, a force-augmented suction manipulation benchmark adapted from LIBERO, with complete demonstration trajectories for policy training. FoRe consistently improves task success rates for VLA-Adapter and $π_{0.5}$ on LIBERO-SUCTION, LIBERO, and real-world tasks. On LIBERO-SUCTION, average absolute gains are 18.4% and 6.5%, respectively. The corresponding real-world absolute gains are 25.0% and 21.7%. FoRe also remains effective with only one demonstration per task on both simulation benchmarks.

title: Same Facts, Different Decision: Fact-Invariant Manipulation and Provenance-Based Defense in Typed Decision Models
authors: Yujie Wang, Haotian Chi, Shunrong Jiang
abstract: Typed decision models such as TypeSafe's Jev answer only with a probability, an option, or a score, so software can act on them directly. Their inputs, however, often include text from outsiders. Prior attacks test this risk poorly. Injected instructions rarely work on these models, and added facts can make a changed decision correct. We show that outside comments can persuade these models to make a wrong decision without adding any fact. We propose LEVER, an attack that writes such comments with four levers from argumentation theory, uses a separate verifier to discard any comment that adds a fact, and searches for effective comments guided by the model's output probabilities. We further propose the Provenance Gate, a defense that accepts a changed decision only if the model reaches it again without the outside comments. On three benchmarks, LEVER flips about a third of Jev's correct decisions, 2.8 times as many as the strongest prior attack under the same limit on facts, and more on five other models. The gate blocks all of these attacks with at most one extra query and still accepts trusted updates.

title: Real-Time On-Drone Hyperspectral Anomaly Detection for Wilderness Search and Rescue
authors: Jacqueline Liu, Gyabaah Kyere, Chengyan Liu, Kenneth Chiu, Lynn Marie, Church, Sean Gleason, Jayson Boubin
abstract: Wilderness search-and-rescue (WSAR) teams use uncrewed aerial systems (UASs) to survey terrain for indicators of missing persons that are rare, blend into the background, or lack thermal signatures. Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) provides rich spectral information, but its high data volume challenges real-time on-drone processing. We present SABL, an edge-computing pipeline for on-drone Spectral Anomaly-Based Localization. SABL integrates hyperspectral streaming with exponentially moving Reed-Xiaoli (ERX) anomaly detection and DBSCAN spatial filtering to group pixel-level anomalies into candidate search regions. SABL is evaluated on data collected during a 10-day deployment with Quinhagak Search and Rescue (QSAR) in remote Alaska. It processes hyperspectral scanlines at 5.67-5.73 ms per line, meeting the camera's 10-ms acquisition interval; DBSCAN requires only 6.5-12.5 ms per 100-line update for filtering. SABL achieves approximately 56% and 99% object-level precision on QSAR-selected search indicators across two scenes, with corresponding recall of 55% and 29%, providing significant background filtering while identifying difficult-to-see anomalous search indicators.

title: Integral Multipliers and Arithmetic Obstructions for Two-Hidden-Layer ReLU Maxima
authors: Pengcheng Cheng
abstract: We study exact representations of maximum functions by ReLU networks with two hidden layers and integer parameters. The least positive output multiplier is two for the six-input maximum, and either two or six for the seven-input maximum. We obtain these bounds from integral cubical fillings and a coefficient-preserving passage from polytope identities to networks. For the coordinate-facet complex of the six-simplex, we compute a coning index of six over the integers and three after inverting two, allowing arbitrary integral directions within each facet. A class in the homology of the unrestricted kernel complex characterizes the remaining seven-input problem; its vanishing is equivalent to an integral filling of a fixed target. We also construct a finite character that separates rational from three-local representability in a dictionary containing two known constructions and all pairs of edge-disjoint three-edge forests. This obstruction permits nonsymmetric coefficients and is confined to the specified dictionary. Control of lower-dimensional remainders yields a sufficient criterion in the top-dimensional quotient. Exact certificates and verification programs accompany the finite calculations.

title: Ruby: State-of-the-Art Potency Prediction across Discovery Regimes Using Learned Structural Representations
authors: Michael Atkin, Dominique Beaini, Jules Berman, Rebecca Boiarsky, Jamin Chen, Alejandro Dobles, Sergey Edunov, Evan Feinberg, Nate Gruver, Will Harvey, Deidre Johns, Nina Jovic, Steven Kearnes, Allison Keys, Rohit Kundu, Ken Leidal, Gerald Lelais, Michael V. Levine, Indrawan McAlpine, Gabriel Monteiro da Silva, Igor Morozov, Pranav Murugan, Adi Nagle, Frank Pickard, Wesley Qian, Gianluca Scarpellini, Ansh Sharma, Richard Strong Bowen, Wojtek Swiderski, Laura Tapias, Carl Tilbury, Cyr Vetcher, Han Wang, William Wang, David Charles Williams, Drausin Wulsin, Han Yoon
abstract: Small-molecule drug discovery proceeds through repeated design-make-test-analyze cycles. The goal is often to maximize potency while keeping other properties within the ranges required for a viable therapeutic candidate. Compound prioritization places different demands on computational methods as drug discovery progresses from hit identification through hit-to-lead and lead optimization, with changing computational budgets and increasing amounts of on-target experimental data. We introduce Ruby, a Robust Universal Binding affinitY predictor that uses intermediate representations from the structural foundation model Pearl without requiring an explicit binding pose for every compound. Ruby is trained on proprietary data plus GenesisPotency-2026, an audited public-source potency training dataset released for academic and commercial use under a CC BY-SA 4.0 license with row-level provenance and audit annotations. Ruby achieves the highest aggregate early enrichment across seven public hit-identification targets among evaluated methods, with adjustable inference effort trading off enrichment and computational cost over more than two orders of magnitude. Ruby achieves the highest average correlations across four public benchmarks: OpenFE, CASP16, FEP+ 4, and OpenBind. Ruby significantly outperforms other methods in zero-shot prediction across eight biochemical and cellular assays from five ongoing Genesis-Incyte programs, widening its performance advantage relative to the public benchmarks. Ruby continues to improve more than other methods when all are given the opportunity to recalibrate using earlier assay measurements. Together, these contributions provide an annotated training resource for the field and a state-of-the-art potency predictor for broad screening, prioritization within related chemical series, and assay-specific prediction as experimental measurements accumulate.

title: ReactDrive: Self-Reactive Driving World Model
authors: Yifan Wang, Xiaoqi Wang, Cho-Ying Wu, Wenbin He, Chenyu You, Liu Ren
abstract: The world evolves through the dynamics of its constituent entities and their interactions, with changes in one entity influencing the behavior of others. To simulate this evolution under different actions, interactive world models need to capture the resulting agent responses as part of the world's own dynamics. In autonomous driving, errors in modeling these responses can misrepresent maneuver safety and undermine the reliability of generated videos used for policy evaluation and learning. To formalize this intrinsic requirement for driving world model, we define self-reactivity as the capability to model agent responses from observed history and a specified ego action, and generate visual futures that reflect those responses without prescribed future agent trajectories. To realize this capability, we introduce ReactDrive, a driving world model that jointly learns agent dynamics and visual generation through a shared agent state representation. Within this framework, dynamics supervision grounds a reactive dynamics prior in observed agent states, while the video objective jointly optimizes the self-reactivity and visual realism. Experiments show improved agent responses, ego controllability, and video quality, a 96.0% preference for agent reactivity in human comparisons across five baselines, and better downstream planning through augmentation with generated videos. We hope this work encourages the community to recognize self-reactivityas a foundational capability for developing and evaluating interactive world models. Project page: https://reactdrive.github.io/ .

title: Toward a digital twin of the ICU patient: Forecasting and treatment response in a generative event model
authors: Zhuoyang Lyu, Yiming Li, Peter C. Hou, Pengyu Hong, Li Zhou
abstract: A digital twin of a patient in intensive care would forecast the patient's course and what a treatment would change. Generative event models, trained to continue a patient's electronic health record (EHR), have been proposed as a path toward such twins. We trained TWICE, a 79M-parameter decoder-only transformer, on the ICU records of one academic health system (127,332 training patients and 1.57 billion tokens). We evaluated it on clinical prediction tasks, generation fidelity, individual trajectories and counterfactual validation. Reading 19 clinical outcomes off 50 simulated futures, with no task-specific training, TWICE matched the best of 144 supervised configurations on held-out patients (mean AUROC 0.836 vs. 0.834). It led on events that change care within a day and trailed on death. With the training data fixed, more and longer simulated futures were worth more than a 6.8-fold larger model. Its generated records matched real ones closely and were as specific to each patient as its own variability allowed. Its predicted risk rose as events approached. Pre-specified controls showed that it reproduced the side effects of drugs and was barely moved by an inert drug. On the values that treatments are given to correct, however, an opposite treatment moved its forecasts like the right one. TWICE forecasts ICU events about as well as task-specific models, and we see it as a step toward a digital twin of the ICU patient.

title: TSIR: Ray-Traced Triangle Splats for Inverse Rendering
authors: Wentao Yang, Chentao Shen, Zhengqi Zhang, Bolin Chen, Yan Ye, Xiangru Huang
abstract: Inverse rendering enables realistic relighting for visual effects and augmented reality. However, overlapping Gaussian primitives complicate surface recovery and require costly multi-layer traversal and compositing for light transport. We propose TSIR, a two-stage inverse rendering method that reconstructs relightable triangle splats from multi-view images. The first stage prepares opaque triangle splats with learnable vertex shading normals. The second stage directly traces these surfaces to estimate materials through Monte Carlo integration of direct illumination and indirect reflections, reducing reliance on multi-layer compositing. Anti-aliasing improves rendering quality while maintaining efficiency. Experiments demonstrate higher relighting quality than the evaluated baselines and more efficient anti-aliasing than supersampling.

title: Mind World Models: Joint Learning of Motor EEG Representations and Action-Conditioned World Dynamics
authors: Weikang Qiu, Zheng Huang, Tinglin Huang, Yujun Yan, Rex Ying
abstract: Motor decoding from electroencephalography (EEG) supports non-invasive brain-computer interfaces, yet existing methods either rely on costly cue-based trials and coarse categorical labels or use pretraining objectives that do not directly capture how movement unfolds, limiting their ability to learn transferable motor representations. To this end, we propose the Mind World Model (MWM), a framework that learns motor EEG representations from scalable naturalistic EEG and egocentric video without action annotations. MWM treats EEG observed up to the current frame as the latent action of a world model: a mind model encodes the EEG, and a world model uses it to predict the representation of a future frame, yielding a movement-grounded pretraining objective. We further introduce the Lateralization-Aware Transformer (LAT), which uses frame averaging to separate shared bilateral from side-specific lateral features, encoding hemispheric correspondence to reduce the burden of learning left-right relationships from data. MWM pretraining produces two models: a mind model for downstream motor decoding and a world model that can be adapted to prediction conditioned on real actions, opening a scalable and flexible path to collect egocentric data for embodied AI. Across 9 classification and 7 regression tasks, the mind model improves task-averaged balanced accuracy by 5.9% and Pearson correlation by 16.2% relative to the strongest baseline in each task family. Compared with an inverse-dynamics latent-action baseline, the world model achieves lower prediction error and benefits 3.3 times more from matched real actions within recordings and 4.7 times more on held-out subjects.

title: Disentangling Verbalized Evaluation Awareness and Refusal through Neuron-Level Intervention
authors: Jingyuan Feng, Gouki Minegishi, Andrew Gambardella, Takeshi Kojima, Yusuke Iwasawa
abstract: As large reasoning models (LRMs) become more capable, reliable evaluation becomes essential. LRMs can sometimes recognize that they are being evaluated, a phenomenon known as \emph{evaluation awareness}. This phenomenon raises concerns about whether safety behavior, particularly refusal behavior, generalizes from evaluation to deployment. Prior work manipulates \emph{verbalized evaluation awareness (VEA)} through activation steering and observes higher refusal rates when VEA is present, but the mechanisms underlying this connection remain poorly understood. We identify \emph{VEA neurons} by contrasting their activations in VEA and non-VEA reasoning segments. Intervening on 5,000 VEA neurons reduces the VEA rate from 12.6--51.8\% to at most 1.4\% across the model benchmark combinations in our main experiments, and lowers a probe score for unverbalized evaluation awareness (unVEA). In QwQ-32B, VEA-neuron intervention also reduces refusal even in rollouts without VEA; VEA text itself explains only 4--10\% of the decrease. We further show that their down-projection vectors contain refusal components, and preserving these components during intervention partially restores refusal while maintaining VEA suppression, accounting for about half of the refusal decrease and providing a mechanistic explanation for the connection between evaluation awareness and refusal. Finally, across the OLMo 3 SFT, DPO, and RLVR checkpoints, the VEA rate on SorryBench and StrongREJECT is similar after SFT and DPO but substantially higher after RLVR, alongside an increase in the number of VEA neurons. Together, these findings show that VEA text itself has a limited effect on refusal, and that VEA neurons integrate evaluation awarenss and refusal.

title: Testable Testing: Distribution-Robust Property Testing
authors: Xi Chen, Renato Ferreira Pinto Jr., Nathaniel Harms, Rocco A. Servedio
abstract:
We introduce a new model for property testing of Boolean functions, which we call distribution-robust testing. Distribution-robust testing is motivated by the hope of designing testers whose output can be trusted even when the underlying probability distribution does not satisfy the assumptions of the tester, while still being more efficient than distribution-free testers that make no assumptions at all.
  The purpose of this paper is to perform a broad initial exploration of this new model. In particular, we present a variety of general algorithmic techniques, which we apply to show that several well-studied properties admit distribution-robust testers that are significantly more efficient than their distribution-free counterparts. For example, we obtain constant-query distribution-robust testers for conjunctions, decision lists, and unions of intervals, all of which are known to require significantly more queries in the distribution-free model. These encouraging results suggest a range of questions for future work.

title: Subverting Tool Arguments: Defense-Evading Metadata Poisoning in LLM Agents
authors: Shih-Chieh Dai, Xinyu Sun, Haichuan Zhang, Zhiyuan Zhong, Guanhong Tao
abstract: Conventional indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks hijack an LLM agent's workflow through malicious instructions embedded in retrieved external content. The growing adoption of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) exposes another attack surface: tool descriptions supplied by third-party MCP servers. Attackers can manipulate this metadata to induce malicious argument generation during tool calls. The challenge is to ensure that the modified descriptions still appear benign to both LLMs and users. Existing IPI attacks, however, struggle to achieve both high attack success and low detectability in this setting. To address this challenge, we propose GRAFT, an LLM-based optimization method for crafting adversarial tool descriptions. Specifically, GRAFT uses a masking mechanism to identify argument-relevant token positions for targeted injection. It then iteratively refines candidate descriptions using dynamic mutation strategies proposed by an LLM, guided by the agent's tool choices and generated arguments. We evaluate GRAFT on three public datasets against several attack baselines. The results show that GRAFT achieves higher attack success while maintaining low detection rates across five filter-based defenses. It also bypasses several existing IPI defenses. Even under an adaptive defense trained on GRAFT-generated injections, GRAFT remains more effective than the baselines.

title: RoboColiseum: Co-evolution of Simulation, Evaluation, and Models
authors: Chenghao Yin, Da Huang, Di Yang, Jichao Wang, Junhui Wu, Nanshu Zhao, Tong Ran, Zhijun Li, Gang Zhao, Linting Guo, Rui Feng, Sheng Zhang, Tianyu Jiang, Wenjun Sun, Yongxin Su, Zhaobo Liu, Zheyuan Xing, Sukai Wang, Yue Zhou, Qihan Jiang, Jianhua Jiang, Chuang Men, Yuxiang Yan, Daizhen Lv, Kunyu Yu, Yongjian Shen, Tianxiang Zhu, Siying Zhang, Wenhao Wang, Jun Zhao, Bowen Jiang, Zhi Zeng, Maoqing Yao, Qian Wang
abstract: Simulation-based evaluation of embodied models requires calibrated interactions, diverse tasks, and explicit execution constraints. We present RoboColiseum, a platform combining system identification, composable physics and rendering, and multidimensional benchmarking. Recorded-command replay characterizes robot dynamics and object interactions, while a shared interface connects rigid and deformable simulation to rendering. Across 22 paired real--simulation robot--task configurations, task scores have a reported Pearson correlation of 0.9686. Eight evaluation tracks span instruction following, spatial reasoning, general manipulation, robustness, dexterous manipulation, precision manipulation, whole-body coordination, and execution across robot embodiments. Budget-aware scoring combines task progress, resource use, and completion rewards. We report 12 selected Season~I policies and all 11 systems on the public Season~II leaderboard, comprising eight Agent systems and three VLA policies. Agent2Act connects language models to robot-control execution; the VLA study uses mixed-task supervised fine-tuning. The results reveal substantial variation across tracks within each evaluation category. RoboColiseum connects simulation development with capability-oriented evaluation and provides a foundation for extending robot interactions and model assessment.
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures. The first eight authors contributed equally. Maoqing Yao and Qian Wang are the corresponding authors

title: Mind the Delta: Early Pruning of RTL Variants for Agentic Hardware Optimization
authors: Siyang Cai, Cangyuan Li, Haoyu Gao, Kun Wang, Mochen Li, Yilin Zhong, Ke Xu, Yinhe Han, Ying Wang
abstract: Autonomous coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) now write diverse microarchitectural variants of existing register-transfer level (RTL) designs at high throughput, shifting the primary bottleneck of agentic RTL optimization onto logic synthesis. Commercial toolchains take hours per variant, creating an acute compute asymmetry between proposing and evaluating variants. Existing fast evaluators falter in this regime. Subtle RTL edits trigger nonlinear synthesis shifts that learned predictors and coding agents cannot resolve, while synthesis proxies at reduced effort either alter the optimization trajectory or retain most of its runtime. Selecting a variant, however, does not require regressing absolute quality of results across designs, only identifying when a candidate cannot surpass the best completed feasible implementation. Based on the observation that synthesis trajectories share strong design-specific bias with their base design, we propose DiffScope, a training-free anytime selection framework that races full synthesis runs in parallel. By pairing live area telemetry with the already synthesized base trajectory, DiffScope cancels early mapping inflation, reducing residual variance during initial mapping by 73.6X, and stops uncompetitive runs via a lower bound calibrated on other design lineages. Across 43 design families from small blocks to processors with millions of cells, DiffScope uniquely recovers the optimum of exhaustive synthesis in every family, cuts total evaluation work by 44.9% (1.81X), and reaches 2.18X on L-tier designs.

title: Hypergraph Structural Entropy-Enhanced Hierarchy-Aware Semi-Supervised Graph Classification
authors: Guangjie Zeng, Hao Peng, Angsheng Li, Li Sun, Chunyang Liu, Yicheng Pan, Shengze Li, Philip S. Yu
abstract: Semi-supervised graph classification aims to learn graph-level representations by leveraging a large number of unlabeled graphs alongside a small set of labeled ones, effectively mitigating the issue of label scarcity. Despite significant progress by various semi-supervised learning strategies, complex relationships among graph vertices beyond pairwise edges, especially hierarchical structures, remain underexplored by existing methods. In this work, we propose a Hypergraph Structural Entropy-Enhanced hierarchy-aware framework, namely HypSEE, for semi-supervised graph classification. Specifically, we first construct walk-induced and embedding-derived hypergraphs to capture hierarchy-aware local and long-range higher-order relationships within graphs. Then, we devise a hierarchical hypergraph pooling approach guided by hypergraph structural entropy (HSE) to facilitate hierarchical representation learning in hypergraphs. Lastly, we employ an anchor graph-based consistency strategy to mutually align the representations from these two hypergraph views, enhancing the learning efficacy on unlabeled data. Extensive experiments on 8 benchmark datasets demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of our approach.
zh_title: 超图结构熵增强的层次感知半监督图分类
translation: 半监督图分类旨在通过利用大量无标签图和少量有标签图来学习图级表示，有效缓解标签稀缺问题。尽管各种半监督学习策略取得了显著进展，但现有方法未能充分探索图顶点之间超越成对边缘的复杂关系，特别是层次结构。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个超图结构熵增强的层次感知框架，即HypSEE，用于半监督图分类。具体来说，我们首先构建步长诱导和嵌入导出的超图，以捕获图内层次感知的局部和长距离高阶关系。然后，我们设计了一种由超图结构熵（HSE）引导的分层超图池化方法，以促进超图中的分层表示学习。最后，我们采用基于锚图的一致性策略来相互对齐这两个超图视图的表示，从而提高无标签数据的学习效率。在8个基准数据集上进行的大量实验证明了我们方法的最先进性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一个名为HypSEE的超图结构熵增强的层次感知框架，用于半监督图分类，通过构建超图捕获高阶关系，并利用超图结构熵引导分层池化和一致性策略，在8个基准数据集上取得了最先进的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入超图结构熵来增强层次感知学习，并通过双视图超图构建和一致性策略有效利用了无标签数据。这种方法解决了现有半监督图分类方法对复杂高阶和层次关系探索不足的问题，为图表示学习提供了一个新颖且有效途径。
motivation: 现有半监督图分类方法未能充分探索图顶点之间超越成对边缘的复杂关系，特别是层次结构，导致对复杂关系的建模不足。
method: 本文提出了HypSEE框架，具体包括：1. 构建步长诱导和嵌入导出的超图，以捕获图内层次感知的局部和长距离高阶关系。2. 设计由超图结构熵（HSE）引导的分层超图池化方法，促进超图中的分层表示学习。3. 采用基于锚图的一致性策略，相互对齐这两个超图视图的表示，增强无标签数据的学习效率。
results: 在8个基准数据集上，该方法表现出最先进的性能。
conclusion: 通过引入超图结构熵增强的层次感知框架HypSEE，本研究有效解决了现有半监督图分类方法对复杂层次关系探索不足的问题，并在多个基准数据集上取得了最先进的性能，证明了其在图级表示学习中的有效性。

title: BeyondEgo: Learning to Act Beyond Egocentric Perception via Humanoid Ego-Exo Foresight
authors: Zhaoshan Yang, Chenglei Li, Haoyu Lei, Yutao Zhang, Yuyu Yang, Zhuo Chen, Ling Ding, Zhongxing Ren, Yi Gu, Heyang Zhang, Peng Su, Jin Pan
abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinating whole-body motion to perform manipulation tasks in complex environments. Yet egocentric vision-language-action (VLA) policies can miss critical body--scene relationships, and action imitation alone provides no explicit supervision for future scene evolution. We propose BeyondEgo to extend VLA perception in space and time. Spatially, we encode a synchronized exocentric view with frozen DINOv3 and concatenate the resulting tokens with egocentric VLM tokens to condition the action expert. Temporally, we use future observations from both views as privileged supervision for a residual adapter on task-conditioned VLM features. A foresight expert regresses DINOv3 representations of both views 0.6s ahead. At deployment, the foresight expert is discarded and the 4.2M-parameter adapter is retained. We also introduce HELM, to our knowledge, the first closed-loop humanoid loco-manipulation benchmark with synchronized egocentric and exocentric views across five whole-body tasks.On HELM, BeyondEgo improves success from 48.0% to 92.0% in distribution and from 23.5% to 65.0% on 200 held-out scenes with layout, asset, material, and lighting shifts. Ablations show that dual-view DINOv3 foresight yields the best transfer results.
zh_title: 超越自我：通过人形机器人自我-外部预见学习超越自我中心感知进行行动
translation: 人形机器人运动-操作需要在复杂环境中协调全身运动以执行操作任务。然而，以自我为中心的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略可能会错过关键的身体-场景关系，而单纯的动作模仿无法为未来场景演变提供明确的监督。我们提出了BeyondEgo，以在空间和时间上扩展VLA感知。在空间上，我们使用冻结的DINOv3编码同步的外部视角，并将生成的令牌与自我中心VLM令牌拼接以调节动作专家。在时间上，我们使用来自两种视角的未来观测作为特权监督，用于任务条件VLM特征上的残差适配器。一个预见专家回归0.6秒后两种视角的DINOv3表示。在部署时，预见专家被丢弃，保留4.2M参数的适配器。我们还推出了HELM，据我们所知，这是第一个具有同步自我中心和外部视角的人形机器人闭环运动-操作基准，涵盖了五个全身任务。在HELM上，BeyondEgo在分布内将成功率从48.0%提高到92.0%，在200个具有布局、资产、材料和光照变化的保留场景上从23.5%提高到65.0%。消融实验表明，双视角DINOv3预见产生了最佳的迁移结果。
tldr: BeyondEgo通过整合外部视角和未来预见，显著提升了人形机器人在复杂操作任务中的成功率，解决了自我中心感知和缺乏未来监督的问题。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入外部视角和未来预见机制，有效地解决了人形机器人自我中心感知局限性的关键问题。其创新点在于结合了空间和时间上的感知扩展，并提出了一个轻量级的适配器用于部署。HELM基准的引入也为该领域的研究提供了重要的评估工具，其在分布内外性能的显著提升显示了方法的有效性和重要性。
motivation: 现有的自我中心视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略可能忽略关键的身体-场景关系，并且单纯的动作模仿无法提供对未来场景演变的明确监督，这限制了人形机器人复杂环境中的全身运动协调能力。
method: 提出BeyondEgo框架，通过以下方式扩展VLA感知：空间上，编码同步的外部视角（使用冻结的DINOv3），将其与自我中心VLM令牌拼接以调节动作专家。时间上，使用来自两种视角的未来观测作为特权监督，用于任务条件VLM特征上的残差适配器。一个预见专家回归0.6秒后的两种视角的DINOv3表示，部署时该专家被丢弃，保留4.2M参数的适配器。此外，引入HELM基准，这是第一个具有同步自我中心和外部视角的人形机器人闭环运动-操作基准，包含五个全身任务。
results: 在HELM基准上，BeyondEgo将分布内成功率从48.0%提高到92.0%，在200个具有布局、资产、材料和光照变化的保留场景上从23.5%提高到65.0%。消融实验表明，双视角DINOv3预见带来了最佳的迁移结果。
conclusion: BeyondEgo通过整合多视角感知和未来预见，能够显著提升人形机器人在复杂全身运动-操作任务中的性能和泛化能力。

title: Action-Conditioned Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
authors: Yutong Xia, Yangyou Liu, Yuxuan Liang, Yuankai Wu, See-Kiong Ng, Roger Zimmermann
abstract: We study spatio-temporal forecasting in networked systems under specified actions. The challenge is to capture the action's effects without predicting spurious changes in unaffected regions. However, direct supervision and evaluation of these effects require paired futures with and without the action, whereas observational trajectories reveal only the realized future. We introduce PairST, a benchmark comprising six datasets across traffic, power transmission and water distribution, with paired reference and intervened futures simulated from the same system state. These pairs enable separate evaluation of affected-region forecast accuracy and quiet-region response error. We further propose ActionST, which forecasts the intervened future by writing an explicit response onto an intervention-independent reference forecast. Specifically, node-time addressing constructs a query for each response position, a state-conditioned response writer computes candidate responses, and a graph-aware locality gate controls their strength. Experiments on six datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ActionST at new action targets, with the lowest mean absolute error on five datasets and the best average rank. Our source code and the PairST benchmark are available at https://github.com/yutong-xia/ActionST.
zh_title: 动作条件下的时空预测
translation: 我们研究了指定动作下网络系统中的时空预测。挑战在于捕捉动作的影响，同时避免对未受影响区域预测虚假变化。然而，对这些影响的直接监督和评估需要有动作和无动作的配对未来数据，而观测轨迹只揭示已实现的未来。我们引入了PairST，一个包含交通、电力传输和水分配领域六个数据集的基准，这些数据集模拟了相同系统状态下有参考和有干预的配对未来数据。这些配对使得能够单独评估受影响区域的预测准确性和安静区域的响应误差。我们进一步提出了ActionST，它通过将显式响应写入与干预无关的参考预测来预测干预后的未来。具体而言，节点-时间寻址为每个响应位置构建一个查询，状态条件响应写入器计算候选响应，图感知局部性门控制其强度。在六个数据集上的实验证明了ActionST在新的动作目标上的有效性，在五个数据集上具有最低的平均绝对误差和最佳的平均排名。我们的源代码和PairST基准可在https://github.com/yutong-xia/ActionST获取。
tldr: 该研究提出了PairST基准数据集和ActionST模型，用于在网络系统中进行动作条件下的时空预测，通过显式响应机制有效处理动作影响并避免对未受影响区域的虚假预测。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入PairST基准数据集，创新性地解决了动作条件时空预测中缺乏配对数据的问题，为该领域的研究提供了重要的评估工具。ActionST模型提出的显式响应机制，能够有效地区分动作影响区域和未受影响区域，避免了传统方法可能产生的虚假预测，是模型设计上的一个亮点。该方法在实际应用中，如交通管理、电力调度和水资源分配等领域，具有重要的潜在价值。
motivation: 在网络系统中，动作条件下的时空预测面临挑战，即需要捕捉动作的影响，同时避免对未受影响区域进行虚假预测。然而，直接监督和评估这些影响需要有动作和无动作的配对未来数据，而观测轨迹只揭示已实现的未来。
method: 引入了PairST基准，包含交通、电力传输和水分配领域的六个数据集，这些数据集模拟了相同系统状态下有参考和有干预的配对未来数据。提出了ActionST模型，通过将显式响应写入与干预无关的参考预测来预测干预后的未来。具体而言，通过节点-时间寻址构造每个响应位置的查询，状态条件响应写入器计算候选响应，图感知局部性门控制其强度。
results: 在六个数据集上的实验表明，ActionST在新的动作目标上表现出有效性，在五个数据集上具有最低的平均绝对误差，并获得了最佳的平均排名。
conclusion: ActionST模型通过其独特的显式响应机制，在动作条件下的时空预测任务中表现出色，特别是在处理动作影响和保持未受影响区域预测准确性方面。PairST基准的引入也为该领域的进一步研究提供了重要工具。

title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Stateful Privacy Sniffing of LLM Agents via Behavioral Covert Channels in Web Interactions
authors: Ruichao Liang, Wenzhong Deng, Jing Chen, Yuqing Li, Kaixuan Li, Cong Wu, Yang Liu
abstract:
LLM agents increasingly rely on Web interaction, issuing searches, following links, and reading pages, to complete complex user tasks. Since each action is driven by the agent's private context, including the user's prompt, dialogue history, memory, and connected data, it also opens a new privacy exposure surface. Prior attacks either passively analyze network traffic, which yields only coarse correlations, or hijack the agent through indirect prompt injection, which must place sensitive content in an outgoing field and is blocked by content-level defenses. Whether an attacker can actively recover fine-grained private context without any explicit transmission thus remains insufficiently understood.
  Our insight is that an agent's benign Web decisions themselves leak private context, as what it chooses to visit encodes whether, which, and in what order it acts, forming a behavioral covert channel. Building on this, we design SNOOP, a stateful hierarchical probing framework that narrows a coarse-to-fine hypothesis tree per task and reconstructs user queries and profiles from the agent's observable paths. Across four agents and three LLM backbones on 500 StackExchange queries and 378 multi-turn iKAT dialogues, SNOOP recovers query concepts with an average F1 of 0.89 and user profiles with an F1 of 0.80, while four representative agent defenses change its recovery by less than 0.03 F1. Since no sensitive content is ever transmitted, content-level inspection cannot detect this leakage; we therefore propose Selection-Obfuscated Retrieval (SOR), which acquires resources under a fixed budget independent of private context and confines the agent's selection to a local snapshot, cutting SNOOP's F1 to 0.39 without additional LLM inference.
zh_title: 行动胜于言语：通过网页交互中的行为隐蔽通道对LLM智能体进行状态式隐私嗅探
translation:
大模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地依赖网页交互（如发起搜索、点击链接和阅读页面）来完成复杂的任务。由于每个动作都由智能体的私密上下文（包括用户提示词、对话历史、记忆和连接的数据）驱动，这也开启了一个新的隐私暴露面。先前的攻击要么被动分析网络流量（只能产生粗粒度的相关性），要么通过间接提示注入劫持智能体（必须将敏感内容放入外发字段中，且会被内容级防御阻止）。因此，攻击者是否能在没有任何显式传输的情况下主动恢复细粒度的私密上下文，目前仍缺乏充分的了解。
我们的洞察是：智能体的良性网页决策本身就会泄露私密上下文，因为它的访问选择编码了它是否行动、采取了哪个行动以及行动的顺序，从而形成了行为隐蔽通道。在此基础上，我们设计了SNOOP，这是一个状态式分层探测框架，它在每个任务中缩小由粗到细的假设树，并从智能体可观测的路径中重建用户查询和画像。在4个智能体、3个LLM骨干网、500个StackExchange查询和378个多轮iKAT对话的测试中，SNOOP以平均0.89的F1分数恢复了查询概念，以0.80的F1分数恢复了用户画像，而4种具有代表性的智能体防御使其恢复率的变化小于0.03的F1。由于从未传输任何敏感内容，内容级检查无法检测到这种泄漏；因此，我们提出了选择混淆检索（SOR），它在独立于私密上下文的固定预算下获取资源，并将智能体的选择限制在本地快照中，在不增加额外LLM推理的情况下将SNOOP的F1降至0.39。
tldr: 大模型智能体在网页浏览时的选择行为会泄露私密上下文，本文提出了SNOOP攻击框架证明了该隐蔽通道的威胁，并设计了SOR防御机制。
ai_comments: 本文针对LLM智能体在网页交互中的隐私泄露问题，提出了一种基于行为隐蔽通道的状态式隐私嗅探攻击（SNOOP），并进一步设计了相应的防御机制（SOR）。该研究创新性地指出，智能体的正常网页浏览决策本身就会泄露私密上下文，无需显式的数据传输即可重构用户隐私，对大模型智能体的安全部署具有重要的警示和防御指导意义。
motivation: 现有的隐私攻击要么依赖被动网络流量分析（粒度粗），要么依赖间接提示词注入（受内容级防御阻断），因此需要研究攻击者是否能在没有显式数据传输的情况下，主动恢复细粒度的私密上下文。
method: 设计了SNOOP（Stateful Hierarchical Probing）框架，利用由粗到细的假设树针对每个任务进行探测，通过观察智能体的浏览路径来重构用户查询和画像；同时提出Selection-Obfuscated Retrieval（SOR）防御机制来切断信息泄露。
results: 在4个智能体和3个LLM骨干网络、500个StackExchange查询及378个多轮iKAT对话上，SNOOP恢复查询概念的平均F1分数为0.89，用户画像的F1为0.80，且代表性防御对其次影响小于0.03 F1；提出的SOR防御可将SNOOP的F1降至0.39。
conclusion: 研究证明了LLM智能体在Web交互中存在通过行为隐蔽通道泄露隐私的严重风险，现有的内容级防御对此无效。提出的SNOOP框架能高效重构用户隐私，而新提出的Selection-Obfuscated Retrieval（SOR）防御机制则能有效缓解该隐私威胁。

title: A Learning-Enhanced Control Scheme for Aerial Manipulator Under Composite Disturbances
authors: Meng Wang, Jindou Jia, Kexin Guo, Xiang Yu, Lei Guo
abstract: Achieving high-precision dynamic tracking in aerial manipulators remains fundamentally challenging due to strong coupling effects and external disturbances. Existing approaches are typically limited to compensating first-order coupling term, leaving higher-order nonlinearities unaddressed. Building upon the philosophy of learning-for-control, this paper proposes a composite control scheme that combines learning-based approximation with observer-based compensation in a complementary manner. Based on the polynomial decomposition theorem, the unknown high-order term is decomposed into a shared constant basis matrix, a state-related polynomial matrix, and a task-related parameter vector. A bilevel optimization formula is first established to extract the task-invariant shared information, enabling efficient knowledge reuse across different operation conditions. By leveraging the learned shared basis, an adaptive law is designed to update the task-dependent parameter vector online. Furthermore, an observer is introduced to compensate for the inevitable approximation residual and external disturbances. The resulting framework leads to a concurrent attainment of the stable transient response and high-precision steady-state tracking performance. Extensive real-world experiments on an aerial manipulator across four representative scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed approach.
zh_title: 复合扰动下空中机械手的学习增强控制方案
translation: 空中机械手在强耦合效应和外部扰动下实现高精度动态跟踪仍然面临根本性挑战。现有方法通常仅限于补偿一阶耦合项，而未能解决更高阶的非线性问题。本文基于“学习-控制”理念，提出一种复合控制方案，以互补的方式结合了基于学习的近似和基于观测器的补偿。基于多项式分解定理，将未知高阶项分解为共享常数基矩阵、状态相关多项式矩阵和任务相关参数向量。首先建立双层优化公式以提取任务不变的共享信息，从而实现知识在不同操作条件下的高效重用。通过利用学习到的共享基，设计了一种自适应律来在线更新任务相关的参数向量。此外，引入了一个观测器来补偿不可避免的近似残差和外部扰动。由此产生的框架能够同时实现稳定的瞬态响应和高精度的稳态跟踪性能。在四种代表性场景下对空中机械手进行的广泛真实世界实验证明了所提出方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
tldr: 针对空中机械手高精度动态跟踪中的强耦合效应和外部扰动问题，本文提出了一种结合学习近似和观测器补偿的复合控制方案。该方案通过多项式分解高阶非线性项，利用双层优化提取共享知识，并通过自适应律在线更新任务相关参数，同时引入观测器补偿残差和扰动。实验证明该方法能实现稳定的瞬态响应和高精度稳态跟踪。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过将高阶非线性项分解为共享和任务相关部分，并结合双层优化和在线自适应学习，有效地解决了空中机械手高精度动态跟踪中的复杂耦合和复合扰动问题。其创新点在于知识重用机制和学习与观测器补偿的互补结合，有望显著提升空中机械手在复杂环境下的性能。
motivation: 空中机械手在高精度动态跟踪中面临强耦合效应和外部扰动的挑战。现有方法通常只能补偿一阶耦合项，而忽略了更高阶的非线性问题。
method: 本文提出一种结合学习近似和观测器补偿的复合控制方案。该方案基于多项式分解定理，将未知高阶项分解为共享常数基矩阵、状态相关多项式矩阵和任务相关参数向量。首先建立双层优化公式以提取任务不变的共享信息，实现知识在不同操作条件下的高效重用。利用学习到的共享基，设计自适应律在线更新任务相关的参数向量。此外，引入观测器来补偿不可避免的近似残差和外部扰动。
results: 该框架实现了稳定的瞬态响应和高精度的稳态跟踪性能。在四种代表性场景下对空中机械手进行的广泛真实世界实验证明了所提出方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
conclusion: 该学习增强控制方案能够有效应对空中机械手的强耦合和复合扰动，实现高精度动态跟踪，并具有良好的稳定性和鲁棒性。

title: Inverse scattering for the one-dimensional discrete Schrödinger operator: a computational perspective
authors: Peter C. Gibson, Basant Lal Sharma
abstract: We revisit inverse scattering for the one-dimensional discrete Schrödinger operator with compactly supported perturbation. We consider a computational perspective, adapted to the case of a digitally sampled reflection coefficient, to determine the perturbation in the form of a Jacobi matrix, including a computation of the length of the smallest interval supporting the perturbation. A new representation of scattering data in terms of orthogonal polynomials underpins the computational results. A key technical role is played by polynomials on the circle constructed from pairs of successive orthogonal polynomials on the line. The inverse algorithm is demonstrated on numerical examples.
zh_title: 一维离散薛定谔算子的逆散射：计算视角
translation: 我们从计算的视角重新审视了一维具有紧支撑微扰的离散薛定谔算子的逆散射问题。我们考虑了一个适应数字采样反射系数的计算视角，以雅可比矩阵的形式确定微扰，包括计算支持微扰的最小区间的长度。在正交多项式下散射数据的新表示支撑了计算结果。由直线上连续的正交多项式对构造的圆周多项式起到了关键的技术作用。该逆算法在数值算例中得到了验证。
tldr: 本文提出了一种从计算视角求解一维离散薛定谔算子逆散射问题的新算法，能够根据数字采样的反射系数有效确定雅可比矩阵和微扰区间。
ai_comments: 该论文从计算视角重新审视了一维离散薛定谔算子的逆散射问题，利用正交多项式理论处理数字采样反射系数，并展示了数值算例，具有较强的算法实用性和理论创新性。
motivation: 为了从计算的视角重新审视一维离散薛定谔算子的逆散射问题（特别是适应数字采样反射系数的情况），并确定雅可比矩阵形式的微扰及最小支撑区间的长度。
method: 采用计算视角，利用在圆上的多项式（由直线上连续的正交多项式对构造）来表示散射数据，进而构建逆算法来确定雅可比矩阵及微扰支撑区间的长度，并在数值算例中进行演示。
results: 提出了一种基于正交多项式的新散射数据表示方法，支撑了相关的计算结果，并成功通过数值算例演示了该逆算法。
conclusion: 本文成功构建了一种基于计算视角的、适用于数字采样反射系数的一维离散薛定谔算子逆散射算法，并通过数值例子验证了其有效性。

title: Isolating the Language Shell: A Content-Controlled Study of Multilingual Reasoning
authors: Hoejoon Kwon, Jinhee Jang, Byeonggeuk Lim, YoungBin Kim
abstract: Multilingual reasoning distillation requires choosing the language in which teacher reasoning is presented, yet existing recipes often entangle linguistic form with differences in generation, translation, and filtering. We construct content-controlled supervision by rendering the same verified English trajectories into English, translated target-language, and language-mixed shells, and fine-tune two pretrained students in three target languages, evaluating them on multilingual mathematical reasoning at two difficulty levels. Even with the underlying reasoning content held fixed, we find that shell choice can change downstream accuracy, with effects varying across students, languages, and difficulty levels. Pre-training compatibility does not consistently track these outcomes, and even when our tests find no clear accuracy difference between shells, their output-language behavior can still differ substantially. These results suggest that the supervision shell is a distinct design choice in multilingual reasoning distillation.
zh_title: 隔离语言外壳：一项多语言推理的内容控制研究
translation: 多语言推理蒸馏需要选择呈现教师推理的语言，但现有方法常常将语言形式与生成、翻译和过滤的差异纠缠在一起。我们通过将相同的经过验证的英文轨迹渲染成英文、翻译的目标语言和语言混合的外壳来构建内容受控的监督，并在三种目标语言中微调两个预训练的学生模型，在两种难度级别的多语言数学推理上进行评估。即使底层推理内容保持不变，我们发现外壳选择可以改变下游准确性，其影响因学生、语言和难度级别而异。预训练兼容性并不能始终跟踪这些结果，即使我们的测试发现不同外壳之间没有明显的准确性差异，它们的输出语言行为仍然可能存在实质性差异。这些结果表明，监督外壳是多语言推理蒸馏中一个独特的（设计）选择。
tldr: 研究发现，在多语言推理蒸馏中，即使底层推理内容相同，语言外壳的选择也会影响下游准确性及输出语言行为，表明语言外壳是一个重要的设计选择。
ai_comments: 这项研究通过巧妙地隔离语言外壳与底层推理内容，填补了多语言推理蒸馏领域的一个重要空白。其创新之处在于构建了“内容受控的监督”，有效解耦了语言形式和内容的影响，为理解多语言模型行为提供了更清晰的视角。研究结果具有重要意义，提示研究人员在设计多语言推理系统时，应将监督语言外壳视为一个关键且独立的参数进行考量，而非简单地与内容或翻译过程混为一谈。
motivation: 现有的多语言推理蒸馏方法常常将语言形式与生成、翻译和过滤的差异混淆，使得难以独立评估语言外壳的影响。
method: 通过将相同的经过验证的英文轨迹渲染成英文、翻译的目标语言和语言混合的外壳，构建内容受控的监督。然后，在三种目标语言中微调两个预训练的学生模型，并在两种难度级别的多语言数学推理上进行评估。
results: 即使底层推理内容固定，语言外壳的选择也能改变下游准确性，且效果因学生、语言和难度级别而异。预训练兼容性不能始终预测这些结果。即使在没有明确准确性差异的情况下，不同外壳的输出语言行为也可能存在显著差异。
conclusion: 监督外壳是多语言推理蒸馏中一个独特的且重要的设计选择。

title: Towards Text-Mask Consistency in Medical Image Segmentation
authors: Jie Gui, Hang Tu, Wen Sha, Xiuquan Du
abstract: Vision-language models for medical image segmentation often produce masks that conflict with the accompanying text, especially under multi-site/multi-lesion descriptions. We trace this failure to two factors: (i) highly templated and repetitive clinical language causes one-to-one hard contrastive learning to yield numerous false negatives, weakening cross-modal alignment; and (ii) predominantly vision-driven, one-way cross-attention lacks a language-dominant, spatially aware pathway, hindering effective injection of textual semantics into the spatial visual domain. To this end, we propose Consistency-enhanced Two-stage Segmentation (C2Seg). In the pretraining stage, Cluster-aware Contrastive Learning uses a frozen strong baseline to construct an intra-batch text similarity matrix as soft labels, thereby alleviating false negative conflicts and producing more discriminative visual representations. In the fusion stage, we introduce a Bidirectional Complementary Attention Module, where each modality dominates attention along its own path, fostering deep interaction and structural consistency between visual and textual representations. In order to enhance the expressive power of multimodal features, we further adopt KAN-based Attention Gating. Without updating the language encoder, our approach significantly improves text-mask consistency and segmentation accuracy on four public medical imaging datasets. The source code is available at https://github.com/JGuiidev/C2Seg.
zh_title: 医学图像分割中实现文本-掩膜一致性
translation: 医学图像分割的视觉-语言模型经常生成与伴随文本冲突的掩膜，尤其是在多部位/多病变描述下。我们将此失败归因于两个因素：(i) 高度模板化和重复的临床语言导致一对一的硬对比学习产生大量假阴性，削弱了跨模态对齐；(ii) 主要由视觉驱动的单向交叉注意力缺乏语言主导的、空间感知的路径，阻碍了文本语义有效地注入空间视觉领域。为此，我们提出了“一致性增强两阶段分割”（C2Seg）。在预训练阶段，“簇感知对比学习”使用冻结的强大基线来构建批内文本相似性矩阵作为软标签，从而缓解假阴性冲突并产生更具判别性的视觉表示。在融合阶段，我们引入了一个“双向互补注意力模块”，其中每个模态在其自己的路径上主导注意力，促进视觉和文本表示之间的深度交互和结构一致性。为了增强多模态特征的表达能力，我们进一步采用了基于KAN的注意力门控。在不更新语言编码器的情况下，我们的方法显著提高了四个公共医学图像数据集上的文本-掩膜一致性和分割精度。源代码可在https://github.com/JGuiidev/C2Seg 获取。
tldr: 现有医学图像分割的视觉-语言模型在文本-掩膜一致性上存在问题，尤其在多部位/多病变描述下。本文提出C2Seg，通过簇感知对比学习和双向互补注意力模块，显著提升了文本-掩膜一致性和分割精度。
ai_comments: 这项工作通过识别医学影像领域特有的语言特征（高度模板化、重复性）导致的问题，并针对性地提出了解决方案，具有创新性。其两阶段方法，特别是引入软标签的簇感知对比学习和双向互补注意力模块，有效解决了跨模态对齐和信息注入的挑战。该方法在不更新语言编码器的情况下取得显著提升，表明其在实际应用中具有较高的效率和潜力。
motivation: 现有医学图像分割的视觉-语言模型在多部位/多病变描述下，生成的掩膜与伴随文本存在冲突。这主要归因于两个因素：1) 高度模板化和重复的临床语言导致硬对比学习产生大量假阴性，削弱了跨模态对齐；2) 视觉主导的单向交叉注意力缺乏语言主导、空间感知的路径，阻碍了文本语义有效注入空间视觉领域。
method: 本文提出了“一致性增强两阶段分割”（C2Seg）。在预训练阶段，使用“簇感知对比学习”（Cluster-aware Contrastive Learning），通过冻结的强基线构建批内文本相似性矩阵作为软标签，以缓解假阴性冲突并产生更具判别性的视觉表示。在融合阶段，引入“双向互补注意力模块”（Bidirectional Complementary Attention Module），使每个模态在其各自路径上主导注意力，促进视觉和文本表示之间的深度交互和结构一致性。为增强多模态特征的表达能力，进一步采用了基于KAN的注意力门控（KAN-based Attention Gating）。
results: 在不更新语言编码器的情况下，该方法显著提高了四个公共医学图像数据集上的文本-掩膜一致性和分割精度。
conclusion: C2Seg通过解决假阴性冲突和引入双向互补注意力机制，有效提升了医学图像分割中视觉-语言模型的文本-掩膜一致性和分割性能。

title: A Continuous Relaxation of Quantization-Aware Training
authors: Kartikeya Bhardwaj, Mohammed Almousa, Chaitanya Mullapudi, Ananth Balasubramanian, Nithin Ramesan, Tuc Nguyen, Harris Teague
abstract: Quantization is a critical piece of the deployment pipeline in the era of large generative models. Low-bit quantization, particularly 2-bits or sub-2-bits, is a notoriously difficult problem, particularly when using a channelwise quantization scheme which has been shown as a leading candidate for hardware-efficiency. The key challenges with low-bit quantization range from limited quantization levels to saddle points or flat regions in the loss surface. In this paper, we look at the problem of flat quantization loss surfaces through a lens of dynamically changing bitwidth. Unlike existing techniques which either change the bit-precision abruptly or keep it fixed, we propose to gradually alter the bitwidth as the model trains. To this end, we propose RelaxQAT, a continuous relaxation of the QAT process. We also provide simple theoretical and empirical insights behind why RelaxQAT helps the QAT performance. Our extensive experiments demonstrate up to 6.3% average accuracy gains on vision and up to 7.7% better average accuracy on natural language tasks, compared to the leading QAT methods.
zh_title: 量化感知训练的连续松弛
translation: 量化是大型生成模型部署流程中的关键一环。低比特量化，特别是2比特或亚2比特量化，是一个出了名的难题，尤其在使用已被证明是硬件效率领先候选的通道级量化方案时。低比特量化的主要挑战包括有限的量化级别、损失面中的鞍点或平坦区域。在本文中，我们通过动态改变位宽的视角来审视量化损失面平坦的问题。与现有技术（要么突然改变位精度，要么保持固定）不同，我们建议在模型训练过程中逐渐改变位宽。为此，我们提出了RelaxQAT，这是QAT过程的一种连续松弛。我们还提供了RelaxQAT如何帮助QAT性能的简单理论和经验见解。我们广泛的实验表明，与领先的QAT方法相比，视觉任务上平均准确率提高了高达6.3%，自然语言任务上平均准确率提高了高达7.7%。
tldr: 提出RelaxQAT，通过在训练中逐渐改变位宽来解决低位量化中的损失面平坦问题，显著提升了视觉和自然语言任务的准确性。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入“连续松弛”和“逐渐改变位宽”的概念，为低位量化提供了一个新颖且有效的解决方案，特别是在处理损失面平坦问题上。这种动态调整位宽的策略具有创新性，并且在实际应用中展现出显著的性能提升，对于大型模型在边缘设备上的部署具有重要意义。
motivation: 低位量化，特别是2比特或亚2比特量化，是一个公认的难题，尤其在使用通道级量化方案时。其主要挑战包括有限的量化级别以及损失面中的鞍点或平坦区域。本文旨在通过动态改变位宽的视角来解决量化损失面平坦的问题。
method: 本文提出RelaxQAT，一种量化感知训练（QAT）过程的连续松弛方法。与现有技术突然改变位精度或保持固定不同，RelaxQAT在模型训练过程中逐渐改变位宽。
results: 实验结果表明，与领先的QAT方法相比，RelaxQAT在视觉任务上平均准确率提高了高达6.3%，在自然语言任务上平均准确率提高了高达7.7%。
conclusion: RelaxQAT通过连续松弛的QAT过程，在训练中逐渐改变位宽，有效解决了低位量化中损失面平坦的问题，显著提升了模型在视觉和自然语言任务上的准确性。

title: Learning 3D MRI Representations with Generative Adversarial Networks
authors: Sujeet Lahane, Sapna Mishra, Akash Suryavanshi, Tapan Gandhi, Bharat Biswal
abstract: Learning representations of visual images is a challenging task. It requires extracting abstract patterns from high-dimensional data without explicit supervision. This becomes pronounced with 3D MR imaging due to sparse features, higher dimensional inputs, and smaller datasets. Many state-of-the-art representation learning algorithms successfully rely on transformers and diffusion-based architectures. However, these methods struggle with smaller datasets. In effect, solution methods relax the problem by slicing 3D volumes and solving the problem for 2D medical imaging, resulting in a loss of spatial 3D information. We present R2RG, a representation learning method based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), with Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) honing the reconstruction task. Our key insights lie in exploiting architectural biases in 3D CNNs, combined with data-efficient auto-encoding GANs and a composite loss function to enhance reconstruction fidelity and stabilize training. Our experiments on three standard datasets and a locally collected dataset show that R2RG not only achieves superior performance but also generalizes to heterogeneous and smaller datasets. Furthermore, representations learned with R2RG outperform those learned with contrastive-based representation learning methods on Parkinson's and Alzheimer's disease classification. Our work demonstrates that reconstruction-based representation learning is a promising direction for 3D medical imaging under limited data availability.
zh_title: 使用生成对抗网络学习3D MRI表征
translation: 学习视觉图像的表征是一项具有挑战性的任务，它需要在没有显式监督的情况下从高维数据中提取抽象模式。由于特征稀疏、高维输入和较小的数据集，这一问题在3D MRI成像中尤为突出。许多最先进的表征学习算法成功依赖于Transformer和基于扩散架构的方法，然而这些方法在较小的数据集上表现不佳。实际上，现有解决方法通过将3D体积切片并将其作为2D医学成像来求解，从而导致了3D空间信息的丢失。我们提出了R2RG，这是一种基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的表征学习方法，并利用生成对抗网络（GAN）来完善重构任务。我们的核心见解在于利用3D CNN中的架构偏差，结合数据高效的自编码GAN以及组合损失函数，以增强重构保真度并稳定训练。我们在三个标准数据集和一个本地数据集上的实验表明，R2RG不仅实现了卓越的性能，还能泛化到异构且较小的数据集。此外，使用R2RG学习到的表征在帕金森病和阿尔茨海默病分类上优于基于对比学习的表征学习方法。我们的工作表明，基于重构的表征学习是数据可用性受限的3D医学成像的一个有前景的方向。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于GAN和3D CNN的表征学习方法（R2RG），有效解决了小数据集下3D医学影像特征稀疏和空间信息丢失的问题，并在疾病分类任务中展现出优越性能。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地利用结合了GAN的3D CNN来进行3D医学图像的表征学习，克服了传统Transformer和扩散模型在小数据集上表现不佳以及2D切片导致3D空间信息丢失的问题，在帕金森病和阿尔茨海默病的分类任务中表现优异。
motivation: 学习3D MRI图像的表征由于特征稀疏、高维输入和数据集较小而极具挑战性。现有的Transformer和Diffusion模型在小数据集上表现不佳，而将其切片为2D图像又会导致3D空间信息的丢失。
method: 提出了R2RG方法，这是一种基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的表征学习方法，结合了生成对抗网络（GAN）来完善重构任务，利用3D CNN的架构偏差、数据高效的自编码GAN以及组合损失函数。
results: 在三个标准数据集和一个本地数据集上的实验表明，R2RG不仅取得了卓越的性能，还能泛化到异构且较小的数据集，并且在帕金森病和阿尔茨海默病分类任务中优于基于对比学习的表征学习方法。
conclusion: 基于重构的表征学习在数据可用性受限的3D医学成像中是一个极具前景的方向，R2RG方法能有效提取3D空间特征并泛化至异构及小数据集。

title: Structural Agreement Indicates Prediction Accuracy For Protein-Ligand Co-Folding
authors: J. Henry Broster, Bojana Popovic, Diana Kondinskaia, Charlotte M. Deane, Fergus Imrie
abstract: Co-folding models predict the structures of proteins and their bound ligands, but their accuracy varies across targets. Their usefulness therefore depends on knowing which predictions a user can trust. Confidence scores are intended to guide that choice. However, across seven co-folding models, we show that confidence-based selection offers little improvement over choosing a prediction at random. For approximately three-quarters of structures, predictions are either exclusively correct or incorrect, leaving no opportunity for ranking to change the outcome. Moreover, high confidence does not reliably discriminate correct top-ranked predictions from incorrect ones. We find that structural agreement among predictions is a more accurate measure of likely success than current confidence scores. We capture this with the Concentration of Repeated Ensembles (CORE) Score, which combines cluster tightness with ensemble support. CORE Score discriminates top-1 success and oracle success, achieving mean ROC AUCs of 0.866 and 0.838, compared to 0.757 and 0.759 for ipTM. CORE Score also outperforms training set similarity measures, including ligand Tanimoto, protein sequence, and Runs N' Poses similarity, despite requiring no experimental ligand pose. Structural agreement is therefore a practical indicator of reliability and a baseline for evaluating future confidence estimators, without requiring an additional trained uncertainty estimator.
comment: 30 pages, 9 figures, 20 supplementary figures, 3 supplementary tables. Code: https://github.com/oxpig/core-score
zh_title: 结构一致性指示蛋白质-配体共折叠的预测准确性
translation: 共折叠模型可以预测蛋白质及其结合配体的结构，但其准确性因目标而异。因此，它们的实用性取决于用户能信任哪些预测。置信度分数旨在指导这种选择。然而，在七个共折叠模型中，我们发现基于置信度的选择与随机选择预测相比几乎没有什么改进。对于大约四分之三的结构，预测要么完全正确，要么完全错误，这使得排序无法改变结果。此外，高置信度并不能可靠地区分正确的顶级预测和错误的预测。我们发现，预测之间的结构一致性比当前的置信度分数更能准确衡量可能的成功。我们用重复集成浓度（CORE）分数来捕捉这一点，该分数结合了集群紧密度与集成支持度。CORE Score能够区分top-1成功和oracle成功，平均ROC AUC分别达到0.866和0.838，而ipTM分别为0.757和0.759.尽管不需要实验配体构象，CORE Score的性能也优于训练集相似性测量（包括配体Tanimoto、蛋白质序列和Runs N' Poses相似性）。因此，结构一致性是可靠性的实用指标，也是评估未来置信度估计器的基线，无需额外的训练不确定性估计器。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于结构一致性的CORE Score，用于替代传统的置信度分数，能更准确地评估蛋白质-配体共折叠模型的预测可靠性。
ai_comments: 该论文针对蛋白质-配体共折叠模型中置信度分数不可靠的问题，提出了一种基于结构一致性的CORE Score，无需训练便能有效评估预测准确性，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 目前蛋白质-配体共折叠模型的准确性因目标而异，现有的置信度分数在指导用户选择正确预测方面表现不佳，因此需要更可靠的方法来评估预测的可信度。
method: 提出了Concentration of Repeated Ensembles (CORE Score)，通过结合集群紧密度与集成支持度来衡量预测结构间的一致性，并与现有的置信度分数（如ipTM）及训练集相似度进行了性能对比。
results: 研究发现约四分之三的预测结构非对即错，高置信度无法可靠区分正确预测；而CORE Score在区分顶级预测成功率和Oracle成功率方面表现出色，平均ROC AUC分别达到0.866和0.838，优于ipTM及其他相似度测量方法。
conclusion: 结构一致性（如CORE Score）是评估蛋白质-配体共折叠预测可靠性的有效指标，优于现有的置信度分数和训练集相似度方法。

title: PACE: Policy Augmentation and Compensation With Explicit Disturbance Estimation for Robust Locomotion
authors: Shixuan Han, Yuyang Wang, Jingting Jia, Zeshuai Chen, Jindou Jia, Kexin Guo, Xiang Yu
abstract: Reinforcement learning has made quadrupedal locomotion remarkably robust. To handle unmodeled dynamics and external disturbances, domain randomization is usually employed to make a policy hedge against every condition it might meet. However, maintaining accurate tracking across varying dynamics and generalizing beyond the sampled range remain challenging. Here we show that explicitly estimating the disturbance and feeding the resulting estimation back into both the policy and the controller can relax this compromise. We introduce Policy Augmentation and Compensation with Explicit disturbance estimation (PACE). The framework lumps payload variations, center-of-mass (CoM) shifts, actuator degradation, and external forces into one joint-space disturbance. A nonlinear observer subsequently recovers this disturbance online without requiring joint acceleration measurements. The disturbance estimation provides feedforward torque compensation as the foundational control pathway and further augments the policy observation to enable disturbance-aware action generation. Considering the learning difficulty of fast-varying contact effects, we further provide an analytical contact estimation approach from joint and inertial measurements, without demanding force sensors. Across eleven simulated dynamics conditions, PACE reduces velocity-tracking error by 18.1% to 57.0% against state-of-the-art baselines, and maintains improved tracking under out-of-distribution (OOD) commands. Notably, in real-world experiments, the deployed real robot carried an 11.5 kg payload, nearly equal to its own mass. It also negotiated unseen 16 cm step-downs and crossed five outdoor terrains. The policy was trained exclusively on flat ground in simulation with at most 3 kg of added mass.
zh_title: PACE：具有显式扰动估计的策略增强与补偿，实现稳健运动
translation: 强化学习使四足机器人的运动变得非常稳健。为了处理未建模的动力学和外部干扰，通常采用域随机化来使策略防范其可能遇到的每一种情况。然而，在不同的动力学变化下保持精确的轨迹跟踪以及泛化到采样范围之外仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们证明了显式估计扰动并将估计结果反馈到策略和控制器中可以缓解这种折衷。我们引入了具有显式扰动估计的策略增强与补偿（PACE）框架。该框架将负载变化、质心（CoM）偏移、执行器退化和外力合并为一个关节空间扰动。随后，非线性观测器在线恢复该扰动，而无需关节加速度测量。扰动估计既作为基础控制通路提供前馈力矩补偿，又进一步增强了策略观测，以实现具扰动感知能力的动作生成。考虑到快速变化接触效应的学习难度，我们进一步提供了一种来自关节和惯性测量的解析接触估计方法，而不需要力传感器。在11种模拟动力学条件下，与最先进的基线相比，PACE将速度跟踪误差减少了18.1%至57.0%，并在分布外（OOD）指令下保持了改善的跟踪效果。值得注意的是，在真实世界的实验中，部署的真实机器人携带了11.5公斤的负载，几乎等于其自身的质量。它还克服了未见过的16厘米下台阶并跨越了五种户外地形。该策略仅在仿真平地上进行训练，附加质量最多为3公斤。
tldr: 提出了一种名为PACE的强化学习控制框架，通过显式估计关节扰动并进行前馈补偿与策略增强，使四足机器人在面对大负载和未知户外地形时表现出极强的鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种结合显式扰动估计的策略增强与补偿框架（PACE），创新性地利用非线性观测器在线估计关节空间扰动，无需关节加速度测量，并通过前馈力矩补偿和策略观测增强显著提升了四足机器人在复杂动态和未见环境下的鲁棒性。其在真实世界中实现超大负载（11.5公斤）和多地形穿越的能力展示了极高的实用价值。
motivation: 尽管强化学习使四足机器人运动变得相当稳健，但传统的域随机化方法在处理未建模动力学和外部干扰时，难以在保持准确轨迹跟踪和泛化到采样范围之外（OOD）之间取得平衡。
method: 引入了PACE框架，将负载变化、质心偏移、执行器退化和外力合并为关节空间扰动，利用非线性观测器在线恢复该扰动（无需关节加速度测量），并提供前馈力矩补偿以及增强策略观测；同时采用基于关节和惯性测量的解析接触估计方法。
results: 在11种模拟动态条件下，PACE将速度跟踪误差比最先进的基线降低了18.1%至57.0%，并在分布外（OOD）指令下保持了更好的跟踪效果。在真实世界实验中，部署的机器人在仅在仿真平地和最多3kg负载下训练的情况下，成功携带了11.5kg的负载（接近其自身质量），并通过了16厘米的未见台阶和五种户外地形。
conclusion: PACE通过显式扰动估计与策略增强补偿的结合，有效解决了传统域随机化方法在应对大负载、未建模动力学和分布外指令时的局限性，大幅提升了四足机器人在模拟和现实世界中的运动鲁棒性。

title: NightmareDiscourseBench: A Benchmark Dataset for Fictional Direct Discourse Identification Pipelines
authors: Claudia Carroll, Gabi Kirilloff, Dashiell Leigh
abstract: In this paper we introduce a new benchmark dataset, NightmareDiscourseBench, for testing NLP pipelines that identify forms of direct discourse in English-language fiction. We first review existing publicly available benchmarks (providing summary statistics and reviewing available metadata) for this task, identifying theoretical inconsistency and exclusive focus on speech as primary issues in this domain. We then overview our narrative theory-based framework for classifying and evaluating different forms of direct discourse, and finally describe NightmareDiscourseBench, a new benchmark test set of 12 text samples accompanied by metadata pertinent to the task of direct discourse identification.
zh_title: NightmareDiscourseBench：用于虚构直接话语识别管道的基准数据集
translation: 在本文中，我们引入了一个新的基准数据集NightmareDiscourseBench，用于测试用于识别英语小说中各种形式直接话语的NLP管道。我们首先回顾了该任务现有的公开基准（提供汇总统计数据并审查可用的元数据），指出了该领域理论不一致和独占关注言语等主要问题。然后，我们概述了用于分类和评估不同形式直接话语的基于叙事理论的框架，最后描述了NightmareDiscourseBench，这是一个包含12个文本样本以及与直接话语识别任务相关的元数据的新基准测试集。
tldr: 本文推出了NightmareDiscourseBench数据集，用于改进和测试英语小说中直接话语识别的NLP管道。
ai_comments: 该论文针对英语小说中直接话语（direct discourse）识别这一NLP任务，指出了现有基准数据集存在理论不一致和仅关注言语（speech）的主要问题，并基于叙事理论框架提出了NightmareDiscourseBench数据集。该数据集包含12个文本样本及相关元数据，具有较强的创新性，对提升叙事文本处理的NLP模型性能有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的直接话语识别基准数据集存在理论不一致以及过度关注言语（speech）的问题，缺乏一个全面且基于叙事理论的基准来测试和评估相关的NLP管道。
method: 回顾了现有公开基准数据集及其元数据，指出其局限性；建立了一个基于叙事理论的框架，用于分类和评估不同形式的直接话语；并构建了包含12个文本样本及相关元数据的NightmareDiscourseBench基准测试集。
results: 推出了NightmareDiscourseBench数据集，包含12个带有相关元数据的英文小说文本样本，专门用于测试和评估识别各种形式直接话语的NLP管道。
conclusion: NightmareDiscourseBench的提出填补了小说直接话语识别基准数据集在理论完备性和多样性方面的空白，为未来的NLP管道测试提供了有效工具。

title: Rethinking Cross-Sensor Domain Adaptation for Bridge Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation
authors: Linghui Huang, Zipeng Wang, Shunjie Chen, Peng Guan, Jiandong Wang, Siqing Li, Luming Yang
abstract: Segmentation models for bridge point clouds lose accuracy when trained on terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) data and applied to mobile laser scanning (MLS) data. This study re-examines the SemanticBridge TLS-to-MLS protocol to determine how sampling density, surface roughness, color, and acquisition viewpoint are expressed in the 8-cm sparse-voxel representation, and how adaptation gains depend on source-model convergence. Using one sparse-convolution U-Net, we combine raw-point statistics with controlled input perturbations and compare adaptive batch normalization, entropy minimization, Mean Teacher, and confidence-filtered self-training under 100- and 300-epoch schedules. TLS and MLS have similar nearest-neighbor spacing after preprocessing (12.08 and 12.02 mm), and a 4-mm perturbation of TLS points changes voxel occupancy by only 4.4%. Color distributions differ systematically, but zeroing color on identical voxels changes target mean intersection over union (mIoU) by only +0.02, and by +0.06 after the color augmentation is scale-corrected. The sensors also observe different portions of the bridge, yielding different class proportions. A 300-epoch source-only model obtains 57.80 mIoU on the paired-bridge protocol. Confidence-filtered self-training improves the 100-epoch baseline, but from a converged model it changes target mIoU by -0.97 (source-selected checkpoints) and -2.44 (final-50-epoch means). Repeated evaluation (standard deviation 0.27-0.64) and seed variation (1.88 across three seeds) are comparable to several method differences. Adaptation results on this benchmark therefore depend on representation scale, source-model convergence, and evaluation variability.
zh_title: 重新思考桥梁点云语义分割的跨传感器域适应
translation: 桥梁点云语义分割模型在地面激光扫描 (TLS) 数据上训练并在移动激光扫描 (MLS) 数据上应用时会失去准确性。本研究重新审视了 SemanticBridge TLS-to-MLS 协议，以确定采样密度、表面粗糙度、颜色和采集视角在 8 厘米稀疏体素表示中如何表达，以及适应增益如何依赖于源模型收敛。我们使用一个稀疏卷积 U-Net，将原始点统计数据与受控输入扰动相结合，并比较了自适应批量归一化、熵最小化、Mean Teacher 和置信度过滤自训练在 100 轮和 300 轮训练计划下的效果。预处理后，TLS 和 MLS 的最近邻间距相似（12.08 和 12.02 毫米），TLS 点 4 毫米的扰动只会使体素占用率改变 4.4%。颜色分布存在系统性差异，但在相同体素上将颜色置零仅使目标平均交并比（mIoU）改变 +0.02，经过尺度校正的颜色增强后改变 +0.06。传感器还观察到桥梁的不同部分，导致类别比例不同。一个 300 轮的仅源模型在配对桥梁协议上获得了 57.80 mIoU。置信度过滤自训练改善了 100 轮基线，但对于已收敛的模型，它使目标 mIoU 改变 -0.97（源选择检查点）和 -2.44（最后 50 轮平均值）。重复评估（标准差 0.27-0.64）和种子变异（三个种子之间为 1.88）与几种方法差异相当。因此，本基准上的适应结果取决于表示尺度、源模型收敛和评估变异性。
tldr: 本研究重新审视了桥梁点云语义分割中跨传感器域适应的问题。发现模型在TLS数据上训练并在MLS数据上应用时精度下降。研究通过分析采样密度、表面粗糙度、颜色和采集视角在稀疏体素表示中的表达，以及适应增益对源模型收敛的依赖，比较了多种适应方法。结果表明，适应效果取决于表示尺度、源模型收敛和评估变异性。
ai_comments: 该论文对桥梁点云语义分割中的跨传感器域适应问题进行了深入的重新审视，特别关注了数据表示、源模型收敛状态以及评估变异性对适应效果的影响。其创新之处在于通过控制输入扰动和系统性分析不同因素（如颜色、采样密度）来量化它们的作用。研究结果对于理解和改进点云域适应技术具有重要指导意义，强调了在设计和评估域适应策略时需考虑的复杂性，而不仅仅是简单应用现有方法。
motivation: 当在地面激光扫描 (TLS) 数据上训练的桥梁点云分割模型应用于移动激光扫描 (MLS) 数据时，其准确性会下降。本研究旨在重新审视这一问题，并探究影响跨传感器域适应效果的因素。
method: 本研究重新审视了SemanticBridge TLS-to-MLS协议，以确定采样密度、表面粗糙度、颜色和采集视角在8厘米稀疏体素表示中的表达方式，以及适应增益如何依赖于源模型收敛。使用一个稀疏卷积U-Net，结合原始点统计数据和受控输入扰动，并比较了自适应批量归一化、熵最小化、Mean Teacher和置信度过滤自训练等适应方法，在100和300轮训练计划下进行。研究还通过改变TLS点进行扰动和零化颜色来分析影响。
results: 预处理后，TLS和MLS的最近邻间距相似（12.08和12.02毫米）。TLS点4毫米的扰动只会使体素占用率改变4.4%。颜色分布存在系统性差异，但在相同体素上将颜色置零仅使目标平均交并比（mIoU）改变+0.02，经过尺度校正的颜色增强后改变+0.06。不同传感器观察桥梁的不同部分，导致类别比例不同。300轮源模型在配对桥梁协议上获得57.80 mIoU。置信度过滤自训练改善了100轮基线，但对于已收敛的模型，它使目标mIoU改变-0.97（源选择检查点）和-2.44（最后50轮平均值）。重复评估（标准差0.27-0.64）和种子变异（三个种子之间为1.88）与几种方法差异相当。适应结果取决于表示尺度、源模型收敛和评估变异性。
conclusion: 桥梁点云语义分割的跨传感器域适应结果受表示尺度、源模型收敛和评估变异性的影响。简单地应用置信度过滤自训练等方法可能无法在已收敛模型上带来显著增益，甚至可能降低性能。

title: Distribution-Robust Halfspace Testing
authors: Xi Chen, Renato Ferreira Pinto Jr., Nathaniel Harms, Rocco A. Servedio
abstract:
Standard property testing algorithms are typically designed either for a specific input distribution (distribution-specific algorithms) or for an arbitrary unknown distribution (distribution-free algorithms). Halfspaces are an important example where distribution-specific testers can be extremely efficient, while distribution-free testers are expensive and essentially require learning. We introduce an intermediate type of algorithm, a distribution-robust halfspace tester, which must provide the same guarantees as a distribution-specific tester when the input distribution is the one specified, but must also provide a trustworthy answer under arbitrary distributions. This is achieved by allowing the tester to report that its input distribution is not what it expected (inspired by the recent testable learning framework of Rubinfeld and Vasilyan).
  We prove that distribution-robust testing of halfspaces under the standard Gaussian requires only $O(n^{2/3})$ queries, compared to the known $\widetilde Ω(n)$ required for distribution-free testing. We also prove that sample-based distribution-robust testing of halfspaces is harder than sample-based testing under the standard Gaussian, requiring at least $Ω(n^{2/3})$ samples compared to the known $\widetilde Θ(\sqrt n)$ bound for the latter. In fact, we show that the latter $\widetilde Θ(\sqrt n)$ bound becomes $Ω(n^{2/3})$ when the covariance matrix is only mildly perturbed.
zh_title: 分布鲁棒的半空间测试
translation:
标准的属性测试算法通常是为特定的输入分布（特定分布算法）或任意未知分布（免分布算法）设计的。半空间是一个重要的例子，其中特定分布的测试器可以极其高效，而免分布的测试器则很昂贵且本质上需要学习。我们引入了一种中间类型的算法——分布鲁棒半空间测试器，当输入分布是指定的分布时，它必须提供与特定分布测试器相同的保证，但也必须在任意分布下提供可靠的回答。这是通过允许测试器报告其输入分布不是预期的分布来实现的（受到Rubinfeld和Vasilyan最近的可测试学习框架的启发）。
我们证明了在标准高斯下对半空间进行分布鲁棒测试仅需要 $O(n^{2/3})$ 次查询，而免分布测试所需的已知查询复杂度为 $\widetilde \Omega(n)$。我们还证明了基于样本的半空间分布鲁棒测试比标准高斯下的基于样本测试更难，至少需要 $\Omega(n^{2/3})$ 个样本，而后者已知的界限为 $\widetilde \Theta(\sqrt n)$。事实上，我们表明，当协方差矩阵仅受到轻微扰动时，后者的 $\widetilde \Theta(\sqrt n)$ 界限会变为 $\Omega(n^{2/3})$。
tldr: 本文提出了半空间的分布鲁棒测试算法，在标准高斯分布下实现了 $O(n^{2/3})$ 的高效查询复杂度，兼具特定分布的高效性与任意分布的鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 该论文引入了一种介于特定分布测试和免分布测试之间的新型“分布鲁棒”测试算法，成功在保持特定分布下高效性的同时，提升了对未知分布的防御能力，填补了这一理论空白。
motivation: 传统的半空间属性测试要么高度依赖特定分布（高效但脆弱），要么针对任意未知分布（代价高昂且接近学习）。为了结合两者的优点，作者旨在提出一种介于两者之间、既保证特定分布下的高效性又能在任意分布下给出可信回答的“分布鲁棒”测试算法。
method: 引入分布式鲁棒半空间测试算法（允许算法在输入分布不符合预期时进行报告），并分析了其在标准高斯分布下的查询复杂度和样本复杂度。
results: 在标准高斯分布下，半空间的分布鲁棒测试仅需 $O(n^{2/3})$ 次查询（优于免分布测试的 $\widetilde \Omega(n)$）；而在样本复杂度方面，分布鲁棒测试需要至少 $\Omega(n^{2/3})$ 个样本，且协方差矩阵受到微小扰动时样本界限也会恶化到 $\Omega(n^{2/3})$。
conclusion: 论文证明了在标准高斯分布下，半空间的分布鲁棒测试所需查询复杂度为 $O(n^{2/3})$，优于免分布测试，同时揭示了样本复杂度下界，对理解半空间性质测试有重要贡献。

title: Dynamic Token Merging for Efficient Vision-Language Models
authors: Chris Gu, Marco Andono Sie, Nathan Zhou, Christopher Potts, Julie Kallini
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) represent each image with hundreds of visual tokens, which can make inference costly even when a prompt depends on only part of the image. Dynamic Token Merging (DTM), introduced in MrT5 for byte-level text encoders, learns which tokens to remove: a lightweight delete gate scores contextualized hidden states, acts as a differentiable attention bias during training, and physically removes tokens at inference. We argue that DTM is a general token deletion framework rather than a byte-level technique, and extend it to the vision modality and to decoder-only models. Applying DTM to T5Gemma 2 and Gemma 3 yields V-MrT5Gemma2, which deletes visual tokens inside a bidirectional multimodal encoder, and V-MrGemma3, which compacts the prompt and its key-value caches during decoder-only prefill. Across ten benchmarks, DTM's advantage over attention-based and random deletion grows with the deletion rate and is largest on document, chart, and scene-text reading. At 80% visual token deletion (approximately 60% fewer FLOPs), DTM raises accuracy over FastV from 51.8 to 63.0 on ChartQA and from 63.3 to 67.8 on TextVQA with V-MrT5Gemma2, as well as from 62.2 to 68.8 and from 71.2 to 75.1 with V-MrGemma3, retaining 90-96% of unpruned performance on both tasks with significant efficiency gains. These results support DTM as a general framework for efficient transformers.
zh_title: 用于高效视觉-语言模型的动态Token合并
translation: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）用数百个视觉Token表示每张图像，即使提示词仅依赖图像的一部分，也会使推理成本高昂。字节级文本编码器MrT5中引入的动态Token合并（DTM）学习了要移除哪些Token：一个轻量级的删除门控对上下文隐藏状态进行打分，在训练期间充当可微分的注意力偏置，并在推理期间物理移除Token。我们认为DTM是一个通用的Token删除框架，而不是一种字节级技术，并将其扩展到视觉模组和仅解码器模型。将DTM应用到T5Gemma 2和Gemma 3中，产生了V-MrT5Gemma2（在双向多模态编码器内部删除视觉Token）和V-MrGemma3（在仅解码器预填充期间压缩提示词及其键值缓存）。在十个基准测试中，DTM相对于基于注意力的删除和随机删除的优势随着删除率的增加而增长，并且在文档、图表和场景文本阅读方面最为显著。在进行80%的视觉Token删除（大约减少60%的FLOPs）时，使用V-MrT5Gemma2，DTM将ChartQA上的准确率从51.8提高到63.0，将TextVQA上的准确率从63.3提高到67.8；使用V-MrGemma3，准确率分别从62.2提高到68.8以及从71.2提高到75.1，在两项任务上均保留了未剪枝性能的90-96%，并获得了显著的效率提升。这些结果支持DTM作为高效Transformer的通用框架。
tldr: 通过将动态Token合并（DTM）扩展到视觉-语言模型，实现了在大幅减少计算成本的同时，高精度地保留图像关键信息。
ai_comments: 该论文将原本用于文本编码器的动态Token合并（DTM）技术成功扩展到了视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的视觉模组和解码器中，证明了其作为高效Transformer通用框架的潜力，尤其在处理文档、图表等密集文本图像时性能显著优于现有方法。
motivation: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）用数百个视觉Token表示每张图像，导致推理成本高昂，且现有的视觉Token删除方法在面对高删除率时性能损失较大，缺乏一个通用的高效Token删除框架。
method: 将Dynamic Token Merging (DTM)框架扩展到视觉模组和解码器中，通过轻量级的删除门控（delete gate）对上下文隐藏状态进行评分，在训练时作为可微分的注意力偏置，在推理时物理移除冗余的视觉Token，从而构建了V-MrT5Gemma2和V-MrGemma3模型。
results: 在80%的视觉Token删除率（约减少60%的FLOPs）下，V-MrT5Gemma2和V-MrGemma3在ChartQA和TextVQA等基准测试中显著优于FastV等现有方法，保留了未剪枝模型90-96%的性能。
conclusion: 动态Token合并（DTM）是一种高效且通用的Transformer Token裁剪框架，能够显著减少VLMs的计算开销（FLOPs），同时在各种视觉-语言基准测试中保持极高的准确率。

title: V2VFusion: Text-Controlled Video-to-Video Diffusion for Degradation-Aware Video Fusion
authors: Jiajun Chen, Han Xu, Yunfei Huang, Zhuoya Zhang, Guangcan Liu, Jiayi Ma
abstract: Video fusion integrates complementary information in multiple source video streams into a single sequence for complete scene perception. Existing methods perform frame-wise fusion and lack unified spatio-temporal modeling across sequences, damaging temporal coherence across sequences. When dealing with degradations, they also ignore temporal dynamics and overload a single network with diverse degradations, leading to limited and imbalanced degradation suppression. To address these issues, we propose V2VFusion, the first unified video-to-video fusion framework that directly generates temporally coherent, high-quality fused videos from degraded multi-source inputs. By reformulating video fusion as a video-to-video conditional generation problem in latent diffusion space, our approach holistically models spatio-temporal dependencies across entire sequences and intrinsically ensures sequence-level consistency. On this basis, a text-guided degradation-conditioned ControlNet bridges high-level textual degradation descriptions with low-level visual priors, enabling interpretable and controllable guidance for structure-preserving fusion beyond purely data-driven conditioning. To handle heterogeneous and compound degradations, a state-modulated degradation-aware hierarchical mixture-of-experts module decouples expert selection into diffusion-state-aware filtering and degradation-aware routing. It prevents unreliable routing and fosters expert specialization to mitigate representation conflicts among diverse degradations. Experiments on infrared-visible, multi-exposure, and multi-focus video fusion tasks and complex degradations validate that V2VFusion surpasses existing methods in fusion quality and temporal stability. The code is available at https://github.com/ChenDoubleJ/V2VFusion.
zh_title: V2VFusion：面向退化感知视频融合的文本控制视频到视频扩散模型
translation: 视频融合将多个源视频流中的互补信息整合到一个单一序列中，以实现完整的场景感知。现有方法执行逐帧融合，缺乏跨序列的统一时空建模，从而破坏了序列间的时间连贯性。在处理退化问题时，它们也忽视了时间动力学，并将各种退化过载到一个单一网络中，导致有限且不平衡的退化抑制。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 V2VFusion，这是第一个统一的视频到视频融合框架，可直接从退化的多源输入中生成时间连贯的高质量融合视频。通过将视频融合重新表述为潜在扩散空间中的视频到视频条件生成问题，我们的方法整体地模拟了整个序列的时空依赖性，并内在保证了序列级的一致性。在此基础上，文本引导的退化条件 ControlNet 将高级文本退化描述与低级视觉先验桥接起来，为超出纯粹数据驱动条件的结构保持融合提供了解释性和可控性引导。为了处理异构和复合退化，状态调制的退化感知分层混合专家模块将专家选择解耦为扩散状态感知过滤和退化感知路由。它防止了不可靠的路由并促进了专家专业化，以减轻各种退化之间的表示冲突。在红外-可见光、多曝光和多聚焦视频融合任务以及复杂退化上的实验验证了 V2VFusion 在融合质量和时间稳定性方面超过了现有方法。代码可在 https://github.com/ChenDoubleJ/V2VFusion 获取。
tldr: V2VFusion是首个基于文本控制和扩散模型的统一视频融合框架，通过时空建模与退化感知混合专家模块，解决了传统视频融合中的时空不一致与复合退化难题。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将视频融合问题重新构想为潜在扩散空间中的视频到视频条件生成问题，首次实现了基于文本控制的退化感知统一视频融合框架，解决了传统方法时空连贯性不足和复合退化处理不佳的问题。
motivation: 现有的视频融合方法采用逐帧融合，缺乏统一的时空建模，导致跨序列的时间连贯性受损；同时，它们忽视了时间动态，将多种退化过载到单一网络中，导致退化抑制有限且不平衡。
method: 提出V2VFusion框架，将视频融合转化为潜在扩散空间中的视频-视频条件生成任务；设计了文本引导的退化条件ControlNet连接文本与视觉先验；引入了状态调制的退化感知分层混合专家模块，实现扩散状态感知过滤和退化感知路由。
results: 在红外-可见光、多曝光和多聚焦视频融合任务以及复杂退化场景上的实验证明，V2VFusion在融合质量和时间稳定性方面均超越了现有方法。
conclusion: V2VFusion成功构建了一个统一的视频到视频融合框架，通过潜在扩散模型、文本引导控制网和混合专家模块，有效克服了传统视频融合中的时空不一致和退化抑制难题，在多种视频融合任务上取得了优异的表现。

title: COMPASS: Cross-modal Observation with Multi-Path Adaptive Stopping and Selection for Early Time Series Classification
authors: Cheng-En Chung, Yujia Wu, Oscar Tai-Yuan Chen, Vincent S. Tseng
abstract: Early time-series classification (ETSC) balances predictive performance against the amount of observed data. In multimodal settings, modality-associated and fused branches may differ in predictive ability at the same observed prefix, motivating joint decisions about when to stop and which branch should provide the final prediction. We propose COMPASS, a two-stage framework that preserves two modality-associated temporal branches and one fusion branch. The first stage combines cross-modal feature exchange and gated fusion with branch-wise supervision at every prefix. The second stage optimizes a shared four-action controller to continue observation or terminate through one of the frozen branches. Experiments on six physiological and wearable datasets compare COMPASS with multimodal adaptations of five ETSC baselines. COMPASS achieves the best average ranks in accuracy-earliness harmonic mean, AUROC, and earliness within this comparison set. At identical learned stopping times, branch selection improves mean accuracy over fusion readout on five of the six datasets, with gains of 2.35 and 2.16 percentage points on ISRUC-Sleep and UCDDB, respectively. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work on joint stopping and branch selection for multimodal early time series classification.
zh_title: COMPASS：用于早期时间序列分类的带有多路径自适应停止与选择的跨模态观测
