method: 引入CRAFT方法，将问题特定细节抽象为槽位以发现部分词汇化的表达模板（PLETs），将措辞变体聚类为家族，对每个家族代表进行压缩产生共享的删除或重写编辑，并将其应用到各个实例中。
results: 相比按例重写，CRAFT Rewrite在保持中位数准确率损失仅1.21个百分点的前提下，将加权压缩预算减少了中位数90.7%，并生成了更短的推理；与跨样本编码相比，它在所有八个模型-数据集设置中平均将推理缩短了25.3%，并在五个设置中提高了准确率。
conclusion: CRAFT通过识别和复用部分词汇化的表达模板，有效克服了传统按例压缩和跨样本编码的局限性，实现了高效的离线思维链压缩。

title: MetaRigor: From Agentic Automation to Verifiable End-to-End Meta-Analysis Through Scientific Decision Boundaries
authors: Yifeng Xie, Chenke Li, Yangshuo Miao, Jingyuan Zheng, Mingxuan Liu, Feiwei Qin, YaQi Wang, Huiyu Zhou, Yifei Chen
abstract: Automated meta-analysis requires not only accurate numerical extraction but also the consistent preservation of result identity across stages, including the associated study, comparison, population, outcome, time point, and analysis conditions. We present MetaRigor, an LLM workflow framework for verifiable end-to-end evidence synthesis. MetaRigor organizes study results as Study x Target units and operationalizes scientific decision boundaries at the task level through Task Contracts, programmatic rules, and source binding. The model performs semantic interpretation that depends on study context, whereas programs execute formalizable rules, computations, validation, and source verification. We conducted controlled evaluations across five stages: evidence acquisition, data extraction, risk of bias assessment, certainty of evidence assessment, and manuscript generation. MetaRigor achieved an F1 score of 86.29% for complete result delivery and 80.20% agreement for domain-level certainty of evidence judgments. Generated manuscripts received scores of 86.00 under human evaluation, exceeding all three baselines. A seven-case downstream end-to-end evaluation further yielded an aggregate F1 score of 77.01%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 9.78 percentage points. Cross-system tracing of archived outputs from three systems further showed that local mismatches or omissions in result identity could alter statistical inputs and the objects subjected to risk of bias assessment, with these errors subsequently propagating into the final report. Ablation experiments showed that task constraints and programmatic rules played distinct roles across different stages. These findings indicate that, in LLM-driven evidence synthesis workflows, consistently maintaining explicit result identity, decision boundaries, and provenance relationships is critical to improving end-to-end verifiability.
zh_title: MetaRigor：从智能体自动化到通过科学决策边界实现可验证的端到端元分析
translation: 自动化元分析不仅需要准确的数值提取，还需要在各个阶段一致地保持结果身份（包括相关的研究、比较、人群、结局、时间点和分析条件）的完整性。我们提出了 MetaRigor，这是一个用于可验证端到端证据综合的 LLM 工作流框架。MetaRigor 将研究结果组织为“研究 × 目标”单元，并通过任务契约、程序化规则和来源绑定在任务级别操作科学决策边界。模型执行依赖于研究上下文的语义解释，而程序则执行可形式化的规则、计算、验证和来源验证。我们在五个阶段进行了控制评估：证据获取、数据提取、偏倚风险评估、证据确定性评估和文稿生成。MetaRigor 在完整结果交付上取得了 86.29% 的 F1 分数，在领域级证据确定性判断上取得了 80.20% 的一致性。生成的文稿在人工评估下获得了 86.00 分，超过了所有三个基线。七个案例的下游端到端评估进一步产生了 77.01% 的聚合 F1 分数，比最强基线高出 9.78 个百分点。对三个系统的归档输出进行的跨系统追踪进一步表明，结果身份的局部不匹配或遗漏可能会改变统计输入以及偏倚风险评估的对象，这些错误随后会传播到最终报告中。消融实验表明，任务约束和程序化规则在不同阶段发挥了不同的作用。这些发现表明，在 LLM 驱动的证据综合工作流中，持续保持显式的结果身份、决策边界和溯源关系对于提高端到端可验证性至关重要。
tldr: MetaRigor 是一个基于科学决策边界的 LLM 工作流框架，能够实现可验证的端到端自动化元分析，显著提升了证据综合的准确性和可靠性。
ai_comments: MetaRigor 框架通过结合大语言模型的语义理解与程序化规则验证，有效解决了自动化元分析中结果身份丢失和错误传播的问题，在多个评估阶段表现出显著优于现有基线的性能，对可验证的科学证据综合具有重要意义。
motivation: 自动化元分析不仅需要准确的数值提取，还需要在各个阶段持续保持结果身份的一致性（包括关联的研究、比较、人群、结局、时间点和分析条件），而现有方法容易导致错误传播。
method: 提出了 MetaRigor 框架，将研究结果组织为“研究×目标”单元，通过任务契约、程序化规则和来源绑定在任务级别操作科学决策边界，利用大语言模型进行依赖上下文的语义解释，并结合程序执行规则计算、验证和溯源。
results: 在控制评估中，MetaRigor 在完整结果交付上取得了 86.29% 的 F1 分数，在领域级证据确定性评估上达到了 80.20% 的一致性；生成的文稿人工评分达到 86.00 分，超过所有基线；在七个案例的端到端评估中取得了 77.01% 的聚合 F1 分数，比最强基线高出 9.78 个百分点。
conclusion: MetaRigor 证明了在 LLM 驱动的证据综合工作流中，维持显式的研究结果身份、科学决策边界以及溯源关系对于提升端到端可验证性至关重要。

title: Recoverable Symbols, Unstable Execution: Auditing Internal Pathways and Decision Identity in Visual State Tracking
authors: Ruiqi Liu, Jinming Li, Mo Wang, Yang Lu, Yanlan Kang
abstract: Visual features can retain every symbol a task needs while a model built on them still changes its answer when irrelevant parts of the image change. We study this gap in visual state tracking, where a recurrent executor reads a sequence of symbol tiles through a frozen ViT encoder and decides whether a displayed candidate equals the final state. Our diagnostic pairs each input with a donor view that preserves every queried tile, checks with a symbol-supervised decoder that the full symbol chain is recoverable from both feature sequences, and swaps individual internal channels of the same fitted executor in both directions. On 3,526 pairs in which every symbol is recovered in both views, changing the surrounding context lowers the balanced accuracy of a rotary recurrent head by 17.13 points. The loss runs mainly through the input-dependent rotation phase: restoring the original phase repairs 351 of 391 new errors and brings accuracy back to 88.54%, yet 142 individual predictions still differ from the original ones. A locked test on 192 unseen program families reproduces the pathway (28 of 29 new errors repaired; 382 of 384 predictions unchanged), and the effect partly carries over to single-image canvases. Consistency objectives derived from this analysis reduce the internal discrepancy they target but do not outperform ordinary data augmentation.
zh_title: 可恢复的符号、不稳定的执行：视觉状态跟踪中内部通路与决策恒常性的审计
translation: 视觉特征可以保留任务所需的所有符号，但建立在其之上的模型在图像的无关部分改变时仍会改变其答案。我们在视觉状态跟踪中研究了这一鸿沟，其中循环执行器通过冻结的ViT编码器读取一系列符号瓦片，并判断显示的候选状态是否等于最终状态。我们的诊断将每个输入与保留了每个查询瓦片的供体视图配对，用符号监督解码器检查两个特征序列中是否都能恢复出完整的符号链，并在两个方向上交换相同拟合执行器的各个内部通道。在所有符号在两个视图中都可恢复的3,526对输入中，改变周围上下文使旋转循环头的平衡准确率下降了17.13个百分点。性能损失主要通过输入依赖的旋转阶段产生：恢复原始相位修复了391个新错误中的351个，并将准确率带回88.54%，但仍有142个单独的预测与原始预测不同。在192个未见过的程序族上的锁定测试复制了这一通路（28个新错误中修复了28个；382个预测中有382个未改变），并且该效应部分延续到了单图画布上。由该分析衍生的一致性目标减少了它们所针对的内部差异，但并未优于普通的数据增强。
tldr: 视觉状态跟踪中，即使所有任务符号均可完整恢复，无关的上下文变化也会通过输入依赖的旋转阶段导致模型决策不稳定。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地结合了特征恢复度与内部通路审计，深入探讨了视觉状态跟踪中“符号可恢复但执行不稳定”的现象，对理解Vision Transformer在视觉推理任务中的鲁棒性具有重要意义。
motivation: 旨在研究和揭示视觉状态跟踪中的一个鸿沟：即使底层视觉特征保留了任务所需的每个符号，当图像中不相关部分发生变化时，基于这些特征构建的模型依然会改变其输出结果。
method: 配对包含相同查询瓦片的输入与供体视图，利用符号监督解码器检查特征序列中符号链的可恢复性，并在两个方向上交换相同拟合执行器的单个内部通道。
results: 在3526对所有符号均可恢复的输入对中，改变周围上下文会导致旋转循环头的平衡准确率下降17.13个百分点；该性能损失主要发生在输入依赖的旋转阶段，恢复原始相位可以修复大部分错误，但在未见过的程序族上也复现了类似的通路特性。
conclusion: 即使视觉特征中完整保留了所有必需的符号，上下文的变化仍会导致模型决策不稳定。这种不稳定性主要源于输入依赖的旋转阶段，可以通过引入内部一致性目标进行部分缓解，但标准数据 augmentation 仍然更有效。

title: VeilGS: Solving Darkness as a Veil of 2D Basis Maps over Retinex 3DGS
authors: Mohab Kishawy, Chengzhou Tang, Shahram Shirani, Jun Chen
abstract: In a dark capture, the darkness is not uniform. How much light reaches a surface depends on where it lies relative to the few light sources, and the camera compresses what remains with a tone curve. Most low-light 3D reconstruction methods either apply one curve to every pixel of a view, so a dark object beside a lamp and a bright one in an unlit corner receive the same correction, or store the darkness in the 3D representation, where it can absorb scene detail. We present VeilGS, a 3D Gaussian Splatting method for low-light novel view synthesis that treats the degradation as a veil drawn over a clear scene. Each Gaussian carries an albedo and a shading latent instead of spherical harmonics, separating surface colour from illumination. Each view is darkened by a spatially varying gain followed by a global tone curve, and rendering without this veil gives the restored scene. A small network predicts a coarse basis for the gain from the observation, and its coefficients are solved for each view rather than learned. Training through this solve discourages the Gaussians from absorbing what the veil can explain. VeilGS needs no paired normal-light supervision and stores no per-view parameters. On Gaussian-DK, its restored renders score best on no-reference NIQE and CLIP-IQA and are rated highest in a blind user study with 55 participants. On LOM, it achieves results competitive with the state of the art.
zh_title: VeilGS：将黑暗作为Retinex 3DGS上2D基础图的面纱来解决低光照问题
translation: 在黑暗拍摄中，黑暗并非均匀分布。光线到达表面的程度取决于它相对于少数光源的位置，而相机的色调曲线则压缩了剩余的光线。大多数低光照 3D 重建方法要么对视图的每个像素应用一条曲线（因此灯旁边的暗物体和未照明角落的亮物体接受相同的校正），要么将黑暗存储在 3D 表示中，这会吸收场景细节。我们提出了 VeilGS，这是一种用于低光照新视角合成的 3D 高斯泼溅方法，它将退化视为盖在清晰场景上的面纱。每个高斯点携带反照率和阴影潜变量而非球面谐波，从而将表面颜色与光照分离。每个视图通过空间变化的增益和全局色调曲线进行暗化，去除这个面纱即可渲染出恢复的场景。一个小网络从观测中预测增益的粗略基础，其系数是针对每个视图求解而不是学习得到的。通过这种求解进行训练，可以防止高斯点吸收面纱能够解释的内容。VeilGS 不需要成对的正常光监督，也不存储每个视图的参数。在 Gaussian-DK 上，其恢复的渲染图在无参考的 NIQE 和 CLIP-IQA 上得分最高，并在有 55 名参与者的盲测用户研究中获得最高评价。在 LOM 上，它取得了与最先进技术相媲美的结果。
tldr: VeilGS 提出了一种创新的 3D 高斯泼溅低光照渲染方法，将黑暗建模为一层面纱，成功分离了表面颜色与非均匀光照，无需配对数据即可实现高质量的暗光场景重建。
ai_comments: VeilGS 创新性地将暗光下的退化建模为覆盖在清晰场景上的“面纱”，通过将反照率和阴影潜变量与空间变化的增益及全局色调曲线结合，成功分离了表面颜色和光照。这种方法无需成对的正常光监督，且不在3D表示中存储黑暗信息，有效保护了场景细节。
motivation: 现有的低光照 3D 重建方法要么对整张图应用单一的色调曲线（忽略了空间光照的不均匀性），要么将黑暗信息存储在 3D 表示中（导致其吸收了场景细节）。为此，需要一种能够更好分离表面颜色与非均匀光照的方法。
method: 提出 VeilGS 方法，每个高斯点携带反照率和阴影潜变量而非球面谐波；每张图像由空间变化的增益和全局色调曲线进行暗化处理；通过求解每张视图的系数而非学习的方式，训练时抑制高斯点吸收面纱可解释的部分。
results: 在 Gaussian-DK 数据集上，VeilGS 恢复出的渲染图在无参考指标 NIQE 和 CLIP-IQA 上得分最高，并在 55 名参与者的盲法用户研究中获得最高评价；在 LOM 数据集上也取得了与当前最优（SOTA）方法相竞争的结果。
conclusion: VeilGS 是一种用于低光照新视角合成的创新 3D 高斯泼溅方法，能够有效恢复暗光场景并实现高质量的新视角渲染。

title: PAWS: A Parametric Model of Canine Pose and Shape
authors: Theo Wieland, Zala Žgank, Silvia Zuffi, Ylva Mellbin, Elin Hernlund, Hedvig Kjellström
abstract:
We introduce PAWS, a parametric model of canine shape and pose, learned from 3D scans of real dogs. Capturing the full diversity of dogs is challenging, as different breeds vary in size, proportion, and body shape. To capture this range, we scanned 31 dogs across multiple breeds and sizes performing a range of natural movements. From this dataset, we build a parametric model that combines an anatomically faithful skeleton with a linear shape space learned from the 3D scans. Unlike previous models, our model is learned from real dogs in varying poses, allowing for realistic modelling of canine pose and shape.
  We demonstrate that building on PAWS provides a robust framework for downstream tasks, such as surface reconstruction and image regression. In particular, we show that a limited number of anatomically valid degrees of freedom is sufficient to accurately estimate dog pose and shape.
zh_title: PAWS：一种犬类姿态与形状的参数化模型
translation: 我们介绍了PAWS，这是一个从真实犬类的3D扫描中学习得到的犬类形状和姿态的参数化模型。捕捉犬类的全方位多样性具有挑战性，因为不同的犬种在大小、比例和体型上各不相同。为了捕捉这种范围，我们扫描了31只不同品种和体型、进行各种自然运动的犬只。从该数据集出发，我们构建了一个参数化模型，它将解剖学上准确的骨骼与从3D扫描中学习到的线性形状空间结合起来。与以往的模型不同，我们的模型是从处于不同姿态的真实犬类中学习得到的，从而能够对犬类的姿态和形状进行逼真的建模。我们证明了基于PAWS构建可以为诸如表面重建和图像回归等下游任务提供一个稳健的框架。特别是，我们表明有限数量的解剖学有效自由度足以准确估计犬类的姿态和形状。
tldr: 本文提出了PAWS——一个基于真实犬类3D扫描构建的参数化犬类姿态与形状模型，能有效支持表面重建和图像回归任务。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种基于真实犬类3D扫描数据的参数化犬类姿态和形状模型PAWS，克服了犬类品种多样性带来的建模难题，在表面重建和图像回归等下游任务中表现出良好的鲁棒性和应用价值。
motivation: 捕捉犬类的全方位多样性具有挑战性，因为不同品种在大小、比例和体型上差异巨大，且现有模型缺乏基于真实犬类在不同姿态下进行真实建模的能力。
method: 从31只不同品种和体型的犬类在自然运动中的3D扫描数据出发，构建了一个结合了解剖学准确骨骼与从3D扫描中学习到的线性形状空间的参数化模型。
results: 实验证明，基于PAWS的模型能够通过有限的解剖学有效自由度，准确地估计犬类的姿态和形状，并能有效支持表面重建和图像回归等下游任务。
conclusion: PAWS模型能够利用有限的解剖学有效自由度，准确估计犬类的姿态与形状，为犬类三维重建和图像回归提供了强大的参数化框架。

title: Solving the pre-image problem in kernel PCA: The reproducing property is all you need
authors: Joel-Pascal Ntwali N'konzi, Stefan Klus
abstract: Kernel PCA extends PCA to nonlinear dimensionality reduction by implicitly mapping data into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) via the kernel trick, with applications ranging from image denoising to out-of-distribution detection. While its projection map is well understood, appropriately defining the associated reconstruction map is a longstanding challenge since projecting back from the RKHS to the input space is non-trivial. This is known as the pre-image problem. Existing approaches have tackled this problem by either relying on nonlinear optimization, which is prone to numerical instabilities and sensitive to initialization, or by solving a separate supervised learning problem, incurring additional computational overhead. Furthermore, although the projection map of kernel PCA reduces to that of standard PCA when a linear kernel is used, most of these approaches are not guaranteed to recover PCA's reconstruction map in this case, a consistency property that one would naturally expect to hold. In this paper, we leverage the reproducing property of the RKHS to derive a reconstruction map for kernel PCA that is provably consistent. Our derivations rely on the mild assumption that the RKHS either contains linear functions or the kernel is universal, which holds for standard kernels. We further extend the method to the random Fourier features (RFFs) approximation of kernel PCA by introducing a corresponding notion of RFF reproducing property. Numerical experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed method performs comparably with state-of-the-art methods across kernel choices, while remaining more computationally efficient and maintaining consistent performance in settings where these baseline methods drastically fail.
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
zh_title: 解决核PCA中的原像问题：你只需要再生性质
translation: 核PCA通过核技巧将数据隐式映射到再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中，从而将PCA扩展到非线性降维，其应用从图像去噪到分布外检测。虽然其投影映射已被充分理解，但合理定义相关的重建映射长期以来一直是一个挑战，因为从RKHS投影回输入空间并非易事，这就是所谓的原像问题。现有的方法通过依赖非线性优化（容易出现数值不稳定且对初始化敏感）或解决单独的监督学习问题（带来额外的计算开销）来解决这个问题。此外，尽管在使用线性 kernel 时核PCA的投影映射会退化为标准PCA的投影映射，但大多数这些方法不能保证在这种情况下恢复PCA的重建映射，而这是一种人们自然期望成立的一致性属性。在本文中，我们利用RKHS的再生性质推导出了核PCA的重建映射，该映射具有可证明的一致性。我们的推导依赖于RKHS包含线性函数或核是通用核这一温和假设，这对于标准核是成立的。我们进一步通过引入相应的RFF再生性质概念，将该方法扩展到核PCA的随机傅里叶特征（RFF）近似。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的数值实验表明，所提出的方法在各种核选择下表现出与最先进方法相当的性能，同时保持了更高的计算效率，并在基准方法严重失效的设置中保持了一致的性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用再生核希尔伯特空间的再生性质来解决核PCA原像问题的新方法，该方法高效、鲁棒且具备理论一致性。
ai_comments: 本文巧妙地利用再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）的再生性质，解决了核主成分分析（KPCA）中长期存在的原像问题。该方法不仅在理论上证明了线性核下的一致性，还通过随机傅里叶特征（RFF）扩展了应用范围，兼具高效性与鲁棒性，具有很高的理论与实用价值。
motivation: 核PCA中将高维特征空间投影回输入空间的“原像问题”长期存在。现有的非线性优化方法容易出现数值不稳定且对初始化敏感，而监督学习方法则带来额外的计算开销，且多数方法在退化为线性核时无法保证与标准PCA的重建映射一致。
method: 利用RKHS的再生性质推导出一个具有可证明一致性的核PCA重建映射，并在通用核或包含线性函数的假设下成立，同时将其扩展到随机傅里叶特征（RFF）的近似中。
results: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的数值实验表明，该方法在各种核选择下表现出与最先进方法相当的性能，同时计算效率更高，并在基准方法严重失效的设置中保持了一致的性能。
conclusion: 本文提出的基于再生性质的原像求解方法在理论上具有一致性，在计算上高效且鲁棒，为核主成分分析提供了一个优雅且通用的重建方案。

title: Beyond Math, Code, and Logic: Do Reasoning Models Transfer to Scientific Argumentation?
authors: Buse Sibel Korkmaz, Antonio del Rio Chanona
abstract: Scientific discourse depends on argumentative reasoning: identifying claims, evaluating evidence, and constructing coherent responses. While recent advances in reasoning-capable language models have demonstrated strong performance on mathematical, coding, and logical benchmarks, their ability to engage in scientific argumentation remains unclear. We present the first systematic evaluation of language models across seven tasks spanning argument mining, rebuttal generation, and discourse-level reasoning using research papers, peer reviews, and grant proposals. Our study reveals that even frontier models with strong general reasoning skills struggle with domain-specific argumentative tasks, highlighting a fundamental capability gap. To address this, we introduce a training framework that explicitly scaffolds the argumentative reasoning process in language models, substantially improving their competence in scientific discourse. The resulting compact models approach or exceed the performance of much larger proprietary systems and generalize to unseen conversational settings, demonstrating reasoning transfer beyond task-specific supervision. These findings underscore that effective scientific argumentation is not an emergent property of scale, but requires explicit reasoning-aware training, and they point toward practical pathways for building AI systems that can contribute meaningfully to scientific discourse.
zh_title: 超越数学、代码与逻辑：推理模型能迁移到科学论证吗？
translation: 科学论证依赖于论证推理：识别论证、评估证据和构建连贯的回复。虽然最近具备推理能力的大语言模型在数学、编码和逻辑基准测试中表现出强劲的性能，但它们参与科学论证的能力仍不明确。我们对七个跨越研究论文、同行评审和资助申请的论证挖掘、反驳生成和语篇级推理任务的模型进行了首次系统评估。我们的研究表明，即使是具有强大通用推理技能的前沿模型，也在特定领域的论证任务中挣扎，这突显了一个根本性的能力差距。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个训练框架，显式地在语言模型中搭建论证推理过程的脚手架，从而大幅提升其在科学话语中的能力。由此产生的紧凑型模型接近或超过了更大的专有系统的性能，并推广到未见过的对话设置中，证明了超越任务特定监督的推理迁移。这些发现强调，有效的科学论证不是规模的涌现属性，而是需要显式的推理感知训练，并指出了构建能够为科学话语做出有意义贡献的AI系统的实用路径。
tldr: 推理大模型在科学论证任务上表现不佳，但通过本文提出的显式推理训练框架，紧凑型模型可以显著提升科学话语处理能力并超越大模型。
ai_comments: 该论文指出了当前大语言模型在数学和逻辑推理上的优势并不自然延伸至科学论证领域，并创新性地提出了显式脚手架训练框架，为AI辅助科研论证提供了重要的研究方向。
motivation: 探究在数学、代码和逻辑领域表现出色的推理大模型是否能够迁移并胜任科学论证任务，并弥补其在科学论证上的能力差距。
method: 进行了跨越七个任务（包括论证挖掘、反驳生成和语篇级推理）的系统评估，并引入了一个显式脚手架化论证推理过程的训练框架。
results: 前沿模型在特定领域的论证任务上表现不佳，存在能力差距；而提出的训练框架显著提升了模型在科学话语中的能力，紧凑型模型性能达到或超越了更大的专有系统。
conclusion: 科学论证能力不是规模的自然涌现属性，需要显式的推理感知训练。紧凑型模型通过该框架可匹敌甚至超越大型专有模型。

title: Decision Models for Multilingual Emotion Classification: A Comparative Study Against LLMs and Encoders
authors: Alessandro Piccolo, Francesco De Nicolò, Francesco Manco, Eufemia Lella
abstract: Decision models receive a question with a closed list of answers and return a probability for each answer instead of free text. They promise low latency and robustness to prompt wording, but no study has compared several of them with fine-tuned encoders across languages. We ask whether systems used without training on labelled data (zero-shot) can replace fine-tuning, and what the decision format adds over a general-purpose large language model (LLM). We compare three decision models (Jev, OpenAI Decisions, Strands Decider 2B) and two LLMs (GPT-6 Luna, Qwen3.5-2B), given Italian instructions, with two fine-tuned multilingual encoders (tabularisai, XLM-EMO) on four emotions (joy, sadness, anger, fear) in 10 social-media datasets in five languages, with paired difference and equivalence tests. The three best zero-shot systems (two decision models and one LLM) score on average about one macro-F1 point below an encoder fine-tuned on the target dataset; our test sets cannot exclude a gap of 4-5 points, and on single datasets either approach wins by up to 22 points. They beat encoders fine-tuned on another dataset by 8-15 points, though against XLM-EMO this may not extend to new datasets, and instructions in each text's language change their results by under 1 point. Exploratorily, they beat the strongest public emotion model used as is by about 6 points. OpenAI's decision endpoint matches GPT-6 Luna, the LLM it runs on, at a fifth of its median latency, and a 2-billion-parameter decision model beats a same-size general LLM by 10 points, owing to its training, not the decision format. The best zero-shot systems, the LLM included, have an SD of about 1 point across prompts. Without labelled data they are a strong default, and decision models add lower latency and, unlike generative LLM use, per-option probabilities. Fine-tuning won by a wide margin only on the largest dataset, GoEmotions.
zh_title: 多语言情感分类的决策模型：与大语言模型和编码器的对比研究
translation: 决策模型接收带有封闭答案列表的问题并返回每个答案的概率，而不是自由文本。它们有望实现低延迟和对提示词措辞的鲁棒性，但没有研究跨语言比较几种决策模型与微调编码器。我们探讨了在没有标注数据（零样本）情况下使用的系统是否可以替代微调，以及决策格式相对于通用大语言模型（LLM）的优势。我们对比了三个决策模型（Jev、OpenAI Decisions、Strands Decider 2B）和两个LLM（GPT-6 Luna、Qwen3.5-2B），在意大利语指令下，与两个微调的多语言编码器（tabularisai、XLM-EMO）在5种语言的10个社交媒体数据集上的4种情感（喜悦、悲伤、愤怒、恐惧）进行对比，并使用了配对差值和等效性测试。表现最好的三个零样本系统（两个决策模型和一个LLM）的平均宏F1分数比在目标数据集上微调的编码器低约1分；我们的测试集无法排除4-5分的差距，在单个数据集上，任一方法最多可胜出22分。它们比在另一个数据集上微调的编码器高出8-15分，尽管对抗XLM-EMO时这可能不适用于新数据集，并且每种文本语言的指令使其结果改变不到1分。探索性地，它们比作为基准使用的最强公共情感模型高出约6分。OpenAI的决策端点与它运行在其上的LLM（GPT-6 Luna）表现相当，但其中位延迟仅为后者的五分之一；一个20亿参数的决策模型凭借其训练（而非决策格式）击败了同尺寸的通用LLM。最好的零样本系统（包括LLM）在不同提示词之间的标准差约为1分。在没有标注数据的情况下，它们是一个强有力的默认选择，而决策模型增加了更低的延迟，并且与生成式LLM的使用不同，它们提供了每个选项的概率。仅在最大的数据集GoEmotions上，微调才以较大优势获胜。
tldr: 决策模型在多语言情感分类中无需标注数据即可达到接近微调模型的性能，且具有更低延迟和更好鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 该论文首次系统性地对比了零样本决策模型、大语言模型与微调编码器在多语言情感分类任务上的性能，揭示了决策模型在延迟和鲁棒性上的优势，为无标注数据场景下的模型选择提供了重要参考。
motivation: 决策模型具有低延迟和对提示词措辞鲁棒性的优势，但目前尚无研究将其与跨语言的微调编码器进行全面对比，且其相对于通用大语言模型的增益也亟待明确。
method: 对比了三种决策模型、两种大语言模型以及两个微调的多语言编码器，在10个社交媒体数据集（5种语言、4种情感）上进行零样本与微调性能的对比，并采用配对差值和等效性测试进行统计分析。
results: 最好的零样本系统平均比目标数据集上微调的编码器低约1个macro-F1点；决策模型相比同尺寸通用大模型表现出显著优势（得益于训练而非决策格式），且延迟大幅降低；提示词语言的改变对结果影响很小（小于1点）。
conclusion: 在无需标注数据的场景下，零样本决策模型和大模型可作为强有力的默认选择；决策模型在保持与大模型相当性能的同时，具备更低的延迟和每个选项的概率输出。

title: A Cognitive Agentic AI Framework for Interactive Process Analysis and Optimization
authors: Trung Ngoc Trinha, Roman Tschentscher, Trong Dong Nguyen, Trung Thanh Nguyen, Anna Trubetskaya
abstract: Complex multivariable process analysis and optimization require coordinated access to simulation, structured data, machine learning (ML), optimization, and scientific literature, often across disconnected software tools. We present a Cognitive Agentic AI Framework (CAAF) that enables interactive, iterative process investigation through natural-language prompts within an established flowsheet. Following harness-engineering principles, CAAF assigns task interpretation, planning, knowledge synthesis, and context management to a large language model while delegating numerical calculations to specialized tools. Dedicated providers connect databases, scientific-document retrieval, ML-assisted Bayesian optimization (BO), and COCO process simulation. The framework is demonstrated on methyl acetate production. Guided by successive prompts, an engineer explored multivariable relationships, conducted 4,000 BO iterations to maximize carbon conversion yield (C-Yield) and minimize specific energy cost (C-SEC), refined operating bounds, and verified selected candidates through process simulation. Re-simulation of 16 candidates within the restricted domain showed close agreement with ML predictions, with a mean absolute C-Yield error of 0.0085 (0.85 percentage points). The highest BO-derived C-Yield, verified by COCO, was 0.921 versus approximately 0.81 in the initial dataset, an improvement of about 11 percentage points. CAAF also detects and reports non-converged simulations, excludes invalid outputs, and continues subsequent evaluations. The results demonstrate how human-guided agentic coordination can combine engineering tools for iterative analysis and optimization with rigorous simulation-based verification under a fixed process topology.
zh_title: 面向交互式过程分析与优化的认知主体AI框架
translation: 复杂的多元过程分析与优化需要协调访问仿真、结构化数据、机器学习（ML）、优化和科学文献，通常跨越不连通的软件工具。我们提出了一个认知主体AI框架（CAAF），它通过在已建立的流程图中进行自然语言提示，实现交互式的、迭代的过程研究。遵循组合工程原理，CAAF将任务解释、规划、知识综合和上下文管理分配给一个大型语言模型，同时将数值计算委托给专门的工具。专用的提供者连接数据库、科学文档检索、ML辅助贝叶斯优化（BO）和COCO过程仿真。该框架在甲基乙酸酯生产中得到演示。在连续提示的指导下，工程师探索了多元关系，进行了4000次BO迭代以最大化碳转化率（C-Yield）并最小化单位能耗（C-SEC），完善了操作范围，并通过过程仿真验证了选定的候选方案。在限制域内对16个候选方案的重新仿真显示与ML预测非常吻合，平均绝对C-Yield误差为0.0085（0.85个百分点）。经COCO验证的最高BO衍生的C-Yield为0.921，而初始数据集约为0.81，提高了约11个百分点。CAAF还能检测并报告非收敛仿真，排除无效输出，并继续后续评估。结果表明，在固定工艺拓扑下，人类引导的主体协调如何能够结合工程工具进行迭代分析和优化，并进行严格的基于仿真的验证。
tldr: 该研究提出了一个认知主体AI框架（CAAF），通过自然语言指令协调各种工程工具（如模拟、机器学习、优化和文献检索），以实现复杂多变量过程的交互式分析和优化。在甲基乙酸酯生产的案例中，CAAF成功地引导工程师进行了大量的优化迭代，显著提高了碳转化率并降低了能耗，同时通过模拟验证了优化结果的准确性。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的框架，有效地整合了大型语言模型和传统的工程工具，实现了复杂过程的交互式分析和优化。将LLM的角色定义为“认知主体”并负责高层规划和知识综合，而将数值计算交给专业工具，这种分工是该方法的核心创新。框架在甲基乙酸酯生产案例中的成功应用，以及量化的性能提升，证明了其有效性。然而，该框架在处理非收敛模拟和排除无效输出方面的能力，以及其在处理更复杂、动态变化的过程中的扩展性，还有待进一步研究。
motivation: 复杂的多元过程分析和优化需要整合模拟、结构化数据、机器学习、优化和科学文献等多种工具，但这些工具通常是分离的，难以协调。
method: 提出一个认知主体AI框架（CAAF），该框架基于“组合工程”原理。它利用大型语言模型（LLM）来处理任务解释、规划、知识综合和上下文管理，并将数值计算任务委托给专门的工具，如数据库、科学文献检索系统、机器学习辅助贝叶斯优化（BO）和COCO过程模拟器。
results: 在甲基乙酸酯生产的案例中，CAAF通过4000次BO迭代，将碳转化率（C-Yield）最大化并最小化了单位能耗（C-SEC）。优化后的C-Yield从初始数据集的约0.81提高到0.921，提升了约11个百分点。ML预测与COCO模拟结果吻合良好，C-Yield的平均绝对误差为0.0085。框架还能处理非收敛模拟和排除无效输出。
conclusion: 研究结果表明，由人类引导的主体协调可以有效地整合各种工程工具，实现迭代分析和优化，并通过严格的模拟验证，在固定的工艺拓扑下取得显著的性能提升。

title: Quantitative Measurement of Pavement Distress based on Vehicle Camera and Perspective Correction
authors: Sike Wang, Yizhou Lin, Shuo Li, Yi Jiang, Chengcheng Tao
abstract: Using image data is becoming an important method for highway agencies to automatically evaluate pavement conditions. However, most studies focus on improving detection accuracy rather than obtaining quantitative measurements, such as the length or area of pavement distress. Although field camera calibration can provide such measurements, it is impractical for large volumes of onboard images collected from different vehicles. This study develops a method to quantitatively measure pavement distress directly from in-vehicle camera images without on-site camera calibration. A quadrilateral region of interest is first identified based on lane detection and used to construct a perspective transformation matrix for image correction. Size correction is then performed using the proportions of road markings in the image and a specified scale, which also enables estimation of the actual width of the selected region. The corrected images are subsequently processed using object detection algorithms to obtain quantitative distress measurements. The proposed method can efficiently perform perspective correction for images collected by the same vehicle camera with minimal manual effort. The measured pavement patch lengths show a trend consistent with pavement friction data. By calibrating vehicle cameras using only image information, this study enables quantitative pavement distress detection without additional field experiments. The approach provides a practical solution for processing large volumes of vehicle-camera data, particularly as connected vehicles generate increasing amounts of uncalibrated roadway imagery.
zh_title: 基于车载摄像头和透视校正的路面病害定量测量
translation: 使用图像数据已成为公路部门自动评估路面状况的重要方法。然而，大多数研究侧重于提高检测精度，而不是获得定量测量，例如路面病害的长度或面积。尽管现场相机校准可以提供此类测量，但对于从不同车辆收集的大量车载图像来说，它是不切实际的。本研究开发了一种直接从车载摄像头图像中定量测量路面病害的方法，无需现场相机校准。首先，基于车道检测识别一个感兴趣的四边形区域，用于构建透视变换矩阵以进行图像校正。然后，使用图像中道路标线比例和指定的尺度进行尺寸校正，这也能估算出所选区域的实际宽度。校正后的图像随后使用目标检测算法进行处理，以获得定量的路面病害测量结果。所提出的方法能够高效地对同一车辆摄像头所采集的图像进行透视校正，所需手动操作最少。测量的路面病害长度与路面摩擦数据呈现出一致的趋势。通过仅使用图像信息校准车辆摄像头，本研究实现了无需额外现场实验即可进行定量路面病害检测。该方法为处理大量车辆摄像头数据提供了一个实用的解决方案，特别是随着网联汽车产生越来越多的未校准道路图像。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种直接从车载摄像头图像中定量测量路面病害（如长度、面积）的方法，无需现场校准。通过识别车道、进行透视变换和基于路面标线比例进行尺寸校正，然后利用目标检测算法进行测量。该方法能有效处理大量未校准的道路图像，且测量结果与路面摩擦数据趋势一致。
ai_comments: 该研究在路面病害定量测量领域具有重要意义，解决了实际应用中的痛点。通过巧妙地利用图像信息进行透视校正和尺寸标定，避免了繁琐的现场校准，大大提高了效率和可行性。将目标检测算法与几何校正相结合，实现了从图像到定量数据的转化。未来的工作可以进一步探索在不同光照、天气条件下的鲁棒性，以及与其他传感器数据的融合。
motivation: 大多数现有研究侧重于提高路面病害检测的准确性，但忽略了获取定量测量（如长度、面积）的需求。现场相机校准虽然可行，但对于从不同车辆收集的大量车载图像来说不切实际。
method: 首先，基于车道线检测识别感兴趣的四边形区域，并构建透视变换矩阵进行图像校正。然后，利用图像中道路标线比例和指定尺度进行尺寸校正，估算选定区域的实际宽度。最后，使用目标检测算法处理校正后的图像，以获得定量的路面病害测量结果。
results: 该方法能够高效地对同一车辆摄像头的图像进行透视校正，且只需少量手动操作。测量的路面病害长度与路面摩擦数据呈现出一致的趋势。通过仅利用图像信息校准车辆摄像头，实现了无需额外现场实验即可进行定量路面病害检测。
conclusion: 本研究提出了一种无需现场校准即可从车载摄像头图像中定量测量路面病害的方法，为处理大量未校准的道路图像提供了一个实用的解决方案，尤其适用于网联汽车产生的数据。

title: A Switching Mechanism for Selecting Environment-Adaptive Personalized Gains in Hearing Aids
authors: Nafisa Zarrin Tasnim, Nasser Kehtarnavaz
abstract: Personalized amplification gains for hearing aids have been shown to be preferred over prescriptive gains. Since the preferred settings can vary depending on the background audio environment, this paper presents a switching mechanism or system that automatically selects personalized gains for a current background audio environment. To prevent foreground speech from interfering with background environment analysis, a one-class voice activity detector is designed to identify speech activity from speech mixed with noise. A consistency check is conducted to enable distinguishing foreground speech from background speech, preserving babble as a background environment of interest because hearing aid users often struggle to understand speech in background babble. Sound segments without foreground speech are then analyzed by an online discovery method combining Bayesian change-point detection with a memory of previously encountered environments. This discovery method detects changes, recognizes returning environments, and discovers new ones without a predefined number of environments. Experimental results show that three-seed mean macro-averaged F1 scores of 85.53%-91.98% across eight speech/background-corpus pairs covering 36 background noise types were achieved. Furthermore, the discovery method achieved adjusted Rand indices of 0.91 and 0.96 on two families of test streams. In the same-recording-return condition of audio streams combining speech with four background audio environments often encountered by hearing aid users, the switching mechanism selected the correct personalized gain profile after 105 environment changes, recalled the stored gain profile at every return, and made no switches to an incorrect gain profile.
zh_title: 一种用于助听器中选择环境自适应个性化增益的切换机制
translation: 助听器的个性化放大增益已被证明比处方增益更受欢迎。由于首选设置可能因背景音频环境而异，本文提出了一种切换机制或系统，能够自动为当前背景音频环境选择个性化增益。为了防止前景语音干扰背景环境分析，设计了一种单类语音活动检测器，用于识别混合了噪声的语音中的语音活动。进行一致性检查以区分前景语音和背景语音，将乱声（babble）保留为感兴趣的背景环境，因为助听器用户经常在背景乱声中难以听懂语音。然后，通过结合贝叶斯变点检测和先前遇到环境记忆的在线发现方法，对没有前景语音的声音片段进行分析。该发现方法可以在没有预定义环境数量的情况下检测变化、识别返回的环境并发现新环境。实验结果表明，在涵盖36种背景噪声类型的8个语音/背景语料库对中，取得了85.53%-91.98%的三种子集平均宏平均F1分数。此外，该发现方法在两个测试流系列上取得了0.91和0.96的调整兰德指数。在结合了语音和助听器用户经常遇到的四种背景音频环境的音频流的“同录返回”条件下，该切换机制在经历了105次环境变化后选择了正确的个性化增益配置文件，在每次返回时都召回了存储的增益配置文件，并且没有发生切换到不正确增益配置文件的情况。
tldr: 本文提出了一种能够根据背景环境自动为助听器选择和切换个性化增益的智能系统，实验证明其准确率高、鲁棒性强。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种自适应助听器个性化增益切换机制，结合了单类语音活动检测器与贝叶斯变点检测，有效解决了复杂噪声环境中环境识别与增益自适应匹配的难题，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 助听器的个性化放大增益优于处方增益，但用户的偏好设置会随背景音频环境的变化而改变，因此需要一种能够自动选择适应当前背景音频环境的个性化增益的切换机制。
method: 设计了一个单类语音活动检测器来识别混合噪声中的前景语音，并通过一致性检查区分前景与背景语音；利用结合了贝叶斯变点检测和历史环境记忆的在线发现方法对无前景语音的声音片段进行分析，实现环境的检测、识别与新环境发现。
results: 实验结果表明，在8个语音/背景语料库对（涵盖36种背景噪声类型）中，三种子集平均宏平均F1分数为85.53%-91.98%；在两个测试流家族中调整后的Rand指数分别达到0.91和0.96；在包含105次环境变化的测试中，切换机制成功选择了正确的个性化增益配置文件，并在每次返回时召回了存储的增益配置文件，没有发生错误的切换。
conclusion: 该机制能够准确检测环境变化、识别已知环境并发现新环境，在复杂的噪声环境中实现高效、准确的个性化增益切换。

title: Convex Structure-Preserving EDMD: Passive Koopman Matrices as $Q$-Contractions
authors: Matthias Ehrhardt, Achraf Zinihi
abstract: Extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) approximates the Koopman operator using a matrix based on a finite set of observables. However, the least-squares matrix of a port-Hamiltonian (pH) system is generally neither passive nor invariant-preserving. We demonstrate that the implicit midpoint discretization of a lifted pH model precisely preserves energy balance, passivity, and all linear Casimirs for every step size. For a fixed storage metric $Q$, the resulting Koopman matrices are the Cayley transforms of $(J-R)Q$, where $J$ is skew-symmetric and $R$ is positive semidefinite. This set does not depend on the step size and is the closure of all Q-contractions. This set is LMI-representable; therefore, structure-preserving EDMD, including ports through a discrete-time Kalman-Yakubovich-Popov condition and Casimirs through affine constraints, is a semidefinite program. The constrained estimate is a projection of the unconstrained estimate in the data-weighted norm and cannot increase estimation error when the population target is pH-compatible. For every $Q$-contraction, a certified bound on the lifted prediction error grows linearly at most in time, whereas it grows geometrically for unconstrained models with Q-gain above one. Benchmarks on a damped pendulum and a damped rigid body demonstrate that constrained models never generate energy and that imposed Casimirs are maintained with solver accuracy (approximately $10^{-8}$). In contrast, EDMD may diverge or lose the Casimir with noisy data. The benchmarks also demonstrate that when $Q$ is the physical energy, the constrained models are less accurate than EDMD and can exhibit significant structural bias.
zh_title: 凸结构保持的EDMD：作为Q-收缩的无源Koopman矩阵
translation: 扩展动态模态分解（EDMD）使用基于一组有限可观测量的矩阵来近似Koopman算子。然而，端口哈密顿（pH）系统的最小二乘矩阵通常既不具有无源性，也不保持不变性。我们证明了提升的pH模型的隐式中点离散化在每个步长下都精确地保持了能量平衡、无源性和所有线性Casimir不变量。对于固定的存储度量 $Q$，所得到的Koopman矩阵是 $(J-R)Q$ 的Cayley变换，其中 $J$ 是反对称的， $R$ 是半正定的。该集合与步长无关，并且是所有 $Q$-收缩的闭包。该集合可由线性矩阵不等式（LMI）表示；因此，结构保持的EDMD（包括通过离散时间Kalman-Yakubovich-Popov条件的端口和通过仿射约束的Casimir）是一个半定程序。受约束的估计是在数据加权范数下对无约束估计的投影，当总体目标与pH相容时，它不会增加估计误差。对于每一个 $Q$-收缩，提升预测误差的认证界在时间上最多呈线性增长，而具有大于1的Q增益的无约束模型则呈几何级增长。对阻尼单摆和阻尼刚体的基准测试表明，受约束的模型从不产生能量，并且施加的Casimir以求解器精度（约为 $10^{-8}$）得以维持。相比之下，EDMD在噪声数据下可能会发散或丢失Casimir。基准测试还表明，当 $Q$ 是物理能量时，受约束模型的准确性低于EDMD，并可能表现出显著的结构偏差。
tldr: 提出了一种基于半定规划的结构保持EDMD方法，通过施加无源性和不变量约束，解决了传统Koopman算子近似在物理系统建模中能量不守恒和发散的问题。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种凸结构保持的扩展动态模态分解（EDMD）方法，通过将无源性、能量守恒和Casimir不变量约束建模为半定规划（SDP），有效解决了传统EDMD在处理哈密顿系统时能量不守恒或发散的问题。同时，作者也指出了当物理能量作为存储度量时可能引入结构偏差这一局限性。
motivation: 传统的扩展动态模态分解（EDMD）及其最小二乘矩阵应用于端口哈密顿（pH）系统时，通常无法保持无源性和系统的不变量（如能量和Casimir），因此需要开发一种能够保持这些物理结构的方法。
method: 利用隐式中点离散化提升的pH模型，推导其Koopman矩阵形式，并将无源性、Casimir不变量等物理性质转化为线性矩阵不等式（LMI）约束，从而将结构保持EDMD构建为一个半定规划（SDP）问题。
results: 基准测试（阻尼单摆和阻尼刚体）表明，受约束的模型不会凭空产生能量，能以求解器精度保持Casimir不变量，并且在噪声数据下比传统EDMD更稳定（预测误差线性增长而非几何级增长），但在使用物理能量作为Q时可能会表现出结构偏差。
conclusion: 通过将Koopman矩阵限制在Q-收缩集合内，结构保持EDMD能够有效保证系统的物理性质（无源性、能量守恒、Casimir不变量），并在噪声数据下显著提高预测的稳定性，尽管在某些情况下可能会引入结构偏差。

title: Do Alice and Bob Dream of the Oracle? Wishful Cryptanalysis
authors: Guoxiao Liu, Keting Jia, Hongbo Yu, Zongyue Wang, Tianshuo Cong, Junfeng Fan, Anyu Wang, Xiaoyun Wang
abstract: For two millennia, offense and defense have forged cryptographic security boundaries. Tools automated calculation and search, while humans drove discovery. Foundation models now mark a shift from automated computation to intelligent scientific discovery. Because cryptanalysis rests on exact mathematical definitions and immediately executable truth, it offers a proving ground for autonomous intelligence to move past security reliant on scarce human attention and explore structures beyond human working memory. Unguided models stall between two opposite traps: authority hallucination, where they surrender whenever prior literature declares a route blocked, and reasoning hallucination, where they produce subtle, unverifiable flaws. Closed platforms and generic agent loops further impede sustained open inquiry. We introduce wishful cryptanalysis, a harness-agnostic methodology that pairs constructive optimism against entrenched assumptions with blinded, zero-import verification against error. Agents first compress reduced-scale theory within provisioned compute so live witnesses certify their mathematics automatically. They then co-adapt primitive, algorithm, and hardware, and climb parameter ladders toward high-round theory. Applied across frontier open-weight and proprietary models with minimal human intervention beyond targets and compute, this paradigm yielded novel attack techniques and thirteen verifiable practical results across Keccak (SHA-3) and AES. These include breaking a fifteen-year-open public challenge and closing longstanding practical gaps, released alongside an early-preview open-source workbench (agent-framework). Extending Kerckhoffs's principle into the AI era, we envision an Open Oracle, an open and auditable public infrastructure that frees cryptographers to legislate security goals, challenge assumptions, distill theory, and co-design resilient standards.
zh_title: 爱丽丝和鲍勃会梦见预言机吗？愿景密码分析
translation:
爱丽丝和鲍勃会梦见预言机吗？愿景密码分析

两千年来，攻防双方共同塑造了密码安全边界。工具自动化了计算和搜索，而人类推动了发现。基础模型现在标志着从自动化计算向智能科学发现的转变。由于密码分析基于精确的数学定义和可立即执行的真理，它为自主智能提供了一个试验场，使其能够超越依赖稀缺人类注意力的安全性，探索超越人类工作记忆的结构。不受引导的模型在两个相反的陷阱之间停滞不前：权威幻觉（当先前的文献声明某条路径被阻断时，它们就会放弃）和推理幻觉（它们会产生微妙的、无法验证的缺陷）。封闭平台和通用代理循环进一步阻碍了持续的开放探究。我们引入了愿景密码分析，这是一种与具体框架无关的方法论，它将建设性乐观主义与对根深蒂固假设的挑战相结合，并采用盲测、零导入的验证来对抗错误。代理首先在预设计算资源内压缩缩减规模的理论，以便实时验证器自动认证其数学正确性。然后，它们协同适应原语、算法和硬件，并逐步提升参数，以探索高轮次理论。该范式在几乎没有人工干预（除了目标和计算资源）的情况下，应用于前沿的开源和专有模型，产生了新颖的攻击技术和Keccak (SHA-3) 和AES上的13项可验证的实际成果。其中包括破解一个长达15年的公开挑战，并弥补了长期存在的实际空白，同时发布了一个早期预览的开源工作台（代理框架）。我们将Kerckhoffs原则扩展到AI时代，设想了一个开放预言机，这是一个开放且可审计的公共基础设施，它将使密码学家能够制定安全目标、挑战假设、提炼理论并共同设计弹性标准。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“愿景密码分析”的新型密码分析方法，利用大语言模型在Keccak (SHA-3) 和AES上取得了13项可验证的实际成果，包括破解一个15年未解的公开挑战，并设想了一个开放可审计的“开放预言机”基础设施。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将AI基础模型应用于密码分析这一高度依赖精确数学和逻辑推理的领域，并提出了一种克服AI固有缺陷（如幻觉）的独特方法——“愿景密码分析”。通过结合乐观假设和严格验证，该方法成功地在Keccak和AES等主流密码算法上取得了显著的实际成果，甚至破解了长期未解的挑战。这不仅展示了AI在复杂科学发现中的巨大潜力，也为AI在安全领域的应用开辟了新途径。论文提出的“开放预言机”概念，进一步展望了AI时代密码学研究和标准制定的未来，具有重要的前瞻性和影响力。
motivation: 传统的密码分析依赖人类发现，但大语言模型（基础模型）的出现标志着从自动化计算转向智能科学发现。然而，不受引导的模型在密码分析中面临“权威幻觉”和“推理幻觉”两大陷阱，以及封闭平台和通用代理循环的限制。因此，需要一种新方法来克服这些挑战，利用AI进行自主智能密码分析，超越人类注意力限制，探索更复杂的结构。
method: 本文提出了“愿景密码分析”方法。这是一种与具体框架无关的方法，将建设性乐观主义与对既有假设的挑战，以及盲测、零导入的错误验证相结合。代理首先在预设计算资源内压缩小规模理论，由实时验证器自动认证其数学正确性。然后，它们协同适应原语、算法和硬件，并逐步提升参数，以探索高轮次理论。该方法应用于前沿的开源和专有模型，仅需最少的人工干预（目标和计算资源）。
results: 该范式在Keccak (SHA-3) 和AES上产生了新颖的攻击技术和13项可验证的实际成果。这些成果包括破解一个长达15年的公开挑战，并弥补了长期存在的实际空白。研究人员还发布了一个早期预览的开源工作台（代理框架）。
conclusion: 愿景密码分析利用大语言模型在密码分析领域取得了显著突破，克服了传统AI在这一领域的挑战。它不仅产生了实际的攻击成果，还提出了一个“开放预言机”的愿景，旨在建立一个开放、可审计的公共基础设施，使密码学家能够制定安全目标、挑战假设、提炼理论并共同设计弹性标准，将Kerckhoffs原则扩展到AI时代。

title: AutoOntologyBench: A Task-Grounded Benchmark for Agentic Knowledge Engineering
authors: Minye Shao, Chenghao Xiao, Xingyue Zhao, Yang Long
abstract: Foundation-model agents are increasingly extending beyond software engineering (SWE) into autonomous scientific research, where acquiring and integrating domain knowledge remains a critical challenge. Recent industrial advances have increasingly adopted knowledge graphs and ontology-based semantic layers to organize heterogeneous knowledge into reusable representations. We ask: Can autonomous agents construct ontologies that help them solve real tasks, and do they offer measurable benefits over alternative knowledge representations? Existing benchmarks evaluate ontology correctness or agent task success in isolation, leaving the value of autonomously acquired knowledge unresolved. We therefore introduce AutoOntologyBench, a task-grounded benchmark comprising 19,947 audited tasks grounded in 18 real-world knowledge sources across 7 domains, with source-native verification. Spanning Application, Repair, Organization, and Construction, AutoOntologyBench compares nine frontier-model agents under matched knowledge representations. Layered on retrieval, agent-built ontologies add 6.1 points of task success, yet trail an expert-derived reference by 13.0, identifying autonomous knowledge acquisition as the bottleneck to scalable scientific research. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/VinyehShaw/AutoOntologyBench.
zh_title: AutoOntologyBench：面向智能体知识工程的任务驱动基准
translation: 基础模型智能体正日益从软件工程（SWE）扩展到自主科学研究，获取和整合领域知识仍然是一个关键挑战。最近的工业进展越来越多地采用知识图谱和基于本体的语义层来将异构知识组织成可重用的表示。我们提出了一个问题：自主智能体能否构建有助于解决实际任务的本体，与替代知识表示相比，它们是否具有可衡量的优势？现有的基准测试孤立地评估本体的正确性或智能体的任务成功率，使得自主获取知识的价值未得到解决。因此，我们推出了 AutoOntologyBench，这是一个以任务为基础的基准测试，包含 19,947 个经过审计的任务，这些任务以 7 个领域的 18 个真实世界知识源为基础，并具有源生验证。跨越应用、修复、组织和构建四个维度，AutoOntologyBench 在匹配的知识表示下比较了九个前沿模型智能体。在检索的基础之上，智能体构建的本体使任务成功率增加了 6.1 个百分点，但仍比专家推导的参考标准落后 13.0 个百分点，这表明自主知识获取是可扩展科学研究的瓶颈。代码和资源可在 https://github.com/VinyehShaw/AutoOntologyBench 获取。
tldr: 本文提出了AutoOntologyBench，用于评估智能体自主构建本体并解决实际任务的能力，发现智能体构建的本体能有效提升任务成功率，但与专家水平相比仍存在明显差距。
ai_comments: 该论文填补了评估智能体自主构建本体并解决实际任务能力的空白，通过大规模基准测试揭示了当前前沿智能体在自主知识获取方面的瓶颈，具有较高的科学研究和工业应用价值。
motivation: 现有的基准测试孤立地评估本体正确性或智能体任务成功率，未能解答自主获取的知识是否具有实际价值，因此需要一个任务驱动的基准来评估智能体构建本体的能力及其对解决实际任务的益处。
method: 引入了AutoOntologyBench基准，包含19,947个经过审计的任务，基于7个领域的18个真实知识源和源生验证，评估了9个前沿模型智能体在应用、修复、组织和构建四类任务上的表现。
results: 在检索基础之上，智能体构建的本体使任务成功率提高了6.1个百分点，但仍比专家导向的参考标准落后13.0个百分点。
conclusion: 智能体构建的本体虽然能提升任务成功率，但与专家构建的本体仍有差距，凸显了自主知识获取是扩展科学研究的关键瓶颈。

title: Average-Depth Variable Execution via Request-Local Token Routing
authors: Pengjie Zheng, Mengwei Xie, Huan Yang, Si Wu, Pengfei Hu, Feng Li
abstract: Layer skipping can reduce large language model inference costs, but a request budget does not specify how to allocate layer execution across generated tokens. We introduce \method{}, which allows tokens to execute different numbers of layers while matching each request's mean executed depth to a continuous budget. At each routed layer, a router reads the current token state and its request's budget and decides whether to execute the Transformer block. Tokens that skip the block pass through a lightweight residual adapter and write no key/value (K/V) entry at that layer. A single checkpoint serves requests with different budgets in the same batch. Across three LLaMA backbones, six quality metrics, and 13 budgets, AVERT is best or tied for best in 206 of 234 comparisons. Across single- and mixed-budget batches, the mean absolute per-request budget error is at most 1.15 percentage points. When grouping requests by budget leaves batches underfilled, mixing budgets reduces decode time per output token (TPOT) by 4.3--21.2%.
zh_title: 通过请求级Token路由实现的平均深度可变执行
translation: 层跳过可以降低大语言模型（LLM）的推理成本，但请求预算并未指明如何在生成的Token之间分配层执行。我们引入了AVERT，它允许Token执行不同数量的层，同时将每个请求的平均执行深度匹配到一个连续的预算。在每个被路由的层，路由器读取当前的Token状态与其请求的预算，并决定是否执行Transformer块。跳过该块的Token通过一个轻量级的残差适配器，并且在该层不写入键/值（K/V）条目。单一检查点即可在同一批次中服务具有不同预算的请求。在三个LLaMA骨干网络、六个质量指标和13种预算的跨度下，AVERT在234次比较中有206次表现最优或并列最优。在单预算和混合预算批次中，每请求预算的平均绝对误差至多为1.15个百分点。当按预算分组请求导致批次未填满时，混合预算可将每个输出Token的解码时间（TPOT）减少4.3%至21.2%。
tldr: 提出了一种名为AVERT的Token路由方法，允许大语言模型在推理时动态跳过层以精确匹配预算，显著提升了混合预算批次的解码速度。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的平均深度可变执行方法AVERT，通过请求级Token路由实现了大语言模型推理中细粒度且精确的层数预算控制，不仅性能优异，还显著提升了混合预算批处理的推理吞吐和解码速度，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的层跳过技术虽然能降低大语言模型推理成本，但请求预算未能指定如何在生成的Token之间分配层执行，缺乏对连续预算的精确匹配和灵活性。
method: 引入AVERT方法，在每个路由层由一个路由器根据当前Token状态和请求预算决定是否执行Transformer块，跳过该块的Token通过轻量级残差适配器且不写入K/V条目，并支持在同一批次中服务不同预算的请求。
results: 在三个LLaMA骨干网络、六个质量指标和13个预算的234次比较中，AVERT在206次中达到或并列最佳；单预算和混合预算批次中的平均每请求预算绝对误差至多为1.15个百分点；混合预算将每个输出Token的解码时间（TPOT）减少了4.3--21.2%。
conclusion: AVERT通过请求级Token路由有效解决了大语言模型推理中的动态层跳过和预算分配问题，在保证生成质量的同时显著减少了解码延迟。

title: Hardness of algorithmic Kadison-Singer problem from approximate hypergraph colouring
authors: Danny Vagnozzi
abstract:
In 2015, Marcus, Spielman and Srivastava published a solution of a strong form of a conjecture by Weaver implying a positive answer to the Kadison-Singer problem - an open question of interest to several fields of pure and applied mathematics. Specifically, they proved that for all $α>0$ and finite lists of vectors whose Euclidean norm is at most $\sqrtα$ and whose outer products sum to the identity matrix, there exists a signed sum of these outer products whose operator norm is at most $\sqrt{8α}+2α$. Since then, significant effort has been put into understanding the algorithmic side of the Kadison-Singer problem; that is, the task of actually finding a signing resulting in a matrix with operator norm at most $c\sqrtα$ for some fixed constant $c$. The first hardness results for this problem were proven independently by Spielman and Zhang [APPROX'22] and by Jourdan, Macgregor and Sun [ISAAC'23].
  In this short note, we prove that there exist values of $c$ arbitrarily close to $1$ such that it is NP-hard to distinguish indexed families of vectors for which there is a signed sum with operator norm equal to $0$ from those for which every signed sum has operator norm at least $c\sqrtα$. This improves on the previous best bound by Spielman and Zhang. Our proof borrows significant ideas from the above mentioned hardness results, by adapting them to a reduction from the problem of approximating hypergraph colouring in the sense of promise constraint satisfaction problems.
zh_title: 基于近似超图着色的算法Kadison-Singer问题难解性
translation:
2015年，Marcus、Spielman和Srivastava发表了对Weaver猜想强形式的解答，从而肯定地回答了Kadison-Singer问题——这是一个纯数学和应用数学中几个领域都感兴趣的公开问题。具体而言，他们证明了对于所有的 $\alpha>0$ 以及欧几里得范数至多为 $\sqrt{\alpha}$ 且其外积之和为单位矩阵的有限向量列表，存在这些外积的一个符号和，其算子范数至多为 $\sqrt{8\alpha}+2\alpha$。自那时起，人们投入了大量精力来理解Kadison-Singer问题的算法方面；也就是说，实际寻找一个符号分配的任务，该分配产生一个算子范数至多为 $c\sqrt{\alpha}$（对于某个固定常数 $c$）的矩阵。该问题的首批难解性结果由 Spielman 和 Zhang [APPROX'22] 以及 Jourdan、Macgregor 和 Sun [ISAAC'23] 分别独立证明。
在本短文中，我们证明了存在任意接近 1 的常数 $c$，使得区分以下两类带索引的向量族是 NP 难的：一类存在算子范数等于 0 的符号和，另一类每个符号和的算子范数都至少为 $c\sqrt{\alpha}$。这改进了 Spielman 和 Zhang 先前的最佳界。我们的证明借鉴了上述难解性结果的重要思想，通过将其改造成从承诺约束满足问题意义下的近似超图着色问题的归约。
tldr: 本文证明了算法Kadison-Singer问题中寻找特定算子范数符号和的任务是NP难的，并将难解性常数提升至接近1。
ai_comments: 该论文在算法Kadison-Singer问题的难解性研究上取得了重要进展，通过将证明归约到近似超图着色问题（PCSP），将算子范数常数的下界提升至任意接近1，深化了理论计算机科学对该数学难题计算复杂度的理解。
motivation: 为了理解算法Kadison-Singer问题的计算复杂度和难解性，特别是改善和推导关于寻找特定算子范数符号和的NP难度的新下界。
method: 通过将算法Kadison-Singer问题的求解归约到近似超图着色问题（以promise constraint satisfaction problems的形式），借用了先前难解性结果的核心思想并进行了改进。
results: 证明了存在任意接近1的常数 $c$，使得区分存在算子范数为0的符号和与所有符号和算子范数至少为 $c\sqrt{\alpha}$ 的向量族是NP难的，改进了Spielman和Zhang先前的工作。
conclusion: 证明了寻找满足特定算子范数界的Kadison-Singer符号和是NP难的，且常数 $c$ 可以任意接近1，显著改进了此前的最好结果。

title: Pre-Crawl Prioritization and Seed Classification for Large-Scale Web Archiving
authors: Akshith Garapati, Sawood Alam
abstract: Pre-crawl prioritization systems decide which pages to fetch first before indexing, aiming to improve crawl efficiency and coverage. Existing approaches based on page popularity and relevance are unsuited to web-archival crawlers that prioritize comprehensive coverage over selective retrieval. We explore prioritization techniques tailored to web archival operations using URL lexical analysis, dynamic domain reputation systems, and HTTP response analysis to inform crawl scheduling decisions. By incorporating predictive models that estimate content change and disappearance probabilities, we improve crawl completeness while reducing redundant visits to stable resources. Through large-scale experiments, we demonstrate that our methods improve archival effectiveness and resource utilization compared to undirected crawling.
comment: 4 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Published in the 2025 ACM/IEEE Joint Conference on Digital Libraries (JCDL)

title: Iteration-Dependent Temporal Resilience in Diffusion Models for Approximate Computing
authors: Ori Schweitzer, Uri Weiser, Freddy Gabbay
abstract: This paper empirically analyzes iteration-dependent resilience in diffusion models by replacing MACs with efficient SAC approximations. Results on Q-Diffusion show early steps are highly sensitive while later steps are robust, enabling iteration- aware approximation that improves efficiency and reduces hardware cost with minimal quality loss.

title: Shared Understanding in Human-AI Teams: Coordination Continuity in Evolving Work
authors: Siân Lindley, Britta Burlin, Christian Poelitz, Lev Tankelevitch, Richard Banks
abstract: People are increasingly working with AI agents as part of extended, asynchronous workflows. In these settings, shared access to information does not guarantee a shared basis for action: goals, plans, and roles may persist while their current significance changes. We introduce coordination continuity, the extent to which collaborators sustain a workable basis for interdependent action as work progresses. Drawing on research on collaborative work, along with two qualitative team studies and a reflexive case from our own repository-based environment, we present a framework of three elements: durable representations of collaborative work; relative coordination properties that support interpretation of representations in the moment; and interaction mechanisms through which the status of representations can be understood and altered. We use a build-act-drift-rebuild heuristic and the notion of consequential moments to characterise when rebuilding may be needed. We draw eight design implications for collaborative AI infrastructure.

title: RoSci: Exploring Robustness in Science VLMs
authors: Junying Wang, Yijin Guo, Yalun Wu, Ziheng Jiao, Farong Wen, Qihang Yan, Wenzhe Li, Ye Shen, Qi Jia, Chunyi Li, Zicheng Zhang, Guangtao Zhai
abstract: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable significant progress in scientific tasks. However, these models are generally assumed to be presented with complete and accurate information, overlooking the challenges of erroneous/missing information in wild scenarios. To address this gap, we introduce the concept of Scientific Model Robustness, which defines a model's ability to detect anomalies, assess solvability, and perform self-calibration when faced with Information Error (inconsistencies) or Information Loss (insufficiency). Specifically, we present RoSci-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,220 samples using a seed-variant strategy across six degradation types. To address VLM fragility, we further propose RoSci-Agent, a framework that employs a Parse-Verify-Decide pipeline to vet premises before reasoning. The evaluated VLMs sometimes answer questions whose premises are invalid or incomplete. RoSci-Agent achieves a higher Overall Robustness Score than the evaluated standalone VLMs. RoSci-Bench gives the multimodal reasoning community a common test of when models answer, request clarification, or reject a scientific question.

title: Can Vision-Language Models Synthesize Executable Game-Playing Programs?
authors: Yao Tong, Jiaxin Qi, Dingyu Zhang, Jianqiang Huang
abstract: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have endowed multimodal agents with increasingly strong visual perception and long-horizon reasoning capabilities, making VLM-based autonomous game playing feasible. Existing game benchmarks primarily evaluate whether an agent can select appropriate actions from the current visual state across different scenarios and games. However, most of them adopt a step-by-step interaction paradigm where the current visual observation is sent to the agent before each action. In practical deployment, this paradigm introduces two fundamental limitations: the game loop must wait for model inference, making real-time interaction impractical, and repeated VLM calls incur substantial cost. Therefore, we propose PlayScriptBench, a script-based game benchmark that evaluates whether VLMs can synthesize an executable game-playing program from game states. This setting jointly evaluates visual grounding, understanding of game dynamics, long-horizon strategic reasoning, and executable program synthesis, providing a more comprehensive assessment of game-playing agents. To support more tractable evaluation for current general-purpose VLMs, we further introduce a four-stage pipeline --- Explore, Perception, API Construction, and Strategy Composition --- that decomposes controller synthesis into game exploration, state perception, interface construction, and strategic control, enabling agents to progressively construct an executable program. Experiments on 16 games spanning 4 genres show that even strong VLMs struggle on our benchmark, revealing a substantial gap between passive visual game understanding and executable closed-loop game control. These results establish script-based controller synthesis as a complementary direction for benchmarking VLM-based game-playing agents.
comment: 21 pages (main paper with appendix), 3 figures, 13 tables. Yao Tong and Jiaxin Qi contributed equally to this work
zh_title: 视觉语言模型能合成可执行的游戏程序吗？
translation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的最新进展赋予了多模态智能体日益强大的视觉感知和长视野推理能力，使得基于VLM的自主游戏游玩成为可能。现有的游戏基准主要评估智能体是否能在不同场景和游戏中从当前视觉状态选择合适的动作。然而，大多数基准采用逐步交互范式，在每次动作之前将当前视觉观察发送给智能体。在实际部署中，这种范式引入了两个根本性限制：游戏循环必须等待模型推理，使得实时交互变得不切实际，并且频繁的VLM调用会带来巨大的成本。因此，我们提出了PlayScriptBench，这是一个基于脚本的游戏基准，用于评估VLM是否能够从游戏状态合成可执行的游戏游玩程序。该设置共同评估了视觉基础（visual grounding）、游戏动态理解、长视野战略推理以及可执行程序合成，从而对游戏智能体进行了更全面的评估。为了支持当前通用VLM更易处理的评估，我们进一步引入了一个四阶段流水线——探索、感知、API构建和策略组合——将控制器合成分解为游戏探索、状态感知、接口构建和战略控制，使智能体能够逐步构建可执行程序。在跨越4种流派的16款游戏上的实验表明，即使是强大的VLM在我们的基准上也举步维艰，这揭示了被动视觉游戏理解与可执行闭环游戏控制之间存在巨大差距。这些结果确立了基于脚本的控制器合成作为评估基于VLM的游戏智能体的互补方向。
tldr: 论文提出了PlayScriptBench基准测试，评估视觉语言模型直接合成可执行游戏程序的能力，揭示了当前模型在闭环控制与程序合成上的性能差距。
ai_comments: 该论文指出了现有视觉语言模型在游戏智能体评测中的痛点，即传统的逐步交互范式存在高延迟和高成本问题。通过提出PlayScriptBench基准和四阶段流水线，将游戏控制器的合成任务推向了更具挑战性和实用价值的可执行程序合成方向，揭示了当前模型在视觉理解与闭环控制之间的巨大差距。
motivation: 现有的逐步交互范式存在游戏循环等待模型推理导致实时交互不切实际以及频繁调用视觉语言模型成本高昂的根本限制，因此需要评估视觉语言模型是否能够直接从游戏状态合成可执行的游戏游玩程序。
method: 提出了PlayScriptBench（一个脚本式游戏基准），并设计了一个包含探索、感知、API构建和策略组成四个阶段的流水线，将控制器合成进行解耦以支持通用视觉语言模型的评测。
results: 在跨越4个流派的16款游戏上的实验表明，即使是强大的视觉语言模型在这个基准上也表现挣扎，揭示了被动视觉游戏理解与可执行闭环游戏控制之间的巨大差距。
conclusion: 当前强大的视觉语言模型在脚本式游戏控制器合成任务中仍然表现不佳，被动视觉游戏理解与可执行闭环游戏控制之间存在显著差距，PlayScriptBench为该领域提供了一个富有价值的评测基准。

title: Post-Quantum Migration in Brownfield 5G Core Networks: Verified Hybrid Key Establishment, Performance, and Rollback
authors: Shubham Verma
abstract: Migrating brownfield 5G Core networks to post-quantum cryptography (PQC) is difficult because deployed network functions, base images, and TLS libraries evolve under different upgrade constraints. This paper evaluates a deployment-controlled migration strategy that enables hybrid post-quantum/traditional key establishment through externally deployed Boundary Cryptographic Execution Entities (BCEEs), without modifying participating network function source code. The approach is evaluated using the Open5GS AMF-NRF Service-Based Interface as a representative 5G Core scenario. Classical and hybrid configurations are compared under an unchanged mediation topology. Packet-level analysis confirms successful negotiation of X25519MLKEM768, and functional validation demonstrates that representative SBI procedures remain operational through the mediated path. In 120 NF-registration transactions, the median AMF-facing registration latency increased from 22.968 ms under the classical state to 26.351 ms under the hybrid state, reflecting a 3.383 ms (14.73 percent) increase, with a whole-block 95 percent confidence interval of [1.193, 7.872] ms. At the mediated TLS boundary, the hybrid configuration shows a 4.599 ms higher median segment-local TLS-establishment time than the classical configuration. These two reported differences reflect system-level runtime effects and do not isolate key-encapsulation cost. Packet evidence verifies rollback from hybrid-mediated operation to classical mediated operation and, separately, restoration of the native direct path. NF-facing compatibility legs remained plaintext and outside the hybrid post-quantum scope. The results demonstrate a packet-verifiable and manually reversible brownfield mechanism for introducing hybrid post-quantum key establishment on a controlled 5G SBI segment.

zh_title: 存量5G核心网中的后量子迁移：经过验证的混合密钥协商、性能与回滚
translation: 将现有的5G核心网迁移到后量子密码学（PQC）是困难的，因为已部署的网络功能、基础镜像和TLS库在不同的升级限制下演进。本文评估了一种部署受控的迁移策略，该策略通过外部部署的边界密码执行实体（BCEEs）启用混合后量子/传统密钥协商，且无需修改参与网络功能的源代码。该方法以Open5GS AMF-NRF服务化接口（SBI）作为代表性的5G核心网场景进行了评估。在不变的中介拓扑下比较了经典配置和混合配置。数据包级分析证实成功协商了X25519MLKEM768，功能验证表明具有代表性的SBI程序通过中介路径保持可操作性。在120次NF注册事务中，面向AMF的中位注册延迟从经典状态下的22.968毫秒增加到混合状态下的26.351毫秒，增加了3.383毫秒（14.73%），全块95%置信区间为[1.193, 7.872]毫秒。在受控的TLS边界处，混合配置的中位分段局部TLS建立时间比经典配置高4.599毫秒。这两个报告的差异反映了系统级运行时的影响，并未隔离密钥封装成本。数据包证据验证了从混合中继操作到经典中继操作的回滚，以及分别恢复原生直接路径。面向NF的兼容性链路保持明文且在混合后量子范围之外。结果证明了一种在受控5G SBI段上引入混合后量子密钥协商的、可数据包验证且可手动反转的存量机制。
tldr: 提出了一种无需修改源码即可将存量5G核心网平滑迁移至后量子密码学的外部边界代理方案，并通过Open5GS验证了其可行性、微小的延迟增加以及回滚能力。
ai_comments: 该论文针对存量（Brownfield）5G核心网向后量子密码（PQC）迁移的难题，提出了一种无需修改网络功能源码的外部边界密码执行实体（BCEEs）方案。该方法创新性地通过控制部署策略实现了混合密钥协商，并在Open5GS平台上进行了详尽的性能和回滚验证，具有很高的工程实用价值。
motivation: 由于已部署的网络功能、基础镜像和TLS库在不同的升级限制下演进，将现有的（存量）5G核心网迁移到后量子密码学（PQC）非常困难，因此需要一种无需修改网络功能源码的平滑迁移策略。
method: 提出了一种部署控制的迁移策略，利用外部部署的边界密码执行实体（BCEEs）来实现混合后量子/传统密钥协商，无需修改网络功能源码；以Open5GS AMF-NRF服务化接口（SBI）为场景进行评估，并对经典与混合配置进行抓包分析和性能基准测试。
results: 在120次NF注册事务中，混合状态下的中位AMF侧注册延迟比经典状态增加了3.383毫秒（14.73%），中继TLS边界处的TLS建立时间增加了4.599毫秒；同时通过了数据包验证，证明了从混合中继操作到经典中继操作的回滚以及恢复原生直接路径的可行性。
conclusion: 论文证明了通过外部BCEEs在存量5G核心网中引入混合后量子密钥协商是可行且包机制可验证的，虽然会带来微小的延迟开销（约14.73%的注册延迟增加），但能够保证平滑迁移和安全回滚。

title: SUPERVISE: A Unified Framework for Standardized and Reproducible Superpixel Evaluation
authors: Julien Walther, Rémi Giraud, Michaël Clément
abstract: Image segmentation into superpixels is a widely used technique in computer vision, with a large body of work developed over the years. Yet, its evaluation remains poorly standardized, as methods are compared under heterogeneous protocols, across inconsistent scale ranges, and with redundant or misaligned metric subsets. In this work, we introduce SUPERVISE (SUperpixel PERformance VISualization and Evaluation), a unified and reproducible benchmark that addresses these longstanding inconsistencies. Built on a scale-normalized protocol based on interpolation over the actual number of generated superpixels, SUPERVISE enables fair and consistent cross-method comparisons. We leverage this standardized framework to conduct the first large-scale statistical analysis of 20 evaluation metrics across 7 datasets and 31 methods, revealing strong inter-metric correlations and significant redundancy that challenge common evaluation practices. These findings provide empirical support for reporting a compact set of representative metrics. SUPERVISE is released as a lightweight, modular framework built on precomputed shared label maps, making large-scale reproducible evaluation accessible to the community. All code, label maps, and evaluation results are publicly available at: https://github.com/waldo-j/supervise

title: Eliminating Make-Whole Uplifts with a Minimum-Cost Uniform Price Adder
authors: Valentina Norambuena-Guzman, Cong Chen, Lang Tong, Timothy D. Mount
abstract: Co-optimizing energy and flexible ramping reserves may dispatch generators at locational marginal prices (LMPs) below their submitted energy offer prices, necessitating out-of-market make-whole payments. Such payments create discriminatory settlements among generators and may incentivize strategic bidding for higher profits. This paper proposes LMP+U, an in-market uniform price adder to LMP for transmission-constrained networks, which minimizes demand payments subject to zero out-of-market make-whole uplift, preserves LMP-based congestion charges, and provides locally truthful bidding incentives for price-taking generators. We also identify conditions under which a price-taking generator can increase its profit by inflating its energy offer under conventional LMP with make-whole uplift. Numerical simulations illustrate the properties of LMP+U and its advantages over conventional LMP in congested networks.

title: Ref-YOLO-World: Decoupling Text-Side Computation for Efficient Referring Expression Comprehension on Edge Devices
authors: Yuki Aoki, Hiroo Bekku, Tadashi Okoshi, Jin Nakazawa
abstract: Many high-accuracy referring expression comprehension (REC) methods produce image-dependent multimodal representations. These representations must be recomputed for every video frame, even when the referring expression remains unchanged. Fast open-vocabulary detectors such as YOLO-World instead pre-encode text once and reuse it throughout the stream. However, encoding each referring expression as a single embedding prevents explicit token-level correspondence. We propose Ref-YOLO-World, which separates text-side computation that depends only on the referring expression from image processing and reuses its outputs across frames. Two lightweight modules inject cached per-token text features into YOLO-World's detection path. Ref-YOLO-World achieves 81.29% Acc@0.5 on RefCOCOg val, the highest among REC models with a decoupled text branch, and consistently outperforms a fine-tuned YOLO-World. Precomputation reduces per-image inference time by 18.5%, yielding 47.0 FPS. A Core ML version runs at 15.73 FPS on an iPhone 15 Pro, demonstrating efficient on-device REC. Code is available at https://github.com/sakusaku3939/Ref-YOLO-World.

title: DPMA: Learning to Compress Mixture-of-Experts Models
authors: Jon Irureta, Jon Imaz, Philipp Wiesner, Gorka Azkune, Javier Fernandez-Marques, Alex Iacob, Andrej Jovanović, Aizea Lojo, Nicholas D. Lane
abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures offer high computational efficiency, but storing all experts requires substantial memory and limits deployment on resource-constrained hardware. Most retraining-free MoE compression methods commit to either pruning or merging experts, often with a uniform compression ratio across layers. We introduce DPMA (Differentiable Prune Merge Absorb), which jointly learns compression operations and layer-wise expert allocation through gradient descent under a global expert budget. Separate learnable coefficients allow DPMA to prune experts, merge their parameters, and absorb their routing contributions by forwarding routing weights to retained experts. These coefficients and expert assignments are optimised to match the original model's outputs on calibration data while its weights remain frozen. Across four MoE models, eight multiple-choice benchmarks, and five compression ratios, DPMA achieves the highest accuracy averaged over benchmarks and compression ratios on each model among the evaluated methods. At $75\%$ expert reduction, it outperforms the strongest baseline on every model, with gains of up to $6.7$ percentage points.

title: Enhancing Attention with Higher-Order Attention
authors: R. I. Cukier
abstract: Current decoder large language models rely on a combination of attention, feed forward and residual layers. The attention used is autoregressive (AR) though this is not strictly correct, as we note. That motivates the introduction of other attention methods that, while also not strictly AR, do enhance the AR character. One is based on a decomposition of mutual information (MI) into a set of Conditional MIs (CMIs) that correlate key tokens with pairs of query tokens. A second, higher-order attention, introduces correlations between contiguous key and query tokens. A third introduces correlations between a set of key and query tokens and uses a Generalized Maximum Entropy Principle to obtain an attention expression spanning a sequence of tokens. All these methods may enhance the information content of the autoregressive probabilities that are used in inference/generation. Applications to contrastive decoding and a systematic analysis of autoregressive probabilities are presented.

title: Weave: Routing-Adaptive Runtime Warp Scheduling for MoE Megakernels
authors: Ziyu Huang, Yangjie Zhou, Chenhao Zhu, Hongzhe Yan, Tianwei Qiao, Sicheng He, Zihan Liu, Peng Yu, Shulai Zhang, Xingxun Tang, Xinhao Luo, Minyi Guo, Xiu Lin, Yinghao Yu, Guodong Yang, Liping Zhang, Shixuan Sun, Qingyun Chen, Jingwen Leng
abstract: The Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture is widely used in mainstream large language models. Under expert parallelism (EP), state-of-the-art systems fuse each MoE layer into a persistent megakernel for high performance. By the nature of EP, each GPU's communication and computation volumes vary with the routing result. However, prior work either fixes how GPU resources are divided between communication and computation at compile time (e.g., MegaMoE), or adapts to runtime dynamism only at coarse-grained SM granularity (e.g., mKernel), dedicating whole SMs to communication and leaving their Tensor Cores idle. At the finer warp granularity within each SM, static warp schedules can neither match routing-dependent loads nor prevent warps from idling while waiting for inputs or after finishing their assigned work. Therefore, we propose Weave, an MoE megakernel with three key designs. First, a spatial schedule allocates resources between communication and computation at both SM and warp granularities to match each GPU's load. Second, a temporal schedule switches warp roles as execution progresses, enlisting all warps at the start and end of a layer and selectively handing output scatter to idle communication warps. Third, a fused cost model jointly selects both schedules per GPU at launch from runtime routing statistics. Across all evaluated platforms, Weave outperforms the strongest baselines: under EP8 over DeepGEMM-MegaMoE, it speeds up the MoE layer by 1.30x geomean and up to 1.97x on SM103, and by 1.24x geomean and up to 1.72x on SM90; under EP16 on CDNA3, it beats the fastest official RCCL+AITER baseline by 1.44x geomean (up to 2.87x; 1.67x over vLLM).

title: QuASAR: Toward an LLM-Assisted Framework for Screening, Prototyping, and Assessing Quantum-Advantage Opportunities in Scientific Computing
authors: Mark L. Carroll, Jordan A. Caraballo-Vega, Brian P. Powell, John L. Schnase
abstract: Identifying scientific computations that could benefit from quantum algorithms requires both domain knowledge and fluency in quantum algorithm design, expertise that rarely resides in one person. We report results from QuASAR, an experimental, two-agent, LLM-driven pipeline intended to bridge this gap. One agent screens scientific literature for computational kernels with a plausible quantum-algorithmic analogue and proposes candidates, each backed by citations. A second agent independently verifies those citations. For candidates that survive verification, it reconstructs the source's computational structure, formulates a quantum mapping, builds and executes a prototype, and benchmarks it against classical baselines. We applied this pipeline to ten candidate computations drawn from the astrophysics literature. Nine candidates were carried through to a small-scale, benchmarked prototype. We report three in detail, chosen as the clearest examples with the least redundancy across the set. They span combinatorial optimization, stochastic simulation, and Bayesian inference. The pipeline attempted to supply quantum-design expertise a domain scientist might lack, reconstructing source algorithms where one existed and building original, disclosed mappings where none did. None of the three case studies achieved quantum advantage at the tested scales, and their astrophysical framing has not yet undergone expert validation. What the experiment does show is that the pipeline can turn a published idea into a runnable prototype, which a scientist can then inspect, test against classical methods, and decide whether to pursue. QuASAR is an exploratory framework, offered to the community for evaluation, critique, and further development, with an approach that could broaden the use of quantum computing in scientific research and extend to computational improvements more generally.

title: Search-RSI: Expanding Search Worlds Along Multimodal Agents' Capability Frontier
authors: Chengchao Lv, Yin Wang, Chunzheng Zhu, Wanli Chang
abstract: Multimodal search agents answer knowledge intensive visual questions by grounding them in retrieved evidence, and recent recipes train them on multi hop tasks that are synthesized from knowledge graphs and grown online to keep pace with the agent. These recipes, however, treat the searchable world as fixed: a new question can be well formed and verifiable while its evidence is absent from the retrieval backend, so the agent issues the right query, retrieves nothing, and is penalized as if its policy were at fault. Such unreachable negatives accumulate with every round of growth. We propose Search-RSI, a recursive self improvement framework that expands the search world along the agent's capability frontier. In each round, the current policy diagnoses its partially mastered regions of a task space spanned by hop depth, relation rarity, and distractor density; new tasks there are grown together with their evidence; and the same policy decides how they are used: candidates on which its probes disagree feed reinforcement learning, while those beyond its reach become hint guided demonstrations of its own. Keeping the policy inside this loop matters: an improver frozen at the start of training loses 3.2 points. On nine multimodal search benchmarks, Search-RSI keeps improving where static task growth saturates, raising the average accuracy of the recipe it builds on by 9.8 and 9.5 points at 9B and 27B, of which 7.0 points are out of reach for a world that is merely made consistent. The loop uses no external model and only privileged task structure that is removed before training, at 1.27x the compute of static growth.

title: From Novel Combinations to Informative Absence: Structural permission, communicative opportunity, and form choice in language learning
authors: Yanzhe Zhao
abstract: Language learners must infer which novel expressions are grammatically licensed and when continued absence is evidence against them. Our generative theory unites these capacities via counterfactual expression opportunities, decomposing utterance generation into structural permission, communicative opportunity, and form choice. First, shared predictive continuations recover structural permission for unseen word-construction pairings across 30 artificial grammars (mean AUC 0.945 after 120 sentences). Second, under hierarchical uncertainty, we derive a joint evidence law linking omissions to context diversity and within-context repetition, and an exact finite-sample context-refinement inequality. Thus, observing related expressions calibrates expected use to sharpen negative evidence, and higher expected use can drive steeper posterior declines for stronger-permission candidates (reversing initial order after six omissions in a fixed-rate example). Third, we prove that while raw counts confound semantic availability and form selection, scene-level opportunity observations identify both. Empirically, reanalyzing adult and child artificial-language experiments shows meaning-conditioned restriction; judgments of restricted combinations improve held-out production predictions across 399 participants (+0.036 nats/production). Naturalistic child-directed and child speech (11 families, six corpora) shows pervasive source-level usage clustering beyond lexical, number, and dependency-role controls, grounding hierarchical rate uncertainty. Finally, modeling causative judgments across five languages shows that structural compatibility and calibrated usage probabilities draw on distinct distributional, semantic, and discriminative cues. Together, these findings show how the organization and calibration of communicative opportunities govern the evidential value of linguistic absence.

title: An Autonomous Adaptive Learning System for Robotic Grasping in the Circular Factory
authors: Yitian Shi, Rosa Wolf, Rania Rayyes
abstract: Linear manufacturing typically operates in highly structured settings with standardized objects, allowing robots to execute pre-programmed motions based on precise models. In contrast, circular manufacturing involves dynamic and less controlled environments, where product components can vary due to appearance and physical changes across different product generations. In this context, uncertainty arises from both the unknown or partially observed states of components (e.g., damaged surfaces, altered shapes) and the unstructured disassembly environment, often characterized by heavy clutter, occlusions, and limited sensing viewpoints. This demands a flexible and adaptable robotic grasping system that can cope with unexpected object changes. To address these challenges, this paper proposes an autonomous grasp learning framework designed for highly uncertain and variable conditions. The framework explicitly distinguishes between uncertainty due to noisy or incomplete sensory observations (aleatoric uncertainty) and uncertainty due to limited knowledge and distribution shift (epistemic uncertainty). Moreover, the framework employs an active perception strategy to reduce visual ambiguity: semantic and spatial scene understanding is achieved using vision language models (VLMs), while view planning enables the robot to adjust its viewpoint to improve observability. In addition, the approach leverages large-scale human demonstration data to learn interaction patterns, which are then transferred to robotic end-effectors, enabling robust manipulation in these variable settings. Quantitative validation, including the utility of active vision on disassembled components in practice, is expected to form an important part of future work.

title: $L^1$ stability of the entropy power inequality in $\mathbb{R}^d$ without moment assumptions
authors: Norman El Fartass, Lampros Gavalakis, Ioannis Kontoyiannis
abstract: We establish qualitative stability in $L^1$ and Ruzsa distance for Shannon's entropy power inequality in $\mathbb{R}^d$, without any moment assumptions. The proof uses the optimal transport argument by Rioul (2017), majorization bounds of density rearrangements, and the stability of the sharp form of Young's inequality due to Christ (2019). Along the way we also extend recent one-dimensional results on de Bruijn's identity, the continuity of differential entropy, and the equality case of the entropy power inequality to random vectors of any dimension.

title: Neural Defend ARCAS 290M: A Robust Foundation Model for AI-Generated Audio Detection
authors: Sivashankar Selvarajan, Piyush Verma, Sumit Kumar, Sharayu N. Deshmukh
abstract: Voice cloning now needs only seconds of audio, and detectors tuned to one dataset often fail when the generator, channel, or language changes. We introduce ARCAS 290M, Neural Defend's foundation model for detecting AI-generated audio. A single frozen production model, with no benchmark-specific fine-tuning, generalizes across text-to-speech, voice-conversion, and codec-language-model generators, telephone and Bluetooth channels, recording conditions, and languages. We evaluate it on the complete official test sets of ten public benchmarks, scoring every recording exactly as released, and against commercial systems on independent leaderboards. ARCAS 290M ranks first among all systems on the Podonos leaderboard and has the lowest equal error rate among commercial detectors on ASVspoof5. It separates real from AI-generated speech almost perfectly on ASVspoof5, SpeechFake, and ShiftySpeech, and detects nearly all AI-generated speech in Hindi, Tamil, Bengali, and Telugu. On every benchmark with a published zero-shot comparison, including in-the-wild audio, partial fakes, and the conditions hardest for the field, it surpasses the strongest reported detector by a wide margin. These results establish ARCAS 290M as a general-purpose foundation for AI-generated audio detection in fraud prevention, platform safety, and media verification.

title: When Does Looking Closer Pay Off? Simple Foveated ViTs for Fine-Grained Recognition
authors: Boris Kriuk, Mohamed Sobhy
abstract: Fine-grained recognition benefits from high resolution, but not every image region needs it. We study a foveated Vision Transformer (FoVT) that uses last-block class attention from a 224-pixel glance to select regions for refinement. Fine patches from the 448-pixel image replace the selected coarse cells, and the same backbone classifies the mixed-resolution input. We evaluate FoVT on five benchmarks with two seeds and 26 configurations per dataset. Attention beats random selection on all five benchmarks, by up to 2.45 percentage points overall and 4.18 points on the smallest objects. At equal transformer cost, Holm-corrected tests detect no FoVT deficit relative to a port of the official CF-ViT, but no dataset shows a corrected FoVT advantage in both seeds. FoVT requires no feature reuse, distillation loss, or selection schedule. Reusing coarse features shows no significant benefit and costs 1 to 3 points when the reuse module is trained at the head learning rate. Skipping refinement for the most confident 19 to 24 percent of images leaves accuracy unchanged to two decimal places. At the transformer cost of uniform 336-pixel inference, gated FoVT improves accuracy on four benchmarks, with the largest gains on NABirds and FGVC-Aircraft and no significant gain on Stanford Dogs. Foveation primarily saves computation: relative to a uniform 448-pixel model trained with the same auxiliary glance loss, ungated FoVT uses 44 percent fewer transformer operations, with no significant accuracy difference on four benchmarks and a 0.53-point deficit on FGVC-Aircraft. Wall-clock savings are smaller than the reduction in transformer operations.

title: A Benchmark Protocol and Fairness Analysis Towards Open-Set EEG Seizure Type Classification
authors: Targol Bakhtiarvand, Terrance E. Boult, Jugal Kalita, Adham Atyabi
abstract: Automated EEG seizure type classification systems are typically trained and evaluated under the closed-set assumption, where all seizure types encountered at deployment are seen during training. In clinical practice, this assumption fails: patients present with rare or atypical seizure types that fall outside the training label space, and a system that forces a wrong label is worse than one that abstains. We introduce the first open-set recognition protocol for EEG seizure type classification on the Temple University Hospital Seizure Corpus (TUSZ v2.0.3), defining known and unknown classes using the clinical taxonomy itself: seizure types with sufficient subject representation (at least 12 subjects) form the known set, and rare types form the unknown set. We evaluate seven post-hoc open-set scorers (MSP, MaxLogit, energy, Mahalanobis, kNN, GHOST, and COSTARR) applied to a partially fine-tuned EEG Foundation Model (EFM), using a subject-disjoint leave-one-class-out (LOCO) protocol over three seeds that tests whether methods can detect seizure types excluded from fine-tuning. On true unknown classes, the best scorer (Mahalanobis) reaches a mean AUROC of 0.66, and differences among the top scorers are within seed-to-seed variation. Held-out known seizure types from unseen subjects are detected only slightly above chance (AUROC 0.54-0.58 for all scorers). Per-subject rejection rates are highly uneven for all scorers, and GHOST does not significantly improve per-subject fairness over energy scoring (two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, p >= 0.25). We release the protocol, subject splits, and code as an initial baseline; our results indicate that open-set seizure type recognition remains a hard, open problem.
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027 Workshop. Code and evaluation protocol are publicly available

title: EvoTER: Evolving Embodied Agents via Tool-Use Experience and Reflection
authors: Yingting Zhou, Yuyin Zhou, Yongliang Wang, Haoran Li, Dongbin Zhao
abstract: Long-horizon embodied tasks require agents to ground instructions in changing observations, coordinate heterogeneous tools, and recover from failures that can propagate through downstream operations. Although existing LLM-based agents retain experience and refine reusable skills, successful local repairs do not by themselves establish complete-task gains over the current shared procedure library. We present EvoTER, an experience-driven framework that enables embodied agents to self-evolve tool-use skills without updating model parameters. EvoTER operates through a three-role evolution loop: Explorer records tool-use trajectories; Diagnoser distills successful and failed executions into skills for tool selection, parameter computation, postcondition checks, and recovery; and Validator retains candidate revisions only when they improve complete-task success in fresh sessions. In simulation, EvoTER improves overall task success from a pre-evolution baseline of 53.60% to 80.40%. In real-world experiments, simulation initialization reduces the attempts required to acquire short-horizon skills, while continued real-world evolution improves long-horizon success from 20% to 80%-100% across tasks and enables the evolving skill library to incorporate new tool functionality introduced after simulation development. Project page: https://evoter-project.github.io/

title: ChildAI-Gov: An Evidence-Linked AI System for Assessing EdTech Policies Against Children's Digital Rights
authors: Naveen Sigalapalli, Huizhi Liang, Clara Crivellaro
abstract: We present ChildAI-Gov, an explainable AI system for assessing whether education-technology (EdTech) policies respect children's digital rights. Generative AI is reaching children's education faster than its governance can keep pace, yet checking a tool against children's rights remains manual, expert-dependent, and slow. We propose the Child Rights Impact Score (CRIS), an evidence-linked measure across five dimensions: safety, privacy, transparency, autonomy, and non-discrimination. ChildAI-Gov reads an EdTech tool's privacy or AI policy and scores each dimension by combining a large-language-model judgement (gpt-4o-mini) with a deterministic rule check.
