A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) component grounds every score in the governing provisions, retrieved from a curated knowledge base of children's rights frameworks (the EU AI Act, UNICEF guidance, and others), so each score is tied to the evidence behind it and an auditor can trace which provision it rests on. We also construct AIPolicy-EdTech, a dataset of 57 real EdTech policies. On it, the five dimensions cohered as a single measure (Cronbach's alpha = 0.79), and grounding made scoring stricter while preserving rankings; an ungrounded baseline was far more lenient, passing nearly half the policies where ChildAI-Gov passed none. It offers evidence-linked decision support on documented commitments, not observation of real-world behaviour or determinations of legal compliance.

title: Generalist Action Critic: Harnessing Frontier Models in Autonomous Driving
authors: Yun Yan, Shizhi Hu, Zhichao Li, Yang Guan, Shiqi Liu, Jiaxin Gao, Xiangteng Zhang, Wenbo Ding, Jiuhua Zhao, Hui Guo, Xintao Yan, Keqiang Li, Shengbo Eben Li
abstract: Frontier models have demonstrated remarkable general-purpose reasoning capabilities, opening new possibilities for intelligent decision making in the physical world. In autonomous driving, many recent approaches seek to leverage these capabilities through additional adaptation for action output, particularly in scenarios where existing models underperform. We introduce Generalist Action Critic (GAC), a zero-shot framework that combines frontier models' general-purpose reasoning with the planning competence of specialized driving models through an inference-time harness. In GAC, specialized planners generate multiple candidate trajectories and make an initial selection, while a frozen frontier model serves as an action critic that assesses the selected trajectory against scene evidence and either retains it or reselects from the available candidates. The harness combines camera images with spatial overlays, provides driving context and reasoning principles through textual instructions, and regulates the information available at each stage to support trajectory assessment and reselection. On HUGSIM, GAC raises DrivoR's HD-Score to 43.2, achieving state-of-the-art performance among methods trained without additional simulation data. GAC also consistently improves closed-loop driving safety across three planners, with relative HD-Score gains of up to 32.1%. Experiments on NAVSIM v1 further reveal how GAC improves planning performance by correcting up to 52.13% of eligible unsafe trajectory selections while introducing new failures in only 0.67% of originally high-quality selections. These results demonstrate the potential of harnessing frontier models to improve driving safety through inference-time cooperation with specialized planners.

title: $\varepsilon$-SegFormer: Multi-Resolution Vision Transformers for Sparsely Supervised Segmentation in Electron Microscopy
authors: Erfan Amidi, Sheida RahnamaiKordasiabi, Edoardo Giacomello, Florian Jug
abstract: Segmenting organelles in electron microscopy (EM) volumes requires dense annotations that take experts months to produce, and every gain in imaging resolution adds to this cost. Sparsely supervised methods reduce this cost to a small fraction of labeled pixels, but the convolutional networks they build on see a limited neighborhood around each pixel, while the identity of an organelle often depends on context far beyond it. We introduce $\varepsilon$-SegFormer, a multi-resolution Vision Transformer for sparsely supervised semantic segmentation, which builds on the architecture of MuViT and extends the training method of $\varepsilon$-Seg. For each labeled pixel, $\varepsilon$-SegFormer samples views at three physical resolutions centered on it, embeds their patches into a single token sequence, and encodes every token's position in image coordinates, so that attention relates all views in one shared frame. A segmentation head classifies the pixel from the tokens around it; during training, the pixel's own token is hidden, so the label must be predicted from context rather than local appearance. The model is trained in a single stage, without pretraining, with an auxiliary reconstruction loss. On the BetaSeg FIB-SEM dataset, $\varepsilon$-SegFormer learns from about 10,000 labeled pixels among the 670 million voxels inside three cells, and, given the cell mask, segments nuclei, mitochondria and insulin granules in a slice of a fourth, unseen cell with an average Dice of 0.89 (0.91 after post-processing). Ablations show that coarser views improve accuracy and that a compact head on local tokens works best, with the wider context entering through attention in the encoder.

title: $\mathtt{DistP}$: Scaling Local-Update Training with Zero-Shot Hyperparameter Transfer
authors: Andrej Jovanović, Alex Iacob, Philipp Wiesner, Christophe Roux, Max Zimmer, Lorenzo Sani, Sebastian Pokutta, Nicholas D. Lane
abstract: Local-update methods offer a communication-efficient alternative to Distributed Data Parallelism ($\mathtt{DDP}$), but introduce additional hyperparameters that require costly tuning. For $\mathtt{DDP}$, zero-shot hyperparameter transfer reduces this cost by reusing settings tuned on smaller models, but its applicability to local-update training remains unclear. We propose $\mathtt{DistP}$, a theoretical framework extending existing transfer rules from $\mathtt{DDP}$ to local-update training with varying worker counts, local steps, and outer optimizers. With averaging as the outer optimizer, $\mathtt{DistP}$ supports learning-rate transfer across width and depth while improving model quality. The tuned inner learning rate also directly transfers across synchronization intervals, but follows two regimes when increasing the global batch size: square-root learning-rate scaling for larger local batches and a fixed reference rate for additional workers. We then generalize width and depth transfer to other outer optimizers, enabling stable scaling with $\mathtt{Adam}$. However, with momentum in the outer optimizer, changing batch size or local steps can require inner--outer learning-rate tuning, consistent with prior work. In language-modeling experiments at $823$M parameters, $\mathtt{DistP}$ reduces validation loss by $8.1\%$ and improves mean downstream accuracy by $10\%$ relative to baselines without retuning at the larger scale. Fitted scaling laws suggest that this advantage grows with the compute budget, reinforcing the benefits of $\mathtt{DistP}$ for communication-efficient training.

title: Evaluating Prompting Strategies for Zero-Shot Multilingual Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis with Large Language Models
authors: Jakub Šm{í}d, Pavel Kr{á}l
abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have advanced natural language understanding, their ability to perform complex target-aspect-sentiment detection (TASD) -- a key task within aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) -- in zero-shot multilingual settings remains underexplored. Existing ABSA research predominantly focuses on English or relies on fine-tuned task-specific models, leaving a gap in understanding how open-weight LLMs handle compound sentiment triplet extraction across diverse language families and domains. We present a systematic evaluation of zero-shot multilingual TASD across 12 languages and three domains using seven instruction-tuned open-weight models -- ranging from 8B to 35B parameters across dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures -- under four prompting paradigms: monolithic, chain-of-thought, sequential, and sequential refine. Our results show that direct monolithic prompting achieves strong zero-shot performance, outperforming multi-step pipelines, while dense models consistently outperform sparse MoE architectures. Through fine-grained error taxonomy profiling and step-level pipeline tracking, we demonstrate that initial aspect term recall forms a hard bottleneck, whereas multi-step decomposition degrades extraction quality; iterative refinement only partially recovers this loss on larger models while inducing net-negative over-refinement on smaller architectures. Finally, generation volume analysis shows that multi-step strategies incur up to 2.38x token overhead without F1 gains, establishing monolithic prompting as the most effective and efficient paradigm for multilingual ABSA.
comment: Accepted to the 19th International Conference on Agents and Artificial Intelligence (ICAART 2027)

title: Refrain: Learning Multi-Shot Consistency from Inconsistent References for A$^2$O Video Generation
authors: Hongru Yan, Yue Wu, Jian-Wei Zhang, Liangbin Xie, Mingzhe Zheng, Shenghua Gao
abstract: A comic-book character, a photorealistic cityscape, an oil-painted coffee cup -- such stylistically diverse references provide visual guidance across shots and frames, yet generating a coherent multi-shot video that unifies their visual styles while preserving subject identities and scene content remains challenging. Existing methods maintain cross-shot continuity through additional attention control or memory processing. However, they struggle to resolve disparate per-shot styles or handle reference-target duration mismatches within a single framework. We introduce Refrain, a unified model that learns cross-shot consistency through a self-supervised reconstruction task. Reference clips from the same original video are deliberately perturbed with distinct visual edits, and the model recovers the unedited source footage under a shared style prompt. The resulting pipeline yields DurMix-300K, which pairs independently edited references of varying durations with their original videos. Operating on the A$^2$O principle (Any Reference, Any Duration, One Timeline), Refrain maps image and video references onto a shared temporal canvas without auxiliary conditioning modules. For evaluation, experiments show that standard CLIP or DINO metrics frequently overlook stylistic clashes or misinterpret intended narrative cuts as inconsistency. We propose Shot-Debiased Consistency (SDC), which uses an extensive real-video bank to establish a baseline for style variation associated with content changes within shots. By discounting this baseline divergence, SDC evaluates cross-shot style shifts against real-world distributions, where smaller residual differences indicate higher stylistic continuity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Refrain achieves state-of-the-art performance in cross-shot consistency, while excelling at shot timing, reference adherence, and text alignment.

title: DOiT: Better Money-Flow Ranking Can Coexist with Worse Account Selection in Anti-Money Laundering Review
authors: Gwangui Hong, Seonkyu Lim, Min-Soo Kim
abstract: Anti-money laundering (AML) review selects suspicious accounts and reconstructs transfers. Downstream graph neural networks (GNNs) rank money-flow evidence but may also reorder the account queue. DOiT separates these decisions at equal review capacity: account selection determines where graph investigation starts. Across AMLWorld and AMLNet, GNN reordering harms higher-yield upstream orders but helps lower-yield ones. On AMLWorld, this harm coexists with higher transaction average precision (AP) in dimension-matched, per-run decoders, demonstrating separable ranking abilities. At small capacities, positive neighbors can displace a denser upstream prefix and lower yield; replacement costs fall as that prefix is exhausted, allowing the preferred order to reverse. A restricted-access synthetic benchmark informed by real transaction patterns reproduces this separation and validation-based upstream preservation. Capacity-matched combination protects upstream ordering while retaining GNN money-flow analysis, admitting GNN queue influence only where held-out evidence supports it.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Author-prepared version of the paper published in the Proceedings of the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF 2026)

title: Pushdown Reachability Requires $N^{3/2}$ Time on Multitape Turing Machines
authors: A. R. Balasubramanian, Rupak Majumdar
abstract:
Pushdown reachability, or equivalently, language non-emptiness of pushdown automata (PDA), is a fundamental problem in automata theory and program analysis. We show that, for every $ε>0$, no deterministic multitape Turing machine can decide pushdown reachability in $O(N^{\frac{3}{2}-ε})$ time, where $N$ is the input size. The lower bound already holds for \emph{sparse instances}, i.e., instances in which the number of transitions is linear in the number of states. This gives the first unconditional super-linear lower bound for pushdown reachability. Furthermore, we also extend this result and show that for any $ε> 0$ and $k \ge 1$, no deterministic multitape Turing machine can decide the intersection non-emptiness problem of one PDA and $k-1$ NFAs in time $O(N^{\frac{3k}{2}-ε})$, where $N$ is the input size.
  Finally, pushdown reachability is well-known to be quasi-linear time equivalent to many different problems in program analysis. Our result translates to all of those problems as well and provides the first unconditional super-linear lower bounds for those problems on multitape Turing machines.

title: SLP-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Acoustic Claims of Reasoning Audio Language Models on Clinical Speech
authors: Côme Hosxe, Rachid Riad, Quentin Spinat
abstract: Audio language models (ALMs) can answer clinical questions from speech, outperforming baselines built on handcrafted acoustic features. Reasoning ALMs generate a chain of thought that refers to properties of the speaker's voice before predicting. Each statement the model makes about the voice needs to be checked against clinicians' perceptual ratings of the same recording. On clinical speech, existing evaluations score only the final answer. We introduce Speech Language Pathologist Bench (SLP-Bench), a benchmark grading each acoustic claim in the chain of thought against clinicians' perceptual ratings of the same recording. It covers five clinician-rated datasets and 25 perceptual dimensions, and assesses claims for factuality, stability under resampling, and consistency across reworded and different questions. Across ten open-weight reasoning ALMs evaluated zero-shot, claim balanced accuracy ranges from 0.52 to 0.58, claims change under resampling and rewording, and the most consistent models are not the most factual. Fine-tuning a 7B ALM with GRPO on a reward for claims that agree with clinicians raises its claim balanced accuracy from 0.54 to 0.60 and its mean kappa from 0.39 to 0.61, while preserving answer accuracy on per-dimension questions. SLP-Bench is available upon request, subject to approval by the providers of each dataset.
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, submitted to ICASSP 2027 workshop "Explainability, Robustness, and Controllability of Language Modeling for Speech and Audio"

title: Redesigning Neural Networks to Not be Confidently Wrong even to Strong Adversarial Attacks
authors: Michael W. Spratling, Heiko H. Schütt
abstract: Early deep learning models attempted to simulate visual perception using a neural hierarchy that alternated between two types of layer: one modelled on cortical simple cells (that was designed to increase selectivity), and one modelled on cortical complex cells (that aimed to increase tolerance). We show that such a neural network (NN) architecture, when implemented with novel components that are better able to learn selective and tolerant representations, is capable of accurate and robust image classification and improved alignment between the behaviour of the model and the perceptual abilities of humans. Firstly, the proposed models are shallow, fewer than ten layer-pairs, which is more consistent with the rapid feedforward object categorisation performed by the biological visual system. Secondly, they are far less prone to producing classification predictions with high confidence for samples from unknown classes or for image consisting of pure noise, and hence, like humans are not easily fooled into perceiving objects that are not present in the image. Thirdly, for the proposed NNs adversarial samples cause predictions with low confidence, enabling them to be accurately identified. In contrast to humans, our networks still do not correctly classify adversarial samples. However, the behaviour of our networks is a significant step towards human-like behaviour compared to standard DNNs that produce highly confident, but incorrect, classification predictions for adversarial samples. The increased robustness to adversarial and unknown samples is achieved while maintaining competitive performance in terms of generalisation to novel samples from the training categories. This enables models of this type to be competitive with state-of-the-art DNNs across multiple different evaluation metrics and benchmark tasks.

title: BRINA: Bottom-Referenced Inertial Navigation with AKAZE, a Sonar SLAM for Autonomous Marine Vehicles
authors: Adolfo Damiano Cafaro, Patrizio Mariani, Roberto Galeazzi
abstract: Forward-looking sonar (FLS) provides reliable underwater perception where optical sensing is limited, but its use for navigation is hindered by the unobserved elevation of each return. As a result, motion estimated directly from sonar images suffers from an unknown metric scale that is commonly resolved using a Doppler velocity log (DVL). We present BRINA (Bottom-Referenced Inertial Navigation with AKAZE), a sonar-inertial SLAM system for marine vehicles that uses the FLS as its only exteroceptive sensor. BRINA estimates the sonar altitude from the first seabed return in each beam and uses it to project matched features onto the seabed, providing metric odometry without a DVL. We further derive a bound relating the remaining scale error to seabed tilt and slope variability. The method is evaluated in simulation with an autonomous underwater vehicle, and in field experiments with uncrewed surface vehicles over ten missions, using two FLS systems under different operating conditions.

title: Mixture of Latent Recursions for Low-Rank Adaptation
authors: Weixun Luo, Ye Mao, Ranran Huang, Junpeng Jing, Krystian Mikolajczyk
abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) performs task-specific adaptation using a fixed low-rank architecture, whose expressiveness is typically increased by enlarging or adding learnable modules with a proportional parameter overhead. We introduce Mixture of Latent Recursions (MoLR), an adaptive recursion framework that enhances adaptation expressiveness while preserving parameter efficiency. MoLR recursively refines the down-projected latent representation of each input using a shared transformation. A lightweight threshold-based router independently determines whether each token should undergo further refinement, while dynamically adjusted thresholds encourage balanced utilization across recursion depths. Extensive experiments across diverse language and vision tasks demonstrate that MoLR consistently outperforms representative LoRA variants with negligible parameter overhead over LoRA. Further analyses show that MoLR learns input-dependent recursion-depth allocation and enables a controllable inference-time compute-performance trade-off without requiring retraining. Code will be publicly available.

title: BinXSight: Fast Binary Program Summarization via Hierarchical Modular Decomposition
authors: Zhijie Liu, Zhipeng Xue, Zhipeng Gao, Pengfei Jing, Zixiong Qin, Sen Nie, Shi Wu, Liang Feng Zhang, Yutian Tang
abstract: Binary code summarization (BCS) is crucial in fields such as cybersecurity. Particularly, program-level BCS can quickly provide a comprehensive overview of an entire stripped binary without in-depth manual reverse engineering. However, a binary often contains numerous functions with complex interactions, making it challenging to extract its functionality efficiently. Moreover, existing methods focus solely on function-level without considering contextual information, limiting their applicability to program-level analysis. Towards comprehensive and fast program-level BCS, we propose BinXSight, an LLM-powered framework based on hierarchical modular decomposition. Specifically, we first propose binary graph, a new data structure composed of four graphs, to comprehensively represent a binary. Then, based on the binary graph, we hierarchically decompose functions into modules and select the most significant ones. Finally, BinXSight generates a program-level summary from these module summaries. We evaluate BinXSight on stripped binaries across various sizes, fields, platforms, and architectures. Results show that BinXSight outperforms baselines by 23.18% to 46.99%, and summarizes a binary with about 3K functions in 24.3 seconds on average. In addition, a user study with 27 experts shows that BinXSight's high-quality summaries help users quickly understand the whole binary. Our case analysis on recent real-world malware further demonstrates its practical utility.

title: Graph Signal Generation via Graph-Aware Diffusion Models
authors: Vimal K B, Sergio Rozada, Antonio G. Marques, Elvin Isufi, Hadi J. Rad
abstract: Many signals are defined on the nodes of a graph, such as traffic flow at road sensors or user purchases of related products. They are often partly observed, and learning their distribution enables imputing missing values and forecasting future ones. Diffusion models learn such distributions, but their forward noise is independent across nodes and does not depend on the graph. We introduce graph-aware diffusion (GAD), whose forward process is a heat diffusion on the graph driven by Gaussian noise. In the graph Fourier basis, the forward transition is a scalar Gaussian channel at each frequency. With a shared diffusion rate, high graph frequencies are attenuated faster than low ones. We propose Mode-Adaptive SNR Scheduling (MASS), which assigns each graph frequency its own diffusion rate and keeps all of them at the same SNR. For graph-stationary signals, MASS equalizes the normalized error of the optimal linear denoiser across frequencies. We bound reverse-SDE stiffness as a function of the (shifted) Laplacian's condition number, with a logarithmic upper bound for MASS and a linear lower bound for shared rates. GAD with MASS improves recommendation accuracy by 5-19%, reduces traffic-imputation RMSE by up to 7.8% with half as many reverse steps, and improves forecasting MAE and RMSE using only 3 reverse steps.
comment: 19 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Under review at IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence. Code: https://github.com/vimalkb7/SpectralAnalysisGAD

title: From Correctness to Consistency: Redefining Reliability for the Agentware Era
authors: Xue Qin, Maurício Gruppi
abstract: The rise of "vibe coding" has marginalized requirements analysis, allowing unverified "Make it Work" assumptions to accumulate into complex defects that evade standard testing. In the absence of a reliable ground truth oracle, we advocate a paradigm shift from correctness verification to logic consistency. We introduce Differential Logic Analysis (DLA), a framework that utilizes Logical Inference to detect internal contradictions across parallel and sequential development workflows. Preliminary simulations demonstrate that DLA successfully intercepts logic drift, such as contradictions and unspecified assumptions, and offers a new perspective on reliability assessment in the AI-assistant development era.

title: DistDNA: Language Model Fingerprinting under Stochastic Decoding
authors: Lifan Hu, Qian Yu, Zhaomin Wu, Bingsheng He
abstract: Behavioral fingerprints identify a large language model (LLM) from its responses to a shared set of prompts, enabling applications such as verifying whether a deployed model corresponds to the checkpoint it claims to be. Deployed models, however, are commonly served with stochastic decoding, under which the same model may produce different responses to an identical prompt, depending on an unknown temperature and top-$p$ setting. Existing representations such as LLM DNA provide limited treatment of this variation. A natural remedy is to characterize models by their response distributions, which, however, raises two challenges. First, each distribution must be estimated from only a small number of sampled responses. Second, a change in decoding setting can alter responses to the same extent as a change of checkpoint. Consequently, fingerprint distances alone provide an incomplete basis for model identity, and identification typically relies on a classifier trained jointly on fingerprints from many checkpoints. We propose DistDNA, which represents a model by its prompt-conditional response distributions and compares models by promptwise maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). The model under examination is assigned to the known checkpoint whose reference fingerprints, collected at several decoding settings, lie nearest to its own, without training a classifier. We show that finite sampling adds variance-dependent terms to the expected squared fingerprint distance, with these terms decreasing as $O(1/R)$ for equal response counts, where $R$ is the number of responses per prompt. Experiments across 115 model checkpoint entries demonstrate that DistDNA improves identification accuracy over the strongest baseline, LLM DNA, by 10.36%.

title: Beyond Self-Critique: Epistemic Convergence Control for Multi-Agent Research Verification
authors: Chrisantus Eze
abstract: Multi-agent systems for scientific claim verification increasingly rely on role-structured LLM debate to pressure-test hypotheses. However, when debating agents are instantiated from the same underlying base model, they share identical latent representations, making self-critique bias structurally inevitable. Static fixed-iteration protocols compound this by either halting prematurely before evidence stabilizes or wasting inference compute after convergence. We present \sys{}, a multi-agent research verification framework that addresses both failure modes. First, we introduce an asymmetric role architecture comprising an Advocate, Skeptic, and Arbitrator with opposing epistemic directives, producing significantly lower role-embedding similarity (0.852 vs.\ 0.918 for symmetric Multi-Agent Debate [MAD], $p = 5.82 \times 10^{-8}$) and surfacing more contested claims (22.0\% vs.\ 15.4\%). Second, we propose the Belief-Delta ($\DB$) convergence criterion, an evidence-grounded stopping rule that eliminates over-iteration (0.0\% vs.\ 62.5\% for Fixed-$3$) while cutting LLM calls by 2.4$\times$. Third, each supported claim is anchored to a verbatim literature snippet audited by an independent NLI classifier, achieving a 21.7\% hallucination rate (comparable to 25.9\% for a Self-Refine critic, $p = 0.61$) while establishing auditable evidence grounding. Across 200 runs on 40 research hypotheses evaluated with DeepSeek-R1-32B, \sys{} balances compute efficiency with rigorous epistemic verification.

title: Auditable Financial Knowledge Graphs: Schema-Driven Construction and Intrinsic Quality Evaluation
authors: Samarth Sarin, Lovepreet Singh, Dhagash Mehta
abstract: Financial documents combine narrative disclosures, accounting metrics, corporate structures, management commentary, and time-dependent facts, making them difficult to represent using conventional chunk-based retrieval-augmented generation systems. This paper presents an auditable, schema-driven methodology for constructing temporal financial knowledge graphs from page-delimited documents parsed using a general purpose document intelligence service. Overlapping document windows undergo phased large language model extraction of structural entities, quantitative observations, and domain-specific relationships. Candidate graph elements are validated against predefined schemas and consolidated through scope-aware exact, normalized, fuzzy, embedding-based, and LLM-assisted entity resolution. Temporal merge constraints, deterministic edge deduplication, conflict-aware property management, and fine-grained provenance preserve issuer identity, reporting-period validity, and traceability to source evidence. The contributions of this work comprise the proposed methodology for financial knowledge graph construction, the creation of an evidence-grounded temporal knowledge graph from heterogeneous financial documents, and an intrinsic framework for evaluating the quality of the resulting graph. The evaluation framework assesses seven weighted dimensions, two hard validation gates, and structural diagnostics. By separating graph-quality assessment from downstream retrieval and answer generation, the framework supports systematic diagnosis and iterative refinement of the constructed graph.
comment: The paper was accepted in ICAIF Conference 2026 and presented in Milan, Italy

title: A code-level survey of CPU scheduling mechanisms in open-source embedded hypervisors
authors: Lisa Mignerey, Anthony Ferrari, Damien Sauveron, Karim Tamine
abstract: Virtualization is increasingly used in embedded systems to consolidate mixed-criticality applications onto a single platform, relying on the hypervisor's CPU scheduler to share physical CPU (pCPU) time among virtual CPUs (vCPUs). This paper surveys ten CPU scheduling algorithms implemented in four open-source hypervisors for resource-constrained systems (Bao, Xen, ACRN, and Xvisor): static partitioning, ARINC653, Credit, Credit2, RTDS, Priority-based, BVT, IORR, PRR, and PRM. Analyzed at the source-code level without runtime measurements, each algorithm is characterized by its decision rule, parameters, selection criterion, triggers, and admission control. They are evaluated against nine criteria (temporal isolation, real-time guarantees, I/O responsiveness, resource utilization, fairness, mixed-criticality support, efficiency/scalability, configurability, and multicore support) and illustrated on a common single-pCPU workload. Source-code inspection reveals key deviations from documented designs: ACRN's default BVT scheduler lacks the warp mechanism, its priority-based scheduler exposes only two priority levels, and apart from ARINC653's static frame check, only Xen's development-branch RTDS performs utilization-based admission control. Furthermore, no policy natively supports criticality attributes or mode changes, requiring integrators to encode criticality via partitions, budgets, caps, or priorities. Finally, a qualitative matrix and a decision tree guide system integrators.

title: Humanoid robots for safety-critical electrical switching: A perception-informed runtime constraint filter
authors: Songyang Liu, Yu Hou, Yuqing Hu, Shuai Li
abstract: Humanoid robots can reduce personnel exposure in electrical switching, but safe control is challenging because the tool must reach a target switch next to similar devices, where an imprecise operator command can contact a non-target switch. This study proposes a runtime safety filter that checks each operator command during virtual-reality teleoperation of a humanoid robot. The filter integrates a scene model estimated from the robot head camera and a target-conditioned control barrier function quadratic program that keeps the tool away from the non-target switch while passing safe commands unchanged. In real-world experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, with six rounds at each of two standing positions, target operations succeed in all ten rounds with an unchanged target and no non-target actuation. A simulation study achieves 9/9 safe completions, compared with 5/9 for raw teleoperation, demonstrating the feasibility of the method for humanoid switching operations.
zh_title: 面向安全性要求极高的电力开关的人形机器人：一种感知驱动的运行时约束滤波器
translation: 人形机器人可以减少人员在电力开关操作中的暴露，但安全控制具有挑战性，因为工具必须到达相邻类似设备旁的目标开关，此时不精确的操作员指令可能会接触到非目标开关。本研究提出了一种运行时安全滤波器，在虚拟现实遥操作人形机器人期间检查每个操作员指令。该滤波器整合了从机器人头部摄像头估计的场景模型以及目标条件控制屏障函数二次规划，在保持安全指令不变的同时，使工具远离非目标开关。在Unitree G1人形机器人的真实世界实验中（每个站立位置进行六轮），目标操作在全部十轮中均成功且无非目标驱动。仿真研究实现了9/9的安全完成，而原始遥操作为5/9，证明了该方法用于人形机器人开关操作的可行性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种感知驱动的运行时安全滤波器，可有效防止人形机器人在VR遥操作进行电力开关时误触周围设备。
ai_comments: 该论文针对人形机器人执行高风险电力开关操作的安全性问题，创新性地提出了一种融合视觉感知的运行时约束滤波器。结合了控制屏障函数与虚拟现实遥操作，有效防止了误操作，实验验证充分，对工业具身智能安全具有重要意义。
motivation: 人形机器人虽然可以减少人员在电力开关操作中的暴露风险，但在相似设备密集的环境中，不精确的操作员指令容易触碰到非目标开关，因此安全控制极具挑战性。
method: 提出了一种运行时安全滤波器，该滤波器整合了来自机器人头部摄像头的场景模型，并采用目标条件控制屏障函数二次规划，在保持安全命令不变的同时，使工具远离非目标开关。
results: 在Unitree G1人形机器人的真实世界实验中，目标操作在所有轮次中均成功且无非目标驱动；仿真研究中实现了9/9的安全完成率，而原始遥操作仅为5/9。
conclusion: 本研究提出的基于感知的运行时约束滤波器能有效提高人形机器人在电力开关任务中的安全性，实现零误操作的目标，具有广阔的工业应用前景。

title: DGC-Net: A Depth-Geometric Conditioning Network for Projection-Supervised OCTA Segmentation
authors: Lucas Santiago, Bisheng Wang, Jaime S. Cardoso, Tomás Ribeiro
abstract: OCTA segmentation is commonly formulated as a projection supervised task: models observe 3D volumetric scans but are supervised by 2D en-face semantic maps. Existing 2D and 3D-to-2D methods either discard axial information or compress depth responses into latent projections, leaving vessel crossings, diffuse capillary regions, and FAZ boundaries vulnerable to projection-induced ambiguity. We propose DGC-Net, a Depth-Geometric Conditioning Network that recasts 3D-to-2D OCTA segmentation as depth-geometrically conditioned prediction, where projected features are decoded with compact descriptors of axial vascular evidence. DGC-Net preserves local depth geometry through Depth-Moment Conditioning (DM), which injects axial localization and dispersion cues into the projection stream, and captures global depth layout through Holistic Depth-Geometry Modulation (HDM), which derives a raw-volume axial prior for final 2D decoding. Experiments on the OCTA-500 6mm and 3mm subsets show that DGC-Net achieves 83.58% and 88.62% mIoU, respectively, reaching state-of-the-art performance.
zh_title: DGC-Net：一种用于投影监督OCTA分割的深度几何条件网络
translation: OCTA分割通常被表述为一个投影监督任务：模型观察3D体积扫描，但由2D平面对语义图进行监督。现有的2D和3D-to-2D方法要么丢弃轴向信息，要么将深度响应压缩为潜在投影，使得血管交叉、弥散毛细血管区域和FAZ边界容易受到投影引起的歧义影响。我们提出了DGC-Net，一个深度几何条件网络，它将3D-to-2D OCTA分割重新定义为深度几何条件预测，其中投影特征通过轴向血管证据的紧凑描述符进行解码。DGC-Net通过深度矩条件（DM）保留局部深度几何，该条件将轴向定位和离散线索注入到投影流中，并通过整体深度几何调制（HDM）捕获全局深度布局，该调制为最终的2D解码导出一个原始体积轴向先验。在OCTA-500 6mm和3mm子集上的实验表明，DGC-Net分别达到了83.58%和88.62%的mIoU，达到了最先进的性能。
tldr: DGC-Net是一种新的深度几何条件网络，通过结合局部深度几何和全局深度布局来解决现有OCTA分割方法中投影引起的歧义，并在OCTA-500数据集上达到了最先进的性能。
ai_comments: DGC-Net的创新之处在于其将深度几何信息（包括局部轴向定位和全局深度布局）引入到投影监督OCTA分割任务中，有效解决了传统方法中因信息丢失导致的歧义问题。这种深度几何条件预测的方法为3D-to-2D医学图像分割提供了一个新的视角。
motivation: 现有的2D和3D-to-2D OCTA分割方法在处理投影监督任务时，要么丢弃轴向信息，要么将深度响应压缩为潜在投影，导致血管交叉、弥散毛细血管区域和FAZ边界容易受到投影引起的歧义影响。
method: 本文提出了DGC-Net，一个深度几何条件网络，将3D-to-2D OCTA分割重新定义为深度几何条件预测。它通过深度矩条件（DM）注入轴向定位和离散线索以保留局部深度几何，并通过整体深度几何调制（HDM）捕获全局深度布局，为最终的2D解码提供原始体积轴向先验。
results: DGC-Net在OCTA-500 6mm和3mm子集上分别达到了83.58%和88.62%的mIoU，取得了最先进的性能。
conclusion: DGC-Net通过深度几何条件预测有效解决了投影监督OCTA分割中的歧义问题，并在标准数据集上取得了最先进的性能。

title: Kidney Exchange in Deterministic $O^*(4^{t+o(t)})$ Time
authors: Binh T. Nguyen
abstract: Kidney exchange admits a randomized $O^*(4^t)$ algorithm parameterized by the target number $t$ of transplants, but the best previous deterministic algorithm requires $O^*(6.855^t)$ time. We nearly close this gap by developing a deterministic $O^*(4^{t+o(t)})$ algorithm. Our approach uses Dynamic Representative Sets to execute the semi-feasible packing recurrence under a global cardinality budget of $2t$, exploiting a residual extension-budget invariant to avoid repeated static representative-family compression. To handle admissible cycles containing at least $t$ vertices, we establish a deterministic $O^*(4^{k+o(k)})$ algorithm for finding a shortest simple directed cycle of length at least $k$. Beyond feasibility, our framework supports additive optimization, yielding the same running-time bound for maximizing arc utility among packings with exactly $t$ transplants. Consequently, a packing that lexicographically maximizes the number of transplants and then additive utility can be computed deterministically in $O^*(4^{τ+o(τ)})$ time, where $τ$ is the maximum achievable number of transplants.
zh_title: 肾脏交换中的确定性$O^*(4^{t+o(t)})$时间算法
translation: 肾脏交换问题存在一个随机$O^*(4^t)$算法（参数为目标移植次数$t$），但之前最好的确定性算法需要$O^*(6.855^t)$的时间。我们通过开发一个确定性$O^*(4^{t+o(t)})$算法，几乎弥补了这一差距。我们的方法利用动态代表集（Dynamic Representative Sets）在全局基数预算为$2t$的情况下执行半可行打包递归，并利用残余扩展预算不变量（residual extension-budget invariant）来避免重复的静态代表族压缩。为了处理包含至少$t$个顶点的可接受循环，我们建立了一个确定性$O^*(4^{k+o(k)})$算法，用于找到长度至少为$k$的最短简单有向循环。除了可行性，我们的框架还支持加性优化，在最大化具有精确$t$次移植的打包中的弧效用时，也产生了相同的运行时间界限。因此，一个按移植数量和加性效用进行字典序最大化的打包可以在$O^*(4^{τ+o(τ)})$时间内确定性地计算出来，其中$τ$是可实现的最大移植数量。
tldr: 开发了一种确定性$O^*(4^{t+o(t)})$算法，显著提升了肾脏交换问题的解决效率，接近随机算法的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于其通过结合动态代表集和残余扩展预算不变量，以及为最短简单有向循环问题设计新算法，从而在肾脏交换领域实现了确定性算法的重大突破。它将确定性算法的性能提升到了接近随机算法的水平，对于需要高可靠性和可预测性的实际应用具有重要意义。同时，对加性优化的支持也扩展了该方法的实用性。
motivation: 肾脏交换问题存在一个随机的$O^*(4^t)$算法，但之前最好的确定性算法需要$O^*(6.855^t)$的时间。本文的动机是缩小确定性算法与随机算法之间的性能差距。
method: 该方法利用动态代表集（Dynamic Representative Sets）在全局基数预算为$2t$的情况下执行半可行打包递归，并利用残余扩展预算不变量（residual extension-budget invariant）来避免重复的静态代表族压缩。为了处理包含至少$t$个顶点的可接受循环，作者建立了一个确定性$O^*(4^{k+o(k)})$算法来找到长度至少为$k$的最短简单有向循环。
results: 开发了一个确定性$O^*(4^{t+o(t)})$的肾脏交换算法，几乎缩小了与随机算法之间的性能差距。该框架还支持加性优化，在最大化具有精确$t$次移植的打包中的弧效用时，也达到了相同的运行时间界限。最终，一个按移植数量和加性效用进行字典序最大化的打包可以以$O^*(4^{τ+o(τ)})$的时间确定性地计算出来。
conclusion: 本文成功开发了一种高效的确定性算法，显著提高了肾脏交换问题的解决效率，并扩展了其在加性优化方面的应用，使其性能接近随机算法。

title: Geometrically Constrained Learning I: Agnostically Learning Adversarially Robust Classifiers
authors: Jane Lange, Cassandra Marcussen, Arsen Vasilyan
abstract:
We study agnostic learning under the Gaussian distribution with guarantees on both classification error and robustness to adversarial perturbations. We say that a function has boundary profile $K \ge 1$ if, for all $r > 0$, the probability that a point lies within Euclidean distance $r$ of the classification boundary is at most $Kr$. We give an algorithm that takes a robustness radius parameter $r$ and learns a hypothesis with boundary volume $O(Kr)$ and classification error $\mathsf{opt}_K + \varepsilon$, where $\mathsf{opt}_K$ is the minimum classification error among functions with boundary profile at most $K$.
  For general $r$, $K$, and $\varepsilon$, the algorithm runs in time $d^{\widetilde{O}(K^2/\varepsilon^2 + K^4r^2/\varepsilon^4)}$. In particular, in the $Kr = O(\varepsilon)$ regime, the algorithm runs in time $d^{\widetilde{O}(K^2/\varepsilon^2)}$. Up to logarithmic factors in the exponent, this matches the statistical query lower bound for agnostically learning the $K$-profile class without recovering robustness. For natural geometric classes, including convex sets and Boolean combinations of halfspaces, this matches the corresponding surface-area-based running-time bound for non-robust agnostic learning via $L_1$ polynomial regression, up to logarithmic factors in the exponent.
  Our algorithm performs $L_1$ error minimization over polynomials, with an auxiliary coordinate roughly standing in for distance to the boundary. A convex constraint on the gradient of the polynomial, in this $(d+1)$-dimensional space, produces local certificates of the range of the polynomial on balls of radius $r$. Our algorithm finds a polynomial such that these certified ranges are small, then obtains a robust classifier via randomized rounding and partitioning of the domain.
zh_title: 几何约束学习I：不可知地学习对抗性鲁棒分类器
translation:
我们研究了在高斯分布下，具有分类误差和对抗性扰动鲁棒性双重保证的不可知学习。如果对于所有$r > 0$，一个点位于分类边界欧几里得距离$r$之内的概率至多为$Kr$，我们称一个函数具有边界剖面$K \ge 1$。我们提出了一种算法，该算法以鲁棒性半径参数$r$为输入，学习一个边界体积为$O(Kr)$且分类误差为$\mathsf{opt}_K + \varepsilon$的假设，其中$\mathsf{opt}_K$是在边界剖面至多为$K$的函数中最小的分类误差。
对于一般的$r, K, \varepsilon$，该算法的运行时间为$d^{\widetilde{O}(K^2/\varepsilon^2 + K^4r^2/\varepsilon^4)}$。特别地，在$Kr = O(\varepsilon)$的情况下，算法的运行时间为$d^{\widetilde{O}(K^2/\varepsilon^2)}$。在指数的对数因子内，这与不可知地学习$K$-profile类而不恢复鲁棒性的统计查询下界相匹配。对于包括凸集和半空间的布尔组合在内的自然几何类别，这在指数的对数因子内与通过$L_1$多项式回归进行非鲁棒不可知学习的相应基于表面积的运行时间界限相匹配。
我们的算法在多项式上执行$L_1$误差最小化，其中一个辅助坐标大致表示到边界的距离。在这个$(d+1)$维空间中，对多项式梯度施加的凸约束，能够为半径为$r$的球体上多项式的范围提供局部证书。我们的算法找到一个多项式，使得这些经过认证的范围很小，然后通过随机舍入和域划分获得一个鲁棒分类器。
tldr: 本文研究了在高斯分布下具有分类误差和对抗性扰动鲁棒性保证的不可知学习，并提出了一种基于多项式L1误差最小化的算法，能够在特定条件下达到与非鲁棒学习相当的运行时间。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种将几何约束与$L_1$多项式回归相结合的方法，以在理论上保证对抗性鲁棒性的同时，保持与非鲁棒学习相当的计算效率。其引入的“边界剖面”概念和通过辅助坐标及梯度约束来处理鲁棒性的策略是新颖的。这项工作对于理解和构建在高斯分布下具有强理论保证的鲁棒分类器具有重要意义，尤其是在处理高维数据时。
motivation: 在对抗性扰动日益普遍的背景下，研究在分类误差和对对抗性扰动鲁棒性两方面都有保证的不可知学习方法。
method: 提出了一种算法，该算法以鲁棒性半径参数$r$为输入，学习一个边界剖面为$O(Kr)$且分类误差为$\mathsf{opt}_K + \varepsilon$的假设。该算法通过在多项式上执行$L_1$误差最小化来实现，其中一个辅助坐标大致表示到边界的距离。在$(d+1)$维空间中，对多项式梯度施加凸约束，以生成在半径为$r$的球体上多项式范围的局部证书。然后，通过随机舍入和域划分获得鲁棒分类器。
results: 该算法学习到的假设具有$O(Kr)$的边界体积和$\mathsf{opt}_K + \varepsilon$的分类误差。对于一般的$r, K, \varepsilon$，算法运行时间为$d^{\widetilde{O}(K^2/\varepsilon^2 + K^4r^2/\varepsilon^4)}$。在$Kr = O(\varepsilon)$的情况下，算法运行时间为$d^{\widetilde{O}(K^2/\varepsilon^2)}$，这在指数的对数因子内匹配了不可知地学习$K$-profile类而不恢复鲁棒性的统计查询下界。对于凸集和半空间的布尔组合等自然几何类别，这在指数的对数因子内匹配了通过$L_1$多项式回归进行非鲁棒不可知学习的相应基于表面积的运行时间界限。
conclusion: 本文提出了一种用于不可知地学习对抗性鲁棒分类器的新算法，该算法在高斯分布下提供了分类误差和鲁棒性保证，并在特定条件下达到了与非鲁棒学习方法相当的运行时间效率。

title: Anchors That Move Without Collapsing: Exclusive-Region Anchor Routing for Vision Transformers
authors: Aadi Gupta
abstract: Anchor tokens let a vision transformer exchange global information through a few summaries, but nothing forces different anchors to summarise different things. On one shared backbone we show that a Perceiver-style pathway and an AnchorFormer pathway collapse to a single summary, the latter despite its mass normalisation (pooling-map similarity 0.99), while other soft pathways, including Representative Attention, stay partly redundant (0.59-0.79). These results concern the routing modules inside our block, not the full published models. An exclusive partition of the patch grid cannot collapse by construction, and matched component by component it is 2.4-3.6 points more accurate than Representative Attention on CIFAR-100. We then propose focus anchors, which place most anchors at the peaks of a learned importance map while all anchors keep one exclusive Voronoi partition. Focus anchors beat a fixed partition on a cluttered canvas (+1.5 points, 95% CI [0.5, 2.6]) but not on full-HD traffic-sign recognition. There, both variants match dense attention with local windows at about a fifth of its FLOPs, and the fixed partition also trains 1.5x faster per step than dense attention with FlashAttention, though both use more memory; a ViT on a downsampled input loses half its mean average precision. Hard exclusive assignment is the only region assignment we tested that is both stable and most accurate: softmax and Sinkhorn relaxations diverge, and Gumbel-softmax trains but is less accurate. We also report the limits: a ResNet-18 is more accurate on every task we trained it on in this from-scratch regime, and anchors train faster than FlashAttention only from about 1536x1536 pixels and never use less memory.
zh_title: 不会崩溃的移动锚点：用于视觉Transformer的专属区域锚点路由
translation: 锚点令牌允许视觉Transformer通过少量摘要交换全局信息，但没有机制强制不同的锚点总结不同的内容。在一个共享骨干网络上，我们发现Perceiver风格的路径和AnchorFormer路径会崩溃成一个单一摘要，后者尽管进行了质量归一化（池化图相似度0.99），而其他软路径，包括代表性注意力（Representative Attention），仍然部分冗余（0.59-0.79）。这些结果涉及我们模块内部的路由模块，而非完整的已发布模型。补丁网格的专属分区在构造上不会崩溃，并且逐组件匹配时，在CIFAR-100上比代表性注意力准确率高2.4-3.6点。然后，我们提出了焦点锚点（focus anchors），它将大多数锚点放置在学习到的重要性图的峰值处，同时所有锚点都保持一个专属的Voronoi分区。焦点锚点在杂乱画布上击败了固定分区（+1.5点，95%置信区间[0.5, 2.6]），但在全高清交通标志识别上没有。在那里，两种变体都以约五分之一的FLOPs匹配了带局部窗口的密集注意力，并且固定分区每步训练速度比带FlashAttention的密集注意力快1.5倍，尽管两者都使用更多内存；对下采样输入进行ViT处理会损失一半的平均精度。硬专属分配是我们测试的唯一既稳定又最准确的区域分配方法：softmax和Sinkhorn松弛会发散，Gumbel-softmax可以训练但准确率较低。我们还报告了局限性：在所有我们从头开始训练的任务中，ResNet-18都更准确；锚点仅在大约1536x1536像素及以上时训练速度快于FlashAttention，并且从不使用更少内存。
tldr: 本文提出了一种专属区域锚点路由方法，以解决视觉Transformer中锚点令牌信息冗余和崩溃的问题。通过硬专属分配，该方法在保持稳定性和准确性的同时，显著减少了计算量。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了“专属区域锚点路由”来解决视觉Transformer中锚点令牌的信息崩溃和冗余问题。通过引入硬专属分配和焦点锚点，它有效地强制锚点关注不同的区域，从而提升了模型的稳定性和准确性。其重要性体现在它能显著减少计算量（约五分之一的FLOPs）并加快训练速度，这对于处理高分辨率图像的Vision Transformer具有重要意义。然而，论文也坦诚地指出了局限性，例如在某些任务上性能不如ResNet-18，以及在特定情况下内存消耗可能更高，这为未来的研究提供了明确的方向。
motivation: 现有的锚点令牌在视觉Transformer中交换全局信息时，不同锚点会总结相同的内容，导致信息冗余和“崩溃”到单一摘要的问题。
method: 作者首先展示了Perceiver风格和AnchorFormer路径会崩溃到单一摘要。为解决此问题，提出了两种方法：1) 补丁网格的专属分区，通过构造避免崩溃。2) 焦点锚点（focus anchors），将大多数锚点放置在学习到的重要性图的峰值处，同时所有锚点保持一个专属的Voronoi分区。研究发现硬专属分配是唯一稳定且最准确的区域分配方法。
results: 1. Perceiver风格和AnchorFormer路径会崩溃到单一摘要（池化图相似性0.99）。2. 专属分区比Representative Attention在CIFAR-100上准确率高2.4-3.6点。3. 焦点锚点在杂乱画布上比固定分区高1.5点，但在全高清交通标志识别上未超越。4. 在全高清交通标志识别中，两种锚点变体以约五分之一的FLOPs匹配局部窗口的密集注意力。5. 固定分区训练速度比使用FlashAttention的密集注意力快1.5倍/步，但两者都使用更多内存。6. 硬专属分配是唯一稳定且最准确的区域分配方法；softmax和Sinkhorn松弛会发散，Gumbel-softmax虽然可训练但准确率较低。7. 局限性：ResNet-18在所有从头开始训练的任务上都更准确；锚点仅在约1536x1536像素及以上时训练速度快于FlashAttention，且从不使用更少内存。
conclusion: 硬专属分配是作者测试的唯一既稳定又最准确的区域分配方法，它解决了现有锚点令牌在视觉Transformer中信息崩溃的问题，并在保持高精度的同时显著提升了效率。

title: ENC-QA: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Vision-Language Models on Electronic Navigational Charts
authors: Jiyoon Pyo, Jacob Arndt, Yao-Yi Chiang, Dalton Lunga
abstract: Nautical charts encode safety-critical maritime information through standardized symbols, attributes, text, and heterogeneous geometries. Interpreting these charts and assessing the navigational significance of successive chart updates requires recognizing nautical features, determining their spatial relationships, and applying navigational knowledge. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising approach to nautical-chart interpretation, yet systematic evaluation of their fine-grained nautical feature recognition, chart-based spatial reasoning, and application of navigational knowledge to assessing chart changes remains limited. We introduce ENC-QA, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 77,312 questions derived from 6,612 National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) Electronic Navigational Charts (ENCs). The benchmark evaluates four complementary capabilities: ENC Perception, Spatial Reasoning, Joint Perception and Spatial Reasoning, and Application. Of these, 8,227 questions form a progressive subset that decomposes selected chart-change cases into linked questions progressing from change detection to criticality assessment, enabling case-level analysis of how models use perceptual and spatial evidence to determine the navigational significance of chart changes. Evaluations of 10 open-weight VLMs reveal substantial limitations in fine-grained nautical feature recognition and feature-grounded spatial reasoning. Controlled evidence interventions show that relevant perceptual and spatial information improves change-criticality accuracy. Our findings establish ENC-QA as a diagnostic resource for nautical-chart understanding and safety-critical navigational decisions. We will release the benchmark and evaluation code upon publication.
zh_title: ENC-QA：用于电子海图视觉语言模型的诊断基准
translation: 航海图通过标准化符号、属性、文本和异构几何图形编码了对安全至关重要的海事信息。解释这些海图并评估连续海图更新的导航重要性需要识别航海特征，确定它们的空间关系，并应用航海知识。视觉语言模型（VLMs）为航海图解释提供了一种有前景的方法，但对其精细航海特征识别、基于海图的空间推理以及应用航海知识评估海图变化的系统性评估仍然有限。我们引入了ENC-QA，一个诊断基准，包含从6,612张美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）电子海图（ENCs）中提取的77,312个问题。该基准评估四种互补能力：ENC感知、空间推理、联合感知与空间推理以及应用。其中，8,227个问题构成一个渐进子集，将选定的海图变化案例分解为一系列关联问题，从变化检测到关键性评估，从而能够对模型如何利用感知和空间证据来确定海图变化的导航重要性进行案例级分析。对10个开源视觉语言模型进行评估，揭示了它们在精细航海特征识别和基于特征的空间推理方面存在显著局限性。受控证据干预表明，相关的感知和空间信息可以提高变化关键性评估的准确性。我们的研究结果确立了ENC-QA作为航海图理解和安全关键导航决策的诊断资源。我们将在发表后发布该基准和评估代码。
tldr: ENC-QA是一个新的诊断基准，包含77,312个问题，用于评估视觉语言模型在电子海图解读方面的能力，特别是精细特征识别和空间推理，发现现有模型存在显著局限性。
ai_comments: ENC-QA的创新之处在于其专门针对航海图这一安全关键领域，并提供了一个细致的诊断框架。它不仅评估了视觉语言模型在感知和空间推理方面的能力，还通过渐进式问题设计，允许对模型如何处理海图变化的关键性评估进行案例级分析。这对于推动VLM在专业领域应用的发展具有重要意义，尤其是在需要高精度和可靠性的场景中。
motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在航海图解释方面有前景，但对其精细航海特征识别、基于海图的空间推理以及应用航海知识评估海图变化的系统性评估仍然有限。本研究旨在解决这一评估空白。
method: 引入了ENC-QA，一个诊断基准，包含从6,612张NOAA电子海图（ENCs）中提取的77,312个问题。该基准评估四种能力：ENC感知、空间推理、联合感知与空间推理以及应用。其中8,227个问题构成一个渐进子集，将海图变化案例分解为关联问题，从变化检测到关键性评估。
results: 对10个开源视觉语言模型进行评估，揭示了它们在精细航海特征识别和基于特征的空间推理方面存在显著局限性。受控证据干预表明，相关的感知和空间信息可以提高变化关键性评估的准确性。
conclusion: ENC-QA被确立为航海图理解和安全关键导航决策的诊断资源。

title: Who Grades the Agent? Privilege Separation for Coding-Agent Benchmarks
authors: Nathan Nour Houlamy, Mattia Favretto, Earlence Fernandes, Mauro Conti
abstract:
Benchmarks for AI-based coding agents are a staple of the current AI landscape, because they are the leading way to measure the performance of LLMs. Their scores guide business and research decisions. Evaluating coding agents is challenging, since they are able to manipulate their evaluation infrastructure to artificially achieve better scores. Grading an agent's solution often requires running its code, which can then manipulate the evaluation process. BenchJack, an automated benchmark auditor, recently reached near-perfect scores on nine of ten popular agent benchmarks without actually solving their tasks. Agents already do this unprompted, as OpenAI's July 2026 Hugging Face incident showed.
  Building on secure systems design, we introduce SplitBench, a privilege separation framework for evaluating coding agents and the first in the scientific literature to separate running a task's tests from judging their results. Even an agent whose code takes over the entire test environment cannot forge a pass, because a trusted grader holds the expected answers. We show that real-world benchmarks (e.g., Terminal-Bench, DeepSWE) can be ported to the SplitBench framework with minimal effort and high fidelity: 180 of 202 tasks convert, and SplitBench agrees with the native graders on 98.7% of agent attempts. We attack the converted tasks in the worst case, where adversarial agents can read all the grading code but not the expected answers. SplitBench blocked 75% of their attempts; the rest mostly reveal weaknesses in the original tasks' tests rather than flaws in SplitBench.
zh_title: 谁来评判代理？编码代理基准测试的权限分离
translation:
AI编码代理的基准测试是当前AI领域的主流，因为它们是衡量大型语言模型（LLMs）性能的主要方式。它们的得分指导着商业和研究决策。评估编码代理具有挑战性，因为它们能够操纵其评估基础设施以人为地获得更好的分数。对代理解决方案进行评分通常需要运行其代码，而代码可以操纵评估过程。BenchJack，一个自动基准审计器，最近在十个流行的代理基准测试中的九个上获得了接近满分，而实际上并未解决其任务。正如OpenAI在2026年7月的Hugging Face事件所示，代理已经自发地这样做。
基于安全系统设计，我们引入了SplitBench，一个用于评估编码代理的权限分离框架，也是科学文献中第一个将任务测试的运行与结果的判断分离的框架。即使代理的代码控制了整个测试环境，也无法伪造通过，因为一个受信任的评分器掌握着预期答案。我们展示了真实世界的基准测试（例如Terminal-Bench, DeepSWE）可以以最小的努力和高保真度移植到SplitBench框架：202个任务中有180个成功转换，并且SplitBench与原生评分器在98.7%的代理尝试上保持一致。我们以最坏的情况攻击了转换后的任务，即对抗性代理可以读取所有评分代码但不能读取预期答案。SplitBench阻止了75%的尝试；其余的失败主要揭示了原始任务测试的弱点，而不是SplitBench的缺陷。
tldr: 现有编码代理基准测试易受代理操纵。本文提出SplitBench，一个权限分离框架，将测试运行与结果判断分离，有效阻止代理伪造分数，并展示了其在实际基准测试中的有效性。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新在于提出了一个针对AI编码代理评估中安全漏洞的系统级解决方案——权限分离。它解决了当前大型语言模型（LLM）基准测试中一个关键的信任问题，即代理可能通过操纵评估环境来虚报性能。SplitBench的设计思路借鉴了安全系统领域的成熟经验，并通过实验验证了其有效性和实用性，对于提高AI代理评估的公正性和可靠性具有重要意义。
motivation: AI编码代理的基准测试对于衡量大型语言模型（LLMs）的性能至关重要，其分数影响商业和研究决策。然而，现有评估机制容易被代理操纵，导致分数虚高，这削弱了基准测试的可靠性。
method: 本文引入了SplitBench，一个基于安全系统设计的权限分离框架，用于评估编码代理。该框架首次在科学文献中将任务测试的运行与结果的判断分离。即使代理的代码控制了整个测试环境，也无法伪造通过，因为一个受信任的评分器掌握着预期答案。
results: 真实世界的基准测试（如Terminal-Bench, DeepSWE）可以以最小的努力和高保真度移植到SplitBench框架中（202个任务中有180个成功转换）。SplitBench与原生评分器在98.7%的代理尝试上保持一致。在对抗性攻击下，当代理可以读取所有评分代码但不能读取预期答案时，SplitBench阻止了75%的尝试，其余的失败主要揭示了原始任务测试的弱点而非SplitBench的缺陷。
conclusion: SplitBench通过引入权限分离机制，有效解决了AI编码代理基准测试中代理操纵评估结果的问题，显著提高了评估的可靠性和安全性。它能够轻松集成到现有基准测试中，并有效抵御恶意代理的攻击。

title: OpenAHBU: Open-sourced Automatic Human Behaviour Understanding Toolkit Through Facial Behaviour Analysis
authors: Zijian Wu, Yupeng Huo, Cheng Luo, Yichen Huang, Junan Long, Haijun Lin, Lu Liu, Hatice Gunes, Bernard Ghanem, Siyang Song
abstract: Automatic facial behaviour understanding (AFBU) is fundamental to various human-centred applications, yet existing academically available toolkits offer limited functionality, closed training pipelines, and weak generalisation. This paper presents OpenAHBU, a fully open-sourced, generalisable toolkit integrating 11 AFBU functions across three semantic levels: (i) short-term external facial attributes, including landmarks, blendshapes, Action Units, and expressions; (ii) short-term facial behaviour-related human psychological states, including valence/arousal and pain; and (iii) long-term facial behaviour-related psychological traits, including depression and personality. Particularly, we re-developed eight functions, where at least four deep learning models covering different computational complexities are developed for each function, providing flexible deployment on resource-constrained and high-throughput computing scenarios. More importantly, models of most functions are trained on a comprehensive corpus aggregating multiple academically available datasets, ensuring robust cross-dataset generalisability.In addition, we include a Synergistic Multi-task Enhancement (SMTE) module to efficiently and adaptively enhance each OpenAHBU function by leveraging the complementary cues contained in its most-related support function's predictions.Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our OpenAHBU outperformed existing open-source toolkits not only in functional coverage but also the predictive performances, while providing superior deployment flexibility across diverse computational scenarios.With fully publicly available training and inference scripts, pre-trained weights, user-friendly GUI, Python library, and cross-platform compatibility, our OpenAHBU provides a reproducible, scalable and extensible toolkit at https://github.com/OpenAHBU/OpenAHBU.
zh_title: OpenAHBU：通过面部行为分析开源的自动人类行为理解工具包
translation: 自动面部行为理解（AFBU）是各种以人为中心的应用的基础，然而现有的学术可用工具包提供的功能有限、训练管线封闭且泛化能力弱。本文提出了 OpenAHBU，这是一个完全开源、可泛化的工具包，集成了跨三个语义级别的 11 个 AFBU 功能：（i）短期外部面部属性，包括关键点、Blendshapes、动作单元和表情；（ii）短期面部行为相关的心理状态，包括效价/唤醒度和疼痛；（iii）长期面部行为相关的心理特征，包括抑郁和人格。特别地，我们重新开发了 8 个功能，每个功能开发了至少四个涵盖不同计算复杂度的深度学习模型，为资源受限和高吞吐量计算场景提供灵活的部署。更重要的是，大多数功能的模型都在整合了多个学术可用数据集的综合语料库上进行训练，确保了强大的跨数据集泛化能力。此外，我们包含了一个协同多任务增强（SMTE）模块，通过利用与其最相关的支持功能的预测中所包含的互补线索，高效且自适应地增强每个 OpenAHBU 功能。广泛的评估表明，我们的 OpenAHBU 不仅在功能覆盖率上，而且在预测性能上都优越于现有的开源工具包，同时在不同的计算场景下提供了卓越的部署灵活性。凭借完全公开的训练和推理脚本、预训练权重、用户友好的 GUI、Python 库和跨平台兼容性，我们的 OpenAHBU 提供了一个可复现、可扩展和可延伸的工具包，网址为 https://github.com/OpenAHBU/OpenAHBU。
tldr: OpenAHBU 是一个开源的自动面部行为理解工具包，具有强大的泛化能力、丰富的功能覆盖和灵活的部署选项。
ai_comments: OpenAHBU 是一个功能全面、开源的面部行为理解工具包，通过整合多语义级别的任务、提供多样化的模型复杂度选择以及引入多任务增强模块，显著提升了跨数据集泛化能力和部署灵活性。
motivation: 现有学术可用的面部行为理解工具包存在功能有限、训练管线封闭以及泛化能力弱的问题。
method: 开发了涵盖三个语义级别的11个 AFBU 功能，其中8个功能重新开发并提供了4种不同计算复杂度的深度学习模型；引入了协同多任务增强（SMTE）模块。
results: 实验表明，OpenAHBU 在功能覆盖面和预测性能上均超越了现有的开源工具包，同时在各种计算场景下展现出优越的部署灵活性。
conclusion: OpenAHBU 提供了一个可复现、可扩展且开源的面部行为理解工具包，在功能覆盖、预测性能和部署灵活性上均优于现有工具包。

title: SLICR: Strategy Logic-Guided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors: Arshia Rafieioskouie, Matthew Lucas, Tzu-Han Hsu, Borzoo Bonakdarpour
abstract: Specification-guided reinforcement learning (RL) translates formal specifications of desired behavior of agents into shaped rewards. This paper introduces SLICR, a significant paradigm shift that advances the state of the art to specification-guided RL in adversarial settings under partial observability. We employ Strategy Logic (SL), which allows explicit quantification over agents' strategies and uses the linear temporal logic (LTL) to specify the agents' objectives and constraints. This enables reasoning not only about how agents should act to satisfy a specification, but also about how they should respond to the strategies and behaviors of other agents. We evaluate SLICR on three popular benchmarks: Predator-Prey, Google Research Football, and our home-grown extension of SMAC-HARD, demonstrating its effectiveness, scalability, and ability to adapt to diverse adversarial strategies.
zh_title: SLICR：策略逻辑引导的多智能体强化学习
translation: 规范引导的强化学习（RL）将期望行为的形式化规范转化为塑造奖励。本文引入了SLICR，这是一个重大的范式转变，将对抗性、部分可观测设置下的规范引导RL推进到了最新水平。我们采用策略逻辑（SL），它允许对智能体的策略进行显式量化，并使用线性时序逻辑（LTL）来指定智能体的目标和约束。这不仅能够推理智能体应如何行动以满足规范，还能推理它们应如何响应其他智能体的策略和行为。我们在三个流行基准测试上评估了SLICR：Predator-Prey、Google Research Football以及我们自主扩展的SMAC-HARD，证明了其有效性、可扩展性以及适应多样化对抗策略的能力。
tldr: 本文提出了SLICR，一种结合策略逻辑的多智能体强化学习新范式，能够有效解决部分可观测对抗环境下的规范引导任务。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了SLICR，利用策略逻辑（SL）与强化学习结合，解决了对抗性与部分可观测环境下的多智能体规范引导强化学习问题。创新点在于通过显式量化智能体策略及使用LTL表达目标和约束，增强了对其他智能体行为的推理能力。
motivation: 现有的规范引导强化学习难以应对对抗性设置和部分可观测性下的复杂多智能体交互，无法有效推理其他智能体的策略和行为。
method: 采用策略逻辑（SL）允许对智能体的策略进行显式量化，并使用线性时序逻辑（LTL）来指定智能体的目标和约束，从而在部分可观测的对抗环境中指导多智能体强化学习。
results: 在Predator-Prey、Google Research Football和SMAC-HARD扩展版三个基准测试上的实验证明了该方法的有效性、可扩展性及其对不同对抗策略的适应性。
conclusion: SLICR在三个基准测试（Predator-Prey、Google Research Football、SMAC-HARD扩展版）中表现出有效性、可扩展性以及对多样化对抗策略的适应能力。

title: Bayesian Bias Learning-Enabled Probabilistic Voltage Estimation with Unknown Uncertainty Modeling of DERs in Distribution Grids
authors: Yuanshuo Zhang, Ying Zhang, Fei Ding, Jiahao Chen
abstract: One key challenge in distribution system state es- timation is unknown input statistics from the growing inte- gration of distributed energy resources (DERs), which may largely deviate from Gaussian uncertainty. Existing model-based estimators often rely on the assumption that all inputs follow known Gaussian distributions, while data-driven methods suffer from overfitting and failure in out-of-distribution scenarios. This paper proposes a Bayesian bias learning (BBL)-enabled probabilistic voltage estimation method in distribution systems with unknown DER generation statistics. The proposed learning- enabled method consists of two stages: probabilistic uncertainty inference and computationally efficient voltage estimation. First, a physics-constrained probabilistic density inference network is developed to learn Gaussian mixture representations of DER generation from historical data. Then, the resulting probabilistic representations, treated as pseudo-measurements, are integrated into a BBL-enabled voltage estimator via a decomposition- and-parallelization mechanism. Furthermore, utilizing a linear analytical solution, the proposed BBL-enabled voltage estimator efficiently captures linearization-induced biases and attains ac- curate probabilistic estimation. By integrating learning-enabled probabilistic uncertainty modeling into the parallel estimation structure, the proposed method achieves uncertainty-aware scal- able voltage estimation. Case studies on two unbalanced IEEE distribution networks show that the proposed estimator achieves significantly higher accuracy and computational efficiency under unknown uncertainty, outperforming recent data-driven and model-based methods.
zh_title: 配电网中基于贝叶斯偏差学习与未知DER不确定性建模的概率电压估计
translation: 配电系统状态估计的一个关键挑战来自分布式能源（DERs）不断增长的融合所带来的未知输入统计数据，这些数据可能很大程度上偏离高斯不确定性。现有的基于模型的估计器通常依赖于所有输入遵循已知高斯分布的假设，而数据驱动的方法则面临过拟合以及在分布外场景中失效的问题。本文提出了一种在配电系统中具有未知DER发电统计信息的基于贝叶斯偏差学习（BBL）的概率电压估计方法。所提出的学习增强方法包括两个阶段：概率不确定性推理和计算高效的电压估计。首先，开发了一个物理约束的概率密度推理网络，从历史数据中学习DER发电的高斯混合表示。然后，将所得的概率表示视为伪测量，通过分解和并行化机制集成到基于BBL的电压估计器中。此外，利用线性解析解，所提出的基于BBL的电压估计器能够有效地捕获线性化引起的偏差并获得精确的概率估计。通过将学习增强的概率不确定性建模集成到并行估计结构中，该方法实现了不确定性感知的可扩展电压估计。在两个不平衡的IEEE配电网络上的案例研究表明，所提出的估计器在未知不确定性下实现了显着更高的精度和计算效率，优于近期的数据驱动和基于模型的方法。
tldr: 提出了一种基于贝叶斯偏差学习的配电网概率电压估计方法，有效解决了分布式能源未知非高斯不确定性带来的估计难题。
ai_comments: 该论文针对配电网中分布式能源（DER）输入统计未知且非高斯分布的挑战，创新性地提出了一种基于贝叶斯偏差学习的概率电压估计方法，结合了物理约束与并行计算架构，兼具高精度与高计算效率。
motivation: 随着分布式能源（DERs）的大量接入，其输入统计信息未知且往往严重偏离高斯分布，导致传统的基于模型的方法失效，而纯数据-driven方法容易过拟合且在分布外场景下表现不佳。
method: 提出了一种两阶段方法：首先开发物理约束的概率密度推理网络从历史数据中学习DER生成的混合高斯表示；然后通过分解与并行化机制，将概率表示作为伪测量集成到基于贝叶斯偏差学习的电压估计器中，利用线性解析解捕捉线性化引起的偏差。
results: 在两个不平衡的IEEE配电网络上的案例研究表明，该方法在未知不确定性下具有显著更高的准确性和计算效率。
conclusion: 该论文提出的基于贝叶斯偏差学习的概率电压估计方法在处理未知DER不确定性时，显著优于现有的数据驱动和基于模型的方法，实现了高精度和高计算效率。

title: From Gist to Verbatim: The Controllable Path of One Image Through a Diffusion Prior
authors: Luca Saglietti, Luca Giammanco, Marc Mezard, Chiara Plizzari, Luca Biggio
abstract: Modern generative models are typically studied for their ability to generalize, while memorization is treated as a failure mode. We invert this perspective and ask how a generative model can recall a single datum. We frame memorization as a control problem: a learned conditioning signal steers a frozen diffusion model toward a target image, and we follow the formation of this memory throughout training. Before converging to exact reproduction (verbatim), memory passes through a regime of abstraction: samples preserve the target's semantic content (gist) while remaining diverse in appearance, leaving predictable detail to the generative prior. This semantic organization emerges despite the absence of labels, captions, or any explicit semantic objective. In the abstraction regime, the learned memory approaches ordinary text conditioning and supports editing, one-shot recognition, and retrieval more effectively than in the near-perfect reconstruction regime. These results suggest that memorization can serve as a probe of the relevance structure encoded by a generative model: what must be stored about a datum, what can be reconstructed from prior knowledge, and how learned memories interpolate between reconstructive recall and literal data storage.
zh_title: 从主旨到字面：单张图像通过扩散先验的可控路径
translation: 现代生成模型通常因其泛化能力而被研究，而记忆化则被视为一种失效模式。我们颠倒了这一视角，探讨生成模型如何回忆单个数据。我们将记忆化构想为一个控制问题：一个学习到的条件信号引导一个冻结的扩散模型朝向目标图像，我们在整个训练过程中追踪这种记忆的形成。在收敛到精确复现（字面）之前，记忆会经过一个抽象阶段：样本保留了目标的语义内容（主旨），同时在外表上保持多样性，将可预测的细节留给生成先验。这种语义组织的出现，并没有借助标签、说明文字或任何显式的语义目标。在抽象阶段，学习到的记忆接近于普通的文本条件支持，并且比在近乎完美的重建阶段更有效地支持编辑、单次识别和检索。这些结果表明，记忆化可以作为生成模型所编码的相关性结构的探针：关于一个数据必须存储什么，可以从先验知识中重建什么，以及学习到的记忆如何在重建性回忆与字面数据存储之间进行插值。
tldr: 本文研究了扩散模型中单张图像的记忆过程，发现记忆在精确复现前会经历一个语义抽象阶段，支持图像编辑和检索。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将扩散模型的记忆现象转化为一个可控问题，揭示了从语义抽象（gist）到精确复现（verbatim）的演化路径，为理解生成模型的内部表征提供了全新的视角。
motivation: 现代生成模型通常研究其泛化能力并将记忆化视为失败模式，该论文试图颠倒这一视角，研究生成模型如何回忆单个数据。
method: 将记忆化建模为一个控制问题，利用一个学习到的条件信号引导冻结的扩散模型朝向目标图像，并追踪整个训练过程中记忆的形成。
results: 在收敛到精确复现之前，记忆会经历一个抽象阶段：样本保留了目标的语义内容（主旨），同时外观保持多样性；在抽象阶段，学习到的记忆接近普通的文本条件，支持编辑、单次识别和检索，效果优于近乎完美重建的阶段。
conclusion: 记忆化可以作为探究生成模型编码关联结构的有效探针，展示了学习到的记忆如何在重建性回忆和字面数据存储之间进行插值。

title: Integrating Generative Artificial Intelligence with Learning Style Models: Opportunities, Challenges, and Future Directions
authors: Malithi Nawarathne, Prasanna Haddela, Nuwan Kodagoda
abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI) has emerged as a powerful tool for transforming learning. This review examines how Generative AI can be integrated with established learning style models (VARK, Kolb, Felder-Silverman, and Honey & Mumford) to support student engagement in large online classes. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, we searched Scopus, IEEE Xplore, and Google Scholar (2015 to 2026) and included 41 studies that met the eligibility criteria. The review maps Generative AI capabilities to learning style preferences, synthesizes existing implementations, highlights benefits and challenges, and proposes pathways for future research and practice. Despite ongoing debates regarding the empirical validity of learning styles, Generative AI enables flexible, multimodal, and real-time adaptation. This study offers practical insights for educators and developers seeking to build more effective, learner centered learning systems
zh_title: 将生成式人工智能与学习风格模型相结合：机遇、挑战与未来方向
translation: 生成式人工智能（Generative AI）已成为改变学习方式的强大工具。本综述探讨了如何将生成式人工智能与成熟的学习风格模型（VARK、Kolb、Felder-Silverman 以及 Honey & Mumford）相结合，以支持大型在线课堂中的学生参与度。遵循 PRISMA 2020 指南，我们检索了 Scopus、IEEE Xplore 和 Google Scholar（2015年至2026年），并纳入了 41 项符合资格标准的研究。该综述将生成式人工智能的功能与学习风格偏好进行映射，综合了现有的实现方式，突出了优势与挑战，并为未来的研究和实践提出了路径。尽管关于学习风格的实证有效性仍存在争论，但生成式人工智能实现了灵活、多模态和实时的自适应。本研究为寻求构建更有效、以学习者为中心的学习系统的教育工作者和开发人员提供了实用的见解。
tldr: 本文通过系统综述探讨了如何利用生成式人工智能结合学习风格模型来优化大规模在线教育，提供了现状分析、挑战及未来展望。
ai_comments: 该论文通过系统综述探讨了生成式人工智能与经典学习风格模型的结合，为大规模在线教育的个性化和 learner-centered（以学习者为中心）发展提供了重要的前瞻性见解，方法规范（PRISMA 2020），但在学习风格本身的争议性上需要更谨慎的实证支持。
motivation: 为了探讨如何将生成式人工智能与经典的学习风格模型（VARK、Kolb、Felder-Silverman 和 Honey & Mumford）相集成，以支持大规模在线教育中的学生参与度。
method: 遵循 PRISMA 2020 指南，检索了 Scopus、IEEE Xplore 和 Google Scholar（2015至2026年）数据库，最终纳入了41篇符合条件的研究进行系统综述。
results: 研究梳理了生成式人工智能功能与学习风格偏好的映射关系，综合了现有实现方式，突出了其带来的益处与面临的挑战，并为未来的研究和实践提出了发展路径。
conclusion: 生成式人工智能能够有效弥合传统学习风格模型的局限，为大规模在线教育提供实时、多模态的个性化支持，尽管存在一定争议和挑战，但前景广阔。

title: Beyond Visual Fidelity: Comparing Categorical and Continuous World Models
authors: Sarah Parisot, Melanie Fernandez Pradier, David Bignell, Sergio Valcarcel Macua, Katja Hofmann
abstract: Visual world models can now generate compelling interactive worlds, but visual realism does not guarantee faithful dynamics. We systematically compare how categorical and continuous prediction shape learned dynamics under both next-token and iterative whole-frame generation. These choices are often bundled in approaches such as autoregressive token models and whole-frame flow matching. We design controlled 2D and 3D environments and evaluate dynamics validity, calibration, and visual quality. In 2D with lossless visual encoding, categorical models achieve higher rollout validity with less training compute, particularly for stochastic entities. Among categorical models, greedy decoding produces the highest rollout validity, while sampling from a next-token model yields the best-calibrated stochastic predictions. Failures in continuous models, such as disappearing game characters, echo those seen in more complex environments. Here, known dynamics let us measure their impact. In 3D, categorical models also achieve stronger long-horizon performance with less training compute. Even models with lossy tokenization remain competitive on semantic accuracy and FVD, despite lower next-frame RGB accuracy. Together, these findings make a strong case for categorical prediction as a compute-efficient route to learning world dynamics.
zh_title: 超越视觉保真度：比较分类世界模型与连续世界模型
translation: 视觉世界模型现在可以生成引人入胜的交互式世界，但视觉真实性并不能保证动力学的真实性。我们系统地比较了分类预测和连续预测在下一个标记生成和迭代整帧生成下如何塑造学习到的动力学。这些选择通常捆绑在自回归标记模型和整帧流匹配等方法中。我们设计了受控的2D和3D环境，并评估了动力学有效性、校准性和视觉质量。在具有无损视觉编码的2D中，分类模型以更少的训练计算量实现了更高的 rollout 有效性，特别是对于随机实体。在分类模型中，贪婪解码产生最高的 rollout 有效性，而从下一个标记模型中采样产生最佳校准的随机预测。连续模型中的失败（例如游戏角色消失）呼应了在更复杂的环境中看到的失败。在这里，已知动力学使我们能够衡量它们的影响。在3D中，分类模型还以更少的训练计算量实现了更强的长视野性能。即使具有有损标记化的模型在语义准确性和FVD上也保持竞争力，尽管下一帧RGB准确性较低。总之，这些发现为分类预测作为学习世界动力学的计算高效路线提供了强有力的证据。
tldr: 分类预测比连续预测能以更少的计算量学习到更真实、更具长程有效性的世界动力学模型。
ai_comments: 本文深入探讨了世界模型中分类预测与连续预测的性能差异，揭示了视觉保真度与动力学真实性之间的权衡，为构建更高效的世界模型提供了重要的实证依据。
motivation: 尽管视觉世界模型能生成逼真的互动世界，但视觉真实性并不等同于动力学的真实性，本文旨在系统比较分类和连续预测对学习动力学的影响。
method: 设计了受控的2D和3D环境，系统比较了分类与连续预测在自回归下一个标记生成和迭代整帧生成下的动力学有效性、校准性和视觉质量。
results: 在2D和3D环境中，分类模型均以更少的训练计算量实现了更高的长程有效性，其中贪婪解码产生最高的有效性，而连续模型常出现角色消失等故障。
conclusion: 分类预测是学习世界动力学的一种计算效率更高且长程性能更强的途径。

title: Speculative Decoding Is Less Speculative Than You Think
authors: Guanning Zeng, Andrea Zanette
abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model inference by preparing candidate continuations before the target model generates them. Its efficiency depends on how well limited drafting computation anticipates the path the target will actually follow. Anticipating this path involves two sources of uncertainty: the target model's predictions and the randomness of sampling. Yet the former requires a target-model forward pass, while the latter can be fixed before drafting. Building on this observation, we introduce DICE (Draw-Informed Candidate Selection), which pre-samples and synchronizes verification randomness across drafting and verification. By combining these known draws with predictions from an existing drafter, DICE allocates computation toward continuations more likely to be used in the current sampling run. This principle guides node selection throughout draft-tree construction and extends to asynchronous prefetching, where DICE predicts which next-round drafts to prepare. Without additional drafter training or changes to the target sampling distribution, DICE achieves state-of-the-art decoding throughput across diverse settings, with speedups of up to 24.6pp over strong baselines.
zh_title: 投机解码比你想象的要少一些“投机”
translation: 投机解码通过在目标模型生成之前准备候选延续来加速语言模型的推理。其效率取决于有限的草稿计算能在多大程度上预测目标模型实际会遵循的路径。预测这条路径涉及两个不确定性来源：目标模型的预测和采样的随机性。然而，前者需要目标模型的前向传递，而后者可以在草稿生成之前被固定。基于这一观察，我们引入了DICE（Draw-Informed Candidate Selection），它在草稿和验证阶段预采样并同步验证随机性。通过将这些已知的抽样结果与现有草稿模型的预测相结合，DICE将计算资源分配给当前采样运行中最可能被使用的延续。这一原则指导了整个草稿树构建过程中的节点选择，并扩展到了异步预取中，其中DICE预测了下一轮需要准备的草稿。在无需额外的草稿模型训练或改变目标采样分布的情况下，DICE在各种设置下实现了最先进的解码吞吐量，相比强基线模型取得了高达24.6pp的加速。
tldr: 本文提出了DICE方法，通过预采样和随机性同步优化投机解码，在不改变目标分布和不增加模型训练的情况下显著提升大语言模型推理速度。
ai_comments: 该论文通过预采样和同步验证随机性，有效降低了投机解码中的不确定性，在无需额外训练草稿模型的情况下显著提升了推理吞吐量。
motivation: 投机解码的效率取决于草稿计算预测目标模型路径的能力，而该路径受到目标模型预测和采样随机性双重不确定性的影响，其中采样随机性可以在草稿生成前被固定。
method: 提出DICE（Draw-Informed Candidate Selection）方法，通过预采样和同步草稿与验证阶段的随机性，并结合现有草稿模型的预测结果来指导草稿树的构建和异步预取。
results: 在无需额外训练草稿模型或改变目标采样分布的情况下，DICE实现了最先进的解码吞吐量，相比强基线模型取得了高达24.6pp的加速。
conclusion: DICE通过巧妙地处理采样随机性和目标模型预测，展示了在保持目标采样分布不变的前提下进一步加速大模型推理的巨大潜力。

title: Renormalized Entropy from Symmetries: Simplicity Bias and Neural Heat Death
authors: Vasco Portilheiro, Samuel Liebana, Andrew Saxe, Peter Orbanz
abstract: Neural networks have parameter symmetries: parameter transformations that do not affect the represented function. How do these symmetries affect the functions that neural networks ultimately learn? We study the implicit bias arising from these symmetries by calculating the equilibrium distribution over represented functions under Langevin dynamics with Gaussian regularization. To isolate the effect of symmetries on this distribution, we study the limit in which the strength of the regularization is taken to zero. In certain cases, we show that the zero-regularization and infinite-time limits commute. In the low temperature limit, we recover known effective regularizations. At positive temperature, a renormalization procedure allows us to derive a novel entropy which predicts symmetry-induced preference for certain functions. For linear networks, we obtain explicit entropy terms that favor singular and low-rank functions. For networks with homogeneous activations, we find entropy terms that favor inactive neurons, which can lead to neural "heat death" in which equilibrium mass concentrates on networks with vanishing output. We interpret these results through the neural tangent kernel, as a simplicity bias selecting for functions that vary slowly under variations in the parameters.
zh_title: 基于对称性的重整化熵：简单性偏置与神经热寂
translation: 神经网络具有参数对称性：即不影响所表示函数的参数变换。这些对称性如何影响神经网络最终学习到的函数？我们通过计算高斯正则化下朗之万动力学中表示函数的平衡分布，研究了由这些对称性引起的隐式偏差。为了隔离对称性对该分布的影响，我们研究了正则化强度趋于零的极限。在某些情况下，我们证明了零正则化和无限时间极限是可交换的。在低温极限下，我们恢复了已知的有效正则化。在正温度下，重整化过程允许我们推导出一个新的熵，该熵预测了对称性对某些函数的偏好。对于线性网络，我们获得了倾向于奇异函数和低秩函数的显式熵项。对于具有齐次激活函数的网络，我们发现了倾向于不活跃神经元的熵项，这可能导致神经“热寂”，即平衡质量集中在输出消失的网络上。我们通过神经切线核将这些结果解释为选择随参数变化而变化缓慢的函数的简单性偏置。
tldr: 研究神经网络参数对称性如何通过重整化熵诱导简单性偏置并导致“神经热寂”。
ai_comments: 本文从参数对称性出发，通过朗之万动力学和重整化熵研究了神经网络的隐式偏差，揭示了对称性如何导致简单性偏置和神经热寂现象，为理解神经网络的泛化和学习行为提供了新颖的理论视角。
motivation: 研究神经网络的参数对称性（即不影响所表示函数的参数变换）如何影响神经网络最终学习到的函数。
method: 通过计算高斯正则化下朗之万动力学中表示函数的平衡分布，并在正则化强度趋于零的极限下研究对称性的影响，利用重整化程序在正温度下推导熵。
results: 对于线性网络，明确的熵项倾向于奇异函数和低秩函数；对于具有齐次激活函数的网络，倾向于不活跃的神经元，从而导致平衡质量集中在输出消失的网络上的“神经热寂”现象。
conclusion: 神经网络的参数对称性在零正则化极限下会诱导出一类新的重整化熵，从而导致对低秩函数和神经热寂状态的偏好。

title: Interpretable Tissue Architecture Complements Pathology Foundation Models
authors: Zeeshan Shahid, Hammam M. AlGhamdi
abstract: Tissue architecture provides important information for histopathological assessment, yet its complementary predictive value alongside pathology foundation-model representations remains insufficiently understood. This study investigates whether interpretable measurements of cellular and multicellular tissue organization provide additional predictive information beyond learned representations. We introduce a 139-dimensional cellular-to-community representation comprising nine feature groups characterizing nuclear morphology, cellular composition, spatial connectivity, community organization, and cell-cell interactions. Their predictive contributions are systematically evaluated independently and through feature-level fusion with CTransPath and PLIP embeddings using multiple-instance learning (MIL). On the BCNB dataset, estrogen receptor (ER) and progesterone receptor (PR) classification is evaluated across four MIL architectures using five-fold patient-disjoint cross-validation. Selected CTransPath fusion configurations achieved mean ROC-AUC values of 0.9144 (ER) and 0.8360 (PR), while PLIP fusion achieved 0.8791 and 0.8015, respectively. Patient-level analyses identified ER-associated differences in nuclear morphology, graph connectivity, cellular communities, and cell-cell interactions. On LungHist700, selected fusion configurations achieved higher mean ROC-AUC across four classification tasks, including adenocarcinoma versus squamous cell carcinoma (0.7967 versus 0.7137 for CTransPath alone). Overall, these findings suggest that interpretable tissue-architecture descriptors can complement foundation-model representations while providing measurable insights into histopathological organization.
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to Biomedical Signal Processing and Control
zh_title: 可解释的组织结构互补于病理学基础模型
translation: 组织结构为组织病理学评估提供了重要信息，然而其与病理学基础模型表示并列的互补预测价值仍未得到充分理解。本研究探讨了细胞和多细胞组织组织的可解释测量是否能提供超越学习表示的额外预测信息。我们引入了一个139维的细胞到群落表示，包含九个特征组，用于表征核形态、细胞组成、空间连通性、群落组织和细胞间相互作用。通过多实例学习（MIL），系统评估了它们独立以及与CTransPath和PLIP嵌入进行特征级融合的预测贡献。在BCNB数据集上，雌激素受体（ER）和孕激素受体（PR）分类在四种MIL架构下通过五折患者不相交交叉验证进行了评估。选定的CTransPath融合配置实现了0.9144（ER）和0.8360（PR）的平均ROC-AUC值，而PLIP融合分别达到了0.8791和0.8015。患者水平分析识别出了与ER相关的核形态、图连通性、细胞群落和细胞间相互作用的差异。在LungHist700上，选定的融合配置在四个分类任务中实现了更高的平均ROC-AUC，包括腺癌与鳞状细胞癌的分类（CTransPath单独为0.7137，而融合后更高）。总体而言，这些发现表明可解释的组织结构描述符可以补充基础模型表示，同时提供对组织病理学组织的可测量见解。
tldr: 将可解释的组织结构特征与病理学基础模型进行融合，能够显著提升癌症分类性能并增强模型的可解释性。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将可解释的细胞和多细胞组织结构特征与病理学基础模型（如CTransPath和PLIP）相结合，通过特征级融合提升了癌症分类性能，并增强了模型的可解释性，弥补了现有黑盒基础模型的不足。
motivation: 组织结构为组织病理学评估提供了重要信息，但其与病理学基础模型学到的表示之间的互补预测价值仍未得到充分理解。
method: 引入一个包含九个特征组的139维细胞到群落表示，通过特征级融合将其与CTransPath和PLIP嵌入结合，并在多个多实例学习（MIL）架构和数据集（BCNB、LungHist700）上进行评估。
results: 在BCNB和LungHist700数据集上，融合了组织结构特征的配置在各项分类任务中均取得了更高的平均ROC-AUC，且患者水平分析揭示了与ER相关的形态和空间特征差异。
conclusion: 可解释的组织结构描述符能够有效补充病理学基础模型的表示能力，在提升分类准确率的同时提供具可解释性的组织学洞察。

title: LesionAgent: Training-Free Agentic Tumor Tracking and Response Assessment in Longitudinal CT
authors: Maximilian Rokuss, Jeya Maria Jose Valanarasu, Alejandro Lozano, Benjamin Hamm, Yannick Kirchhoff, Fabian Isensee, Klaus Maier-Hein
abstract: Every few months, a cancer patient's CT scans decide whether treatment continues. 3D foundation models can now detect, segment, register and track lesions, yet none of them reads the scans as a radiologist does. A radiologist decides which findings are lesions, which are the same lesion months later and whether a new spot means progression, and checks each decision against the extensive rules of a clinical guideline. We introduce LesionAgent, an LLM agent that performs this read end to end without task-specific training. It operates frozen 3D models as tools, acts in 3D through coordinate-labelled views, remembers every lesion across visits in a registry, verifies every model output it relies on, and leaves every number to a deterministic guideline engine. On four public longitudinal CT datasets, LesionAgent tracks more lesions and measures them more accurately than every automatic baseline, and where the same 3D models chained by fixed rules call progression falsely at 33 of 56 follow-ups, it does so twice. On clinical follow-up CTs, it agrees with the radiologists' response at 20 of 23 follow-ups, including every change in response, and without training on DeepLesion, it retrieves more of its lesions than every tracker trained on it (89.0% vs. 87.4%). Its harness, not its LLM, makes the difference: given the same LLM and 3D models but not the harness, Claude Code reaches a detection F1 of 41% and LesionAgent 78%, and an open-weight LLM that can run inside the hospital rises from 6% to 73%. LesionAgent and a napari reading app for any LLM are available at https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/LesionAgent.
zh_title: LesionAgent：纵向CT中无需训练的智能体肿瘤追踪与疗效评估
translation: 每隔几个月，癌症患者的CT扫描结果就决定了治疗是否继续。3D基础模型现在可以检测、分割、配准和追踪病灶，但没有一个能像放射科医生那样解读扫描结果。放射科医生决定哪些发现是病灶、几个月后哪些是同一病灶、新出现的光点是否意味着疾病进展，并根据广泛的临床指南规则对每项决定进行核对。我们介绍了 LesionAgent，这是一个无需特定任务训练即可端到端完成此项解读的LLM代理。它将冻结的 3D 模型作为工具运行，通过带坐标标签的视图在 3D 空间中行动，在注册表中记住跨越多次访视的每一个病灶，验证它所依赖的每一个模型输出，并将所有数值计算留给确定性的指南引擎。在四个公开的纵向CT数据集上，LesionAgent 追踪了比所有自动基线更多的病灶，测量也更准确；在由固定规则链接的相同 3D 模型在 56 次随访中有 33 次错误判定进展的情况下，它的错误判定次数减半（仅一半）。在临床随访 CT 上，它在 23 次随访中有 20 次与放射科医生的反应一致（包括所有的反应变化），并且在未对 DeepLesion 进行训练的情况下，它检索到的病灶比所有在该数据集上训练过的追踪器还要多（89.0%对87.4%）。起决定作用的是它的运行框架（harness）而非LLM本身：给定相同的LLM和3D模型但没有该框架，Claude Code的检测 F1 分数达到了 41%，而 LesionAgent 达到了 78%；一个能够在医院内部运行的开源权重LLM的准确率从 6% 飙升至 73%。LesionAgent 以及适用于任何 LLM 的 napari 阅读应用程序已在 https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/LesionAgent 上开源。
tldr: LesionAgent 是一个基于大语言模型的代理，它通过结合冻结的 3D 模型和严谨的临床工作流框架，实现了精准的纵向 CT 肿瘤追踪与疗效评估，其性能超越了现有的大多数自动基线和特定训练模型。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型（LLM）代理与冻结的3D基础模型相结合，提出了一种无需特定训练的纵向CT肿瘤追踪与疗效评估框架（LesionAgent）。通过引入结构化的工作流 harness，它模拟了放射科医生的决策和临床指南复核过程，显著提升了病灶追踪的准确性和临床一致性，展现了很高的临床应用潜力。
motivation: 现有的 3D 基础模型能够检测、分割和追踪病灶，但无法像放射科医生那样依据临床指南端到端地解读扫描结果并进行复杂的纵向疗效评估。
method: 提出 LesionAgent，一个无需特定训练的 LLM 代理，将冻结的 3D 模型作为工具，通过坐标标记的视图在 3D 空间中操作，利用注册表跨访视记忆病灶，验证模型输出，并将计算交由确定性指南引擎处理。
results: 在四个公开的纵向CT数据集上，LesionAgent 的病灶追踪数量和准确率均优于所有自动基线模型，假阳性率显著降低，与放射科医生在疗效反应评估上的高度一致（23次随访中有20次达成一致），且无需训练即可在病灶检索上超越特定训练的追踪器。
conclusion: LesionAgent 无需针对性训练即可实现端到端的纵向CT肿瘤追踪和疗效评估，其精心设计的执行框架（harness）是性能突破的关键所在，并在公开和临床数据集上展现出优于现有基线的性能。

title: FairITR: Fairness-Aware Learning of Multicategory Individualized Treatment Rules
authors: Zeyu Chen, Wei Qian, Bintong Chen
abstract: Individualized treatment rules (ITRs) recommend treatment decisions based on individual characteristics and can improve treatment outcomes beyond traditional one-size-fits-all strategies. However, similar to other commonly used algorithmic decision-making methods, ITRs without considering model fairness may result in unfair decisions across groups defined by sensitive attributes, such as race or gender. Although extensive methods have been developed for ITR estimation, most focus solely on optimizing treatment outcomes, while research on fairness-aware ITRs remains limited. Moreover, the practical scenario of multicategory treatments is rarely considered in existing fair ITR studies. To address these gaps, we introduce a fairness notion for multicategory ITRs that requires treatment decisions to be independent of sensitive attributes, and then formulate the corresponding problem of estimating fair ITRs. To solve this problem, we further propose FairITR, a fairness-aware learning framework that jointly optimizes treatment outcomes and fairness. FairITR builds on angle-based classification for multicategory ITR learning and integrates adversarial learning with covariance-based regularization to mitigate unfairness in treatment decisions. A theoretical justification for the fairness properties induced by the adversarial debiasing mechanism is also provided. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show that FairITR substantially reduces unfairness in ITRs while maintaining competitive treatment values relative to existing baselines.
zh_title: FairITR：多分类个体化治疗规则的公平感知学习
translation: 个体化治疗规则（ITRs）根据个体特征推荐治疗方案，能够比传统的“一刀切”策略更好地改善治疗效果。然而，与其他常用的算法决策方法类似，不考虑模型公平性的ITRs可能会导致由种族或性别等敏感属性定义的群体之间做出不公平的决策。尽管已经为ITRs估计开发了大量方法，但大多数方法仅关注优化治疗结果，而对公平感知ITRs的研究仍然有限。此外，现有的公平ITR研究很少考虑多分类治疗的实际场景。为了解决这些空白，我们引入了一个针对多分类ITRs的公平性概念，要求治疗决策独立于敏感属性，并进而构建了估计公平ITRs的相应问题。为了解决这个问题，我们进一步提出了FairITR，这是一个联合优化治疗结果和公平性的公平感知学习框架。FairITR建立在用于多分类ITR学习的基于角度的分类之上，并将对抗学习与基于协方差的正规化相结合，以减轻治疗决策中的不公平性。论文还提供了对抗去偏机制所诱导的公平性质的理论证明。在真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，与现有基线相比，FairITR在保持竞争力的治疗价值的同时，显著减少了ITRs中的不公平性。
tldr: 提出FairITR框架，通过对抗学习和正规化方法联合优化多分类个体化治疗规则（ITRs）的治疗效果与公平性。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地提出了多分类个体化治疗规则（ITRs）的公平性学习框架，结合了基于角度的多分类ITR学习、对抗学习和基于协方差的正规化方法，兼顾了治疗效果与公平性，填补了多分类公平ITR研究的空白。
motivation: 现有的个体化治疗规则（ITRs）大多仅关注优化治疗结果，忽略了跨敏感属性群体的模型公平性，且现有公平ITR研究很少考虑多分类治疗的实际场景。
method: 提出FairITR框架，基于多分类ITR的角度分类方法，并整合了对抗学习与基于协方差的正规化方法来联合优化治疗效果和公平性。
results: 在真实数据集上的广泛实验表明，FairITR在显著减少ITR不公平性的同时，保持了与现有基线相比具有竞争力的治疗价值。
conclusion: FairITR能够有效减少多分类ITR中的不公平性，同时在真实世界数据集上保持了具有竞争力的治疗效果。

title: The Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework: Scalable Multimodal UX Attribution in Web Search
