These results demonstrate the importance of modeling nuclear-powered electric ships as coupled multi-domain systems and show that BESS integration can improve short-term load-following performance.
zh_title: 配备电池储能的SMR全电力船舶的负荷跟随动力学
translation: 小型模块化反应堆（SMR）正被视为未来全电力船舶的紧凑、高能量密度电源。在这类系统中，推进负荷的变化可以通过电网、汽轮发电机组、蒸汽发生器和反应堆传播，产生耦合的核、热、机械和电气瞬态过程。本文对配备和不配备电池储能系统（BESS）支持的SMR全电力船舶进行了集成的动态负荷跟随分析。该模型耦合了一体化压水堆、直流移动边界蒸汽发生器、简化汽轮机模型、同步发电机、交流船用电网、异步推进电机和并网BESS。通过电机转矩指令施加推进负荷减少，并对比了纯SMR与SMR+BESS配置的响应。结果表明，在没有BESS支持的情况下，推进电机功率的突然下降会在轮机机械功率和电能需求之间产生临时盈余，导致大的超频瞬态和快速的蒸汽循环调节。在BESS支持下，电池在瞬态期间吸收多余的电能，将频率峰值从约61.1 Hz降低至约60.06 Hz。BESS还间接平滑了上游蒸汽循环和反应堆的响应，包括蒸汽流量、蒸汽发生器压力、给水流量、冷却剂温度、反应性、反应堆热功率和蒸汽发生器区域长度。这些结果证明了将核动力电力船舶建模为耦合多域系统的重要性，并表明BESS集成可以改善短期负荷跟随性能。
tldr: 本文展示了电池储能系统（BESS）如何显著改善SMR驱动的全电力船舶的动态负荷跟随性能，抑制频率过冲并平抑反应堆热工波动。
ai_comments: 该论文首次对搭载小型模块化反应堆（SMR）和电池储能系统（BESS）的全电力船舶进行了集成动态负荷跟随分析。创新之处在于采用了多域耦合建模方法（核、热、机、电），并证明了BESS在抑制频率瞬变和平衡上游热工水力状态方面的显著优势。
motivation: 小型模块化反应堆（SMR）正被视为未来全电力船舶的高能量密度紧凑型电源，但推进负荷的变化会引发耦合的核、热、机、电瞬变，因此需要研究其动态负荷跟随性能及电池储能系统（BESS）的改善效果。
method: 建立了一个集成动态模型，将一体化压水堆、直流移动边界蒸汽generator、简化汽轮机模型、同步发电机、交流船用电网、异步推进电机和并网电池储能系统（BESS）耦合在一起，对比分析了有无BESS支持下的推进负荷减少瞬变响应。
results: 在没有BESS支持的情况下，推进电机功率的突然下降会导致发电机频率出现约61.1 Hz的大幅超频瞬变；而在BESS支持下，电池可吸收过剩电功率，将频率峰值降低至约60.06 Hz，同时间接平滑了上游蒸汽循环和反应堆的各项响应。
conclusion: 将电池储能系统集成到SMR驱动的全电力船舶中，可以显著缓解推进负荷波动引起的电网频率瞬变，并平抑上游蒸汽循环和反应堆的响应。

title: Model Carving: Training Transformers That Optimize Their Own Topology
authors: Kaden Zheng, Pratyusha Sharma
abstract: Machine learning has largely kept separate the choice of architecture and the process of training. A classic Transformer, for instance, trains a fixed set of attention and MLP sublayers at every layer, in the same order, and optimizes the weights within. This uniformity is a convention rather than a principled design choice, and it is likely suboptimal: the best architecture for a given task may be smaller, more efficient, and far from uniform. We believe that, ideally, training itself should shape the model's topology. To this end, we introduce Model Carving, which learns both a Transformer's weights and its architecture in a single run. By applying learnable, scalar gates to each sublayer, we allow the training loss to remove the model's own components during training -- freeing a smaller heterogeneous network inside. We evaluate Model Carving by pre-training standard Transformers from 140M to 2.7B parameters and looped Transformers from 140M to 1.3B. At equal training compute, carved models reach a lower validation loss than dense models trained with up to 1.7 times more compute. Furthermore, carved models also outperform size-matched models produced by pruning or distillation, suggesting that the best way to obtain small models for edge devices is to carve them during training, not to compress a large one afterwards. This advantage both grows with scale and carries over to downstream tasks such as few-shot evaluation and generation. Because the removed sublayers no longer run, carved models also cost up to 34% fewer FLOPs per token and decode up to 1.6 times faster without cost in quality. Our results show that architecture, like weights, should be learned and not fixed in advance, and that inside every large transformer is a smaller, faster, stronger one waiting to be carved out.
comment: 38 pages, 15 figures, 19 tables. Under review at ICLR 2027. Project page: https://kadenzheng.com/model-carving/
zh_title: 模型雕刻：训练能够优化自身拓扑结构的Transformer
translation: 机器学习在很大程度上将架构的选择与训练过程分离开来。例如，经典的Transformer在每一层训练一组固定且顺序相同的注意力机制和MLP子层，并优化其中的权重。这种统一性更多是一种惯例而非原则性的设计选择，并且很可能是次优的：给定任务的最佳架构可能更小、更高效且远非均匀。我们认为，理想情况下，训练本身应该塑造模型的拓扑结构。为此，我们引入了“模型雕刻”（Model Carving），它在单次运行中同时学习Transformer的权重和架构。通过对每个子层应用可学习的标量门控，我们允许训练损失在训练过程中移除模型的自身组件——从而释放出一个更小的异构网络。我们通过从140M到2.7B参数的标准Transformer和从140M到1.3B的循环Transformer来评估模型雕刻。在相等的训练计算量下，雕刻模型的验证损失低于使用高达1.7倍计算量训练的稠密模型。此外，雕刻模型还优于通过剪枝或蒸馏产生的大小匹配的模型，这表明获取用于边缘设备的小型模型的最佳方法是在训练期间对其进行雕刻，而不是事后压缩大型模型。这种优势随着规模的扩大而增长，并延续到了少样本评估和生成等下游任务中。由于被移除的子层不再运行，雕刻模型在不牺牲质量的前提下，每个token的FLOPs减少了高达34%，解码速度提升了高达1.6倍。我们的结果表明，架构应该像权重一样通过学习得到，而不是预先固定，并且在每一个大型Transformer内部，都有一个更小、更快、更强的Transformer等待被雕刻出来。
tldr: Model Carving通过在训练中引入可学习的门控机制动态优化Transformer的拓扑结构，在单次运行中生成更小、更快且性能更强的异构模型。
ai_comments: 本文提出了一种名为Model Carving的新方法，将架构搜索与权重训练合二为一，突破了传统Transformer结构固定且非均匀的限制，在效率和性能上取得了显著提升，对端侧模型部署具有重要的应用价值。
motivation: 传统的Transformer采用固定且均匀的架构，这往往不是最优的选择。为了克服这一局限性，作者认为理想的训练过程应该能够直接塑造模型的拓扑结构，从而针对特定任务获得更小、更高效的异构网络。
method: 通过对每个子层应用可学习的标量门控，使训练损失能够在训练过程中动态移除冗余组件，从而在单次运行中同时学习Transformer的权重和架构。
results: 在相等的训练计算量下，雕刻模型（carved models）达到了比使用多达1.7倍计算量的密集模型更低的验证损失，且优于通过剪枝或蒸馏得到的大小匹配的模型；同时，其每个token的FLOPs减少了高达34%，解码速度提升了高达1.6倍。
conclusion: 训练过程应该塑造模型的拓扑结构，架构应当像权重一样通过学习得到，而无需预先固定。

title: Ranking-Preserving Coreset Selection for Efficient Evolutionary Hyperparameter Optimization
authors: Mamoona Tasadduq, Maryam Bashir
abstract: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) is essential for high predictive performance, but its computational cost becomes prohibitive when candidate configurations require repeated training on large datasets. This paper proposes a ranking-preserving coreset (RPC) selection framework for accelerating evolutionary HPO. The method constructs a compact coreset that preserves the relative ranking of hyperparameter configurations observed on the full training data. Coreset selection is formulated as an evolutionary optimization problem that maximizes Spearman rank correlation between full-data and subset-based configuration rankings while penalizing subset size. The selected coreset is then used for HPO with three evolutionary algorithms: Genetic Algorithm (GA), Cross-generational elitist Selection, Heterogeneous Recombination and Cataclysmic Mutation (CHC), and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). Experiments on seven tabular, two text, and two image benchmark datasets show that RPC substantially reduces HPO time while maintaining test accuracy comparable to full-dataset HPO across decision tree, text classification, and image classification tasks. Across datasets and optimizers, HPO-stage speedups range from approximately 1.14x to 8.80x, while the one-time coreset construction cost is accounted for separately through end-to-end runtime and break-even analysis. On 20 held-out configurations excluded from coreset construction, RPC achieves higher ranking correlation than same-size random sampling on 8 of 11 datasets (dataset-level Wilcoxon signed-rank test, p = 0.014). These results show that ranking preservation extends beyond the configurations used during selection. The one-time construction cost can be amortized when the coreset is reused across HPO runs.
zh_title: 用于高效演化超参数优化的保持排序的核心集选择
translation: 超参数优化（HPO）对于实现高预测性能至关重要，但当候选配置需要在大型数据集上进行重复训练时，其计算成本往往高得令人望而却步。本文提出了一个用于加速演化HPO的排序保持核心集（RPC）选择框架。该方法构建了一个紧凑的核心集，能够保持在完整训练数据上观察到的超参数配置的相对排序。核心集选择被建模为一个演化优化问题，旨在最大化全数据与子集配置排名之间的斯皮尔曼等级相关性，同时惩罚子集大小。然后，将所选核心集用于结合三种演化算法（遗传算法（GA）、跨代精英选择、异构重组与灾变突变（CHC）以及粒子群优化（PSO））的HPO中。在7个表格、2个文本和2个图像基准数据集上的实验表明，RPC在决策树、文本分类和图像分类任务中，大幅减少了HPO时间，同时保持了与全数据集HPO相当的测试准确率。在各个数据集和优化器中，HPO阶段的加速比大约在1.14倍到8.80倍之间，而一次性的核心集构建成本则通过端到端运行时间和盈亏平衡分析进行了单独核算。在排除在核心集构建之外的20个保留配置上，RPC在11个数据集中的8个上实现了比同等大小随机采样更高的排名相关性（数据集级威尔科克森符号秩检验，p = 0.014）。这些结果表明，排名保持能力延伸到了选择过程中使用的配置之外。当核心集在多次HPO运行中重复使用时，一次性构建成本可以被摊销。
tldr: 本文提出了一种排序保持核心集（RPC）选择框架，通过构建紧凑的核心集来加速演化超参数优化，在大幅提升优化速度的同时保持了优异的测试准确率。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的排序保持核心集（RPC）选择框架，用于加速演化超参数优化。通过将核心集选择建模为最大化斯皮尔曼等级相关的演化优化问题，有效减少了HPO的计算成本，并在多个基准数据集上验证了其加速效果和泛化能力。创新点在于保持了配置间的相对排名，且核心集可跨运行复用以分摊构建成本。
motivation: 超参数优化（HPO）对于实现高性能至关重要，但当候选配置需要在大型数据集上进行重复训练时，其计算成本过高，因此需要加速HPO过程。
method: 提出了一种排序保持核心集（RPC）选择框架，将其公式化为一个最大化全数据与子集配置排名之间斯皮尔曼等级相关性并惩罚子集大小的演化优化问题，并结合遗传算法（GA）、CHC和粒子群优化（PSO）三种演化算法进行HPO。
results: 在7个表格、2个文本和2个图像基准数据集上的实验表明，HPO阶段的加速比约为1.14倍到8.80倍，同时保持了与全数据集HPO相当的测试准确率；在未用于核心集构建的20个保留配置上，RPC在11个数据集中的8个上实现了比同等大小随机采样更高的排名相关性。
conclusion: RPC框架能够有效加速演化超参数优化，在大幅减少HPO运行时间的同时，保持了与全数据集HPO相当的测试准确率，且核心集具有良好的泛化能力和可复用性。

title: Non-penetrating World Models
authors: Yuhang Dai, Yinwei Wu, Ziyue Lin, Han Ji, Xingyi Yang
abstract: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles. Our evaluation reveals that none of the open-source models can reliably prevent such failures. Surprisingly, however, these models already encode the information needed to predict such violations. We find that the hidden states of diffusion transformers (DiTs) can predict whether a candidate action will penetrate an obstacle. Building on this, we introduce NoPeWorld, a lightweight framework that detects and prevents penetration. Specifically, we train a small prediction head on top of a frozen DiT's hidden states to read out if a candidate action is safe or not. Unsafe actions are then replaced with safe ones that best preserve the original intent. Despite its simplicity, NoPeWorld substantially reduces the physical violation rate, averaged over six video world models, from 74% to 16%. Remarkably, our method shows zero-shot generalization to open-domain imagery, third-person viewpoints, and moving obstacles. We publicly release our code, the NoPeBench benchmark, and model weights. Project Page: https://nopeworld.github.io .
translation: 我们研究了防止交互式视频世界模型中物体穿透的新问题。为了解现有模型如何处理该问题，我们推出了 NoPeBench，这是一个评估世界模型对物理障碍物反应的基准。我们的评估显示，没有一个开源模型能可靠地防止此类失效。然而令人惊讶的是，这些模型已经编码了预测此类违规所需的信息。我们发现扩散变压器（DiTs）的隐藏状态可以预测候选动作是否会穿透障碍物。在此基础上，我们推出了 NoPeWorld，这是一个轻量级的检测和防止穿透的框架。具体而言，我们在冻结的 DiT 隐藏状态之上训练了一个小型预测头，以读出候选动作是否安全。然后，将不安全动作替换为最能保留原始意图的安全动作。尽管结构简单，NoPeWorld 将六个视频世界模型的平均物理违规率从 74% 大幅降低至 16%。值得注意的是，我们的方法对开放域图像、第三人称视角和移动障碍物表现出了零样本泛化能力。我们公开了代码、NoPeBench 基准和模型权重。项目主页：https://nopeworld.github.io。
tldr: 通过利用扩散变压器隐藏状态中的内置信息，NoPeWorld框架能够有效检测并防止交互式视频世界模型中的物体穿透现象。
ai_comments: 该论文针对交互式视频世界模型中常见的物体穿透物理规律失效问题，提出了NoPeBench基准以及轻量级框架NoPeWorld。创新点在于利用预训练扩散变压器（DiT）中固有的隐藏状态来预测碰撞，无需对基础模型进行大规模重新训练，展现出优秀的零样本泛化能力。
motivation: 现有的交互式视频世界模型在处理物理障碍时经常失效，无法防止物体穿透现象，因此需要研究如何解决这一物理不一致性问题。
method: 引入NoPeBench基准评估物理障碍响应；发现扩散变压器（DiT）的隐藏状态编码了穿透信息；提出NoPeWorld框架，在冻结的DiT隐藏状态上训练小型预测头以识别不安全动作，并将其实时替换为最符合原意的安全动作。
results: 在六个视频世界模型上，NoPeWorld将物理违规率从74%大幅降低至16%，并且在开放域图像、第三人称视角和移动障碍物上表现出零样本泛化能力。
conclusion: 通过在冻结的DiT隐藏状态上训练一个小型预测头，NoPeWorld能够有效检测并纠正不安全动作，大幅降低了世界模型中的物理穿透率，同时保持了良好的泛化性。

title: Your Camera Can Hear You: Side-Channel Acoustic Eavesdropping via Android Camera2 Metadata
authors: Guangyuan Ji, Wenjing Wang, Bingsheng Zhang
abstract:
To prevent motion sensors from acting as covert microphones, Android 12+ caps SensorManager gyroscope and accelerometer rates at 200 Hz by default, requires HIGH_SAMPLING_RATE_SENSORS for higher rates, and throttles sensors back to 200 Hz when the microphone toggle is off. We show that Android's Camera2 subsystem bypasses these defenses. During an active Camera2 session, Camera HAL stabilization pipelines record high-rate gyroscope measurements and export them via vendor CaptureResult metadata. Loudspeaker speech excites chassis vibrations that couple into this path. Across 50 smartphones (2020-2026) from 10 vendors, 37 expose gyroscope metadata via Camera2, and 26 exceed 200 Hz--including six flagship models at 800-1000 Hz, double SensorManager's 400-500 Hz ceiling. This channel requires neither RECORD_AUDIO nor HIGH_SAMPLING_RATE_SENSORS and defeats privacy switches: turning off the microphone toggle does not throttle metadata, and turning off the camera toggle blanks only video frames while 800-1000 Hz metadata keeps streaming.
  To build a zero-profiling attack that generalizes to unseen phones, we introduce Source-to-Leakage Learning (S2L). Prior attacks train on real sensor traces, entangling speech with a specific phone's mechanical resonances and sampling rate. S2L decouples speech content from hardware acoustics using a physics-constrained forward simulator. Trained exclusively on simulated leakage without target-phone traces, our universal recognizer CamEar achieves 52.1% mean word accuracy (up to 61.8%) and 74.3% character accuracy (up to 80.7%) across the six 800-1000 Hz phones. In contrast, ISpyU models fine-tuned on real target-phone data drop to 25.9% word accuracy on unseen phones; CamEar improves cross-device accuracy by 101.4% and outperforms ISpyU's same-device models on every tested phone.
zh_title: 你的相机能听到你：通过Android Camera2元数据的侧信道声学窃听
translation:
为了防止运动传感器充当隐蔽麦克风，Android 12及以上版本默认将SensorManager陀螺仪和加速度计的采样率限制在200 Hz，更高频率需要HIGH_SAMPLING_RATE_SENSORS权限，并且在关闭麦克风开关时将传感器节流回200 Hz。我们发现Android的Camera2子系统绕过了这些防御。在活动的Camera2会话期间，相机HAL稳定管道记录高速陀螺仪测量值，并通过供应商的CaptureResult元数据导出。扬声器语音激发底盘振动并耦合到该路径中。在来自10个厂商的50部智能手机（2020-2026年）中，有37部通过Camera2暴露了陀螺仪元数据，26部超过了200 Hz——其中包括6款达到800-1000 Hz的旗舰机型，是SensorManager的400-500 Hz上限的两倍。该通道既不需要RECORD_AUDIO也不需要HIGH_SAMPLING_RATE_SENSORS权限，并且能击败隐私开关：关闭麦克风开关不会节流元数据，而关闭相机开关只会使视频帧变白，而800-1000 Hz的元数据仍在持续流式传输。
为了构建适用于未见过手机的零配置攻击，我们引入了源到泄漏学习（S2L）。先前的攻击在真实传感器轨迹上训练，将语音与特定手机的机械共振和采样率纠缠在一起。S2L使用物理约束的正向模拟器将语音内容与硬件声学解耦。我们的通用识别器CamEar仅在模拟泄漏上训练，无需目标手机的轨迹，在六款800-1000 Hz手机上实现了52.1%的平均词准确率（最高61.8%）和74.3%的字符准确率（最高80.7%）。相比之下，在真实目标手机数据上微调的ISpyU模型在未见过的手机上的词准确率下降到25.9%；CamEar将跨设备准确率提高了101.4%，并在每个测试手机上都优于ISpyU的同设备模型。
tldr: 攻击者可利用Android相机元数据中的高速陀螺仪数据绕过隐私开关进行窃听，无需录音权限即可将手机变成窃听器。
ai_comments: 本文揭示了一种利用Android Camera2元数据进行侧信道声学窃听的新型攻击方式，巧妙绕过了Android系统的传感器速率限制和麦克风隐私开关。引入的S2L学习方法无需目标手机真实训练数据即可实现跨设备泛化，对移动端隐私防护敲响了警钟。
motivation: 尽管Android 12+对运动传感器（如陀螺仪和加速度计）的采样率进行了限制和隐私节流，但研究者发现Android的Camera2子系统绕过了这些防御，因此旨在探索利用相机元数据进行声学窃听的可行性及通用攻击防御。
method: 利用Android Camera2会话期间相机HAL稳定管道导出的高速陀螺仪元数据，并提出Source-to-Leakage Learning (S2L)方法，通过物理约束的正向模拟器解耦语音内容与硬件声学，训练通用识别器CamEar。
results: 测试的50部手机中有37部通过Camera2暴露陀螺仪元数据，26部超过200 Hz（其中6款旗舰机达到800-1000 Hz）。提出的CamEar在无需目标手机真实数据训练的情况下，在6款高频手机上实现了平均52.1%的词准确率和74.3%的字符准确率，跨设备准确率比ISpyU提升了101.4%。
conclusion: 研究证明了Android Camera2元数据存在严重的声学侧信道隐私漏洞，现有的权限和硬件开关无法完全防御，必须对相机元数据流中的高频传感器数据进行限制和净化。

title: Convergence of a finite element Chorin projection method for the stochastic Navier--Stokes equations
authors: Franziska Weber
abstract: We analyze a fully discrete finite element projection method for the stochastic incompressible Navier--Stokes equations with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions and multiplicative noise. We show solvability and uniform moment estimates for the intermediate and the corrected velocity approximations under the assumption that the initial data is square-integrable and divergence free, and that the deterministic forcing term is bounded in $L^{q}(0,T;H^{-1}(D))$ for a sufficiently large $q$. Under standard stability and approximation assumptions on the finite element spaces and a coupling condition on the spatial and temporal discretization parameters, we prove convergence of a subsequence to a martingale solution of the stochastic Navier--Stokes equations. The analysis combines the complementary spatial and temporal estimates of the predicted and the corrected velocity approximations and uses the numerical dissipation to identify their common limit. We establish tightness of the piecewise constant temporal interpolations of the velocity field approximations using Aldous' criterion combined with the uniform discrete moment estimates. The convergence result holds in two and three space dimensions as it does not rely on any additional regularity of the limiting martingale solution beyond the one naturally available from the energy inequality. Finally, we demonstrate the performance of the scheme in numerical experiments in two space dimensions for smooth and vortex sheet initial data.
zh_title: 随机Navier--Stokes方程有限元Chorin投影法的收敛性
translation: 我们分析了具有齐次Dirichlet边界条件和乘性噪声的随机不可压缩Navier--Stokes方程的完全离散有限元投影方法。在初始数据平方可积且无散度，以及确定性强迫项在$L^{q}(0,T;H^{-1}(D))$中对于足够大的$q$有界的情况下，我们证明了中间和修正速度近似值的可解性和一致矩估计。在有限元空间的标准稳定性和近似假设以及空间和时间离散化参数的耦合条件下，我们证明了子序列收敛到随机Navier--Stokes方程的鞅解。该分析结合了预测和修正速度近似值的互补空间和时间估计，并利用数值耗散来识别它们的共同极限。我们利用Aldous准则结合一致离散矩估计，建立了速度场近似值的分段常数时间插值的紧性。收敛结果在二维和三维空间中均成立，因为它不依赖于极限鞅解的任何额外正则性，而是自然地从能量不等式中获得。最后，我们通过在二维空间中对光滑和涡片初始数据进行的数值实验，展示了该方案的性能。
tldr: 本文分析并证明了用于随机不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程的完全离散有限元投影法的收敛性，适用于二维和三维空间。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它在随机Navier--Stokes方程的背景下，对有限元Chorin投影方法的收敛性进行了严格的数学分析，特别是在二维和三维空间中均能成立，且不依赖于额外的正则性假设，这对于随机偏微分方程的数值分析具有重要意义。
motivation: 分析和证明一种用于随机不可压缩Navier--Stokes方程的完全离散有限元投影方法的收敛性。
method: 本文分析了一种用于具有齐次Dirichlet边界条件和乘性噪声的随机不可压缩Navier--Stokes方程的完全离散有限元投影方法。在特定条件下，证明了中间和修正速度近似值的可解性和一致矩估计。在标准稳定性和近似假设以及空间和时间离散化参数的耦合条件下，证明了子序列收敛到随机Navier--Stokes方程的鞅解。分析结合了预测和修正速度近似值的互补空间和时间估计，并利用数值耗散识别共同极限。使用Aldous准则结合一致离散矩估计建立了速度场近似值的分段常数时间插值的紧性。最后，通过数值实验展示了该方案的性能。
results: 在特定假设下，中间和修正速度近似值具有可解性和一致矩估计。证明了子序列收敛到随机Navier--Stokes方程的鞅解。收敛结果在二维和三维空间中均成立，且不依赖于极限鞅解的任何额外正则性。数值实验展示了该方案在二维空间中对光滑和涡片初始数据的良好性能。
conclusion: 本文成功地证明了用于随机Navier--Stokes方程的有限元Chorin投影法的收敛性，该方法在二维和三维空间中均有效，且不依赖于额外的正则性，并通过数值实验验证了其性能。

title: Task2Hand: A Contact-Grounded Skill for Parametric Dexterous-Hand Morphology Design
authors: Haoyang Wang, Weibo Gao, Zhengxiong Li, Lingfeng Tao
abstract: Dexterous hand design demands repeated expert work across geometry, robot-description code, collision debugging, grasp initialization, and policy training. We present Task2Hand, a Skill: a specification package that turns a functional manipulation brief into a parameterized hand model and routes every candidate through cost-ordered contact, dynamics, and learning gates. Each gate returns a status and an evidence record; on failure, the Skill records the earliest blocker, revises one bounded parameter group, and reruns the cheaper gates. The agent generates, validates, and trains autonomously within declared bounds, and escalates trade-offs, plateaus, and conflicting evidence to a human who sets the next design direction. An evidence-driven design trajectory for bidirectional in-hand manipulation yielded SAGE Hand (Skill-Aware Generative Embodiment): four fingers, 16 actuated DoF, an integrated guiding palm, compact roots, cylindrical tips, and a collision-cleared opposable thumb. Under a matched training protocol, SAGE Hand reaches 45.6% task success on a hexagonal prism against 37.3% for the LEAP hand, and 70.8% on a bicolor cylinder against 51.6%. Dense simulated tactile input more than halves the cylinder drop rate. In a controlled iteration study, the Skill path preserves capture at 164/165 trials while the path without the Skill degrades to 14/165, confirming that the gates act as a regression guard during refinement. Accepted candidates pack with URDF/MJCF, metrics, checkpoints, and a provenance manifest.
zh_title: Task2Hand：用于参数化灵巧手形态设计的接触基础技能
translation: 灵巧手的设计需要在几何学、机器人描述代码、碰撞调试、抓取初始化和策略训练等方面进行重复的专家工作。我们提出了 Task2Hand——一种技能：它是一个规范包，可将功能操作简报转化为参数化手部模型，并通过成本排序的接触、动力学和学习门控来路由每个候选模型。每个门控返回状态和证据记录；失败时，该技能记录最早的阻塞点，修订一个有界参数组，并重新运行成本较低的门控。智能体在声明的范围内自主生成、验证和训练，并将权衡、平台期和冲突证据升级给人工以设定下一个设计方向。用于双向手内操作的证据驱动设计轨迹产生了 SAGE Hand（技能感知生成具身）：四根手指、16个驱动自由度、一个集成引导手掌、紧凑的根部、圆柱形指尖和一个无碰撞的对置拇指。在匹配的训练协议下，SAGE Hand 在六角棱柱上的任务成功率为 45.6%（LEAP 手为 37.3%），在双色圆柱体上为 70.8%（LEAP 手为 51.6%）。密集的模拟触觉输入使圆柱体掉落率降低了一半以上。在对照迭代研究中，技能路径在 164/165 次试验中保持了捕获率，而没有技能的路径则退化至 14/165，这证实了门控在精炼过程中起到了回归保护的作用。被接受的候选者打包有 URDF/MJCF、指标、检查点和出处清单。
tldr: Task2Hand是一个自动化、基于门控机制的灵巧手形态设计框架，成功生成了超越现有设计的SAGE Hand。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种名为Task2Hand的接触基础技能框架，实现了多指灵巧手形态设计的自动化和参数化，通过证据驱动的设计轨迹成功开发了SAGE Hand，显著提升了抓取和操作任务的成功率。其创新点在于引入了门控机制作为回归保护，极大地减少了人工调试的成本。
motivation: 传统的灵巧手设计需要专家在几何学、代码编写、碰撞调试、抓取初始化和策略训练等方面进行重复且繁琐的工作，缺乏一种自动化的、基于任务的形态设计方法。
method: 提出Task2Hand技能包，将功能操作需求转化为参数化手部模型，并通过成本排序的接触、动力学和学习门控对候选模型进行验证和迭代，失败时记录阻碍并修正有界参数。
results: 基于Task2Hand生成了SAGE Hand（4指，16自由度），在六角棱柱和双色圆柱体操作任务上的成功率显著优于LEAP手，且受控研究证明该技能路径能有效防止设计退化。
conclusion: Task2Hand通过系统化的门控机制和自主迭代，有效解决了灵巧手设计中的复杂协同问题，并成功推出了性能优于现有LEAP手的新型SAGE Hand。

title: On the Complete Feature Set for ADHD Classification in Children and Adolescents Based on EEG Signals
authors: Javier Sanchis, Álvaro Navarro, Jorge García-Carrasco, Tahar Kechadi, Juan Trujillo
abstract: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder is a neurodevelopmental condition that can affect attention, activity and impulse control. Electroencephalography (EEG) records brain activity as children and adolescents perform cognitive tasks. However, comparing features derived from these recordings requires consistent signal preparation, shared analysis windows and documented quality decisions. We curated 669 existing BALLADEER recordings from 156 participants across five task conditions so that researchers can compare seven EEG feature families on the same time intervals for each participant and task. The dataset links continuous signals to precomputed measurements from 115 feature definitions or templates and records the quality decisions made for each recording. Analyses must still account for repeated measurements within participants, residual artefacts and differences between acquisition systems. Technical validation covered signal integrity, numerical checks on feature estimators and completeness of the released files. In every task, the median proportion of recording time retained after preprocessing was 100%. To illustrate reuse, we report saved participant-held-out evaluations comparing XGBoost using all seven families on eight-second windows with a predictor based only on recruitment-group prevalence in the training fold. Recruitment-group discrimination was stronger in Robots than in the three Slackline conditions. These descriptive results from overlapping cohorts do not establish diagnostic validity. The dataset, curation software and aggregate results for the predictive example are publicly available.
comment: 28 pages, 7 figures. EEG dataset (v1.0.0): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21982978 EEG preprocessing and feature extraction software with XGBoost example (v1.1.0): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24399993
zh_title: 关于基于脑电图信号的儿童和青少年多动症分类的完整特征集
translation: 注意缺陷多动障碍是一种神经发育疾病，会影响注意力、活动和冲动控制。脑电图（EEG）记录了儿童和青少年执行认知任务时的大脑活动。然而，比较从这些记录中提取的特征需要一致的信号准备、共享的分析窗口和记录的质量决策。我们整理了来自156名参与者在五种任务条件下的669个现有BALLADEER记录，以便研究人员可以在每个参与者和任务的相同时间间隔内比较七个EEG特征家族。该数据集将连续信号与来自115个特征定义或模板的预计算测量值关联起来，并记录了对每个记录做出的质量决策。分析仍必须考虑参与者内部的重复测量、残余伪影以及采集系统之间的差异。技术验证涵盖了信号完整性、特征估计器的数值检查以及发布文件的完整性。在每个任务中，预处理后保留的记录时间中位数比例为100%。为了说明重用，我们报告了保存的参与者留一法评估结果，该评估比较了使用所有七个家族在八秒窗口上运行的XGBoost与仅基于训练折叠中招募组流行率的预测器。在“机器人”任务中，招募组的判别力强于三种“走钢丝”任务。这些来自重叠队列的描述性结果不建立诊断有效性。数据集、整理软件和预测示例的聚合结果已公开。
tldr: 本文介绍了一个经过精心整理的EEG数据集，包含156名参与者的669个记录，旨在为ADHD分类研究提供标准化的特征比较平台，并展示了其在XGBoost分类中的应用潜力，强调了数据质量和标准化处理的重要性。
ai_comments: 这项工作通过提供一个大规模、高质量且标准化的EEG数据集，为ADHD分类研究奠定了重要基础。其创新之处在于对现有数据的精心整理和标准化处理，解决了长期以来EEG研究中数据比较困难的问题。数据集的公开可用性极大地降低了研究门槛，有望加速ADHD诊断生物标志物的发现。然而，论文也明确指出，初步的预测结果仅为说明性，不具有诊断有效性，这提醒未来的研究者需要更深入的验证。
motivation: 现有EEG记录的特征比较缺乏一致的信号准备、共享的分析窗口和记录的质量决策，阻碍了研究进展。因此，需要一个标准化的数据集来促进ADHD分类中EEG特征的比较研究。
method: 研究人员整理了156名参与者在五种任务条件下获得的669个现有BALLADEER EEG记录。他们标准化了信号准备、分析窗口和质量决策。数据集将连续信号与115个特征定义或模板的预计算测量值联系起来，并记录了每个记录的质量决策。为了说明数据重用，他们使用XGBoost模型，结合所有七种特征家族，在八秒窗口上进行参与者留一法评估，并与仅基于训练折叠中招募组流行率的预测器进行比较。
results: 经过预处理后，每个任务中保留的记录时间中位数比例为100%，表明数据质量良好。在“机器人”任务中，招募组的判别力强于三种“走钢丝”任务。这些描述性结果不建立诊断有效性。数据集、整理软件和预测示例的聚合结果已公开。
conclusion: 本文成功创建了一个高质量、标准化的EEG数据集，用于ADHD分类研究中的特征比较。尽管初步的预测示例结果表明了其潜力，但这些结果尚不能确立诊断有效性。数据集的公开可用性将促进未来的研究。

title: No Polynomial-Time Algorithm For Tarski Fixed Points Unless Cryptographic Assumptions Fail
authors: Eleni Batziou, John Fearnley, Alexandros Hollender, Rahul Savani
abstract: We study the time complexity of finding a Tarski fixed point. We provide a subexponential-time reduction from the Unique End of Potential Line (UEOPL) problem to the problem of finding a Tarski fixed point. Using a range of known cryptographic lower bounds for UEOPL, our reduction implies a range of conditional lower bounds on the running time of any algorithm that finds a Tarski fixed point. The strongest of these give quasi-polynomial-time lower bounds for the problem. We also obtain a similar quasi-polynomial-time lower bound for Tarski based instead on a weak exponential-time type hypothesis for UEOPL. These running time lower bounds match the recently discovered quasi-polynomial query lower bounds for the problem.
zh_title: 除非密码学假设失败，否则塔斯基不动点没有多项式时间算法
translation: 我们研究寻找塔斯基不动点的时间复杂度。我们提供了一个从唯一潜在线端点（UEOPL）问题到寻找塔斯基不动点问题的亚指数时间归约。利用UEOPL的一系列已知密码学下界，我们的归约意味着任何寻找塔斯基不动点的算法的运行时间都存在一系列条件下的计算下界。其中最强的给出了该问题的准多项式时间下界。我们还基于UEOPL的弱指数时间类型假设，得到了塔斯基不动点问题的类似准多项式时间下界。这些运行时间下界与该问题最近发现的准多项式查询下界相匹配。
tldr: 该研究将塔斯基不动点问题的计算复杂度与密码学假设联系起来，表明除非某些密码学假设不成立，否则不存在有效（多项式时间）的算法来找到塔斯基不动点，并提出了亚指数时间归约和准多项式时间下界。
ai_comments: 这项研究将塔斯基不动点问题的计算复杂度与密码学领域的前沿问题联系起来，具有重要的理论意义。通过利用密码学下界，研究为理解该问题的计算难度提供了新的视角，并得到了与现有研究相匹配的下界。然而，该研究的结论是基于“除非密码学假设失败”的条件，这意味着如果这些密码学假设不成立，则可能存在更快的算法，这一点值得进一步探讨。
motivation: 研究塔斯基不动点的计算时间复杂度，并将其与密码学假设联系起来，以推导其计算下界。
method: 从唯一潜在线端点（UEOPL）问题到寻找塔斯基不动点问题进行亚指数时间归约，并利用已知的密码学下界来推导塔斯基不动点问题的条件计算下界。
results: 推导出了寻找塔斯基不动点问题的准多项式时间下界，并基于UEOPL的弱指数时间类型假设得到了类似的准多项式时间下界。这些下界与最近发现的该问题的准多项式查询下界相匹配。
conclusion: 除非某些密码学假设（如UEOPL的密码学下界）失败，否则不存在寻找塔斯基不动点的多项式时间算法。该研究为塔斯基不动点问题提供了新的计算下界。

title: Recognizing $k$-inducible Digraphs is NP-complete
authors: Felix Brandt, Fabian Frank
abstract: A digraph is k-inducible if its arcs correspond to the pairwise majority relation of a preference profile with k voters. By McGarvey's theorem, every asymmetric digraph is k-inducible for some k, but for every fixed k there are digraphs that are not k-inducible. Whether a digraph is 1-inducible or 2-inducible can easily be decided in polynomial time. The complexity of deciding whether a digraph is k-inducible for every fixed $k\geq 3$ has been a long-standing open problem. We prove that deciding whether a tournament is 3-inducible is NP-complete and then leverage this result to show that deciding whether a digraph is k-inducible is NP-complete for every fixed $k\geq 3$. Our results imply that, unless P=NP, k-inducible digraphs cannot be characterized by finitely many forbidden induced subdigraphs.
zh_title: 识别 $k$-可导有向图是 NP-complete 的
translation: 若一个有向图的弧对应于具有 $k$ 个投票者的偏好轮廓的两两多数关系，则该有向图是 $k$-可导的。根据 McGarvey 定理，每个不对称的有向图对于某个 $k$ 都是 $k$-可导的，但对于每个固定的 $k$，都存在非 $k$-可导的有向图。判断一个有向图是否为 1-可导或 2-可导可以轻松在多项式时间内判定。判定一个有向图对于每个固定的 $k \ge 3$ 是否为 $k$-可导的复杂度一直是一个长期存在的公开问题。我们证明了判断一个锦标赛图是否为 3-可导图是 NP-complete 的，并利用这一结果表明，对于每个固定的 $k \ge 3$，判断一个有向图是否为 $k$-可导图是 NP-complete 的。我们的结果表明，除非 P=NP，$k$-可导有向图不能通过有限个禁止导出子图来刻画。
tldr: 论文证明了对于任意固定的 $k \ge 3$，判断一个有向图是否为 $k$-可导图是 NP-complete 的。
ai_comments: 该论文解决了计算社会 choice 理论中一个长期存在的公开问题，证明了判断有向图 $k$-可导性在 $k\ge 3$ 时是 NP-complete 的，具有重要的理论价值。
motivation: 解决关于判断有向图在 $k \ge 3$ 时是否为 $k$-可导图的计算复杂度的长期公开问题。
method: 通过证明判断锦标赛图是否为 3-可导图是 NP-complete 的，并基于此结果将结论推广到对于所有固定的 $k \ge 3$，判断有向图是否为 $k$-可导图也是 NP-complete 的。
results: 证明了对于任意固定的 $k \ge 3$，判定一个有向图是否为 $k$-可导图是 NP-complete 的，并且这意味着这类图无法被有限个禁止导出子图刻画（除非 P=NP）。
conclusion: 对于任意固定的 $k \ge 3$，判断一个有向图是否为 $k$-可导图是 NP-complete 的，且除非 P=NP，否则 $k$-可导有向图无法通过有限个禁止导出子图来刻画。

title: A Methodologically Rigorous Benchmark of Linear Regression,RNN, and LSTM for S&P 500 Forecasting:Identifying Sources of Performance Inflation in Financial DeepLearning
authors: Hari Sitaula, Joseph Opitz
abstract: This study examines one-day-ahead forecasting of the S&P 500 closing level using a 2006-2025 dataset that includes fundamental price data, macroeconomic indicators, and engineered technical features. We benchmark three model families, namely linear regression, vanilla recurrent neural networks (RNN), and long short-term memory networks (LSTM), within a unified preprocessing and chronological evaluation pipeline. A central contribution of this work is a methodological audit of common practices in the deep-learning-for-stock-prediction literature. We identify three sources of result inflation that frequently appear in published methodologies: wavelet-denoised evaluation targets, the absence of a naive persistence baseline, and best-of-N replicate reporting. We then re-evaluate all model families under a corrected protocol that controls for each. Performance is reported using root mean squared error, mean absolute percentage error, and the Pearson correlation coefficient, averaged across N = 30 independent replicates per configuration. We compare models on accuracy, stability across replicates, and architectural depth sensitivity, using the naive persistence forecast (predicting today's close as tomorrow's close) as a primary baseline against which all candidate models must demonstrate improvement.

title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
authors: Chang Nie, Chaoyou Fu, Songlin Liu, Yiqing Hu, Caifeng Shan
abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. Standard Transformers accumulate layer-wise, token-level KV caches, incurring linear GPU memory growth and quadratic computational complexity as the context expands. In contrast, linear-time architectures compress history into fixed-size states, but struggle to retain fine-grained details. We introduce MemOnce, a foundation architecture that learns scalable memory states for language models. MemOnce is based on two core designs: (a) Memory encoder-decoder: it caches only a small subset of final-layer hidden states as compact memory representations and dynamically decodes them back into KV caches for attention layers; (b) Memory sparse attention: for each continual input, MemOnce adaptively retrieves relevant memory representations, with the sparse indices computed only once across layers. Coupling these two designs enables efficient on-the-fly memory loading and KV cache decoding, drastically reducing the GPU memory footprint and achieving linear-time complexity. We conduct extensive experiments to show that MemOnce outperforms Transformers and other architectures across varying model sizes, context lengths, and training paradigms (pretraining and post-training adaptation). In particular, adapting Qwen3.5-4B with MemOnce reduces memory state cache by 1313$\times$ and prefill latency by 6.9$\times$ at 1M context, and improves throughput by 3.5$\times$ and overall memory performance by +5.77%. Finally, MemOnce generalizes zero-shot to downstream representation tasks, achieving competitive results against specialized models.
zh_title: MemOnce：一种用于大型语言模型的大规模内存架构
translation: 部署大型语言模型（LLM）进行长时限和持续交互需要为未来的推理维护可重用的内存状态，这对现有架构提出了挑战。标准的 Transformer 会累积层级、令牌级别的 KV 缓存，随着上下文的扩展，GPU 内存呈线性增长，计算复杂度呈二次方增长。相比之下，线性时间架构将历史压缩为固定大小的状态，但难以保留细粒度的细节。我们引入了 MemOnce，一种用于学习语言模型可扩展内存状态的基础架构。MemOnce 基于两个核心设计：（a）内存编码器-解码器：它仅将一小部分最终层隐藏状态缓存为紧凑的内存表示，并动态地将它们解码回注意力层的 KV 缓存；（b）内存稀疏注意力：对于每个持续输入，MemOnce 自适应地检索相关的内存表示，并且稀疏索引仅在各层计算一次。这两种设计的结合使得高效的即时内存加载和 KV 缓存解码成为可能，从而大大减小了 GPU 内存占用并实现了线性时间复杂度。我们进行了广泛的实验，证明 MemOnce 在不同模型大小、上下文长度和训练范式（预训练和训练后适应）下，在各项指标上均优于 Transformer 和其他架构。特别地，在使用 MemOnce 适配 Qwen3.5-4B 时，在 1M 上下文长度下，内存状态缓存减少了 1313 倍，预填充延迟减少了 6.9 倍，并将吞吐量提高了 3.5 倍，整体内存性能提升了 5.77%。最后，MemOnce 在下游表示任务上实现了零样本泛化，取得了与专用模型相媲美的结果。
tldr: MemOnce是一种新的内存架构，通过学习可扩展的内存状态来解决大型语言模型在长上下文交互中的内存瓶颈问题。它使用内存编码器-解码器来压缩和动态解码最终层隐藏状态，并结合内存稀疏注意力来检索相关信息，从而显著减少GPU内存占用并实现线性时间复杂度。实验证明，MemOnce在不同模型尺寸和上下文长度下均优于Transformer，并在特定场景下实现了显著的内存和延迟改进。
ai_comments: MemOnce 架构在解决 LLM 内存瓶颈方面取得了显著进展，其内存编码器-解码器和稀疏注意力机制的设计具有创新性。然而，动态解码和稀疏索引的计算开销在极端情况下可能仍是一个需要关注的方面。此外，该架构在不同硬件平台上的实际部署性能表现也值得进一步研究。
motivation: 现有的大型语言模型（LLM）架构在长上下文和持续交互中存在内存瓶颈，因为它们会随着上下文的扩展而导致GPU内存线性增长和计算复杂度二次方增长，或者压缩历史信息导致细节丢失。需要一种新的架构来维持可重用的内存状态，以应对这些挑战。
method: MemOnce 采用两种核心设计：1. 内存编码器-解码器：仅缓存一小部分最终层隐藏状态作为紧凑的内存表示，并动态解码回注意力层的KV缓存。2. 内存稀疏注意力：为每个持续输入自适应地检索相关的内存表示，并且稀疏索引仅在各层计算一次。这两种设计协同工作，实现了高效的内存加载和KV缓存解码。
results: MemOnce 在不同模型尺寸、上下文长度和训练范式下均优于 Transformer 和其他架构。具体而言，在 1M 上下文长度下，使用 MemOnce 适配 Qwen3.5-4B 可将内存状态缓存减少 1313 倍，预填充延迟减少 6.9 倍，并将吞吐量提高 3.5 倍，整体内存性能提升 5.77%。此外，MemOnce 在下游表示任务上实现了零样本泛化，取得了与专用模型相媲美的结果。
conclusion: MemOnce 成功地解决了大型语言模型在长上下文交互中的内存效率问题，通过其创新的内存编码器-解码器和内存稀疏注意力机制，实现了显著的内存节省和性能提升，并在下游任务上展现了良好的泛化能力。

title: Ensuring Grid-Safe Forwarding of Distributed Flexibility in Sequential DSO-TSO Markets
authors: Wicak Ananduta, Anibal Sanjab, Luciana Marques
abstract: This paper investigates sequential flexibility markets consisting of a first market layer for distribution system operators (DSOs) to procure local flexibility to resolve their own needs (e.g., congestion management) followed by a second layer, in which the transmission system operator (TSO) procures remaining flexibility forwarded from the distribution system layer as well as flexibility from its own system for providing system services. As the TSO does not necessarily have full knowledge of the distribution grid constraints, this bid forwarding can cause an infeasibility problem for distribution systems, i.e., cleared distribution-level bids in the TSO layer might not satisfy local network constraints. To address this challenge, we introduce and examine three methods aiming to enable the grid-safe use of distribution-located resources in markets for system services, namely: a corrective three-layer market scheme, a bid prequalification/filtering method, and a bid aggregation method. Technically, we provide conditions under which these methods can produce a grid-safe use of distributed flexibility. We also characterize the efficiency of the market outcome under these methods. Finally, we carry out a representative case study to evaluate the performances of the three methods, focusing on economic efficiency, grid-safety, and computational load.

title: Cup and Cap Topological Neural Network
authors: Marta Niedostatek, Ferran Hernandez Caralt, Runyue Wang, Federica Baccini, Lorenzo Giambagli, Pietro Lió, Ginestra Bianconi
abstract: Topological Deep Learning (TDL) is designed to learn features associated not only with nodes but also with edges, triangles and higher dimensional simplices. However, most TDL approaches, being based on boundary operators and Hodge Laplacians, have the limitation that features and signals cannot be lifted or lowered across more than one dimension per layer. To overcome this limitation, in this work, we propose the adoption of the cup and cap products. Specifically, we formulate the Cup and Cap Topological Neural Network (CCNN), a topological deep learning architecture designed to learn node-based variables (or 0-cochains) by taking into account their many-body interactions (e.g. triangles) present in the data. We validate CCNN by assessing its performance on the TopoBench datasets, demonstrating its competitive performance with respect to other simplicial complex neural networks.

title: To predict or to persist: how decoherence shapes learning in a spin-qubit quantum reservoir
authors: Nikolaos Petropoulos, Elena Blokhina
abstract: In this work we investigate how dephasing and the choice of measured observables affect learning in a simulated six-qubit spin chain with Markovian dissipation and exact expectation-value readout. For externally driven nonlinear autoregressive moving-average signals, combining single- and two-qubit observables gives better predictions than a population-only readout at comparable polynomial feature counts. Most of the configurations we tested become more accurate than a reference with relaxation and dephasing disabled, most strongly at $T_2=1\,μ$s, where total memory capacity drops, and still at $T_2=5$-$10\,μ$s, where memory is only redistributed across delays. For autonomous generation, we train the readout with scheduled sampling and iterative dataset aggregation to expose it to states reached under its own feedback. We do not find a clear systematic dependence of limit-cycle persistence on coherence across the reservoir ensemble. For chaotic forecasting, in contrast, prediction horizons at $T_2=1\,μ$s shorten in all 10 reservoir realizations relative to that reference. For the noise-driven strange non-chaotic attractor, the model produces a smooth, approximately closed orbit, and neither captures the target's scatter nor follows its trajectory pointwise. We conclude that, within this simulated reservoir, the impact of coherence depends strongly on the task.

title: Nanoscale single-electron box with a floating lead for quantum sensing: modelling and device characterization
authors: Nikolaos Petropoulos, Xutong Wu, Andrii Sokolov, Panagiotis Giounanlis, Imran Bashir, Mike Asker, Dirk Leipold, Andrew K. Mitchell, Robert B. Staszewski, Elena Blokhina
abstract: We present an in-depth analysis of a single-electron box (SEB) biased through a floating node technique that is common in charge-coupled devices (CCDs). The device is analyzed and characterized in the context of single-electron charge-sensing techniques for integrated silicon quantum dots (QD). The unique aspect of our SEB design is the incorporation of a metallic floating node, strategically employed for sensing and precise injection of electrons into an electrostatically formed QD. To analyse the SEB, we propose an extended multi-orbital Anderson impurity model (MOAIM), adapted to our nanoscale SEB system, that is used to predict theoretically the behaviour of the SEB in the context of a charge-sensing application. The validation of the model and the sensing technique has been carried out on a QD fabricated in a fully depleted silicon on insulator (FDSOI) process on a 22-nm technological node. We demonstrate the MOAIM's efficacy in predicting the observed electronic behavior and elucidating the complex electron dynamics and correlations in the SEB. The results of our study reinforce the versatility and precision of the model in the realm of nanoelectronics and highlight the practical utility of the metallic floating node as a mechanism for charge injection and detection in integrated QDs. Finally, we identify the limitations of our model in capturing higher-order effects observed in our measurements and propose future outlooks to reconcile some of these discrepancies.

title: Distributional Deep Hedging
authors: El-Amine Cherrat, Skander Kazdaghli, Iordanis Kerenidis
abstract: Deep hedging learns a hedging strategy by optimising a risk preference over a neural-network policy. The preference is fixed before training, so each new preference requires a new policy and, in actor-critic methods, a new critic. We propose distributional deep hedging, in which the distribution of the hedging profit and loss is learned through its quantiles and the risk preference is applied afterwards, as a weight on those quantiles. We characterise the preferences that admit this representation, which include expected shortfall and its mixtures, and show that the entropic utility is computed from the same quantiles. At the current policy, each of these preferences is bounded below by an expected utility with the same gradient. This bound reduces risk-sensitive hedging to a sequence of risk-neutral problems, from which we derive policy-search and actor-critic algorithms. In numerical experiments, the learned hedges approach references computed by dynamic programming, and a single distributional critic trained without a preference can serve preferences chosen after training.
comment: 34 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables; v2: introduction clarified, references added

title: VerifiQuant: Governance-by-Execution for Financial LLM Workflows
authors: Yu-Chi Ko, Mi-Yen Yeh, Shou-De Lin
abstract: Large language models embedded in financial workflows fail most dangerously by emitting confident, well-formatted but wrong numbers with no signal distinguishing them from correct ones. We argue that the central deployment problem is governability: a system must determine when a question supports a numeric answer and when it should instead clarify, intercept, or refuse. We present VerifiQuant, a governance-by-execution framework that packages financial logic into inference contracts and evaluates each query through an executable diagnostic funnel before deterministic computation. This separation makes computation, clarification, and refusal structured and auditable while keeping financial arithmetic outside the language model. Against matched retrieval-and-execution baselines, and within a declared contract library, the principal benefit is not higher accuracy on well-posed questions but safer behavior when an input does not justify a number. When it finds no applicable contract, it says so instead of guessing. Coverage sweeps and failure analysis put a price on this boundary: safety is bought with coverage rather than with accuracy, and residual failures remain attributable to specific runtime frontiers.
comment: 26 pages, 3 figures, 16 tables. Accepted at ACM ICAIF 2026 (7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance, Milan). The first 9 pages are the conference paper; Appendices A-K are extra. Code and prompts: https://github.com/datafox-tw/icaif-verifiquant

title: SDG: State-Dependent Gating at Chunk Boundaries for Linear Attention
authors: Renjia Deng, Yuxi Liu, Yutong He, Xue Wang, Kun Yuan
abstract: Recent gated linear attention models use state-independent gates, computed from token representations without directly reading the recurrent memory. This design supports efficient chunkwise computation: sequences are divided into chunks of consecutive tokens, with parallel computation within each chunk. However, the same token representation produces the same gate, even when the layer stores different information. We introduce State-Dependent Gating (SDG), which computes element-wise gates from the change in memory over a chunk and applies them at the chunk boundary. This provides state feedback for forgetting while preserving parallel computation within each chunk. We develop fused kernels for Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention, Gated DeltaNet-2, and Mamba-3. Our theoretical analysis quantifies the potential reconstruction benefits of state-dependent, element-wise gating under a signal--noise model. We also show that boundary decay is an element-wise ridge proximal step when the gate is held fixed. Empirical evaluation of 1.3B linear attention and hybrid models trained on 100B tokens shows improvements across language modeling, commonsense reasoning, synthetic and real-world retrieval, and long-context understanding. These results demonstrate that SDG is an effective approach to enhancing existing linear attention models.

title: Pharos: Learning to Control Rare Events at Scale
authors: Jiajun He, Jacky Chen, Weiliang Luo, Heather Kulik, David R. Koes, Carles Domingo-Enrich, Yuanqi Du
abstract: Rare events drive transformations across physics, chemistry and biology, yet predicting their mechanisms and rates remains a fundamental challenge. Here we introduce Pharos, a framework that learns to make rare transitions accessible while predicting how frequently they occur under physical dynamics. Through stochastic optimal control, Pharos jointly learns the probability of completing a transition and how to steer simulations toward it, allowing sampling and learning to improve one another. Across biomolecular benchmarks, Pharos learns accurate transition probabilities with order-of-magnitude gains in convergence speed over previous algorithms. It transfers across ion assembly systems in explicit solvent while maintaining accurate reaction rate predictions, scales to host-guest binding systems that span millisecond timescales, and enables chemical reaction studies with a computationally demanding machine learning interatomic potential. By combining efficient sampling, quantitative kinetics, and transferability, Pharos opens a route toward foundation models of rare event mechanisms and rates across molecular systems.

title: Avoiding squares over words with lists of size three
authors: Matthieu Rosenfeld
abstract:
We prove that every sequence of lists of size three admits an infinite square-free word, establishing that the Thue choice number of the path is three. More precisely, the number of compatible square-free words of length $n$ is at least $c(5/4)^n$, where $c>0$ is an absolute constant.
  The proof combines a computer-assisted construction of weights with the weighted counting method previously introduced by the author. We first consider words avoiding only squares of bounded period and use a finite state model to certify a uniform lower bound on their growth. The counting argument then controls the loss caused by excluding longer squares. The main new ingredient is a coarser description of the states, which makes the computation feasible without restricting the union of the lists.
  The same computation yields a deterministic polynomial-time strategy for constructing an infinite square-free word when each list is chosen adversarially after the preceding letters have been fixed.

title: Self-verifiable LLM-driven science and why it needs human researchers
authors: Michael G. Medvedev, Nikolai V. Krivoshchapov, Stepan N. Ostarkov
abstract: Language models are now used throughout all sciences - for reading literature, extracting numbers from tables and spectra, analyzing data, drafting conclusions - and their answers arrive in the same polished confident tone whether they are right or wrong, so a result has to be re-derived by a human researcher before it can be relied on. The cost of that re-checking, not the ability to generate results, is what currently limits AI-assisted research. In the field of mathematics, this problem is solved by proof assistants like Lean 4 and Coq that let any formal statement and its proof be written down and checked - a perfect match for LLMs, which are now actively used to search for proofs with every step automatically validated, rather than relying on a human to judge the result. In this paper, we propose an extension of this approach to non-mathematical sciences. We describe an AI agent harness that aims to make LLM's scientific reasoning verifiable: the starting assumptions are proposed by LLM and reviewed by a human, and everything built on top of them is checked by a machine with Lean 4. We illustrate how this mechanism works in practice on several examples and our results show that scientific arguments in these tasks can be expressed as formal proofs from explicit assumptions, including experimental results, known theoretical statements, and additional assumptions, produced by the agent. We suggest that this approach could change how scientific research is conducted across all sciences.

title: MambaSplit: Severity-Robust and Inference-Efficient Semantic Unmixing of Fluorescence Microscopy Image Data
authors: Aman Kukde, Ruggiero Santeramo, Federico Carrara, Ashesh Ashesh, Igor Zubarev, Florian Jug
abstract: The number of structures fluorescence microscopy can image in one sample is limited by how few fluorophores can be separated without significant spectral overlap. Semantic unmixing circumvents this limit by imaging two structures in one fluorescent channel and computationally separating the superimposed image into one image per structure. Because pixels rarely identify their structure, unmixing requires both local and long-range spatial context. The relative brightness of the two structures is unknown and can be very uneven, so predictions must remain accurate across mixing severities, from balanced mixtures to ones where a structure is barely visible. Existing methods either process small image patches or add context through auxiliary pathways that slow inference on large images. We present MambaSplit, a hierarchical state-space encoder with a convolutional decoder that captures context across large tiles in linear time and predicts both channels in one deterministic pass. MambaSplit trains either on computationally summed channel images with random mixing ratios, where a lightweight head estimates the unknown ratio and conditions the decoder on it, or on experimentally acquired superpositions. Across five datasets and nine mixing ratios, MambaSplit achieves the highest RI-PSNR, by up to 3.0 dB, in 11 of 15 dataset-severity combinations and ties in one more, while running 5.9x faster than the strongest baseline. On acquired superpositions, fine-tuning a model pretrained on summed inputs matches or exceeds all baselines. Ablations show that accuracy and robustness come mainly from the training recipe: large tiles, mixing ratios sampled across their full range (up to 11 dB over fixed-ratio training), and independently drawn channel crops (3.9 dB on BioSR). The state-space backbone makes large tiles affordable, enabling high-content screening and event-driven smart microscopy.
comment: 28 pages, 15 figures, 23 tables; main paper (8 pages) followed by supplementary material

title: A boundary integral equation solver for capsule suspensions
authors: Joar Bagge, Ziyu Du, George Biros
abstract: Deformable capsules serve as models for biological cells, such as red blood cells, as well as for synthetic capsules in biomedical and industrial applications. In this work, we introduce a framework for fast and robust simulation of deformable capsules in three-dimensional Stokes flow, both in unbounded domains and in pipe-confined geometries. We solve the Stokes equations using a boundary integral formulation, employing a partition-of-unity discretization for the capsule membrane and the trapezoidal rule with regularization to handle the singular quadrature. Dense periodic interactions are evaluated via a fast Ewald summation scheme, achieving $O(N \log N)$ complexity for $N$ grid points. The interfacial forces on the capsule membrane are modeled using the Skalak constitutive law. We carry out a spectral analysis of this model for small perturbations of a spherical capsule, which indicates that the relaxation dynamics are intrinsically stable. However, the nonlinear character of the Skalak model induces aliasing errors that can compromise numerical stability. To address this when needed, we perform de-aliasing through upsampling and spectral filtering, and we derive guidelines for choosing appropriate filter parameters, thereby stabilizing the method. We investigate the stability and convergence behavior of the resulting scheme and conduct simulations of long-time dynamics, focusing on the relaxation of unconfined capsules and the lateral migration of pipe-confined capsules under various flow conditions.

title: Polynomial sequences of Simplex pivots on 0/1-polytopes
authors: Laura Sanità
abstract:
We study the number of Simplex pivots needed to solve linear programs over $0/1$-polytopes, starting from an arbitrary feasible basis and counting degenerate pivots. It has been known since the 1990s that from any extreme point of a 0/1-polytope there exists a monotone path of linear length to an optimal one. However, translating this into a polynomial sequence of Simplex pivots, i.e., improving basis exchanges, has remained an open question.
  We here provide an affirmative answer, showing that for every 0/1-polytope $\mathcal P \subseteq \mathbb R^d$, an optimal basis can be reached with $O(d^3)$ Simplex pivots, independently of the number of inequalities and of the size of the coefficients.

title: Nonholonomic Event-Triggered Source Seeking
authors: Victor Hugo Pereira Rodrigues, Tiago Roux Oliveira, Miroslav Krstic
abstract: This paper introduces an event-triggered source seeking control (ET-SSC) strategy for autonomous vehicles modeled as nonholonomic unicycles. The key feature of the proposed design is the separation between the continuous probing motion required for gradient extraction and the event-triggered update of the source-seeking correction. This separation enables aperiodic computation and transmission of the correction while the periodic probing signals remain continuously active. The triggering mechanism acts on a low-pass-filtered gradient estimate, obtained by high-pass (washout) filtering, demodulation, and low-pass filtering of the measured signal, and combines a relative and an absolute threshold. Stability is proved with a time-periodic Lyapunov function constructed along the exponentially stable periodic solution of the filtered closed loop, establishing practical exponential convergence of the vehicle to a neighborhood of the unknown source. The guaranteed minimum dwell time is strictly positive and independent of the probing frequency, which excludes Zeno behavior. Unlike available Lie-bracket analyses of the forward-velocity design, the proposed averaging-based analysis accommodates anisotropic quadratic source fields with distinct spatial curvatures. The resulting ET-SSC framework therefore provides a resource-aware implementation in which the source-seeking correction is updated aperiodically while the information-generating probing motion remains continuous.

title: Optimized solver algorithms for computing $\mathrm{Tr}(A^{-1})$
authors: Benjamin Luke, Sudip Shiwakoti, Shayan Nadeem, Ronald Morgan, Walter Wilcox
abstract: Estimating the trace of the inverse of a large quark matrix is a longstanding problem in lattice QCD. The standard approach is Hutchinson's method, which uses random noise vectors to estimate the trace to a desired statistical tolerance. Each noise vector $b$ requires solving a system of linear equations $Ax = b$. In this work, we introduce a new class of Krylov solvers for this task, called Twin methods. Twin methods generate the Krylov polynomial once then reuse it on all other right-hand sides. This reduces the number of basic linear algebra operations in the algorithm and therefore lowers the trace computation time. We apply the Twin approach to BiCG and BiCGStab and test them on lattice QCD matrices of varying size and in a range of computing contexts. We also present a more economical estimation of $\mathrm{Tr}(A^{-1})$ which implements a polynomial approximation of $A^{-1}$ and a singular value deflation. In this scheme, the solvers are applied to only a few noise vectors, and the remainder are treated by the polynomial and the deflation. In our tests, the polynomial approximation combined with the deflation yield a 17-fold speedup in the time required to compute the trace over standard Hutchinson's method.
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. To be published in the proceedings of LATTICE 2026

title: A High-Compression Transformer VAE for Efficient and Controllable 3D Medical Image Generation with Diffusion Transformers
authors: Bo Liu, Bingliang Zhang, Yubo Wang, Yunxiang Li, Yang Yang, Janine M. Lupo, Hui Lin
abstract: Many medical image processing tasks, such as completing missing regions or correcting acquisition artifacts, can be cast as volumetric generation conditioned on observations of the same patient. Diffusion Transformers offer scalable capacity and flexible conditioning for this setting, but they operate on a learned image representation that must preserve fine anatomical and pathological detail while keeping complete three-dimensional volumes tractable. We bring Transformer variational autoencoding and multimodal diffusion together to address this challenge. Trained on BrainTumor-256K, a 249M Transformer VAE encodes and decodes $256^3$ volumes 7.6x faster than a comparably sized CNN trained on the same collection. Their PSNR difference is near zero with training-sized crop inputs, but the Transformer leads by 0.749 dB with full-volume inputs and an unchanged scoring region. Increasing Transformer capacity to 499M improves PSNR across all four brain MRI evaluation sets while retaining 3.8x lower encoding-decoding latency than the CNN. Fast encoding also allows conditions to be constructed dynamically in image space during latent diffusion training. Within the compressed representation, a shared Diffusion Transformer integrates text and spatial references for volumetric synthesis, completion and restoration. The brain-trained autoencoder further transfers to non-brain MRI and CT without target-domain fine-tuning, extending its use beyond the anatomy and modality on which it was learned. The framework provides a reusable representation and conditioning interface for efficient, controllable medical image generation. Code is available at https://github.com/OncoMMAI/brainmri-vit-vae3d.

title: AI-Assisted Decision Support for Formula 1 Pit-Stop Strategy: Deep Reinforcement Learning and Mathematical Programming
authors: Felipe Méndez, Charles Thraves
abstract: Pit-stop strategy in Formula 1 is a sequential decision problem under uncertainty, in which strategists decide at each lap whether to pit and which tire compound to fit. We develop a data-driven simulator, calibrated with historical race data, that captures tire degradation, drivers' recent performance, overtaking, yellow flag events, and rivals' pit-stop decisions. We train agents with five Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) algorithms and compare them with a Quadratic Mixed-Integer Programming (QMIP) formulation that is optimal in deterministic single-driver settings. Without uncertainty or competition, all DRL methods except TRPO achieve near-optimal performance. With a full grid of competitors and stochastic race events, the ranking of DRL methods depends on the evaluation setting: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and its recurrent variant are the only methods that improve on the QMIP both in fully simulated races and when the actual 2024 races are replayed. Averaged over eight circuits, PPO improves on the QMIP by 0.33 and 0.49 positions in the two settings and Recurrent PPO by less, and in the replay PPO finishes 0.66 positions ahead of the drivers' actual strategies simulated in the same races. The QMIP performs similarly to the other methods, even though it cannot anticipate yellow flag events. Finally, we use the trained PPO policy as a look-ahead decision-support tool that shows the strategist the distribution of race outcomes under each candidate pit-stop action. Applied retrospectively to eight 2024 races, the look-ahead identifies the laps where the actual decision, the recommendation, or a third action was preferable.
comment: 54 pages (main text and appendices). Code, data and trained models: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24361704

title: Semigroup Hessian Estimates for Underdamped Langevin Dynamics
authors: Xuda Ye, Zhihan Zhang
abstract:
For the semigroup $e^{t\mathcal L}$ of the underdamped Langevin dynamics, we bound the Hessian $
abla^2(e^{t\mathcal L}f)$ when $
abla f$ is uniformly bounded. When the potential is strongly convex outside a ball and has bounded second and third derivatives, and the damping rate is above an explicit threshold, the bounds on $
abla^2(e^{t\mathcal L}f)$ decay exponentially in time with constants free of the dimension. The proof combines the Wasserstein contraction of the dynamics with a Bismut--Elworthy--Li formula for the degenerate noise. As an application, we prove the uniform-in-time error of the stochastic gradient UBU integrator, with an explicit coefficient of the numerical bias in the step size, proportional to the covariance of the stochastic gradient noise.
zh_title: 欠阻尼朗之万动力学的半群Hessian估计
translation:
对于欠阻尼朗之万动力学的半群$e^{t	au}$，当$
abla f$一致有界时，我们对其Hessian $
abla^2(e^{t	au}f)$进行了界定。当势函数在球外强凸且具有有界二阶和三阶导数，并且阻尼率高于一个显式阈值时，$
abla^2(e^{t	au}f)$的界限随时间呈指数衰减，且常数与维度无关。该证明结合了动力学的Wasserstein收缩性与退化噪声的Bismut-Elworthy-Li公式。作为一个应用，我们证明了随机梯度UBU积分器的时间一致误差，其数值偏差的显式系数与步长成比例，并与随机梯度噪声的协方差相关。

title: Surface Cues Over Structure: Probing LLM Behavior on Brain Connectivity Graphs
authors: Prapti Roy, Khaled Mohammed Saifuddin
abstract: Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) provides a noninvasive view of functional interactions across the brain, which can be represented as connectivity graphs for neurological disease analysis. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being paired with such representations, yet it remains unclear whether they genuinely reason over the underlying connectivity or simply respond to surface-level cues that may trigger learned priors. We probe this question through a controlled study of Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) diagnosis from resting-state functional connectivity, isolating one factor at a time to determine what drives an LLM's predictions on brain connectivity graphs. Across six models, from small open-weight LLMs to a proprietary one, the same pattern holds: the results provide little evidence that predictions are consistently grounded in subject-specific connectivity. Brain region names, numeric formatting, and prompt framing shift what a model predicts without improving how well it separates ADHD subjects from Controls; perturbing the graph changes predictions no more for clinically meaningful regions than for random ones; and the models' own justifications contradict the values they cite, inconsistently interpreting the connectivity evidence provided to them. Across every probe, predictions follow the model's built-in class bias and the surface form of the prompt rather than the subject's connectivity, calling into question a premise underlying current LLM brain integration work. Our code is available at https://github.com/Roy025/ADHD-code.
zh_title: 表面线索优于结构：探究LLM在脑连接图上的行为
translation: 静息态功能磁共振成像（rs-fMRI）提供了一种非侵入性的视角，用于观察大脑的功能性相互作用，这些相互作用可以表示为连接图，用于神经疾病分析。大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地与此类表示结合使用，但目前尚不清楚它们是真正基于底层的连接性进行推理，还是仅仅响应可能触发其学习到的先验知识的表面线索。我们通过一项关于静息态功能连接中注意力缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）诊断的对照研究来探究这个问题，每次隔离一个因素，以确定驱动LLM对脑连接图预测的因素。在从小型开源LLM到专有LLM的六个模型中，都出现了相同的模式：结果几乎没有证据表明预测始终基于受试者特定的连接性。脑区域名称、数字格式和提示框架会改变模型的预测，但不会提高其区分ADHD受试者和对照组的能力；扰动图对临床有意义区域的预测改变程度与对随机区域的改变程度相同；模型自身的解释与它们引用的值相矛盾，对提供的连接证据解释不一致。在每次探究中，预测都遵循模型的内置类别偏差和提示的表面形式，而非受试者的连接性，这挑战了当前LLM脑整合工作的一个基本前提。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Roy025/ADHD-code获取。
tldr: LLM在从脑连接图诊断ADHD时，主要依赖表面线索和内置偏见，而非真正的受试者特异性连接数据。
ai_comments: 这项研究具有重要意义，因为它对LLM在处理复杂生物数据（如脑连接图）时的实际推理能力进行了批判性评估。它揭示了LLM可能依赖表面模式或自身偏见而非真正理解底层生物关系的局限性，这对LLM在临床环境中的可靠和伦理应用具有重大影响。其严谨的对照研究设计是该论文的亮点。
motivation: 当大型语言模型（LLM）与脑连接图结合用于神经疾病分析时，目前尚不清楚它们是真正基于底层的连接性进行推理，还是仅仅响应可能触发其学习到的先验知识的表面线索。本研究旨在探究这一问题。
method: 本研究通过对静息态功能连接进行注意力缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）诊断的对照研究，每次隔离一个因素，以确定驱动LLM对脑连接图预测的因素。研究涵盖了六种模型，包括小型开源LLM和专有LLM。
results: 研究结果几乎没有证据表明LLM的预测始终基于受试者特定的连接性。脑区域名称、数字格式和提示框架会改变模型的预测，但不会提高其区分ADHD受试者和对照组的能力；扰动图对临床有意义区域的预测改变程度与对随机区域的改变程度相同；模型自身的解释与它们引用的值相矛盾，对提供的连接证据解释不一致。在每次探究中，预测都遵循模型的内置类别偏差和提示的表面形式，而非受试者的连接性。
conclusion: LLM在脑连接图上的预测主要依赖于模型的内置类别偏差和提示的表面形式，而非受试者特定的连接数据，这挑战了当前LLM脑整合工作的基本前提。

title: Spectral Estimation with Deformed Decompression
authors: Siavash Ameli, Chris van der Heide, Liam Hodgkinson, Michael W. Mahoney
abstract: Sample covariance matrices are fundamental objects in machine learning and statistics, with valuable information encoded into their eigenvalues. When treating modern problems, the scale of these matrices can become prohibitive for tractable computation. This creates a critical need for "spectral decompression": a method for inferring the eigenspectrum of a very large-scale model using only information from its smaller realizations. Existing methods fall into two main categories: those relying on spectral inversion; and those that rely on Free Decompression techniques. On the one hand, spectral inversion is a fundamentally ill-posed problem that is notoriously unstable, often failing to yield reliable results in finite-size settings. On the other hand, while Free Decompression was recently proposed to address this scaling, its reliance on the Nica-Speicher framework restricts its use to unitarily invariant ensembles, a symmetry condition that subsampled covariance matrices fail to satisfy. In this work, we introduce Deformed Decompression (DD), a novel framework for the stable, forward-extrapolation of spectral densities. By leveraging properties of the companion matrix, DD recasts the spectral decompression problem as a directed evolution of the Stieltjes transform of the companion matrix. This approach bypasses the instabilities of traditional inversion and provides a robust methodology for scaling covariance matrices and even their generalized variants (including Hessian matrices) that lack unitary invariance. We demonstrate the utility of our framework through experiments on a variety of random matrix examples, showing that DD successfully captures the complex spectral signatures of large-scale systems.
zh_title: 基于畸变解压的谱估计
translation: 样本协方差矩阵是机器学习和统计学中的基本对象，其中有价值的信息被编码在其特征值中。在处理现代问题时，这些矩阵的规模可能会变得过大而无法进行易处理的计算。这就产生对“谱解压”的迫切需求：一种仅利用其较小实现的信来推断超大规模模型的特征谱的方法。现有方法主要分为两类：依赖于谱反演的方法；以及依赖于自由解压（Free Decompression）技术的方法。一方面，谱反演是一个根本上不适定的问题， notoriously unstable，在有限规模设置中往往无法产生可靠的结果。另一方面，虽然最近提出了自由解压来解决这种规模缩放问题，但它对 Nica-Speicher 框架的依赖将其使用限制在酉不变系综中，而次采样协方差矩阵无法满足这种对称性条件。在这项工作中，我们引入了畸变解压（DD），这是一种用于谱密度稳定前向外推的新颖框架。通过利用伴随矩阵的性质，DD 将谱解压问题重新表述为伴随矩阵 Stieltjes 变换的有向演化。这种方法绕过了传统反演的不稳定性，并为扩展缺乏酉不变性的协方差矩阵及其广义变体（包括 Hessian 矩阵）提供了一种稳健的方法。我们通过各种随机矩阵示例的实验证明了我们框架的实用性，表明 DD 成功捕捉了大规模系统的复杂谱特征。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为畸变解压（DD）的新框架，用于稳定地从小型实现中外推超大规模协方差矩阵及Hessian矩阵的特征谱，克服了传统方法的不稳定性和局限性。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种名为畸变解压（Deformed Decompression）的新框架，用于解决大规模样本协方差矩阵及Hessian矩阵的谱外推问题。该方法绕过了传统谱反演的不稳定性，且克服了自由解压技术对酉不变性的严格限制，具有重要的理论价值和广泛的应用前景。
motivation: 现代机器学习和统计学中样本协方差矩阵规模巨大，计算困难，现有的“谱解压”方法（如谱反演）存在严重的不稳定性，而“自由解压”技术则受限于酉不变性假设，无法处理抽样协方差矩阵，因此需要一种新的稳定方法来从小规模实现推断大规模模型的特征谱。
method: 利用伴随矩阵的性质，将谱解压问题转化为伴随矩阵的 Stieltjes 变换的有向演化，从而实现谱密度的稳定前向外推。
results: 实验结果表明，DD 框架能够成功捕捉大规模系统的复杂谱特征，实现了稳定且鲁棒的谱密度外推。
conclusion: Deformed Decompression (DD) 框架成功解决了缺乏酉不变性的大规模系统的谱解压问题，避开了传统反演的不稳定性，并通过实验验证了其有效性。

title: MG-EDA: Maturity-Gated Skew-Normal Estimation of Distribution Algorithms
authors: Jun Zhang, Tong Qian, Hua Ding, Weijie Yu, Zhi-Hui Zhan
abstract: Gaussian estimation of distribution algorithms shrink their variance on slopes and stall far from the optimum. This paper equips the corrections that act along the direction of movement -- a mean shift, an elongation of the covariance along the path and a skewness -- with the rule they lack: a calibrated gate, driven by a maturity statistic of the population, decides whether, how strongly and for how long each correction acts, and when the gate is closed the algorithm is exactly the estimation of multivariate normal algorithm (EMNA). The statistic is a cumulative path of whitened mean shifts with an inverse-Wishart correction, whose expectation is one under a null model without systematic movement and whose quantiles give thresholds with known false-alarm rate. It gates the three corrections as three rank-one terms of one matrix sampling equation, the skewness being carried by a skew-normal sampler that preserves the estimated mean and covariance; all vanish at maturity. We call the resulting algorithm the maturity-gated EDA (MG-EDA). A full factorial study on a training set of black-box optimization benchmarking (BBOB) functions separates the parameters: variance scaling is the prerequisite, the mean shift needs a feedback correction removing the injected shift from the statistic, the elongation turns the variance loss on a slope into a gain, and the skewness substitutes for the mean shift rather than complementing it. On held-out instances MG-EDA with the first- and second-order corrections is significantly better than the skewness-only predecessor and than EMNA with variance scaling, ties with EMNA with anticipated mean shift, and trails the adapted maximum-likelihood Gaussian model (AMaLGaM) in 20 dimensions.
comment: 50 pages (13 main, 37 supplement), 11 figures, 60 tables. Version 2; version 1 was titled "MG-EDA: Maturity-Gated Skew-Normal Estimation of Distribution Algorithms". The method is reduced to the skewness alone (no gate, mean shift or covariance elongation) and renamed SN-EDA; new title, abstract and pre-registered experiments. Variants of version 1 are in the supplement
zh_title: MG-EDA：成熟度门控偏态正态分布估计算法
translation: 高斯分布估计算法在斜坡上会缩小其方差，并在远离最优解时停滞。本文为沿着运动方向作用的修正项——均值偏移、协方差沿着路径的拉伸和偏度——配备了它们所缺乏的规则：一个由群体成熟度统计量驱动的校准门控，它决定了每个修正项何时、多强以及作用多久，当门控关闭时，该算法就是精确的多元正态估计算法（EMNA）。该统计量是白化均值偏移的累积路径，并经过逆Wishart修正，其在无系统运动的零模型下期望为一，并且其分位数给出了具有已知误报率的阈值。它将这三个修正项作为同一矩阵采样方程的三个秩一项进行门控，偏度由一个保留估计均值和协方差的偏态正态采样器承载；所有这些修正项在成熟时都消失。我们将由此产生的算法称为成熟度门控EDA（MG-EDA）。对黑盒优化基准（BBOB）函数训练集进行的全因子研究分离了参数：方差缩放是先决条件，均值偏移需要一个反馈修正，将注入的偏移从统计量中移除，拉伸将斜坡上的方差损失转化为增益，偏度替代了均值偏移而不是补充它。在保留的实例上，具有一阶和二阶修正的MG-EDA显著优于仅有偏度的前身算法和带有方差缩放的EMNA，与带有预期均值偏移的EMNA持平，但在20维问题上落后于自适应最大似然高斯模型（AMaLGaM）。
tldr: MG-EDA引入了一个由群体成熟度统计量驱动的门控机制，以动态调整均值偏移、协方差拉伸和偏度等修正项，解决了传统高斯分布估计算法在斜坡上收敛过快和停滞的问题，并在黑盒优化基准函数上表现出优异性能。
ai_comments: MG-EDA的创新点在于引入了“成熟度门控”这一概念，为EDA中的修正项（均值偏移、协方差拉伸、偏度）提供了智能的控制机制。这种动态调整策略有效解决了传统EDA在复杂优化景观中遇到的收敛问题。通过将修正项与群体演化状态（成熟度）关联，算法能够更灵活地适应优化过程的不同阶段，避免过早收敛或停滞。其在黑盒优化基准上的表现也验证了其有效性，尤其是在处理方差缩放和偏度等复杂修正时展现出精细的控制能力。
motivation: 传统高斯分布估计算法（EDA）在优化过程中，其方差在斜坡上会收缩，导致算法在远离最优解时停滞。为了解决这个问题，需要一种机制来更好地控制均值偏移、协方差拉伸和偏度等修正项的作用时机和强度。
method: 本文提出了MG-EDA（Maturity-Gated EDA）算法。该算法为均值偏移、协方差拉伸和偏度等修正项引入了一个由群体成熟度统计量校准的门控机制。该统计量是白化均值偏移的累积路径，并经过逆Wishart修正，其在无系统运动的零模型下期望为一。门控机制决定了每个修正项的作用强度、时长以及何时关闭（关闭时算法退化为EMNA）。偏度通过一个保留估计均值和协方差的偏态正态采样器实现。所有修正项在成熟时消失。实验通过全因子研究分离了参数，并对修正项进行了反馈校正。
results: 在训练集BBOB函数上，研究发现方差缩放是前提，均值偏移需要反馈校正，拉伸将斜坡上的方差损失转化为增益，偏度可以替代均值偏移而非补充。在保留的实例上，MG-EDA结合一阶和二阶修正显著优于仅有偏度的前身算法和带有方差缩放的EMNA，与带有预期均值偏移的EMNA持平，但在20维问题上略逊于AMaLGaM。
conclusion: MG-EDA通过引入成熟度门控机制，有效解决了传统高斯EDA在斜坡上收敛过快和停滞的问题，显著提升了算法性能。该算法通过动态调整均值偏移、协方差拉伸和偏度等修正项，使其在优化过程中更加灵活和高效。

title: Semi-regular admixed arrays: asymptotic enumeration and when information is additive
authors: Alan J. Aw
abstract: In genomic data analysis, admixed arrays are pairs of matrices recording the local ancestry and the allele at each position of the haplotypes of admixed individuals. We study two-way diploid admixed arrays with $N$ individuals and $P$ loci under two families of constraints: local ancestry tallies, which fix the number of ancestry assignments per individual, and ancestry-specific sums, which fix the allele count per locus and ancestry. These two constraint families correspond to summaries of admixed genetic data investigated in biomedical and genomic applications. In the semi-regular regime, where all tallies and sums are uniform, we use complex martingale techniques to derive asymptotic formulas for the number of doubly constrained arrays as $N$ and $P$ grow with bounded ratio, over the whole feasible region. The leading term is governed by the Shannon entropy of the frequencies of the four possible pairs of entries at a position of the two matrices; on the boundary one or two of them vanish, changing the Gaussian correction. We then ask whether the two families carry information additively, that is, whether an independence heuristic predicts the doubly constrained count up to a bounded factor. Measured against the smallest set of arrays defined by a constraint that each family implies on its own, additivity holds only on a set of measure zero. It includes an edge of the feasible region with correction factor $e^{-1/4}$, extending our earlier result at the symmetric point. Thus, how far the two summaries jointly narrow down individual-level ancestry and genotype configurations cannot generally be predicted from how far each does on its own.
zh_title: 半正则混合阵列：渐近枚举与信息何时具有可加性
translation: 在基因组数据分析中，混合阵列是一对记录混合个体单倍型每个位置的局地祖先和等位基因的矩阵。我们在两类约束下研究了具有 $N$ 个个体和 $P$ 个基因座的双向二倍体混合阵列：局地祖先计数（固定每个个体的祖先分配数量）和祖先特异性求和（固定每个基因座和祖先的等位基因计数）。这两类约束对应于生物医学和基因组应用中研究的混合遗传数据摘要。在半正则状态（即所有计数和求和都是均匀的）下，我们使用复鞅技术推导了当 $N$ 和 $P$ 以有界比率增长时，在整个可行区域内双重约束阵列数量的渐近公式。主导项由矩阵位置四个可能条目频率的香农熵控制；在边界处，其中一个或两个条目消失，从而改变了高斯修正。然后我们探讨这两类约束是否具有信息可加性，即独立性启发式算法是否能预测双重约束计数（最多相差一个有界因子）。通过与每个约束自身所定义的最小阵列集进行比较，可加性仅在测度为零的集合上成立。它包括可行区域的一个边界，其修正因子为 $e^{-1/4}$，这扩展了我们先前在对称点上的结果。因此，这两类摘要共同缩小个体水平祖先和基因型配置范围的程度，通常无法仅从它们各自的缩减程度来预测。
tldr: 本文研究了混合阵列的渐近枚举公式，并证明了其两类基因组约束的信息通常不具有可加性。
ai_comments: 本文利用复杂鞅技术研究了基因组数据分析中半正则混合阵列的渐近枚举问题，并探讨了信息的可加性，具有较高的理论深度和严谨性。
motivation: 研究基因组数据分析中两类约束（局地祖先计数和祖先特异性求和）下的双重约束二倍体混合阵列，探讨其在半正则情况下的渐近枚举公式以及这两类约束是否具有信息可加性。
method: 利用复鞅技术（complex martingale techniques）推导了双重约束阵列数量的渐近公式，并分析了香农熵及高斯修正项。
results: 导出了双重约束阵列数量随个体数N和基因座数P增长的渐近公式，主导项由香农熵控制；同时发现两类约束的信息可加性仅在测度为零的集合上成立，说明联合约束的缩减效应通常不能简单由各自独立效应预测。
conclusion: 在半正则混合阵列的双重约束计数中，信息通常不具有可加性，不能简单通过各自约束的预测结果相乘来估计联合计数，且该结论在边界特殊区域（如修正因子为e^{-1/4}的边界）有所拓展。

title: Weight-space programming and mechanistic interpretability for model editing in particle physics
authors: Raphaël Bonnet-Guerrini, Johann Ioannou-Nikolaides, Troels Petersen
abstract: We demonstrate that weight-space programming and edits guided by sparse autoencoders can remove unwanted aspects of a particle-physics foundation model through direct edits to its weights. In a foundation model trained on jets, we observe that adding a single soft neutral particle causes large changes in jet classification, violating infrared safety. We locate the responsible attention heads with mechanistic analysis and trace the flaw's origin to pretraining on datasets with different reconstruction thresholds. We then propose two targeted approaches to repair the flaw: by removing three latent directions identified with sparse autoencoders, and by letting language-model agents edit the weights directly, without gradients and with only 50 queries to the model. Both their edits individually remove almost the entire flaw and leave the rest of the model's response nearly unchanged. Compared to fine-tuning, both methods change far fewer parameters. Although built only on $W$ and QCD jets, the edits carry over to all signal classes, the pretrained generator, and a newly trained regression head.
zh_title: 粒子物理学中用于模型编辑的权重空间编程与机械可解释性
translation: 我们证明了通过直接修改权重空间编程以及由稀疏自编码器引导的编辑，可以去除粒子物理基础模型中不需要的方面。在训练于喷注的基础模型中，我们观察到添加单个软中性粒子会导致喷注分类发生巨大变化，从而违反了红外安全性。我们通过机械分析定位了相关的注意力头，并将缺陷的根源追溯到具有不同重建阈值的数据集的预训练。然后，我们提出了两种有针对性的方法来修复该缺陷：通过移除稀疏自编码器识别出的三个潜在方向，以及让语言模型智能体直接编辑权重（无需梯度，且只需对模型进行50次查询）。这两种方法各自独立地消除了几乎整个缺陷，同时使模型的其余响应几乎保持不变。与微调相比，这两种方法改变的参数要少得多。尽管这些编辑仅基于W和QCD喷注，但它们可以迁移到所有信号类别、预训练生成器以及新训练的回归头上。
tldr: 本文提出利用权重空间编程和稀疏自编码器直接修改粒子物理基础模型权重的技术，在无需梯度的前提下高效修复了模型的红外安全性缺陷。
ai_comments: 本文将权重空间编程和稀疏自编码器（SAE）等机械可解释性技术引入粒子物理学基础模型编辑中，展示了如何在不使用梯度、极少查询的情况下精准修复模型缺陷，方法创新且对保持模型其余部分性能具有重要意义。
motivation: 粒子物理学基础模型在面对微小扰动（如添加软中性粒子）时会出现违反红外安全性的巨大分类变化，且该缺陷源于预训练数据集重建阈值的差异，因此需要开发无需全面微调的精准模型编辑方法。
method: 利用机械可解释性定位相关的注意力头，并通过两种定向方法修复缺陷：一是移除通过稀疏自编码器识别出的三个潜在方向，二是利用大语言模型智能体在无梯度且仅需50次查询的情况下直接编辑权重。
results: 两种方法都能在几乎不改变模型其余部分响应的前提下，几乎完全消除该缺陷，且涉及的参数修改远少于传统微调，编辑效果可泛化至所有信号类别、预训练生成器及回归头。
conclusion: 权重空间编程和稀疏自编码器引导的编辑能够高效、精准地修复粒子物理基础模型中的特定缺陷（如红外安全性违背），且对模型整体性能影响极小。

title: Moonshine Conjecture Formalized
authors: Jin-Cheng Guu
abstract:
The celebrated and intimidating Moonshine Conjecture has now been formalized in Lean. This achievement might suggest that, once a sufficiently large library compiles, the principal mathematical work is complete. This paper tells a less optimistic story.
  During our formalization project, we repeatedly encountered two problems that a formally checked proof alone does not settle: (1) whether the formal statements actually express the mathematics we humans expect, and (2) how that meaning survives as the repositories and their dependencies evolve.
  We argue that there is no magic pill that turns a large agent-produced library into mathematics a community can trust. Even after the proofs are checked by the Lean kernel, someone must judge whether the definitions and statements express the intended mathematics and whether future updates preserve that meaning. This work, even when done, can only be trusted. We must therefore return to the usual trust model: relying on the mathematical judgment of maintainers and expert communities.
  But semantic review is expensive, making it tempting to keep producing code and take successful kernel checks as sufficient grounds for trust. This shortcut accumulates semantic debt: definitions and results with unchecked mathematical interpretations are reused as foundations for further work. A library may keep compiling and produce the desired formal theorem while users lose track of which mathematical claims they can responsibly rely on.
  Reliable reuse is also a prerequisite for Terence Tao's vision of formal mathematics as something people can navigate, explain, learn from, and build with. This paper takes our work connecting the VOA and CFSG repositories for the Moonshine Conjecture as a case study of the challenges of reliable reuse as formal developments scale.
comment: 7 pages, 0 figures. A case study in Lean formalization, semantic trust, and repository versioning
translation:
著名的、令人生畏的月光猜想现已在Lean中形式化。这一成就可能表明，一旦足够大的库编译完成，主要的数学工作就完成了。本文讲述了一个不那么乐观的故事。
在我们的形式化项目中，我们反复遇到两个仅凭形式化验证的证明无法解决的问题：（1）形式化陈述是否真正表达了我们人类所期望的数学，以及（2）这种意义如何随着代码库及其依赖的演变而得以保持。
我们认为，没有灵丹妙药能将一个大型的、由代理生成的库转化为社区可以信任的数学。即使证明经过Lean内核的检查，也必须有人判断定义和陈述是否表达了预期的数学，以及未来的更新是否会保留这种意义。这项工作，即使完成了，也只能被信任。因此，我们必须回到通常的信任模型：依赖维护者和专家社区的数学判断。
但语义审查成本高昂，这使得人们很容易继续编写代码，并将成功的内核检查视为足够的信任依据。这种捷径积累了语义债务：未经检查数学解释的定义和结果被重用作为进一步工作的基础。一个库可能持续编译并产生所需的形式化定理，而用户却不知道他们可以负责任地依赖哪些数学主张。
可靠的重用也是Terence Tao对形式化数学的愿景的先决条件，即人们可以导航、解释、学习和构建的形式化数学。本文以我们为月光猜想连接VOA和CFSG仓库的工作为例，探讨了形式化发展规模化时可靠重用面临的挑战。
tldr: 形式化数学，即使通过内核验证，也面临语义正确性、稳定性及社区信任问题，不能完全取代人类判断，否则会积累“语义债务”。
ai_comments: 这篇论文深刻地揭示了形式化数学领域的一个核心困境：技术验证的严谨性与人类数学理解及社区信任之间的鸿沟。它提醒我们，形式化不仅仅是代码编译和定理证明，更关乎语义的准确性、稳定性和可信赖性。它提出的“语义债务”概念极具洞察力，对未来大规模形式化项目的开发和维护具有重要的指导意义。
motivation: 尽管月光猜想已在Lean中形式化，但作者指出，形式化证明本身无法解决两个关键问题：形式化陈述是否真正表达了人类期望的数学意义，以及这种意义如何随着代码库演进而保持。因此，论文旨在探讨大规模形式化数学中信任和语义可靠性面临的挑战。
method: 本文通过将月光猜想的形式化工作（连接VOA和CFSG仓库）作为案例研究，论证了大规模形式化开发中可靠重用所面临的挑战。
results: 论文指出，仅仅通过形式化验证并不能建立社区信任，因为存在语义正确性和稳定性问题。过度依赖内核检查会积累“语义债务”，导致用户无法判断哪些数学主张是可靠的。可靠的重用是形式化数学实现其潜力的前提。
conclusion: 即使形式化证明通过了内核检查，也无法完全取代人类的数学判断和社区信任模型。语义审查是昂贵但必需的，忽视它会导致语义债务，损害对形式化数学的信任和可靠重用。

title: On the convergence of greedy algorithms in one-dimensional Wasserstein space
authors: Geneviève Dusson, Carlo Marcati, Maximilian Penka
abstract: We study the convergence of the greedy algorithm for approximating a compact set by barycenters in metric spaces, in particular in the space of one-dimensional measures endowed with the 2-Wasserstein distance. To this end, we compare several metric $N$-widths, which measure the best error achievable with $N$-point barycenters, using either classical barycenters having nonnegative weights or signed barycenters, with weights of arbitrary sign summing to one. For the analysis we exploit that quantile functions embed the one-dimensional 2-Wasserstein space isometrically into a convex cone of $L^2(0,1)$, and barycenter sets correspond to nonlinear projections of convex or affine hulls. We prove, both in the algebraic and exponential case, that the convergence rate of the greedy algorithm using signed barycenters matches the one of the metric $N$-width defined with classical barycenters. We provide counterexamples showing that this fails for the other combinations.
zh_title: 论一维Wasserstein空间中贪婪算法的收敛性
translation: 我们研究了度量空间中通过重心逼近紧集的贪婪算法的收敛性，特别是在赋予2-Wasserstein距离的一维测度空间中。为此，我们使用具有非负权重的经典重心或权重任意且和为1的带符号重心，比较了几种衡量N点重心所能达到最佳误差的度量N-宽度。为了进行分析，我们利用了分位数函数将一维2-Wasserstein空间等距嵌入到$L^2(0,1)$的凸锥中，并且重心集对应于凸包或仿射包的非线性投影。无论是代数情况还是指数情况，我们都证明了使用带符号重心的贪婪算法的收敛速度与用经典重心定义的度量N-宽度相匹配。我们提供了反例，表明对于其他组合情况则不成立。
tldr: 本文证明了在一维Wasserstein空间中，使用带符号重心的贪婪算法能达到与经典重心度量N-width相同的收敛率。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地研究了一维Wasserstein空间中贪婪算法的收敛性，通过分位数函数的等距嵌入性质，深入对比了带符号重心和经典重心的度量N-宽度，并给出了明确的收敛率和反例。
motivation: 研究度量空间中通过重心逼近紧集的贪婪算法的收敛性，特别是一维测度空间中赋予2-Wasserstein距离的情况。
method: 利用分位数函数将一维2-Wasserstein空间等距嵌入到L^2(0,1)的凸锥中，并将重心集对应于凸包或仿射包的非线性投影，对比了几种度量N-宽度。
results: 在代数和指数情况下，证明了使用带符号重心的贪婪算法的收敛速度与使用经典重心的度量N-width相匹配，并提供了反例证明其他组合不成立。
conclusion: 使用带符号重心的贪婪算法的收敛速度与使用经典重心的度量N-宽度相匹配，而其他组合则不然。

title: Adaptive Collective Decision-Making in Signed Networks
authors: Vishnudatta Thota, Aditi Saxena, Twinkle Tripathy, Vaibhav Srivastava
abstract: Collective decision-making often unfolds in networks where cooperation and antagonism coexist. Such signed interactions arise in social, biological, and robotic systems, and can lead to qualitatively different collective outcomes: consensus, polarization, or clustering. Existing signed network models typically explain these outcomes separately, leaving open how they can emerge within a single dynamical framework. Here, we introduce a generalized Laplacian flow for bi-partitioned signed networks, a class of networks that allows cooperative and antagonistic interactions both within and across two prescribed groups. The proposed model includes an adaptive social effort state, interpreted as a leaky memory of persistent signed network disagreement, which enables bounded and nontrivial steady-states beyond classical signed Laplacian flows.
