Each hardness result uses one fixed demand curve in every market, a constant number of markets per firm, and globally nondecreasing strongly convex quadratic costs.
  We also give a polynomial-time algorithm for arbitrary-degree nonincreasing concave polynomial demands when each firm's convex polynomial cost depends only on its total production. The algorithm applies to arbitrary access graphs and permits firm-specific inverse demands. Its running time is polynomial in the input size and the logarithm of the inverse accuracy. The algorithm assigns one marginal charge to each firm and adjusts the charges until each firm's total sales approximate the quantity it would produce at that charge.
zh_title: 网络古诺竞争的尖锐复杂度阈值
translation:
我们确定了网络古诺均衡的近似复杂度作为需求阶数和共享市场厂商数量的函数的规律。对于常见的非递减凹多项式逆需求、厂商分配向量的凸二次成本以及有理总容量，无论市场规模如何，高精度近似对于三次需求都是多项式时间可解的。当每个市场最多有三个厂商时，四次需求仍然是易解的；当最多有两个厂商时，五次需求也是易解的。这些阈值是精确的：在固定的正利润误差容忍度下，对于每个市场有四个厂商的四次需求、三个厂商的五次需求以及两个厂商的六次需求，近似计算是PPAD难的。每个难度结果在每个市场中使用一个固定的需求曲线、每个厂商有恒定数量的市场，以及全局非递减强凸二次成本。
我们还为任意阶次的非递减凹多项式需求提供了一种多项式时间算法，此时每个厂商的凸多项式成本仅取决于其总产量。该算法适用于任意访问图，并允许厂商特定的逆需求。其运行时间在输入大小和逆精度的对数上是多项式的。该算法为每个厂商分配一个边际电荷，并调整电荷，直到每个厂商的总销售量近似于其在该电荷下将生产的数量。
tldr: 本文确定了网络古诺竞争均衡的精确计算复杂度阈值，发现其取决于需求阶数和市场厂商数量，并在特定条件下提供了多项式时间算法。
ai_comments: 该论文在网络古诺竞争的计算复杂度研究中取得了突破，给出了精确的复杂性阈值（P与PPAD-hard的界限），并在特定约束（总产量相关的成本函数）下提供了多项式时间算法，理论价值高。
motivation: 揭示网络古诺均衡（Network Cournot Equilibrium）计算复杂性的精确边界，填补关于需求阶数和市场规模对近似复杂度影响的理论空白。
method: 通过分析需求阶数、市场厂商数量以及成本函数的性质，结合多项式时间算法设计与PPAD难度归约方法确定复杂性阈值。
results: 对于三次及以下需求多项式，高精度近似可在多项式时间内求解；四次需求（$\ge 4$个厂商）、五次需求（$\ge 3$个厂商）及六次需求（$\ge 2$个厂商）的近似计算是PPAD难的。同时，在厂商成本仅依赖于总生产量的假设下，给出了任意阶数需求多项式的高效多项式时间算法。
conclusion: 网络古诺均衡的计算复杂性取决于需求阶数和市场厂商数量，存在精确的复杂性阈值，并且在某些特定限制下可以高效求解。

title: Knowing What You Know: A Trait Theory of Reviewer Value in Human-AI Cognitive Systems
authors: Priyanka Sinha, Sugam Pandey
abstract: When a capable model and a human reviewer cooperate on the same decision, which human still adds value? We argue this is a question about a single cognitive trait, metacognitive calibration: the alignment between a reviewer's behavioral confidence and the actual correctness of their judgments. We develop a trait theory of reviewer value to make it precise. The theory makes five claims: value is governed by calibration rather than by activity, speed, agreement, or tenure; calibration leaves observable traces in behavioral telemetry; those traces are non-diagnostic on their own, because the fast, low-revision signature of a calibrated expert is indistinguishable from that of a confident novice until it is gated by outcomes; human calibration and a model's self-knowledge are the same construct, so the joint system should defer to whichever agent is better calibrated on each item; and individual calibration is causally identifiable only above the level of the single judgment. We ground each claim in a six-month production window of an AI-assisted accounting system (541621 reviewer events, 483 reviewers), and find that a purely behavioral expertise profile inverts the ground truth, scoring an overconfident cohort (5.2 percent correction survival) higher than genuine experts (99.2 percent); that reviewer quality is flat across tenure, so the trait is not learned on the job; and that the same calibration logic that separates good from bad reviewers, applied to the model, concentrates 92.5 percent of human effort on genuine errors. We close with the boundary the theory must respect: under majority-vote aggregation, individual causal value is unidentifiable.
comment: Accepted at the Thirteenth Annual Conference on Advances in Cognitive Systems (ACS), Edinburgh, United Kingdom, October 6-9, 2026. Awarded one of 2026 Ada Lovelace Awardees for Excellent Paper Submissions to ACS
zh_title: 知其所知：人机认知系统中审阅者价值的特质理论
translation: 当一个能力出色的模型和一个人类审阅者合作做出相同的决策时，哪个尚能体现价值的人类还在发挥作用？我们认为这是一个关于单一认知特质的问题，即元认知校准：审阅者的行为置信度与其实际判断正确性之间的契合度。我们发展了一套关于审阅者价值的特质理论使其精确化。该理论提出了五个主张：价值由校准而非活动、速度、一致性或资历决定；校准在行为遥测中留下可观察的痕迹；这些痕迹本身是非诊断性的，因为已校准专家的快速、低修改特征在受结果门控之前与自信新手的特征无法区分；人类校准和模型的自我知识是相同的构念，因此联合系统应服从于在每个项目上校准得更好的代理；个体校准只有在单个判断的水平之上才是因果可识别的。我们在一个AI辅助会计系统的六个月生产窗口期（541,621个审阅者事件，483个审阅者）中验证了每一项主张，发现纯粹的行为专业知识画像颠倒了真实情况，将过度自信的群体（5.2%的修正存活率）得分高于真正的专家（99.2%）；审阅者质量在资历上是平稳的，因此该特质并非在工作中学到；同样的校准逻辑将好审阅者与坏审阅者区分开并应用于模型，将92.5%的人类精力集中在真正的错误上。最后，我们指出了该理论必须遵守的边界：在多数票聚合下，个体的因果价值是不可识别的。
tldr: 在人机协同决策中，人类审阅者的价值不取决于活动量、速度或资历，而取决于其元认知校准能力（即行为置信度与判断准确性的对齐程度）。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将元认知校准（metacognitive calibration）引入人机协同决策领域，通过大规模真实生产数据颠覆了传统以活动量、速度或资历衡量人类审阅者价值的观点，对构建高效的人机认知系统具有重要指导意义。
motivation: 在人机合作决策中，探讨当AI模型能力强大时，人类审阅者如何以及在何种情况下才能真正体现其价值。
method: 构建了审阅者价值的特质理论，包含五项核心声明，并通过分析长达六个月的AI辅助会计系统生产数据（包含541,621次审阅事件和483名审阅者）进行实证检验。
results: 研究发现，单纯基于行为的专业知识画像会颠倒真实情况，高估过度自信的新手而低估真正的专家；审阅者的质量不随资历增长而提高；应用校准逻辑可将92.5%的人类精力集中在真正的错误上。
conclusion: 人类审阅者的价值取决于元认知校准而非传统指标，通过对比人机校准度可实现高效的资源分配与决策优化。

title: Jailbreak Detection on Large Language Models via Contrastive Prototype Structures
authors: Yan Qiu, Yuanyuan Li
abstract: Jailbreak attempts and harmful prompts remain a challenge for the safe deployment of large language models. We study whether contrastively learned representations can support safety detection without training an additional downstream classifier. We propose Jailbreak Detection with Prototype Inference (JDPI), which uses binary safety labels to construct harmful and benign prototypes and makes predictions from relative prototype distances. JDPI uses only binary safety labels for encoder adaptation, prototype construction, and validation. In our setup, it uses fewer labeled examples than the classifier baseline (Method A) by avoiding the separate split used to train the downstream classifier. Across four benchmarks covering different input formats, contrastive fine-tuning improves JDPI's detection accuracy by 9.1-18.0 percentage points. Using the same encoder, JDPI achieves slightly higher ROC-AUC on one benchmark and stays within 0.017 of the baseline across all four. With dataset-specific adaptation, JDPI exceeds the released Llama Guard 3-8B baseline by 0.173-0.310 in ROC-AUC across the four benchmarks. In multi-turn replay on TomGibbs, JDPI uses accumulated user history as the conversation unfolds, achieving higher conversation-level accuracy than when it uses the current turn alone. Across 12 directed transfers, JDPI outperforms the classifier by an average of 1.59 percentage points in accuracy, demonstrating stronger cross-dataset robustness.
zh_title: 基于对比原型结构的大语言模型越狱检测
translation: 大语言模型的越狱尝试和有害提示仍然是其安全部署的一大挑战。我们研究了对比学习得到的表示是否能够在不训练额外下游分类器的情况下支持安全检测。我们提出了基于原型推理的越狱检测（JDPI）方法，该方法利用二元安全标签构建有害和良性原型，并根据相对原型距离进行预测。JDPI仅使用二元安全标签进行编码器自适应、原型构建和验证。在我们的设置中，它通过避免用于训练下游分类器的独立数据集划分，比分类器基线（方法A）使用了更少的标记样本。在涵盖不同输入格式的四个基准测试中，对比微调使JDPI的检测准确率提高了9.1-18.0个百分点。使用相同的编码器，JDPI在一个基准测试上实现了略高的ROC-AUC，并在所有四个基准测试中与基线的差距保持在0.017以内。通过特定数据集的自适应，JDPI在四个基准测试中的ROC-AUC比发布的Llama Guard 3-8B基线高出0.173-0.310。在TomGibbs的多轮重放中，JDPI随着对话的展开使用累积的用户历史记录，实现了比单独使用当前轮次更高的对话级准确率。在12次定向迁移中，JDPI的准确率平均比分类器高出1.59个百分点，证明了更强的跨数据集鲁棒性。
tldr: 提出了一种名为JDPI的越狱检测方法，它利用对比原型结构进行推理，无需训练额外的下游分类器，即可在大语言模型中实现高效且鲁棒的有害提示检测。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种基于对比原型结构的大语言模型越狱检测方法（JDPI），无需训练额外的下游分类器，仅利用二元安全标签即可实现高效、鲁棒的检测。创新之处在于利用对比学习构建安全与有害原型并通过相对距离进行预测，展示了出色的跨数据集鲁棒性和少样本学习能力。
motivation: 大语言 models 的安全部署面临越狱攻击和有害提示词的挑战，本研究旨在探讨对比学习表示是否能在不训练额外下游分类器的情况下支持安全检测。
method: 提出Jailbreak Detection with Prototype Inference (JDPI)方法，利用二元安全标签构建有害和良性原型，通过计算相对原型距离来进行预测，并在编码器适应、原型构建和验证中仅使用二元安全标签。
results: 在四个基准测试中，对比微调将JDPI的检测准确率提高了9.1-18.0个百分点；在ROC-AUC指标上与基线相当，并在特定数据集适应下显著超越Llama Guard 3-8B基线；在多轮对话中表现出更高的会话级准确率，且跨数据集鲁棒性优于传统分类器。
conclusion: JDPI通过对比原型结构和相对距离度量，在不需要额外下游分类器的情况下，实现了与基线相当甚至更优的越狱检测性能，同时具备更强的跨数据集鲁棒性。

title: $Z$-sight: Unifying Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
authors: Junjie Ye, Yiqi Zhao, Muchen Xu, Celina Shiyu Wang, Hao Dong, Ruohai Ge, Rong Xue, Benjamin J Kolligs, Aditya Dutt, Sasanka Nagavalli, Nassim A. Samad, Gaurav S. Sukhatme, Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh, Yue Wang, Yuliang Guo
abstract: We introduce $Z$-sight, a unified robot foundation model that couples vision-language-action (VLA) and generative latent world modeling. Video-based world action models (WAMs) show the value of joint future-and-action generation for control, yet inherit the heavy cost of video generators. Recent latent-space policies avoid pixel generation, yet typically align intermediate features or rely on frozen target encoders, decoupling future prediction from the VLM's native feature space. $Z$-sight instead predicts the future directly in the visual token space in which its VLM perceives the present. Coupling a foresight expert and a continuous action expert with the VLM in a mixture-of-transformers, $Z$-sight jointly denoises future spatial tokens and actions at inference without pixel reconstruction or external encoders. Trained on human video and robot trajectories, $Z$-sight achieves 81.9% success on SIMPLE (+9.6 points over the strongest baseline) and 73.3% across six Unitree G1 tasks (+20.0 points) at 110 ms per chunk, while remaining competitive on tabletop benchmarks.
zh_title: Z-sight：统一视觉-语言-动作与潜在世界建模
translation: 我们介绍了Z-sight，一个将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）与生成式潜在世界建模相结合的统一机器人基础模型。基于视频的世界动作模型（WAMs）展示了联合未来与动作生成对于控制的价值，但继承了视频生成器的高昂成本。最近的潜在空间策略避免了像素生成，但通常对齐中间特征或依赖于冻结的目标编码器，将未来预测与VLM的原生特征空间解耦。相反，Z-sight直接在其VLM感知当下的视觉Token空间中预测未来。通过将远见专家和连续动作专家与VLM通过混合Transformer耦合，Z-sight在推理时联合去噪未来的空间Token和动作，而无需像素重建或外部编码器。在人类视频和机器人轨迹上训练后，Z-sight在SIMPLE上取得了81.9%的成功率（比最强基线高9.6个百分点），在六个Unitree G1任务上取得了73.3%的成功率（高20.0个百分点），每个数据块耗时110毫秒，同时在桌面基准测试中保持竞争力。
tldr: Z-sight是一个统一的机器人基础模型，它将视觉-语言-动作模型与潜在世界建模相结合，直接在VLM的视觉Token空间中预测未来和生成动作，实现了高效、高精度的机器人控制。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与潜在世界建模（Latent World Modeling）统一起来，直接在VLM原生的视觉Token空间中进行未来预测和动作生成，避免了高昂的像素生成成本和外部编码器的解耦问题。在多个机器人数据集上表现出色，具有很高的实用价值和性能提升。
motivation: 现有的基于视频的世界动作模型（WAMs）计算成本高昂，而基于潜在空间的策略通常依赖于冻结的目标编码器或对齐中间特征，导致未来预测与VLM的原生特征空间解耦。为了解决这些问题，需要一个将VLA与潜在世界建模有机统一的模型。
method: 结合远见专家（foresight expert）和连续动作专家（continuous action expert）与VLM组成混合Transformer架构（mixture-of-transformers），直接在VLM感知的视觉Token空间中联合去噪未来空间Token和动作，无需像素重建或外部编码器。
results: 在SIMPLE基准测试上取得81.9%的成功率（比最强基线高9.6个百分点），在六个Unitree G1任务上取得73.3%的成功率（高20.0个百分点），每个数据块推理时间为110毫秒，同时在桌面基准测试中保持竞争力。
conclusion: Z-sight成功统一了VLA与潜在世界建模，在多项机器人操作和人形机器人任务中取得了显著的性能提升，且推理速度高效。

title: Reusing formal Vlasov-Maxwell proofs to certify plasma solver outputs
authors: Bowen Zhu, Jian Wu
abstract: AI now produces machine-checked mathematics faster than researchers can read it. Can such theorems do practical computational work? We reuse one from \mbox{OpenAI's} Lean~4 relativistic Vlasov--Maxwell library: initial fields determine the field at an outside point until plasma signals reach it, and the energy leaving a surrounding box before they reach its faces. New Lean proofs and numerical bounds give particle-free references for particle-in-cell simulations across three tasks. Domain size follows analytically from observation time, exposing boundary and initialization errors in WarpX and Smilei that global energy checks missed. Grid choice can be tested directly: combining two coarse grids recovers unknown plasma inputs within tolerance at a median 14.9-fold speedup over a fine grid, where the medium grid alone fails. For reduced models, the bounds establish the minimum number of time curves needed to predict energy loss.
comment: 39 pages (including Supplementary Information), 8 figures, 5 ancillary files (source data and video). Submitted to Nature Computational Science
zh_title: 重用形式化Vlasov-Maxwell证明以认证等离子体求解器输出
translation: 人工智能现在生成机器检查数学的速度比研究人员阅读它的速度还要快。这些定理能做实际的计算工作吗？我们重用了OpenAI的Lean 4相对论Vlasov-Maxwell库中的一个定理：初始场决定了外部某一点的场，直到等离子体信号到达该点，并且能量在信号到达包围盒面之前离开该包围盒。新的Lean证明和数值界限为三个任务中的粒子网格法模拟提供了无粒子参考。域大小根据观察时间进行解析推导，暴露出全局能量检查所错过的WarpX和Smilei中的边界和初始化误差。网格选择可以直接测试：结合两个粗网格在容差范围内恢复了未知的等离子体输入，中等网格单独失效时，其加速比中位数为14.9倍。对于简化模型，这些边界确定了预测能量损失所需的最少时间曲线数。
tldr: 通过重用形式化Vlasov-Maxwell数学证明来验证等离子体模拟软件的输出，能够有效发现隐藏误差并优化计算网格选择。
ai_comments: 该论文展示了如何将形式化数学定理（如Lean 4证明）应用于实际计算物理中，通过严格的解析边界和能量界限来诊断和验证先进等离子体模拟软件（如WarpX和Smilei）的数值误差，为计算科学与形式化验证的结合提供了新思路。
motivation: 探讨人工智能生成的、经过机器检查的数学定理是否能够进行实际的计算工作，即如何重用形式化的Vlasov-Maxwell证明来认证等离子体求解器的输出。
method: 重用OpenAI的Lean 4相对论Vlasov-Maxwell库中的形式化定理，结合新的Lean证明和数值边界，为粒子网格法模拟提供无粒子的参考标准，应用于确定域大小、测试网格选择及确定简化模型的时间曲线数量。
results: 通过解析方法得出域大小，暴露出传统全局能量检查未能发现的WarpX和Smilei软件中的边界和初始化误差；通过组合粗网格在容差范围内恢复未知等离子体输入，比细网格实现显著加速；确立了预测能量损失所需的最小时间曲线数。
conclusion: 形式化Vlasov-Maxwell证明能够成功应用于等离子体模拟的输出认证，有效识别传统全局能量检查无法发现的边界和初始化误差，优化网格选择并指导简化模型。

title: UltraTex: Aligning Physical Knowledge for High-Fidelity PBR Texture Generation
authors: Jingzhi Bao, Xiaohe Ma, Hong Li, Yuanming Hu, Xiaoguang Han
abstract: Generating physically based rendering (PBR) texture maps for a 3D mesh from a single reference image is highly ambiguous, as the observed appearance entangles material identity, surface reflectance, and illumination. While current generative methods produce realistic albedo maps, they still struggle to infer accurate metallic and roughness attributes for relighting. We present UltraTex, a cascaded multi-view framework that moves beyond appearance matching by integrating physical knowledge into multi-view diffusion-based PBR generation. UltraTex first jointly predicts albedo and world-space shading normals to generate more detailed albedo maps, and then predicts metallic-roughness (MR) maps conditioned on the generated albedo, reference image, and material semantic priors. To inject material semantics, a lightweight adapter transforms hidden-layer features of a vision-language model (VLM) into intrinsic material representation tokens, providing part-level knowledge anchors for MR estimation. To model material-light interaction, photometric representation alignment guides intermediate diffusion features toward ground-truth material renderings under controlled lighting. This makes metallic and roughness variations observable through highlight intensity, specular sharpness, and local reflectance contrast, providing stronger guidance for fine-grained material prediction without explicit lighting supervision. Extensive experiments show that UltraTex generates high-quality textures and outperforms existing open-source and commercial methods in visual fidelity, material accuracy, and physical plausibility.
comment: Accepted to ACM Transactions on Graphics (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026). Project page: https://ultratex.vercel.app/
zh_title: UltraTex：为高保真PBR纹理生成对齐物理知识
translation: 从单个参考图像为3D网格生成基于物理渲染（PBR）的纹理贴图高度模糊，因为观测到的外观交织了材质属性、表面反射率和光照。虽然当前的的生成方法能够产生逼真的反照率贴图，但它们在推断用于重新光照的准确金属和粗糙度属性时仍然存在困难。我们提出了UltraTex，这是一个级联的多视图框架，通过将物理知识集成到基于多视图扩散的PBR生成中，超越了单纯的外观匹配。UltraTex首先联合预测反照率和世界空间着色法线以生成更详细的反照率贴图，然后以生成的反照率、参考图像和材质语义先验为条件预测金属-粗糙度（MR）贴图。为了注入材质语义，一个轻量级适配器将视觉语言模型（VLM）的隐藏层特征转换为内在材质表示标记，为MR估计提供部件级的知识锚点。为了对材质与光的交互进行建模，光度表征对齐引导中间扩散特征朝向受控光照下的真实材质渲染。这使得金属和粗糙度的变化可以通过高光强度、高光锐度和局部反射率对比度被观察到，从而在没有显式光照监督的情况下为细粒度材质预测提供更强的引导。大量实验表明，UltraTex能够生成高质量的纹理，并在视觉保真度、材质准确性和物理合理性方面优于现有的开源和商业方法。
tldr: UltraTex通过将物理知识与多视图扩散模型相结合，解决了单图生成高质量PBR纹理时材质属性推断不准的难题。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将物理知识（如材质语义和光度表征对齐）引入多视图扩散模型中，解决了单图3D网格PBR纹理生成中材质属性推断不准的难题，显著提升了生成纹理的视觉保真度和物理合理性。
motivation: 从单张参考图像为3D网格生成基于物理渲染（PBR）的纹理图高度模糊，因为观测到的外观夹杂了材质属性、表面反射率和光照，现有生成方法难以准确推断用于重新光照的金属和粗糙度属性。
method: 提出UltraTex级联多视图框架：首先联合预测反照率和世界空间着色法线以生成精细的反照率图，然后结合反照率、参考图像及利用轻量级适配器从视觉语言模型（VLM）中提取的材质语义先验，预测金属-粗糙度（MR）图；同时通过光度表征对齐引导中间扩散特征逼近受控光照下的真实材质渲染效果。
results: 广泛的实验表明，UltraTex能够生成高质量的纹理，并在视觉保真度、材质准确性和物理合理性方面超越了现有的开源和商业方法。
conclusion: UltraTex通过整合物理知识与级联多视图扩散框架，有效解决了单图PBR纹理生成中的歧义性问题，在视觉保真度、材质准确性和物理合理性方面均优于现有开源和商业方法。

title: Phoenix: Learning Scene Structure Representations for Generalizable World-Action Models
authors: Yupeng Zheng, Chaoyue Li, Linbo Wang, Xiang Li, Yuhang Zheng, Xiaotong Su, Songen Gu, Yichen Zhang, Zebin Xing, Shuai Tian, Jingxiang Guo, Jing Li, Zhiyong Zhao, Zhongpu Xia, Qichao Zhang, Haoran Li, Shuicheng Yan, Dongbin Zhao
abstract: World-action models jointly predict future observations and actions, yet reconstruction-oriented visual representations do not explicitly emphasize the spatial relationships and object-state changes needed for manipulation. We introduce Phoenix, which learns representations of scene structure for world-action modeling. Specifically, Phoenix Encoder enriches DINOv3's general visual semantics through dual-teacher distillation of geometric and spatiotemporal semantic knowledge. Next, CS-VAE causally aggregates and compresses Phoenix Encoder features into generative latents while preserving scene information and spatial layout. Finally, Phoenix jointly predicts these latents, complementary appearance latents, and robot actions, linking scene evolution with action generation. To study pretraining data efficiency, we curate approximately 39,000 hours of egocentric and robot manipulation data for representation learning and use the robot demonstration subset for WAM pretraining. Following benchmark-specific post-training, Phoenix achieves state-of-the-art performance across simulation and real-robot benchmarks spanning single-arm, bimanual, and dexterous manipulation. It demonstrates strong robustness to perturbations, achieving success rates of 94.8% on LIBERO-Plus and 72.4% on RoboTwin 2.0 C2R, alongside strong cross-embodiment transfer and real-world manipulation performance on Bench2Dex and RoboDojo-RealWorld, respectively. Pretraining-scale analysis shows larger performance gains from data scaling than a video-VAE-only baseline, indicating stronger scaling benefits and more effective data utilization. Moreover, Phoenix maintains high success rates when adapted with limited downstream demonstrations, demonstrating strong few-shot adaptation. Our code, pretraining data, and models are available on the project page to help the community reproduce our results.
zh_title: Phoenix：为可泛化的世界-动作模型学习场景结构表征
translation: 世界-动作模型联合预测未来的观察和动作，然而面向重建的视觉表征并未显式强调操作所需的空间关系和物体状态变化。我们推出了Phoenix，它为世界-动作建模学习场景结构表征。具体而言，Phoenix编码器通过几何与时空语义知识的双教师蒸馏，丰富了DINOv3的通用视觉语义。接着，CS-VAE在保留场景信息和空间布局的同时，将Phoenix编码器的特征因果聚合并压缩为生成隐变量。最后，Phoenix联合预测这些隐变量、互补的外观隐变量以及机器人动作，将场景演化与动作生成联系起来。为了研究预训练数据的效率，我们收集了约39,000小时的自我中心和机器人操作数据用于表征学习，并使用机器人示范子集进行WAM预训练。经过基准特定的后训练，Phoenix在涵盖单臂、双臂和灵巧操作的模拟和真实机器人基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。它表现出对扰动的强鲁棒性，在LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0 C2R上分别取得了94.8%和72.4%的成功率，同时在Bench2Dex和RoboDojo-RealWorld上分别展现出强大的跨具身迁移和真实世界操作性能。预训练规模分析表明，与仅使用视频-VAE的基线相比，数据扩展带来了更大的性能提升，这表明其具有更强的扩展收益和更高效的数据利用率。此外，Phoenix在通过有限的下游示范进行适配时仍能保持高成功率，展现出强大的少样本适应能力。我们的代码、预训练数据和模型已在项目主页上发布，以帮助社区复现我们的结果。
tldr: Phoenix是一种用于世界-动作模型的场景结构表征学习方法，通过增强几何与时空语义感知，在多项机器人操作基准测试中实现了最先进的性能与出色的泛化能力。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种名为Phoenix的世界-动作模型，创新性地通过双教师蒸馏和因果聚合变分自编码器（CS-VAE）来学习显式的场景结构表示，从而克服了传统重建导向视觉表征在机器人操作任务中的局限性。在多个模拟和真实机器人基准测试中均展现出了最先进的性能以及极强的泛化和数据扩展能力。
motivation: 现有的世界-动作模型（World-action models）多依赖于注重重建的视觉表征，无法显式强调机器人操作所需的空间关系和物体状态变化。
method: 提出Phoenix编码器通过几何与时空语义知识的双教师蒸馏来丰富DINOv3的通用视觉语义，并利用CS-VAE将特征因果聚合和压缩为生成隐变量，最终联合预测隐变量、外观隐变量和机器人动作。
results: 在仿真和真实机器人基准测试（如LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0、Bench2Dex等）中取得了最先进的性能，对扰动表现出强鲁棒性，具备优秀的跨具身迁移、少样本适应能力和数据规模扩展收益。
conclusion: Phoenix通过学习显式的场景结构表示，有效提升了世界-动作模型在各种复杂机器人操作任务中的泛化能力、鲁棒性和少样本适应性，并在数据规模扩展上表现出显著优势。

title: A Differential Theory of Quality-Resource Trade-offs for AI Model Selection: The Multiresource Frontier and Its Minimax Price
authors: Dmitry Ignatov
abstract: Comparing AI models across resource budgets yields quality-resource frontiers relating error to latency, parameter count, training compute, and energy. Offset power laws summarize such frontiers, but their fitted parameters reveal neither the price-independent geometry nor the manner in which trade-offs extend across several resource channels. This paper addresses both gaps by developing a differential theory in which this structure is made explicit. Each frontier admits a price-independent plane-curve representation relating the effective number of active resource channels, $N_{\mathrm{eff}} = s^2/κ$ (squared slope over curvature), to the remaining log-error depth, $ΔS = \ln(\varepsilon/\varepsilon_{\infty})$. This representation separates intrinsic shape from the scale and origin of the resource axis. Complete monotonicity and divisibility yield differential inequalities and frontier bounds. When each of $N$ resources contributes one active channel, the theory gives the parameter-free operating rule $N_{\mathrm{eff}} = 1$ in delivered units and derives minimax resource prices $λ^{\star}_i = α_i/(N+1)$ with an exact worst-case regret of $\ln(N+1)$ nats. The results make it possible to interpret measured frontiers and compare resource costs without hand-chosen exchange rates. The theory is evaluated on 117 published frontiers and implemented in the open-source package nn-rank, which derives prices from measured quality and cost, ranks candidates, and reports supported choices and minimax regret: https://github.com/ABrain-One/nn-rank
zh_title: AI模型选择中质量-资源权衡的微分理论：多资源前沿与其极 minimax 价格
translation: 跨资源预算比较AI模型会产生将误差与延迟、参数数量、训练计算和能量联系起来的质量-资源前沿。偏移幂律总结了此类前沿，但其拟合参数既没有揭示与价格无关的几何形状，也没有揭示权衡如何在多个资源渠道中延伸。本文通过开发一个使这种结构明确的微分理论来填补这两个空白。每个前沿都承认一个与价格无关的平面曲线表示，将有效活动资源通道数 $N_{\mathrm{eff}} = s^2/\kappa$（斜率平方除以曲率）与剩余对数误差深度 $\Delta S = \ln(\varepsilon/\varepsilon_{\infty})$ 联系起来。这种表示将内在形状与资源轴的比例和原点分离开来。完全单调性和可分性产生了微分不等式和前沿界限。当 $N$ 个资源中的每一个贡献一个活动通道时，该理论给出了交付单位下的无参数操作规则 $N_{\mathrm{eff}} = 1$，并推导出了极 minimax 资源价格 $\lambda^{\star}_i = \alpha_i/(N+1)$，其精确的最坏情况遗憾为 $\ln(N+1)$ nats。这些结果使得解释测量的边界和比较资源成本成为可能，而无需人工选择的汇率。该理论在 117 个已发表的前沿上进行了评估，并在开源包 nn-rank 中实现了，该包根据测量的质量和成本推导价格、对候选人进行排名，并报告支持的选择和极 minimax 遗憾：https://github.com/ABrain-One/nn-rank
tldr: 本文建立了一个关于AI模型选择中质量与多资源权衡的微分理论，能够无需主观汇率即可比较资源成本并指导模型选择。
ai_comments: 该论文为AI模型选择中的质量-资源权衡问题建立了一个优雅的微分理论框架，摆脱了对主观汇率（exchange rates）的依赖，并通过极 minimax 价格和有效资源通道的概念，为多资源约束下的模型选择提供了严格的数学基础和开源工具。
motivation: 现有的偏移幂律（offset power laws）拟合参数无法揭示与价格无关的几何形状，也无法展示权衡如何在多个资源通道间延伸。本文旨在通过微分理论填补这两个空白，以便在不需要人工选择的汇率的情况下解释测得的前沿并比较资源成本。
method: 开发了一个微分理论，将前沿表示为与价格无关的平面曲线（关联有效活动资源通道数 $N_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 与剩余对数误差深度 $\Delta S$），利用完全单调性和可分性推导微分不等式和前沿界限，并推导极 minimax 资源价格。
results: 当每个资源贡献一个活动通道时，导出了无参数的操作规则 $N_{\mathrm{eff}} = 1$，以及极 minimax 资源价格 $\lambda^{\star}_i = \alpha_i/(N+1)$（具有 $\ln(N+1)$ nats 的确切最坏情况遗憾）。该理论在 117 个已发表的前沿上进行了评估，并开源了实现该理论的 nn-rank 包。
conclusion: 本文成功开发了质量-资源权衡的微分理论，引入了价格无关的平面曲线表示、有效资源通道数及极 minimax 价格，并通过公开工具进行了广泛验证，解决了AI模型选择中多资源成本比较的难题。

title: Classification of Forbidden 0-1 Patterns by Their Extremal Function
authors: Jesse Geneson, Seth Pettie
abstract: This paper concerns the maximum weight of $n\times n$ 0-1 matrices that avoid some pattern $P$, denoted $\operatorname{ex}(n,P)$. Furedi and Hajnal initiated a research program of classifying all patterns according to their extremal function, but to date, only the weight-4 patterns are completely understood. In this paper we make progress on several fronts of the classification problem. A pattern is light if its columns have weight 1 and linear if $\operatorname{ex}(n,P)=O(n)$. We characterize the set of weight-5 linear light patterns, and the set of weight-5 linear patterns more generally. Along the way we identify several new infinite classes of linear patterns, which support the Pettie-Tardos conjecture on characterizing all linear light patterns. It was known that there exist infinitely many minimally nonlinear patterns. We identify a specific infinite set of minimally nonlinear patterns. We also prove that there are $2^{Ω(r)}$ weight-$r$ minimally nonlinear patterns, and that every minimally nonlinear pattern has extremal function $O(n\log n)$, with the exception of the 4-cycle. We classify many of the outstanding weight-5 patterns according to their extremal function, leaving only a small set remaining. The newly classified weight-5 patterns have extremal function $Θ(n)$ or $Θ(nα(n))$. We also exhibit a large number of weight-6 patterns with extremal function $Θ(n\log n/\log\log n)$, which is notable in that this function had not been encountered before for any single pattern $P$, though it was known to be the correct extremal function for a pair of forbidden patterns.
zh_title: 根据极值函数对禁止的0-1模式进行分类
translation: 本文研究了避免某些模式 $P$ 的 $n\times n$ 0-1矩阵的最大权重，记为 $\operatorname{ex}(n,P)$。Furedi 和 Hajnal 开启了一项根据极值函数对所有模式进行分类的研究计划，但迄今为止，只有重量为 4 的模式被完全理解。在本文中，我们在分类问题的几个方面取得了进展。如果一个模式的列重为 1，则称其为轻模式；如果 $\operatorname{ex}(n,P)=O(n)$，则称其为线性模式。我们刻画了重量为 5 的线性轻模式集，以及更一般的重量为 5 的线性模式集。在此过程中，我们识别了几个新的线性模式的无穷类，这支持了关于刻画所有线性轻模式的 Pettie-Tardos 猜想。已知存在无限多个极小非线性模式。我们识别出一个特定的极小非线性模式的无限集。我们还证明了存在 $2^{\Omega(r)}$ 个重量为 $r$ 的极小非线性模式，并且除了 4-圈之外，每个极小非线性模式的极值函数都是 $O(n\log n)$。我们根据极值函数对许多未解决的重量为 5 的模式进行了分类，仅留下少量模式未解。新分类的重量为 5 的模式其极值函数为 $\Theta(n)$ 或 $\Theta(n\alpha(n))$。我们还展示了大量极值函数为 $\Theta(n\log n/\log\log n)$ 的重量为 6 的模式，这值得注意的是，对于任何单个模式 $P$，以前从未遇到过这种函数，尽管已知它是某对禁止模式的正确极值函数。
tldr: 该论文推进了0-1矩阵中禁止模式的极值函数分类，重点研究了5重和6重模式，发现了新的线性及极小非线性模式类，并揭示了前所未见的极值函数。
ai_comments: 该论文在禁止0-1模式的极值函数分类问题上取得了重要进展，特别是对重量为5和6的模式进行了深入研究，识别出新的线性模式和极小非线性模式类，并首次发现某些单个模式具有特定的超线性极值函数。这为理解Furedi-Hajnal猜想和Pettie-Tardos猜想提供了重要的理论支撑。
motivation: 延续Furedi和Hajnal提出的根据极值函数对所有禁止0-1模式进行分类的研究计划，解决当前仅完全了解重量为4的模式的局限，并在重量为5和6的模式分类上取得新进展。
method: 通过理论分析和组合数学方法，研究包含特定禁止模式的n×n 0-1矩阵的最大权重，刻画不同权重模式的极值函数行为。
results: 刻画了重量为5的线性和轻线性模式集；识别了新的无穷类线性模式和极小非线性模式；证明了极小非线性模式的数量随权重呈指数增长且其极值函数除4-cycle外均为O(n log n)；分类了多数剩余的5重模式；发现了具有新极值函数Θ(n log n / log log n)的大量6重模式。
conclusion: 论文推进了0-1矩阵禁止模式的极值函数分类，刻画了5重线性模式，找到了新的无穷类线性模式和极小非线性模式，并发现了新的极值函数界。

title: SurgCBVR: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Content-Based Surgical Video-to-Video Retrieval
authors: Mohammad Eslami, Mousa Moradi, Negin Ghamsarian, Nazlee Zebardast, Jennifer L Lindsey, Sophia Y. Wang, Lucia Sobrin, Rishi P Singh, Tobias Elze
abstract: Hospitals record thousands of hours of surgical video annually, yet these archives remain difficult to search by content. Surgeons cannot readily retrieve similar operations, complications, or workflow events. Existing surgical computer vision primarily produces labels rather than retrieving relevant videos. We introduce SurgCBVR, the first benchmark for content-based video-to-video retrieval in surgery. It integrates eight public datasets across four domains-ophthalmic, laparoscopic, robotic-assisted, and colonoscopy-covering six procedure types, 679 cases, and 76,489 clips (106 hours). SurgCBVR comprises two tiers: Scene, retrieving the same operative state across cases and sites, and Workflow, retrieving and localizing phase transitions and deviations. Scene includes 74,765 clips spanning 40 classes, three temporal granularities, and three playback speeds; Workflow contains 1,724 transition clips. Fixed clip lengths and frame counts, together with phase-classifier oracle and duration-only baselines, help assess label and timing shortcuts. We evaluate six generic and surgical foundation models, two video retrieval methods, and contrastive heads trained on SurgCBVR, using within-dataset, cross-dataset, and pooled-gallery retrieval restricted to the same procedure type. Frozen representations barely outperform a timing-only baseline, transition retrieval approaches chance, and trained heads lose up to half their accuracy across datasets. These findings expose substantial limitations in current video representations and establish SurgCBVR as a benchmark for advancing surgery-aware retrieval.
zh_title: SurgCBVR：一个用于内容基外科视频到视频检索的多领域基准
translation: 医院每年记录数千小时的手术视频，然而这些档案仍然很难按内容进行搜索。外科医生无法轻易检索到类似的手术、并发症或工作流事件。现有的外科计算机视觉主要产生标签而不是检索相关视频。我们介绍了SurgCBVR，这是外科领域内容基视频到视频检索的第一个基准。它整合了四个领域（眼科、腹腔镜、机器人辅助和结肠镜）的八个公共数据集，涵盖六种手术类型、679个病例和76489个片段（106小时）。SurgCBVR包含两个层级：场景（Scene），检索跨病例和地点的相同手术状态；工作流（Workflow），检索和定位阶段转换与偏差。场景层级包括跨越40个类别、三个时间粒度和三个播放速度的74765个片段；工作流层级包含1724个转换片段。固定的片段长度和帧数，以及阶段分类器oracle和纯持续时间基线，有助于评估标签和时间捷径。我们评估了六个通用和外科基础模型、两个视频检索方法，以及在SurgCBVR上训练的对比学习头，使用了数据集内部、跨数据集和限制在相同手术类型的合并图库检索。冻结的表示几乎不比仅时间的基线表现更好，转换检索方法接近随机，训练好的表现在跨数据集时损失了一半的准确性。这些发现暴露出当前视频表示的巨大局限性，并确立了SurgCBVR作为推进外科感知检索的基准。
tldr: SurgCBVR是首个多领域外科视频检索基准，通过对多款基础模型的测试，揭示了当前视频表征在跨数据集泛化和时序理解上的重大局限。
ai_comments: SurgCBVR填补了外科手术视频检索领域缺乏综合基准的空白，跨越多个领域和数据集，对现有的基础模型和视频检索方法进行了严苛的测试，发现当前模型在泛化能力和细粒度时序理解上存在显著局限，对推动外科计算机视觉的发展具有重要意义。
motivation: 医院每年记录大量手术视频但内容难以检索，现有的外科计算机视觉研究主要关注标签生成而非检索相关视频，缺乏一个统一的、多领域的内容基外科视频到视频检索（CBVR）基准。
method: 构建了一个包含八个公开数据集（覆盖四个领域、六种手术类型、679个病例、76489个片段）的SurgCBVR基准，设立Scene（场景检索）和Workflow（工作流检索）两个层级；评估了六种通用及外科基础模型、两种视频检索方法以及在SurgCBVR上训练的对比学习头部，并采用了数据集内、跨数据集和合并图库的评估策略。
results: 冷冻特征表示几乎仅略微优于纯时间基线，转换检索方法的表现接近随机，训练后的对比学习头部在不同数据集间准确率下降高达一半，暴露出当前视频表示的巨大局限性。
conclusion: 现有通用及外科基础模型在内容基外科视频检索任务中表现受限（部分仅略优于纯时间基线），跨数据集泛化能力差，SurgCBVR作为首个多领域外科视频检索基准，成功揭示了当前技术的不足并指明了未来改进方向。

title: Neural Circuit Architectural Priors for Rat Locomotion
authors: Nikhil X. Bhattasali, Jaron Cui, Lerrel Pinto, Grace W. Lindsay
abstract: Animals generate behavior through continuous interactions between their neural circuits, bodies, and environment. Embodied simulations study these interactions by testing neural circuit models in biologically realistic settings. Recent efforts have simulated diverse animals, and emerging work on biologically grounded neural architectures has begun to integrate circuit connectivity and single-unit dynamics from experimental data into artificial neural networks, introducing stronger inductive biases and closer mechanistic alignment with biology. How can we develop embodied simulations that enable the study of increasingly complex bodies and neural circuits? In this work, we address the challenge through coordinated advances in the simulated body, neural architecture, and training infrastructure. We introduce Rat v2, an efficient and flexible biomechanical body for simulating rat behavior. To control this body, we develop Rat NCAP, a biologically grounded neural architecture for locomotion based on mammalian spinal circuits that incorporates cell-type-specific connectivity and a novel flexor-extensor neuromechanical interface. To optimize circuit parameters, we develop GPU-accelerated simulation and training infrastructure. The model learns to locomote at different speeds and transition between gaits without imitation learning, producing locomotion statistics, kinematics, and cell-type-specific neural activity consistent with experimental data. Analyses reveal that the neuromechanical interface substantially affects trainability and gait quality, and in silico cell-type ablations reproduce known gait phenotypes and predict gait changes under graded perturbations. Together, these findings support the view that embodied simulations at an intermediate level of abstraction can simultaneously reproduce complex behavior and yield mechanistic insights into the neural circuits that generate it.
comment: NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages main text, 41 pages total, 7 figures in main text. Code and videos: https://rat-ncap.github.io/
zh_title: 用于大鼠运动的神经环路架构先验
translation: 动物通过其神经电路、身体和环境之间的持续交互来产生行为。具身仿真通过在生物学真实的设置中测试神经电路模型来研究这些交互。最近的努力模拟了多种动物，并且关于生物学基础神经架构的兴起工作已开始将实验数据中的电路连接和单单元动力学整合到人工神经网络中，引入了更强的归纳偏置和更接近生物学的机械对齐。我们如何才能开发出能够研究日益复杂的身体和神经电路的具身仿真呢？在这项工作中，我们通过在模拟身体、神经架构和训练基础设施方面的协调进展来应对这一挑战。我们推出了Rat v2，这是一种用于模拟大鼠行为的高效且灵活的生物力学身体。为了控制这个身体，我们开发了Rat NCAP，这是一种基于哺乳动物脊髓电路的用于运动的生物学基础神经架构，它结合了细胞类型特异性连接和一种新颖的屈肌-伸肌神经机械接口。为了优化电路参数，我们开发了GPU加速的仿真和训练基础设施。该模型无需模仿学习即可学会以不同速度运动并在步态之间转换，产生的运动统计数据、运动学和细胞类型特异性神经活动与实验数据一致。分析表明，神经机械接口对可训练性和步态质量有很大影响，计算机细胞类型消融复制了已知的步态表型，并预测了渐进扰动下的步态变化。总之，这些发现支持了这样一种观点，即处于中等抽象水平的具身仿真可以同时复制复杂的行为，并产生对生成该行为的神经电路的机制洞察。
tldr: 该论文通过结合生物学基础的神经架构（Rat NCAP）与高效的大鼠身体模型（Rat v2），成功仿真了大鼠的自然运动与步态转换，并验证了细胞特异性的神经机制。
ai_comments: 该论文通过结合生物学上真实的大鼠脊髓神经环路架构（Rat NCAP）与高效的生物力学身体模型（Rat v2），在具身仿真领域取得了重要进展。其创新点在于不依赖模仿学习就能自发涌现出自然的步态转换，并且能够进行细胞特异性的计算机消融实验，为理解神经环路机制提供了强大的工具。
motivation: 为了开发能够研究日益复杂的身体和神经环路的具身仿真，通过在模拟身体、神经架构和训练基础设施方面取得协调一致的进展，克服现有模拟的局限性。
method: 开发了高效灵活的生物力学身体模型Rat v2；构建了基于哺乳动物脊髓电路的生物学基础神经架构Rat NCAP；以及用于优化电路参数的GPU加速仿真与训练基础设施。
results: 模型无需模仿学习即可学会在不同速度下 locomotion 并进行步态转换，生成的运动统计数据、运动学和细胞特异性神经活动与实验数据一致；消融实验复现了已知的步态表型并预测了渐进扰动下的步态变化。
conclusion: 处于中等抽象水平的具身仿真能够同时复现复杂的动物行为，并为生成该行为的底层神经环路提供机械动力学洞察。

title: Optimal Joint Bounds for Sparse Ground-State Energy Estimation and Ground-State Preparation
authors: Dhrumil Patel
abstract: Ground-state energy estimation (GSEE) and ground-state preparation (GSP) are fundamental problems in quantum computing. Given a Hamiltonian $H$ with $\|H\|\le1$ and a guiding state $|ψ\rangle$ with overlap at least $γ>0$ with the ground space of $H$, the goal in GSEE is to estimate the ground-state energy of $H$ to additive error $δ$ with failure probability at most $\varepsilon$, while in GSP it is to prepare a state with ground-space weight at least $1-\varepsilon$, given a gap lower bound $Δ$. Their costs are measured by quantum query complexity, i.e., the number of oracle calls needed to access $H$. Recent work proved optimal bounds $Θ(\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γδ))$ for GSEE and $Θ(\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γΔ))$ for GSP in the time-evolution and block-encoding models. However, these models do not directly account for the sparsity of $H$, measured by the maximum number $s$ of nonzero entries in any row or column. In the sparse-access model, oracles instead return the locations and values of these entries. This introduces the additional parameter $s$, and it remained open how query complexity depends jointly on $s$, $γ$, $δ$ or $Δ$, and $\varepsilon$. We resolve this by proving sparse-query lower bounds $Ω(\sqrt{s}\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γδ))$ for GSEE and $Ω(\sqrt{s}\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γΔ))$ for GSP, even for stoquastic Hamiltonians. We also show that these constructions recover the earlier time-evolution and block-encoding lower-bound scalings. We then give matching upper-bound algorithms in the reversible in-place sparse-location model. Thus, we obtain $Θ(\sqrt{s}\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γδ))$ for GSEE and $Θ(\sqrt{s}\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γΔ))$ for GSP, showing that $\sqrt{s}$ is necessary and sufficient and completing the joint dependence on all problem parameters.
zh_title: 稀疏基态能量估计与基态制备的最优联合界
translation: 基态能量估计（GSEE）和基态制备（GSP）是量子计算中的基本问题。给定一个哈密顿量 $H$（$\|H\|\le1$）和一个导引态 $|\psi\rangle$（其与 $H$ 的基空间的重叠至少为 $\gamma>0$），GSEE 的目标是以加性误差 $\delta$ 和不超过 $\varepsilon$ 的失败概率估计 $H$ 的基态能量，而在 GSP 中，给定一个能隙下限 $\Delta$，其目标是制备一个基空间权重至少为 $1-\varepsilon$ 的态。它们的成本由量子查询复杂度（即访问 $H$ 所需的预言机调用次数）来衡量。近期研究在时间演化和块编码模型中证明了 GSEE 的最优界 $\Theta(\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γ\delta))$ 和 GSP 的最优界 $\Theta(\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γΔ))$。然而，这些模型并未直接考虑 $H$ 的稀疏性（由任意行或列中非零条目的最大数量 $s$ 衡量）。在稀疏访问模型中，预言机会返回这些条目的位置和值。这引入了额外的参数 $s$，而查询复杂度如何联合依赖于 $s$、$γ$、$\delta$ 或 $\Delta$ 以及 $\varepsilon$ 长期以来一直是一个开放问题。我们通过证明即使对于随机哈密顿量，GSEE 的稀疏查询下界为 $\Omega(\sqrt{s}\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γ\delta))$，GSP 的下界为 $\Omega(\sqrt{s}\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γΔ))$，从而解决了这个问题。我们还表明这些构造恢复了早期时间演化和块编码模型的下界标度。随后，我们在可逆原位稀疏位置模型中给出了匹配的上界算法。因此，我们得到了 GSEE 的 $\Theta(\sqrt{s}\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γ\delta))$ 和 GSP 的 $\Theta(\sqrt{s}\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γΔ))$，表明 $\sqrt{s}$ 是必要且充分的，并完善了对所有问题参数的联合依赖性。
tldr: 该论文解决了量子计算中稀疏哈密顿量的基态能量估计和基态制备问题，证明了包含稀疏度$s$在内的最优查询复杂度界为$\Theta(\sqrt{s}\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γ\delta))$和$\Theta(\sqrt{s}\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γΔ))$。
ai_comments: 该论文首次完整给出了稀疏哈密顿量模型下基态能量估计（GSEE）和基态制备（GSP）的渐近最优联合界，证明了$\sqrt{s}$依赖关系的必要性与充分性，理论意义重大。
motivation: 先前的研究虽然在时间演化和块编码模型中证明了GSEE和GSP的最优界，但这些模型未直接考虑哈密顿量的稀疏性$s$。本文旨在解决稀疏访问模型下，查询复杂度如何联合依赖于$s$、$\gamma$、$\delta$/$\Delta$以及$\varepsilon$这一未解问题。
method: 通过证明稀疏查询下界（针对甚至包含随机哈密顿量的情况），并设计在可逆原位稀疏位置模型中的匹配上界算法，从而确立了最优的联合界。
results: 证明了GSEE的稀疏查询下界为$\Omega(\sqrt{s}\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γ\delta))$，GSP的下界为$\Omega(\sqrt{s}\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γ\Delta))$，并给出了相应的匹配上界算法，证实了$\sqrt{s}$是必要且充分的。
conclusion: 本文通过证明下界并提出匹配的上界算法，彻底解决了稀疏访问模型下GSEE和GSP的查询复杂度问题，确立了$\sqrt{s}\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γ\delta)$和$\sqrt{s}\log(1/\varepsilon)/(γ\Delta)$的最优界。

title: LIC-Audit: How Comparable Are Reported Gains in Learned Image Compression?
authors: Haisheng Fu, Jie Liang, Runyu Yang, Feng Ding, Xin Dong, Zixiao Jin, Jingning Han
abstract: Learned image compression (LIC) papers often report BD-rate improvements of only a few percent. They are measured against VTM reference software whose version keeps changing: the claims we audit name 7 versions, 5 in 2025 papers alone. But how comparable are these numbers across papers, and what evidence should future papers give for such small gains? We introduce LIC-Audit, an analysis of 353 released rate-distortion curves from 36 repositories, and a controlled re-evaluation of eight public codec releases with 28,193 encode-decode records. We identify three problems. First, different VTM reference runs change BD-rates by up to 3.56 percentage points, and on CLIC Pro published numbers order 10 of 55 method pairs differently from a common computation; comparing codecs directly over a fixed quality range removes this dependence. Second, releases use different and mostly undocumented conventions for counting bits, computing PSNR, and padding images. Under consistent measurement, the GLIC method's 1.00% lead over the HPCM method on Tecnick becomes a 1.43% deficit, changing only the padding reverses the comparison of HPCM and CMIC, and most gaps narrow when MS-SSIM replaces PSNR. Third, average curves hide how much results vary from image to image, so whether a small gain is statistically significant depends on the assumed variation. An optimistic assumption calls 12.0% of comparisons between equally good codecs significant on test sets as small as Kodak, instead of 5%; a cautious one leaves 18 of 45 differences between recent codecs undecided, yet per-image results show 12 of them to be significant. Beyond auditing past results, LIC-Audit provides a versioned evaluation protocol, a public leaderboard website with a scoring tool, source-linked benchmark data, per-image measurements, and reporting guidelines, to help future LIC papers make comparable and verifiable claims of progress.
zh_title: LIC-Audit：学习型图像压缩中报道的性能增益究竟具有多大可比性？
translation: 学习型图像 compression (LIC) 论文通常报告 BD-rate 仅有百分之几的改进。它们是以不断变化的 VTM 参考软件版本为基准进行测量的：我们审计的声明涉及 7 个版本，仅 2025 年的论文中就有 5 个。但是，这些数字在不同论文之间的可比性如何，未来的论文应该为如此小的增益提供什么证据？我们引入了 LIC-Audit，对来自 36 个代码库的 353 条发布的率失真曲线进行了分析，并对 8 个公开的编解码器发布版本进行了包含 28,193 条编码-解码记录的受控重新评估。我们发现了三个问题。首先，不同的 VTM 参考运行将 BD-rate 改变了最多 3.56 个百分点，并且在 CLIC Pro 上，已发布的数据对 55 个方法对中的 10 个的排序与通用计算不同；在固定的质量范围内直接比较编解码器消除了这种依赖性。其次，各个版本对于计算比特数、计算 PSNR 和图像填充使用了不同且大多未记录的约定。在一致的测量下，GLIC 方法在 Tecnick 上对 HPCM 方法的 1.00% 优势变成了 1.43% 的劣势，仅改变填充就会逆转 HPCM 和 CMIC 的比较，并且当用 MS-SSIM 代替 PSNR 时，大多数差距缩小了。第三，平均曲线掩盖了结果随图像的不同而变化的程度，因此微小的增益是否具有统计显著性取决于假设的变化。在乐观的假设下，在像 Kodak 这样小的测试集上，等效优质编解码器之间 12.0% 的比较被认为是显著的（而不是 5%）；谨慎的假设使最近编解码器之间的 45 个差异中有 18 个未决，但逐图像结果表明其中 12 个是显著的。除了审计过去的结果之外，LIC-Audit 还提供了一个版本化的评估协议、一个带有评分工具的公共排行榜网站、源码链接的基准数据、逐图像测量和报告指南，以帮助未来的 LIC 论文做出可比较和可验证的进展声明。
tldr: 本文通过对学习型图像压缩（LIC）文献的系统审计（LIC-Audit），发现由于参考软件版本、计算约定和统计显著性假设的不一致，当前论文中报道的小幅性能增益往往缺乏可比性，并为此提出了标准化的评估协议与工具。
ai_comments: 该论文针对学习型图像压缩（LIC）领域中微小性能提升的可比性问题进行了系统性审计，指出了当前评估标准不统一、参考软件版本多变及统计显著性不足等痛点，并提供了实用的开源评估工具与协议，对规范该领域的未来研究具有重要意义。
motivation: 当前学习型图像压缩（LIC）论文通常报告微小的BD-rate提升（仅百分之几），但其参考软件版本不断变化，引发了人们对这些数字跨论文可比性的质疑，因此需要进行系统性审计并探究未来应提供何种评估证据。
method: 引入了LIC-Audit，分析了来自36个代码库的353条率失真曲线，并对8个公开编解码器发布版本进行了包含28,193条编码-解码记录的受控重新评估。
results: 研究发现了三个主要问题：VTM参考运行版本差异导致BD-rate变化高达3.56个百分点；比特计算、PSNR计算和图像填充等约定不一致会逆转方法间的优劣比较；平均曲线掩盖了图像间的变异性，导致微小增益的统计显著性存疑。
conclusion: LIC-Audit揭示了当前LIC文献中微小BD-rate增益的不稳定性与不可比性，并提出了标准化的评估协议、排行榜及报告准则，旨在推动该领域走向更加严谨、可验证的发展方向。

title: Streaming Generative Video Compression with Embedding Alignment and In-Context Propagation
authors: Zhitao Wang, Hengyu Man, Han Liu, Wenrui Li, Debin Zhao, Xiaopeng Fan
abstract: Video compression at ultra-low bitrates presents substantial challenges in preserving perceptual quality. Although pretrained video diffusion transformers (DiTs) provide powerful generative priors, existing generative video compression (GVC) methods built on them typically rely on computationally expensive VAE decoders to reconstruct video frames. Moreover, jointly refining multiple frames to exploit the inherent spatiotemporal modeling capabilities of video DiTs introduces additional buffering delay. To address these challenges, we propose SGVC, a streaming generative video compression framework that adapts a pretrained latent video DiT into a causal pixel-space refiner. Specifically, SGVC projects decoded features from a contextual pixel codec directly into the DiT input embedding space. To bridge the representation gap between codec-derived embeddings and pretrained DiT embeddings, we introduce Embedding Alignment, which aligns the projected embeddings with input embeddings extracted from the original frames during training. The refined DiT hidden states are then mapped directly to the pixel domain through a lightweight reconstruction path, bypassing the pretrained VAE decoder. To further exploit the spatiotemporal priors of the video DiT while maintaining causal decoding, we introduce In-Context Propagation, which reuses layer-wise K/V states across frames to exploit historical generative context, improving temporal consistency without requiring clip-wise buffering. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SGVC achieves competitive rate-perception performance, with average BD-rate savings of 71.97% over S$^2$VC in terms of DISTS. Project Page: https://chigland.github.io/SGVC/
comment: 15 pages, 18 figures, 5 tables, including supplementary material
zh_title: 基于嵌入对齐与上下文传播的流式生成式视频压缩
translation: 极低比特率下的视频压缩在保持感知质量方面面临重大挑战。尽管预训练的视频扩散Transformer（DiTs）提供了强大的生成先验，但现有基于它们的生成式视频 compression（GVC）方法通常依赖计算成本高昂的VAE解码器来重建视频帧。此外，联合精炼多帧以利用视频DiT固有的时空建模能力会引入额外的缓冲延迟。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SGVC，一个将预训练的潜在视频DiT适配为因果像素级精炼器的流式生成式视频压缩框架。具体而言，SGVC将来自上下文像素编解码器的解码特征直接投影到DiT输入嵌入空间中。为了弥合编解码器派生嵌入与预训练DiT嵌入之间的表征差距，我们引入了嵌入对齐，在训练期间将投影嵌入与从原始帧提取的输入嵌入进行对齐。然后，精炼后的DiT隐藏状态通过一条轻量级重建路径直接映射到像素域，绕过了预训练的VAE解码器。为了在保持因果解码的同时进一步利用视频DiT的时空先验，我们引入了上下文传播，它跨帧重用逐层的K/V状态以利用历史生成上下文，在无需片段级缓冲的情况下提高了时间一致性。大量实验表明，SGVC实现了具有竞争力的率-感知性能，在DISTS指标上相比S$^2$VC平均节省了71.97%的BD-rate。
tldr: 提出一种名为SGVC的流式生成式视频压缩框架，通过嵌入对齐和上下文传播，在无需昂贵VAE解码器和缓冲延迟的情况下，实现了极低比特率下的高质量视频压缩。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的流式生成式视频压缩框架SGVC，创新性地通过嵌入对齐和上下文传播，解决了传统基于DiT的方法计算成本高和存在缓冲延迟的问题，实现了高效的像素级流式生成压缩。
motivation: 现有的基于视频扩散Transformer（DiT）的生成式视频压缩方法严重依赖计算成本高昂的VAE解码器来重建视频帧，并且联合精炼多帧会引入额外的缓冲延迟，无法满足流式传输的需求。
method: 提出SGVC框架，包含两个核心技术：一是嵌入对齐（Embedding Alignment），将解码后的特征投影并对齐到DiT输入空间以弥合表示差距，并绕过繁重的VAE解码器；二是上下文传播（In-Context Propagation），复用跨帧的层级K/V状态以实现因果解码和时序一致性。
results: 实验表明SGVC取得了具有竞争力的率-感知性能，在DISTS指标上相比S$^2$VC平均节省了71.97%的BD-rate。
conclusion: SGVC通过嵌入对齐和上下文传播成功将预训练视频DiT适配为因果像素级精炼器，在极低比特率下实现了优异的率失真-感知性能和流式传输能力。

title: Hebbian self-organization of monosynaptic reflexes in a biologically realistic multiarticular limb
authors: Jonathan Realmuto, Erfan Nozari, Gerald E. Loeb
abstract: Spinal monosynaptic reflexes depend on patterns of connectivity between muscle spindle afferents and motoneurons that should reflect musculoskeletal dynamics. One possibility is that the details of these circuits are specified genetically, but this requires an unlikely coevolution of musculoskeletal and neural elements. Here we show how biomechanical structure can determine the connectivity of self-organized spinal circuits. Using a neuromechanical model combining a multi-joint limb, proprioceptive feedback, and Hebbian plasticity driven by motor babbling, we find that biologically realistic connectivity emerges spontaneously when babbling is neither too sparse nor too frequent. This results in strong homonymous projections, weaker heteronymous projections among functional synergists, and very weak connections among antagonists. This outcome also depends on musculoskeletal morphometry. Heteronymous synergies form when proximal muscles are strongest---the characteristic gradient of mammalian limbs--whereas excessively strong biarticular muscles lead to unphysiological antagonist coupling. The mechanisms differ: homonymous connections arise from direct sensorimotor correlation during fusimotor coactivation by beta motoneurons, while heteronymous connections depend on multi-joint dynamics that emerge only after homonymous reflexes stabilize and increasing muscle strength generates multisegmental motion. Overall, this study provides a mechanistic basis for fetal sensorimotor development and generates testable predictions about the consequences of naturally occurring and experimentally induced variations.
zh_title: 生物真实多关节肢体中单突触反射的赫布自组织
translation: 脊髓单突触反射依赖于肌梭传入神经元与运动神经元之间的连接模式，这些模式应当反映肌肉骨骼动力学。一种可能是这些回路的细节是由基因指定的，但这需要肌肉骨骼和神经元要素进行不太可能的协同进化。在这里，我们展示了生物力学结构如何决定自组织脊髓回路的连接性。通过使用结合了多关节肢体、本体感觉反馈以及由运动乱语驱动的赫布可塑性的神经力学模型，我们发现当乱语既不太稀疏也不太频繁时，生物学上真实的连接会自发涌现。这导致了强的同名投射、功能协同肌之间较弱的异名投射，以及拮抗剂之间极弱的连接。这一结果还取决于肌肉骨骼的形态测量。当近端肌肉最强（哺乳动物肢体的特征梯度）时，异名协同肌形成；而过强的双关节肌肉则会导致不符合生理的拮抗剂偶联。其机制有所不同：同名连接产生于由β运动神经元进行梭肌共激活期间的直接感觉运动相关性，而异名连接则依赖于多关节动力学，该动力学仅在同名反射稳定且肌肉力量增加产生多节段运动后才会出现。总的来说，本研究为胎儿感觉运动发育提供了机械基础，并对自然发生和实验诱导变异的后果产生了可检验的预测。
tldr: 本文通过神经力学模型证明，脊髓单突触反射回路中的生物学真实连接可以通过肌肉骨骼动力学和赫布可塑性的相互作用自发形成。
ai_comments: 该论文结合了神经力学模型与赫布可塑性，成功解释了脊髓单突触反射中生物学真实连接的自组织形成过程。创新之处在于展示了生物力学结构如何指导神经回路的发育，并阐明了同侧与异侧连接形成的不同机制，为胎儿感觉运动发育提供了重要的理论基础。
motivation: 脊髓单突触反射的连接模式需要反映肌肉骨骼动力学，纯粹由基因指定的假设需要不切实际的神经与骨骼协同进化，因此本文旨在探索生物力学结构如何通过自组织决定脊髓回路的连接性。
method: 使用了一个结合了多关节肢体、本体感觉反馈以及由运动乱语驱动的赫布可塑性的神经力学模型进行模拟研究。
results: 当运动乱语频率适中时，自发涌现出了生物学上真实的连接模式（如强的同名投射、较弱的协同肌异名投射以及极弱的拮抗肌连接），且这一结果受到肌肉骨骼形态测量的影响。同名连接由直接的感觉运动相关性产生，而异名连接则依赖于同名反射稳定后多关节动力学的发展。
conclusion: 生物力学结构和运动学特性在通过赫布可塑性自组织形成脊髓单突触反射回路中起着决定性作用，为胎儿感觉运动发育提供了机械基础。

title: The Spectral Distribution of Matrix Least Squares Solutions, and the Ellipsoid Fitting Problem
authors: Afonso S. Bandeira, Yue M. Lu, Petar Nizić-Nikolac
abstract: We study the spectral distribution of the least squares solution to a random linear system whose unknown is a symmetric matrix. In the normalized and isotropic setting, we derive a closed-form description of the support of the spectral distribution. As an application, we consider the ellipsoid fitting problem: given $n$ standard Gaussian vectors in $\mathbb{R}^d$, does there exist a centered ellipsoid passing through all of them? It was recently shown that this problem has a sharp phase transition at $n \approx d^2/4$. On the satisfiability side, unlike earlier results, these sharp results do not rely on least squares candidates. We show that the least squares candidates considered in earlier works have a threshold of positive semi-definiteness at $n \approx d^2/10$, which was previously observed numerically and predicted non-rigorously using statistical physics methods. Moreover, we show that the corresponding least squares dual certificates have a threshold of positive definiteness at $n \approx 2d^2/5$. Our approach combines several matrix concentration tools. A key technical ingredient, which may be of independent interest, is showing that a certain kernel matrix is well-conditioned with high probability until $n \approx d^2/2$.
zh_title: 矩阵最小二乘解的谱分布与椭球拟合问题
translation: 我们研究了以对称矩阵为未知数的随机线性系统最小二乘解的谱分布。在归一化和各向同性的设定下，我们导出了谱分布支集的闭式描述。作为一项应用，我们考虑了椭球拟合问题：给定 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中的 $n$ 个标准高斯向量，是否存在一个经过所有这些向量的中心椭球？最近的研究表明，该问题在 $n \approx d^2/4$ 处具有尖锐的相变。在可满足性方面，与早期结果不同，这些尖锐的结果不依赖于最小二乘候选解。我们证明了早期工作中考虑的最小二乘候选解在 $n \approx d^2/10$ 处具有半正定性阈值，这此前是通过数值观测和统计物理方法非严格预测的。此外，我们证明了相应的最小二乘对偶证书在 $n \approx 2d^2/5$ 处具有正定性阈值。我们的方法结合了几种矩阵浓度工具。一个关键的技术成分（可能具有独立的研究价值）是证明了某个核矩阵在高概率下直到 $n \approx d^2/2$ 之前都是良态的（well-conditioned）。
tldr: 本文研究了矩阵最小二乘解的谱分布，并将其成功应用于解决椭球拟合问题中的相变与阈值预测。
ai_comments: 该论文在随机线性系统和椭球拟合问题上取得了重要的理论突破，通过严谨的数学工具（如矩阵浓度不等式）解析了矩阵最小二乘解的谱分布，并解释了以往物理方法的预测结果。
motivation: 为了研究矩阵作为未知数的随机线性系统最小二乘解的谱分布，并以此解决椭球拟合问题中最小二乘方法的阈值谜题。
method: 结合了多种矩阵浓度工具，推导了规范且各向同性设置下谱分布支集的闭式描述，并分析了核矩阵的条件数。
results: 推导出了谱分布支集的闭式描述；证明了最小二乘候选解的正半定性阈值在 $n \approx d^2/10$，对偶证书的正定性阈值在 $n \approx 2d^2/5$；证明了特定核矩阵在高概率下直到 $n \approx d^2/2$ 时都具有良好的条件数。
conclusion: 本文给出了随机矩阵最小二乘解谱分布的闭式描述，并成功应用于椭球拟合问题，证明了最小二乘候选解和对偶证书的正定性阈值。

title: Compute Before You Digitize: ADC-less Mixed-Signal Processing for Scalable Cryogenic Qubit Readout
authors: Qirui Zhang, Ben Toby, He Wang, Benjamin Lienhard, David Blaauw, Dennis Sylvester
abstract: We introduce DIRAC, an ADC-less in-cryostat qubit readout architecture that uses analog computing to redraw the analog-digital boundary. Directly operating on the front-end's analog output, passive complex mixers perform the equivalent of digital demodulation, ping-pong active-RC integrators average their outputs into down-sampled per-qubit traces, and a time-domain stage digitizes them, eliminating Nyquist-rate ADCs. A TX-RX co-design derives the mixers' local oscillators from the readout transmitter's baseband rather than per-tone PLLs. A per-line calibration flow trains the matched filter jointly with the neural network, improving fidelity and enabling low-bit-width, low-voltage digital processing. Designed in 22 nm FD-SOI and evaluated at 4 K on 1.12M experimental shots, DIRAC matches the fidelity of a floating-point (FP32) digital pipeline for readout windows down to 750 ns, at 31.6$\times$ and 238$\times$ lower energy than the fixed-point (FxP) and FP32 pipelines. It cuts the total 4 K power per physical qubit by 50.4% and 68.6% relative to FxP and room-temperature flex cables, respectively. At a fixed logical-qubit count and 4 K budget, this yields, against FxP, a code distance larger by 2 to 6 and a 1.6-7.3$\times$ (Willow) and 4.9-204$\times$ (SI1000, $p = 10^{-3}$) lower logical error rate.

title: Gaussian Splatoms: Direct Atomic Structure Identification in Electron Tomography
authors: Nalini Singh, Tiffany Chien, Cedric Lim, Arthur R. C. McCray, Colin Ophus, Laura Waller
abstract: Atomic electron tomography (AET) computationally reconstructs the 3D atomic structure of materials from a series of 2D projection measurements acquired at different tilt angles. Inspired by Gaussian splatting techniques from computer vision, we introduce an atom-centric parameterization for modeling AET samples. Instead of a conventional volumetric representation with a grid of voxels, we model the sample as a list of atoms, where each atom is a 3D Gaussian characterized by learned location, scale, and amplitude. The Gaussian model is a natural fit for atoms that allows us to easily incorporate prior information grounded in physics; we impose isotropy of atoms, a minimum interatomic distance, and realistic atomic radii. We show in simulation that our method is more robust than volumetric baselines to real-world imaging challenges, including a limited number of measurements and low electron dose. We further show that our method yields a more physically plausible reconstruction of an experimental 23,000 atom iron-platinum nanoparticle than a previously published volumetric reconstruction. Beyond tomography, our representation is a promising tool for any atomic resolution imaging modality (e.g. multislice electron ptychography).
zh_title: 高斯原子泼溅：电子断层扫描中的直接原子结构识别
translation: 原子电子断层扫描（AET）通过在不同倾斜角度获取的一系列二维投影测量，以计算方式重建材料的三维原子结构。受计算机视觉中高斯泼溅技术的启发，我们引入了一种以原子为中心的参数化方法来对AET样品进行建模。我们没有采用具有体素网格的传统体积分数表示，而是将样品建模为原子列表，其中每个原子都是一个由学习到的位置、尺度和振幅特征表征的三维高斯函数。高斯模型与原子高度契合，使我们能够轻松地结合基于物理学的先验信息：我们强制原子各向同性、设置最小原子间距并引入真实的原子半径。模拟结果表明，我们的方法在面对有限测量数量和低电子剂量等现实成像挑战时，比体积分数基线更具鲁棒性。我们进一步证明，与先前发布的体积分数重建相比，我们的方法对包含23,000个原子的铁铂纳米颗粒的实验重建更加符合物理真实性。除了断层扫描之外，这种表示法对于任何原子分辨率成像模态（例如多层电子叠层成像）都是一个极具前景的工具。
tldr: 该论文借鉴计算机视觉的高斯泼溅技术，提出了一种基于3D高斯函数的原子电子断层扫描（AET）重建方法，显著提高了低剂量和有限测量条件下的重建鲁棒性和物理真实性。
ai_comments: 该论文借鉴了计算机视觉中的高斯泼溅技术，将其创新性地应用到原子电子断层扫描（AET）中，通过原子中心化的高斯参数化方法取代传统体素网格，有效克服了有限测量和低电子剂量等现实成像挑战，具有很高的创新性和实用价值。
motivation: 传统的原子电子断层扫描（AET）多采用基于体素网格的体素化表示，在面对现实世界中的有限测量次数和低电子剂量等成像挑战时鲁棒性不足，因此需要一种能更好地结合物理先验、提高重建鲁棒性的原子中心化建模方法。
method: 引入一种以原子为中心的高斯参数化方法（Gaussian Splatoms），将样品建模为一系列3D高斯函数（每个函数由学习得到的空间位置、尺度和振幅表征），并融入物理先验信息（如原子各向同性、最小原子间距以及现实的原子半径）。
results: 模拟实验表明，该方法在应对有限测量次数和低电子剂量等现实成像挑战时，比体素化基线方法更具鲁棒性；在对包含23,000个原子的铁铂纳米颗粒实验数据重建中，该方法比以往的体素重建展现出更高的物理合理性。
conclusion: 高斯泼溅原子化方法为原子电子断层扫描及其他原子分辨率成像模态提供了一种更加鲁棒且物理真实性高的3D重建方案。

title: JEPA for astronomy: multi-survey spectral alignment puts stellar parameters on the leading principal axes
authors: Xiaosheng Zhao, Rosemary F.G. Wyse, Yuan-Sen Ting, Alexander S. Szalay
abstract: Spectra from different surveys carry different systematics and are not calibrated against one another. Multi-survey foundation models for stellar spectra are then built by aligning embeddings of the same star observed across surveys. Most in astronomy follow the recipes established for language and vision, aligning with a contrastive loss that separates every star from the others. However, this does not ensure that the stellar physics is encoded in a form that a simple read-out can recover. Holding the cross-survey architecture fixed and varying only the alignment loss, we measure what an objective encodes from the principal-component geometry of the Gaia BP/RP (XP) spectra and from a linear probe of the stellar parameters. In a properly aligned embedding, the leading two principal components form a plane that recovers an analog of the Kiel diagram, the third component tracks [Fe/H], and [alpha/Fe] varies coherently across the plane, such that the chemically defined Galactic disks and accreted populations occupy distinct loci. We show that legibility, the ease of reading the information out, is highest for a training objective that never pushes stars apart, and instead constrains only the overall distribution of each survey's embeddings (JEPA). JEPA also exceeds the contrastive alternative at the same architecture, and the performance improves further as more surveys (Gaia XP+LAMOST LRS+DESI+APOGEE) are included. Predicted abundances for 8.0 million XP giants reproduce the main [alpha/Fe]-[Fe/H] structure of the Milky Way. These results indicate that the choice of alignment objective, not alignment alone, determines whether stellar labels are linearly recoverable.
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to AAS journals. Comments welcome

title: PhysDial: Adapting Pretrained Video Models for PDE Simulation under Changing Physical Conditions
authors: Yilong Dai, Yiming Sun, Shengyu Chen, Jiaqi Gong, Xiaowei Jia, Runlong Yu
abstract: Simulating how physical systems respond to changing conditions is central to control, design, and scenario studies. To our knowledge, prior PDE foundation models have not been trained or evaluated on changes within trajectories. Our counterfactual test measures how far predictions move toward a changed solver branch from the same state. Models trained on fixed conditions follow changes only partly. A PDE foundation model given a condition input after pretraining barely responds. PhysDial adapts a pretrained video diffusion transformer to eight two-dimensional PDE families. Coefficients enter with the noise level, condition fields as reference frames, and equation text as a prompt. In Kolmogorov flow, switches within trajectories account for about 5% of the training samples. At matched compute, they halve the error after a change in forcing wavenumber or amplitude. A few trajectories at new amplitudes more than halve extrapolation error. Without physics pretraining, PhysDial matches or exceeds PDE foundation models under training conditions on two turbulent flows. At step 64 on the Kolmogorov test split, PhysDial has 1.07 times the solver's small-scale energy and Walrus 7.1 times. Our experiments suggest that a learned simulator uses a condition only as far as its training data make that condition necessary for prediction. Learning from trajectories that diverge under intervention can help scientific simulators predict what would happen if a system's forcing or parameters changed.

title: Balancing Partition Forest for Causal Weighting
authors: Felipe Angelim, Alessandro Leite
abstract: Balancing weights are used in observational causal inference to construct a population in which the treatment is independent of observed pretreatment covariates. The ideal weight is the ratio between the product of the covariate and treatment marginals and their joint distribution, for binary and continuous treatments alike. We propose Balancing Partition Tree (BPT) and Balancing Partition Forest (BPF), which estimate this ratio on a learned rectangular partition of covariate--treatment space. Each split maximizes the gain in a Bregman divergence computed from joint and marginal counts. Two choices of divergence yield criteria that maximize the mutual information captured by the partition or reduce the squared error of the weights. We show that the population residual of either criterion bounds the bias of inverse-probability-weighted and doubly robust response estimators that use the population partition weights. Across 17 synthetic and semi-synthetic settings and three response estimators, BPF obtains the lowest mean RMSE rank among seven weight estimators, and a single tree fits in 0.14 seconds on 16,512 observations.

title: Electromagnetic Channel Model and Sensing Performance for ISAC: The Case of a Single Cylindrical Scatterer
authors: Gabriele Gradoni, Ahmed Elzanaty, Yadong Yang, Mohsen Khalily, Mahmoud Shahabadi, Fan Wang, Peiying Zhu, Wen Tong, Rahim Tafazolli
abstract: We propose an electromagnetic wireless channel model for accurate target localization in radar-like sensing scenarios. The model employs a self-consistent method grounded in wave scattering theory and imposing boundary conditions, providing the (impedance) channel transfer matrix for a propagation channel with a single target modeled as a cylindrical scatterer. The model is: 1) physics-based, as it includes electromagnetic interactions between objects; 2) unified, as it is valid in both near- and far-field regions. Within the canonical two-dimensional and 2.5-dimensional configurations with line-source and dipole-source excitations, respectively, the model supports dielectric cylinders with frequency-dependent permittivity. Localization accuracy is assessed via the Cramer-Rao lower bound for a dielectric cylinder with variable position, radius, and dielectric constant. Provisions for future extensions to extended targets are discussed in the context of 3GPP channel modeling.
comment: 16 pages; published in IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications

title: Bounded-Order Non-Identifiability in Latent Structure Block Models: The Fiber in Closed Form
authors: Sie Hendrata Dharmawan, Peter Chin
abstract: A graphon is determined by all of its homomorphism densities, but motif-based methods use finitely many. We compute exactly what that truncation costs in a natural family: latent structure block models whose positions lie on $K$ rays, equivalently degree-corrected block models of rank two. For a given radial law, the configurations that agree on every graph with fewer than $2K-1$ vertices form a one-dimensional fiber, which we give in closed form with explicit endpoints; the friendship graph $F_{K-1}$ is its unique edge-minimal separator, so no fixed motif order serves every $K$. The separating signal is suppressed by a factor of at most $m_1^{2(K-1)}$, where $m_1$ is the mean squared slope, about $10^{-4}$ at $K=4$: detecting it from motif counts would take about $10^{15}$ nodes in a single graph, at any edge density. The information is nonetheless in the graph; the fiber belongs to the statistic, not the model. Common spectral pipelines, which count no motifs, still slide along the fiber by more than a third of its length at ordinary densities, with confidence regions that almost never contain the truth, while model-based fits of the same embedding do not. We give practitioners four checks: whether a fit is at risk, what to run instead, why a confidence interval will not warn, and how wide the remaining ambiguity is.

title: Averting `Gravity': Launch Control and the Limits of Collision Avoidance in Low Earth Orbit Operations
authors: Aditya S. Gopalan, Harsha Honnappa
abstract: As large constellations fill low Earth orbit, the risk of a runaway collision cascade has become a central concern of space operations. Debris population models treat collision avoidance as a fixed input, although the capacity to screen potential collisions and plan maneuvers degrades as debris accumulates. Using a stylized multi-layer queueing network model, we show that collision avoidance capabilities that saturate as the in-custody fragment count increases, can make the orbital shell bistable, with a low-debris and a high-debris equilibrium, and hysteretic. This has two major operational consequences. First, leaving the high-debris equilibrium requires a large cut in launch rates. Second, in the low-debris equilibrium, fragment counts respond with a delay as the launch rate rises past a tipping point. Removing bistability is desirable, and we show that fragment count-indexed admission control can achieve this. The least restrictive such policy lengthens the lag, whereas an exponential tilt of this policy makes the fragment count track its equilibrium with a bounded lag. Furthermore, admitting more launches can reduce the rate of completed missions, and under a unimodality condition a threshold rule on the debris fragment count maximizes this rate at equilibrium.

title: Spectral Pricing of Corridor Products under Layered Local Volatility
authors: Andrey Itkin, Dmitry Muravey
abstract: We price corridor products under a $N$-layered local volatility, piecewise constant in the price and in time, with knock-out barriers. A spatial scale transformation and the GIT method reduce the killed Green's function to a symmetric tridiagonal system of fixed size $N-1$. With equal scaled layer widths the spectrum follows from one tridiagonal eigen-decomposition together with the explicit eigenfunctions that vanish at every interface. For general scaled layer widths an exact counting theorem locates every eigenvalue. Consecutive time intervals of constant volatility are connected by a matrix that re-expands the solution in the eigenbasis of the preceding interval, and the result converges exponentially in the number of retained terms in the eigenfunction expansion. Allowing the killing rate to vary between layers preserves this construction. On a single time interval, the corridor accrual distribution is then recovered by inverting the time and Fourier transforms, without introducing an additional state variable. Exact representations for Greeks and layer vegas follow by differentiation. In our benchmarks the method agrees with independent calculations near rounding error and keeps full accuracy at volatility interfaces, where the tested uniform finite-difference (FD) grids lose one order of convergence. The method computes the accrual law about sixty times faster than the tested FD scheme that includes accrued time as a second state variable.

title: From Persistent Cohomology to Maps into Arbitrary Eilenberg-MacLane Spaces
authors: Tony Xiaochen Xiao, Jose A. Perea
abstract: In this paper, we address the construction of Eilenberg-MacLane coordinates (functions from datasets to Eilenberg-MacLane spaces $K(G,n)$) that encode nontrivial persistent cohomology classes in arbitrary dimensions $n$ and coefficient group $G$. The construction leverages the connecting homomorphism in the long exact sequence in Čech cohomology, from the short exact sequence of sheaves of continuous maps with values in $G$, $EG$ and $BG$. Crucially, the derivation is constructive: we give an explicit, recursive formula for preimages under the connecting homomorphism, which yields a constructive version of a classical cohomology vanishing theorem and, in turn, an algorithm for general Eilenberg-MacLane coordinates. We validate our approach through experiments on synthetic datasets, and present novel examples of $K(\mathbb{Z}/2, 2)$-coordinates not addressed in prior work.

title: Separating QMA from the QCMA Hierarchy via a Switching Lemma for Polynomials
authors: Yiming Wang
abstract: We construct a classical oracle relative to which QMA is not contained in the QCMA hierarchy. Our main technical contribution is a switching lemma for bounded polynomials, which provides a new conceptual viewpoint on earlier sampler-based arguments separating QMA and QCMA. Crucially, the parameters of this switching lemma are independent of the number of input variables. The separation builds on the code intersection subset size problem of Bostanci, Huang, and Vaikuntanathan (FOCS 2026). We also construct a classical oracle relative to which QCMA collapses to P but QMA does not, and another relative to which QMA collapses to P but PP does not.

title: A Free Lunch: Gradient Averaging Achieves Optimal Statistical Efficiency in Newton Sketch
authors: Haoxuan Wang, Jianliang Ye, Sen Na
abstract: We study statistical inference for online sketched Newton methods, in which each Newton system is approximately solved by an inner randomized sketching solver. Existing work reveals a computational--statistical trade-off: the sketching solver (and its accelerated variants) reduces the per-step cost of Newton methods from $O(d^3)$ to $O(d^2)$, but the randomness introduced by sketching also inflates the limiting covariance of both the last and the averaged Newton iterates. In this work, we address this trade-off via gradient averaging. We show that simply replacing the stochastic gradient with a moving average at each step can mitigate, and in some cases eliminate, the trade-off in Newton sketch. Importantly, gradient averaging requires no additional oracle evaluations and leaves the contraction bound of the inner sketching solver unchanged. In particular, we prove that the last sketched Newton iterate with gradient averaging attains a limiting covariance no larger than that without gradient averaging, while the averaged iterate even attains the minimax optimal limiting covariance, matching that of the exact Newton method. To our knowledge, this is the first analysis showing that randomness introduced to improve computational efficiency need not compromise statistical efficiency as long as proper gradient estimates are used. The key analytical challenge is that gradient averaging destroys the crucial martingale difference structure underlying central limit theorem arguments. We overcome this challenge by analyzing the coupled two-timescale recursions governing the iterate and the gradient estimator. Numerical experiments on linear and logistic regression support our theoretical covariance comparisons.

title: Optical Neural Networks Should Be Evaluated by Function, Not Only Physics
authors: Shi-Yuan Ma, Xingjian Bai, Ryan Hamerly, Mahmoud Jalali Mehrabad
abstract:
Optical neural networks (ONNs) are attracting significant attention as alternative platforms for machine learning (ML). In an ONN, an optical module often takes over part of the computation inside a digital ML pipeline. How much of the task does the optical module itself perform, and how much does it contribute to any claimed system-level advantages, such as throughput or energy?
  This paper offers a simple, function-oriented evaluation methodology. Whatever its internal physics, the optical module appears to the surrounding digital pipeline as a mapping between real-valued tensors. We therefore evaluate it in three steps: (i) define its boundary in the pipeline, as real-valued tensors in and out; (ii) replace it with standard digital modules to identify those that match the optical system's performance on the same task and metric; and (iii) state system-level claims, such as speed or energy, per inference against the performance-matched digital module. We summarize steps (i) and (ii) in an Expressivity Card and demonstrate its use on published ONN systems. This helps isolate the optical module's contribution and provides a concrete digital reference for assessing its claimed system-level advantages, without the need to understand the physics.
  While we focus on optical systems as the most prominent example, the same approach applies to any physical analog computing platform used in ML, wherever a physical module takes over part of a digital pipeline.

title: Addressable transversal CCZ gates on almost good quantum LDPC codes and nearly optimal magic state protocols
authors: Shi Jie Samuel Tan, Guanyu Zhu
abstract: Assuming uniform subfield product expansion, we construct quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes with distances $Ω_ε(N/\log^2N)$ and at least $N^{1-ε}$ individually addressable logical CCZ gates on pairwise disjoint triples of logical qubits, for every fixed $0<ε<1$. With all logical qubits outside these triples initialized to $|0\rangle$, any subset of the corresponding logical CCZ gates can be implemented with a transversal physical CCZ circuit. As applications, we obtain two nearly optimal magic state protocols: CCZ distillation with arbitrarily small overhead exponent $γ\rightarrow 0$ and error suppression of nearly linear order, and a magic state fountain that directly prepares $N^{1-ε}$ encoded CCZ magic states with nearly linear distance $Ω_ε(N/\log^2N)$. The construction uses balanced products of expanding graph covers. The assumption concerns Reed--Solomon codes on three subfields of characteristic two and pairwise coprime extension degrees, a local hypothesis studied in a companion manuscript. We design the expanding graph covers to admit many common classical codewords, which yield logical operators whose pairings select the logical CCZ gates independently. Without the product expansion assumption, the graph covers also yield classical LDPC codes over a fixed field with almost linear dimension and linear distance that satisfy a multiplication property: the coordinatewise product of any three codewords lies in a second LDPC code of linear distance.

title: Superspecial curves of genus two over prime fields: Frobenius types and rational (2,2)-kernels
authors: Hung Dang
abstract: Superspecial curves of genus two over a prime field $\mathbb{F}_p$, and the rational $(2,2)$-isogenies between their Jacobians, are the vertices and edges of the graph on which genus-two isogeny-based cryptography is built. Let $C$ be such a curve, with Jacobian $J$ and Frobenius endomorphism $π$. We show that $π^2 = p\,α_*$ for a unique automorphism $α$ of $C$ over $\mathbb{F}_p$ whose action on the Weierstrass points is the square of that of Frobenius. For $p \ge 7$ this gives the list of Frobenius types of the Weierstrass points: eight types, each with its Weil polynomial, a congruence condition on $p$, and its number 15, 3, 3, 7, 1, 1, 3 or 1 of $\mathbb{F}_p$-rational $(2,2)$-kernels; when all Weierstrass points are rational, the 2-Tate pairing on $J[2]$ is determined by $p \bmod 8$. We then prove closed formulas, in terms of class numbers of imaginary quadratic orders and of $ζ_{\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt p)}(-1)$, for the mass of the curves of each type and for the mass of the rational kernels whose quotient is a product of elliptic curves. For $π^2 = \pm p$ the total masses are due to Ibukiyama and to Xue and Yu; our proofs use the 2-adic Tate modules, the symmetry of the Richelot correspondence and Eichler's mass formula, and, for the other curves, modules over orders of a quartic CM field. The kernels are counted through gluings of supersingular elliptic curves. As a consequence, the proportion of rational kernels with decomposed quotient is of order $p^{-1/2}(1+L(1,χ))$, where $χ$ is the quadratic character of $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-p})$. All formulas agree with an exact enumeration for the 37 primes $7 \le p \le 173$. Finally we describe the graph of $\mathbb{F}_p$-rational Richelot isogenies, which is far from connected in the range computed, and discuss what these results say about its use in isogeny-based cryptography.

title: Beyond Intelligibility: Fine-Grained Perceptual Assessment of Dysarthric Speech with Auditory Large Language Models
authors: Haotian Wei, Can Long, Wen Xian Jim, Guangzhi Sun, Zengrui Jin, Chao Zhang
abstract: Accurate assessment of dysarthric speech is vital for clinical diagnosis and rehabilitation, yet existing automated methods rely heavily on isolated, single-task models or generic speech quality metrics that fail to disentangle heterogeneous neuromotor deficits. This work presents the first systematic investigation into adapting auditory large language models (ALLMs) for multi-dimensional dysarthric speech assessment under a unified, prompt-conditioned framework. Four representative ALLMs are benchmarked across five clinical perceptual dimensions from the Speech Accessibility Project (SAP): naturalness, monopitch, intelligibility, imprecise consonants, and inappropriate silences. To bridge generic perceptual quality and clinical evaluation, a two-stage training paradigm is explored, leveraging out-of-domain pre-training followed by in-domain clinical adaptation. Experimental results demonstrate that leading ALLMs reliably capture fine-grained pathological variations, exhibiting distinct and complementary strengths across prosodic and articulatory attributes. These findings establish ALLMs as a scalable foundation for clinical speech evaluation and provide practical insights into model selection and multi-task transfer potential.
comment: 5 pages; Haotian Wei, Can Long, and Wen Xian Jim contributed equally

title: STORM: A Lightweight Structure-Free Model for Binding Affinity Prediction
authors: Ayush Pandit, Rohan V. Koodli, Wei Deng, Roxana Daneshjou, Ron O. Dror
abstract: Accurately predicting a small molecule's binding affinity to a protein, a critical task in drug discovery, remains challenging. Physics-based approaches like free-energy perturbation (FEP) have very high computational costs and require expert setup. Recent machine learning--based cofolding models have reported accuracy approaching that of FEP---and at least one of them, Boltz-2, has already been widely adopted for affinity prediction---but they remain expensive for large computational screens and even more expensive for retraining on newly collected experimental data. To address these challenges, we introduce STORM: Similarity Transfer from Observed Reference Molecules. STORM is a fast, simple machine learning model that ensembles many small model fusions of diverse protein and molecule representations for binding affinity prediction. Trained on the same data, STORM matches or exceeds the accuracy of Boltz-2 on multiple evaluation datasets, while delivering a speed improvement of over five orders of magnitude for both inference and training. Our results also suggest opportunities to substantially improve affinity prediction accuracy by integrating historical experimental affinity data with structural and biophysical information.

title: Geometry-bridge flow matching for blind rigid-motion correction in head cone-beam CT
authors: Sungho Yun, Seungryong Cho
abstract: Rigid motion of a patient head during head cone-beam CT (CBCT) scan can degrade image quality and complicate recovery of accurate anatomical structures from the measured projections. We present a 3D flow-matching prior approach that learns the image changes induced by motion. Its geometry-bridge connects motion-corrupted and motion-free Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstructed images of the same source volume through progressively reduced simulated motion. The forward projector's geometry derivative supplies analytic velocity targets along this path. A plug-and-play loop encompasses the learned image updates together with spline-based pose estimation, conjugate-gradient data consistency, and image total-variation regularization. Both the refined image volume and the FDK reconstructed image volume at the estimated poses are evaluated. On simulated 360-view scans from 30 held-out CQ500 patients with nominal per-component motion amplitudes within 10 mm / 10 degrees, the framework achieved state-of-the-art image reconstruction quality and motion accuracy in comparison with other methos such as learned autofocus and diffusion-based joint reconstruction. Mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) reached 37.1 dB and mean detector-plane reprojection error (RPE) was 0.27 mm. With matched endpoints at the inference settings, the geometry bridge improved PSNR by 1.6 dB and reduced RPE by 33% relative to image-linear training. With 50 prior updates and coarse-to-fine motion estimation, total processing time averaged 9.1 minutes per patient on an RTX A6000.

title: A Dual-SOM Learner Model of Instructional Efficiency within Cognitive Load Theory
authors: Spyridon Revithis
abstract: This paper presents a novel methodological framework, integrating a dual self-organising map (SOM) neural network architecture with Cognitive Load Theory (CLT), for assessing instructional efficiency within learning environments. By representing curriculum content as a directed acyclic graph of topic dependencies, the proposed model captures collective learning behaviour across two core dimensions: academic performance and subjective/introspective mental effort. During SOM training, representative data sets of successful learner trajectories are compressed into two topologically ordered, identically structured neural networks: PSOM (performance space) and ESOM (mental effort space). By pairing these behavioural maps, the model serves as a decision-support tool that enables instructors to simultaneously pinpoint structural instructional design defects, such as hidden topic prerequisites, and evaluate collective cognitive load profiles. The implementation and performance of the PSOM component (and, by extension, its symmetrical twin, ESOM) is linked to an earlier modelling study employing a SOM with identical structure and encoding semantics situated in the same domain (i.e., a learning environment). This paper combines the study of behavioural phenomena with theoretical work on human cognitive architecture via SOM neurocomputational cognitive behavioural modelling.
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures. This paper is a substantially revised and expanded version of Revithis S., Wilson W. H., and Marcus N. (2010). "A Neurocomputational Instructional Indicator of Working Memory Load in Cognitive Load Theory". title: Improved Leverage Score Sampling for Constrained Active Linear Regression
authors: Aarshvi Gajjar, Syamantak Kumar, Aditya Makkar, Christopher Musco, Joey Zhou
abstract: In this paper we study active learning for constrained linear regression. Given a design matrix $A\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times d}$, a constraint set $C\subseteq\mathbb{R}^d$, and query access to $b\in\mathbb{R}^n$, we seek an approximate solution to $\min_{x\in C}\|Ax-b\|_2^2$ using as few queries as possible. This problem arises in many scientific and engineering applications, and randomized leverage score sampling provides a powerful method to solve it. However, existing leverage score methods ignore the constraint or encode it through ridge regularization, suffering unfavorable query complexity for anisotropic constraint sets. We propose ellipsoid-regularized leverage scores, where we approximate the constraint set by an outer ellipsoid and use its shape matrix to bias sampling toward directions that matter under the constraint geometry. We prove that the query complexity is governed by an anisotropic effective dimension $d_{\text{eff}}(C)\le d$. With appropriate parameters, $O(d_{\text{eff}}(C)\log d/\varepsilon^2)$ queries suffice to return a point in $C$ with objective value at most $(1+\varepsilon)$ times the optimum. This bound can substantially improve on the standard leverage-score bound, since anisotropic constraints can make $d_{\text{eff}}(C)$ much smaller than $d$. For convex constraints, we improve the dependence on $\varepsilon$ from $1/\varepsilon^2$ to $1/\varepsilon$. We also prove two lower bounds: first, the $d/\varepsilon^2$ dependence is unavoidable without convexity assumptions on $C$, and second, in some regimes, the effective dimension dependence $d_{\mathrm{eff}}(C)/\varepsilon$ is necessary for ellipsoidal constraints. Experiments on synthetic regression problems and a parametric heat conduction problem show lower regression error than standard baselines for similar query budget.

title: Breaking the Myth of Four-Tier Stacked Transistors for Logic: an Investigation from Process to Device and Block-Level PPA
authors: Jianxiang Jin, Haoran Lu, Yihan Luo, Yanbang Chu, Yibo Zhang, Jingru Jiang, Yuji Cheng, Wanyue Peng, Xun Jiang, Feiyu Teng, Kairang Guo, Ming Li, Yibo Lin, Runsheng Wang, Heng Wu, Ru Huang
abstract: For the first time, this work evaluated whether 4-tier stacked transistors can translate the straightforward density gains into realistic chip-level scaling benefits.
