A practical dual-sided 4-tier transistor-stacking CFFET (Flipped CFET-to-CFET) process was proposed, on which a DTCO framework spanning standard-cell design, local interconnects, RO analysis, and physical implementation was built under 2A node design rules. The CFFET was also benchmarked with its 2-tier transistor-stacking counterparts FFET. Among CFFET configurations, the best-performing Symmetric Power still lags FFET by 11.2% in RO frequency due to the complex MOL parasitics. At the block level, CFFET reduces the Ibex RISC-V core area by only 12.8% (far below the 40% nominal cell-height reduction), while running 10.9% slower at iso-power. We further introduced a novel Tetris-like cell stitching to minimize the area overhead, which allows non-rectangular cell design and recovers 7.4% area in a 1-bit ALU design. An optimized NanoStack CFFET was finally proposed, inspired by previous work. This work indicates that straightforward vertical 4-tier stacking proves insufficient to guarantee enough PPA benefits, though the resulting design insights may guide future advanced architectures.

title: Covering the Pauli Observables: Sampling Thresholds and the Design Effect of a Measurement Setting
authors: Kausthubh Chandramouli, Noah Siekierski, Bojko N. Bakalov, Dror Baron
abstract: Quantum state tomography and shadow-based estimation rely on measuring Pauli observables. An experiment does not measure them one at a time: it chooses a measurement setting that assigns one of the bases X, Y or Z to each qubit, and a single run in that setting yields estimates of every Pauli observable compatible with it. We say that the setting covers those observables. We determine how many random settings cover a prescribed fraction of all Pauli observables. As the number of settings grows exponentially with the number of qubits, the covered fraction has a sharp threshold at a growth rate of $3^{3/4}$ per qubit, set by the rate-distortion function of covering at zero distortion. We give an explicit expression for the number of settings needed to reach a target fraction, accurate up to a remainder that reduces to a small oscillation for many qubits, and show that random sampling is asymptotically optimal up to a factor of less than 1.69. Coverage does not determine what a setting contributes to an estimator. Observables covered by one setting are estimated from the same outcomes, so their estimates are correlated. We quantify this correlation through the design effect of a setting, which equals the squared Pauli expectation that the setting captures and depends on the target state. We derive its mean over settings in closed form for every state and show that it can be estimated without bias from the measurement data. In simulations on six qubits, measuring settings needs 7.6 to 38 times fewer circuit runs than measuring the same number of observables independently. At high coverage, fitting the outcome histograms instead of averaged estimates roughly halves the reconstruction error, mainly because the fit counts how many settings cover each observable. The correlation itself costs such a fit about a factor of two, and a larger design effect signals more to gain from modeling it.

title: In Situ Training of Optical Neural Networks by Coding Agents
authors: Ilker Oguz, Colin Christian, Christophe Moser, Demetri Psaltis, Gordon Wetzstein
abstract: Optical neural networks promise fast, energy-efficient computing, but every device departs from its design and must be trained with the hardware. In situ training relies on an expert-built calibrated digital model of each device or on gradient-free trial and error. Coding agents, large language models that write and run programs, have shown an emergent ability to understand and edit the weights of digital neural networks. Here we introduce optics as code, a method in which a coding agent trains an optical neural network from measurements alone, through a harness that returns camera images of its probes and requires a hypothesis per request. We discovered that the agent forms a physical understanding of the optics and reparametrizes the network with interpretable optical elements tuned on the hardware. It outperforms gradient-free methods in classification and image encoding, approaching backpropagation through a calibrated model at a fraction of the cost. Needing neither per-device calibration nor gradients through the hardware, and improving with more capable models, optics as code offers a practical route to large, scalable optical neural networks and a general tool for calibrating and optimizing optical experiments.
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures. Our project website is at https://ioguz.github.io/optics-as-code/

title: Infinity-Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Principal Component Analysis: Exact Reformulation, Finite-Sample Guarantee, and Efficient Algorithm
authors: Zhouxing Luo, Lei Wang, Xin Liu
abstract: Principal component analysis (PCA) is a fundamental and ubiquitous technique for dimension reduction and representation learning, yet its empirical formulation remains vulnerable to distributional uncertainty. While distributionally robust optimization (DRO) offers a natural remedy, existing order-2 Wasserstein models of PCA either preserve the nominal PCA subspace or lack an exact reformulation. This paper demonstrates how the infinity-Wasserstein distance can reconcile these two desirable properties. For the resulting DRO model of PCA, we derive an exact finite-dimensional reformulation and explicitly identify a worst-case distribution attaining the inner maximum. Crucially, the reformulated objective retains samplewise residual information beyond the empirical covariance matrix, revealing a mechanism through which distributional robustness can reshape the learned principal subspace. Under the mild assumption that the true distribution has a finite fourth moment, we further establish a uniform finite-sample performance guarantee for the proposed model. An iteratively reweighted majorization-minimization algorithm is also developed to solve the resulting nonconvex and nonsmooth optimization problem, with a rigorous analysis of its convergence properties. Numerical experiments substantiate the computational efficiency of the proposed algorithm and the practical effectiveness of the infinity-Wasserstein model in downstream applications.

title: Physical Layer Security for Digital Semantic Communication: A Bit-Level Perspective
authors: Seonjung Kim, Jaehyeok Kim, Yo-Seb Jeon
abstract: Digital semantic communication requires reliable recovery of task-relevant information at a legitimate receiver while limiting source reconstruction by an eavesdropper. Uniform bit protection, however, does not account for the heterogeneous reliability and secrecy requirements of semantic bits. This paper proposes a bit-level physical layer security (PLS) framework that learns these requirements and incorporates them into physical-layer resource allocation. We first introduce a wiretap semantic feature channel whose two-stage training learns per-bit target bit-flip probabilities for the legitimate receiver (Bob) and the eavesdropper (Eve). These targets characterize the reliability requirements at Bob and the secrecy protection requirements against Eve. Based on the learned targets, we formulate a joint power and artificial-noise (AN) allocation problem for a multiple-input single-output wiretap channel under a worst-case angular-separation model. For a given target profile, the optimal information-AN power split admits a closed-form solution, and the per-bit power allocation is obtained by water-filling. We further develop a leakage-aware selection method among multiple learned-target profiles and extend the design to multiple-input multiple-output channels. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves a better trade-off between preserving reconstruction quality at Bob and degrading that at Eve than uniform power allocation and the evaluated learning-based secure semantic communication schemes.

title: ReliFlow: Reliability-Calibrated Residual Transport for Combinatorial Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
authors: Jinrui David, Yun Peng
abstract: Predicting the transcriptional response to combined perturbations requires distinguishing interactions between interventions from errors in their individual effect estimates. The latter become more pronounced when single-perturbation evidence is sparse or withheld. We introduce a conditional flow-matching model that estimates the reliability of single-gene effects from training-only cross-fitting and uses those estimates to calibrate the additive source distribution. The velocity is decomposed into a known correction of the additive reference and a learned residual transport field. On Norman genetic perturbations, reduces mean absolute error (MAE) from 0.142 to 0.131 for unseen combinations of observed singles and from 0.198 to 0.178 when constituent singles are withheld. On held-out ComboSciPlex drug combinations, MAE decreases from 0.191 to 0.176. Non-additive residual correlation improves from 0.574 to 0.638, and component ablations identify the contribution of reliability weighting. The results indicate that accounting for uncertain constituent effects improves generalization to unseen genetic and chemical combinations, with a moderate increase in training cost.

title: Vanilla Adiabatic Quantum Optimization Can Have Subexponential Advantage
authors: Yufan Zheng
abstract: We construct a family of objective functions $f \colon \{0,1\}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ for which vanilla adiabatic quantum optimization along $H(s) = -(1-s)\sum_{i=1}^n X_i + s\sum_x f(x)\lvert x\rangle\!\langle x\rvert$ finds the global minimizer in $\operatorname{poly}(n)$ time, whereas any classical algorithm requires $\exp(n^{Ω(1)})$ time to do so in the black-box model. Our result is achieved by replacing the linearization technique in an earlier work of Leng et al. (arXiv:2504.14841), which establishes a similar subexponential quantum speedup using a transverse field Ising mixer rather than $-\sum_{i=1}^n X_i$.

title: NOTREKS: Marginal Independence in Score-based Structure Learning
authors: Fabian Bleile, Sarah Lumpp, Mathias Drton
abstract: Score-based structure learning estimates causal graphs by optimizing a data-dependent objective over structural equation models. We study how prior knowledge that selected pairs of variables are marginally independent can be incorporated into such causal discovery methods. Under faithfulness, marginally independent pairs cannot be connected by a trek, so the knowledge becomes a graphical no-trek constraint, which we call NOTREKS information. We introduce a power-series trek (PSTrek) penalty for gradient-based optimization and a trek constraint for order-based search, and we analyze why such information helps in finite samples and how it restricts the search space. Our numerical experiments illustrate to what extent NOTREKS information helps in causal discovery. In particular, using synthetic benchmarks with oracle NOTREKS information, we show that these constraints can improve both structural recovery and adjustment-based effect identification.

title: How Reward Gain Imbalance Shapes Ranking: Rethinking Rubric-Based Reward Aggregation
authors: Zhengyuan Fan, Zhonghua Wu, Tianyu Cheng, Qun Chen
abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning constructs rewards for aligning large language models with human preferences, typically by equally aggregating continuous scores that a judge assigns to individual criteria. However, scoring heterogeneity across criteria can distort candidate rankings. Existing work has focused on improving judges, learning criterion weights, or refining aggregation, whereas the interaction between scoring heterogeneity and ranking remains insufficiently understood. We formalize this heterogeneity as \emph{reward gain imbalance}: each criterion enters the aggregated reward with its own reward gain, the gap between its expected scores on satisfied and unsatisfied responses. Counterintuitively, our experiments show that removing this imbalance, even with ground-truth labels, lowers ranking accuracy. To explain this, we derive an exact decomposition of the reward difference between any two candidates into a base satisfaction signal, a reward gain imbalance term, and a residual term, showing that reward gain imbalance can attenuate or amplify the base signal, and finding that misrankings usually concentrate on pairs where it attenuates. Guided by this analysis, we propose the adaptive \textbf{D}ual-\textbf{C}enter \textbf{C}lipping aggregation (DCC), which bounds each criterion's contribution to the reward difference instead of simply removing the imbalance. Using only the scores of the current candidate group, it determines a clipping interval that imposes a common upper bound on per-criterion score differences between candidates, limiting the excessive influence of extreme scores while preserving continuous judgment information....

title: Optimal Deep Nonparametric Regression with Uniformly Bounded Lipschitz Constants
authors: Jiaxin Shi, Ziyuan Chen, Jian Huang, Hansheng Wang
abstract: Stability under input perturbations is necessary for deep neural network estimators in many applications involving noisy covariates or estimated features. Weight norm constraints are widely used to control sensitivity to input perturbations by bounding the Lipschitz constant of neural networks. However, existing approximation results under fixed bounds on standard norm products are insufficient to establish optimal statistical rates. In this paper, we establish a sharp approximation theory for deep ReLU networks under a split spectral norm product constraint. This theoretical result shows that sufficiently smooth Hölder functions can be uniformly approximated to arbitrary accuracy as the network depth increases, with the norm-product bound held fixed. We then propose a penalized least squares estimator for deep nonparametric regression. The resulting estimator has a uniformly bounded Lipschitz constant while still achieving the optimal nonparametric rate up to a logarithmic factor. As applications, we establish optimal prediction rates for two-stage learning and provide robustness guarantees under adversarial input perturbations. Numerical studies show that the penalized estimator has well-controlled sensitivity to input perturbations and prediction accuracy comparable to that of classical deep network methods.

title: 21Codec: Decoder-side Speaker Control for Text-to-Speech
authors: David Lindevelt, Suzan Verberne, Joost Broekens
abstract: We propose 21Codec, a streaming codec model with reduced recoverable speaker information from the token stream and decoder-side speaker control. Existing codec models infer speaker identity from token stream. Making them streamable is not sufficiently robust to speaker drift, because each chunk re-infers the identity from the local chunk context alone. Our adversarial speaker classifier and NANSY-style formant-shift data augmentation pushes the model to rely on the provided speaker embedding while reducing the recoverable speaker information from the token stream. We show that 21Codec can control speaker identity through the conditioning vector, and that the speaker identity is maintained across chunks during streaming. With the ability to control speaker identity even in mid-stream, 21Codec is a promising candidate for streaming TTS systems for better controllability of speaker identity.

title: AG-BFGS: Foundations for Accelerated Geometry Learning
authors: Regina Carla Sousa, Denis Vargas, Elizabeth Wanner, Joshua Knowles
abstract: We introduce an accelerated geometry-learning framework for BFGS that incorporates momentum into the learning of Hessian inverse approximations. We prove that the resulting accelerated updates satisfy explicit stability conditions and preserve positive definiteness within admissible parameter regions. Numerical experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over the corresponding non-accelerated schemes while maintaining numerical stability. These results provide the first rigorous theoretical foundation for accelerated quasi-Newton learning and bridge the gap between empirical observations and mathematical guarantees for accelerated second-order methods.

title: Location Matters: Layer-wise Prompt Conditioning for Voice--Style Disentanglement in Text-to-Speech
authors: David Lindevelt, Suzan Verberne, Joost Broekens
abstract: Independent control of voice and emotional style characteristics of speech is a long-standing problem in text-to-speech (TTS) systems. We investigate how the conditioning location of voice and style prompts across TTS decoder layers affects the trade-off between preservation and expressiveness for voice identity and emotional style. We introduce a layer-dependent gated fusion mechanism and systematically study which layers should be influenced by which prompt type. Our findings show an asymmetric relationship. Voice benefits from early conditioning for identity preservation, while style benefits from early conditioning for expressiveness. Our findings provide practical guidance that helps neural network architects make an appropriate trade-off for the architecture of TTS systems according to their use cases.

title: Nearly Tight Almost Sure Convergence Rates for the Last iterate of SGD
authors: Weiming Ou, Andrea Paudice, Xiao Wang
abstract: We study the almost sure convergence of the last-iterate optimization error of Stochastic (sub)Gradient Descent (SGD) for convex objectives. For smooth objectives, we establish convergence rates of order $k^{-1/3}$ when a stationary minimizer exists, and $k^{-1/4}$ otherwise, up to polylogarithmic factors, where $k$ denotes the iteration counter. We further show that the latter rate extends to nonsmooth convex objectives. All these rates are achieved by deterministic, anytime stepsize policies. Finally, we establish matching lower bounds showing that the exponents $-1/3$ and $-1/4$ are optimal, up to polylogarithmic factors, for the corresponding problem classes.

title: Fill-Distance-Guided Active Learning for Causal Function Recovery under Network Interference
authors: Peiyao Liu, Hongtao Zhu, Sizhe Zhang, Yang Su, Zhenyu Zhao, Nan Chen
abstract: Causal inference seeks to learn how outcomes change under alternative interventions, but network interactions complicate this task. Under network interference, outcomes depend on both own treatment and neighbors' treatments, making causal effects functions of neighborhood exposure rather than single treatment contrasts. Existing methods primarily target prespecified causal contrasts or their estimation precision, leaving global response-function recovery largely unexplored. We study sequential experimentation under a limited experimental budget, with the goal of recovering the full exposure-dependent population-average response function. To this end, we propose FANCI (Fill-Distance-Guided Active Learning for Network-Interference Causal Inference). For function learning, treatment-specific Gaussian processes flexibly model nonlinear conditional response surfaces. For experimental design, we formulate global response-function recovery as a coverage problem and propose a fill-distance criterion that guides new experiments toward poorly covered regions. To account for network constraints on attainable exposure patterns, we develop full-network and target-screened strategies for selecting feasible network--assignment pairs. Theoretically, we derive uniform error bounds linking fill distance to response-function estimation and characterize the approximation loss from target screening. Simulations and an online-game experiment show that FANCI improves recovery of nonlinear exposure-dependent effects and reveals treatment patterns obscured when network interference is ignored.

title: Quantum Annealing with a Quantum Neural Network: Width of Annealing Matters
authors: Mojtaba Asadollahi, Danial Khajehzadeh, Abolfazl Ramezanpour
abstract: Quantum annealing is a promising quantum algorithm for dealing with computationally hard optimization problems. Currently available hardware can implement the algorithm for a significant class of Hamiltonian problems. However, its performance is especially limited in discontinuous quantum phase transitions, where the energy gap shrinks exponentially with system size. In this paper, we introduce an extension of quantum annealing to a quantum neural network and study its performance in a number of prototypical optimization problems. In particular, we observe that already a random quantum annealing network of width W = 2 can exponentially reduce the number of evolution layers or depth of the annealing process in the quantum search problem. By tuning the network parameters the search problem can be solved with exponentially small errors by a quantum perceptron of depth L = 1 and width W = 2. The findings show that width of a quantum annealing network is critical to enhance the success probability of the algorithm by providing a larger and learnable evolution space for the annealing process.

title: DOA Estimation in Antenna Arrays: Super-Resolution Methods in a Common Space
authors: Sergey S. Kuzin
abstract: This paper introduces a unified framework for angular super-resolution in antenna arrays. By integrating linear prediction beyond the physical aperture, entropy variations, and harmonic spatial spectra averaging, we recast classical methods - including Capon, Pisarenko, Maximum Entropy, and MUSIC - into a single structure. We extend this framework to accommodate ESPRIT-type methods by treating the number of simultaneously predicted subarray channels as an additional dimension. Furthermore, we adapt this approach to non-Gaussian signals, establishing a parallel framework for Virtual-ESPRIT-type methods. As a practical application, we propose universal, J-orthogonalization-based algorithms that estimate spatial super- resolution spectra within a unified computational architecture. This architecture produces spatial spectrum estimates for multiple super-resolution methods and any intermediate variations.

title: Joint Image Denoising and Interpolation via Mixed Graph Filtering
authors: Gene Cheung, Niruhan Viswarupan, Romisaa Elsaidy
abstract: Images often require both denoising and interpolation, yet treating the two tasks separately is suboptimal: interpolation introduces correlated noise that complicates subsequent denoising, while denoising may remove image details useful for interpolation. In this paper, we study joint image denoising and interpolation from a mixed graph filtering perspective, where denoising is modeled using undirected graph filters and interpolation using directed graph filters. We first establish that, under mild conditions, any (pseudo-)linear denoiser and interpolator can be interpreted as solution filters of maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimation problems regularized by undirected and directed graph smoothness priors, respectively. Guided by these results, we formulate graph-based joint denoising and interpolation problems using both directed and undirected graph structures. We characterize when joint denoising/interpolation reduces to a separable pipeline and when a genuinely coupled optimization is required. For the non-separable case, we recover sparse graph operators from given denoisers and interpolators, yielding an efficient linear-system formulation solvable via conjugate gradient. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed joint framework consistently outperforms separate denoising and interpolation pipelines across multiple denoiser-interpolator combinations.

title: Functional Principal Component Analysis: Minimax Optimality from Sparse to Dense Designs and Beyond
authors: Shunxing Yan, Fang Yao
abstract: Functional principal component analysis (FPCA) plays a central role as a dimension-reduction and representation tool in functional data analysis, but its minimax theory for diverging spectral indices under noisy discrete observation has remained open for over two decades. To fill this gap, we consider a sieve-based FPCA framework that pools discrete measurements across subjects and accommodates sampling frequencies ranging from sparse to dense under random designs. We begin by establishing new minimax rates for covariance estimation over general bivariate function classes beyond tensor-product low-complexity structures, thereby identifying the intrinsically two-dimensional optimal rate. Our central theoretical contribution is to establish minimax optimal rates for both individually labelled eigenfunctions with diverging indices and leading principal subspaces of increasing dimensions, under explicit growth and regularity conditions. To establish these results, we develop a general framework for sharp minimax analysis of FPCA under discrete observation, separating spectral approximation from stochastic perturbations and exploiting their distinct structures, thereby offering a new approach to a broad class of nonparametric spectral estimation problems. For both spectral targets, the optimal rates reveal two distinct statistical mechanisms, spectral identification and nonparametric reconstruction, whose interplay gives rise to either four or two sampling regimes. This yields, for the first time, a precise characterization of the impact of discrete sampling across the full range from sparse to dense designs. Finally, as a downstream application, we analyze FPCA-based functional linear regression and show that the FPCA-based estimator attains the minimax-optimal rates.

title: Stability-compatible kernels: beyond Gaussianity for impulse response estimation
authors: Gianluigi Pillonetto, Mauro Bisiacco
abstract: Kernel-based regularization for linear system identification uses positive semidefinite kernels both to define reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHSs) and as covariance models for stochastic impulse responses. Sharp kernel conditions are known for RKHS stability, while almost-sure BIBO stability under Gaussian priors requires an even more restrictive covariance condition. These restrictions, however, need not persist beyond Gaussianity, where the covariance no longer determines the full probability law. We introduce the notion of a stability-compatible kernel, namely a covariance kernel admitting at least one stochastic realization with almost-surely absolutely summable sample paths. We show that stability-compatibility holds if and only if the stable elements are dense in the associated RKHS, a condition strictly weaker than RKHS stability, and derive practical sufficient conditions, including a spectral criterion for stationary kernels. We then construct non-Gaussian priors that preserve a prescribed covariance while enforcing almost-sure stability. In particular, this yields a stable prior based on the stationary radial-basis-function (RBF) kernel, separating covariance structure from the mechanism enforcing stability. Numerical experiments show substantial estimation gains for several important classes of impulse responses, with particularly pronounced advantages when relevant dynamics occur at late lags or in separated temporal regions.

title: Rare-Tail Statistics For Learning Biased Gaussian Halfspaces with Label Noise
authors: Arya Mazumdar, Prateeti Mukherjee, Harsh Vardhan
abstract: We revisit the classical problem of learning general Gaussian halfspaces in the presence of label noise, with particular focus on the large-bias regime, where information-computation gaps are conjectured in several standard label-noise models. Concretely, we present and analyze the rare-tail mean estimator, an extremely simple one-shot statistic that averages only the observed minority class. In the large-bias regime, classical Averaging (Servedio, 1999) and related global first-moment statistics are provably suboptimal, while the rare-tail mean estimator recovers the target halfspace direction at the information-theoretic sample rate (modulo log factors) under a broad class of label noise models, including probit noise and margin-dependent noise with very slow decay away from the boundary. Notably, our guarantees allow labels arbitrarily close to the decision boundary to be nearly random, while still giving strong directional recovery from a small number of samples. The estimator also cleanly interpolates between the noiseless and noisy regimes: without noise, it attains the same sample rate as classical separability-based methods for realizable halfspaces, and under low noise, or noise that decays away from the boundary, it keeps this rate even after linear separability has been destroyed. As an application, we consider a two-stage curriculum in which source samples, whose noise may be arbitrarily close to $1/2$ near the boundary and decay very slowly away from it, precede target samples, whose noise flips every label at the same rate, i.e., random classification noise (RCN). Since both stages share the same Bayes optimal halfspace, our estimator supplies the directional warm start needed by existing refinement routines, and together they learn the RCN target at the information-theoretic sample rate in the large-bias regime, up to log factors.

title: An additive-square-free word over an alphabet of size 6
authors: Jeffrey Shallit
abstract: An additive square over $\mathbb{N}$ is two consecutive nonempty blocks of the same length and same sum. For example, 1423 is an additive square, since 14 and 23 both have length 2 and sum 5. Solving a problem that has been open for more than 50 years, we give an example of an infinite word over a 6-letter subset of N that avoids additive squares.

title: Mesh Sensitivity of Different Boundary Treatments in High-Order Compact Gas-Kinetic Scheme for Hypersonic Heat-Flux Prediction
authors: Xingyi Jiang, Jiawang Zhang, Junlei Mu, Xing Ji
abstract: Accurate wall-heat-flux prediction in hypersonic flow depends on both the wall treatment and the available near-wall resolution. This work compares three complete implementations of a gas-kinetic scheme (GKS) for Mach~8.03 laminar flow over an isothermal circular cylinder: a linear Green--Gauss scheme (GG), a compact ghost-cell scheme (GC), and a pointwise one-sided compact scheme (POS). In POS, the stationary isothermal-wall conditions are imposed at the two Gaussian points used by the kinetic wall-flux quadrature. A reference mesh and six meshes in the uniform reduction (UR), log-layer unpacked (LLU), and log-layer packed (LLP) families are used to assess heat-flux sensitivity. At 24 digitized experimental angles, GG has the lowest root-mean-square difference on the reference, UR, and LLP families, whereas POS is closest on the two LLU meshes; GC is not the lowest-RMS scheme on any tested mesh. Hence no treatment is uniformly superior. On the present high-aspect-ratio cylinder grids, GG is the more robust choice except under LLU node redistribution, for which POS is preferable. Uniform reduction produces the largest heat-flux response for all three implementations. The comparison concerns complete schemes and does not isolate the pointwise constraints from differences in reconstruction and geometry representation.

title: Efficient simulation of variational quantum circuits: representation, accuracy and CPU/GPU allocation
authors: Vojtěch Novák, Radovan Rečka, Ondřej Knebl, Ivan Zelinka
abstract: Classical circuit simulation supports quantum software development and verification and provides a baseline for assessing quantum advantage. We compare gate-based statevector simulation, direct Pauli evolution and matrix product states for molecular and spin Variational Hamiltonian Ansatze and hardware-efficient ansatze on CPU/GPU systems, varying width, depth, precision and resource allocation. In the tested implementations, direct Pauli evolution benefits complex molecular VHA, whereas GPUs accelerate wider spin and hardware efficient circuits. Matrix product state is useful when limited entanglement permits accurate compression; corrected CPU FP32 can meet the tested tolerance while costing more than FP64. Workload size, startup, worker memory and task-specific profiling can change the preferred allocation. Matched NumPy Pauli updates accelerate two-layer full LiH by 3.45-fold; the GPU gives approximately 30-fold acceleration over 18-thread Aer for 28-qubit, four-layer TFIM, both in FP64. We provide a procedure for choosing representation, precision and worker allocation jointly, comparing the cost of complete energy evaluations under accuracy, memory and core constraints.

title: Transferable Named Sparse Features for Morphology-based Gleason Grading
authors: Argyrios Zafeiriou, Athanasios Kallipolitis, Ilias Maglogiannis
abstract: Deep learning systems grade prostate biopsies at the level of pathologists, but most report a grade without the glandular architecture that justifies it. This work presents a grading system built on a sparse code over the tokens of a pathology foundation model. A sparse autoencoder pretrained on biopsies is aligned with multi-reader annotations, so that 69 of its 2048 features are named after Gleason morphologies such as cribriform glands, cords, and comedonecrosis. The same code feeds a grading network, which reads all features to predict Gleason patterns and the Grade Group, while morphology maps read directly from the named features. We evaluate the system on five public datasets that include needle biopsies, tissue-microarray cores, multi-reader annotations, and three scanners. The morphology maps remain stable across alignment runs and, without retraining, detect cribriform glands in external biopsies (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, AUROC, 0.849) and pattern 5 in unseen cores when evaluated by up to six pathologists (AUROC 0.846 to 0.919). In an independent biopsy cohort, Grade Group agreement with three pathologists on Leica scans is close to their agreement with each other. Removing the named features reduces the corresponding Gleason pattern predictions by 49% to 98%, with effects larger than those from 20 activity-matched random feature removals. These results show that a shared sparse representation can support competitive Gleason grading while providing named morphological evidence that transfers across datasets and whose contribution to grading can be measured directly.

title: A combinatorial proof of a symmetric joint distribution on strict binary trees
authors: Shishuo Fu
abstract: Nonplanar strict binary trees on $2n+1$ vertices are enumerated by the reduced tangent numbers $T_{2n+1}/2^n$, whose entries are refined by Poupard's triangle. Poupard defined the end of the minimal chain ($\mathrm{eoc}$) and the parent of the maximum leaf ($\mathrm{pom}$) on these trees, proving that $\mathrm{eoc}$ and $\mathrm{pom}+1$ share this triangular distribution. Foata and Han subsequently showed via tree calculus and partial difference equations that the joint distribution of $(\mathrm{eoc}, 2n+1-\mathrm{pom})$ is symmetric. By introducing an auxiliary tree statistic dual to $\mathrm{eoc}$, we give a bijective proof of this symmetry. Our proof composes a recursive bijection on strict binary trees, a bijection to alternating André permutations, and the reverse-complement involution on permutations.

title: Treewidth 3 in the Product Structure Theorem for Bounded Degree Graphs in Minor-Closed Classes
authors: Vida Dujmović, Robert Hickingbotham, Pat Morin, David R. Wood
abstract: We show that, for all positive integers $t$ and $Δ$, there exists an integer $c$ such that, for every $K_t$-minor-free graph $G$ with maximum degree at most $Δ$, there exists a graph $H$ of treewidth at most $3$ and a path $P$ such that $G$ is isomorphic to a subgraph of the strong product $H\boxtimes P\boxtimes K_c$. This improves on a previous result of Dujumović, Esperet, Micek, Walczak, and Wood (2022) by bounding the treewidth of $H$ independently of $t$ and $Δ$. As an immediate consequence we obtain a bound of $O(r^4)$ on the $r$-weak colouring number of bounded-degree graphs from any proper minor-closed graph class.

title: Sparse designs via quantization of the uniform measure on high-dimensional hypercubes
authors: Luc Pronzato, Anatoly Zhigljavsky
abstract: While the notions of sphere packing and sphere covering underlie the most widely used criteria for space-filling design in computer experiments, namely, the maximin and minimax approaches, they suffer from major drawbacks in high dimensions. First, when the dimension $d$ is very large, deploying a space-filling design requires an extremely large number of design points, making the very notion of a space-filling design questionable. Second, these two design characteristics are highly sensitive to boundaries, particularly when the design domain is a hypercube (the case considered in this paper), and especially to its vertices. This sensitivity is particularly acute when the design size is less than $2^d$. Instead of considering the maximin or minimax criterion, we consider here the quantization error of the uniform measure on the hypercube. This error has three key advantages: it accounts for the entire distribution of distances from a random point $U$ to the design, is less sensitive to boundary effects than the maximin and minimax criteria, and, thanks to Zador's celebrated theorem, enables a smooth and natural transition to uniform designs as the design size tends to infinity. Building on recent results on the construction of optimal random quantizers for spherically symmetric distributions (arXiv:2610.11772) we propose a method to generate random designs of a given target size $n$ with small $L_s$-mean quantization error. The support of the resulting distribution is then used to construct designs, possibly incrementally, with sizes up to $n$. We demonstrate that, for moderate $n$, designs supported on a fractional factorial subset of the vertices of a small hypercube perform exceptionally well---and significantly better than designs uniformly distributed over the entire hypercube. We also explain how to account for projections onto lower-dimensional subspaces.

title: Taming the Tails of Stochastic Gradient Descent in the Interpolation Regime
authors: Leonardo Galli, Daniela Angela Parletta, Andrea Paudice
abstract: In this paper, we study stochastic gradient descent in the smooth interpolation regime, where the population objective shares a common minimizer with the sample losses. In contrast to prior work, which has largely focused on in-expectation analysis, we obtain high-probability convergence guarantees under the same assumptions. In the convex case, we prove a fast rate of order $\log(β^{-1}) \cdot n^{-1}$ after $n$ iterations, with failure probability at most $β$. In the strongly convex case, we derive a family of moment-based bounds of order $β^{-p} \cdot \exp(-\mathcal{O}(p \cdot n))$ for $p \in (0,1]$, and complement them with a matching lower bound showing that the corresponding deterioration in the exponential rate is essentially unavoidable. In both settings, our theoretical results are unified across a broad class of step-size schedules. Building on this analysis, we extend our results to a low-noise regime and to nonconvex objectives satisfying the Polyak-Lojasiewicz condition.
zh_title: 驯服插值区间内随机梯度下降的尾部
translation:
标题：驯服插值区间内随机梯度下降的尾部

摘要：在本文中，我们研究了平滑插值区间内的随机梯度下降，其中总体目标函数与样本损失函数共享一个共同的最小化器。与以往主要关注期望分析的工作不同，我们在相同假设下获得了高概率收敛保证。在凸情况下，我们证明了经过$n$次迭代后，收敛速率为$\log(β^{-1}) \cdot n^{-1}$，失败概率至多为$β$。在强凸情况下，我们推导了一系列形式为$β^{-p} \cdot \exp(-\mathcal{O}(p \cdot n))$的基于矩的界限，其中$p \in (0,1]$，并辅以匹配的下界，表明指数速率的相应恶化是基本不可避免的。在这两种设置中，我们的理论结果对于广泛的步长调度类是统一的。在此分析的基础上，我们将结果扩展到低噪声区间和满足Polyak-Lojasiewicz条件的非凸目标。
tldr: 本文在插值区间内研究随机梯度下降（SGD）的高概率收敛性，并在凸、强凸、低噪声和特定非凸设置下提供了理论保证，超越了以往仅关注期望分析的工作。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将随机梯度下降（SGD）的分析从传统的期望收敛提升到更强的高概率收敛保证，这在实践中对于理解算法在最坏情况下的表现至关重要。其在凸、强凸、低噪声和非凸设置下提供了统一的理论框架，并揭示了某些收敛速率的内在局限性，对SGD的理论研究具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有关于随机梯度下降（SGD）的研究主要集中在期望分析上。本文的动机是在平滑插值区间内，相同假设下，获得SGD的高概率收敛保证，而非仅仅是期望意义上的收敛，从而提供更强的理论保证。
method: 本文通过理论分析方法，在平滑插值区间内，为随机梯度下降（SGD）推导高概率收敛保证。具体地，在凸和强凸情况下，推导了收敛速率和基于矩的界限，并通过匹配的下界证明了某些速率的不可避免性。此外，将分析扩展到低噪声区间和满足Polyak-Lojasiewicz条件的非凸目标。
results: 1. 在凸情况下，经过$n$次迭代后，证明了收敛速率为$\log(β^{-1}) \cdot n^{-1}$，失败概率至多为$β$。 2. 在强凸情况下，推导了一系列形式为$β^{-p} \cdot \exp(-\mathcal{O}(p \cdot n))$的基于矩的界限，其中$p \in (0,1]$，并辅以匹配的下界，表明指数速率的相应恶化是基本不可避免的。 3. 理论结果适用于广泛的步长调度，并已扩展到低噪声区间和满足Polyak-Lojasiewicz条件的非凸目标。
conclusion: 本文成功在插值区间内为随机梯度下降（SGD）提供了高概率收敛保证，超越了以往仅关注期望分析的局限。研究结果统一了凸、强凸、低噪声和满足Polyak-Lojasiewicz条件的非凸目标下的理论框架，为理解SGD的行为提供了更深入的见解。

title: Capacity-Aware Redistribution Control for Mitigation of Cascading Failures in Networks
authors: Ujjwal Pratap, Christian A. Hans
abstract: This paper studies the control of irreversible cascading failures in networks with finite node capacities. Each node carries a nonnegative divisible quantity, referred to as load, and fails irreversibly when its load exceeds its capacity. The network dynamics are represented by topology-dependent row-stochastic matrices. When nodes fail, these matrices must be updated. However, directly deleting rows and columns corresponding to failed nodes can reduce the total load in the network. We therefore introduce a topology update that preserves unit row sums and quantifies any unserved load explicitly. We derive the resulting load-balance relation and a necessary and sufficient condition for lossless redistribution after simultaneous failures. Based on these results, we formulate a two-stage optimization problem: the first stage minimizes unserved load, and the second stage minimizes the highest capacity utilization among the surviving nodes. Simulations on grid and Barabasi-Albert networks show that, unlike the standard equal and residual-capacity redistribution approaches, the proposed method prevents secondary failures in all tested cases, with a tradeoff against served load on scale-free networks.
zh_title: 网络中级联故障缓解的容量感知再分配控制
translation: 本文研究了具有有限节点容量的网络中不可逆级联故障的控制。每个节点承载一个非负可分量，称为负载，当其负载超过容量时会不可逆地失效。网络动态由依赖于拓扑的行随机矩阵表示。当节点失效时，这些矩阵必须更新。然而，直接删除对应于失效节点的行和列会减少网络中的总负载。因此，我们引入了一种保留单位行和明确量化任何未服务负载的拓扑更新。我们推导了由此产生的负载平衡关系以及同时故障后无损再分配的充要条件。基于这些结果，我们提出了一个两阶段优化问题：第一阶段最小化未服务负载，第二阶段最小化幸存节点中最高的容量利用率。在网格和Barabasi-Albert网络上的模拟表明，与标准的相等和残余容量再分配方法不同，所提出的方法在所有测试情况下都防止了二次故障，但以牺牲无标度网络上的服务负载为代价。
tldr: 本文研究了具有有限节点容量的网络中不可逆级联故障的控制问题，提出了一种新的拓扑更新和两阶段优化方法，以防止二次故障并最小化未服务负载和容量利用率。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入一种创新的拓扑更新方法来精确量化未服务负载，并结合两阶段优化策略，有效解决了网络级联故障中的负载再分配问题。其主要创新在于对故障后网络动态的更精确建模和优化，成功防止了二次故障，这对于提升网络鲁棒性具有重要意义。然而，在无标度网络上服务负载的权衡是一个值得关注的限制。
motivation: 研究在具有有限节点容量的网络中，当节点负载超过容量时发生不可逆级联故障的问题。现有方法在节点失效时直接删除行和列会导致总负载减少，因此需要一种新的拓扑更新方法来保留单位行和量化未服务负载。
method: 1. 引入了一种保留单位行和显式量化未服务负载的拓扑更新方法，以解决节点失效后直接删除行和列导致总负载减少的问题。2. 推导了由此产生的负载平衡关系以及同时故障后无损再分配的充要条件。3. 基于这些结果，提出了一个两阶段优化问题：第一阶段最小化未服务负载，第二阶段最小化幸存节点中最高的容量利用率。
results: 在网格和Barabasi-Albert网络上的模拟表明，与标准的相等和残余容量再分配方法不同，所提出的方法在所有测试情况下都防止了二次故障。在无标度网络上，这以牺牲部分服务负载为代价。
conclusion: 提出了一种容量感知的再分配控制方法，通过新的拓扑更新和两阶段优化，有效缓解了网络中的级联故障，并在所有测试案例中防止了二次故障，尽管在无标度网络上存在服务负载的权衡。

title: Diffusion Models are Provably Efficient Priors for Sparse Recovery
authors: Ivan Lee, Xingyu Xu, Yuejie Chi
abstract: Diffusion models have transformed generative modeling through their ability to capture and generate samples from complex data distributions. This success has spurred substantial interest in using pretrained diffusion models as expressive priors for highly ill-posed inverse problems in imaging and sensing. Despite strong empirical performance, theoretical understanding of this approach remains limited: existing guarantees are often asymptotic or entail prohibitive computational costs in the worst case. In this paper, we address this gap by studying sparse recovery from a small number of linear measurements, a classical problem in compressed sensing. We show that, given an accurate diffusion model capturing a sparsity-promoting Bernoulli-Gaussian prior, a likelihood-guided annealed Langevin sampler provably recovers the sparse signal in polynomial time with near-optimal sample complexity for a broad family of random and deterministic sensing matrices. When the signal is indeed drawn from the postulated prior, we further establish total variation guarantees for posterior sampling after a final denoising step. These results lay a theoretical foundation for statistically and computationally efficient inverse solvers with diffusion priors.
zh_title: 扩散模型是稀疏恢复的理论高效先验
translation: 扩散模型凭借其捕获和生成复杂数据分布样本的能力，彻底改变了生成建模。这一成功激发了人们对使用预训练扩散模型作为富有表现力的先验，解决成像和感知中高度病态的逆问题的浓厚兴趣。尽管经验性能强劲，但这种方法的理论理解仍然有限：现有保证往往是渐近的，或者在最坏情况下需要高昂的计算成本。在本文中，我们通过研究从少量线性测量中进行稀疏恢复（一个经典的压缩感知问题）来弥补这一空白。我们表明，给定一个捕捉稀疏促进伯努利-高斯先验的精确扩散模型，一个似然引导的退火Langevin采样器可以被证明在多项式时间内，以接近最优的样本复杂度，为广泛的随机和确定性感测矩阵恢复稀疏信号。当信号确实来自假设先验时，我们进一步建立了最终去噪步骤后后验采样的总变差保证。这些结果为使用扩散先验的统计和计算高效逆求解器奠定了理论基础。
tldr: 本文理论证明了扩散模型作为先验在稀疏恢复问题中的统计和计算效率，表明通过似然引导的退火Langevin采样器，可以在多项式时间内以接近最优的样本复杂度恢复稀疏信号。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于为扩散模型在逆问题中的应用提供了严格的理论保证，特别是在稀疏恢复领域。它解决了现有研究中理论理解不足的痛点，为扩散先验的统计和计算效率提供了坚实的基础，对于推动扩散模型在实际应用中的可信度和普及具有重要意义。在技术细节上，结合似然引导的退火Langevin采样器来证明其效率，是其核心贡献。
motivation: 尽管扩散模型作为先验在图像和感知中的病态逆问题中表现出色，但其理论理解仍然有限，现有的保证往往是渐近的或计算成本过高。
method: 通过研究压缩感知中的经典问题——从少量线性测量中进行稀疏恢复，并使用一个捕捉稀疏促进伯努利-高斯先验的精确扩散模型，结合似然引导的退火Langevin采样器。
results: 证明了在多项式时间内，以接近最优的样本复杂度，可以从广泛的随机和确定性感测矩阵中恢复稀疏信号。当信号确实来自假设先验时，进一步建立了最终去噪步骤后后验采样的总变差保证。
conclusion: 这些结果为使用扩散先验的统计和计算高效逆求解器奠定了理论基础。

title: Task-Oriented Network Ranging via Joint Graph and Schedule Design
authors: Zijian Zhang, Yuan Shen
abstract: Measuring inter-node distances is the basis for network localization, whereas acquiring node positions does not require a fully connected graph of distances. Existing complete-ranging protocols for network localization require every node pair to exchange signals, which prolongs the ranging cycle. In this paper, we propose sparse signal-multiplexing network ranging (S-SM-NR), a task-oriented framework that adapts the transmit-listen schedule to the ranging task required by network localization. First, we establish the S-SM-NR framework by formulating the joint design of the task graph and the transmit-listen schedule. Then, we analyze the minimum round count required by S-SM-NR and establish a connectivity condition for network localization. Subsequently, we develop a closed-form joint design that constructs the sparse task graph and the balanced transmit-listen schedule. In particular, the joint design can achieve the minimum round count under the complete physical connectivity. Finally, simulations show that the proposed S-SM-NR scheme reduces the occupied-round count and improves the localization accuracy by shortening the ranging cycle.
zh_title: 面向任务的网络测距：通过联合图和调度设计
translation: 测量节点间距离是网络定位的基础，而获取节点位置并不需要完全连接的距离图。现有用于网络定位的完整测距协议要求每个节点对都交换信号，这会延长测距周期。在本文中，我们提出了一种稀疏信号复用网络测距（S-SM-NR），这是一个面向任务的框架，它根据网络定位所需的测距任务调整收发调度。首先，我们通过制定任务图和收发调度的联合设计来建立S-SM-NR框架。然后，我们分析了S-SM-NR所需的最小轮次计数，并建立了网络定位的连接条件。随后，我们开发了一个闭式联合设计来构建稀疏任务图和平衡的收发调度。特别是，该联合设计可以在完全物理连接下实现最小轮次计数。最后，仿真结果表明，所提出的S-SM-NR方案通过缩短测距周期，减少了占用轮次计数并提高了定位精度。
tldr: 本文提出了一种稀疏信号复用网络测距（S-SM-NR）框架，通过联合设计任务图和收发调度来优化网络定位中的节点间距离测量，从而减少测距周期并提高定位精度。
ai_comments: 本文提出了一种创新的面向任务的网络测距方法，通过联合优化任务图和收发调度，解决了传统完整测距协议效率低、测距周期长的问题。其核心在于将测距任务与调度紧密结合，实现了资源（轮次计数）的节约和定位精度的提升，对于大规模无线传感器网络或物联网中的定位应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 测量节点间距离是网络定位的基础，但现有完整的网络定位测距协议需要所有节点对交换信号，这会延长测距周期，而获取节点位置并不需要完全连接的距离图。
method: 本文提出了稀疏信号复用网络测距（S-SM-NR），这是一个面向任务的框架，它根据网络定位所需的测距任务调整收发调度。首先，通过制定任务图和收发调度的联合设计来建立S-SM-NR框架。然后，分析了S-SM-NR所需的最小轮次计数，并建立了网络定位的连接条件。随后，开发了一个闭式联合设计来构建稀疏任务图和平衡的收发调度。
results: 所提出的联合设计可以在完全物理连接下实现最小轮次计数。仿真结果表明，S-SM-NR方案通过缩短测距周期，减少了占用轮次计数并提高了定位精度。
conclusion: 所提出的S-SM-NR框架通过联合设计任务图和收发调度，有效地优化了网络测距过程，显著减少了测距周期，提高了网络定位的效率和精度。

title: Surrogate Modeling and Reduced-Order Methods in Gravitational-Wave Physics and Numerical Relativity: From Spectral Representations to Adaptive Compression
authors: Manuel Tiglio
abstract: The rapid expansion of gravitational-wave astronomy and high-precision numerical relativity has created an acute computational bottleneck: direct numerical integration of the Einstein field equations and high-dimensional Bayesian parameter estimation require millions of waveform evaluations that cannot be sustained by traditional solvers alone. Reduced-order modeling (ROM) and surrogate techniques have emerged as foundational tools to bridge this gap, compressing high-fidelity solution manifolds into compact, rapidly evaluable representations without sacrificing physical accuracy. This perspective reviews the mathematical pillars of projection-based reduced-order modeling---including Proper Orthogonal Decomposition, greedy basis selection, and the Empirical Interpolation Method---and traces their operational impact in gravitational-wave data analysis through surrogate waveform families and Reduced-Order Quadratures. We then examine the fundamental approximation barriers posed by slow Kolmogorov n-width decay in non-stationary, transient, and strongly nonlinear regimes, showing how adaptive hp-greedy domain partitioning and multi-scale spectral compression overcome these limits. Finally, we discuss how combining certified reduced-order structures with modern scientific machine learning and sensitivity-aware quantization provides a rigorous blueprint for next-generation detectors such as LISA, Einstein Telescope, and Cosmic Explorer.
zh_title: 引力波物理和数值相对论中的代理建模和降阶方法：从谱表示到自适应压缩
translation: 引力波天文学和高精度数值相对论的迅速发展造成了严重的计算瓶颈：爱因斯坦场方程的直接数值积分和高维贝叶斯参数估计需要数百万次的波形评估，而传统求解器无法单独维持。降阶建模（ROM）和代理技术已成为弥合这一差距的基础工具，它们将高保真解流形压缩成紧凑、快速可评估的表示，而不会牺牲物理精度。本文回顾了基于投影的降阶建模的数学支柱——包括本征正交分解、贪婪基选择和经验插值方法——并追溯了它们在引力波数据分析中通过代理波形族和降阶正交法产生的操作影响。随后，我们审视了非平稳、瞬态和强非线性区域中由慢柯尔莫哥洛夫n-宽度衰减所带来的基本近似障碍，展示了自适应hp-贪婪域划分和多尺度谱压缩如何克服这些限制。最后，我们讨论了如何将经过认证的降阶结构与现代科学机器学习和敏感度感知量化相结合，为LISA、爱因斯坦望远镜和宇宙探索者等下一代探测器提供一个严谨的蓝图。
tldr: 引力波天文学和数值相对论面临计算瓶颈，本文回顾了降阶建模和代理技术，讨论了其数学基础、在引力波数据分析中的应用，以及如何通过自适应压缩克服近似障碍，并展望了其与机器学习结合在未来探测器中的应用。
ai_comments: 这篇论文提供了一个全面的视角，审视了降阶建模和代理技术在解决引力波物理和数值相对论中计算挑战方面的关键作用。其创新之处在于不仅回顾了传统方法，还深入探讨了如何通过先进的自适应压缩技术克服非线性系统的近似障碍，并提出将这些技术与机器学习结合，为下一代引力波探测器提供解决方案，具有重要的理论和应用价值。
motivation: 引力波天文学和高精度数值相对论的快速发展导致了严重的计算瓶颈：爱因斯坦场方程的直接数值积分和高维贝叶斯参数估计需要数百万次波形评估，而传统求解器无法支持。
method: 本文回顾了基于投影的降阶建模的数学支柱，包括本征正交分解（Proper Orthogonal Decomposition）、贪婪基选择（greedy basis selection）和经验插值方法（Empirical Interpolation Method）。探讨了自适应hp-贪婪域划分（adaptive hp-greedy domain partitioning）和多尺度谱压缩（multi-scale spectral compression）来克服近似障碍。最后，讨论了将认证的降阶结构与现代科学机器学习和敏感度感知量化相结合的方法。
results: 降阶建模（ROM）和代理技术能够将高保真解流形压缩成紧凑、快速可评估的表示，而不牺牲物理精度。自适应hp-贪婪域划分和多尺度谱压缩能够克服非平稳、瞬态和强非线性区域中由慢柯尔莫哥洛夫n-宽度衰减引起的近似障碍。
conclusion: 将经过认证的降阶结构与现代科学机器学习和敏感度感知量化相结合，为LISA、爱因斯坦望远镜和宇宙探索者等下一代探测器提供了一个严谨的蓝图。

title: Sex Differences in the Detection of Parkinson's Disease from Speech
authors: Hiba Akhaddar, Peter Plantinga, Mirco Ravanelli, Tristan Glatard
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is the second most common neurodegenerative disease in the world, and 70\% to 75\% of PD patients suffer from speech disorders at some stage. Since PD affects men more frequently than women, previous publications tend to rely on unbalanced datasets that potentially introduce sex biases into trained models. This study investigates sex differences in PD detection from speech using deep learning and traditional machine learning approaches. We evaluated speech-based PD detection using embeddings from three pre-trained speech models, combined with handcrafted acoustic features and different classifiers. Sex-specific experiments were conducted on balanced subsets of four sustained phonation datasets, controlling for sex, disease status, and, where possible, age. All recordings were obtained during a sustained phonation task. Results show that female speakers were more accurately classified than male speakers in the larger dataset. Sex-specific results show that when the models are trained on one sex, they fail to generalize to the other one. Our results highlight the importance of including sex as a variable in the development of PD detection systems.
zh_title: 语音帕金森病检测中的性别差异
translation: 帕金森病（PD）是世界上第二常见的神经退行性疾病，70%至75%的PD患者在某个阶段会患有言语障碍。由于PD对男性的影响比女性更频繁，以往的出版物倾向于依赖不平衡的数据集，这可能给训练模型引入性别偏差。本研究使用深度学习和传统机器学习方法调查了从语音中检测PD时的性别差异。我们通过结合来自三个预训练语音模型的嵌入、手工声学特征和不同的分类器，评估了基于语音的PD检测。在四个持续发声数据集的平衡子集上进行了性别特异性实验，控制了性别、疾病状态以及可能的年龄变量。所有录音均在持续发声任务中获得。结果显示，在较大的数据集中，女性说话者的分类准确性高于男性说话者。性别特异性结果表明，当模型在一个性别上训练时，它们无法泛化到另一个性别。我们的结果强调了在帕金森病检测系统开发中，将性别作为一个变量纳入的重要性。
tldr: 本研究探讨了使用深度学习和传统机器学习方法从语音中检测帕金森病时的性别差异，发现女性患者的分类准确性更高，且模型在不同性别间泛化能力差，强调了将性别作为变量纳入帕金森病检测系统开发的重要性。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于它直接解决了帕金森病检测领域中长期存在的性别偏差问题，特别是考虑到男性PD患病率更高可能导致数据集不平衡。通过进行性别特异性实验并发现模型在不同性别间的泛化能力差，该研究为未来开发更公平、准确的PD检测系统提供了重要指导，强调了在模型设计和数据收集阶段就应将性别纳入考量。
motivation: 由于帕金森病（PD）对男性的影响比女性更频繁，以往的研究倾向于使用不平衡的数据集，这可能给训练模型引入性别偏差。本研究旨在调查从语音中检测PD时存在的性别差异，以解决这一潜在的偏差问题。
method: 本研究采用深度学习和传统机器学习方法，通过结合来自三个预训练语音模型的嵌入、手工声学特征和不同的分类器来评估基于语音的PD检测。在四个持续发声数据集的平衡子集上进行了性别特异性实验，并控制了性别、疾病状态以及可能的年龄变量。
results: 结果显示，在较大的数据集中，女性说话者的分类准确性高于男性说话者。性别特异性结果表明，当模型在一个性别上训练时，它们无法泛化到另一个性别。
conclusion: 本研究结果强调了在帕金森病检测系统的开发中，将性别作为一个变量纳入考虑的重要性。

title: Learning the Anyon Atlas
authors: Jonah Berean-Dutcher, Clay Cordova, Julio Parra-Martinez, Richard Tuddenham, Zekai Zhu
abstract: We extend our previous search for the modular data of topological quantum field theories in 2+1 dimensions from 22 to 42 anyons, identifying 150,679 new modular data. We do so by adding to our algorithm three rejection gates, two of them based on logistic regression, that discard representations of $SL(2,\mathbb{Z})$ unlikely to yield modular data. We estimate that roughly 80% of the modular data between ranks 23 and 42 has been identified after closing under known constructions. With this data, we find counterexamples to a conjecture of Geiko and Moore that the reality of the higher Gauss sums suffices for time-reversal symmetry in Chern-Simons theories, and propose a refined criterion. We demonstrate the scalability of this gated implementation by identifying prime modular data at rank 100 that is not realized by any Chern-Simons theory. The identified data through rank 42 has been made available at https://AnyonAtlas.org, to which further data will be added as it is found.
zh_title: 学习任意子图谱 (Learning the Anyon Atlas)
translation: 我们将2+1维拓扑量子场论模数据的搜索范围从22个任意子扩展到42个，识别出了150,679个新的模数据。我们通过在算法中加入三个拒绝门（其中两个基于逻辑回归，用于丢弃不太可能产生模数据的 $SL(2,\mathbb{Z})$ 表示）来实现这一点。我们估计，在通过已知构造进行闭包后，已识别出 rank 23 到 42 之间约 80% 的模数据。利用这些数据，我们发现了 Geiko 和 Moore 猜想（即较高高斯和的实性足以保证 Chern-Simons 理论中的时间反演对称性）的反例，并提出了一个改进的标准。我们通过识别不被任何 Chern-Simons 理论实现的 rank 100 的素模数据，展示了这种带门控实现的的可扩展性。通过 rank 42 识别出的数据已在 https://AnyonAtlas.org 公开，未来发现的更多数据也将被添加至该网站。
tldr: 该论文将2+1维拓扑量子场论模数据的搜索规模扩大到了42个任意子，发现了15万个新数据，推翻了一个著名猜想，并开源了“Anyon Atlas”数据库。
ai_comments: 该论文扩展了2+1维拓扑量子场论中任意子模数据的搜索规模，通过引入逻辑回归等拒绝门显著提升了算法效率，并构建了公开的“Anyon Atlas”，对检验相关数学猜想和理解非阿贝尔任意子具有重要价值。
motivation: 为了克服大规模搜索2+1维拓扑量子场论中模数据时的计算瓶颈，从而发现更多模数据并用于检验和完善关于拓扑量子场论及时间反演对称性的数学物理猜想。
method: 通过在现有算法中加入三个拒绝门（其中两个基于逻辑回归），过滤掉不太可能产生模数据的 $SL(2,\mathbb{Z})$ 表示，从而扩展了模数据的搜索范围，并利用已知构造进行闭包处理。
results: 识别出了150,679个新的模数据（rank 23至42），估计覆盖了该区间约80%的模数据；找到了反驳Geiko和Moore关于时间反演对称性猜想的反例，并提出了改进标准；在 rank 100 处识别出了不被任何 Chern-Simons 理论实现的素模数据，展示了算法的可扩展性。
conclusion: 通过引入高效的筛选算法，该研究成功扩展了模数据的搜索规模至 rank 42 及更高（如 rank 100），否定了关于时间反演对称性的已有猜想，并建立了“Anyon Atlas”数据库供研究社区使用。

title: Soft Mixture of Quantum Experts for Hybrid Quantum-Classical Learning
authors: Valeria Repetto, Romina D'Aurizio, Piero Farinelli
abstract: Quantum Machine Learning (QML) has attracted increasing interest as a possible route to construct feature representations that are difficult to reproduce with classical models. However, near-term QML architectures based on trainable parametrized quantum circuits remain affected by limited hardware resources, noise, and severe optimization difficulties such as barren plateaus. In this work we propose Soft-MoQE, a Soft Mixture of Quantum Experts architecture that replaces variational quantum training with the input-dependent selection and combination of fixed quantum feature maps. The model is composed of a heterogeneous pool of non-trainable quantum circuits, each defining a distinct embedding, and a classical gating network that learns how to weight these embeddings for each data point. We benchmark Soft-MoQE on three PCA-reduced tasks: MNIST parity, MNIST 10-class, and FashionMNIST. Soft-MoQE outperforms the single best expert, the uniform average of all experts and a linear baseline, achieving task-dependent performance comparable to that of a trainable quantum neural network, without optimizing any quantum parameter and with a quantum training cost that is lower by orders of magnitude. The analysis of the class- conditioned expert usage shows that the learned routing combines a few experts for each input, with a selection that depends on the class. These results support the learned routing among fixed quantum circuits as a trainability-aware design principle for hybrid QML.
zh_title: 混合量子-经典学习的软量子专家混合模型
translation: 量子机器学习（QML）作为一种构建难以用经典模型重现的特征表示的可能途径，引起了越来越多的兴趣。然而，基于可训练参数化量子电路的近期QML架构仍然受到有限硬件资源、噪声和严重的优化困难（如贫瘠高原）的影响。在这项工作中，我们提出了Soft-MoQE，一种软量子专家混合架构，它用输入依赖的固定量子特征映射的选择和组合取代了变分量子训练。该模型由一个异构的不可训练量子电路池组成，每个电路定义一个独特的嵌入，以及一个学习如何为每个数据点加权这些嵌入的经典门控网络。我们在三个PCA降维任务上对Soft-MoQE进行了基准测试：MNIST奇偶性、MNIST 10分类和FashionMNIST。Soft-MoQE优于单一最佳专家、所有专家的均匀平均值和线性基线，取得了与可训练量子神经网络相当的任务依赖性能，而无需优化任何量子参数，并且量子训练成本降低了几个数量级。对类别条件专家使用情况的分析表明，学习到的路由为每个输入组合了少数专家，选择取决于类别。这些结果支持将学习到的固定量子电路路由作为混合QML的一种可训练性感知设计原则。
tldr: Soft-MoQE是一种混合量子-经典学习架构，它通过经典网络选择和组合固定的量子特征映射，避免了量子参数优化，解决了近中期QML的训练难题，并取得了与可训练QNN相当的性能。
ai_comments: 这篇论文提出了一种新颖的混合量子-经典学习架构Soft-MoQE，通过将量子参数优化转移到经典门控网络，巧妙地规避了近期量子计算机面临的“贫瘠高原”等优化难题。其创新点在于利用固定的量子特征映射池和数据依赖的经典路由机制，显著降低了量子训练成本，并取得了与可训练模型相当的性能，为可训练性受限的QML提供了一个有前景的解决方案。
motivation: 近期量子机器学习(QML)架构受限于硬件资源、噪声和优化困难（如贫瘠高原），难以有效训练参数化量子电路。
method: 提出Soft-MoQE，一种软量子专家混合架构。它使用一个异构的不可训练量子电路池（每个定义一个独特的嵌入）和一个经典门控网络，该网络学习如何为每个数据点加权这些嵌入，从而实现输入依赖的固定量子特征映射的选择和组合，替代变分量子训练。
results: Soft-MoQE在MNIST奇偶性、MNIST 10分类和FashionMNIST三个PCA降维任务上优于单一最佳专家、所有专家的均匀平均值和线性基线。它实现了与可训练量子神经网络相当的任务依赖性能，且无需优化任何量子参数，量子训练成本降低了几个数量级。对类别条件专家使用情况的分析表明，学习到的路由为每个输入组合了少数专家，选择取决于类别。
conclusion: 学习到的固定量子电路路由支持了一种针对混合量子机器学习的可训练性感知设计原则。

title: 4D-TEMPO: Differentiable 4D-STEM ptychography via fast Physics Optimizers
authors: Ramani Duraiswami, Yichao Zhang
abstract: Electron ptychography recovers atomic structure from 4D-STEM data: diffraction patterns at multiple positions of a scanned probe. Current codes reconstruct an image and read atoms off it, or fit atoms under an $L_1$ loss; neither gives per-atom uncertainty. We propose 4D-TEMPO, a differentiable physical renderer that fits the atoms, the microscope, and the detector directly to the recorded electron counts under a Poisson likelihood. The output is a list of atoms, each a Gaussian primitive with a 3D position, a thermal width, and a model-conditional error bar from the Fisher information. The Fisher information also conditions the solver, gives the dose (electrons per Å$^2$) each parameter needs, and separates calibration from imaging. On a simulated WSe$_2$ bilayer, starting from the published reconstruction, fitted atoms cut in-plane error by a third (3.2 vs. 4.8 pm) and depth error by 40-61% against its 3D peaks. Depth comes from multiple scattering into the dark field, the faint counts outside the direct beam. The two layers, $10\times$ closer than the depth of field, separate; per-atom depth then follows the layer geometry. When the model is well specified, the bars are calibrated (69% of position coordinates within $1σ$). On experimental WSe$_2$, fitted atoms predict held-out patterns better than the three published codes we test. With free probe modes where atoms are incomplete, the same likelihood predicts best on all three held-out benchmarks, matches every WSe$_2$ baseline in 5 min against up to 20.5 h, and passes torchslice at its released setting 180$\times$ sooner on PrScO$_3$. Per-atom error bars, planned doses, and fast reconstruction point to low-dose, real-time 3D imaging of beam-sensitive and dynamic materials.
comment: 34 pages: 8-page paper, references, and 23-page supplementary material; 10 figures, 10 tables
zh_title: 4D-TEMPO：通过快速物理优化器实现可微分的4D-STEM叠层成像
translation: 电子叠层成像从4D-STEM数据中恢复原子结构：在扫描探针的多个位置获取衍射图案。当前的编码重建图像并从中读取原子，或在L1损失下拟合原子；两者都不能提供每个原子的不确定性。我们提出4D-TEMPO，一个可微分的物理渲染器，它在泊松似然下将原子、显微镜和探测器直接拟合到记录的电子计数。输出是一个原子列表，每个原子都是一个高斯基元，具有3D位置、热宽度和基于费舍尔信息的模型条件误差棒。费舍尔信息还调节求解器，给出每个参数所需的剂量（每Å$^2$的电子数），并分离校准和成像。在模拟WSe$_2$双层结构上，从已发布的重建开始，拟合原子将面内误差减少了三分之一（3.2 vs. 4.8 pm），深度误差减少了40-61%，优于其3D峰值。深度来自多重散射到暗场，即直接束外的微弱计数。两层（比景深近10倍）分离；每个原子的深度随后遵循层几何形状。当模型良好指定时，误差棒是经过校准的（69%的位置坐标在1σ内）。在实验WSe$_2$上，拟合原子比我们测试的三个已发布代码能更好地预测保留模式。在原子不完整的自由探针模式下，相同的似然在所有三个保留基准上预测最佳，在5分钟内匹配了所有WSe$_2$基线（相比之下，其他方法长达20.5小时），并在PrScO$_3$上以其发布的设置比torchslice快180倍。每个原子的误差棒、计划剂量和快速重建指向光束敏感和动态材料的低剂量、实时3D成像。
tldr: 4D-TEMPO是一种可微分的物理渲染器，直接将原子、显微镜和探测器拟合到4D-STEM数据中，提供每个原子的不确定性、更低的误差和更快的重建速度，有望实现低剂量、实时3D成像。
ai_comments: 4D-TEMPO的创新之处在于引入了可微分的物理渲染器和泊松似然，直接拟合物理参数并提供每个原子的不确定性。这解决了传统方法无法量化原子定位置信度的问题。其在精度和速度上的显著提升，尤其是在处理光束敏感和动态材料方面的潜力，使其成为一个重要的进展。通过将校准与成像分离以及剂量优化，也为更高效的实验设计提供了指导。
motivation: 目前的电子叠层成像代码在重建图像和拟合原子时无法提供每个原子的不确定性，且精度有待提高。
method: 提出4D-TEMPO，一个可微分的物理渲染器，它在泊松似然下将原子、显微镜和探测器直接拟合到记录的电子计数。它输出一个原子列表，每个原子都是一个高斯基元，具有3D位置、热宽度和基于费舍尔信息的模型条件误差棒。
results: 在模拟WSe$_2$双层结构上，拟合原子将面内误差减少了三分之一（3.2 vs. 4.8 pm），深度误差减少了40-61%。当模型良好指定时，误差棒是经过校准的（69%的位置坐标在1σ内）。在实验WSe$_2$上，拟合原子比现有代码能更好地预测保留模式。在原子不完整的自由探针模式下，4D-TEMPO在所有三个保留基准上预测最佳，在5分钟内匹配了所有WSe$_2$基线（相比之下，其他方法长达20.5小时），并在PrScO$_3$上比torchslice快180倍。
conclusion: 4D-TEMPO通过提供每个原子的误差棒、计划剂量和快速重建，为光束敏感和动态材料的低剂量、实时3D成像提供了可能性。

title: List packing for graphs with small arboricity
authors: Stijn Cambie, Wouter Cames van Batenburg, Xuding Zhu
abstract: We prove that every graph $G$ whose edge set is the union of $r$ forests has list packing number at most $2^r$. This means that for all $k\ge 2^r$ and every list-assignment $L$ with lists of size $k$, the graph $G$ admits $k$ disjoint proper $L$-colourings. While for large $r$ this bound is far from optimal, for $r\in\{1,2\}$ it is sharp. As a direct corollary of the case $r=2$, we obtain that every triangle-free planar graph has list packing number at most $4$, thus improving upon a result of Dvořák, Masařík, Musílek and Pangrác and providing the optimal answer to a question of Dvořák, Postle and Norin on (weighted) $ε$-flexibility of such graphs. As a corollary of the case $r=3$, we obtain a short alternative proof that every $K_5$-minor-free (and hence every planar) graph has list-packing number at most $8$, matching the state of the art. All results above also hold for the stronger notion of correspondence packing.
comment: 10 pages (of which 2 for the main proofs). v2: fixed typos
zh_title: 具有小树木性图的列表堆积
translation: 我们证明了每个边集是 $r$ 个森林并集的图 $G$，其列表堆积数至多为 $2^r$。这意味着对于所有 $k \ge 2^r$ 以及每个大小为 $k$ 的列表分配 $L$，图 $G$ 允许存在 $k$ 个不相交的适当 $L$-着色。虽然对于较大的 $r$，这个界限远非最优，但对于 $r \in \{1, 2\}$ 它是尖锐的。作为 $r=2$ 情况的一个直接推论，我们得到每个无三角平面图的列表堆积数至多为 4，从而改进了 Dvořák、Masařík、Musílek 和 Pangrác 的结果，并对 Dvořák、Postle 和 Norin 关于此类图的（加权）$\epsilon$-灵活性的问题给出了最优答案。作为 $r=3$ 情况的推论，我们得到了一个简短的替代证明，即每个无 $K_5$ 微子（从而每个平面）图的列表堆积数至多为 8，与目前最先进的成果相匹配。以上所有结果对于更强的 correspondence packing 概念也同样成立。
tldr: 本文证明了由 $r$ 个森林并集构成的图其列表堆积数至多为 $2^r$，并由此改进了无三角平面图和无 $K_5$ 微子图列表堆积数的已知结果。
ai_comments: 该论文在图论的列表堆积（list packing）领域取得了重要进展，特别是通过树木性（arboricity）给出了图的列表堆积数的统一上界，对无三角平面图以及无K5微子图的列表堆积数给出了最优或改进的解答。其创新性在于推导出适用于 correspondence packing 的更强结论。
motivation: 探讨树木性较小的图的列表堆积数（list packing number），旨在改善和推广图的列表堆积以及 $\epsilon$-灵活性（flexibility）领域现有的最优结果。
method: 通过证明边集是 $r$ 个森林并集的图的列表堆积数至多为 $2^r$ 的理论方法，推导出了适用于三角自由平面图、平面图和无 $K_5$ 微子图的具体上界。
results: 证明了任意森林并集数为 $r$ 的图的列表堆积数至多为 $2^r$；推导出无三角平面图的列表堆积数至多为 4，无 $K_5$ 微子图的列表堆积数至多为 8，且这些结果均可推广至 correspondence packing。
conclusion: 证明了边集可分解为 $r$ 个森林的图其列表堆积数至多为 $2^r$，该结论在 $r \in \{1, 2\}$ 时是最优的，并对平面图和无 $K_5$ 微子图的列表堆积数给出了重要推论。

title: A Java Math.BigDecimal Implementation of Core Mathematical Functions
authors: Richard J. Mathar
abstract: The mathematical functions log(x), exp(x), root[n]x, sin(x), cos(x), tan(x), arcsin(x), arctan(x), x^y, sinh(x), cosh(x), tanh(x) and Gamma(x) have been implemented for arguments x in the real domain in a native Java library on top of the multi-precision BigDecimal representation of floating point numbers. This supports scientific applications where more than the double precision accuracy of the library of the Standard Edition is desired. The full source code is made available under the LGPL v3.0.
comment: Version 5 includes a function to factorize integer polynomials and a fitting routine to detect P-recursive integer sequences
zh_title: 基于Java Math.BigDecimal的核心数学函数实现
translation: 在Java原生库中，基于多精度的BigDecimal浮点数表示，针对实数域内的参数x，实现了log(x)、exp(x)、root[n]x、sin(x)、cos(x)、 tan(x)、arcsin(x)、arctan(x)、x^y、sinh(x)、cosh(x)、tanh(x)和Gamma(x)等数学函数。这支持了那些需要高于标准版双精度库精度的科学应用。完整的源代码已在LGPL v3.0下开源。
tldr: 该论文使用Java的BigDecimal实现了一个高精度的核心数学函数库，旨在满足科学应用对超越双精度精度的需求并已开源。
ai_comments: 该工作填补了Java原生库在高精度科学计算方面的空白，基于BigDecimal实现了全面的核心数学函数，并开源供科学界使用，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 满足科学应用中对超越Java标准版双精度（double precision）精度限制的高精度计算需求。
method: 基于Java的多精度BigDecimal浮点数表示，原生实现了一系列核心数学函数。
results: 成功在Java中实现了一组包含对数、指数、根式、三角函数、反三角函数、双曲函数及Gamma函数在内的多精度数学函数库，并以LGPL v3.0协议开源。
conclusion: 成功实现了一套基于Java BigDecimal的多精度核心数学函数库，并开源发布。

title: Decomposing SGD Dynamics in Neural Networks: Teacher-Induced Spikes and Variance Inflation
authors: Samet Demir, Zafer Dogan
abstract: We study two-layer neural networks trained by stochastic gradient descent (SGD) on a multi-index teacher model, focusing on how first-layer parameters orthogonal to the teacher subspace affect generalization. We decompose the first-layer weights into a signal component aligned with the teacher and an orthogonal complement, and analyze their joint SGD dynamics together with the second layer in the proportional limit. We show that although SGD updates to the complement are initially isotropic, the training dynamics induce teacher-dependent spectral spikes in the complement Gram matrix. This emergent anisotropy provides a concrete mechanism by which representation variance is amplified, and generalization degrades. To isolate this effect, we introduce Decomposed Dynamics, an analytically tractable surrogate whose asymptotic test-error dynamics coincide with those of SGD. In simulations with a ReLU student, freezing the directions of the orthogonal complement improves generalization relative to training them. Finally, we show that the signal component rapidly aligns with the second-layer weights, revealing strong cross-layer coupling even in this shallow setting. Together, our results provide a dynamical explanation for how feature learning outside the teacher subspace harms generalization.
zh_title: 分解神经网络中的SGD动力学：教师诱导的尖峰与方差膨胀
translation: 我们研究了在多指标教师模型上由随机梯度下降（SGD）训练的两层神经网络，重点关注第一层中与教师子空间正交的参数如何影响泛化。我们将第一层权重分解为与教师对齐的信号分量和正交补，并在比例极限下分析它们与第二层的联合SGD动力学。我们表明，尽管对正交补的SGD更新最初是各向同性的，但训练动力学会诱导正交补Gram矩阵中出现教师依赖的谱尖峰。这种突现的各向异性提供了一个具体的机制，通过该机制表征方差被放大，泛化能力下降。为了隔离这种效应，我们引入了分解动力学（Decomposed Dynamics），这是一种渐近测试误差动力学与SGD一致的解析易处理代理。在具有ReLU学生的模拟中，相对于训练正交补，冻结正交补的方向可以改善泛化。最后，我们表明信号分量与第二层权重迅速对齐，揭示了即使在这个浅层设置中也存在强烈的跨层耦合。总之，我们的结果为教师子空间之外的特征学习如何损害泛化提供了一个动力学解释。
tldr: 本文通过分解SGD动力学，揭示了神经网络在教师子空间之外进行特征学习如何导致方差膨胀并损害泛化能力。
ai_comments: 该论文从理论和动力学角度深入探讨了神经网络中SGD训练过程中的泛化退化现象，特别是教师子空间外正交分量的影响，具有较强的理论价值和创新性。
motivation: 研究两层神经网络在多指标教师模型上通过随机梯度下降（SGD）训练时，第一层中与教师子空间正交的参数如何影响泛化能力，并揭示表征方差放大和泛化降级的具体机制。
method: 将第一层权重分解为与教师对齐的信号分量和正交补，在比例极限下分析它们与第二层的联合SGD动力学，并引入了解析易处理的代理模型（Decomposed Dynamics）。
results: 证明了SGD更新虽初始各向同性，但动力学会诱导正交补Gram矩阵中出现教师依赖的谱尖峰（Spikes）；引入的Decomposed Dynamics其渐近测试误差与SGD一致；ReLU学生模型的实验表明冻结正交补的方向能提高泛化能力；发现信号分量与第二层权重快速对齐。
conclusion: 本文提供了一个关于教师子空间之外特征学习如何损害泛化能力的动态解释，并指出了通过控制正交分量来提升泛化性能的途径。

title: Coherence boosting: When your pretrained language model is not paying enough attention
authors: Esmeralda S. Whitammer, Zhen Wang, Nebojsa Jojic
abstract: Long-range semantic coherence remains a challenge in automatic language generation and understanding. We demonstrate that large language models have insufficiently learned the effect of distant words on next-token prediction. We present coherence boosting, an inference procedure that increases a LM's focus on a long context. We show the benefits of coherence boosting with pretrained models by distributional analyses of generated ordinary text and dialog responses. It is also found that coherence boosting with state-of-the-art models for various zero-shot NLP tasks yields performance gains with no additional training.
zh_title: 相干性提升：当你的预训练语言模型关注度不够时
translation: 长距离语义相干性仍然是自动语言生成和理解中的一个挑战。我们证明了大型语言模型对远距离词汇对下一个词预测的影响学习得不够充分。我们提出了相干性提升（coherence boosting），这是一种增加语言模型对长上下文关注的推理程序。通过对生成的普通文本和对话回复进行分布分析，我们展示了相干性提升对预训练模型的益处。研究还发现，将相干性提升应用于各种零样本NLP任务的最先进模型中，可以在无需额外训练的情况下带来性能提升。
tldr: 提出了一种名为“相干性提升”的无需训练推理方法，通过增强语言模型对远距离上下文的关注，显著改善了长文本生成与零样本NLP任务的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种简单且无需训练的推理增强方法（Coherence boosting），有效解决了预训练语言模型在处理长文本时对远距离词汇关注不足的问题，对提升生成质量和零样本任务性能具有重要意义。
motivation: 长距离语义相干性在自动语言生成和理解中依然是一个挑战，且大型语言模型对远距离词汇对下一个词预测的影响学习得不够充分。
method: 提出了一种名为“相干性提升”（coherence boosting）的推理阶段处理程序，旨在增加语言模型对长上下文的关注。
results: 通过对生成的普通文本和对话回复进行分布分析，证明了相干性提升对预训练模型的益处；同时，将其应用于最先进模型的各种零样本NLP任务中，在无需额外训练的情况下实现了性能提升。
conclusion: 通过增加语言模型对长上下文的关注度，相干性提升（Coherence boosting）方法在无需额外训练的情况下，显著改善了长文本生成质量并提升了零样本NLP任务的性能。

title: Consistent interfacial flow numerics - Part II: The momentum convection term
authors: Johan Roenby
abstract: The two-phase Volume-of-Fluid solvers of OpenFOAM overpredict the horizontal water velocity near the crest of a water wave, and the error grows as the wave propagates. Part I of this series removed the spurious air velocities caused by the gravity term but left this error unchanged. Here we show that it is caused by the momentum convection term. Its mass flux is computed in the interface advection step from the velocity at the start of the time step, whereas the convected velocity is taken at the end of the step, because convection is discretised implicitly. In a progressive wave, where the horizontal and vertical velocities are 90 degrees out of phase, this time lag produces an upward flux of horizontal momentum, proportional to the time step, which accumulates in a spurious current near the surface. The same mismatch makes the response to a force depend on the density at the wrong time level. Explicit convection removes the lag and makes the response consistent with the gravity force, but requires the convected face velocity at the interface to be taken from the upwind cell. Only then is the new velocity of a cell a weighted average of old velocities, whatever the density ratio. We demonstrate both requirements with prescribed flows and with the full solver. For a progressive wave, explicit convection with upwind face velocities at the interface reduces the overprediction of the crest velocity from 26-31 % to within 1 % and removes the near-surface current. The resulting solver, fluxinator, is meant for maximum Courant numbers of 0.1 and below, where it keeps the wave height within 1.5 % over 15 periods on meshes with six or more cells per wave height. Because the spurious velocities that limit the time step are removed, it needs 34-42 % less wall-clock time than interFoam for the tested wave.
comment: 22 pages, 15 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/isoAdvector/fluxinator v2: arXiv reference of the companion paper added
zh_title: 一致的界面流数值计算 - 第二部分：动量对流项
translation: OpenFOAM 的两相流体积函数 (Volume-of-Fluid) 求解器会过高预测水波波峰附近的水平水速，且误差随波浪传播而增大。本系列的第一部分消除了由重力项引起的虚假空气速度，但此误差仍未改变。本文表明，该误差是由动量对流项引起的。其质量通量在界面对流步骤中从时间步开始时的速度计算，而对流速度则取自时间步结束时，因为对流是隐式离散的。在行波中，水平速度和垂直速度相位相差90度，这种时间滞后会产生一个与时间步长成比例的向上水平动量通量，并在表面附近积聚成虚假电流。同样的失配使得对力的响应取决于错误时间层上的密度。显式对流消除了滞后，并使响应与重力一致，但要求界面处的对流面速度取自迎风单元。只有这样，无论密度比如何，单元的新速度才是旧速度的加权平均值。我们通过预设流和完整求解器演示了这两个要求。对于行波，采用界面迎风面速度的显式对流将波峰速度的过预测从26-31%降低到1%以内，并消除了近地表电流。由此产生的求解器 fluxinator 适用于最大库朗数0.1及以下的情况，在每个波高有六个或更多单元的网格上，它能在15个周期内将波高保持在1.5%以内。由于消除了限制时间步长的虚假速度，对于测试的波浪，它比 interFoam 节省了34-42%的实际运行时间。
tldr: OpenFOAM双相流求解器在波浪模拟中存在速度过预测问题，本文通过改进动量对流项的数值离散方式，显著提高了模拟精度和效率。
ai_comments: 本文通过细致地识别并解决了OpenFOAM广泛使用的两相流求解器中一个长期存在的数值不准确问题，做出了重要贡献。对动量对流项中时间滞后问题的详细解释以及所提出的显式对流与迎风面速度的结合，展现了对界面流数值方法的深刻理解。由此产生的'fluxinator'求解器在精度和效率方面表现出显著改进，使其成为模拟行波和类似两相现象的宝贵工具。其创新之处在于通过改进基础数值方案实现了实际且有影响力的结果。
motivation: OpenFOAM的两相流体积函数(Volume-of-Fluid)求解器过高预测水波波峰附近的水平水速，且误差随波浪传播而增大。本系列的第一部分未能解决此问题。
method: 本文研究发现误差是由动量对流项的时间滞后引起的，具体表现为质量通量在时间步开始时计算，而对流速度在时间步结束时取用。为解决此问题，提出采用显式对流，并要求界面处的对流面速度取自迎风单元，以消除时间滞后并确保对力的响应与重力一致。
results: 采用界面迎风面速度的显式对流将波峰速度的过预测从26-31%降低到1%以内，并消除了近地表电流。由此产生的求解器fluxinator在最大库朗数0.1及以下时，能在15个周期内将波高保持在1.5%以内，且比interFoam节省34-42%的实际运行时间。
conclusion: 通过对动量对流项采用显式对流并结合迎风面速度，可以有效解决OpenFOAM双相流求解器在波浪模拟中的速度过预测问题，显著提高模拟精度和计算效率。

title: Coarse-to-Fine Sparse Transformer for Hyperspectral Image Reconstruction
authors: Yuanhao Cai, Jing Lin, Xiaowan Hu, Haoqian Wang, Xin Yuan, Yulun Zhang, Radu Timofte, Luc Van Gool
abstract: Many algorithms have been developed to solve the inverse problem of coded aperture snapshot spectral imaging (CASSI), i.e., recovering the 3D hyperspectral images (HSIs) from a 2D compressive measurement. In recent years, learning-based methods have demonstrated promising performance and dominated the mainstream research direction. However, existing CNN-based methods show limitations in capturing long-range dependencies and non-local self-similarity. Previous Transformer-based methods densely sample tokens, some of which are uninformative, and calculate the multi-head self-attention (MSA) between some tokens that are unrelated in content. This does not fit the spatially sparse nature of HSI signals and limits the model scalability. In this paper, we propose a novel Transformer-based method, coarse-to-fine sparse Transformer (CST), firstly embedding HSI sparsity into deep learning for HSI reconstruction. In particular, CST uses our proposed spectra-aware screening mechanism (SASM) for coarse patch selecting. Then the selected patches are fed into our customized spectra-aggregation hashing multi-head self-attention (SAH-MSA) for fine pixel clustering and self-similarity capturing. Comprehensive experiments show that our CST significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods while requiring cheaper computational costs. The code and models will be released at https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/MST . An online Gradio demo is available at https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/MST
zh_title: 用于高光谱图像重建的粗到细稀疏Transformer
translation: 许多算法已被开发用于解决编码孔径快照光谱成像（CASSI）的逆问题，即从2D压缩测量中恢复3D高光谱图像（HSIs）。近年来，基于学习的方法展示了有希望的性能，并主导了主流研究方向。然而，现有的基于CNN的方法在捕获长距离依赖和非局部自相似性方面显示出局限性。之前的基于Transformer的方法密集采样令牌，其中一些是无信息的，并且在内容不相关的令牌之间计算多头自注意力（MSA）。这不符合HSI信号的空间稀疏性质，并限制了模型的可扩展性。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于Transformer的方法——粗到细稀疏Transformer（CST），首次将HSI稀疏性嵌入到深度学习中进行HSI重建。具体来说，CST使用我们提出的光谱感知筛选机制（SASM）进行粗略的块选择。然后，将选定的块输入到我们定制的光谱聚合哈希多头自注意力（SAH-MSA）中，用于精细的像素聚类和自相似性捕获。综合实验表明，我们的CST显著优于现有最先进的方法，同时需要更低的计算成本。代码和模型将发布在https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/MST。在线Gradio演示可在https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/MST上找到。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CST的粗到细稀疏Transformer，通过嵌入高光谱图像的稀疏性，解决了现有CNN和Transformer方法在捕获长距离依赖和处理无信息令牌方面的局限性，实现了更优的性能和更低的计算成本。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于首次将高光谱图像的空间稀疏性与Transformer模型相结合，通过提出光谱感知筛选机制和光谱聚合哈希多头自注意力，有效地解决了现有方法在捕获长距离依赖和处理无信息令牌方面的局限性。其粗到细的处理策略不仅提升了重建性能，还降低了计算成本，对高光谱图像重建领域具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的基于CNN的方法在捕获长距离依赖和非局部自相似性方面存在局限性。而之前的基于Transformer的方法则存在密集采样无信息令牌、在内容不相关的令牌之间计算多头自注意力，这不符合高光谱图像信号的空间稀疏性，并限制了模型的可扩展性。
method: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于Transformer的方法——粗到细稀疏Transformer（CST），首次将高光谱图像的稀疏性嵌入到深度学习中进行高光谱图像重建。具体来说，CST利用所提出的光谱感知筛选机制（SASM）进行粗略的块选择。然后，将选定的块输入到定制的光谱聚合哈希多头自注意力（SAH-MSA）中，用于精细的像素聚类和自相似性捕获。
results: 综合实验表明，我们提出的CST显著优于现有最先进的方法，同时计算成本更低。
conclusion: CST通过有效处理高光谱图像的稀疏性，在性能和计算效率上均超越了现有方法，为高光谱图像重建提供了一个更优的解决方案。

title: ThinkSum: Probabilistic reasoning over sets using large language models
authors: Batu Ozturkler, Esmeralda S. Whitammer, Zhen Wang, Nebojsa Jojic
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have a substantial capacity for high-level analogical reasoning: reproducing patterns in linear text that occur in their training data (zero-shot evaluation) or in the provided context (few-shot in-context learning). However, recent studies show that even the more advanced LLMs fail in scenarios that require reasoning over multiple objects or facts and making sequences of logical deductions. We propose a two-stage probabilistic inference paradigm, ThinkSum, which reasons over sets of objects or facts in a structured manner. In the first stage (Think - retrieval of associations), a LLM is queried in parallel over a set of phrases extracted from the prompt or an auxiliary model call. In the second stage (Sum - probabilistic inference or reasoning), the results of these queries are aggregated to make the final prediction. We demonstrate the possibilities and advantages of ThinkSum on the BIG-bench suite of LLM evaluation tasks, achieving improvements over the state of the art using GPT-family models on thirteen difficult tasks, often with far smaller model variants. We also compare and contrast ThinkSum with other proposed modifications to direct prompting of LLMs, such as variants of chain-of-thought prompting. Our results suggest that because the probabilistic inference in ThinkSum is performed outside of calls to the LLM, ThinkSum is less sensitive to prompt design, yields more interpretable predictions, and can be flexibly combined with latent variable models to extract structured knowledge from LLMs. Overall, our proposed paradigm represents a promising approach for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs.
zh_title: ThinkSum：使用大型语言模型进行集合上的概率推理
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）具有强大的高级类比推理能力：能够重现其训练数据中（零样本评估）或提供的上下文中（少样本上下文学习）出现的线性文本模式。然而，最近的研究表明，即使是更先进的LLMs在需要对多个对象或事实进行推理并进行一系列逻辑推导的场景中也会失败。我们提出了一个两阶段的概率推理范式——ThinkSum，它以结构化的方式对对象或事实集进行推理。在第一阶段（思考 - 关联检索），LLM被并行查询，查询对象是来自提示或辅助模型调用中提取的一组短语。在第二阶段（求和 - 概率推理或推导），这些查询的结果被聚合以做出最终预测。我们展示了ThinkSum在LLM评估任务的BIG-bench套件上的可能性和优势，在使用GPT家族模型在十三个困难任务上取得了超越现有技术水平的改进，通常使用远小于SOTA的模型变体。我们还将ThinkSum与直接提示LLM的其他提议修改（例如思维链提示的变体）进行了比较和对比。我们的结果表明，由于ThinkSum中的概率推理是在对LLM的调用之外执行的，因此ThinkSum对提示设计不敏感，产生更可解释的预测，并且可以灵活地与潜在变量模型结合以从LLM中提取结构化知识。总的来说，我们提出的范式代表了一种增强LLMs推理能力的有前景的方法。
tldr: ThinkSum是一个两阶段的概率推理范式，通过并行查询和聚合结果来提高LLM在集合推理任务上的表现，并在BIG-bench上取得了SOTA结果。
ai_comments: ThinkSum的创新之处在于将复杂的推理过程分解为LLM外部的两个阶段，利用LLM进行并行信息检索，再通过独立的概率推理模块进行聚合。这种设计避免了LLM在长序列逻辑推导中的弱点，并且提高了模型的可解释性和鲁棒性。其在多个任务上超越SOTA，且能使用更小模型，表明了其效率和有效性。
motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在需要对多个对象或事实进行推理以及进行一系列逻辑推导的场景中表现不佳。
method: 提出ThinkSum，一个两阶段的概率推理范式。第一阶段（Think - 关联检索）并行查询LLM，获取从提示或辅助模型调用中提取的短语集。第二阶段（Sum - 概率推理或推导）聚合这些查询结果以做出最终预测。
results: 在BIG-bench套件的13个困难任务上，使用GPT家族模型取得了优于SOTA的改进，且通常使用更小的模型变体。ThinkSum对提示设计不敏感，产生更可解释的预测，并且可以灵活地与潜在变量模型结合以从LLM中提取结构化知识。
conclusion: ThinkSum代表了一种增强LLMs推理能力的有前景的方法。

title: MST++: Multi-stage Spectral-wise Transformer for Efficient Spectral Reconstruction
authors: Yuanhao Cai, Jing Lin, Zudi Lin, Haoqian Wang, Yulun Zhang, Hanspeter Pfister, Radu Timofte, Luc Van Gool
abstract: Existing leading methods for spectral reconstruction (SR) focus on designing deeper or wider convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to learn the end-to-end mapping from the RGB image to its hyperspectral image (HSI). These CNN-based methods achieve impressive restoration performance while showing limitations in capturing the long-range dependencies and self-similarity prior. To cope with this problem, we propose a novel Transformer-based method, Multi-stage Spectral-wise Transformer (MST++), for efficient spectral reconstruction. In particular, we employ Spectral-wise Multi-head Self-attention (S-MSA) that is based on the HSI spatially sparse while spectrally self-similar nature to compose the basic unit, Spectral-wise Attention Block (SAB). Then SABs build up Single-stage Spectral-wise Transformer (SST) that exploits a U-shaped structure to extract multi-resolution contextual information. Finally, our MST++, cascaded by several SSTs, progressively improves the reconstruction quality from coarse to fine.
