Comprehensive experiments show that our MST++ significantly outperforms other state-of-the-art methods. In the NTIRE 2022 Spectral Reconstruction Challenge, our approach won the First place. Code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/MST-plus-plus . An online Gradio demo is available on HuggingFace at https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/MST-plus-plus
comment: Winner of NTIRE 2022 Challenge on Spectral Reconstruction from RGB; The First Transformer-based Method for Spectral Reconstruction
zh_title: MST++：用于高效光谱重建的多阶段谱向Transformer
translation: 现有领先的光谱重建 (SR) 方法侧重于设计更深或更宽的卷积神经网络 (CNN) 来学习从RGB图像到高光谱图像 (HSI) 的端到端映射。这些基于CNN的方法在实现令人印象深刻的恢复性能的同时，在捕获长距离依赖和自相似性先验方面表现出局限性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的基于Transformer的方法，即多阶段谱向Transformer (MST++)，用于高效光谱重建。特别是，我们采用基于HSI空间稀疏而谱向自相似性特性的Spectral-wise Multi-head Self-attention (S-MSA) 来组成基本单元Spectral-wise Attention Block (SAB)。然后SABs构建了利用U形结构提取多分辨率上下文信息的单阶段谱向Transformer (SST)。最后，我们的MST++通过级联多个SST，逐步从粗到精地提高重建质量。综合实验表明，我们的MST++显著优于其他最先进的方法。在NTIRE 2022光谱重建挑战赛中，我们的方法获得了第一名。代码和预训练模型可在https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/MST-plus-plus 公开获取。HuggingFace上提供了在线Gradio演示：https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/MST-plus-plus。
tldr: MST++是一种基于Transformer的新型光谱重建方法，通过S-MSA、SAB和U形SST结构，并级联多个SST以从粗到精地逐步提高重建质量，显著优于现有SOTA方法，并在NTIRE 2022光谱重建挑战赛中获得第一名。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将Transformer架构应用于光谱重建领域，并通过S-MSA利用了高光谱图像在空间上的稀疏性和谱向上的自相似性，有效解决了CNN在长距离依赖捕获上的不足。其多阶段级联SST的设计也体现了从粗到精逐步优化的思想，是其取得优异性能的关键。在NTIRE 2022挑战赛中夺冠，进一步证明了其方法的有效性和先进性。
motivation: 现有的光谱重建方法（基于CNN）虽然性能良好，但在捕获长距离依赖和自相似性先验方面存在局限性。
method: 提出了一种新颖的基于Transformer的方法——多阶段谱向Transformer (MST++)。它采用基于HSI空间稀疏而谱向自相似性的Spectral-wise Multi-head Self-attention (S-MSA) 来构建基本单元Spectral-wise Attention Block (SAB)。SABs进一步构建了利用U形结构提取多分辨率上下文信息的单阶段谱向Transformer (SST)。最后，MST++通过级联多个SST，逐步从粗到精地提高重建质量。
results: MST++显著优于其他最先进的方法。在NTIRE 2022光谱重建挑战赛中，该方法获得了第一名。
conclusion: MST++通过其多阶段谱向Transformer架构，有效解决了现有方法的局限性，实现了高效且卓越的光谱重建性能。

title: Retinexformer: One-stage Retinex-based Transformer for Low-light Image Enhancement
authors: Yuanhao Cai, Hao Bian, Jing Lin, Haoqian Wang, Radu Timofte, Yulun Zhang
abstract: When enhancing low-light images, many deep learning algorithms are based on the Retinex theory. However, the Retinex model does not consider the corruptions hidden in the dark or introduced by the light-up process. Besides, these methods usually require a tedious multi-stage training pipeline and rely on convolutional neural networks, showing limitations in capturing long-range dependencies. In this paper, we formulate a simple yet principled One-stage Retinex-based Framework (ORF). ORF first estimates the illumination information to light up the low-light image and then restores the corruption to produce the enhanced image. We design an Illumination-Guided Transformer (IGT) that utilizes illumination representations to direct the modeling of non-local interactions of regions with different lighting conditions. By plugging IGT into ORF, we obtain our algorithm, Retinexformer. Comprehensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our Retinexformer significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on thirteen benchmarks. The user study and application on low-light object detection also reveal the latent practical values of our method. Code, models, and results are available at https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/Retinexformer . An online Gradio demo is available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/Retinexformer
comment: ICCV 2023 top-10 most cited; NTIRE 2024-2026 winning solutions; The first Transformer-based method for low-light image enhancement
zh_title: Retinexformer：基于Retinex的一阶段Transformer低光图像增强
translation: 当增强低光图像时，许多深度学习算法都基于Retinex理论。然而，Retinex模型没有考虑隐藏在黑暗中或由提亮过程引入的损坏。此外，这些方法通常需要繁琐的多阶段训练管道，并且依赖于卷积神经网络，在捕获长距离依赖方面表现出局限性。在本文中，我们提出了一个简单而有原则的一阶段Retinex框架（ORF）。ORF首先估计光照信息以提亮低光图像，然后恢复损坏以生成增强图像。我们设计了一个光照引导Transformer（IGT），它利用光照表示来指导不同光照条件下区域非局部交互的建模。通过将IGT插入ORF中，我们得到了我们的算法Retinexformer。全面的定量和定性实验表明，我们的Retinexformer在十三个基准测试上显著优于最先进的方法。用户研究和在低光目标检测上的应用也揭示了我们方法的潜在实用价值。代码、模型和结果可在https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/Retinexformer 获取。在线Gradio演示可在Hugging Face上获取：https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/Retinexformer。
tldr: Retinexformer提出一个一阶段基于Retinex的Transformer框架，用于低光图像增强，解决了现有方法的局限性并取得了SOTA性能。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过结合Retinex理论和Transformer的优势，提出了一阶段的Retinexformer，有效解决了传统Retinex方法忽略图像损坏以及CNN在捕获长距离依赖方面的局限性。其创新点在于引入了光照引导Transformer（IGT）来处理非局部交互，并实现了端到端的一阶段训练，简化了流程并提升了性能。在多个基准测试上超越SOTA，并展示了在低光目标检测中的实用性，显示了其重要性。
motivation: 现有深度学习算法在低光图像增强中基于Retinex理论，但忽略了暗区隐藏的或提亮过程中引入的损坏，且通常需要繁琐的多阶段训练管道，并依赖CNN，在捕获长距离依赖方面存在局限性。
method: 提出一个简单而有原则的一阶段Retinex框架（ORF），首先估计光照信息以提亮低光图像，然后恢复损坏以生成增强图像。设计了一个光照引导Transformer（IGT），利用光照表示来指导不同光照条件下区域非局部交互的建模。将IGT集成到ORF中形成Retinexformer。
results: Retinexformer在十三个基准测试上显著优于最先进的方法，并在用户研究和低光目标检测应用中展现了潜在的实用价值。
conclusion: Retinexformer通过其一阶段Retinex框架和光照引导Transformer，有效解决了低光图像增强中的挑战，并取得了卓越的性能和实际应用潜力。

title: Loss-Controlling Calibration with Asymptotic Guarantees
authors: Di Wang, Yujin Li, Junzhi Shi, Pingping Wang, Shuo Zhuang, Hongyue Li
abstract: We propose a learning framework for calibrating predictive models to perform loss-controlling prediction, which extends our proposed conformal loss-controlling prediction framework to more general settings. In contrast to existing methods, the predictors built by the proposed approach are not restricted to set-valued predictors, and the loss function can be any measurable function without requiring monotonicity assumptions. The approach is a natural extension of conformal loss-controlling prediction, since it reduces to the latter when the predictors are set-valued with the nesting property and the losses are monotone. The loss-controlling guarantee of the proposed framework is established in the asymptotic setting and is empirically verified in selective regression and high-impact weather forecasting, demonstrating its effectiveness for the domains requiring general loss-controlling prediction.
zh_title: 具有渐近保证的损失控制校准
translation: 我们提出了一个学习框架，用于校准预测模型以执行损失控制预测，该框架将我们提出的保形损失控制预测框架扩展到更通用的设置。与现有方法不同，所提出方法构建的预测器不限于集合值预测器，并且损失函数可以是任何可测函数，无需单调性假设。该方法是保形损失控制预测的自然延伸，因为它在预测器是具有嵌套属性的集合值预测器且损失是单调的情况下，可简化为后者。所提出框架的损失控制保证在渐近设置中建立，并在选择性回归和高影响天气预报中得到经验验证，证明了其在需要通用损失控制预测的领域中的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一个用于校准预测模型的学习框架，以实现损失控制预测，该框架扩展了现有的一致性损失控制预测框架，支持更通用的设置，不限于集合值预测器，并且损失函数可以是任何可测函数，无需单调性假设。该框架在渐近设置下提供了损失控制保证，并在选择性回归和高影响天气预报中得到了实证验证。
ai_comments: 这项工作的主要创新在于其通用性，它通过放宽对预测器类型和损失函数特性的限制，显著扩展了损失控制预测的适用范围。渐近保证的建立以及在实际应用中的验证增强了其理论和实践价值。这对于需要严格控制预测损失（如高风险决策）的领域具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的损失控制预测方法通常将预测器限制为集合值预测器，并且对损失函数有单调性假设。本文的动机是开发一个更通用的框架，能够处理更广泛的预测器类型和损失函数，而无需这些限制。
method: 本文提出了一个学习框架，用于校准预测模型以进行损失控制预测。该方法是现有保形损失控制预测框架的扩展，不限制预测器为集合值预测器，并且损失函数可以是任何可测函数，无需单调性假设。它在预测器是具有嵌套属性的集合值预测器且损失是单调的情况下，可简化为保形损失控制预测。
results: 该框架在渐近设置下建立了损失控制保证，并在选择性回归和高影响天气预报中得到了经验验证，证明了其在需要通用损失控制预测的领域中的有效性。
conclusion: 本文提出的损失控制校准框架扩展了现有的保形损失控制预测，提供了更通用的设置，能够处理非集合值预测器和非单调损失函数，并在渐近设置下提供损失控制保证，在实际应用中表现出有效性。

title: Binarized Spectral Compressive Imaging
authors: Yuanhao Cai, Yuxin Zheng, Jing Lin, Xin Yuan, Yulun Zhang, Haoqian Wang
abstract: Existing deep learning models for hyperspectral image (HSI) reconstruction achieve good performance but require powerful hardwares with enormous memory and computational resources. Consequently, these methods can hardly be deployed on resource-limited mobile devices. In this paper, we propose a novel method, Binarized Spectral-Redistribution Network (BiSRNet), for efficient and practical HSI restoration from compressed measurement in snapshot compressive imaging (SCI) systems. Firstly, we redesign a compact and easy-to-deploy base model to be binarized. Then we present the basic unit, Binarized Spectral-Redistribution Convolution (BiSR-Conv). BiSR-Conv can adaptively redistribute the HSI representations before binarizing activation and uses a scalable hyperbolic tangent function to closer approximate the Sign function in backpropagation. Based on our BiSR-Conv, we customize four binarized convolutional modules to address the dimension mismatch and propagate full-precision information throughout the whole network. Finally, our BiSRNet is derived by using the proposed techniques to binarize the base model. Comprehensive quantitative and qualitative experiments manifest that our proposed BiSRNet outperforms state-of-the-art binarization methods and achieves comparable performance with full-precision algorithms. Code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/BiSCI and https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/MST . An online Gradio demo is available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/MST
comment: NeurIPS 2023; The first work to study binarized spectral compressive imaging reconstruction problem
translation: 现有的高光谱图像（HSI）重建深度学习模型表现良好，但需要强大的硬件、巨大的内存和计算资源。因此，这些方法很难部署在资源有限的移动设备上。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，即二值化光谱再分配网络（BiSRNet），用于在快照压缩成像（SCI）系统中从压缩测量中高效实用地恢复HSI。首先，我们重新设计了一个紧凑且易于部署的基础模型以进行二值化。然后，我们提出了基本单元——二值化光谱再分配卷积（BiSR-Conv）。BiSR-Conv可以在激活二值化之前自适应地再分配HSI表示，并使用可伸伸缩的双曲正切函数来更接近地近似反向传播中的符号函数。基于我们的BiSR-Conv，我们定制了四个二值化卷积模块，以解决维度不匹配问题并在整个网络中传播全精度信息。最后，我们的BiSRNet通过使用所提出的技术来二值化基础模型而得到。全面的定量和定性实验表明，我们提出的BiSRNet优于最先进的二值化方法，并与全精度算法实现了可比的性能。代码和模型可在https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/BiSCI和https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/MST公开获取。在线Gradio演示可在Hugging Face上获取：https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/MST
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为BiSRNet的新型二值化深度学习模型，用于高效地从压缩测量中恢复高光谱图像，使其适用于资源受限的移动设备，并在性能上超越了现有二值化方法。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了BiSRNet，通过二值化技术显著降低了高光谱图像重建模型的计算和内存需求，使其能部署在移动设备上。BiSR-Conv的设计，特别是自适应光谱再分配和可伸缩双曲正切函数对符号函数的近似，是其成功的关键。这项工作对于推动高光谱成像技术在边缘设备上的应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的高光谱图像（HSI）重建深度学习模型需要强大的硬件、巨大的内存和计算资源，这使得它们难以部署在资源有限的移动设备上。
method: 本文提出了一种名为二值化光谱再分配网络（BiSRNet）的新方法。首先，设计了一个紧凑且易于部署的二值化基础模型。然后，提出了基本单元——二值化光谱再分配卷积（BiSR-Conv），它能在激活二值化之前自适应地再分配HSI表示，并使用可伸缩的双曲正切函数来近似反向传播中的符号函数。基于BiSR-Conv，定制了四个二值化卷积模块来解决维度不匹配问题，并在整个网络中传播全精度信息。最终，BiSRNet通过将上述技术应用于二值化基础模型而得到。
results: 全面的定量和定性实验表明，所提出的BiSRNet优于最先进的二值化方法，并与全精度算法实现了可比的性能。
conclusion: 本文提出的BiSRNet能够有效解决现有高光谱图像重建深度学习模型对硬件资源要求高的问题，通过二值化技术实现了高效且实用的高光谱图像恢复，使其能在资源受限设备上部署，同时保持了与全精度算法相当的性能。

title: Human-AI Interactions and Societal Pitfalls
authors: Francisco Castro, Jian Gao, Sébastien Martin
abstract: When working with generative artificial intelligence (AI), users may see productivity gains, but the AI-generated content may not match their preferences exactly. To study this effect, we introduce a Bayesian framework in which heterogeneous users choose how much information to share with the AI, facing a trade-off between output fidelity and communication cost. We show that the interplay between these individual-level decisions and AI training may lead to societal challenges. Outputs may become more homogenized, especially when the AI is trained on AI-generated content, potentially triggering a homogenization death spiral. And any AI bias may propagate to become societal bias. A solution to the homogenization and bias issues is to reduce human-AI interaction frictions and enable users to flexibly share information, leading to personalized outputs without sacrificing productivity.
translation: 当与生成式人工智能（AI）合作时，用户可能会看到生产力的提升，但AI生成的内容可能无法完全符合他们的偏好。为了研究这种效应，我们引入了一个贝叶斯框架，其中异质性用户选择向AI分享多少信息，面临着输出保真度和沟通成本之间的权衡。我们表明，个人层面的决策与AI训练之间的相互作用可能会导致社会挑战。输出可能会变得更加同质化，特别是当AI使用AI生成的内容进行训练时，可能会引发同质化死亡螺旋。并且任何AI偏见都可能传播并成为社会偏见。解决同质化和偏见问题的一个方案是减少人机交互摩擦，使能够灵活地共享信息，从而在不牺牲生产力的前提下实现个性化输出。
tldr: 论文通过理论框架揭示了生成式AI可能引发的内容同质化与偏见传播问题，并指出降低交互摩擦是解决之道。
ai_comments: 本文通过一个贝叶斯框架理论化地探讨了人机交互与生成式AI对社会层面的负面影响（如内容同质化和偏见放大），视角独特，模型对理解AI生态发展具有重要警示意义。
motivation: 研究当用户与生成式AI协作时，尽管能带来生产力的提升，但AI生成的内容可能无法完全符合用户偏好这一现象，并探究个体决策与AI训练交互所引发的社会挑战。
method: 引入了一个贝叶斯框架，在该框架中，异质性用户在输出保真度和沟通成本之间进行权衡，并研究了个人决策与AI训练之间的相互作用。
results: 研究表明，个体决策与AI训练的交织会导致输出内容同质化（特别是在使用AI生成内容进行训练时可能触发“同质化死亡螺旋”），并且任何AI偏见都可能演变成社会偏见。
conclusion: 减少人机交互摩擦并允许用户灵活分享信息，可以在不牺牲生产力的同时，有效解决内容同质化和偏见问题。

title: Co-Pilot for Health: Personalized Algorithmic AI Nudging to Improve Health Outcomes
authors: Jodi Chiam, Aloysius Lim, Cheryl Nott, Nicholas Mark, Ankur Teredesai, Sunil Shinde
abstract: The ability to shape health behaviors of large populations automatically, across wearable types and disease conditions at scale has tremendous potential to improve global health outcomes. We designed and implemented an AI driven platform for digital algorithmic nudging, enabled by a Graph-Neural Network (GNN) based Recommendation System, and granular health behavior data from wearable fitness devices. Here we describe the efficacy results of this platform with its capabilities of personalized and contextual nudging to $n=84,764$ individuals over a 12-week period in Singapore. We statistically validated that participants in the target group who received such AI optimized daily nudges increased daily physical activity like step count by 6.17% ($p = 3.09\times10^{-4}$) and weekly minutes of Moderate to Vigorous Physical Activity (MVPA) by 7.61% ($p = 1.16\times10^{-2}$), compared to matched participants in control group who did not receive any nudges. Further, such nudges were very well received, with a 13.1% of nudges sent being opened (open rate), and 11.7% of the opened nudges rated useful compared to 1.9% rated as not useful thereby demonstrating significant improvement in population level engagement metrics.
zh_title: 健康副驾驶：个性化算法AI助推以改善健康结果
translation: 自动塑造大规模人群健康行为的能力，跨越不同可穿戴设备和疾病状况，对于改善全球健康结果具有巨大的潜力。我们设计并实现了一个由图神经网络（GNN）推荐系统支持的AI驱动数字算法助推平台，利用来自可穿戴健身设备的颗粒状健康行为数据。在此，我们描述了该平台在新加坡对 $n=84,764$ 名个体进行为期12周的个性化和语境化助推能力的效力结果。我们经统计学验证发现，与未接受任何助推的匹配对照组合相比，接受此类AI优化日常助推的目标组参与者，其每日身体活动（如步数）增加了 6.17% ($p = 3.09\times10^{-4}$)，每周中高强度身体活动（MVPA）时间增加了 7.61% ($p = 1.16\times10^{-2}$)。此外，这些助推非常受欢迎，发送的助推中有 13.1% 被打开（打开率），在打开的助推中有 11.7% 被评价为有用，相比之下仅有 1.9% 被评价为无用，从而展示了在人群级别参与度指标上的显着改善。
tldr: 本文开发了一个基于图神经网络的AI健康助推平台，通过大规模随机对照试验验证了其能显著增加用户的日常身体活动和参与度。
ai_comments: 该论文设计并实现了一个基于图神经网络（GNN）推荐系统的AI个性化健康助推平台，并通过大规模真实人群实验验证了其在提升日常身体活动和人群参与度方面的显著效果，展示了AI在改善全球健康状况方面的巨大潜力。
motivation: 利用自动化的方式跨不同可穿戴设备和疾病状况大规模塑造全球人群的健康行为，从而改善全球健康状况。
method: 设计并实现了一个AI驱动的数字算法助推平台，采用基于图神经网络（GNN）的推荐系统，利用来自可穿戴健身设备的颗粒状健康行为数据，在新加坡对84,764名个体进行了为期12周的对照实验。
results: 在为期12周的试验中，与对照组相比，接受AI优化日常助推的目标组参与者的每日步数增加了6.17%，每周中高强度身体活动（MVPA）时间增加了7.61%。同时，助推信息的打开率为13.1%，认为有用的比例是认为无用比例的6倍以上（11.7%对1.9%）。
conclusion: 基于图神经网络的个性化AI数字化助推平台能够显著提升大规模人群的日常身体活动水平和用户参与度。

title: Games played by Exponential Weights Algorithms
authors: Maurizio d'Andrea, Fabien Gensbittel, Jérôme Renault
abstract: This paper studies the last-iterate convergence properties of the exponential weights algorithm with constant learning rates. We consider a repeated interaction in discrete time, where each player uses an exponential weights algorithm characterized by an initial mixed action and a fixed learning rate, so that the mixed action profile $p^t$ played at stage $t$ follows an homogeneous Markov chain. At first, we show that whenever a strict Nash equilibrium exists, the probability to play a strict Nash equilibrium at the next stage converges almost surely to 0 or 1. Secondly, we show that the limit of $p^t$, whenever it exists, belongs to the set of ``Nash Equilibria with Equalizing Payoffs''. Thirdly, we show that in strong coordination games, where the payoff of a player is positive on the diagonal and 0 elsewhere, $p^t$ converges almost surely to one of the strict Nash equilibria. We conclude with open questions.
comment: Published in Mathematics of Operations Research. Revised version with minor corrections and improvements in presentation
zh_title: 指数权重算法进行的博弈
translation: 本文研究了具有常数学习率的指数权重算法的最后迭代收敛性质。我们考虑离散时间下的重复交互，其中每个玩家使用由初始混合动作和固定学习率特征化的指数权重算法，使得在阶段 $t$ 游玩的混合动作分布 $p^t$ 遵循齐次马尔可夫链。首先，我们证明了只要存在严格纳什均衡，下一阶段游玩严格纳什均衡的概率几乎必然收敛到 0 或 1。其次，我们证明了 $p^t$ 的极限（如果存在）属于“具有均衡收益的纳什均衡”集合。第三，我们证明了在强协调博弈中（其中玩家在对角线上的收益为正，其余为 0），$p^t$ 几乎必然收敛到其中一个严格纳什均衡。最后，我们提出了开放性问题。
tldr: 本文研究了指数权重算法在重复博弈中的最后迭代收敛性，证明了其在严格纳什均衡存在时以及强协调博弈中的收敛行为。
ai_comments: 该论文深入研究了指数权重算法在博弈论中的最后迭代收敛性，通过引入齐次马尔可夫链分析了其渐近行为，特别是在严格纳什均衡和强协调博弈中的表现，为理解无监督学习算法在多智能体系统中的动态演化提供了重要的理论支撑。
motivation: 研究使用常数学习率的指数权重算法（Exponential Weights Algorithm）在重复博弈中的最后迭代（last-iterate）收敛性质。
method: 通过将使用常数学习率的指数权重算法建模为齐次马尔可夫链，分析其在离散时间重复博弈中的最后迭代收敛性质。
results: 1. 当存在严格纳什均衡时，下一阶段游玩严格纳什均衡的概率几乎必然收敛到0或1；2. 混合动作序列的极限（若存在）属于“具有均衡收益的纳什均衡”集合；3. 在强协调博弈中，混合动作序列几乎必然收敛到其中一个严格纳什均衡。
conclusion: 指数权重算法在具有严格纳什均衡或强协调博弈的特定条件下表现出良好的最后迭代收敛性，这增进了我们对多智能体学习动态的理解。

title: I2I Backdoor: Backdoor Attacks against Image-to-Image Tasks
authors: Wenbo Jiang, Hongwei Li, Jiaming He, Rui Zhang, Guowen Xu, Tianwei Zhang, Rongxing Lu
abstract: With the rapid development of deep learning technology, deep learning-based Image-to-Image (I2I) networks have become the predominant choice for I2I tasks like image super-resolution and denoising. Despite their remarkable performance, the security of I2I networks has not been thoroughly investigated. While some studies have probed their susceptibility to adversarial attacks, none have explored the backdoor attack against I2I networks, which is a more stealthy and severe threat. In this work, for the first time, we comprehensively investigate the vulnerability of I2I networks to backdoor attacks. We propose a backdoor attack against I2I tasks, where the backdoored I2I network behaves normally on clean input images, yet outputs a specific inappropriate image when the backdoor trigger appears on the input image. To achieve such an I2I backdoor attack, we design a universal adversarial perturbation (UAP) generation algorithm for I2I networks, where the generated UAP is used as the trigger for the I2I backdoor. Besides, multi-task learning (MTL) with dynamic weighting methods is employed in the backdoor training process to gain better results. Expanding our focus beyond I2I tasks, we extend our I2I backdoor to attack downstream tasks, including image classification and object detection. Specifically, the backdoor-triggered image processed by the backdoored image denoising network can fool the downstream image classifiers and object detectors. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the I2I backdoor on state-of-the-art I2I network architectures as well as the robustness against different backdoor defenses.
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing (TDSC)
zh_title: I2I后门：针对图像到图像任务的后门攻击
translation: 随着深度学习技术的快速发展，基于深度学习的图像到图像（I2I）网络已成为超分辨率和去噪等I2I任务的主要选择。尽管它们表现出色，但I2I网络的安全性尚未得到彻底研究。虽然一些研究探讨了它们对对抗攻击的敏感性，但没有人探索针对I2I网络的后门攻击，这是一种更隐蔽、更严重的威胁。在这项工作中，我们首次全面研究了I2I网络对后门攻击的脆弱性。我们提出了针对I2I任务的后门攻击，其中被植入后门的I2I网络在干净的输入图像上表现正常，但当输入图像上出现后门触发器时，会输出特定的不当图像。为了实现这样的I2I后门攻击，我们为I2I网络设计了一种通用对抗扰动（UAP）生成算法，其中生成的UAP被用作I2I后门的触发器。此外，在后门训练过程中采用具有动态加权方法的多任务学习（MTL）以获得更好的结果。将我们的研究重点扩展到I2I任务之外，我们将I2I后门扩展到攻击下游任务，包括图像分类和目标检测。具体而言，由被植入后门的图像去噪网络处理的带有后门触发的图像可以欺骗下游的图像分类器和目标检测器。大量实验证明了I2I后门在最先进的I2I网络架构上的有效性以及对不同后门防御的鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文首次提出针对图像到图像（I2I）网络的后门攻击，通过引入通用对抗扰动作为触发器，不仅能在I2I任务中隐蔽触发错误输出，还能有效攻击下游的图像分类和目标检测任务。
ai_comments: 该论文首次系统性地研究了图像到图像（I2I）网络中的后门攻击，填补了该领域的空白。其创新点在于设计了适用于I2I网络的通用对抗扰动（UAP）作为触发器，并结合多任务学习与动态权重法，同时展示了该攻击能够跨领域影响下游的分类和检测任务，具有较高的隐蔽性和威胁性。
motivation: 尽管基于深度学习的图像到图像（I2I）网络在超分辨率和去噪等任务中表现出色，但其安全性尚未得到充分研究，特别是隐蔽且严重的后门攻击在此类网络中尚未被探索。
method: 提出了一种针对I2I任务的后门攻击方法，设计了用于I2I网络的通用对抗扰动（UAP）生成算法作为触发器，并在后门训练过程中采用带有动态加权方法的多任务学习（MTL）。
results: 广泛的实验表明，所提出的I2I后门攻击在最先进的I2I网络架构上是有效的，对不同的后门防御具有鲁棒性，并且能够成功欺骗下游的图像分类器和目标检测器。
conclusion: 论文成功证明了I2I网络容易受到后门攻击，且这类攻击能够跨域影响下游任务，这突显了提高I2I任务及依赖其的下游系统安全性的迫切需求。

title: Hydrogen reaction rate modeling based on convolutional neural network for large eddy simulation
authors: Quentin Malé, Corentin J Lapeyre, Nicolas Noiray
abstract: This paper establishes a data-driven modeling framework for lean Hydrogen (H2)-air reaction rates for the Large Eddy Simulation (LES) of turbulent reactive flows. This is particularly challenging since H2 molecules diffuse much faster than heat, leading to large variations in burning rates, thermodiffusive instabilities at the subfilter scale, and complex turbulence-chemistry interactions. Our data-driven approach leverages a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), trained to approximate filtered burning rates from emulated LES data. First, five different lean premixed turbulent H2-air flame Direct Numerical Simulations (DNSs) are computed each with a unique global equivalence ratio. Second, DNS snapshots are filtered and downsampled to emulate LES data. Third, a CNN is trained to approximate the filtered burning rates as a function of LES scalar quantities: progress variable, local equivalence ratio and flame thickening due to filtering. Finally, the performances of the CNN model are assessed on test solutions never seen during training. The model retrieves burning rates with very high accuracy. It is also tested on two filter and downsampling parameters and two global equivalence ratios between those used during training. For these interpolation cases, the model approximates burning rates with low error even though the cases were not included in the training dataset. This a priori study shows that the proposed data-driven machine learning framework is able to address the challenge of modeling lean premixed H2-air burning rates. It paves the way for a new modeling paradigm for the simulation of carbon-free hydrogen combustion systems.
comment: 18 pages, 9 figures. The journal version is available online at: https://doi.org/10.1017/dce.2025.1

title: Mixtures of In-Context Learners
authors: Giwon Hong, Emile van Krieken, Edoardo Ponti, Esmeralda S. Whitammer, Pasquale Minervini
abstract: In-context learning (ICL) adapts LLMs by providing demonstrations without fine-tuning the model parameters; however, it does not differentiate between demonstrations and quadratically increases the complexity of Transformer LLMs, exhausting the memory. As a solution, we propose Mixtures of In-Context Learners (MoICL), a novel approach to treat subsets of demonstrations as experts and learn a weighting function to merge their output distributions based on a training set. In our experiments, we show performance improvements on 5 out of 7 classification datasets compared to a set of strong baselines (up to +13\% compared to ICL and LENS). Moreover, we enhance the Pareto frontier of ICL by reducing the inference time needed to achieve the same performance with fewer demonstrations. Finally, MoICL is more robust to out-of-domain (up to +11\%), imbalanced (up to +49\%), or noisy demonstrations (up to +38\%) or can filter these out from datasets. Overall, MoICL is a more expressive approach to learning from demonstrations without exhausting the context window or memory.

title: MultiAgentBench: Evaluating the Collaboration and Competition of LLM agents
authors: Kunlun Zhu, Hongyi Du, Zhaochen Hong, Xiaocheng Yang, Shuyi Guo, Zhe Wang, Zhenhailong Wang, Cheng Qian, Xiangru Tang, Heng Ji, Jiaxuan You
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities as autonomous agents, yet existing benchmarks either focus on single-agent tasks or are confined to narrow domains, failing to capture the dynamics of multi-agent coordination and competition. In this paper, we introduce MultiAgentBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate LLM-based multi-agent systems across diverse, interactive scenarios. Our framework measures not only task completion but also the quality of collaboration and competition using novel, milestone-based key performance indicators. Moreover, we evaluate various coordination protocols (including star, chain, tree, and graph topologies) and innovative strategies such as group discussion and cognitive planning. Notably, gpt-4o-mini reaches the average highest task score, graph structure performs the best among coordination protocols in the research scenario, and cognitive planning improves milestone achievement rates by 3%. Code and datasets are public available at https://github.com/MultiagentBench/MARBLE.

title: VerifyPrompt: Towards Text-to-Image Models Verification Behind Black-Box APIs
authors: Ji Guo, Rui Zhang, Guomin Lu, Aiguo Chen, Tianwei Zhang, Hongwei Li, Wenbo Jiang
abstract: With the rise of diverse Text-to-Image (T2I) models such as DALL-E 3, third-party platforms increasingly integrate multiple black-box APIs to deliver cost-effective services. This also raises a new and practical security question: are these third-party platforms truly offering the models they claim? Such model substitution fraud, in which a malicious third-party platform operator acts as the adversary, enables the platform to profit illicitly while undermining user interests and damaging the commercial reputation of legitimate model providers. To address this practical concern, we first define the task of T2I model verification, which determines whether a black-box target model matches a black-box oracle reference model. After that, we propose VerifyPrompt, which performs T2I model verification through a specially designed verify prompt. Intuitively, the verify prompt is an adversarial prompt for the target model, without transferability to other models. It makes the target model generate a specific image while making other models produce entirely different images. Our key idea for generating verify prompts is to enforce strong interactions between adversarial perturbations and the target model, thereby overfitting the target and producing model-specific perturbations. To enable efficient black-box search for verify prompts, we further introduce VerifyPrompt-RL, a reinforcement learning-based strategy that leverages multi-sample exploration and group relative error estimation to stabilize and accelerate the search process. Experiments show that VerifyPrompt achieves over 90\% accuracy across various T2I platforms, confirming its effectiveness in real-world third-party services.
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing (TDSC)

title: Meme Template Identification in the Wild: Comparing Methods for Semi-Open-Set Recognition
authors: Huy Nguyen, Donát Ákos Köller, Levente Murgás, József Pintér, Marcell Nagy, Kate Barnes, Roland Molontay
abstract: Image-with-text memes are a dominant form of online communication, and much of their spread happens through meme templates which are recurring visual formats that users adapt with new text or imagery. Most prior work scores memes individually for engagement or harmful content, an approach that is structurally blind to templates. Templates might amplify these patterns and enable coordinated harassment, which becomes visible only when memes are grouped by shared template. We formalize meme template identification as a semi-open-set recognition problem, requiring methods to both classify known templates and reject template-free memes and non-meme content. We introduce an evaluation framework spanning a controlled setting (1,704 ImgFlip templates) and a heterogeneous real-world social media sample, comparing supervised CNN- and distance-based methods, unsupervised density-based clustering, a novel fused SigLIP2+DINOv2 representation, and a retrieval-augmented LLM pipeline. In real-world social media sources dedicated to meme sharing, we find that only 21% of images use a known template, while 58% are template-free and 21% are not memes at all; identification performance also drops sharply from the controlled setting (best MCC 0.974 to 0.684). The loss comes mainly from deciding whether an image is a template-based meme at all, rather than identifying the template. Our dataset of 1.1M soft-labeled social media images, together with code for reproducibility, is available upon request.
zh_title: 野外迷因模板识别：半开放集识别方法的比较
translation: 图文迷因是线上交流的主要形式，其传播很大程度上通过迷因模板进行，迷因模板是用户用新文本或图像进行改编的重复视觉格式。大多数先前的研究单独评估迷因的参与度或有害内容，这种方法在结构上对模板是盲目的。模板可能会放大这些模式并促成协同骚扰，这只有在迷因按共享模板分组时才能显现。我们将迷因模板识别形式化为一个半开放集识别问题，要求方法既能分类已知模板，又能拒绝无模板迷因和非迷因内容。我们引入了一个评估框架，涵盖受控环境（1,704个ImgFlip模板）和异构的真实世界社交媒体样本，比较了监督式CNN和基于距离的方法、无监督密度聚类、一种新颖的融合SigLIP2+DINOv2表示，以及一个检索增强型LLM管道。在专门用于迷因分享的真实世界社交媒体源中，我们发现只有21%的图片使用了已知模板，而58%是无模板的，21%根本不是迷因；识别性能也从受控环境（最佳MCC 0.974）急剧下降到0.684。性能下降主要来自于判断图像是否为基于模板的迷因，而非识别具体的模板。我们包含110万张软标签社交媒体图像的数据集，连同可复现的代码，可应要求提供。
tldr: 本研究将迷因模板识别形式化为半开放集识别问题，比较了多种方法在受控和真实社交媒体环境下的表现。结果显示，在真实世界中识别模板迷因的挑战主要在于区分其是否为模板迷因，而非识别具体模板，且性能显著下降。
ai_comments: 这项研究创新性地将迷因模板识别框架为半开放集识别问题，这更好地模拟了真实世界的复杂性。其重要性在于揭示了迷因模板在内容传播和潜在不良行为（如协同骚扰）中的关键作用，填补了现有研究对模板盲点的不足。研究通过在受控和真实世界环境中的全面评估，揭示了在“野外”识别模板迷因的巨大挑战，特别是在区分模板迷因与非迷因内容方面的困难。这对于社交媒体平台的内容管理和理解线上文化传播具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的迷因分析方法通常单独评估迷因，忽略了迷因模板在内容传播中的关键作用。迷因模板是线上交流中重复的视觉格式，可能放大参与度或有害内容模式，甚至导致协同骚扰。这些模式只有在迷因按共享模板分组时才能被发现，因此需要有效识别迷因模板。
method: 该研究将迷因模板识别形式化为半开放集识别问题，要求方法既能分类已知模板，又能拒绝无模板迷因和非迷因内容。研究引入了一个评估框架，涵盖受控环境（1,704个ImgFlip模板）和异构的真实世界社交媒体样本。比较的方法包括：监督式CNN和基于距离的方法、无监督密度聚类、一种新颖的融合SigLIP2+DINOv2表示，以及一个检索增强型LLM管道。
results: 在真实世界的迷因分享社交媒体源中，仅有21%的图片使用了已知模板，58%是无模板的，21%根本不是迷因。识别性能从受控环境（最佳MCC 0.974）急剧下降到真实环境（0.684）。性能下降的主要原因在于判断图像是否为基于模板的迷因，而非识别具体的模板。
conclusion: 在真实世界社交媒体环境中识别迷因模板是一项具有挑战性的任务，尤其是在区分模板迷因与无模板内容或非迷因内容方面。现有方法在受控环境下表现良好，但在真实世界的开放集识别场景中性能显著下降。

title: Survival of the Fittest Perturbations: Uncertainty-Aware Evolution of Adversarial Distributions for Robust Generalization
authors: Junhao Dong, Zicheng Yu, Xinghua Qu, Z. Jane Wang, Yew-Soon Ong
abstract: Despite deep learning's broad successes across diverse scenarios, its vulnerability to adversarial examples impedes deployment, making adversarial training a leading approach to improve robustness. However, pointwise adversarial training maps each clean sample to a single adversary, overlooking surrounding adversarial variability and the associated shifts in feature statistics. To address these issues, we propose Evolutionary Uncertainty-Aware Distributional Adversarial Training (EvoUAD-AT). Specifically, we design an evolutionary adversarial uncertainty modeling module that maintains an instance-wise search distribution over adversarial feature statistics around an adversarially generated anchor. Candidates are evaluated under the current model, selected by their threat to a benign reference, and used to adapt the distribution; strategy parameters are retained across epochs. To avoid anchoring on misclassified clean samples, we refine the alignment reference and match benign and adversarial distributions. Introspective gradient matching further regularizes input gradients without external supervision. Our analysis characterizes the elite fitness surrogate and gives a conditional certificate for latent adversarial features. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in both clean accuracy and robustness, with thorough analyses confirming the effectiveness of each proposed component.

title: LLM-Assisted Reranking to Operationalize Nuanced Objectives in Recommender Systems
authors: Amir Ghasemian, Homa Hosseinmardi, Upasana Dutta, Duncan J. Watts
abstract: Recommender systems shape what information we see, raising concerns about filter bubbles, radicalization, polarization, and social inequality. Large language models (LLMs) enable more powerful personalization that may intensify these dynamics, yet most recommenders are tuned for engagement or narrow accuracy metrics, with little attention to broader social effects. We investigate whether LLM-assisted reranking, while improving personalization, inadvertently amplifies exposure to ideologically congenial, extreme, or conspiratorial political content, a risk theorized but not yet empirically characterized. Using real YouTube trajectories, we rerank the platform's sidebar candidates by zero-shot prompting across three models, alongside an embedding baseline, and evaluate relevance, ideological alignment and diversity, and exposure to conspiratorial or extremist content. We find that (i) under a pure personalization instruction, reranking improves relevance while narrowing ideological exposure and, on two of three models, promoting problematic content for users with such histories; the third model, which declines most explicitly partisan requests, points to model-specific guardrails; (ii) lightweight prompt-level constraints substantially reduce problematic exposure on all three models, while the regularized rerankers still rank above the platform baseline on relevance; and (iii) synthetic experiments varying topical and partisan cues independently show no fixed preference between them: topic dominates on abortion and immigration, while partisanship takes over on elections, where the topical signal is weaker. Our results highlight the power of LLMs to operationalize contextual nuance in high-stakes political recommendation, and underscore the need to evaluate LLM-assisted personalization beyond accuracy and to treat prompt design as a value-laden choice rather than a neutral default.

zh_title: 利用大语言模型辅助重排序在推荐系统中实现细微目标的运行化
translation: 推荐系统塑造了我们所看到的信息，引发了对信息茧房、激进化、极化和社会不公的担忧。大型语言模型（LLM）实现了更强大的个性化，可能会加剧这些动态，然而大多数推荐系统都是为了迎合互动率或狭隘的准确率指标而调整的，对更广泛的社会影响关注甚少。我们研究了LLM辅助重排序在提升个性化的同时，是否会无意中放大意识形态一致、极端或阴谋论政治内容的曝光风险——这是一个已被理论化但尚未得到实证特征化的风险。使用真实的YouTube轨迹，我们通过三个模型的零样本提示对平台的侧边栏候选进行重排序，并与嵌入基线进行对比，评估了相关性、意识形态对齐与多样性，以及对阴谋论或极端内容的接触。我们发现：(i) 在纯个性化指令下，重排序在提高相关性的同时缩小了意识形态的曝光，并在三个模型中的两个上，为具有此类历史的用户推广了问题内容；第三个模型拒绝了大多数明确带党派色彩的请求，指出了模型特定的防护栏；(ii) 轻量级的提示-级别约束显著减少了所有三个模型的问题曝光，而正则化重排序器在相关性上仍然高于平台基线；以及(iii) 独立改变话题和党派线索的合成实验显示它们之间没有固定的偏好：话题在堕胎和移民问题上占主导地位，而党派在话题信号较弱的选举问题上占主导地位。我们的结果凸显了LLM在高风险政治推荐中运用上下文细微差别的能力，并强调需要超越准确性来评估LLM辅助的个性化，并将提示设计视为一种充满价值的选择，而不是中立的默认选项。
tldr: 利用大语言模型进行推荐系统重排序虽然能提升相关性并带来极化风险，但通过简单的提示词约束即可在控制风险的同时保持推荐质量。
ai_comments: 该论文首次实证研究了大语言模型辅助重排序在推荐系统中的社会影响（如极端内容暴露），其创新之处在于证明了通过轻量级提示词约束即可在保持推荐相关性的同时抑制问题内容的曝光。对未来构建负责任的推荐系统具有重要指导意义。
motivation: 当前的推荐系统主要针对互动率或准确率进行优化，忽视了更广泛的社会影响；而大语言模型驱动的个性化推荐可能会加剧政治极化、同温层效应和极端内容曝光等风险，因此需要对其进行实证研究与风险控制。
method: 利用真实的YouTube轨迹数据，通过三种大模型进行零样本提示（zero-shot prompting）重排序和嵌入基线对比，评估相关性、意识形态对齐与多样性，以及对阴谋论或极端内容的接触情况，并辅以控制主题与党派线索的合成实验。
results: (1) 纯个性化指令会提高相关性但收窄意识形态曝光，并在部分模型上向特定历史用户推送问题内容；(2) 轻量级提示词约束能显著减少所有模型的问题内容曝光，且正则化重排器的相关性仍高于平台基线；(3) 合成实验表明主题和党派线索无固定偏好，主题在部分议题上占优，党派在弱主题信号议题上占优。
conclusion: 大语言模型能够有效操作政治推荐中的细微上下文目标，但提示词设计包含价值选择。通过合理的提示词约束，可以在维持高相关性的同时有效抑制极端内容的传播。

title: GRTO: Bootstrapped Group Relative Tool Optimization for Referring Segmentation
authors: Mario Markov, Stefan Maria Ailuro, Mohammad Mahdi, Luc Van Gool, Danda Pani Paudel
abstract: Referring segmentation requires reasoning to connect language with visual evidence and identify the intended target in challenging scenarios. This makes GRPO a natural choice for training VLMs together with a segmentation tool. However, existing approaches optimize only the VLM, assuming that the tool is perfect and leaving it untouched. This assumption is particularly limiting when the tool faces domain shift, as segmentation errors can undermine even correct reasoning. We therefore argue that the segmentation tool should be optimized together with the reasoning policy. However, this is challenging because policy optimization and differentiable tool learning rely on fundamentally different objectives. In this work, we introduce group relative tool optimization (GRTO), a mathematically grounded two-stage framework for jointly optimizing a policy and its differentiable tool. The key idea is to first align the tool with the policy expected after joint training, rather than the initial policy. The prealigned tool then leads to a more robust reward signal and superior policy convergence in subsequent policy training. In the first stage, GRTO bootstraps the tool toward the theoretically optimal policy, capturing readily attainable gains without costly on-policy rollouts. This alignment bootstraps the second stage, where GRTO extends GRPO to jointly refine the policy and tool. Across three challenging referring segmentation benchmarks, GRTO achieves substantial improvements over plain GRPO and alternative tool training procedures, matching or surpassing domain-specific state-of-the-art methods. This demonstrates the value of unifying reinforcement learning with differentiable auxiliary objectives for reasoning-intensive segmentation.
zh_title: GRTO：面向指代分割的引导式群组相对工具优化
translation: 指代分割需要推理来连接语言与视觉证据，并在复杂的场景中识别出预期的目标。这使得 GRPO 成为训练视觉语言模型（VLM）与分割工具结合的自然选择。然而，现有方法仅优化 VLM，假设工具是完美的且保持不变。当工具面临领域偏移时，这种假设尤为局限，因为分割错误会破坏即使是正确的推理。因此，我们认为分割工具应与推理策略一起优化。然而，这具有挑战性，因为策略优化和可微工具学习依赖于根本不同的目标。在这项工作中，我们引入了群组相对工具优化（GRTO），这是一个有数学依据的两阶段框架，用于联合优化策略及其可微工具。其核心思想是首先将工具与联合训练后的期望策略（而不是初始策略）进行对齐。预对齐的工具随后在后续的策略训练中带来更鲁棒的奖励信号和更优的策略收敛性。在第一阶段，GRTO 将工具自举朝向理论上最优的策略，在没有高昂在线 rollout 开销的情况下捕获容易获得的增益。这种对齐引导了第二阶段，GRTO 在该阶段扩展了 GRPO，以联合精炼策略和工具。在三个具有挑战性的指代分割基准测试中，GRTO 比普通的 GRPO 和替代工具训练程序取得了实质性的改进，达到或超越了特定领域的最新方法。这证明了将强化学习与可微辅助目标统一用于推理密集型分割的价值。
tldr: 提出GRTO框架，首次实现了视觉语言模型策略与可微分割工具的联合优化，显著提升了指代分割性能。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了GRTO框架，首次将视觉语言模型的策略优化与可微分割工具的联合优化有机结合，通过两阶段自举机制解决了目标不一致和领域偏移的问题，在指代分割任务上取得了显著成果。
motivation: 现有的指代分割方法在结合VLM和分割工具时，仅优化VLM而假设工具完美，当工具面临领域偏移时，分割错误会破坏正确的推理，因此需要将分割工具与推理策略进行联合优化。
method: 提出GRTO（群组相对工具优化）两阶段框架：第一阶段通过自举将工具对齐到联合训练后的期望策略，避免高昂的在线 rollout 开销；第二阶段扩展 GRPO，联合精炼策略与工具。
results: 在三个具有挑战性的指代分割基准测试中，GRTO相比普通GRPO和替代工具训练程序取得了显著改进，达到或超过了领域特定的最先进方法。
conclusion: GRTO通过将强化学习与可微辅助目标相统一，成功实现了视觉语言模型策略与分割工具的联合优化，为推理密集型分割任务提供了强大的新范式。

title: Uncertainty, bias and the institution bootstrapping problem
authors: Stavros Anagnou, Christoph Salge, Peter R. Lewis
abstract: Institutions play a critical role in enabling communities to manage common-pool resources and avert tragedies of the commons. However, a fundamental issue arises: Individuals typically perceive participation as advantageous only after an institution is established, creating a paradox: How can institutions form if no one will join before a critical mass exists? We term this conundrum the institution bootstrapping problem and propose that misperception, specifically, agents' erroneous belief that an institution already exists, could resolve this paradox. By integrating well-documented psychological phenomena, including cognitive biases, probability distortion, and perceptual noise, into a game-theoretic framework, we demonstrate how these factors collectively mitigate the bootstrapping problem. Notably, unbiased perceptual noise (e.g., noise arising from agents' heterogeneous physical or social contexts) drastically reduces the critical mass of cooperators required for institutional emergence. This effect intensifies with greater diversity of perceptions. We explain this counter-intuitive result through asymmetric boundary conditions: proportional underestimation of low-probability sanctions produces distinct outcomes compared to equivalent overestimation. Furthermore, the type of perceptual distortion, proportional versus absolute, yields qualitatively different evolutionary pathways. These findings challenge conventional assumptions about rationality in institutional design, highlighting how "noisy" cognition can paradoxically enhance cooperation. Finally, we contextualize these insights within broader discussions of multi-agent system design and collective action. Our analysis underscores the importance of incorporating human-like cognitive constraints, not just idealized rationality, into models of institutional emergence and resilience.
