(eds) Coordination, Organizations, Institutions, Norms, and Ethics for Governance of Multi-Agent Systems XVIII. COINE 2025. Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol 16253. Springer, Cham

title: Reinforcement Learning for Large-Scale Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding with Shared Spatial Fields
authors: Jean Seong Bjorn Choe
abstract: Large-scale applications of lifelong multi-agent path finding (LMAPF) call for computationally inexpensive movement decisions under changing traffic conditions and across varied layouts. We propose a navigation policy in which a convolutional network computes a shared spatial field over the map once per timestep and a compact goal-conditioned operator derives agents' movement preferences. The complete policy is trained end-to-end using average-reward reinforcement learning with throughput as the reward, without planner demonstrations or a separate online path planner. For structured and unstructured layouts, we train one policy per class on pools of small maps and deploy each without retraining on larger, unseen layouts and agent populations. Across six layouts with 10,000 agents, our policies achieve throughput comparable to or higher than the strongest evaluated baselines. The proposed method has an average execution time below 10 ms per step, more than an order of magnitude faster than several established planners.
zh_title: 基于共享空间场的大规模终身多智能体路径寻找强化学习方法
translation: 大规模终身多智能体路径寻找（LMAPF）的应用要求在变化的交通条件和不同的布局下，做出计算开销低廉的移动决策。我们提出了一种导航策略，其中卷积网络在每个时间步计算地图上的共享空间场，并且一个紧凑的目标条件算子推导智能体的移动偏好。整个策略使用以吞吐量为奖励的平均奖励强化学习进行端到端训练，无需规划器演示或单独的在线路径规划器。对于结构化和非结构化布局，我们在小型地图池上为每个类别训练一个策略，并在无需重新训练的情况下将其部署到更大、未见过的布局和智能体群体中。在包含10,000个智能体的六种布局中，我们的策略实现了可与最强评估基线相比拟甚至更高的吞吐量。该方法的平均执行时间低于每步10毫秒，比几个成熟的规划器快一个多数量级以上。
tldr: 提出了一种基于强化学习的大规模终身多智能体路径寻找方法，利用共享空间场实现了高效、实时的智能体导航，且无需在线路径规划器。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种基于强化学习的大规模终身多智能体路径寻找方法，通过共享空间场和紧凑的目标条件算子，实现了极高的计算效率和优秀的泛化能力，能够直接部署在未见过的更大规模地图和智能体群体中，具有很强的实用价值。
motivation: 大规模终身多智能体路径寻找（LMAPF）应用需要在不断变化的交通条件和不同的布局下，做出计算开销低廉的移动决策。
method: 提出了一种导航策略，其中卷积网络在每个时间步计算地图上的共享空间场，并由紧凑的目标条件算子推导智能体的移动偏好；使用平均奖励强化学习进行端到端训练，以吞吐量作为奖励，无需规划器演示或独立的在线路径规划器。
results: 在包含10,000个智能体的六种布局测试中，该策略实现了与最强基线相当或更高的吞吐量，且每步平均执行时间低于10毫秒，比多个传统规划器快一个多数量级以上。
conclusion: 该方法在保持高吞吐量的同时，实现了显著优于传统规划器的计算速度，为大规模终身多智能体路径寻找问题提供了一种高效、可扩展的纯强化学习解决方案。

title: AStockArena: Beyond Returns, Can We Entrust Real Capital to the Decisions of Financial Agents?
authors: Zeyu Liu, Sing Kwong Lai, Xuanzhi Feng, HaoYang Shang, Yang Li, Zihao Fang, Xuan Liu, Song Guo
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in dynamic financial trading, yet real-time trading benchmarks mainly evaluate agents by cumulative returns and risk-adjusted performance. Such outcome metrics cannot show whether trades are faithfully reported, supported by available evidence, and consistent with account states. We introduce AStockArena, a real-time decision-auditing benchmark for continuous trading in China's A-share market. Under shared market conditions and execution constraints, we evaluate 13 open- and closed-source models over 3,198 sequential decisions. AStockArena reconstructsthe actions actually posted to accounts by aligning reports, trade requests, execution responses, and account states, and audits them with eight checks spanning execution traceability (O), evidence sufficiency (RK), and financial meta-awareness (B), combining record verification with consensus expert annotation. Of 1,070 trading points, 72.99% exhibit at least one audit gap; model-level rates range from52.2% to 91.2%, with evidence gaps most prevalent. Historical trade-filtering replay further shows thatportfolio outcomes are sensitive to these flagged trades. Decision-process auditing thus offers a verifiable complement to return-based evaluation of financial agents.
zh_title: AStockArena：超越回报，我们能将真实资本托付给金融智能体的决策吗？
translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于动态金融交易，然而实时交易基准主要通过累积回报和风险调整后表现来评估智能体。这种结果指标无法显示交易是否被忠实报告、是否有可用证据支持以及是否与账户状态一致。我们推出了AStockArena，这是一个针对中国A股市场连续交易的实时决策-审计基准。在共享的市场条件和执行约束下，我们评估了13个开源和闭源模型在3,198个连续决策中的表现。AStockArena通过对齐报告、交易请求、执行响应和账户状态来重建实际发布到账户的操作，并通过涵盖执行可追溯性（O）、证据充分性（RK）和金融元意识（B）的八项检查对其进行审计，结合记录验证与共识专家注释。在1,070个交易点中，72.99%表现出至少一个审计漏洞；模型级别的漏洞率从52.2%到91.2%不等，其中证据漏洞最为普遍。历史交易过滤回测进一步表明，投资组合结果对这些被标记的交易很敏感。因此，决策过程审计为金融智能基于回报的评估提供了一个可验证的补充。
tldr: 本文提出了首个针对金融大模型的决策审计基准AStockArena，发现大多数模型在真实交易决策中存在审计漏洞，证明了仅凭回报评估金融智能体的局限性。
ai_comments: 该论文指出了现有金融大模型评测仅看重最终收益和风险调整后表现的局限性，创新性地提出了AStockArena这一专注于决策过程审计的实时基准，揭示了当前大模型在交易执行中普遍存在的漏洞，具有很高的学术价值和现实指导意义。
motivation: 现有的实时交易基准主要通过累积回报和风险调整后表现来评估智能体，这种结果指标无法显示交易是否被忠实报告、是否有可用证据支持以及是否与账户状态一致。
method: 引入AStockArena基准，在共享市场条件和执行约束下，评估13个开源和闭源模型在3,198个连续决策中的表现。通过对齐报告、交易请求、执行响应和账户状态重建实际操作，并采用涵盖执行可 traceability、证据充分性和金融元意识的8项检查进行审计。
results: 在1,070个交易点中，72.99%存在至少一个审计漏洞，模型漏洞率在52.2%到91.2%之间，其中证据漏洞最为普遍。历史交易过滤回测表明，投资组合结果对这些被标记的交易非常敏感。
conclusion: 决策过程审计能够作为基于回报的金融智能体评估的有效补充，对于确保大模型在真实金融资本交易中的安全性和可靠性至关重要。

title: SANTA++: Sampling Attention through Representative Keys
authors: Kyle Lee, Christian Z. Pratt, Ruoyu Fang, Heekyung Lee, Avinash Lohitsa, Ryan Modafe, Kerem Y. Camsari
abstract: Attention often concentrates on a small subset of tokens in the context, but which subset matters changes from one query to the next. To exploit this changing structure, we introduce SANTA++, a training-free stochastic attention method that uses representative keys for memory-efficient selection without scanning the entire key-value (KV) cache. Cached keys are organized into teams, and the query scores one representative from each team to decide which teams to sample. We compute exact attention scores within the sampled teams and reweight each team's contribution by the inverse of its inclusion probability. This importance sampling correction estimates attention over the full cache, with a sampling budget that lets us trade memory reads for accuracy. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct at 32K context, contiguous SANTA++ at S=1024 retains 95-98% of dense aggregate scores on LongBench v2, HELMET RAG, and RULER using 28-31% logical KV access. On RULER, SANTA++ outperforms Quest across the tested accuracy-access sweep, using 48.7% fewer KV reads at approximately 79% accuracy. It also outperforms MagicPIG at low access. At S=1024, our Triton implementation gives a 1.38x attention-operator speedup over the Flash backend of PyTorch scaled dot-product attention (Flash SDPA) in FP16. At batch eight, full-model decoding is 1.23x faster than dense Flash SDPA with matched INT4 model weights and FP16 KV-cache precision on an RTX 5090 Laptop GPU. Our kernels are available at https://github.com/OPUSLab/santapp-kernel-demo.
zh_title: SANTA++：通过代表性键进行采样注意力
translation: 注意力机制通常集中在上下文中一小部分 Token 上，但具体哪一部分取决于不同的查询。为了利用这种变化的结构，我们引入了 SANTA++，这是一种无需训练的随机注意力方法，它使用代表性键进行内存高效的选择，而无需扫描整个键值（KV）缓存。缓存的键被组织成团队，查询对每个团队的一个代表性键进行评分，以决定采样哪些团队。我们在采样的团队内计算精确的注意力分数，并通过其包含概率的倒数来重新加权每个团队的贡献。这种重要性采样修正估计了整个缓存的注意力，其采样预算允许我们在内存读取和准确性之间进行权衡。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 模型的 32K 上下文下，连续 SANTA++ 在 S=1024 时，在 LongBench v2、HELMET RAG 和 RULER 上保留了密集聚合分数的 95-98%，同时使用了 28-31% 的逻辑 KV 访问量。在 RULER 上，SANTA++ 在测试的准确率-访问量区间内优于 Quest，在约 79% 的准确率下减少了 48.7% 的 KV 读取。它在低访问量下也优于 MagicPIG。在 S=1024 时，我们的 Triton 实现比 PyTorch 缩放点积注意力的 Flash 后端（Flash SDPA）在 FP16 下实现了 1.38 倍的注意力算子加速。在批大小为 8 时，在 RTX 5090 笔记本 GPU 上，配合匹配的 INT4 模型权重和 FP16 KV 缓存精度，全模型解码速度比密集的 Flash SDPA 快 1.23 倍。我们的内核可在 https://github.com/OPUSLab/santapp-kernel-demo 获取。
tldr: SANTA++ 是一种无需训练的随机注意力方法，通过对代表性键团队进行重要性采样，在大幅减少 KV 缓存内存读取的同时保持了长文本大语言模型的高准确率和推理速度。
ai_comments: 该论文提出的 SANTA++ 是一种无需训练的随机注意力方法，通过代表性键的选择和重要性采样修正，有效降低了长文本推理时的 KV 缓存内存访问开销，同时保持了较高的准确率。方法具有较强的实用价值，在实际硬件上也取得了明显的加速效果。
motivation: 注意力机制通常只集中在上下文中一小部分 Token 上，但具体子集随查询变化而变化。为了在不扫描整个 KV 缓存的情况下利用这种可变的结构，从而实现内存高效的注意力计算。
method: 将缓存的键组织成团队，查询对每个团队的一个代表性键进行评分以决定采样的团队，在采样的团队内计算精确的注意力分数，并利用包含概率的倒数对团队贡献进行重新加权（重要性采样修正）。
results: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 32K 上下文下，SANTA++ 使用 28-31% 的逻辑 KV 访问量即可保留全量密集注意力 95-98% 的分数；相比 Quest 和 MagicPIG 具有更好的准确率-访问量权衡；Triton 实现带来了 1.38x 的注意力算子加速和 1.23x 的全模型解码加速。
conclusion: SANTA++ 实现了内存高效的注意力计算，通过代表性键团队采样和重要性修正，在长上下文任务中大幅减少 KV 缓存读取的同时保持了高准确率，且在硬件上取得了显著的推理加速。

title: Shared Randomness and Parallel Rounds in Permutation Sampling
authors: Haoxiang Huang
abstract:
Sampling a uniformly random permutation of $[n]$ in parallel is a coordination problem: $n$ processors, one per coordinate, must output distinct values. A single round requires a shared seed of $\log n!$ nats, while $n$ rounds require no shared randomness. We determine the tradeoff in between for $R$ rounds, in which the values of each round are written independently given the shared randomness and the earlier output, and the output must be a uniform permutation, exactly or within total-variation error $\varepsilon$. Shared randomness is measured by its support size or by its entropy, and it is either fixed in advance or drawn adaptively during the execution.
  For exact sampling, all four costs equal one explicit combinatorial quantity up to an absolute additive constant. A fixed error $0<\varepsilon<1$ shortens the seed by $O(1)$ nats in one round, where the least number of seed values, an approximate nonnegative tensor rank, is $(1-3\varepsilon/2)\,n!$ up to an additive two for $\varepsilon\le1/2$. The saving is $Θ((\log n)^2)$ nats in two rounds, with a sharp constant, and of lower order for $R=o(n)$; for $R\simρn$ with $0<ρ<1$ it is linear in $n$, with the optimal rate given by a variational formula. Here, errors above an explicit threshold need only $o(n)$ nats, and at every positive error below it, shared randomness drawn adaptively has strictly smaller entropy than a seed fixed in advance. A central tool is a change of measure that turns lower bounds with error into entropy bounds for a single batch of distinct, nearly independent values. The results for sublinearly and linearly many rounds extend to sampling without replacement.
zh_title: 排列采样中的共享随机性与并行轮数
translation:
在并行环境中对 $[n]$ 的均匀随机排列进行采样是一个协调问题：每个坐标一个处理器，必须输出不同的值。单轮采样需要 $\log n!$ nat 的共享随机种子，而 $n$ 轮则不需要共享随机性。我们确定了在这两者之间 $R$ 轮的权衡关系，其中每一轮的值在给定共享随机性和先前输出的条件下独立写入，且输出必须是均匀排列，要求是精确的或总变差误差在 $\varepsilon$ 以内。共享随机性通过其支撑集大小或熵来衡量，既可以预先固定，也可以在执行期间自适应抽取。
对于精确采样，所有四种成本都等于一个明确的组合量（相差一个绝对加性常数）。对于固定的误差 $0<\varepsilon<1$，单轮采样可以缩短 $O(1)$ nat 的种子，其中种子值的最少数量（一个近似非负张量秩）在 $\varepsilon\le 1/2$ 时为 $(1-3\varepsilon/2)\,n!$（相差一个加性常数2）。在两轮中节省的大小为 $\Theta((\log n)^2)$ nat（具有精确的常数），对于 $R=o(n)$ 则是低阶的；当 $R\sim \rho n$ 且 $0<\rho<1$ 时，节省量随 $n$ 线性增长，其最优速率由一个变分公式给出。在此，高于显式阈值的误差仅需 $o(n)$ nat 的随机性，而在其之下的每一个正误差处，自适应抽取的共享随机性具有严格小于预先固定种子的熵。一个核心工具是度量变换，它将带误差的下界转化为单批不同且近似独立的值的熵界。关于子线性轮数和线性轮数的结果可以推广到无放回采样。
tldr: 论文解决了并行排列采样中共享随机性与并行轮数的权衡问题，精确刻画了不同轮数和误差要求下的资源消耗。
ai_comments: 该论文深刻探讨了在并行排列采样中共享随机性与并行轮数之间的权衡关系，理论性强，结合了组合数学、信息论和概率论的方法。
motivation: 探究在并行排列采样问题中，介于单轮（需要大量共享随机性）与 $n$ 轮（不需要共享随机性）之间的 $R$ 轮并行计算中，共享随机性（支持集大小或熵）与轮数及误差之间的权衡关系。
method: 通过组合数学分析、近似非负张量秩以及度量变换（change of measure）方法，建立了错误率与信息论界限之间的联系。
results: 对于精确采样，四种成本均等于一个显式的组合量；对于固定误差，单轮、两轮、亚线性轮数和线性轮数下节省的随机性大小被精确量化，且在某些阈值下自适应随机性比固定随机性具有更小的熵。
conclusion: 论文完全确定了在精确和近似排列采样中所需的共享随机性与并行轮数之间的权衡关系，并揭示了固定与自适应共享随机性的差异。

title: GSExplorer: Interactive World Generation with a Persistent 3DGS World State
authors: Sicheng Yu, Liu Liu, Xinjie Wang, Xinjiang Wang, Taojun Ding, Wenhao Hu, Beizhen Zhao, Puxin Yan, Zhizhong Su, Hao Wang
abstract: Interactive world generation requires both accurate local control and stable scene consistency over long rollouts. Existing methods improve local generation through camera or geometry conditioning and extend historical context with memory mechanisms. However, long-horizon exploration remains challenging due to incomplete target-view guidance and inconsistencies accumulated during scene updates. We present \textbf{GSExplorer}, a generation--reconstruction framework built around a persistent 3D Gaussian world state. At each step, the current 3DGS scene provides multimodal rendering conditions for a video generator, while camera geometry is injected through a separate Relative Ray Encoding branch. Generated videos are then fed back to a SLAM-based reconstruction backend, where appearance and geometric consistency checks produce a shared support mask for selective scene updates and cross-chunk pose refinement. We further design a data-construction pipeline that reproduces realistic 3DGS degradation during scene extrapolation, yielding 293K training pairs of degraded multimodal renderings and real target videos. GSExplorer achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods on both single-step and three-step WorldScore evaluation, including a Camera Control score of 99.07 in single-step extrapolation. On 481-frame leave-and-return rollouts, it also shows strong revisit consistency.
zh_title: GSExplorer：基于持久化3DGS世界状态的交互式世界生成
translation: 交互式世界生成需要在长时程推演中兼具精确的局部控制和稳定的场景一致性。现有方法通过相机或几何条件增强局部生成，并利用记忆机制扩展历史上下文。然而，由于目标视角引导的不完整以及场景更新过程中累积的不一致性，长时程探索仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了GSExplorer，这是一个围绕持久化3D高斯（3DGS）世界状态构建的“生成-重建”框架。在每一步中，当前3DGS场景为视频生成器提供多模态渲染条件，同时通过独立的相对光线编码（Relative Ray Encoding）分支注入相机几何信息。生成的视频随后被反馈至基于SLAM的重建后端，通过外观与几何一致性检查生成共享支持掩码，以实现场景的选择性更新和跨分块位姿精炼。此外，我们设计了一个数据构建管线，用于重现在场景外推过程中真实的3DGS退化，从而生成了包含29.3万对退化多模态渲染与真实目标视频的训练数据。GSExplorer在单步和三步WorldScore评估中均取得了对比方法中的最佳综合性能，其中包括在单步外推中达到99.07的相机控制得分。在481帧的“离开并返回”漫游推演中，该方法也展现出强大的重访一致性。
tldr: GSExplorer通过持久化3D高斯泼溅世界状态与SLAM一致性更新后端，实现了高精度局部控制与长时程重访一致的交互式世界生成。
ai_comments: GSExplorer通过将持久化的3DGS表示与SLAM后端机制融合，有效解决了长程交互式世界生成中累积误差和视角外推不一致的核心难题。其提出的退化数据构造管线和双重一致性掩码更新机制，为视频生成与显式3D表征的闭环结合提供了极具参考价值的思路。
motivation: 交互式世界生成需兼顾精确局部控制和长程稳定一致性。现有方法依赖相机/几何条件或记忆机制，但由于目标视角指引不完整以及场景更新时累积的不一致性，长时程探索仍然面临巨大挑战。
method: 提出GSExplorer生成-重建框架：1) 以持久化3DGS作为全局世界状态，渲染多模态条件输入视频生成器，并通过相对光线编码注入相机几何；2) 将生成视频回传至基于SLAM的重建后端，通过外观与几何一致性检验生成共享支持掩码，进行选择性场景更新与跨分块位姿优化；3) 构建模拟3DGS外推退化的数据管线，生成29.3万对训练数据。
results: 在单步和三步WorldScore评估中均取得对比方法中的最佳综合表现，单步外推相机控制得分达99.07；在长达481帧的“离开并返回”漫游测试中表现出出色的重访一致性。
conclusion: GSExplorer通过持久化3DGS状态、SLAM式一致性更新及专门的数据退化微调，有效突破了长时序交互式世界生成的难题，显著提升了控制精度与重访一致性。

title: PhoneValue-Bench: A Dual-Ground-Truth Scorecard Benchmark for Smartphone Recommerce Inspection
authors: Zihan Deng, Chuanzhi Xu, Junjie Huang, Xiaozhen Zhong, Du Tiantian
abstract: Remote smartphone recommerce is scaling quickly, and locking a repurchase offer from seller photos and diagnostic screens before the handset arrives has become a central operational task. Existing multimodal resources mainly target defect localization, catalog attributes, or screen reading. They overlook payout-facing scorecards with dual cosmetic and operational ground truth under a declared input contract. This gap stems from two challenges: (1) the lack of a large weakly labeled trade-in corpus kept separate from a compact audited ranking cut, and (2) architectures that either flatten unordered photo bags into one prompt or collapse evaluation into a single price scalar. To address these challenges, we propose PhoneValue-Bench, a dual-ground-truth recommerce framework with PhoneValue-Corpus for weak training on 21,550 orders and 278,748 images, and PV-Rank as the only leaderboard on 335 quality-gated orders. Systems are ranked by CardScore under LeadGate, with Cosmetic Fill and Operational Fill as diagnostics, while grade and price stay off the board. Notably, ValueAgent is a six-stage perception-fusion reference that canonicalizes views, detects regional defects, reads screenshots, and fuses evidence under warehouse-style rules, so bag-of-images prompting is not the only evaluation unit. On the same PV-Rank cut and frozen scorer, this full-system and input-contract comparison finds ValueAgent at 84.1 CardScore against the strongest Flat Vision-Language Model at 69.9, with the largest reported gap in CosFill, while OpsFill remains limited under the two declared contracts. CardScore measures field-fill completeness, not quote accuracy.
zh_title: PhoneValue-Bench：用于智能手机回收检验的双地面真值评分卡基准
translation: 远程智能手机回收规模迅速扩大，在手机到达之前根据卖家照片和诊断屏幕锁定回购报价已成为核心运营任务。现有的多模态资源主要针对缺陷定位、目录属性或屏幕阅读。它们忽视了在声明的输入契约下具有双重外观和操作地面真值的面向支付的评分卡。这一差距源于两个挑战：（1）缺乏与紧凑审计排名切片分开的大型弱标签以旧换新语料库，以及（2）将无序照片包展平为一个提示或将评估折叠为单个价格标量的架构。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了PhoneValue-Bench，这是一个双地面真值回收框架，包含用于在21,550个订单和278,748张图像上进行弱训练的PhoneValue-Corpus，以及作为335个质量门控订单上唯一排行榜的PV-Rank。系统通过CardScore在LeadGate下进行排名，CosFill和OpsFill作为诊断指标，而等级和价格则不上榜。值得注意的是，ValueAgent是一个六阶段的感知融合参考，它规范化视图、检测区域缺陷、读取截图并根据仓库式规则融合证据，因此图像包提示不再是唯一的评估单元。在相同的PV-Rank切片和冻结评分器上，这种全系统和输入契约比较发现ValueAgent的CardScore为84.1，而最强的扁平化视觉语言模型为69.9，其中在CosFill中报告了最大的差距，而OpsFill在两个声明的契约下仍然受到限制。CardScore衡量的是字段填充的完整性，而不是报价的准确性。
tldr: 本文推出了用于二手手机回收检验的双地面真值基准PhoneValue-Bench及多阶段参考系统ValueAgent，显著提升了评分卡的评估与预测性能。
ai_comments: 该论文填补了二手手机回收（recommerce）领域中缺乏双地面真值评分基准的空白，提出了PhoneValue-Bench及相应的语料库和排行榜。创新性地引入了ValueAgent这一多阶段感知融合参考系统，改变了以往直接将图像包扁平化处理的粗放做法，对推动多模态模型在复杂垂直业务场景中的应用具有重要价值。
motivation: 现有的多模态资源主要针对缺陷定位、目录属性或屏幕阅读，忽视了在特定输入契约下具有双重外观和操作地面真值的面向支付的评分卡，且缺乏专门的弱标签回收语料库及细粒度评估基准。
method: 提出了PhoneValue-Bench框架，包含用于弱监督训练的PhoneValue-Corpus（包含21,550个订单和278,748张图像）以及用于评估的PV-Rank排行榜（包含335个质量控制订单）。同时设计了ValueAgent这一六阶段感知融合参考系统，用于规范视图、检测区域缺陷、读取截图并结合仓库风格的规则融合证据。
results: 在相同的PV-Rank测试集和冻结评分器下，ValueAgent取得了84.1的CardScore，显著优于最强的扁平化视觉语言模型（69.9分），特别是在外观填充（CosFill）指标上展现出最大差距。
conclusion: PhoneValue-Bench有效地解决了二手手机回收检验中缺乏双地面真值及结构化评分基准的难题，而ValueAgent则证明了多阶段感知融合方法在提升检验完整性方面的有效性。

title: Unconditionally $L^2$-stable explicit--implicit--null filtered Runge--Kutta methods for general nonlinear degenerate parabolic equations
authors: Yue Wu, Chi-Wang Shu
abstract: We develop unconditionally $L^2$-stable explicit--implicit--null (EIN) filtered Runge--Kutta (RK) methods for nonlinear degenerate parabolic equations with space-, time-, state-, and gradient-dependent diffusion coefficients. The methods are linearly implicit in the sense that they evaluate nonlinear terms explicitly and require only linear solves. Unlike classical EIN methods that are direct applications of implicit--explicit (IMEX) RKs, our construction is built upon explicit RKs. The key ingredient is two-sided symmetric filtering applied at each RK stage: a high-order filter is applied both before and after evaluating the original nonlinear residual. It leads to a dissipation estimate independent of the time step and retains the underlying RK order formally. Assuming time-dependent splitting operators with stagewise pointwise coefficient bounds, we rigorously prove non-increasing $L^2$ norm for arbitrary time steps. A quadratic matrix criterion covers explicit RK-based methods with positive weights, while strong stability preserving (SSP) compositions yield exact energy identities and weighted dissipation estimates. We present SSP methods through fourth order and a method based on the classical RK4. The framework accommodates spatial discretizations with discrete gradient structures including continuous Galerkin, Bassi--Rebay 1, the method of Brezzi et al., and local discontinuous Galerkin. Compatible summation-by-parts discretizations with simultaneous approximation terms are also covered in their discrete mass norm.
zh_title: 一般非线性退化抛物型方程的无条件 $L^2$ 稳定显-隐-零过滤 Runge-Kutta 方法
translation: 我们开发了针对具有空间、时间、状态和梯度依赖扩散系数的非线性退化抛物型方程的无条件 $L^2$ 稳定显-隐-零（EIN）过滤 Runge-Kutta (RK) 方法。这些方法在显式评估非线性项且仅需求解线性方程的意义上是线性隐式的。与作为隐式-显式 (IMEX) RK 直接应用的经典 EIN 方法不同，我们的构造建立在显式 RK 的基础之上。核心要素是在每个 RK 阶段应用双侧对称滤波：在评估原始非线性 residual 之前和之后都应用高阶滤波器。这导致了与时间步长无关的耗散估计，并形式上保留了底层 RK 的阶数。假设具有分阶段逐点系数界的时间依赖分裂算子，我们严格证明了任意时间步长下的非递增 $L^2$ 范数。二次矩阵准则涵盖了基于具有正权重的显式 RK 的方法，而强稳定性保持 (SSP) 组合产生了精确的能量恒等式和加权耗散估计。我们提出了高达四阶的 SSP 方法以及基于经典 RK4 的方法。该框架适应了具有离散梯度结构的空间离散化，包括连续 Galerkin、Bassi-Rebay 1、Brezzi 等人的方法以及局部间断 Galerkin。兼容的分部求和 (SBP) 离散化与同时近似项 (SAT) 也在其离散质量范数下得到了涵盖。
keywords: 显-隐-零过滤 Runge-Kutta 方法
非线性退化抛物型方程
tldr: 针对非线性退化抛物型方程，开发了一种在任意时间步长下无条件 $L^2$ 稳定的显-隐-零过滤 Runge-Kutta 方法。
ai_comments: 该论文针对非线性退化抛物型方程提出了一种无条件 $L^2$ 稳定的显-隐-零（EIN）过滤 Runge-Kutta 方法，通过在每个 RK 阶段应用双侧对称滤波，成功在任意时间步长下实现了耗散估计和非递增的 $L^2$ 范数，具有重要的理论创新和广泛的适用性。
motivation: 传统的 EIN 方法直接应用隐-显（IMEX）RK，为了克服在求解具有空间、时间、状态和梯度依赖扩散系数的非线性退化抛物型方程时的稳定性限制，需要开发无条件 $L^2$ 稳定的显-隐-零过滤 Runge-Kutta 方法。
method: 基于显式 Runge-Kutta 方法，在每个 RK 阶段应用双侧对称滤波（高阶滤波器在评估原始非线性残差前后均应用），并结合线性隐式求解和强稳定保持（SSP）组合。
results: 严格证明了在任意时间步长下非增加的 $L^2$ 范数，建立了适用于正权重显式 RK 方法的二次矩阵准则，并通过 SSP 组合给出了精确的能量恒等式和加权耗散估计，最高支持到四阶方法。
conclusion: 提出了一种用于一般非线性退化抛物型方程的无条件 $L^2$ 稳定显-隐-零过滤 Runge-Kutta 方法，并严格证明了其在任意时间步长下的能量稳定性。

title: OctreeSplat: Hierarchical Octree-Guided Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting
authors: Yibin Zhao, Yihan Pan, Wenli Yang, Jun Nan, Jianjun Yi
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has shown considerable potential for novel view synthesis (NVS) and 3D reconstruction. Feed-forward methods avoid costly per-scene optimization, but fixed image or spatial resolutions limit their ability to allocate primitives according to local complexity. We present OctreeSplat, a hierarchical octree-guided feed-forward Gaussian splatting. OctreeSplat extracts multi-view features and geometric priors from a frozen visual foundation model (VFM), constructs a hierarchical octree, and predicts densification scores. The resulting representation allocates Gaussian primitives at spatially varying densities according to local complexity. Stochastic solids volume rendering improves depth rendering, strengthens geometric supervision, and supports surface reconstruction. When camera parameters are available, an optional test-time optimization (TTO) module improves agreement between predicted and ground-truth parameters. Training updates only 76 million additional parameters and requires 35 GPU-hours. Experiments on Replica, TUM, Tanks and Temples, and DTU demonstrate competitive RGB view synthesis, depth synthesis, and surface reconstruction. OctreeSplat reduces the number of Gaussian primitives while maintaining high reconstruction quality.
zh_title: OctreeSplat：分层八叉树引导的前馈高斯溅射
translation: 三维高斯溅射（3DGS）在视点合成（NVS）和三维重建方面展现出巨大的潜力。前馈方法避免了耗时的每个场景优化，但固定的图像或空间分辨率限制了其根据局部复杂度分配基元的能力。我们提出了 OctreeSplat，一种分层八叉树引导的前馈高斯溅射方法。OctreeSplat 从冻结的视觉基础模型（VFM）中提取多视点特征和几何先验，构建分层八叉树，并预测致密化得分。由此产生的表示根据局部复杂度以空间变化的密度分配高斯基元。随机立体体素渲染改善了深度渲染，增强了几何监督，并支持表面重建。当相机参数可用时，可选的测试时优化（TTO）模块提高了预测参数与真实参数之间的一致性。训练仅更新 7600 万个附加参数，且需要 35 个 GPU 小时。在 Replica、TUM、Tanks and Temples 和 DTU 上的实验证明了其在 RGB 视点合成、深度合成和表面重建方面的竞争力。OctreeSplat 在保持高重建质量的同时减少了高斯基元的数量。
tldr: 提出了一种分层八叉树引导的前馈高斯溅射方法 OctreeSplat，能够根据局部复杂度自适应分配高斯基元，在减少基元数量的同时实现高质量的新视点合成与表面重建。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地结合了八叉树结构与前馈高斯溅射，利用视觉基础模型提取先验，实现了基于局部复杂度的自适应高斯基元分配，兼顾了渲染质量与存储效率。
motivation: 传统的前馈3D高斯溅射方法由于采用固定的图像或空间分辨率，限制了它们根据局部场景复杂度灵活分配高斯基元的能力。
method: 从冻结的视觉基础模型中提取多视图特征和几何先验，构建分层八叉树，预测致密化得分，从而在不同空间区域根据局部复杂度分配高斯基元；引入随机立体体素渲染以提升深度渲染和几何监督；并在相机参数可用时提供可选的测试时优化（TTO）模块。
results: 在 Replica、TUM、Tanks and Temples 和 DTU 数据集上的实验表明，该方法在 RGB 视点合成、深度合成和表面重建方面表现出竞争力，且在减少高斯基元数量的同时维持了高重建质量。
conclusion: OctreeSplat 能够有效解决传统前馈高斯溅射中固定分辨率无法自适应局部复杂度的问题，在减少高斯基元数量的同时保持了高质量的新视点合成、深度合成和表面重建。

title: Training Autoregressive Language Models on Rounded, Bounded, and Censored Numerical Labels via Exact Likelihood
authors: Jingquan Yan, Yuwei Miao, Yang Xie, Junzhou Huang
abstract: Numerical labels often specify a set of possible values: a measurement is rounded, a laboratory test reports only a bound, or a program is stopped at a timeout. We introduce boundary marginalization, the first method that trains an autoregressive language model on the exact likelihood of such observations through its existing digit tokens. A fixed-width, order-preserving numeral representation groups consecutive grid values under shared digit prefixes. An interval is a union of such groups, so its exact probability and gradient follow from at most two boundary paths, the successive digit prefixes of its endpoints, each of length logarithmic in the number of grid values. The resulting objective unifies precise, rounded, bounded, and censored supervision and trains digit decisions at the resolution supplied by each observation. The same computation supports exact distributional queries and unbiased gradients for the continuous ranked probability score on exact labels. Experiments show recovery of a conditional distribution from rounded and censored reports alone, improved likelihood on naturally censored molecular measurements, and more accurate code latency distributions on two backbones. Exact interval updates remain tractable as the numerical support grows to one million values.
zh_title: 通过精确似然在四舍五入、有界和删失数值标签上训练自回归语言模型
translation: 数值标签通常指定了一组可能的值：测量结果被四舍五入、实验室测试仅报告一个边界、或者程序在超时时停止。我们引入了边界边缘化（boundary marginalization）方法，这是第一种通过自回归语言模型的现有数字Token，在此类观测值的精确似然下对其进行训练的方法。固定宽度、保持顺序的数字表示法将连续的网格值组合在共享的数字前缀下。一个区间是此类组合的并集，因此其精确概率和梯度最多遵循两条边界路径（即其端点的连续数字前缀，每个前缀的长度随网格值数量呈对数增长）。由此产生的目标函数统一了精确、四舍五入、有界和删失的监督，并以每个观测值提供的分辨率训练数字决策。同样的计算支持精确分布查询和对精确标签的连续排位概率得分（CRPS）的无偏梯度。实验表明，仅从四舍五入和删失的报告中即可恢复条件分布，提高了自然删失分子测量的似然度，并在两个骨干网上获得了更准确的代码延迟分布。当数值支持度增长到一百万个值时，精确区间更新依然保持可计算性。
tldr: 提出了一种名为边界边缘化的新方法，使自回归语言模型能够直接且高效地利用四舍五入、有界和删失等不精确数值标签进行精确似然训练。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的边界边缘化方法，使得自回归语言模型能够直接在四舍五入、有界和删失的数值标签上通过精确似然进行训练。这一方法具有很强的通用性和实用性，能够很好地处理科学计算、测量和代码执行时间等多种实际场景中的不精确数值数据。
motivation: 现实世界中的数值标签往往是不精确的（如四舍五入的测量值、有界的实验室测试或超时停止的程序），现有的自回归语言模型缺乏一种统一且原则性的方法来直接利用这些受限或删失的数值标签进行精确似然训练。
method: 引入边界边缘化方法，利用固定宽度、保持顺序的数字表示法将连续网格值分组，通过端点的连续数字前缀（其长度随网格值数量呈对数增长）计算区间的精确概率和梯度，从而在现有数字Token上实现精确似然训练。
results: 实验表明，该方法能够仅从四舍五入和删失的报告中恢复条件分布，提高自然删失分子测量的似然度，并在两个骨干网上获得更准确的代码延迟分布，且在数值支持度增长到一百万时依然保持高效。
conclusion: 边界边缘化为自回归语言模型处理各种不精确数值标签提供了一种原则性且高效的精确似然训练方法，具有广泛的应用前景和良好的可扩展性。

title: VidDub: Replacement-Aware Supervision for Two-Step Video Dubbing
authors: Yexin Liu, Yunlong Lin, Zehan Wang, Guangxin He, Xinli Xu, Jiajun Zha, Yaofu Liu, Yueze Wang, Bowen Ping, Yuanming Li, Amie Wang, Bernard Ghanem, Bing Li, Harry Yang
abstract: Video dubbing aims to synthesize lip movements that match target speech while preserving the speaker identity, head pose, and background of a source video. Existing editors are predominantly trained via self-reconstruction under original paired audio, even though the source mouth becomes a conflicting target when driving speech is replaced. We introduce \emph{replacement-aware cross-audio supervision}: paired-audio samples use full-frame reconstruction, whereas unpaired replacement-audio samples mask out source-mouth reconstruction losses and supervise the mouth solely through audio--visual synchronization while preserving unmasked facial regions and background. Because offline dubbing provides the complete source video and target speech beforehand, we present \method, a full-context diffusion editor that uses matched trajectory regression to transfer CFG-guided teacher trajectories to a two-step student and distribution matching to recover visual quality after compression. We will release the curated training dataset, VidDub-Bench, fixed paired- and cross-audio evaluation manifests, preprocessing outputs, and unified evaluation code. Across three training seeds, masking out conflicting source-mouth reconstruction improves cross-audio Sync-C by 0.833. At two NFE, the final student provides the strongest cross-audio synchronization and visual-speech recognition among the evaluated methods, with competitive visual fidelity and source preservation.
zh_title: VidDub：面向两阶段视频配音的替换感知监督
translation: 视频配音旨在合成与目标语音相匹配的唇部动作，同时保留源视频的说话者身份、头部姿势和背景。现有的编辑器主要通过原始配音下的自重建进行训练，尽管当驱动语音被替换时，源嘴部会成为一个冲突的目标。我们引入了“替换感知交叉音频监督”：配对音频样本使用全帧重建，而未配对的替换音频样本掩盖了源嘴部重建损失，仅通过视听同步来监督嘴部，同时保留未掩盖的面部区域和背景。由于离线配音预先提供了完整的源视频和目标语音，我们提出了VidDub，这是一个全上下文扩散编辑器，它使用匹配的轨迹回归将CFG引导的教师轨迹迁移到两阶段学生模型中，并使用分布匹配在压缩后恢复视觉质量。我们将发布精选的训练数据集 VidDub-Bench、固定的配音和跨音频评估清单、预处理输出以及统一的评估代码。在三个训练种子中，掩盖冲突的源嘴部重建将跨音频 Sync-C 提高了 0.833。在两个 NFE 下，最终的学生模型在评估方法中提供了最强的跨音频同步和视觉语音识别，并具有竞争力的视觉保真度和源保留。
tldr: 提出VidDub，利用替换感知监督和两阶段扩散模型，解决了视频配音中替换语音时的嘴型冲突问题，实现了优异的视听同步与视觉保真度。
ai_comments: 该论文针对视频配音中当驱动语音被替换时源视频嘴型会成为冲突目标的问题，创新性地提出了“替换感知交叉音频监督”方法，并在两阶段视频配音中取得了极佳的视听同步效果与视觉保真度，极具实用价值。
motivation: 现有的视频编辑器主要通过原始配音进行自重建训练，然而当驱动语音被替换时，源视频的嘴型会变成一个冲突的目标，因此需要一种新的监督机制来解决这一矛盾。
method: 引入替换感知交叉音频监督（配音样本使用全帧重建，未配对的替换音频样本则掩盖源嘴部重建损失，仅通过视听同步监督嘴部），并提出VidDub（一个使用匹配轨迹回归和分布匹配的两阶段全上下文扩散编辑器）。
results: 在三个训练种子下，掩盖冲突的源嘴部重建将跨音频Sync-C提升了0.833；在2个NFE下，最终的学生模型在评估方法中提供了最强的跨音频同步和视觉语音识别能力，并具备有竞争力的视觉保真度和源身份保留。
conclusion: 通过引入替换感知交叉音频监督和两阶段扩散编辑器（VidDub），该论文有效解决了视频配音中语音替换时的冲突目标问题，实现了极佳的视听同步和视觉质量。

title: MAGE: Towards Generalizable Multi-timescale EEG Representations
authors: Tuan-Kiet Doan, Van-Chien Nguyen, Trung-Hieu Tran, Quang-Hung Pham, Ngoc-Son Vu, Huy Phan, Phi Le Nguyen, Duc-Han Le, Nikola Simidjievski, Van-Tam Nguyen
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) data plays an important role in understanding human brain activity, with various major applications. While current approaches, which largely build on EEG foundation models, have demonstrated strong performance across datasets and tasks, they typically rely on a fixed temporal scale. This design choice limits their ability to capture characteristics of neural dynamic behavior, often spanning across multiple timescales, which are naturally captured in EEG recordings. To address this limitation, we propose MAGE (\textbf{Multi-timescale Adaptive Generalization for EEG}), a foundation model that dynamically adapts to capture and integrate information across different timescales. Specifically, MAGE combines two key mechanisms: (i) a novel multi-timescale attention mechanism, capable of learning representations across multiple temporal scales and (ii) a trainable aggregation module, that dynamically identifies and adapts to the most informative timescale of the input signal. Experimental results across seven datasets demonstrate that MAGE consistently outperforms existing EEG foundation models while using substantially fewer parameters. Moreover, our results support the hypothesis that different downstream tasks benefit from distinct temporal scales.
comment: This work has been accepted to NeurIPS 2026
zh_title: MAGE：迈向可泛化的多时间尺度脑电图表征
translation: 脑电图（EEG）数据在理解人脑活动及其各种主要应用中发挥着重要作用。虽然目前大多基于EEG基础模型的现有方法在不同数据集和任务中表现出强劲性能，但它们通常依赖于固定的时间尺度。这种设计选择限制了它们捕捉跨多个时间尺度的神经动态行为特征的能力，而这些特征自然存在于EEG记录中。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了MAGE（面向EEG的多时间尺度自适应泛化），这是一个能够动态适应、捕捉并整合不同时间尺度信息的foundation model。具体而言，MAGE结合了两个关键机制：（i）一种新颖的多时间尺度注意力机制，能够在多个时间尺度上学习表征；（ii）一个可训练的聚合模块，能够动态识别并适应输入信号中最具信息量的时间尺度。在七个数据集上的实验结果表明，MAGE在大幅减少参数量的同时，持续优于现有的EEG基础模型。此外，我们的结果支持了不同的下游任务受益于不同的时间尺度的假设。
tldr: MAGE是一种新型的脑电图（EEG）基础模型，通过动态适应并整合多时间尺度的信息，在减少参数量的同时显著提升了跨任务和数据集的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文针对现有脑电图（EEG）基础模型依赖固定时间尺度的局限性，创新性地提出了多时间尺度自适应泛化模型（MAGE）。通过引入多时间尺度注意力机制和可训练的聚合模块，MAGE能够动态适应并整合不同时间尺度的信息。实验证明其在参数量显著减少的同时性能超越现有模型，验证了不同下游任务依赖不同时间尺度的假设，对脑电图基础模型的发展具有重要意义。
motivation: 当前的EEG基础模型通常依赖于固定的时间尺度，这限制了它们捕捉跨多个时间尺度的神经动态行为特征的能力，而脑电图记录本身自然包含了多时间尺度的信息。
method: 提出了MAGE模型，包含两个核心机制：（1）用于学习多个时间尺度上表征的新型多时间尺度注意力机制；（2）能够动态识别并适应输入信号最具信息量的时间尺度的可训练聚合模块。
results: 在七个数据集上的实验结果表明，MAGE在显著减少参数量的前提下，性能持续优于现有的EEG基础模型，并且证明了不同的下游任务受益于不同的时间尺度。
conclusion: 论文提出的MAGE模型成功实现了EEG多时间尺度特征的动态捕获与整合，在减少参数量的同时显著提升了跨数据集和任务的泛化性能，证实了不同任务对不同时间尺度的依赖性。

title: Distinguishing Extraction Failures and Clinical Discordance with LLM Uncertainty on Radiology Reports
authors: Jerjes Aguirre-Chavez, Shant Malkasian, Roshun Sankaran, Brendan Crabb, Albert Hsiao
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to structure data from unstructured text, but extraction errors remain inevitable. We evaluated whether LLM uncertainty could distinguish extraction failure from true clinical discordance. In 5{,}225 vessels from 1{,}045 patients undergoing coronary CT angiography (CCTA) for suspected coronary artery disease (CAD), we evaluated token-level and self-reported LLM uncertainty during extraction of vessel-level stenosis severity. Extraction failure was defined as disagreement between LLM-extracted stenosis and expert annotations. Clinical discordance was defined as disagreement in obstructive CAD status between CCTA and subsequent invasive coronary angiography (ICA). Incremental discrimination was assessed after adjustment for stenosis severity, calcium burden, and coronary vessel. Extraction failure was evaluated in 1{,}077 vessels from 253 patients with expert annotations, and clinical discordance in 1{,}641 vessels from 729 patients undergoing ICA within 90 days. Token-level Stenosis Margin showed the strongest association with extraction failure (adjusted OR, 4.15 [95\% CI, 2.57--6.69]; $P<0.001$) and clinical discordance (adjusted OR, 1.22 [95\% CI, 1.04--1.43]; $P=0.118$). Stenosis Margin significantly improved discrimination of extraction failure ($Δ$AUC, +0.06 [95\% CI, +0.03 to +0.09]; $P=0.001$), but not clinical discordance ($Δ$AUC, +0.01 [95\% CI, $-0.00$ to +0.02]; $P=0.245$). In a nested cohort of 138 vessels from 57 patients, 38 of 42 clinically discordant vessels (90\%) were extracted correctly. LLM uncertainty improved identification of extraction failure but not clinical discordance, suggesting that uncertainty may identify errors introduced during data extraction but may not generalize to discordance in underlying clinical data.
comment: Accepted as a spotlight presentation at ML4H 2026, published at Proceedings of Machine Learning Research 346
zh_title: 利用放射学报告中LLM的不确定性区分提取失败与临床不一致性
translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于从非结构化文本中提取结构化数据，但提取错误依然不可避免。我们评估了LLM的不确定性是否能够区分提取失败与真正的临床不一致。在1,045名因疑似冠状动脉疾病（CAD）接受冠状动脉CT血管造影（CCTA）的患者的5,225条血管中，我们在提取血管级狭窄严重程度时评估了Token级和自我报告的LLM不确定性。提取失败定义为LLM提取的狭窄度与专家注释不一致。临床不一致定义为CCTA与随后侵入性冠状动脉造影（ICA）之间的阻塞性CAD状态不一致。在校准狭窄严重程度、钙化负荷和冠状动脉血管后评估了增量区分能力。在带有专家注释的253名患者的1,077条血管中评估了提取失败，在90天内接受ICA的729名患者的1,641条血管中评估了临床不一致。Token级别的狭窄边界（Stenosis Margin）显示出与提取失败最强的关联（调整后OR为4.15 [95% CI, 2.57-6.69]; P<0.001），而与临床不一致的关联较弱（调整后OR为1.22 [95% CI, 1.04-1.43]; P=0.118）。狭窄边界显著改善了提取失败的区分度（ΔAUC, +0.06 [95% CI, +0.03至+0.09]; P=0.001），但未改善临床不一致的区分度（ΔAUC, +0.01 [95% CI, -0.00至+0.02]; P=0.245）。在包含57名患者的138条血管的嵌套队列中，42条临床不一致的血管中有38条（90%）被正确提取。LLM不确定性改善了对提取失败的识别，但未改善对临床不一致的识别，这表明不确定性可以识别数据提取过程中引入的错误，但可能无法推广至底层临床数据的 discordance。
tldr: 大语言模型的不确定性有助于识别放射学报告中的数据提取错误，但无法区分真实的临床不一致。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地探讨了利用大语言模型的不确定性来区分数据提取失败与真正的临床不一致，对于提高医疗文本结构化数据的可靠性具有重要意义。
motivation: 大语言模型在处理非结构化文本时常用于数据结构化，但提取错误不可避免，需要研究是否能利用LLM的不确定性来区分提取失败与真正的临床不一致。
method: 对5,225条冠状动脉CT血管造影（CCTA）数据进行评估，利用大语言模型提取血管级狭窄严重程度，分析模型在Token级别的自我报告不确定性（如狭窄边界 Stenosis Margin），并与专家注释及后续侵入性冠状动脉造影（ICA）结果进行对比。
results: Token级别的狭窄边界（Stenosis Margin）与提取失败显著相关（aOR=4.15），并显著提升了提取失败的区分度（ΔAUC=+0.06），但对临床不一致性的区分无显著提升。在临床不一致的血管中，90%被正确提取。
conclusion: LLM不确定性可以有效识别数据提取错误，但不能推广至底层临床数据的疾病不一致性。

title: MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification
authors: Jiaju Ma, Ashvini Kumar Jindal, Chuhua Wang, Sumithra Bhakthavatsalam
abstract: Large language models can generate motion graphics from static images and natural language requests, but it remains difficult to evaluate how well models follow requests that combine spatial, appearance, and temporal requirements. We introduce MotionGraphicsBench, an expert-curated benchmark of 100 instances for animating an input static SVG with a motion edit prompt. By supplying all required visual elements, our editing task reflects a designer-like workflow and isolates motion generation from graphic generation. Derived from real-world Lottie motion designs, our benchmark contains diverse combinations of spatio-temporal animation behaviors. Each benchmark instance pairs its model input with a deterministic, human-readable verification program that accepts different valid implementations and reports which prompt requirements pass or fail, rather than comparing against a reference animation or using a VLM judge. We construct these programs with a multi-agent pipeline using human-labeled animations and synthesized test cases. On a balanced test set of 180 animations, our programs achieve 93.3% raw agreement with human judgments, outperforming frontier VLM judges by 4.4%-12.8% while achieving at least 90% recall for both human approvals and rejections. Across 47 configurations from 32 LLMs and 12 providers, pass@1 ranges from 5.0% to 68.0%. Across 15 models at their highest reasoning effort, additional attempts improve every model, but pass@32 still ranges from 38.0% to 95.0%. Our analysis of verification programs reveals that generated animations often fail to match reference poses, follow requested motion trajectories, or coordinate related events. We fine-tune Qwen3.8-27B with group relative policy optimization (GRPO) using our verification programs as rewards, improving pass@1 from 30.31% to 52.19% on held-out instances. Our project page is at https://motion-graphics-bench.github.io/.
zh_title: MotionGraphicsBench：利用程序化验证评估动态图形生成
translation: 大语言模型可以根据静态图像和自然语言请求生成动态图形，但评估模型遵循结合了空间、外观和时间要求的请求的效果仍然很困难。我们引入了 MotionGraphicsBench，这是一个由专家策划的基准，包含 100 个实例，用于使用动态编辑提示对输入静态 SVG 进行动画处理。通过提供所有需要的视觉元素，我们的编辑任务反映了类似设计师的工作流程，并将运动生成与图形生成隔离。我们的基准源自现实世界的 Lottie 动态设计，包含多样化的时空动画行为组合。每个基准实例将其模型输入与确定性、人类可读的验证程序配对，该程序接受不同的有效实现并报告哪些提示要求通过或失败，而不是与参考动画进行比较或使用 VLM 评判。我们使用包含人工标注动画和合成测试用例的多智能体管道构建了这些程序。在一个包含 180 个动画的平衡测试集上，我们的程序与人类判断达到了 93.3% 的原始一致性，表现优于前沿 VLM 评判 4.4%-12.8%，同时对人类批准和拒绝均实现了至少 90% 的召回率。在来自 32 个 LLM 和 12 个提供商的 47 种配置中，pass@1 的范围从 5.0% 到 68.0%。在 15 个处于最高推理努力的模型中，额外的尝试改进了每个模型，但 pass@32 的范围仍然从 38.0% 到 95.0%。我们对验证程序的分析表明，生成的动画经常无法匹配参考姿势、遵循请求的运动轨迹或协调相关事件。我们使用验证程序作为奖励，通过群组相对策略优化（GRPO）微调了 Qwen3.8-27B，在保留实例上的 pass@1 从 30.31% 提高到 52.19%。我们的项目页面位于 https://motion-graphics-bench.github.io/。
tldr: 本文提出了 MotionGraphicsBench，这是一个通过程序化验证来评估大模型动态图形生成能力的基准测试，有效解决了现有 VLM 评判精度不足的问题，并能作为强化学习奖励提升模型性能。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种针对动态图形生成的基准测试 MotionGraphicsBench，创新性地采用程序化验证（Programmatic Verification）替代了传统的 VLM 评判，不仅精度高、可解释性强，还可以作为奖励机制用于模型微调（GRPO），为大模型在复杂时空动画生成上的评估与优化提供了重要工具。
motivation: 目前大型语言模型能够根据静态图像和自然语言生成动态图形，但缺乏有效的方法来评估模型遵循结合空间、外观和时间要求的复杂指令的能力。
method: 引入由专家策划的 100 个实例构成的基准测试 MotionGraphicsBench，每个实例包含静态 SVG 和动态编辑提示词，并利用多智能体管道构建确定性、人类可读的程序化验证方案；同时采用带群组相对策略优化（GRPO）的验证程序奖励进行模型微调。
results: 在平衡测试集上，程序化验证与人类判断的一致性达到 93.3%，超越了前沿的 VLM 评判；测试的 32 个 LLM 的 pass@1 率在 5.0% 到 68.0% 之间，通过微调可将特定模型的 pass@1 从 30.31% 提升至 52.19%。
conclusion: MotionGraphicsBench 填补了动态图形生成评估的空白，通过程序化验证准确衡量了当前大模型在空间、外观和时间多重要求上的生成能力，且验证程序可有效作为强化学习奖励提升模型性能。

title: Graphene: A Lightweight Transformer with Ising Mean-Field Refinement for Image Super-Resolution
authors: Seungki Hong, Taekwang Jang
abstract: This paper proposes Graphene, a lightweight image super-resolution architecture with two complementary feature refinement mechanisms: Ising-model-inspired local feature refinement using an Ising Refinement Block (IRB) and stage-history-based feature refinement using a History Attention (HistAttn) module. The IRB reuses attention output features and pre-softmax attention logits to construct signed pairwise token couplings within each local window, applies unrolled mean-field updates, and refines features through a gated residual correction. These signed couplings allow alignment and opposition between latent spins to modulate local feature refinement. HistAttn attends over the current stage output and earlier representations at the same token position and adaptively blends the current stage output with a history-weighted feature aggregate without adding spatial pairwise attention. On Urban100 at $\times4$, Graphene and Graphene-light improve over IET and IET-light by 0.24 dB and 0.38 dB, respectively, with 34.3%/13.7% fewer parameters, 44.8%/44.4% fewer FLOPs, 83.9%/95.9% lower latency, and 63.7%/92.0% lower peak memory. Real-world SR comparisons further show that Graphene recovers fine details and preserves textures across diverse degradations. Code and reference checkpoints are available at https://github.com/skethz/Graphene

title: MOSU2: Long-range Navigation System with Multi-modal Scene Understanding
authors: Jing Liang, Zhenyu Hou, Senthurbavan Kirubaharan, Md Safwan Mondal, Ashok Gudivada, Xuesu Xiao, Dinesh Manocha
abstract: Robots that travel long distances through public outdoor spaces must do more than avoid obstacles: they must remain on terrain suited to their mobility and decide when to proceed, yield, or detour around pedestrians, cyclists, vehicles, traffic signals, and temporary restrictions. These decisions are difficult because their correctness often depends on how a scene evolves, such as whether an approaching car is slowing or a cyclist will cross the robot's path. Vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret such cues, but they reason over images that lack metric geometry and motion. Supplying this evidence at every step is too slow for real-time navigation, and hand-crafted triggers cannot anticipate the open-ended variety of outdoor situations. We present MOSU2, a long-range navigation system with two-stage trajectory selection, in which first-stage contextual reasoning determines when additional evidence is needed and what to retrieve. Only when an interaction remains unresolved does the first stage trigger the second stage to retrieve geometric and dynamic information and align it with scene context to make navigation decisions. Building on MOSU, MOSU2 follows routes from GPS-based route planning and filters candidate trajectories through multi-modal traversability analysis before selecting a trajectory to move the robot. In real-world experiments spanning stop gestures, construction sites, crosswalks, and roads shared with vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians, MOSU2 raises mean navigation success from 61.8% to 94.2% and condition-detection accuracy from 72.2% to 91.4% over its single-image predecessor, at about 2.2 times its mean decision latency. Project website: https://jinggm.github.io/mosu2/

title: Prescriptive Learning of Linear Policies with Feasibility Guarantees for Binary Decision-Making
authors: Farzaneh Pourahmadi, Trine Krogh Boomsma, Pierre Pinson
abstract: Binary decision-making under uncertainty arises across a wide range of applications, including energy systems scheduling, transportation, and workforce planning. While machine learning has been increasingly applied to accelerate or replace mixed-integer solvers in such settings, existing approaches rely on predictive learning, training models to reproduce optimal decisions from labeled data, which lacks knowledge of counterfactual outcomes and provides no guarantees that the resulting decisions will be feasible. This limitation is further compounded under distributional shift, where policies trained on historical data may produce systematically infeasible decisions. We propose a prescriptive learning framework for binary decision-making that addresses both limitations. Rather than predicting optimal labels, the framework jointly optimizes over linear decision policies and feasible assignments across all training scenarios, allowing feasible alternatives and their operational performance to be considered directly during training. We further extend the framework to a distributionally robust chance-constrained formulation using a Wasserstein ambiguity set, which enforces feasibility with a prescribed probability under the worst-case distribution in the ambiguity set and enables a tunable trade-off between robustness and solution quality. We demonstrate the framework on two case studies, namely a unit commitment problem and a staff allocation problem. Out-of-sample experiments under test distributions that either match or differ from the training distribution show that the robust model is more conservative when the two distributions coincide, while under distributional shift it substantially reduces unmet demand and lowers total cost by up to 76.5% relative to classical predictive learning.

title: 2D Gum-Net: Unsupervised Dense Elastic Image Registration via Symmetric Correlation and Spectral Pooling
authors: Aarya Bhave, Anushka Ajay Bhave
abstract: Dense non-rigid registration, the recovery of a pixel-wise deformation field that warps one image into geometric agreement with another, is fundamental across medical imaging, structural biology, and correspondence estimation, yet learning-based approaches face a severe bottleneck: ground-truth deformation fields are notoriously difficult to obtain for real data. We present 2D Gum-Net, an end-to-end architecture that predicts dense elastic deformation fields fully unsupervised. We transfer the Geometric Unsupervised Matching Network (Gum-Net), originally developed for 3D subtomogram alignment in cryo-electron tomography, to 2D elastic registration: all three modules are redesigned in 2D, and the rigid transformation head is replaced by a Dense Spatial Transformer that regresses a sparse control-point grid, lifted to a full-resolution field $Φ$ by bicubic interpolation. Downsampling uses DCT spectral pooling, implemented as frozen-basis matrix multiplications ($\approx 50\times$ GPU speedup), preserving the fine, quasi-periodic structure that max and average pooling destroy. We evaluate on contact-based fingerprints, a challenging testbed for this task: locally self-similar ridge patterns make correspondence maximally ambiguous, skin pressed against a sensor generates authentic large-displacement elastic distortion, and minutiae act as precise landmarks through which an independent matcher externally verifies the topological correctness of predicted fields. Trained purely on synthetic impressions and evaluated zero-shot on real benchmarks, our method improves structural correlation by up to 15.7% on FVC2004 and raises genuine match scores under an independent matcher while leaving imposter scores essentially unchanged. This suggests that the predicted deformations restore true structure without fabricating correspondences.
comment: 19 pages, 11 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the NewInML Workshop at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

title: Lie Group Structure of Six-Degree-of-Freedom Rigid-Body Uncertainty Representation and Propagation
authors: Zhuochen Wang, Panagiotis Tsiotras
abstract: For six-degree-of-freedom rigid-body motion, the choice of Lie-group structure affects both how well the group-theoretic mean and covariance represent the state distribution and how accurately these moments are propagated. A quaternion-based, left-trivialized semidirect-product formulation of the velocity phase space is developed for the actuated body-frame dynamics, with closed-form group operations and Jacobians that avoid matrix-group embeddings. We derive the controlled stochastic dynamics and establish that the direct- and semidirect-product formulations describe the same physical process under the specified noise model. Since the semidirect exponential coordinates account for frame changes between body twists at different poses, they capture pose--twist coupling more naturally. A lunar powered-descent experiment assesses low-order moment representations of uncertainty and propagation performance under the proposed group structure using two distinct algorithms. Compared with direct-product formulations and a linearized baseline, the proposed structure improves the representation of the banana-shaped body-velocity distribution using group-theoretic moments, yields more consistent propagated moments, and produces distribution approximations that agree more closely with the Monte Carlo reference. In this experiment, changing the group structure accounts for most of the observed improvement, highlighting the practical value of the proposed semidirect-product formulation.

title: FlashREINFORCE: Critic-Free Single-Rollout Asynchronous RL for Agentic Language Models
authors: Jian Hu, Yifan Zhang, Hao Zhang, Binfeng Xu, Shaokun Zhang, Hongqing Peng, Zhiding Yu, Pavlo Molchanov, Jan Kautz, Yi Dong
abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning suits long-horizon agents with irregular rollout times, but group-relative updates require repeated rollouts of each prompt. However, group-based sampling limits prompt coverage at a fixed rollout budget and introduces group synchronization barriers. One rollout per prompt avoids these constraints but requires learning from stale, variable-length trajectories without a sibling baseline. We present FlashREINFORCE, to our knowledge the first critic-free single-rollout framework that scales to long asynchronous training and large models. It combines One-Batch REINFORCE, a Sequence Trust Region, and Sample-Mean Optimization, which provide prompt coverage and batch centering while controlling policy drift and length-amplified negative updates. Each component is easy to implement, and the result is their combination: a batch-mean baseline is stable under sample-mean loss, and each common alternative degrades or collapses training. FlashREINFORCE remains stable through 6,000 updates on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B at policy lag four, and through 1,450 on the 30B MoE Qwen3-30B-A3B at lag eight. Under identical loss, data, and lag it matches a strengthened group-relative baseline within 0.5 points, and with half the rollouts exceeds published synchronous baselines on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B (38.0 versus 36.3 five-benchmark mean). On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct it maintains tool use where GRPO stops calling tools and achieves 98.3%/96.5% seen/unseen ALFWorld success.

title: Run, Read Back, Refine: Observation Fidelity in Execution-Grounded EDA Agents
authors: Yang Liu, Shiwei Hou, Xiyuan Chen, Sen Yuan, Shao You, Feifan Chen, Wencheng Li, Shuyang Hu, Emma Xia, Xiaojing Lu, Wenchuan Zhang, Hao Wang, Fan Xu, Yanfeng Li, Hongwen Li, Yiming Zhu
abstract: Design engineers lose the most time orchestrating flows and patching the gaps where closed EDA tools refuse to interoperate. We present an execution-grounded LLM agent for PyAether, SKILL, and Tcl that closes a generate-execute-refine loop over unified MCP tools (API retrieval, documentation, sandbox execution) and is already deployed in production EDA flows, with a grounding-gap framework positing that EDA-scripting correctness is bottlenecked by observation fidelity at the L4 (situated) layer, which model scale alone cannot reach. On EDA-Scripting-Bench (449 tasks, three languages, four commercial runtimes), the system reaches 76.5% pooled Pass@1 versus 19.7% (pure LLM): the system-level observation axis spans 56.8 percentage points with the model fixed, exceeding the 23.3-percentage-point backbone range with the harness fixed---two axes answering different questions; observation is an under-invested axis whose returns are measurable and graded.
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Manuscript prepared for the DAC 2027 Research Track (IEEE conference format)

title: Composable Rewrites for Layouts of Algebraic Data Types
authors: Christophe Gyurgyik, Alexander J Root, Benjamin Driscoll, Gabriel Radanne, Fredrik Kjolstad, Clément Pit-Claudel
abstract:
Algebraic data types (ADTs) decouple the logical structure of data from physical layout choices that affect performance. For example, packing small fields into a word improves spatial locality, while storing co-accessed fields contiguously can enable vectorization. Such choices reinforce or undermine one another, with ramifications for compiler optimizations and memory management. Their interplay creates a combinatorial space of layouts with different runtime costs and memory footprints. The most favorable layout depends on the program's construction and destruction patterns, the characteristics of input data, and the target machine.
  Exploring this space requires control over layout decisions and a way to compose them while preserving program semantics. We provide both through rewrite rules over layouts, independent of any particular source language or bit-level encoding. Starting from a canonical layout derived from the ADT, these rules transform its representation while leaving the source program intact. We identify a local refinement criterion for proving each rewrite rule correct, so that layouts continue to represent every value and keep distinct values apart. Adding a new rule therefore only requires a proof satisfying this local criterion.
  We realize these rules in Isomer, a new pure functional programming language whose compiler specializes construction, pattern matching, and memory management to the chosen layouts. Using a default layout for all ADTs, Isomer achieves competitive performance against established functional compilers that automatically select layouts. Our rewrites further improve performance by tailoring layouts to each workload, permitting representations that prior work cannot attain or can only achieve through explicit changes to the source code.

title: SuperGlance: Driving at a Glance with a Vision-Language Model
authors: Jieyuan Pei, Xin Yan, Mingwei Xu, Haiyi Zhang, Siyu Zou, Zhangyi Hu, Zhuoxuan Li, Yuguang Yang, Rongjunchen Zhang, Cheng Chi, Hui Xiong, Yan Wang
abstract: Autonomous driving is turning to vision-language-action models (VLAs). They answer and plan by decoding, one step at a time. Each step is another forward pass, so a plan can take over a second of GPU time. Embodied AI often pairs such a slow, reasoning System 2 with a fast System 1 that acts. Human drivers plan at a glance, with System 1. Faster designs usually put System 1 outside the vision-language model (VLM), in a planner without its abilities. Yet before a VLM writes its first token, it has already read the scene into one hidden state. We show that, once trained, this hidden state is enough to drive and to answer questions about what the model sees. SuperGlance reads it to turn a decoder-only VLM into an encoder-style driving policy. Its linear head scores a fixed set of 5,273 candidate trajectories. With the set fixed, rewards are computed offline, so supervised targets can be reward-weighted and reinforcement learning maximizes the exact expected reward. Before and during policy training, multiple-choice training keeps the VLM's visual abilities in one pass, so the policy still answers questions about driving scenes. Training questions are built against shortcuts. Each must be answered right in two option orders. Against drift, a KL term keeps each stage near its starting model. One pass offers VLAs a more plausible path to System 1. SuperGlance answers visual multiple-choice questions as well as its base VLM does by decoding. It plans in 84 ms of GPU time, six times faster than Qwen-Drive-1.0, and at least as well on NAVSIM, PAI-AV and WOD-E2E. In AlpaSim closed loop, km per at-fault incident holds for both planners up to a 300-ms delay and drops beyond. With GPU time charged as delay, SuperGlance's lead over Qwen-Drive-1.0 grows from 2.8 to 3.9 times. Delayed by 1.2 s, our model falls below Qwen-Drive-1.0 at its own 518 ms.
comment: 22 pages, 10 figures, 20 tables. Project page: https://guobapei.github.io/SuperGlance/ ; code: https://github.com/GuobaPei/SuperGlance

title: Agentic On-Policy Distillation Implicitly Reshapes LLMs' ReAct Patterns
authors: Deyang Kong, Zhaoyi Li, Sijian Ren, Ying Wei, Defu Lian, Shikun Zhang, Wei Ye
abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers specialized capabilities to language-model agents, but its cross-domain effects on interaction remain unclear. We investigate how OPD reshapes ReAct interaction patterns across mathematics, ALFWorld, and $τ^2$-bench, focusing on reasoning, actions, and observation acquisition. General-reasoning supervision reduces mathematical tool attempts from 70.4% to 14.4% while increasing accuracy from 16.7% to 38.0%; code-interpreter supervision improves household actions and retail queries. In contrast, ALFWorld supervision reduces $τ^2$-bench accuracy from 41.5% to 6.6%, accompanied by frequent tool calls that violate user-information dependencies. To address negative transfer using only source-domain training trajectories, we explore selective OPD guided by teacher preference changes before and after domain-specific RL. Retaining the top 95% of positions raises $τ^2$ accuracy from 11.5% to 29.9% with a source-learning trade-off.

title: Live Noise Fingerprints for Quantum Program Analysis
authors: Avner Bensoussan, Karine Even-Mendoza, Debalina Banerjee, Elena Chachkarova, Sophie Fortz, Vasileios Klimis, Mohammad Reza Mousavi
abstract: Quantum programs are probabilistic in nature, and noisy execution due to current imperfect hardware further complicates their analysis. In this paper, we study abstract semantics for analysing quantum programs under these conditions. We introduce noise fingerprints, compact descriptions of the observable effects of noise relative to a finite interface of input states and output measurements. We use them to define our abstract domain with respect to the concrete noise-related behaviour. We relate the concrete and abstract domains through a probabilistic Galois connection, extending the Galois-connection framework to distribution-valued interpretations. We study the resulting abstraction in terms of observational soundness, conciseness, efficiency, and ability to adapt to changing noise. We show that polynomial-size interfaces yield exponentially smaller fingerprints than full noise models while preserving the chosen observations, and that fingerprint distance characterises the largest observational discrepancy over the chosen interface. Further, we develop ChanShadow, which reuses noise fingerprints of commonly used short program fragments to analyse noisy execution of whole programs and provides a uniform finite-sample error bound. We construct working examples showing how fingerprints support program analysis. We evaluate fingerprint precision, representation cost, measurement requirements, and behaviour under noise drift. On a synthetic benchmark, fingerprints retain $(99 \pm 1)\%$ of the noise strength information of a full noise model. On simulated noise drift, reusing earlier measurements reduces the number of fresh measurement rounds needed to reach an error tolerance of $0.10$ by a factor of $2.3$ at $95\%$ confidence and by a factor of $27$ under the median-error criterion.

title: ReCALM: A Residual-enhanced Crowdsourced Analytic Learning Mechanism for Distributed Continual Service Construction
authors: Kejia Fan, Yajiang Huang, Jianheng Tang, Jinfeng Xu, Huiping Zhuang, Anfeng Liu, Houbing Herbert Song, Yunhuai Liu
abstract: Crowdsourcing has emerged as a promising paradigm for constructing AI services by harnessing the collective capabilities of distributed workers. As consumers' demands continually evolve, service models must acquire new knowledge while retaining previously learned information. However, due to the inherited reliance on gradients for backpropagation, existing approaches typically suffer from catastrophic forgetting during continual model updates on heterogeneous data. Recent studies have introduced analytic learning, a gradient-free paradigm that achieves invariance through recursive closed-form solutions. Nevertheless, existing analytic methods are typically constrained by single-layer linear networks, which tend to suffer from underfitting due to their inability to perform deep representation learning. To address this issue, we propose ReCALM, a Residual-enhanced Crowdsourced Analytic Learning Mechanism that achieves deep nonlinear invariance for distributed continual service construction. Inspired by the success of ResNet, we develop gradient-free residual blocks for ReCALM with closed-form solutions. To implement distributed continual training for ReCALM, we further devise a cross-recursive strategy via least squares. Both theoretical and experimental analyses verify ReCALM's dual superiority in heterogeneity invariance and deep representation. With 20 residual layers, ReCALM improves accuracy by 8.85%-9.83% over the single-layer analytic baseline, while reducing computational costs by over 94% compared with gradient-based baselines.

title: Ambiguous Examples Help, But Full Data Wins: Revisiting Dataset Cartography for Extractive Adversarial QA
authors: Paul K. Mandal
abstract: Dataset cartography argues that training dynamics can reveal regions of a dataset that matter differently for learning: easy-to-learn examples aid optimization, hard-to-learn examples often expose annotation problems, and ambiguous examples contribute strongly to out-of-distribution generalization. A striking implication of the original work is that a model trained on only 33% ambiguous examples can outperform full-data training on several OOD evaluations, including a QNLI reformulation of SQuAD evaluated on Adversarial SQuAD. We revisit this claim in a stricter setting: open-ended extractive question answering, where models must predict answer spans rather than classify question-sentence pairs. For each encoder family, we compute clean-source SQuAD training dynamics, train on full, random, easy-ranked, ambiguous-ranked, and hard-ranked subsets, and evaluate robustness on adversarial-only AddSent and AddOneSent rows. Ambiguous-ranked 33% subsets beat random 33% subsets on exact-match accuracy in all 14 model-evaluation cells and on F1 in 12/14 cells. However, full-data training beats ambiguous-ranked training in 12/14 exact-match cells and 12/14 F1 cells, with mean full-minus-ambiguous gains of 3.40 EM and 4.10 F1. The most thoroughly replicated ELECTRA-small panel is also the main exception to the ambiguous-over-random F1 gains. These results show that clean-source cartography remains useful for reduced-data selection, but its OOD advantage does not carry over as a general replacement for full-data training in extractive adversarial QA.

title: Pros4D: Modeling Evolving 4D Worlds in Latent Space for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning
authors: Rongxin Gao, Dongxuan Liu, Chu Li, Chengyang Ji, Jialing Huang, Runyu Chen, Kairun Wen, Chenxin Li, Jingrui Ye, Haosong Zhen, Xinghao Ding, Yue Huang, Yuzhi Huang, Xiaotong Tu, Jingyan Jiang
abstract: Dynamic spatial reasoning from monocular video enables vision-language models (VLMs) to understand how 3D environments evolve over time, supporting physical world understanding and embodied intelligence. Existing efforts primarily address observed-dynamics understanding, whereas agents in dynamic environments also require future-dynamics prediction beyond the observation boundary. Moreover, external geometric processing and textual descriptions can increase inference complexity or lose information when representing continuous dynamics. These limitations motivate a shared internal state that preserves observed dynamics and remains predictive beyond the input video. Accordingly, we present Pros4D, a framework for modeling evolving 4D worlds in latent space that unifies retrospective understanding of observed-dynamics with prospective reasoning for future-dynamics prediction. Specifically, Pros4D-Engine derives geometry-grounded supervision and constructs paired examples for both tasks, while Pros4D-Bench evaluates them across eight spatial task categories spanning dynamic cameras, objects, and scenes. At the model level, Pros4D compresses observed dynamics into latent observed states and autoregressively rolls them forward into latent future states. 4D Latent Alignment (4DLA) grounds these states through complementary visual-semantic and geometric supervision, while joint language supervision connects them to task reasoning. Experiments across benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines in both capabilities.

title: Passable for Whom? Few-Shot Learning for Personal Calibration of Sidewalk Accessibility Perception for Human-Centered Autonomous Driving
authors: Wesley Maia, Angel Martinez-Sanchez, Maitrayee Keskar, Ross Greer
abstract: Whether a sidewalk is passable depends on who is trying to pass: people who use the same mobility aid disagree about the same image, so one label per scene, or per aid, is wrong for many of them. We introduce few-shot personal accessibility perception: from K answers of a person never seen before, predict their judgment of sidewalk scenes never seen before. PassCal separates a shared description of the scene from the person's interpretation of it. The description comes from the internal state of a frozen vision-language model (VLM) and from barrier type, severity and context properties predicted by a detector trained on 14.9k public audits; the interpretation, a calibration of the person's response style and a weighting of the properties, is fit from their answers. On 8,883 judgments in which each of 135 verified mobility-aid users rated the same 50 sidewalk scenes, with people and scenes both held out, eight answers lower the Brier score from 0.550 to 0.479. The same VLM prompted with those answers reaches 0.562, and the same calibration without the scene 0.521. Conformal risk control turns predictions into passable, blocked or "depends on you" statements with a bounded expected rate of wrong statements over people; at 5%, eight answers raise the share of decisive scenes from 27% to 42%. Audit-supervised properties improve all sixteen vision and VLM encoders we test and outperform attributes from a sidewalk navigation VLM.

title: Machine interpreting competitiveness: a discourse-sensitive comparison of meaning and target-language quality in English-Chinese simultaneous interpreting
authors: Yuanyuan Ding
abstract: Machine interpreting (MI), or AI-enabled speech translation, is increasingly visible in professional and public-facing communication, yet its performance relative to human simultaneous interpreters remains insufficiently understood. Existing studies are often limited by a single discourse mode and evaluation frameworks that are not well aligned with interpreting as a discourse-level communicative activity. The present study compares five commercial MI systems with 26 human interpreters (14 professionals, 12 advanced students) on English-to-Chinese simultaneous interpreting across planned and unplanned discourse, focusing on meaning and target-language quality. In these materials, MI performance differed sharply between the two discourse modes. In the planned formal speech, the strongest system became highly competitive on meaning, entering the upper human range, and a second system also performed strongly. In the extemporaneous interview, however, no MI system approached the stronger human tiers. Code-level analysis further shows that similar overall scores often masked different error profiles. Human interpreters were more likely to preserve the broader communicative trajectory through selective omission, restructuring, and contextual inference, whereas even the best MI systems were more vulnerable to semantic distortion, discourse-tracking failures, and context-insensitive interpretation. On target-language quality, the human advantage proved more stable than on meaning. Unintelligible or nonsensical output and disfluency carryover emerge as particularly salient weaknesses in machine performance, especially in spontaneous discourse. Overall, the findings are consistent with a discourse-sensitive account of where MI appears competitive, where it remains limited, and why these distinctions matter for interpreting practice, interpreter education, and future MI development.
