title: CiGS: Conduction in Gaussian Splats for Interior Temperature Field from Thermal Images
authors: Liu Zhenyuan, Bharath Seshadri, Bailey Miller, George Kopanas, Ioannis Gkioulekas, Bernd Bickel
abstract: We present a method for inferring the interior temperature distribution of a solid object from registered multi-view visible-spectrum and thermal images, even when the thermal views cover only part of its surface. We formulate steady-state heat conduction as a Laplace boundary value problem and solve it with a direct boundary integral equation discretized over a point cloud: a Gaussian reconstruction of the visible-spectrum images supplies the boundary geometry, and the thermal images supply the boundary data. We do not build surface or volume meshes at any stage in our method. Instead, we sample collocation points from rendered depth without the pixels at depth discontinuities, and use a density subtraction that keeps the interior evaluation accurate up to the surface. The whole chain is differentiable, and we use it to recover the pose and depth of heating pipes, insulation defects, and the shape of cracks from thermal images. We validate our method through experiments on boundary value problems with Dirichlet-only and mixed Dirichlet and Robin boundaries, using synthetic and real captured data on scenes with challenging topology. These experiments show that our method matches analytical solutions and has better accuracy than FEM solvers.

title: ReactBench-AD: Do Driving VLAs and World-Action Models React to Imminent Hazards in Their Path?
authors: Nikos Theodoridis, Reenu Mohandas, Sushil Sharma, Ciarán Hogan, Ganesh Sistu, Anthony Scanlan, Tim Brophy, Ciarán Eising
abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) and World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged in autonomous driving with the promise of strong generalization to long-tail scenarios. Although these models achieve state-of-the-art results on autonomous driving benchmarks, most existing benchmarks are dominated by nominal scenarios and therefore cannot test this promise. To test one such long-tail capability that is critical for safety, we introduce ReactBench-AD, a benchmark that measures how driving models react to objects that appear in the ego vehicle's path. Built on real NAVSIM and PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles scenes, ReactBench-AD composites a crossing pedestrian, a standing pedestrian, or a stationary car consistently across all camera views and history frames. Each edited scene thus forms an exact, pixel-level counterfactual pair with its original, which allows us to isolate the causal effect of the inserted object on the predicted trajectory. Evaluating four VLAs and two WAMs, we find that they react weakly, often barely at all. Finally, we test how easily one of the evaluated VLAs, ReCogDrive, can be taught to brake hard for imminent hazards: a short fine-tuning stage on edited scenes substantially improves its reactions, with the learned behavior generalizing to unseen objects and fully real scenes, at minimal cost to nominal driving. These results call into question the out-of-the-box long-tail capabilities of these models, but suggest that they can be a strong foundation for acquiring them with little additional training, highlighting the value of real or synthetic data that demonstrates the long-tail behaviors nominal datasets rarely contain.

title: Social Welfare and Equilibrium in Distributed Microgrid Prosumer Coordination Under a Mixed Competitive-Cooperative Setting
authors: Mahan Fakourifard, Elizabeth L. Ratnam, Mingxi Liu
abstract: Price-based distributed prosumer coordination in distribution networks is fundamentally challenging when the aggregator pursues grid-level goals that couple prosumers' decisions, because the Lagrangian fails to separate and nodal prices are undefined under conventional dual decomposition. This paper develops a novel method that embeds mixed competitive-cooperative objectives exactly into prices, which are split into energy, congestion, and grid-objective components, closing the gap between the social welfare optimum and the competitive equilibrium. To compute the equilibrium, a distributed optimization algorithm is developed based on the projected Arrow-Hurwicz-Uzawa scheme. Explicit step-size rules are developed for the algorithm to guarantee $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{L})$ and $\mathcal{O}(1/L)$ ergodic convergence rates. Simulations on an IEEE 33-bus feeder that is connected to prosumers and electric vehicle fleets validate the accuracy and efficacy of the proposed methods.
comment: This paper is submitted to IEEE transactions on control of network systems

title: BlockAlign: Preference Optimization for Trajectory-Distilled Video Generation
authors: Jingyuan Zhu, Biaolong Chen, Yangyang Qin, Shengyang Shen, Yaohua Wang, Weiming Bai, Miao Lu, Aixi Zhang
abstract: Directly aligning trajectory-distilled video generators slashes rollout costs and optimizes the deployed few-step model without teacher fine-tuning or re-distillation. However, conventional flow-matching preference objectives assume single-head local velocity supervision, mismatching the finite-interval, block-average transition interface of trajectory-distilled generators such as Parallel Decoding Distillation (PDD) and Parametric Trajectory Distillation (PTD). Naively supervising individual unfused sub-interval velocity heads across all sub-steps rather than the fused block-average velocity at block starts (DirectAlign) induces a severe training--inference mismatch that degrades preference below the unaligned baseline. We introduce BlockAlign, an interface-consistent preference optimization framework that constructs states at valid block boundaries, queries the fused block-level velocity predictor, and supervises span-normalized transition residuals---seamlessly supporting DPO-, NFT-, and rollout-style objectives while preserving the native few-step sampler. We further build a unified post-training pipeline integrating offline pairs, reward-free semi-online continuations, and online rollouts with hierarchical preference selection and objective-aware block scheduling. Experiments on multi-reference video generation across MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA and an in-house model RefVid-V4 show that BlockAlign consistently outperforms unaligned distilled models and DirectAlign in structural plausibility, reference consistency, and visual quality. Notably, our approach unlocks PDD's 5x few-step rollout speedup for 3x faster end-to-end online training, achieving statistically significant human preference gains over PDD baselines (54.0% vs. 33.3% wins/losses, or 61.8% non-tie win rate on RefVid-V4; 51.3% vs. 34.7%, or 59.7% non-tie win rate on MiniMax-H3) and up to an 82.7% win rate against DirectAlign.

title: Signs of Wear: Evaluating Intelligent Speed Assistance Under Synthetic Adverse Conditions
authors: Johannes Fabian Hahn, Mao Shan, Julie Stephany Berrio Perez
abstract: Intelligent Speed Assistance (ISA) systems rely on cameras to recognize speed-limit signs, yet existing benchmarks underrepresent the weathered, dirty, and overgrown signs commonly encountered on rural roads. We use generative image editing to introduce different forms of wear into real street-level images of speed-limit signs. The resulting ISA-Wear dataset contains paired original and edited images. Guided by text instructions, a multimodal image-editing model adds snow, rust, vegetation, faded paint, or mud to the speed-limit sign in a street-level frame at three severity levels. Where appropriate, the surrounding scene is adapted as well, and the viewpoint is kept. Every edited frame has an unedited counterpart, and we only evaluate frames whose original is recognized correctly, so any failure can be attributed to the wear. Since the model alters the sign's geometry in 21\% of the edits, all edits are filtered by a geometric check and a manual review. Severity is measured as the LPIPS distance between the original and the edited sign plate. On 716 worn frames, we find that in detect-then-read pipelines, wear breaks detection before it breaks reading. The detector finds only 62\% of the worn signs, even though it finds every one of them in the original frames. Missed detections account for 78--87\% of failed reads, a pattern that a zero-shot detector shares. Given the annotated sign box, as in the crop-based benchmarks, a classifier still reads 78\% of the worn signs, but only 56\% when it has to rely on the detector

title: Up or down at every integer: Collatz-type maps of arbitrary sets and the up-down graph
authors: Oleg Vasilyev
abstract: For a set $S$ of positive integers let $T_S$ send $x$ to $\lceil 3x/2\rceil$ if $x\in S$ and to $\lceil x/2\rceil$ otherwise. The odd numbers give the Collatz map, the even numbers give it again after a shift by one, and $S=\mathbb{N}$ gives Mahler's map $x\mapsto\lceil 3x/2\rceil$. All these maps are subgraphs of the up-down graph $G$, in which every $x$ has the edges $x\to\lceil x/2\rceil$ and $x\to\lceil 3x/2\rceil$, and so are the families of maps in which the direction is forced at some numbers and free at the others. The cycles of the maps are the simple cycles of the subgraph, their divergent orbits are its rays, and all maps of a family are bounded exactly when the subgraph has no ray. We classify the simplest sets and show that density says little: some sets of density one send every orbit to 1, and some periodic sets of arbitrarily small density have increasing orbits. Every positive integer is the least element of a cycle of some map. The critical proportion of steps up is $\log_3 2$: cycles stay below it, divergent orbits stay above it, and both come arbitrarily close. For sets periodic modulo a power of 2, an effective up-frequency from a finite Markov chain takes the place of the density, and a finite computation can prove that every orbit reaches a cycle. Mahler's Z-number problem is implied by a question about one such map. Finally, we ask how far the Collatz map is from maps whose behaviour can be proved. Finite changes never help. Adding fewer than $\log_{3/2}N+1$ even numbers below $N$ makes an orbit increase, while removing the odd numbers congruent to 9 or 15 modulo 16, an eighth of all integers, gives a map all of whose orbits provably reach the cycle (1,2); removing 22 residue classes modulo 512, a proportion 0.043, also suffices.

title: Beyond Family Labels: A Taxonomic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Prior for Avian 3D Shape Recovery
authors: Yunchan Jeon, SooGon Kim, Seungwook Kim, CheolWon Lee, Jongmin Lee
abstract: Recovering 3D pose and shape of birds from single images is bottlenecked by the long tail of avian diversity: out of ~10,000 species, only a few dozen have 3D-labeled training data, and in-the-wild test sets routinely contain species never seen at training. Generalizing across clades is therefore a central problem. The current state of the art, AniMer+, mitigates it with a family-level contrastive loss that conveys only a binary same-family indicator per pair and discards the continuous structure of the species tree. We propose a taxonomic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck prior on the shape code of the AVES parametric bird mesh model: a multivariate Gaussian whose covariance decays exponentially with Linnaean rank distance, with a learnable selection strength and noise scale. The prior generalizes family contrastive into a continuous, generative form, exposing the graded cross- and within-family similarity that a binary indicator cannot, and brings continuous comparative phylogenetics in as a biology-grounded inductive bias for the long tail. Our method improves over AniMer+ on both metrics of the unseen-species CowBird benchmark and on CtrlAVES3D, while remaining comparable on seen-species CUB. A permutation ablation isolates taxonomic structure from generic Gaussian smoothing, and a rank-granularity ablation identifies cross-order distinctions (the structure beyond a family-vs-not indicator) as the dominant source of the unseen-species gain.

title: Exploring the link between predictive uncertainty and the sim-to-real gap in deep learning models utilizing synthetic data
authors: Alexander Moriz, Lukas Krebs, Amon Göppert, Robert H. Schmitt
abstract: Today, state-of-the-art methods for quality control (QC) are based on Machine Vision, combining deep learning (DL) models with camera-based inspection. Yet, the integration of such solutions in industrial applications is often impeded by data sparsity and trust in model reliability. While synthetic data offers a promising approach to generate the necessary data with perfect annotations, it poses risks related to performance degradation due to the possible occurrence of the sim-to-real gap. This study conducts experiments using the ensemble method to estimate the predictive uncertainty of DL models trained on synthetic data. The results show that predictive uncertainty increases under the sim-to-real domain shift. However, the observed performance drop is dominated by a systematic sim-to-real bias rather than by ensemble disagreement.These findings contribute to the effective utilization of synthetic data in industrial settings while highlighting the importance of risk assessment for the deployment of DL solutions for QC tasks.

title: Constant-Factor Matching-Size Estimation in Random-Order Streams
authors: Alireza Farhadi, Mohammad Hajiaghayi, Morteza Monemizadeh
abstract:
We give a one-pass algorithm that estimates the maximum matching size of an arbitrary simple graph within a constant factor using $O(\log^2 n)$ bits of space. The edges arrive exactly once in uniformly random order. The algorithm succeeds with probability at least $2/3$, does not require the number of edges in advance, and has worst-case total running time $O((m+1)\log(n+2))$ on a word RAM.
  Kapralov, Khanna, and Sudan (SODA 2014) obtained a polylogarithmic approximation in polylogarithmic space. Kapralov, Mitrović, Norouzi-Fard, and Tardos (SODA 2020) subsequently gave a constant-factor approximation from independent uniform edge samples and an $O(\log^2 n)$-approximation in random order. We obtain a constant factor in the latter model with the same $O(\log^2 n)$ space bound.
  The main ingredient is a comparison between the memory states of a recursive sampling algorithm under sampling with and without replacement. We account jointly for the sampled edges retained by the recursion and the positions at which they arrived. Randomized thresholds limit the additional information stored in numerical counters. A bound on the expected work of the entire recursion then removes the loss from its logarithmic depth. The resulting estimator repeatedly improves a coarse estimate while storing only one recursion stack.

title: Embedding Cosine Measures Text Length Before It Measures Homogenization
authors: Fengming Liu, Mingyu Shu
abstract: Mean pairwise cosine similarity between transformer embeddings is a standard measure of whether online discourse is converging under generative AI. When the embeddings are mean-pooled outputs of an encoder never trained for sentence similarity, this measure mostly tracks text length. In 6.06 million Reddit comments, an uncentered DeBERTa-v3 measure had suggested that only conservative discourse broke toward homogeneity after late 2022. Truncating the same comments from 10 to 150 words raises their mean cosine by eight times the reported break. A placebo that swaps every comment for a random one of equal length reproduces 81% of the asymmetry, and a fixed-content simulation reproduces 78%. The leading principal direction carries 99.9% of raw DeBERTa homogeneity, and once length is handled the asymmetry disappears under every encoder. On 575,000 Stack Exchange answers the measure reports a post-ChatGPT homogenization of technical sites that the placebo fully reproduces, although answers grew longer. A census of 31 studies locates the risk where anisotropic encoders meet time-series or length-unequal designs. A reverse control on a well-known experiment shows that centering with renormalization can reverse a genuine effect. We propose a low-cost diagnostic protocol. Corrected measures show that the two political camps converged between 2019 and 2022 and stopped converging before ChatGPT. Cross-camp replies engage their targets more closely than same-camp replies.

title: Jetriever: Shifting Agent Memory Retrieval from Similarity to Utility
authors: Ruizhe Li, Licheng Zhang, Mingxuan Du, Zhendong Mao
abstract: Whether a stored memory helps answer a user's question often depends on world knowledge rather than surface similarity. Jetriever replaces similarity search with full-pool utility scoring: given a query, it uses Jev, an LLM-derived System One decision model, to score every stored memory for the probability that it is useful to the answer, ranking the memory pool directly by those probabilities. On InMind's 125 indirect-query tasks, Jetriever places the gold exchange first in 84.8% of cases (versus 1.6% for BM25 and 0.0% for MiniLM with user-turn indexing) and reaches 76.0% end-to-end Application, compared with at most 16.0% across published retrieval and memory systems. A controlled 20-question comparison disentangles recognizing implicit evidence from ranking it properly: Jev and Qwen3.5-9B both recover 90% of gold exchanges within the top 50 (versus 30% for the BERT-based decision model Laya), yet at rank 1 Jev reaches 85% while Qwen3.5-9B drops to 40%. On a dimension-proportional random sample of 60 MemoryAgentBench questions, Jetriever raises the four-dimension average from 44.3% (ReFind) to 55.4%, at a mean retrieval cost of USD 0.00834 per InMind query and USD 0.03103 per MAB query. Together, these results show that effective utility retrieval hinges on combining broad world knowledge, calibrated ranking probabilities, and affordable full-pool evaluation.

title: Mask-guided Spectral-wise Transformer for Efficient Hyperspectral Image Reconstruction
authors: Yuanhao Cai, Jing Lin, Xiaowan Hu, Haoqian Wang, Xin Yuan, Yulun Zhang, Radu Timofte, Luc Van Gool
abstract: Hyperspectral image (HSI) reconstruction aims to recover the 3D spatial-spectral signal from a 2D measurement in the coded aperture snapshot spectral imaging (CASSI) system. The HSI representations are highly similar and correlated across the spectral dimension. Modeling the inter-spectra interactions is beneficial for HSI reconstruction. However, existing CNN-based methods show limitations in capturing spectral-wise similarity and long-range dependencies. Besides, the HSI information is modulated by a coded aperture (physical mask) in CASSI. Nonetheless, current algorithms have not fully explored the guidance effect of the mask for HSI restoration. In this paper, we propose a novel framework, Mask-guided Spectral-wise Transformer (MST), for HSI reconstruction. Specifically, we present a Spectral-wise Multi-head Self-Attention (S-MSA) that treats each spectral feature as a token and calculates self-attention along the spectral dimension. In addition, we customize a Mask-guided Mechanism (MM) that directs S-MSA to pay attention to spatial regions with high-fidelity spectral representations. Extensive experiments show that our MST significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods on simulation and real HSI datasets while requiring dramatically cheaper computational and memory costs. Code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/MST/ . An online Gradio demo is available on HuggingFace at https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/MST

title: HDNet: High-resolution Dual-domain Learning for Spectral Compressive Imaging
authors: Xiaowan Hu, Yuanhao Cai, Jing Lin, Haoqian Wang, Xin Yuan, Yulun Zhang, Radu Timofte, Luc Van Gool
abstract: The rapid development of deep learning provides a better solution for the end-to-end reconstruction of hyperspectral image (HSI). However, existing learning-based methods have two major defects. Firstly, networks with self-attention usually sacrifice internal resolution to balance model performance against complexity, losing fine-grained high-resolution (HR) features. Secondly, even if the optimization focusing on spatial-spectral domain learning (SDL) converges to the ideal solution, there is still a significant visual difference between the reconstructed HSI and the truth. Therefore, we propose a high-resolution dual-domain learning network (HDNet) for HSI reconstruction. On the one hand, the proposed HR spatial-spectral attention module with its efficient feature fusion provides continuous and fine pixel-level features. On the other hand, frequency domain learning (FDL) is introduced for HSI reconstruction to narrow the frequency domain discrepancy. Dynamic FDL supervision forces the model to reconstruct fine-grained frequencies and compensate for excessive smoothing and distortion caused by pixel-level losses. The HR pixel-level attention and frequency-level refinement in our HDNet mutually promote HSI perceptual quality. Extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluation experiments show that our method achieves SOTA performance on simulated and real HSI datasets. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/MST . An online Gradio demo is available on HuggingFace at https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/MST
zh_title: HDNet：用于光谱压缩成像的高分辨率双域学习
translation: 深度学习的快速发展为高光谱图像（HSI）的端到端重建提供了更好的解决方案。然而，现有的基于学习的方法存在两个主要缺陷。首先，带有自注意力的网络通常牺牲内部分辨率以平衡模型性能与复杂性，导致丢失细粒度高分辨率（HR）特征。其次，即使专注于空间-光谱域学习（SDL）的优化收敛到理想解，重建的HSI与真实图像之间仍然存在显著的视觉差异。因此，我们提出了一种用于HSI重建的高分辨率双域学习网络（HDNet）。一方面，所提出的HR空间-光谱注意力模块及其高效的特征融合提供了连续和精细的像素级特征。另一方面，引入频率域学习（FDL）用于HSI重建，以缩小频率域差异。动态FDL监督强制模型重建细粒度频率，并补偿像素级损失引起的过度平滑和失真。我们HDNet中的HR像素级注意力和频率级细化相互促进HSI的感知质量。广泛的定量和定性评估实验表明，我们的方法在模拟和真实HSI数据集上均实现了SOTA性能。代码和模型将发布在https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/MST。HuggingFace上提供了在线Gradio演示：https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/MST。
tldr: HDNet提出了一种高分辨率双域学习网络，通过结合HR空间-光谱注意力模块和频率域学习，解决了现有高光谱图像重建方法中分辨率损失和视觉差异大的问题，实现了SOTA性能。
ai_comments: HDNet的创新性在于其双域学习策略，特别是在引入频率域学习来解决像素级损失导致的平滑和失真问题。通过结合HR空间-光谱注意力与频率域监督，该方法有效地弥补了现有方法的缺陷，在保持高分辨率特征的同时提升了重建图像的感知质量，为高光谱图像重建领域提供了新的视角和解决方案。
motivation: 现有基于深度学习的高光谱图像（HSI）重建方法存在两个主要缺陷：一是自注意力网络通常牺牲内部分辨率以平衡性能与复杂性，导致丢失细粒度高分辨率特征；二是即使空间-光谱域学习（SDL）优化达到理想解，重建的HSI与真实图像之间仍存在显著的视觉差异。
method: 本文提出了一种高分辨率双域学习网络（HDNet）用于HSI重建。该网络一方面通过高分辨率空间-光谱注意力模块及其高效特征融合提供连续且精细的像素级特征；另一方面，引入频率域学习（FDL）来缩小频率域差异，并通过动态FDL监督强制模型重建细粒度频率，补偿像素级损失造成的过度平滑和失真。HDNet中的HR像素级注意力和频率级细化相互促进HSI的感知质量。
results: 广泛的定量和定性评估实验表明，所提出的方法在模拟和真实HSI数据集上均达到了SOTA（State-of-the-Art）性能。
conclusion: HDNet通过创新的高分辨率双域学习策略，有效解决了现有高光谱图像重建方法的局限性，显著提升了重建图像的感知质量，并在多个数据集上取得了最先进的性能。

title: Degradation-Aware Unfolding Half-Shuffle Transformer for Spectral Compressive Imaging
authors: Yuanhao Cai, Jing Lin, Haoqian Wang, Xin Yuan, Henghui Ding, Yulun Zhang, Radu Timofte, Luc Van Gool
abstract: In coded aperture snapshot spectral compressive imaging (CASSI) systems, hyperspectral image (HSI) reconstruction methods are employed to recover the spatial-spectral signal from a compressed measurement. Among these algorithms, deep unfolding methods demonstrate promising performance but suffer from two issues. Firstly, they do not estimate the degradation patterns and ill-posedness degree from the highly related CASSI to guide the iterative learning. Secondly, they are mainly CNN-based, showing limitations in capturing long-range dependencies. In this paper, we propose a principled Degradation-Aware Unfolding Framework (DAUF) that estimates parameters from the compressed image and physical mask, and then uses these parameters to control each iteration. Moreover, we customize a novel Half-Shuffle Transformer (HST) that simultaneously captures local contents and non-local dependencies. By plugging HST into DAUF, we establish the first Transformer-based deep unfolding method, Degradation-Aware Unfolding Half-Shuffle Transformer (DAUHST), for HSI reconstruction. Experiments show that DAUHST significantly surpasses state-of-the-art methods while requiring cheaper computational and memory costs. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/MST . An online Gradio demo is available at https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/MST
comment: NeurIPS 2022; The first Transformer-based deep unfolding method for spectral compressive imaging
zh_title: 用于光谱压缩成像的降级感知展开半混洗Transformer
translation: 在编码孔径快照光谱压缩成像（CASSI）系统中，高光谱图像（HSI）重建方法被用于从压缩测量中恢复空间-光谱信号。在这些算法中，深度展开方法表现出有前景的性能，但存在两个问题。首先，它们未能从高度相关的CASSI中估计降级模式和病态程度来指导迭代学习。其次，它们主要基于CNN，在捕获长距离依赖方面显示出局限性。本文提出了一种原则性的降级感知展开框架（DAUF），该框架从压缩图像和物理掩模中估计参数，然后使用这些参数控制每次迭代。此外，我们定制了一个新颖的半混洗Transformer（HST），它能同时捕获局部内容和非局部依赖。通过将HST插入DAUF中，我们建立了第一个基于Transformer的深度展开方法——降级感知展开半混洗Transformer（DAUHST），用于HSI重建。实验表明，DAUHST显著超越了现有最先进的方法，同时所需的计算和内存成本更低。代码和模型将在https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/MST 发布。在线Gradio演示可在https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/MST 获得。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DAUHST的Transformer基深度展开方法，通过降级感知框架和半混洗Transformer解决了CASSI系统中高光谱图像重建的两个主要问题：未能估计降级模式和长距离依赖捕获能力不足，并在计算和内存成本更低的情况下显著超越了现有技术。
ai_comments: 这项工作通过引入Transformer架构和降级感知机制，解决了现有深度展开方法在CASSI高光谱图像重建中面临的降级估计不足和长距离依赖捕获受限的问题。其创新性在于将物理模型与深度学习模型相结合，并利用Transformer的优势，这对于高光谱图像处理领域具有重要意义。同时，其在提升性能的同时降低了计算成本，展现了实际应用潜力。
motivation: 现有的深度展开方法在CASSI系统中的高光谱图像（HSI）重建方面存在两个问题：1) 它们未能从CASSI中估计降级模式和病态程度来指导迭代学习；2) 它们主要基于CNN，在捕获长距离依赖方面存在局限性。
method: 本文提出了一个降级感知展开框架（DAUF），该框架从压缩图像和物理掩模中估计参数，并用这些参数控制每次迭代。此外，定制了一个新颖的半混洗Transformer（HST），它能同时捕获局部内容和非局部依赖。通过将HST集成到DAUF中，建立了第一个基于Transformer的深度展开方法——降级感知展开半混洗Transformer（DAUHST），用于HSI重建。
results: 实验结果表明，DAUHST显著超越了现有最先进的方法，同时所需的计算和内存成本更低。
conclusion: DAUHST作为首个基于Transformer的深度展开方法，通过其降级感知框架和半混洗Transformer，有效解决了高光谱图像重建中的降级估计和长距离依赖问题，并在性能上取得了显著提升，同时降低了计算成本。

title: Structure-Aware Sparse-View X-ray 3D Reconstruction
authors: Yuanhao Cai, Jiahao Wang, Alan Yuille, Zongwei Zhou, Angtian Wang
abstract: X-ray, known for its ability to reveal internal structures of objects, is expected to provide richer information for 3D reconstruction than visible light. Yet, existing neural radiance fields (NeRF) algorithms overlook this important nature of X-ray, leading to their limitations in capturing structural contents of imaged objects. In this paper, we propose a framework, Structure-Aware X-ray Neural Radiodensity Fields (SAX-NeRF), for sparse-view X-ray 3D reconstruction. Firstly, we design a Line Segment-based Transformer (Lineformer) as the backbone of SAX-NeRF. Linefomer captures internal structures of objects in 3D space by modeling the dependencies within each line segment of an X-ray. Secondly, we present a Masked Local-Global (MLG) ray sampling strategy to extract contextual and geometric information in 2D projection. Plus, we collect a larger-scale dataset X3D covering wider X-ray applications. Experiments on X3D show that SAX-NeRF surpasses previous NeRF-based methods by 12.56 and 2.49 dB on novel view synthesis and CT reconstruction. Code, models, and data are released at https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/SAX-NeRF . Our project page at https://caiyuanhao1998.github.io/project/SAX-NeRF/ shows more video and interactive results. An online Gradio demo is available on HuggingFace at https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/SAX-NeRF
comment: CVPR 2024; The first Transformer-based method for X-ray and CT 3D reconstruction
zh_title: 结构感知的稀疏视角X射线三维重建
translation: X射线以其揭示物体内部结构的能力而闻名，预计能为3D重建提供比可见光更丰富的信息。然而，现有的神经辐射场（NeRF）算法忽视了X射线的这一重要特性，导致其在捕获成像物体的结构内容时存在局限性。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于稀疏视角X射线3D重建的框架——结构感知X射线神经辐射密度场（SAX-NeRF）。首先，我们设计了一个基于线段的Transformer（Lineformer）作为SAX-NeRF的骨干网络。Lineformer通过建模X射线每个线段内的依赖关系，在3D空间中捕获物体的内部结构。其次，我们提出了掩码局部-全局（MLG）射线采样策略，以提取2D投影中的上下文和几何信息。此外，我们收集了一个涵盖更广泛X射线应用的大规模数据集X3D。在X3D上的实验表明，SAX-NeRF在新视点合成和CT重建方面分别比以前的基于NeRF的方法高出12.56 dB和2.49 dB。
tldr: 本文提出了SAX-NeRF框架，利用Lineformer和MLG采样策略改进了稀疏视角下的X射线3D重建与CT成像质量。
ai_comments: 该论文针对稀疏视角X射线3D重建这一具有挑战性的任务，提出了结构感知的方法SAX-NeRF，创新性地引入了Lineformer骨干网络和MLG射线采样策略，并构建了更大规模的X3D数据集，在 novel view synthesis 和 CT 重建上取得了显著的性能提升。
motivation: 现有的基于神经辐射场（NeRF）的算法忽略了X射线能够揭示物体内部结构的本质特性，导致它们在捕捉成像物体的结构内容方面存在局限性。
method: 提出SAX-NeRF框架，包含两个核心设计：1）基于线段的Transformer（Lineformer）作为骨干网络，通过建模X射线各线段内的依赖关系来捕获3D空间中的内部结构；2）掩码局部-全局（MLG）射线采样策略，用于提取2D投影中的上下文和几何信息。同时收集了一个更大规模的X3D数据集。
results: 在X3D数据集上的实验表明，SAX-NeRF在新视点合成和CT重建任务上分别超越以前的NeRF方法12.56 dB和2.49 dB。
conclusion: 提出了一种新颖的结构感知X射线神经辐射密度场（SAX-NeRF）框架，通过Lineformer和MLG采样策略有效地解决了稀疏视角X射线3D重建问题，并在新视点合成和CT重建上超越了现有方法。

title: Design Optimization of Nuclear Fusion Reactor through Deep Reinforcement Learning
authors: Jinsu Kim, Jaemin Seo
abstract: In this research, we investigate deep reinforcement learning (DRL) as a practical tool for constrained, multi-objective optimization for tokamak fusion reactor designs. The task is to optimize the design configurations that minimize building cost while achieving high energy gain and long energy confinement time, subject to the four operational limits required for stable operation. Due to the coupled physics-engineering evaluation, the resulting objectives and constraints are black-box, making it challenging to find optimal solutions with conventional search strategies. To address this, we implement Reward-Constrained Policy Optimization (RCPO) for tokamak fusion reactor design. This method integrates multiple constraints into the reward functions, guiding the policy towards feasible solutions and simplifying the design optimization process. Our numerical results show that the proposed DRL-based approach finds more feasible designs that satisfy operational constraints more efficiently than other data-driven optimization methods, demonstrating the potential of DRL for efficient future reactor design.

title: How Path Integral Diffusion Decides a Finite Spin Glass
authors: Michael Chertkov
abstract: When an AI diffusion-type generator samples a frustrated spin glass, which macroscopic alternatives does it decide first, and when? We study this for bridge-diffusion models of the Path Integral Diffusion (PID) type started from a point source. We show that every isotropic PID is a time-changed Gaussian stochastic localization, and conversely every signal-to-noise schedule is realized by a PID protocol. What a continuous-time generator decides therefore does not depend on the protocol, which only sets when and at what cost. We describe the generator's state by its partial commitments: the probabilities it assigns, at each moment, to nested classes of configurations fixed by the target. The partial commitments are martingales that move only along class contrasts. Their ensemble average gives the information about each level at an exact rate set by squared magnetization contrasts. In the balanced, effectively binary approximation, a split reaches half of its class information near γ=1.044/λ_P, where λ_P is the leading eigenvalue of the parent covariance. The theory is applied to Bethe-lattice and Sherrington--Kirkpatrick (SK) glasses with up to 24 spins. It is observed generically that a trajectory first shifts its weight to one of the two mirror halves of the zero-field measure and then to the glassy classes inside it. These classes appear near the glass transition, keep their identity on cooling and are absent in a ferromagnet on the same graphs. Sparse (Bethe) and dense (SK) glasses differ in how often and how strongly such classes exist, not in how trajectories commit to them. For a generator that takes finitely many steps, the protocol matters through the late, local stage rather than the macroscopic decisions. Sampled posteriors at N=32,64 and small trained denoisers show the same sequence.
zh_title: 路径积分扩散如何决定有限自旋玻璃
translation: 当一个AI扩散型生成器采样一个受挫的自旋玻璃时，它首先决定哪些宏观替代方案，以及何时决定？我们研究了从点源开始的路径积分扩散（PID）类型的桥接扩散模型。我们表明，每个各向同性PID都是一个时间变化的高斯随机局部化，反之，每个信噪比调度都可以通过PID协议实现。因此，一个连续时间生成器决定什么不依赖于协议，协议只设定了何时以及以何种成本。我们通过其部分承诺来描述生成器的状态：它在每个时刻分配给由目标固定的嵌套配置类的概率。部分承诺是马尔可夫链，只沿着类对比移动。它们的集合平均以平方磁化对比设定的精确速率提供关于每个级别的信息。在平衡的、有效二元近似中，一个分裂在其类信息的一半附近达到γ=1.044/λ_P，其中λ_P是父协方差的主导特征值。该理论应用于Bethe晶格和Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) 玻璃，最多24个自旋。通常观察到，轨迹首先将其权重转移到零场测度的两个镜像一半之一，然后转移到其中的玻璃态类。这些类出现在玻璃转变附近，冷却时保持其特性，并且在相同图上的铁磁体中不存在。稀疏（Bethe）和稠密（SK）玻璃在这些类的存在频率和强度上有所不同，而不是轨迹如何承诺它们。对于采取有限步骤的生成器，协议通过后期、局部阶段而不是宏观决策发挥作用。N=32, 64的采样后验和小型训练去噪器显示出相同的序列。
tldr: 本文研究了AI扩散型生成器在采样受挫自旋玻璃时，如何以及何时决定宏观替代方案，发现连续时间生成器的决定不依赖于协议，并揭示了轨迹如何从宏观到微观承诺于玻璃态类。
ai_comments: 这篇论文深入探讨了AI扩散模型在处理复杂物理系统（如自旋玻璃）时的决策机制，特别是其如何从宏观层面逐步聚焦到微观结构。创新点在于将PID与高斯随机局部化联系起来，并引入“部分承诺”来量化决策过程。其发现连续时间生成器的宏观决策与协议无关，对理解扩散模型的基本行为具有重要意义。同时，对自旋玻璃中“玻璃态类”的发现及其与铁磁体的对比，以及对稀疏与稠密玻璃差异的分析，为物理学和机器学习交叉领域提供了新的见解。
motivation: 了解AI扩散型生成器在采样受挫自旋玻璃时，它首先决定哪些宏观替代方案以及何时决定。
method: 研究了从点源开始的路径积分扩散（PID）类型的桥接扩散模型，并通过将PID描述为时间变化的高斯随机局部化来分析其行为。通过部分承诺（partial commitments）来描述生成器的状态演变。该理论应用于Bethe晶格和Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) 玻璃，最多24个自旋，并通过N=32, 64的采样后验和小型训练去噪器进行验证。
results: 每个各向同性PID都是时间变化的高斯随机局部化，每个信噪比调度都可以通过PID协议实现。连续时间生成器的决定不依赖于协议，协议只决定时间和成本。生成器的状态通过部分承诺描述，这些承诺是仅沿类对比移动的马尔可夫链。在平衡的、有效二元近似中，一个分裂在其类信息的一半附近达到γ=1.044/λ_P。轨迹首先将其权重转移到零场测度的两个镜像一半之一，然后转移到其中的玻璃态类，这些类出现在玻璃转变附近，冷却时保持其特性，且在铁磁体中不存在。稀疏（Bethe）和稠密（SK）玻璃在这些类的存在频率和强度上有所不同。对于有限步数的生成器，协议通过后期、局部阶段而不是宏观决策发挥作用。N=32, 64的采样后验和小型训练去噪器显示出相同的序列。
conclusion: 连续时间生成器在采样自旋玻璃时的宏观决策不依赖于具体的扩散协议，而是通过部分承诺的演化，从宏观上（如零场测度的镜像半部分）逐步转向微观的玻璃态类。协议主要影响局部阶段和时间/成本。

title: Markets for Compute and Inference: Structure, Financing, and Risk Transfer
authors: Dr Gabriel Borrageiro
abstract:
Capacity to run large language models is rented by the accelerator-hour, and their output is sold by the million tokens. Both goods now have published price indices, an over-the-counter forward has traded on one, compute futures are listed offshore, and CME and ICE have specified futures on rental indices that await the United States regulator. We ask what in these two markets can be hedged, by whom, and at what price.
  Three findings stand out. First, the price that exchange contracts settle on is not the price that drives operators' revenue. The contracts on CME and ICE reference published short-dated rental rates, while most revenue, and with it credit quality, comes from private multi-year contracts whose prices are largely undisclosed. Second, the token price and the rental rate are linked by an identity through throughput and margin, but they are different exposures, so a hedge on the rental rate does not hedge the cost of inference; at the measured capability of GPT-5 the cheapest list price fell by a factor of 17 in twelve months, and by far less at lower capability. Third, the demand for hedging already sits in credit agreements, as the years by which operators' debt outlives their contracted revenue. Filings cannot measure that gap, because debt is scheduled year by year while contracted revenue rarely is, and the one loan that prices it settles the risk by cash prepayment against a model only the parties see.
  We design a reverse convertible note through which leveraged operators could buy protection against falling rental rates. Its coupon depends steeply on the annualised volatility of the rental rate, which the two public indices put between about 5% and 89% according to how each is built and the horizon measured; across that range the fair one-year coupon runs from 4.1% to 31.6%.
zh_title: 算力与推理市场：结构、融资与风险转移
translation:
运行大型语言模型的算力按加速器小时租赁，其输出按百万Token出售。这两种商品现在都有了已发布的Цена指数，其中一种商品已经进行了场外远期交易，算力期货在离岸上市，CME和ICE也指定了等待美国监管机构批准的租赁指数期货。我们探讨了这两个市场中什么可以被对冲、由谁对冲以及以什么价格对冲。

三个发现引人注目。首先，交易所合约结算的价格并不是驱动运营商收入的价格。CME和ICE上的合约参考了已发布的短期租赁费率，而大部分收入（以及信用质量）来自私密的多年度合同，其价格在很大程度上并未公开。其次，Token价格和租赁费率通过吞吐量和利润率的恒等式联系在一起，但它们是不同的风险敞口，因此对冲租赁费率并不能对冲推理成本；按照GPT-5测得的能力，最低标价在十二个月内下降了17倍，而在较低能力下下降幅度要小得多。第三，对冲需求已经存在于信贷协议中，因为运营商的债务存续期超出了其签约收入的年限。公开文件无法衡量这一差距，因为债务是按年安排的，而签约收入很少如此，而定价该风险的一笔贷款通过对仅双方可见的模型进行现金预付款来结算风险。

我们设计了一种反向可转换票据，高杠杆运营商可以通过它购买对抗租赁费率下跌的保护。其息票高度依赖于租赁费率的年化波动率，根据每个指数的构建方式和测量的视野，两个公开指数将其置于约5%到89%之间；在该范围内，合理的一年期息票率为4.1%至31.6%。
tldr: 本文研究了算力与推理市场的金融衍生品及风险对冲机制，发现公开期货与实际运营商收入存在脱节，并设计了一种反向可转换票据帮助运营商对冲租赁费率下跌的风险。
ai_comments: 本文首次深入探讨了算力和推理市场的结构、融资及风险转移机制，指出了公开衍生品与私有合同之间的基差风险，并设计了反向可转换票据来帮助运营商进行风险对冲，具有极高的现实应用价值和学术创新性。
motivation: 随着大语言模型算力和推理市场的发展，相关的价格指数和衍生品（如期货）开始出现。作者旨在研究这两个市场中什么可以被对冲、由谁对冲以及以什么价格对冲，特别是解决运营商面临的收入与债务错配及价格波动风险。
method: 通过经济学与金融学分析框架，研究算力和推理市场的价格指数、合约结算价与实际运营收入的关系，并设计了一种针对租赁费率下跌的逆向可转换票据（reverse convertible note）。
results: 发现交易所合约结算价与驱动运营商收入的私有合同价格存在背离；代币价格与租赁费率通过吞吐量和利润率相连但属于不同风险敞口；对冲需求存在于信贷协议中。计算出不同波动率下一年期票据的公允息票率在4.1%至31.6%之间。
conclusion: 算力与推理市场正在金融化，但公开指数与实际运营收入之间存在错配。文章提出的反向可转换票据为高杠杆运营商提供了有效的对冲工具。

title: Radiative Gaussian Splatting for Efficient X-ray Novel View Synthesis
authors: Yuanhao Cai, Yixun Liang, Jiahao Wang, Angtian Wang, Yulun Zhang, Xiaokang Yang, Zongwei Zhou, Alan Yuille
abstract: X-ray is widely applied for transmission imaging due to its stronger penetration than natural light. When rendering novel view X-ray projections, existing methods mainly based on NeRF suffer from long training time and slow inference speed. In this paper, we propose a 3D Gaussian splatting-based method, namely X-Gaussian, for X-ray 3D reconstruction. Firstly, we redesign a radiative Gaussian point cloud model inspired by the isotropic nature of X-ray imaging. Our model excludes the influence of view direction when learning to predict the radiation intensity of 3D points. Based on this model, we develop a Differentiable Radiative Rasterization (DRR) with CUDA implementation. Secondly, we formulate a principled Radiative Gaussian Volume Querying (RGVQ) method that defines a continuous attenuation field from the original radiative point attributes and enables direct CT volume reconstruction through CUDA-based parallel querying. Thirdly, we customize an Angle-pose Cuboid Uniform Initialization (ACUI) strategy that directly uses the parameters of the X-ray scanner to compute the camera information and then uniformly samples point positions within a cuboid enclosing the scanned object. On novel view synthesis, X-Gaussian outperforms SOTA methods by 6.5 dB while enjoying less than 15% training time and over 73x inference speed. On CT reconstruction, X-Gaussian outperforms SOTA methods by 0.40 dB and 4.34 dB on synthetic and real scenes, while achieving 4.30x faster inference of the learned CT volume. Code, models, and datasets are at https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/X-Gaussian . More video and interactive visualizations are presented on our project page at https://caiyuanhao1998.github.io/project/X-Gaussian . We also built an online Gradio demo page on HuggingFace at https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/X-Gaussian .
comment: ECCV 2024; The first 3D Gaussian Splatting-based method for X-ray 3D reconstruction
zh_title: 用于高效X射线新视点合成的辐射高斯散射
translation: X射线由于比自然光具有更强的穿透性，被广泛应用于透射成像中。在渲染新视点X射线投影时，现有的主要基于NeRF的方法存在训练时间长、推理速度慢的问题。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于3D高斯散射的X射线三维重建方法，名为X-Gaussian。首先，受X射线成像各向同性性质的启发，我们重新设计了辐射高斯点云模型。我们的模型在学习预测3D点的辐射强度时排除了视角方向的影响。基于该模型，我们开发了带有CUDA实现的微分辐射光栅化（DRR）。其次，我们制定了一种有原理依据的辐射高斯体积查询（RGVQ）方法，从原始辐射点属性定义了连续衰减场，并通过基于CUDA的并行查询实现直接CT体积重建。第三，我们定制了一种角度-姿态长方体统一初始化（ACUI）策略，直接使用X射线扫描仪的参数来计算相机信息，然后在包围扫描物体的长方体内均匀采样点位置。在新视点合成方面，X-Gaussian比SOTA方法高出6.5 dB，同时训练时间不到15%，推理速度快了73倍以上。在CT重建方面，X-Gaussian在合成场景和真实场景上分别比SOTA方法高出0.40 dB和4.34 dB，同时学到的CT体积推理速度快了4.30倍。代码、模型和数据集可在https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/X-Gaussian 获取。更多视频和交互式可视化展示在我们的项目网页https://caiyuanhao1998.github.io/project/X-Gaussian 上。我们还在HuggingFace上构建了一个在线Gradio演示页面：https://huggingface.co/spaces/CaiYuanhao/X-Gaussian 。
tldr: 本文提出了基于3D高斯散射的X-Gaussian方法，实现了高效的X射线新视点合成和CT重建，在精度大幅提升的同时，训练和推理速度实现了数量级的飞跃。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将3D Gaussian Splatting引入X射线成像和CT重建领域，打破了以往基于NeRF的方法在训练和推理上的效率瓶颈，在保证重建质量的同时大幅提升了计算速度，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有基于NeRF的X射线新视点合成方法存在训练时间长和推理速度慢的问题，无法满足高效成像和重建的需求。
method: 1. 重新设计了辐射高斯点云模型（忽略视角方向影响）；2. 开发了基于CUDA的可微分辐射光栅化（DRR）；3. 提出了辐射高斯体积查询（RGVQ）方法；4. 定制了角度-姿态长方体统一初始化（ACUI）策略。
results: 在X射线新视点合成上，比SOTA方法高出6.5 dB，训练时间缩短至15%以下，推理速度提升73倍以上；在CT重建上，合成和真实场景分别超出SOTA方法0.40 dB和4.34 dB，CT体积推理速度提升4.30倍。
conclusion: 本文提出的X-Gaussian方法在X射线新视点合成和CT重建任务中，均显著优于现有SOTA方法，并实现了数量级上的速度提升，展示了3D高斯散射在穿透性成像中的巨大潜力。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Benchmarking Uncertainty Quantification in Retinal Disease Screening
authors: Mahvash Jebeli, Mohammad Eslami, Nazlee Zebardast, Lucia Sobrin, Tobias Elze
abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for evaluating retinal AI systems beyond classification accuracy, yet it remains unclear whether existing UQ strategies generalize across diseases, model architectures, and reliability criteria. We introduce a large-scale, multi-disease benchmark comprising over $242,000$ fundus photographs from $32$ datasets covering diabetic retinopathy, age-related macular degeneration, and glaucoma. We evaluate six representative UQ strategies across three Vision Transformer configurations, assessing discrimination, probabilistic calibration, selective prediction, and conformal prediction-set coverage. Our findings reveal no universally superior model or UQ strategy: methods that improve reliability in one disease or architecture may underperform in another, while improvements in discrimination, calibration, and selective prediction do not necessarily align. Notably, computationally intensive methods do not consistently outperform simple confidence scores, and domain-specific foundation models and calibration-oriented loss functions do not guarantee greater reliability. In contrast, conformal prediction provides a complementary framework for achieving near-nominal marginal prediction-set coverage across diverse settings, subject to its statistical assumptions. These findings challenge universal UQ recommendations and highlight the need for disease-specific, model-specific, and multidimensional reliability evaluation before clinical deployment. We release standardized dataset splits, trained checkpoints, evaluation code, and an interactive research demonstration to support reproducible benchmarking.
zh_title: 超越准确性：视网膜疾病筛查中不确定性量化的基准测试
translation: 可靠的不确定性量化（UQ）对于评估超越分类准确性的视网膜AI系统至关重要，但目前尚不清楚现有的UQ策略是否能在不同疾病、模型架构和可靠性标准之间泛化。我们引入了一个大规模、多疾病基准，包含来自32个数据集的超过242,000张眼底照片，涵盖糖尿病视网膜病变、年龄相关性黄斑变性和青光眼。我们评估了六种代表性的UQ策略在三种Vision Transformer配置上的表现，评估判别能力、概率校准、选择性预测和共形预测集覆盖。我们的研究结果表明，没有普遍优越的模型或UQ策略：在一种疾病或架构中提高可靠性的方法可能在另一种情况下表现不佳，而判别能力、校准和选择性预测的改进不一定一致。值得注意的是，计算密集型方法并不总是优于简单的置信度分数，领域特定基础模型和面向校准的损失函数也不能保证更高的可靠性。相比之下，共形预测提供了一个互补框架，可在多样化设置中实现接近标称的边缘预测集覆盖，但受其统计假设的限制。这些发现挑战了普遍的UQ建议，并强调在临床部署前需要进行针对疾病、模型特定和多维度的可靠性评估。我们发布了标准化的数据集划分、训练好的检查点、评估代码和一个交互式研究演示，以支持可复现的基准测试。
tldr: 该研究对视网膜AI系统中的不确定性量化策略进行了大规模基准测试，发现没有普适的优越模型或策略，强调了部署前需要针对疾病和模型进行多维度可靠性评估。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过其大规模的基准测试和对多种不确定性量化策略的全面评估，为视网膜疾病筛查AI系统的可靠性研究做出了重要贡献。其核心创新在于挑战了“一刀切”的UQ解决方案，并强调了在真实临床部署前进行细致、多维度和情境化评估的必要性。论文的局限性可能在于，虽然强调了没有普遍优越的策略，但并未提出一个明确的替代框架或指导原则，仅指出了共形预测的互补性。其开源资源的举动对社区具有重要价值。
motivation: 可靠的不确定性量化（UQ）对于评估超越分类准确性的视网膜AI系统至关重要，但目前尚不清楚现有的UQ策略是否能在不同疾病、模型架构和可靠性标准之间泛化。
method: 引入一个大规模、多疾病基准数据集，包含超过242,000张眼底照片，涵盖糖尿病视网膜病变、年龄相关性黄斑变性和青光眼。评估了六种代表性的UQ策略在三种Vision Transformer配置上的表现，评估指标包括判别能力、概率校准、选择性预测和共形预测集覆盖。
results: 没有普遍优越的模型或UQ策略；在一种疾病或架构中提高可靠性的方法可能在另一种情况下表现不佳；判别能力、校准和选择性预测的改进不一定一致；计算密集型方法不一定优于简单的置信度分数；领域特定基础模型和面向校准的损失函数不能保证更高的可靠性；共形预测提供了一个互补框架，可在不同设置下实现接近标称的边缘预测集覆盖。
conclusion: 研究结果挑战了普遍的UQ建议，并强调在临床部署前，需要进行针对疾病、模型特定和多维度的可靠性评估。

title: Foundation Model-Driven Agentic AI for 6G
authors: Mohammad Ghassemi, Han Zhang, Akram Bin Sediq, Ali Afana, Melike Erol-Kantarci
abstract: Mobile networks are outgrowing manual tuning: parameters multiply, services diversify, and traffic shifts faster than experts can react. The machine learning (ML) models that automate radio control are narrow: each is trained for one task, degrades when conditions move, and needs specialist retraining. This article introduces FM-in-the-loop, a framework for 6G radio access networks in which a foundation model (FM) reasons while lightweight machine learning agents act. It reads operator intents in plain language, decomposes them into subtasks, coordinates task-specific agents over Model Context Protocol (MCP) interfaces, and supervises them across their lifecycle---while the orchestration FM never enters the latency-critical control path. We locate seven integration points across four lifecycle stages, compare three cloud-to-edge deployments, and evaluate two elements: channel representations from a wireless FM are tested under noise-level and channel-estimation-error shift, and an instrumented emulation of the orchestration loop reports the measured cost of turning an operator intent into dispatched agent goals. Hallucination, cost, and standardization barriers remain.
zh_title: 基础模型驱动的6G智能体AI
translation: 移动网络正在超越手动调优的能力：参数激增，服务多样化，流量变化速度快于专家反应。自动化无线电控制的机器学习（ML）模型过于狭窄：每个模型都针对一个任务进行训练，在条件变化时性能下降，并且需要专业的再训练。本文介绍了FM-in-the-loop，一个用于6G无线接入网络的框架，其中基础模型（FM）进行推理，而轻量级机器学习代理进行操作。它以自然语言读取操作员意图，将其分解为子任务，通过模型上下文协议（MCP）接口协调特定任务代理，并在其整个生命周期中进行监督——同时编排FM从不进入延迟关键的控制路径。我们确定了四个生命周期阶段的七个集成点，比较了三种云到边缘的部署方案，并评估了两个要素：在噪声水平和信道估计误差变化下测试了来自无线FM的信道表示，并且对编排循环的仪器化仿真报告了将操作员意图转化为分派代理目标的测量成本。幻觉、成本和标准化障碍依然存在。
tldr: 针对6G移动网络手动调优和传统ML模型的局限性，本文提出FM-in-the-loop框架，利用基础模型进行推理，轻量级ML代理执行，实现无线电控制的自动化与智能化。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将基础模型引入6G网络控制领域，通过“FM-in-the-loop”框架，实现了高级推理与轻量级代理执行的分离，有望解决传统ML模型在复杂多变网络环境中的局限性。其提出的架构考虑了实际部署和延迟问题，具有重要意义。然而，论文也坦诚指出了幻觉、成本和标准化等潜在挑战，表明该技术仍处于早期阶段。
motivation: 移动网络日益复杂，手动调优已无法应对参数激增、服务多样化和流量快速变化。现有自动化无线电控制的ML模型过于狭窄，仅针对单一任务训练，在条件变化时性能下降，且需要专业人员重新训练。
method: 提出FM-in-the-loop框架，用于6G无线接入网络。该框架中，基础模型（FM）负责推理和编排，而轻量级机器学习代理负责执行。FM能理解自然语言操作意图，分解为子任务，通过模型上下文协议（MCP）接口协调特定任务代理，并监督其生命周期，同时编排FM不进入延迟关键的控制路径。文章还确定了四个生命周期阶段的七个集成点，并比较了三种云到边缘的部署方案。
results: 评估了两个方面：在噪声水平和信道估计误差变化下测试了无线FM的信道表示；通过编排循环的模拟，报告了将操作员意图转化为分派代理目标的测量成本。
conclusion: 幻觉、成本和标准化是该方法仍面临的挑战。

title: How to Receive Focused Beams in Near-Field MIMO? Analytical Combiners and Array Size Optimization
authors: Phinehas Chinthalagattu, Vitaly Petrov, Emil Björnson
abstract: This paper investigates receive combining for near-field beamfocusing in line-of-sight channels with antenna array misalignment. We propose and evaluate two analytical combiners: analog ANF-AC and digital ANF-DC. Beyond focusing the beam toward the transmitter, ANF-AC benefits from the proposed phase-flip corrections (PFCs), while ANF-DC additionally exploits Dirichlet-kernel-based amplitude tapering. ANF-AC closely matches theoretically optimal analog equal-gain combining (EGC), with an SNR gap below 0.006 dB. Similarly, ANF-DC matches optimal digital maximum-ratio combining (MRC). We then leverage the analytical properties of these combiners for link-level evaluation and optimization, deriving a closed-form expression for the optimal transmitter-receiver array-size trade-off that maximizes received SNR with analog combining. We also show that the optimized analog receiver performs within 0.84 dB of its fully digital MRC-equivalent counterpart. These results demonstrate that optimized analog combining (with potentially lower implementation complexity and cost, particularly at higher frequencies) can get close to the fully digital performance. Beyond the theoretical insights presented, the analytical tractability and EGC-like / MRC-like performance of our combiners enable accurate network-level mathematical studies of beamfocusing, such as coverage, capacity, and interference analysis and optimization toward efficient 6G+ near-field MIMO communication systems.
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, Submitted to IEEE ICC 2027
zh_title: 如何在近场MIMO中接收聚焦波束？解析合并器与阵列尺寸优化
translation: 本文研究了天线阵列未对准的视距信道中近场波束聚焦的接收合并问题。我们提出并评估了两种解析合并器：模拟合并器ANF-AC和数字合并器ANF-DC。除了将波束聚焦朝向发射端外，ANF-AC还得益于所提出的相位翻转校正（PFC），而ANF-DC则进一步利用了基于狄利克雷核的幅度加权。ANF-AC与理论最优的模拟等增益合并（EGC）高度吻合，信噪比差距低于0.006 dB；类似地，ANF-DC与最优数字最大比合并（MRC）相匹配。随后，我们利用这些合并器的解析特性进行链路级评估与优化，推导出了在使用模拟合并时最大化接收信噪比的最优发射-接收阵列尺寸权衡的闭合表达式。我们还证明了优化后的模拟接收机性能与其等效的全数字MRC接收机差距在0.84 dB以内。这些结果表明，优化后的模拟合并（具有潜在更低的实现复杂度和成本，尤其在高频段）可以逼近全数字性能。除了给出的理论见解外，我们提出的合并器的解析易处理性以及类EGC/类MRC性能，使得针对高效6G+近场MIMO通信系统的覆盖、容量和干扰分析及优化等网络级数学研究成为可能。
tldr: 本文提出了两种高性能且具闭合形式的近场接收合并器，推导了最优收发阵列尺寸权衡，证明了低复杂度的模拟合并方案性能可逼近全数字MRC（差距在0.84 dB以内）。
ai_comments: 该论文的重要意义在于解决了近场MIMO中波束聚焦接收设计的复杂度问题。其创新点在于提出了具备解析形式的模拟（ANF-AC）与数字（ANF-DC）合并器，并给出了最优阵列尺寸权衡的闭合表达式；局限性在于摘要仅针对视距（LoS）信道和天线阵列失准场景进行了验证，对复杂非视距多径环境下的适应性未做阐述。
motivation: 针对存在天线阵列未对准的视距信道，探究近场波束聚焦中的接收合并方案，以寻求兼具接近最优性能、较低实现复杂度及解析易处理性的设计方法。
method: 提出了两种解析合并器：带有相位翻转校正（PFC）的模拟合并器ANF-AC，以及基于狄利克雷核幅度加权的数字合并器ANF-DC；同时，利用其解析特性推导出了最大化接收信噪比的收发天线阵列尺寸权衡的闭合表达式。
results: ANF-AC与理论最优的模拟等增益合并（EGC）相比信噪比差距小于0.006 dB；ANF-DC性能与最优数字最大比合并（MRC）一致；经过阵列尺寸优化后的模拟接收机与全数字MRC接收机之间的性能差距在0.84 dB以内。
conclusion: 优化后的模拟合并可以在保持较低实现复杂度和硬件成本的同时，获得接近全数字接收机的性能。所提合并器的解析易处理性为未来面向6G+近场MIMO系统的网络级覆盖、容量及干扰分析提供了坚实的理论工具。

title: SWIMSS: An Open Multi-Center SwinUNETR Model for Multiple Sclerosis White Matter Lesion Segmentation
authors: Federico Spagnolo, Po-Jui Lu, Mario Ocampo-Pineda, Lester Melie-Garcia, Esther Ruberte, Riccardo Galbusera, Matthias Weigel, Alessandro Cagol, Johanna Maria Lieb, Nicolin Hainc, Franca Wagner, Piotr Radojewski, Felix Tobias Kurz, Vincent Dunet, Emanuele Pravatà, Olaf Chan-Hi Kim, Patrick Roth, Marina Herwerth, Sebastian Finkener, Robert Hoepner, Patrice H. Lalive, Caroline Pot, Claudio Gobbi, Stefanie Müller, Jens Kuhle, Vincent Andrearczyk, Adrien Depeursinge, Cristina Granziera
abstract: Purpose: To develop and validate SWIMSS (SWInUNETR for Multiple Sclerosis white matter lesion Segmentation), a SwinUNETR-based deep learning (DL) model for reliable automated white matter (WM) lesion segmentation, in a large multicentric cohort of people with multiple sclerosis (pwMS). Methods: A real-world longitudinal dataset of 1,385 pwMS from seven Swiss clinical centers was used to train, validate, and test SWIMSS and two state-of-the-art DL architectures: UNETR and MSSegDiff. Inference results obtained with LST-AI were also compared. Preprocessed magnetization-prepared rapid acquisition gradient echo and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery MRI sequences, acquired with various MR systems and field strengths, served as model inputs. Model performance was evaluated using the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) with 95% confidence intervals (CI). Results: SWIMSS achieved the highest performance, with a DSC of 81.37 (95% CI: 80.63-82.11), outperforming UNETR (79.06; 95% CI: 78.33-79.79), MSSegDiff (75.70; 95% CI: 74.97-76.43), and LST-AI (63.19; 95% CI: 62.08-64.30). Normalized DSC followed a similar trend, with SWIMSS reaching 84.88. Lesion detection F1 achieved 81.14. Statistical analyses confirmed its superior performance (p < 0.001). Conclusion: SWIMSS achieved state-of-the-art performance for WM lesion segmentation. By making this model publicly available, we enable broader access to high-quality segmentation tools, allowing smaller centers, often lacking large annotated datasets or computational resources, to benefit from a model trained on a diverse, large-scale cohort. This promotes more equitable access to advanced imaging analysis and supports reproducibility and standardization in MS research.
zh_title: SWIMSS：一个用于多发性硬化症白质病变分割的开放多中心SwinUNETR模型
translation: 目的：开发并验证SWIMSS（用于多发性硬化症白质病变分割的SWInUNETR），这是一个基于SwinUNETR的深度学习（DL）模型，用于在多发性硬化症（pwMS）大型多中心队列中实现可靠的自动化白质（WM）病变分割。方法：使用来自七个瑞士临床中心的1,385名多发性硬化症患者的真实世界纵向数据集，对SWIMSS以及两种先进的DL架构（UNETR和MSSegDiff）进行了训练、验证和测试。还与LST-AI获得的推理结果进行了比较。使用各种MR系统和场强采集的预处理MPRAGE和FLAIR MRI序列作为模型输入。使用带有95%置信区间（CI）的Dice相似系数（DSC）评估模型性能。结果：SWIMSS取得了最高性能，DSC为81.37（95% CI：80.63-82.11），优于UNETR（79.06；95% CI：78.33-79.79）、MSSegDiff（75.70；95% CI：74.97-76.43）和LST-AI（63.19；95% CI：62.08-64.30）。归一化DSC遵循类似的趋势，SWIMSS达到了84.88。病变检测F1达到81.14。统计分析证实了其优越的性能（p < 0.001）。结论：SWIMSS实现了白质病变分割的最先进性能。通过公开该模型，我们使人们能够更广泛地获得高质量的分割工具，使通常缺乏大型注释数据集或计算资源的小型中心受益于在多样化、大规模队列上训练的模型。这促进了对先进影像分析的更公平访问，并支持了MS研究的可重复性和标准化。
tldr: SWIMSS是一个基于SwinUNETR的开源多中心深度学习模型，在多发性硬化症白质病变分割任务上取得了显著优于现有方法的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文开发并验证了一个基于SwinUNETR的多发性硬化症白质病变分割模型SWIMSS，利用了来自7个瑞士临床中心的庞大多中心真实世界纵向数据集。该工作不仅展现了模型卓越的分割性能，还通过开源代码促进了医疗资源的不均衡问题，具有极高的临床应用和科研推广价值。
motivation: 开发并验证一个基于SwinUNETR的深度学习模型（SWIMSS），以在大型多中心多发性硬化症患者队列中实现可靠的自动化白质病变分割。
method: 本研究利用来自7个瑞士临床中心的1385名多发性硬化症患者的真实世界纵向数据集，对基于SwinUNETR的SWIMSS模型以及其他两种先进的深度学习架构（UNETR和MSSegDiff）和LST-AI进行了训练、验证和测试。输入数据为预处理的MPRAGE和FLAIR磁共振序列，使用Dice相似系数（DSC）评估模型性能。
results: SWIMSS取得了最高的性能，DSC达到81.37，显著优于UNETR（79.06）、MSSegDiff（75.70）和LST-AI（63.19）。其归一化DSC达到84.88，病变检测F1值为81.14（p < 0.001）。
conclusion: SWIMSS在多发性硬化症白质病变分割任务上实现了SOTA性能，其开源特性有望促进多发性硬化症研究中的可重复性、标准化以及先进影像分析工具的普及。

title: Beyond RSRP: An Exploration of Alternative Metrics for Beam Management in an Urban Micro 5G NR Scenario
authors: Saakshi Gupta, Tarun S. Cousik, Pratheek Upadhyaya, Nishith Tripathi, Jeffery Reed, Daniel J. Jakubisin
abstract: Reference Signal Received Power (RSRP) is widely used for beam selection in 5G NR as it is an easy indicator of path loss, but is not interference-aware, limiting its effectiveness in dense deployments. In this paper, we explore RSRP, Reference Signal Received Quality (RSRQ), and Signal to Interference-plus-Noise Ratio (SINR) as beam selection metrics alongside three UE-gNB association strategies in a 3GPP-compliant Urban Micro multi-cell simulation, benchmarked against Regularized Zero-Forcing (RZF) full-Channel State Information (CSI) upper bounds. Using a 3GPP-compliant Urban Micro multi-cell simulation benchmarked against RZF full-CSI upper bounds, we demonstrate two findings: directional RSRQ, despite its inter-cell interference awareness, is the worst-performing strategy in symmetric interference, and sequential association outperforms power-optimal Hungarian assignment. We also establish that the residual performance gap to full-CSI precoding stems from codebook quantization rather than metric imperfection, identifying adaptive codebook design as a mechanism to enhance performance.
zh_title: 超越RSRP：城市微小区5G NR场景下波束管理替代指标的探索
translation: 参考信号接收功率（RSRP）由于能简单指示路径损耗，在5G NR中被广泛用于波束选择，但它缺乏对干扰的感知，限制了其在密集部署中的有效性。在本文中，我们在3GPP标准的城市微小区多小区仿真中，探讨了RSRP、参考信号接收质量（RSRQ）以及信号与干扰加噪声比（SINR）作为波束选择指标，并结合三种UE-gNB关联策略，同时以正则化迫零（RZF）全信道状态信息（CSI）上限作为基准。通过符合3GPP标准的仿真，我们得出了两个发现：尽管定向RSRQ具有感知小区间干扰的能力，但它在对称干扰下表现最差；顺序关联优于功率最优的匈牙利分配。我们还确立了与全CSI预编码之间的剩余性能差距源于码本量化而非指标缺陷，从而指出了自适应码本设计作为增强性能的机制。
tldr: 本文研究了5G中RSRP的替代波束管理指标（如SINR和RSRQ），发现性能差距主要源于码本量化而非指标缺陷。
ai_comments: 该论文深入探讨了5G NR中不同波束选择指标在城市微小区场景下的表现，突破了传统仅依赖RSRP的局限，揭示了码本量化是性能差距的主因，对未来的自适应码本设计具有重要的指导意义。
motivation: 传统的参考信号接收功率（RSRP）虽然能简单反映路径损耗，但缺乏对干扰的感知，在密集部署中限制了其有效性，因此需要探索替代指标。
method: 采用符合3GPP标准的城市微小区多小区仿真，评估RSRP、RSRQ和SINR三种波束选择指标以及三种UE-gNB关联策略，并与正则化迫零（RZF）全CSI上限进行对比。
results: 在对称干扰下，具备小区间干扰感知能力的定向RSRQ表现最差；顺序关联优于功率最优的匈牙利分配；全CSI预编码的剩余性能差距源于码本量化而非指标本身。
conclusion: 波束管理中选择合适的指标（如SINR）和关联策略至关重要，且性能瓶颈主要在于码本量化而非测量指标本身。

title: Towards Environment-Aware 6G Network Planning: An Any-to-Any Channel Knowledge Map Approach
authors: Yilong Chen, Jiaxuan Li, Yuan Guo, Wenhai Lai, Xinhao Li, Kaiming Shen, Guangxu Zhu, Jie Xu, Rui Zhang, Zhi-Quan Luo
abstract: Planning sixth-generation (6G) networks for reliable coverage across diverse environments is challenging, as it requires channel knowledge between candidate network node locations and potential service regions. This article proposes an environment-aware network planning framework based on any-to-any (X2X) channel knowledge maps (CKMs), which characterize channels between arbitrary transmitter-receiver location pairs. Within this framework, we first construct X2X CKMs from environmental information, sparse channel measurements, or both, with map types and spatial resolutions selected according to the planning task. We then use these maps to predict coverage and optimize network deployment and configuration subject to service requirements and practical constraints, while accounting for subsequent network operation. Finally, field measurements assess channel prediction accuracy and deployment performance, providing feedback for CKM correction and deployment refinement. We discuss implementation methods and tradeoffs across these stages. Case studies illustrate the effectiveness of the framework for indoor intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) deployment and outdoor base station (BS) deployment. Live-network trials further demonstrate coverage gains from IRS deployment and BS reconfiguration, with measurement feedback supporting CKM calibration and configuration refinement.
zh_title: 迈向环境感知的6G网络规划：一种任意到任意的信道知识图谱方法
translation: 规划旨在跨多样化环境实现可靠覆盖的第六代（6G）网络具有挑战性，因为它需要候选网络节点位置与潜在服务区域之间的信道知识。本文提出了一种基于任意到任意（X2X）信道知识图谱（CKM）的环境感知网络规划框架，该图谱表征了任意发射器-接收器位置对之间的信道。在此框架内，我们首先根据规划任务选择的地图类型和空间分辨率，利用环境信息、稀疏信道测量或两者结合来构建X2X CKM。然后，在满足服务要求和实际约束条件的同时，利用这些地图预测覆盖范围并优化网络部署和配置，同时考虑后续的网络运营。最后，通过现场测量评估信道预测准确性和部署性能，为CKM修正和部署精炼提供反馈。我们讨论了这些阶段的实现方法和权衡。案例研究说明了该框架在室内智能反射面（IRS）部署和室外基站（BS）部署方面的有效性。实网试验进一步证明了IRS部署和BS重配置带来的覆盖增益，测量反馈支持了CKM校准和配置精炼。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于任意到任意信道知识图谱（X2X CKM）的6G网络规划框架，通过融合环境数据与测量结果来实现精准的网络覆盖预测和部署优化。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种基于任意到任意（X2X）信道知识图谱（CKM）的环境感知6G网络规划框架，创新性地将环境信息与稀疏信道测量相结合，并通过现场试验验证了其在室内IRS部署和室外基站部署中的有效性。
motivation: 为了应对6G网络在多样化环境中实现可靠覆盖的挑战，传统的网络规划需要候选节点位置与潜在服务区域之间的信道知识，而现有方法缺乏对复杂环境的有效感知与综合利用。
method: 提出一个基于任意到任意（X2X）信道知识图谱（CKM）的网络规划框架，利用环境信息和稀疏信道测量构建CKM，进而预测覆盖并优化网络部署与配置，最后通过现场测量进行校正和精炼。
results: 案例研究和现网试验表明，该框架能有效提升室内IRS部署和室外基站部署的覆盖性能，且测量反馈能够支持CKM校准和配置精炼。
conclusion: 基于X2X CKM的环境感知网络规划框架能够有效应对6G网络规划中复杂环境覆盖的挑战，并通过实测反馈实现持续优化。

title: Fisher Information Characterization in GNSS DPE under Multipath-Induced Channel Uncertainty
authors: Sijia Li, Bing Xu, Shuo Tang, Pau Closas
abstract: The availability and utilization of Fisher information in global navigation satellite system (GNSS) direct position estimation (DPE) under multipath-induced channel uncertainty are investigated. First, a unified estimation-theoretic framework is developed to characterize information mapping and utilization across direct and two-step receivers. Next, a scalar-equivalent statistical channel model for short-delay multipath is established via least-squares (LS) projection. Based on this model, receiver-state Cramér-Rao bounds (CRBs) are derived under perfect and statistical channel knowledge, while misspecified CRBs (MCRBs) are derived under a simplified deterministic complex-gain model that neglects channel uncertainty. The closed-form approximations and asymptotic analyses of the derived bounds further reveal how channel uncertainty affects different components of waveform-domain Fisher information. Our results reveal that: 1) DPE and fully coupled two-step estimation achieve comparable accuracy, whereas the performance loss caused by sequential decoupling substantially exceeds the additional loss from suboptimal weighting; 2) under statistical channel knowledge, improving received signal quality does not necessarily yield noticeable positioning gains; 3) positioning information remains available even as the coherent channel mean vanishes; and 4) neglecting channel randomness causes the MCRBs to diverge in this limit and can introduce positioning error floors that become more pronounced with longer observations.

zh_title: 多径诱导信道不确定性下GNSS DPE中的费舍尔信息表征
translation: 本文研究了多径诱导信道不确定性下全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）直接位置估计（DPE）中费舍尔信息的可用性与利用情况。首先，开发了一个统一的估计理论框架，用于表征直接接收机和两步接收机之间的信息映射和利用。其次，通过最小二乘（LS）投影建立了一种用于短时延多径的标量等效统计信道模型。基于此模型，推导了在完美和统计信道已知情况下的接收机状态克拉美-罗界（CRBs），同时推导了忽略信道不确定性的简化确定性复增益模型下的误设CRB（MCRBs）。所得界的闭式近似和渐近分析进一步揭示了信道不确定性如何影响波形域费舍尔信息的不同分量。研究结果表明：1）DPE与完全耦合的两步估计达到相当的精度，而顺序解耦引起的性能损失大大超过了亚优加权产生的额外损失；2）在统计信道已知的情况下，提高接收信号质量不一定能产生明显的定位增益；3）即使相干信道均值消失，定位信息仍然可用；4）在此极限下，忽略信道随机性会导致MCRB发散，并可能引入随着观测时间延长而更加明显的定位误差下限。
tldr: 本文研究了多径信道不确定性对GNSS直接位置估计（DPE）中费舍尔信息的影响，通过推导克拉美-罗界揭示了信道不确定性与定位精度的内在关系。
ai_comments: 该论文深入探讨了多径信道不确定性下GNSS直接位置估计（DPE）的Fisher信息特征，通过建立统一的估计理论框架和推导CRB/MCRB，揭示了信道不确定性对定位性能的深远影响，具有重要的理论和实际应用价值。
motivation: 研究并阐明在多径引起的信道不确定性下，全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）直接位置估计（DPE）中费舍尔信息的可用性与利用情况。
method: 开发了统一的估计理论框架，通过最小二乘投影建立了短时延多径的标量等效统计信道模型，并推导了不同信道知识下的接收机状态CRB以及误设CRB（MCRB）。
results: 1) DPE与全耦合两步法精度相当，而顺序解耦性能损失显著；2) 在统计信道已知下，提升信号质量不必然带来定位增益；3) 相干信道均值消失时定位信息依然可用；4) 忽略信道随机性会导致MCRB发散并产生定位误差下限。
conclusion: 研究表明，信道不确定性对GNSS定位性能有重大影响，忽略信道随机性会导致性能评估失效，而DPE与全耦合两步法表现出相近的估计精度。

title: Deep-Learning-Assisted Full Waveform Inversion for Attenuation Reconstruction in Ultrasound Computed Tomography
authors: Mingrui Liu, Michael L. Oelze
abstract: Acoustic attenuation is more challenging to reconstruct and has received less attention than sound speed in ultrasound computed tomography using full-waveform inversion (FWI). In this study, a deep-learning (DL)-assisted FWI framework was proposed for attenuation reconstruction based on our previous work. Some numerical experiments were conducted to investigate the strategy and the effectiveness of using DL to help accelerate and improve the reconstruction quality of attenuation imaging in FWI. The results indicated that DL saved computational cost by 28% and improved attenuation reconstruction accuracy by 70% when combined with sufficiently accurate sound speed estimates. The result supports the potential of DL initialization to improve the computational efficiency and reconstruction quality of joint SOS and attenuation FWI.
zh_title: 深度学习辅助全波形反演用于超声计算机断层扫描中的衰减重建
translation: 在使用全波形反演（FWI）的超声计算机断层扫描中，声衰减的重建比声速更具挑战性，且受到的关注较少。在本研究中，基于我们先前的工作，提出了一种用于衰减重建的深度学习（DL）辅助FWI框架。研究开展了若干数值实验，以探讨利用DL加速并提高FWI衰减成像重建质量的策略和有效性。结果表明，当与足够精确的声速估计相结合时，DL可节省28%的计算成本，并将衰减重建精度提高70%。该结果支持了利用DL初始化来改善声速与衰减联合FWI计算效率和重建质量的潜力。
tldr: 本文提出了一种深度学习辅助的全波形反演框架，在准确声速估计配合下，将超声CT衰减重建的计算成本降低了28%，精度提升了70%。

motivation: 在使用全波形反演（FWI）的超声计算机断层扫描中，声衰减参数的重建相比声速更具挑战性，且以往受到的关注较少。
method: 基于作者先前的工作提出了一种深度学习（DL）辅助的FWI衰减重建框架，并通过数值实验研究利用DL加速并提升FWI衰减成像质量的策略与有效性。
