title: Multidimensional Source-Space MEG Representation of Network Imbalance in ADHD
authors: Xiran Guo, Zhihao Liu, Guanghua Liu
abstract: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is associated with an atypical imbalance between the default mode network (DMN) and task-control systems. However, compressing neural activity into a single macroscopic imbalance measure may obscure individual neurophysiological differences. To address this, we leveraged the source-orientation selectivity and related measurement properties of resting-state magnetoencephalography (MEG) to establish a multidimensional source-space network representation in 21 individuals with ADHD and 21 healthy controls. We defined the macroscopic imbalance in relative Alpha activity between the DMN and task-control systems as the Core, and expanded its constituent information along three dimensions: spatial sources, spectral composition, and temporal network organization: into in-depth measures, assessed for stability, robustness, and complementarity. We found that the ADHD group exhibited a significant Core Alpha imbalance, driven mainly by task-control regions, while the multidimensional expansion revealed complementary ADHD-related neurophysiological information not fully represented by the Core, suggesting that similar macroscopic imbalances may reflect distinct underlying physiological states. Across 40 exploratory within-cohort held-out evaluations with separate development and test subsets, mean ROC-AUC increased from 0.7607 (Core-only) to 0.8995 with multidimensional inputs and to 0.9051 with the final ensemble, and mean accuracy increased from 71.43% to 79.82%. These findings suggest that multidimensional source-space expansion can further clarify the neurophysiological composition of ADHD-related network imbalance and improve individual-level discrimination, offering an interpretable framework potentially applicable to other brain disorders characterized by network imbalance.
comment: Submitted to IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (JBHI)
zh_title: ADHD网络失衡的多维源空间MEG表征
translation: 注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）与默认模式网络（DMN）和任务控制系统之间的非典型失衡有关。然而，将神经活动压缩为单一的宏观失衡测量可能会掩盖个体神经生理学的差异。为了解决这个问题，我们利用静息态脑磁图（MEG）的源方向选择性和相关测量特性，在21名ADHD患者和21名健康对照中建立了多维源空间网络表征。我们将DMN与任务控制系统之间相对Alpha活动的宏观失衡定义为核心（Core），并沿着三个维度扩展其组成信息：空间源、频谱成分和时间网络组织，并评估了深入测量指标的稳定性、鲁棒性和互补性。我们发现，ADHD组表现出显著的Core Alpha失衡，主要由任务控制区域驱动；而多维扩展揭示了Core未完全代表的互补ADHD相关神经生理信息，这表明相似的宏观失衡可能反映了不同的底层生理状态。在包含独立开发和测试子集的40次探索性群组内留出评估中，平均ROC-AUC从仅Core的0.7607提高到多维输入的0.8995以及最终集合的0.9051，平均准确率从71.43%提高到79.82%。这些发现表明，多维源空间扩展可以进一步阐明ADHD相关网络失衡的神经生理成分，并改善个体层面的区分，为其他以网络失衡为特征的脑部疾病提供了一个潜在的解释性框架。
tldr: 本研究利用MEG提出了一种多维源空间网络表征方法，克服了传统单一宏观失衡测量的局限，揭示了ADHD患者深层的神经生理差异并显著提升了个体分类准确率。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将传统的宏观神经网络失衡测量扩展为多维源空间表征（涵盖空间源、频谱组成和时间网络组织），不仅揭示了ADHD患者看似相同的宏观失衡背后可能存在不同的潜在生理状态，还显著提升了个体层面的分类准确率，为精神疾病的脑网络研究提供了可解释的新框架。
motivation: 注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）与默认模式网络（DMN）和任务控制系统之间的非典型失衡有关，但将神经活动压缩为单一的宏观失衡测量可能会掩盖个体的神经生理差异。
method: 研究纳入21名ADHD患者和21名健康对照，利用静息态脑磁图（MEG）的源方向选择性及测量特性，将DMN与任务控制系统之间相对Alpha活动的宏观失衡定义为核心（Core），并沿空间源、频谱组成和时间网络组织三个维度对其进行扩展，评估其稳定性、鲁棒性和互补性，最后通过交叉验证评估分类性能。
results: ADHD组表现出显着的Core Alpha失衡，主要由任务控制区驱动；多维扩展揭示了Core未能完全代表的互补神经生理信息。在40次探索性留出评估中，多维输入的平均ROC-AUC从仅Core的0.7607提高到0.8995（最终集成达到0.9051），平均准确率从71.43%提高到79.82%。
conclusion: 多维源空间扩展能够进一步阐明ADHD相关网络失衡的神经生理成分，并提高个体层面的区分度，为其他以网络失衡为特征的脑部疾病提供了一个可解释的潜力框架。

title: Convolution-Augmented Transformer for Robust Blind CFO Estimation in LEO Satellite Communication System
authors: Miaomiao Wei, Huaiyuan Chen, Xinnan Shao, Lulu Gao, Hang Liu
abstract: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite communications are essential for achieving ubiquitous global connectivity. However, the high mobility of LEO satellites induces massive Doppler shifts and fast time-varying fading, severely impairing signal synchronization. Accurate Carrier Frequency Offset (CFO) estimation is critical for receiver synchronization. Nevertheless, conventional estimators and deep learning approaches often degrade significantly under highly dynamic, low-SNR conditions. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel Convolution Augmented Transformer architecture for robust, blind CFO estimation in LEO communication systems. Initially, to overcome the inherent limitations of standard linear embedding layers in capturing nonlinear phase rotations, we construct a multi-domain input feature that encompasses in-phase/quadrature (I/Q), polar, and statistical autocorrelation properties. Subsequently, a Convolutional Pre-Denoising (CPD) module, integrating multi-scale dilated convolutions and an attention mechanism, is deployed at the front end to adaptively suppress localized noise and extract robust spatiotemporal representations. These refined latent features are then processed by a Transformer encoder to explicitly track global, long-range phase dependencies. Extensive simulation results demonstrate that the proposed data-driven approach significantly outperforms conventional estimation algorithms, achieving enhanced estimation accuracy and superior resilience in highly dynamic LEO environments.
zh_title: 面向低轨卫星通信系统鲁棒盲载波频率偏移估计的卷积增强Transformer
translation: 低地轨道（LEO）卫星通信对于实现无处不在的全球连接至关重要。然而，LEO卫星的高移动性会引起巨大的多普勒频移和快速时变衰落，严重损害信号同步。精确的载波频率偏移（CFO）估计对于接收机同步至关重要。尽管如此，传统估计器和深度学习方法在高度动态、低信噪比（SNR）条件下性能往往会显著下降。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种新颖的卷积增强Transformer架构，用于LEO通信系统中的鲁棒、盲CFO估计。首先，为了克服标准线性嵌入层在捕获非线性相位旋转方面的固有局限性，我们构建了一个包含同相/正交（I/Q）、极坐标和统计自相关特性的多域输入特征。随后，前端部署了一个集成多尺度膨胀卷积和注意力机制的卷积预去噪（CPD）模块，以自适应地抑制局部噪声并提取鲁棒的时空表示。然后，这些精炼的潜在特征由Transformer编码器处理，以显式地跟踪全局的、长距离的相位依赖关系。大量的仿真结果表明，所提出的数据驱动方法显著优于传统估计算法，在高度动态的LEO环境中实现了更高的估计精度和卓越的鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合多域特征、卷积去噪和Transformer的新型架构，实现了低轨卫星通信中高动态、低信噪比条件下的鲁棒盲载波频率偏移估计。
ai_comments: 该论文巧妙结合了卷积神经网络（局部抗噪与时空表征）与Transformer（捕捉长距离相位依赖），针对低轨卫星通信中高动态、低信噪比场景下的盲载波频率偏移估计问题，提出了一个创新的多域输入与混合架构，显著提升了系统的鲁棒性。
motivation: 低轨卫星的高移动性会引发巨大的多普勒频移和快时变衰落，严重损害信号同步。传统估计器和现有深度学习方法在高度动态、低信噪比的条件下性能会显著下降，因此需要一种更具鲁棒性的盲载波频率偏移（CFO）估计方法。
method: 提出了一种新颖的卷积增强Transformer架构。首先构建包含I/Q、极坐标和统计自相关属性的多域输入特征；接着在前端部署集成多尺度膨胀卷积和注意力机制的卷积预去噪（CPD）模块以抑制噪声；最后利用Transformer编码器跟踪全局的远距离相位依赖关系。
results: 广泛的仿真结果表明，该数据-driven方法显著优于传统的估计算法，在高度动态的低轨卫星环境中实现了更高的估计精度和卓越的鲁棒性。
conclusion: 提出的卷积增强Transformer架构能够有效解决低轨卫星通信中高动态和低信噪比带来的盲CFO估计难题，在估计精度和鲁棒性方面均显著优于传统算法。

title: Trade-off Between Airspace and Channel Capacity for Low-altitude Wireless Network
authors: Xinyang Zhang, Yuanhao Cui, Xiaotong Zhao, Ningyan Guo, Christos Masouros, Dong In Kim
abstract: Communication-serviceable capacity for low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) networks depends on both spatial occupancy and wireless quality of service (QoS). This paper formulates a communication-feasible occupancy-planning model that maps candidate-grid assignments to concurrent beam loads and per-user rates under fixed-stream and fixed-beam power. With fixed effective noise, per-beam QoS screening determines maximum admission, and an exact dynamic program maximizes aggregate spectral efficiency at that fixed admission. Signal-level simulations validate the SINR expressions, while an explicit-array model examines load-dependent inter-beam leakage. The dynamic program is globally optimal for the separable integer problem, but that guarantee does not extend to the coupled problem. Equal-time orthogonal multiple access (OMA) and ideal-SIC non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) are evaluated through the same local beam reduction under fixed effective noise and fixed per-beam power.
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures; submitted to IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems (TAES)
zh_title: 低空无线网络中 airspace 与 channel capacity 的权衡
translation: 低空无人机（UAV）网络的通信服务能力取决于空间占用和无线服务质量（QoS）。本文建立了一个通信可行性的占用规划模型，在固定流和固定波束功率下，将候选网格分配映射到并发波束负载和每个用户的速率。在固定有效噪声下，每个波束的QoS筛选决定了最大接入量，而精确的动态规划在此固定接入量下最大化了总频谱效率。信号级仿真验证了SINR表达式，同时显式阵列模型检查了负载相关的波束间泄漏。对于可分离的整数问题，动态规划是全局最优的，但该保证不能扩展到耦合问题。在相同的固定有效噪声和每个波束功率下，通过相同的局部波束减少评估了等时正交多址接入（OMA）和理想SIC非正交多址接入（NOMA）。
tldr: 本文建立了低空无人机网络中空间占用与信道容量权衡的规划模型，并通过动态规划与仿真验证了其频谱效率。
ai_comments: 该论文新颖地探讨了低空无线网络中 airspace（空间占用）与 channel capacity（信道容量）之间的权衡关系，通过建立通信可行性占用规划模型，将候选网格分配与并发波束负载和用户速率挂钩，对低空无人机网络的研究具有重要价值。
motivation: 低空无人机（UAV）网络的通信服务能力取决于空间占用和无线服务质量（QoS）两方面，为了平衡这两者，需要研究低空无线网络中 airspace 与 channel capacity 之间的权衡。
method: 提出了一个通信可行性的占用规划模型，利用固定有效噪声下的最大接入筛选，通过精确的动态规划在固定接入下最大化总频谱效率；采用信号级仿真验证SINR表达式，并用显式阵列模型检查负载相关的波束间泄漏。
results: 信号级仿真验证了SINR表达式的准确性，动态规划对于可分离的整数问题是全局最优的，同时也评估了等时正交多址接入（OMA）与理想SIC非正交多址接入（NOMA）的性能。
conclusion: 论文建立并求解了低空无线网络中的通信可行性占用规划模型，验证了动态规划在特定条件下的全局最优性，并评估了OMA与NOMA的性能表现。

title: EEGSync: Unitary Temporal Alignment Method for Naturalistic and Resting-State EEG
authors: Anand A. Joshi, Satwik Bathula, Richard M. Leahy
abstract:
Electroencephalography (EEG) studies increasingly use naturalistic and resting-state paradigms that lack discrete event timing. These recordings contain structured oscillatory activity but often lack repeated stimulus onsets to define a shared time clock across trials or participants. We introduce EEGSync, a complex-valued unitary Procrustes temporal alignment method for band-limited analytic EEG signals. EEGSync represents each subject as a matrix of complex oscillatory trajectories and solves a unitary Procrustes problem, mapping a target subject into the temporal coordinate system of a reference or group template. The method is computationally tractable through an economy-SVD factorization that avoids constructing the full temporal operator. This alignment strictly preserves original pairwise relationships and power across EEG channels. The unitary transformation aligns latent temporal structure rather than estimating a physical clock offset. Consequently, nonlinear instantaneous measures like phase-locking value, amplitude-envelope correlation, and phase-amplitude coupling are not guaranteed to be invariant. This framing makes EEGSync highly suitable for naturalistic shared-stimulus data, and potentially useful for resting-state data as a covariance-preserving latent manifold alignment.
  Evaluated via subject-independent cross-validation across physiological and clinical settings, EEGSync-based features achieved an AUROC of 0.9600 and 89.45% maximum classification accuracy in eyes-open versus eyes-closed state discrimination. For Alzheimer's disease versus healthy control classification, the highest AUROC reached 0.9272 in eyes-closed recordings, with further discrimination under eyes-open photostimulation. These findings suggest temporal alignment captures discriminative information complementing conventional spectral and statistical EEG features.
zh_title: EEGSync：用于自然状态和静息态脑电图的单一时间对齐方法
translation:
脑电图（EEG）研究越来越多地使用缺乏离散事件定时的自然状态和静息态范式。这些记录包含结构化的振荡活动，但通常缺乏重复的刺激起点来定义跨试验或跨受试者的共享时间时钟。我们介绍了EEGSync，这是一种针对带限解析脑电信号的复值单一普罗克鲁斯时间对齐方法。EEGSync将每个受试者表示为复杂振荡轨迹的矩阵，并求解单一普罗克鲁斯问题，将目标受试者映射到参考或群体模板的时间坐标系统中。该方法通过经济型SVD分解计算上是易处理的，避免了构建完整的时间算子。这种对齐严格保留了EEG通道之间的原始两两关系和功率。单一变换对齐的是潜在时间结构，而不是估计物理时钟偏移。因此，非线性瞬时测量（如锁相值、振幅包络相关和相位-振幅耦合）不能保证是不变。这种框架使EEGSync非常适合自然状态的共享刺激数据，并且作为一种协方差保持的潜在流形对齐，对静息态数据也具有潜在的用处。
通过跨生理和临床设置的受试者独立交叉验证进行评估，基于EEGSync的特征在睁眼与闭眼状态区分中实现了0.9600的AUROC和89.45%的最大分类效率。对于阿尔茨海默病与健康对照的分类，在闭眼记录中最高AUROC达到了0.9272，并在睁眼光刺激下进行了进一步区分。这些发现表明，时间对齐捕捉到了补充传统光谱和统计EEG特征的判别信息。
tldr: 本文提出了EEGSync，一种用于自然状态和静息态脑电图的新型复值时间对齐方法，在保持脑电功率和通道关系的同时有效对齐潜在时间结构，并在生理和临床分类任务中取得高准确率。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的复杂值单一普罗克鲁斯对齐方法（EEGSync），专门用于处理缺乏离散事件时间戳的自然状态和静息态脑电图（EEG）。该方法在保持功率和通道间关系的同时，能够有效对齐潜在时间结构，并在分类任务中表现出优异的性能，具有重要的应用价值。
motivation: 自然状态和静息态脑电图（EEG）研究缺乏离散的事件时间，导致跨试验或跨受试者时无法共享时间坐标轴，因此需要一种无需明确事件时钟的时间对齐方法来对齐结构化振荡活动。
method: 提出EEGSync方法，这是一种针对带限解析脑电信号的复值单一普罗克鲁斯（unitary Procrustes）时间对齐方法。通过经济型SVD分解求解，将目标受试者映射到参考或群体模板的时间坐标系中。
results: 在受试者无关的交叉验证中，基于EEGSync特征的睁闭眼状态分类AUROC达到0.9600，最大分类准确率为89.45%；在阿尔茨海默病与健康对照的分类中，睁眼光刺激及闭眼记录下的AUROC最高达到0.9272。
conclusion: EEGSync通过对齐潜在于脑电数据中的时间结构，为缺乏明确时间锚点的脑电数据分析提供了一种强有力的工具，且在生理和临床分类任务中展现出卓越的性能。

title: Towards Deep Learning-Based Linear Assignment Problem Solvers for Multi-Object Tracking
authors: Chu Tam Vu, Tran Thi Thuy Quynh, Do Hai Son
abstract: This paper proposes and evaluates deep learning (DL)-based linear assignment problem (LAP) solvers as a replacement for the classical Hungarian algorithm in multi-object tracking (MOT) systems. Three representative neural models are studied, namely a convolutional network (CNN), a graph neural network (GNN), and the graph-based linear assignment network (GLAN). A cost-matrix embedding is introduced so that a single model operates on cost matrices of any size, as required in MOT where the number of objects varies over time, without training a separate model for each input shape. Extensive simulations show that the embedding improves the accuracy of the neural solvers (i.e., CNN and GNN), while GLAN attains the best accuracy among them. These solvers are then integrated into a generalized labeled multi-Bernoulli (GLMB) tracker and evaluated on the WILDTRACK dataset, where GLAN yields tracking accuracy close to the Hungarian reference and comparable to recent DL-based trackers.
zh_title: 迈向基于深度学习的多目标跟踪线性分配问题求解器
translation: 本文提出并评估了基于深度学习（DL）的线性分配问题（LAP）求解器，以替代多目标跟踪（MOT）系统中的经典匈牙利算法。研究了三种代表性神经模型：卷积网络（CNN）、图神经网络（GNN）和基于图的线性分配网络（GLAN）。引入了一种代价矩阵嵌入，使单一模型能够对任意大小的代价矩阵进行操作（正如MOT中对象数量随时间变化的需求那样），而无需针对每种输入形状训练单独的模型。广泛的模拟表明，该嵌入提高了神经求解器（即CNN和GNN）的准确率，其中GLAN在它们之中获得了最佳准确率。然后，将这些求解器集成到广义标记多伯努利（GLMB）跟踪器中，并在WILDTRACK数据集上进行评估，其中GLAN产生的跟踪准确率接近匈牙利参考值，并可与近期的DL基跟踪器相媲美。
tldr: 本文提出使用深度学习模型（如GLAN）结合代价矩阵嵌入技术来替代传统的多目标跟踪匈牙利算法，实验证明其能达到接近传统算法的准确率。
ai_comments: 该论文探索了使用深度学习（CNN、GNN、GLAN）替代传统匈牙利算法来求解多目标跟踪中的线性分配问题，并通过引入代价矩阵嵌入技术很好地解决了输入形状可变的问题，为深度学习在经典组合优化问题中的应用提供了有价值的参考。
motivation: 传统多目标跟踪（MOT）系统通常使用经典的匈牙利算法来求解线性分配问题（LAP），该研究旨在评估基于深度学习的LAP求解器作为其替代方案的可行性与性能。
method: 研究了三种代表性神经网络模型（CNN、GNN和GLAN），并引入了一种代价矩阵嵌入方法，使单一模型能够处理任意大小的代价矩阵；随后将这些求解器集成到广义标记多伯努利（GLMB）跟踪器中并在WILDTRACK数据集上进行评估。
results: 广泛的模拟表明，代价矩阵嵌入提高了神经网络求解器（CNN和GNN）的准确率，其中GLAN在它们之中达到了最佳准确率。在WILDTRACK数据集上的评估显示，GLAN的跟踪准确率接近匈牙利算法参考值，并与近期的DL基跟踪器相当。
conclusion: 深度学习基础的线性分配问题求解器（特别是GLAN）可以有效集成到多目标跟踪系统中，其跟踪准确率接近传统的匈牙利算法，且与近期基于深度学习的跟踪器具有可比性。

title: Micrograph B-factor estimation via Wilson statistics
authors: Ayelet Heimowitz, Amit Singer
abstract: The single-particle cryo-electron microscopy imaging process is known to cause exponential decay in the amplitude and power spectra of proteins. This decay is modeled by the B factor and is currently corrected as a post-processing stage of the 3D reconstruction. As a consequence, all experimental images in the dataset are assumed to share the same B factor. In this paper, we suggest a novel approach wherein the B factor is determined and corrected as a preprocessing step to the reconstruction. We show such an approach can improve reconstruction resolution.
zh_title: 基于威尔逊统计的显微图像B因子估计
translation: 单颗粒冷冻电子显微镜成像过程已知会导致蛋白质振幅和功率谱呈指数衰减。这种衰减由B因子建模，目前在3D重构的后处理阶段进行校正。因此，数据集中的所有实验图像都被假设共享相同的B因子。在本文中，我们提出了一种新方法，其中B因子在重构的预处理阶段被确定和校正。我们表明这种方法可以提高重构分辨率。
tldr: 本论文提出在预处理阶段利用威尔逊统计估计和校正冷冻电镜显微图像的B因子，从而提高了重构分辨率。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将冷冻电镜单颗粒重构中的B因子校正从传统的后处理阶段前置到预处理阶段，并针对每张实验图像单独估计和校正B因子，从而提高了重构分辨率。
motivation: 传统的冷冻电镜单颗粒重构中，B因子衰减通常在3D重构的后处理阶段进行校正，这导致数据集中所有实验图像都被假设共享相同的B因子，忽略了图像间的差异。
method: 提出了一种新方法，利用威尔逊统计在重构前的预处理阶段确定和校正每张显微图像的B因子。
results: 实验表明，在预处理阶段确定和校正B因子的方法能够有效改善重构分辨率。
conclusion: 通过利用威尔逊统计在预处理阶段估计并校正显微图像的B因子，能够有效提升冷冻电镜单颗粒重构的分辨率。

title: Toward Massive MIMO HAPS Networks: Antenna Architectures and Design
authors: Shasha Liu, Abla Kammoun, Mohamed Slim Alouini
abstract: High-altitude platform stations (HAPS) are expected to become an important component of sixth-generation (6G) and beyond wireless networks by providing wide-area wireless connectivity through massive multiple-input multiple-output (mMIMO) technology. As the communication performance of HAPS systems is fundamentally determined by the antenna array architecture, efficient antenna design has become a critical research topic. Motivated by these considerations, this article provides a comprehensive overview of antenna array design for mMIMO-enabled HAPS systems and proposes two novel antenna architectures to improve antenna-user alignment and communication performance. Specifically, the representative applications of mMIMO-enabled HAPS are first introduced, followed by the key design requirements for HAPS antenna arrays. Representative antenna architectures are then systematically reviewed and compared under a unified simulation framework based on the 3GPP NTN channel model. Finally, several promising research directions are discussed to provide insights into the design of next-generation intelligent HAPS antenna systems.
zh_title: 面向大规模MIMO HAPS网络：天线架构与设计
translation: 高空平台站（HAPS）有望成为第六代（6G）及以后无线网络的重要组成部分，通过大规模多输入多输出（mMIMO）技术提供广域无线连接。由于HAPS系统的通信性能根本上取决于天线阵列架构，高效的天线设计已成为一个关键的研究课题。受这些考虑的启发，本文全面概述了mMIMO赋能的HAPS系统的天线阵列设计，并提出了两种新型天线架构，以改善天线与用户的对准以及通信性能。具体而言，首先介绍了mMIMO赋能HAPS的代表性应用，接着阐述了HAPS天线阵列的关键设计要求。随后，在基于3GPP NTN信道模型的统一仿真框架下，系统地回顾和比较了代表性天线架构。最后，讨论了几个有前景的研究方向，为下一代智能HAPS天线系统的设计提供见解。
tldr: 本文综述了面向6G的大规模MIMO高空平台站（HAPS）天线设计，提出了两种新型天线架构，并在3GPP NTN模型下进行了仿真对比与未来展望。
ai_comments: 本文系统性地综述了大规模MIMO赋能的高空平台站（HAPS）的天线架构与设计，并创新性地提出了两种新型天线架构，结合3GPP NTN信道模型进行了统一仿真对比，为6G HAPS网络的天线设计提供了重要的理论参考和研究方向。
motivation: HAPS作为6G及未来无线网络的重要组成部分，其通信性能取决于天线阵列架构。为满足宽区域无线连接需求，高效的大规模MIMO天线设计至关重要。
method: 系统回顾和对比了代表性的天线架构，在基于3GPP NTN信道模型的统一仿真框架下进行评估，并提出了两种旨在改善天线-用户对准和通信性能的新型天线架构。
results: 介绍了mMIMO HAPS的代表性应用和关键设计要求，通过统一框架对代表性天线架构进行了系统性比较，并提出了提升性能的两大新型天线架构以及未来的研究方向。
conclusion: 本文全面概述了大规模MIMO HAPS系统的天线阵列设计，提出了两款新型天线架构以增强对准和通信性能，并通过统一的仿真框架对代表性架构进行了对比，指出了未来的研究方向。

title: Stochastic Optimisation for Scalable Ptychographic Image Reconstruction
authors: Alan W. Muriithi, Jared Tanner, Jaroslav M. Fowkes, Benedikt J. Daurer
abstract: X-ray ptychography is a lensless coherent diffraction imaging technique capable of high spatial resolution, in which an image is reconstructed by solving a large-scale inverse problem from highly redundant far-field diffraction measurements acquired under overlapping illumination. Whilst the measurement redundancy created by overlapping illumination is essential for reconstruction fidelity, it leads to computational and memory demands that scale poorly with object size and target resolution when using conventional reconstruction algorithms. This work proposes a ptychographic reconstruction framework that reduces peak memory usage and time to convergence by leveraging stochastic optimisation techniques developed for large-scale machine learning. Specifically, the framework employs stochastic gradient descent with a decaying step size that progressively reduces the effect of gradient noise, referred to here as variance reduction (VR), with gradients that agree with automatic differentiation, to optimise the ptychographic forward model using randomly sampled subsets of diffraction measurements. For an experimental dataset of 200,000 diffraction patterns of $128\times128$ pixels, VR is demonstrated to require $65\%$ of the peak GPU memory and $22\%$ of the reconstruction time of the established maximum-likelihood (ML) algorithm. The VR framework incorporates the Poisson maximum-likelihood formulation and partial coherence within a unified and extensible optimisation setting. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the framework achieves reconstruction quality visually comparable to established methods, with lower peak GPU memory and a shorter time
zh_title: 面向可扩展叠层成像重建的随机优化
translation: X射线叠层成像是一种无透镜相干衍射成像技术，具有高空间分辨率，通过求解在重叠照明下采集的高度冗余远场衍射测量的大规模逆问题来重建图像。虽然重叠照明产生的测量冗余对于重建保真度至关重要，但当使用传统重建算法时，它会导致计算和内存需求随物体大小和目标分辨率呈极差的扩展性。本工作提出了一种叠层成像重建框架，通过利用为大规模机器学习开发的随机优化技术，降低了峰值内存使用和收敛时间。具体而言，该框架采用具有衰减步长的随机梯度下降，该步长渐进地减小梯度噪声的影响（在此称为方差缩减，VR），其梯度与自动微分相契合，利用随机采样的衍射测量子集来优化叠层成像前向模型。对于包含200,000个 $128\times128$ 像素衍射图样的实验数据集，经验证VR仅需传统最大似然（ML）算法的 $65\%$ 峰值GPU内存和 $22\%$ 的重建时间。VR框架在统一且可扩展的优化设置中结合了泊松最大似然公式和部分相干性。数值实验表明，该框架在实现与传统方法视觉上相当的重建质量的同时，具有更低的峰值GPU内存和更短的时间。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于机器学习随机优化（方差缩减）的叠层成像重建框架，大幅减少了计算内存并缩短了重建时间。
ai_comments: 该论文将大规模机器学习中的随机优化技术（特别是方差缩减的随机梯度下降）引入X射线叠层成像（ptychography）中，显著降低了计算内存并缩短了重建时间，具有很高的实用价值和创新性。
motivation: 传统的叠层成像重建算法在面对大规模对象和高目标分辨率时，由于重叠照明产生的测量冗余，导致计算和内存需求急剧增加，扩展性较差。
method: 提出了一种基于随机优化技术的叠层成像重建框架，采用带有衰减步长的随机梯度下降（方差缩减，VR）和自动微分，利用随机采样的衍射测量子集来优化前向模型。
results: 在包含200,000个128x128像素衍射图样的实验数据集上，该方法仅需传统最大似然算法65%的峰值GPU内存和22%的重建时间，且重建图像质量与之相当。
conclusion: 提出的基于方差缩减的随机优化框架能够有效应对大规模叠层成像的计算和内存瓶颈，在保持重建质量的同时大幅提高效率。

title: Constellation Shaping for OFDM-ISAC Systems: A Systematic and Experimental Comparison
authors: Benedikt Geiger, Daniel Gil Gaviria, Christian Karle, Delcho Donev, Charlotte Muth, Thomas Zwick, Jürgen Becker, Benjamin Nuss, Laurent Schmalen
abstract: Emerging integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) systems reuse the communications signal for radar-like sensing to provide environmental awareness. However, this integrated design imposes conflicting constraints on the modulation format, as communications systems use higher-order modulation formats while sensing systems use unit-modulus signals, making constellation shaping a key performance driver in ISAC systems. This paper develops a unified analytical and experimental framework for constellation shaping in monostatic orthogonal frequency division multiplexing ISAC systems and systematically analyzes its interaction with the three canonical sensing channel estimators (SCEs): the matched filter, the reciprocal filter, and the Wiener filter (WF). We begin by deriving constellation-dependent image signal-to-interference-and-noise ratio (ISINR) expressions for the SCEs that account for practical effects such as windowing and multi target scenarios. Based on this, we derive the corresponding entropy-maximizing channel input distributions. We generalize an autoencoder framework to optimize geometric, probabilistic, including conventional and generalized low-complexity probabilistic amplitude shaping (PAS), and joint constellation shaping across all three SCEs. Extensive simulations and hardware-in-the-loop experiments validate the derived ISINR and show that sensing performance is governed by the SCE choice, while communications performance is dominated by the shaping method. Notably, the WF combined with joint shaping achieves the best ISAC trade-off. Low-complexity PAS variants closely approach this performance, offering a flexible trade-off and outperforming legacy modulation formats.

zh_title: OFDM-ISAC系统的星座整形：系统性与实验性比较
translation: 新兴的集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统复用通信信号进行雷达式感知以提供环境感知能力。然而，这种集成设计对调制格式施加了相互冲突的约束：通信系统使用高阶调制格式，而感知系统使用单位模信号，这使得星座整形成为ISAC系统中的关键性能驱动因素。本文针对单基地正交频分复用（OFDM）ISAC系统，开发了一个用于星座研究的统一分析与实验框架，并系统地分析了其与三种典型感知信道估计器（SCEs）的相互作用：匹配滤波器、倒置滤波器和维纳滤波器（WF）。我们首先推导了针对SCE的、依赖于星座的图像信干噪比（ISINR）表达式，这些表达式考虑了窗函数和多目标场景等实际效应。在此基础上，我们推导了相应的最大熵信道输入分布。我们泛化了一个自动编码器框架，以优化所有三种SCE下的几何、概率（包括传统和广义低复杂度概率幅度整形（PAS））以及联合星座整形。大量的仿真和硬件在环实验验证了所推导的ISINR，并表明感知性能由SCE的选择主导，而通信性能则由整形方法主导。值得注意的是，WF与联合整形相结合实现了最佳的ISAC折衷。低复杂度PAS变体紧密接近这一性能，提供了灵活的折衷方案，并优于传统调制格式。
tldr: 该论文在OFDM-ISAC系统中系统评估了星座整形方法与感知信道估计器的交互，证明Wiener滤波结合联合整形可实现最佳ISAC性能权衡。
ai_comments: 该论文系统性地研究了OFDM-ISAC系统中的星座整形技术，首次建立了一个统一的分析和实验框架，连接了三种经典的感知信道估计器与不同星座整形方法，具有很高的理论价值和实际应用指导意义。
motivation: 新兴的ISAC系统复用通信信号进行雷达式感知，但通信追求高阶调制而感知偏好恒模信号，两者的冲突使得星座整形成为ISAC系统的关键性能驱动因素，亟需系统性的研究和比较。
method: 推导了考虑窗函数和多目标场景的ISINR表达式，基于此推导了熵最大化的信道输入分布，并泛化了一个自动编码器框架来优化几何、概率及联合星座整形。
results: 仿真和硬件在环实验验证了ISINR推导；感知性能受感知信道估计器（SCE）选择主导，而通信性能由整形方法主导；Wiener滤波与联合整形结合取得最佳ISAC折衷。
conclusion: Wiener滤波结合联合星座整形实现了最佳的ISAC性能权衡，且低复杂度PAS变体能以较低代价接近最优性能，超越传统调制格式。

title: Spectrally Correlated Frequency Spreading Codes for FRESH Filtering-based Interference Cancellation
authors: Karim Said, Xinrui Li, Daniel J. Jakubisin, Jeffrey H. Reed
abstract: Frequency shift (FRESH) filters can achieve co-channel interference cancellation by exploiting spectral correlation statistics of both the desired and interfering signals. In orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) signals, spectral correlation can be introduced in a structured way by symbol repetition across subcarriers. While this repetition generally requires duplicating symbols by an integer multiple of 2+ times (significantly impacting spectral efficiency), in this work it is shown that applying an incomplete spreading code, that trades spectral efficiency, to the desired signal can control its spectral correlation properties at redundancy factors less than 2. The distribution of the spectral correlation across frequencies determines the level of protection against interference at a given frequency. We introduce the design of frequency spreading codes that provide uniform spectral correlation distribution across frequencies, which provides equal interference cancellation capability independent of the center frequency of the interfering signal. The introduced spreading code can achieve arbitrary code rates while possessing two important properties: 1) semi-orthogonality and 2) spectral correlation uniformity. We evaluate the BER performance at very low signal-to-interference levels SIR$=0, 5 $ dB comparing spreading, LDPC, and LDPC+spreading at equal code rates.
zh_title: 用于基于FRESH滤波抗干扰的谱相关频域扩频码
translation: 频移（FRESH）滤波器可以通过利用期望信号和干扰信号的谱相关统计特性来实现同信道干扰消除。在正交频分复用（OFDM）信号中，可以通过子载波间的符号重复以结构化的方式引入谱相关。虽然这种重复通常需要将符号复制2倍或以上的整数倍（显著影响频谱效率），但本工作表明，对期望信号应用以牺牲一定频谱效率为代价的不完整扩频码，可以在小于2的冗余因子下控制其谱相关特性。谱相关在频率上的分布决定了给定频率下的抗干扰保护水平。我们介绍了频域扩频码的设计，该扩频码在各个频率上提供均匀的谱相关分布，从而提供与干扰信号中心频率无关的相等干扰消除能力。所引入的扩频码可以实现任意码率，同时具备两个重要特性：1）半正交性，2）谱相关均匀性。我们在非常低的信干比（SIR = 0, 5 dB）下评估了BER性能，并在相等的码率下比较了扩频、LDPC以及LDPC+扩频的性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种用于FRESH滤波器的频域扩频码，通过引入谱相关均匀性和半正交性，在极低信干比下有效实现同信道干扰消除，同时避免了传统方法对频谱效率的严重影响。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种基于不完整频域扩频码的FRESH滤波抗干扰方法，能够在小于2的冗余因子下控制信号的谱相关特性，并在牺牲部分频谱效率的同时实现均匀的谱相关分布和任意码率。论文结构清晰，针对OFDM系统的同信道干扰问题提出了创新性的解决方案。
motivation: 传统的基于符号重复的FRESH滤波器虽然能利用OFDM信号的谱相关性进行同信道干扰消除，但通常需要将符号重复整数倍（$\ge 2$），严重影响了频谱效率。为此，需要在小于2的冗余因子下有效控制谱相关特性并保持良好的抗干扰能力。
method: 提出应用不完整频域扩频码来控制期望信号的谱相关特性，设计出能够提供跨频率均匀谱相关分布的频域扩频码，使其兼具半正交性和谱相关均匀性，并对比了扩频、LDPC以及LDPC+扩频在极低SIR下的BER性能。
results: 该方法能够在小于2的冗余因子下控制信号的谱相关特性，实现任意码率，并具备半正交性和谱相关均匀性，在极低SIR条件下展现了优于对比方案的BER性能。
conclusion: 所提出的具有半正交性和谱相关均匀性的频域扩频码能够有效实现FRESH滤波器的同信道干扰消除，在低SIR环境下表现出良好的误码率性能。

title: Greedy Vector Approximation Based on Rotation for Multiplierless Complex Products
authors: Luiz F. da S. Coelho, Paulo S. R. Diniz, Didier Le Ruyet
abstract: This paper proposes a greedy approximation algorithm for performing complex-valued inner products in multiplierless hardware. The matching pursuits for accurate rotation approximation (MPARA) algorithm approximates the tangent of the phase of complex elements as a sum of signed powers of two (SOPOT) representation, enabling multiplierless hardware for complex-valued multiplication. The proposed algorithm outperforms other state-of-the-art approximation methods for approximating the twiddle factors of a fast Fourier transform (FFT).
comment: This paper is submitted to ICASSP 2027
zh_title: 基于旋转的无乘法器复数积贪婪向量近似
translation: 本文提出了一种用于在无乘法器硬件中执行复数值内积的贪婪近似算法。用于精确旋转近似的匹配追踪（MPARA）算法将复数元素的相位正切近似为有符号二的幂和（SOPOT）表示形式，从而实现了用于复数值乘法的无乘法器硬件。该算法在近似快速傅里叶变换（FFT）的旋转因子方面优于其他前沿近似方法。
tldr: 提出 MPARA 贪婪算法，利用 SOPOT 表示相位正切，实现高效的无乘法器复数乘法及高精度的 FFT 旋转因子近似。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将匹配追踪（Matching Pursuits）思想引入复数旋转相位近似中，将正切值转化为有符号二的幂和（SOPOT），显著降低了硬件中复数乘法器的资源开销，对低功耗边缘计算和专用信号处理芯片（如FFT加速器）的设计具有较高的工程实用价值。其局限性在于摘要中仅展示了在FFT旋转因子上的表现，对于更大规模矩阵运算或通用复数内积的泛化能力未在摘要中说明。
motivation: 旨在为无乘法器硬件设计高效的复数值内积计算方案，降低复数乘法在硬件实现中的复杂度和开销。
method: 提出了用于精确旋转近似的匹配追踪（MPARA）贪婪算法，该算法将复数元素的相位正切近似为有符号二的幂和（SOPOT）表示形式。
results: 在逼近快速傅里叶变换（FFT）旋转因子的测试中，所提出的 MPARA 算法性能优于现有的其他前沿近似方法。
conclusion: MPARA算法能够成功将复数相位正切转换为SOPOT表示，从而在无乘法器硬件中实现高性能复数乘法，并在FFT旋转因子近似中达到领先水平。

title: Slim-Mamba: An Efficient and Reconfigurable Mamba-Based Accelerator for Massive MIMO Indoor Localization
authors: Shengjie Chen, Chenxi Zhang, Sijia Cheng, Ove Edfors, Liang Liu, Ilayda Yaman
abstract: Using real-world massive MIMO measurements from the LuViRA dataset, we present a system-level solution combining Mamba-based model development and hardware acceleration for indoor localization. Three Mamba-based models are explored: the original Mamba architecture, CMamba, a channel-correlation-enhanced state-space model designed to exploit correlations across input channels, and our proposed Slim-Mamba. Hardware implementation and bottleneck analysis are then used to guide further model simplification and optimization. The resulting Slim-Mamba simplifies the original Mamba selective state-space block into a lightweight gated recurrent update, preserving temporal state modelling and output gating while reducing the complexity of the selective-scan computation. The deployed model contains 816k trainable parameters and has a model size of 3.40MB under FP32 precision while maintaining high localization accuracy. The corresponding accelerator provides a reconfigurable architecture with a highly parallel MAC array optimized for matrix-vector operations and fine-grained pipelining, improving resource utilization and reducing inference latency. The hardware-aware fixed-point model achieves a mean localization error of 0.14m, closely matching the floating-point baseline. Implemented on a Zynq UltraScale+ ZCU102 FPGA, the four-block backbone has an estimated serial latency of 212.04us per token at 100MHz.
zh_title: Slim-Mamba：面向大规模MIMO室内定位的高效可重构Mamba架构加速器
translation: 利用LuViRA数据集中的真实大规模MIMO测量数据，我们提出了一种结合Mamba模型开发和硬件加速的系统级室内 localization（定位）解决方案。研究了三种基于Mamba的模型：原始Mamba架构、旨在利用输入通道间相关性的通道相关性增强状态空间模型CMamba，以及我们提出的Slim-Mamba。硬件实现和瓶颈分析随后用于指导模型的进一步简化和优化。由此产生的Slim-Mamba将原始Mamba的选择性状态空间块简化为轻量级的门控循环更新，在保留时间状态建模和输出门控的同时降低了选择性扫描计算的复杂度。部署的模型包含816k个可训练参数，在FP32精度下的模型大小为3.40MB，同时保持了高定位精度。相应的加速器提供了一种可重构架构，带有针对矩阵向量运算优化的、高度并行的MAC阵列以及细粒度流水线，提高了资源利用率并降低了推理延迟。硬件感知的定点模型实现了0.14米的平均定位误差，与浮点基线非常吻合。在Zynq UltraScale+ ZCU102 FPGA上实现时，该四块骨干网在100MHz下每个token的估计串行延迟为212.04us。
tldr: 该论文开发了Slim-Mamba及其FPGA硬件加速器，实现了面向大规模MIMO的高精度、低延迟室内定位。
ai_comments: 该论文展示了从算法设计（引入Slim-Mamba）到硬件加速（FPGA实现）的全栈式室内定位优化方案，对大MIMO系统中的高效时序建模和边缘计算具有重要意义。
motivation: 为了解决现有室内定位系统在处理大规模MIMO测量数据时计算复杂度高、延迟大的问题，探索并优化基于Mamba的模型及其硬件加速方案。
method: 结合基于Mamba的模型开发与硬件加速，提出将Mamba选择性状态空间块简化为轻量级门控循环更新的Slim-Mamba模型，并设计了带有高度并行MAC阵列和细粒度流水线的可重构硬件加速器。
results: Slim-Mamba模型参数量为816k，FP32下大小为3.40MB；硬件感知定点模型平均定位误差为0.14m；在Zynq UltraScale+ ZCU102 FPGA上实现，四块骨干网在100MHz下每个token的估计串行延迟为212.04us。
conclusion: 提出了一种高效、可重构的基于Mamba的室内定位加速器Slim-Mamba，在保持高定位精度的同时显著降低了计算复杂度和硬件延迟。

title: ASDL: A Fast Vector Approximation Algorithm for Multiplierless Designs of Convolutional Neural Networks
authors: Guillaume H. Tong, Luiz F. da S. Coelho, Lounis Zerioul, Didier Le Ruyet
abstract: Matrix multiplications are one of the main computational bottlenecks in neural networks. The calculation reduces to numerous sums of partial products, which scale with the total number of Signed Power of Two (SPT) values in the multiplier matrix. Minimizing the SPT count can significantly reduce the computational burden. In this context, we present a Sum Of (signed) Powers Of Two (SOPOT) vector approximation algorithm that limits SPT counts, namely the Accelerated Signed Digit Loading (ASDL) algorithm. This approximation algorithm converts ResNet50 10 times faster than its predecessor MPGBP, while being more precise. We apply this method to the pre-trained coefficients of different convolutional neural networks, achieving 80.41\% ImageNet accuracy down from 81.3\%, at an average of only 1.5 active bits per coefficient. This is done without any retraining or calibration, which are typically required for the most aggressive quantization methods. Our approach offers a promising direction for neural network inference with higher energy efficiency and fewer hardware requirements: we anticipate up to 10 times improvement over bfloat16 inference.
zh_title: ASDL：一种用于卷积神经网络无乘法器设计的快速向量近似算法
translation: 矩阵乘法是神经网络中的主要计算瓶颈之一。该计算简化为大量的局部乘积之和，这些和与乘法器矩阵中总的有符号二的幂（SPT）值数量成正比。最小化SPT计数可以显著减少计算负担。在此背景下，我们提出了一种求和（有符号）二的幂（SOPOT）向量近似算法，该算法限制了SPT计数，被称为加速有符号数加载（ASDL）算法。该近似算法转换ResNet50的速度比其前身MPGBP快10倍，且更加精确。我们将该方法应用于不同卷积神经网络的预训练系数，在平均每个系数仅有1.5个有效比特的情况下，实现了80.41%的ImageNet准确率（原为81.3%）。这一过程不需要任何通常在最具侵略性的量化方法中所需的重新训练或校准。我们的方法为具有更高能源效率和更少硬件需求的神经网络推理提供了有前景的方向：我们预计其性能比bfloat16推理提升高达10倍。
tldr: 本文提出了ASDL算法，这是一种快速的向量近似算法，用于卷积神经网络的无乘法器设计。它能在无需重新训练或校准的情况下大幅提高能效并减少硬件需求，同时保持高精度。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种无需重新训练或校准的快速向量近似算法ASDL，用于卷积神经网络的无乘法器设计。它通过最小化有符号二的幂（SPT）数量显著降低了计算和硬件需求，在保持高准确率的同时大幅提升了处理速度和能源效率。
motivation: 矩阵乘法是神经网络的主要计算瓶颈，其计算量与乘法器矩阵中Signed Power of Two (SPT) 值的总数成正比。最小化SPT数量能够显著减轻计算负担，因此需要开发一种快速且高精度的向量近似算法来实现高效的无乘法器设计。
method: 提出了加速有符号数加载（ASDL）算法，这是一种SOPOT向量近似算法，用于限制和最小化矩阵中的SPT计数值，从而优化卷积神经网络的预训练系数。
results: 该算法转换ResNet50的速度比其前身MPGBP快10倍且精度更高；在不同的卷积神经网络上应用该方法，无需重新训练或校准，在平均每个系数仅有1.5个有效比特的情况下，ImageNet准确率从81.3%微降至80.41%，相比bfloat16推理有望实现高达10倍的性能提升。
conclusion: ASDL算法为卷积神经网络的硬件推理提供了一种高效的无乘法器设计方案，在无需重训和校准的情况下实现了极高的能效比和准确率。

title: Risk-Aware Safe Hierarchical Learning for Robust eMBB-URLLC Resource Allocation in O-RAN
authors: Mohammad Hussain, Dilara Gurer, Gokhan Kalem, Sinem Coleri
abstract: Joint resource allocation for enhanced mobile broadband (eMBB) and ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC) must satisfy stringent URLLC latency and reliability requirements while maintaining eMBB throughput under uncertain traffic and channel conditions. Existing learning-based allocators often optimize average aggregate performance without explicitly accounting for prediction errors, potentially resulting in severe service degradation for individual users. We propose a risk-aware safe hierarchical learning framework for Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN) that learns resource-feasible allocations using service-cost penalties and a per-user URLLC service test. A non-real-time policy determines slice-level resource-block and power budgets, near-real-time policies allocate resource blocks and transmit power among users, and an execution-time safety layer checks per-user URLLC service and corrects allocations through bounded resource transfers when feasible. A deterministic per-user service test, derived using protected rates accounting for channel state information prediction errors and conformal upper bounds on traffic demand, ensures satisfaction of the probabilistic URLLC requirement. Service-specific conditional value-at-risk objectives prioritize users with the highest URLLC deadline-miss ratios and lowest eMBB rates. Experimental results show that, under nominal load, the proposed framework is the only evaluated method that satisfies both the URLLC deadline-miss target and worst-user eMBB rate criterion on average. It reduces the mean miss ratio by 64% relative to the best baseline in this metric and achieves the highest worst-user eMBB rate.
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Communications
zh_title: Open-RAN中面向鲁棒eMBB-URLLC资源分配的风险感知安全分层学习
translation: 增强型移动宽带（eMBB）与超可靠低时延通信（URLLC）的联合资源分配必须在满足严格的URLLC时延和可靠性要求的同时，在不确定的流量和信道条件下维持eMBB吞吐量。现有的基于学习的分配器通常优化平均聚合性能，而没有显式考虑预测误差，这可能导致个别用户的服务严重恶化。我们为开放式无线接入网（O-RAN）提出了一种风险感知安全分层学习框架，该框架使用服务成本惩罚和每用户URLLC服务测试来学习资源可行的分配。非实时策略确定切片级的资源块和功率预算，近实时策略在用户之间分配资源块和发射功率，执行时安全层检查每用户URLLC服务并在可行时通过有界资源转移来修正分配。通过利用信道状态信息预测误差和流量需求的保形上限推导出的确定性每用户服务测试，确保满足概率URLLC要求。特定服务的条件风险价值（CVaR）目标优先考虑URLLC截止期错失率最高和eMBB速率最低的用户。实验结果表明，在标称负载下，所提出的框架是唯一平均同时满足URLLC截止期错失目标和最差用户eMBB速率标准的评估方法。相对于该指标下的最佳基准，它将平均错失率降低了64%，并实现了最高的最差用户eMBB速率。
tldr: 提出了一种用于O-RAN的风险感知安全分层学习框架，解决了eMBB和URLLC切片在不确定环境下的鲁棒资源分配问题，显著降低了URLLC错失率并保障了最差用户的eMBB速率。
ai_comments: 该论文针对O-RAN中eMBB与URLLC切片的资源分配难题，创新性地提出了一种风险感知安全分层学习框架。通过结合非实时、近实时策略与执行时安全层，并利用保形预测和CVaR优化目标，有效解决了不确定环境下的鲁棒性问题。实验证明其在满足严格的时延和吞吐量约束方面具有显著优势。
motivation: 现有的基于学习的资源分配器通常优化平均聚合性能，未显式考虑预测误差，在不确定流量和信道条件下可能导致个别用户的服务质量严重下降，难以同时满足严格的URLLC时延可靠性要求与eMBB吞吐量。
method: 提出一种风险感知安全分层学习框架，包含非实时策略（决定切片级资源块和功率预算）、近实时策略（在用户间分配资源）以及执行时安全层（检查每用户URLLC服务并通过有界资源转移纠正分配）。同时利用保形上限和条件风险价值（CVaR）目标来处理不确定性。
results: 实验结果表明，在标称负载下，该框架是唯一平均满足URLLC截止期错失目标和最差用户eMBB速率标准的评估方法，较最佳基准方法平均错失率降低了64%，并实现了最高的最差用户eMBB速率。
conclusion: 所提出的风险感知安全分层学习框架能够在不确定流量和信道条件下，有效保障URLLC的时延可靠性并维持eMBB吞吐量，优于现有的基准方法。

title: Spatial Extremes on Domains with Physical Barriers
authors: Chien-Chung Wang, Benjamin A. Shaby
abstract:
We propose a model for spatial extremes what realistically accommodates nonconvex domains. Most existing models assume that tail dependence between locations depends only on their separation. Even if extended to be anisotropic or nonstationary, they still cannot accommodate features between points that may mediate the dependence. This assumption limits their applicability in settings where physical barriers like mountains, coastlines, or islands may attenuate or even block dependence in extreme events.
  In this work, we use the idea of a visibility graph to modify an existing spatial random scale model. This results in a tail dependence model that naturally accommodates nonconvex spatial domains, where the nonconvex features are interpreted as physical barriers. Furthermore, the model inherits key properties from the scale mixture like the ability to represent asymptotic independence at long ranges and either asymptotic dependence or asymptotic independence at short ranges.
  We apply our model to two applications in which physical barriers feature prominently in determining the spatial structure of extreme events. The first is precipitation in the South Island of New Zealand, where the Southern Alps shelter the eastern region from the effects of atmospheric rivers which arrive from the west. The second is significant wave heights in the North Atlantic, where the Faroe Islands tend to block the effects of extratropical cyclones traveling into the North Sea.
zh_title: 具有物理屏障域的空间极端值问题
translation:
我们提出了一种能够真实适应非凸域的空间极端值模型。大多数现有模型假设位置之间的尾部相关性仅取决于它们的间距。即使扩展为各向异性或非平稳性，它们仍然无法适应可能介导相关性的点之间的特征。这种假设限制了它们在物理屏障（如山脉、海岸线或岛屿）可能减弱甚至阻挡极端事件相关性的场景中的适用性。
在这项工作中，我们利用可见性图的思想修改了现有的空间随机尺度模型。这产生了一个自然适应非凸空间域的尾部相关性模型，其中非凸特征被解释为物理屏障。此外，该模型继承了尺度混合的关键特性，例如在长距离表现出渐近独立性，在短距离表现出渐近依赖性或渐近独立性的能力。
我们将模型应用于两个物理屏障在确定极端事件空间结构中起显着作用的应用中。第一个是新西兰南岛的降水，那里的南阿尔卑斯山保护东部地区免受来自西方的的大气河的影响。第二个是北大西洋的有效波高，那里的法罗群岛倾向于阻挡温带气旋进入北海的影响。
tldr: 提出了一种结合可见性图的新空间极端值模型，能够有效解决山脉或岛屿等物理屏障对极端事件相关性的阻挡问题。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的空间极端值建模方法，通过引入可见性图成功解决了传统模型无法处理非凸区域及物理屏障阻碍空间极端事件相关性的难题，在气象学和海洋学领域具有重要的应用价值。
motivation: 现有的空间极端值模型大多假设位置间的尾部相关性仅取决于它们的间距，无法处理诸如山脉、海岸线或岛屿等物理屏障对极端事件相关性的衰减或阻挡作用，且难以适应非凸域。
method: 利用可见性图（visibility graph）的概念修改现有的空间随机尺度模型，构建能够自然适应非凸空间区域的尾部相关性模型。
results: 该模型成功应用于新西兰南岛降水（Southern Alps的山脉屏障效应）以及北大西洋浪高（法罗群岛的阻挡效应），能够准确反映物理屏障对极端事件空间结构的影响。
conclusion: 通过可见性图修改空间随机尺度模型，可以有效解决存在物理屏障的非凸区域空间极端值建模问题，并在新西兰降水和北大西洋浪高应用中验证了其有效性。

title: A probabilistic analysis of the Brumadinho tailings dam-breach using uncertainty quantification and global sensitivity analysis
authors: Yuri Taglieri Sáo, Geraldo de Freitas Maciel, Julian Cardoso Eleutério
abstract: On 25th January 2019, Dam B1 in Brumadinho, Brazil, suddenly collapsed and produced a catastrophic tailings flow with severe human, environmental and infrastructural consequences. Previous numerical back-analyses of the tailings flow have relied on deterministic approaches, which provide useful reference results but do not explicitly incorporate uncertainty associated to rupture hydrograph and tailings' physical properties. This work presents a probabilistic approach to study the tailings dam-breach flow caused by the rupture of Dam B1, focusing on the quantification and interpretation of the effects of input uncertainty on hazard-related hydrodynamical outputs. Deterministic data was obtained through HEC-RAS v6.6 by considering tailings as an one-phase Bingham fluid. The probabilistic framework combines dimensionality reduction, metamodeling and flooding classification to perform fast prediction of unexplored input scenarios. It allows to obtain data distributions that reflect output uncertainty and to estimate variance-based sensitivity indices to quantify the influence of input uncertainty over output variability. Results show that uncertainty is strongly dependent on time and spatial location. Hydrograph-related parameters mainly control the timing and magnitude of the early flow, whereas yield stress becomes more influential in regions associated with flow attenuation, spreading and possible arrest. Overall, the framework provides probabilistic hazard estimates and insights into the physical mechanisms governing the dynamics of tailings flow.
zh_title: 基于不确定性量化和全局敏感性分析的布鲁马迪纽尾矿坝溃决概率分析
translation: 2019年1月25日，巴西布鲁马迪纽的B1号尾矿坝突然坍塌，产生灾难性的尾矿流，造成严重的人员、环境和基础设施后果。以往对尾矿流的数值反演分析依赖于确定性方法，提供了有用的参考结果，但并未明确纳入与破裂水文图和尾矿物理性质相关的不确定性。本研究提出了一种概率方法来研究由B1号尾矿坝溃决引起的尾矿坝溃决流，重点是量化和解释输入不确定性对外生水动力输出的影响。确定性数据是通过HEC-RAS v6.6将尾矿视为单相宾汉流体获得的。概率框架结合了降维、元模型和洪水分类，以实现对未探索输入场景的快速预测。它允许获得反映输出不确定性的数据分布，并估计基于方差的敏感性指数，以量化输入不确定性对输出变异性的影响。结果表明，不确定性在很大程度上取决于时间和空间位置。与水文图相关的参数主要控制早期流动的昭和震级，而屈服应力在与流动衰减、扩散和可能停止相关的区域中更具影响力。总的来说，该框架提供了概率危害估计，并深入了解了控制尾矿流动力学的物理机制。
tldr: 利用概率框架和敏感性分析研究布鲁马迪纽尾矿坝溃决，量化了参数不确定性对尾矿流动力学的影响。
ai_comments: 该论文通过结合降维、元模型和洪水分类技术，首次对布鲁马迪纽尾矿坝溃决进行了概率分析和全局敏感性分析，克服了传统确定性方法的局限性，为尾矿坝溃决风险评估提供了创新的方法论。
motivation: 以往对布鲁马迪纽B1尾矿坝溃决的数值反演分析主要依赖于确定性方法，未能显式考虑溃决水文图及尾矿物理性质相关的不确定性，因此需要一种概率方法来研究溃决流并量化输入不确定性对危害相关水动力输出的影响。
method: 采用Hec-RAS v6.6将尾矿视为单相宾汉流体获取确定性数据，并结合降维、元建模和洪水分类技术构建概率预测框架，同时进行方差基敏感性指数估计。
results: 结果表明，输出的不确定性高度依赖于时间和空间位置；水文图相关参数主要控制早期流动的时效和震级，而屈服应力在与流动衰减、扩散和可能停止相关的区域中更具影响力。
conclusion: 该研究成功建立了一个高效的尾矿坝溃决概率分析框架，明确了溃决水文图参数和屈服应力在不同时空对尾矿流动力学的主导作用，为尾矿坝灾害的预测和风险管理提供了重要见解。

title: Developing a Subdistrict-Level Economic Progress Index Using Geospatial Data
authors: Meenu Mohan, Siddhartha Chattopadhyay
abstract: This paper develops an Economic Progress Index (EPI), a composite measure built from Earth Observation (EO) and open geospatial data with unsupervised Principal Component Analysis (PCA) weighting. The index captures the observable productive and enabling capacity of local economies and the intensity with which economic space is used. Sub-national monitoring in developing economies is held back by sparse data: district GDP estimates arrive with multi-year lags, rely on price deflators and top-down allocation, and do not exist at the subdistrict (taluka/tehsil) scale where place-based policy is targeted. The EPI fuses multi-sensor satellite data, gridded population and OpenStreetMap road and amenity networks across 357 subdistricts of Maharashtra, India, over 46 quarters (2015 Q1 - 2026 Q2). Seasonal-Trend decomposition using LOESS (STL) separates long-run trends from monsoon and crop-cycle seasonality. A non-negative PCA gives sign-consistent, interpretable weights and rankings nearly identical to standard PCA ($ρ$ = 0.998). Across districts, the index explains 74% of the variation in the NFHS-5 wealth index, 52% in household consumption (HCES 2023-24) and about 78% in real district GDP levels (65% in logs), but does not track short-run output growth. Because it measures structural capacity rather than annual output, the index kept rising through the FY2020-21 COVID-19 contraction. Across Maharashtra's six revenue divisions, relative inequality fell by 44% even as the absolute gap between leading and lagging divisions widened by 32%; district-level $β$-convergence implies a half-life of about 14 years. The framework offers a scalable, deflator-free basis for structural monitoring in data-sparse economies.
comment: 52 pages (46 pages main text, 6 pages appendices), 5 figures, 13 tables (6 main text, 7 appendix). An earlier version was presented at the XKDR Alternate Data Workshop, Mumbai. JEL: R11, R12, O18, E01, C43, C38
zh_title: 利用地理空间数据开发街道级经济发展指数
translation: 本文开发了一种经济发展指数（EPI），这是一个由地球观测（EO）和开放地理空间数据构建的复合指标，采用无监督主成分分析（PCA）加权。该指数捕捉了地方经济可观测的生产和赋能能力以及经济空间的使用强度。发展中国家的次国家监测受到稀缺数据的阻滞：地区GDP估计值存在多年滞后，依赖价格平减指数和自上而下的分配，并且在针对基于地点政策的次区（taluka/tehsil）规模上并不存在。EPI融合了2015年第一季度至2026年第二季度期间印度马哈拉施特拉邦357个次区的多传感器卫星数据、格网人口以及OpenStreetMap道路和设施网络。使用LOESS的季节性趋势分解（STL）将长期趋势与季风和作物周期季节性分离。非负PCA给出了符号一致、可解释的权重，且排名与标准PCA几乎完全一致（$\rho$ = 0.998）。在各个地区，该指数解释了NFHS-5财富指数74%的变异、家庭消费（HCES 2023-24）52%的变异以及实际地区GDP水平约78%的变异（对数形式为65%），但无法追踪短期产出增长。由于它测量的是结构能力而非年度产出，该指数在2020-2021财年COVID-19收缩期间持续上升。在马哈拉施特拉邦的六个税收部门中，相对不平等下降了44%，而领先部门与落后部门之间的绝对差距扩大了32%；地区级$\beta$收敛意味着半衰期约为14年。该框架为数据稀缺经济体的结构监测提供了一个可扩展的、免平减指数的基础。
tldr: 本研究利用卫星和地理空间数据构建了街道级别的经济发展指数（EPI），成功解决了发展中国家基层经济数据稀缺与滞后的问题，为地方政策制定和结构性监测提供了可靠工具。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地利用地球观测和开源地理空间数据构建了街道（乡镇）级别的经济发展指数（EPI），克服了发展中国家基层经济数据稀缺和滞后的难题，为地方政策制定和经济结构监测提供了可扩展、免价格平减指数的现代化方案。
motivation: 发展中国家缺乏次国家层面的基层经济数据（如区县GDP存在多年滞后且无法落实到乡镇级别），这严重阻碍了精准地方政策的制定。
method: 融合了多传感器卫星数据、格网人口以及OpenStreetMap道路和配套设施网络，采用季节性趋势分解（STL）分离长期趋势与季节性，并利用非负主成分分析（PCA）进行赋权。
results: 该指数解释了NFHS-5财富指数74%的方差、家庭消费52%的方差以及实际地区GDP水平约78%的方差；它成功捕捉了结构性容量，在COVID-19收缩期持续上升，并揭示了马哈拉施特拉邦相对不平等下降及绝对差距扩大的趋势。
conclusion: 基于地球观测和地理空间数据的经济发展指数（EPI）能够有效克服发展中国家次国家层面的数据稀缺问题，为高频、细颗粒度的结构性经济监测提供可靠框架。

title: Laplace Bayesian transport maps for generative modeling of non-Gaussian climate fields
authors: Jacob A. Johnson, Felix Jimenez, Matthias Katzfuss
abstract: Transport maps provide a powerful framework for the generative modeling of complex, non-Gaussian spatial fields, such as those encountered in climate science. By mapping a complicated target distribution to a standard Gaussian reference distribution, they can serve as efficient stochastic surrogates. However, current Bayesian transport maps, which are modeled using autoregressive Gaussian processes, typically rely on empirical Bayes estimates that ignore hyperparameter uncertainty. Here, we contrast this point-estimate approach with a fully Bayesian model that provides posterior uncertainty quantification in transport map hyperparameters. To avoid the high cost of Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), we also propose a Laplace approximation to the hyperparameter posteriors, which can be computed at negligible additional computational cost relative to empirical Bayes. We provide numerical evidence and a real-data climate application demonstrating that these Laplace approximations can accurately capture most posterior summaries at a fraction of the cost of MCMC, while maintaining good predictive properties. Thus, our approach offers a scalable, uncertainty-aware framework for the generative modeling of non-Gaussian climate fields.
zh_title: 用于非高斯气候场生成建模的拉普拉斯贝叶斯传输图
translation: 传输图为复杂、非高斯空间场（如气候科学中遇到的空间场）的生成建模提供了一个强大的框架。通过将复杂的棘手目标分布映射到标准高斯参考分布，它们可以作为高效的随机代理模型。然而，当前使用自回归高斯过程建模的贝叶斯传输图，通常依赖于忽略超参数不确定性的经验贝叶斯估计。在这里，我们将这种点估计方法与一个全贝叶斯模型进行对比，该模型在传输图超参数中提供后验不确定性量化。为了避免马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）的高昂成本，我们还提出了超参数后验的拉普拉斯近似，与经验贝叶斯相比，该近似可以以微不足道的额外计算成本计算得出。我们提供了数值证据和真实数据气候应用，证明这些拉普拉斯近似能够以MCMC的一小部分成本准确捕捉大部分后验汇总，同时保持良好的预测性能。因此，我们的方法为非高斯气候场的生成建模提供了一个可扩展的、具不确定性感知的框架。
tldr: 提出了一种基于拉普拉斯近似的贝叶斯传输图方法，高效实现了非高斯气候场的生成建模与不确定性量化。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种基于拉普拉斯近似的贝叶斯传输图方法，能够以极低的计算成本实现对气候场等复杂非高斯空间场的全贝叶斯不确定性量化，具有很高的实用价值和创新性。
motivation: 现有的基于自回归高斯过程建模的贝叶斯传输图通常依赖于经验贝叶斯估计，忽略了超参数的不确定性，因此需要一种既能捕捉超参数不确定性又具有计算可扩展性的方法。
method: 提出了一种全贝叶斯模型来对传输图超参数进行后验不确定性量化，并利用拉普拉斯近似来避免昂贵的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）计算成本。
results: 数值证据和真实气候数据应用表明，拉普拉斯近似能够以远低于MCMC的成本准确捕获大多数后验汇总统计，同时保持良好的预测性能。
conclusion: 拉普拉斯贝叶斯传输图方法提供了一个可扩展且具有不确定性感知的框架，用于非高斯气候场的生成建模。

title: Global sensitivity analysis of transient regimes in non-Newtonian dam-break flows applied in rheometry
authors: Yuri Taglieri Sáo, João Batista Pereira, Geraldo de Freitas Maciel
abstract: Non-Newtonian dam-break flows are a classical problem with numerous engineering applications. These flows are particularly important in alternative rheometry, where they are used to rapidly and affordably estimate rheological properties, such as in the slump test and Bostwick consistometer test. However, the lifting dynamics of the containing obstacle introduce inertial effects that can compromise the accurate estimation of these properties. These effects are influenced by the lifting velocity, the fluid's viscosity, and the initial geometry of the sample. This study aims to quantify the influence of lifting velocity and to provide physical insights into how inertial effects influence the flow. A global sensitivity analysis (GSA) framework adapted for functional outputs (e.g., time series) is employed, using data generated from high-fidelity simulations with ANSYS Fluent. The GSA produces sensitivity curves that track the evolving importance of each input parameter over time. Three distinct flow regimes are identified, namely mobilization, transition and viscous regimes, each governed by different dominant factors. The first two regimes are significantly affected by the lifting velocity, revealing the influence of inertial effects, whereas the viscous regime is dominated by fluid rheology and shows a increasing importance of the yield stress. These results are contextualized in terms of traditional rheometry tests.
zh_title: 非牛顿溃坝流瞬态过程的全局敏感性分析及其在流变学中的应用
translation: 非牛顿溃坝流是一个具有众多工程应用的经典问题。这些流体在替代流变学中尤为重要，常用于快速且经济地估计流变特性，例如在坍落度测试和 Bostwick 稠度计测试中。然而，容纳障碍物的提升动力学引入了惯性效应，可能会损害这些特性估计的准确性。这些效应受提升速度、流体粘度和样品初始几何形状的影响。本研究旨在量化提升速度的影响，并深入了解惯性效应如何影响流动的物理机制。采用适应于函数输出（例如时间序列）的全局敏感性分析（GSA）框架，利用使用 ANSYS Fluent 生成的高保真模拟数据。GSA 生成了敏感性曲线，可随时间追踪每个输入参数不断变化的重要性。研究识别出三种不同的流态，即动员流态、过渡流态和粘性流态，每种流态由不同的主导因素控制。前两个流态受提升速度显著影响，揭示了惯性效应的影响，而粘性流态则由流体流变学主导，并且屈服应力的重要性不断增加。这些结果在传统流变学测试的背景下进行了关联分析。
tldr: 本研究通过全局敏感性分析和仿真，揭示了非牛顿溃坝流中提升速度引起的惯性效应，并识别出三个受不同因素主导的流动阶段，为流变测量提供了重要参考。
ai_comments: 本研究将全局敏感性分析（GSA）应用于非牛顿流体溃坝流及流变学测量中，通过高精度仿真识别出了瞬态过程中的三个不同流态，对改进传统流变测试方法（如坍落度测试和 Bostwick 稠度计测试）具有重要意义。
motivation: 传统替代流变测试（如坍落度测试和 Bostwick 稠度计测试）中阻挡物的提升动力学引入了惯性效应，从而影响流变特性估计的准确性。本研究旨在量化提升速度的影响，并深入剖析惯性效应对流动影响的物理机制。
method: 采用适用于函数输出（如时间序列）的全局敏感性分析（GSA）框架，结合利用 ANSYS Fluent 生成的高精度仿真数据进行研究。
results: 研究识别出了三个不同的流态（动员阶段、过渡阶段和粘性阶段）。前两个阶段受提升速度显著影响，暴露出惯性效应；而粘性阶段则由流体流变学主导，屈服应力的重要性随时间增加。
conclusion: 该研究量化了非牛顿溃坝流中提升速度和流变特性的影响，识别出三个流动阶段，强调了控制惯性效应对于提高替代流变测量准确性的必要性。

title: Sensor Monitoring Towards Industry 4.0: Bridging Concepts on the $C_n$ Multivariate Control Chart
authors: Diego C. Nascimento, Ana C. S. Batista, Francisco Louzada, Paulo H. Ferreira
abstract: The main challenge in monitoring multiple sensors is the high dimensionality that a process can easily reach. From a decision-making perspective, converting these multivariate dynamics into an informative visualization is also not trivial. Statistical Process Control (SPC) techniques detect changes in quality characteristics, but they are difficult to apply beyond the normality (Gaussian) assumption. For instance, the most well-known SPC multivariate control chart is based on Hotelling's $T^2$ statistic, which assumes that the process data follow a multivariate normal distribution (which rarely occurs in practice) and that the observations are serially independent. This study focuses on the multivariate case (dimension $d \geq 2$), regardless of the data dependence or marginal asymmetry. We propose a new control chart for change detection in copula-based multivariate processes, called the $C_n$-chart, which is based on a density level-set tolerance region built from a copula function, and we derive its run-length properties. The methodology also quantifies the (not necessarily linear) dependence among the variables. Two case studies are presented, one on water quality control and the other on monitoring brass-steel thermostats, complemented by a simulation study of run-length performance and computational cost. The results show that the proposed methodology captures both the association among variables and the anomalies, and that it accommodates variable selection through conditional (regression) modeling of the margins.
zh_title: 面向工业4.0的传感器监测：连接$C_n$多元控制图的概念
translation: 监测多个传感器的主要挑战是过程容易达到高维性。从决策的角度来看，将这些多元动态转化为信息丰富的可视化也不是一件小事。统计过程控制（SPC）技术可以检测质量特征的变化，但它们很难在超出正态（高斯）假设的情况下应用。例如，最著名的SPC多元控制图基于Hotelling的$T^2$统计量，该统计量假设过程数据服从多元正态分布（这在实践中很少发生）且观测值是序列独立的。本研究重点关注多元情况（维度$d \geq 2$），无论数据依赖性或边缘不对称性如何。我们提出了一种用于基于Copula的多元过程中的变化检测的新控制图，称为$C_n$图，它基于由Copula函数构建的密度水平集容忍区域，并推导了其运行长度属性。该方法还量化了变量之间（不一定是线性）的依赖关系。本文提出了两个案例研究，一个是水质控制，另一个是监测黄铜-钢恒温器，并辅以运行长度性能和计算成本的模拟研究。结果表明，所提出的方法既能捕捉变量之间的关联又能捕捉异常，并且通过边缘的条件（回归）建模适应了变量选择。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Copula函数的全新多元控制图（$C_n$-chart），无需正态分布假设即可有效监测工业多传感器系统中的异常和变量依赖关系。
ai_comments: 本文针对工业4.0中多传感器监测的高维和非正态分布挑战，创新性地结合了Copula函数和密度水平集容忍区域，提出了$C_n$多元控制图。该方法无需假设数据服从多元正态分布，且能捕捉复杂的非线性变量间依赖关系，对实际工业应用具有重要价值。
motivation: 多传感器监测面临高维性挑战，而传统的多元统计过程控制（如Hotelling's $T^2$控制图）严格依赖于多元正态分布和序列独立性假设，这在实际工业4.0应用中极少满足，且难以将多元动态转化为直观的信息可视化。
method: 提出了一种基于Copula函数的密度水平集容忍区域的新型多元控制图（$C_n$-chart），推导了其运行长度（run-length）性质，并通过条件（回归）建模边缘分布来实现变量选择。
results: 通过水质控制和黄铜-钢温控器监测两个案例研究以及模拟研究，结果表明该方法能有效捕捉变量间的关联和异常，并能很好地适应运行长度性能和计算成本。
conclusion: 本研究提出的$C_n$控制图能够有效克服传统多元控制图对正态假定的依赖，成功捕捉变量间的非线性关联及异常，适用于复杂的工业4.0多传感器监测环境。

title: The Structural Number of Parties: An Electoral-Outcome-Independent Baseline for Comparing Party-System Scale
authors: Adama Nouboukpo, Kodzo Michel Aladji, Bappa Muktar
abstract: How many parties can a country structurally sustain? Standard measures such as the effective number of parties (ENP) cannot answer this question. They are descriptive and post hoc: they summarize competition only after an election, and they depend on electoral returns that are often missing, interrupted, or unreliable in many developing democracies, particularly in Africa. They also offer no common scale for comparing the size of party registers with realized electoral fragmentation. We introduce the Structural Number of Parties (SNP), an outcome-independent baseline derived from two universally available quantities: population size and territorial area. Building on the logic of the seat product model and the cube-root law of assembly size, the SNP gives an ex ante benchmark that can be computed for any country and year, including where electoral data are absent. Applied to African states, the SNP enables a structural gap diagnosis that distinguishes under-fragmented systems, marked by hegemonic-party dominance, from over-fragmented ones, marked by excessive atomization. The framework thus provides a transparent and reproducible tool to inform institutional reform and the rationalization of party systems across the continent.
zh_title: 政党的结构数量：用于比较政党系统规模的不依赖选举结果的基准
translation: 一个国家在结构上能够维持多少政党？诸如有效政党数（ENP）等标准测量方法无法回答这个问题。它们是描述性和事后的：它们仅在选举结束后总结竞争情况，并且依赖于在许多发展中国家（特别是非洲）经常缺失、中断或不可靠的选举回报。它们也没有为比较政党名册规模与已实现的选举碎片化提供共同的尺度。我们引入了政党结构数量（SNP），这是一个独立于结果的基准，源自两个普遍可用的数量：人口规模和领土面积。基于席位乘积模型和议会规模立方根定律的逻辑，SNP给出一个事前基准，可以为任何国家和年份计算，甚至包括缺乏选举数据的地方。应用于非洲国家，SNP能够实现结构性差距诊断，区分以霸权政党主导为特征的欠碎片化系统与以过度原子化为特征的过碎片化系统。因此，该框架提供了一个透明且可复制的工具，为整个大陆的制度改革和政党系统的理性化提供信息。
tldr: 本文提出了一种不依赖选举结果的政党结构数量（SNP）指标，仅通过人口和面积来衡量国家结构上可维持的政党规模，填补了发展中国家政党系统研究的空白。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种不依赖选举结果的政党结构数量（SNP）指标，突破了传统有效政党数（ENP）必须依赖选举数据的局限，为发展中国家（特别是非洲）的政党政治和制度改革研究提供了重要的基准工具。
motivation: 传统的有效政党数（ENP）等测量标准依赖于事后选举结果，无法回答一个国家在结构上能够维持多少政党的问题，且在许多发展中国家（特别是非洲）缺乏可靠的选举数据。
method: 基于席位乘积模型（seat product model）和议会规模立方根定律（cube-root law of assembly size），利用人口规模和领土面积两个普适变量，推导出一个事前基准（SNP）。
results: 通过应用于非洲国家，SNP能够成功识别出以一党独大为特征的“欠碎片化”系统和以过度原子化为特征的“过碎片化”系统。
conclusion: SNP指标为跨国政党系统规模的比较提供了一个独立于选举结果的通用基准，有助于诊断政党系统的结构性差距并指导制度改革。

title: Entropy of a Zipfian Distributed Lexicon
authors: Leonardo Carneiro Araujo, Thaïs Cristófaro-Silva, Hani Camille Yehia
abstract: This article presents the calculation of the entropy of a system with Zipfian distribution and shows that a communication system tends to present an exponent value close to one, but still greater than one, so that it might maximize entropy and hold a feasible lexicon with an increasing size. This result is in agreement with what is observed in natural languages and with the balance between the speaker and listener communication efforts. On the other hand, the entropy of the communicating source is very sensitive to the exponent value as well as the length of the observable data, making it a poor parameter to characterize the communication process.
translation: 本文计算了具有Zipfian分布的系统的熵，并表明通信系统倾向于呈现接近1但仍大于1的指数值，从而使其能够最大化熵并随着词汇量增加而保持可行的词汇表。这一结果与自然语言中观察到的现象以及说话者和听者通信努力之间的平衡相一致。另一方面，通信源的熵对指数值以及可观测数据的长度非常敏感，这使其成为表征通信过程的一个不佳参数。
tldr: 本文通过计算Zipfian分布系统的熵，解释了自然语言中词汇量和指数保持在1左右的原因，并指出熵不适合作为表征通信过程的参数。
ai_comments: 该论文从信息论和Zipf定律的角度切入，探讨了自然语言词汇量与熵之间的数学关系，揭示了通信系统在平衡说话者与听者努力程度方面的机制。然而，论文也指出了熵作为通信过程表征参数的局限性。
motivation: 为了计算Zipfian分布系统的熵，并解释为什么通信系统的指数倾向于接近但不小于1，从而在最大化熵的同时保持可行的词汇量规模。
method: 通过计算具有Zipfian分布的系统的熵，分析其在不同指数和数据长度下的表现，并将其与自然语言及通信双方的努力平衡进行对比。
results: 通信系统的指数倾向于接近1但大于1，这与自然语言中的观察结果以及说话者与听者努力的平衡相一致；同时发现通信源的熵对指数和可观测数据长度非常敏感。
conclusion: Zipfian分布系统的熵值对指数和数据长度高度敏感，因此不适合作为表征通信过程的单一参数，但其 exponent 接近并大于1的特征解释了自然语言中词汇量增长与熵极大化的平衡。

title: Bayesian Computation of Copula-based Multivariate Models with an Application to Doping Detection
authors: Emanuele Masillo, Eva Pigi Viltanioti, Nina Deliu, Brunero Liseo
abstract: The Athlete Biological Passport (ABP) monitors athletes for doping by comparing their biomarker readings against personalized reference ranges. These are estimated via the Bayesian ADAPTIVE model, which analyzes biomarkers separately and ignores their dependence. Building on a recently proposed copula-based multivariate extension of ADAPTIVE, this paper focuses on its computational aspects, introducing a fully joint MCMC algorithm and comparing it with a two-step Bayesian IFM estimator. Simulations show the two procedures perform comparably under a correctly specified copula, but exhibit a genuine trade-off under misspecification: the Bayesian IFM protects marginal inference, while the joint MCMC yields better-calibrated dependence estimates and is markedly faster. The two approaches are tested on a dataset containing ABP profiles of elite athletes, provided by NADO Italia, and collected as part of the project {\it Enhancing the methodological framework for doping detection: from univariate to multivariate testing analysis on Athlete Biological Passport profiles}. Both approaches achieve consistent classification performance, providing anti-doping organizations with two concrete inferential routes for adopting a multivariate ADAPTIVE model, along with guidance on the trade-offs between them.
zh_title: 基于Copula多元模型的贝叶斯计算及其在兴奋剂检测中的应用
translation: 运动员生物护照（ABP）通过将运动员的生物标志物读数与个性化参考范围进行比较来监测兴奋剂。这些是通过贝叶斯ADAPTIVE模型估计的，该模型单独分析生物标志物而忽略了它们的依赖性。在最近提出的基于Copula的ADAPTIVE多元扩展的基础上，本文重点研究其计算方面，引入了一个完全联合的MCMC算法，并将其与两步贝叶斯IFM估计器进行比较。模拟表明，在正确设定的Copula下，这两种程序表现相当，但在误设下表现出真正的权衡：贝叶斯IFM保护边际推断，而联合MCMC产生更好校准的依赖性估计并且明显更快。这两种方法在NADO Italia提供的包含精英运动员ABPprofiles的数据集上进行了测试，该数据集作为项目“增强兴奋剂检测的方法学框架：从运动员生物护照profile的单变量到多变量测试分析”的一部分收集。这两种方法都取得了一致的分类性能，为反兴奋剂组织提供了采用多元ADAPTIVE模型的两条具体推断路线，以及关于它们之间权衡的指导。
tldr: 本文研究了用于兴奋剂检测的多变量ADAPTIVE模型的贝叶斯计算方法，对比了全联合MCMC算法和两步Bayesian IFM估计器在模型误设情况下的优劣，为反兴奋剂机构提供了实用的多元分析途径。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将多变量Copula模型引入运动员生物护照（ABP）的兴奋剂检测中，通过全联合MCMC算法与两步Bayesian IFM估计器的对比，揭示了它们在模型误设情况下的性能权衡，为反兴奋剂机构提供了坚实的方法论支持。
motivation: 现有的运动员生物护照（ABP）使用贝叶斯ADAPTIVE模型单独分析生物标志物，忽略了它们之间的依赖关系。为了弥补这一缺陷并基于最近提出的基于Copula的多变量ADAPTIVE扩展，本文旨在研究其计算方面，并为反兴奋剂机构提供具体的推断途径和权衡指导。
method: 引入了一种全联合MCMC算法，并将其与两步贝叶斯IFM（Inference Functions for Margins）估计器进行对比，通过模拟实验和NADO Italia提供的精英运动员实际数据集进行测试。
results: 模拟结果显示，在正确设定Copula的情况下，两种程序表现相当；但在模型误设时存在权衡：贝叶斯IFM保护边际推断，而全联合MCMC在依赖关系估计上校准更好且显著更快。在实际数据集上的测试表明两者均达到了一致的分类性能。
conclusion: 研究表明，全联合MCMC算法和两步Bayesian IFM估计器在多变量ADAPTIVE模型的应用中各有利弊：MCMC速度快且依赖结构估计更好，而IFM保护了边际推断。两者在实际精英运动员数据集上均展现出一致的分类性能。

title: Total Positivity Properties of American Options
authors: Paul Glasserman, Mike Li, Dan Pirjol
abstract: Call option prices, viewed as functions of strike and time-to-expiration, are totally positive of order 2 (TP2) if the ratio of the price of a higher-strike call to a lower-strike call increases with time-to-expiration. A corresponding property applies to put option prices. Prior work has developed conditions for these properties to hold for European options; here we establish these properties for American options. The key condition we require is that log returns on the underlying asset have a log-concave density. Gaussian densities provide an important special case. Within our framework, we show that total positivity properties hold more broadly for American than European options. Empirically, we find that violations of TP2 properties are infrequent, typically small, and reverse quickly. Trades that bet against violations achieve high hit rates. Violations are more frequent among European than American options, a pattern that is qualitatively consistent with our theoretical results.
zh_title: 美式期权的全正性性质
translation: 当把看涨期权价格视为执行价格和到期时间的函数时，如果较高执行价格与较低执行价格的期权价格之比随着到期时间的增加而增加，则它们是2阶全正的（TP2）。看跌期权价格也存在相应的性质。先前的工作已经为欧式期权开发了这些性质成立的条件；在这里，我们为美式期权确立了这些性质。我们需要的关键条件是底层资产的对数收益率具有对数凹密度。高斯密度提供了一个重要的特例。在我们的框架内，我们表明全正性性质比欧洲期权更广泛地适用于美式期权。从实证来看，我们发现对TP2性质的违背是不频繁的，通常很小，并且恢复得很快。押注于违背情况的交易获得了很高的命中率。违背在欧式期权中比在美式期权中更频繁，这一模式与我们的理论结果在定性上是一致的。
tldr: 本文证明了在特定条件下美式期权满足2阶全正性（TP2）性质，且其适用范围比欧式期权更广，实证结果验证了这一理论发现。
ai_comments: 该论文将全正性（Total Positivity）理论成功扩展到美式期权中，结合理论推导与实证分析，具有较高的创新性和金融数学应用价值。
motivation: 以往的研究主要集中于欧洲期权的TP2（2阶全正性）性质，作者旨在探讨这些全正性性质是否以及如何能够推广到美式期权中。
method: 通过理论数学推导证明在底层资产对数收益率具有对数凹密度时美式期权满足TP2性质，并利用期权市场数据进行实证检验。
results: 理论上证明了美式期权比欧式期权更广泛地满足全正性性质；实证上发现TP2性质的违背现象不频繁、幅度小且恢复快，且欧式期权的违背频率高于美式期权。
conclusion: 在底层资产对数收益率具有对数凹密度这一关键条件下，美式期权价格满足2阶全正性（TP2），且其适用范围较欧式期权更广。实证表明TP2违背现象较少且短暂，这也印证了理论发现。

title: Inferring Neural Activity Changes under Recording Uncertainty with Transformers and Variational Inference
authors: Nilson Chapagain, Pooja Chapagain
abstract: A difference in recorded firing rate across days may reflect a change in neuronal activity, missed spikes or recording a different neuron. We present a statistical approach that combines neuron tracking with Bayesian estimates of stationary mean recorded firing rates. Bounds under assumed differences in spike detection connect recorded rates to biological rate changes. We assess recording loss and uncertainty in rate changes in simulations, and count-model fit in recordings. We also compare two transformer estimators with Gaussian and flow variational inference under a shared temporal negative-binomial model. Flow variational inference agrees most closely with reference posteriors, while predictive performance varies across mice. Rate-change intervals contain true simulated changes less often than intended. In UnitMatch recordings from five mice, some inferred changes remain supported when spike detection is allowed to differ between days; others depend on equal detection. These interpretations require a correct neuron match. The approach identifies which inferred rate changes remain supported under specified recording assumptions and where uncertainty limits interpretation.
zh_title: 使用Transformer和变分推断在记录不确定性下推断神经元活动变化
translation: 跨天记录到的放电率差异可能反映了神经元活动的变化、漏掉的尖峰或者是记录到了不同的神经元。我们提出了一种统计方法，将神经元追踪与平稳平均记录放电率的贝叶斯估计结合起来。在假设尖峰检测存在差异的情况下的边界，将记录到的放电率与生物学放电率的变化联系起来。我们在模拟中评估了记录丢失和放电率变化的 không确定性，以及在实际记录中的计数模型拟合。我们还比较了两个Transformer估计器与高斯变分推断和流变分推断在共享时间负二项模型下的表现。流变分推断与参考后验分布吻合得最好，而预测性能在不同小鼠之间有所差异。放电率变化区间包含真实模拟变化的频率低于预期。在使用来自五只小鼠的UnitMatch记录时，一些推断出的变化在允许尖峰检测在不同天之间存在差异时仍然得到支持，而另一些则取决于相等的检测条件。这些解释需要正确的神经元匹配。该方法确定了哪些推断出的放电率变化在特定的记录假设下仍然得到支持，以及不确定性在哪里限制了解释。
tldr: 提出了一种结合Transformer与变分推断的新方法，用于在跨天记录存在不确定性的情况下准确推断神经元放电率的变化。
ai_comments: 该论文结合了Transformer和变分推断，提出了一种新颖的统计框架来处理神经元记录中的不确定性问题（如漏检、神经元漂移等），在神经科学数据分析中具有重要的理论和实际意义。
motivation: 跨天记录到的放电率差异可能反映了真实的神经元活动变化、漏掉的尖峰或是记录到了不同的神经元，因此需要一种能够处理记录不确定性的统计方法。
method: 结合了神经元追踪与平稳平均记录放电率的贝叶斯估计，并比较了两种 Transformer 估计器与高斯变分推断、流变分推断（flow variational inference）在共享时间负二项模型下的表现。
results: 流变分推断与参考后验分布吻合度最高，而预测性能在不同小鼠之间有所差异；放电率变化区间包含真实模拟变化的频率低于预期；部分推断出的变化在允许跨天尖峰检测存在差异时依然成立，而其他变化则依赖于相等的检测条件。
conclusion: 该方法能够有效识别在特定记录假设下哪些推断出的放电率变化依然成立，同时明确了不确定性限制解释的边界，强调了神经元匹配和放电检测假设的重要性。

title: Stock bubbles in limited participation models with power utilities
authors: Kasper Larsen
abstract: We prove that the equilibrium state-price deflated cum-dividend stock-price process in Guasoni, Larsen, and Leoni (2025) is a strict local martingale. Our result is based on proving that the unrestricted trader faces an endogenously complete model.
zh_title: 具有幂效用函数的有限参与模型中的股票泡沫
translation: 我们证明了Guasoni、Larsen和Leoni（2025）中均衡状态价格平减的含息股票价格过程是一个严格局部鞅。我们的结果基于证明无约束交易者面临一个内生完备的模型。
tldr: 该文证明了在具有幂效用函数的有限参与模型中，均衡状态价格平减的含息股票价格过程是一个严格局部鞅。
ai_comments: 该论文精炼地证明了在具有幂效用函数的有限参与模型中，均衡状态价格平减的含息股票价格过程是一个严格局部鞅，并将其归因于无约束交易者面临一个内生完备的模型。这对理解资产泡沫的数学机制具有重要贡献。
motivation: 为了深入研究和证明具有幂效用函数的有限参与模型中股票价格过程的数学性质（特别是关于股票泡沫的局部鞅特征）。
method: 通过证明无约束交易者面临一个内生完备的模型，推导并证明均衡状态价格平减的含息股票价格过程的性质。
results: 证明了Guasoni、Larsen和Leoni（2025）模型中的均衡状态价格平减含息股票价格过程确实是一个严格局部鞅。
conclusion: 在特定的有限参与模型中，通过证明无约束交易者面临内生完备模型，成功证明了均衡状态价格平减的含息股票价格过程为严格局部鞅。

title: Exploring Test Smells Across Programming Languages: A Systematic Mapping Study
authors: Publio Silva, Carla Bezerra, Ivan Machado, Márcio Ribeiro
abstract: Tests are essential for ensuring code quality in software development. However, poor implementation practices can compromise the maintainability and evolution of test code, leading to additional costs and effort. These practices, known as test smells, have been the focus of numerous studies that expanded the catalog of known test smells. Despite this progress, little attention has been given to examining test smells from the perspective of programming languages, particularly their relationship with specific languages or test frameworks. As a result, researchers and practitioners have proposed various approaches and tools to detect and refactor the same test smells across different languages. In this work, we address this gap by analyzing test smells in the literature from a programming language perspective. We conducted a systematic mapping study, gathering data from papers published up to August 2025, examining 117 papers. We identified the most prevalent languages and frameworks associated with test smells, the most common test smells in each language, refactorings for addressing test smells, datasets of test smells, the criticality of specific test smells, and a collection of tools to detect or refactor test smells for various languages and frameworks. Our results show that while many test smells have been addressed, research remains limited to a few languages and frameworks. We also found datasets and detection/refactoring tools for some languages and analyzed the criticality of frequently mentioned test smells. This study highlights the need to expand research to more languages and develop more universal solutions.

title: Does Your Agent Need to Know Its Budget? A Placebo-Controlled Experiment on LLM Coding Agents
authors: Iftesam Nabi, Jarif Ul Alam, Sunzid Hassan, Sabbir Alom Shuvo, Md Faiaz Al Islam, Yead Rahman, Mehrab Hosain
abstract: Organizations deploying autonomous coding agents impose token budgets, yet the causal effects of a budget, and of telling the agent about it, are unmeasured. We conduct a placebo-controlled factorial experiment under a frozen, timestamped protocol, crossing budget enforcement with budget disclosure on two executable program-repair benchmarks (5,835 runs, two open models, three cap levels). Enforcing a calibrated cap reduced task resolution by 20.0 percentage points while reducing tokens per resolved task roughly twelvefold. Disclosing the enforced budget never helped: the placebo-controlled risk difference was -2.8 pp (95% CI [-6.2, +0.7]) at the medium cap and -4.2 pp ([-8.1, -0.2], nominally significant, unadjusted) at the tight cap, with every prompt wording and per-turn feedback variant far below the 10-point effect size of interest. Observed run-to-run outcome variance was roughly 1.5x the uncapped level under caps, though part of this reflects resolution rates moving nearer one half. These results make budget governance for coding agents an enforcement-design problem: no communication variant produced an effect beyond that of an unrelated sentence, which itself raised resolution by 7.2 pp (95% CI [+4.0, +10.5]) over silent enforcement, a sentence effect that only a placebo control removes.
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Study archive (frozen protocol, per-run logs, and analysis code) to be deposited in a DOI-issuing repository

title: A Systematic Survey of Decompilation: Mapping Classical and Machine-Learning Approaches
authors: Keitaro Shimane, Minami Yoda, Jialong Li, Yutaka Matsuno
abstract: Context: Decompilers reconstruct source-level code from compiled binaries, and analysts rely on them whenever source code is unavailable. Many recent studies apply machine learning (ML), including large language models, to parts of this task. From the primary literature alone, it is unclear where these methods sit in the classical decompilation pipeline and how well their claims are supported. Objectives: We map decompilation research onto a pipeline-centered taxonomy and ask two questions: where classical, ML-trained, and ML-prompted approaches are positioned (RQ1), and how ML-based studies vary in technical design and evaluation evidence (RQ2). Methods: We surveyed 405 decompilation studies from 1973 to 2026, collected through database search and citation tracing. We classified 394 primary studies into eight pipeline stages and two complementary categories. For the 116 ML-based studies that propose or modify decompilation methods, we extracted the model-use strategy, reusable backbones, target platform, and the evidence behind each evaluation. Results: Classical techniques still dominate front-end recovery, IR lifting, and control-flow structuring (277 of 394 primary studies are classical). ML-based work (117 studies) clusters instead around symbol and name recovery, output refinement, and end-to-end translation. Type recovery is the clearest mixed region. Most ML-based studies target native binaries (97 of 116), and most evidence is item-level matching against references (89 of 116); execution-based tests, human or LLM judgment, and downstream-task evidence are much rarer. Conclusion: ML has not displaced the classical pipeline. It has been taken up where a recovered artifact can be posed as a prediction, translation, or refinement problem, and reported gains only make sense when read against the pipeline position and the evidence used to support them.

title: Wrong yet Confident: Automated Detection of Silent Failures in Location-Dependent Software
authors: Juan A. Padilla
abstract: We report an experience paper applying round-trip offset---an automated testing oracle for location-dependent software---at deployment scale across 32,019 GPS delivery transactions, corresponding to 24,501 unique coordinates, from a single USDA COVID-19 food assistance deployment in Bayamón, Puerto Rico. The oracle tests each geocoder's implicit spatial accuracy claim by measuring the deviation between an input coordinate and the coordinate recovered after reverse-then-forward geocoding, without requiring manual labeling of correctness. We evaluated one community-contributed and two commercial geocoders against this operationally validated corpus. The experience surfaces two distinct failure classes, which we report with their respective denominators because they are not comparable quantities. First, 2,441 of the 24,501 unique coordinates (10.0%) are invisible to all three platforms: an acknowledged failure with no resolution, and a property of the corpus rather than of any one geocoder. Second, and platform-specific: 10.0% of the 13,221 coordinates Google resolves to a civic address exhibit round-trip offsets exceeding 2~km---5.4% of the full corpus---returned with no error signal, against 0.5% for the second commercial platform and 0.04% for the community geocoder. Round-trip offset detects all large-offset failures observed in this dataset while standard resolution-rate evaluation detects none. We document an eight-mode fault taxonomy, a structured comparison of detection methods, and concrete lessons for integrating automated geocoder verification into CI/CD pipelines. The key lesson: resolution rate measures availability; round-trip offset measures correctness. In non-standard addressing environments these two metrics select for opposite behaviors, and only the latter catches the failures that matter for autonomous action.

title: Stochastic Modeling of the Mean Time Between Software Failures: A review
authors: Gabriel Pena, Veronica Moreno, Nestor Barraza
abstract: A review of several models for the software failure detection stochastic process is per- formed. We focus on how the Mean Time Between Failures is obtained from those models and present a comparative study. The models considered involve some of the well known based on non- homogeneous Poisson processes and a recently proposed model based on contagion. Our main target is to evaluate the models performance when they are applied to modern software projects developed under Agile methodologies. Recently developed Software Engineering practices (TDD, Scrum, etc.), propose an iterative procedure be- tween development, testing and debugging, introducing this way, particular challenges to Software Reliability modeling. As opposed to the non-homogeneous Poisson processes, the failure rate of the contagion model depends not just on time but also on the number of previously detected failures. All the considered models are particular cases of non- homogeneous Birth Processes, a general fundamental theory on how to obtain time to failure and time between failures expectations is also shown.

title: Revision-Consistent Code Context for Agents That Edit Their Environment
authors: Meng Shi
abstract:
Editing agents query repositories while simultaneously changing them. Source content, symbols, graph relations, and retrieval state may be maintained by different stores and refreshed at different times. During an update, a successful query can therefore combine facts that never belonged to the same repository state. We call this condition mixed-revision code context.
  This paper proposes an Agent-visible complete-revision publication contract for composite code-intelligence queries. Before a query-visible publication point, a service must wait, report unavailability, or serve a complete old revision; after that point, it serves the complete new revision. The contract requires a shared version identity and publication boundary across every view returned in one response.
  We instantiate the method in Codetrip, whose brief operation joins source, symbol, and graph facts. In a controlled comparison on frozen Gin v1.12.0, live-source composition produced two unsafe responses in 150 update trials, whereas complete-revision publication produced none under the same five edit scenarios. We further implement journaled, idempotent publication and terminate the real MCP process at five durable boundaries. All 300 evaluable recovery trials on frozen Gin and Cobra returned complete-new context equivalent to a clean full rebuild, with median restart-to-context latency of 77--131 ms. In a separate rename probe, mixed context occurred in 0/30 Codetrip trials and 30/30 trials for both CodeGraph and codebase-memory-mcp before clean-full-equivalent convergence.
  The contribution is an Agent-facing safety contract, implementation pattern, and measurement protocol for joining live repository bytes with asynchronously derived facts. Every successful composite response consequently has a testable repository-state meaning, including after interruption.
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures. Source code and reproducibility artifacts are available at https://github.com/mengshi02/codetrip

title: The Defense Rests: A Courtroom-Inspired Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Automated Safety Case Generation
authors: Gerhard Yu, Amanuel Aknaw, Amir Ali Mohaghegh, Yong Song, Alvine B. Belle
abstract: Safety cases are widely used to demonstrate that mission-critical systems, such as autonomous vehicles and unmanned aerial systems, can operate safely after deployment. However, manually constructing safety cases is complex, time-consuming, and labor-intensive, which calls for the proposal of automated approaches to support their creation. Inspired by the legal nature of safety case construction, we formalize the safety case creation problem through a courtroom analogy, where stakeholders collaboratively propose, examine, criticize, review, improve and validate safety claims and their supporting evidence. In this analogy, the safety analyst acts as a prosecutor by identifying hazards and safety concerns, while the assurance case developer serves as a defense attorney by constructing and substantiating safety arguments. An orchestrator acts as a judge by coordinating stakeholder interactions, and a review board serves as a jury by assessing argument completeness and persuasiveness. Based on this formalization, we propose eTrustWare, a Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent framework for automated safety case generation and review. Our experiments on several safety cases of ML-enabled autonomous driving systems demonstrate the feasibility of coordinated LLM-based agents for generating safety cases.

title: A Chain-of-Thought Prompt Engineering Framework for Automated Technical Specification Generation in Enterprise Integration: A Real-World Case Study
authors: Aryan Dhingra, Gokul Menon, Anusha Antony
abstract: Technical Specification Documents (TSDs) translate functional requirements into implementable designs and are mandatory artifacts in governed Enterprise Application Integration (EAI) programs, yet their production remains a manual, expertise-intensive bottleneck. Large Language Models (LLMs) have been studied extensively for code generation, but long-form, template-governed engineering documents remain comparatively unexplored. This paper reports an industrial case study, conducted during a migration of more than 250 enterprise integrations to Microsoft Azure Integration Services at a large Australian wholesale distributor, that introduces a chain-of-thought prompt-engineering framework for automated TSD generation using GitHub Copilot. The framework combines a two-phase generation architecture that grounds the model in the functional specification, organizational standards, and the approved template; a six-stage prompting pipeline with human validation checkpoints; and Prompt-as-a-Code, under which prompts are version-controlled and reviewed as engineering artifacts. Applied to a stratified sample of fifteen production interfaces, the framework reduced TSD authoring effort from 793 to 300 person-hours, a 62.2% pooled reduction and a 64.0% mean per-document reduction (Wilcoxon signed-rank, n = 15, p < 0.001), at 74.3% reviewer-assessed accuracy and 3.7/5 developer satisfaction. Benefits degrade monotonically with interface complexity: between the simplest and most complex bands, effort reduction falls from 70.6% to 58.9% and accuracy from 91% to 62.5%, and the residual human effort concentrates in diagrams, sequence flows, and cross-system integration content. We additionally report comparative observations of GPT-4.1/5 and Claude Sonnet 4, as well as Copilot's Ask and Agent interaction modes, offering reusable, practice-grounded guidance for enterprise settings.

title: From AIOps Pipelines to Agentic Service Operations: A Survey of Capability, Authority, and Evidence
authors: Hailiang Zhao, Wenzhuo Qian, Jianwei Yin, Shuiguang Deng
abstract: Modern service systems combine rapidly changing dependencies, heterogeneous telemetry, and operational actions whose side effects may amplify an incident. Conventional AIOps research has produced effective detectors, localizers, and diagnostic models, yet surveys typically organize them by task, telemetry modality, or learning technique. Such taxonomies describe what a method predicts, but not which decisions it may make or which evidence justifies that authority. We survey the transition from AIOps pipelines to agentic service operations through three coupled lenses: capability, operational authority, and evaluation evidence. We first relate SOA, microservices, Kubernetes, service meshes, and serverless platforms to the incident lifecycle. We then review conventional AIOps methods and audit 22 language-model-enabled systems according to their evaluated behavior rather than their intended autonomy. The audit shows that most systems remain copilots or read-only investigators. Only two exercise write authority; both use constrained action envelopes, and neither carries controlled production-outcome evidence. Building on these findings, we synthesize a four-plane reference architecture, evidence grades, an evaluation ladder, and a controlled adoption path. Together, these artifacts clarify which claims current evaluations support and what evidence is still required for dependable agentic service operations.
