title: Movable Antenna for Anti-Jamming Transmission: Continuous and Discrete Positioning Designs
authors: Yifan Guo, Junshan Luo, Shilian Wang, Zhenhai Xu, Ana Garcia Armada
abstract: Movable antenna (MA) system holds big promise in further wireless communications due to the ability of reconfiguring the antenna position to enhance the spatial diversity. This paper investigates the joint design of beamforming and antenna positions in MA-assisted anti-jamming communications. We consider a multi-user multiple-input multiple-output downlink scenario where multiple malicious jammers exist. The goal is to maximize the sum-rate under the imperfect jammer channel state information. Then, we develop two distinct optimization frameworks for continuous and discrete antenna position designs, respectively. For the continuous position design, we propose an alternating optimization (AO) framework that integrates successive convex approximation and majorization minimization (MM) to handle the highly non-convex problem. For the discrete position design, based on the minimum mean squared error criterion and MM, we reformulate the problem as a sparse recovery task and propose a low-complexity heuristic block coordinate descent and simultaneous orthogonal matching pursuit, which enables joint design rather than AO. Numerical results show that the proposed discrete-position heuristic achieves higher sum rates than the adopted AO-based continuous-position algorithm. This observation highlights the trade-off between spatial resolution and optimization tractability, indicating that the sparse-recovery formulation can yield better performance than the continuous AO algorithm in the MA-assisted anti-jamming scenarios.

title: Copula-Based Synthetic Data Generation: A Use-Inspired Perspective on Trade-offs
authors: Antoine Faul, David Ginsbourger, Ben Spycher, Petra Stute
abstract: The generation of synthetic data offers a promising way to address challenges related to data scarcity and privacy concerns. While many approaches have been developed, tabular synthetic data generation methods often require complex models and extensive training data, while lacking interpretability. In this work, we investigate versatile probabilistic approaches using copulas, and leverage in particular the Gaussian Mixture Copula Model, to model the joint distribution of multivariate data, with a main focus on moderate-dimensional data sets. Taking a use-inspired perspective, we examine key trade-offs inherent to synthetic data evaluation, spanning fidelity, utility, and privacy, and demonstrate that copula-based methods achieve a sound balance across all three dimensions while remaining interpretable and providing an explicit probabilistic model. We illustrate and highlight the potential benefits of the method on a test case focusing on systematic missing values in a cardiovascular risk calculator and develop specific evaluation metrics for this application.

title: Deep Learning Models for Fractional Option Pricing
authors: Hana Sagor, Edward L. Boone, Ryad A. Ghanam
abstract: This paper investigates whether neural networks can infer fractional option prices and the Hurst parameter directly from sequences of fractional Gaussian returns, without separately estimating the latent parameters for each new sequence. Feedforward neural networks (FNNs) and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks are trained to jointly predict European call prices, put prices, and the Hurst parameter from 252-return sequences. A controlled simulation varies the total sample size from 5,000 to 500,000 sequences and evaluates point prediction, empirical residual-based prediction intervals, and computational performance. The neural-network models are also compared on a common simulated test set with Bayesian joint estimation and exact Gaussian maximum likelihood estimation. In that four-method comparison, the LSTM achieves the lowest Hurst-parameter root mean squared error (0.033) and option-price root mean squared error (1.305). After training, neural-network predictions are substantially faster than repeated parameter estimation, although the methods quantify uncertainty in different ways. Applications to five financial return series illustrate differences between data-driven and model-based fractional price estimates. The results support sequence-based learning as a computationally efficient complement to statistical inference under the assumed fractional model; they do not establish out-of-distribution accuracy or accuracy against observed traded-option prices.

title: JALE: A new Python toolbox for coordinate-based neuroimaging meta-analysis using activation likelihood estimation
authors: Edna C. Cieslik, Lennart Frahm, Felix Hoffstaedter, Robert Langner, Changyi Kuang, Peter T. Fox, Federico Raimondo, Simon B. Eickhoff, Veronika I. Mueller
abstract: Coordinate-based neuroimaging meta-analysis using activation likelihood estimation (ALE) is commonly used to synthesize reported results of functional or structural magnetic resonance imaging studies. We here present JALE, a new, open-source Python package for conducting ALE meta-analyses. Besides computing standard ALE main effects and contrast analyses, this toolbox implements several novel analytical approaches including new options for thresholding (threshold-free cluster enhancement statistics, significance threshold prediction) as well as sensitivity and cluster analyses that were only available as in-house scripts in the past. The purpose of this paper is to provide an integrated conceptual foundation of recent developments in the ALE meta-analysis framework, with a particular focus on novel methodological implementations that can be executed in a straightforward and standardized manner using the new JALE toolbox.

title: Deep Mixture Models: A Statistical Review with R
authors: Jinran Wu, Geoffrey J. McLachlan
abstract: Deep mixture models extend finite mixture models through hierarchical latent factor structures with shared mixture parameters. This focused review examines deep Gaussian mixture models (DGMMs), robust deep mixture models (RDMMs), deep skew-$t$ mixture models (DStMMs), and mixed deep Gaussian mixture models (MDGMMs) within a common statistical framework. We compare their pathway distributions, measurement models, and latent architectures, highlighting the implications for likelihood evaluation and inference. For continuous measurements, we discuss Gaussian conditional calculations and the scale-mixture methods underlying Student-$t$ and skew-$t$ pathways. For mixed measurements, we consider response-specific likelihoods and numerical integration for discrete variables. Alongside the review, we introduce \texttt{MixedDeepMM}, an R package providing a unified interface for fitting and evaluating deep mixture models with Gaussian, Student-$t$, and skew-$t$ kernels, supporting continuous and mixed measurements and single- and two-head architectures. We illustrate its use on the UCI Wine and Cryotherapy datasets, reporting clustering measures with standard errors across repeated fits and visualising consensus partitions. For mixed data, Gower silhouette widths complement external clustering agreement measures. We conclude by discussing computational challenges, model selection, and uncertainty assessment.

title: Milk yield responses to heat stress in tropical dairy cattle
authors: Leonardo Nascimento Ferreira, Delane Ribas da Rosa, Renata Negri, Marcos Vinicius Gualberto Barbosa da Silva, Rafaella Resende Andrade, Nicole Costa Resende Ferreira
abstract:
Context: Rising temperatures and warm tropical nights threaten dairy productivity and resilience across tropical landscapes.
  Objective: This study characterises multi-scale interactions among thermal regimes, nighttime cooling, metabolic heat load, and crossbred genetics on daily milk yield in Brazilian dairy systems.
  Methods: A 24-year panel (2001--2024) of 788,528 test-day records from 87,809 Girolando (Holstein $\times$ Gyr) cows across 408 municipalities was linked to weather data. Two-way fixed effects, distributed lag, and piecewise threshold spline models were estimated across yield quartiles and crossbred fractions.
  Results: While aggregate summaries suggest stable yield up to a daily mean Temperature--Humidity Index (THI) of 76, production-stratified splines show high-yielding cows lose milk starting at THI 68 and accelerating above 76 ($-0.162$ kg animal$^{-1}$ d$^{-1}$ unit$^{-1}$, $p=0.0062$), whereas low-yielding cows remain unaffected ($p=0.81$). Distributed lag models reveal an immediate drop followed by a deeper trough four days later. Lack of nighttime relief ($\mathrm{THI}_{\min} \ge 68$) reduces yield by an extra 2.37 kg animal$^{-1}$ d$^{-1}$ ($p \le 0.001$) and causes an 8.6\% loss after seven warm nights, whereas wide diurnal amplitude buffers output by $+1.60$ kg animal$^{-1}$ d$^{-1}$. At comparable high yields ($\approx 31$ kg animal$^{-1}$ d$^{-1}$), intermediate crossbreds ($1/2$ and $5/8$ Holstein) sustain yield up to THI 76, whereas $7/8$ Holstein cows decline at THI 68.
  Conclusions: Tropical dairy adaptation requires continuous nighttime cooling for high-yielding cows combined with balanced Zebu--taurine crossbreeding.

title: Distributed Blind Source Separation from Compressed Mixtures
authors: Amir Weiss
abstract: Blind source separation (BSS) is increasingly needed in sensing architectures where mixtures are acquired by multiple remote devices but the inference itself is carried out centrally. In such systems, the sensors often cannot transmit their raw observations since the communication links are rate-limited, energy-limited, or both. The fusion center therefore must recover the latent sources from compressed versions of the mixtures. This setting raises questions that classical BSS models do not address directly: whether source identifiability survives compression, how separation accuracy changes under a specified compression model, and how the separation procedure should be modified to account for the statistical model induced by the compression stage. In this work, we develop a framework for distributed BSS from compressed mixtures that addresses these issues at three levels. First, we formalize identifiability under compression and establish a data-processing viewpoint showing that compression cannot introduce distinguishability that is absent before compression. Second, for mixtures of Gaussian sources with general covariance structures, we derive an idealized Gaussian rate-distortion-based Cramér-Rao lower bound benchmark for the interference-to-source ratio. Third, we develop practical compression-aware separation schemes based on subtractively dithered quantization together with debiasing at the fusion center for both fourth-order-cumulant-based and second-order-statistics-based methods. Simulation experiments demonstrate the resulting tradeoffs between communication rate and separation performance and the gains obtained by compression-aware separation in representative distributed sensing scenarios.

title: TRAIL-IRL: Crossed Reward-Temperature Mixtures for Unlabeled Trajectory Clustering
authors: Yichen Zhu, Guanhua Fang, Ming Zheng
abstract: Different paths need not imply different preferences, trajectories also differ in how randomly actions are chosen. Many multi-reward inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) methods assume common action randomness and can confound it with preference heterogeneity. We introduce TRAIL-IRL, which clusters unlabeled trajectories using rewards for preferences and temperatures for action randomness. Its crossed mixture pairs each reward with a shared set of temperature levels, allowing action regularity to vary within preference groups. With centered and normalized rewards in a known finite-state environment, we establish the identifiability conditions under which the distribution of sufficiently long trajectories determines rewards, temperatures, mixing weights, and class counts up to relabeling. Under the same conditions and reward constraints, common-temperature reward mixtures with the same component count cannot reproduce a crossed mixture with multiple temperatures. We develop a generalized expectation-maximization algorithm and select class counts using the Bayesian information criterion (BIC). Simulations show improved predictive fit, reward recovery, and trajectory classification over common-temperature mixtures with the same component count. For 140 bird-year trajectories from 79 white storks, BIC favors four reward classes and three temperature levels over common-temperature candidates. Younger birds have higher posterior membership probabilities for a southwestward migration class, whereas older birds have higher probabilities for a northern retention class. Within reward classes, higher temperatures are associated with more variable movement directions and positions farther ahead along the migration route, consistent with social information use and collective sensing.

title: When Should LLM Agents Forget? Memory Filtering Under Query-Critical Resolver Errors
authors: Samarth Vinayaka
abstract: LLM memory systems often delete facts classified as stale. We show that this hard-filtering step can reduce downstream accuracy when resolver errors delete query-critical facts. Across three models, a controlled sensitivity intervention moves hard-drop from gains of +0.186 to +0.230 at perfect resolution to losses of -0.176 to -0.181 at the lowest tested reliability. Paired targeted interventions show that false-drop causes significantly greater degradation than false-keep, while a non-deleting baseline can still fail when incorrect labels steer generation. On a frozen 102/102 calibration/test split, a simple deployment-matched gate reaches 0.655 accuracy versus 0.641 for always hard-drop and 0.662 for test-informed oracle selection. Global-accuracy crossovers require gold labels and are model- and task-specific diagnostics, not deployment thresholds. Deletion should instead be treated as cost-sensitive: validate query-critical false-drop risk on matched data, or default to label-free retention when such validation is unavailable.
zh_title: LLM智能体何时应该遗忘？查询关键解析器错误下的记忆过滤
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）的记忆系统经常会删除被分类为陈旧的事实。我们发现，当解析器错误删除了查询关键的事实（query-critical facts）时，这种硬过滤步骤会降低下游准确率。在三个模型中，受控的敏感度干预将完美解析下的硬删除收益从+0.186至+0.230转变为在测试最低可靠性下的-0.176至-0.181的损失。成对的靶向干预表明，错误删除（false-drop）造成的性能退化明显大于错误保留（false-keep），而不删除的基线在错误标签引导生成时仍然可能失败。在一个固定的102/102校准/测试拆分上，一个简单的部署匹配门控达到了0.655的准确率，而总是硬删除为0.641，测试通知的预言机选择为0.662。全局准确率交叉点需要黄金标签，且是模型和任务特定的诊断，而非部署阈值。因此，删除应该被视为成本敏感的：在匹配数据上验证查询关键的错误删除风险，或者在无法进行此类验证时默认采用无标签保留。
tldr: 研究表明LLM记忆系统中的盲目删除会导致查询关键事实丢失并降低准确率，因此记忆删除应作为成本敏感问题处理，缺乏验证时建议默认保留。
ai_comments: 该论文针对大语言模型智能体记忆系统中的“遗忘”机制进行了深入探讨，揭示了传统硬过滤策略在解析器错误下的负面影响，并提出了将删除视为成本敏感型决策的新视角，具有很高的实用价值和创新性。
motivation: 大语言模型记忆系统通常会删除被分类为陈旧的事实，但作者发现当解析器错误导致查询关键事实被删除时，这种硬过滤步骤会降低下游准确率，因此需要研究何时该让LLM智能体遗忘。
method: 通过对照敏感度干预和配对靶向干预，评估了硬过滤对下游准确率的影响，并测试了一个基于部署匹配的门控机制与全局准确率交叉点。
results: 研究表明，错误删除（false-drop）造成的性能退化显著大于错误保留（false-keep）；一个简单的部署匹配门控机制在测试集上达到了0.655的准确率，优于总是硬过滤的0.641。
conclusion: 大语言模型记忆系统的删除操作应作为成本敏感问题处理：在缺乏匹配数据验证时，应默认采用无标签保留策略，以避免查询关键事实的错误删除。

title: LoRAWeaver: Directional Adapter Routing in LoRA Representation Space
authors: Inish Melroy D Souza, Tom Jackson, Vitor Castro, Rebecca Higginson, Andrea Soltoggio
abstract: Large language models are expensive to update through full retraining. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning reduces the cost of adaptation, but repeated adaptation creates a growing pool of task-specific LoRA adapters. This pool complicates adapter selection during inference. Existing routing and encoder-based methods often require retraining when new adapters are added, which limits their use in dynamic settings. This paper treats adapter routing as a representation alignment problem in the adapter-output space. The proposed training-free method selects adapters by matching adapter-conditioned query representations against task prototypes using cosine similarity. Experiments with LLaMA-2-7B and LLaMA-2-13B on a 48-task FLAN-v2 benchmark and on out-of-distribution tasks show that the method outperforms training-free baselines in the cross-task setting and approaches a trained retrieval encoder without learning a router. An ablation confirms the benefit of directional alignment in the adapter-output space.
zh_title: LoRAWeaver：LoRA表示空间中的定向适配器路由
translation: 大语言模型通过完全重新训练来进行更新的代价高昂。参数高效微调降低了适应成本，但反复的适应会产生一个不断增长的任务特定LoRA适配器池。这个池使推理过程中的适配器选择变得复杂。现有的路由和基于编码的方法在添加新适配器时通常需要重新训练，这限制了它们在动态设置中的应用。本文将适配器路由视为适配器输出空间中的表示对齐问题。所提出的无需训练的方法通过使用余弦相似度将适配器条件的查询表示与任务原型进行匹配来选择适配器。在LLaMA-2-7B和LLaMA-2-13B上进行的48任务FLAN-v2基准测试及分布外任务实验表明，该方法在跨任务设置中优于无需训练的基线，并且在不学习路由器的同时逼近了训练好的检索编码器。消融实验证实了适配器输出空间中方向对齐的益处。
tldr: LoRAWeaver提出了一种无需训练的定向适配器路由方法，通过在输出空间对齐表示来高效选择动态增长的LoRA适配器。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的无需训练的LoRA适配器路由方法，通过将路由问题转化为适配器输出空间的表示对齐问题，有效应对了动态环境中适配器池不断增长的挑战。其创新点在于利用余弦相似度匹配查询表示与任务原型，既避免了重新训练路由器的开销，又逼近了有监督检索编码器的性能。
motivation: 随着参数高效微调的普及，任务特定的LoRA适配器池不断增长，导致推理时的适配器选择变得复杂，而现有的路由和基于编码器的方法在添加新适配器时通常需要重新训练，难以适应动态环境。
method: 提出了一种无需训练的方法，将适配器路由视为适配器输出空间中的表示对齐问题，通过使用余弦相似度将适配器条件的查询表示与任务原型进行匹配来选择适配器。
results: 在LLaMA-2-7B和LLaMA-2-13B基于48个任务的FLAN-v2基准测试以及分布外任务上的实验表明，该方法在跨任务设置中优于无需训练的基线，且在无需学习路由器的情况下接近了已训练的检索编码器的性能。
conclusion: LoRAWeaver提供了一种高效、无需训练的动态LoRA适配器路由方案，在跨任务设置中表现优异，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Everything is an Operational View: UI as a Projection over Context in Agentic Systems
authors: Jieshan Chen, Robert Mao, Xiwei Xu, Xuewu Gu, Yechao Li, Zhenchang Xing
abstract: The emergence of generative AI has enabled Generative User Interfaces (GenUI) that dynamically construct interfaces from user intent, yet existing approaches rely on request-response pipelines that fragment context and limit transparency and control. This paper proposes AFS-UI, which reconceptualises UI as projections over context built on an agentic file-system abstraction that organizes data, capabilities, and interaction state within a unified, persistent workspace. In particular, AFS-UI addresses key limitations in current systems, including heterogeneous resource discoverability, incompatible operation semantics, tangling projection and context, rigid source composition and substitution, and limited evolvability. Within this framework, interfaces become dynamic, inspectable views over shared resources, supporting both human and agent interaction through a common operational surface.
zh_title: 一切皆操作视图：代理系统中作为上下文投影的用户界面
translation: 生成式AI的出现催生了根据用户意图动态构建界面的生成式用户界面（GenUI），然而现有方法依赖于请求-响应管道，这会割裂上下文并限制透明度与控制力。本文提出了AFS-UI，它将UI重新构想为构建在代理文件系统抽象之上的上下文投影，该抽象在一个统一、持久的工作空间中组织数据、能力和交互状态。特别是，AFS-UI解决了当前系统的关键局限，包括异构资源可发现性、不兼容的操作语义、投影与上下文的纠缠、刚性的源组合与替换，以及有限的可演进性。在此框架内，界面成为共享资源上动态、可检查的视图，通过公共操作表面支持人类和智能体的交互。
tldr: 本文提出了AFS-UI框架，将UI视为代理文件系统上下文中动态投影，从而解决了现有生成式UI的碎片化和透明度问题。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的GenUI框架（AFS-UI），将用户界面重新构想为基于代理文件系统的上下文投影，为智能体系统中的人机交互提供了一个统一、透明且动态的操作视图。
motivation: 现有的生成式用户界面（GenUI）依赖于请求-响应管道，这会导致上下文碎片化，并限制了透明度和控制力。
method: 提出了AFS-UI框架，将数据、能力和交互状态组织在统一、持久的工作空间中，并将UI重构为基于代理文件系统抽象的上下文投影。
results: 成功解决了当前系统在异构资源可发现性、不兼容的操作语义、投影与上下文纠缠、刚性源组合与替换以及有限的可演进性等方面的主要局限。
conclusion: 通过将UI视为上下文的投影，AFS-UI克服了传统生成式UI在透明度、控制力和上下文碎片化方面的局限，实现了人机交互的统一操作视图。

title: Tabular Population Priors as Structured Retrieval for EHR Medication Set Prediction
authors: Animesh Agarwal, Meysam Ghaffari, Nina Fatehi, Carlos Morato
abstract: Medication prediction from electronic health records is a fixed vocabulary structured prediction problem, yet recent clinical RAG systems often treat it like open ended case based reasoning: retrieve similar patient admissions and ask an LLM to infer a medication set. This retrieval object is indirect the model receives retrieved patient records while the target is a discrete set of medication class labels. We propose a more task aligned retrieval object: a tabular population prior ranked medication class candidates from a sparse condition medication co occurrence table estimated from training admissions. Using PACERAG as a fixed downstream pipeline and replacing only its patient retriever, this drop in swap improves F1 from 0.303 to 0.338 (+11.5% relative) and Jaccard from 0.218 to 0.237 on 1,004 heldout MIMIC IV admissions, with no additional LLM calls and no inference time patient index. A non LLM top k baseline reaches F1=0.248, confirming the prior is predictive before LLM integration. Aggregate population statistics can provide a more task aligned, efficient, and auditable retrieval source than patient level nearest neighbors for fixed vocabulary EHR set prediction.
comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Structured Data for Health (SD4H), Seoul, South Korea
zh_title: 作为结构化检索的表格总体先验用于EHR药物集预测
translation: 从电子健康记录中预测药物是一个固定词汇的结构化预测问题，然而最近的临床RAG系统通常将其视为开放式的基于案例的推理：检索相似的患者入院记录并要求LLM推断药物集。这种检索对象是间接的——模型接收检索到的患者记录，而目标是一组离散的药物类别标签。我们提出了一种更具任务对齐性的检索对象：表格化总体先验，它根据从训练入院记录中估计出的稀疏病情-药物共现表对药物类别候选进行排序。将PACERAG用作固定的下游管道并仅替换其患者检索器，这种直接替换在1,004个留出的MIMIC-IV入院记录上将F1值从0.303提高到0.338（相对提高11.5%），Jaccard系数从0.218提高到0.237，且没有额外的LLM调用，也没有推理时患者索引。一个非LLM的top-k基线达到了F1=0.248，证实了该先验在LLM集成之前就具有预测能力。对于固定词汇表的EHR集合预测，聚合总体统计数据可以提供比患者级最近邻更具任务对齐性、高效且可审计的检索来源。
tldr: 通过用基于人群统计的表格先验替代传统的患者实例检索，显著提升了电子病历药物预测的准确性与效率，且无需增加大语言模型调用。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出用表格化的总体先验（Tabular Population Priors）替代传统的基于患者实例的检索，直接针对电子病历（EHR）中的药物预测任务。这种方法无需增加大语言模型调用，也无需推理时患者索引，不仅显著提升了预测准确率，还增强了可解释性和效率。
motivation: 近期的临床检索增强生成（RAG）系统通常将电子病历中的药物预测视为开放式基于案例的推理（检索相似的患者入院记录并让LLM推断药物集），这种检索对象是间接的，因为模型接收的是患者记录，而目标是离散的药物类别标签集合。
method: 提出了一种更具任务对齐性的检索对象：表格化总体先验，通过训练入院记录中估计出的稀疏病情-药物共现表来对药物类别候选进行排序。将其作为直接替换件替换PACERAG中的患者检索器，无需额外的LLM调用和推理时患者索引。
results: 在1,004个留出的MIMIC-IV入院记录上，仅替换患者检索器就使F1分数从0.303提高到0.338（相对提升11.5%），Jaccard相似度从0.218提高到0.237，且无需额外的LLM调用。非LLM的top-k基线达到了F1=0.248，证实了该先验在LLM集成之前就具有预测能力。
conclusion: 聚合的总体统计数据可以为固定词汇表的EHR集合预测提供比患者级最近邻更具任务对齐性、高效性和可审计性的检索来源。

title: Does the Ranking Hold? A Practitioner-Facing Audit of Hallucination Detectors on Small, Quantized, On-Device LLMs
authors: Shubhra Mittal, Gaurav Naresh Mittal
abstract: Hallucination detection for large language models is dominated by methods evaluated on 7B-70B research models with abundant sampling budgets and exact-match or ROUGE correctness labels. The small models practitioners actually ship on-device, Phi-3-mini, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, and Gemma-2-2B-Instruct, typically at 4-bit precision, sit outside this evidence base. We present a reproducible one-GPU audit of four detectors spanning three paradigms: length-normalized token-margin calibration, a lexical n-gram baseline, and two sampling-based consistency methods (semantic entropy and SelfCheckGPT-NLI) on two small open instruction-tuned models (Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct) loaded at 4-bit NF4 quantization on a single Colab T4 GPU, evaluated on closed-book TriviaQA. Cross-model ranking transfer is poor: Spearman rho is -0.80 and Kendall tau-b is -0.667, meaning the detector ranking actively inverts between the two models, and the cheap lexical baseline is statistically indistinguishable from the sampling-based consistency detectors on both models under bootstrap 95 percent confidence intervals. As a second, methodological contribution, we show that the standard token-overlap-to-multiple-choice correctness labeler for TruthfulQA-Generation produces near-chance AUROC (0.46-0.59) for all four detectors on both models, a labeler failure, not a detector failure, since the same detectors reach 0.69-0.89 AUROC on TriviaQA under the identical pipeline. We release the harness, prompts, and per-item scores and frame the detector choice explicitly as a fairness-of-error-rates allocation problem for practitioners deploying on resource-constrained, on-device hardware.
zh_title: 排名还成立吗？针对小型、量化、端侧LLM幻觉检测器的面向从业者的审计
translation: 大语言模型的幻觉检测主要由在7B-70B研究模型上评估的方法主导，这些方法具有丰富的采样预算和精确匹配或ROUGE正确性标签。从业者实际在端侧部署的小型模型（Phi-3-mini、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct和Gemma-2-2B-Instruct，通常采用4位精度）并不在这一证据基础之内。我们对跨越三个范式的四个检测器（长度归一化Token边际校准、词汇n-gram基线、以及两个基于采样的⼀致性方法即语义熵和SelfCheckGPT-NLI）进行了可复现的单GPU审计，对象是加载在单个Colab T4 GPU上的4位NF4量化的两个小型开源指令微调模型（Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct），并在闭卷TriviaQA上进行了评估。跨模型排名迁移表现较差：Spearman相关系数为-0.80，Kendall tau-b为-0.667，这意味着检测器排名在两个模型之间发生了主动倒置；在Bootstrap 95%置信区间下，廉价的词汇基线在两个模型上与基于采样的⼀致性检测器在统计上没有区别。作为第二个方法论贡献，我们表明TruthfulQA-Generation的标准Token重叠转多选题正确性标签器对两个模型上的所有四个检测器产生了接近随机的AUROC（0.46-0.59），这是标签器的失败，而非检测器的失败，因为相同的检测器在相同的流水线下的TriviaQA上达到了0.69-0.89的AUROC。我们公开了测试框架、提示词和每个项目的得分，并将检测器的选择明确定义为面向在资源受限的端侧硬件上部署的从业者的错误率公平分配问题。
tldr: 论文对端侧小型量化LLM的幻觉检测器进行了审计，发现大模型上的检测器排名无法直接迁移到小模型，且简单词汇基线与复杂采样方法效果相当。
ai_comments: 该论文针对资源受限的端侧小模型量化部署场景，对现有的幻觉检测器进行了极具现实意义的审计。其发现跨模型排名不稳定性以及传统基于词汇的基线方法不输于复杂采样方法的结论，对端侧AI工程实践具有重要的指导价值。
motivation: 目前大语言模型幻觉检测的研究主要集中在7B-70B的大型研究模型上，缺乏对从业者实际部署在端侧的小型量化模型（如Phi-3, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-3B, Gemma-2-2B等）的实证研究。
method: 在单张Colab T4 GPU上对4种跨3种范式的幻觉检测器进行了可复现的审计，使用两个加载为4位NF4量化的小型指令微调模型（Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct），并在TriviaQA数据集上进行评估。
results: 检测器的跨模型排名转移极差（Spearman rho为-0.80），廉价的词汇基线方法在统计上与基于采样的检测器无异，且标准TruthfulQA-Generation正确性标签器在小模型上表现为几近随机的AUROC。
conclusion: 端侧小模型量化部署下的幻觉检测与大模型时代存在显著差异，跨模型检测器排名不具迁移性，且简单基线方法表现极具竞争力，标准多选题正确性标签器在小模型上易失效。

title: fieldsmith: Automated symbolic derivation in classical field theory and gauge theory from LaTeX input
authors: Nikola Mirkov
abstract: We present fieldsmith, an open-source Python library for the automated derivation of analytical results in classical field theory, and non-abelian gauge theories. A Lagrangian is entered the way it is written on a blackboard, in LaTeX index notation, and the library produces and verifies Euler-Lagrange equations (of arbitrary derivative order, on flat or curved backgrounds), Noether currents and identities, canonical and Hilbert energy-momentum tensors, canonical momenta and Hamiltonians, local Poisson brackets and a Dirac-Bergmann constraint analysis with degree-of-freedom counting, linearised wave equations and dispersion relations, gauge-covariant derivatives and field strengths for products of unitary groups, and mass spectra after spontaneous symmetry breaking. A fitting routine translates component-level output back into covariant index notation, and a grading module checks students' submitted field equations, identities and conserved currents. The implementation is a compact (about 2,700 lines) layer on top of SymPy: tensors are stored by components with labelled, variance-aware slots, and every statement is established by exact symbolic computation rather than pattern matching. This document is the companion guide to the library. It explains the intent and design, describes the algorithms, and then works through eighteen self-checking examples, ranging from the Klein-Gordon field to the BPST instanton and the 't Hooft-Polyakov monopole, each preceded by the background physics needed to follow it. The examples double as a compact introduction to classical field theory and gauge theory as seen through a computational lens. We are explicit about the limitations of the approach.
zh_title: fieldsmith：从LaTeX输入自动推导经典场论和规范场论中的符号结果
translation: 我们介绍了fieldsmith，一个用于自动推导经典场论和非阿贝尔规范场论中解析结果的开源Python库。拉格朗日量的输入方式与黑板上书写的一样，采用LaTeX指标符号，该库可以生成并验证欧拉-拉格朗日方程（任意导数阶，在平坦或弯曲背景上）、诺伊特流与恒等式、正则和希尔伯特能量动量张量、正则动量与哈密顿量、局部泊松括号以及带自由度计数的狄拉克-伯格曼约束分析、线性化波动方程与色散关系、酉群乘积的规范协变导数与场强，以及自发对称性破缺后的质量谱。一个拟合例程将分量级输出转换回协变指标符号，一个评分模块用于检查学生提交的场方程、恒等式和守恒流。该实现是SymPy之上一个紧凑的层（约2700行代码）：张量通过带标签、区分变异的槽按分量存储，每个语句都是通过精确的符号计算而不是模式匹配建立的。本文是该库的配套指南。它解释了意图和设计，描述了算法，然后通过十八个自检示例（从克莱因-戈尔登场到BPST瞬子和't Hooft-Polyakov磁单极子），每个示例前都有跟进所需的背景物理知识。这些示例兼作通过计算视角对经典场论和规范场论的紧凑介绍。我们明确指出了该方法的局限性。
tldr: fieldsmith是一个基于LaTeX输入的Python库，能够自动化推导经典场论和规范场论中的各种复杂解析结果。
ai_comments: 该论文介绍了一个名为fieldsmith的开源Python库，能够直接从LaTeX输入自动推导经典场论和规范场论中的解析结果。其创新之处在于支持LaTeX输入、基于SymPy进行精确的符号计算，并涵盖了从欧拉-拉格朗日方程到Dirac-Bergmann约束分析等广泛的物理量推导，对物理研究和教学都有很高的价值。
motivation: 为了解决经典场论和非阿贝尔规范场论中解析结果推导繁琐且容易出错的问题，提供一个能够直接从LaTeX输入自动进行符号推导的开源Python工具。
method: 基于SymPy构建了一个约2700行代码的轻量级层，通过带标签、区分变异的组件存储张量，利用精确的符号计算而非模式匹配来建立每一条语句，并包含一个将分量级输出翻译回协变指标的拟合例程和一个评分模块。
results: 成功开发了fieldsmith库，能够自动推导并验证欧拉-拉格朗日方程、诺伊特流、能量动量张量、哈密顿量、泊松括号、狄拉克-伯格曼约束分析、线性化波动方程、规范协变导数、场强以及质量谱，并通过18个自检示例进行了演示。
conclusion: fieldsmith作为一个基于LaTeX输入的轻量级Python符号计算库，能够高效、准确地完成经典场论和规范场论中复杂的解析推导，具有广泛的应用前景。

title: TSP instances that require exponentially many subtour elimination constraints
authors: Eleonora Vercesi, Austin Buchanan
abstract: We construct pathological TSP instances that require exponentially many subtour elimination constraints (SECs) in the sense that, if a smaller collection of SECs is imposed, then the Dantzig-Fulkerson-Johnson model returns a disconnected solution costing less than an optimal tour. For asymmetric instances on $n$ vertices, we prove a growth rate of \(Ω(φ^n)\), where \(φ\approx 1.618\) is the golden ratio. A node-splitting reduction gives metric instances with \(Ω(φ^{n/2})\) growth. We also give instances in the plane under the Euclidean, Rectilinear, and Maximum metrics that require exponentially many SECs. Concorde struggles on them, with solve times growing exponentially despite tiny integrality gaps.
zh_title: 需要指数级多子环路消除约束的TSP实例
translation: 我们构造了病态的TSP实例，这些实例在以下意义上需要指数级数量的子环路消除约束（SECs）：如果施加较小集合的SECs，那么Dantzig-Fulkerson-Johnson模型将返回一个成本低于最优巡回的不连通解。对于n个顶点的不对称实例，我们证明了增长率为Ω(φ^n)，其中φ≈1.618是黄金比例。节点分裂归约给出了具有Ω(φ^{n/2})增长的度量实例。我们还给出了在欧几里得、直线和最大值度量下的平面实例，这些实例需要指数级数量的SECs。Concorde在这些实例上表现挣扎，尽管积分间隙很小，但求解时间呈指数级增长。
tldr: 本文构造了需要指数级数量子环路消除约束（SECs）的TSP病态实例，证明了Dantzig-Fulkerson-Johnson模型和当前主流求解器在此类问题上面临的理论和实际困难。
ai_comments: 该论文在旅行商问题（TSP）多面体理论和割平面方法方面取得了重要进展，首次严格构造了需要指数级子环路消除约束（SECs）的病态实例，对理解当前高效求解器（如Concorde）在某些实例上失效的原因具有重要价值。
motivation: 探讨Dantzig-Fulkerson-Johnson模型在求解旅行商问题（TSP）时，是否真的在所有情况下都只需要多项式数量的子环路消除约束（SECs），还是存在某些病态实例需要指数级数量的SECs。
method: 通过构造不对称的病态TSP实例证明增长率为Ω(φ^n)；利用节点分裂归约法得到度量实例；并在欧几里得、直线和最大值度量下构造平面实例，最后结合Concorde求解器进行计算验证。
results: 对于非对称实例，证明了SECs的增长率为Ω(φ^n)（其中φ约为1.618的黄金比例）；通过节点分裂降维得到Ω(φ^{n/2})增长的度量实例；同时在欧几里得、直线和最大值度量下的平面实例中也需要指数级数量的SECs，且Concorde求解器在此类实例上的求解时间呈指数级增长。
conclusion: 通过构造特定的病态TSP实例，本文证明了Dantzig-Fulkerson-Johnson模型在求解时确实需要指数级数量的子环路消除约束（SECs），从而在理论上证实了这类约束的必要性和局限性。

title: Beyond Attack-Based Accuracy: Rethinking Adversarial Robustness Evaluation Through Structural Gradient Alignment
authors: Hanrui Wang, Yu Luo, Shuo Wang, Xingbo Dong, Zhe Jin, Isao Echizen
abstract: Visual adversarial robustness remains a fundamental security property as vision systems evolve from conventional classifiers to vision-language models (VLMs) and large vision-language models (LVLMs), with visual inputs remaining an attack surface across generations. Yet existing evaluation methods often depend on prescribed attacks, in-distribution data, extensive probing, or classifier-specific formulations, limiting external auditing of diverse models. We introduce Structural Gradient Alignment (SGA), a complementary robustness metric measuring the structural alignment between input content and objective-conditioned local model sensitivity. SGA uses a few randomly sampled, unlabeled public probes that need not follow the downstream task distribution and only one input-gradient computation per model--probe pair. Across 38 distinct DNNs, VLMs, and LVLMs, SGA produces rankings consistent with attack-based references. Without robustness references, uncalibrated SGA achieves $83.72\%$ average pairwise agreement across eight public-probe conditions, outperforming the strongest overall baseline in all eight by $9.38$ percentage points on average. With known robustness orders of anchor models, calibrated SGA increases agreement to $85.36\%$. These results demonstrate an attack-agnostic, computationally efficient robustness signal across conventional DNNs, VLMs, and autoregressive LVLMs, downstream tasks, threat norms, probe distributions, and evaluator-knowledge settings. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/azrealwang/SGA.
zh_title: 超越基于攻击的准确性：通过结构梯度对齐重新思考对抗鲁棒性评估
translation: 视觉对抗鲁棒性仍然是安全的关键属性，因为视觉系统正从传统的分类器演变为视觉语言模型（VLMs）和大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs），而视觉输入在各代模型中仍然是一个攻击面。然而，现有的评估方法通常依赖于预设的攻击、分布内数据、广泛的探测或特定于分类器的表述，限制了对各种模型的外部审计。我们引入了结构梯度对齐（SGA），一种互补的鲁棒性指标，用于衡量输入内容与目标条件下的局部模型敏感度之间的结构对齐程度。SGA使用少量随机采样的、无标签的公开探针，这些探针不需要遵循下游任务分布，并且每个模型-探针对只需要一次输入-梯度计算。在38个不同的DNN、VLM和LVLM上，SGA产生的排名与基于攻击的参考结果一致。在没有鲁棒性参考的情况下，未经校准的SGA在八种公开探针条件下实现了83.72%的平均成对一致性，平均比最强的整体基线高出9.38个百分点。在已知锚定模型的鲁棒性顺序的情况下，校准后的SGA将一致性提高到85.36%。这些结果证明了一种跨越传统DNN、VLM和自回归LVLM、下游任务、威胁模型、探针分布和评估者知识设置的、不依赖攻击的、计算高效的鲁棒性信号。我们的实现可在https://github.com/azrealwang/SGA 获取。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为结构梯度对齐（SGA）的新鲁棒性评估指标，用于评估视觉模型的鲁棒性，特别是视觉-语言模型（VLMs）和大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）。SGA不依赖于特定的攻击方法，而是衡量输入内容与目标条件下的局部模型敏感度之间的结构对齐程度。该方法计算效率高，只需少量无标签的公开探针和一次输入-梯度计算。实验表明，SGA在不同类型的模型上能产生与基于攻击的评估一致的排名，并且在没有鲁棒性参考模型的情况下，其性能优于现有基线方法。校准后的SGA进一步提高了评估的一致性。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖且有前景的鲁棒性评估方法SGA，它克服了现有方法的局限性，实现了对各种视觉模型的攻击无关评估。其计算效率高和对探针数据要求低的特点使其具有广泛的应用潜力。然而，未来研究可以进一步探索SGA在更广泛的攻击场景和模型架构下的鲁棒性，并研究如何进一步提高其校准精度。
motivation: 现有的视觉对抗鲁棒性评估方法依赖于特定的攻击、分布内数据、大量的探测或特定于分类器的公式，这限制了对不同模型的外部审计。因此，需要一种新的、更通用的鲁棒性评估方法。
method: 提出了一种名为结构梯度对齐（SGA）的鲁棒性评估指标。SGA通过计算输入内容与目标条件下的局部模型敏感度之间的结构对齐程度来衡量鲁棒性。该方法使用少量随机采样的、无标签的公开探针，并且每个模型-探针对只需要一次输入-梯度计算。
results: 在38个不同的深度神经网络（DNN）、视觉-语言模型（VLMs）和大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）上，SGA产生的排名与基于攻击的参考结果一致。在没有鲁棒性参考的情况下，SGA在八种公开探针条件下实现了83.72%的平均成对一致性，平均比最强的整体基线高出9.38个百分点。在已知锚定模型的鲁棒性顺序的情况下，校准后的SGA将一致性提高到85.36%。
conclusion: SGA提供了一种不依赖于攻击、计算高效的鲁棒性信号，适用于各种模型（DNN、VLM、LVLM）、下游任务、威胁模型、探针分布和评估者知识设置。

title: ProdPilot: A Layered Model Context Protocol System for Automated Production Readiness and Deployment of Vibe-Coded Projects
authors: Muhammad Sudais Khalid, Muhammad Junaid Asif, Rehan Naveed Abbasi, Rana Fayyaz Ahmad
abstract: AI-assisted development environments turn natural-language requests into working applications, yet the projects they produce often fail on their first deployment for operational reasons: credentials in source files, missing security middleware, no container definition, no health endpoint and no delivery pipeline. Automated repair of such defects usually relies on free-form model generation, which varies between runs and is seldom checked independently. This paper presents ProdPilot, a local Model Context Protocol server that audits Node.js and React projects against 50 production readiness rules, repairs violations through a bounded loop, gates the result and deploys it. Each rule is classified by what its fix requires: 28 fixes are fixed templates, 16 are filled with values extracted from the project and only 6 are written by the IDE agent's model, so 88.0\% of the ruleset needs no model-written content, and across 499 real repositories 93.5\% of the violations found fall in those classes. A fix, however it was produced, is accepted only if the checker that flagged the rule now passes. In a full-chain run over 23 sample projects, template and extraction fixes that were applied as written passed their checkers in 87.6\% and 95.0\% of cases, and independent verification rejected 25 of the 237 fixes reported as applied. A deployability model trained on 684 real deployments ranks held-out projects at 0.909 ROC AUC, a gated project was deployed, smoke-tested and connected to an active CI/CD pipeline in 82 seconds, and the unchanged server worked from the IDE agents in VS Code, Cursor and Windsurf, where live agents resolved all six delegated rules on the first attempt under the same verification. ProdPilot itself runs no model.
zh_title: ProdPilot：用于自动化生产就绪与部署Vibe-Coding项目的分层模型上下文协议系统
translation: AI辅助开发环境将自然语言请求转化为可运行的应用程序，但它们生成的项目往往由于操作原因在首次部署时失败：源文件中的凭证、缺少安全中间件、没有容器定义、没有健康端点以及没有交付管道。此类缺陷的自动修复通常依赖于自由形式的模型生成，这在不同运行之间有所不同，且很少得到独立检查。本文介绍了 ProdPilot，这是一个本地模型上下文协议服务器，它根据 50 条生产就绪规则审核 Node.js 和 React 项目，通过有界循环修复违规项，对结果进行门控并部署。每条规则都按其修复所需的内容进行分类：28 个修复是固定模板，16 个是从项目中提取的值填充的，只有 6 个是由 IDE 代理的模型编写的，因此 88.0% 的规则集不需要模型编写的内容，并且在 499 个真实仓库中，发现的 93.5% 的违规项属于这些类别。然而，无论修复是如何产生的，只有在标记该规则的检查器现在通过的情况下才被接受。在对 23 个样本项目的全链运行中，按原样应用的模板和提取修复在其检查器中分别通过了 87.6% 和 95.0% 的情况，独立验证拒绝了报告为已应用的 237 个修复中的 25 个。在 684 次真实部署上训练的部署性模型对保留项目的 ROC AUC 进行了 0.909 的排名，一个受控项目在 82 秒内被部署、进行冒烟测试并连接到活跃的 CI/CD 管道，并且未更改的服务器在 VS Code、Cursor 和 Windsurf 中的 IDE 代理下工作，其中实时代理在相同的验证下第一次尝试就解决了所有六个委派规则。ProdPilot 本身不运行任何模型。
tldr: ProdPilot是一个本地模型上下文协议系统，通过分层规则审核、有界循环修复和独立验证机制，实现了AI生成项目的自动化生产就绪修复与快速部署。
ai_comments: 该论文提出的 ProdPilot 系统创新性地将模型上下文协议（MCP）与分层修复策略相结合，通过高比例的模板和值提取机制（88%不需要模型生成），有效解决了AI生成项目（vibe-coded projects）在生产部署中常见的配置和安全缺陷。其闭环验证和独立检查机制保证了修复的可靠性，具有很高的实际应用价值。
motivation: AI辅助开发环境生产的应用往往因缺少凭证、安全中间件、容器定义、健康端点或交付管道等操作原因而在首次部署时失败，且现有的自由生成模型修复方法存在不稳定性且缺乏独立检查。
method: 提出 ProdPilot 本地模型上下文协议服务器，针对Node.js和React项目根据50条生产就绪规则进行审核，通过有界循环修复违规项并进行门控和部署；修复分为固定模板、值提取和模型编写三种类型，并强制执行独立检查验证。
results: 在499个真实仓库中，93.5%的违规项属于无需模型编写的类别；模板和提取修复在检查器中的通过率分别达到87.6%和95.0%；独立验证拒绝了25个修复；部署模型在测试集上达到0.909的ROC AUC；样本项目在82秒内完成部署、冒烟测试和CI/CD流水线连接；IDE代理成功首次尝试解决所有委托规则。
conclusion: ProdPilot 成功通过分层模型上下文协议系统实现了AI生成项目的自动化生产就绪审核、修复与部署，显著提高了部署成功率并减少了对自由生成模型的依赖。

title: Time-Consistent Evaluation of Hierarchical Code Graphs for SWE Agents
authors: Xianpeng, Tian Yu, Haonan Sun, Sheng Ma, Qincheng Zhang, Lifei Rao, Jie Li, Jian, Qi Zhang
abstract:
Evaluating repository-aware software engineering (SWE) agents requires strict separation between pre-existing repository knowledge and future code evolution, yet standard benchmarks frequently suffer from temporal contamination and prompt-level solution leakage. Building on the time-consistent benchmark protocol of Sun (2026), we enforce strict zero-leakage isolation across DragonFly in C++ and React in JavaScript/TypeScript, locking repository snapshots and knowledge graphs at historical cutoff commits $T_0$ and evaluating 100 post-$T_0$ pull requests across four prompt granularities: Minimal, Concise, Contextual, and Guided.
  Under this zero-leakage protocol, we conduct a matched evaluation of three context-augmentation regimes: (1) an unaugmented Baseline, (2) a flat syntax-level Tree-sitter AST graph, and (3) ServiceExplorer, a deterministic two-level hierarchical dependency graph capturing Level-1 system/package containers and Level-2 architectural modules. Across 7,200 paired evaluations spanning six foundation models across the MAI-Code Flash, Claude, and GPT-Sol families, ServiceExplorer consistently outperforms both Baseline and Tree-sitter AST across every model, repository, and prompt granularity ($+15.6\%$ to $+86.2\%$ relative $F_1$ lift, $p < 10^{-4}$), while tripling exact full-PR localization on DragonFly. Crucially, equipping an efficiency-tier or prior-generation model with ServiceExplorer consistently surpasses the unaugmented Baseline $F_1$ of the next-generation model across all evaluated families.
zh_title: SWE智能体分层代码图谱的时间一致性评估
translation:
评估具备仓库意识的软件工程（SWE）智能体需要严格区分预先存在的仓库知识与未来的代码演进，然而标准基准经常受到时间污染和提示级解决方案泄漏的影响。基于Sun（2026）的时间一致性基准协议，我们在C++的DragonFly和JavaScript/TypeScript的React中强制实施了严格的零泄漏隔离，在历史截止提交 $T_0$ 处锁定仓库快照和知识图谱，并在四种提示粒度（极简、简明、上下文、引导）下评估了100个 $T_0$ 之后的拉取请求。
在这一零泄漏协议下，我们对三种上下文增强机制进行了匹配评估：（1）未增强的基线，（2）扁平的语法级 Tree-sitter AST 图谱，以及（3）ServiceExplorer（一种确定性的两级分层依赖图谱，捕获Level-1系统/包容器和Level-2架构模块）。在跨越MAI-Code Flash、Claude和GPT-Sol家族的六个基础模型的7,200次配对评估中，ServiceExplorer在每个模型、仓库和提示粒度上均始终优于基线和Tree-sitter AST（相对 $F_1$ 提升 $+15.6\%$ 至 $+86.2\%$，$p < 10^{-4}$），同时在DragonFly上使精确的全PR定位能力增加了两倍。至关重要的是，在所有评估的模型家族中，为效率层或前代模型配备ServiceExplorer，其性能始终超过了未增强的次世代模型基线 $F_1$。
tldr: 本文提出了一种时间一致的零泄漏评估协议，并引入ServiceExplorer分层依赖图谱，显著提升了软件工程智能体在代码定位和任务解决上的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了时间一致性零泄漏评估协议，并提出了ServiceExplorer这一分层依赖图谱，有效解决了软件工程智能体评估中的知识污染和提示泄漏问题。研究结果证明了分层图谱在代码定位和修复上的显著优势，对未来SWE智能体的发展和评测标准具有重要影响。
motivation: 评估具备仓库意识的软件工程智能体需要严格区分预先存在的仓库知识与未来的代码演进，但现有标准基准常受时间污染和提示级解决方案泄漏的影响，因此需要一种时间一致的零泄漏评估协议及有效的代码图谱增强方案。
method: 基于Sun（2026）的时间一致性基准协议，在C++的DragonFly和JS/TS的React中强制实施零泄漏隔离，在历史提交T0处锁定仓库快照和知识图谱，评估100个post-T0的拉取请求，并对比基线、扁平Tree-sitter AST图谱和ServiceExplorer两级分层依赖图谱。
results: ServiceExplorer在所有模型、仓库和提示粒度下均一致优于基线和Tree-sitter AST（相对F1提升+15.6%到+86.2%，p < 10^-4），在DragonFly上将完整PR定位的准确率提高了两倍，且能使效率层/前代模型配备ServiceExplorer后的F1性能超越无增强的次世代模型基线。
conclusion: 在零泄漏时间一致性评估下，ServiceExplorer分层依赖图谱显著提升了软件工程智能体在各个模型、仓库和提示粒度下的性能，甚至能让前代模型表现超越无增强的次世代模型。

title: Agentic-Teacher: An Agentic Data Engine for Failure-Driven VLA Post-Training
authors: Gongyue Teng, Yuqing Xie, Yixian Zhang, Feng Gao, Shu'ang Yu, Jiaji Rao, Sukai Wang, Guanghui Ren, Ya Zhang, Maoqing Yao, Yu Wang, Chao Yu, Xinlei Chen
abstract: Improving a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model requires demonstrations that address its weaknesses and provide effective supervision for learning. Coding agents can autonomously generate demonstrations through environment interaction, yet successful execution alone does not ensure effective supervision for VLA learning. We introduce Agentic-Teacher, an autonomous data engine for failure-driven VLA post-training. Given a VLA checkpoint, a task specification, and configured environment tools, the engine analyzes failed rollouts, selects intervention states, and iteratively develops closed-loop code policies through execution feedback. Validated policies become reusable demonstration generators that collect successful continuations from states where the VLA struggles. To make these demonstrations suitable for learning, Agentic-Teacher introduces temporally correlated action noise to broaden state-action coverage, removes idle frames while preserving gripper transitions, and filters trajectories using the frozen base model's flow-matching loss. The resulting demonstrations are combined with successful VLA rollouts for post-training, yielding an updated policy that operates without coding-agent assistance. Agentic-Teacher thus connects the weaknesses of a target VLA to both the generation and curation of its training data. In simulation, it improves $π_0$ success rates from 79.4% to 87.8% on LIBERO-10, from 80.4% to 90.6% on MetaWorld-10, and from 0% to 30.0% across three RoboCasa tasks.
zh_title: Agentic-Teacher：一个用于失败驱动的VLA后训练的Agentic数据引擎
translation: 改进预训练的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型需要能够解决其弱点并为学习提供有效监督的演示。编码代理可以通过环境交互自主生成演示，但成功的执行本身并不能保证对 VLA 学习的有效监督。我们引入了 Agentic-Teacher，一个用于失败驱动的 VLA 后训练的自主数据引擎。给定一个 VLA 检查点、一个任务规范和配置的环境工具，该引擎会分析失败的回放，选择干预状态，并通过执行反馈迭代地开发闭环代码策略。验证后的策略成为可重用的演示生成器，从 VLA 模型 struggling 的状态收集成功的延续。为了使这些演示适合学习，Agentic-Teacher 引入了时间相关的动作噪声以拓宽状态-动作覆盖范围，在保留抓取器转换的同时去除了空闲帧，并使用冻结的基础模型的流匹配损失来过滤轨迹。生成的演示与成功的 VLA 回放结合用于后训练，产生一个无需编码代理协助即可运行的更新策略。因此，Agentic-Teacher 将目标 VLA 的弱点与训练数据的生成和精选联系起来。在模拟中，它将 LIBERO-10 上的 $π_0$ 成功率从 79.4% 提高到 87.8%，在 MetaWorld-10 上从 80.4% 提高到 90.6%，在三个 RoboCasa 任务上从 0% 提高到 30.0%。
tldr: Agentic-Teacher 是一个自主数据引擎，通过分析失败的 VLA 模型交互，生成和精炼训练数据，以改进模型性能。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的 Agentic-Teacher 方法，用于通过分析失败的交互来改进 VLA 模型。其核心创新在于将 VLA 模型的弱点与训练数据的生成和精炼过程联系起来，形成一个闭环系统。通过引入时间相关的动作噪声、去除空闲帧和使用流匹配损失进行过滤，该方法能够生成高质量、有针对性的训练数据，从而在多个基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升。然而，该方法在 RoboCasa 任务上的成功率提升幅度较大，可能需要进一步探究其在更复杂或稀疏奖励环境中的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
motivation: 现有的预训练视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型需要针对其弱点进行改进，并提供有效的学习监督。虽然编码代理可以生成演示，但成功的执行并不足以保证有效的 VLA 学习监督。
method: Agentic-Teacher 分析失败的 VLA 模型交互，选择干预状态，并通过执行反馈迭代开发闭环代码策略。然后，它会生成可重复使用的演示，并通过添加动作噪声、去除空闲帧和使用预训练模型的流匹配损失来精炼这些演示，以拓宽状态-动作覆盖范围，保留关键的抓取器转换，并确保数据质量。最后，将精炼后的演示与成功的 VLA 交互结合起来进行后训练。
results: 在 LIBERO-10 数据集上，Agentic-Teacher 将成功率从 79.4% 提高到 87.8%；在 MetaWorld-10 数据集上，成功率从 80.4% 提高到 90.6%；在三个 RoboCasa 任务上，成功率从 0% 提高到 30.0%。
conclusion: Agentic-Teacher 能够将目标 VLA 模型的弱点与训练数据的生成和精炼过程联系起来，从而有效地改进 VLA 模型。

title: Evolutionary-based Transfer Learning for Physical Attack on End-to-End Autoencoder Communications
authors: Ho Viet Duc Luong, Lang Hong Nguyet Anh, Huynh Thi Thanh Binh, Trinh Van Chien
abstract: End-to-end autoencoder communication has emerged as a promising means of achieving efficient data transmission across various domains. Nevertheless, vulnerabilities have recently been revealed in these systems by adversarial attacks, wherein malevolent entities manipulate the transmitted signals to deceive the autoencoder. This paper leverages the applications of evolutionary algorithms to solve a challenging optimization problem of launching physical attacks against end-to-end autoencoder communication. For white-box scenarios, we introduce PAGA (Physical Attack based on Genetic Algorithm), which combines a genetic algorithm with elite population initialization to craft attack signals that degrade autoencoder performance. To gauge the efficacy of these attack signals, we employ a fitness function that assesses their capacity to induce substantial reconstruction errors and misclassification rates. A Multi-Factorial version of PAGA, referred to as PAMFGA, is proposed to deal with practical scenarios where the attackers have limited knowledge about the receiver, also known as a black-box attack. Our experimental results show that the proposed attacks can substantially degrade the reliability of the considered autoencoder communication systems across the evaluated settings. This study also underscores the critical importance of incorporating security considerations into the design and implementation of end-to-end autoencoder communication systems.
comment: 31 pages, 10 figures, and 4 tables. Accepted by JNCA
zh_title: 面向端到端自编码器通信物理攻击的基于进化算法的迁移学习
translation: 端到端自编码器通信已成为在各个领域实现高效数据传输的有前景的手段。然而，最近通过对抗攻击在这些系统中暴露出了漏洞，恶意实体可以通过操纵传输的信号来欺骗自编码器。本文利用进化算法的应用来解决对端到端自编码器通信发动物理攻击这一具有挑战性的优化问题。对于白盒场景，我们引入了PAGA（基于遗传网络的物理攻击），它结合了遗传算法与精英种群初始化来制作降低自编码器性能的攻击信号。为了评估这些攻击信号的效能，我们采用了一个适应度函数来评估它们引起大量重构误差和误分类率的能力。提出了PAGA的多因子版本，称为PAMFGA，以应对攻击者对接收器了解有限的实际场景，这也称为黑盒攻击。我们的实验结果表明，所提出的攻击可以显著降低所考虑的自编码器通信系统在评估设置下的可靠性。本研究还强调了在端到端自编码器通信系统的设计和实现中纳入安全考虑的关键重要性。
tldr: 本文利用进化算法针对端到端自编码器通信系统提出了白盒与黑盒物理攻击方案，成功验证了其脆弱性。
ai_comments: 该论文将进化算法引入端到端自编码器通信系统的物理对抗攻击中，创新性地提出了白盒攻击算法PAGA和黑盒攻击算法PAMFGA，不仅揭示了此类系统的脆弱性，也为未来设计更具鲁棒性的通信系统敲响了警钟。
motivation: 端到端自编码器通信系统容易受到对抗攻击的操纵，为了解决在物理层面对其发起攻击这一具有挑战性的优化问题，论文探讨了利用进化算法的应用来解决该问题。
method: 提出了基于遗传算法的物理攻击方法（PAGA）用于白盒场景，并结合精英种群初始化；同时提出了多因子遗传算法（PAMFGA）用于攻击者对接收器了解有限的黑盒/迁移学习场景。
results: 实验结果表明，所提出的攻击方法能够显著降低端到端自编码器通信系统在各种评估设置下的可靠性。
conclusion: 本文通过进化算法成功实现了对端到端自编码器通信系统的物理攻击，证明了该系统在对抗攻击下的脆弱性，并强调了在系统设计中纳入安全机制的必要性。

title: Can LLMs Write Backdoors? An Empirical Security Study of Weight-Space Programming
authors: Zhaojia Wang, Jiucui Lu, Zheng Li
abstract: Recent advances in weight-space programming (WSP) have demonstrated that large language models (LLMs) can directly inspect and modify neural network weights without conventional gradient-based training. While this capability opens new possibilities for model improvement, it also raises an important security question: Can LLMs exploit weight-space programming to inject backdoors into neural networks? To answer this question, we present an empirical security study of LLM-driven weight-space programming for backdoor injection. Specifically, we investigate whether general-purpose LLMs can directly modify the weights of target models according to natural-language instructions, without accessing task-specific data, performing forward passes, or computing gradients. We evaluate five LLMs as weight editors across three target architectures: an MLP on MNIST, ResNet-18 on CIFAR-10, and Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct on AG News. Our experiments reveal three key findings. First, LLM-driven weight editing can successfully inject backdoors across different architectures while largely preserving clean performance. Second, successful attacks can require remarkably few parameter modifications, including only six parameters for the MLP and 0.02% of the weights for a fine-tuned Qwen model. Third, editing capabilities vary substantially across LLMs and target architectures: although all five LLMs successfully backdoor the MLP, only GPT-6 Astra succeeds across all three targets. These findings highlight an emerging security risk of weight-space programming and underscore the importance of safeguarding LLM-driven weight editing.
zh_title: 大模型能编写后门吗？权重空间编程的实证安全研究
translation: 近期权重空间编程（WSP）的进展表明，大语言模型（LLM）可以在没有传统基于梯度训练的情况下直接检查和修改神经网络权重。虽然这一能力为模型改进开辟了新可能，但也引发了一个重要的安全问题：LLM能否利用权重空间编程向神经网络中注入后门？为了回答这个问题，我们对LLM驱动的权重空间编程进行了一项关于后门注入的实证安全研究。具体而言，我们研究了通用LLM是否能够根据自然语言指令直接修改目标模型的权重，而无需访问任务特定数据、执行前向传递或计算梯度。我们在三种目标架构（MNIST上的MLP、CIFAR-10上的ResNet-18以及AG News上的Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct）上评估了五个LLM作为权重编辑器的性能。我们的实验揭示了三个关键发现：首先，LLM驱动的权重编辑可以成功在不同架构中注入后门，同时在很大程度上保持清洁性能。其次，成功的攻击所需的参数修改量异常之少，例如MLP仅需6个参数，微调后的Qwen模型仅需0.02%的权重。第三，编辑能力在不同的LLM和目标架构之间存在显著差异：尽管所有五个LLM都成功对MLP植入了后门，但只有GPT-6 Astra在所有三个目标上都取得了成功。这些发现突显了权重空间编程带来的新兴安全风险，并强调了保障LLM驱动的权重编辑安全的重要性。
tldr: 大语言模型能够通过直接修改神经网络权重（权重空间编程）在无需训练的情况下秘密注入后门，带来重大安全隐患。
ai_comments: 该论文首次对大语言模型在权重空间编程（WSP）中的后门注入能力进行了系统的实证研究，揭示了无需训练数据和梯度即可直接修改模型权重的安全风险，对未来AI安全防护具有重要警示意义。
motivation: 探索大语言模型是否能够利用最近发展的权重空间编程（WSP）技术，在无需传统基于梯度的训练、任务特定数据或前向传播的情况下，直接将后门注入到神经网络中。
method: 评估了5个大语言模型作为权重编辑器，在3种目标架构（MLP、ResNet-18、Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct）上执行自然语言指令直接修改模型权重以注入后门的能力。
results: 实验发现：1）LLM驱动的权重编辑可以成功注入后门并保持干净样本性能；2）成功的攻击只需要修改极少量的参数（如MLP仅需6个参数，Qwen模型仅需0.02%的权重）；3）不同LLM和目标架构的编辑能力差异显著，仅有GPT-6 Astra在所有三个目标上均取得成功。
conclusion: LLM驱动的权重空间编程具有注入后门的强大能力，这构成了新兴的安全威胁，亟需针对LLM权重编辑开发相应的防护机制。

title: Admissibility-Preserving Control for Block Strict-Feedback Systems Under Time-Varying Asymmetric Actuator and State Constraints
authors: Saurabh Kumar, Lohitvel Gopikannan, Shashi Ranjan Kumar, Abhinav Sinha
abstract: This paper addresses the tracking control of block strict-feedback nonlinear systems subject to time-varying asymmetric actuator and full state constraints. To that end, we develop a time-varying Admissibility-Preserving Control (APC) framework, in which the Admissibility-Preserving Input Realization (APIR) generates the plant input through a dynamic realization. The APIR guarantees input admissibility under the moving actuator set whenever each actuator bound contracts slower than the decay rate of the realization, and a closed-form lower bound on its gain is derived. The state constraints are handled by a logarithmic barrier coordinate at every backstepping step, with widths measured from the virtual control to the moving envelope of the corresponding state. We prove that every state lies inside its envelope, with each virtual control only required to remain inside the envelope of the next state, while the tracking error converges to zero exponentially. Simulations demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed safety-critical control scheme.
zh_title: 时变非对称执行器和状态约束下块严格反馈系统的可容许性保持控制
translation: 本文研究了受时变非对称执行器和全状态约束的块严格反馈非线性系统的跟踪控制问题。为此，我们开发了一种时变可容许性保持控制（APC）框架，其中可容许性保持输入实现（APIR）通过动态实现生成系统输入。APIR在每个执行器界限收缩速度慢于实现衰减率时保证输入可容许性，并导出了其增式下界。状态约束通过每个反步步骤中的对数障碍坐标来处理，其宽度从虚拟控制到相应状态的移动包络进行测量。我们证明了每个状态都位于其包络内，每个虚拟控制只需保持在下一个状态的包络内，同时跟踪误差指数收敛到零。仿真结果证明了所提出的安全关键控制方案的有效性。
tldr: 本文开发了一种时变可容许性保持控制（APC）框架，用于处理具有时变非对称执行器和状态约束的块严格反馈非线性系统的跟踪控制，并通过仿真验证了其有效性。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的时变可容许性保持控制框架，有效地解决了复杂非线性系统在时变非对称执行器和全状态约束下的控制难题。其结合APIR和对数障碍坐标的方法在保证输入和状态约束的同时实现了跟踪误差的指数收敛，对安全关键控制领域具有重要意义。
motivation: 解决受时变非对称执行器和全状态约束的块严格反馈非线性系统的跟踪控制问题。
method: 提出了一种时变可容许性保持控制（APC）框架，其中可容许性保持输入实现（APIR）通过动态实现生成系统输入，并利用对数障碍坐标在每个反步步骤处理状态约束。
results: APIR在执行器界限收缩速度慢于实现衰减率时保证输入可容许性，并导出了其增益的闭式下界。证明了每个状态都位于其包络内，每个虚拟控制只需保持在下一个状态的包络内，且跟踪误差指数收敛到零。仿真验证了所提出方案的有效性。
conclusion: 所提出的安全关键控制方案能有效处理时变非对称执行器和全状态约束下的块严格反馈非线性系统的跟踪控制问题，确保输入可容许性、状态约束满足和跟踪误差指数收敛。

title: Alignment with Reflect-Reasoning: Learning How To Follow Principles
authors: Henry Bell, Caroline Zhang, Dhaval Potdar, Mohammed Mobasserul Haque, Brandon Fain
abstract: The appropriate governing norms and principles for the alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) often depend on cultural context and deployment application. However, most alignment techniques focus on training models to conform to human preferences or constitutional principles specified at training time and subsequently fixed. In practice, many deployers rely on system prompting to implement contextual norms and guardrails at inference time. Prior work has shown that post-generation reflective reasoning with critique and revision can improve conformance compared to simple system prompting, but such methods are limited to the reasoning abilities inherent in the trained model. We introduce Reflect-Reasoning, a training method that teaches models how to reason about alignment to principles, rather than simply which principles to follow. Across five models, Reflect-Reasoning consistently outperforms both system prompting and explicit prompting strategies for in-context reflective reasoning. These improvements extend and generalize to entirely out-of-distribution domains of medical and financial principles. We additionally demonstrate that Reflect-Reasoning reduces the occurrence of rare but serious principle violations. Finally, we show that Reflect-Reasoning does not erode the safety engineering of a model and is robust against jailbreaking attempts using adversarial constitutions. Overall, our results demonstrate that Reflect-Reasoning is a scalable method for training constitutional alignment as a generalizable reasoning capability, enabling models to adapt to novel principles and produce transparent reasoning traces without additional fine-tuning.
zh_title: 通过反思推理实现对齐：学习如何遵循原则
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）对齐的适当治理规范和原则通常取决于文化背景和部署应用。然而，大多数对齐技术侧重于训练模型以符合在训练时指定并随后固定的人类偏好或宪法原则。在实践中，许多部署者依赖系统提示在推理时实施上下文规范和防护措施。先前的研究表明，带有批判和修订的后生成反思推理可以比简单的系统提示更好地提高依从性，但此类方法仅限于训练模型固有的推理能力。我们引入了Reflect-Reasoning，这是一种训练方法，它教授模型如何推理对齐原则，而不是简单地遵循哪些原则。在五种模型中，Reflect-Reasoning始终优于系统提示和用于上下文反思推理的显式提示策略。这些改进扩展并泛化到医疗和金融原则的完全分布外领域。我们还证明，Reflect-Reasoning减少了罕见但严重的原则违规的发生。最后，我们表明Reflect-Reasoning不会侵蚀模型的安全工程，并且对使用对抗性宪法的越狱尝试具有鲁棒性。总的来说，我们的结果表明，Reflect-Reasoning是一种可扩展的方法，用于训练宪法对齐作为一种可泛化的推理能力，使模型能够适应新颖的原则并产生透明的推理轨迹，而无需额外的微调。
tldr: Reflect-Reasoning是一种新的训练方法，它教授大型语言模型如何推理原则对齐，而不是简单地遵循固定原则，从而在遵循上下文规范和避免原则违规方面表现优于现有方法。
ai_comments: 这项研究提出了一种创新性的LLM对齐方法，通过教授模型“如何”推理原则而非简单“遵循”特定原则，解决了现有方法在适应上下文规范和泛化能力方面的局限性。其在泛化性、安全性（减少违规、抵抗越狱）方面的验证，以及无需额外微调的特点，使其成为一个重要且有前景的方向，有望提升LLM在复杂多变环境中的可靠性和可信度。
motivation: 现有的LLM对齐技术通常在训练时固定原则，或依赖推理时的系统提示，这限制了模型适应文化背景和部署应用中上下文规范的能力，且后生成反思推理受限于模型固有的推理能力。
method: 本文引入了Reflect-Reasoning，这是一种训练方法，旨在教授模型如何推理原则对齐，而不是仅仅遵循哪些原则。该方法通过训练使模型具备泛化推理能力，以适应新颖原则并产生透明的推理轨迹。
results: Reflect-Reasoning在五种模型上持续优于系统提示和上下文反思推理的显式提示策略。这些改进扩展并泛化到医疗和金融原则的完全分布外领域。Reflect-Reasoning还减少了罕见但严重的原则违规的发生，并且不会削弱模型的安全工程，对使用对抗性宪法的越狱尝试具有鲁棒性。
conclusion: Reflect-Reasoning是一种可扩展的训练方法，能够将宪法对齐作为一种可泛化的推理能力进行训练，使模型能够适应新颖的原则并产生透明的推理轨迹，而无需额外的微调。

title: WETW: Learning Pair-Specific Weighted Euclidean Distances for Efficient DTW Search
authors: Christos Panourgias, Qitong Wang, George Tzagkarakis, Themis Palpanas
abstract: Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is the standard distance for similarity search over time series that are misaligned in time, but its cost is quadratic in the series length and lower bounds often prune few candidates, so search over large collections of long series is slow. Learned approximations embed the series to make comparisons cheap, yet compare every pair with the same fixed rule, usually the Euclidean distance, although DTW aligns each pair differently. We observe that, once a pair is aligned, DTW is a Euclidean distance over coordinates selected for that pair. Building on this view, we propose Weighted Euclidean Time Warping (WETW), a learned distance that adapts the comparison of fixed-length embeddings to each pair. A small symmetric network predicts one weight per embedding di- mension and pair without computing an alignment, which halves the error of the best static distance on the same embeddings. The embeddings come from the Weighted Euclidean SEries Encoder (WESEE), whose multi-scale Temporal Feature Extractor keeps the timing information that global pooling removes and raises recall@1 from 0.90 to 0.95, although WETW works with any encoder. We also show that fitting DTW distances is not enough for search, as regression alone misorders the closest neighbours, and that ranking regularization raises recall@1 from 0.79 to 0.95. Our filter-and-verify pipeline, WETW-FV, uses WETW to build a shortlist and exact DTW to check it, so the search is approximate but every returned distance is exact. Over eight datasets, WETW-FV is 11.4x faster than the fastest exact method among the UCR Suite, lower bounds and MESSI-DTW, at a mean recall@10 of 0.93, while the best learned baseline reaches 0.59 at the same speed. On 48K-point series, WETW- FV remains 40x faster than the UCR Suite at a recall@10 of 0.91.
zh_title: WETW: 学习特定对加权欧几里得距离以实现高效DTW搜索
translation: 动态时间规整 (DTW) 是用于时间错位时间序列相似性搜索的标准距离，但其成本是序列长度的二次方，并且下界通常只能剪枝少量候选，因此对大量长序列的搜索速度很慢。学习到的近似方法通过嵌入序列来降低比较成本，但它们使用相同的固定规则（通常是欧几里得距离）比较每一对，尽管DTW对每一对的对齐方式不同。我们观察到，一旦一对序列被对齐，DTW就相当于对该对序列选定坐标的欧几里得距离。基于这一观点，我们提出了加权欧几里得时间规整 (WETW)，这是一种学习到的距离，它能使固定长度嵌入的比较适应于每一对序列。一个小型对称网络为每个嵌入维度和序列对预测一个权重，而无需计算对齐，这将相同嵌入上最佳静态距离的误差减半。嵌入来自加权欧几里得序列编码器 (WESEE)，其多尺度时间特征提取器保留了全局池化移除的时间信息，并将召回率@1从0.90提高到0.95，尽管WETW适用于任何编码器。我们还表明，仅拟合DTW距离不足以进行搜索，因为单独的回归会错误地排序最近邻，而排序正则化将召回率@1从0.79提高到0.95。我们的过滤-验证管道WETW-FV使用WETW构建候选列表，并使用精确DTW进行检查，因此搜索是近似的，但返回的每个距离都是精确的。在八个数据集上，WETW-FV比UCR Suite、下界和MESSI-DTW中最快的精确方法快11.4倍，平均召回率@10为0.93，而最佳学习基线在相同速度下达到0.59。在48K点序列上，WETW-FV比UCR Suite快40倍，召回率@10为0.91。
tldr: WETW提出一种学习到的、适应每对时间序列的加权欧几里得距离，显著加速了DTW相似性搜索，并在保持高召回率的同时，比现有方法快10倍以上。
ai_comments: WETW的创新点在于它认识到DTW本质上是特定对的欧几里得距离，并据此设计了一个学习模型来动态调整嵌入空间的权重，从而在不进行实际对齐的情况下模拟DTW的行为。这种“学习特定对权重”的思路非常巧妙，有效解决了传统嵌入方法忽略DTW对齐差异的问题。结合过滤-验证的管道设计，实现了速度与精度的平衡，对于大规模时间序列分析具有重要意义。
motivation: 动态时间规整 (DTW) 在时间序列相似性搜索中因其二次计算成本和低效的剪枝机制而速度缓慢。现有的学习近似方法使用相同的固定规则（通常是欧几里得距离）比较所有序列对，而忽略了DTW为每对序列进行不同对齐的事实，导致精度不足。
method: WETW (Weighted Euclidean Time Warping) 是一种学习到的距离度量，它通过一个小型对称网络为每对序列预测每个嵌入维度的权重，从而将固定长度嵌入的比较适应于特定序列对。该方法基于DTW一旦对齐后就相当于对选定坐标的欧几里得距离的观察。WETW还与WESEE (Weighted Euclidean SEries Encoder) 结合，WESEE的多尺度时间特征提取器保留了时间信息。此外，研究引入了排序正则化以提高搜索精度。最终，WETW-FV (filter-and-verify) 管道使用WETW进行初选，再用精确DTW进行验证。
results: 在相同嵌入上，WETW将最佳静态距离的误差减半。结合WESEE，召回率@1从0.90提高到0.95。排序正则化将召回率@1从0.79提高到0.95。WETW-FV在八个数据集上比UCR Suite、下界和MESSI-DTW中最快的精确方法快11.4倍，平均召回率@10为0.93。在48K点序列上，WETW-FV比UCR Suite快40倍，召回率@10为0.91。
conclusion: WETW通过学习特定对的加权欧几里得距离，在保持高召回率的同时，显著提高了时间序列DTW相似性搜索的效率，解决了传统DTW计算成本高昂和现有学习方法泛化性差的问题。

title: ParseBench-2: Severity-Aware Evaluation of Document Parsing
authors: Pierre-Loïc Doulcet, Boyang Zhang, Sebastián G. Acosta, Sacha Bron, Daniel B. Ospina, Antonio Jimeno Yepes, Nutchapol Dendumrongsup, Simon Suo
abstract: Document-parsing metrics can give high scores to outputs that change important facts and penalize changes that preserve meaning. People can often judge these consequences more easily than they can design a metric to measure them. We introduce a method for developing parsing metrics from severity policies that specify how each error type should affect the score. We express these policies through test scenarios that specify how a metric should behave. We then optimize the metric implementations against these fixed expectations, using coding agents to refine comparison rules, error detectors and weights under human review. This makes stated human priorities an explicit objective of metric design. We apply this method in ParseBench-2, a comprehensive document-parsing benchmark that combines broad capability coverage with metrics calibrated to error severity. It covers 4,317 pages across six dimensions of parsing quality: text, formatting, tables, charts, visual grounding, and forms. We use detailed annotations and targeted difficult cases to check for changed facts, broken structural relationships, and missing content. We take the lower of a parsing score that measures content recovery and a severity cap that penalizes detected errors, so recovering most of a page cannot hide a serious error. Across six severity test suites, our metrics more closely match the expert judgments expressed by the scenario targets than existing metrics and penalize at most 3.4% of the tested benign variations. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation spanning frontier vision-language models, specialized document parsers and open-weight systems, comparing their overall rankings, performance across parsing capabilities and tradeoffs between accuracy and cost.
zh_title: ParseBench-2：文档解析的严重程度感知评估
translation: 文档解析指标常常会对篡改重要事实的输出给出高分，而对保留原意的变动施加惩罚。相较于设计指标来度量这些后果，人们往往能更轻松地评判其影响。我们提出了一种根据严重程度策略开发解析指标的方法，该策略规定了每种错误类型应当如何影响得分。我们通过明确指标预期行为的测试场景来表达这些策略。随后，我们在人工审查下，利用编程智能体优化比对规则、错误检测器和权重，使指标实现契合这些固定的预期，从而将明确的人类优先级转化为指标设计的显式目标。我们在 ParseBench-2 中应用了该方法，这是一个兼具广泛能力覆盖和经过错误严重度校准的综合性文档解析基准。它涵盖了 4,317 页，横跨解析质量的六个维度：文本、排版、表格、图表、视觉定位和表单。我们利用详细的标注和针对性的疑难案例来检查事实篡改、结构关系破坏和内容缺失。我们取衡量内容恢复的解析得分与惩罚已检测错误的严重度上限中的较低值，使得即使恢复了页面大部分内容也无法掩盖严重的错误。在六个严重程度测试集中，我们的指标比现有指标更贴近场景目标所表达的专家判断，且对测试的良性变异的惩罚最多仅为 3.4%。我们展开了全面的评估，覆盖前沿视觉语言模型、专用文档解析器和开源权重系统，对比了它们的总体排名、各项解析能力的表现以及精度与成本之间的权衡。
tldr: ParseBench-2 提出了依据错误严重程度构建文档解析指标的方法，通过“内容恢复分与严重度上限取低值”机制，显著提升了评估指标对致命错误与良性变异的判别准确性。
ai_comments: 该研究的重要创新在于敏锐地指出了传统文档解析指标（如基于重叠度或编辑距离）在关键事实篡改与良性排版变异上的判断失准，并创造性地提出了“严重度上限（severity cap）”机制，防止整体高召回掩盖致命错误；同时利用 coding agent 协同人类专家构建和优化评测规则，展现了设计复杂多模态评估指标的新范式。局限性在于错误检测器和严重度策略的设定可能仍需针对新兴领域持续迭代维护。
motivation: 现有的文档解析评估指标存在严重缺陷：容易对篡改关键事实的错误输出给出高分，同时又过度惩罚保持原意的良性表达变异，导致评测结果与人类的实际判断和需求脱节。
method: 1. 制定严重程度策略并转化为测试场景，明确错误类型对得分的影响；2. 在人工审查下利用编程智能体（coding agents）优化比较规则、错误检测器和权重；3. 构建覆盖 4,317 页的 ParseBench-2 基准，涵盖文本、格式、表格、图表、视觉定位和表单 6 个维度；4. 采用“内容恢复得分”与“严重程度上限”二者取较低值的打分机制，防止局部严重错误被整体高分掩盖。
results: 在六个严重程度测试集上，该指标显著比现有指标更契合专家判断，对测试的良性变异的错误惩罚率最高仅为 3.4%；基准全面评估了前沿视觉语言模型、专用文档解析器与开源权重系统在各项能力和精度-成本权衡上的表现。
conclusion: ParseBench-2 成功将人类专家对错误严重程度的考量显式引入文档解析评估中，大幅降低了对良性变异的误判，为前沿多模态大模型及专业文档解析工具提供了更加贴合实际应用价值的评估基准与体系。

title: Interpreting Coding Agents Through Their Behavioral Trajectories
authors: Ibragim Badertdinov, Alexander Golubev
abstract: Standard coding-agent benchmarks primarily evaluate binary task success, treating execution as a black box and obscuring the behaviors that produce those outcomes. We analyze a large corpus of 143,209 execution trajectories from 125 agent configurations spanning 117 unique models. To enable comparisons across heterogeneous agent interfaces, we develop a rule-based parser that maps raw execution traces to high-level actions such as repository search, file editing, and test execution, and audit its predictions against a six-model consensus reference on 500 events. We find that agents with similar solve rates can nevertheless differ substantially in how they explore, modify and verify code. Moreover, without using task outcomes, token counts, or tool names as features, aggregate behavioral profiles retrieve the corresponding agent stack across disjoint repository sets and programming languages, although task composition is not fully controlled in the cross-repository setting. Through analyses of frontier models and agent scaffolds, we further show that scaffold choice and reasoning effort systematically shift agents' search, editing, and testing behavior. We release the deterministic parser together with the full annotation and analysis pipeline alongside an annotated trajectory subset.
comment: Accepted at the 1st Workshop on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB) at NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/SWE-rebench/trajectory-analyzer
zh_title: 通过行为轨迹解释编程代理
translation: 标准编程代理基准主要评估二元任务成功率，将执行视为黑箱，掩盖了产生这些结果的行为。我们分析了一个包含143,209条执行轨迹的大型语料库，这些轨迹来自125种代理配置，涵盖了117个独特的模型。为了实现跨异构代理接口的比较，我们开发了一个基于规则的解析器，将原始执行跟踪映射到高级动作，例如仓库搜索、文件编辑和测试执行，并针对500个事件，根据六模型共识参考对其预测进行了审计。我们发现，即使解决率相似的代理，在探索、修改和验证代码的方式上也可能存在显著差异。此外，在不使用任务结果、token计数或工具名称作为特征的情况下，聚合的行为配置文件能够在不相交的仓库集和编程语言中检索相应的代理栈，尽管在跨仓库设置中任务构成并未完全控制。通过对前沿模型和代理支架的分析，我们进一步表明，支架选择和推理努力系统地改变了代理的搜索、编辑和测试行为。我们发布了确定性解析器、完整的标注和分析管道以及一个标注轨迹子集。
tldr: 研究通过分析14万条执行轨迹来解释编程代理的行为，发现即使解决率相似，代理的行为模式也大相径庭，且行为特征可推断代理栈和编程语言，并受支架选择和推理努力的影响。
ai_comments: 这项研究通过深入分析编程代理的执行轨迹，突破了传统基准测试仅关注任务成功率的局限性，提供了一种更细粒度、更具解释性的评估方法。其创新之处在于将代理行为“白盒化”，通过行为特征来理解代理的内部决策和策略，而非仅仅关注最终结果。这对于理解、改进和开发更智能、更可控的编程代理具有重要意义，尤其是在调试和优化代理性能方面。发布解析器和数据集也为后续研究提供了宝贵的资源。
motivation: 标准编程代理基准只评估二元任务成功率，将执行视为黑箱，掩盖了产生结果的行为。本研究旨在深入理解这些行为。
method: 分析了来自125种代理配置（涵盖117个独特模型）的143,209条执行轨迹。开发了一个基于规则的解析器，将原始执行轨迹映射到高级动作（如仓库搜索、文件编辑、测试执行），并根据六模型共识参考对500个事件的预测进行了审计。
results: 发现解决率相似的代理在探索、修改和验证代码方面可能存在显著差异。在不使用任务结果、token计数或工具名称作为特征的情况下，聚合的行为配置文件能够从不相交的仓库集和编程语言中检索相应的代理栈。支架选择和推理努力系统地改变了代理的搜索、编辑和测试行为。
conclusion: 通过分析编程代理的行为轨迹，揭示了超越二元任务成功率的深层行为模式，并证明了这些行为模式可以用来理解代理的内部运作机制及其对不同因素的响应。

title: Real-Time Diffusion Relighting as a Neural Sensor: Closing the Low-Light Domain Gap for Robotic Perception
authors: Shengjie Xu, Alexander Gao, Anshul Rai, Dae Yeol Lee, Guan-Ming Su, Ming C. Lin
abstract: Low-light conditions severely degrade robotic perception: object detectors trained on daylight imagery are prone to failure under dark and adverse weather conditions that fall outside of their training distribution. Furthermore, from an efficiency standpoint, existing Low-Light Image Enhancement (LLIE) methods are designed for offline processing and are therefore impractical to integrate into live control loops. To address these issues, we propose to embed a Generative Neural Sensor within the control loop that treats illumination as a generative prior rather than a signal processing problem, enabling task-relevant semantic recovery. We further propose an Real-Time Perceptual Architecture that decouples high-latency semantic recovery from low-latency robotic control. Rather than blocking the control loop, our system runs a large-scale image-to-image diffusion model in a background thread, and is activated only when a drop in detection confidence signals a perceptual uncertainty event, significantly reducing computational overhead. Our method sets a new state-of-the-art performance on the ExDark low-light benchmark with 87.1% mAP, and under adverse weather conditions, significantly boosts detection rates over competing methods. On a navigation task in a closed-loop autonomous driving simulator (CARLA), we achieve a 100% lap completion rate, establishing a simulation-based proof-of-concept for integrating high-latency generative models with standard robotic control autonomy stacks.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026. Project page: https://shengjie-xu.com/conferences/2026_IROS_neural-sensor/
zh_title: 实时扩散重照明作为神经传感器：弥合机器人感知的低光域间隙
translation: 低光照条件严重降低机器人感知能力：在日光图像上训练的对象检测器在黑暗和恶劣天气条件下容易失效，因为这些条件超出了它们的训练分布。此外，从效率角度来看，现有的低光图像增强（LLIE）方法是为离线处理设计的，因此不切实际地集成到实时控制回路中。为了解决这些问题，我们建议在控制回路中嵌入一个生成神经传感器，该传感器将照明视为生成先验而不是信号处理问题，从而实现任务相关的语义恢复。我们进一步提出了一种实时感知架构，将高延迟语义恢复与低延迟机器人控制解耦。我们的系统不是阻塞控制回路，而是在后台线程中运行一个大规模的图像到图像扩散模型，并且仅在检测置信度下降指示感知不确定性事件时激活，从而显著降低了计算开销。我们的方法在ExDark低光基准测试中取得了87.1%的mAP，达到了新的最先进性能，并且在恶劣天气条件下，比竞争方法显著提高了检测率。在闭环自动驾驶模拟器（CARLA）的导航任务中，我们实现了100%的圈完成率，为将高延迟生成模型与标准机器人控制自主堆栈集成建立了基于仿真的概念验证。
tldr: 本文提出了一种实时扩散重照明方法，作为一种神经传感器，通过将生成模型嵌入控制回路中，以解决低光照条件对机器人感知的影响，并在低光照基准和自动驾驶模拟中取得了显著性能提升。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将扩散模型作为“神经传感器”集成到机器人控制回路中，以解决低光照下的感知问题。其提出的实时感知架构通过解耦高延迟语义恢复和低延迟控制，并在必要时才激活生成模型，有效降低了计算开销，使其在实际应用中具有潜力。这项工作为在机器人系统中利用先进的生成模型弥合领域差距提供了一个有前景的概念验证。
motivation: 低光照条件严重降低机器人感知能力：在日光图像上训练的对象检测器在黑暗和恶劣天气条件下容易失效。此外，现有的低光图像增强（LLIE）方法设计用于离线处理，无法集成到实时控制回路中。
method: 提出了一种将生成神经传感器嵌入控制回路的方法，将照明视为生成先验而不是信号处理问题，从而实现任务相关的语义恢复。进一步提出了一种实时感知架构，将高延迟语义恢复与低延迟机器人控制解耦，在大规模图像到图像扩散模型在后台线程中运行，仅在检测置信度下降时激活，显著降低计算开销。
results: 在ExDark低光基准测试中，mAP达到87.1%，刷新了SOTA性能。在恶劣天气条件下，比竞争方法显著提高了检测率。在闭环自动驾驶模拟器（CARLA）的导航任务中，实现了100%的圈完成率。
conclusion: 为将高延迟生成模型与标准机器人控制自主堆栈集成提供了基于仿真的概念验证。

title: Racing the Clock: Teaching VLNs Budget-Conditioned Object Search
authors: Maitree Meher, Siming He, S. Shankar Sastry, Jitendra Malik, Claire Tomlin, Jonas Frey
abstract: A rescue robot entering a building with thirty seconds on the clock should sprint toward the single most promising room; given ten minutes, it should instead explore a broader tour. Yet vision-language-navigation (VLN) models are typically evaluated under a fixed episode limit that the policy never observes, even though time-critical missions require behavior to adapt to the available budget. We study budget-conditioned object search: given a target category and an explicit action budget, an agent must find as many distinct target instances as possible before the budget expires. We investigate how to supervise VLNs for this task by comparing a privileged TSP expert, which plans near-optimal routes using the full map and true target locations, with a room-level Bellman expert that maximizes expected return under partial observability using high-level cross-scene semantic priors. Despite the TSP expert achieving substantially higher expert performance, its demonstrations are less effective for learning exploration: on held-out HM3D scenes, the Bellman-supervised VLN consistently outperforms the TSP-supervised VLN, with the advantage becoming more pronounced at longer budgets. At 2000 steps (500m), the Bellman-supervised VLN finds 71.4% of reachable target instances, compared with 65.5% for the TSP-supervised VLN and 44.8% for the pretrained VLN. These results highlight a distinction between optimal routing and optimal exploration: effective exploration supervision should optimize decisions under partial observability rather than imitate routes that are optimal only once the environment is fully known.
zh_title: 与时间赛跑：教导视觉语言导航模型进行预算条件下的目标搜索
translation: 救援机器人带着三十秒的倒计时进入建筑物时，应该冲向最有希望的那个房间；而如果有十分钟时间，它则应该进行更广泛的巡视。然而，视觉语言导航（VLN）模型的评估通常是在一个策略从未观察到的固定回合限制下进行的，尽管时间紧迫的任务要求行为根据可用预算进行调整。我们研究了预算条件下的目标搜索：给定目标类别和明确的动作预算，智能体必须在预算耗尽前找到尽可能多的不同目标实例。我们通过对比利用完整地图和真实目标位置规划近最优路线的特权TSP专家，与利用高级跨场景语义先验在部分可观测下最大化期望回报的房间级贝尔曼专家，来研究如何为该任务监督VLN。尽管TSP专家的专家性能要高得多，但其示范对于学习探索的效果较差：在未见过的HM3D场景中，贝尔曼监督的VLN持续优于TSP监督的VLN，并且在更长的预算下优势更加明显。在2000步（500米）时，贝尔曼监督的VLN找到了71.4%的可达目标实例，而TSP监督的VLN为65.5%，预训练的VLN为44.8%。这些结果突出了最优路线规划与最优探索之间的区别：有效的探索监督应当优化部分可观测下的决策，而不是模仿只有在环境完全已知时才最优的路线。
tldr: 本文提出预算条件下的视觉语言导航任务，发现教导智能体在部分可观测环境下进行最优探索（贝尔曼监督），比模仿上帝视角的全局最优路线（TSP监督）更有效。
ai_comments: 该论文指出了现有视觉语言导航（VLN）模型未考虑时间/步数预算的局限性，并提出了“预算条件下的目标搜索”新任务。研究发现，在部分可观测环境下，基于贝尔曼方程的探索专家在性能上优于全局最优的TSP专家，这揭示了最优路径规划与最优探索监督之间的本质区别，对未来具身智能导航的研究具有重要启发。
motivation: 现实中的时间关键型任务要求导航智能体根据可用的时间预算调整行为（如紧急时直奔最可能的目标，时间充足时进行广泛探索），但现有的视觉语言导航（VLN）模型通常在未观察到预算限制的固定回合限制下进行评估，无法自适应调整策略。
method: 研究了预算条件下的目标搜索任务，比较了两种监督VLN的方法：一是利用全图和真实目标位置规划近最优路线的特权TSP专家，二是基于高层跨场景语义先验、在部分可观测性下最大化期望回报的房间级贝尔曼专家。
results: 在未见过的HM3D场景中，经贝尔曼监督的VLN持续优于TSP监督的VLN，并且在长预算下优势更加明显。在2000步（500米）时，贝尔曼监督的VLN找到了71.4%的可达目标实例，而TSP监督为65.5%，预训练VLN仅为44.8%。
conclusion: 在部分可观测的预算限制导航任务中，基于贝尔曼最优性的监督显著优于全局最优路径（TSP）专家的监督。这表明有效的探索监督需要适应部分可观测性，而不是简单模仿上帝视角下的最优路线。

title: FOMOS: Feature-Oriented Meshing of SDFs
authors: Stefan Ohrhallinger, Amal Dev Parakkat
abstract: We introduce FOMOS, a purely geometric method for feature-oriented meshing of signed distance functions (SDFs) that addresses various challenges of the existing state-of-the-art methods. Our algorithm improves mesh quality and runtime, enabling the SDF meshing in a matter of seconds. While existing techniques such as Marching Cubes and Neural Dual Contouring either produce dense, low-quality triangulations or sacrifice details for sparsity, often requiring carefully chosen user parameters, our single-parameter FOMOS leverages feature sized sampling to dynamically adjust mesh resolution based on local feature size (LFS), which we compute efficiently by sampling a medial scaffold. The LFS considers not only curvature but also shape thickness and captures large features through non-local structure, omitting many redundant small triangles from existing methods. Through extensive comparisons, we demonstrate the distinct strengths of FOMOS in execution time, reconstructed result accuracy, and triangle quality in the output mesh. We also introduce a lightweight variant of FOMOS targeting huge ($10k^3$) sparse inputs, which, to the best of our knowledge, no existing method can handle except Marching Cubes. To demonstrate the usefulness of our method, we show that FOMOS enables instant previews using a sub-sampled medial scaffold and can accelerate volumetric simulations by orders of magnitude.
zh_title: FOMOS: 面向特征的SDF网格生成
translation: 我们引入了FOMOS，一种纯几何的、面向特征的符号距离函数（SDF）网格生成方法，解决了现有最先进方法的各种挑战。我们的算法提高了网格质量和运行时间，使得SDF网格生成在几秒钟内完成。虽然现有技术如Marching Cubes和Neural Dual Contouring要么产生密集、低质量的三角剖分，要么为了稀疏性牺牲细节，并且通常需要仔细选择用户参数，但我们单一参数的FOMOS利用特征尺寸采样，根据局部特征尺寸（LFS）动态调整网格分辨率，我们通过采样中轴骨架高效计算LFS。LFS不仅考虑曲率，还考虑形状厚度，并通过非局部结构捕捉大特征，从而省略了现有方法中的许多冗余小三角形。通过广泛的比较，我们展示了FOMOS在执行时间、重建结果精度和输出网格的三角形质量方面的独特优势。我们还引入了FOMOS的一个轻量级变体，用于处理巨大的（10k^3）稀疏输入，据我们所知，除了Marching Cubes之外，现有方法都无法处理。为了证明我们方法的实用性，我们展示了FOMOS能够使用子采样的中轴骨架实现即时预览，并且可以将体积模拟加速数个数量级。
tldr: FOMOS是一种新的、纯几何的、面向特征的SDF网格生成方法，它通过动态调整网格分辨率来提高网格质量、运行速度和重建精度，并能处理超大稀疏输入。
ai_comments: FOMOS的创新之处在于其纯几何的、单一参数设计，以及通过LFS动态调整网格分辨率的机制，这使其在处理细节和保持稀疏性之间取得了很好的平衡。能够处理10k^3的巨大稀疏输入是其显著优势，这对于现有大多数方法来说是一个巨大的挑战。该方法在加速体积模拟和提供即时预览方面的应用潜力也表明了其重要性。
motivation: 现有SDF网格生成方法（如Marching Cubes和Neural Dual Contouring）存在诸多挑战，包括生成密集、低质量的三角剖分，或为了稀疏性牺牲细节，且通常需要仔细选择用户参数。这些方法产生的网格往往包含许多冗余的小三角形。
method: FOMOS是一种纯几何的、面向特征的SDF网格生成方法。它采用单一参数，利用特征尺寸采样，根据局部特征尺寸（LFS）动态调整网格分辨率。LFS通过采样中轴骨架高效计算，不仅考虑曲率，还考虑形状厚度，并通过非局部结构捕捉大特征，从而省略了现有方法中的许多冗余小三角形。该方法还引入了一个轻量级变体，用于处理巨大的稀疏输入。
results: FOMOS在执行时间、重建结果精度和输出网格的三角形质量方面表现出显著优势。它能在几秒钟内完成SDF网格生成，提高了网格质量和运行速度。其轻量级变体能够处理现有方法（除了Marching Cubes）无法处理的巨大稀疏输入。FOMOS还能实现使用子采样中轴骨架的即时预览，并将体积模拟加速数个数量级。
conclusion: FOMOS是一种高效且高质量的SDF网格生成方法，解决了现有技术的挑战，并在执行时间、精度和网格质量方面表现出色，同时能处理超大稀疏输入并加速体积模拟。

title: A Cut Finite Element Method with Boundary Value Correction for Robin, Neumann and Interface Conditions
authors: Erik Burman, Peter Hansbo, Mats G. Larson
abstract:
We extend the cut finite element method with boundary value correction of Burman, Hansbo and Larson [Math.\ Comp.\ 87 (2018) 633--657] to Robin and Neumann conditions and to interface problems with imperfect bonding. The formulation retains a piecewise affine boundary for all integration, while using the exact geometry only at boundary quadrature points.
  The correction uses Taylor expansions of the solution and its gradient along the discrete normal, with the exact normal used to evaluate the transported flux. At an interface, a further correction to the normal flux jump accounts for the difference between these two normals. Under the stated trace and Poincaré bounds, the corrected form is an $O(h^{1/2})$ perturbation of a symmetric form, whose matrix can therefore be used as a preconditioner.
  For a fixed finite Robin coefficient, we obtain the energy error bound $C_β(h^p+δ_h^{m+1})$, whereas the bound uniform in the Robin coefficient is $C(h^p+h^{-1/2}δ_h^{m+1})$, provided the Poincaré constant is uniform. With $δ_h=O(h^2)$, the sufficient Taylor orders are therefore $2m+2\ge p$ and $2m+\frac32\ge p$, respectively. Numerical examples for $p=1,2,3$ illustrate these rates and the effect of the flux-jump correction in the interface problem.
zh_title: 具有边界值修正的Robin、Neumann及界面条件割线有限元方法
translation: 我们将Burman、Hansbo和Larson [Math. Comp. 87 (2018) 633--657]提出的具有边界值修正的割线有限元方法扩展到了Robin、Neumann条件以及具有不完美粘合的界面问题。该公式在所有积分中保留了分段仿射边界，同时仅在边界求积点处使用精确几何。该修正使用解及其梯度沿离散法线的泰勒展开，并使用精确法线来评估传输通量。在界面处，对法向通量跳跃的进一步修正则解释了这两个法线之间的差异。在规定的迹和庞加莱界限下，修正形式是对称形式的 $O(h^{1/2})$ 微扰，因此其矩阵可用作预条件子。对于固定的有限Robin系数，我们得到了能量误差界 $C_\beta(h^p+\delta_h^{m+1})$，而在Robin系数下一致的界则是 $C(h^p+h^{-1/2}\delta_h^{m+1})$（前提是庞加莱常数是一致的）。因此，当 $\delta_h=O(h^2)$ 时，所需的充分泰勒阶数分别为 $2m+2\ge p$ 和 $2m+\frac{3}{2}\ge p$。针对 $p=1,2,3$ 的数值算例说明了这些收敛率以及界面问题中通量跳跃修正的影响。
tldr: 本文将基于边界值修正的割线有限元方法（CutFEM）推广至Robin、Neumann条件及界面问题，并通过理论分析和数值算例验证了其高阶收敛性。
ai_comments: 该论文将边界值修正的割线有限元方法（CutFEM）成功扩展到Robin、Neumann边界条件以及具有不完美粘合的界面问题，创新性地通过泰勒展开和精确几何信息修正边界通量，并证明了其预处理性质和收敛阶。
motivation: 为了将边界值修正的割线有限元方法（CutFEM）推广到更广泛的边界条件（如Robin和Neumann条件）以及具有不完美粘合的界面问题中，并保持高阶收敛性。
method: 将Burman等人的边界值修正割线有限元方法扩展到Robin、Neumann条件及界面问题，利用解及其梯度的泰勒展开沿离散法向进行修正，并采用精确法向计算传输通量；利用对称形式的矩阵作为预条件子。
results: 在特定的迹和庞加莱界限下，修正形式是对称形式的$O(h^{1/2})$微扰。针对固定Robin系数和一致Robin系数给出了相应的能量误差界，并通过$p=1,2,3$的数值算例验证了理论收敛阶以及界面问题中通量跳跃修正的效果。
conclusion: 论文成功将边界值修正的CutFEM扩展至Robin、Neumann及界面问题，理论分析给出了能量误差界，并通过数值算例验证了理论收敛阶。

title: TSGP-2: On the Non-Linearity of Symbolic Regression Problems and How to Exploit It with Model-based Semantic Genetic Programming
authors: Philipp Anthes, Alina Geiger, Martin Briesch, Franz Rothlauf
abstract: Model-based variation operators such as the one used in Transformer Semantic Genetic Programming (TSGP) are affected by possible biases of their training data. TSGP is trained, in particular, on programs generated by Genetic Programming (GP) runs on linear target functions, which leads to a bias toward linear offspring. This bias can hinder search performance on problems that require non-linear solutions. This work has two goals: first, it investigates the linearity of standard test problems such as the Feynman and real-world benchmark problems. While most of the structure of real-world problems can be well approximated by linear structures, the Feynman problems exhibit varying levels of non-linear structure. Thus, a proper variation operator of a search method should be able to create both types of programs, linear as well as non-linear ones. Motivated by this observation, we propose TSGP-2, which follows the functionality of TSGP but uses as training data programs from GP runs on both linear and non-linear target functions. As a result, the training data includes a lower share of programs that behave linearly (the share drops from 83% to 37%). With a higher share of non-linear structures, TSGP-2 outperforms TSGP on problems with non-linear structure, while performing similarly on linear problems. In addition, TSGP-2 is less biased toward linear offspring and is able to propose a higher number of meaningful non-linear offspring earlier during search, which coincides with better solutions. The findings underscore the importance of training data for a learned variation operator and emphasize that the biases of search operators should be aligned with the problems they are applied to.
zh_title: TSGP-2：关于符号回归问题的非线性及其如何通过基于模型的语义遗传编程加以利用
translation: 基于模型的变异算子，例如Transformer语义遗传编程（TSGP）中使用的算子，会受到其训练数据可能存在的偏差的影响。TSGP特别是在遗传编程（GP）运行在线性目标函数上生成的程序上进行训练的，这导致了对线性后代的偏见。这种偏见可能会阻碍在需要非线性解决方案的问题上的搜索性能。这项工作有两个目标：首先，它调查了标准测试问题（如Feynman和实际基准问题）的线性程度。虽然大多数实际问题的结构可以通过线性结构很好地近似，但Feynman问题表现出不同程度的非线性结构。因此，搜索方法的一个适当的变异算子应该能够创建两种类型的程序，线性和非线性。受此观察的启发，我们提出了TSGP-2，它遵循TSGP的功能，但使用来自线性和非线性目标函数上的GP运行的程序作为训练数据。结果，训练数据中线性行为程序的比例降低（从83%降至37%）。随着非线性结构比例的提高，TSGP-2在具有非线性结构的问题上优于TSGP，同时在线性问题上表现相似。此外，TSGP-2对线性后代的偏见更小，并且能够在搜索早期提出更多有意义的非线性后代，这与更好的解决方案相符。这些发现强调了学习型变异算子的训练数据的重要性，并强调搜索算子的偏见应与其所应用的问题相符。
tldr: TSGP因训练数据偏向线性解而对非线性符号回归问题表现不佳。TSGP-2通过包含线性和非线性目标函数的训练数据来解决此问题，从而在非线性问题上表现更好，同时在线性问题上保持相似性能，并减少了线性偏见。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于通过改进训练数据来解决基于模型的语义遗传编程（TSGP）在处理非线性问题时的局限性。通过将非线性目标函数纳入训练集，TSGP-2能够克服模型对线性解的固有偏见，并在更广泛的问题类型上表现出更强的泛化能力。这对于符号回归领域是一个重要的进展，尤其是在需要发现复杂非线性关系的场景中。研究强调了训练数据质量和多样性对于机器学习模型性能的关键作用。
motivation: 现有的基于模型的变异算子，如Transformer语义遗传编程（TSGP）中使用的算子，因其训练数据偏向线性目标函数而对线性后代产生偏见。这种偏见会阻碍对需要非线性解的问题的搜索性能。此外，研究发现标准测试问题（如Feynman问题）表现出不同程度的非线性结构，因此需要能够创建线性和非线性两种程序的变异算子。
method: 首先，研究了标准测试问题的线性程度。其次，提出了TSGP-2，其功能与TSGP相似，但使用来自线性和非线性目标函数上的GP运行的程序作为训练数据。这使得训练数据中线性行为程序的比例从83%降至37%，增加了非线性结构的比例。
results: TSGP-2在具有非线性结构的问题上优于TSGP，而在线性问题上表现相似。TSGP-2对线性后代的偏见更小，并且能够在搜索早期提出更多有意义的非线性后代，这与更好的解决方案相符。
conclusion: 本研究强调了训练数据对于学习型变异算子的重要性，并强调搜索算子的偏见应与其所应用的问题相符。

title: Tracing Knowledge and Reasoning in LLM
authors: Yang Wang, Xiao Wang, Yiqi Liu, Chenghao Xiao, Eleni Vasilaki, Goran Nenadic, Chenghua Lin
abstract: Current evaluations of Large Language Models (LLMs) report performance at the dataset or task level, revealing what a model achieves but offering little insight into the internal processing associated with its performance. We propose a task-centric framework for characterising the model-internal processing elicited by a benchmark. It combines attention- and activation-based signals with representation-based measures to characterise benchmarks spanning a continuum from retrieval-dominant to reasoning-dominant and to surface failure modes that task-level scores conceal. We evaluate 16 LLMs across 24 diverse benchmarks and conduct targeted internal-state analyses on representative models and tasks, observing systematic differences in processing between knowledge-centric and reasoning-centric tasks. We shift evaluation from asking what score a model achieves toward characterising the processing patterns associated with that score, potentially supporting more targeted benchmark selection and more informed model choice. We open source our code at https://github.com/extraordinarylab/trace-kr.
comment: This paper was accepted with an A-decision to Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics. This version is the pre-publication version prior to MIT Press production
zh_title: 追踪大语言模型中的知识与推理
