title: SPLIT-MOR: Fast and Accurate Model Order Reduction for Nonlinear Transient Thermal Simulation of 2.5D/3D ICs
authors: Zebin Shi, Tianxiang Zhu, Yibo Lin, Runsheng Wang
abstract: Fast and accurate transient thermal simulation is essential to thermal reliability analysis and dynamic thermal management of advanced packages, and model order reduction (MOR) techniques are widely applied to overcome the efficiency bottleneck of rigorous numerical methods. However, nonlinear terms including temperature-dependent leakage power, thermal conductivity, and heat capacity prevent the application of conventional linear MOR, while hyper-reduction solutions require costly nonlinear training data. In this work, we propose SPLIT-MOR (Subdomain-wise Piecewise Linearization with Interval Tensors), a novel nonlinear MOR method that requires no additional training set. SPLIT-MOR computes reduced component tensors by subdomain clustering and temperature-interval partitioning in the offline stage, and updates the reduced coefficient matrices and load vectors efficiently in the online stage. Experimental results show that the online solving time of SPLIT-MOR achieves up to an 830x speedup over COMSOL and a 7.5x speedup over the state-of-the-art hyper-reduction method MDEIM, with a 27x total reduction in the offline time. The relative average error remains below 0.11%, and the maximum error is below 0.86 degrees Celsius, demonstrating the high accuracy of our method.

title: Open-World Scene Deocclusion
authors: K.M.S.J. Kumarasinghe, Neil A. Dodgson, Fang-Lue Zhang
abstract: Recovering the complete appearance of occluded objects from a single image is a fundamental problem for scene understanding and image editing. Real-world scenes are challenging due to clutter, complex spatial occlusions, and diverse object categories. Existing methods often struggle when occlusion involves background surfaces or objects that are not explicitly detected, and fail to resolve the cyclic occlusion dependencies that frequently occur in natural scenes. We introduce a training-free, open-world scene deocclusion framework that recovers the full amodal appearance of detected or user-selected objects from a single RGB image, decomposing the scene into depth-ordered RGBA layers that are geometrically plausible, semantically faithful, and visually consistent with the visible scene. Extensive experiments show that our approach improves scene-level deocclusion, producing coherent and realistic reconstructions in real-world settings. Code will be available on the project page: https://sashjk.github.io/owsd/

title: Co-Sight Harness: Externalized Control Assets and Deterministic Enforcement for Long-Horizon Business Agents
authors: Luyao Wang, Xijun Zhu, Zhaohui Hao, Xiwen Zhang, Xingyu Wen, Weishan Li, Yuyang Liao, Yanqin Gao, Yongsheng Du, Lingjun Huang, Shaowei Zhao, Gang Li, Qifan Yu, Baoli Wang
abstract: Long-horizon business workflows fail in two ways: errors accumulate as a chain of activities lengthens, and the knowledge an activity needs is written in a different vocabulary from the user's request. We study whether such workflows can be made reliable without changing the language model. Our method keeps the backbone fixed and moves the workflow definition, state and domain knowledge into versioned control assets outside the model. A state machine and machine-checkable acceptance gates enforce these assets during execution; an independent auditor grades the resulting trace. The assets are updated only after a regression check and human approval .We evaluate the method on three deployed workflows exceeding 200 steps. On Domain A, a 120-case end-to-end evaluation set shows unattended completion rising from 50% to 100%, retrieval recall from 56% to 91.67%, and end-to-end latency dropping from 440 to 159 minutes, with scenario-analysis recall rising from 45% to 93%. Two other domains were taken over by teams that did not write the assets, one in four days and one in seven days. A controlled ablation separates the two failure sources. The code is available at https://github.com/ZTE-AICloud/Co-Sight/tree/master/Co-Sight%20Harness.

title: iGRAIL: Blockchain-Based Generative Federated Learning for Trustworthy Healthcare Intelligence
authors: Debashis Das, Sourav Banerjee, Saraju P. Mohanty
abstract: Healthcare organizations collect huge amounts of patient data from clinical records, medical tests, monitoring systems, and healthcare services. Such data can underpin intelligent healthcare analytics but remains distributed across institutions and cannot be shared directly due to privacy, security, and trust concerns. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative learning without sharing raw patient records, but the exchanged model information remains vulnerable to privacy leakage, tampering, replay, and unauthorized access. In this paper, we propose iGRAIL, a blockchain-enabled generative FL framework for trustworthy healthcare intelligence. iGRAIL combines local generative learning for data augmentation with differential privacy to protect sensitive information during local training. Model communication is secured using cryptographic mechanisms, and blockchain-based verification and smart-contract access control ensure that only authorized, authentic, fresh, and integrity-preserving updates are accepted for federated aggregation. The framework is evaluated on four healthcare datasets and compared with the conventional FL and blockchain-based FL (BC-FL) under predictive, privacy, non-IID, scalability, malicious-update, security-verification, and runtime settings. For the two large diabetes datasets, iGRAIL improves accuracy by about 5.4-5.6%, the F1-score by 14.6-16.9%, and MCC by 16.0-18.1% over the best FL or BC-FL baseline. Increasing the strength of differential privacy reduces the privacy-loss parameter $ε$ by about 72.5% for the cancer dataset and 87.5% for the diabetes dataset, with only a limited loss in prediction performance. These results indicate that iGRAIL supports secure and scalable federated computing while preserving privacy, model integrity, and controlled participation, at the cost of additional computational overhead.

title: A Unified Framework for First- and Second-Order Energy-Stable Parametric Finite Element Methods for Planar Willmore Flow
authors: Xiaoli Li, Yujing Yan
abstract: The construction of structure-preserving schemes for planar Willmore flow that are second-order accurate in time and avoid large coupled nonlinear solves remains challenging. In this work, we develop a unified framework for first- and second-order fully discrete energy-stable parametric finite element schemes for planar Willmore flow with a length-penalization term. The framework is based on a new equivalent reformulation involving a global auxiliary variable. The main novelty lies in the second-order construction, which combines midpoint curvature quantities weighted by elementwise arc-length Jacobian ratios with a compatible discrete tangent to obtain exact discrete chain rules for the bending energy and curve length. A further contribution is to show that both schemes satisfy discrete modified energy dissipation laws that yield the same type of a priori bounds on the discrete solution as the original energy law. They also retain Barrett--Garcke--N{ü}rnberg tangential motion to promote favorable mesh distribution. Each stage reduces to two linear solves with exactly the same coefficient matrix and one scalar nonlinear solve. We rigorously prove unique solvability of the linear subproblems under suitable assumptions and derive computable sufficient conditions for local existence and uniqueness of the scalar solution near unity. Numerical experiments demonstrate the expected temporal accuracy, energy dissipation, good mesh quality and computational efficiency.

title: An AI-enabled high-resolution chlorophyll-a forecasting model that outperforms the operational global biogeochemical system
authors: Yong Jiang, Zheng Jiang, Gaowei Zhang, Zengzhou Hao, Suixiang Shi, Chi Zhang, Wei Wang
abstract: Surface chlorophyll-a concentration is a key indicator of marine phytoplankton variability, and short-term forecasts of its distribution provide advance information for marine ecosystem monitoring and management. However, interactions between physical transport and biological processes complicate chlorophyll-a forecasting, and simulating these coupled processes with conventional numerical models imposes substantial computational demands. Here we introduce ChlCast, an AI model that generates daily forecasts of surface chlorophyll-a concentration over a 10-day horizon at approximately 4-km resolution between 60$^\circ$S and 60$^\circ$N. ChlCast combines factorized spatiotemporal convolutions with a multiscale architecture to learn from historical chlorophyll-a fields and climatological information. Compared with the operational 0.25$^\circ$ Copernicus global ocean biogeochemical forecasting system, ChlCast reduces mean absolute error and root mean square error by 70.74% and 47.63%, respectively, against satellite-derived Level-4 chlorophyll-a fields, and by 35.03% and 13.07% against independent BGC-Argo in situ observations. Coastal case studies further show that the 4-km forecasts retain coastal gradients and localized concentration maxima that are weakened by coarse-grid averaging. These results demonstrate the potential of observation-driven deep learning for high-resolution forecasting of surface chlorophyll-a variability at the near-global scale.

title: RaFL: An Empirical Study of Random Filter Losses for Image Reconstruction
authors: Ruibo Wang, Fengbei Liu, Aleksei Tiulpin, Mert R. Sabuncu, Heejong Kim
abstract: Pixel losses train image reconstruction networks toward a point statistic of the target distribution, often averaging away fine textures under uncertainty. Perceptual losses alleviate this issue using pretrained features, but those features are inherently domain-specific. We study a random filter loss (RaFL) that compares prediction and target through filters with random weights, avoiding both pretrained features and task-specific loss engineering. RaFL combines random convolutions, random Fourier features, and random wavelet filters, automatically balancing their contributions through gradient-norm matching, eliminating manual loss-weight tuning and grid search. We systematically investigate three design choices: filter family, weight resampling schedule, and weight initialization. Based on validation PSNR and stability across random seeds, we select the configuration that uses all three filter families, redraws filters every optimization step, and employs Gaussian initialization. We evaluate RaFL on three 2D and two 3D image reconstruction tasks. RaFL outperforms a pixel loss on three tasks and matches it on two, and demonstrates stable performance across random seeds on all five tasks. RaFL adds less than 2% to the backbone's forward FLOPs and no inference cost, requiring $182\times$ fewer loss FLOPs than a VGG19 perceptual loss. These findings suggest that RaFL is a simple, tuning-free, and domain-agnostic loss objective for 2D and 3D image reconstruction.

title: DesignSpecs: A DESIGN.md Dataset of Visual Design Specifications for AI Agents
authors: Jialiang Wei, Walid Maalej
abstract: While AI agents increasingly generate and modify user interfaces, they rarely rely on a visual design specification for a certain project. The DESIGN.md format, which originated from Google's AI design tool Stitch and which was open-sourced in April 2026, addresses this gap by describing a visual identity through design tokens (such as named colors, text styles) and Markdown prose. To our knowledge, no large-scale research dataset of such design specification files exists. We present DesignSpecs, a dataset of 36,906 DESIGN.md files from 15,794 public, non-fork GitHub repositories, representing 17,240 unique file contents. We collected 613,207 files named DESIGN.md in October 2026. Because the same file name also denotes architectural plans and other design documents, we filtered those with YAML front matter, a design-system name, at least one recognized design token, and zero errors under the official linter. Our JSON Lines dataset provides file-level and deduplicated views of the original Markdown, links files to repositories, paths, and commits, and is released with related scripts. We outline research opportunities on visual design knowledge and design-aware AI agents. Dataset is available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Jl-wei/DesignSpecs

conclusion: 提出了DesignSpecs数据集，填补了视觉设计规范大规模数据集的空白。为视觉设计知识和设计感知AI代理的研究提供了机会。

title: QCAP-VQA: Question-Conditioned Capped Prior-Mass Supervision for Medical Visual Question Answering
authors: Yining Zhao, Catarina Moreira, Mukesh Prasad, Ali Braytee
abstract: Medical visual question answering models can answer correctly without attending to the anatomy that the question names. Automatic region priors allow spatial supervision without expert masks, but they are noisy, and it is unclear how strongly they should shape attention and how their effect should be verified. We present QCAP-VQA, which supervises a subset of cross-attention heads with a question-conditioned prior built from ranked segmentation proposals. Its capped prior-mass objective penalizes insufficient attention inside the prior only below a threshold. We evaluate attention against SLAKE structure boxes that play no role in training, separating attention on the named anatomy from how attention shifts between questions about the same image. QCAP-VQA matches the accuracy of a baseline without spatial supervision (84.26% vs. 84.23%), and every evaluated prior-supervised model places more attention on the annotated structures. Over a 64-fold range of regularization strength, the capped objective keeps prior mass between 0.67 and 0.77, whereas a pooled region-mass objective drives it to 0.97 and loses accuracy. The cost lies in question conditioning: as the constraint widens or strengthens, attention shifts agree less with the expert-defined contrast. Across 13 configurations, prior-referenced and expert-referenced evaluation rank the models in largely opposite order (Spearman correlation of -0.87), and the capped models it favors track the prior's own errors. Because clinical use of medical visual question answering requires answers grounded in the queried anatomy, supervision from automatic priors should be judged against independent anatomical references.
zh_title: QCAP-VQA：用于医学视觉问答的问题条件有界先验质量监督方法
translation: 医学视觉问答（VQA）模型有时无需关注问题中指明的解剖结构也能做出正确回答。自动区域先验允许在缺少专家标注掩膜的情况下进行空间监督，但这些先验存在噪声，目前尚不清楚它们应在多大程度上影响注意力，以及该如何验证其效果。我们提出了QCAP-VQA，该方法利用基于排序分割建议构建的问题条件先验来监督交叉注意力头的一个子集。其有界先验质量目标仅在先验内部的注意力低于阈值时施加惩罚。我们根据未参与训练的SLAKE结构框评估注意力，将对指定解剖结构的注意力与针对同一图像不同问题间的注意力转移分离开来。QCAP-VQA达到了与无空间监督基线相当的准确率（84.26% 对 84.23%），并且所有经过先验监督的模型在标注结构上的注意力均有所提升。在64倍的正则化强度范围内，该有界目标将先验质量保持在0.67至0.77之间，而池化区域质量目标则将其推至0.97并导致准确率下降。其代价在于问题条件化：随着约束放宽或增强，注意力的转移与专家定义的对比一致性降低。在13种配置中，基于先验与基于专家的评估对模型的排序基本相反（Spearman相关性为-0.87），其倾向的有界模型会追踪先验本身的错误。由于医学视觉问答的临床应用需要将回答扎根于所查询的解剖结构中，因此来自自动先验的监督应依据独立的解剖参考进行评判。
tldr: QCAP-VQA通过问题条件的截断先验目标对注意力进行轻量级空间监督，在保持VQA高准确率的同时提升解剖定位，并揭示了利用带噪先验进行模型评估存在的严重偏差。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一种带有上限阈值（capped prior-mass）的先验注意力监督方法，避免了模型因过度拟合带噪伪掩膜而损失分类准确率。更具启发性的是，论文揭示了先验参考评估与专家参考评估之间的高度负相关性（Spearman -0.87），警示了仅依赖自动先验进行验证可能带来的误导，强调了在医学领域建立独立解剖基准评估的重要性。
motivation: 医学视觉问答（VQA）模型常在未关注问题所提及解剖结构的情况下做出正确回答；虽然自动区域先验可在缺少专家掩膜时提供空间监督，但先验噪声较大，且难以确定先验施加多强的约束以及如何科学验证其有效性。
method: 提出了QCAP-VQA方法：利用排序分割建议构建基于问题条件的先验，并对交叉注意力头子集进行监督；设计了上限先验质量目标（capped prior-mass objective），仅在先验区域内的注意力低于设定阈值时进行惩罚；在验证时采用未参与训练的SLAKE结构框评估注意力分配及问题间的注意力转移。
results: QCAP-VQA在分类准确率上与无空间监督的基线相当（84.26% vs. 84.23%），且有效提升了模型对标注结构的注意力集中度；在64倍正则化强度变化范围内，该方法将先验质量稳定在0.67至0.77之间，避免了准确率下降；但在跨13种配置中，基于先验与基于专家的模型评估排序呈现出相反趋势（Spearman相关系数达-0.87），模型会追踪先验本身的错误。
conclusion: 医学VQA模型在临床应用中必须将回答建立在所询问的解剖结构之上，因此基于自动先验的弱监督方法必须通过独立的解剖结构基准进行验证，而非仅依赖先验本身进行评估。

title: Cross-Linguistic Acoustic Biomarkers of Cognitive Impairment Across Interactive and Single-Speaker Speech Tasks
authors: Kenyu Ikeuchi, Tomoaki Ohtsuki, Michelle Cohn, Alyssa Weakley, Yui Ishihara, Joseph Hoang, Taishiro Kishimoto, Sarah Tomaszewski Farias, Jet M. J. Vonk, Chen-Nee Chuah
abstract: Multilingual dementia detection is essential for scalable and equitable screening. In recent years, automated speech analysis has emerged as a promising approach for supporting dementia detection by enabling non-invasive and scalable assessment of cognitive function. However, existing studies that use automated speech analysis often rely on one type of task, such as picture description, and use black-box models. These studies often neglect the role of task and language. To address these gaps, we performed a cross-linguistic and cross-task acoustic analysis that integrates a conversational dataset with structured speech tasks across four languages (Spanish, Mandarin, English, Japanese). We applied statistical, linguist-/clinician-guided, and machine learning model-based feature selection to derive compact acoustic feature sets while maintaining classification performance. This enabled systematic comparison of cognitive impairment-relevant features across datasets and tasks. Our results revealed that acoustic features did not generalize uniformly across tasks and languages. Temporal features remained robust across all datasets, consistently capturing timing disruption regardless of language or task. In contrast, speech rate showed strong task dependence -- emerging as informative mainly in single-speaker tasks with externally anchored content and pacing, but becoming less reliable when speech content was highly individualized. Pitch-related features further exhibited language-specific patterns, favoring chroma-related features in tonal languages (e.g., Mandarin) and F0-related features in non-tonal languages. These findings caution against indiscriminate pooling of heterogeneous speech data and underscore the need for interpretable, context-aware approaches to multilingual dementia detection using automated speech analysis.
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Accepted for publication in Proc. 48th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC 2026)
zh_title: 跨语言、跨交互式和单人说话任务的认知障碍声学生物标志物
translation: 多语言痴呆症检测对于可扩展和公平的筛查至关重要。近年来，自动化语音分析作为一种支持痴呆症检测的有前景的方法而出现，它能够对认知功能进行非侵入性和可扩展的评估。然而，现有使用自动化语音分析的研究通常依赖于一种任务，例如图片描述，并使用黑盒模型。这些研究常常忽视任务和语言的作用。为了解决这些空白，我们进行了一项跨语言和跨任务的声学分析，整合了四种语言（西班牙语、普通话、英语、日语）的对话数据集和结构化语音任务。我们应用了统计学、语言学家/临床医生指导和基于机器学习模型的特征选择，以在保持分类性能的同时导出紧凑的声学特征集。这使得能够系统地比较不同数据集和任务中与认知障碍相关的特征。我们的结果显示，声学特征在不同任务和语言之间不统一。时间特征在所有数据集中保持稳健，无论语言或任务如何，都能一致地捕捉到时间中断。相比之下，语速表现出很强的任务依赖性——主要在具有外部锚定内容和节奏的单人说话任务中显示出信息量，但在语音内容高度个性化时可靠性降低。音高相关特征进一步表现出语言特异性模式，在声调语言（例如普通话）中偏爱色度相关特征，在非声调语言中偏爱基频相关特征。这些发现警示不要不加区分地汇集异构语音数据，并强调了使用自动化语音分析进行多语言痴呆症检测时，需要可解释、上下文感知的方法。
tldr: 本研究对四种语言的交互式和单人说话任务中的认知障碍声学生物标志物进行了跨语言、跨任务分析，发现声学特征的泛化能力因任务和语言而异，强调了上下文感知方法的重要性。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地进行了跨语言和跨任务的声学分析，揭示了现有痴呆症检测方法中任务和语言依赖性的重要局限性。其发现对于开发更稳健、公平和可解释的多语言认知障碍筛查工具具有重要指导意义，特别是对特征选择和模型泛化提出了挑战。
motivation: 现有的自动化语音分析痴呆症检测研究常依赖单一任务和黑盒模型，忽略了任务和语言的作用，导致可扩展性和公平性受限。
method: 研究整合了四种语言（西班牙语、普通话、英语、日语）的对话数据集和结构化语音任务，进行了跨语言、跨任务的声学分析。采用统计学、语言学家/临床医生指导和机器学习模型进行特征选择，以导出紧凑的声学特征集。
results: 声学特征在不同任务和语言之间不统一。时间特征在所有数据集中保持稳健。语速在单人任务中具有信息量，但在高度个性化的语音内容中可靠性降低。音高相关特征表现出语言特异性模式（声调语言偏爱色度特征，非声调语言偏频特征）。
conclusion: 结果警示不要不加区分地汇集异构语音数据，并强调了使用自动化语音分析进行多语言痴呆症检测时，需要可解释、上下文感知的方法。

title: Ego2Flow: Benchmarking the Traffic-System Impact of Autonomous Driving on Maps Distilled from Real-World Roads
authors: Yu Dong, Weiying Shen, Hangyu Li, Shu Han, Hong Li, Xiangbo Gao, Keshu Wu, Zhengzhong Tu, Soyoung Ahn, Zhiyuan Liu, Xiaopeng Li
abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving is predominantly evaluated through ego-vehicle safety and task completion. Its deployment in urban traffic, however, creates sustained interactions among vehicles whose collective effects remain insufficiently evaluated. We introduce Ego2Flow, a closed-loop benchmark for assessing the traffic-system impact of autonomous driving on maps distilled from real-world cities. To construct realistic 3D urban environments for sustained closed-loop traffic simulation, we develop an agent-guided map distillation framework that integrates real-world maps and observations with complementary geographic information. Through an iterative feedback mechanism and a traffic information graph that jointly guide scene generation, the framework preserves lane topology, critical road geometry and decision-relevant visual conditions while simplifying nonessential details and completing unobserved regions. Using our proposed framework, we generate and publicly release six CARLA maps from the Argoverse 2 dataset, covering the corresponding real-world regions and enabling paired comparisons of driving behavior under real and simulated observations. On these maps, Ego2Flow evaluates how autonomous driving policies affect traffic efficiency, safety, stability and energy consumption across diverse road structures. Compared with existing construction methods, our framework achieves the lowest average displacement error between planning outputs from paired real and simulated observations. We further benchmark representative driving policies to characterize their system-level impact on urban traffic. Project Page: https://github.com/Fisher-007/Ego2Flow.
zh_title: Ego2Flow：基于真实道路蒸馏地图评估自动驾驶对交通系统影响的基准
translation: 端到端自动驾驶主要通过自车安全性和任务完成情况进行评估。然而，它在城市交通中的部署会产生车辆之间持续的交互，其集体效应尚未得到充分评估。我们引入了 Ego2Flow，这是一个用于评估自动驾驶对基于真实城市蒸馏地图的交通系统影响的闭环基准。为了构建用于持续闭环交通模拟的真实 3D 城市环境，我们开发了一个智能体引导的地图蒸馏框架，该框架将真实世界的地图和观测数据与互补的地理信息集成在一起。通过迭代反馈机制和共同指导场景生成的交通信息图，该框架在简化非必要细节并补全未观测区域的同时，保留了车道拓扑、关键道路几何形状和决策相关的视觉条件。使用我们提出的框架，我们生成并公开了来自 Argoverse 2 数据集的六个 CARLA 地图，涵盖了相应的真实世界区域，并能够对真实和模拟观测下的驾驶行为进行成对比较。在这些地图上，Ego2Flow 评估了自动驾驶策略如何影响不同道路结构下的交通效率、安全性、稳定性和能耗。与现有构建方法相比，我们的框架在成对的真实和模拟观测规划输出之间实现了最低的平均位移误差。我们进一步对具有代表性的驾驶策略进行了基准测试，以表征它们对城市交通的系统级影响。项目页面：https://github.com/Fisher-007/Ego2Flow。
tldr: 本文提出了 Ego2Flow，一个基于真实世界道路地图蒸馏的闭环交通系统基准，用于评估自动驾驶对城市交通效率、安全和能耗的宏观影响。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种闭环基准测试 Ego2Flow，用于评估端到端自动驾驶对交通系统的宏观影响。其核心创新在于 agent 引导的地图蒸馏框架，能有效结合真实地图与地理信息构建逼真的 3D 城市仿真环境。这项工作对理解自动驾驶在城市交通流中的实际表现具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的端到端自动驾驶评估主要集中在自车（ego-vehicle）的安全性和任务完成度上，对其在城市交通中与其他车辆持续交互所产生的集体效应评估不足，因此需要一个能够评估自动驾驶对交通系统影响的闭环基准。
method: 提出了一种由智能体引导的地图蒸馏框架，整合了真实地图、观测数据以及互补的地理信息，通过迭代反馈机制和交通信息图共同指导场景生成，并基于 Argoverse 2 数据集生成了六个 CARLA 地图进行基准测试。
results: 与现有构建方法相比，该框架在配对的真实与模拟观测规划输出之间实现了最低的平均位移误差（ADE），并成功评估了代表性驾驶策略对城市交通效率、安全性、稳定性和能耗的影响。
conclusion: Ego2Flow 成功构建了一个基于真实道路的闭环交通仿真基准，能够有效评估自动驾驶策略对交通系统的多维影响，为未来自动驾驶的大规模部署提供了重要的评估工具。

title: Towards High-Performance Multimodal Discovery: Evaluating Retrieval Efficacy and Operational Scalability in Digital Libraries
authors: Krishna Priya, Sai Navya Jyesta, Sachith Withana, Neelesh Karthikeyan, Beth Plale
abstract: Large-scale digital repositories with million plus digitized volumes serve as vital engines for scientific and scholarly discovery. However, as collections grow, finding specific research or educational material remains a significant challenge. This difficulty is compounded by the multimodal nature of texts, that is, texts which combine dense narrative content with essential illustrative charts, annotated diagrams, and complex layouts. Historically, discovery has been supported by full-text search indexes implemented as inverted indexes (e.g., Lucene or Solr). While these systems scale well for textual strings, they are fundamentally "blind" to the semantic nuance of visual information. We explore the benefit of discovery through texts that have been converted to numerical vectors. By representing page images as numerical vectors rather than OCR-extracted text, and doing so for both text and images on a page, we capture both textual and visual semantics while mitigating reverse engineering and copyright infringement concerns. The primary contribution of this research is an evaluation of the multimodal retrieval landscape, encompassing both semantic precision and architectural scalability. Our findings demonstrate that integrating visual and textual features significantly enhances the discovery of relevant material, particularly in domains where diagrammatic content is essential for conceptual understanding. We assess retrieval efficacy, demonstrating that the system achieves sub-linear scalability. Our findings suggest that an optimized vector database configuration is the critical factor in transforming VLM-based embeddings into a production-ready, library-scale discovery solution.
zh_title: 迈向高性能多模态检索发现：评估数字图书馆中的检索效能与运行可扩展性
translation: 拥有数百万数字化卷册的大规模数字知识库是科学与学术发现的重要引擎。然而，随着馆藏的增长，寻找特定的研究或教学材料仍然是一项重大挑战。文献的多模态特性加剧了这一困难，即文本往往将密集的叙述性内容与不可或缺的说明性图表、带注释的图示和复杂的版面相结合。历史上，检索发现主要依靠以倒排索引（如Lucene或Solr）实现的全文搜索引擎。尽管这些系统在处理文本字符串方面具有良好的扩展性，但它们在本质上对视觉信息的语义细微差别“视而不见”。我们探索了通过将文本转化为数值向量进行检索的优势。通过将页面图像而非OCR提取的文本表示为数值向量，并同时对页面上的文本和图像进行表征，我们既捕捉了文本和视觉语义，又缓解了逆向工程和版权侵权的担忧。本研究的主要贡献是对多模态检索领域进行了评估，涵盖语义精度和架构可扩展性。我们的研究结果表明，整合视觉和文本特征能够显著增强相关材料的检索效果，尤其是在图表内容对概念理解至关重要的领域。我们评估了检索效能，证明系统实现了亚线性的可扩展性。我们的研究结果表明，优化的向量数据库配置是将基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的嵌入转化为可用于生产环境的图书馆级检索解决方案的关键因素。
tldr: 本文提出利用页面图像级多模态向量嵌入替代传统OCR全文检索，在显著提升图文检索精度的同时实现了亚线性扩展，为大规模数字图书馆提供了生产级检索方案。
ai_comments: 本论文聚焦于大规模数字图书馆检索中文本与视觉图表融合的现实瓶颈，提出将页面图像整体向量化检索方案，创新性地规避了OCR错误与版权逆向工程风险，同时兼顾了语义精度与亚线性扩展性，对推动多模态检索技术在实际生产级图书情报系统中的落地具有重要的实用参考价值。
motivation: 传统基于倒排索引的全文检索对图表、标注和复杂排版等关键视觉语义“盲视”，难以满足包含图文混排的百万级数字化文献的精准检索需求，且存在版权与逆向工程顾虑。
method: 将页面图像（涵盖页面上的文本与图像）直接转换为数值向量（基于VLM的嵌入），而非仅依赖OCR提取文本，并利用优化的向量数据库支持多模态检索。
results: 整合视觉与文本特征显著提升了相关资料的检索效果（尤其在强图表依赖领域），并且检索系统实现了亚线性（sub-linear）的运行扩展性。
conclusion: 优化后的向量数据库配置是将基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的嵌入表示转化为面向生产环境、图书馆级发现解决方案的关键因素。

title: A Spectral Framework for Universal Proxy Regularization in Model Merging
authors: Shangge Liu, Danyue Qian, Qi Fan, Yinghuan Shi, Wenbin Li, Lei Wang, Yang Gao, Dacheng Tao
abstract: Model merging constructs multi-task models without expensive joint training but often suffers from parameter interference. Some solutions mitigate this by constraining finetuning using data from the other tasks to be merged, violating the core independence and privacy assumption of model merging. Recent work offers preliminary empirical evidence that a universal, task-agnostic proxy distribution can substitute for such data, but leaves open when and why it suffices. To this end, we propose a \textit{Spectral Framework for Universal Proxy Regularization}, which characterizes the relationship between a proxy distribution and the distribution of other tasks to be merged through spectral coverage ($α$) and leakage ($β$). Based on the framework, we derive a unified parameter interference bound: smaller $(α, β)$ provably yields lower parameter interference through better spectral alignment. To exploit such a proxy, we augment the training objective with a proxy regularizer. Evaluating this regularizer during fine-tuning requires a concrete mechanism. We study three instantiations, including (J) an exact evaluation via Jacobian-vector products, (F) a frozen curvature approximation using the Fisher information matrix, and (O) an output-drift formulation that constrains the model's functional deviation on the proxy directly. We prove that all three coincide under the NTK linearization, where existing analyses of such regularizers stop, and go further to characterize standard non-linear fine-tuning, bounding how far each instantiation departs from its linearized reference and obtain a three-way hierarchy, zero for (J), proxy-independent for (F), and proxy-quality-scaling for (O). Empirical validation on the commonly used vision-language model CLIP confirms these theoretical predictions.
zh_title: 模型合并中通用代理正则化的谱框架
translation: 模型合并无需昂贵的联合训练即可构建多任务模型，但往往受到参数干扰的影响。一些解决方案通过利用待合并其他任务的数据约束微调来缓解这一问题，但这违背了模型合并的核心独立性和隐私性假设。近期研究提供了初步实证证据，表明通用的、任务无关的代理分布可以替代此类数据，但关于其何时以及为何充分有效仍悬而未决。为此，我们提出了一个“通用代理正则化的谱框架”，通过谱覆盖度（α）和泄漏度（β）来刻画代理分布与待合并其他任务分布之间的关系。基于该框架，我们推导出了一个统一的参数干扰界：更小的 (α, β) 可通过更好的谱对齐在理论上带来更低的参数干扰。为了利用该代理，我们在训练目标中加入了代理正则化项。在微调过程中评估该正则化项需要具体的机制。我们研究了三种具体实现，包括：(J) 通过雅可比-向量积进行的精确评估，(F) 使用Fisher信息矩阵的冻结曲率近似，以及 (O) 直接约束模型在代理上函数偏差的输出漂移形式。我们证明了所有这三种形式在神经正切核（NTK）线性化下完全一致（现存对该类正则化项的分析仅停留在该阶段），并进一步刻画了标准非线性微调，界定了每种实现与其线性化参考偏离的程度，从而得到了一个三级层级体系：对于 (J) 为零，对于 (F) 独立于代理，对于 (O) 随代理质量缩放。在常用的视觉-语言模型 CLIP 上的实证验证确认了这些理论预测。
tldr: 本文构建了通用代理正则化的谱理论框架，解释了任务无关代理数据减少模型合并参数干扰的机制，并证明和验证了三种具体正则化算法的理论特性。
ai_comments: 该研究的重要价值在于为模型合并中“无监督/任务无关代理数据为何有效”这一经验发现提供了首个严格的谱理论解释，消除了微调时依赖其他私有任务数据的需求，维护了模型合并的隐私与独立性。此外，文章跳出传统的NTK线性化分析，深入探讨非线性微调机制的分级偏离，理论与实证结合紧密，对未来设计高效多模型融合正则化策略具有指导意义。
motivation: 模型合并中缓解参数干扰的现有方法常需依赖其他任务的数据，违反了数据隐私与任务独立性；虽然任务无关的通用代理分布显示出替代潜力，但其何时生效以及作用机理尚缺乏明确的理论解释。
method: 提出了通用代理正则化的谱框架，使用谱覆盖度（α）和泄漏度（β）刻画代理分布与合并任务分布的关联；将代理正则项引入微调目标，并分析了三种实现机制：雅可比-向量积精确评估（J）、Fisher信息矩阵冻结曲率近似（F）和输出漂移形式（O）；同时在NTK线性化与标准非线性微调下分别进行了理论推导与偏差界定。
results: 理论证明了三种正则化机制在NTK线性化下等价，但在非线性微调中呈现出三层偏离层级（J偏差为零、F与代理无关、O随代理质量缩放）；在视觉-语言模型CLIP上的实验证实了相关理论推导与预测。
conclusion: 本文通过建立通用代理正则化的谱框架，系统阐明了任务无关代理分布减少模型合并干扰的作用机理，推导了统一干扰界，并给出了三种实现方式的理论层次与实证验证。

title: Federated Soft Poly-Level Learning Over a Distributed Network with Guaranteed Convergence
authors: Yang Jiao, Kai Yang, Jianwei Huang
abstract: Multi-level learning/optimization, e.g., bilevel optimization, has been recognized for its versatile applicability across a broad array of domains, spanning from signal processing to machine learning. However, most existing works focus on bilevel and trilevel optimization. In contrast, multi-level optimization problems involving four or more hierarchical levels, which we term poly-level learning (PLL) problems, remain largely unexplored.In addition, in practical PLL, data may be distributed across multiple nodes over a distributed network. Nevertheless, extant studies on PLL predominantly focus on the non-federated setting, necessitating the collection of data to central servers and thereby posing potential privacy risks. To this end, we propose a Federated Poly-Level Learning (FPLL) framework over a distributed network to tackle the PLL problems with soft constraints in a federated manner. FPLL hinges on a novel non-linear cut, i.e., $L$-cut, for the level-wise relaxation to the PLL problems. Additionally, the proposed federated algorithm is designed with adjustable parameters that allow for a flexible trade-off between its computational complexity and performance efficiency, enabling users to tune it according to specific application requirements. We also carry out non-asymptotic analysis to derive the iteration complexity for the proposed FPLL to achieve the $ε$-Pareto stationary point. Extensive experiments have been undertaken to elucidate the superior efficacy of the proposed method.
comment: Accepted at IEEE Transactions on Networking
zh_title: 具有收敛性保证的分布式网络联邦软多层级学习
translation: 多层级学习/优化（如双层优化）因其在信号处理到机器学习等广泛领域的通用适用性而受到认可。然而，大多数现有工作集中在双层和三层优化。相比之下，涉及四个或更多层次结构的多层级优化问题（我们称之为多层级学习，PLL）在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。此外，在实际的PLL中，数据可能分布在分布式网络的多个节点上。然而，现有的PLL研究主要集中在非联邦设定，需要将数据收集到中心服务器，从而带来潜在的隐私风险。为此，我们提出了一个在分布式网络上的联邦多层级学习（FPLL）框架，以联邦方式解决带软约束的PLL问题。FPLL依托于一种新颖的非线性割（即L-cut）来进行PLL问题的逐层松弛。此外，所提出的联邦算法设计了可调节参数，允许在计算复杂度和性能效率之间进行灵活权衡，使用户能够根据具体的应用需求进行调整。我们还进行了非渐近分析，推导出所提FPLL达到ε-Pareto驻点的迭代复杂度。我们开展了大量实验，以阐明所提出方法的卓越有效性。
tldr: 提出了一种面向四层及以上多层优化的联邦软多层级学习（FPLL）框架，利用新型L-cut松弛方法，在保护数据隐私的同时提供了非渐近收敛保证。
ai_comments: 该论文首次系统性地将四层及以上的多层级学习（PLL）扩展至联邦分布式场景，打破了以往集中式存储导致的隐私壁垒。提出的L-cut非线性割松弛机制和可调节权衡参数设计巧妙，且具备严格的非渐近收敛性证明，在复杂多层优化领域具有重要的理论与应用价值。
motivation: 现有多层级优化主要集中在双层和三层，四层及以上的多层级学习（PLL）尚未得到充分探索；同时，实际中数据常分散在各节点，而现有PLL多为非联邦架构，集中数据会导致隐私泄露风险。
method: 提出了分布式网络下的联邦多层级学习（FPLL）框架，以联邦方式处理带软约束的PLL问题。该方法引入了新型非线性割（L-cut）实现层级松弛，并设置了可在计算复杂度与性能效率之间灵活权衡的调节参数；同时提供了达到ε-Pareto驻点的非渐近迭代复杂度理论分析。
results: 大量实验证明了所提出FPLL方法在性能和效率上的优越有效性。
conclusion: 论文成功提出了首个具备收敛性保证的分布式联邦多层级学习框架（FPLL），有效解决了带软约束的超高层级优化及其隐私数据协作问题。

title: uhd-rfsoc: Bringing Off-the-Shelf RFSoC Boards to Unmodified UHD Applications
authors: Wei Cheng, Yiming Li, Junyao Zheng, Cheng-Bin Chen, Tingjun Chen
abstract: Next-generation wireless research relies on software-defined radios (SDRs) with more channels and larger bandwidth. The USRP family is one of the most widely used SDR platforms, and much of the wireless software ecosystem is built on top of the USRP hardware driver (UHD). However, each USRP model comes with a fixed channel count, bandwidth, and streaming capability. Off-the-shelf radio frequency system-on-chip (RFSoC) boards, on the other hand, integrate up to 16 analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) and 16 digital-to-analog converters (DACs) operating at several gigasamples per second (GS/s), but existing UHD applications cannot directly use them. We present uhd-rfsoc, an open-source FPGA design and host software stack that turns these boards, including the 16-channel ZCU216 and the RFSoC 4x2, into standard UHD devices without modifying UHD. Through standard UHD calls, applications can configure the carrier frequency, channel count, the per-channel I/Q sample rate, and the wire format. uhd-rfsoc combines timestamped, flow-controlled sample transport in the FPGA with data plane development kit (DPDK) packet processing and vectorized sample conversion on x86 and Arm hosts. The built bitstreams for a number of RFSoC board configurations with varying RF data converter rates, channel counts, I/Q sample rates, and wire formats all successfully pass UHD's built-in streaming benchmarks. We further demonstrate compatibility with unmodified GNU Radio flowgraphs, a custom GPU-accelerated transceiver digital signal processing pipeline, as well as the OCUDU and Duranta 5G radio access network stacks using both software and commodity user equipment.
zh_title: uhd-rfsoc：让现成RFSoC开发板无缝接入未修改的UHD应用
translation: 下一代无线通信研究依赖于具有更多通道和更大带宽的软件定义无线电（SDR）。USRP系列是最广泛使用的SDR平台之一，大部分无线软件生态都构建在USRP硬件驱动程序（UHD）之上。然而，每种USRP型号都具有固定的通道数、带宽和流式传输能力。另一方面，现成的射频片上系统（RFSoC）板卡集成了多达16个模数转换器（ADC）和16个数模转换器（DAC），工作速率达每秒数十亿次采样（GS/s），但现有的UHD应用无法直接使用它们。我们提出了uhd-rfsoc，这是一个开源的FPGA设计和主机软件栈，可以在不修改UHD的情况下，将包括16通道ZCU216和RFSoC 4x2在内的这些板卡转变为标准UHD设备。通过标准的UHD调用，应用程序可以配置载波频率、通道数、单通道I/Q采样率和传输格式。uhd-rfsoc将FPGA中带时间戳、带流控的样本传输与x86及Arm主机上的数据平面开发套件（DPDK）数据包处理和向量化样本转换相结合。针对具有不同射频数据转换器速率、通道数、I/Q采样率和传输格式的多种RFSoC板卡配置所构建的比特流，均成功通过了UHD内置的流式传输基准测试。我们还进一步证明了它与未经修改的GNU Radio流图、自定义GPU加速收发机数字信号处理（DSP）流水线，以及使用软件和商用用户终端的OCUDU和Duranta 5G无线接入网协议栈的兼容性。
tldr: uhd-rfsoc是一个开源软硬件栈，使现成商用RFSoC板卡无需修改UHD即可无缝兼容现有的UHD/GNU Radio/5G RAN等软件无线电生态。
ai_comments: 该工作极具实用价值与工程创新性。长期以来，学术界和工业界在构建超大规模MIMO或超宽带无线原型时，受限于商用USRP设备固定的通道数和高昂成本，而商用RFSoC板卡生态与主流开源SDR软件（如UHD生态）存在鸿沟。uhd-rfsoc在不修改UHD源码的前提下实现了对RFSoC的高性能无缝适配，打通了高性能硬件与成熟无线协议栈生态（如GNU Radio、5G RAN等），显著降低了多通道宽带无线通信研究的开发门槛。
motivation: 下一代无线研究需要更多通道和更宽带宽的SDR平台。现有的USRP型号通道数和带宽固定，而集成了多达16个ADC/DAC且采样率达数GS/s的商用RFSoC开发板由于缺乏支持，无法直接在庞大的UHD应用生态中使用。
method: 开发了开源的FPGA设计与主机软件栈uhd-rfsoc，在FPGA端结合带时间戳且流控的样本传输，在x86和Arm主机端结合DPDK数据包处理与向量化样本转换技术，在无需修改UHD源码的前提下，让应用能通过标准UHD调用配置载波频率、通道数、采样率及传输格式。
results: 在ZCU216（16通道）和RFSoC 4x2等开发板上的多种配置下，均成功通过了UHD内置的流传输基准测试；并验证了其在未修改的GNU Radio流图、自定义GPU加速收发机DSP流水线，以及基于通用UE的OCUDU和Duranta 5G无线接入网协议栈中的完全兼容性。
conclusion: uhd-rfsoc成功消除了商用RFSoC开发板与现有UHD软件生态之间的壁垒，为下一代无线研究提供了极具扩展性、高带宽且即插即用的多通道SDR平台。

title: ERA: Error-Resistant Autonomous Object Navigation with Predicted Depth
authors: Shunyang Huang, Shuo Wang, Wenyuan Xie, Mingyu Lin, Yue Ding, Hongtao Lu
abstract: Depth and 3D foundation models can predict geometry from RGB images, allowing zero-shot object navigation without a depth sensor. However, when predicted depth is mapped as if it came from a sensor, view-dependent errors accumulate in the map, remove exploration goals, and end the search before the agent can observe and correct them. We propose ERA, a training-free object navigation system that replaces the depth sensor with depth predicted from RGB images and poses. ERA follows a paradigm we call Move with Error: movement provides new views that correct map errors, and the corrected map enables further movement. It realizes this paradigm with revisable occupancy and with exploration from reachable viewpoints, which continues the search when no frontier remains, and verifies the target across views before stopping. On three benchmarks, ERA achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods without depth sensors. Its map and exploration components also raise VLFM's success from 10.8% to 61.7% under the same predicted depth. We further deploy ERA on a real robot.
zh_title: ERA：基于预测深度的抗误差自主目标导航
translation: 深度与3D基础模型能够从RGB图像预测几何结构，从而在无需深度传感器的情况下实现零样本目标导航。然而，当预测的深度像传感器数据一样直接建图时，视点相关的误差会在地图中累积，消除探索目标并在智能体观察和修正错误之前过早终止搜索。我们提出了ERA，一种免训练的目标导航系统，用基于RGB图像和位姿预测的深度替代深度传感器。ERA遵循一种称为“带误差移动”的范式：移动提供修正地图误差的新视角，而修正后的地图又支持进一步的移动。它通过可修正的占据栅格和来自可达视点的探索机制来实现该范式，当没有剩余探索边界时仍能继续搜索，并在停止前跨视角验证目标。在三个基准测试中，ERA在无深度传感器的免训练方法中取得了最先进的性能。在相同的预测深度下，其建图和探索组件还将VLFM的成功率从10.8%提升至61.7%。我们进一步将ERA部署在真实机器人上。
tldr: ERA通过“带误差移动”范式和可修正建图机制，解决了仅靠RGB图像预测深度进行目标导航时的误差累积与过早终止问题，大幅提升了无深度传感器下的导航成功率。
ai_comments: 该研究针对无深度传感器场景下预测深度带来的视点相关误差累积问题，提出了优雅且实用的闭环纠错机制（Move with Error），有效解决了建图死锁与过早终止搜索的问题，并在仿真与真实机器人上展现出极高的通用性和性能提升。
motivation: 利用基础模型从RGB图像预测深度虽可摆脱深度传感器，但预测深度会累积视点依赖误差，导致建图错误、消除探索目标并过早终止搜索，使智能体无法及时纠正错误。
method: 提出无需训练的导航系统ERA，践行“带误差移动（Move with Error）”范式：采用可修正的占据栅格地图、基于可达视点的探索机制（在无探索边界时仍能继续搜索），并在停止前跨视角验证目标。
results: 在三个基准测试中，ERA在无深度传感器的免训练方法中达到SOTA；在相同预测深度下，使VLFM的成功率从10.8%提升至61.7%；并成功部署在真实机器人上。
conclusion: ERA成功克服了预测深度带来的建图误差问题，实现了在无需深度传感器和额外训练的情况下稳健、高效的自主目标导航，并在真实机器人部署中验证了其实用性。

title: HarmonyText: Harmonious Scene Text Editing via Reverse-to-Refined Pair Synthesis and Region-Decoupled Frequency Learning
authors: Ziqi Yi, Huiguo He, Guitao Xu, Peirong Zhang, Cheng Da, Xinyao Yu, Zhanpeng Wang, Changqian Yu, Huan Yang, Kun Gai, Lianwen Jin
abstract: Natural language-guided, mask-free scene text editing aims to modify text in real-world images using only textual instructions, yet remains challenged by unreliable pseudo-GT supervision, over-smoothed text generation, and the absence of GT-free evaluation. Existing methods often rely on imperfect pseudo-targets with background discrepancies, while standard MSE-based velocity regression tends to suppress high-frequency details, leading to blurred text boundaries and weakened local textures. To address these issues, we propose HarmonyText, a mask-free scene text editing framework with region- and frequency-aware supervision. HarmonyText introduces Region-Decoupling Optimization (RDO), which aligns edited text regions with pseudo-targets while anchoring preserved regions to the source image, and Cascaded High-Frequency Texture Guidance (CHFTG), which applies cascaded wavelet-domain constraints to preserve sharp boundaries and fine-grained textures of textual content. We further propose Reverse-to-Refined Pair Synthesis (RePair) to construct STE25K, a high-quality 25K paired dataset, and introduce a GT-free evaluation protocol with Color Distribution Divergence and a Harmony Assessment Model. Extensive experiments show that HarmonyText outperforms existing methods in text editing accuracy, background fidelity, color consistency, and perceptual harmony.
comment: 11 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers
zh_title: HarmonyText：基于反向精细化配对合成与区域解耦频域学习的和谐场景文本编辑
translation: 自然语言引导的免掩码场景文本编辑旨在仅依靠文本指令修改真实图像中的文本，但目前仍面临不可靠伪真实标签（Pseudo-GT）监督、文本生成过度平滑以及缺乏无GT评估指标等挑战。现有方法通常依赖具有背景差异的不完美伪目标，而标准的基于均方误差（MSE）的速度回归往往会抑制高频细节，导致文本边界模糊和局部纹理弱化。为解决这些问题，我们提出了HarmonyText，一种具备区域与频域感知监督的免掩码场景文本编辑框架。HarmonyText引入了区域解耦优化（RDO），将编辑文本区域与伪目标对齐，同时将保留区域锚定至源图像；并提出了级联高频纹理引导（CHFTG），利用级联小波域约束来保留文本内容的锐利边界和细粒度纹理。此外，我们提出了反向精细化配对合成（RePair）策略以构建包含2.5万个高质样本对的数据集STE25K，并提出了包含颜色分布散度和和谐度评估模型的无GT评估协议。大量实验表明，HarmonyText在文本编辑准确性、背景保真度、颜色一致性和感知和谐度方面均优于现有方法。
tldr: 提出HarmonyText框架，结合区域解耦与频域小波约束，并构建高质量数据集STE25K与无参考评估协议，实现了高保真、锐利和谐的免掩码场景文本编辑。
ai_comments: 该论文针对免掩码场景文本编辑中伪真实标签不准、高频纹理模糊以及缺乏无GT评估标准等痛点，从数据构建、区域解耦、频域引导和无参考评估四个维度提出了系统性的解决方案，兼顾了生成文本的清晰度与背景的一致性，具有很高的实用价值和理论完备性。
motivation: 自然语言引导的免掩码场景文本编辑面临三大难题：伪真实标签（Pseudo-GT）监督不可靠且存在背景差异、标准均方误差回归导致的高频信息丢失与文本过度平滑/模糊、以及缺乏无真实参考（GT-free）的有效评估标准。
method: 1. 提出区域解耦优化（RDO），使编辑文本区域与伪目标对齐，同时将保留区域锚定在源图像上；2. 提出级联高频纹理引导（CHFTG），利用级联小波域约束保留锐利边缘和精细纹理；3. 提出反向精细化配对合成策略（RePair）构建包含2.5万对样本的数据集STE25K；4. 引入包含颜色分布散度与和谐度评估模型的无GT评估协议。
results: 实验表明，HarmonyText在文本编辑准确度、背景保真度、色彩一致性以及感知和谐度方面均显著优于现有方法。
conclusion: HarmonyText通过区域解耦优化、小波域频域纹理引导以及高质量数据集和新评估基准的构建，有效克服了传统场景文本编辑中的模糊与不协调问题，显著提升了编辑质量。

title: State-of-Charge Targets for Storage Participation in Two-Settlement Markets: Reliability, Price, and Compensation Impacts
authors: Yichen Li, Alexandre Moreira, Ruiwei Jiang, Miguel Heleno, Julie Mulvaney-Kemp
abstract: As energy storage assumes a larger role in electricity systems, market operation must coordinate its use across time to support reliability during periods of system stress. Minimum state-of-charge (SOC) targets provide a means of preserving energy for these periods, but their design shapes reliability, operating efficiency, and storage compensation. This paper evaluates alternative SOC target designs in a California-based day-ahead and real-time electricity market model. The comparison examines targets based on day-ahead schedules or rolling centralized dispatch, enforced at the individual-resource or system level, across seasons, stress conditions, and participant information settings. The results show that retaining more energy does not necessarily reduce load shedding: targets that restrict discharge can limit storage support during shortages. Under critical summer conditions, individual targets derived from rolling centralized dispatch reduce weekly load shedding by approximately 83--84\% relative to operation without targets. Lower RT clearing costs and average prices can coexist with higher storage compensation, reflecting the role of day-ahead positions and real-time deviations in determining settlement outcomes. These findings highlight the importance of coordinating energy retention with timely discharge and network deliverability when designing SOC requirements for storage participation in electricity markets.
zh_title: 储能参与两阶段结算市场的荷电状态目标：可靠性、价格和补偿影响
translation: 随着储能系统在电力系统中扮演越来越重要的角色，市场运营必须协调其跨时间的使用，以在系统压力期间支持可靠性。最小荷电状态（SOC）目标提供了一种在这些时期保留能量的方法，但其设计会影响可靠性、运行效率和储能补偿。本文评估了在加州基于日前和实时电力市场模型中的替代SOC目标设计。该比较考察了基于日前计划或滚动集中调度、在个体资源或系统层面执行、跨季节、压力条件和参与者信息设置的目标。结果表明，保留更多能量不一定能减少限负荷：限制放电的目标可能会在短缺期间限制储能支持。在关键的夏季条件下，源自滚动集中调度的个体目标相对于无目标运行可将每周限负荷减少约83-84%。较低的实时清算成本和平均价格可以与较高的储能补偿并存，这反映了日前头寸和实时偏差在确定结算结果中的作用。这些发现强调了在设计储能参与电力市场的SOC要求时，协调能量保留与及时放电和网络可输送性的重要性。
tldr: 本文评估了电力市场中储能的荷电状态（SOC）目标设计，以提高可靠性和效率。研究发现，精心设计的目标可以显著减少限负荷并影响补偿。

title: Super-Analysis for Aggressive yet Scalable Compiler Optimization
authors: Amirali Ebrahimzadeh, Amir Shaikhha
abstract:
Aggressive compiler optimization today occupies two distant extremes. Conventional optimizers run in milliseconds but reason through ad-hoc heuristics that miss opportunities; superoptimizers synthesize faster code but take hours, confining them to small kernels and offline use. We introduce solver-based super-analysis, a middle ground that uses expensive SMT-based analysis while transformations remain conventional, avoiding program synthesis entirely. The key argument for super-analysis is that conventional compilers have rich transformation rules, but proving them to be safe requires complex reasoning: proving a safety check dead often needs facts from three independent LLVM analyses simultaneously, a conjunctive entailment problem suited to an SMT solver, not to any single dataflow pass.
  We instantiate super-analysis in ODeSSy, an LLVM pass that proves sanitizer traps and native-language safety checks unreachable and removes them. One mechanism serves four frontend languages and yields speedups in each, including a 3.78x speedup for a GEMM implemented in Julia. A further solver-based optimization, guard synthesis, handles checks that are not dead for every input: the solver synthesizes a cheap invariant safety guard under which a fast check-free loop is cloned, speeding up a Swift Base64 encoder by 1.44x and a Julia LZ77 compressor by 4.01x. Compared with Souper, the synthesizing superoptimizer for LLVM, ODeSSy removes more safety checks in significantly less time, making it viable as an online compiler pass.
zh_title: 面向激进且可扩展编译器优化的超分析
translation:
当今激进的编译器优化存在两个极端。传统优化器在毫秒级运行，但依赖临时启发式方法，错失优化机会；超级优化器能合成更快的代码，但耗时数小时，仅限于小型内核和离线使用。我们引入了基于求解器的超分析，这是一种中间方案，它使用昂贵的基于SMT的分析，同时保持转换的常规性，完全避免程序合成。超分析的关键论点是，传统编译器具有丰富的转换规则，但证明其安全性需要复杂的推理：证明安全检查无效通常需要同时来自三个独立的LLVM分析的事实，这是一个适合SMT求解器而非任何单一数据流遍历的合取蕴涵问题。
我们在ODeSSy中实现了超分析，这是一个LLVM pass，它证明消毒器陷阱和原生语言安全检查不可达并将其移除。一个机制支持四种前端语言，并在每种语言中都带来了加速，包括Julia中实现的GEMM获得了3.78倍的加速。进一步的基于求解器的优化，即守卫合成，处理并非对每个输入都无效的检查：求解器合成一个廉价的不变安全守卫，在此守卫下克隆一个快速的无检查循环，将Swift Base64编码器加速1.44倍，Julia LZ77压缩器加速4.01倍。与LLVM的合成超级优化器Souper相比，ODeSSy在显著更少的时间内移除了更多的安全检查，使其作为在线编译器pass变得可行。
tldr: 本文介绍了基于求解器的超分析（ODeSSy），作为传统优化器和超级优化器之间的中间方案，利用SMT求解器移除安全检查，实现激进而可扩展的编译器优化。
ai_comments: 这项创新的亮点在于，它利用SMT求解器进行深度程序分析，从而实现激进的优化（移除安全检查），同时避免了昂贵的程序合成，为超级优化器提供了一种可扩展的替代方案。其作为LLVM pass (ODeSSy) 的实际实现以及在多种语言中展示的性能提升，突显了其对编译器优化的重要性。这种“中间方案”的方法尤其富有洞察力。
motivation: 当今激进的编译器优化存在两个极端：传统优化器速度快但机会有限，超级优化器功能强但速度慢且适用范围受限。存在一个需求，即需要一种既激进又可扩展的优化方法。具体来说，传统编译器中证明安全检查无效需要复杂的、多分析的推理。
method: 本文引入了“基于求解器的超分析”，它利用昂贵的基于SMT的分析进行推理，同时保持转换的常规性，完全避免程序合成。该方法在ODeSSy中实现，ODeSSy是一个LLVM pass，用于证明消毒器陷阱和原生语言安全检查不可达并将其移除。此外，还引入了“守卫合成”优化，通过求解器合成廉价的不变安全守卫，在此守卫下克隆一个快速的无检查循环。
results: ODeSSy在显著更少的时间内移除了比Souper更多的安全检查，使其可作为在线编译器pass。它在四种前端语言中都带来了加速，包括Julia中实现的GEMM获得了3.78倍的加速。守卫合成将Swift Base64编码器加速了1.44倍，将Julia LZ77压缩器加速了4.01倍。
conclusion: 基于求解器的超分析（ODeSSy）为激进且可扩展的编译器优化提供了一种实用而有效的中间方案，在效率上优于现有的超级优化器，同时能够移除更多的安全检查。

title: Analysing Busy Beaver Machines (Or How to Find Ossified Ocelots)
authors: James Harland
abstract: The busy beaver problem involves working with machines which can produce very large numbers, both for the output of certain Turing machines and for the number of steps taken to execute them. Given that these numbers can involve thousands of digits, it is crucial to have a means of proving properties of the relevant machines which allow manipulation of such large numbers. In this paper we introduce the notion of \textit{shape computations} as a means of isolating key properties that allow efficient execution of the relevant Turing machines based on verifiable properties of state transitions. In particular, this notion allows us to provide an analytical result which demonstrates the quadratic relationship between the size of the output and the number of steps required to generate it. We have also developed an initial implementation of our approach, and we provide empirical evaluation of it on a suite of 240 example machines.
zh_title: 分析忙碌的海狸机器（或者如何找到骨化的豹猫）
translation: 忙碌的海狸问题涉及处理能够产生非常大数字的机器，这些数字既包括某些图灵机的输出，也包括执行它们所需的步数。鉴于这些数字可能包含数千位，拥有一种方法来证明相关机器的性质，从而能够处理如此大的数字至关重要。本文引入了“形状计算”的概念，作为一种分离关键性质的方法，这些性质允许基于状态转换的可验证性质来高效执行相关的图灵机。特别是，这个概念使我们能够提供一个分析结果，证明了输出大小与生成它所需的步数之间存在二次关系。我们还开发了我们方法的初步实现，并在一套240个示例机器上提供了实证评估。
tldr: 本文引入“形状计算”概念，用于分析忙碌的海狸机器，证明输出大小与执行步数之间存在二次关系，并进行了初步实现和实证评估。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于引入了“形状计算”这一新概念，为分析处理巨大数字的图灵机提供了一种理论和实践结合的方法。通过揭示输出与步数之间的二次关系，为理解这类复杂计算行为提供了深刻见解。初步实现和实证评估也展示了其潜在的应用价值。
motivation: 忙碌的海狸问题中的图灵机能产生非常大的数字，包括输出和执行步数，需要一种方法来证明相关机器的性质，以处理这些大数字。
method: 引入“形状计算”的概念，作为一种方法来分离关键性质，这些性质允许基于状态转换的可验证性质来高效执行相关的图灵机。
results: 提供了一个分析结果，证明了输出大小与生成它所需的步数之间存在二次关系。还开发了该方法的初步实现，并在240个示例机器上进行了实证评估。
conclusion: “形状计算”的概念能够有效地分析忙碌的海狸机器，揭示了输出和步数之间的二次关系，并得到了初步的实证支持。

title: Logically Consistent Accurate Forecasts
authors: Kate Yuan, Rohan Alur, Manish Raghavan, Devavrat Shah
abstract: Agentic forecasting systems based on large language models (LLMs) are now competitive with expert human forecasters, but these systems still suffer from a critical limitation: the inability to produce forecasts that are logically consistent. For example, forecasts for related events often fail to satisfy the axioms of probability, which in turn implies that related forecasts cannot simultaneously be correct and undermines their utility for decision makers. Enforcing consistency is not trivial -- naive approaches (e.g., projection onto the set of consistent forecasts) can degrade accuracy. We argue that the key to overcoming the apparent tradeoff between consistency and accuracy lies in the reasoning which supports each forecast. We finetune a supervisory language model that leverages this reasoning to jointly reconcile inconsistencies while improving the accuracy of related forecasts. On ForecastBench, our method improves the Brier score of a retrieval-augmented GPT-5.1 forecaster by 9.3% while reducing measures of structural inconsistency by 82-90%. We interrogate our method via a comprehensive series of baselines and ablations, and find that no alternative method matches our gains in consistency and accuracy simultaneously.

zh_title: 逻辑一致且准确的预测
translation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体预测系统目前已能与人类专家预测者相匹敌，但这些系统仍存在一个关键局限：无法产生逻辑一致的预测。例如，针对相关事件的预测往往无法满足概率公理，这反过来意味着相关预测不可能同时正确，从而削弱了它们对决策者的实用价值。强制施加一致性并非易事——朴素的方法（例如投影到一致预测集上）可能会降低准确性。我们认为，克服一致性与准确性之间这种表面权衡的关键，在于支撑每个预测的推理过程。我们微调了一个监督语言模型，该模型利用这一推理过程来联合调和不一致性，同时提高相关预测的准确性。在ForecastBench基准上，我们的方法将检索增强型GPT-5.1预测器的Brier得分提高了9.3%，同时将结构不一致性指标降低了82%至90%。我们通过一系列全面的基线和消融实验验证了该方法，发现没有任何替代方法能同时在一致性和准确性上取得与我们相匹配的提升。
tldr: 本文提出微调监督语言模型以利用预测背后的推理链，在将预测的不一致性降低82%-90%的同时，使准确率指标（Brier分）提升了9.3%。
ai_comments: 该论文针对大模型智能体预测系统违反概率公理、缺乏逻辑一致性的关键缺陷，指出了传统数学投影后处理会损害准确率的弊端。其创新之处在于提出利用预测背后的“推理过程”作为桥梁，通过微调监督模型进行联合调和，成功打破了一致性与准确性之间的权衡，对构建高可靠性的AI辅助决策系统具有重要价值。
motivation: 基于LLM的预测系统常因违反概率公理而缺乏逻辑一致性，导致相关预测无法同时为真并削弱决策价值；而朴素的一致性约束手段（如投影法）往往会导致预测准确率下降。
method: 微调一个监督语言模型（supervisory language model），利用支撑各项预测的推理内容，联合调和相关事件预测之间的逻辑不一致性并提升其准确度。
results: 在ForecastBench基准测试中，该方法将基于检索增强的GPT-5.1预测器的Brier得分提升了9.3%，同时将结构不一致性指标降低了82%~90%，在一致性和准确性两方面的综合表现均显著优于现有基线方法。
conclusion: 克服逻辑一致性与预测准确性之间权衡的关键在于充分利用支撑预测的推理过程；通过监督语言模型进行联合调和，可以同时显著提升预测的逻辑一致性与准确性。

title: Complex Schrödinger Bridges
authors: Dong-Sig Han, Tolga Birdal
abstract: Diffusion bridges have emerged as versatile frameworks for facilitating transformations between arbitrary data distributions. However, these approaches are hindered by an immense optimization space and its underlying high-order structures. This paper explores a variant of diffusion bridges for solving real-world problems in complex vector spaces governed by scaling and rotation laws, such as Hamiltonian structures. To address this, we introduce conformal optimal transport (COT), a complex-valued transportation framework designed for physical systems with geometric and dissipative dynamics under a geometric lifting. Building on this, we propose a new class of dynamical diffusion bridges, called complex Schrödinger bridges (CSBs), whose derived algorithms can handle diffusion-based tasks using a conformal geometric prior. For scalability, we propose image-to-image CSB (I$^2$CSB), a tractable diffusion-bridge technique with an analytic spiral posterior. Finally, we implement a physics-informed CSB algorithm within simulations of quantum electrodynamics, mimicking the logical behavior of quantum logic gates. Our extensive results validate the underlying theory while highlighting advantages of complex-valued diffusion.
translation: 扩散桥已成为促进任意数据分布之间转换的多功能框架。然而，这些方法受到巨大的优化空间及其潜在高阶结构的阻碍。本文探索了一种扩散桥的变体，用于解决受缩放和旋转定律（例如哈密顿结构）支配的复杂向量空间中的实际问题。为此，我们引入了共形最优传输（COT），一个复值传输框架，专为在几何提升下具有几何和耗散动力学的物理系统而设计。在此基础上，我们提出了一类新的动态扩散桥，称为复杂薛定谔桥（CSBs），其派生算法可以使用共形几何先验处理基于扩散的任务。为了可扩展性，我们提出了图像到图像CSB（I$^2$CSB），这是一种具有解析螺旋后验的可处理扩散桥技术。最后，我们在量子电动力学模拟中实现了一个物理信息CSB算法，模仿量子逻辑门的逻辑行为。我们广泛的结果验证了底层理论，同时突出了复值扩散的优势。
tldr: 本文提出复杂薛定谔桥（CSBs）及其变体（I^2CSB），用于在复杂向量空间中处理扩散任务，通过共形最优传输和物理信息算法，并在量子电动力学模拟中验证了复值扩散的优势。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入复值概念和共形几何先验，在扩散桥领域进行了创新，尤其是在处理具有缩放和旋转特性的复杂物理系统方面。提出的CSB和I^2CSB框架，以及在量子电动力学中的应用，显示了其解决实际问题的潜力。复值扩散的优势被强调，可能为物理系统模拟和数据转换任务提供新的视角。
motivation: 现有的扩散桥在处理任意数据分布转换时，面临巨大的优化空间和高阶结构的限制。本文旨在解决受缩放和旋转定律（如哈密顿结构）支配的复杂向量空间中的实际问题。
method: 1. 引入共形最优传输（Conformal Optimal Transport, COT），一个用于具有几何和耗散动力学的物理系统的复值传输框架。 2. 提出一类新的动态扩散桥，称为复杂薛定谔桥（Complex Schrödinger Bridges, CSBs），其算法利用共形几何先验处理扩散任务。 3. 为提高可扩展性，提出图像到图像CSB（I^2CSB），一种可处理的扩散桥技术，具有解析螺旋后验。 4. 在量子电动力学模拟中实现了一个物理信息CSB算法，模拟量子逻辑门的逻辑行为。
results: 广泛的结果验证了底层理论，并突出了复值扩散的优势。
conclusion: 本文提出的复杂薛定谔桥及其相关算法在处理复杂向量空间中的扩散任务方面具有理论有效性，并展现了复值扩散的优势，尤其是在量子电动力学等物理系统模拟中。

title: When Does Cross-View Consistency Matter in Multi-View Appearance Augmentation? A Controlled Study for Visuomotor Policies
authors: Zixuan Jiang
abstract: Multi-view visual augmentation often seeks consistency across cameras, but it is unclear which forms of consistency matter for downstream control. We use simulation-state replay to manipulate cross-view coupling while preserving the per-camera perturbation distributions, physical trajectories, and action labels. Across seven LIBERO manipulation tasks, marginal-matched changes in global appearance, ghost injection, and target color have small average costs for a late-fusion Diffusion Policy: point estimates are near zero or negative, and the largest upper endpoint of the 90% posterior credible intervals is 2.55 percentage points. In contrast, geometrically anti-coupled observations reduce success by 3.30 percentage points relative to coupled observations (90% CrI [0.64, 6.28]), with displacement magnitude, direction marginals, and the number of affected views matched. Camera interventions reveal substantial dependence on wrist-view geometry, while feature analysis shows appearance sensitivity patterns associated with the factors randomized during training. ACT shows a higher target-color cost estimate than DP, with uncertainty that includes zero and sensitivity to task composition. Within the tested tasks and policy configurations, these findings motivate selective consistency constraints: appearance coupling can sometimes be relaxed, whereas task-relevant geometry and cross-view spatial correspondence warrant protection.
zh_title: 多视角外观增强中，跨视角一致性何时重要？一项关于视觉运动策略的对照研究
translation: 多视角视觉增强通常寻求相机之间的一致性，但尚不清楚哪种形式的一致性对下游控制很重要。我们使用模拟状态回放来操纵跨视角耦合，同时保留每相机扰动分布、物理轨迹和动作标签。在七个LIBERO操纵任务中，全局外观、鬼影注入和目标颜色的边际匹配变化对晚期融合Diffusion Policy的平均成本很小：点估计接近零或为负，90%后验可信区间的最大上限为2.55个百分点。相比之下，几何反耦合观测相对于耦合观测使成功率降低了3.30个百分点（90% CrI [0.64, 6.28]），其中位移幅度、方向边际和受影响的视角数量都匹配。相机干预揭示了对手腕视角几何的强烈依赖性，而特征分析显示外观敏感性模式与训练期间随机化的因素相关。ACT显示出比DP更高的目标颜色成本估计，其不确定性包括零，并且对任务构成敏感。在测试的任务和策略配置中，这些发现促使了选择性的一致性约束：外观耦合有时可以放松，而任务相关的几何和跨视角空间对应关系则需要保护。
tldr: 在多视角外观增强中，外观一致性可以放松，但任务相关的几何和跨视角空间对应关系需要保护。
ai_comments: 该研究通过严格的对照实验，深入分析了多视角外观增强中不同形式的跨视角一致性对视觉运动策略的影响。其创新之处在于通过控制变量法，精确分离了外观和几何一致性的作用。研究结果对于设计更高效、鲁棒的多视角视觉控制系统具有重要指导意义，尤其是在机器人操作等领域。它挑战了传统上对所有形式一致性都一概而论的观点，提出了选择性一致性的新思路。
motivation: 多视角视觉增强通常追求相机之间的一致性，但尚不清楚哪种形式的一致性对下游控制很重要。本研究旨在探究在多视角外观增强中，跨视角一致性何时以及以何种形式对视觉运动策略产生影响。
method: 研究使用模拟状态回放来操纵跨视角耦合，同时保持每相机扰动分布、物理轨迹和动作标签不变。在七个LIBERO操纵任务上，比较了晚期融合Diffusion Policy在全局外观、鬼影注入和目标颜色等方面的变化。此外，通过几何反耦合观测与耦合观测进行对比，并进行了相机干预和特征分析。
results: 全局外观、鬼影注入和目标颜色等边际匹配的变化对晚期融合Diffusion Policy的平均成本很小，点估计接近零或为负。几何反耦合观测使成功率相对耦合观测降低了3.30个百分点（90%可信区间[0.64, 6.28]）。相机干预揭示了对手腕视角几何的强烈依赖性，特征分析显示外观敏感性模式与训练期间随机化的因素相关。ACT显示出比DP更高的目标颜色成本估计。
conclusion: 在测试的任务和策略配置中，这些发现表明需要选择性的一致性约束：外观耦合有时可以放松，而任务相关的几何和跨视角空间对应关系则需要保护。

title: Evaluating the Robustness of PRNU Source-Camera Attribution to the Fingerprint-Copy Attack: An Open Toolkit with Triangle-Test Detection
authors: Zeno J. M. H. Geradts
abstract: Photo-Response Non-Uniformity (PRNU) is the de facto standard trace for sensor-level source-camera attribution, and a high Peak-to-Correlation-Energy (PCE) between a questioned image and a camera reference fingerprint is routinely treated as strong evidence of common origin. The fingerprint-copy attack of Goljan, Fridrich and Chen (2011) shows that this signal can be forged: an adversary who estimates a target camera's fingerprint from that camera's publicly available images can inject a scaled copy of it into an unrelated photograph, producing a forgery that clears a PCE decision threshold despite never having been taken by the target device. We present prnucf, an open, auditable toolkit that pairs a reference implementation of the (additive) fingerprint-copy attack with the triangle-test detector and a cohort-calibrated decision procedure, so that practitioners can quantify how fragile a PRNU attribution is against this attack on their own pipelines. On a controlled multi-camera Monte-Carlo benchmark the attack reaches an arbitrary target PCE at a mean PSNR of 59.2 dB (visually lossless), yet the triangle test separates forgeries from innocent images with an area under the ROC curve of 0.999, detecting every forgery at a cohort-calibrated 5% false-positive operating point. We discuss why a fixed significance cut-off is not safe in casework, the limitations of synthetic validation, and the open problem of extending explainable detection to the modern, GAN-based generation of fingerprint-transfer attacks. The toolkit is released under the MIT license with an explicit dual-use statement.
zh_title: 评估PRNU源相机归因对指纹复制攻击的鲁棒性：一个带有三角测试检测的开放工具包
translation: 光响应非均匀性（PRNU）是传感器级别源相机归因的事实标准痕迹，图像与相机参考指纹之间的高峰值相关能量（PCE）通常被视为共同来源的有力证据。Goljan、Fridrich和Chen（2011）的指纹复制攻击表明，这种信号可以被伪造：攻击者可以从目标相机的公开图像中估计其指纹，并将其按比例注入到不相关的照片中，从而产生一个通过PCE决策阈值但从未由目标设备拍摄的伪造品。我们提出了prnucf，一个开放、可审计的工具包，它将（加性）指纹复制攻击的参考实现与三角测试检测器和队列校准决策程序相结合，以便从业者可以量化PRNU归因在他们自己的流程中对此类攻击的脆弱程度。在受控的多相机蒙特卡洛基准测试中，攻击能够以平均59.2 dB的PSNR（视觉无损）达到任意目标PCE，但三角测试能够以0.999的ROC曲线下面积将伪造图像与无辜图像区分开来，在队列校准的5%误报率操作点上检测出所有伪造。我们讨论了为什么固定的显著性截止值在实际案例中不安全，合成验证的局限性，以及将可解释检测扩展到现代基于GAN的指纹转移攻击的开放问题。该工具包以MIT许可证发布，并附有明确的双重使用声明。
tldr: 本文提出了一个名为prnucf的开放工具包，用于评估PRNU源相机归因对指纹复制攻击的鲁棒性，并证明其三角测试检测器能够高效识别伪造图像。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提供了一个开放且可审计的工具包prnucf，使得研究人员和从业者能够量化PRNU归因对指纹复制攻击的鲁棒性。其重要性在于通过引入三角测试检测器，显著提高了对指纹复制伪造图像的检测能力，为PRNU源相机归因的安全性提供了新的保障。同时，论文也指出了现有方法的局限性，例如固定显著性阈值的不安全性以及对新型GAN生成攻击的检测挑战，为未来的研究指明了方向。
motivation: PRNU是相机归因的标准方法，但指纹复制攻击可以伪造PRNU信号，使得相机归因容易被欺骗，因此需要一种方法来量化并抵御这种攻击。
method: 本文提出了一个名为prnucf的开放且可审计的工具包，它结合了指纹复制攻击的参考实现、三角测试检测器和队列校准决策程序，以量化PRNU归因在此类攻击下的脆弱性。
results: 在受控的多相机蒙特卡洛基准测试中，攻击能够以平均59.2 dB的PSNR（视觉无损）达到任意目标PCE。然而，三角测试能够以0.999的ROC曲线下面积将伪造图像与无辜图像区分开来，在队列校准的5%误报率操作点上检测出所有伪造。
conclusion: 三角测试检测器能够有效防御指纹复制攻击，但固定的显著性阈值在实际案例中不安全。文章还讨论了合成验证的局限性以及将可解释检测扩展到基于GAN的指纹转移攻击的开放问题。

title: See Every Block Once: Variance-Reduced Post-Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models
authors: Yunzhen He, Hiroaki Yamagiwa, Hidetoshi Shimodaira
abstract: Policy gradient methods are widely used to align large language model outputs with human preferences, but the log-likelihoods they require cannot be directly computed in Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs). MDLM post-training therefore relies on a surrogate objective based on the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO), and recent work estimates a blockwise variant of this objective via Monte Carlo methods to support blockwise generation. However, existing estimation schemes randomly sample the block index, so they may evaluate the same block more than once and leave some blocks unevaluated. This introduces variance arising from block selection into the estimates. In this work, we propose a full-block estimator that evaluates every block exactly once and averages the results. We theoretically show that the proposed estimator remains unbiased while eliminating the between-group variance arising from block selection, thereby achieving lower variance than the baseline for the same sample size. In experiments on five benchmarks spanning mathematics, planning, and coding, our method achieves the highest accuracy on four benchmarks and outperforms the random block sampling baseline by an average of 12.79 points.
zh_title: 每个块只看一次：掩码扩散语言模型的方差减少后训练
translation: 策略梯度方法广泛用于使大型语言模型的输出与人类偏好对齐，但它们所需的对数似然在掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）中无法直接计算。因此，MDLM的后训练依赖于基于证据下界（ELBO）的替代目标，最近的工作通过蒙特卡洛方法估计该目标的块状变体以支持块状生成。然而，现有的估计方案随机采样块索引，因此它们可能会多次评估同一个块并遗漏一些块。这在估计中引入了由块选择引起的方差。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个全块估计器，它只评估每个块一次并对结果进行平均。我们从理论上证明了所提出的估计器在消除由块选择引起的组间方差的同时保持无偏，从而在相同样本量下比基线具有更低的方差。在涵盖数学、规划和编码的五个基准测试中，我们的方法在其中四个基准测试中取得了最高准确率，并且平均比随机块采样基线高出12.79个百分点。
tldr: 提出一种全块估计器，通过评估每个块一次来降低掩码扩散语言模型后训练中的方差，并在多个基准测试中取得了更高的准确性。
ai_comments: 这项工作通过引入一个简单的“每个块只评估一次”的策略，巧妙地解决了MDLM后训练中因随机块采样导致的方差问题。其理论证明和显著的实验性能提升表明了该方法的有效性和重要性，对于提升MDLM的训练效率和性能具有实际意义。
motivation: 现有掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs）的后训练方法在估计基于ELBO的块状目标时，随机采样块索引，导致块选择引入方差，可能重复评估或遗漏某些块。
method: 本文提出了一个全块估计器，该估计器对每个块只评估一次并对结果进行平均。理论上证明了该估计器无偏，同时消除了块选择产生的组间方差，从而在相同样本量下实现更低的方差。
results: 在数学、规划和编码领域的五个基准测试中，该方法在其中四个基准测试中取得了最高准确率，并且平均比随机块采样基线高出12.79个百分点。
conclusion: 本文提出的全块估计器有效降低了掩码扩散语言模型后训练中的方差，并在多个任务上显著提升了性能。

title: Stage-wise Lineage-aware Dropout for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting
authors: Yan Xing, Zhi Chen, Fanglue Zhang, Junhong Zhao, Bing Xue, Mengjie Zhang
abstract: Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is prone to overfitting because only a limited number of images are available to constrain scene geometry. Dropout is one regularization strategy for alleviating this problem. We introduce the concept of a lineage family to describe a set of Gaussian primitives derived from the same founder through cloning or splitting operations. The founder Gaussians refer to all Gaussian primitives generated during initialization. Descendants within the same family often jointly contribute to the refinement of adjacent local regions. However, dropping individual Gaussians can be less effective due to the compensation effect from neighboring Gaussians for the dropped ones. To address this issue, we propose Stage-wise Lineage-aware Dropout(SLD), which applies lineage-family dropout during the structural regularization stage and switches to individual dropout during the later refinement stage. We further propose Lineage-Balanced Densification(LBD), which operates during densification by constructing an expanded candidate pool and reallocating the densification budget according to the mean gradient scores and existing descendant sizes of different families. Experiments on the LLFF, MipNeRF360, and Blender datasets show that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance in sparse-view reconstruction
comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables, including supplementary material
zh_title: 面向稀疏视角3D高斯泼溅的分阶段谱系感知Dropout
translation: 稀疏视角3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）容易发生过拟合，因为可用于约束场景几何的图像数量非常有限。Dropout是缓解该问题的一种正则化策略。我们引入了“谱系家族”的概念，用以描述通过克隆或分裂操作由同一个始祖衍生出的一组高斯基元。始祖高斯是指在初始化期间生成的所有高斯基元。同一家族内的后代通常共同参与相邻局部区域的精细化。然而，由于相邻高斯对被丢弃高斯的补偿效应，单独丢弃某些高斯的效果并不理想。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了分阶段谱系感知Dropout（SLD），它在结构正则化阶段应用谱系家族Dropout，并在后期的精细化阶段切换为独立Dropout。我们进一步提出了谱系平衡致密化（LBD），在致密化过程中通过构建扩展候选池，并根据不同家族的平均梯度得分和现有后代规模重新分配致密化预算。在LLFF、MipNeRF360和Blender数据集上的实验表明，所提出的框架在稀疏视角重建中取得了具有竞争力的性能。
tldr: 提出谱系感知的分阶段Dropout与平衡致密化策略，通过消除同源高斯的补偿效应来解决稀疏视角3DGS的过拟合问题。
ai_comments: 本研究创新性地从3D高斯基元的演化谱系（克隆与分裂起源）切入，指出了传统独立Dropout容易被同谱系近邻高斯基元补偿的根本缺陷，提出了从家族级到个体级的分阶段Dropout（SLD）与平衡致密化（LBD）机制。该思路兼顾了结构规范化与局部精细化，针对性强且逻辑严密。局限在于摘要未提及该机制对训练时间和显存开销的具体影响。
motivation: 稀疏视角下的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）因几何约束不足极易发生过拟合。现有的Dropout策略由于同源近邻高斯对被丢弃基元存在补偿效应，导致单独丢弃高斯的效果受到限制。
method: 引入由同一初始高斯克隆或分裂形成的“谱系家族”概念，提出：1）分阶段谱系感知Dropout（SLD），在结构正则化阶段以谱系家族为单位进行丢弃，在后期精细化阶段切换为独立高斯丢弃；2）谱系平衡致密化（LBD），构建扩展候选池并依据不同家族的平均梯度得分与已有后代规模动态重分配致密化预算。
results: 在LLFF、MipNeRF360以及Blender基准数据集上的实验结果表明，该框架在稀疏视角重建任务中取得了具有竞争力的性能。
conclusion: 论文提出了结合谱系感知Dropout与谱系平衡致密化的全新框架，有效克服了传统高斯Dropout中的补偿效应与过拟合问题，在稀疏视角3D重建任务中取得了优异表现。

title: VACO: Vertex-Aligned Decoding for Dense Hand Contact Estimation from a Single Image
authors: Binhong Ye, Jin-Chuan Shi, Tao Liu, Xin Wang, Hao Chen, Chunhua Shen
abstract: Dense hand contact estimation from a single RGB image is a foundational primitive for dexterous manipulation and 3D interaction analysis. Direct predictors typically decode the entire per-vertex contact map from one shared query, leaving individual vertices ungrounded in the image and smearing contact across adjacent, non-touching surfaces. We present VACO, a vertex-aligned decoder in which each MANO vertex samples local image features at its projected location. A hand-reconstruction backbone, jointly trained for reconstruction and contact, predicts these locations at inference without an auxiliary reconstructor. Training uses noise-perturbed ground-truth projections and end-to-end feature adaptation to improve robustness and contact-sensitive features. A single VACO checkpoint sets a new state of the art on five benchmarks spanning hand-object, hand-human, hand-scene, and bimanual interactions. It improves F1 by +20.7 pp over the strongest prior direct predictor on Hi4D and generalizes to the held-out HOT3D and HOCap, with gains of +5.5 and +2.7 pp. The resulting contact predictions also improve downstream HOI reconstruction.
zh_title: VACO：用于从单张图像中进行密集手部接触估计的顶点对齐解码
translation: 从单张RGB图像中进行密集手部接触估计是灵巧操作和3D交互分析的基础原语。直接预测器通常从一个共享查询解码整个逐顶点接触图，导致单个顶点在图像中未被定位，并使接触模糊到相邻的非接触表面上。我们提出了VACO，一个顶点对齐解码器，其中每个MANO顶点在其投影位置采样局部图像特征。一个手部重建骨干网络，经过重建和接触的联合训练，在推理时无需辅助重建器即可预测这些位置。训练使用噪声扰动的真实投影和端到端特征适应，以提高鲁棒性和接触敏感特征。一个VACO检查点在涵盖手-物体、手-人、手-场景和双手交互的五个基准测试中均创造了新的最先进水平。与之前最强的直接预测器相比，它在Hi4D上F1分数提高了+20.7个百分点，并泛化到未公开的HOT3D和HOCap，分别获得了+5.5和+2.7个百分点的提升。由此产生的接触预测也改进了下游的HOI重建。
tldr: VACO是一种顶点对齐解码器，通过让每个MANO顶点采样其投影位置的局部图像特征，实现了从单张RGB图像中对密集手部接触的精确估计，并在多个基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。
ai_comments: VACO的创新之处在于其顶点对齐解码机制，通过让每个MANO顶点直接采样其投影位置的局部图像特征，有效解决了传统直接预测器中顶点未对齐和接触模糊的问题。这种方法结合了联合训练的手部重建骨干网络，避免了对额外重建器的依赖，简化了流程。其在多个基准测试中显著超越现有技术的表现，以及对下游HOI重建的改进，都凸显了其重要性和实用价值。
motivation: 从单张RGB图像中估计密集手部接触是灵巧操作和3D交互分析的基础。现有直接预测器通常从单一共享查询解码整个逐顶点接触图，导致单个顶点在图像中缺乏定位，并将接触模糊到相邻的非接触表面上，因此需要更精确的方法。
method: 本文提出了VACO，一个顶点对齐解码器。VACO的每个MANO顶点都会在其投影位置采样局部图像特征。一个手部重建骨干网络，经过重建和接触的联合训练，在推理时无需辅助重建器即可预测这些位置。训练过程中使用了噪声扰动的真实投影和端到端特征适应来提高鲁棒性和接触敏感特征。
results: VACO在手-物体、手-人、手-场景和双手交互等五个基准测试中均创造了新的最先进水平。与之前最强的直接预测器相比，在Hi4D上F1分数提高了+20.7个百分点，并在未公开的HOT3D和HOCap上分别获得了+5.5和+2.7个百分点的提升。此外，由此产生的接触预测还改进了下游的HOI重建。
conclusion: VACO通过其顶点对齐解码方法，显著提高了从单张图像中进行密集手部接触估计的准确性和鲁棒性，并在多个关键基准测试中超越了现有技术，同时对下游任务也有积极影响。

title: Superfluid: Local AI Server for Distributed LLM Inference
authors: Prabod Rathnayaka, Isura Manchanayake, Srikandabala Kogul, Steve Siu, Fabian Waschkowski, Lukas Wesemann
abstract: Running large language models (LLMs) on local devices keeps data private, removes per-token cost, cuts network latency, and keeps working without a connection. Two shifts now strain how such models are served. On one device, several agents share a locally served model with an interactive user. Across devices, a developer or small team often owns several capable machines from different vendors, which sit idle most of the day because every local server serves one runtime on one machine. We present Superfluid, an open-source LLM server built for local inference at both scales. On one device, Superfluid drives llama.cpp, MLX, or BaseRT in isolated worker processes through one scheduler that moves interactive requests ahead of agent work, computes a prompt shared by many requests once, and writes every token to a durable log before it reaches the client. Across devices, one Superfluid server turns a fleet of machines into a single API endpoint. Machines with different hardware serve copies of the same model, receive work according to their measured speed, and can join or fail under load without losing a request. For Qwen3.8-27B on an Apple M5 Pro, a chat sent while eight agents are working receives its first token in 1.5 s, against 291-612 s on llama-server, Ollama, and mlx_lm.server. On six machines from three chip vendors serving 64 simulated users for one hour, Superfluid answers all 5,041 requests while machines join one at a time and one is killed and rejoins; throughput grows from 112 to 534 tok/s and the median first-token time falls from 99 to 12 s. On twelve Mac Studio M3 Ultras it sustains 10,656 tok/s across 38,563 requests from 384 agents without a failure. Superfluid is available under the Apache-2.0 licence at https://github.com/basecompute/superfluid.
zh_title: Superfluid: 分布式LLM推理的本地AI服务器
translation: 在本地设备上运行大型语言模型（LLMs）可以保护数据隐私，消除按token付费的成本，降低网络延迟，并能在没有连接的情况下继续工作。目前，两种转变正在对这些模型的服务方式构成压力。在单个设备上，多个代理与交互式用户共享一个本地服务模型。在设备之间，开发者或小型团队通常拥有多台来自不同供应商的强大机器，但这些机器大部分时间处于闲置状态，因为每个本地服务器只能在一台机器上运行一个运行时。我们提出了Superfluid，一个开源的LLM服务器，专为这两种规模的本地推理而构建。在单个设备上，Superfluid通过一个调度器在隔离的工作进程中驱动llama.cpp、MLX或BaseRT，该调度器将交互式请求置于代理工作之前，对许多请求共享的提示进行一次计算，并在每个token到达客户端之前将其写入持久日志。在设备之间，一个Superfluid服务器将多台机器整合成一个单一的API端点。具有不同硬件的机器服务相同模型的副本，根据其测量速度接收工作，并能在负载下加入或失败而不会丢失请求。对于Apple M5 Pro上的Qwen3.8-27B，当八个代理正在工作时，发送的聊天请求在1.5秒内收到第一个token，而llama-server、Ollama和mlx_lm.server则为291-612秒。在六台来自三个芯片供应商的机器上，为64个模拟用户提供一小时服务，Superfluid回答了所有5,041个请求，同时机器逐一加入，一台机器被杀死并重新加入；吞吐量从112 tok/s增长到534 tok/s，中位数首个token时间从99秒降至12秒。在十二台Mac Studio M3 Ultra上，它为384个代理的38,563个请求维持了10,656 tok/s的吞吐量，无任何故障。Superfluid在Apache-2.0许可下可用，网址为https://github.com/basecompute/superfluid。
tldr: Superfluid是一个开源的本地LLM服务器，旨在解决在单个设备上为多个代理提供服务以及跨多个异构设备进行分布式推理的效率问题，显著提高了性能和可靠性。
ai_comments: Superfluid的创新在于其双重优化策略，既解决了单设备上LLM服务的多任务冲突问题，又通过将异构设备集群化来提高分布式推理的效率和弹性。其性能提升数据非常显著，特别是与现有解决方案的对比，突显了其在本地LLM推理领域的潜在重要性。开源性质也利于社区采纳和进一步发展。
motivation: 在本地设备上运行大型语言模型（LLMs）面临两个主要挑战：1) 单个设备上，多个代理与交互式用户共享模型时效率低下；2) 开发者或小团队拥有多台来自不同供应商的机器，但每台本地服务器只能在一台机器上运行一个运行时，导致大部分时间设备闲置。
method: Superfluid是一个开源的LLM服务器，用于本地推理：1) 在单个设备上，它通过一个调度器在隔离的工作进程中驱动llama.cpp、MLX或BaseRT，优先处理交互式请求，对多个请求共享的提示进行一次计算，并将每个token写入持久日志。2) 跨设备时，一个Superfluid服务器将多台机器（即使硬件不同）整合成一个API端点，根据测量速度分配工作，并能在负载下加入或失败而不会丢失请求。
results: 1) 在Apple M5 Pro上，当八个代理工作时，Qwen3.8-27B的聊天请求收到第一个token的时间为1.5秒，而llama-server、Ollama和mlx_lm.server则为291-612秒。2) 在六台来自三个芯片供应商的机器上，为64个模拟用户提供一小时服务，Superfluid处理了所有5,041个请求，吞吐量从112 tok/s增长到534 tok/s，中位数首个token时间从99秒降至12秒。3) 在十二台Mac Studio M3 Ultra上，它为384个代理的38,563个请求维持了10,656 tok/s的吞吐量，无任何故障。
conclusion: Superfluid通过其创新的调度和分布式能力，显著提高了本地大型语言模型推理的效率、可靠性和性能，解决了单设备多代理和跨设备异构部署的挑战。

title: Graph Neural Network Prediction of Frequency Nadir and RoCoF Under Topology Variations
authors: Linhan Fang, Fan Jiang, Xingpeng Li
abstract: Accurate prediction of frequency dynamics under varying network topologies is essential for rapid frequency security assessment, whereas repeated electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulations are computationally intensive. This paper develops a topology-aware graph neural network with a radial basis function Kolmogorov-Arnold network (RBF-KAN) regression head, termed RK-GNN, to predict frequency nadir and maximum absolute rate of change of frequency (RoCoF). Scenarios combine load scaling, regional load redistribution, and generator redispatch with intact, N-1, and N-2 transmission topologies. After checks for network connectivity, generator reference limits, and numerical consistency, the retained scenarios are simulated in PSCAD to construct the reference dataset. The RK-GNN is evaluated against a conventional deep neural network (DNN) and a baseline GNN. On the IEEE 39-bus system, the RK-GNN reduces the mean absolute errors (MAEs) of nadir and RoCoF by 48% and 59% relative to the DNN and by 42% and 61% relative to the baseline GNN. Incorporating the bridge indicator and disturbance hop distance yields further MAE reductions of 27% and 54%. These results show that the proposed topology-aware architecture provides accurate prediction of both frequency metrics under varying topologies and substantially reduces the need for repeated EMT simulations.
zh_title: 基于图神经网络的拓扑变化下频率最低点与RoCoF预测
translation: 在网络拓扑变化下准确预测频率动态对于快速频率安全评估至关重要，而重复的电磁暂态（EMT）仿真计算密集。本文开发了一种拓扑感知图神经网络，并带有径向基函数柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络（RBF-KAN）回归头（称为RK-GNN），用于预测频率最低点（nadir）和最大绝对频率变化率（RoCoF）。场景结合了负荷缩放、区域负荷重新分配和发电机重新调度，并包含完整、N-1和N-2输电拓扑。在进行网络连通性、发电机参考限制和数值一致性检查后，保留的场景在PSCAD中进行仿真以构建参考数据集。RK-GNN与传统深度神经网络（DNN）和基线GNN进行了对比评估。在IEEE 39节点系统上，与DNN相比，RK-GNN将nadir和RoCoF的平均绝对误差（MAE）分别降低了48%和59%；与基线GNN相比，分别降低了42%和61%。结合桥接指标和扰动跳数距离可使MAE进一步降低27%和54%。这些结果表明，所提出的拓扑感知架构能够在各种拓扑下准确预测两个频率指标，并大幅减少对重复EMT仿真的需求。
tldr: 提出了一种基于图神经网络的RK-GNN模型，能够在电力系统拓扑变化时快速、准确地预测频率最低点与RoCoF，大幅减少了EMT仿真计算。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种结合图神经网络与RBF-KAN回归头的RK-GNN架构，用于在拓扑变化下快速准确地预测电力系统频率最低点（nadir）和最大频率变化率（RoCoF），显著降低了传统电磁暂态（EMT）仿真计算量。创新点在于拓扑感知设计以及引入桥接指标和扰动跳数距离。
motivation: 在不断变化的网架拓扑下准确预测频率动态对于快速频率安全评估至关重要，但传统的电磁暂态（EMT）仿真计算密集且耗时。
method: 开发了一种拓扑感知图神经网络（RK-GNN），带有径向基函数柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络（RBF-KAN）回归HEAD，并通过PSCAD仿真构建数据集进行评估。
results: 在IEEE 39节点系统上的测试表明，与传统深度神经网络（DNN）和基线GNN相比，RK-GNN将nadir和RoCoF的平均绝对误差（MAE）大幅降低，进一步引入桥接指标和扰动跳数距离后误差显著进一步减小。
conclusion: 研究所提出的拓扑感知RK-GNN架构能够准确预测不同拓扑下的频率动态指标，极大地减少了对重复电磁暂态仿真的依赖。

title: Convergence analysis of physics-informed neural networks for subdiffusion
authors: Bangti Jin, Qiqi Rao, Zhi Zhou
abstract: Physics-informed neural networks have emerged as mesh-free solvers for partial differential equations, yet their rigorous convergence theory for time-fractional problems remains limited. We present a convergence analysis of PINNs for linear subdiffusion equations and for the associated backward problem of recovering the initial data from terminal observations. To address the nonlocality and weakly singular kernels of fractional derivatives, we introduce a discretization-based PINN framework built on some popular time-stepping schemes satisfying discrete maximal regularity, including backward Euler, BDF2, L1, and fractional CN schemes. This approach avoids the exact evaluation of fractional derivatives at training points while preserving the stability structure needed for convergence analysis. For the forward problem, we prove that, under the natural fractional maximal-regularity condition $u\in W^{α,p}(0,T;L^2(Ω))\cap L^p(0,T;H^2(Ω)\cap H_0^1(Ω))$, the piecewise linear temporal reconstructions of PINN-loss minimizers converge to the exact solution. This result avoids the higher-order regularity assumptions on the exact solution that are often imposed in existing PINN convergence analyses. We also verify the required discrete maximal regularity and consistency properties for the aforementioned popular time discretizations. We then extend the analysis to the backward subdiffusion problem and establish convergence of the regularized recovery of the initial data from terminal observations, despite its ill-posedness. Numerical experiments for both forward and backward problems support the theoretical results, demonstrate the necessity of regularization, and show that $L^2$-type losses alone are generally insufficient. These results establish a rigorous theoretical basis for discretization-based PINNs for time-fractional diffusion problems.
zh_title: 次扩散问题物理信息神经网络的收敛性分析
translation: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）已作为偏微分方程的无网格求解器出现，然而其针对时间分数阶问题的严格收敛性理论仍然有限。本文对线性次扩散方程及从终端观测恢复初始数据的相关逆问题进行了PINN的收敛性分析。为了处理分数阶导数的非局域性和弱奇异核，我们引入了一个基于离散化的PINN框架，该框架建立在满足离散极大正则性的一些流行时间步进格式之上，包括后向欧拉、BDF2、L1和分数阶CN格式。该方法避免了在训练点精确计算分数阶导数，同时保持了收敛性分析所需的稳定性结构。对于正向问题，我们证明了在自然分数阶极大正则性条件 $u\in W^{\alpha,p}(0,T;L^2(\Omega))\cap L^p(0,T;H^2(\Omega)\cap H_0^1(\Omega))$ 下，PINN损失极小化子的分段线性时间重构收敛于精确解。这一结果避免了现有PINN收敛性分析中经常施加的对精确解的高阶正则性假设。我们还验证了上述流行时间离散化所需的离散极大正则性和相容性性质。随后，我们将分析扩展到反向次扩散问题，并尽管其具有不适定性，仍建立了从终端观测正则化恢复初始数据的收敛性。正向和反向问题的数值实验支持了理论结果，证明了正则化的必要性，并表明仅靠 $L^2$ 类型的损失通常是不够的。这些结果为时间分数阶扩散问题的基于离散化的PINN奠定了严密的理论基础。
tldr: 本文建立了物理信息神经网络求解时间分数阶次扩散方程的严格收敛性理论。
ai_comments: 该论文针对时间分数阶次扩散方程，填补了物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在理论收敛性分析上的空白。通过引入基于离散极大正则性的时间步进框架，成功避免了对解的高阶正则性假设，并将其扩展到了具有不适定性的反问题中，具有重要的理论和应用价值。
motivation: 尽管物理信息神经网络（PINNs）已被广泛用作偏微分方程的无网格求解器，但其针对时间分数阶问题的严格收敛性理论仍然非常有限，且现有分析往往对精确解有较高阶的正则性假设。
method: 引入了一个基于离散时间步进框架的离散化PINN方法，结合了后向欧拉、BDF2、L1和分数阶CN等格式，避免了对训练点处分数阶导数的精确求值，并利用极小化损失函数证明了解的收敛性。
results: 在自然的Нет分数阶极大正则性条件下，证明了前向问题中PINN损失极小化项的逐段线性时间重构能够收敛到精确解，并将分析成功扩展到了逆向次扩散问题的正则化初始数据恢复。
conclusion: 本文建立了基于离散的PINN方法求解正向和反向次扩散方程的严密收敛性理论，并通过数值实验验证了理论结果的正确性。

title: Efficient Genotype Classification from 3D MRI in ADPKD via Density-Aware Point Sampling and E(3)-invariance
authors: Kwanghee Lee, Hyeongsub Lee, Youngwoo Kim, Hyunji Jeong
abstract: Early detection of genetic kidney diseases, especially autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD), is crucial because certain genotypes such as truncating PKD1 mutations cause rapid kidney growth and early progression to end-stage kidney disease. MRI-based genotype inference is a potential low-cost complement to genetic testing. However, although many deep learning methods have been developed for classifying various MR images, applying them to ADPKD remains challenging: (1) abdominal MR images are generally too large to be handled by deep learning models designed for smaller images like brain MRI, and (2) the amount of labeled data for ADPKD genetic mutations is insufficient to train deep learning models. In order to address these challenges, we propose E3PN, an efficient 3D MRI-based ADPKD genotype classification network that relies on point sampling and E(3)-invariance. We utilize a point representation of 3D MRI, which consumes less GPU memory than a voxel representation. For further memory efficiency, 3D points are sampled from a mixture distribution over the two kidneys in each image. Since E(3)-invariance has been shown to improve data efficiency, we also incorporate it into our model through coordinate canonicalization. On our ADPKD dataset, E3PN trains 163 times faster and uses 103x less GPU memory than a 3D ResNet, while also improving F1 from 0.165 to 0.226 over both baselines. These results establish a first benchmark for five-way ADPKD genotype classification from 3D MRI and show that point sampling and coordinate canonicalization yield two-orders-of-magnitude efficiency gains with a modest but consistent improvement in F1.
zh_title: 基于密度感知点采样和E(3)不变性的ADPKD中3D MRI高效基因型分类
translation: 早期发现遗传性肾病，尤其是常染色体显性多囊肾病（ADPKD），至关重要，因为诸如截短性PKD1突变等特定基因型会导致肾脏快速生长并较早进展为终末期肾病。基于MRI的基因型推断是基因检测潜在的低成本补充。然而，尽管许多深度学习方法已被开发用于分类各种MR图像，将其应用于ADPKD仍然具有挑战性：（1）腹部MR图像通常太大，无法由设计用于较小图像（如脑部MRI）的深度学习模型处理，以及（2）ADPKD基因突变的标记数据量不足以训练深度学习模型。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了E3PN，这是一种依赖于点采样和E(3)不变的高效基于3D MRI的ADPKD基因型分类网络。我们利用3D MRI的点表示，它比体素表示消耗更少的GPU内存。为了获得更高的内存效率，3D点是从每个图像中两个肾脏的混合分布中采样出来的。由于E(3)不变性已被证明可以提高数据效率，我们还通过坐标规范化将其整合到我们的模型中。在我们的ADPKD数据集上，与3D ResNet相比，E3PN的训练速度快了163倍，使用的GPU内存减少了103倍，同时还将两个基线的F1分数从0.165提高到了0.226。这些结果为从3D MRI进行五分类ADPKD基因型分类建立了第一个基准，并表明点采样和坐标规范化产生了两个数量级的效率收益，同时F1分数有了适度但一致的改进。
keywords: 常染色体显性多囊肾病
tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的3D MRI基因型分类网络E3PN，利用点采样和E(3)不变性解决常染色体显性多囊肾病（ADPKD）分类中的计算内存大和数据少的问题，实现了两个数量级的效率提升和性能改善。
ai_comments: 该论文针对常染色体显性多囊肾病（ADPKD）基因型分类这一临床痛点，创新性地结合了点云表示、混合分布密度感知采样以及E(3)不变性（坐标规范化），在大幅度降低计算资源消耗的同时提升了分类性能，为3D医学图像的高效处理提供了优秀范例。
motivation: 常染色体显性多囊肾病（ADPKD）的早期基因型检测对预测病情发展至关重要，但传统的基于深度学习的MRI分类方法面临腹部MR图像尺寸过大、模型显存消耗高以及标记数据不足的挑战。
method: 提出E3PN网络，采用3D MRI的点表示法以减少GPU内存占用；通过对双肾混合分布进行点采样进一步提高内存效率；利用坐标规范化引入E(3)不变性以增强数据效率。
results: 在ADPKD数据集上，E3PN相比3D ResNet训练速度快163倍，GPU内存消耗减少103倍，F1分数从0.165提升至0.226，确立了五分类ADPKD基因型分类的首个基准。
conclusion: 本研究提出的E3PN网络通过密度感知点采样和E(3)不变性，成功解决了3D MRI在ADPKD基因型分类中面临的高内存消耗和少样本挑战，确立了该任务的首个基准。

title: Compiling Matrix Formulas to Quantum Block Encodings
authors: Daksh Shami, Charles Yuan
abstract:
Realizing the promise of quantum applications such as chemistry or fluid dynamics requires building quantum circuits that efficiently encode and manipulate exponentially large matrices. This process forces researchers to grapple with the reality that a matrix expressible as one equation on paper can map to thousands of bit-level quantum logic gates, historically written by hand. Even worse, it often ends with a discovery that the needed resources grow so quickly with matrix size that the quantum algorithm loses its asymptotic speedup.
  In this work, we present MARBLE, a language that automatically synthesizes an efficient circuit from the publication-style formula for the entries of a matrix. MARBLE algebraically rewrites programs into symbolic combinations of simpler matrices that have known circuit realizations. It analyzes costs of possible representations, notably the subnormalization term that dominates time complexity. It then emits an OpenQASM circuit and certifies whether its cost is poly-logarithmic in problem size, as required by quantum algorithms.
  When evaluated on quantum applications ranging from fluid dynamics to physical Hamiltonians, MARBLE matches or surpasses 37 of 39 published baselines. On the low end, it automatically matches many theoretically optimal circuits, and on the high end, it improves on a published construction in fluid dynamics by 10,487x in subnormalization. MARBLE produces exponentially smaller circuits than the leading tool FABLE, and it successfully compiles matrices whose dimensions exceed 2^100 within five seconds on a laptop.
zh_title: 将矩阵公式编译为量子块编码
translation:
实现诸如化学或流体力学等量子应用的承诺，需要构建能够高效编码和操作指数级大矩阵的量子电路。这一过程迫使研究人员面对这样一个现实：在纸上能用一个方程表达的矩阵，可能会映射到数千个按位计数的量子逻辑门，这些门历史上都是手工编写的。更糟糕的是，人们往往最后才发现，所需的资源随着矩阵规模的增长如此之快，以至于量子算法失去了渐近加速。
