Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative models in terms of reconstruction accuracy, structural consistency, and distributional realism.
zh_title: Vessel2Brain：基于血管掩码的3D脑图像生成的边缘感知多尺度流匹配
translation: 从稀疏解剖先验生成逼真的3D脑部MRI体积是一个高度不适定但临床价值巨大的问题，在数据 augmentation、模拟和下游神经影像分析中具有重要应用。在这项工作中，我们研究了仅以血管标签图为条件的完整3D脑部MRI体积合成这一具有挑战性的任务。虽然血管结构提供了强烈的解剖学和拓扑学线索，但它们仅占脑体积的一小部分，并未直接提供关于周围组织外观的信息。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了Vessel2Brain，这是一个边缘感知多尺度条件流匹配框架，它明确将血管结构信息纳入生成过程。我们的方法将血管引导的脑图像合成公式化为条件连续流，实现稳定的训练和灵活的生成，同时保持结构对应关系。引入了多尺度流匹配策略，以联合建模全球解剖相干性和细粒度局部细节，辅助速度预测跨空间分辨率提供额外的监督。此外，我们设计了一个边缘感知目标函数，在训练期间强调血管边界，鼓励围绕血管结构进行解剖学上真实的组织合成。我们在两个带有配对血管注释的公开3D脑MRI数据集上评估了Vessel2Brain。广泛的定量和定性实验表明，我们的方法在重建精度、结构一致性和分布真实性方面 consistently 优于最先进的生成模型。
tldr: 本文提出了Vessel2Brain，一种能够仅根据稀疏血管掩码高质量生成3D脑部MRI的边缘感知多尺度流匹配方法。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种基于血管掩码生成3D脑部MRI的边缘感知多尺度流匹配框架，有效解决血管结构稀疏与周围组织复杂性之间的信息不对称问题，在医学图像生成和增强方面具有重要应用价值。
motivation: 从稀疏的血管掩码生成现实的3D脑部MRI体积是一个高度不适定但临床价值很高的问题，因为血管结构仅占脑体积的一小部分且不包含周围组织的直接外观信息，现有方法难以准确捕捉这种复杂的对应关系。
method: 提出Vessel2Brain框架，采用边缘感知、多尺度条件流匹配方法，将血管结构信息显式融入生成过程，利用辅助速度预测和边缘感知目标函数确保全局解剖连贯性和局部细节准确性。
results: 在两个包含配对血管注释的公开3D脑MRI数据集上的实验表明，该方法在重建准确性、结构一致性和分布真实性方面均持续优于最先进的生成模型。
conclusion: Vessel2Brain方法通过结合条件连续流匹配、多尺度建模和边缘感知目标函数，能够从稀疏的血管掩码中高质量地合成真实且结构一致的3D脑部MRI图像，优于现有最先进的生成模型。

title: TIDE: Reclaiming Lost Performance In On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
authors: Mathew Jacob, Morgan Borjigin-Wang, Kan Zhu, Po Hao Chen, Yi Pan, Andy Ruan, Nayani Modugula, Ethan Lavi, Luis Ceze, Malte Schwarzkopf, Akshay Narayan, Deepti Raghavan, Stephanie Wang
abstract: Synchronous, colocated RL post-training of large language models (LLMs) today suffers from severe under-utilization due to long-tail rollouts. Inference engines fall idle waiting for long-tail rollouts or decode at low, inefficient batch sizes. To address this, we present TIDE, an RL training system that preserves on-policy training semantics while recovering resource utilization. TIDE does so by two complementary techniques: (1) dynamically repurposing rollout GPUs for training while long-tail rollouts complete and (2) dynamically migrating rollouts between inference engines to boost decoding throughput. TIDE automatically determines the right time to repurpose rollout resources through an adaptive migration policy, obtaining performance improvements that generalize across multiple applications and hardware configurations without requiring bespoke configuration. In our evaluation, TIDE provides end-to-end speedups of up to 1.36x over colocated systems, outperforming all evaluated on-policy baselines and achieving up to 97% of optimal throughput.

title: When Cooperation Must Change: Semantic Strategy Unlearning in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors: Wenhan Wu, Linghan Chen, Yudong Gao, Fan Yang, Honglong Chen, Kai Yin, Jiawei Jiang, Chuang Hu
abstract: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) supports coordinated decision-making in distributed Web services, multi-robot control, and collaborative games through learned coordination conventions. When deployment requirements change, a previously useful convention may become obsolete or unsafe. For example, revised cache-sharing permissions in Web content delivery may require caches to abandon a learned division of storage and serving roles while maintaining efficient delivery. Teams must therefore remove the specified convention while preserving useful cooperation. This is challenging because the same relational pattern can be reproduced by different agents across different histories. Runtime shielding leaves the underlying coordination preference intact and can impair task progress, while existing reinforcement unlearning and trajectory-deletion methods do not directly target role-invariant conventions. This paper formalizes this problem as semantic coordination-strategy unlearning and proposes CARVE.CARVE uses causal coordination attribution to identify influential interactions and retain-aware subspace updates to limit interference with unrelated behaviors. Counterfactual re-coordination helps agents learn productive alternatives, while adversarial auditing tests whether the target convention can still be recovered. Accepted updates are merged into decentralized actors for direct deployment. Evaluation across five cooperative MARL benchmarks shows that CARVE reduces mean nominal convention-completion and worst-case elicitation rates by 91.4\% and 83.3\%, respectively.The median utility loss is 5.9\%, and measured inference latency matches that of the original policies.
zh_title: 当合作必须改变时：多智能体强化学习中的语义策略遗忘
translation: 合作性多智能体强化学习（MARL）通过学习到的协调约定，支持分布式Web服务、多机器人控制和协作游戏中的协调决策。当部署要求改变时，之前有用的约定可能会变得过时或不安全。例如，Web内容交付中修订的缓存共享权限可能要求缓存放弃学习到的存储和服务角色划分，同时保持高效交付。因此，团队必须移除指定的约定，同时保留有用的合作。这具有挑战性，因为相同的关系模式可以由不同智能体在不同历史中重现。运行时屏蔽保留了潜在的协调偏好，并可能损害任务进展，而现有的强化遗忘和轨迹删除方法不直接针对角色不变的约定。本文将此问题形式化为语义协调策略遗忘，并提出了CARVE。CARVE利用因果协调归因来识别有影响力的交互，并使用保留感知子空间更新来限制对无关行为的干扰。反事实再协调帮助智能体学习有成效的替代方案，而对抗性审计则测试目标约定是否仍可恢复。接受的更新会合并到去中心化智能体中进行直接部署。在五个合作性MARL基准测试中，评估表明CARVE将平均名义约定完成率和最坏情况下的引发率分别降低了91.4%和83.3%。中位数效用损失为5.9%，测得的推理延迟与原始策略一致。
tldr: 本文提出了CARVE，一种用于多智能体强化学习中语义协调策略遗忘的方法，旨在移除过时或不安全的合作约定，同时保留有用的合作。
ai_comments: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法CARVE，用于解决多智能体强化学习中语义协调策略遗忘的挑战，这在现实世界的动态环境中具有重要意义。其创新之处在于将问题形式化为语义遗忘，并结合了因果归因、子空间更新、反事实学习和对抗性审计等多种技术，以确保有效移除目标约定同时最小化对其他有用行为的干扰。该方法在实际应用中具有潜力，尤其是在需要灵活调整智能体合作行为的场景中。一个潜在的局限性可能是其复杂性以及在更大规模或更复杂任务中的可扩展性。
motivation: 在多智能体强化学习中，当部署要求改变时，之前有用的合作约定可能会变得过时或不安全。现有的方法无法直接针对角色不变的约定进行遗忘，同时保留有用的合作。
method: 本文将问题形式化为语义协调策略遗忘，并提出了CARVE。CARVE利用因果协调归因来识别有影响力的交互，并使用保留感知子空间更新来限制对无关行为的干扰。反事实再协调帮助智能体学习有成效的替代方案，而对抗性审计则测试目标约定是否仍可恢复。接受的更新会合并到去中心化智能体中进行直接部署。
results: 在五个合作性MARL基准测试中，CARVE将平均名义约定完成率和最坏情况下的引发率分别降低了91.4%和83.3%。中位数效用损失为5.9%，测得的推理延迟与原始策略一致。
conclusion: CARVE能够有效地移除多智能体强化学习中过时或不安全的语义协调策略，同时保持了高效的合作并具有可接受的性能开销。

title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Scientific Paper Search: Retrieval Success and Inference Latency on Mac Studio and NVIDIA A100
authors: Frederic Andriantseheno Rakoto, Yannis Bendi-Ouis, Xavier Hinaut
abstract: Scientific literature search can benefit from locally deployed LLM assistants, which reduce reliance on hosted model providers while giving research teams greater control over their data and infrastructure. This work investigates whether open-weight models can support web-assisted paper retrieval under practical computing constraints. We first characterize inference latency as the input context grows from 512 to 128k tokens on a Mac Studio and a server equipped with two NVIDIA A100 GPUs. We then evaluate eight models on the retrieval of 70 papers from seven scientific repositories, using queries that represent three levels of domain knowledge. The results show that retrieval success depends strongly on the selected model and the specificity of the query. And that A100 GPUs are generally faster than the Mac Studio, but its unified memory allows larger models that could not be loaded in the tested GPU configuration.

title: RecMem: Recurrent Memory Compression for Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation
authors: Haoyi Hu, Gaoyang Guo, Yunjia Xi, Wen Chen, Weiwen Liu, Jian Wu, Yuning Jiang, Weinan Zhang
abstract: Generative recommendation benefits from long interaction histories, but the cost of processing them directly grows with history length. We propose RecMem, a recurrent memory compression framework guided by three desiderata: space invariance, semantic fidelity, and lifelong evolvability. RecMem compresses historical segments into a fixed set of memory slots using a bifurcated encoder-decoder with shared lower layers and slot-wise forget-gated updates. Recommendation supervision trains the memory to preserve predictive information, while stream-consistency training aligns predictions from sequential and packed processing. By construction, the memory state and decoder context are independent of history length; under contraction and approximate semigroup consistency, we further derive a horizon-independent bound on the state discrepancy between these two processing orders. On MerRec, RecMem uses 16 memory slots and a 216-token decoder context, compared with 1,200 tokens for HSTU-1200, while retaining 87.9% of HSTU-1200's Recall@10 and 97.0% of its Recall@200. It outperforms PHSTU and the evaluated recent-only and retrieval baselines, and analyses of distant history show that archived interactions contribute predictive signal.
zh_title: 循环记忆：长序列推荐的循环记忆压缩
translation: 生成推荐受益于长交互历史，但直接处理它们的成本随着历史长度的增加而增加。我们提出了RecMem，一个由三个基本要求指导的循环记忆压缩框架：空间不变性、语义保真度和终身可演化性。RecMem使用一个分层的编码器-解码器来压缩历史片段到一个固定的记忆槽集合，该编码器-解码器具有共享的底层和分槽遗忘门更新。推荐监督训练记忆以保留预测信息，而流一致性训练则使顺序处理和打包处理的预测保持一致。根据构造，记忆状态和解码器上下文与历史长度无关；在收缩和近似半群一致性下，我们进一步推导了这两种处理顺序之间状态差异的有界性，该界限与历史长度无关。在MerRec上，RecMem使用16个记忆槽和216个token的解码器上下文，而HSTU-1200使用1200个token，同时保留了HSTU-1200的召回率@10的87.9%和召回率@200的97.0%。它优于PHSTU以及经过评估的仅最近和检索基线，并且对远程历史的分析表明，存档的交互贡献了预测信号。
tldr: RecMem是一种循环记忆压缩框架，通过固定数量的记忆槽和分层编码器-解码器来处理长序列推荐，有效减少了计算成本，同时保持了推荐性能。
ai_comments: 该方法在处理长序列推荐方面具有创新性，通过记忆压缩技术有效平衡了性能和效率。空间不变性、语义保真度和终身可演化性的设计原则为后续研究提供了理论指导。然而，对于“终身可演化性”的具体实现机制和长期效果仍需进一步的实验验证。
motivation: 直接处理长交互历史在生成推荐中成本高昂，需要一种有效的方法来压缩历史信息。
method: RecMem采用分层编码器-解码器，利用共享底层和分槽遗忘门更新来压缩历史片段到固定数量的记忆槽。通过推荐监督和流一致性训练来优化记忆，使其保留预测信息并对齐不同处理顺序的预测。
results: 在MerRec数据集上，RecMem使用16个记忆槽和216个token的解码器上下文，相比HSTU-1200的1200个token，召回率@10保持了87.9%，召回率@200保持了97.0%。优于其他基线方法，并且分析表明存档的交互对预测有贡献。
conclusion: RecMem通过记忆压缩有效解决了长序列推荐的成本问题，在保持高性能的同时显著降低了计算需求。

title: What Balanced Accuracy Cannot Identify in Neural-Signal Decoding under Test-Time Adaptation
authors: Jiangshuo Xie, Zonghan Wu
abstract: Adaptation for neural-signal classification is usually transductive: each batch is scored after updating on it, and the gain depends on the adapted model [4]. This paper asks what an aggregate change fails to characterise inside the cohort. Full test-time adaptation (full_ttt) was evaluated in 11 dataset-encoder cells (four each on Siena/EEG and PTB-XL/ECG, three on Sleep-EDF/EEG), with splits and source-model evaluation fixed; the subject was the unit, exact sign tests were Holm-corrected and conditional on the shared stream, and bootstrap intervals accompanied a dependence audit. Two results of different kinds follow. In the binary case balanced accuracy gives a one-class decoder the same value as one reporting both classes at 50%, so the aggregate cannot identify a class that stopped being reported; a class covering a tenth of a subject's samples went unpredicted in 26-47 of 112 subject-cells, against 7-9 for the controls, which is a descriptive count. With cohort, split and update rule fixed, the within-subject class contrast follows the encoder, tested directly rather than inferred from tests against zero: two of six Siena encoder pairs survive the dependence readings at their nominal reference and one at a fold-level reference, while two of ten Sleep-EDF stage pairs pass the run-clustered gate at its nominal reference; aggregate and contrast named different encoders in 10 of 11. The protocol bounds both results, since a stream-interleaving effect reverses sign with state sharing (+3.5 to -2.4 pp). An aggregate score can hide individual harm, as [1] showed, but it cannot distinguish a uniform loss from a deleted class; class-level change should therefore be reported alongside the aggregate and subject-level change alongside it, with both results conditional on the cell, the rule and the stream construction.

title: OutfitterBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Resource Allocation and Commitment Coordination
authors: Jie Huang, Yuecheng Hong, Yao Chen, Shengding Jiao, Xudong Liu, Qiang Ye
abstract: In many long-horizon settings, an agent's own choices create future constraints: committing finite capacity establishes future obligations and forecloses later opportunities. Sustaining performance therefore requires both keeping evolving plans feasible and comparing the value of resource allocations with the alternatives they displace. Recent benchmarks increasingly evaluate LLM agents in continuing operations, but give less attention to how agents keep their own commitments feasible while reassessing resource allocations as opportunities change. We introduce OutfitterBench, where agents manage an outdoor-equipment rental business for 200 days, purchasing from a 46-product catalog and handling roughly 1,100 reservation requests. Under a fixed capital ceiling, reservations and uncertain walk-in demand compete for reusable equipment whose availability changes over time. Experiments with seven frontier LLMs show that several agents underperform a simple rule-based baseline, while only the leading agent consistently surpasses it. Trajectory analysis shows that some agents apply known constraints inconsistently and make new decisions that conflict with existing commitments. Agents with more reliable fulfillment can still secure low returns from comparable commitments or delay resource reallocation. The leading agent better connects preparation with economic choices but also misses opportunities for more profitable asset use. These findings highlight limitations in sustaining coherent resource plans and reassessing their value over time. The benchmark code is publicly available at https://github.com/adminblackjack/OutfitterBench.

title: MineralExp: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Experimental Design in Real-World Mineral Exploration
authors: Bing Wang, Mingyang Wang, Yuanhang Mi, Yue Xu, Kaibo Su, Li'ang Xiao, Chunguo Wu, Changchun Li, Ximing Li, Kun-Feng Qiu, Bo Yang
abstract: In mineral exploration, verifying geological hypotheses relies on designing a variety of geochemical experiments. While large language model (LLM) agents increasingly automate downstream geoscientific data analysis, a crucial upstream capability remains largely unexplored: automated geochemical experimental design, i.e., deciding which experiments to conduct before committing to costly laboratory work. Evaluating this capability of LLM agents is difficult for two reasons. First, geochemical experiments exhibit high methodological diversity and subjectivity: to test the same hypothesis, different geologists may choose different minerals and instruments, so no single protocol can serve as the reference answer. Second, open-ended experimental plans resist representation as structured labels, which makes objective scoring difficult. To address these challenges, we introduce MineralExp, a benchmark that reformulates geochemical experimental design as a hypothesis-based experiment selection problem, i.e., a multi-label classification problem. We abstract concrete instrument names and procedural details into a shared taxonomy of 19 experimental types across five mineral-system processes: Source, Transport, Deposition, Modification, and Preservation. This taxonomy yields deterministic multi-label targets while accommodating diverse experimental protocols. Constructed from published ore-deposit literature and verified by domain experts, MineralExp comprises 277 cases and 1,572 reference experimental plans. Given a geological hypothesis and initial context, an LLM agent selects the relevant tasks and generates concrete experimental plans, which are scored by multi-label classification metrics and an LLM-as-a-Judge metric. The experimental results show that current agents generally achieve high recall but low precision, tending to propose more experiments than are necessary to test the hypothesis.

title: Token2Tile: Token-Wise Sparse Attention with Tile Execution through a Low-Rank Space for Video DiTs
authors: Xuecheng Wu, Aichen Feng, Jinyan Chen, Qingjie Zhao, Julien Lai
abstract: Attention is essential for modeling spatio-temporal dependencies in video diffusion transformers, but its quadratic cost makes it a major inference bottleneck. Its high sparsity offers an opportunity to accelerate generation by focusing computation on important interactions. However, accuracy and execution favor different granularities: each query attends to its own key tokens, whereas GPU kernels work on tiles. We present Token2Tile, a training-free sparse attention operator that combines per-query scoring and a per-query residual with tile execution. An online low-rank space, computed directly from queries and keys to preserve attention logits, makes clustering, scoring, and residual approximation efficient. Token2Tile unites query-specific selections to allocate exact work across query clusters, then packs the selected keys into GPU tiles. On MiniMax-H3 and Wan2.1-14B, Token2Tile delivers 1.48-1.54x end-to-end speedup over dense FlashAttention-3 with VBench scores within 0.5 points of dense. At comparable speeds on H3, it improves PSNR over SOL and SubBlock by 5.5-6.8 dB; on Wan, it exceeds SOL by 4.6-4.8 dB while running faster.

title: Tracing Actual Causes with Counterfactual Witness Maps
authors: Tim Woydt, Matej Zečević, Kristian Kersting, Moritz Willig
abstract: Halpernian actual causation, the formal study of which events in a specific situation caused a specific outcome in acyclic structural causal models, underpins legal responsibility, moral blame, and the assessment of causal harm. Despite the rich logical framework, no prior sound and complete enumeration procedure is known for finding all actual causes in a given setting, blocking downstream tasks such as responsibility attribution, blame assessment, and causal-harm grading that aggregate over the full cause set. We close this gap by introducing witness targets: sets of joint configurations containing every counterfactual witness. In combination with an ancestor intervention grammar we derive a finite directed acyclic witness map. We prove that for every actual cause there exists a contingency set such that the joint intervention set appears as a node of this map, and present an algorithm for Tracing Actual Causes (TrAC) that is sound and complete for enumerating all actual causes of any target event. We compare TrAC empirically with existing single-cause baselines on random Boolean structural causal models, demonstrating practical feasibility for graphs of up to 15 nodes.

title: Measured from the feed: the unsustainable growth of AI video generation
authors: Tristan Coignion, Aurélie Bugeau, Gael Guennebaud, Anne-Laure Ligozat
abstract: Text-to-video generation runs at commercial scale, but its broader environmental impacts remain, to our knowledge, understudied. Providers rarely disclose video volumes or energy needs; we measured the yearly video output of two commercial platforms and built a prospective model of such services' absolute footprint from training to storage. Our projections suggest that reducing emissions depends on both limiting growth in video generation and achieving substantial efficiency gains. Under continued growth, emissions rise nearly seventy-five-fold by 2030 despite technological improvements. When usage remains at 2026 levels, the same improvements reduce emissions by about two-fifths. These estimates are a conservative lower bound: they cover one AI service among many; other services and uses would push the total higher.
comment: Main paper + Supplementary paper Under submission at a journal

title: Differentially Private Federated Class-Incremental Learning for EEG Mental State Classification
authors: Baran Can Gül, Ali Gülümser, Nasser Jazdi, Michael Weyrich
abstract: Federated learning (FL) under differential privacy (DP) is typically evaluated on large client cohorts, where subsampling and cross-client averaging amplify privacy and smooth injected noise. Personal biosignal applications such as wearable EEG instead involve small federations of a handful of subjects, a regime whose interaction with formal client-level DP is largely uncharacterized. We study differentially private federated class-incremental learning in this small-cohort regime, combining a public EEG dataset with a custom four-channel MUSE 2 recording set into a K=5-client federation, and give a masked per-class training protocol that avoids degenerate gradients and missing negative supervision under class-incremental streaming. We propose FedEEG, combining Synaptic-Intelligence consolidation with a lagged adaptive FedProx term, and show it reduces catastrophic forgetting relative to FedAvg, FedProx, and a federated Learning-without-Forgetting baseline; on-device balanced-batch replay reduces mean forgetting by a further 56.7%. A class-scoping diagnosis yields $50.5\%\pm3.6\%$ accuracy with 6 seeds and 2.02 times chance. We also introduce head-scoped client-level DP, which protects the classification head and alone reduces the achievable $\varepsilon$ by 200 times at a matched round budget; combined with fewer communication rounds it reaches $\varepsilon\!\approx\!10.4$ with utility not statistically distinguishable from non-private training.

title: Can You Trust Your Finance Agent? Drift, Diagnosis and Auditable Intervention on One Shipped Financial Research Agent
authors: Cosimo Galeone, Anna Ettorre, Ginevra Mariani, Minsu Park, Giuseppe Ettorre, Daniele Ligorio
abstract: Can you trust a finance agent you did not build? We take the reference agent shipped with the Vals Finance Agent Benchmark v2, leave it untuned, and ask four questions a leaderboard score does not answer. Is the score stable? Seven identical runs on 18 questions pass between 105 and 123 of 149 rubric criteria, and the bill varies by up to 17%. When the agent fails, who owns the fix? We classify 20 failed trajectories, from three runs of nine held-out questions, by the layer whose owner would remedy them, under a taxonomy frozen in advance: 13 belong to the agent's instructions, 3 to its tools, 4 to the model, none to its data. Can that diagnosis be trusted? Four blind readers from three model families, given only the traces, name the same fault as our LLM analyzer in 94% of cases, the rate at which they agree with one another (93%). Can a change be trusted? An optimization loop reads the traces, makes one targeted change per round and keeps it only if it clears a fixed threshold. Under a cost objective its final configuration costs 0.34x the baseline on the held-out questions (95% CI [0.22, 0.58]) at accuracy within noise. Under an accuracy objective it gains 14 points on the development questions and 1.5 on the held-out ones (CI [-5.3, +7.2]). Judged against the measured run-to-run noise, under a rule written before the test was opened, the first is a real saving and the second is not. This is a case study of one agent and nine test questions, not a general result.
comment: 9 pages. Accepted as an oral presentation at the AI4F workshop, ICAIF 2026, Milan

title: A narrow band method for non-causal discretizations of anisotropic eikonal equations, with adaptive width, sub-and super-solution construction, and quasi-linear complexity
authors: Jean-Marie Mirebeau, Yanis Mouheb
abstract: We describe a narrow band method for numerically solving anisotropic eikonal equations, and more generally static first order Hamilton-Jacobi equations with possibly non-convex Hamiltonians, discretized using standard schemes (semi-Lagrangian, upwind-differences, Lax-Friedrichs). The causality property is not needed, in contrast with the fast marching method. The proposed approach simultaneously builds a numerical sub-solution u and super-solution u to the problem, and adapts the width of the narrow band based on their comparison. We prove that (1 + $ε$)u $\ge$ u at termination, where $ε$ > 0 is any given tolerance parameter, and that the worst case complexity is O(N | ln $ε$| ln(N/$ε$)), where N denotes the number of discretization points, and the underlying constant is explicit in terms of those associated with the scheme properties. Numerical experiments illustrate our results.
zh_title: 各向异性程函方程非因果离散化的窄带方法：具有自适应宽度、次解与超解构造及拟线性复杂度
translation: 我们介绍了一种用于数值求解各向异性程函方程、以及更一般的具有可能非凸哈密顿量的静态一阶Hamilton-Jacobi方程的窄带方法，这些方程采用标准格式（半拉格朗日格式、迎风差分格式、Lax-Friedrichs格式）进行离散化。与快速步进法不同，该方法不需要因果性性质。所提出的方法在求解问题时能够同时构建数值次解与超解，并根据它们的对比来自适应调整窄带的宽度。我们证明了在终止时满足 (1 + ε)u_sub ≥ u_super（其中 ε > 0 为任意给定的容差参数），且最坏情况下的复杂度为 O(N |ln ε| ln(N/ε))，其中 N 表示离散点数，隐藏常数可通过离散格式特性的相关常数显式表示。数值实验验证了我们的结论。
tldr: 提出了一种无需因果性假设的自适应窄带算法，用于求解各向异性程函方程的标准离散化问题，具备拟线性复杂度并能同时构建次解与超解。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新之处在于突破了传统快速步进法（Fast Marching）对因果性性质的依赖，使得算法能够适用于更广泛的标准离散化格式与可能非凸的哈密顿量。同时，通过构造次解与超解实现窄带宽度的自适应控制，并在理论上严格证明了具有准线性（quasi-linear）复杂度界。局限性在于摘要未详述算法常数在极端各向异性条件下的具体表现及高维扩展性能。
motivation: 传统的快速步进法高度依赖因果性（causality），难以直接应用于采用非因果离散化或具有非凸哈密顿量的各向异性程函方程及静态一阶Hamilton-Jacobi方程。
method: 提出一种不需要因果性假设的窄带方法，适用于半拉格朗日、迎风差分和Lax-Friedrichs等标准离散格式；同时构造数值次解与超解，并依据两者的对比自适应调整窄带的宽度。
results: 理论证明了算法终止时数值次解与超解满足 (1 + ε)u_sub ≥ u_super（ε > 0为容差参数），最坏情况计算复杂度为 O(N |ln ε| ln(N/ε))（N为离散点数），且相关常数可由离散格式性质显式给出；数值实验验证了所得理论结果。
conclusion: 该方法成功为各向异性程函方程及静态一阶Hamilton-Jacobi方程的非因果离散化提供了一种高效、可靠且具拟线性复杂度的自适应窄带求解框架。

title: The Transformer Paradigm: Dynamic Processing and a New Principle of Inference
authors: Marco Giunti, Fabrizia Giulia Garavaglia
abstract: We argue that the Transformer revolution is not adequately understood as a merely quantitative expansion of deep learning, but as the emergence of a new paradigm based on a different principle of inference. We interpret the Transformer as a system in which token representations are transformed by parameterized transformations, or transforming concepts. During inference, some of these transformations are dynamically constructed from the current input: previously acquired transformations are first adapted and then applied. At the mechanical-structural level, this dynamic processing is realized through output-weight interconnections, whereby outputs of some networks determine the weights of others. The resulting mode of processing, which we call Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing (SIDPP), provides a framework for explaining strong prompt sensitivity and opens research directions concerning interpretability, control, alternative AI architectures, neuromorphic systems, and possible biological realizations of dynamic processing.
zh_title: Transformer范式：动态处理与一种新的推理原则
translation: 我们认为，Transformer的革命不能仅仅理解为深度学习的量化扩展，而是基于一种不同推理原则的新范式的出现。我们将Transformer解释为一个系统，其中标记（token）表示通过参数化转换（或称转换概念）进行变换。在推理过程中，其中一些转换是根据当前输入动态构建的：首先调整先前获取的转换，然后再应用它们。在机械-结构层面上，这种动态处理是通过输出-权重互联实现的，即某些网络的输出决定了其他网络的权重。由此产生的处理模式被称为序列级交互式动态并行处理（SIDPP），它为解释强提示敏感性提供了框架，并开启了关于可解释性、控制、替代AI架构、神经形态系统以及动态处理可能的生物学实现的研究方向。
tldr: Transformer不仅是深度学习的量化扩展，而是一种基于输入动态调整转换的全新推理范式（SIDPP），解释了其强大的提示敏感性并开启了新的研究方向。
ai_comments: 本文从全新的哲学与计算范式高度审视了Transformer架构，指出其核心在于输入驱动的动态权重生成，并提出了SIDPP概念，对理解当前大模型及未来神经形态计算具有重要启发意义。
motivation: 作者认为Transformer革命不能简单地被视为深度学习的量化扩展，而是基于一种全新推理原则的新范式，需要一种理论框架来解释其动态处理机制及强提示敏感性。
method: 从机械-结构层面解释Transformer的运作机制，指出其通过输出-权重互联（output-weight interconnections）实现动态处理，并将这种模式命名为序列级交互式动态并行处理（SIDPP）。
results: 提出了“序列级交互式动态并行处理”（SIDPP）框架，能够解释Transformer的强提示敏感性，并为可解释性、控制、替代AI架构及神经形态系统指明了新的研究方向。
conclusion: Transformer代表了一种超越传统深度学习的、基于输入动态构建和应用转换的新推理范式，为理解和改进AI架构提供了统一的理论框架。

title: Domain Adaptation Based Pipeline for Character Classification and Handwritten Text Recognition
authors: Florent Imbert, Simon Corbillé, Hui Han, Elisa H. Barney Smith
abstract: Character classification and handwritten text recognition, particularly in specialized tasks, often suffer from limited labeled data, while a large amount of unlabeled data remains unused. To address this challenge, we propose a novel unsupervised domain adaptation-based pipeline to reduce the distribution gap between source and target domains. Our pipeline follows three main steps. In the first step, we pretrained an expert model on source data, to learn a strong general representation. In the second step, we perform unsupervised domain adaptation to leverage unlabeled target data, adapting the model to the specific characteristics of the target domain. In the third step, we trained the expert model on source data in the target style. By aligning the feature distributions between the source and target, our method enables the model to generalize effectively across diverse datasets. The unsupervised training increases the computation time only during training not in inference. We evaluate the pipeline on both character-level and historical handwritten line recognition tasks, demonstrating its flexibility. We establish a new state-of-the-art on the Safran-MNIST-DLS dataset defined in Track 2 of the DAGECC competition with 76.17% Macro F1-score and achieve competitive results on each of the specific datasets of READ 2018 without using the labels of the target data. Code is available at https://github.com/simon-corbi/DRANet-for-classification-and-htr
zh_title: 基于域适应的字符分类和手写文本识别流程
translation: 字符分类和手写文本识别，特别是在专业任务中，常常面临标记数据有限而大量未标记数据未被利用的问题。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的基于无监督域适应的流程，以减少源域和目标域之间的分布差距。我们的流程遵循三个主要步骤。在第一步中，我们在源数据上预训练了一个专家模型，以学习强大的通用表示。在第二步中，我们执行无监督域适应，以利用未标记的目标数据，使模型适应目标域的特定特征。在第三步中，我们在目标风格的源数据上训练了专家模型。通过对齐源域和目标域之间的特征分布，我们的方法使模型能够有效地泛化到不同的数据集。无监督训练只在训练期间增加计算时间，而不在推理期间增加。我们在字符级和历史手写线识别任务上评估了该流程，展示了其灵活性。我们在DAGECC竞赛Track 2定义的Safran-MNIST-DLS数据集上建立了新的最先进水平，Macro F1分数为76.17%，并在不使用目标数据标签的情况下，在READ 2018的各个特定数据集上取得了有竞争力的结果。代码可在https://github.com/simon-corbi/DRANet-for-classification-and-htr 获取。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于无监督域适应的流程，用于在标记数据有限的情况下，进行字符分类和手写文本识别，并取得了最先进的结果。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个三步走的无监督域适应流程，有效解决了专业手写文本识别任务中标记数据不足的挑战。通过利用大量未标记数据进行域适应，显著提升了模型在不同数据集上的泛化能力，并在多个基准测试中取得了最先进或有竞争力的结果，证明了其重要性。一个潜在的限制是无监督训练会增加训练时间，尽管推理时间不受影响。
motivation: 字符分类和手写文本识别，特别是在专业任务中，常面临标记数据有限而大量未标记数据未被利用的挑战。
method: 本文提出了一种新颖的无监督域适应流程，旨在减少源域和目标域之间的分布差距。该流程分为三个主要步骤：首先，在源数据上预训练一个专家模型以学习强大的通用表示；其次，进行无监督域适应以利用未标记的目标数据，使模型适应目标域的特定特征；最后，在目标风格的源数据上训练专家模型。通过对齐源域和目标域之间的特征分布，使模型能够有效地泛化到不同数据集。
results: 该流程在字符级和历史手写线识别任务上进行了评估，并展示了其灵活性。在DAGECC竞赛Track 2定义的Safran-MNIST-DLS数据集上，取得了76.17%的Macro F1分数，建立了新的最先进水平。在不使用目标数据标签的情况下，在READ 2018的各个特定数据集上也取得了有竞争力的结果。无监督训练仅在训练期间增加计算时间，推理时间不受影响。
conclusion: 本文提出的基于无监督域适应的流程能够有效解决标记数据有限的问题，通过对齐特征分布，使模型在字符分类和手写文本识别任务中实现跨数据集的有效泛化，并在多个基准测试中取得了优异表现。

title: Toward Interference-Agnostic RF Source Separation
authors: Maxence Albert, Raphaël Duroselle, Thibaud Ehret, Olivier Boeffard, Jean-François Bonastre
abstract: Separating a radio-frequency signal of interest from a co-channel interference is mostly addressed with specialized separators, each trained for one pair of signal and interference types and therefore relying on a label that a heavily jammed receiver cannot identify. We show that this reliance is not benign: applied to an interference it was not trained on, such a separator usually fails to recover the signal, and in most of the cases we measure it leaves the signal worse than no processing at all. We then train a single separator over every pair, giving it no indication at test time of which one it faces, on two architectures with no component in common: the convolutional WaveNet of the ICASSP 2024 RF Challenge, and a band-split transformer that we adapt from music source separation. Both behave the same way. At the size of one specialized model, the unified separator stays close to the whole models it replaces, keeping the bit error rate close on almost every pair, better on one and worse on another. On an interference absent from every training set, it does as well as the best specialized model, without anyone having to choose which one to deploy.
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 tabs. Submitted to ICASSP2027
zh_title: 走向干扰无关的射频源分离
translation: 从同信道干扰中分离出感兴趣的射频信号主要通过专用分离器来解决，每个分离器都针对一对信号和干扰类型进行训练，因此依赖于重度干扰接收器无法识别的标签。我们发现这种依赖并非良性：当应用于未经训练的干扰时，这种分离器通常无法恢复信号，并且在我们测量的多数情况下，它使信号比不进行任何处理更差。然后，我们对每个信号-干扰对训练一个单一的分离器，在测试时不对其提供任何关于它面临哪种干扰的指示，使用了两种没有共同组件的架构：ICASSP 2024 RF挑战赛的卷积WaveNet，以及我们从音乐源分离中改编的频带分割Transformer。两者表现相同。在单个专用模型的尺寸下，统一分离器与其所替代的整个模型保持接近，在几乎每个信号-干扰对上都保持接近的误码率，其中一对更好，另一对更差。在每个训练集中都不存在的干扰上，它的表现与最好的专用模型一样好，而无需任何人选择部署哪一个。
tldr: 现有的射频信号分离器在面对未知干扰时表现不佳。本文提出了一种统一的、干扰无关的分离器，它在各种干扰类型上表现良好，甚至对训练中未见的干扰也有效，且性能与最佳的专用分离器相当。
ai_comments: 这篇论文提出了一种重要的范式转变，从依赖于特定干扰类型的专用分离器转向一个能够处理多种甚至未知干扰的统一模型。这种“干扰无关”的特性对于实际应用中，特别是当干扰类型难以预测或识别时，具有显著的优势。其创新点在于无需在测试时指示干扰类型，并展示了其在未知干扰上的鲁棒性，大大简化了部署和提高了实用性。
motivation: 现有的射频信号分离技术依赖于为特定信号和干扰类型训练的专用分离器，但在面对未训练的干扰时会失效，甚至恶化信号，这凸显了对更鲁棒分离器的需求。
method: 本文训练了一个单一的、统一的分离器来处理所有信号和干扰类型，并在测试时无需预先指示干扰类型。研究使用了两种不同的架构进行验证：ICASSP 2024 RF挑战赛的卷积WaveNet和一种从音乐源分离改编而来的频带分割Transformer。
results: 统一分离器在尺寸与单个专用模型相当的情况下，其误码率在几乎所有信号-干扰对上都与专用模型接近，其中一对表现更好，另一对表现稍差。更重要的是，在面对训练集中未出现的干扰时，其性能与最好的专用模型相当。
conclusion: 一个单一的、干扰无关的射频源分离器可以有效替代多个专用模型，即使在面对未知干扰时也能提供鲁棒的性能，而无需预先识别干扰类型。

title: Parameterized Approximation for Minimizing Uncovered Elements and Unsatisfied Constraints
authors: Rudranarayan Kar, Souvik Saha, Abhishek Sahu
abstract:
Min-UnCoverage asks for at most $k$ sets minimizing uncovered weight. Min-Unsat SAT and Min-Unsat CSP ask for an assignment with at most $k$ true variables minimizing the weight of unsatisfied clauses or constraints.
  For constraints of arity at most $d$, we give a deterministic $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation for weighted Min-Unsat CSP in $(dk/\varepsilon)^{O(k)}N^{O(1)}$ time, where $N$ is the input size. This also gives approximation schemes for bounded-arity SAT and coverage with bounded element frequency. We show that weighted coverage with set size at most $d$ can be solved exactly in $2^{O(kd)}N^{O(1)}$ time by adapting color-coding. For coverage on incidence graphs of bounded semi-ladder index, we give a deterministic parameterized approximation scheme .
  We show that, unless $\mathrm{FPT}=\mathrm{W}[1]$, SAT and CSP have no finite-factor FPT approximation parameterized by $k+d$ when variable frequency is at most $d$, or on $K_{3,3}$-free incidence graphs of semi-ladder index at most four. Known Hitting Set hardness gives the same lower bound for all three problems at VC dimension two.
  Under the same assumption, we show that no computable relaxation $g(k,d)\geq k$ allows an FPT algorithm to preserve a prescribed unsatisfied-weight target for SAT or CSP, already for arity three and, separately, bounded variable frequency. For coverage, known algorithms preserve the target using at most $k+1$ sets on incidence graphs of bounded semi-ladder index.
zh_title: 参数化近似以最小化未覆盖元素和未满足约束
translation:
Min-UnCoverage问题要求最多$k$个集合，以最小化未覆盖的权重。Min-Unsat SAT和Min-Unsat CSP问题要求一个最多有$k$个真变量的赋值，以最小化未满足子句或约束的权重。
对于最大度为$d$的约束，我们为加权Min-Unsat CSP提供了一个确定性的$(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法，时间复杂度为$(dk/\varepsilon)^{O(k)}N^{O(1)}$，其中$N$是输入大小。这也为有界度SAT和有界元素频率覆盖问题提供了近似方案。我们展示了通过适配颜色编码，集合大小最大为$d$的加权覆盖问题可以在$2^{O(kd)}N^{O(1)}$时间内精确求解。对于有界半梯形索引关联图上的覆盖问题，我们提供了一个确定性参数化近似方案。
我们证明，除非$\mathrm{FPT}=\mathrm{W}[1]$，否则当变量频率最大为$d$，或在$K_{3,3}$-free关联图上，并且半梯形索引最大为四时，SAT和CSP不存在参数化为$k+d$的有限因子FPT近似。已知的Hitting Set硬度为VC维数为二的所有这三个问题提供了相同的下界。
在相同假设下，我们证明，对于度为三的SAT或CSP，以及单独的有界变量频率情况，不存在可计算松弛$g(k,d)\geq k$的FPT算法来保持预设的未满足权重目标。对于覆盖问题，已知算法在有界半梯形索引关联图上使用最多$k+1$个集合来保持目标。
tldr: 本文研究了最小化未覆盖元素和未满足约束的参数化近似问题，提供了多种近似算法和精确算法，并证明了在某些条件下这些问题不存在有限因子FPT近似。
ai_comments: 这篇论文在参数化近似算法领域做出了重要贡献，不仅提出了新的近似和精确算法，还通过建立FPT硬度下界，深入探讨了这些问题的计算复杂性限制。其对Min-Unsat CSP、SAT和覆盖问题的统一处理以及对不同图结构的考虑，展现了研究的全面性。硬度结果对于理解这些问题的内在困难性具有重要指导意义。
motivation: 论文旨在解决Min-UnCoverage、Min-Unsat SAT和Min-Unsat CSP等问题，这些问题涉及在给定限制（例如最多k个集合或真变量）下最小化未覆盖权重或未满足约束的权重。
method: 对于最大度为d的约束，使用确定性(1+ε)-近似算法解决加权Min-Unsat CSP。通过适配颜色编码，精确解决集合大小最大为d的加权覆盖问题。为有界半梯形索引关联图上的覆盖问题提供确定性参数化近似方案。
results: 在(dk/ε)^O(k)N^O(1)时间内，为最大度为d的约束的加权Min-Unsat CSP提供确定性(1+ε)-近似。为有界度SAT和有界元素频率覆盖问题提供近似方案。在2^O(kd)N^O(1)时间内，通过颜色编码精确解决集合大小最大为d的加权覆盖问题。除非FPT=W[1]，否则当变量频率最大为d或在K_{3,3}-free关联图上时，SAT和CSP不存在参数化为k+d的有限因子FPT近似。在相同假设下，对于度为三或有界变量频率的SAT或CSP，不存在可计算松弛g(k,d) >= k的FPT算法来保持预设的未满足权重目标。对于覆盖问题，已知算法在有界半梯形索引关联图上使用最多k+1个集合来保持目标。
conclusion: 论文为最小化未覆盖元素和未满足约束问题提供了新的参数化近似算法和精确算法，并建立了重要的FPT近似硬度下界，表明在特定条件下，这些问题无法获得有效的FPT近似。

title: In the Eye of the Beholder: Human Label Variation in Textual and Visual Entailment
authors: Monica Riedler, Jasmin Orth, Raffaella Bernardi, Barbara Plank
abstract: Human Label Variation (HLV) is increasingly recognised as an informative signal that reflects meaningful differences in how people interpret the same input. While HLV has been studied extensively in Natural Language Inference (NLI), much less is known about HLV in Visual Entailment (VE; Xie et al., 2019), where the textual premise is replaced by an image, keeping the hypothesis and label space fixed. We introduce VariNLI-VE, a dataset for studying how HLV changes between paired NLI and VE instances. We re-annotate a subset of originally neutral SNLI (Bowman et al., 2015) instances and their visual counterparts, with the same annotators evaluating both the textual and visual versions. Each annotation includes a label, confidence score, and explanation, yielding 2,250 annotations. Labels and explanations are collected jointly, providing ecologically valid explanations. Because the image may reveal information not stated in the text, one might expect disagreement to decrease in VE. Instead, we find no clear overall reduction: disagreement decreases for some instances while it increases for others. Explanations reveal further variation, as annotators can retain the same label while changing their rationale. When evaluating vision-language models (VLMs) on the paired data, we find lower accuracy, weaker alignment with human label distributions, and generally higher uncertainty in VE than in NLI.
zh_title: 情人眼里出西施：文本与视觉蕴含中的人类标签变异
translation: 人类标签变异（HLV）日益被认为是一种信息信号，反映了人们对同一输入解释的实质性差异。虽然HLV在自然语言推理（NLI）中得到了广泛研究，但对于视觉蕴含（VE；Xie等，2019）中的HLV知之甚少，VE中将文本前提替换为图像，而假设和标签空间保持不变。我们介绍了VariNLI-VE，这是一个用于研究配对NLI和VE实例之间HLV如何变化的迷数据集。我们重新标注了原本为中性的SNLI（Bowman等，2015）实例及其视觉对应部分的子集，由相同的标注者评估文本和视觉版本。每个标注包括标签、置信度分数和解释，共产生2250个标注。标签和解释是联合收集的，从而提供了生态有效的解释。由于图像可能会透露文本中未说明的信息，人们可能会期望VE中的分歧会减少。然而，我们发现整体分歧并没有明确减少：某些实例的分歧减少，而其他实例的分歧增加。解释揭示了进一步的变异，因为标注者在改变理由的同时可以保留相同的标签。在配对数据上评估视觉语言模型（VLM）时，我们发现与NLI相比，VE中的准确率较低、与人类标签分布的一致性较弱，且总体不确定性更高。
tldr: 本研究通过构建新数据集 VariNLI-VE，探讨了人类在文本蕴含与视觉蕴含任务中理解分歧的异同，并发现当前视觉语言模型在视觉蕴含上面对人类分歧时的表现明显逊色。
ai_comments: 该论文首次将人类标签变异（HLV）的研究从文本蕴含（NLI）拓展到视觉蕴含（VE），通过成对的数据集 VariNLI-VE 揭示了文本与视觉模态下人类理解和分歧的异同，并对当前视觉语言模型（VLM）的对齐能力提出了新的挑战和基准。
motivation: 尽管人类标签变异（HLV）在自然语言推理（NLI）中得到了广泛研究，但在视觉蕴含（VE）领域仍缺乏了解。本研究旨在探究当文本前提被图像替换时，人类的标签变异如何变化。
method: 引入了 VariNLI-VE 数据集，重新标注了 SNLI 文本实例及其视觉对应实例的子集，由同一批标注者对文本和视觉版本进行评估，收集标签、置信度和解释，并评估了多个视觉语言模型（VLM）在成对数据上的表现。
results: 研究发现，总体 disagreement（分歧）并没有明显减少，某些实例的分歧减少而另一些增加；解释表明标注者可能会在保持标签不变的同时改变理由；视觉语言模型在 VE 上的准确率更低、与人类标签分布的一致性更弱、不确定性更高。
conclusion: 人类在视觉蕴含中的标签分歧并不比文本蕴含少，且当前的视觉语言模型在处理视觉蕴含任务时表现出较低的准确率、较弱的人类偏好对齐度以及更高的不确定性。

title: WebArena-Pro: A Heterogeneous, Multimodal, Reproducible Benchmark for Web Agents
authors: Imene Kerboua, Fatemeh Pesaran Zadeh, Xing Han Lù, Weijian Qi, Alexander Miller, Junyi Song, Yunjia Tian, Dongjin Kang, Seyeon Choi, Marzia Nouri, Ewen Gueguen, Matteo Boglioni, Fengyuan Liu, Zeyi Liao, Mengqi Yuan, Yue Li, Alexandre Lacoste, Alexandre Drouin, Spandana Gella, Huan Sun, Gunhee Kim, Siva Reddy
abstract: Web agents powered by large language and vision-language models are increasingly applied to realistic browser work that spans heterogeneous applications, multimodal content, and stateful workflows. However, existing reproducible web-agent benchmarks cover only a small number of web applications drawn from a few software categories, and restrict modality to text and vision. Live benchmarks broaden site coverage but sacrifice reproducibility, since pages and data drift between runs. Moreover, existing benchmarks do not meaningfully evaluate whether agents can understand and use audio and video content embedded within web tasks. To address these gaps, we introduce WebArena-Pro, a benchmark comprising 300 tasks across 20 self-hosted web applications in six domain categories, spanning distinct interface conventions, workflows, and data models. Across the evaluated agents, the best performance is achieved by both Codex with GPT 6.1 Sol and Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 at 62.3%, followed by OpenCode with Kimi 3.1 Pro at 60.7%. The strongest GenericAgent configurations, Gemini 3.1 Pro omni and Gemma4 31B, both achieve 30.3%. Among reproducible, human-curated web agent benchmarks, WebArena-Pro provides the broadest application coverage and the most comprehensive multimodal support to date. The benchmark treats audio and video as core observations alongside text and vision, with dedicated actions for extracting information from each. WebArena-Pro runs each task in isolation and supports reproducible, parallel evaluation. Tasks are authored through a dedicated annotator interface, filtered by LLM-assisted triage, and finally validated by humans before release. Project page: https://webarena-pro.github.io
zh_title: WebArena-Pro：一个面向网页智能体的异构、多模态、可复现基准测试
translation: 由大语言模型和视觉语言模型驱动的网页智能体，正越来越多地应用于跨异构应用、多模态内容和有状态工作流的现实浏览器任务中。然而，现有的可复现网页智能体基准测试仅涵盖少数几个软件类别中的少量网页应用，且模态仅限于文本和视觉。实时基准测试虽然扩大了网站覆盖面，但牺牲了可复现性，因为网页和数据在不同运行之间会发生漂移。此外，现有基准测试并未有意义地评估智能体是否能够理解和使用网页任务中嵌入的音频和视频内容。为了填补这些空白，我们推出了WebArena-Pro，这是一个包含来自六个领域类别的20个自托管网页应用的300个任务的基准测试，涵盖了不同的界面约定、工作流和数据模型。在评估的智能体中，Codex（带GPT 6.1 Sol）和Claude Code（带Claude Opus 5.5）取得了62.3%的最佳性能，其次是OpenCode（带Kimi 3.1 Pro）的60.7%。最强的GenericAgent配置（Gemini 3.1 Pro omni和Gemma4 31B）均达到了30.3%。在可复现的人工精心策划的网页智能体基准测试中，WebArena-Pro提供了迄今为止最广泛的应用覆盖和最全面的多模态支持。该基准将音频和视频视为与文本和视觉并列的核心观察结果，并配备了用于从各自内容中提取信息的专用操作。WebArena-Pro在隔离状态下运行每个任务，并支持可复现的并行评估。任务通过专用的标注界面编写，经过LLM辅助分流过滤，最后在发布前经过人工验证。项目主页：https://webarena-pro.github.io
tldr: WebArena-Pro是一个全新的异构多模态网页智能体可复现基准测试，首次全面评估了智能体对网页中音视频等复杂多模态内容的处理能力。
ai_comments: WebArena-Pro填补了现有Web智能体基准测试在多模态（如音视频处理）和异构应用覆盖率上的空白，通过自托管环境和严格的人机协同验证保障了可复现性，是评估先进多模态智能体的重要进展。
motivation: 现有的可复现Web智能体基准测试应用覆盖面窄且模态受限（仅限文本和视觉），而实时基准虽然覆盖广但缺乏可复现性，且现有基准均未评估智能体处理网页中内嵌音视频内容的能力。
method: 构建包含20个自托管Web应用、300个任务的基准测试，支持文本、视觉、音频和视频的多模态观察及专用交互动作，并通过独立隔离的环境运行、并行评估及LLM辅助加人工验证来确保可复现性。
results: 在评估的智能体中，Codex（带GPT 6.1 Sol）和Claude Code（带Claude Opus 5.5）表现最好，准确率达62.3%，其次是OpenCode（带Kimi 3.1 Pro）的60.7%，最强的GenericAgent配置准确率为30.3%。
conclusion: WebArena-Pro作为目前覆盖最广、多模态支持最全面的可复现Web智能体基准，有效推动了具备音视频处理能力的复杂浏览器智能体的发展。

title: nnAEU: a Simple and Efficient CNN-Autoencoder for Hyperspectral Unmixing
authors: Edgard Dabier, Christophe Kervazo, Pietro Gori, Florence Tupin
abstract: Deep learning-based hyperspectral unmixing (HSU) has followed a trajectory of increasing architectural complexity, from simple autoencoders to transformers and, most recently, Mamba-based models, each claiming to advance the state of the art. Contrary to this trend, we propose a lightweight CNN-based autoencoder, coined "Not New Autoencoder Unmixing" (nnAEU). It is derived from the backbone of UNMamba (2025) through a pruning study that removes the Mamba component entirely. nnAEU uses less than 10 times fewer parameters than UNMamba, and far fewer than other transformer- and GAN-based methods, while outperforming them in accuracy. We provide a complete, minimal, reproducible code, available at https://gitlab.telecom-paris.fr/ring/nnAEU.git.
zh_title: nnAEU：一种简单高效的用于高光谱解混的CNN自编码器
translation: 基于深度学习的高光谱解混（HSU）遵循着架构复杂性不断增加的轨迹，从简单的自编码器到Transformer，再到最近基于Mamba的模型，每一种都声称推动了技术发展。与这一趋势相反，我们提出了一种轻量级的基于CNN的自编码器，命名为“Not New Autoencoder Unmixing”（nnAEU）。它源自UNMamba (2025) 的骨干网络，通过一项剪枝研究完全移除了Mamba组件。nnAEU的参数量比UNMamba少10倍以上，并且远少于其他基于Transformer和GAN的方法，同时在精度上超越了它们。我们提供了一个完整、极简、可复现的代码，可在https://gitlab.telecom-paris.fr/ring/nnAEU.git获取。
tldr: nnAEU是一种简单高效的CNN自编码器，通过移除UNMamba的Mamba组件，参数量大幅减少但精度优于现有的复杂模型。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于其反潮流的设计理念，即通过简化而非增加模型复杂性来提升性能。nnAEU在参数量大幅减少的情况下，仍能超越现有更复杂的模型，这对于资源受限的应用场景具有重要意义，也为深度学习模型设计提供了新的思考方向。
motivation: 针对高光谱解混(HSU)领域模型架构日益复杂化的趋势，本文旨在提出一种更轻量、更高效且性能更优的深度学习模型，以对抗这种复杂化趋势。
method: 本文提出了nnAEU，一个轻量级的CNN自编码器。它通过对UNMamba (2025)的主干进行剪枝研究，完全移除了Mamba组件而得到。
results: nnAEU的参数量比UNMamba少10倍以上，也远少于其他基于Transformer和GAN的方法，同时在精度上超越了它们。
conclusion: nnAEU证明了通过简化模型架构而非增加复杂性，也能在高光谱解混任务中达到甚至超越现有先进模型的性能，且具有更高的效率。

title: MacroGS: Macro-Pixel Shared Gaussian Primitives for Arbitrary-Scale Light Field Super-Resolutio
authors: Zeqiang Wei, Angulia Yang, Min Xu
abstract: Arbitrary-scale light field spatial super-resolution reconstructs high-resolution views at any requested scale from low-resolution multi-view observations. Gaussian primitives enable continuous reconstruction, but generating separate primitive sets for each view redundantly encodes shared scene structure across views and causes the primitive count grow linearly with the number of views. To avoid such redundancy, we propose MacroGS, a feed-forward decoder that jointly predicts a single shared Gaussian set per macro pixel rather than generating separate sets for each view. Disparity-dependent replacement and angle-conditioned appearance allow each set to be reused across all output views, keeping the predicted primitive count independent of the number of views at each requested scale. The decoder iteratively predicts per-primitive disparities, retrieves the corresponding multi-view features, and updates the primitive states. Gaussian splatting and residual refinement then reconstruct the output light field. Despite being learned without geometric supervision, the predicted disparities strongly correlate with underlying scene geometry. Experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that MacroGS integrates effectively with diverse light field encoders, improving reconstruction quality at fixed scales while achieving leading performance across most evaluated arbitrary-scale settings. The decoder also achieves speedups of approximately $2$-$10\times$ over state-of-the-art implicit light field decoders and $10$-$18\times$ over the view-wise Gaussian baseline.
zh_title: MacroGS：用于任意尺度光场超分辨率的宏像素共享高斯原语
translation: 任意尺度光场空间超分辨率从低分辨率多视点观测中以任意请求的尺度重建高分辨率视图。高斯图元能够实现连续重建，但为每个视图生成独立的图元集会冗余编码跨视图的共享场景结构，并导致图元数量随视图数量线性增长。为了避免这种冗余，我们提出了 MacroGS，这是一种前馈解码器，它联合预测每个宏像素的单个共享高斯集，而不是为每个视图生成独立的集。视差相关替换和角度条件外观允许每个集在所有输出视图中被复用，保持预测的图元数量在每个请求的尺度上独立于视图数量。该解码器迭代预测每个图元的视差，检索相应的多视点特征，并更新图元状态。然后，高斯溅射和残差精细化重建输出光场。尽管在没有几何监督的情况下进行学习，但预测的视差与底层场景几何高度相关。在五个基准测试上的实验表明，MacroGS 与各种光场编码器有效集成，在固定尺度下提高了重建质量，同时在大多数评估的任意尺度设置中实现了领先的性能。该解码器还比最先进的隐式光场解码器实现了大约 2 到 10 倍的加速，比逐视角高斯基线快 10 到 18 倍。
tldr: 提出 MacroGS，通过宏像素共享高斯原语实现高效的任意尺度光场超分辨率，解决了传统方法视角冗余和图元暴增的问题，兼具卓越的重建质量和数倍的推理加速。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将高斯点云表示引入光场超分辨率任务中，通过宏像素共享高斯原语（MacroGS）的方式有效解决了传统方法中随视角数量线性增长的冗余性问题，不仅显著提升了重建质量，还在计算效率上实现了突破性的提升。
motivation: 传统高斯图元方法为每个视角生成独立的图元集，导致跨视角的共享场景结构被冗余编码，且图元数量随视角数量线性增长，为了消除这种冗余并实现任意尺度的高场空间超分辨率，亟需一种更加高效的图元共享表示方法。
method: 提出 MacroGS 前馈解码器，为每个宏像素联合预测单个共享的高斯集，结合视差相关替换和角度条件外观实现跨视角复用，并迭代预测视差、检索多视角特征来更新高斯状态，最后通过高斯溅射和残差精细化重建输出光场。
results: 在五个基准测试上的实验表明，MacroGS 与多种光场编码器能够有效结合，在固定尺度下改善了重建质量并在大多数任意尺度设置下达到了领先性能，同时比最先进的隐式光场解码器快 2-10 倍，比逐视角高斯基线快 10-18 倍。
conclusion: MacroGS 成功实现了高效的任意尺度光场空间超分辨率，在无需几何监督的情况下，能够提供准确的场景几何感知，并在性能和速度上均优于现有的隐式光场解码器和逐视角高斯基线。

title: DeltaVisionX: A Low-Cost Vision-Guided Automation System Using YOLOv11 and PLC-Based Actuation
authors: Lara Sobh, Marc Nahhas, Francisco Katach El Halabi, Michel Owayjan, Fadi Elias Sleiman
abstract: This paper presents DeltaVisionX, a low-cost industrial automation system that integrates real-time computer vision with PLC-based actuation for object classification and sorting. The system uses the YOLOv11 (You Only Look Once) deep learning model to detect objects on an operating conveyor belt and communicates detection results to a Delta DVP-SE PLC, which actuates pneumatic pistons for sorting. A custom dataset was created, labeled, and augmented to train the YOLOv11 model, achieving a mean average precision of 0.97 with real-time inference of 100 ms per frame. Encoder-based tracking ensures reliable synchronization between detection and actuation, supporting a throughput of 80 objects per minute. Results show that affordable, locally developed automation can reduce labor dependency and improve manufacturing efficiency. The novelty of the proposed system lies in its encodersynchronized vision-PLC integration rather than in the detection model itself. Future work includes integrating a highspeed Delta robot with EtherCAT-based servo control for advanced pick-and-place operations.
zh_title: DeltaVisionX：使用YOLOv11和基于PLC驱动的低成本视觉引导自动化系统
translation: 本文介绍了DeltaVisionX，这是一个集成了实时计算机视觉与PLC驱动的低成本工业自动化系统，用于物体分类与分拣。该系统使用YOLOv11（You Only Look Once）深度学习模型来检测运行中的传送带上的物体，并将检测结果通信给Delta DVP-SE PLC，由其驱动气动活塞进行分拣。通过创建、标注和增强自定义数据集来训练YOLOv11模型，使其达到了0.97的平均精度，单帧实时推理时间为100毫秒。基于编码器的追踪确保了检测与驱动之间的可靠同步，支持每分钟80个物体的吞吐量。结果表明，经济实惠、本地开发的自动化可以减少对人工的依赖并提高制造效率。该系统的创新之处在于编码器同步的视觉-PLC集成，而不是检测模型本身。未来的工作包括集成具有EtherCAT伺服控制的高速Delta机器人，以进行高级的抓取和放置操作。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于YOLOv11和PLC的低成本视觉引导自动化分拣系统DeltaVisionX，实现了高精度、高效率的工业物体分类与分拣。
ai_comments: 该论文创新点在于将低成本视觉检测（YOLOv11）与PLC控制通过编码器进行精确同步，实现了高效的工业分拣自动化，具有很高的实用价值和经济效益。
motivation: 开发一种低成本的工业自动化系统，通过集成实时计算机视觉与基于PLC的驱动装置，实现高效的物体分类与分拣，从而降低制造企业对人工的依赖并提升效率。
method: 使用YOLOv11深度学习模型进行实时物体检测，结合基于编码器的跟踪技术，将检测结果传输至Delta DVP-SE PLC，并通过PLC驱动气动活塞进行物体的分类与分拣。
results: YOLOv11模型实现了0.97的平均精度（mAP）和100毫秒/帧的实时推理速度，系统支持每分钟80个物体的吞吐量。
conclusion: DeltaVisionX系统证明了低成本、本地开发的自动化系统能够有效减少对人工的依赖并提升制造效率。

title: Reasoning Models Confabulate to Defend Injected Beliefs About Their Own Requests
authors: Yang Ou
abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring and self-report are proposed as levers for AI oversight, on the assumption that a model's account of what it is doing is anchored to what it was asked. We show this anchor can be cut. An activation edit invisible in the prompt text, the injected forming-trace of an off-topic concept, overwrites a reasoning model's belief about its own request: across six models spanning scale, architecture, and recipe, the injected topic becomes the task it reasons about, reports back, and answers: the forced quote-back returns the injected topic in 47 of 48 model-concept cells, and on the four models with clean final haiku the injected answer follows in 99% of generations. Warnings barely move it: even one naming the true topic yields under 5% true-topic answers. Handed the truth in clean tokens, the model confabulates a story about the user ("maybe they got confused and corrected themselves") and answers with the injection anyway, its behavior and chain-of-thought corrupted together: a concrete limit on CoT monitorability. Opening the model up offers no reprieve: it attends to the true request even harder after edits, yet that attention is causally inert, and the injected content rides intact task circuits, so attention maps and circuit attributions read as on-task too; the same edit redirects the request's language and format, not only its topic. What the injection reaches is the model's reference to its own input; what it elicits is its defense of it.
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. Also available on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20980353
zh_title: 推理模型为维护其自身请求的注入信念而进行虚构
translation: 思维链（CoT）监控和自我报告被提议作为AI监督的手段，其假设是模型对自己行为的解释与其被要求的内容相锚定。我们证明这个锚点是可以被切断的。一个在提示词文本中不可见的激活编辑——注入一个离题概念的形成痕迹——会覆写推理模型对其自身请求的信念：跨越六种不同规模、架构和训练配方的模型，注入的主题变成了它所推理、汇报和回答的任务：强制引用在48个模型-概念单元中的47个返回了注入的主题，并且在四个具有干净最终俳句的模型中，注入的答案在99%的生成中被遵循。警告几乎无法改变这一点：即使有一个命名真实主题的警告，真实主题的答案也低于5%。当提供干净的真实标记时，模型会虚构一个关于用户的故事（“也许他们糊涂了并纠正了自己”）并仍然使用注入内容进行回答，其行为和思维链同时被损坏：这是CoT可监控性的一个具体限制。打开模型内部也无法提供解脱：编辑后模型更加关注真实的请求，然而这种注意力在因果上是惰性的，注入的内容完好无损地搭乘了任务回路，因此注意力图和回路归因读数也显示为在执行原任务；同样的编辑重定向了请求的语言和格式，而不仅仅是其主题。注入所触及的是模型对其自身输入的引用；它所引发的是模型对该输入的辩护。
tldr: 通过隐蔽的激活编辑，推理模型会被迫相信并捍卫被注入的虚假任务，甚至在面对真相警告时也会进行虚构，这挑战了基于思维链（CoT）的AI监管可靠性。
ai_comments: 该论文揭示了当前推理模型（Chain-of-Thought）在自我监督和监控方面的一个根本性漏洞：内部激活编辑可以彻底劫持模型的认知信念，使其对自身输入产生幻觉并进行辩护。这表明传统的CoT监控机制可能并不像预期的那样可靠，对于AI对齐和可解释性研究具有重要警示意义。
motivation: 检验基于“模型的行为解释与其被请求内容相关”这一假设的Chain-of-Thought（CoT）监控和自我报告机制在面对隐蔽激活干预时的可靠性。
method: 通过对六种不同规模、架构和训练配方的推理模型进行隐蔽的激活编辑（注入离题概念的形成痕迹），观察其在思维链、回答内容以及对真实请求的反应方面的表现。
results: 实验表明，注入的主题成为模型推理、汇报和回答的任务；在48个模型-概念测试单元中，有47个返回了注入的主题；即使提供真实的警告，模型也会虚构用户混淆的故事，仍旧按照注入的内容生成结果（99%的生成率），且传统的注意力图和电路归因分析无法察觉这种异常。
conclusion: 推理模型中对自身请求信念的追踪可以通过隐蔽的激活编辑切断，导致模型坚定地为其注入的错误信念进行虚构和辩护，这对基于CoT的AI监管构成了重大挑战。

title: Toward Universal Translatability: On the Statistical Ontology of Generative AI
authors: Katia Schwerzmann
abstract: This paper argues that the problem of translation functions both as a point of origin and as a normative horizon for contemporary generative AI. In current discourse around ''world models,'' their attainment is framed as the achievement of internal consistency, cross-modal alignment, and physical grounding. Taken together, these demands converge on an ideal of the model as a universal translation machine capable of establishing lossless correspondences across linguistic, visual, and physical representation spaces. I show that this ideal presupposes a metaphysical commitment that I call a statistical ontology: the belief that reality has an underlying, computable statistical structure that can be recovered through sufficient data and modeling, rather than being shaped and accessed through situated human interpretation and labor. Tracing this commitment back to Warren Weaver's 1949 Memorandum on machine translation, I outline how translation was historically recast as code deciphering and, later, as the alignment of probability distributions across structured outputs. Finally, I contrast this paradigm with approaches in Translation Studies that foreground opacity, power asymmetries, and the translator's positionality. I argue that generative AI's statistical ontology is pre-Kantian, pre-critical and obscures the infrastructures and human labor that make machine translatability---as alignment---possible in the first place.
zh_title: 实现通用可翻译性：关于生成式AI的统计本体论
translation: 本文认为，翻译问题既是当代生成式人工智能的起源点，也是其规范性地平线。在当前关于“世界模型”的讨论中，它们的实现被表述为内部一致性、跨模态对齐和物理基础的实现。这些要求合在一起，汇聚成一个理想，即模型应成为一个通用翻译机器，能够建立跨越语言、视觉和物理表征空间的无损对应关系。我表明，这一理想预设了一种我称之为“统计本体论”的形而上学承诺：即相信现实具有一个潜在的、可计算的统计结构，该结构可以通过足够的数据和建模来恢复，而不是通过情境化的人类解释和劳动来塑造和接触。我将这一承诺追溯到沃伦·韦弗（Warren Weaver）1949年关于机器翻译的备忘录，概述了翻译在历史上如何被重新定义为密码破译，以及后来如何被定义为跨结构化输出的概率分布的对齐。最后，我将这一范式与翻译研究中那些优先考虑不透明性、权力不对称和翻译者立场的观点进行了对比。我认为，生成式AI的统计本体论是前康德的、前批判的，它掩盖了使机器可翻译性——作为对齐——成为可能的基础设施和人力劳动。
tldr: 该论文认为，翻译问题是当前生成式AI的起点和规范目标。当前的“世界模型”被认为是实现了内部一致性、跨模态对齐和物理基础，从而成为能够跨语言、视觉和物理表示空间建立无损对应关系的通用翻译机器。这种理想源于一种“统计本体论”，即认为现实具有可计算的统计结构，可以通过数据和模型恢复。论文追溯了这一承诺的起源，并将其与翻译研究中强调不透明性、权力不对称和翻译者立场的观点进行了对比，认为生成式AI的统计本体论忽视了实现机器可翻译性的基础设施和人力劳动。
ai_comments: 该论文对生成式AI的“世界模型”提出了深刻的哲学批判，揭示了其背后隐藏的“统计本体论”假设。作者将这一概念追溯到早期机器翻译的研究，并将其与翻译研究中的前沿观点进行对比，强调了该范式在忽视人类解释、劳动和社会基础设施方面的不足。论文的论证逻辑清晰，观点具有启发性，对于理解生成式AI的局限性和未来发展方向具有重要意义。然而，论文可能需要进一步探讨如何克服“统计本体论”的局限性，并提出更具包容性和批判性的AI发展框架。
motivation: 生成式AI的“世界模型”被视为通用翻译机器，能够实现跨语言、视觉和物理表示空间的无损对应。然而，这种理想化目标背后存在一种“统计本体论”的假设，即认为现实具有可计算的统计结构，可以通过数据和模型恢复。本文旨在探讨这一假设的起源、影响及其局限性。
method: 论文追溯了“统计本体论”的起源，将其与Warren Weaver在1949年的备忘录联系起来，并分析了翻译如何被重新定义为密码破译和概率分布对齐。此外，论文还对比了生成式AI的范式与翻译研究中强调不透明性、权力不对称和翻译者立场的观点。
results: 生成式AI的“统计本体论”是一种前康德、前批判的观点，它忽视了实现机器可翻译性（作为对齐）所必需的基础设施和人力劳动。它将现实简化为可计算的统计结构，而忽略了人类的解释和劳动在塑造和获取现实中的作用。
conclusion: 生成式AI的“统计本体论”是一种有缺陷的哲学前提，它掩盖了机器翻译的复杂性和人类在其中的作用。未来的研究应超越单纯的对齐，关注更广泛的社会、政治和伦理维度。

title: Analyzing Learning-Dynamics Across Loss and Prediction Choices for Diffusion Models
authors: Dongwoo Kim
abstract: Denoising generative models predict clean data ($x$), noise ($ε$), or velocity ($v$), while training losses can be measured in any of these spaces. Although the resulting nine combinations are algebraically related, they can yield substantially different denoising accuracy and sample quality. We disentangle the effects of prediction and loss spaces. For a fixed prediction target, we show that changing the loss space is exactly equivalent to timestep reweighting and provide a heuristic analysis of how this reweighting affects generation quality. We then show that a rank-$m$ linear bottleneck compressing a $D$-dimensional noisy input imposes an irreducible squared-error floor of $D-m$ on noise and velocity prediction, whereas clean-data prediction can exploit low-dimensional data structure. Combining this bound with prediction-dependent error conversion yields distinct necessary conditions on bottleneck capacity. Experiments with U-Net and JiT across CIFAR-10, Imagenette, and ImageNet-256 support these theoretical predictions. Under compression, prediction choice strongly affects both denoising accuracy and sample quality, with noise-prediction errors closely matching the theoretical lower bound. Our results provide a quantitative understanding of how architectural bottlenecks interact with prediction and loss choices in denoising generative models.
zh_title: 扩散模型中损失与预测选择跨学习动力学的分析
translation: 去噪生成模型可以预测干净数据（$x$）、噪声（$\epsilon$）或速度（$v$），同时训练损失可以在这些空间的任意一个中进行测量。尽管由此产生的九种组合在代数上相关，但它们会产生显著不同的去噪精度和样本质量。我们解耦了预测空间和损失空间的影响。对于固定的预测目标，我们证明了改变损失空间完全等价于时间步重新加权，并对这种重新加权如何影响生成质量进行了启发式分析。接着我们表明，将$D$维含噪输入压缩的rank-$m$线性瓶颈对噪声和速度预测施加了$D-m$的不可约平方误差下限，而干净数据预测则可以利用低维数据结构。将此界限与预测相关的误差转换结合，产生了对瓶颈容量的不同必要条件。在CIFAR-10、Imagenette和ImageNet-256上使用U-Net和JiT的实验支持了这些理论预测。在压缩下，预测选择强烈影响去噪精度和样本质量，噪声预测误差与理论下限密切吻合。我们的结果为架构瓶颈如何与去噪生成模型中的预测和损失选择相互作用提供了定量的理解。
tldr: 本文研究了扩散模型中不同预测目标和损失函数对学习动力学的影响，揭示了损失空间等价于时间步重新加权，并证明了架构瓶颈对噪声/速度预测施加了理论误差下限。
ai_comments: 该论文深入剖析了扩散模型中不同预测目标与损失函数空间组合对学习动力学的影响，填补了理论分析与实验现象之间的空白，对架构设计和超参数选择具有重要的指导意义。
motivation: 去噪生成模型支持多种预测目标（预测数据、噪声或速度）和损失空间组合（共9种组合），尽管它们代数相关，但实际生成质量和去噪精度差异显著。作者旨在从理论和实验上彻底解耦并理解预测空间和损失空间对学习动力学的影响。
method: 通过数学推导分析损失空间变化与时间步重新加权（timestep reweighting）等价性；分析线性瓶颈对不同预测目标（噪声、速度、干净数据）引入的平方误差下限；并在CIFAR-10、Imagenette和ImageNet-256数据集上利用U-Net和JiT进行实验验证。
results: 证明了改变损失空间等价于时间步重新加权；发现rank-$m$线性瓶颈对噪声和速度预测施加了$D-m$的不可约平方误差下限，而干净数据预测则能避开该限制；实验结果验证了这些理论预测。
conclusion: 论文通过理论与实验证明，在存在架构瓶颈时，数据预测（clean-data prediction）由于能利用低维数据结构而表现更优，而噪声和velocity预测则受限于理论误差下限，这为扩散模型的优化提供了新的量化理解。

title: From Images to Grounded Edits: A Real-World Benchmark for Chinese Grammatical Error Correction in Handwritten Essays
authors: Weiru Zhang, Yuzhong Hong, Junwei Bao, Lemao Liu, Dejing Dou
abstract: Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (CGEC) is typically formulated as a text-to-text problem. While suitable for digital texts, this formulation falls short in real-world K-12 education, where AI-assisted corrections are expected directly on essay images, which are primarily handwritten and exhibit many irregularities. To bridge this gap, we introduce Grounded Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (G-CGEC), an image-to-grounded-edit task requiring systems to predict both corrections and their positions on essay images. We propose G-CGEC-Eval, a benchmark comprising real-world images of K-12 Chinese essays with fine-grained annotations. For evaluation, we adapt IoU-based metrics from object detection and propose a more tolerant alternative based on center-distance matching. Using this benchmark, we evaluate open-source and proprietary vision-language models under a direct single-pass setting, as well as settings with auxiliary components (OCR and character grounding) coordinated via pipelining or agentic harnessing. Results show that even top-tier proprietary models perform surprisingly poorly in the single-pass setting, while pipelining and agentic harnessing yield meaningful improvements. Notably, an error-type-based multi-agent workflow achieves the best performance, establishing it as the strongest baseline for future G-CGEC research. Through ablations and fine-grained analysis, we find the task remains far from solved, with linguistic error discovery and character-level grounding as the primary bottlenecks. This underscores the need for models that better integrate visual perception with linguistic reasoning and visual grounding.
zh_title: 从图像到定位编辑：手写作文中中文语法纠错的真实世界基准
translation: 中文语法纠错（CGEC）通常被构建为文本到文本的问题。虽然适用于数字文本，但这种构建在现实世界的K-12教育中显得不足，因为在教育中，人工智能辅助的纠错期望直接在主要为手写且表现出许多不规则性的作文图像上进行。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了接地中文语法纠错（G-CGEC），这是一项图像到定位编辑的任务，要求系统预测作文图像上的纠错及其位置。我们提出了G-CGEC-Eval，这是一个包含具有细粒度标注的真实K-12中文作文图像的基准。为了进行评估，我们从目标检测中调整了基于IoU的指标，并提出了基于中心距离匹配的更具容忍度的替代方案。使用该基准，我们在直接单次传递设置以及通过管道或智能体协调具有辅助组件（OCR和字符定位）的设置下，评估了开源和专有视觉语言模型。结果表明，即使是顶级专有模型在单次传递设置下的表现也出奇地糟糕，而管道化和智能体协调产生了有意义的改进。值得注意的是，基于错误类型的多智能体工作流实现了最佳性能，确立了其作为未来G-CGEC研究的最强基准。通过消融和细粒度分析，我们发现该任务远未解决，语言错误发现和字符级定位是主要瓶颈。这强调了对更好地将视觉感知与语言推理和视觉定位相结合的模型的急需。
tldr: 本文提出了手写作文中文语法纠错（G-CGEC）的新任务与基准，评估了视觉语言模型及多智能体方案的性能，发现结合错误类型的多智能体工作流能有效提升纠错与定位效果。
ai_comments: 该论文针对真实教育场景中手写作文纠错的痛点，创新性地提出了图像到定位编辑的G-CGEC任务及相应的G-CGEC-Eval基准。研究评估了多种视觉语言模型及Agent方案，发现结合错误类型的多智能体工作流表现最好，但任务本身仍极具挑战性，为视觉与语言深度融合的研究指明了方向。
motivation: 传统的中文语法纠错（CGEC）通常被视为文本到文本的问题，这不适用于真实世界K-12教育中主要为手写且具有许多不规则性的作文图像。为了弥补这一差距，需要将纠错扩展到直接在作文图像上进行。
method: 提出了G-CGEC任务和G-CGEC-Eval基准，适配了基于IoU和中心距离匹配的评估指标，并在直接单次传递、管道化以及利用OCR和字符定位的Agent协作设置下评估了开源和专有视觉语言模型。
results: 顶级专有模型在单次传递设置下表现较差，而管道化和多智能体控制带来了显著改进；其中基于错误类型的多智能体工作流取得了最佳性能。消融实验表明，语言错误发现和字符级定位是主要瓶颈。
conclusion: G-CGEC任务和基准揭示了当前多模态大模型在真实手写作文纠错中的局限性，证明了基于错误类型的多智能体工作流的有效性，并指出视觉定位和语言推理的深度融合是未来的关键研究方向。

title: Enhancing Transient Stability of VSG-Controlled Converters Under Grid Frequency Disturbances
authors: B. Li, Y. Zhang, X. Wang, S. Yang, Z. Hao, F. Milano
abstract: Strong damping feedback can substantially improve the transient synchronization stability of renewable energy converters employing virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control. However, conventional damping feedback uses the nominal frequency as its reference. When the frequency of a weak grid deviates from nominal, strong damping tends to keep the VSG frequency near nominal. This can sustain a frequency difference between the VSG and the grid and compromise transient synchronization. To address this problem, this paper proposes a complex-frequency-based method to estimate the grid reference frequency from local terminal measurements. The estimated frequency replaces the nominal reference in the VSG synchronization loop, so that damping acts on the frequency difference between the VSG and the real grid. Controller hardware-in-the-loop tests validate the effectiveness of the proposed method under grid frequency disturbances and its robustness to grid parameter uncertainty and adverse grid conditions.
zh_title: VSG控制的换流器在电网频率扰动下的瞬态稳定性增强
translation: 强阻尼反馈可以显著提高采用虚拟同步发电机（VSG）控制的可再生能源换流器的瞬态同步稳定性。然而，传统的阻尼反馈使用标称频率作为其参考。当弱电网的频率偏离标称值时，强阻尼倾向于使VSG频率保持在标称值附近。这会维持VSG和电网之间的频率差，并损害瞬态同步。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种基于复频率的方法，从本地端子测量中估计电网参考频率。估计的频率替代了VSG同步环路中的标称参考频率，从而使阻尼作用于VSG和真实电网之间的频率差。控制器硬件在环测试验证了所提出方法在电网频率扰动下的有效性，以及其对电网参数不确定性和不利电网条件的鲁棒性。
tldr: 通过基于复频率的方法估计电网参考频率，并将其用于VSG同步环路，以增强VSG控制的换流器在电网频率扰动下的瞬态稳定性。
ai_comments: 该研究解决了VSG控制换流器在弱电网频率扰动下瞬态同步稳定性的一项重要挑战。通过引入基于复频率的参考频率估计，该方法能够更准确地响应实际电网频率变化，从而增强阻尼控制的效果。然而，该方法在实际应用中的计算复杂度和实时性可能需要进一步评估。
motivation: 传统的阻尼反馈使用标称频率作为参考，在弱电网频率偏离标称值时，会导致VSG频率接近标称值，维持VSG与电网之间的频率差，从而损害瞬态同步。
method: 提出一种基于复频率的方法，从本地端子测量中估计电网参考频率，并用该估计频率替代VSG同步环路中的标称参考频率。
results: 控制器硬件在环测试验证了所提出方法在电网频率扰动下的有效性，以及其对电网参数不确定性和不利电网条件的鲁棒性。
conclusion: 所提出的基于复频率的方法能够有效估计电网参考频率，并将其用于VSG同步环路，以增强VSG控制的换流器在电网频率扰动下的瞬态稳定性，并具有良好的鲁棒性。

title: Wireless Node Ranking via Fourier-Driven Maximum-Likelihood Estimation (extended version)
authors: Daniel Schneider, Hannes Frey
abstract:
We apply non-abelian Fourier theory to the problem of maximum-likelihood estimation of the order of a line topology, based on signal strength measurements under shadowing only. This yields up to a 60-fold speedup over standard methods for uncorrelated shadowing.
  Moreover, for correlated Gaussian shadowing with a singular covariance (e.g. the joint path-loss model), maximum-likelihood recovery is exact and independent of the shadowing variance (an infinite Le Cam threshold), which our implementation confirms for $σ/α$ as high as 7.0. The key object is the covariance's null space. Its dimension is fixed by the topology; its orientation depends on the correlation function only through the per-link variances.
  Although the mechanism formally requires an exact line, it is robust to small perturbations of the formation: an approximate kernel recovers as well as the exact one. We explore the dependence on the perturbation in detail for five nodes.
zh_title: 通过傅里叶驱动的最大似然估计实现无线节点排序（扩展版）
translation: 我们应用非阿贝尔傅里叶理论来解决线型拓扑顺序的最大似然估计问题，该估计基于仅考虑阴影效应的信号强度测量。对于不相关的阴影，这比标准方法带来了高达60倍的加速。此外，对于具有奇异协方差的相关高斯阴影（例如联合路径损耗模型），最大似然恢复是精确的且与阴影方差无关（无限的勒康阈值），我们的实现在$\sigma/\alpha$高达7.0时证实了这一点。核心对象是协方差的零空间，其维度由拓扑决定，其方向仅通过单链路方差依赖于相关函数。尽管该机制形式上需要精确的直线，但它对结构的微小扰动具有鲁棒性：近似核的恢复效果与精确核一样好。我们详细探讨了五个节点对扰动的依赖关系。
tldr: 利用非阿贝尔傅里叶理论高效且精确地实现无线节点排序，速度提升高达60倍并在特定阴影下实现零误差恢复。
ai_comments: 该论文巧妙地将非阿贝尔傅里叶理论应用于无线网络中的节点排序和最大似然估计问题，不仅在无相关阴影衰落时实现了数量级的速度提升，而且在相关高斯阴影下证明了最大似然恢复的精确性和不变性，展现了极高的理论价值与鲁棒性。
motivation: 解决基于阴影信号强度测量进行线型拓扑无线节点排序时的计算效率和准确性问题。
method: 应用非阿贝尔傅里叶理论，基于仅有信号强度的测量数据，对线型拓扑结构进行最大似然估计与节点排序，并利用协方差矩阵的零空间特性。
results: 在不相关阴影下比标准方法提速高达60倍；在具有奇异协关联高斯阴影下，最大似然恢复是精确的且与阴影方差无关；同时该方法对拓扑的小扰动表现出良好的鲁棒性。
conclusion: 通过利用非阿贝尔傅里叶理论和协方差矩阵的零空间，论文成功解决了线型拓扑无线节点的排序与最大似然估计问题，兼具高效性与极强的鲁棒性。

title: Algorithmic Opacity as a Principal-Agent Problem
authors: Ignacio Cofone, Katherine J. Strandburg
abstract: Concerns about gaming and trade secrecy, frequently invoked to justify algorithmic opacity, can also mask self-serving strategic behavior by decision-makers, who may prioritize private benefits over social welfare. We develop a principal-agent test for when algorithmic decision-making should trigger disclosure obligations even when concerns about gaming or trade secrecy exist. The test, which is anchored in decision quality, relies on two diagnostics that can be disclosed without enabling gaming or revealing trade secrets: the error profile (false positive and false negative rates, overall and for each group) and the distribution of decision outcomes across groups. These diagnostics make visible whether decision-makers align design and implementation with the public interest or instead use opacity to obscure bias, inefficiency, or strategic shirking. Strong disparities across social groups, and asymmetries in the distribution of decision errors across outcome types, should trigger rebuttable presumptions favoring further disclosure. Where ground-truth error rates are unavailable, outcome distributions across groups can support the same presumption, and a decision-maker's inability to produce an error profile is itself diagnostic. The test thus treats fairness metrics as triggers for further disclosure and extends to generative and agentic systems through analogous metrics. The framework informs differentiated disclosure regimes (staged, partial, mediated, or audience-segmented). Once such regimes are considered, the domain of justifiable algorithmic opacity is significantly narrower than commonly assumed: when gaming or trade secrecy risks are legitimate, actionable disclosures (such as training data characteristics and key system design parameters) ordinarily can be mandated without compromising innovation or enabling gaming, even for technically inscrutable algorithms.
zh_title: 作为委托-代理问题的算法不透明性
translation: 关于操纵和商业秘密的担忧常常被用来为算法不透明性辩护，但这也会掩盖决策者优先考虑私人利益而非社会福利的自利战略行为。我们针对算法决策何时应触发披露义务开发了一个委托-代理测试，即使在存在操纵或商业秘密担忧的情况下也适用。该测试锚定于决策质量，依赖于两项可以在不启用操纵或泄露商业秘密的情况下公开的诊断指标：错误率画像（误报率和漏报率，总体及各群体情况）以及各群体间的决策结果分布。这些诊断指标使得公众能够看出决策者是将设计和实施与公共利益对齐，还是利用不透明性来掩盖偏见、低效或战略性怠工。社会群体之间的巨大差异以及决策错误在结果类型之间的不对称性，应触发支持进一步披露的可反驳推定。在无法获取真实错误率的情况下，各群体间的结果分布可以支持相同的推定，且决策者无法提供错误画像本身就具有诊断意义。因此，该测试将公平性指标视为进一步披露的触发器，并通过类似指标扩展到生成式和代理式系统。该框架为差异化披露机制（分阶段的、部分的、中介的或受众细分的）提供了信息。一旦考虑了此类机制，合理算法不透明性的领域就会比通常假设的要窄得多：当操纵或商业秘密风险合法时，通常也可以强制进行可操作的披露（例如训练数据特征和关键系统设计参数），而不会损害创新或促成操纵，即使对于技术上难以捉摸的算法也是如此。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于委托-代理理论的新测试框架，利用错误画像和结果分布作为诊断指标，证明了在保护商业机密的同时强制披露算法细节是完全可行的，从而大幅缩小了可辩解的算法不透明性范围。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将委托-代理问题（Principal-Agent Problem）引入算法不透明性（Algorithmic Opacity）的研究中，通过提出基于决策质量的测试框架，巧妙地绕过了商业秘密和策略性操纵（gaming）的困境，为平衡算法透明度与知识产权/防操纵保护提供了切实的理论和政策路径。
motivation: 现有的算法不透明性常常被决策者利用贸易保密或防止操纵（gaming）为借口来掩盖私利、偏见或低效，损害社会福利。因此，需要一种新的理论框架来厘清何时应强制要求算法披露。
method: 开发了一个基于委托-代理理论的测试框架，依赖于两项无需泄露商业机密即可披露的诊断指标（错误画像和结果分布），用以识别决策者的自利行为并触发进一步的披露义务。
results: 研究表明，利用错误画像和群体间结果分布等诊断指标作为披露触发器，可以在不妥协创新或引发操纵的前提下，大幅缩小可辩解的算法不透明性范围，并支持差异化的披露机制。
conclusion: 通过引入基于决策质量的委托-代理测试框架，该论文证明了在存在合法保密需求的情况下，强制披露关键错误画像与结果分布是完全可行且必要的，从而大幅压缩了可辩解的算法不透明性范围。

title: Interactive deep-learning based interface for brain tumour segmentation
authors: Enora Giffard, Pierre Jannin, John S H Baxter
abstract: Brain tumour segmentation from MR images is an integral part of their treatment, either through surgical resection or radiotherapy. Both applications require a high degree of precision that can be difficult to ensure for all patients due to the high degree of variability in the size, shape, number, and location of these tumours. This leads to difficulties with their automatic segmentation via deep learning, which can display catastrophic segmentation errors when presented with images that differ, even subtly, in terms of the specific MR sequence used, which varies from vendor to vendor. This article presents a deep-learning-based interactive segmentation system that, while being fully automatic by default, has the capability of being easily corrected by human users, allowing them ensure sufficiently high brain tumour segmentation accuracy for all patients. This interface is evaluated both in terms of the accuracy of its automatic approach as well as its usability through a preliminary observational expert user study.
zh_title: 基于交互式深度学习的脑肿瘤分割界面
translation: 脑肿瘤分割从核磁共振图像是其治疗的一个组成部分，无论是通过手术切除或放射治疗。这两种应用都需要高度的精度，由于肿瘤的大小、形状、数量和位置的高度可变性，这可能难以确保所有患者都达到这种精度。这导致通过深度学习进行自动分割的困难，当面对成像序列略有不同时，可能会显示出灾难性的分割错误，而成像序列会因供应商而异。本文提出了一种基于深度学习的交互式分割系统，该系统默认是全自动的，但能够被用户轻松纠正，从而允许用户为所有患者确保足够高的脑肿瘤分割精度。该界面通过其自动方法的准确性以及通过初步观察性专家用户研究的可用性进行了评估。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种交互式深度学习系统，用于分割脑部核磁共振图像中的脑肿瘤。该系统在默认情况下是全自动的，但允许用户进行纠正，以确保分割的准确性，并通过用户研究进行了评估。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法，将深度学习的强大分割能力与用户交互的灵活性相结合，解决了脑肿瘤分割中的一个重要挑战。通过允许用户进行纠正，该系统能够提高分割的鲁棒性和可靠性，这对于临床应用至关重要。然而，用户研究的初步性质可能限制了其结论的普遍性，未来的研究可以进一步探索不同用户群体和更广泛的临床场景。
motivation: 脑肿瘤分割是手术切除或放疗的关键一步，但肿瘤的变异性给自动分割带来挑战，深度学习模型在面对不同成像序列时可能出现错误。
method: 提出了一种基于深度学习的交互式分割系统，该系统默认全自动，但允许用户进行交互式纠正。通过用户研究评估了该系统的准确性和可用性。
results: 该系统能够实现高精度的脑肿瘤分割，并且用户研究表明其具有良好的可用性。
conclusion: 该交互式深度学习系统为脑肿瘤分割提供了一种精确且用户友好的解决方案。

title: When Does Oversampling Help? A Decision Framework for Imbalanced Data Streams Under Label Delay and Concept Drift
authors: Ahmed Awad, Anirudh Sengar
abstract: For imbalanced data streams with delayed labels, is it worth adding a streaming oversampler, or does continuous re-evaluation of earlier predictions already recover the cost of the delay? We address this through an extensive experimental comparison of streaming oversampling and continuous re-evaluation under joint class imbalance, concept drift, and label delay. Streaming oversamplers are typically evaluated under the test-then-train assumption of immediate labels; their behaviour under these conditions, assessed through re-evaluation, has not been systematically studied. We close this gap with a decision framework that predicts when oversampling adds value over re-evaluation, organised around three axes: drift density, minority-class learnability, and delay relative to the refinement window, and operationalised as a competition between a recovery channel (re-evaluation) and a minority-coverage channel (oversampling). Evaluating $15$ classifiers on $6$ synthetic and $6$ real streams, we find: re-evaluation recovers delay-induced loss on drift-active streams but is silent on stationary ones; oversampling's marginal contribution over re-evaluation is statistically detectable in only one real-data configuration; and cost--performance Pareto recommendations from synthetic streams do not transfer to real data, where fronts partition by drift regime. Method selection should therefore be conditioned on the stream's profile and re-estimated as it evolves, not inherited from synthetic benchmarks.
zh_title: 过采样何时有用？标签延迟和概念漂移下不平衡数据流的决策框架
translation: 对于具有延迟标签的不平衡数据流，添加流过采样器是否值得，还是说持续重新评估早期预测已经能够弥补延迟的成本？我们在联合类不平衡、概念漂移和标签延迟下，通过对流过采样和持续重新评估的广泛实验比较来解决这个问题。流过采样器通常在即时标签的测试后训练假设下进行评估；它们在这些条件下的行为（通过重新评估进行评估）尚未得到系统研究。我们通过一个决策框架来填补这一空白，该框架预测过采样何时比重新评估更有价值，围绕三个轴组织：漂移密度、少数类可学习性以及相对于求精窗口的延迟，并将其操作化为恢复通道（重新评估）和少数类覆盖通道（过采样）之间的竞争。通过在6个合成流和6个真实流上评估15个分类器，我们发现：重新评估恢复了漂移活跃流中延迟引起的损失，但对平稳流无效；过采样相对于重新评估的边际贡献在统计学上仅在一种真实数据配置中可检测；来自合成流的成本-性能帕累托推荐不能转移到真实数据中，因为帕累托前沿按漂移机制划分。因此，方法选择应根据数据流的profile进行调节，并随着其演变而重新估计，而不是从合成基准中继承。
tldr: 在存在标签延迟和概念漂移的不平衡数据流中，持续重新评估往往能弥补延迟损失，过采样的实际增值非常有限，决策应基于数据流的动态特征而非合成基准。
ai_comments: 该论文深入探讨了在标签延迟和概念漂移共存的情况下，流过采样方法的实际价值。创新点在于提出了一个评估是否需要过采样的决策框架，并对比了持续重新评估（re-evaluation）的作用，对实际流数据挖掘具有重要的指导意义。
motivation: 探讨在不平衡数据流且伴随标签延迟的情况下，引入流过采样器是否真的有价值，还是说通过对早期预测进行持续重新评估就已经能够弥补延迟带来的损失。
method: 通过对15个分类器在6个合成流和6个真实流上的广泛实验比较，建立了一个围绕漂移密度、少数类可学习性和相对延迟三个轴的决策框架，将恢复通道（重新评估）和少数类覆盖通道（过采样）进行竞争分析。
results: 重新评估可以恢复漂移活跃流中由延迟引起的损失，但对平稳流无效；过采样相对于重新评估的边际贡献在统计学上仅在一种真实数据配置中可检测；合成流的成本-性能帕累托推荐无法直接迁移到真实数据中。
conclusion: 在存在标签延迟和概念漂移的数据流中，单纯依赖过采样带来的边际效益有限，方法选择应根据数据流的动态特征（如漂移密度、可学习性等）进行条件化调整，而不是盲目继承合成基准的建议。

title: TotalSegmentator Aorta Report: Automated Aortic Diameter Measurement at 11 Standardized Landmarks on CT Images
authors: Jakob Wasserthal, Daniel Hinck, Martin Segeroth, Joshy Cyriac, Denis Berdajs, Jules Miazza, Maurice Pradella
abstract:
Purpose: To develop and evaluate a fully automated, open-source tool that measures aortic diameters at 11 standardized landmarks from the aortic annulus to the bifurcation on any CT image, following current guideline recommendations.
  Materials and Methods: This retrospective single-center study included 239 arterial phase CT angiography examinations of 230 patients (median age, 65 years [range, 18-99 years]; 163 men) performed between April 2025 and October 2026 (209 electrocardiographically [ECG] gated). The tool locates landmarks from TotalSegmentator segmentations of aortic branches and vertebrae and measures the maximum diameter at each. A senior radiologist reviewed and, where needed, corrected the automated measurements to create the reference standard. Agreement was assessed with mean absolute error (MAE), bias, and differences greater than 2 mm.
  Results: Across all landmarks, MAE was 1.06 mm (95% CI: 0.91, 1.22), and 86.6% (95% CI: 84.4, 88.5) of differences were 2 mm or less. The tool measured slightly larger diameters (bias, 0.45 mm [95% CI: 0.34, 0.57]). The sinuses of Valsalva had the largest MAE (2.17 mm [95% CI: 1.59, 2.86]). For 1.2% of landmarks, the automatic measurement failed. Examination-level MAE did not differ significantly by pathology, atherosclerosis grade (P=.95), or ECG gating (P=.14). Examinations with mural thrombus more often had an MAE greater than 2 mm (50% [95% CI: 31, 69] vs 20%; P=.03).
  Conclusion: The tool measured aortic diameters at 11 landmarks along the entire aorta with an MAE of about 1 mm, below published interreader variability. Agreement was lower at the aortic root and with mural thrombus.
  Code availability: The tool is open source and freely available at https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator.
zh_title: TotalSegmentator主动脉报告：基于CT图像在11个标准化标志点自动测量主动脉直径
translation:
目的：开发并评估一种全自动开源工具，该工具遵循当前指南建议，可在任意CT图像上自动测量从主动脉瓣环到分叉处11个标准化解剖标志点的主动脉直径。
材料与方法：这项回顾性单中心研究纳入了2025年4月至2026年10月期间进行的230名患者的239次动脉期CT血管造影检查（中位年龄65岁[范围18-99岁]；163名男性；其中209例进行了心电门控）。该工具根据TotalSegmentator对主动脉分支和椎体的分割结果来定位解剖标志点，并测量每个标志点处的最大直径。一名资深放射科医生对自动测量结果进行审查并在必要时予以修正，以此作为参考标准。通过平均绝对误差（MAE）、系统偏倚以及大于2 mm的差异来评估一致性。
结果：在所有标志点中，MAE为1.06 mm（95% CI: 0.91, 1.22），86.6%（95% CI: 84.4, 88.5）的差异在2 mm或以内。该工具测量的直径略大（偏倚为0.45 mm [95% CI: 0.34, 0.57]）。瓦氏窦（主动脉窦）处的MAE最大（2.17 mm [95% CI: 1.59, 2.86]）。自动测量在1.2%的标志点处失败。检查层面的MAE在不同病理类型、动脉粥样硬化程度（P=.95）或心电门控状态（P=.14）下无显著差异。存在附壁血栓的检查中，MAE大于2 mm的情况更为常见（50% [95% CI: 31, 69] 对比 20%；P=.03）。
结论：该工具在全主动脉11个标志点测量的主动脉直径MAE约为1 mm，低于已报道的阅片者间变异。在主动脉根部和伴有附壁血栓时一致性较低。
代码可用性：该工具为开源工具，可免费获取：https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator。
tldr: 开发并开源了一种基于TotalSegmentator的工具，可在CT图像上自动测量主动脉11个标志点的直径，平均绝对误差约为1 mm，达到临床可用精度。
ai_comments: 该研究将广泛使用的开源分割工具TotalSegmentator进一步拓展至主动脉径线的自动化临床测量，契合现行指南规范，且平均绝对误差接近1 mm，低于放射科医生间读数变异，具有极高的临床实用和推广价值。其局限性在于主动脉根部（瓦氏窦）及存在附壁血栓时测量误差较大，且研究为单中心回顾性设计，需在更多异构数据上验证泛化性。
motivation: 遵循当前临床指南推荐，开发并评估一种全自动、开源的工具，能够在任意CT图像上测量从主动脉瓣环到腹主动脉分叉处11个标准化解剖标志点的主动脉直径。
method: 基于回顾性单中心239例动脉期CTA检查（230名患者），利用TotalSegmentator对主动脉分支和椎体进行分割来定位11个标志点，并测量每个标志点处的最大直径。由资深放射科医生审查并修正自动测量结果作为金标准参考，通过平均绝对误差（MAE）、偏倚以及大于2 mm的差异比例评估测量一致性。
results: 所有标志点的总体平均绝对误差（MAE）为1.06 mm，86.6%的测量差异在2 mm以内；工具测量值略偏大（偏倚为0.45 mm）；瓦氏窦（主动脉窦）的MAE最大（2.17 mm）；自动测量失败率仅为1.2%。不同病理类型、动脉粥样硬化分级及是否行动电门控对检查层面的MAE无显著差异，但伴有附壁血栓的检查中MAE大于2 mm的比例显著增加（50% vs 20%）。
conclusion: 该开源工具能够沿整个主动脉在11个解剖标志点测量主动脉直径，平均绝对误差约为1 mm，优于已发表的阅片者间变异度；但在主动脉根部以及存在附壁血栓的病变中，测量一致性相对较低。

title: LACCO: Local Accumulation with Computation--Communication Overlap
authors: Daniele Kopyshevskiy, Benjamin Th{é}rien, Nicolas Pinto, Edouard Oyallon
abstract: Training language models across low-bandwidth networks requires reducing synchronization overhead. Local optimization methods such as DiLoCo communicate only after several local steps, but outer gradient averaging and the outer update remain on the critical path. Existing computation-communication overlap methods avoid this stall through delayed or replica-local updates, which can degrade convergence or cause replicas to drift. We propose LACCO (Local Accumulation with Computation-Communication Overlap), a two-stage algorithm that overlaps global communication with local computation while applying globally aggregated updates shared by every replica, without introducing staleness in the outer update. We establish convergence guarantees for smooth non-convex objectives. Experiments on language-model pre-training with FineWeb show that LACCO consistently outperforms communication-overlapped baselines such as Eager and Delayed DiLoCo. These gains remain robust as model size scales up to 0.5B parameters and across a range of communication intervals and numbers of replicas up to 16 workers, while incurring only negligible-or fully overlappable-computational or memory overhead, which demonstrates the strength of LACCO.
zh_title: LACCO：具备计算与通信重叠功能的局部累积算法
translation: 在低带宽网络跨网络训练语言模型需要减少同步开销。诸如 DiLoCo 的局部优化方法仅在进行几次局部步骤后才进行通信，但外部梯度平均和外部更新仍然处于关键路径上。现有的计算-通信重叠方法通过延迟更新或副本局部更新来避免这种停滞，但这可能会降低收敛性或导致副本漂移。我们提出了 LACCO（Local Accumulation with Computation-Communication Overlap），这是一种两阶段算法，它将全局通信与局部计算重叠，同时应用由每个副本共享的全局聚合更新，而不会在外部更新中引入陈旧性。我们为平滑非凸目标建立了收敛性保证。在使用 FineWeb 进行的语言模型预训练实验表明，LACCO 在 Eager 和 Delayed DiLoCo 等通信重叠基线上始终表现出优越性。这些增益随着模型规模扩大到 0.5B 参数、以及在各种通信间隔和多达 16 个工作节点的副本数范围内保持稳健，同时仅产生可忽略或完全可重叠的计算或内存开销，这证明了 LACCO 的优势。
tldr: LACCO 是一种新型分布式训练算法，它在低带宽网络下实现了计算与通信的高效重叠，在保证收敛性的同时显著提升了语言模型预训练的性能。
ai_comments: LACCO 提出了一种巧妙的两阶段算法，通过在保持全局一致更新的同时实现计算与通信的重叠，有效解决了低带宽网络下大语言模型分布式训练的同步瓶颈问题。该方法在理论上具有收敛性保证，在实验中表现出优于现有基线的性能和良好的可扩展性。
motivation: 在低带宽网络中训练语言模型需要减少同步开销。现有的局域优化方法（如 DiLoCo）存在外部梯度平均和更新处于关键路径上的问题，而现有的计算-通信重叠方法则通过延迟更新或副本局部更新来避免停顿，但这会导致收敛性下降或副本漂移。
method: 提出了一种名为 LACCO 的两阶段算法，该算法将全局通信与局部计算进行重叠，应用由所有副本共享的全局聚合更新，且不会在外部更新中引入陈旧性，同时为平滑非凸目标建立了收敛性保证。
results: 使用 FineWeb 进行的语言模型预训练实验表明，LACCO 在通信重叠基线（如 Eager 和 Delayed DiLoCo）上表现更佳，当模型规模扩展至 0.5B 参数、并在不同的通信间隔和多达 16 个工作节点的副本数下依然保持稳健，且仅产生可忽略或完全可重叠的计算或内存开销。
conclusion: LACCO 成功实现了低带宽网络下大语言模型训练中计算与通信的重叠，在不牺牲收敛性的前提下显著提高了训练效率。

title: Understanding the limits of snapshot-based fault diagnosis in distribution networks
authors: Ba Tu Phung, Huy Hoang Le, Kim-Anh Nguyen
abstract: Inverter-based resources weaken fault currents in distribution networks, and snapshot-based diagnosis, which classifies a fault from voltage phasors at a few buses at one instant, offers a cheap first-stage screen. Its published accuracies, however, rest on different noise assumptions and do not show whether the error comes from the classifier, the features, the measurement error, or the fault resistance. This paper separates these sources on three IEEE test feeders and a public data set with distributed generation, using four feature sets, thirteen classifiers, and measurement error defined by total vector error classes. The classifier is not the limiting factor, because the full phasor snapshot classifies every fault correctly without noise, and the remaining error comes from measurement error on high-impedance faults. Three voltage sensors classify 90-96% of faults at the 1% accuracy class and 96-99% with distribution micro phasor measurement units (micro-PMUs). A discriminability-margin placement selects them from simulations alone in under one second and matches the best of twelve placement methods. The results show when snapshot-based diagnosis can be trusted.
zh_title: 理解配电网中基于快照的故障诊断的局限性
