translation: 随着逆变器并网风力机比例的增加，评估其电网行为的测试方法变得越来越重要。本文提出了一种基于功率硬件在环（PHiL）的风力机并网测试方法。该方法首次将通过互联网进行的空气动力学地理分布式仿真以及通过光纤连接进行的电网模型仿真整合到认证相关测试中。该概念扩展了IEC TS 61400-21-4中描述的方法。初步实验结果证实了其具有高仿真质量和足够低的延迟，满足标准兼容的电网仿真要求。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于功率硬件在环（PHiL）的风力机并网测试新方法，通过分布式仿真实现了符合标准的高质量电网仿真。

motivation: 随着逆变器并网风电机组比例的增加，评估其电网行为的测试方法变得日益重要，现有的测试方法需要扩展以适应这种趋势。
method: 提出了一种基于功率硬件在环（PHiL）的方法，并将通过互联网进行的空气动力学地理分布式仿真与通过光纤连接进行的电网模型仿真集成到认证测试中。

title: Quantifying the Advantage of Coarser DPOR
authors: Minjian Zhang, Rupak Majumdar, Umang Mathur, C.-H. Luke Ong
abstract:
Dynamic partial-order reduction (DPOR) has emerged as a promising approach to addressing interleaving explosion in bounded model checking of concurrent programs. Given an equivalence relation on interleavings, the model checker explores a program's executions while minimizing repeated visits to the same class; optimal model checkers avoid such repetition altogether. A coarser equivalence promises faster exploration by reducing the number of classes. This has motivated alternatives to Mazurkiewicz's trace equivalence such as reads-from and reads-value-from equivalence. This promise, however, does not always materialize in practice: while a coarser equivalence can yield exponentially fewer classes on some families of programs, it may offer little or no reduction for the program at hand.
  We show how to quantify the advantage of coarser equivalences for individual programs. We focus on the problem of counting the reads-from (RF) equivalence classes induced by a given program, as well as the problem of computing the ratio of RF to Mazurkiewicz class counts under sequential consistency. We show that both problems are $\#\mathrm{P}$-hard and that the reduction ratio remains hard to approximate accurately under standard complexity assumptions.
  Guided by these limits, we present CoEst, a sampling-based algorithm for estimating both the RF count and its ratio to the Mazurkiewicz count. For a fixed number of threads, each trial runs in polynomial time and yields unbiased count estimates. As the number of independent trials grows, the count and ratio estimates converge almost surely to their true values. Our algorithm can provide statistical evidence for deciding whether Mazurkiewicz or RF model checking is likely to be faster for a given program. In experiments across 34 benchmark configurations, our method selects the faster checker in 99.4% of runs using a one-minute estimation budget.
zh_title: 量化更粗粒度 DPOR 的优势
translation:
动态偏序规约（DPOR）已成为解决并发程序有界模型检验中交织爆炸问题的一个有前景的方法。给定交织上的等价关系，模型检查器在探索程序执行的同时最小化对同一类别的重复访问；最优模型检查器完全避免了这种重复。更粗的等价关系通过减少类别数量，有望实现更快的探索。这促使人们寻找 Mazurkiewicz 轨迹等价性的替代方案，例如读自（reads-from）和读值自（reads-value-from）等价性。然而，这种前景在实践中并不总是能够实现：虽然更粗的等价关系在某些程序族上可以产生指数级更少的类别，但它对当前的程序可能提供很少或没有规约效果。
我们展示了如何量化单个程序中更粗等价关系的优势。我们重点研究了计算给定程序诱导的读自（RF）等价类数量的问题，以及在顺序一致性下计算 RF 与 Mazurkiewicz 类计数比率的问题。我们证明这两个问题都是 #P-hard 的，并且在标准复杂性假设下，规约比率仍然难以被准确近似。
在这些理论限制的指引下，我们提出了 CoEst，一种基于采样的算法，用于估计 RF 计数及其与 Mazurkiewicz 比率。对于固定的线程数，每次试验在多项式时间内运行并产生无偏的计数估计。随着独立试验次数的增加，计数和比率估计几乎必然收敛到其真实值。我们的算法可以提供统计证据，用于决定 Mazurkiewicz 或 RF 模型检验对于给定程序哪个可能更快。在 34 个基准配置的实验中，我们的方法在使用一分钟估计预算的运行中，有 99.4% 的情况下选择了更快的检验器。
tldr: 本文研究并量化了并发程序模型检验中粗粒度 DPOR 等价关系的优势，证明了其计算复杂性，并提出了一种高效的采样估计算法 CoEst 来指导检验器的选择。
ai_comments: 该论文深入探讨了并发程序模型检验中动态偏序规约（DPOR）方法的效率问题，首次从计算复杂性角度量化了粗粒度等价关系的优势，并提出了基于采样的实用估计算法 CoEst，实验效果显著。
motivation: 虽然更粗的等价关系（如 reads-from 和 reads-value-from 等价性）理论上可以通过减少等价类数量来加速并发程序的模型检验，但在实践中这种优势并不总是能够实现，缺乏一种针对特定程序量化这种优势的方法。
method: 证明了计算读自（RF）等价类数量及与 Mazurkiewicz 类计数比率的问题是 #P-hard 且难以精确近似的；在此基础上，提出了一种名为 CoEst 的基于采样的估计算法，能够在多项式时间内给出无偏估计，并通过统计学方法指导模型检验器的选择。
results: 理论上证明了相关计数与比率计算问题的 #P-hard 性质及不可近似性；实验表明，CoEst 算法在 34 个基准配置中，在 1 分钟的预算内有 99.4% 的准确率选择出更快的模型检验器。
conclusion: 粗粒度 DPOR 等价类计数及规约比的计算具有极高的复杂度（#P-hard 且难以近似），但通过 CoEst 算法可以高效地进行统计估计，从而在实践中准确指导模型检验器（Mazurkiewicz 或 RF）的选择。

title: High-order IMEX local discontinuous Galerkin methods with sparse grids for high-dimensional nonlinear parabolic PDEs
authors: Joel P. Villarino, Manuel J. Castro, J. A. García-Rodríguez, J. G. López-Salas
abstract: In this work, we develop a high-order IMEX-LDG scheme on sparse grids for solving nonlinear parabolic PDEs in moderate to high dimensions. The method combines the advantages of LDG methods for convection--diffusion problems, IMEX-RK time integrators for stiff systems, and sparse-grid techniques to mitigate the curse of dimensionality. The resulting scheme is fully parallelized in MPI, is robust, efficient, and scalable, making it suitable for a wide range of applications involving high-dimensional nonlinear parabolic PDEs.
zh_title: 针对高维非线性抛物型偏微分方程的基于稀疏网格的高阶IMEX局部门断Galerkin方法
translation: 在这项工作中，我们开发了一种在稀疏网格上的高阶IMEX-LDG格式，用于求解中高维非线性抛物型偏微分方程。该方法结合了LDG方法用于对流扩散问题的优势、IMEX-RK时间积分器用于刚性系统的优势，以及稀疏网格技术以缓解维数灾难。由此产生的格式在MPI中完全并行化，具有稳健性、高效性和可扩展性，使其适用于涉及高维非线性抛物型偏微分方程的广泛应用。
keywords: 高维非线性抛物型偏微分方程
tldr: 本文开发了一种基于稀疏网格的高阶IMEX-LDG并行数值格式，用于高效求解中高维非线性抛物型偏微分方程。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将高阶IMEX时间积分器、局部门断Galerkin（LDG）方法与稀疏网格技术相结合，有效克服了高维非线性抛物型偏微分方程求解中的“维数灾难”问题，并通过MPI实现了全并行化，具有很高的效率和可扩展性。
motivation: 为了解决中高维非线性抛物型偏微分方程求解中面临的“维数灾难”以及刚性系统计算效率低的问题。
method: 结合了用于对流扩散问题的局部门断Galerkin（LDG）方法、用于处理刚性系统的高阶IMEX-RK时间积分器，以及用于缓解维数灾难的稀疏网格技术，并通过MPI实现全并行化。
results: 开发出一种高阶、稳健、高效且可扩展的稀疏网格IMEX-LDG数值格式，并完成了MPI全并行化，适用于广泛的高维非线性抛物型偏微分方程应用。
conclusion: 通过结合IMEX-LDG方法与稀疏网格技术，并利用MPI进行全并行化，成功实现了一种高效、稳健且具可扩展性的求解高维非线性抛物型偏微分方程的高阶数值格式。

title: Measuring Public Participation in Local Government: An Audio-Based Instrument for Classifying Speakers in City Council Meetings
authors: Menglin Liu, J. Sophia Wang, Ge Shi
abstract: How much does the public actually speak in local government? Despite sustained interest in democratic participation, we lack large-scale measures of public voice at the local level, because the underlying record -- audio of open meetings -- has been prohibitively costly to convert into data. We contribute a measurement instrument: an audio-analysis pipeline that classifies each speaker in a city council meeting as an elected official or a member of the public directly from audio, and aggregates these labels into validated measures of participation such as floor-time share. The pipeline first segments each recording by speaker, then classifies each speaker with a multimodal large language model (MLLM), using the meeting's own temporal structure (neighboring speakers, iterative refinement, and a majority vote across three classifiers) as supporting components. We collect 1,618 recordings from seven U.S. cities (2017-2023); after diarization and quality control, the analytic corpus is 1,565 meetings from five cities. The task is non-trivial: audio quality is uneven, members of the public speak informally and are often introduced only briefly, and speech frequently overlaps. Even so, segmentation reaches 89% accuracy (mean pairwise kappa=0.84), and the classifier reaches 87.7% accuracy (kappa=0.736, public-participant F1=0.832) on ground truth from five cities (N=1,761 speakers) -- agreement comparable to that among the human annotators themselves. At scale, members of the public receive a median of just 10% of floor time, the top speaker is an official in over 94% of meetings, and public participation declined over COVID-19 without recovering by 2023. The instrument measures participation directly from audio, without transcription or linkage to external voter or property records, establishing audio-as-data as a practical approach for the study of local politics.
zh_title: 衡量地方政府中的公众参与：一种基于音频的城市议会会议发言者分类工具
translation: 公众在地方政府中实际发言多少？尽管对民主参与持续关注，但我们缺乏大规模衡量地方层面公众声音的方法，因为将底层记录——开放会议的音频——转换为数据成本过高。我们贡献了一个测量工具：一个音频分析流程，直接从音频中将城市议会会议的每个发言者分类为民选官员或公众成员，并将这些标签聚合为经过验证的参与度量，例如发言时间份额。该流程首先按发言者分割每段录音，然后使用多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）对每个发言者进行分类，并利用会议自身的时间结构（相邻发言者、迭代细化和三个分类器的多数投票）作为辅助组件。我们收集了来自七个美国城市（2017-2023年）的1618份录音；经过语音分离和质量控制后，分析语料库包括来自五个城市的1565次会议。这项任务并非易事：音频质量不均，公众成员非正式发言且通常只作简短介绍，并且发言经常重叠。尽管如此，在来自五个城市（N=1,761名发言者）的真实数据上，分割准确率达到89%（平均成对kappa=0.84），分类器准确率达到87.7%（kappa=0.736，公众参与者F1=0.832）——这一一致性与人类标注者之间的一致性相当。大规模分析发现，公众成员获得的发言时间中位数仅为10%，超过94%的会议中首席发言人是官员，并且公众参与度在COVID-19期间下降，到2023年仍未恢复。该工具无需转录或链接外部选民或财产记录，直接从音频测量参与度，证实了“音频即数据”是研究地方政治的一种实用方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于音频分析的工具，用于分类城市议会会议中的发言者（官员或公众），并测量公众参与度。研究发现，公众的发言时间份额中位数仅为10%，且在COVID-19后有所下降。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的方法，利用音频分析和多模态大型语言模型来克服传统数据收集的障碍，从而大规模衡量地方政府中的公众参与。其创新性在于将复杂的音频数据转化为可量化的民主参与指标，为政治学研究提供了强大的新工具。研究结果揭示了公众参与度低的现实，并指出了其在疫情期间的下降趋势，具有重要的社会和政策意义。
motivation: 尽管对民主参与持续关注，但缺乏大规模衡量地方层面公众声音的方法，因为将开放会议的音频记录转换为数据成本过高。
method: 研究开发了一个音频分析流程，直接从音频中将城市议会会议的每个发言者分类为民选官员或公众成员，并将这些标签聚合为参与度量。该流程首先按发言者分割录音，然后使用多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）进行分类，并利用会议的时间结构（相邻发言者、迭代细化和三个分类器的多数投票）作为辅助组件。收集了来自七个美国城市的1618份录音，最终分析了来自五个城市的1565次会议。
results: 分割准确率达到89%（平均成对kappa=0.84），分类器准确率达到87.7%（kappa=0.736，公众参与者F1=0.832），与人类标注者之间的一致性相当。大规模分析发现，公众成员获得的发言时间中位数仅为10%，超过94%的会议中首席发言人是官员，并且公众参与度在COVID-19期间下降，到2023年仍未恢复。
conclusion: 该工具无需转录或链接外部选民或财产记录，直接从音频测量参与度，证实了“音频即数据”是研究地方政治的一种实用方法。

title: TelePhysica: Agentic Reconstruction of Physically Interactive Scenes
authors: Ruiqi Shu, Xufeng Zhan, Yuanzhi Liang, Haibin Huang, Chi Zhang, Xuelong Li
abstract: Direct image-to-video diffusion models entangle pixel synthesis with implicit latent motion, precluding persistent 3D mechanical equilibrium, mid-rollout intervention, and counterfactual force control. Conversely, single-pass programmatic 3D reconstruction from an uncalibrated photograph leaves monocular depth and support clearance underconstrained, causing reconstructed scenes to interpenetrate or collapse under gravity. We present TelePhysica, a closed-loop framework that reconstructs an executable, multi-regime physical world from a single photograph to drive stateful 3D interaction and trajectory-grounded video synthesis. A vision-language coding agent synthesizes separable visual meshes and declarative physical models within a two-stage verification loop that pairs pixel-aligned silhouette critique with a zero-force gravitational equilibrium preflight. The verified world compiles into a unified solver coupling rigid bodies, articulated chains, co-dimensional cloth shells, and 3D tetrahedral elastodynamics, whose simulated rollouts condition pretrained video diffusion models through pixel-aligned structural streams. On a 100-scene single-image benchmark, closed-loop execution raises equilibrium-verified world recovery from $0\%$ in single-pass synthesis to $81\%$. Controlled constitutive ablations show over an order-of-magnitude larger localized corner displacement and out-of-plane pleating in finite-element cloth than in matched rigid-plate proxies. Conditioning video diffusion on simulated trajectories increases dynamic motion-mask overlap by $2{\times}\text{--}5{\times}$ and preserves motion direction under counterfactual force reversals where direct image-to-video models fail.
zh_title: TelePhysica：物理交互场景的智能体重建
translation: 直接图像到视频扩散模型将像素合成与隐式潜在运动纠缠在一起，排除了持久的3D机械平衡、中间干预和反事实力控制。相反，从未经校准的照片进行单通道程序化3D重建会使单目深度和支撑间隙约束不足，导致重建的场景相互穿透或在重力作用下坍塌。我们提出了TelePhysica，一个闭环框架，它从一张照片中重建一个可执行的多模式物理世界，以驱动有状态的3D交互和轨迹驱动的视频合成。一个视觉-语言编码代理在一个两阶段验证循环中合成可分离的视觉网格和声明式物理模型，该循环将像素对齐的轮廓批判与零力重力平衡预检相结合。经验证的世界被编译成一个统一的求解器，耦合了刚体、关节链、协同维度布料壳和3D四面体弹性动力学，其模拟结果通过像素对齐的结构流调节预训练的视频扩散模型。在100个场景的单图像基准测试中，闭环执行将平衡验证的世界恢复率从单通道合成的0%提高到81%。受控的本构消融实验表明，有限元布料中的局部角位移和平面外褶皱比匹配的刚性板代理大一个数量级以上。通过模拟轨迹调节视频扩散模型，动态运动掩模重叠增加了2到5倍，并在直接图像到视频模型失效的反事实力逆转下保持了运动方向。
tldr: TelePhysica是一个闭环框架，能从单张照片重建可执行的物理世界，解决现有方法在物理平衡和交互方面的不足，并显著提高3D场景重建的物理真实性和视频合成的准确性。
ai_comments: TelePhysica通过引入闭环验证和多物理求解器，为从单张图像重建物理上可信的交互式3D场景提供了一种新颖且强大的方法。其创新之处在于结合了视觉-语言代理、分阶段验证以及统一的物理引擎，显著提高了重建场景的物理真实性和可操作性。这对于需要精确物理交互和动态视频生成的应用具有重要意义，克服了传统图像到视频模型和单通道3D重建的局限性。
motivation: 现有图像到视频扩散模型无法保持3D机械平衡、干预或反事实力控制；单通道3D重建则因深度和支撑间隙不足导致场景穿透或坍塌。本文旨在解决这些问题，实现从单张照片重建物理上可信且可交互的场景。
method: TelePhysica是一个闭环框架，利用视觉-语言编码代理合成可分离的视觉网格和声明式物理模型。通过像素对齐的轮廓批判和零力重力平衡预检两阶段验证循环，确保场景的物理可行性。验证后的世界被编译成一个统一的求解器，处理刚体、关节链、协同维度布料壳和3D四面体弹性动力学，其模拟结果通过像素对齐的结构流调节预训练的视频扩散模型。
results: 在100个场景的单图像基准测试中，闭环执行将平衡验证的世界恢复率从单通道合成的0%提高到81%。有限元布料在局部角位移和平面外褶皱方面比匹配的刚性板代理大一个数量级以上。通过模拟轨迹调节视频扩散模型，动态运动掩模重叠增加了2到5倍，并在直接图像到视频模型失效的反事实力逆转下保持了运动方向。
conclusion: TelePhysica框架通过闭环验证和多物理求解器，能够从单张照片高精度地重建物理上可信且可交互的3D场景，显著优于现有方法在物理平衡、干预能力和视频合成真实性方面的表现。

title: Generalized hydraulic neural operators turbocharging sewer digital twins
authors: Ruozhou Lin, Shixun Li, Tao Shi, Lihan Hu, Zhiyu Zhang, Wenchong Tian, Zhiguo Yuan
abstract: Hydraulic digital twins are emerging as the next-generation paradigm for operating and managing sewer systems. Conventional hydraulic digital twinning relies on running physics-based models (e.g., Saint-Venant equations), which are computationally expensive and often too slow for real-time applications. Although surrogates (e.g., neural networks) can be fast, existing approaches are typically non-generalizable, requiring costly retraining for unseen pipes, networks, or flow conditions. Here, we develop a fast, generalized and differentiable multi-branch neural operator trained on solutions of the Saint-Venant equations that predicts in-pipe hydraulics. The learned operator reproduces complex hydraulic dynamics with high fidelity while achieving thousand- to million-fold speedups for online prediction, data assimilation, and diagnostics. Equally importantly, the learned operator generalizes to unseen pipes, networks, and flow conditions without retraining. These advances address key computational barriers to real-time sewer digital twins, opening new opportunities for more responsive flood-risk management and protection of urban water environments.
zh_title: 广义水力神经算子赋能下水道数字孪生
translation: 水力数字孪生正在成为运营和管理下水道系统的下一代范式。传统的水力数字孪生依赖于运行基于物理模型（例如圣维南方程），这些模型计算成本高，通常对于实时应用而言过于缓慢。尽管替代模型（例如神经网络）速度很快，但现有方法通常不可泛化，需要对未见过的管道、网络或流况进行昂贵的重新训练。在这里，我们开发了一种快速、广义且可微的多分支神经算子，该算子根据圣维南方程的解进行训练，用于预测管道内水力学。所学习到的算子以高保真度复现复杂的水力动力学，同时在在线预测、数据同化和诊断方面实现了千倍至百万倍的加速。同样重要的是，所学习到的算子无需重新训练即可泛化到未见过的管道、网络和流况。这些进展解决了实时下水道数字孪生的关键计算障碍，为更具响应性的防洪管理和城市水环境保护开辟了新的机遇。
tldr: 开发了一种新型水力神经算子，实现了下水道水力模拟数百万倍的加速，且无需重新训练即可泛化至未知管网和流况。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将神经常微分方程或神经算子（Neural Operator）应用于城市排水管网的水力学模拟，通过学习圣维南方程的解，实现了极高的计算加速（上千到上百万倍），并且具备对未见管道、网络和流况的零样本泛化能力，为实时城市防洪和水环境管理扫清了计算障碍。
motivation: 传统的基于物理模型（如圣维南方程）的水力数字孪生计算成本高昂，无法满足实时应用的需求；而现有的神经网络代理模型缺乏泛化能力，面对未见过的管道、网络或流况时需要重新进行代价高昂的训练。
method: 开发了一种快速、广义且可微的多分支神经算子，该算子基于圣维南方程的解进行训练，用于预测管道内部的水力状态。
results: 该学习得到的算子能够高保真地复现复杂的水力动力学过程，在在线预测、数据同化和诊断方面实现了数千至数百万倍的加速，并且能够在无需重新训练的情况下泛化到未见过的管道、网络和流况中。
conclusion: 研究所开发的广义水力神经算子成功克服了传统物理模型计算缓慢和现有代理模型泛化能力差的瓶颈，为实现实时、高效的下水道数字孪生系统奠定了坚实的基础。

title: On Applications of Polynomial-Time Group Isomorphism Algorithm
authors: Wenkang Zhang, Zhinan Wang, Jincheng Zhuang
abstract: The group isomorphism problem is a fundamental problem in computational group theory and is closely related to many other problems. Recently, Qiao and Zhang proposed a polynomial-time algorithm for finite group isomorphism in the multiplication-table model that computes the coset of all isomorphisms. Based on the algorithm of Qiao and Zhang, we study applications to finite associative ring isomorphism, bilinear map isotopism over finite commutative rings and free three-tensor isomorphism over finite commutative rings. First, we obtain a polynomial-time algorithm that returns the coset of all isomorphisms for finite associative rings. Second, we extend efficient isotopism and isomorphism algorithms for bilinear maps and free three-tensors from fields to general finite commutative rings.
zh_title: 论多项式时间群同构算法的应用
translation: 群同构问题是计算群论中的一个基础问题，并且与许多其他问题紧密相关。最近，Qiao和Zhang提出了在乘法表模型中计算所有同构陪集的有限群同构多项式时间算法。基于Qiao和Zhang的算法，我们研究了其在有限结合环同构、有限交换环上的双线性映射同位素以及有限交换环上的自由三阶张量同构中的应用。首先，我们获得了一个返回有限结合环所有同构陪集的多项式时间算法。其次，我们将双线性映射和自由三阶张量的高效同位素与同构算法从域推广到了通用的有限交换环。
tldr: 利用最新的多项式时间群同构算法，本文实现了有限结合环同构以及有限交换环上双线性映射和三阶张量同构的高效求解。
ai_comments: 该论文基于Qiao和Zhang近期提出的乘法表模型下有限群同构的多项式时间算法，成功将其应用拓展至有限结合环同构、有限交换环上的双线性映射同位素以及自由三阶张量同构问题，展现了群同构算法在代数结构计算中的广泛应用价值与重要性。
motivation: 群同构问题是计算群论中的基本问题，且与许多其他问题密切相关。Qiao和Zhang最近提出了乘法表模型下计算所有同构陪集的有限群同构多项式时间算法，这激发了研究者探索该算法在其他代数结构中的应用潜力。
method: 基于Qiao和Zhang提出的乘法表模型下的有限群同构多项式时间算法，研究其在有限结合环同构、有限交换环上的双线性映射同位素及自由三阶张量同构中的应用，并将其从域推广到一般的有限交换环。
results: 首先，得到了一个可在多项式时间内返回有限结合环所有同构陪集的算法；其次，将双线性映射和自由三阶张量的高效同位素与同构算法从域推广到了普通的有限交换环。
conclusion: 论文成功利用多项式时间群同构算法，推导并扩展出多个相关代数结构（结合环、双线性映射、自由三阶张量）的高效同构与同位素算法。

title: Two-Clustering Regime of Token Dynamics in Causal Attention
authors: Trinh T. Nguyen, Duy-Tung Pham, Hoang-Son Do, Tan Minh Nguyen, Thieu N. Vo
abstract: We partially resolve Conjecture 1 of [Karagodin et al., Clustering in Causal Attention Masking (NeurIPS 2024)] and extend it to time-dependent parameter regimes. The conjecture predicts that causal attention dynamics converge to two clusters aligned with the eigenvectors associated with the largest eigenvalue $λ_{\max}$ of the value transformation. We prove that this behavior holds when $λ_{\max}>0$ and is generally false when $λ_{\max}\le0$. The resulting two-cluster regime is common in practice and substantially more challenging than the classical single-cluster setting studied previously. A central contribution of our work is the identification of a rigorous dimension reduction phenomenon: despite evolving in a high-dimensional embedding space, token trajectories collapse onto a two-dimensional structure governed by a small number of dominant directions. Building on this insight, we introduce a new analytical framework--instability within the flow--inspired by instability phenomena in physical systems. This framework enables the analysis of steady-regime behavior in non-monotone, non-autonomous attention dynamics. Our theoretical findings are illustrated through simulations and experimental studies using Group Query Attention (GQA) layers.

title: Bound-preserving finite volume scheme for a coupled parabolic system with nonlinear and nonlocal drift
authors: Nicklas Jävergård, Adrian Muntean
abstract: We propose a bound preserving finite-volume scheme for a coupled system of partial differential equations with nonlinear, nonlocal drift. The main contribution of this work is twofold: $(1)$ we show that the proposed scheme preserves physically motivated bounds; $(2)$ we prove that the scheme is well-posed and leads to a sequence of approximate solutions converging to the weak solution of the original problem. This setting is motivated by questions related to morphology formation in organic solar cells.

title: Distributed Output-Feedback Control for Linear Multichannel Systems
authors: Ruixuan Zhao, Guitao Yang, Boli Chen, Thomas Parisini
abstract: This paper investigates distributed output-feedback stabilization of linear multichannel systems in which agents exchange state estimates without disclosing local control inputs or feedback gains. Remote control actions are treated as unknown inputs and geometrically decoupled from stable quotient-error dynamics. The proposed framework accommodates nontrivial intersections of local loss subspaces by retaining the coupling between the plant and common estimation errors. A Hurwitz condition on the coupled dynamics, together with a sufficient consensus-gain bound, guarantees exponential closed-loop convergence for every fixed feedback selection in a compact family. For polytopic feedback families, a quotient-preserving parameterization of output injections enables joint synthesis of nominal feedback and observer gains via alternating linear matrix inequalities, followed by a convex semidefinite program certifying a common consensus gain. A numerical example demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed design.
zh_title: 线性多通道系统的分布式输出反馈控制
translation: 本文研究了线性多通道系统的分布式输出反馈镇定，其中智能体在交换状态估计的同时不公开本地控制输入或反馈增益。远程控制动作被视为未知输入，并在几何上与稳定的商误差动力学解耦。所提出的框架通过保持植物与公共估计误差之间的耦合，适应了局部损失子空间的非平凡交集。耦合动力学上的Hurwitz条件以及足够的一致性增益界，保证了紧凑族中每个固定反馈选择的指数闭环收敛性。对于多面体反馈族，输出注入的商保持参数化使得能够通过交替线性矩阵不等式联合综合名义反馈和观测器增益，随后通过凸半定规划证明公共一致性增益。数值算例证明了所提设计的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于线性多通道系统的分布式输出反馈控制与镇定方法，该方法在保护局部隐私的同时，通过几何解耦与交替LMI实现了指数收敛的闭环控制。
ai_comments: 该论文在保证控制输入和反馈增益隐私的前提下，研究了线性多通道系统的分布式输出反馈镇定问题。方法创新地利用几何解耦和交替线性矩阵不等式（LMI）来实现观测器与反馈增益的联合综合，具有很强的理论深度和应用价值。
motivation: 研究线性多通道系统的分布式输出反馈镇定问题，特别是在智能体交互状态估计时如何不泄露本地控制输入或反馈增益的隐私，同时克服局部损失子空间非平凡交集的挑战。
method: 将远程控制动作视为未知输入并通过几何解耦将其与稳定商误差动力学分离；针对多面体反馈族，通过商保持参数化输出注入，利用交替线性矩阵不等式联合综合名义反馈和观测器增益，最后通过凸半定规划证明公共一致性增益。
results: 满足耦合动力学的Hurwitz条件以及足够的一致性增益界时，可保证紧凑族中每个固定反馈选择的指数闭环收敛性，数值算例验证了设计方案的有效性。
conclusion: 本文成功实现了线性多通道系统的分布式输出反馈镇定，既保护了局部隐私，又确保了系统的指数收敛性，并通过数值算例验证了方法的有效性。

title: Deep Latents, Long Memory: Latent persistence explains temporal correlations in transformer activations
authors: Francesco Cagnetta, Santiago Acevedo
abstract: The hidden layers of Large Language Models (LLMs) are believed to encode representations of the data whose abstraction increases with depth. However, in the absence of an operational notion of abstraction, this statement is hard to test quantitatively. Here, we propose an alternative view, building on the principle that the correlations of a sequence reflect the structure of the process that generated it. We define the autocorrelation function of a layer as the average dot product between its activations at two context positions separated by a lag. Latent variables encoded persistently along the context create slowly decaying tails in the autocorrelation, and we find these tails to grow across layers in both synthetic and natural data. In synthetic data with controlled hierarchical latent structure, this growth stems from the encoding of abstract latent variables, which govern long stretches of the input. Indeed, the persistence of latent codes predicts the qualitative structure of autocorrelations and accounts for most of the empirical measures. In real text, we take sparse-autoencoder features as proxies for latent variables, and find that their persistence correlates strongly with the magnitude of autocorrelations across datasets and LLMs. In particular, the persistence time increases with depth, as do autocorrelations, implying that deeper latent features persist for longer context spans. We complement this analysis by explicitly ablating the persistent sparse-autoencoder features and observing a consequent decrease in the autocorrelations.

title: VEPO: Mitigating Multilingual Hallucinations in LVLMs via Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization
authors: Chengpeng Fu, Xiaocheng Feng, Wenshuai Huo, Yichong Huang, Baohang Li, Duyu Tang, Ting Liu
abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) achieve strong multimodal performance, yet they remain prone to object hallucination---generating answers that are linguistically fluent but visually ungrounded. This issue is especially severe in low-resource languages, where weaker cross-modal alignment causes models to rely more on language priors than on image evidence. Existing remedies either require costly multilingual annotations or external translation/reward models, or intervene at inference time in ways that can distort the output language. We propose VEPO(Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization), a training-time method that transfers reliable visual grounding from English to other languages without external models. VEPO first localizes key visual evidence using English queries via mid-layer cross-modal attention, then constructs preference pairs that share the same correct answer but differ in evidence sufficiency (full image vs.\ key-region masked image). Direct preference optimization on these pairs encourages low-resource inputs to prefer answers supported by complete visual evidence. Experiments on multilingual POPE and MME with Chinese, French, and Hindi show consistent hallucination reduction and perception gains, with the largest improvements on the lowest-resource language. Analyses further confirm that VEPO sharpens question-relevant attention and that evidence-guided masking outperforms random masking.

title: Controllability-Informed Distributed Electric Propulsion Aircraft Design Using Probabilistic Attainable Moment Sets
authors: Umut Demir, Torbjørn Cunis, Aamir Ahmad, Walter Fichter
abstract: Integrated aircraft design combines models of aerodynamics, propulsion, mass, and mission performance in one design loop, so that the disciplines can be traded against each other from the earliest stage. For configurations with distributed electric propulsion (DEP), part of the control authority comes from the propulsion system itself, which directly affects the required size of the tail and should therefore be known while the aircraft is being sized. This paper presents a controllability measure that is evaluated for every design in the loop and returned to it as a design signal. The attainable moment set of each candidate design is computed from the surrugate models of the loop and it is compared with a required moment set. Since the low-fidelity surrugate models are uncertain, the comparison is formulated with probabilistic attainable moment sets: the uncertainty is propagated to the boundary of the set, which yields a margin for every direction in the moment space and the probability of violating the requirement. The design loop thereby informed whether a configuration provides sufficient control authority, on which axes it falls short, and how this changes with the design variables. The approach is demonstrated on a DEP regional aircraft, where the signal is used to assess the size of the vertical tail.

title: AG-JEPA: Anatomically Guided Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Neurodegenerative Representation Learning
authors: Azad Singh, Ayantika Das, Amog Rao, Aiman Farooq, Anirban Porya, Ananya Shukla, Sowbhagya Suresh, Srinivasan Iyengar, Mohit Jain, Mercy Prasanna Ranjit
abstract: Brain MRI can reveal early signs of Alzheimers disease (AD) before measurable cognitive decline becomes apparent. However, during the transition from cognitively normal (CN) to mild cognitive impairment (MCI), the disease-related signals are often subtle and confined to only a few brain regions. Existing Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) models learn general structural representations but do not explicitly capture the anatomical regions affected in AD. We propose Anatomically Guided JEPA (AG-JEPA), which introduces anatomical tokens that interact with patch tokens during pretraining to learn region-specific representations from brain regions relevant to neurodegeneration. Building on this representation space, we further propose Prog-AG-JEPA, which models disease progression trajectory as a conditioned latent displacement within this space. We evaluate AG-JEPA across five downstream tasks spanning Alzheimer's disease diagnosis and progression prediction. AG-JEPA improves diagnosis and MCI prognosis, achieving an 8.4 percentage point AUROC gain over the strongest baseline on CN/MCI classification and a 7.1 percentage point gain on out-of-distribution CN/AD classification on the MR-RATE dataset, highlighting its effectiveness across both early-stage detection and cross-cohort generalization. For disease progression modeling, Prog-AG-JEPA consistently outperforms all baselines on future diagnosis and brain volume change prediction, demonstrating the value of anatomically grounded neurodegeneration representations for diagnosis and prognosis.

title: Beyond Scalar Inertia: Frequency-Response-Based Assessment of Finite-Duration Inertial Support in Grid-Forming Converters
authors: Ziqi Zhou, Mahdieh S. Sadabadi, Sante Pugliese, Xiaoqiang Li, Xiaojie Wu, Marco Liserre
abstract: Conventional scalar inertia characterizes only the low-frequency terminal behavior of grid-forming converters (GFMs) and cannot fully predict inertial energy delivery during short-duration frequency disturbances. This letter proposes a frequency-response-based method to assess finite-duration inertial support using complex terminal power--frequency responses, such as those provided by Network Frequency Perturbation (NFP) plots. For GFMs with nonzero steady-state droop, a duration-dependent energy-equivalent inertia is defined after subtracting the ideal static-droop contribution. An exact spectral relationship is established, expressing this metric as a duration-weighted integral of frequency-dependent inertia, without requiring knowledge of the internal controller structure and parameters. The duration dependence of the metric is further shown to encode observable oscillation frequencies and damping ratios. A coefficient-decoupling GFM control with identical scalar inertia and droop across different settings is used for verification.
comment: This paper has 8 pages with 8 figures

title: Do Machines Learn Deviance From Their Peers? A Randomized Test of Differential Association With AI Agents
authors: Murat Ozer, Arif Akgul, Amitabh Chakravorty
abstract: Differential association theory and its extension, social learning theory, hold that rule-breaking, and the definitions that make it acceptable, are learned through interaction with others. Because people choose their friends, this claim has been hard to test. We addressed this selection problem with AI agents, which learn only through communication and can be assigned to peers at random. In a preregistered experiment, 420 teams of three agents (1,260 agents; seven AI models) worked on coding tasks that could not be solved honestly. A scripted teammate said that it had cheated (deviant peer), that it had reported the problem honestly (honest peer), or said nothing (silent peer). Half of the teams were told that an auditor read their chat. Compared with a silent peer, a deviant peer increased cheating (66.2% vs. 62.9%; OR = 1.96) and an honest peer reduced it (55.7%; OR = 0.35). Among agents that cheated, a deviant peer increased claims that cheating was normal (13.7% vs. 3.4%), often as the team's norm. Monitoring did not suppress prohibited discussion; it doubled it. Peers mattered only for models that had not yet decided. AI agents offer a new way to test criminological learning theories without selection effects.

title: EcoVGGT: Pinned-Key Inference for Efficient and Streamable Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Long Videos
authors: Hongsen Cao, Shanxin Yuan, Mona Jaber, Ahmed Sayed
abstract: Feed-forward multi-view transformers such as VGGT recover the cameras and geometry of a video in one pass, but the cost of their cross-frame attention grows quadratically with the frame count, and their accuracy drops on long videos. Most remedies approximate attention over all frames within a budget or select a few keys by their content. We hypothesize that the keys of a long video can be chosen without looking at its content, and our experiments on VGGT and $π^3$ support it: a few dozen evenly spread frames can serve as the keys of every frame. We present EcoVGGT, a training-free inference framework whose keys form a Pinned Key Set of 31 such frames. A pin pass stores their tokens in a Scene Cache, and the other frames read it in independent batches that reproduce joint inference with these keys exactly, at a constant cost per frame. An Online Stream updates the pinned frames during recording. Six middle global blocks align the frames and form a reusable VGGT module: the Alignment Score reads their attention to flag failures, and Alignment Refocusing reduces them by fine-tuning only these blocks (3.6 GPU hours). EcoVGGT ($π^3$) matches the success rate of $π^3$ on 1,000-frame ScanNet videos at 13.8 times its speed. With refocusing, EcoVGGT (VGGT) raises the success rate of VGGT from 70% to 82% at 8.5 times its speed on 500 frames. EcoVGGT reconstructs 4,000 frames on one GPU, and EcoVGGT ($π^3$) streams 1,000 frames at 18.6 frames per second with the lowest online absolute trajectory error.
comment: 26 pages, 10 figures. v2: renamed the method from EcoVGGT to Eco3R, added Figure 1, and revised the text

title: Contagious Fingerprints: When LLMs Inherit Another Model's Identity
authors: Zailong Tian
abstract: The fingerprint by which a classifier recognizes the LLM behind a text is usually treated as a fixed property of the model. We show that it is contagious: a model that continues a conversation begun by another model inherits that model's fingerprint. This undermines audits of API relays, which can serve the first turns of a conversation with the model a customer pays for and silently hand the rest to a cheaper one. After such a handoff, detection of the substitute by a text classifier drops from 0.97 to 0.72 (DeepSeek replacing Claude Sonnet) and from 0.87 to 0.54 for a same-vendor downgrade (Haiku), and retraining on handoff data repairs only substitutes seen in training. Preregistered experiments trace the contagion to imitation of the history's style. History also moves a model away from its own fingerprint: active probes are not camouflaged, but when calibrated on fresh conversations they flag \emph{honest} models on long contexts at rates up to 1.00, and a standard MMD equality test rejects all nine models we test. Both failures come from comparing a history-dependent reply with a history-free reference. We propose \textsc{Lineup}, which samples references from the claimed model \emph{on the same history} and tests the audited reply by its rank among them. \textsc{Lineup} controls false positives by exchangeability and needs no fitted threshold or log-probabilities. With contemporaneous references on two closed models, its false-positive rate is 0.056 (preregistered bound 0.10), and it detects 0.81 of substitute sessions across six pairs after four audited turns.

title: KnowVis: Dual-View Evaluation and Diagnosis of World-Knowledge Grounding in Text-to-Image Models
authors: Yonghang Yu, Ruoyu Wang, Haoyu Zhang, Lin Qi, Yawei Zhou, Changqian Yu
abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models have made substantial progress in visual realism, aesthetic quality, and instruction following. However, real-world prompts often go beyond explicit visual descriptions and require implicit facts, structured knowledge, and domain-specific commonsense. Existing evaluations mainly focus on explicit prompt-to-image semantic alignment or specific knowledge subdomains, lacking unified evaluation and diagnosis of world-knowledge grounding in T2I models. We introduce KnowVis for dual-view evaluation and diagnosis of world-knowledge grounding in T2I generation. Built on a hierarchical knowledge taxonomy with case-level annotations, KnowVis combines two complementary benchmark views with a structured MLLM-based VQA judge protocol. The Skill-Tree Benchmark supports fine-grained atomic knowledge evaluation, while the Generalized Benchmark examines open-ended knowledge composition and expression. The protocol uses Required VQAs to assess atomic knowledge correctness in the Skill-Tree Benchmark, and combines Required, Optional, and dynamically discovered knowledge expressions with human-judge collaborative evaluation in the Generalized Benchmark. We validate the protocol's reliability on the Skill-Tree validation split, enabling scalable evaluation and diagnostic error attribution. Experiments show that KnowVis reveals notable gaps in world-knowledge grounding across existing T2I models and provides structured diagnostic signals for knowledge-intensive image generation.
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 E&D Track. Codebase: https://github.com/QuantumWhisper42/KnowVis

title: Multi-GPU Tridiagonal Partition Algorithm
authors: Milena Veneva
abstract: This paper presents a multi-GPU version and a multi-GPU recursive version of the parallel partition method for systems of linear algebraic equations with tridiagonal coefficient matrices and their implementations in CUDA. Computational experiments on one and two GPU cards, for different system sizes and with different number of recursive steps are conducted. The results are analyzed and discussed.
comment: 3 pages, 3 tables, Mathematical Modelling and Computational Physics 2026 international conference (MMCP'2026), Dubna, Russia

title: PoliMop: Policy-in-the-Loop Motion Planning in 3D Spaces for Mobile Robots
authors: Yael Fassbind, Valentin N. Hartmann, Huang Su, Yijiang Huang, Stelian Coros
abstract: Reaching a goal state in a complex environment often requires a robot to overcome challenging terrain and obstacles. Which routes are accessible depends on the robot's physical design, the control policy it uses, and how it modifies its surroundings. We present a kinodynamic rapidly-exploring random tree (RRT) planner that uses physics simulation to exploit skills encoded in the control policy, which allows it to find a path in the scene with respect to the robot's capabilities. The planner samples states from a reduced state space in 3D around the scene and expands the RRT toward each sample using policy rollouts. We guide sampling with a preplanned path for a simple mass-point model to focus exploration on promising regions leading toward the goal state, reducing planning time by up to 63%. Simulation experiments with quadrupeds, humanoids, and wheeled robots demonstrate that our approach supports drop-in integration of various robots and control policies, exploiting their physical and policy capabilities without modifying the underlying planning algorithm. Predefined environmental modifications, such as placing a plank across a gap to build a bridge, will automatically be picked up by the planner as the robot's reachable space expands.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Videos and code: https://ariael21.github.io/polimop.html

title: Query Processing with eBPF-Offload on Computational Storage
authors: Alexander Krause, Niclas Hedam, Johannes Pietrzyk, Dirk Habich, Wolfgang Lehner, Sangjin Lee, Alberto Lerner, Philippe Bonnet
abstract: The idea of pushing computation to storage devices has been explored for decades. In recent years, research has focused on computational storage, i.e., devices that allow a host to execute functions as I/O commands on local data. Today, the NVMe and SNIA computational storage standards share an execution model in which the host invokes functions on the device, on data that the host has moved into device memory. Both standards single out eBPF as a format for functions offloaded by the host. In this paper, we study whether this form of computational storage is a good match for query processing. We present the design and implementation of Delilah, a prototype based on an open-hardware device that implements the standard execution model on an actual device and runs eBPF programs calling device-resident functions. As an initial step, we hand-coded a portion of SSB Q3.3 for execution on the device, aiming to integrate computational storage with a database system's storage manager. The series of experiments that we ran showed that offloading gains little over host execution, execution degenerates into column-at-a-time processing, and time is spent staging and moving data in device memory. Because these roadblocks stem from the execution model rather than from the query, we did not pursue integration further. We detail these limitations and lay the groundwork for a different computational storage model better aligned with data-intensive workloads.

title: Folding Language Models into Themselves
authors: Ziyang Zhang, Yubin Jing, Yuyao Li, Haofan Wang, Yichen Gong
abstract: Knowledge distillation usually trains a compact student from scratch, which needs a large amount of data even though the teacher's weights already encode most of what the student has to learn. In this work, we explore building the student directly from the teacher's weights. We propose Concertina, which folds every group of N adjacent teacher layers into one shared block that is executed N times. Each loop step carries a low-rank correction initialized from the layer it replaces, and a per-token gate mixes these corrections, to let every token recover the behavior of the original layers from a single shared block. We further design a distillation data recipe that balances general, mathematical, academic and targeted multiple-choice data, to recover all capabilities of the teacher together rather than one at the expense of another. On Qwen3-4B, a 2.27B Concertina model distilled on 22B tokens retains about 90% of the teacher on commonsense and mathematical reasoning and 84% on average across eight benchmarks. It outperforms same-size dense and layer-sharing baselines, as well as Qwen3-1.7B, which is trained on over a thousand times more data. These results suggest that a compact model need not be retrained at scale, since folding the teacher into itself and distilling it on the right data recovers most of its capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/myboker/concertina.

title: Interpretable weight-space programming builds transparent transformers and brain encoding models
authors: Yash Mehta, Chandan Singh, Weijia Xu, Richard J. Antonello, Adeen Flinker, Nima Mesgarani, Michael F. Bonner, Nebojsa Jojic, Jianfeng Gao
abstract: Neural networks are powerful predictors, yet their opacity limits their usefulness in science, where the goal is explanation rather than mere prediction. In neuroscience, for example, deep encoding models accurately predict brain activity in response to natural stimuli, but struggle to reveal which stimulus features drive those predictions. Here we introduce interpretable weight-space programming (iWSP), a method in which an LLM agent iteratively builds interpretable models by explicitly programming their weights and features in code, without gradient-based training (backpropagation). Without backpropagation to tune parameters, the agent must draw on its prior knowledge and reason over previous trials to hypothesize, hand-craft, and refine human-interpretable computations mirroring the workflow of a human scientist. LLM audits confirm the interpretability of the hand-crafted models. We first validate iWSP by tasking it with constructing transformers for canonical benchmarks such as arithmetic and sentiment classification, finding that LLM agents can successfully craft compact, accurate networks directly. Next, we apply iWSP to build neural encoding models across vision, language, and audition. In the visual cortex, iWSP outpredicts existing interpretable baselines, uncovers distinct computations across early/higher visual areas, and generalizes to unseen data. In language fMRI, iWSP surfaces a confound in the data and in auditory ECoG, it systematically discovers interpretable acoustic features that predict neural activity. Together, these results establish iWSP as a general paradigm for aligning high predictive performance with human-interpretable scientific discovery.

title: Any Channel Count, One Token Stream: Incorporating Spatial Audio Understanding and Reasoning into Large Audio-Language Models
authors: Yuhuan You, Wenxiang Guo, Zhifang Guo, Yuxuan Wang, Jin Xu
abstract: Audio phase relations encode source locations, yet existing large audio-language models (LALM) reduce audio to single-channel content to stabilise general audio understanding, leaving spatial information for direction, distance, and source-relation questions unused. We present SpheraAudio, which accepts recordings with any channel count -- mono, stereo, First-Order Ambisonics (FOA), or higher -- and maps them into a single token stream. A spatial encoder turns complex multichannel spectra into spatial tokens interleaved with audio tokens at corresponding temporal positions. Spatial Multimodal RoPE (SMRoPE) makes each token's modality identity and temporal slot visible to rotary attention without altering the language model's original RoPE. Training runs in three stages -- spatial-encoder pretraining, projector alignment, and joint supervised-and-reinforcement learning -- progressing from geometric supervision to language-based spatial decisions, with answers trained as explicit spatial chain-of-thought: step-by-step geometric reasoning over the heard scene. Current benchmarks tie questions to a fixed channel-count format and score answers without spatial reasoning evidence. We introduce SpheraQA, which spans mono, stereo, and FOA recordings and organises questions hierarchically from single-attribute perception through cross-source relations to multi-step reasoning, scored programmatically against simulated scene geometry and real-recording annotations with step-by-step solution references. Across SpheraQA and public spatial-audio benchmarks, SpheraAudio sets a new performance standard for spatial audio understanding. It supports high-precision localisation, tracking, and reasoning over static and moving sound sources while preserving strong general-audio capabilities. We will release code, SpheraQA, and evaluation metrics to support reproducibility.
comment: 27 pages, 5 figures. Code: https://github.com/Konoyo-014/SpheraQA. Dataset: https://modelscope.cn/datasets/Konoyo/SpheraQA. Paper experiments use the 20,492-question SpheraQA version; the public release contains 22,197 questions

title: Evaluating Language Models as Spatial Priors for Object-Goal Navigation
authors: Jun Miura
abstract: Semantic exploration methods for object-goal navigation use large language models (LLMs) to score how strongly a target object is associated with a room type or with a nearby object. This paper considers obtaining from the LLM a spatial prior instead: a distribution over the position of the target in a room. We evaluate whether two open-weight LLMs, Qwen3.5-27B and Gemma-4-31B-it, can provide such a prior. Using real room layouts from CubiCasa5K and ScanNet, we measure the likelihood the models assign to real and perturbed layouts, and the layouts they generate. The object frequencies and room sizes of the generated rooms follow the room type, but the proximity of the objects to the walls does not follow the differences between room types found in real rooms. The likelihood distinguishes real layouts from perturbed ones partly through their geometry and partly through the agreement between the coordinates and a field that states the wall each object touches; for the movable furniture of ScanNet, it is higher for layouts with all objects piled near the room center than for the real layouts in most rooms. When an object is given in the prompt, the models place a related object relative to it. When the wall of each object is given, they place most objects against that wall, but do not keep all objects inside a given room rectangle. As a prior for object search, the generated placements reduce the searched area relative to a uniform prior, but by less than a third of the reduction obtained with a prior built from real layouts, and by less than two thirds when both priors are spatially smoothed. These results support the use of LLMs for object-room associations and for writing coordinates under constraints determined by another component, followed by a geometric check, but not as a source of placement priors where real layouts are available.

title: Optimizing Drilling Trajectories in Multi-Material Structures Using Quantum Annealers
authors: Eneko Osaba, Antonio Rubio-Mateos
abstract: In this work we present a quantum-hybrid optimization approach for planning drilling trajectories on multi-material structures, with the objective of minimizing total energy consumption. The proposed formulation models the drilling process as a constrained routing problem in which each hole must be visited while accounting for heterogeneous material properties, material-dependent drilling costs and displacement energy, as well as tool-wear penalties. Our method incorporates realistic industrial constraints, including open-path routing and mandatory grouping of holes belonging to the same material to avoid frequent tool-bit changes. The modeled problem is solved using D-Wave's Leap Constrained Quadratic Model Hybrid Solver. To evaluate performance, we benchmark instances ranging from 10 to 55 holes with varying material distributions and cost matrices. The results highlight the capability of quantum-hybrid optimization to handle complex multi-physics constraints and to generate energy-efficient drilling sequences under realistic manufacturing conditions.
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Paper submitted to IEEE QCNC 2027 conference

title: Hello Again: Exploiting Replay Protected Monotonic Counters to Brute-Force Windows Hello PINs
authors: Christian Werling, Matti Finder, Hans Niklas Jacob, Julian Prein, Niclas Kühnapfel, Jean-Pierre Seifert
abstract:
Windows Hello is the primary authentication mechanism on over one billion Windows 11 devices, supporting PINs as short as four digits. Such low-entropy PINs are viable only because the TPM's anti-hammering protection mitigates brute-force attacks. Most modern x86 platforms rely on firmware TPMs (fTPMs) that persist their non-volatile (NV) state, including the lockout state, to SPI flash. On newer platforms, rollback prevention of this state is delegated to the flash chip via Replay Protected Monotonic Counters (RPMCs), a JEDEC-standardized mechanism operating over a physically accessible bus.
  We present the first practical security analysis of RPMC in shipping x86 systems. Using low-cost interposer hardware, we identify multiple implementation flaws, two of which fundamentally undermine RPMC's security model: First, Winbond SPI flash - the leading NOR flash vendor with over 25% market share - leaks its HMAC key under voltage glitching, enabling arbitrary counter forgery. Second, AMD's NV controller does not verify RPMC increments, so an interposer can suppress them unnoticed. Moreover, AMD platforms without RPMC flash appear to lack NV rollback protection altogether: on two AMD desktops, reflashing an old image resets the fTPM's lockout counters.
  Both flaws enable rollbacks of the fTPM's NV state (AMD, Intel, or Pluton), including its lockout counters. We demonstrate this end-to-end on locked, encrypted hardware: our setup finds a 4-digit Windows Hello PIN in 40 hours instead of 69 days. A compromised PIN also grants access to device-bound keys and Hello-based enterprise SSO. The same primitive defeats BitLocker's TPM+PIN pre-boot protector, reducing the worst-case time for a default-length 6-digit PIN from 19 years to 20 days.
comment: This is a slightly updated version of the paper published at ACM CCS '26 (https://doi.org/10.1145/3830454.3846631). The section Changes from the CCS '26 Version lists all changes
zh_title: 再次问好：利用重放保护单调计数器暴力破解 Windows Hello PIN
translation: Windows Hello 是超过10亿台 Windows 11 设备上的主要身份验证机制，支持短至四位的 PIN 码。此类低熵 PIN 码之所以可行，仅是因为 TPM 的防暴力破解保护机制缓解了暴力破解攻击。大多数现代 x86 平台依赖固件 TPM（fTPM），其将包括锁定状态在内的非易失性（NV）状态持久化存储至 SPI 闪存中。在较新的平台上，该状态的防回滚功能通过重放保护单调计数器（RPMC）委派给闪存芯片，这是一种在物理可访问总线上运行的 JEDEC 标准化机制。\n  我们对出货的 x86 系统中的 RPMC 进行了首次实用安全性分析。利用低成本的硬件转接板，我们发现了多个实现缺陷，其中两个从根本上破坏了 RPMC 的安全模型：首先，市场份额超过 25% 的领先 NOR 闪存供应商华邦（Winbond）SPI 闪存在电压故障注入下会泄露其 HMAC 密钥，从而允许任意伪造计数器；其次，AMD 的 NV 控制器不验证 RPMC 递增，因此转接板可以在不被察觉的情况下抑制递增操作。此外，没有 RPMC 闪存的 AMD 平台似乎完全缺乏 NV 防回滚保护：在两台 AMD 台式机上，重新刷入旧镜像即可重置 fTPM 的锁定计数器。\n  这两个缺陷都允许回滚 fTPM 的 NV 状态（AMD、Intel 或 Pluton），包括其锁定计数器。我们在已锁定且加密的硬件上端到端地展示了这一点：我们的攻击方案在 40 小时内找出了一个 4 位的 Windows Hello PIN，而不是常规的 69 天。被破解的 PIN 还可以授予对设备绑定密钥和基于 Hello 的企业单点登录（SSO）的访问权限。同样的利用原语还攻破了 BitLocker 的 TPM+PIN 预启动保护器，将默认长度 6 位 PIN 的最坏破解时间从 19 年缩短至 20 天。
tldr: 本研究发现了商用x86系统中RPMC防回滚机制的重大硬件与固件缺陷，成功绕过TPM锁定限制，将4位Windows Hello PIN的破解时间缩短至40小时。
ai_comments: 该研究具有很高的实际安全影响力和创新性：首次对商用x86系统中的JEDEC RPMC硬件防回滚机制进行了实测攻破，揭露了供应链硬件实现（华邦闪存电压故障注入）和芯片厂商控制器设计（AMD未校验递增）的双重缺陷，直接瓦解了依赖TPM防暴力破解机制保护的低熵PIN码体系。
motivation: Windows Hello支持仅4位的低熵PIN，其安全性完全依赖TPM的防暴力破解锁定机制；现代x86平台将防回滚委派给SPI闪存中的重放保护单调计数器（RPMC），但其在实际商用系统中的安全性尚未得到深入评估。
method: 使用低成本硬件转接板（interposer）对商用x86系统中的RPMC进行安全性分析；结合电压故障注入（voltage glitching）从华邦SPI闪存中提取HMAC密钥以伪造计数器；利用转接板压制未经验证的AMD RPMC递增操作，或直接重刷旧固件镜像以实现fTPM非易失性状态回滚。
results: 成功使AMD、Intel及Pluton的fTPM非易失性状态发生回滚；在锁定且加密的真实硬件上，将4位Windows Hello PIN的破解时间从69天缩短至40小时，并获取设备绑定密钥及企业SSO权限；同时攻破BitLocker的TPM+PIN保护，将6位PIN最坏破解时间从19年降低至20天。
conclusion: JEDEC RPMC在实际商用x86系统中的硬件与固件实现存在严重安全漏洞，导致fTPM防回滚保护机制失效，使攻击者能够高效暴力破解Windows Hello PIN和BitLocker PIN。

title: Efficient Poincaré Convolutions through Patch-Statistics Factorization
authors: Lukáš Jochymek, Markéta Vašinková, Petr Gajdoš
abstract: Published implementations of the Poincaré convolution in Hyperbolic Neural Networks++ (HNN++) map every overlapping image patch to the Poincaré ball before evaluating its score. We show that the clipped score depends on each patch only through two statistics, its squared norm and its inner products with the filters, which a native convolution and a single-channel box filter compute directly. The factorized layer therefore evaluates the specified score exactly, without constructing ball-valued patches, and its single-precision outputs and gradients agree with double-precision evaluations at least as closely as those of the explicit reference. On an RTX A6000 under two versions of JAX, complete training updates of a Poincaré U-Net and a Poincaré ResNet-20 are 1.5 to 1.8 times faster than the faster of two explicit implementations that map patches to the ball (1.2 to 1.4 times against an explicit implementation that skips this mapping); on a V100, the gain over the gather-based one persists as the ResNet-20 is widened eightfold. In 15 paired training runs per task, updates are 2.0 and 1.8 times faster than a reference that follows the published execution order, with no consistent change in final segmentation or classification quality, and peak memory falls by 38 to 55% in a U-Net scaling study. Replacing the convolutions of the official PyTorch Hyperbolic U-Net makes its training step 1.4 times faster with half the memory. Evaluating an existing layer from its patch statistics thus makes Poincaré convolutional networks cheaper to train in the tested models and software stacks.
zh_title: 基于补丁统计量因式分解的高效庞加莱卷积
translation: 已发表的在双曲神经网络++（HNN++）中庞加莱卷积的实现，在评估其得分前需要将每个重叠图像块映射到庞加莱球。我们证明了截断得分对每个图像块的依赖仅取决于两个统计量：其平方范数以及其与滤波器的内积，而这两个统计量可以直接通过原生卷积和单通道盒式滤波器计算得出。因此，因式分解后的卷积层无需构建庞加莱球值的图像块即可精确计算指定得分，其单精度输出和梯度与双精度评估的一致性至少与显式参考实现相当。在配备两个 JAX 版本的 RTX A6000 显卡上，Poincaré U-Net 和 Poincaré ResNet-20 的完整训练更新速度比映射图像块至球面的两个显式实现中较快者快 1.5 到 1.8 倍（比跳过该映射的显式实现快 1.2 到 1.4 倍）；在 V100 上，当 ResNet-20 宽度扩大 8 倍时，相对于基于 gather 操作实现的性能优势依然稳固。在每项任务 15 次配对训练运行中，更新速度相比遵循已发表执行顺序的参考实现提升了 2.0 和 1.8 倍，且最终的分割或分类质量没有一致性改变，在 U-Net 扩展性研究中峰值显存降低了 38% 至 55%。替换官方 PyTorch Hyperbolic U-Net 的卷积后，其训练步长加快 1.4 倍且显存减半。因此，通过图像块统计量评估现有卷积层，大幅降低了庞加莱卷积网络在所测试模型与软件栈中的训练成本。
keywords: 双曲神经网络 (Hyperbolic Neural Networks)
补丁统计量因式分解 (Patch-Statistics Factorization)
tldr: 通过将庞加莱卷积分解为原生卷积与盒式滤波以直接获取统计量，省去了图像块向庞加莱球显式映射的开销，实现训练速度翻倍并减少最高 55% 的显存占用。
ai_comments: 该研究具有极高的工程实用价值与算法洞察力。其核心创新在于从数学层面剖析了庞加莱卷积的分数计算公式，巧妙将其因式分解为原生欧氏卷积与单通道盒式滤波，从而规避了高显存消耗且耗时的庞加莱球图像块显式映射（如 im2col 操作）。这种“算法重构以适应硬件原生加速”的思想不仅保证了严格的数学等价性与数值稳定性，而且直接在 JAX 和 PyTorch 中实现了高达 2 倍的加速和最高 55% 的显存节约，极大推动了双曲卷积网络在大规模视觉任务中的可行性。局限性在于该方法主要针对 HNN++ 中特定的庞加莱卷积定义进行了代数推导，推广到其他变体流形卷积可能需要重新推导。
motivation: 双曲神经网络++（HNN++）中现有的庞加莱卷积实现需要将每个重叠的图像块显式映射到庞加莱球后再计算得分，造成了巨大的计算开销与显存冗余。
method: 证明庞加莱卷积中的截断得分在数学上仅依赖于图像块的两个统计量（平方范数以及与滤波器的内积），并提出利用标准原生卷积配合单通道盒式滤波器（box filter）直接计算上述统计量，从而完全避免了将重叠图像块显式映射到庞加莱球上的中间过程。
results: 在 RTX A6000 和 V100 GPU 上，Poincaré U-Net 和 ResNet-20 的训练更新速度相比显式实现提升 1.2 至 2.0 倍；在 U-Net 扩展测试中峰值显存降低 38% 至 55%；替换 PyTorch 官方 Hyperbolic U-Net 的卷积层使其训练速度提升 1.4 倍且显存减半；单精度下数值稳定性优于显式双精度参考，且最终任务精度（分类/分割）无损失。
conclusion: 通过补丁统计量因式分解评估庞加莱卷积层，无需显式构建球值图像块即可保持严格等价的计算结果，显著降低了庞加莱卷积神经网络在现有模型与框架下的训练耗时与内存开销。

title: PRISM: A Post-Prediction Reliability Framework for Evidence-Guided Correction and Selective Abstention
authors: Omm Swarup, Shrishail M. Hiremath
abstract:
A model may produce a prediction with high confidence and still get the outcome wrong. This is a challenge in sequential applications, where the system evolves over time and deployment data may differ from the data used during training. To address this issue, we propose PRISM (Prediction Reliability and Intelligent Self-Correction Mechanism), a framework that evaluates prediction reliability after the initial output is generated. It estimates the risk of error and examines predictions identified as potentially unreliable. For these cases, PRISM analyses available signals, retrieves similar situations from historical data, and verifies whether an alternative prediction is supported by the evidence. It can then retain the original prediction, apply a verified correction, or abstain when the evidence is insufficient.
  We evaluate PRISM on second-innings match prediction in the Indian Premier League (IPL). Ball-by-ball records are converted into over-level observations to capture changes in match conditions throughout an innings. To preserve temporal order, earlier IPL seasons are used for training, IPL 2024 for validation, and IPL 2025-2026 for out-of-time testing. The dataset contains 8,665 over-level observations from 475 matches, with the test partition comprising 2,568 observations from 142 matches. In one experimental record, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and HistGradientBoosting achieve accuracies of 65.2%, 68.4%, and 70.2%, respectively. The corresponding PRISM evaluation reports a selective accuracy of 82.4% at 88.5% coverage, with a Brier score of 0.126 and an expected calibration error (ECE) of 0.019.
zh_title: PRISM：用于证据引导校正与选择性弃权的预测后可靠性框架
translation: 模型可能会产生具有高置信度的预测，但结果依然是错误的。在系统随时间演变且部署数据可能与训练数据存在差异的时序应用中，这是一个严峻的挑战。为了解决该问题，我们提出了 PRISM（预测可靠性与智能自我校正机制），这是一个在生成初始输出后评估预测可靠性的框架。它评估错误风险并审查被标记为潜在不可靠的预测。针对这些情况，PRISM 会分析可用信号，从历史数据中检索相似情境，并验证证据是否支持替代预测。随后，它可以保留原始预测、应用经过验证的校正，或在证据不足时选择弃权。我们在印度板球超级联赛（IPL）的第二局比赛预测中评估了 PRISM。逐球记录被转化为逐轮次（over-level）观测数据，以捕捉整局比赛中比赛条件的变化。为了保持时间先后顺序，较早的 IPL 赛季用于训练，IPL 2024 用于验证，IPL 2025-2026 用于外推时序测试。数据集包含来自 475 场比赛的 8,665 条轮次级观测，其中测试集包含来自 142 场比赛的 2,568 条观测。在一项实验记录中，逻辑回归、随机森林和 HistGradientBoosting 的准确率分别为 65.2%、68.4% 和 70.2%。相应的 PRISM 评估表明，在 88.5% 的覆盖率下，其选择性准确率达到 82.4%，Brier 分数为 0.126，预期校准误差（ECE）为 0.019。
tldr: PRISM 提出了一种后预测可靠性框架，通过评估错误风险并结合历史证据进行预测校正或适时弃权，大幅提升了动态时序场景下的预测准确率与校准性能。
ai_comments: 该论文创新地将证据检索、自我校正与选择性预测（弃权）相结合，构建了一个模型无关的后预测可靠性保障机制。其重要性在于直面真实世界中时序数据分布偏移与模型过度自信的问题。局限性在于摘要中仅展示了在印度板球超级联赛（IPL）这一特定体育场景下的测试结果，在更广泛、更大规模的时序决策任务中的通用性与检索带来的计算开销仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 机器学习模型常常以高置信度给出错误预测，尤其在时序动态演化的应用场景中，系统随时间变化导致实际部署数据与训练数据存在分布差异，传统预测可靠性面临挑战。
method: 提出 PRISM 框架：在模型生成初始预测后评估其可靠性并估计错误风险；针对潜在不可靠样本，分析可用信号并从历史数据中检索类似情境，核验证据是否支持备选预测；最终根据证据充分程度选择保留原预测、执行验证后的校正，或在证据不足时选择弃权（abstain）。
results: 在印度板球超级联赛（IPL）第二局逐轮次预测的时序测试集（包含142场比赛的2,568条观测）上，基线模型逻辑回归、随机森林和HistGradientBoosting的准确率分别为65.2%、68.4%和70.2%；而 PRISM 在覆盖率为88.5%的情况下实现了82.4%的选择性准确率，Brier 分数为0.126，预期校准误差（ECE）达到0.019。

title: JFinBench: A Continuously Refreshable Japanese Financial Benchmark from the Latest Certification Exams
authors: Issa Sugiura, Taro Makino, Takashi Ishida
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to finance, creating a need for benchmarks that evaluate their capabilities across financial systems with different regulations and practices. However, existing financial benchmarks provide limited coverage of country-specific financial systems, and they are difficult to keep up to date as released questions leak into training data. We introduce JFinBench, a Japanese financial benchmark comprising 321 examples from the 2026 editions of six regularly administered certification exams covering accounting, tax, financial planning, and banking. To construct it, we develop a human-in-the-loop agentic pipeline in which a coding agent writes exam-specific conversion code and a review page, while a human verifies every example and feeds corrections back to the agent. This pipeline adapts to heterogeneous exam formats and reduces the effort of incorporating new exam editions, enabling periodic refreshes that mitigate data contamination. Evaluating 12 recent LLMs, we find that Claude Fable 5 and GPT-6 Astra exceed 93% overall, while even the best open-weight model, Kimi K3.1 Pro, trails Claude Fable 5 by 12 percentage points. When models can additionally use a terminal and web access, they retrieve the knowledge they lack and every model improves. The gap narrows but about 4 points remain, and the ranking of models stays largely the same, suggesting that knowledge held in the model itself remains valuable even with tools. We release the dataset, the evaluation code, and the construction pipeline.
zh_title: JFinBench：源自最新资格考试的可持续更新日语金融基准
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益应用于金融领域，因而需要评估其在不同法规和实践的金融体系中能力的基准。然而，现有的金融基准对特定国家金融系统的覆盖有限，且由于已公开的题目会泄露到训练数据中，难以保持最新。我们推出了JFinBench，这是一个包含321道题目的日本金融基准，涵盖来自2026年定期举办的六大会计、税务、财务规划和银行业资格考试。为了构建该基准，我们开发了一种人机协同的智能体流水线：编程智能体负责编写特定考试的转换代码与审核页面，人类专家则核对每个样本并将更正反馈给智能体。该流水线能够适应多样化的考试格式并降低纳入新考题的成本，从而支持定期更新以缓解数据污染。在评估12个最新LLM时，我们发现Claude Fable 5和GPT-6 Astra的总体准确率超过93%，而表现最好的开源权重模型Kimi K3.1 Pro落后Claude Fable 5达12个百分点。当模型额外获得终端与网络访问权限时，它们能够检索到缺失的知识，所有模型表现均有提升。虽然差距缩小至约4个百分点，但模型排名大体保持一致，这表明即使在使用工具的情况下，模型自身内化的知识依然极具价值。我们开源了该数据集、评估代码以及构建流水线。
tldr: 本文推出了源自日本最新金融资格考试的可持续更新基准JFinBench，提出了人机协同智能体更新流水线，并揭示了模型内化知识在使用工具时依然不可替代。
ai_comments: 该工作创新性地提出了基于人机协同智能体流水线的可刷新基准构建范式，有效解决了金融评测领域中特定国家制度覆盖不足及训练数据污染的两大痛点；实验不仅全面对比了闭源与开源前沿模型，还深入探讨了工具增强与模型内在知识的关系，具有较高的实用与参考价值。
motivation: 现有金融基准缺乏对特定国家金融系统与法规的覆盖，且考试题目极易泄露至LLM训练数据中，基准难以保持最新且面临数据污染问题。
method: 基于2026年日本六大会计、税务、理财规划及银行业资格考试构建包含321道例题的数据集；采用人机协同（human-in-the-loop）智能体流水线，由编程智能体编写特定考试转换代码及审核页面，人工核验并反馈修正，以支持异构格式并降低定期更新维护成本。
results: 在12个最新LLM评测中，Claude Fable 5与GPT-6 Astra准确率超93%，最佳开源模型Kimi K3.1 Pro落后约12%；在使用终端和网络检索工具后，所有模型性能提升且差距缩小至约4个百分点，但模型相对排名基本不变。
conclusion: 模型自身内化的专业知识在工具增强环境下依然至关重要，且通过人机协同智能体流程能够高效构建并持续维护高质量、抗污染的垂直领域基准。

title: Parameterized Weakest-Precondition Calculus for Fine-grained Properties of Quantum Loops
authors: Tianshi Yu, Minbo Gao, Li Zhou
abstract: Quantum loops may execute arbitrarily many iterations, and understanding their runtime behavior requires knowing how often they terminate, how long terminating runs take, and how common very long runs are. We develop a compositional weakest-precondition framework for analyzing these properties on possibly infinite-dimensional state spaces. It uses parameterized predicates: families of quantum effects indexed by a positive observation scale. These families retain runtime information even when the expected runtime is infinite and can be reused through sequential composition and nested loops. We prove that weakest-precondition equations for loops have unique solutions in the parameterized predicate domain. From the asymptotic behavior of the derived weakest preconditions, we then recover these runtime properties and quantify the influence of very long terminating executions. For the classic discrete-time quantum walk on the one-dimensional infinite line with one absorbing boundary at the origin and the Hadamard gate as its coin operator, we verify its termination probability $2/π$, conditional mean $π/2$, and logarithmic growth of the conditional capped second moment. We then reuse the walk's specification to verify the termination probability and conditional mean runtime of an outer loop that repeatedly invokes it.
zh_title: 面向量子循环细粒度属性的参数化最弱前条件演算
translation: 量子循环可能会执行任意多次迭代，理解其运行时行为需要了解其终止的频率、终止运行所耗费的时间，以及极长运行的普遍程度。我们开发了一个组合式最弱前条件框架，用于在可能无限维的状态空间上分析这些属性。该框架使用参数化谓词：即由正观测尺度索引的量子效应族。即使在期望运行时间为无限时，这些族仍能保留运行时信息，并可在顺序组合和嵌套循环中复用。我们证明了循环的最弱前条件方程在参数化谓词域中具有唯一解。然后，我们从导出的最弱前条件的渐近行为中恢复这些运行时属性，并量化极长终止执行的影响。针对在一维无限线上具有原点单吸收边界、以哈达玛门为硬币算子的经典离散时间量子行走，我们验证了其终止概率为 2/π、条件均值为 π/2，以及条件受限二阶矩的对数增长。随后，我们复用了该行走的规约，验证了重复调用它的外层循环的终止概率和条件均值运行时间。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于参数化谓词的组合式最弱前条件演算框架，用于精确分析可能具有无限维状态空间和无限期望时间的量子循环的终止概率与运行时间属性。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将参数化谓词引入最弱前条件演算中，成功克服了传统形式化方法在处理无限维状态空间及期望运行时间无限的量子循环时的分析难题，为量子程序验证和时间复杂度精细化分析提供了强大的组合推理工具。
motivation: 量子循环可能执行任意多次迭代，若要深入理解其运行时行为，需要获知其终止频率、终止运行所需时间以及极长运行的发生概率等精细化运行时属性，特别是在可能包含无限维状态空间以及期望运行时间无限的情况下。
method: 提出了一种组合式最弱前条件框架，该框架利用由正观测尺度索引的量子效应族（参数化谓词），即使在期望运行时间为无限大时也能保留运行时间信息，并证明了循环的最弱前条件方程在该谓词域中具有唯一解；通过分析最弱前条件的渐近行为来量化运行属性。
results: 成功验证了一维无限线上带有原点吸收边界、以哈达玛门为硬币算子的经典离散时间量子行走的终止概率为 2/π、条件均值为 π/2 以及条件受限二阶矩的对数增长；并复用了该行走的规约，验证了重复调用该行走的外部嵌套循环的终止概率和条件均值运行时间。
conclusion: 作者证明了所提出的循环最弱前条件方程在参数化谓词域中存在唯一解，能够有效恢复精细运行时间属性并分析极长运行的影响，且验证结果在嵌套循环中具备高度可复用性。

title: Rate Optimal Streaming Codes Under an Extended Delay Profile for Three-Node Relay Networks
authors: Ke Wang, Wenjie Ma, Zhipeng Li, Yaqiang Zhang
abstract: We study streaming codes for a three-node relay network with burst lengths $b_1,b_2$ and an end-to-end decoding delay $T$. Let $u=\max\{b_1,b_2\}$ and $v=\min\{b_1,b_2\}$, and write $T-v=pu+q$, where $T\ge u+v$ and $0\le q<u$. We develop two binary constructions, SR and SR-2, using extended delay profiles that allow the relay to forward causally invertible combinations of current and past source symbols. The SR construction attains the non-adaptive rate upper bound whenever \[ \frac{T-u-v}{2u-v}\le\left\lfloor\frac{T-u-v}{u}\right\rfloor. \] SR-2 enlarges this range under the sufficient condition \[ q(v-q)\le(p-1)u(u-v). \] These constructions complement the known divisibility and large-delay regimes. We also establish two limitations of systematic ordinary coordinate forwarding. First, it cannot attain the rate upper bound when $0<T-u-v<v$. Second, for equal burst lengths $b$, it attains the bound if and only if $b\mid(T-2b)$; a quantitative upper bound gives a strictly positive rate gap in every nondivisible case. These converses allow nonlinear components and predetermined time variation within the stated ordinary-forwarding architecture. Existing adaptive schemes for equal bursts approach the same rate upper bound asymptotically using time-varying convolutional codes and lie outside the non-adaptive setting considered here.
zh_title: 三节点中继网络中基于扩展延迟轮廓的速率最优流式码
translation: 我们研究了突发长度为 $b_1,b_2$ 且端到端解码延迟为 $T$ 的三节点中继网络流式码。令 $u=\max\{b_1,b_2\}$ 且 $v=\min\{b_1,b_2\}$，记 $T-v=pu+q$，其中 $T\ge u+v$ 且 $0\le q<u$。我们利用扩展延迟轮廓开发了两种二进制构造（SR 和 SR-2），该轮廓允许中继转发当前及历史源符号的因果可逆组合。当满足 $(T-u-v)/(2u-v)\le\lfloor(T-u-v)/u\rfloor$ 时，SR 构造可达到非自适应速率上限。SR-2 在充分条件 $q(v-q)\le(p-1)u(u-v)$ 下进一步扩展了该范围。这些构造补充了已知的可整除和大延迟区间。我们还确立了系统普通坐标转发的两个局限性：首先，当 $0<T-u-v<v$ 时它无法达到速率上限；其次，对于相等的突发长度 $b$，它当且仅当 $b\mid(T-2b)$ 时才能达到该上限，且定量上限表明在每个不可整除的情形中都存在严格正的速率间隙。这些逆命题在给定的普通转发架构下允许非线性组件和预定的时间变化。现有的针对等突发长度的自适应方案使用时变卷积码渐进逼近相同的速率上限，超出了本文所考虑的非自适应设定。
tldr: 本文针对三节点中继网络提出两种基于扩展延迟轮廓的最优非自适应流式码构造，扩大了速率达标区间，并证明了传统普通坐标转发存在内在速率差距。
ai_comments: 该论文在三节点中继流式码领域取得了重要进展，通过引入允许转发因果可逆符号组合的扩展延迟轮廓，克服了传统系统坐标转发策略的速率瓶颈，并严格刻画了普通坐标转发在不可分情况下的速率劣势，为低延迟网络编码方案设计提供了坚实的理论指导。
motivation: 在具有突发擦除长度为 $b_1, b_2$ 和端到端时延约束 $T$ 的三节点中继网络中，克服传统普通坐标转发机制在非整除参数和特定时延范围内的速率损失，寻求可达到速率理论上限的非自适应编码构造。
method: 利用扩展延迟轮廓提出了两种二进制流式码构造（SR 和 SR-2），允许中继节点转发当前与历史源符号的因果可逆线性组合；同时推导并建立了系统普通坐标转发架构的逆向界限与性能限制。
results: 1. 提出的SR构造在 $(T-u-v)/(2u-v) \le \lfloor(T-u-v)/u\rfloor$ 时达到非自适应速率上限；2. SR-2在满足 $q(v-q)\le (p-1)u(u-v)$ 时进一步扩大了该达上限的参数范围；3. 证明了系统普通坐标转发在 $0<T-u-v<v$ 时无法达到上限，且在等突发长度下当且仅当整除时才可达，在不可分情况下存在严格正的速率差距。
conclusion: 本文提出的流式编码方案有效填补了已知整除和小延迟区间的空白，证明了利用扩展延迟轮廓在中继节点进行因果可逆组合转发可以突破传统系统坐标转发的速率瓶颈，达到非自适应速率理论上限。

title: PUMA-Former: Uncertainty-Aware Agentic Computation Offloading in MEO-LEO Satellite Networks With Incomplete Information
authors: Yi Jing, Chunxiao Jiang, Jiawei Wang, Jiachen Sun
abstract: Satellite edge computing distributes mobile workloads across moving processors whose service capacity must be coordinated over time. In medium Earth orbit (MEO)--low Earth orbit (LEO) networks, periodic reports leave CPU states stale or missing, making offloading sensitive to uncertain capacity and shared-destination congestion. We propose PUMA-Former, an uncertainty-aware agentic framework for cooperative offloading under incomplete information that balances completed work, service delay, and execution cost. A MEO coordinator maintains distinct-report memory and closes the loop between available evidence, capacity estimates, allocation commands, and execution feedback. Latent-delay attention weights plausible measurement-age hypotheses, and historical innovations refine CPU estimates around the latest received report. Queue-error-aware fusion incorporates auxiliary pressure while accounting for backlog uncertainty. The inferred resource moments condition a structured Transformer allocator for joint destination, partition, bandwidth, CPU, and power decisions. Bounded risk-aware calibration then adjusts workload splits to reflect uncertainty and shared destination load. In traffic-driven development evaluation, PUMA-Former increases admitted compute-work completion by 8.62%, reduces mean modeled service delay by 34.78%, and reduces mean episode-P95 delay by 71.08% relative to ATLA-adapt. It also improves completion and normalized energy over fixed-half round-robin offloading. Service gains over the learning baselines involve higher normalized energy.
zh_title: PUMA-Former：在信息不完整的中地球轨道-低地球轨道卫星网络中进行不确定性感知代理计算卸载
translation: 卫星边缘计算将移动工作负载分配到移动处理器上，其服务容量必须随时间协调。在中地球轨道（MEO）-低地球轨道（LEO）网络中，周期性报告导致CPU状态过时或缺失，使得卸载对不确定容量和共享目的地拥塞敏感。我们提出了PUMA-Former，一个不确定性感知代理框架，用于在信息不完整的情况下进行协作卸载，平衡已完成工作、服务延迟和执行成本。一个中地球轨道协调器维护不同的报告记忆，并在可用证据、容量估计、分配命令和执行反馈之间形成闭环。潜在延迟注意力权衡了合理的测量年龄假设，历史创新围绕最新收到的报告完善了CPU估计。队列误差感知融合结合了辅助压力，同时考虑了积压不确定性。推断的资源矩条件化了一个结构化Transformer分配器，用于联合目的地、分区、带宽、CPU和功率决策。有界风险感知校准然后调整工作负载分配，以反映不确定性和共享目的地负载。在流量驱动的开发评估中，PUMA-Former相对于ATLA-adapt将已接受的计算工作完成率提高了8.62%，平均建模服务延迟降低了34.78%，平均事件P95延迟降低了71.08%。它还改进了相对于固定半轮询卸载的完成率和归一化能耗。相对于学习基线，服务增益涉及更高的归一化能耗。
tldr: PUMA-Former是一个不确定性感知代理框架，用于在中地球轨道-低地球轨道卫星网络中，在信息不完整的情况下进行协作计算卸载，通过平衡工作完成度、服务延迟和执行成本，显著提高了计算完成率并降低了延迟。
ai_comments: PUMA-Former的创新点在于其不确定性感知和代理框架，特别是在处理MEO-LEO卫星网络中不完整信息时的能力。它结合了多种技术，如注意力机制、误差感知融合和Transformer分配器，以实现高效的资源管理和工作负载卸载。该研究的重要性体现在其解决了动态卫星网络中计算卸载的关键挑战，对未来空间计算和通信具有潜在影响。然而，论文也指出服务增益伴随着更高的归一化能耗，这可能是一个需要进一步优化或权衡的方面。
motivation: 在中地球轨道-低地球轨道卫星网络中，卫星边缘计算面临CPU状态过时或缺失、容量不确定以及共享目的地拥塞等问题，导致计算卸载效率低下。
method: PUMA-Former框架包括一个中地球轨道协调器，该协调器维护不同报告记忆，并形成证据、容量估计、分配命令和执行反馈之间的闭环。它使用潜在延迟注意力来权衡测量年龄假设，并通过历史创新细化CPU估计。队列误差感知融合结合了辅助压力并考虑了积压不确定性。推断的资源矩用于结构化Transformer分配器，以做出联合目的地、分区、带宽、CPU和功率决策。最后，有界风险感知校准调整工作负载分配，以反映不确定性和共享目的地负载。
results: PUMA-Former将已接受的计算工作完成率提高了8.62%，平均建模服务延迟降低了34.78%，平均事件P95延迟降低了71.08%（相对于ATLA-adapt）。它还提高了相对于固定半轮询卸载的完成率和归一化能耗。相对于学习基线，服务增益涉及更高的归一化能耗。
conclusion: PUMA-Former有效地解决了中地球轨道-低地球轨道卫星网络中信息不完整下的计算卸载问题，通过其不确定性感知和代理框架显著提高了计算完成率并降低了服务延迟，尽管这可能伴随着更高的能耗。

title: When Copying Is Hard to Beat: A Negative Result in Clinical Assessment Forecasting
authors: Marius Fracarolli, Stefan Riezler
abstract: We report a negative result in next-day clinical assessment forecasting: the evaluated models show no consistent advantage over strong persistence-based baselines. Clinicians can view the previous day's questionnaire answers, a plausible source of documentation persistence. Predicting 45 items on 29,715 ICU day-pairs with patient-disjoint splits, a physiology-informed gated model improves item-macro-F1 over a one-line clinical rule by +0.0019 [+0.0006,+0.0031], while losing accuracy. No macro-F1 advantage is established when the physiology window ends at the previous form's reference time (+0.0001 [-0.0006,+0.0008]), or when scoring excludes the 68.5% of cells derived from parent answers; combining both changes yields a small disadvantage. Four checkpoints across three families underperform persistence, and a fine-tuned one differs from it on only two cells. A categorical read-out raises changed-cell accuracy eightfold, but a state-only read-out scores higher overall than forecast-only decoding and matches a transition matrix. This negative result highlights how the documentation process, input cutoff, observation mask and decoding rule shape conclusions about forecasting recorded assessments.
comment: Accepted at FMTS (Foundation Models for Temporal Systems), a workshop at NeurIPS 2026, Sydney
zh_title: 当复制难以超越时：临床评估预测中的一个负面结果
translation: 我们报告了下一天临床评估预测中的一个负面结果：评估模型未能始终优于强大的基于持久性的基线。临床医生可以查看前一天的问卷答案，这是一个合理的文档持久性来源。在29,715个ICU日对上预测45个项目，采用患者不重叠分割，一个生理学知情的门控模型相对于一线临床规则，项目宏观F1提高了+0.0019 [+0.0006,+0.0031]，但准确率下降。当生理学窗口在先前表格的参考时间结束时，没有宏观F1优势（+0.0001 [-0.0006,+0.0008]），或者当评分排除68.5%源自父答案的单元格时；结合这两种变化会导致轻微劣势。三个家族的四个检查点模型均逊于持久性基线，一个微调模型仅在两个单元格上与基线不同。分类读取使已更改单元格的准确率提高了八倍，但状态读取的整体得分高于仅预测解码，并与转换矩阵匹配。这项负面结果强调了文档过程、输入截止、观察掩码和解码规则如何影响对记录评估预测的结论。
tldr: 在下一天的临床评估预测中，评估模型未能始终优于强大的基于持久性的基线。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过报告一个“负面结果”具有重要意义，它挑战了机器学习模型在某些特定临床预测任务中可能被高估的假设。论文强调了简单持久性基线的强大效力，并提醒研究人员在开发复杂模型时，需充分考虑数据生成过程、临床实践的特点以及恰当的评估指标。这对于避免在现有基线已足够强大的领域投入不必要的复杂研究具有指导价值。
motivation: 本研究旨在报告下一天临床评估预测中的一个负面结果，即现有模型难以持续超越基于持久性的强基线，并探讨文档过程、输入截止、观察掩码和解码规则如何影响对记录评估预测的结论。
method: 研究预测了29,715个ICU日对的45个项目，采用患者不重叠分割。评估模型包括生理学知情的门控模型、一线临床规则以及来自三个家族的四个检查点模型和一个微调模型。比较了不同生理学窗口、排除源自父答案的单元格以及状态读取和预测读取等配置。评估指标为项目宏观F1和准确率。
results: 生理学知情的门控模型相对于一线临床规则，项目宏观F1提高了+0.0019，但准确率下降。当生理学窗口在先前的表格参考时间结束时，宏观F1没有优势。当评分排除68.5%源自父答案的单元格时，或结合这两种变化时，模型表现出轻微劣势。三个家族的四个检查点模型均逊于持久性基线，一个微调模型仅在两个单元格上与基线不同。分类读取使已更改单元格的准确率提高了八倍，但状态读取的整体得分高于仅预测解码，并与转换矩阵匹配。总体而言，评估模型未能显示出相对于强大的基于持久性的基线的一致优势。
conclusion: 这项负面结果强调了文档过程、输入截止、观察掩码和解码规则如何影响对记录评估预测的结论。在临床评估预测中，简单的持久性基线难以被超越。

title: Large Language Model-Empowered Intelligent Agent for Adaptive Fast-Charging Control of Lithium-Ion Batteries
authors: Joey Chan, Haoyu Pan, Zhen Chen, ErShun Pan
abstract: Fast charging of lithium-ion batteries is a multi-objective control problem that requires reducing charging time and sustaining high energy throughput while suppressing accelerated degradation and safety-critical electrochemical reactions. Conventional protocols are easy to implement but have limited ability to adapt to variations in battery chemistry, operating conditions, and aging state. Model-based optimization and conventional data-driven control often require accurate models, costly iterative search, or task-specific policies. We develop a large language model (LLM)-empowered intelligent agent for adaptive battery fast-charging control. In this closed-loop framework, the agent interprets structured battery states, generates executable charging actions, observes the resulting battery response, and continuously adjusts subsequent decisions. We construct a large-scale simulation corpus with PyBaMM across five battery chemistries and 11 parameter sets and convert the resulting state-action-response trajectories into structured process data for agent training. Our two-stage strategy combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). SFT establishes battery-control semantics and feasible decision priors from simulation-derived demonstrations. GRPO aligns the agent with a multi-objective control objective covering energy throughput, degradation mitigation, and operational constraints. Closed-loop simulations show that, under matched energy-throughput requirements, the agent achieves longer cycling life than conventional charging baselines and optimization-based strategies across heterogeneous battery configurations. This study provides a simulation-grounded proof of concept for using LLM agents as sequential decision makers in battery management and takes a step toward language-model-enabled control of physical energy systems.
zh_title: 大语言模型赋能的智能代理用于锂离子电池自适应快速充电控制
translation: 锂离子电池的快速充电是一个多目标控制问题，需要缩短充电时间并维持高能量吞吐量，同时抑制加速降解和安全关键的电化学反应。传统协议易于实施，但在适应电池化学、操作条件和老化状态的变化方面能力有限。基于模型的优化和传统数据驱动控制通常需要精确的模型、昂贵的迭代搜索或特定任务策略。我们开发了一个由大语言模型（LLM）赋能的智能代理，用于自适应电池快速充电控制。在这个闭环框架中，代理解释结构化的电池状态，生成可执行的充电动作，观察由此产生的电池响应，并持续调整后续决策。我们使用PyBaMM构建了一个大规模的模拟语料库，涵盖五种电池化学成分和11个参数集，并将由此产生的状态-动作-响应轨迹转换为结构化过程数据用于代理训练。我们的两阶段策略结合了监督微调（SFT）和群体相对策略优化（GRPO）。SFT从模拟演示中建立电池控制语义和可行决策先验。GRPO使代理与涵盖能量吞吐量、降解缓解和操作约束的多目标控制目标对齐。闭环模拟结果显示，在匹配的能量吞吐量要求下，该代理在异构电池配置中实现了比传统充电基线和基于优化的策略更长的循环寿命。这项研究为使用LLM代理作为电池管理中的顺序决策者提供了基于模拟的概念验证，并朝着语言模型赋能的物理能源系统控制迈出了一步。
tldr: 本文开发了一个由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能代理，用于锂离子电池的自适应快速充电控制，通过模拟训练和两阶段策略实现了更长的循环寿命。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于首次将大语言模型引入到锂离子电池的快速充电控制领域，将其作为智能代理进行顺序决策。这为物理能源系统的控制提供了一个新颖的范式。通过结合模拟语料库训练和两阶段优化策略，该方法有效地解决了传统充电协议适应性差和基于模型方法复杂性高的问题。其重要性在于为未来电池管理系统带来了更高的智能化和自适应性，有望在实际应用中提升电池性能和寿命。然而，目前的研究仍基于模拟环境，未来如何将这种方法有效过渡到真实的物理系统并应对实际操作中的不确定性和噪声，将是一个重要的挑战。
motivation: 锂离子电池的快速充电是一个多目标控制问题，需要在缩短充电时间、维持高能量吞吐量的同时，抑制加速降解和安全关键的电化学反应。传统协议适应性有限，而基于模型优化和数据驱动控制需要精确模型、昂贵的迭代搜索或特定任务策略。
method: 研究开发了一个由大语言模型（LLM）赋能的智能代理，用于自适应电池快速充电控制，采用闭环框架。代理解释电池状态、生成充电动作、观察电池响应并持续调整决策。构建了一个大规模的PyBaMM模拟语料库，涵盖五种电池化学成分和11个参数集，将状态-动作-响应轨迹转换为结构化过程数据进行代理训练。采用两阶段策略，结合监督微调（SFT）和群体相对策略优化（GRPO）。SFT从模拟演示中建立电池控制语义和可行决策先验，GRPO使代理与涵盖能量吞吐量、降解缓解和操作约束的多目标控制目标对齐。
results: 闭环模拟结果表明，在匹配的能量吞吐量要求下，该代理在异构电池配置中实现了比传统充电基线和基于优化的策略更长的循环寿命。
conclusion: 本研究为使用LLM代理作为电池管理中的顺序决策者提供了基于模拟的概念验证，并朝着语言模型赋能的物理能源系统控制迈出了一步。

title: DRA-HTR: Disentangling Representation and Adaptation for Handwritten Text Recognition
authors: Gayan H. Pathirage, Florent Imbert, Denis Coquenet, Elisa H. Barney Smith
abstract: Handwritten text recognition (HTR), particularly when applied to historical documents, remains challenging due to the scarcity of annotated data and the substantial domain shifts caused by variations in handwriting styles, document degradation, acquisition conditions, and linguistic characteristics. While large amounts of unlabeled target-domain data are often available, effectively exploiting them requires adaptation strategies tailored to the specific requirements of HTR. We propose DRA-HTR, an unsupervised generative domain adaptation pipeline specifically designed for HTR and built upon the DRANet framework. The proposed approach combines source-domain pretraining, unsupervised adaptation to the visual characteristics of the target domain, relying on the generation of target-style source samples for task-specific training. We further investigate the integration of post-HTR correction to complement visual adaptation with language adaptation, relying on large language models, which we introduce as DRAL-HTR. The proposed framework is evaluated across seven HTR datasets spanning four languages, using a single set of hyperparameters for all source-target combinations. The recognition model achieves state-of-the-art performance on four datasets and competitive results on the remaining three. In addition, the proposed DRA-HTR establishes a new state-of-the-art for domain adaptation across all seven datasets and substantially improves overall robustness and training stability compared to the original DRANet framework: it reduces the Character Error Rate (CER) in average by 13.52 percentage points, and the average standard deviation decreases from 7.23 to 1.11 percentage points. Finally, post-HTR correction further reduces the CER by 2.16 percentage points.
zh_title: DRA-HTR：解耦手写文本识别的表示与自适应
translation: 手写文本识别（HTR），特别是应用于历史文献时，由于标注数据稀缺以及手写风格、文档退化、采集条件和语言特征造成的显著领域偏移，仍然面临挑战。尽管通常可以获得大量未标注的目标领域数据，但有效利用它们需要针对HTR特定要求量身定制的自适应策略。我们提出了DRA-HTR，一个专门为HTR设计的无监督生成式领域自适应管道，并建立在DRANet框架之上。所提出的方法结合了源域预训练、对目标域视觉特征的无监督自适应，依赖于生成目标风格的源样本进行任务特定训练。我们进一步研究了后HTR校正的整合，以通过依赖大型语言模型来补充视觉自适应与语言自适应，我们将其命名为DRAL-HTR。所提出的框架在七个跨越四种语言的HTR数据集上进行了评估，对所有源-目标组合使用单一的超参数集。该识别模型在四个数据集上实现了最先进的性能，并在其余三个数据集上取得了有竞争力的结果。此外，所提出的DRA-HTR在所有七个数据集的领域自适应方面建立了新的最先进水平，并与原始DRANet框架相比，显著提高了整体鲁棒性和训练稳定性：它平均将字符错误率（CER）降低了13.52个百分点，平均标准差从7.23降至1.11个百分点。最后，后HTR校正进一步将CER降低了2.16个百分点。
tldr: 针对手写文本识别（HTR）中的数据稀缺和领域偏移问题，DRA-HTR提出了一种无监督生成式领域自适应方法，结合预训练、目标风格样本生成和后HTR校正，在多个数据集上实现了SOTA性能并显著提高了鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 这项工作创新性地将无监督生成式领域自适应应用于手写文本识别，并通过引入大型语言模型进行后HTR校正，实现了视觉和语言层面的双重自适应。其在多个数据集上取得的SOTA结果和显著的CER降低，证明了该框架在处理历史文档等复杂HTR任务中的重要性和有效性。特别是对鲁棒性和训练稳定性的提升，解决了现有方法的一个关键痛点。
motivation: 手写文本识别（HTR），特别是在应用于历史文献时，由于带标注数据稀缺以及手写风格、文档退化、采集条件和语言特征造成的显著领域偏移，仍然面临挑战。
method: 提出DRA-HTR，一个基于DRANet框架的无监督生成式领域自适应管道，专为HTR设计。该方法结合了源域预训练、对目标域视觉特征的无监督自适应（依赖于生成目标风格的源样本进行任务特定训练）。进一步引入DRAL-HTR，通过整合后HTR校正（依赖大型语言模型）来补充视觉自适应与语言自适应。
results: 该识别模型在七个HTR数据集（跨越四种语言）上，使用单一超参数集进行评估，在其中四个数据集上实现了最先进的性能，并在其余三个数据集上取得了有竞争力的结果。DRA-HTR在所有七个数据集的领域自适应方面建立了新的最先进水平，并相对于原始DRANet框架显著提高了整体鲁棒性和训练稳定性：平均字符错误率（CER）降低了13.52个百分点，平均标准差从7.23降至1.11个百分点。最后，后HTR校正进一步将CER降低了2.16个百分点。
conclusion: DRA-HTR通过解耦表示和自适应，有效解决了手写文本识别中的领域偏移和数据稀缺问题，并在多个维度上显著提升了性能和鲁棒性，尤其是在历史文献HTR方面展现出强大的潜力。

title: Compiling Specialized GPU-Initiated Networking
authors: Javid Baydamirli, Ismayil Ismayilov, Kaan Oktay, Didem Unat
abstract: Machine learning systems specialize computation to the workload and hardware, but communication remains in generic libraries whose device code and transport decisions are not visible to high-level compilers. We present Obaleth, a compiler that makes GPU-initiated communication part of a kernel's intermediate representation, co-optimizes it alongside computation, and lowers it to specialized transport code.
