translation: 测试时强化学习（TTRL）使语言模型能够利用从自身答案中派生出的奖励来进行自适应。然而，即使存在正确的替代答案，多数投票机制也可能会强化错误的解法。我们的训练审计表明，假阳性（即错误的响应获得了正向奖励）在奖励误差中占据主导地位。我们聚焦于一个具有实际意义的场景，即大规模获取真实奖励非常困难，但可获得有限的带标签源数据集。为此，我们提出了TRUER框架，该框架利用有限的监督来训练一个奖励矫正器，以区分正确性与共识。为实现该目标，我们在训练矫正器时重点关注错误的多数解和正确的少数解，专门针对共识与正确性不一致的情况。之后，我们冻结该矫正器，并将其用于后续测试时自适应过程中的奖励校正。通过提高奖励准确性进而提升模型性能，TRUER在所有评估配置下的两项指标上均持续优于朴素TTRL。
tldr: TRUER利用少量标注数据训练奖励矫正器来纠正多数投票产生的假阳性奖励，显著提升了测试时强化学习的效果。
ai_comments: 该研究切中了测试时强化学习（TTRL）中依赖多数投票等伪标签机制易受假阳性误导的痛点。其核心创新在于发现共识不等于正确性，并巧妙利用小样本监督重点对齐“错误多数”和“正确少数”来纠偏奖励。局限性在于仍需依赖一定规模的带标签源数据，且摘要未明确其泛化到分布外任务时的鲁棒性及具体开销。
motivation: 测试时强化学习依赖模型自身答案派生的奖励，但多数投票机制容易强化错误答案，且假阳性（错误响应获得正向奖励）主导了奖励错误；同时大规模真实奖励极难获取。
method: 提出TRUER框架，在真实奖励难以大规模获取但有少量标注数据的设定下，利用有限监督训练一个奖励矫正器；训练重点针对共识与正确性冲突的情况（即错误的多数和正确的少数）；训练完成后冻结矫正器，并在后续测试时自适应阶段使用其对奖励进行修正。
results: 通过改善奖励准确度，TRUER在所有评估配置下的奖励准确率与模型性能两个指标上，均持续优于朴素的测试时强化学习（naive TTRL）。
conclusion: TRUER通过引入区分正确性与共识的误差感知矫正器，有效纠正了测试时强化学习中的奖励错误，并在各项配置中稳定提升了模型性能。

title: Input-to-State Safety and Small-Gain Theorems for Large-Scale Nonlinear Systems
authors: Jianqiang Wang, Tengfei Liu, Zhong-Ping Jiang
abstract: This paper studies the safety verification problem for a general class of large-scale systems characterized by multiple safety indicator functions. Each safety indicator function satisfies a trajectory-based input-to-state safety (ISSf) estimate that provides a lower bound on its value along system trajectories in terms of the initial state, external inputs, and the other safety indicator functions, whose influence is quantified by continuous and nondecreasing gain functions. Within this framework, we establish a safety-oriented small-gain theorem and its corresponding corollaries that enable compositional and scalable safety verification of the interconnected system, provided that the interconnection gain functions satisfy a small-gain condition on the negative real axis. This condition concerns only the neighborhood of the safety boundary, thereby facilitating the application of our results to safety verification of multi-agent systems under distributed control. Our proof combines small-gain techniques with the lower-bound structure of ISSf estimates and develops an inductive comparison argument that establishes the ISSf property for the overall system throughout the maximal interval of existence. As an application, we establish robust safety for the natural distributed "half-spring" controller, theoretically supporting the computationally efficient and inspiring approach to safety-critical control of multi-agent systems in the presence of obstacles and external disturbances.
zh_title: 大规模非线性系统的输入-状态安全性与小增益定理
translation: 本文研究了一类由多个安全指示函数表征的通用大规模系统的安全性验证问题。每个安全指示函数均满足基于轨迹的输入-状态安全性（ISSf）估计，该估计根据初始状态、外部输入以及其他安全指示函数（其影响由连续非递减增益函数量化）为系统轨迹上的指标值提供下界。在此框架下，本文建立了面向安全性的小增益定理及其相关推论；只要互联增益函数在负实轴上满足小增益条件，便可对互联系统进行组合式和可扩展的安全性验证。该条件仅涉及安全边界的邻域，从而有利于将本研究成果应用于分布式控制下的多智能体系统安全性验证。我们的证明将小增益技术与ISSf估计的下界结构相结合，提出了一种归纳比较论证，确立了整体系统在最大存在区间内的ISSf性质。作为应用，本文确立了自然分布式“半弹簧”控制器的鲁棒安全性，为存在障碍物和外部干扰的多智能体系统安全关键控制提供了理论支持和计算高效的方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种面向大规模非线性系统的输入-状态安全性小增益定理，实现了可扩展的分布式系统安全性验证，并成功应用于多智能体鲁棒安全控制。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将经典非线性控制中的小增益定理成功拓展到输入-状态安全性（ISSf）分析中，且小增益条件仅限制在安全边界附近的负实轴上，极大地降低了保守性。该方法为大规模网络化系统和多智能体系统的分布式安全验证提供了强有力的模块化工具。局限性在于文摘未提及如何系统性构造安全指示函数和相应的增益函数。
motivation: 解决由多个安全指示函数表征的大规模非线性互联系统在面临外部输入干扰时，难以进行组合式和可扩展安全性验证的问题。
method: 基于多个安全指示函数构建基于轨迹的输入-状态安全性（ISSf）下界估计，通过连续非递减增益函数刻画子系统间影响；结合小增益技术与归纳比较论证，提出了互联增益在负实轴满足小增益条件下的面向安全性的小增益定理及推论。
results: 建立了整体系统在最大存在区间内的ISSf性质，使得安全性验证仅依赖于安全边界邻域内的互联增益条件；成功证明了在存在障碍物和外部扰动情况下，自然分布式“半弹簧”控制器的鲁棒安全性。
conclusion: 该理论框架为大规模复杂互联系统提供了一种可扩展且组合式的安全性验证方法，有效支持了多智能体系统在扰动和障碍物环境下的鲁棒安全控制。

title: CIALLO: Learning Shared Intent Representations for Cross-Embodiment Manipulation
authors: Choo Sin Wai, Dake Zhong, Jingye Zhang, Zhifang Liu, Siyao Xiao, Zirong Ding, Yuhong Zhang, Kangjie Chen, Dongbin Zhang, Guorui Song, Guocun Wang, Peng Jiao, Haoqian Wang
abstract: Robot demonstrations contain reusable manipulation knowledge, but transferring this knowledge across embodiments requires representations that bridge differences in control interfaces. Action reconstruction alone does not ensure that similar behaviors across robots share a representation. To address this gap, we introduce CIALLO, an action codec that aligns actions, visual changes, and observation-grounded language in a shared space of short-horizon behavioral intent. An embodiment-conditioned decoder maps this intent back to robot-specific actions, allowing a shared representation to support different control interfaces. After pretraining on eight embodiments, CIALLO adapts to a new robot from one recording of at most 10 seconds by updating only its embodiment embeddings. The calibrated codec then remains frozen while a policy learns to predict intent from observations and instructions. We instantiate this policy with Qwen3.5-4B to form Qwen-CIALLO, whose backbone requires no large-scale robot-action pretraining before policy finetuning. With 20 demonstrations per task, Qwen-CIALLO achieves 76.7\% average success across real SO-101 and single-arm Piper robots, compared with 70.0\% for fully finetuned $π_0$. In simulation, we additionally finetune the action decoder, achieving 97.3\% success on LIBERO and 52.7\% on RoboTwin 2.0. The LIBERO policy also achieves 80.8\% on LIBERO-Plus without further finetuning. Together, these results support a shared action codec as a transferable control interface that separates embodiment calibration from task learning.
zh_title: CIALLO：学习用于跨具身操作的共享意图表征
translation: 机器人示范包含可复用的操作知识，但要跨具身迁移这些知识，需要能够弥合控制接口差异的表征。单纯的动作重构无法确保不同机器人之间的相似行为共享统一表征。为了解决这一缺陷，我们提出了CIALLO——一种将动作、视觉变化和基于观察的语言对齐在短期行为意图共享空间中的动作编解码器。以具身为条件的解码器将该意图映射回特定机器人的动作，从而使共享表征能够支持不同的控制接口。在八种具身上预训练后，CIALLO仅需通过一次最多10秒的记录更新其具身嵌入，即可适配到新的机器人。校准后的编解码器随后保持冻结，由策略学习从观察和指令中预测意图。我们使用Qwen3.5-4B实例化该策略以构建Qwen-CIALLO，其骨干网络在策略微调之前无需大规模机器人动作预训练。在每个任务仅使用20次示范的情况下，Qwen-CIALLO在真实SO-101和单臂Piper机器人上取得了76.7%的平均成功率，而全量微调的π0为70.0%。在仿真中，我们额外微调了动作解码器，在LIBERO上取得了97.3%的成功率，在RoboTwin 2.0上取得了52.7%的成功率。此外，LIBERO策略在未经进一步微调的情况下，在LIBERO-Plus上也达到了80.8%的成功率。综上所述，这些结果证明了共享动作编解码器可作为一种可迁移的控制接口，将具身校准与任务学习有效分离开来。
tldr: CIALLO通过多模态对齐学习跨具身共享的短期行为意图表征，仅需10秒数据即可校准新机器人，成功解耦了具身适配与任务策略学习。
ai_comments: CIALLO的核心创新在于提出了以短期行为意图为核心的多模态动作编解码器，将具身硬件差异校准与高层任务策略学习有效解耦。其适配新机器人仅需10秒以内的数据，极大降低了跨具身迁移门槛，并使得下游策略模型能够直接基于通用VLM骨干网络进行微调而无需预先进行大规模机器人动作预训练。局限在于：在部分仿真环境（如LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0）中仍需额外微调动作解码器，表明底层动作生成的完全零样本跨具身泛化仍具挑战。
motivation: 机器人示范包含可复用的操作知识，但跨具身迁移面临控制接口差异的阻碍；仅依靠动作重构无法保证不同机器人的相似行为共享统一表征。
method: 提出CIALLO动作编解码器，将动作、视觉变化和基于观察的语言对齐到短期行为意图的共享空间中，并利用具身条件解码器将意图映射回机器人特定动作。在8种具身上预训练后，仅需≤10秒的单次记录更新具身嵌入即可适配新机器人；随后冻结编解码器，使用Qwen3.5-4B骨干网络训练策略直接预测意图（Qwen-CIALLO），该骨干无需大规模机器人动作预训练。
results: 在真机（SO-101和单臂Piper）上每任务仅用20条示范即达到76.7%平均成功率（超越全微调π0的70.0%）；仿真中在LIBERO达到97.3%，RoboTwin 2.0达到52.7%，且LIBERO策略在无需进一步微调的情况下在LIBERO-Plus上达到80.8%。
conclusion: 研究表明，共享动作编解码器能够作为一种高通用性、可迁移的控制接口，有效将底层具身校准与高层任务策略学习解耦，为跨具身机器人操作提供了新的有效范式。

title: Deterministic, Reproducible Inference in Exact Integer Arithmetic, and Verifiable Distributed Inference as Its Consequence
authors: Sayed Amir Karim
abstract: Optimized floating-point inference is not reproducible across environments: the same model on different hardware, compilers or thread counts can produce different bits. We present tritify, an open-source runtime that executes the forward pass of real models -- decoder-only language models, Mixture-of-Experts decoders, and the Segment Anything 2.1 image/video stack -- with the entire run-time path in exact integer arithmetic; floating point is confined to offline quantization and the float reference used for verification. We make three separate claims and verify each. (1) Cross-hardware reproducibility: the integer path produces bit-identical output run to run, across CPU instruction-set architectures, and across CPU/GPU, carried by a reproducing SHA-256 of the output. (2) Decision fidelity: the integer path reproduces the float reference's decision on the models and inputs tested, with the numeric exceptions measured; per-layer fidelity through sixteen layers of OLMoE-1B-7B and of a 106-billion-parameter MoE shows no fidelity cliff. (3) Location independence: a model's computation can be split across instruction sets, CPU and GPU, and networked machines with zero effect on the output bits. GLM-4.5-Air (106,852,251,264 parameters, 427 GB of integer codes) generated its answer across three machines, none of which can hold its integer codes in RAM, bit-identically to a single-host reference. The consequence is verifiable distributed inference: an untrusted server or a fleet of devices runs the model while an open scalar oracle re-derives the exact bytes; a guarantee against a dishonest server is future work. We do not claim a per-device speed-up, bit-equality of floating-valued intermediates, or confidentiality. Code: https://github.com/pelloran-inc/tritify
zh_title: 基于精确整数算术的确定性、可复现推理及其带来的可验证分布式推理
translation: 优化的浮点推理在不同环境中不具备可复现性：同一模型在不同硬件、编译器或线程数下可能产生不同的比特输出。我们提出了tritify，一个开源运行时，它在精确整数算术下执行真实模型（因果语言模型、混合专家解码器以及Segment Anything 2.1图像/视频栈）的完整前向传播路径；浮点计算仅限于离线量化和用于验证的浮点参考基准。我们提出了三项主张并分别进行了验证：（1）跨硬件可复现性：整数路径在多次运行、不同CPU指令集架构之间以及CPU/GPU之间生成比特级相同的输出，并通过输出的SHA-256一致性进行验证。（2）决策保真度：整数路径在所测试的模型和输入上复现了浮点参考的决策，并测量了数值异常；在OLMoE-1B-7B和拥有1060亿参数的MoE的16层逐层保真度评估中均未出现保真度断崖。（3）位置无关性：模型的计算可以拆分到不同指令集、CPU与GPU以及网络机器上，对输出比特没有任何影响。GLM-4.5-Air（106,852,251,264个参数，427 GB整数码）在三台机器（均无法单独在RAM中容纳其整数码）上生成的答案与单机参考输出完全一致。其结果是实现了可验证的分布式推理：不可信的服务器或设备群运行模型，而公开的标量预言机可重新推导出完全一致的字节；针对恶意欺诈服务器的防护保障为未来工作。我们并不主张单设备上的加速、浮点中间值的比特对齐或数据机密性。代码：https://github.com/pelloran-inc/tritify
tldr: 提出纯整数算术运行时tritify，实现跨异构硬件和网络分布式环境的比特级完全一致可复现推理，为可验证分布式推理提供支撑。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于通过端到端的纯精确整数运算路径，彻底消除了浮点计算在不同硬件/编译环境下的非确定性，实现了比特级（bit-identical）完全一致的推理重现。其重要意义在于为分布式、异构计算环境下的可验证推理（Verifiable Inference）奠定了确定性基础；其局限在于目前不提供单设备推理加速、不保护数据机密性，且防范恶意作恶服务器的完整保障机制仍需后续研究。
motivation: 传统的优化浮点推理在不同硬件、编译器或线程数等环境下不具备比特级可复现性，阻碍了跨异构环境的确定性计算和可验证分布式推理。
method: 提出了名为tritify的开源运行时系统，将模型的完整前向传播路径完全置于精确整数算术中执行（仅离线量化和验证参考使用浮点），并在自回归语言模型、MoE及SAM 2.1等模型上进行了验证。
results: （1）跨硬件可重现：在不同CPU架构及CPU/GPU之间输出完全一致的SHA-256哈希；（2）决策保真度：在OLMoE-1B-7B和106B MoE模型的多层评估中无保真度骤降，复现了浮点基准决策；（3）位置无关性：GLM-4.5-Air（106B参数，427 GB整数码）跨3台无法单独容纳模型的机器分布式运行，输出比特与单机基准完全一致。
conclusion: 通过全整数运算运行时实现了确定性与位置无关的模型推理，为不受信任节点或异构设备集群上的可验证分布式推理提供了可行技术路径。

title: Multi-Objective Scheduling of LLM-Based Multi-Agent Workflows in Cloud Computing
authors: Goshgar Can Ismayilov
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly composed into multi-agent workflows to accomplish complex and multi-step tasks. As the open-weight models continue to close the performance gap with the proprietary ones, model parameters are becoming a less significant source of competitive advantage in the artificial intelligence market. Yet how these models are efficiently scheduled onto distributed infrastructure such as the cloud, with respect to overall latency, monetary cost and resource utilization, remains largely unaddressed in the literature despite being an increasingly critical problem. Existing agentic workflow frameworks mostly focus on output quality and task success rates over popular benchmarks, rarely accounting for execution dynamics of LLM-based agents such as inference latency, computation power of heterogeneous resources, cloud-specific billing period and resource provisioning overheads. Therefore, this paper formulates multi-agent scheduling in cloud computing as a multi-objective optimization problem that jointly minimizes makespan and cost while maximizing resource utilization. Building on this formulation, we propose MO-SAIC (Multi-Objective Scheduling of Multi-Agent Workflows in Cloud Computing), a scheduling framework comprising four multi-objective schedulers with Non-Dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II), Weighted-Sum Genetic Algorithm (W-GA), a multi-objective adaptation of Heterogeneous Earliest Finish Time (MO-HEFT) and a random baseline (RAND). We evaluate the schedulers from the workflow scheduling, multi-objective optimization and system perspectives to measure their overall performance, quality of their Pareto-optimal fronts and impacts of workflow topology, cloud resource composition and scalability parameters. We report the experimental results with their statistical significance via the Wilcoxon test.
zh_title: 云计算中基于大语言模型的多智能体工作流多目标调度
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益被组装进多智能体工作流中以完成复杂的多步任务。随着开源权重模型持续缩小与专有模型的性能差距，模型参数在人工智能市场中作为竞争优势的重要性正在降低。然而，在考虑总体延迟、资金成本和资源利用率的情况下，如何在诸如云等分布式基础设施上高效调度这些模型，尽管已成为一个日益关键的问题，但在文献中仍很大程度上未被探讨。现有的智能体工作流框架主要关注热门基准上的输出质量和任务成功率，极少考虑基于LLM的智能体的执行动态，例如推理延迟、异构资源的计算能力、云特有的计费周期和资源配置开销。因此，本文将云计算中的多智能体调度形式化为一个多目标优化问题，该问题联合最小化完工时间和成本，同时最大化资源利用率。基于此形式化，我们提出了 MO-SAIC（云计算中多智能体工作流的多目标调度），这是一个包含四种多目标调度器的调度框架，包括非支配排序遗传算法 II（NSGA-II）、加权和遗传算法（W-GA）、异构最早完成时间的多目标自适应版本（MO-HEFT）以及一个随机基线（RAND）。我们从工作流调度、多目标优化和系统视角评估了这些调度器，以衡量其总体性能、Pareto最优前沿的质量以及工作流拓扑、云资源构成和可扩展性参数的影响。我们通过 Wilcoxon 检验报告了具有统计显著性的实验结果。
tldr: 本文提出了 MO-SAIC 调度框架，利用多目标优化算法联合优化 LLM 多智能体工作流在云端的延迟、经济成本与资源利用率。
ai_comments: 该论文针对大模型多智能体落地中的高成本与高延迟痛点，创新性地将传统分布式/云工作流调度与新兴的LLM Agent执行动态（如异构推理能力、云计费周期）相结合，填补了现有框架仅关注输出质量而忽略系统资源效率的研究空白。局限在于摘要中未提供具体算法对比优劣和量化结果。
motivation: 现有大模型智能体工作流框架主要关注输出质量和任务成功率，忽视了云端推理延迟、异构算力、计费周期与资源调配开销等执行动态，缺乏在延迟、成本和资源利用率维度的系统调度机制。
method: 将云端多智能体调度建模为联合最小化完工时间与资金成本、最大化资源利用率的多目标优化问题；提出了 MO-SAIC 框架，集成四种调度器：NSGA-II、加权和遗传算法（W-GA）、多目标异构最早完成时间算法（MO-HEFT）以及随机基线（RAND）。
results: 通过工作流调度、多目标优化和系统视角多维度评估了调度算法，分析了总体性能、Pareto最优前沿质量以及拓扑结构、云资源配置和可扩展性参数的影响，并利用Wilcoxon检验报告了具有统计学显著性的实验结果（具体量化指标摘要未提及）。
conclusion: 摘要未明确提及（Not mentioned in abstract）

title: Effects of Laser Beam Width and Measurement Noise on Tree Diameter Estimation in Laser Scanning
authors: Jesse Muhojoki, Nuutti Ervasti, Eric Hyyppä, Aapo Erkkilä, Eppu Honkanen, Tuomas Yrttimaa, Mikko Vastaranta, Juha Hyyppä
abstract: Laser scanning has been utilized for decades to measure tree structure and geometry. Despite continuous advances in sensor technology, uncertainties arising from scanner characteristics and measurement conditions has remained relevant sources of error. In particular, factors such as laser beam diameter can introduce both systematic and random errors in the reconstructed tree geometry. This study investigates the main sources of these errors in mobile laser scanning (MLS) and quantifies their effects on stem curve (stem diameter) estimation. We discovered through simulations and experiments that the heteroscedasticity (difference in variance in ranging and scan angle) in the measurement noise is a key factor along with the beam width of the lidar, which cause the bias of the diameter estimates to depend not only on distance, but also on the tree diameter. We demonstrated that this bias can be reliably predicted and negated for trees with a diameter at the breast height greater than 10 cm using technical specifications of the sensor without any additional calibration. In experiments, the proposed bias compensation method reduced the root-mean-square error of stem diameter estimates to sub-centimeter level on boreal forest test sites. However, for small trees with diameter below 10 cm, the diameter bias becomes sensitive to the diameter of the tree$\unicode{x2013}$an unknown factor$\unicode{x2013}$and other factors, such as different bark and out-of-roundness of the stem, limiting the precision of lidar for measuring geometry of trees and applicability of the presented method.
zh_title: 激光光束宽度和测量噪声对激光扫描树干直径估计的影响
translation: 数十年来，激光扫描一直被用于测量树木结构和几何形状。尽管传感器技术不断进步，但由扫描仪特性和测量条件引起的不确定性仍然是相关的误差来源。特别是激光光束直径等因素会在重建的树木几何形状中引入系统误差和随机误差。本研究探讨了移动激光扫描（MLS）中这些误差的主要来源，并量化了它们对树干曲线（树干直径）估计的影响。通过仿真和实验，我们发现测量噪声中的异方差性（测距和扫描角度的方差差异）与激光雷达光束宽度是一个关键因素，二者导致直径估计的偏差不仅取决于距离，还取决于树木直径。我们证明，利用传感器的技术规格而无需任何额外校准，即可可靠地预测并消除胸径大于10 cm树木的这种偏差。实验表明，所提出的偏差补偿方法在北方森林试验样地上将树干直径估计的均方根误差降低至亚厘米级。然而，对于胸径小于10 cm的小树，直径偏差对树木直径这一未知因素以及树皮差异和树干失圆度等其他因素变得敏感，限制了激光雷达测量树木几何形状的精度以及本方法的适用性。
tldr: 本文揭示了激光束宽与噪声异方差性对树径估计的误差机理，并提出了一种仅利用传感器参数实现亚厘米级精度的偏差补偿方法。
ai_comments: 该研究深入分析了移动激光雷达物理参数（光束宽度）和测量噪声异方差性对树干几何测量带来的系统性偏差机理，无需额外标定即可通过传感器技术规格实现亚厘米级补偿，具有很强的实用价值；但局限性在于该方法对胸径小于10 cm的小树适用性较差，受树皮质地和树干不规则性影响显著。
motivation: 移动激光扫描技术在测量树木结构时，传感器特性（如激光光束直径）和测量条件引起的系统及随机误差仍未得到完全解决，需要探明主要误差来源并量化其对树干曲线（直径）估计的影响。
method: 结合仿真和实地实验，研究了移动激光扫描（MLS）中测量噪声异方差性（测距和扫描角度的方差差异）与激光束宽度的相互作用，并提出了一种仅基于传感器技术规格预测并消除树干直径估计偏差的方法，无需额外校准。
results: 在北方森林测试样地的实验中，所提出的偏差补偿方法将树干直径估计的均方根误差降低到了亚厘米级别；但对于胸径小于10 cm的小树，直径偏差对树径本身高度敏感，且受树皮差异和树干非圆形度等因素影响较大。
conclusion: 激光光束宽度和测距/测角噪声的异方差性共同导致了树径估计偏差；通过传感器参数可对胸径大于10 cm的树木进行可靠的偏差预测与补偿，但小直径树木测量精度仍受多种物理和几何因素限制。

title: Plug-and-Play ADMM for Inverse Problems with Flow Matching Denoiser
authors: Dibyanshu Kumar, Magda Gregorova
abstract: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods with generative priors have achieved strong performance in inverse problems, with recent flow matching models enabling fast and scalable reconstruction. However, a key challenge in PnP methods is maintaining consistency between data fidelity updates and the learned generative prior, as data-consistency steps can move iterates away from the flow trajectory. We propose an ADMM-based PnP framework for flow matching priors that enforces stronger consistency between the measurement model and the prior through auxiliary variables and dual updates. In addition, we introduce a trajectory correction mechanism that restores consistency with the flow via a combination of deterministic and stochastic projections. Our method provides a more principled integration of flow priors within PnP frameworks, achieving high-quality reconstructions with reduced computational cost.
zh_title: 基于流匹配去噪器的逆问题即插即用ADMM方法
translation: 采用生成先验的即插即用（PnP）方法在逆问题求解中取得了出色的性能，而近期出现的流匹配模型更是实现了快速且可扩展的重建。然而，PnP方法的一个核心挑战是保持数据保真度更新与所学生成先验之间的一致性，因为数据一致性步骤可能会使迭代偏离流轨迹。为此，我们提出了一种面向流匹配先验的基于ADMM的PnP框架，该框架通过辅助变量和对偶更新强化了测量模型与先验之间的一致性。此外，我们引入了一种结合确定性投影和随机投影的轨迹校正机制，以恢复与流的一致性。我们的方法为在PnP框架中融合流先验提供了更具原则性的途径，以更低的计算成本实现了高质量的重建。
tldr: 提出了一种结合流匹配先验的ADMM-PnP框架，通过辅助变量对偶更新与轨迹校正机制，解决了数据更新偏离流轨迹的问题，实现了高效、高质量的逆问题重建。
ai_comments: 该论文敏锐地抓住了连续生成模型（流匹配）与传统优化算法（PnP-ADMM）结合时的核心矛盾——数据保真度更新容易破坏生成流的轨迹。通过引入ADMM框架下的辅助变量、对偶更新以及创新的确定性/随机投影轨迹校正机制，在理论和机制上增强了一致性，不仅提高了重构质量，还有效兼顾了流匹配快速采样的计算效率，对扩散/流生成模型在逆问题中的应用具有重要的推动作用。
motivation: 在基于生成先验的PnP方法中，数据保真度更新步骤容易使迭代点偏离学习到的流轨迹，导致数据保真度与生成先验之间难以保持一致性。
method: 提出了一种基于ADMM的流匹配先验PnP框架，通过辅助变量和对偶更新加强测量模型与先验之间的一致性；同时引入了一种结合确定性投影与随机投影的轨迹校正机制，用于恢复并维持与流轨迹的一致性。
results: 该方法以更低的计算成本实现了高质量的图像/信号重建。
conclusion: 该方法为在PnP框架中整合流先验提供了更具原则性的系统化方案，能够在显著降低计算成本的同时实现高质量的逆问题重建。

title: Retargetable Compilation for Tensor Kernels via a Unified Layout Abstraction
authors: Likai Ma, Renze Chen, Tianqi Li, Yuhao Luo, Youwei Xiao, Size Zheng, Xiuhong Li, Yun Liang
abstract:
Modern hardware accelerators achieve high performance through specialized instructions coupled with tightly managed memory hierarchies. These instructions impose strict layout requirements on their operands: where tensor fragments reside, how they are organized, and how parallel units access them. Such instruction-visible layout is critical to kernel performance, as it determines whether instructions execute correctly and how much data movement they incur. However, existing compilers either scatter layout requirements across handwritten programs and local scheduling rules, or provide layout representations and conversions specific to a single class of targets. Both approaches expose the same abstraction gap: the absence of a unified model for instruction layout requirements across backends.
  This paper presents Arknife, a retargetable compiler that treats instruction-visible layout as first-class instruction semantics. Its central idea is a constraint-based layout algebra: tensor layouts map logical axes to hardware axes spanning parallel levels and memory spaces. Instruction operands declare layout requirements, and target-provided repairs resolve conflicts. Layouts are then solved globally across the program. ISA-specific layout facts are supplied by target-side instruction descriptions rather than hardcoded in the compiler. Retargeting reuses the layout algebra and solver while defining the new target's instructions and their operand requirements. We evaluate Arknife across x86 CPU, Hexagon NPU, and NVIDIA A100 GPU. Arknife matches cuBLAS on A100, and on x86 and Hexagon outperforms vendor-optimized libraries by $2.17\times$ and $3.78\times$ and the retargetable compiler MISAAL by $5.08\times$ and $4.53\times$, respectively.
zh_title: 基于统一布局抽象的张量算子可重定向编译
translation: 现代硬件加速器通过专用指令配合严格管理的内存层次结构来实现高性能。这些指令对其操作数施加了严格的布局要求：张量分片存放的位置、组织形式以及并行单元如何访问它们。这种指令可见的布局对算子性能至关重要，因为它决定了指令能否正确执行以及会产生多少数据搬运。然而，现有编译器要么将布局需求分散在手写程序和局部调度规则中，要么提供特定于单一目标类别的布局表示和转换机制。这两种方法都暴露出同样的抽象鸿沟：缺乏跨不同后端的指令布局需求统一模型。本文提出了Arknife，这是一种将指令可见布局作为一等公民指令语义的可重定向编译器。其核心思想是基于约束的布局代数：张量布局将逻辑轴映射到跨越并行级别和内存空间的硬件轴。指令操作数声明布局需求，并通过目标端提供的修复策略解决冲突。随后在整个程序中全局求解布局。ISA特定的布局特征由目标端指令描述提供，而非硬编码在编译器中。重定向到新目标时，只需复用布局代数和求解器，同时定义新目标的指令及其操作数需求。我们在x86 CPU、Hexagon NPU和NVIDIA A100 GPU上对Arknife进行了评估。Arknife在A100上达到了与cuBLAS相当的性能，并在x86和Hexagon上分别超越厂商优化库2.17倍和3.78倍，分别超越可重定向编译器MISAAL 5.08倍和4.53倍。
tldr: Arknife提出了一种统一的约束布局代数与全局求解方案，将指令布局作为一等语义，成功实现了张量算子在CPU、GPU和NPU间的高效可重定向编译。
ai_comments: 本文针对硬件加速器专用指令所带来的严苛且碎片化的张量布局需求，提出了极具创新性的统一约束布局代数，解决了算子编译器在面向异构硬件时难以兼顾“高性能”与“可重定向性”的核心痛点。其全局布局求解思想极具启发性。潜在的局限性在于文摘未提及该代数在处理复杂非规则访存算子时的表达能力及全局求解的编译时间开销。
motivation: 现代硬件加速器的专用指令对张量布局有严格要求，直接影响执行正确性与数据传输开销。现有编译器要么把布局规则分散在手工代码和局部调度中，要么绑定于特定硬件，缺乏跨后端统一的指令布局需求建模抽象。
method: 提出了Arknife可重定向编译器，将指令可见布局作为一等指令语义；核心采用基于约束的布局代数，把张量逻辑轴映射到跨并行层次与存储空间的硬件轴；由指令操作数声明布局约束并通过目标端修复机制化解冲突，在全程序范围内全局求解布局；ISA相关布局知识由目标端配置提供而非硬编码在编译器内，实现高复用性的跨平台重定向。
results: 在NVIDIA A100 GPU上性能达到与cuBLAS相当的水平；在x86 CPU和Hexagon NPU上，分别超越厂商优化库2.17倍和3.78倍，并分别超越开源可重定向编译器MISAAL 5.08倍和4.53倍。
conclusion: 通过将指令可见布局提升为一等语义并建立基于约束的布局代数，统一的布局抽象模型能够有效填补算子编译器的抽象鸿沟，在多种不同架构的硬件加速器上实现卓越的高性能和低迁移成本的可重定向编译。

title: When Covariance Is Not Enough: Kernel-Based Regularization for Single-Cell Counterfactuals
authors: Korbinian Traeuble, Edward de Brouwer, Archit Verma, Doron Haviv, Kipper Fletez-Brant
abstract: Counterfactual editing of single cells, predicting how an observed cell would look had one factor been different, enables in-silico screening where experiments are infeasible, but is useful only if the edit is faithful to the individual and not merely to the condition. Concept bottleneck generative models make the effects of interventions interpretable by decomposing a cell's representation into known and unknown factors. Previous work uses a linear cross-covariance penalty to disentangle known and unknown dimensions. We demonstrate that this first-order criterion does not fully separate information when non-linear interactions are present. We first demonstrate the inadequacy of linear cross-factor penalization with simulation experiments with controlled edits and known non-linear covariate effects. We then demonstrate that adding a nonlinear kernel criterion, the normalized Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion, is able to recover the true intervention effects on simulation data. Finally, we apply the non-linear concept bottleneck model to a complex single-cell RNA-seq dataset and find that it improves the ability to generate counterfactual expression profiles of cells under different tissue environments.
zh_title: 当协方差不足以奏效时：用于单细胞反事实预测的基于核的正则化
translation: 单细胞反事实编辑（即预测若某一因素发生改变，所观察到的细胞会呈现何种状态）使得在实验不可行时进行计算机模拟筛选成为可能，但其前提是编辑必须忠实于细胞个体本身，而非仅仅符合干预条件。概念瓶颈生成模型通过将细胞表征分解为已知和未知因子，使干预效果具备可解释性。先前的工作通常采用线性互协方差惩罚来解耦已知与未知维度。我们证明，当存在非线性相互作用时，该一阶准则无法完全分离信息。我们首先通过具有受控编辑和已知非线性协变量效应的模拟实验，展示了线性跨因子惩罚的不足。随后我们证明，引入一种非线性核准则——归一化希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（nHSIC），能够在模拟数据上恢复真实的干预效应。最后，我们将该非线性概念瓶颈模型应用于复杂的单细胞RNA测序数据集，发现其提升了生成细胞在不同组织环境下反事实表达谱的能力。
keywords: 单细胞反事实编辑 (Single-cell counterfactuals)
概念瓶颈模型 (Concept bottleneck models)
希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则 (Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion)
tldr: 本文提出了一种引入归一化希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（nHSIC）的核正则化方法，解决了单细胞反事实概念瓶颈模型中线性协方差无法解耦非线性相互作用的问题。
ai_comments: 该研究敏锐地指出了当前概念瓶颈模型在单细胞分析中使用线性互协方差惩罚无法解耦非线性依赖的根本缺陷，创新性地引入了非线性核独立性准则（nHSIC），有效提升了反事实单细胞表达谱预测的准确性与个体保真度。其局限性可能在于核方法对超大规模单细胞数据集的计算复杂度较高（摘要未提及扩展性表现）。
motivation: 单细胞反事实生成模型常通过线性互协方差惩罚来解耦已知与未知变量，但当细胞表征中存在非线性相互作用时，该一阶线性准则无法完全分离信息，导致反事实编辑不能很好地忠实于单细胞个体特征。
method: 提出在概念瓶颈生成模型中使用非线性核准则——归一化希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（normalized Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion, nHSIC）替代传统的线性跨协方差惩罚，实现已知和未知因子表示之间的非线性独立性正则化与解耦。
results: 在受控非线性模拟实验中，该方法证明了传统线性惩罚的失效，并成功利用非线性核准则恢复了真实干预效应；在复杂单细胞RNA测序数据集中，显著提升了跨组织环境下生成细胞反事实基因表达谱的能力。
conclusion: 在概念瓶颈生成模型中引入非线性核独立性正则化能够有效克服线性惩罚的局限，成功捕捉复杂的非线性交互，从而在复杂组织环境下生成更忠实可靠的单细胞反事实表达谱。

title: List Update with Per-Page Maximum Delay
authors: Tianhang Lu, Runtian Ren, Shengcai Liu
abstract:
We study list update with per-page maximum delay. Requests may wait, and one access clears all pending requests of a page at its current list rank, paying their maximum waiting penalty. Each service can change the permutation and therefore the cost of later accesses. We give a strictly $5$-competitive deterministic algorithm: serve a page when the oldest waiting time reaches two thirds of its current rank, then move it to the front.
  Our main tool is an asynchronous marked-rank coupling that compares different list orders and different service histories. A temporal transfer principle separates this permutation argument from two waiting-cost inequalities. It gives factor $5$ for page-specific superadditive penalties, common calendar rates, and additional hard deadlines; deadlines alone admit factor $3$. Two structural conditions on request-specific penalties give factor $3+2κ$. In particular, nonincreasing request severity retains factor $5$ even with unbounded weight ratios.
  For linear delay, offline optimization is NP-complete but fixed-parameter tractable in the number of pages. We characterize fixed-list batching, show an $Ω(m)$ gap between the best static order and dynamic reordering, and prove that the optimal deterministic factor for one page is exactly $2$. Counterexamples delineate the threshold rule's scope.
zh_title: 带每页最大延迟的列表更新问题
translation: 我们研究了带每页最大延迟的列表更新问题。请求可以等待，且一次访问可以在某个页面当前的列表秩（rank）位置清除其所有挂起的请求，同时支付它们的最大等待惩罚。每次服务都可以改变排列，从而改变后续访问的成本。我们提出了一个严格5-竞争的确定性算法：当一个页面的最长等待时间达到其当前秩的三分之二时对其进行服务，随后将其移至表头。我们的主要工具是一种异步标记秩耦合，用于比较不同的列表顺序和不同的服务历史。时间转移原则将这种排列论证与两个等待成本不等式分离开来。对于页面特异的超加性惩罚、通用日历速率以及额外的硬截止期限，该原则给出了5的因子；仅有截止期限时因子为3。针对特定请求惩罚的两个结构性条件给出了3+2κ的因子。特别是，非递增的请求严重程度即使在权重比无界的情况下也能保持5的因子。对于线性延迟，离线优化是NP完全的，但关于页面数量是固定参数可解的（FPT）。我们刻画了固定列表批处理的特征，展示了最优静态顺序与动态重排之间存在Ω(m)的差距，并证明了单个页面的最优确定性因子恰好为2。反例界定了阈值规则的适用范围。
tldr: 提出了一个在带每页最大延迟的列表更新问题中达到5-竞争比的确定性算法（等待达秩的2/3时服务并移至表头），并给出了离线复杂度及下界分析。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将列表更新（List Update）经典问题与批处理/延迟惩罚相结合，提出了异步标记秩耦合（asynchronous marked-rank coupling）与时间转移原则，理论工具新颖且分析深刻。不仅给出了具有常数竞争比的确定性在线算法，还拓展到了带硬截止期限及非线性惩罚等广泛场景，同时给出了离线复杂度和理论界限，具有较高的理论价值。
motivation: 经典的列表更新问题通常假设请求必须立即响应，而实际场景中请求可以被缓冲延迟处理，且一次访问即可清空该页面的所有挂起请求并支付最大等待惩罚；需要设计并分析能够权衡等待延迟惩罚与列表重排序访问成本的在线算法。
method: 提出一种确定性在线算法：当某个页面的最长等待时间达到其当前列表秩（rank）的三分之二时对其进行服务，并在服务后移至表头（Move-To-Front）。主要分析工具为异步标记秩耦合（asynchronous marked-rank coupling）以及时间转移原则（temporal transfer principle）。
results: 给出了严格5-竞争的确定性算法；在特定超加性惩罚、通用日历速率及硬截止期限下保持5-竞争比（仅有硬截止期限时为3-竞争比）；对特定请求惩罚满足结构条件时可达(3+2κ)竞争比；证明了线性延迟下离线优化是NP完全的但关于页面数量固定参数可解（FPT）；证明了最佳静态顺序与动态重排之间存在Ω(m)的差距，且单页面的最优确定性竞争比严格为2。
conclusion: 论文证明了基于阈值并移至表头（MTF）的确定性算法在带每页最大延迟的列表更新问题中能够达到5-竞争比，拓展了其在更广泛延迟惩罚和硬截止期限下的适用范围，并确定了离线问题的计算复杂性与理论边界。

title: Word-Level Alignment of OCR and Ground Truth under Zoning and Reading-Order Errors
authors: Fonseca Cacho, Jorge Ramón
abstract: OCR post-processing needs OCR text aligned word by word with its ground truth. Data sets rarely provide that mapping, and a monotone aligner can lose its place when zoning errors permute the reading order. We revisit this problem, the Zoning Problem of our 2019 paper, with a protocol that tests correctness under such permutations. We apply OCR-side reading-order permutations with construction-time word-level gold and score correct-match F1, cascade length and recovery. We compare the 2019 location-aware aligner, a re-anchoring extension of it, a RETAS-style baseline (RETAS-lite), a multi-region aligner that combines unique-word and unique n-gram anchors with chunk-to-window assignment, genalog's RETAS and the original Java RETAS. Experiments use synthetic character noise with block moves, paragraph swaps and column interleaving, historical newspaper reading-order permutations, geometry-derived gold for Tesseract OCR, and a small word-box set. Synthetic tests show where local tracking fails after large displacements and where unique-anchor methods collapse when unique anchors are scarce. On our synthetic boilerplate page the 2019 method had the highest F1 among those tested. Historical newspaper and geometry-derived evaluations carry the limitations of approximate gold and the article-order convention. The first multi-region version has a quadratic scaling cost. Local tracking remains fragile under large reading-order changes; the tested anchor-based methods handle many of those cases but fail when unique anchors are scarce. Approximate gold, the article-order convention, missing residual annotation, and the lack of modern multi-column word-level ground truth remain limitations.
comment: 19 pages. Submitted to IJDAR (ICDAR 2027 Journal Track). Code: https://github.com/SniperJF/zone-robust-ocr-align
zh_title: 分区与阅读顺序错误下的 OCR 与真实标注词级对齐
translation: OCR后处理需要将OCR文本与其真实标注（ground truth）逐词对齐。现有数据集极少提供这种映射，且当分区错误置换阅读顺序时，单调对齐器可能会失去其位置。我们通过一项测试此类置换下正确性的协议，重新审视了这一问题（即我们2019年论文中的“分区问题”）。我们在构建时具有词级黄金标注的OCR侧应用阅读顺序置换，并对正确匹配F1、级联长度和恢复率进行评分。我们对比了2019年的位置感知对齐器、其重新锚定扩展、RETAS风格基线（RETAS-lite）、结合了唯一词与唯一n-gram锚点及块到窗口分配的多区域对齐器、genalog的RETAS以及原始Java RETAS。实验使用了带有文本块移动、段落调换和分栏交叉的合成字符噪声数据、历史报纸阅读顺序置换、Tesseract OCR的几何推导黄金标准以及小型词框集合。合成测试展示了局部跟踪在大位移后失效的位置，以及唯一锚点方法在唯一锚点稀缺时崩溃的情况。在我们的合成样板页面上，2019年的方法在所测试的方法中F1值最高。历史报纸和几何推导的评估存在近似黄金标准和文章顺序惯例的局限性。首个多区域版本具有二次缩放成本。局部跟踪在大规模阅读顺序变动下仍然十分脆弱；所测试的基于锚点的方法可以处理许多此类情况，但在唯一锚点稀缺时会失效。近似黄金标准、文章顺序惯例、缺失的残差标注以及缺乏现代多栏词级真实标准仍然是局限所在。
tldr: 本文评估并对比了在分区和阅读顺序扰动下将OCR与真实文本进行词级对齐的多种方法，指出了局部跟踪和大位移/稀缺锚点条件下的失效瓶颈。
ai_comments: 本文聚焦于OCR后处理中非常基础却极其棘手的阅读顺序置换和分区错误对齐问题，创新性地提出了量化评估协议（F1、级联长度、恢复率）。研究全面对比了位置感知与基于锚点的多种代表性算法，清晰揭示了局部跟踪在面对大位移以及锚点方法在缺乏唯一特征词时的性能瓶颈，为文档分析领域的对齐算法改进提供了重要基准。
motivation: OCR后处理需要OCR文本与真实标注（Ground Truth）逐词精确对齐，但现有数据集极少提供映射关系，且在版面分区错误扰乱阅读顺序时，传统的单调对齐器容易失准。
method: 提出了一种在OCR侧施加阅读顺序置换的评估协议，以正确匹配F1、级联长度和恢复率为评估指标；对比了2019年位置感知对齐器、其重锚定扩展版本、RETAS-lite、结合唯一词/n-gram锚点与块窗口分配的多区域对齐器、genalog RETAS及原版Java RETAS等方法；在合成字符噪声（含块移动、段落调换、分栏交错）、历史报纸排列数据和Tesseract几何标注数据上进行评测。
results: 合成测试揭示了局部跟踪在大位移后失效的边界，以及基于唯一锚点的方法在唯一锚点匮乏时性能崩溃的现象；在合成样板页面上，2019年的位置感知方法取得了最高的F1值；多区域对齐器的第一版实现存在二次方缩放的计算开销。
conclusion: 在大规模阅读顺序变动下，局部跟踪方法依然脆弱；基于锚点的方法虽能解决部分问题，但在唯一锚点稀疏时会崩溃。此外，该领域仍受限于近似标注、文章顺序惯例以及缺乏现代多栏词级真实标准等不足。

title: Do Language Models Feel the Sentiment? Investigating Emotion Vectors
authors: Ali Hassan Khan, Saad Bin Ather, Muhammad Saif, Maryam Bashir, Hajra Waheed
abstract: Emotion vectors are directions in a language model's internal representations that are associated with emotional concepts. Prior work shows that these vectors can influence model behavior, but their role in sentiment classification remains unclear. This study investigates emotion directions in Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct. Eight directions extracted from GoEmotions are evaluated through sentiment probing, activation interventions, and supervised correction. Emotion-only probes achieve 88.66% and 90.70% accuracy on binary TweetEval. In exploratory matched-ablation experiments, raw emotion-space removal causes 2.39 and 1.10 percentage points more accuracy loss than matched isotropic random-subspace removal for 0.5B and 3B, respectively. All four TweetEval raw and denoised effects are significant after Holm adjustment across eight comparisons. An exploratory SST-2 extension shows smaller raw excess losses of 0.66 and 0.57 points, with no effects surviving Holm adjustment. Frozen sentiment-correction classifiers are also tested on 20,000 Amazon Polarity reviews. Emotion-based correction improves accuracy over uncorrected Qwen, but does not consistently outperform margin-only baselines. These results distinguish sentiment information available in model representations, the effects of changing those representations, and their practical value for classification. They do not establish a uniquely emotional mechanism.
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at ExplAI-2026: 2nd Workshop on Advanced AI in Explainability and Ethics for the Sustainable Development Goals
zh_title: 语言模型能感受到情绪吗？探究情绪向量
translation: 情绪向量是语言模型内部表征中与情绪概念相关的方向。先前的研究表明这些向量可以影响模型行为，但它们在情感分类中的作用仍不清晰。本研究探究了Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct中的情绪方向。通过情感探测、激活干预和监督纠错评估了从GoEmotions中提取的八个方向。纯情绪探测在二元TweetEval任务上分别达到了88.66%和90.70%的准确率。在探索性匹配消融实验中，原始情绪空间的移除导致0.5B和3B模型的准确率损失比匹配的各向同性随机子空间移除分别多出2.39和1.10个百分点。在经过Holm校正的八次比较后，TweetEval的所有四种原始和去噪效应均具有统计显著性。探索性SST-2扩展实验显示了较小的原始额外损失（0.66和0.57个百分点），但校正后均不显著。还在20,000条Amazon Polarity评论上测试了冻结的情感纠错分类器。基于情绪的纠错比未纠错的Qwen提高了准确率，但并未持续优于纯边际基线。这些结果区分了模型表征中可用的情感信息、改变这些表征的影响以及它们在分类中的实用价值，但并未确立独特的专属情绪机制。
tldr: 通过对Qwen2.5情绪向量的探测与因果消融干预，研究发现情绪子空间承载有效情感信息，但未能证实模型存在独特的专属情绪机制。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将表示探测、因果激活干预与下游纠错实验相结合，系统验证了情绪向量在情感分类中的实际作用；其局限在于情绪空间剥离效果在不同数据集间存在异质性（如SST-2上不显著），且未能证实模型具有独特的类人情绪处理机制。
motivation: 虽然已知情绪向量能够影响模型行为，但它们在语言模型情感分类中所扮演的具体角色和因果机制尚不明确。
method: 从GoEmotions中提取8个情绪方向，并在Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct与Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct上通过情绪探测（sentiment probing）、激活消融干预（匹配随机子空间移除对比）以及基于冻结分类器的监督纠错进行系统评估。
results: 纯情绪探测在TweetEval二分类上达到88.66%和90.70%的准确率；移除原始情绪空间相比匹配随机子空间在0.5B和3B模型上分别多造成2.39和1.10个百分点的精度损失且通过显著性检验；但在SST-2上效应减弱且调整后不显著；情绪纠错虽提升了基线性能，但未稳定优于纯边际基准。
conclusion: 研究结果区分了模型表征中包含的情感信息、修改表征产生的因果效应以及其在分类中的实际应用价值，但并未证实语言模型内部存在独特的专属情绪机制。

title: Mixed Signals: Weight-Space Programming for EEG and ECG
authors: Dara Varam, Taraneh Aminosharieh Najafi, David Atienza
abstract: Weight-space programming allows language models to read a trained neural network's weights and edit them. This opens the door to ``training'' by reasoning rather than through gradient descent. Prior work has demonstrated its functionality and promise for game-playing networks and fixing specific failures in language models, even extending to diffusion models. In this work, we present its applicability to models trained on biosignal data, specifically EEG and ECG data. We show that frontier models are not only able to debug specific faults planted in biosignal-based models without being told what these faults are, but are even capable of writing all the weights of a network from scratch, given only the architecture, the task, and a minimal set of training subjects. In particular, in one set of experiments, a language model was able to match standard gradient-descent training using $6\times$ fewer training subjects, through reasoning alone and without any gradient descent step. Networks written by Claude Opus 5.5 also scored higher than classic hand-crafted EEG pipelines (alpha band power, and common spatial patterns with linear discriminant analysis) when built from the same 5 subjects. We also highlight some of the limitations, which include the inability of language models to improve already well-trained classification models, and their incapacity to reliably recognize, from the weights alone, the task a network was trained on. Overall, our results indicate that weight-space programming can be useful for small networks, such as those deployed on edge devices and wearables, but the concept still requires further investigation before it can be used in practice.
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Project website: https://daravaram.github.io/BioWSP
zh_title: 混合信号：面向脑电与心电的权重空间编程
translation: 权重空间编程允许语言模型读取已训练神经网络的权重并对其进行编辑。这开启了通过推理而非梯度下降来进行“训练”的大门。先前的研究已经证明了其在博弈网络、修复语言模型特定故障乃至扩展到扩散模型中的功能与前景。在本研究中，我们展示了该方法在基于生物电信号（特别是EEG和ECG数据）训练的模型中的适用性。我们表明，前沿模型不仅能够在未被告知具体缺陷的情况下调试植入在生物信号模型中的特定故障，甚至能够在仅给定网络架构、任务和极少量训练受试者的情况下，完全从头编写网络的所有权重。具体而言，在一组实验中，语言模型仅通过推理、在没有任何梯度下降步骤的情况下，使用少6倍的训练受试者即可达到标准梯度下降训练的效果。在基于相同的5名受试者构建时，由Claude Opus 5.5编写的网络表现也优于传统的经典手工EEG处理管线（alpha频段功率，以及结合线性判别分析的共空间模式）。我们还指出了若干局限性，包括语言模型无法改进已经充分训练的分类模型，以及无法仅凭权重可靠地识别出网络所训练的任务。总体而言，我们的结果表明，权重空间编程对于小型网络（例如部署在边缘设备和可穿戴设备上的网络）可能非常有用，但在投入实际使用之前，该概念仍需进一步深入探索。
tldr: 研究展示了前沿大语言模型可不依赖梯度下降，纯靠推理调试或直接编写用于EEG和ECG的小型网络权重，且性能媲美常规训练。
ai_comments: 该研究具有高度的创新性，首次将“通过LLM推理直接生成/编辑网络权重”（权重空间编程）的思想扩展到EEG和ECG等生物电信号处理领域，展示了极低样本下免梯度训练的潜力。然而其局限性也较为明显：受限于当前LLM对连续参数的表征能力，该方法目前仅适用于小型网络，且无法进一步优化已充分训练的模型，也无法仅凭权重逆向推理任务类型，实际落地仍需更多验证。
motivation: 探索权重空间编程在生物电信号（EEG和ECG）模型上的适用性，尝试通过大语言模型的推理能力代替传统梯度下降来生成或修复模型权重。
method: 利用前沿大语言模型（如Claude Opus 5.5）直接读取、调试或从头编写神经网络权重，仅依据模型架构、任务描述和极少量受试者数据，完全依靠推理而不使用梯度下降。
results: LLM能在未被告知具体错误的情况下调试生物信号模型中的植入缺陷；仅凭推理生成的权重在受试者数量减少6倍的情况下即可媲美标准梯度下降训练；在5名受试者数据下优于传统手工EEG分析管线；但该方法无法改进已充分训练的模型，也无法仅凭权重可靠识别模型的训练任务。
conclusion: 权重空间编程对边缘设备和可穿戴设备上的小型生物信号网络展现出应用价值，但要在实际场景中推广仍需更深入的研究。

title: Exploring Synchrony for Communication in Modular Neural Networks
authors: Nikolas Willems, Qiyang Sun, Björn W. Schuller
abstract: One motivation for modular neural networks is to divide computation across components that learn distinct, reusable functions, which could then be recombined to support compositional generalisation. In practice, modular structure alone does not guarantee that such roles develop, and unrestricted communication between modules can undermine any specialisation that does emerge. This raises the question of how modular communication should be organised. The problem can be viewed as an analogue of the perceptual binding problem, where synchrony has been proposed as a mechanism for coordinating distributed representations. We introduce SyncNet, a modular architecture that separates module content from a dynamical phase state: learnt Kuramoto dynamics evolve the phases, while phase alignment determines communication through a shared channel. We evaluate SyncNet on Sort-of-CLEVR for relational reasoning and on SQOOP for systematic generalisation, where lower pair variety demands more recombination at test time. SyncNet gives the best held-out accuracy of the models compared at the three lowest pair varieties, by 5.1 percentage points at the hardest, and is competitive on Sort-of-CLEVR though below the strongest attention baselines. Test-time overrides show that performance depends on phases that evolve: fixed phases cost as much as no addressing at all, and permuting which module holds which region is nearly as damaging. A content-addressed variant trained from scratch nonetheless matches it, so the benefit appears to come from the modular decomposition rather than synchrony itself.
zh_title: 探索模块化神经网络通信中的同步机制
translation: 模块化神经网络的一个动机是将计算分散到能够学习独立、可重用功能的组件中，进而在后续通过重组来支持组合泛化。但在实践中，单纯的模块化结构并不能保证自发形成这种分工角色，且模块间无限制的通信会削弱已涌现的专门化。这引发了关于应如何组织模块化通信的问题。该问题可类比为感知绑定问题，其中同步性被提议作为协调分布式表征的一种机制。我们提出了SyncNet，一种将模块内容与动态相位状态解耦的模块化架构：通过学习藏本（Kuramoto）动力学来演化相位，而相位对齐则决定通过共享信道进行的通信。我们在用于关系推理的Sort-of-CLEVR和用于系统泛化的SQOOP上对SyncNet进行了评估，在SQOOP中，更低的样本对多样性要求在测试时进行更多重组。在三种最低样本对多样性设置下，SyncNet在对比模型中取得了最佳的保留集准确率，在最困难设置下高出5.1个百分点；在Sort-of-CLEVR上表现具备竞争力，但低于最强的注意力基线。测试时干预实验表明，性能取决于动态演化的相位：固定相位造成的损失与完全不使用寻址相当，而置换模块所对应的区域同样具有破坏性。然而，一个从头开始训练的内容寻址变体同样达到了相近的性能，因此这种增益似乎来自模块化分解本身，而非同步机制本身。
tldr: 本文提出了基于藏本动力学相位同步调控通信的模块化网络SyncNet，虽然显著提升了组合泛化性能，但深入实验表明该增益实质源自模块化分解本身。
ai_comments: 该研究富有创意地将神经科学中的感知绑定与藏本动力学同步机制引入模块化神经网络的通信设计中。论文研究态度严谨客观，通过严密的对照消融实验不仅证明了动态调控通信的重要性，还坦诚指出性能增益主要来自于模块化分解架构本身而非同步机制独有，展现了高度的科学诚信与深入洞察。
motivation: 模块化神经网络在缺乏约束的模块通信下难以维持功能特化，阻碍了组合泛化能力；受感知绑定问题中同步机制的启发，需探索更有效的模块间通信协调机制。
method: 提出了SyncNet模块化架构，将模块的内容与动态相位状态相分离，利用可学习的藏本（Kuramoto）动力学驱动相位演化，并依据相位对齐程度控制模块在共享信道中的通信。
results: 在SQOOP系统泛化基准的低配对多样性任务中取得最优准确率（最难设置下提升5.1个百分点），在Sort-of-CLEVR上具竞争力；测试期干预证明动态演化相位至关重要，但从头训练的内容寻址变体同样达到了相当的性能。
conclusion: 尽管动态相位对齐能有效协调模块通信并显著提升组合泛化能力，但基于内容寻址的基线模型能取得相匹配的性能，表明收益的核心可能源于模块化分解本身而非同步机制本身。

title: Stochastic Aggregation with Prescribed Resources and Additive Delay
authors: Tianhang Lu, Runtian Ren, Shengcai Liu
abstract:
We study online aggregation with prescribed resources and additive delay. In this problem, we are given a finite set of resources with purchase costs and a collection of request types, each specifying the resources it requires. Requests arrive over time, and each request can be served immediately or postponed to a later time. A service may serve several pending requests together by purchasing every resource required by at least one of them, paying for each purchased resource only once. These purchases serve only the current batch; resources needed in a later service must be purchased again. A request served $t$ units of time after its arrival incurs delay cost $t$. The objective is to serve all requests while minimizing the sum of resource purchase costs and individual delay costs.
  We consider a stochastic version of this problem in which requests of each type follow an independent Poisson process of known rate. An online algorithm knows these rates but observes requests only upon arrival. We compare its expected cost with that of an offline optimum that knows the entire realized input and may choose every batch freely. A resource--scale linear program supplies both an offline lower certificate and synchronized service periods. This yields a deterministic online algorithm with polynomial-time preprocessing on rational input and a long-run ratio of expectations below $2.113$. The guarantee applies in particular to rooted multi-level aggregation and prescribed-pair aggregation on trees. Besides, for Poisson TCP acknowledgment, we further characterize the optimal long-run ratio of expectations at every load, showing that its worst-case value is approximately 1.409 and is attained by a deterministic online policy.
zh_title: 具有规定资源和可加延迟的随机聚合问题
translation: 我们研究了具有规定资源和可加延迟的在线聚合问题。在该问题中，给定有限的具有购买成本的资源集合以及一组请求类型，每个类型指定其所需的资源。请求随时间到达，每个请求可以被立即服务或推迟到稍后服务。一次服务可以通过购买至少一个待处理请求所需的所有资源来同时服务它们，并且对每种购买的资源仅支付一次费用。这些购买仅服务于当前批次；在后续服务中所需的资源必须重新购买。一个在到达后 t 单位时间被服务的请求将产生 t 的延迟成本。目标是在服务所有请求的同时，最小化资源购买成本与各个请求延迟成本的总和。我们考虑该问题的随机版本，其中每种类型的请求遵循已知速率的独立泊松过程。在线算法已知这些速率，但只有在请求到达时才能观察到它们。我们将该算法的期望成本与已知全部已实现输入且可自由选择每个批次的离线最优解进行比较。一个基于资源规模的线性规划既提供了离线下界证明，又提供了同步的服务周期。由此产生了一种具有有理数输入下多项式时间预处理的确定性在线算法，其长期期望比率低于2.113。该保证特别适用于树上的有根多级聚合和规定对聚合。此外，对于泊松TCP确认问题，我们进一步刻画了在各种负载下的最优长期期望比率，证明其最坏情况下的值约为1.409，并且可以通过确定性在线策略达到。
tldr: 论文研究了泊松到达下的资源聚合与延迟成本权衡问题，利用线性规划方法提出了长期期望比低于2.113的确定性在线算法，并解决了泊松TCP确认的最优比率刻画。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于利用基于资源规模的线性规划，巧妙地将离线下界证明与确定性同步服务周期设计相结合，成功将随机在线聚合的长期期望比降至2.113以内，并彻底刻画了泊松TCP确认的最优比率（约1.409）。其局限在于强依赖于各请求类型的泊松到达率完全已知且平稳的假设，未探讨到达率未知或时变场景。
motivation: 在带规定资源和可加延迟的在线批处理聚合问题中，探讨当请求到达遵循已知速率的独立泊松过程时，如何设计具有低期望比率（相较于离线全知最优解）的在线算法。
method: 采用基于资源规模的线性规划（resource-scale linear program）构建离线下界证书，并基于其解导出同步服务周期，从而构建具有多项式时间预处理能力的确定性在线调度算法。
results: 提出了一种预处理为多项式时间的确定性在线算法，其长期期望比低于2.113，适用于树上的有根多级聚合和规定对聚合；此外，针对泊松TCP确认问题，刻画了任意负载下的最优长期期望比，证明最坏情况下约为1.409且可由确定性策略达到。
conclusion: 基于资源规模线性规划导出的同步服务周期机制，能够为具有指定资源和可加延迟的随机在线聚合问题提供低于2.113的期望竞争比保证，并在泊松TCP确认问题中实现了最坏情况下约1.409的最优确定性在线策略。

title: FAME-QP: A GPU-Accelerated Quadratic-Programming Solver for Real-Time Model Predictive Control
authors: Santosh Mohan Rajkumar, Debdipta Goswami, Stephanie Stockar
abstract: We present FAME-QP, a GPU-accelerated solver for dense quadratic programs arising in linear model predictive control. FAME-QP combines constraint-dependent operator representations with fused single- and two-kernel iterations replayed through CUDA graphs, automatically selecting the execution configuration through device calibration and problem-specific timing. It probes a cached operator bank to select the initial penalty and updates operators lazily when problem matrices change. Numerical benchmarks and simulated humanoid and quadrotor control experiments demonstrate reduced latency relative to competing GPU solvers while maintaining solution accuracy and control performance.
zh_title: FAME-QP：用于实时模型预测控制的GPU加速二次规划求解器
translation: 我们提出了FAME-QP，这是一种针对线性模型预测控制中出现的密集二次规划的GPU加速求解器。FAME-QP将约束相关的算子表示与通过CUDA图重放的融合单核和双核迭代相结合，通过设备校准和特定于问题的定时自动选择执行配置。它探测缓存的算子库以选择初始惩罚，并在问题矩阵改变时惰性地更新算子。数值基准测试以及模拟的人形机器人和四旋翼控制实验表明，在保持求解精度和控制性能的同时，相对于竞争的GPU求解器，它减少了延迟。
tldr: FAME-QP是一个用于实时模型预测控制的GPU加速二次规划求解器，通过融合内核迭代和缓存优化技术，在保持高精度的同时显著降低了延迟。
ai_comments: 该论文针对线性模型预测控制（MPC）中的密集二次规划（QP）问题，提出了一种创新的GPU加速求解器FAME-QP。其亮点在于结合了约束相关的算子表示、融合的CUDA图迭代、基于设备校准的自适应配置选择以及惰性算子更新策略，显著降低了延迟，同时保持了精度，非常适合实时机器人控制。
motivation: 为了解决线性模型预测控制（MPC）中出现的密集二次规划（QP）问题，现有GPU求解器在实时性上面临延迟和性能瓶颈，需要一种更高效、低延迟的GPU加速求解方案。
method: 结合了约束相关的算子表示、通过CUDA图重放的融合单/双核迭代、设备校准与问题特定计时自动选择执行配置、探测缓存算子库以选择初始惩罚，以及在问题矩阵变化时延迟更新算子。
results: 数值基准测试以及模拟的人形机器人和四旋翼飞行器控制实验表明，与竞争的GPU求解器相比，FAME-QP在保持求解精度和控制性能的同时，显著降低了延迟。
conclusion: FAME-QP通过创新性的GPU加速策略与算法优化，有效解决了实时模型预测控制中稠密二次规划求解的延迟问题，并在复杂机器人仿真中表现优异。

title: Exploiting What NVIDIA Profilers Hide: Fast and Accurate Analytical GPU Performance Modeling
authors: Ziwen Wang, Qi Luo, Kunlin Li, Changxi Liu, Dongsheng Wang, Yun Chen
abstract: GPUs have become essential to many fields, including AI and scientific computing. As GPUs grow more complex, the design space of their hardware configurations becomes increasingly large, yet cycle-level simulators remain too slow to explore it. Analytical models make this exploration much faster. However, existing GPU analytical models fall short of accurately predicting performance across hardware configurations, because they re-estimate or scale every stall of a warp on the target configuration. We observe that fixed-latency stalls stay the same across configurations, whereas queueing stalls vary with the pressure on each hardware unit. Based on this observation, we propose ForeSight, a queueing analytical model that reuses the fixed-latency stalls measured on GPU hardware and recomputes the queueing stalls of each hardware unit from its pressure. To provide ForeSight with the counter values of each hardware unit, we build UnitSight, a profiler that recovers these values, which NVIDIA's official profilers hide by aggregating across units. Our evaluation on hardware configurations of nine NVIDIA GPUs shows that ForeSight predicts kernel execution time with a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 8.3%, compared with 14.1% for the best baseline. ForeSight also predicts the end-to-end execution time of LLM inference on vLLM with a MAPE of 2.0%. It runs 49x faster than the cycle-level simulator Accel-Sim and faster than interval-based models such as GCoM. With the aid of ForeSight, we explore configurations derived from the H20 GPU for LLM inference and find one with 1.78x its performance/cost.
zh_title: 利用NVIDIA性能分析器隐藏的信息：快速且精确的GPU分析型性能建模
translation: GPU已成为包括人工智能和科学计算在内的众多领域不可或缺的基础。随着GPU日趋复杂，其硬件配置的设计空间急剧扩大，但周期级模拟器的速度过慢，无法完成快速探索。分析型模型使这种探索显著提速。然而，现有的GPU分析模型无法准确预测跨硬件配置的性能，因为它们会对目标配置上warp的每一次停顿重新估计或缩放。我们观察到，固定延迟停顿在不同配置间保持不变，而排队停顿则随各个硬件单元上的压力而变化。基于这一观察，我们提出了ForeSight排队分析模型，该模型复用在GPU硬件上实测的固定延迟停顿，并根据各硬件单元的压力重新计算其排队停顿。为了向ForeSight提供每个硬件单元的计数器数值，我们构建了UnitSight剖析器，用于恢复因NVIDIA官方剖析器跨单元聚合而被隐藏的指标。在九款NVIDIA GPU硬件配置上的评估表明，ForeSight预测kernel执行时间的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）为8.3%，而最佳基线为14.1%。ForeSight还能以2.0%的MAPE预测vLLM上LLM推理的端到端执行时间。它的运行速度比周期级模拟器Accel-Sim快49倍，且比基于区间的模型（如GCoM）更快。借助ForeSight，我们探索了基于H20 GPU衍生的LLM推理配置，并找到了一种性能/成本比为其1.78倍的配置。
tldr: 论文提出了UnitSight剖析器与ForeSight排队分析模型，通过揭示细粒度单元数据并解耦固定与排队停顿，实现了超快且高精度的跨GPU硬件配置性能建模。
ai_comments: 该论文洞察非常敏锐，指出了NVIDIA官方Profiler通过数据聚合掩盖硬件单元细粒度瓶颈的问题；通过将warp停顿拆解为固定延迟与排队停顿，既保证了物理机制的准确性，又避免了全模拟带来的开销；在vLLM等大模型推理工作负载上展现了极高的预测精度和出色的架构设计指导价值。
motivation: GPU硬件配置设计空间巨大，周期级模拟器速度太慢无法支持快速探索，而现有分析模型在跨硬件配置预测时会对所有warp停顿进行重新估算或缩放，导致预测精度不足。
method: 提出排队分析模型ForeSight与剖析器UnitSight：基于‘固定延迟停顿跨配置不变、排队停顿随单元压力变化’的观察，ForeSight复用硬件实测的固定延迟停顿并依压力重新计算排队停顿；UnitSight则负责恢复被NVIDIA官方分析工具聚合隐藏的各硬件单元计数器数值。
results: 在9款NVIDIA GPU上，ForeSight预测kernel执行时间的MAPE为8.3%（优于最佳基准的14.1%），预测vLLM上LLM推理端到端时间MAPE仅2.0%；运行速度比周期级模拟器Accel-Sim快49倍且优于GCoM；帮助找到了性价比达H20 GPU 1.78倍的LLM推理衍生配置。
conclusion: ForeSight与UnitSight有效解决了跨硬件配置GPU性能评估在精度与速度上难以两全的问题，为GPU架构设计空间探索（如优化LLM推理性价比）提供了高效实用的分析工具。

title: Beyond Interaction Scores: Selecting Feature Interactions via Independent Replication
authors: Jincheng Gao, Shuo Sun
abstract: Learning feature interactions is essential for accurate prediction and interpretable modeling, yet a high interaction score may reflect fitting noise rather than a reproducible pattern. Ranking methods score feature pairs but leave the cutoff to the user; testing methods set the cutoff but rely on repeated model refits or a model of the joint feature distribution. We present LENS, a model-agnostic framework for selecting feature interactions through independent replication. LENS trains two models with the same learning algorithm on disjoint data and accesses them only through predictions. For each feature pair, it removes main effects from the joint-effect surface to isolate an interaction pattern, ranks pairs by its strength, and tests whether the second model reproduces it at a meaningful strength. A single multiple-testing correction determines which pairs to retain, using only two model fits regardless of the number of features. We prove that a replication ratio alone can retain arbitrarily weak patterns shared by both fits, whereas a strength floor restores selection consistency, and we characterize when normalization in Friedman's $H^2$ reverses interaction rankings. On 16 synthetic designs, LENS matches leading model-specific ranking methods (e.g., TreeSHAP) and recovers 91% of material interactions, against 45% for the knockoff-based DIAMOND, without selecting false pairs; with 1,225 candidate pairs and no interactions, it makes substantially fewer false discoveries. On large-scale French motor insurance data, it identifies interactions documented in the actuarial literature and recovers 90% of the deviance gain obtained using all pairs. On two credit datasets, LENS selects few pairs while maintaining or slightly improving predictive performance over the additive baseline.
zh_title: 超越交互分数：通过独立复制选择特征交互
translation: 学习特征交互对于准确预测和可解释建模至关重要，然而高交互分数可能反映拟合噪声而非可重现的模式。排名方法对特征对进行评分，但将截止点留给用户；测试方法设置截止点，但依赖于重复的模型重拟合或联合特征分布模型。我们提出了LENS，一个模型无关的框架，通过独立复制来选择特征交互。LENS在不相交的数据上使用相同的学习算法训练两个模型，并且仅通过预测访问它们。对于每个特征对，它从联合效应表面移除主效应以分离交互模式，根据其强度对特征对进行排名，并测试第二个模型是否以有意义的强度重现该模式。单一的多重测试校正决定保留哪些对，无论特征数量多少，都只需两次模型拟合。我们证明，仅凭复制比率可以保留两个拟合共享的任意弱模式，而强度阈值恢复了选择一致性，并且我们描述了Friedman $H^2$中归一化何时会逆转交互排名。在16个合成设计上，LENS与领先的模型特定排名方法（例如TreeSHAP）匹配，并恢复了91%的重要交互，而基于knockoff的DIAMOND仅为45%，且没有选择假对；在1,225个候选对且没有交互的情况下，它产生了显著更少的假阳性发现。在大型法国汽车保险数据上，它识别了精算文献中记载的交互，并恢复了使用所有对获得的90%的偏差增益。在两个信用数据集上，LENS选择的对很少，同时保持或略微提高了预测性能优于加性基线。
tldr: LENS是一个模型无关的框架，通过在不同数据集上训练的两个模型之间独立复制来选择特征交互，它能准确识别真实交互并减少假阳性。
ai_comments: LENS的创新之处在于其模型无关的独立复制框架，仅通过两次模型拟合即可选择特征交互，显著提高了效率并减少了对模型内部机制的依赖。它通过强调交互模式的重现性来有效区分真实信号和噪声，这对于提高模型可解释性和预测准确性非常重要。
motivation: 现有的特征交互选择方法（排名和测试方法）存在局限性：排名方法需要用户设置截止点，且高交互分数可能反映拟合噪声；测试方法依赖重复模型重拟合或联合特征分布模型。
method: LENS是一个模型无关的框架，通过独立复制选择特征交互。它在不相交的数据上用相同的学习算法训练两个模型，并通过预测来访问它们。对于每个特征对，它从联合效应表面移除主效应以分离交互模式，按强度排名，并测试第二个模型是否以有意义的强度重现该模式。使用单一多重测试校正来决定保留哪些对，无论特征数量多少，都只需两次模型拟合。
results: 理论证明，仅凭复制比率可以保留两个拟合共享的任意弱模式；强度阈值恢复选择一致性；并描述了Friedman $H^2$中归一化何时会逆转交互排名。在16个合成设计上，LENS与领先的模型特定排名方法（如TreeSHAP）匹配，恢复了91%的重要交互，而基于knockoff的DIAMOND只有45%，且没有选择假对；在1,225个候选对且无交互的情况下，它产生了显著更少的假阳性发现。在大型法国汽车保险数据上，它识别了精算文献中记载的交互，并恢复了使用所有对获得的90%的偏差增益。在两个信用数据集上，LENS选择的对很少，同时保持或略微提高了预测性能优于加性基线。
conclusion: LENS提供了一个有效且高效的模型无关框架，通过独立复制选择特征交互，能准确识别真实交互、减少假阳性，并在多种数据集上表现出色，同时保持或提升预测性能。

title: Unified Far-field and Near-field Codebook Design for XL-array Systems
authors: Chao Zhou, Changsheng You, Liujia Yao
abstract: While extremely large-scale antenna arrays (XL-arrays) hold immense promise for next-generation wireless networks, the paradigm shift encompassing new near-field communications renders conventional discrete Fourier transform (DFT)-based Type-I codebooks inefficient. Meanwhile, existing near-field alternatives usually impose prohibitively high storage and/or feedback burdens. To tackle these challenges, we propose in this letter a unified codebook applicable to both far-field and near-field XL-array systems. Our key idea is to express the near-field channel steering vector in an equivalent form, which is a Hadamard product of an angular vector and a curvature-related vector. This new representation allows direct reuse of the legacy Type-I codebook for angle quantization, while only a lightweight auxiliary codebook is newly added for additional curvature quantization. Subsequently, we optimize the auxiliary curvature codebook by maximizing the average beamforming gain given the information of user distribution. By leveraging the local monotonicity of the beamforming gain with respect to curvature mismatch, the optimization problem is further reduced to a quantization-error minimization problem, for which suboptimal curvature codewords are obtained. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed unified codebook achieves near-optimal beamforming performance that approaches its upper bound based on perfect channel state information (CSI), while significantly reducing the required feedback overhead as compared to various benchmark schemes.
comment: 5 Pages, 2 figures, submitted to IEEE for possible publication
zh_title: 面向超大规模天线阵列系统的统一远近场码本设计
translation: 尽管超大规模天线阵列（XL-array）为下一代无线网络带来了巨大的发展前景，但包含新型近场通信的范式转变使得传统的基于离散傅里叶变换（DFT）的Type-I码本效率低下。同时，现有的近场替代方案通常会带来过高的存储和/或反馈负担。为了应对这些挑战，我们在本快报中提出了一种适用于远场和近场XL-array系统的统一码本。我们的核心思想是将近场信道导向矢量表示为等效形式，即角度向量与曲率相关向量的哈达玛积。这种新表示允许直接重用传统的Type-I码本进行角度量化，同时仅需新增加一个轻量级的辅助码本用于额外的曲率量化。随后，通过给定用户分布信息最大化平均波束成形增益来优化辅助曲率码本。利用波束成形增益对曲率失配的局部单调性，优化问题进一步简化为量化误差最小化问题，并据此获得了次优的曲率码字。数值结果表明，所提出的统一码本实现了接近最优的波束成形性能（接近基于完美信道状态信息（CSI）的上界），同时与各种基准方案相比，显著减少了所需的反馈开销。
tldr: 本文为超大规模天线阵列（XL-array）系统提出了一种统一的远近场码本设计，通过复用传统角度码本并引入轻量级曲率码本，在大幅降低反馈开销的同时实现了近最优的波束成形性能。
ai_comments: 该论文针对超大规模天线阵列（XL-array）在近场通信下面临的传统码本失效与高开销问题，创新性地提出了一种统一的远近场码本设计方案，通过将近场导向矢量表示为角度向量和曲率相关向量的哈达玛积，巧妙地复用了传统Type-I码本并引入轻量级辅助码本，在保证近最优波束成形性能的同时显著降低了反馈开销。
motivation: 由于超大规模天线阵列（XL-array）引入了新的近场通信范式，传统的基于离散傅里叶变换（DFT）的Type-I码本变得低效，而现有的近场替代方案通常会导致过高的存储和/或反馈负担，因此亟需设计一种统一的远近场码本。
method: 提出将近场信道导向矢量表示为角度向量与曲率相关向量的哈达玛积；复用传统Type-I角度码本，并新增一个轻量级的曲率辅助码本；基于用户分布信息及波束成形增益的局部单调性，将曲率辅助码本的优化简化为量化误差最小化问题以求解。
results: 数值结果表明，所提出的统一码本实现了接近基于完美信道状态信息（CSI）上限的近最优波束成形性能，同时与各种基准方案相比显著减少了所需的反馈开销。
conclusion: 本文提出的统一远近场码本设计能够有效解决XL-array系统中的近场通信量化和反馈负担问题，实现接近完美CSI的性能，具有很高的实用价值。

title: RF3DGS: Reflection-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting with Self-Priors
authors: Qiang Wen, Guotao Meng, Junhong Ruan, Hongyu Liu, Chenyang Lei, Qifeng Chen
abstract: 3D reflection removal is crucial in applications demanding high-fidelity visualization, such as museum exhibitions. In this work, we propose Reflection-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting (RF3DGS), a novel method for superior reflection removal. RF3DGS exclusively leverages a widely-adopted photometric prior for reflection removal: that the minimum pixel intensity across multi-view images corresponding to the same 3D point strongly correlates with reflection-free information. However, generalizing this principle to a 3D Gaussian Splatting within a multi-view context is non-trivial. To address this, RF3DGS first optimizes a vanilla 3DGS model using a geometric prior to estimate a coarse, reflection-free depth map for each view. Leveraging these depth maps and photometric prior, a 3D warping process aggregates reflection-free information from auxiliary views to construct a clean transmission pseudo-label for a given reference view. This pseudo-label provides a robust self-supervised signal for optimization. We further introduce an Adaptive Twin Rendering (ATR) loss to synergistically utilize this pseudo-label while preserving high-frequency details from the original, reflection-degraded images. By adeptly fusing these internal 3D self-priors with the ATR loss, RF3DGS demonstrates state-of-the-art reflection removal performance across both synthetic and real-world scenarios. Furthermore, we establish the first 3D reflection removal benchmark, based on the Unity rendering engine, for rigorous quantitative evaluation.
zh_title: 无反射3D高斯泼溅与自先验
translation: 3D反射去除对于需要高保真可视化的应用至关重要，例如博物馆展览。在本工作中，我们提出了反射无关3D高斯泼溅（RF3DGS），一种用于卓越反射去除的新颖方法。RF3DGS专门利用了广泛采用的光度先验进行反射去除：多视角图像中对应于同一3D点的最小像素强度与无反射信息密切相关。然而，将此原理推广到多视角上下文中的3D高斯泼溅并非易事。为解决此问题，RF3DGS首先使用几何先验优化标准的3DGS模型，为每个视角估计一个粗略的无反射深度图。利用这些深度图和光度先验，3D扭曲过程将无反射信息从辅助视图聚合起来，为给定参考视图构建一个干净的透射伪标签。此伪标签为优化提供了强大的自监督信号。我们进一步引入了自适应双渲染（ATR）损失，以协同利用此伪标签，同时保留原始反射降级图像中的高频细节。通过巧妙地融合这些内部3D自先验和ATR损失，RF3DGS在合成和真实世界场景中均展示了最先进的反射去除性能。此外，我们建立了首个基于Unity渲染引擎的3D反射去除基准，用于严格的定量评估。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为RF3DGS的新方法，用于从3D场景中去除反射，通过利用多视角图像中的最小像素强度与无反射信息的相关性，并结合几何先验估计深度图，然后通过3D扭曲聚合无反射信息生成伪标签，最后利用自监督信号和自适应双渲染损失来优化模型，实现了先进的反射去除效果，并建立了首个3D反射去除基准。
ai_comments: 该研究在3D反射去除领域取得了重要进展，提出了一种新颖的RF3DGS方法，该方法结合了自监督学习和3D高斯泼溅技术，实现了优异的性能。其最大的创新点在于利用了广泛采用的光度先验，并巧妙地将其推广到3D高斯泼溅的框架中，通过自监督的方式进行优化，避免了对昂贵标注数据的依赖。此外，建立首个3D反射去除基准也为该领域的研究和评估提供了重要的平台。然而，该方法在处理极其复杂或动态的反射场景时可能仍面临挑战，未来的研究可以进一步探索更鲁棒的反射建模和去除技术。
motivation: 高保真可视化应用（如博物馆展览）需要去除3D反射以实现高质量的视觉效果。
method: RF3DGS方法首先使用几何先验优化标准的3DGS模型，为每个视角估计粗略的无反射深度图。然后，利用深度图和光度先验，通过3D扭曲将辅助视图中的无反射信息聚合起来，为参考视图构建一个干净的透射伪标签。此伪标签提供了用于优化的强大自监督信号。此外，还引入了自适应双渲染（ATR）损失，以协同利用伪标签并保留原始反射降级图像中的高频细节。
results: RF3DGS在合成和真实世界场景中展示了最先进的反射去除性能。
conclusion: RF3DGS通过融合内部3D自先验和ATR损失，实现了最先进的反射去除效果，并建立了首个3D反射去除基准，为该领域的评估提供了标准。

title: AI-Adaptive Virtual Reality for STEM: Engagement, Retention, and Learning Outcomes
authors: Srinivasa K G, Akshit Rana, Aman Singh, Kshitij Kumar Singh Chauhan
abstract: Virtual Reality (VR) presents a com pelling opportunity to transform STEM pedagogy; however, empirical evidence evaluating AI-driven adaptivity, objective engagement metrics, and long-term knowledge retention remains sparse. This paper proposes and evaluates an AI-adaptive VR based solar system learning module deployed on Meta Quest 2, wherein a machine learning model dynamically adjusts in structional difficulty based on real-time learner interaction logs including dwell time, gaze patterns, and response latency. A controlled between-subjects experiment was conducted involving 120 secondary school students (mean age 14.3 years) across three schools in India, randomly assigned to three conditions: AI adaptive VR, standard VR, and traditional classroom instruction. Engagement was measured objectively through eye-tracking fixation density and heart rate variability (HRV), alongside pre-test, immediate post-test, and delayed post-tests at one week and one month intervals. Statistical analyses encompassing paired t-tests, one-way ANOVA, and Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) reveal that the AI-adaptive VR cohort demonstrated significantly higher knowledge improvement scores (mean gain = 38.4 vs. 31.2 vs. 10.7), superior one-month retention (p < 0.001), and measurably elevated engagement across all biometric indicators. SEM confirmed immersion as a significant mediator between adaptive instruction and knowledge acquisition (\b{eta} = 0.63, p < 0.001). Post-session self-directed learning exploration was recorded at 80% among AI-adaptive VR participants versus 40% in the traditional group. These findings establish an evidence based framework for deploying AI-adaptive immersive learning environments in resource-varied STEM educational contexts.

title: Omni-JEV: Text and Dual-Stream Speech Decisions
authors: Shengzhou Kong
abstract: A user utterance does not uniquely determine the next action in full-duplex dialogue: its consequences depend on the assistant's response state and interaction history. Speech activity, utterance completion, and interruption intent provide related evidence, whose implications for a response require an explicit action policy. We formulate this task at collected-segment endpoints and introduce Omni-JEV, which maps text or role-indexed user and assistant-reference speech to probabilities over five interaction actions. An aligned speech-to-speech understanding backbone encodes the acoustic roles separately and shares its candidate readout with text inputs. Bilingual weak supervision supports cross-entropy fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning for probability-sensitive decisions (RLCD). We compare Gaussian-logit and categorical Choice RLCD from the same supervised initialization under matched training exposure, observing different trade-offs between classification and probability quality. Gaussian Omni-JEV achieves test accuracies of 84.08% for audio and 96.55% for text. This common action interface supports decisions about when a full-duplex voice assistant should respond, preserve ongoing speech, interrupt, or resume an interrupted response.

title: Softness is something you also need! Why compliance helps control: information metrics of a passive walker with compliant ankle
authors: Fabio Bonsignorio, Elisabetta Barletta, Sorin Dragomir, Francesco Esposito, Enrica Zereik
abstract:
A great gap in adaptivity, flexibility, and dexterity still exists between intelligent robots, whether they are made of rigid or (partially) compliant components, and their naturally evolved animal and vegetal counterparts. One reason could be of `paradigm' nature. On the one hand, most robots (both rigid and soft) are still designed by following a `Cartesian' approach, with top-down control and a clear mind-body separation. Designing artificial agents on the basis of the principles that we observe in biology is not an easy task. The principles of organization of animals and plants rely on morphological computation and emergence of fit behaviors from loosely coupled networks of embodied agents.
  Modeling and control require radically new approaches. In this paper we briefly recall and explain some seminal mathematical results linking information metrics and dynamics of the agents, already published years ago; we integrate them with some recent methods developed by us and by the community, we highlight some brief remarks about their relevance and we hint to our current and near future work towards finding concrete and efficient ways for the modeling and control of completely or partially compliant artificial agents and for a better understanding of physical intelligence in nature. We present a technical note summarizing phase-space volume calculations for inverted-pendulum and passive-dynamic walking models, following our proposed framework. Starting from the McGeer compass gait, we introduce knee-ankle compliance, foot-rocker effects, and a Ruina-style compass gait with distributed leg inertia. Standard heel-strike maps are derived and used in the estimation of viable phase-space volumes $W(γ)$, based on a state-dependent Monte-Carlo and Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces methods. We show how the methods based on RKHS allow deeper and more subtle analysis.
comment: main: 11 pages, 6 figures; supplemental: 7 pages, 1 figure

title: Integrating Action Prefix Prediction and Alignment Across Modalities for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
authors: Sijie Xu, Francisco Cruz
abstract: Learning representations from multimodal observations is difficult in reinforcement learning with limited interaction data. Multimodal Joint Predictive Representation combines multimodal latent prediction with contrastive learning across modalities, but its recursive rollout depends on earlier predictions and its pairwise alignment focuses on correspondence between modalities. We propose Improved Predictive Representation, which combines prediction from action prefixes with alignment at the observed anchor based on Contrastive Multimodal learning. At each horizon, it predicts future representations directly from the observed anchor and the corresponding sequence of actions. We evaluate two crop configurations: IPR-S with a minimum retained crop area of 10%, and IPR-H with 50%. Across five DeepMind Control Suite tasks, IPR-H achieves an average return across tasks that is 10.0% higher than the baseline with visual and depth images and 3.4% higher with visual images and position vectors. The relative performance of the two configurations varies across tasks. In Webots, both IPR configurations achieve higher mean final returns than the baseline without LiDAR, but not when LiDAR is available.
comment: Accepted at the Australasian Conference on Robotics and Automation (ACRA 2026)

title: DisasterAgent: An Evidence-Driven Agent for Verifiable Disaster Report Generation From Remote Sensing Imagery
authors: Zhijian Li, Jiawei Song, Chao Ren, Yidan Zhang, Peijin Wang, Xian Sun, Kun Fu
abstract: Remote sensing disaster assessment is moving from simple damage classification toward comprehensive report-level analysis. In this setting, responders need not only damage descriptions but also verifiable evidence to guide response and recovery. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) and tool-augmented agents offer strong multimodal reasoning and perception, but they struggle to provide the evidence required for high-stakes verification. To address these limitations, we propose DisasterAgent, an evidence-driven agent that uses a Perception-Augmentation-Generation workflow to generate verifiable disaster reports from bitemporal optical imagery. DisasterAgent first invokes a specialized vision expert toolkit in the perception phase to build a Spatiotemporal Perception Graph (STPG), serving as a structured memory to store and organize disaster-induced changes across space and time. Evidence-based Augmentation (EA) then extracts evidence from the STPG, attaching inline citations that form a closed evidence loop from each statement to the supporting visual evidence. Extensive experiments on the DisasterM3 and RSCC benchmarks demonstrate that DisasterAgent consistently outperforms general-domain VLMs, remote sensing-specialized models, and existing remote sensing agents. Notably, compared with the original model, it improves the average score for disaster report generation on DisasterM3 by 13.5\% and ST5-SCS on RSCC by 15.34\%, providing a more accurate and verifiable solution for disaster emergency response. The code will be available at https://github.com/ZhijianLi2003/DisasterAgent.

title: From Depth to Safe Depth: Uncertainty-Aware Monocular Perception for Mobile Robot Navigation
authors: Saeid Firouzi Daghigh, Saeed Ayat
abstract: Monocular depth foundation models make it tempting to replace depth sensors on mobile robots with a single RGB camera. We show that, used off the shelf, this is unsafe: in a simulated indoor navigation benchmark, a standard Nav2 stack driven by Depth Anything V2 (metric) collides in 63\% of 120 episodes, because the model systematically over-estimates the distance to nearby obstacles. We propose a lightweight plug-in module that turns predicted depth into \emph{safe depth}. A 0.58\,M-parameter head on top of the \emph{frozen} depth model predicts, per pixel, a log-depth correction $μ$ and an uncertainty $σ$, trained with a $β$-weighted Gaussian negative log-likelihood. The navigation stack consumes the one-sided bound $\hat d_{\text{safe}}=d\,e^{μ-kσ}$, where $k$ is set by conformal calibration on a held-out world, and uncertainty also decides which pixels may be treated as floor. The correction halves the depth error (AbsRel $0.262\rightarrow0.134$) and reduces near-range over-estimation from 59.8\% to 12.0\%. In navigation, safe depth raises the success rate from 37\% to 70\% and lowers collisions from 63\% to 3\%, close to the 2\% of ground-truth depth. A constant safety margin calibrated to the same pixel coverage reaches only 30\% success because it freezes the robot; uncertainty-aware safety wins 52 of 56 discordant paired episodes against it. Gains hold on glass, texture-less walls and dark regions.
zh_title: 从深度到安全深度：面向移动机器人导航的不确定性感知单目感知
translation: 单目深度基础模型使得人们倾向于用单个RGB相机替换移动机器人上的深度传感器。我们表明，如果直接使用，这是不安全的：在一个模拟的室内导航基准测试中，由Depth Anything V2（度量版）驱动的标准Nav2堆栈在120个剧集中有63%发生碰撞，因为该模型系统性地高估了附近障碍物的距离。我们提出了一个轻量级的插件模块，将预测的深度转化为\emph{safe depth}（安全深度）。在\emph{frozen}（冻结的）深度模型之上，一个0.58M参数的头部按像素预测对数深度校正$\mu$和不确定性$\sigma$，使用$\beta$加权的Gaussian负对数似然进行训练。导航堆栈消耗单侧边界$\hat d_{\text{safe}}=d\,e^{\mu-k\sigma}$，其中$k$由保留世界上的保形校准设定，不确定性也决定了哪些像素可被视为地面。该校正将深度误差减半（AbsRel从0.262降至0.134），并将近距离高估率从59.8%降低到12.0%。在导航中，安全深度将成功率从37%提高到70%，并将碰撞率从63%降低到3%，接近真实深度传感器的2%。适应相同像素覆盖率的常数安全边际仅达到30%的成功率，因为它使机器人停滞不前；不确定性感知安全性在与它的56个不和谐配对剧集赢了52个。这些增益在玻璃、无纹理墙壁和黑暗区域同样适用。
tldr: 提出一种轻量级不确定性感知插件，将单目深度模型的预测转换为安全深度，大幅降低移动机器人导航中的碰撞率。
ai_comments: 该论文指出了直接将现成单目深度基础模型用于移动机器人导航的不安全性（由于系统性高估近距离障碍物距离），并巧妙地通过一个极轻量级的插件模块（仅0.58M参数）预测深度校正和不确定性，结合一致性校准（conformal calibration）输出“安全深度”，在大幅减少碰撞率的同时接近了真实深度传感器的性能，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 现成的单目深度基础模型在直接用于移动机器人导航时由于系统性地高估了附近障碍物的距离而导致高碰撞率（在模拟测试中达到63%），因此需要一种能够将预测深度转化为安全深度的方法。
method: 在冻结的单目深度模型上外接一个0.58M参数的头部轻量级模块，逐像素预测对数深度修正量和不确定性，采用$\beta$加权的高斯负对数似然进行训练，并通过保留世界上的保形校准来确定安全深度上界和地面像素。
results: 深度误差（AbsRel）从0.262降至0.134，近距离高估率从59.8%降至12.0%；导航成功率从37%提升至70%，碰撞率从63%降至3%（接近真实深度的2%），并在玻璃、无纹理墙壁和黑暗区域表现稳定。
conclusion: 通过引入不确定性感知的安全深度修正模块，单目深度基础模型能够安全且有效地应用于移动机器人导航，显著降低碰撞率并提高任务成功率。

title: The Target Is a Predicate: Predicate-State Grounding for Semantic-Level Video Reasoning Segmentation
authors: Yuhuan Hong, Yiming Ren, Zhiqiang Lin, Feize Wu, Xingyun Liu, Yitong Xie, Lei Zhou, Lisheng Wu, Junjie Wang, Yujiu Yang
abstract: In this paper, we introduce Predicate-State Video Reasoning Segmentation (PS-VRS), where a query defines a dynamic predicate $P(o,t)$ over objects and time rather than a fixed object identity. Existing methods typically treat the target as permanently active once identified, leading to over-emission of masks during vacant intervals and failure to handle target switching. To address this, we construct PS-Bench, a large-scale benchmark with 2,077 videos and 16,250 queries annotated with explicit active/vacant predicate states, temporal intervals, and pixel masks. We further propose Predicate-State Grounding (PSG), a State-Bind-Emit pipeline that: (1) predicts [ACTIVE]/[VACANT] state tokens; (2) aligns them to video frames via dense cross-modal similarity; and (3) emits masks via SAM2 only for active states. Experiments show that PSG outperforms existing baselines by +9.32 J&F on PS-Bench and significantly reduces false-positive mask emissions. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of explicit predicate-state modeling for video reasoning segmentation with dynamic visual witnesses.

title: Marrying Capacity and Precision for Efficient 2D Gaussian Image Representation
authors: Lin Dong, Qi Ming, Liuqian Wang, Wentao Chao, Yufei Gao, Chengming Liu, Lei Shi
abstract: 2D Gaussian representations provide an explicit and efficient way to represent images, but their rate-distortion performance under limited budgets depends critically on how Gaussian capacity and parameter precision are allocated. Existing methods typically optimize these two resources separately, overlooking content-dependent capacity demands and heterogeneous quantization sensitivity. We present CP-GS, a capacity-precision coupled Gaussian splatting framework for budget-aware 2D Gaussian image representation that jointly optimizes capacity allocation and attribute precision under a shared rate constraint. CP-GS first constructs a content-adaptive Gaussian representation by dynamically reallocating a fixed Gaussian budget from redundant regions to areas with higher representation demand. It then introduces hierarchical distortion-aware representation quantization, using efficient rendering-based calibration to allocate precision across Gaussian attributes and further refine it within heterogeneous attribute groups. Finally, it jointly optimizes Gaussian capacity and attribute precision by constructing candidate representations with different Gaussian counts and precision configurations and selecting operating points according to decoded distortion and actual serialized size. Experiments on DIV2K and Kodak show that CP-GS achieves improved rate-distortion performance over representative 2D Gaussian and implicit neural representations across a range of budgets, while maintaining a fixed overall representation budget and low optimization cost. These results demonstrate the benefit of jointly optimizing spatial capacity and parameter precision for compact Gaussian image representation.

title: LLM Validation Makes Minimal-Pair Benchmarks Easier for Language Models
authors: Guofang Tang
abstract: Minimal-pair benchmarks are only as good as their labels, and LLMs are an obvious substitute for costly human validation. We test it on BLiMP (English) and QFrBLiMP (Quebec French), the two public minimal-pair datasets releasing every forced-choice human judgment. Three LLMs validate by forced choice, by rating, and as a panel, scored against human panels of one, three and five judges in two pre-registered phases. On BLiMP, forced-choice validators agree with held-out human majorities more often than five-judge panels, yet catch far fewer pairs whose label humans reject than one judge does. By point estimate, no validator is worth more than one judge. The errors are not random. On both datasets, across 10 open LMs, human-supported pairs that the pre-registered LLM filter flags are 18.9 points harder than those it accepts, in all 70 LM-validator combinations, and harder than pairs a single human judge flags. Filtering thus removes items on which LMs fail but humans do not, raising accuracy more than random removal. A protocol frozen before any output replicates the gap and the lift on Dutch BLiMP-NL. LLM validation makes minimal-pair benchmarks easier for the models they are meant to test; we release code, validator outputs and item-level scores.

title: AnchorMTS: Multi-View Signal Representation and Forecast-Anchored Fusion for Long-Term Time-Series Forecasting
authors: Gao Wu, Tingting Xu, Changning Wu, Tengfei Long, Yong Liu, Jiabin Jin, Kexin Zhang
abstract: Long-term time-series forecasters typically optimize a single numerical representation, even though the same history exposes complementary geometry, recurrence, and semantic structure. We propose AnchorMTS, which derives self-aligned visual and textual views from each observed window and uses them only to refine a complete numerical forecast. A trainable evidence path produces a candidate forecast, while a parameter-free output projection enforces an exact per-variable bound on its displacement from the numerical anchor. Across six benchmarks and four horizons, AnchorMTS achieves the best macro MSE/MAE (0.336/0.367) among seven supervised baselines and wins 18 of 24 MSE settings against the cellwise baseline envelope; removing the auxiliary path raises macro MSE to 0.340. The projection leaves 95.8% of candidate refinements unchanged while yielding zero bound violations, showing that complementary multi-view evidence can improve forecasting while its final influence remains explicitly controlled.

title: RiSE-Drive: Risk-Sensitive Long-Horizon Candidate Evaluation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
authors: Yu Zhao, Hongyi Duan, Ming Yin, Hongyuan Zhang, Fan Yang, Hongzhi Wang, Xiubo Liang
abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving systems increasingly rely on generating multiple trajectory candidates and selecting one for execution. In this setting, a central challenge is no longer only candidate generation, but how to evaluate candidates according to their long-horizon consequences under uncertainty. Existing methods still mainly use deterministic point scores, heuristic subscores, or single-outcome evaluations, which makes it difficult to capture delayed failures, tail risk, and ranking instability under plausible future perturbations. We present RiSE-Drive, a framework for risk-sensitive long-horizon candidate evaluation in end-to-end autonomous driving. RiSE-Drive first performs candidate-conditioned latent future rollout, then estimates long-horizon outcome distributions instead of single scalar scores, and finally ranks candidates using a tail-risk-aware and perturbation-robust decision criterion. This reformulates candidate scoring from deterministic oracle-style evaluation into distributional outcome assessment with explicit risk control. As a result, the evaluator is encouraged to prefer candidates that are not only strong under nominal conditions, but also reliable under long-horizon rollout and safety-critical deviations. Experiments on the NAVSIM-v1 and NAVSIM-v2 benchmarks, as well as the closed-loop HUGSIM benchmark, show that RiSE-Drive achieves state-of-the-art performance and significantly improves the robustness of candidate selection.
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables, including supplementary material. Published in ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)

title: Auditing LLM Pseudo-Label Distillation for Review Informativeness at E-Commerce Scale
authors: M. Emin Dogan, Cansu Er, Aysenur Kulunk, M. Furkan Eseoglu, H. Bahadir Sahin
abstract: We study hard-label distillation from Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite to compact encoders on 5.34 million Turkish marketplace reviews. A strict new-SKU temporal test measures teacher fidelity; a separate, teacher-label-blind audit by one company annotator measures editorial agreement. An H3 category prefix slightly improves teacher fidelity on the full new-SKU test. On the 16,000-review chronological audit subset, it instead reduces agreement with both Gemini and the annotator, with a clearer paired difference for CORN than for cross entropy. Thus the context effect depends on the evaluation population, and teacher fidelity alone does not establish editorial alignment. Under the measured offline configurations, a single-L4 student pipeline processes reviews 50.2 times faster than the teacher pipeline.

title: Local Modifications of Nearest-Neighbor and Min-Plus Representations
authors: Liliia Redina
abstract:
We study how changing a Boolean-valued function at $d$ inputs affects the size and precision of its exact representations. Starting from a representation of size $m$, we prove four bounds, two for nearest-neighbor (NN) representations and two for integer min-plus representations.
  (i) For NN representations on a finite subset of $\mathbb{R}^n$ with $n\ge2$, at most $m+2d$ anchors suffice. The coefficient $2$ is optimal: on a three-point domain, changing one value can increase the minimum number of anchors from one to three.
  (ii) For NN representations on the Boolean cube with rational anchors, let $R$ be the maximum original coordinate bit length, and let $Δ$ be the maximum bit length of the least common denominator of any one original anchor's coordinates. We construct a representation with at most $m+3d$ anchors on a common dyadic grid and coordinate bit length $O(R+Δ+\log(n+1))$.
  (iii) For integer min-plus representations on the Boolean cube, we give a construction that keeps the original $m$ forms and their labels and adds at most $d$ new forms. Its maximum weight is at most $W+2n$, where $W$ is the largest absolute original coefficient, including constant terms.
  (iv) For integer min-plus representations on a finite rational domain $X\subset\mathbb{Q}^n$, at most $m+2d$ forms suffice. Their maximum weight is polynomially bounded in $m,d,W,n,|X|$, the coordinate bound, and the common denominator of $X$. The coefficient $2$ is again optimal: on a three-point domain, changing one value can increase the minimum number of forms from one to three.
  These bounds imply stability under polynomially many changes on the cube for polynomial-size representations, including those with polynomially bounded NN coordinate bit length or min-plus weight.

title: Learning the Brownian Motion in Machine Learning for Parametric Parabolic PDEs: A Backward Quadrature Approach
authors: Qiang Han, Shaolin Ji, Yanan Qi
abstract: We propose a backward quadrature learning (BQL) method for solving high dimensional parametric semilinear parabolic partial differential equations (PDEs). To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first to extend the applicability of BSDE-based stochastic numerical methods to this class of PDEs. Specifically, inspired by the approach of learning the random variables (LRV)~\cite{BeckerJentzenMullerWurstemberger2024}, BQL incorporates learnable quadrature for Brownian increments at each time level into the backward recursion of BSDEs, enabling more efficient layerwise approximation of local conditional expectations. Furthermore, BQL introduces a continuation surrogate to facilitate the transfer of value-function information from subsequent to preceding time levels, avoiding nested quadrature while controlling the propagation of local approximation errors.
