title: Walrus Technical Report
authors: Alkis Koudounas, Osamu Take, Hayato Futami, Quentin Jodelet, Emiru Tsunoo
abstract: We present Walrus, a unified 8B speech-and-audio foundation model handling speech recognition (including code-switching and multi-talker speech), speech-to-text and speech-to-speech translation, text-to-speech, emotion recognition, audio captioning, and general audio understanding. Our main contribution is not a new architecture but a data-centric training recipe; we use a standard decoder-only backbone initialized from Gemma 4, so that gains can be traced to the data. For speech generation, Walrus predicts low-bitrate discrete speech tokens, and a lightweight token-to-waveform decoder converts them into high-fidelity audio. The recipe is a three-stage data curriculum that moves from broad multilingual data to multi-talker, code-switching, and domain-specific data. At each stage, task-aware and dataset-aware weighting balances tasks with very different token budgets and protects core skills from forgetting. Trained on over 600M samples covering more than 20 tasks and 100 languages, Walrus leads on most multilingual, multi-talker, and code-switching ASR, speech translation, and audio understanding benchmarks, outperforming both open speech language models of comparable size and dedicated task-specific models. On most benchmarks, it even matches or surpasses the $4\times$ larger Qwen3-Omni's performance. Results suggest that data engineering is a primary driver of quality in multi-task speech and audio modeling.

title: Rotating Walks, Derandomized Squares, and Permutation Conjugated Walks
authors: Vedat Levi Alev, Shravas Rao
abstract:
Using the recent strong convergence results of Bordenave and Collins (Annals of Mathematics) and Chen et al. (Annals of Mathematics), we study the average case behavior of rotating random walks of Cohen and Maor (STOC 2023) and the derandomized square construction of Rozenman and Vadhan (RANDOM 2005).
  Concretely, we prove a conjecture of Cohen et al. (ITCS 2025) regarding the average case behavior of derandomized squaring for random graphs and show that the existential bounds of Cohen and Maor for their rotating random walk construction hold with high-probability for random graphs. Using the results of O'Donnell and Wu (FOCS 2020), we can in polynomial time construct a family of graphs and rotations which almost saturate the bounds of Cohen and Maor, and meet the bounds conjectured by Cohen et al. for all vertex-transitive auxiliary graphs of fixed degree in the derandomized square.
  Finally, we study independent random permutation conjugates of deterministic regular graph adjacency matrices. We prove quantitative weak convergence to freely independent tree adjacency operators when the degrees are fixed and the girths tend to infinity. Separately, a covering argument gives deterministic spectral lower bounds for polynomials with non-negative coefficients, recovering the lower bound of Cohen et al. for rotating walks.

title: Joint Activation and Weight Quantization for Learned Image Compression
authors: Yile Tu, Heming Sun
abstract: Learned image compression (LIC) models achieve competitive rate-distortion performance with increasingly large networks, making network quantization important for efficient deployment. Directly quantizing LIC models remains difficult in post-training quantization (PTQ) because compression performance is highly sensitive to quantization noise. Existing methods typically focus on optimizing either the weights or the activations, resulting in substantial rate-distortion degradation. To address this limitation, we introduce a two-stage pipeline that uses SmoothQuant to balance activation and weight ranges, followed by GPTQ to adapt the transformed weights. The proposed joint search framework optimizes the balancing transformation and adapted weights under the rate-distortion objective, accounting for the coupling between the two stages. Experiments across multiple LIC architectures and activation quantization configurations show that the joint search strategy consistently reduces rate-distortion degradation after quantization.
comment: Accepted at IEEE VCIP 2026. 5 pages, 3 figures

title: Gödel's Incompleteness Theorems in Grounded Arithmetic
authors: Bryan Ford
abstract: Reflective Grounded Arithmetic (RGA) is a paracomplete arithmetic in which every term is a program and truth is grounded evaluation. RGA discharges a hypothesis only when it proves the hypothesis decided. This paper shows, in a machine-checked Isabelle/HOL development, how Gödel's incompleteness theorems hold for RGA and for systems built on it. RGA's implication is material and RGA has the disjunction property, so the implications the textbook proof of the second theorem uses fail while its entailments and rules hold: Gödel's proof survives as entailments. RGA does not prove its consistency sentence Con, and RGA derives its own second theorem as the entailment $\mathit{Con}\vdash\neg\mathit{Pr}(\ulcorner\mathit{Con}\urcorner)$ and as one sentence quantified over proofs. The second theorem is then proved once, for every Gödel extension of RGA: an entailment relation on RGA's language, closed under RGA's rules, with a checker that meets three structural conditions, NEC, D3 and EXPL as proof transformers, D1 as closed acceptance, and consistency. D2 is not among the conditions. RGA with its checker is one instance. Inductive Grounded Arithmetic (IGA), RGA with ground induction, is another, its checker adding one rule detector, and IGA does not derive its consistency sentence for it. Adoption, a reflection rule whose premise is a derived warrant that the checker accepts computed proofs of every instance of a universal, gives consistent extensions RGA$^+$ and IGA$^+$. RGA$^+$ derives RGA's consistency sentence and IGA$^+$ derives RGA's and IGA's, so each strictly extends its base, and IGA$^+$ both. The second theorem holds at every adopted notation claim, and adopting Turing's code for that claim's checker derives its consistency sentence, so no claim certifies itself. Whether IGA alone derives RGA's consistency sentence is open, and the paper names what two routes to an answer need.
comment: 103 pages; splits the Goedel incompleteness material out of Internal Reasoning companion paper 2608.16140, which is getting a corresponding major update

title: Polynomial Quantum Recurrent Channels for Matrix Inverse Actions: Deferred-Reset Dynamics and Chebyshev Filtering
authors: Vahid Tavakkoli, Kabeh Mohsenzadegan, Kyandoghere Kyamakya
abstract: We develop completely positive, trace-preserving polynomial recurrent channels for quantum solution-state preparation and derive fixed-point and time-varying tracking bounds. Across 2,880 synthetic configurations, resident Chebyshev recurrence improves accuracy-passing snapshot counts in 608 cases, ties in 2,271, and loses in one. A separate 360-scenario cost study shows that fresh recurrence is cheaper in all 184 jointly feasible scenarios (median resident-to-fresh cost ratio: 3.12), while resident recurrence uniquely satisfies accuracy requirements in 74 cases. At a logical noise rate of $10^-4$, neither recurrent method qualifies. Based on exact reduced-density simulations and assumed cost models, our results demonstrate conditional tracking advantages but no general end-to-end speedup or total-cost benefit.

title: A Hardware-Trained Generative Quantum Eigensolver for Sample-Based Quantum Diagonalization of Organotin Hydroxides up to 70 Qubits
authors: Kunal Kumar, Kimberlee Keithley, Toshiya Iwamori, Shu Kanno, Ikko Hamamura, Takao Kobayashi, Akira Koseki, Qi Gao, Naoki Yamamoto, Hiroshi Horii, Yuri Kobayashi, Borja Peropadre, Kouhei Nakaji, Toru Imai, Takayuki Osogami
abstract: Quantum hardware can provide feedback for training circuit generators beyond the reach of exact classical simulation. We train generative quantum eigensolver (GQE) policies, transformers conditioned on molecular descriptors, to generate the state-preparation circuits for sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD). Training runs first on a noiseless simulator and then with the IBM Heron processor ibm_kobe inside the loop, at 46 and 70 qubits ($1.2 \times 10^8$ shots for the four main training runs). A classical CCSD(T) reference energy of the training molecules enters only an admission gate and two auxiliary reward terms. During hardware training, a reward penalty prevents collapse to circuits that sample only the Hartree-Fock determinant. Policies trained on transition-metal complexes are applied without retraining to Sn(OH)$_3$-Me and its hydrates, minimal models of organotin photoresists for extreme-ultraviolet lithography, from 32 to 70 qubits. After one round of hardware sampling, followed by classical ranking and recovery of the cached counts with the molecular Hamiltonian and no further QPU calls, 27 of 28 runs at 46-70 qubits are within 15 mHa of the density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) reference (median 4.5 mHa), and in all eight runs with an untrained control the trained policy is more accurate. At 56-70 qubits the selected circuits use 34-72 times fewer two-qubit gates than the local unitary cluster Jastrow (LUCJ) circuit transpiled for the same device. These results demonstrate that circuit generators can be trained with quantum hardware at 70 qubits.
comment: 76 pages (26 pages main text, 50 pages appendices), 24 figures, 38 tables

title: Recursive memory for prediction and generation
authors: Pengbin Feng, Chunlei Meng
abstract: Recurrent and state-space language models compress the past into a state of fixed size. The state must answer questions about the future now, and it must remain useful as new tokens arrive, including tokens the model samples itself. We show that the second requirement can cost far more memory than the first. For a known hidden Markov source with positive transition probabilities, a state of $O(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ bits answers every question about the future to accuracy $\varepsilon$, however far ahead it looks, because the Bayesian filter forgets its rounding errors. Generating the future is different. When a model feeds each sampled token back into its state, the small errors in its next-token distributions add up, and $T$ tokens can require a state of order $\log(T/\varepsilon)$ bits. The lower bound comes from the KL chain rule: at every step, a model with $K$ states pays for approximating the true next-token distribution by one of only $K$ distributions. The argument applies to any source, including a language model continuing a prompt, and a small-ball estimate makes it tight for two-state sources. The extra $\log T$ disappears if the model keeps private randomness, or if error is budgeted per token, as in perplexity. Statistics of the recent past show the same gap between describing and maintaining. The number of ones among the last $n$ bits takes $\log n$ bits to write down. But if each bit is a noisy copy of the one $n$ steps earlier, tracking that count to a mean-square error $E^2$ well below its variance costs order $n/(1+E^2)+\log n$ bits. Information about each bit must be kept until the bit leaves the window, and a queue holding the counts of recent blocks keeps just enough of it.

title: Neuromodulation Through Intrinsic Noise
authors: Sunghyun Koo, Jin Gyu Lee, Rodolphe Sepulchre
abstract: Neuromodulation, the modulation of excitability through the regulation of neuronal parameters, is a key tool in neuromorphic control design. This paper investigates how spiking excitability can be modulated by intrinsic noise. Focusing on a simplified memristive neuron model, we show that intrinsic noise plays distinct functional roles depending on the feedback pathways: Intrinsic noise in the fast excitatory feedback shapes the nature of excitability and modulates the sensitivity of the neuron to external/internal stimuli, whereas that in the slow inhibitory feedback provides internal stimuli that can trigger stochastic spiking. We expect these findings to guide the design of neuromorphic systems that harness intrinsic noise to exploit beneficial stochastic phenomena, such as stochastic resonance.
zh_title: 通过内在噪声实现的神经调控
translation: 神经调控是指通过调节神经元参数来改变其兴奋性，是神经形态控制设计中的关键工具。本文研究了脉冲兴奋性如何被内在噪声所调节。聚焦于一个简化的忆阻神经元模型，我们展示了内在噪声根据反馈通路的不同发挥着截然不同的功能作用：快速兴奋性反馈中的内在噪声塑造了兴奋性的本质，并调节神经元对外部/内部刺激的敏感性；而慢速抑制性反馈中的内在噪声则提供内部刺激，从而触发随机脉冲。我们期望这些发现能够指导神经形态系统的设计，以利用内在噪声来发挥有益的随机现象（例如随机共振）。
tldr: 本文发现简化忆阻神经元中的内在噪声能够依据快慢反馈通路差异化地调控神经兴奋性与随机放电，为神经形态随机计算设计提供了指导。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将内在噪声视为神经形态控制中一种积极的调控手段，揭示了快慢反馈通路中噪声具有功能不对称性，为利用随机共振等有益随机特性的硬件设计提供了新思路。其潜在局限在于研究建立在简化的忆阻神经元模型上，在复杂神经网络及实际芯片物理环境中的鲁棒性仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 神经调控是神经形态控制设计的核心手段，本文旨在探索如何利用内在噪声来调节神经元的脉冲兴奋性。
method: 基于简化的忆阻神经元模型（simplified memristive neuron model），研究并分析内在噪声在不同反馈回路中的动态作用。
results: 内在噪声在不同反馈通路中起着不同的功能：快速兴奋性反馈中的噪声塑造了兴奋性特征并调节神经元对内外部刺激的敏感度；慢速抑制性反馈中的噪声则充当内部刺激，能够诱发随机脉冲放电。
conclusion: 研究结果预期可指导新型神经形态系统的设计，使其能够有效利用内在噪声来激发和利用诸如随机共振等有益的随机现象。

title: Optimal radio labelings for the Cartesian product of a path and the Heawood graph
authors: Payal Vasoya, Miral Doshi, Devsi Bantva
abstract: For a simple graph $G$, let $d(u,v)$ denote the distance between two vertices $u$ and $v$ in $G$, and let $diam(G)$ denote the diameter of $G$. A radio labeling of $G$ is a mapping $f : V(G) \rightarrow \mathbb{N} \cup \{0\}$ such that $|f(u)-f(v)|\geq diam(G) + 1 - d(u,v)$ holds for every pair of distinct vertices $u, v \in G$. The span of $f$ is the difference between the largest and smallest integers assigned by $f$, and the radio number $rn(G)$ is the minimum span taking over all radio labelings of $G$. Let $P_n$ denote the path on $n$ vertices and let $H$ denote the Heawood graph (see Figure-1). In this paper we determine the radio number for the Cartesian product of a path and the Heawood graph, and characterize all optimal radio labelings of $P_n \Box H$. Moreover, we show that the radio number of $P_n \Box H$ exceed the lower bound given for $rn(G)$ in [6], where $G$ is any graph, and that this gap is arbitrarily large.
zh_title: 路与希伍德图笛卡尔积的最优无线电标号
translation: 对于简单图 $G$，记 $d(u,v)$ 为图 $G$ 中顶点 $u$ 与 $v$ 之间的距离，记 $diam(G)$ 为图 $G$ 的直径。图 $G$ 的无线电标号是一个映射 $f : V(G) \rightarrow \mathbb{N} \cup \{0\}$，使得对图 $G$ 中任意一对不同的顶点 $u, v$，均满足 $|f(u)-f(v)|\geq diam(G) + 1 - d(u,v)$。标号 $f$ 的跨度是指 $f$ 所分配的最大整数与最小整数之差，而无线电数 $rn(G)$ 是图 $G$ 所有无线电标号中的最小跨度。设 $P_n$ 表示具有 $n$ 个顶点的路，$H$ 表示希伍德图（见图1）。在本文中，我们确定了路与希伍德图笛卡尔积的无线电数，并刻画了 $P_n \Box H$ 的所有最优无线电标号。此外，我们证明了 $P_n \Box H$ 的无线电数超过了文献[6]中对任意图 $G$ 所给出的 $rn(G)$ 下界，且这一差距可以任意大。
tldr: 本文确定了路与希伍德图笛卡尔积的无线电数并刻画了其所有最优无线电标号，同时证明其与已有通用理论下界的差距可以任意大。
ai_comments: 本研究不仅精确给出了路与希伍德图笛卡尔积的无线电数，还完全刻画了所有最优标号，展现了构造与极值图论分析的深度。此外，证明其与通用下界存在任意大的差距，对评估和改进现有图无线电数的一般理论下界具有重要的理论参考价值。局限在于研究对象较为具体。
motivation: 求解路与希伍德图笛卡尔积的无线电数，刻画其最优标号，并验证已有通用无线电数下界的紧密程度。
results: 确定了路与希伍德图笛卡尔积 $P_n \Box H$ 的无线电数，刻画了其全部最优无线电标号；同时证明了该图的无线电数超过已有文献给出的通用下界，且两者的差距可以任意大。
conclusion: 研究成功确定了路与希伍德图笛卡尔积的无线电数并给出了所有最优无线电标号的完整刻画，同时指出现有文献中的通用下界可产生任意大的误差。

title: Bridging Graph and Pairwise Learning for Gene Regulatory Network Inference from scRNA-seq Data
authors: Hang Li, Jiaxin Qi, Yan Cui, Yuhua Zheng, Jianqiang Huang
abstract: Motivation: Gene regulatory networks (GRNs) capture the underlying interactions through which transcription factors (TFs) regulate genes. Based on gene expression data, existing GRN inference approaches generally fall into two categories: graph-based methods, which model the GRN as a whole graph, and pairwise-based methods, which decompose the GRN into individual TF-target gene pairs for modeling. However, each approach exhibits limitations that are precisely the strengths of its counterpart. Graph-based methods tend to overfit due to their reliance on a single training graph, whereas pairwise-based methods benefit from abundant TF-target training pairs. In contrast, pairwise-based methods overlook the global topological structure, which is essential for comprehensively capturing regulatory mechanisms. Results: To address these limitations, we propose scGPL, an end-to-end unified framework that jointly models global regulatory topology and local interactions. scGPL extracts macro-level features from the global regulatory graph and introduces a dynamic, importance-guided subgraph sampling mechanism to capture fine-grained local dependencies. By fusing global representations with subgraph-enhanced local features, our framework bridges the gap between the two paradigms, incorporating essential whole-graph topological dependencies while retaining the data abundance advantage of pairwise methods. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that scGPL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, with up to 13.7% improvement over the strongest baseline, validating the effectiveness of our integrative design. Availability and implementation: The source code is maintained on GitHub (https://github.com/talent-hang/scGPL), and the datasets and versioned releases are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21608485 for reproducibility.
zh_title: 融合图学习与成对学习的单细胞RNA测序数据基因调控网络推断
translation: 动机：基因调控网络（GRN）刻画了转录因子（TF）调控基因的潜在相互作用。基于基因表达数据，现有的GRN推断方法通常分为两类：将GRN作为整体图进行建模的图方法，以及将GRN分解为单个TF-靶基因对进行建模的成对方法。然而，这两种方法的局限性恰好对应着彼此的优势。图方法由于依赖单一训练图往往容易发生过拟合，而成对方法则受益于丰富的TF-靶标训练对。相反，成对方法忽略了对全面捕捉调控机制至关重要的全局拓扑结构。结果：为解决这些局限，我们提出了scGPL，这是一个联合建模全局调控拓扑和局部相互作用的端到端统一框架。scGPL从全局调控图中提取宏观特征，并引入动态、重要性引导的子图采样机制来捕获细粒度的局部依赖。通过将全局表征与子图增强的局部特征相融合，我们的框架弥合了两种范式之间的鸿沟，在保留成对方法数据丰富性优势的同时，融入了不可或缺的全图拓扑依赖。在7个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，scGPL始终达到最先进的性能，相比最强基准提升高达13.7%，验证了我们集成设计的有效性。可用性与实现：源代码维护在GitHub（https://github.com/talent-hang/scGPL），数据集和版本归档在Zenodo（https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21608485）以确保可复现性。
tldr: 提出融合全局图拓扑与局部成对交互的端到端框架scGPL，显著提升单细胞基因调控网络推断性能。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于打破了基因调控网络推断中全图建模（易过拟合）与成对建模（缺失全局拓扑）互为孤岛的局面，通过引入重要性引导的动态子图采样机制将二者有效桥接。其局限在于摘要未详细展开在超大规模细胞或极端稀疏数据场景下的计算效率与复杂度分析。
motivation: 现有的基因调控网络推断方法中，基于图的方法依赖单一训练图容易发生过拟合，而基于成对的方法虽拥有丰富的训练样本却忽略了全局拓扑结构，两类方法各自的局限恰为对方的优势。
method: 提出了端到端统一框架scGPL：首先从全局调控图中提取宏观特征，接着引入动态且基于重要性引导的子图采样机制捕获细粒度的局部依赖，最后将全局表征与子图增强的局部特征进行融合。
results: 在7个基准数据集上的大量实验显示，scGPL持续取得最优表现，相比最强基线性能提升最高达13.7%。
conclusion: scGPL成功融合了图学习与成对学习两种范式，兼具全局拓扑依赖性建模与局部数据充分性的优势，为单细胞基因调控网络推断提供了高效可靠的解决方案。

title: Optimal Last-Iterate Bounds for Nonexpansive Stochastic Approximation
authors: Ramanan Tamizholi, Siddharth Chandak, Rahul Singh
abstract: We establish last-iterate mean-square residual bounds for nonexpansive stochastic approximation (SA), or stochastic Krasnoselskii-Mann (KM) iterations. In particular, we consider fixed-point mappings that are nonexpansive with respect to the Euclidean norm, and focus on polynomially decaying stepsizes. We study three conditions on the conditional second moment of the noise, and obtain bounds that are optimal up to logarithmic factors in each case. When it scales linearly with the squared residual, the best rate is $O(1/k^{1-ε})$ for any $ε>0$. In this case, for all considered stepsizes, our bounds match those of the noiseless KM iteration. When it is bounded by a constant, the best rate is $O(\log^2 k/\sqrt{k})$. When it scales affinely with the squared norm of the iterate, the best rate is $O(1/k^{1/2-ε})$, and the mean-square residual can diverge if the stepsizes are not square-summable. Thus, unlike for contractive SA, square-summable stepsizes are necessary for nonexpansive SA. We demonstrate how various algorithms with cocoercive maps, such as stochastic gradient descent, linear SA, and learning in cocoercive games, fit into our framework, and how the different noise conditions arise in each of them.
zh_title: 非扩张随机逼近的最优最后迭代界
translation: 我们建立了非扩张随机逼近（SA），即随机 Krasnoselskii-Mann (KM) 迭代的最后迭代均方残差界。特别是，我们考虑关于欧几里得范数非扩张的不动点映射，并专注于多项式衰减的步长。我们研究了噪声条件二阶矩的三种条件，并在每种情况下获得了在对数因子意义下最优的界。当其与残差平方呈线性比例缩放时，对于任意 ε>0，最佳速率为 O(1/k^{1-ε})。在这种情况下，对于所有考虑的步长，我们的界与无噪声 KM 迭代的界相匹配。当其以常数为界时，最佳速率为 O(log^2 k / √k)。当其与迭代点模长的平方呈仿射比例缩放时，最佳速率为 O(1/k^{1/2-ε})，并且如果步长不是平方可和的，均方残差可能会发散。因此，与收缩 SA 不同，平方可和步长对于非扩张 SA 是必要的。我们展示了各种具有共强制映射的算法（例如随机梯度下降、线性 SA 以及共强制博弈中的学习）如何契合我们的框架，以及不同噪声条件如何在其中产生。
tldr: 本文为非扩张随机逼近在三种不同噪声条件和多项式步长下建立了几乎最优的最后迭代均方残差收敛界，并揭示了步长平方可和的必要性。
ai_comments: 该研究的重要创新在于给出了非扩张随机逼近在最后迭代（last-iterate）意义下的均方残差收敛速率，弥补了以往多关注遍历平均（ergodic）性质的不足；同时严格证明了非扩张情形下步长平方可和的必要性，指出了其与收缩算子设定的本质差异。局限在于当前的理论界在多项式速率中仍存在对数因子差距，且分析主要局限于欧几里得范数。
motivation: 探究非扩张随机逼近（或随机KM迭代）在多项式衰减步长下的最后迭代（last-iterate）均方残差收敛性质与最优速率，明确不同噪声条件及步长性质对算法收敛性的根本影响。
method: 针对欧几里得范数下的非扩张不动点映射与多项式衰减步长，分别在噪声条件二阶矩的三种不同假设（与残差平方线性相关、有常数上界、与迭代点模长平方呈仿射关系）下，系统分析并推导随机KM迭代的最后迭代均方残差界，并映射到共强制算子算法框架。
results: 在噪声二阶矩与残差平方呈线性关系时，最优速率为 O(1/k^{1-ε})，匹配无噪KM迭代界；在噪声二阶矩为常数有界时，最优速率为 O(log^2 k / √k)；在噪声二阶矩与迭代点范数平方呈仿射关系时，最优速率为 O(1/k^{1/2-ε})，且若步长非平方可和则残差可能发散，证实了平方可和步长在非扩张SA中的必要性。
conclusion: 本文建立了非扩张随机逼近在对数因子意义下最优的最后迭代残差收敛界，阐明了三种不同噪声结构对速率的影响，证明了步长平方可和对于非扩张SA的必要性，并为SGD、线性SA及博弈学习等共强制算法提供了统一分析视角。

title: Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation (APGEM): A Unified Learning-Based Framework for Noise Resilience in Quantum Machine Learning
authors: Bisma Majid, Shabir Ahmad Sofi, Mir Mohammad Yousuf
abstract: Error mitigation stands between variational quantum algorithms and useful results on today's noisy hardware, yet in practice a mitigation method is usually chosen once, by hand, and applied unchanged for the life of an experiment. This is a poor fit for quantum machine learning (QML), where the circuit and the noise drift as training proceeds, so the best strategy in one regime is often wrong in another. We present a generalized form of Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation (APGEM), which treats the choice of mitigation technique as an online decision made from an algorithm's own feedback. A single contextual-bandit controller observes signals any variational algorithm already produces, such as fidelity, entropy, reward or loss, and gradient behavior, and selects among Zero-Noise Extrapolation, Probabilistic Error Cancellation, Measurement Error Mitigation, Dynamical Decoupling, and circuit optimization per step. Because it depends only on this shared feedback interface, the framework applies unchanged across supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement, and hybrid quantum-classical learning. Evaluated on five paradigms across 80 algorithm-and-noise conditions, adaptive selection reaches 95.5% of an oracle that always picks the best technique and significantly outperforms all six fixed strategies (Friedman $χ^{2}=92.18$, $p\approx1.1\times10^{-17}$; pairwise Wilcoxon $p<4\times10^{-6}$). The learned policy is noise-aware: its favored technique shifts as depolarizing and readout error rise. On noise models from eight real IBM devices, APGEM tracks the oracle almost exactly (99.9% of oracle utility) at a flat cost of roughly $1.3\times10^{4}$ shots from three to eight qubits.
zh_title: 自适应策略引导的误差缓解（APGEM）：一种用于量子机器学习中噪声鲁棒性的统一学习框架
translation: 在当今带噪声硬件上，误差缓解是变分量子算法获得有效结果的关键，然而在实践中，缓解方法通常是在实验前由人工单次选择并在整个实验周期内保持不变。这并不适合量子机器学习（QML），因为随着训练的进行，电路和噪声会发生漂移，导致某一阶段的最优策略在另一阶段往往不再适用。我们提出了一种通用形式的自适应策略引导误差缓解（APGEM）框架，将缓解技术的选择视为基于算法自身反馈做出的在线决策。单一上下文多臂老虎机（contextual-bandit）控制器通过观测任何变分算法已生成的信号（如保真度、熵、奖励或损失以及梯度行为），在每一步中自适应地在零噪声外推、概率误差消除、测量误差缓解、动态解耦和电路优化之间进行选择。由于它仅依赖于这一共享反馈接口，该框架在监督、无监督、强化和混合量子-经典学习中均可直接通用。在横跨80种算法与噪声条件的五种范式评估中，自适应选择达到了始终选取最优技术的预言机（oracle）95.5%的性能，且显著优于全部六种固定策略（Friedman $\chi^2=92.18, p\approx1.1\times10^{-17}$；成对 Wilcoxon $p<4\times10^{-6}$）。所学习到的策略具备噪声感知能力：其偏好的技术会随着去极化和读出误差的增加而转变。在来自八台真实IBM设备的噪声模型上，APGEM几乎完全跟踪了预言机（达到预言机效用的99.9%），且在3到8量子比特范围内的测量开销稳定在约$1.3\times10^4$ shots。
tldr: APGEM利用上下文多臂老虎机，根据训练实时反馈动态在线选择最佳量子误差缓解策略，在多种QML任务中达到接近最优表现并显著优于静态选择。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将量子误差缓解转化为基于上下文多臂老虎机的在线序列决策问题，克服了传统方法中静态选择单一缓解策略的局限，非常贴合量子机器学习训练过程动态变化的特性。其依赖算法固有反馈信号的通用接口设计具备很强的通用性与扩展性。局限在于评测主要基于噪声模型和模拟实验，在更大规模真实量子硬件上的开销和泛化表现仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 现有的误差缓解方法通常由人工在实验前静态选定并在全流程中保持不变，这无法适应量子机器学习中由于线路和噪声随训练进行而漂移、导致不同阶段最优策略发生变化的动态特性。
method: 提出了自适应策略引导误差缓解（APGEM）框架，将误差缓解技术选择建模为基于在线反馈的决策问题。利用单一上下文多臂老虎机控制器，实时监控算法固有的反馈信号（如保真度、熵、奖励/损失、梯度行为），动态在零噪声外推（ZNE）、概率误差消除（PEC）、测量误差缓解（MEM）、动态解耦（DD）以及电路优化之间按步进行选择。
results: 在5种范式、80种算法与噪声条件下，自适应选择达到了总是选择最优技术的Oracle策略95.5%的性能，显著优于所有6种固定策略；在8台真实IBM设备的噪声模型测试中，APGEM达到Oracle效用评价值的99.9%，且在3到8量子比特规模下每次仅需约1.3×10^4次测量的平直开销。
conclusion: APGEM提供了一种通用的自适应学习框架，能够在量子机器学习训练过程中动态选择最优的误差缓解技术，在接近理论最优表现的同时保持平直的采样开销，展现了极强的噪声鲁棒性和实用价值。

title: Outliers and the Hard-Margin Linear SVM in High-Dimension, Low-Sample-Size Settings
authors: Yugo Nakayama
abstract: We study how outliers affect the hard-margin linear support vector machine when the dimension grows while the sample sizes remain fixed. For one-sided contamination, the centered Gram matrix converges to a constant inlier block plus an outlier-diagonal component, and the limiting dual problem has a closed-form solution. All outliers act through one effective distance. This representation yields explicit thresholds for loss of inlier support, margin shrinkage. intercept displacement, and asymptotic misclassification. We then treat contamination in both classes. The limiting intercept is the multiplier of the class-balance constraint, and the two classes pull it in opposite directions. Consequently, at most one class can collapse or be asymptotically misclassified, whereas symmetric contamination leaves the limiting discriminant function unchanged even though the margin shrinks. Seven numerical experiments verify the dual allocation, phase transitions, and discriminant limits.
zh_title: 高维小样本场景下异常值对硬间隔线性支持向量机的影响
translation: 我们研究了当数据维度增加而样本量保持固定时，异常值如何影响硬间隔线性支持向量机。对于单侧污染，中心化Gram矩阵收敛为一个常数内点块加上一个异常值对角分量，其极限对偶问题具有闭式解。所有异常值通过一个有效距离发挥作用。该表示给出了内点支持丧失、间隔收缩、截距位移以及渐近误分类的明确阈值。随后我们研究了类别双侧均受污染的情况。极限截距是类别平衡约束的乘子，两个类别会将其向相反方向拉拽。因此，至多只有一个类别会崩溃或被渐近误分类，而在对称污染下，即便间隔收缩，极限判别函数仍保持不变。七个数值实验验证了对偶分配、相变和判别极限。
tldr: 论文证明了高维小样本下硬间隔线性SVM受异常值影响的渐近闭式解，推导出误分类与间隔收缩的显式阈值，并揭示了双侧污染下的相变规律。
ai_comments: 本研究在高维小样本（HDLSS）几何表征与支持向量机理论交叉领域具有重要理论价值。作者通过分析Gram矩阵的渐近收敛性，给出了极限对偶问题的闭式解，并精确刻画了异常值引发的多种相变阈值（如支持向量丧失与渐近误分类）。局限在于研究聚焦于硬间隔线性分类器，对于软间隔SVM以及非线性核方法的推广仍有待探索。
motivation: 探究在维度发散而样本量保持固定的高维小样本（HDLSS）场景下，数据中的异常值（outliers）如何从理论和几何上影响硬间隔线性支持向量机。
method: 基于高维小样本渐近理论，分析当维度发散时中心化Gram矩阵的极限结构（常数内点块加异常值对角块），求解极限对偶问题的闭式解，并推导单侧与双侧污染下的拉格朗日乘子、截距及有效距离。
results: 1. 单侧污染下，极限对偶问题具有闭式解，所有异常值通过一个有效距离作用，并导出了内点支持丢失、间隔收缩、截距位移及渐近误分类的显式阈值；2. 双侧污染下，两类异常值对作为约束乘子的截距施加相反拉力，至多只有一类会崩溃或渐近误分类；3. 对称污染下，尽管分类间隔收缩，极限判别函数仍保持不变；4. 七组数值实验验证了上述理论推导。
conclusion: 研究揭示了HDLSS背景下异常值对硬间隔线性SVM影响的渐近行为与几何本质，给出了单侧及双侧污染下的显式相变阈值和判别函数的稳健性规律。

title: Dual-Space Preconditioning for Variational Inequalities and Root-Finding Problems
authors: Jan Quan, Konstantinos Oikonomidis, Alexander Bodard, Panagiotis Patrinos
abstract: This paper develops a dual-space preconditioning framework for variational inequalities and root-finding problems beyond classical cocoercivity and Lipschitz continuity assumptions. To this end, we introduce both a novel cocoercivity-type condition and a relaxed Lipschitz continuity condition, and derive convergence of deterministic and stochastic methods under these generalized conditions. For isotropic preconditioners, the resulting algorithms can be interpreted as variable-stepsize variants of classical methods, extending recent analyses based on $(L_0, L_1)$-type growth conditions while allowing simpler proofs and larger stepsize ranges. We also show that the framework naturally handles variational inequalities through weak Minty-type arguments. Finally, we study the associated continuous-time dynamics and derive a variational and optimal control interpretation of the preconditioned flow. Overall, the results show that dual-space preconditioning provides a flexible mechanism for designing and analyzing operator methods beyond the standard Euclidean Lipschitz setting.
zh_title: 变分不等式与求根问题的对偶空间预条件方法
translation: 本文针对超出经典余强制性和Lipschitz连续性假设的变分不等式和求根问题，开发了一种对偶空间预条件框架。为此，我们引入了一种新颖的余强制性条件以及一种松弛的Lipschitz连续性条件，并推导了确定性和随机方法在这些广义条件下的收敛性。对于各向同性预条件子，所得算法可以解释为经典方法的可变步长变体，扩展了近期基于$(L_0, L_1)$型增长条件的分析，同时提供了更简单的证明和更大的步长范围。我们还表明，该框架可以通过弱Minty型论据自然地处理变分不等式。最后，我们研究了相关的连续时间动力学，并推导出了预条件流的变分和最优控制解释。总体而言，研究结果表明对偶空间预条件为在标准欧氏Lipschitz设定之外设计和分析算子方法提供了一种灵活的机制。
tldr: 本文提出了一种对偶空间预条件框架，在放宽的Lipschitz和余强制性条件下建立了变分不等式和求根问题确定性及随机算法的收敛性保证。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于跳出了经典的欧氏空间Lipschitz连续性与余强制性约束，通过对偶空间预条件技术为算子理论提供了更宽泛的分析框架，不仅兼容了$(L_0, L_1)$型自适应步长分析，还建立了与最优控制的连续动力学联系。
motivation: 突破经典算子方法中对严格欧氏Lipschitz连续性和余强制性（cocoercivity）假设的依赖，以适应更一般的算子问题并获得更优的步长范围。
method: 构建对偶空间预条件框架，提出新型余强制性条件与松弛的Lipschitz连续性条件，结合弱Minty型论证处理变分不等式，并研究其关联的连续时间动力学与最优控制解释。
results: 推导了确定性与随机算法在新广义条件下的收敛性；针对各向同性预条件子，算法拓展了$(L_0, L_1)$型增长条件分析，简化了证明且允许更大的步长选择；并给出了预条件流的变分与最优控制解释。
conclusion: 对偶空间预条件框架为设计和分析超越标准欧氏Lipschitz条件的算子方法提供了一种极其灵活且通用的有效机制。

title: Thermodynamic Formalism for Non-Invariant Probabilities: Entropy, Divergence, Channels
authors: Artur O. Lopes, Elismar R. Oliveira
abstract: Let $\mathcal{M}$ and $\mathcal{M}_σ$ denote, respectively, the sets of Borel and $σ$-invariant probabilities on the uncountable set $Ω=\{1,2,...,d\}^\mathbb{N}$. Given a Hölder Jacobian $J$, the dual Ruelle operator $μ\in \mathcal{M} \mapsto \mathcal{L}_{J}^* (μ)$ will play the role of a dynamical channel; generalizes the action of a stochastic matrix on probability vectors. Since $\mathcal{L}_{J}^*$ generally breaks $σ$-invariance, we introduce the \emph{ni-entropy} $h_{ni}(μ)$ for non-invariant measures, employing the concept of the expected value function on cylinders of size one. $h_{ni}(μ)$ differs from Shannon entropy but extends the Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy from $\mathcal{M}_σ$ to $\mathcal{M}$; $h_{ni}$ is concave and u.s.c. This leads us to the concept of ni-pressure $\mathcal{P}(A)$ of a potential $A:Ω\to \mathbb{R}$. $μ\in \mathcal{M}$ is not a density with respect to a dominating measure. We define an {\it ni-Kullback-Leibler divergence} $D_{ni}(ρ|| ν)$ not assuming absolute continuity. We investigate concepts of Information Theory such as Minimal Output Entropy, Donsker-Varadhan variational principle, a variational formula for $h_{ni}$, bounds for divergence, information projections, and their connections to the ni-pressure $\mathcal{P}$.
zh_title: 非不变概率测度的热力学形式：熵、散度与信道
translation: 令 $\mathcal{M}$ 和 $\mathcal{M}_\sigma$ 分别表示不可数集合 $\Omega=\{1,2,...,d\}^\mathbb{N}$ 上的 Borel 概率测度集与 $\sigma$-不变概率测度集。给定 Hölder 雅可比行列式 $J$，对偶 Ruelle 算子 $\mu\in \mathcal{M} \mapsto \mathcal{L}_{J}^* (\mu)$ 将扮演动力学信道的角色，推广了随机矩阵对概率向量的作用。由于 $\mathcal{L}_{J}^*$ 通常会破坏 $\sigma$-不变性，我们利用大小为 1 的柱集上的期望值函数概念，为非不变测度引入了非不变熵（ni-entropy）$h_{ni}(\mu)$。$h_{ni}(\mu)$ 不同于香农熵，但将 Kolmogorov-Sinai 熵从 $\mathcal{M}_\sigma$ 推广到了 $\mathcal{M}$；$h_{ni}$ 具有凹性和上半连续性。由此我们引入了势函数 $A:\Omega\to \mathbb{R}$ 的非不变压（ni-pressure）$\mathcal{P}(A)$ 概念。测度 $\mu\in \mathcal{M}$ 并不要求是相对于占优测度的密度。我们在不假设绝对连续性的情况下定义了非不变 KL 散度（ni-Kullback-Leibler divergence）$D_{ni}(\rho|| \nu)$。我们研究了诸如最小输出熵、Donsker-Varadhan 变分原理、$h_{ni}$ 的变分公式、散度的界、信息投影等信息论概念，以及它们与非不变压 $\mathcal{P}$ 的联系。
tldr: 本文针对破坏移位不变性的动力学信道，提出了适用于非不变概率测度的熵、压与KL散度，并将经典变分原理和信息论概念拓展至一般Borel测度空间。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于打破了经典动力系统热力学形式对“测度不变性”的长期依赖，通过在柱集上引入期望值函数，成功将Kolmogorov-Sinai熵推广至一般的Borel概率测度空间，并定义了不依赖绝对连续性的散度概念。这为动力系统理论与信息论（尤其是信道容量、最小输出熵等）的交叉融合提供了全新的数学工具。
motivation: 在符号动力系统中，对偶Ruelle算子的作用通常会破坏测度的移位不变性，且非不变测度通常缺乏占优测度与绝对连续性，导致传统依赖不变测度的Kolmogorov-Sinai熵及热力学形式无法直接适用。
method: 通过将对偶Ruelle算子视为动力学信道，并利用大小为1的柱集上的期望值函数，定义了非不变熵（ni-entropy）和非不变压（ni-pressure）；在不预设绝对连续性的前提下，定义了非不变KL散度（ni-Kullback-Leibler divergence），进而展开变分分析。
results: 所定义的非不变熵$h_{ni}$具有凹性与上半连续性，将Kolmogorov-Sinai熵从不变测度集延拓至全体Borel测度；导出了非不变压与非不变KL散度，并在此框架下建立了最小输出熵、Donsker-Varadhan变分原理、熵的变分公式、散度界及信息投影等重要信息论结果。
conclusion: 论文成功构建了一套适用于非不变概率测度的热力学与信息论形式系统，证明了其优良的数学性质并建立了相关的变分原理。

title: Lengthscale Estimation for the Gaussian Kernel and Deterministic Response Functions
authors: Subhendu Pramanick, Toni Karvonen
abstract: The uncertainty estimates Gaussian processes output rely on the chosen covariance kernel and its hyperparameters. We study the fixed-domain asymptotics of the maximum likelihood and cross-validation estimators of the lengthscale parameter of the popular infinitely smooth Gaussian kernel when the observations are produced by a fixed univariate response function. No theoretical results for Gaussian lengthscale estimation exist in this setting. We prove lower bounds on the lengthscale estimators that depend on the regularity of the response function, as measured by the rate of decay of its Fourier transform. If the response function lives in the Hilbert space of the Gaussian kernel with lengthscale $\ell$, the lower bounds have a straightforward dependency on $\ell$. For bandlimited functions and functions whose Fourier transforms decay as $\exp(-a \lvert ω\rvert^γ)$ for $a > 0$ and $γ> 2$, we prove that the estimators blow up essentially at least as fast as $(\log n)^{(γ-2)/(2γ)}$ in the number of data points, $n$. Bandlimited functions are identified with $γ= \infty$. Unlike analogous results for finitely smooth Matérn kernels, our results make no assumptions on the geometry of the observation points. Numerical experiments illustrate the results.
zh_title: 高斯核与确定性响应函数的长度尺度估计
translation: 高斯过程输出的不确定性估计依赖于所选的协方差核及其超参数。我们研究了在观测值由固定的一元响应函数生成时，常用的无限平滑高斯核长度尺度参数的最大似然估计量和交叉验证估计量的固定域渐近性。在此设定下，目前尚无关于高斯长度尺度估计的理论结果。我们证明了长度尺度估计量的下界，该下界取决于响应函数的正则性（以其傅里叶变换的衰减速率衡量）。如果响应函数位于具有长度尺度 $\ell$ 的高斯核希尔伯特空间中，则该下界与 $\ell$ 存在直接的依赖关系。对于带限函数以及傅里叶变换衰减满足 $\exp(-a \lvert \omega\rvert^\gamma)$（其中 $a > 0$ 且 $\gamma > 2$）的函数，我们证明了估计量基本上至少以关于数据点数量 $n$ 的 $(\log n)^{(\gamma-2)/(2\gamma)}$ 速率发散。带限函数等价于 $\gamma = \infty$。与有限平滑 Matérn 核的类似结果不同，我们的结论对观测点的几何分布未作任何假设。数值实验佐证了这些结果。
tldr: 本文首次给出了确定性响应函数下高斯核长度尺度估计量的理论下界与发散速率，且对观测点几何分布无任何假设。
ai_comments: 该论文填补了高斯核在确定性函数响应下超参数估计理论的空白。尤其重要的是，与之前有限平滑Matérn核需假设观测点均匀或满足特定几何条件不同，本文针对高斯核得出的下界与发散速率无需任何关于数据点几何排布的假设，具有很高的理论普适性与严谨性。
motivation: 高斯过程的不确定性估计高度依赖于核函数超参数，而在由固定一元确定性响应函数产生观测值的设定下，目前尚无关于常用无限平滑高斯核长度尺度估计的理论结果。
method: 采用固定域渐近分析方法，针对最大似然估计（ML）和交叉验证估计（CV），通过响应函数傅里叶变换的衰减率来表征其正则性，建立理论下界并分析其发散速率。
results: 证明了长度尺度估计量的下界取决于响应函数的傅里叶衰减率；若函数属于高斯RKHS，下界与真实长度尺度直接相关；对于带限或超指数衰减函数，估计量随数据量n至少以$(\log n)^{(\gamma-2)/(2\gamma)}$速率发散；理论结果无需对观测点几何分布做任何假设，并得到了数值实验验证。
conclusion: 在确定性响应函数下，高斯核的长度尺度估计量存在依赖于函数傅里叶变换衰减率的下界；对于高度光滑（如带限或超高斯衰减）函数，估计量随样本量增加必然发散，且该性质对数据点分布的几何形态不作要求。

title: Counterfactual Analysis of Extent Leakage from Annotation-Derived Prompts in Vision-Language Medical Image Segmentation
authors: Niran Nataraj, Ankita Das, C. Krishna Mohan, Kenji Kawashima
abstract: Text-guided segmentation models receive an image and a short caption about the lesion, and on public benchmarks the caption improves accuracy considerably. On colonoscopy and breast ultrasound, however, the size, count and location words of each caption were computed from the mask that later scores the prediction, and the chest X-ray captions were written by benchmark annotators. We tested what two published models take from them. On colonoscopy and chest X-ray, it is mostly the lesion's extent. Keeping only the size word or the lung-zone phrase recovers 84 to 98 percent of the improvement over an empty caption, and removing it loses 52 to 77 percent. The rest matters little, and a polyp called a rock is segmented just as well. We call this extent leakage. On breast ultrasound, nearly half the captions also name the diagnosis, which carries part of the benefit. Retraining on three datasets shows that models pick up this habit from their training captions, though only partly on breast ultrasound, and that it weakens their segmentation from the image alone. The leak can be measured without training a model, since caption words alone predict lesion area (coefficient of determination 0.54 to 0.77 on six of seven test sets). Without the test mask, the best method we tested, which estimates extent from the image, reaches 74.59 Dice on colonoscopy against the published 77.23. We propose an evaluation protocol that keeps what a caption says about the image apart from what it copies from the label.
zh_title: 视觉-语言医学图像分割中基于标注生成提示的范围泄漏反事实分析
translation: 文本引导的分割模型接收图像和关于病灶的简短描述文本，在公开基准上该文本显著提升了分割精度。然而，在结肠镜和乳腺超声数据集中，每个描述中的大小、数量和位置词均是从后续用于预测评分的真实掩码中计算得出的，而胸部X光描述则由基准标注员撰写。我们测试了两个已发表模型从这些描述中获取的信息。在结肠镜和胸部X光上，模型获取的主要是病灶的范围：仅保留尺寸词或肺区短语即可恢复相比空描述84%至98%的性能提升，而移除该词则会损失52%至77%的提升。其余部分影响甚微，即使将息肉称为石头，分割效果也基本相同。我们将此现象称为“范围泄漏”。在乳腺超声中，近半数描述还给出了诊断名称，这也带来了一部分增益。在三个数据集上的重新训练表明，模型从训练描述中习得了这种依赖习惯（尽管在乳腺超声上仅部分存在），且这种依赖削弱了模型仅凭图像进行分割的能力。无需训练模型即可衡量这种泄漏，因为仅凭描述词即可预测病灶面积（在7个测试集中的6个上决定系数为0.54至0.77）。在没有测试掩码泄漏的情况下，我们测试的最优方法（从图像估计范围）在结肠镜上的Dice分数为74.59，低于已发表的77.23。我们提出了一种评估协议，用以将文本描述中对图像的真实陈述与其从标签中复制的信息区分开来。
tldr: 研究发现医学图像文本引导分割基准存在严重的“范围泄漏”问题：模型提升主要依靠标注派生文本中的尺寸与位置泄漏，而非多模态理解。
ai_comments: 该研究切中要害，敏锐指出了当前医学视觉-语言多模态分割基准中普遍存在的“作弊”与数据泄漏问题，具有极高的学术警示和规范评估价值；其创新之处在于通过系统的反事实分析量化了提示词对真实标注的依赖程度。局限性在于测试主要集中在两款既有模型上，未来可进一步拓展至更大规模的通用医学视觉-语言大模型。
motivation: 在文本引导的医学图像分割基准中，病灶文本提示显著提高了分割精度，但这些提示大多直接提取自真实标注掩码或由标注员撰写，可能存在将病灶范围（大小、位置等）直接泄漏给模型的风险，从而导致评估虚高。
method: 采用反事实分析方法，在两个已公开模型上消融/替换提示词（如仅保留尺寸词、替换病灶名称为无关物体等），重新训练模型以检验其对提示的依赖程度；直接通过文本词预测病灶面积以量化泄漏（计算决定系数 $R^2$）；并提出了一种分离真实图像描述与标签泄漏的新评估协议。
results: 模型主要依赖提示中的病灶范围：仅保留尺寸或区域词可恢复84%至98%的增益，删除则损失52%至77%的增益，而病灶语义名称影响极小（如将息肉称为石头分割效果相同）；仅凭提示词预测病灶面积的 $R^2$ 达0.54至0.77；在排除测试掩码泄漏后，结肠镜分割Dice得分从发表的77.23降至74.59。
conclusion: 现有医学视觉-语言分割模型在公开基准上的高精度在很大程度上源于文本提示中泄漏的病灶范围信息，这掩盖了模型真实的视觉语言推理能力并削弱了单图像分割表现；评估多模态医学图像分割模型时必须严格杜绝标签泄漏。

title: The Role of Insurance in Power-System Risk Management: A Critical Review
authors: Jing Huang, Jiale Guo, Chenjia Gu, Chengcheng Shao, Yue Xiang, Tao Qian, Alexis Pengfei Zhao, Xiuli Wang, Junyong Liu, Xifan Wang
abstract: Modern power systems are becoming more renewable-rich, digitalized, and interconnected, making risk propagation and economic consequences increasingly complex. Physical mitigation remains the primary means of risk control, but technical and economic limits leave residual risk. Insurance can complement these measures by transferring associated economic losses and influencing power-system decisions through risk-responsive terms. Despite growing interest, the literature remains fragmented across power-system engineering, actuarial science, and risk finance. This review develops an integrated physical-financial perspective for reviewing insurance in power systems. It examines how power system risks generate residual economic losses and the conditions under which these losses can be insured and transferred. It then develops an actuarial framework for insured-loss assessment and pricing. Insurance-aware decision-making is synthesized through four coupling levels describing how financial protection interacts with power-system decisions. Further progress is constrained by weak physical-financial loss validation, incomplete representation of systemic and evolving portfolio risk, and limited empirical and actuarial grounding of insurance-decision feedback. Research priorities include stronger physical-financial data linkage, forward-looking portfolio assessment, multi-timescale decision feedback, and empirical validation. Addressing these priorities would help move power-system insurance from fragmented applications toward a more coherent approach to residual-risk management in future power systems.
zh_title: 保险在电力系统风险管理中的作用：批判性综述
translation: 现代电力系统日益呈现高比例可再生能源、数字化和高度互联的特征，使得风险传播和经济后果愈发复杂。物理减灾仍是风险控制的主要手段，但技术和经济上的局限性留下了残余风险。保险可以通过转移相关经济损失并借助风险响应条款影响电力系统决策，从而作为物理措施的补充。尽管关注度日益增加，但相关文献仍碎片化地分散在电力系统工程、精算科学和风险金融领域。本综述构建了一个整合物理-金融的视角，对电力系统中的保险应用进行评述。文中探讨了电力系统风险如何产生残余经济损失，以及这些损失可被承保和转移的条件。随后，建立了一个用于保险损失评估和定价的精算框架。通过描述金融保护与电力系统决策相互作用的四个耦合层级，综合归纳了考虑保险的决策模式。然而，进一步的发展受制于物理-金融损失验证较弱、系统性和演进中的投资组合风险表征不完整，以及保险-决策反馈缺乏足够的实证与精算基础。未来的研究重点包括强化物理-金融数据关联、前瞻性投资组合评估、多时间尺度决策反馈以及实证验证。解决这些优先事项将有助于推动电力系统保险从分散零星的应用，走向未来电力系统中更为连贯系统的残余风险管理方法。
tldr: 本文从物理-金融整合视角综述了保险在电力系统残余风险管理中的角色，构建了精算定价框架与四级决策耦合机制，并指出了未来的研究重点。
ai_comments: 该综述的重要性在于系统性地打通了电力系统工程与精算学、风险金融学之间的跨学科鸿沟，首次提出了物理-金融整合视角和四级耦合决策框架。其创新点在于将传统局限于物理减灾的电力风险管理扩展至经济损失转移与激励相容机制。局限性在于目前该领域仍缺乏坚实的物理-金融损失实证数据支撑，且系统性风险的动态评估建模尚不成熟。
motivation: 现代电力系统因高比例可再生能源、数字化和互联化导致风险传播及经济后果日益复杂；物理减灾手段受限于技术和经济约束存在残余风险，而保险研究目前分散在电力工程、精算科学与风险金融等领域，缺乏统一整合视角。
method: 构建了一个整合物理-金融视角的综述框架：首先分析残余经济损失生成机制及可保条件，随后建立保险损失评估与定价的精算框架，并提出涵盖四个耦合层级的保险感知型决策综合框架。
results: 提炼了评估与转移残余损失的可保条件和精算定价框架；归纳了描述金融保障与电力系统决策交互的四个耦合层级；识别了物理-金融损失验证较弱、系统性与动态组合风险表征不全、决策反馈缺乏实证支撑等关键瓶颈，并指明了未来研究重点。
conclusion: 解决数据连接弱、系统性风险表征不足及反馈机制缺乏实证等研究重点，将推动电力系统保险从碎片化应用迈向更具系统性的未来电力系统残余风险管理。

title: TransGHOST: Real-Time, Synthesis-Free Reconstruction of Instrument-Occluded Regions in Ophthalmic Microsurgery
authors: Niran Nataraj, Maina Sogabe, Masamichi Yamashita, Norihiko Ito, Kenji Kawashima
abstract: Intraoperative scene perception in ophthalmic microsurgery is limited by instrument occlusion: when a tool enters the high-magnification field, it conceals tissue from both the surgeon and the perception components of robot-assisted systems that process the video. Generative inpainting can remove the occluder but replaces the missing image content with synthesis, which is unsuitable when visual provenance matters. Many video inpainters also depend on future frames and cannot operate online. We present TransGHOST, a causal reference-guided reconstruction pipeline whose non-generative safe mode operates in real time. Every restored value is obtained by resampling a recorded frame using geometric transforms fitted only to visible regions. The system provides per-pixel confidence and provenance and marks unsupported pixels as abstentions. We evaluate TransGHOST on a new veterinary clinical corpus of canine cataract surgery with pixel-level instrument and anatomy labels. Only the occluded region is scored, and each scoring target is verified to differ from the reference supplied to the system. Safe mode reaches 31.89 dB masked PSNR and 0.915 masked SSIM at 51.7 ms median and 85.5 ms 95th-percentile latency. On a pre-declared held-out cohort using instrument cutouts excluded from segmentation training, it reaches 29.83 dB masked PSNR, while matched-mask evaluation on validation shows a 3.45 dB advantage over LaMa. Region-aware reference selection improves masked PSNR by 3.60 dB over recency when candidate references can themselves be occluded. Reference-age analysis further defines the operating interval for the brief, repeated occlusions targeted by TransGHOST.
zh_title: TransGHOST：眼科显微手术中器械遮挡区域的实时、免合成重建
translation: 眼科显微手术中的术中场景感知常受到器械遮挡的限制：当工具进入高倍放大视野时，会向手术医生以及处理视频的机器人辅助系统感知组件遮盖组织。生成式图像修复（Inpainting）虽能移除遮挡物，但会用合成内容填补缺失的图像区域，这在注重视觉溯源（visual provenance）的场景中并不适用；许多视频修复算法还依赖未来帧，无法在线实时运行。我们提出了TransGHOST，一种因果参考引导的重建流程，其非生成式的安全模式（safe mode）可在实时状态下运行。每个恢复的像素值均仅通过对可见区域拟合的几何变换，重采样已记录的历史帧来获取。该系统提供逐像素置信度与溯源信息，并将缺乏支撑信息的像素标记为弃权。我们在包含像素级器械与解剖标签的新犬白内障手术兽医临床语料库上对TransGHOST进行了评估。评估仅对遮挡区域打分，并验证了每个评分目标均与提供给系统的参考帧存在差异。安全模式在51.7毫秒的中位延迟和85.5毫秒的第95百分位延迟下，达到了31.89 dB的掩码PSNR和0.915的掩码SSIM。在未参与分割训练的器械抠图预设独立保留队列中，其掩码PSNR达到29.83 dB；验证集上的匹配掩码评估显示其相比LaMa具有3.45 dB的优势。在候选参考帧自身可能被遮挡的情况下，区域感知的参考选择相较于时间临近选择将掩码PSNR提升了3.60 dB。参考帧时间跨度分析进一步界定了TransGHOST所针对的短暂、重复遮挡的有效操作区间。
tldr: TransGHOST是一种面向眼科显微手术的实时免合成重建方法，仅通过重采样历史参考帧即可安全、可溯源地消除器械遮挡。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于针对医疗手术中对内容真实性与溯源性极度苛刻的要求，摒弃了当前主流但具有幻觉风险的生成式修复范式，采用纯几何变换与参考帧重采样的非生成式方案，并赋予算法像素级的置信度和放弃机制（abstention），大幅提升了临床安全性与可解释性。局限性在于其严重依赖组织在历史帧中的可见性，若组织发生大形变或持续遮挡时间过长超出参考有效区间，系统将无法有效恢复内容。
motivation: 眼科显微手术中手术器械进入高倍视野会造成严重的视野遮挡，影响术者和机器人辅助感知；而现有生成式图像修复算法依赖幻觉合成假内容，违反了医学图像对视觉真实溯源的要求，且多依赖未来帧无法在线实时工作。
method: 提出TransGHOST系统，采用因果参考引导且完全免合成的非生成式安全流程。该方法仅基于可见区域拟合的几何变换，对先前已记录的历史帧进行重采样以还原遮挡像素；同时提供逐像素的置信度与来源追踪，对缺乏足够支持信息的像素进行弃权标记（abstentions）；并配备了区域感知的参考帧选择机制。
results: 在犬白内障手术临床数据集上，安全模式下的掩码PSNR达到31.89 dB，掩码SSIM达到0.915，中位延迟仅为51.7 ms（95%分位为85.5 ms）；在未参与分割训练的留出集上掩码PSNR达到29.83 dB，相较于LaMa生成式修复取得了3.45 dB的优势；区域感知参考选择机制比单纯使用最近帧提升了3.60 dB。
conclusion: TransGHOST证明了在无需生成式幻觉合成的情况下，通过因果参考引导和几何变换重采样，能够以实时延迟和高保真度恢复显微手术中被器械遮挡的真实组织细节，为机器人辅助手术与术中感知提供了安全可靠的新方案。

title: Normalizing Flows for Classical Simulation of Quantum Circuits in Phase Space
authors: Edward Jiang, Timothy Heightman, Marcin Płodzień
abstract: We present a novel framework to learn a representation of quantum circuits based on the phase space formulation of many-body systems. Given that $N$-qubit states can be represented as probability distributions on a smooth $2N$-dimensional manifold, we show how unitary gates can be parameterized as normalizing flows between these distributions, opening a new avenue for quantum circuit simulation using generative models. We evaluate our method on three common families of quantum circuits, and show that its accuracy exceeds that of current state-of-the-art neural network methods for large system sizes.
zh_title: 相空间中用于量子线路经典模拟的归一化流
translation: 我们提出了一种基于多体系统相空间表述学习量子线路表示的新型框架。鉴于 $N$ 量子比特态可以表示为光滑 $2N$ 维流形上的概率分布，我们展示了如何将酉门参数化为这些分布之间的归一化流，从而为使用生成模型进行量子线路模拟开辟了一条新途径。我们在三类常见的量子线路族上评估了我们的方法，并证明在大系统尺寸下，其精度超过了当前最先进的神经网络方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于相空间表述和归一化流的生成模型框架，在大尺寸系统下实现了精度超越现有SOTA神经网络的量子线路经典模拟。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将量子物理中的相空间表述与机器学习中的归一化流（Normalizing Flows）相结合，把量子态的演化转化为流形概率分布间的变换，为量子线路的经典模拟提供了基于生成模型的新范式。实验表明其在大尺寸体系中优于现有神经网络方法，具有重要价值；但局限在于摘要未详细说明该方法的计算复杂度及可扩展的具体规模上限。
motivation: 探索基于生成模型和多体系统相空间表述的量子线路经典模拟新途径。
method: 基于多体系统的相空间表述，将N量子比特态表示为光滑2N维流形上的概率分布，并将量子酉门参数化为这些概率分布之间的归一化流（normalizing flows），借此学习量子线路的表示。
results: 在三类常见量子线路族上的评估表明，对于大系统尺寸，该方法的模拟精度超过了当前最先进的神经网络方法。
conclusion: 利用归一化流参数化相空间中的概率分布演化，为量子电路模拟开辟了一条有效的新途径，且在大规模系统上展现出超越现有最先进神经网络方法的模拟精度。

title: On the Spectral Estimation of VARMA Processes
authors: Bin Zhu, Mattia Zorzi
abstract: We consider the problem of estimating the power spectral density of a Vector-valued Autoregressive Moving-Average (VARMA) process. A well-established approach to accomplishing this task consists of formulating a moment problem that selects the spectral density maximizing an entropy-like index while matching certain moments of the underlying process. However, existing methods assume that the moving-average (MA) component is either fixed or scalar, thereby reducing the class of ARMA models over which the optimal spectral density is sought. In this paper, we propose a new moment problem, based on the notion of transportation entropy, for learning the spectral density of a VARMA process without fixing the MA component or restricting it to be scalar.
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures with the IEEE Transactions template
translation: 我们考虑估计向量自回归滑动平均（VARMA）过程的功率谱密度问题。解决该任务的一种成熟方法是构建一个矩问题，该问题在匹配底层过程某些矩的同时，选择使类熵指标最大化的谱密度。然而，现有方法假设滑动平均（MA）分量要么是固定的，要么是标量，从而缩小了寻找最优谱密度的ARMA模型类别。在本文中，我们基于运输熵的概念提出了一种新的矩问题，用于在不固定MA分量或不将其限制为标量的情况下学习VARMA过程的谱密度。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于运输熵的新矩问题，用于在无需固定或限制MA分量为标量的情况下估计VARMA过程的功率谱密度。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于引入了运输熵（transportation entropy）这一概念来构建矩问题，从而突破了以往方法必须将VARMA模型的MA分量固定或假设为标量的理论瓶颈，拓展了谱估计在多变量系统中的泛化能力与表达自由度。其局限在于摘要中未提供具体的优化求解算法复杂度及实证/数值实验结果。
motivation: 现有的基于最大化类熵指标并匹配过程矩的谱估计方法，通常假定滑动平均（MA）分量是预先固定或为标量的，这显著缩小了可搜索最优谱密度的ARMA模型类别。
method: 提出了一种基于运输熵（transportation entropy）的新矩问题（moment problem），在无需固定MA分量或限制其为标量的情况下学习VARMA过程的谱密度。
results: 提出了一种全新的基于运输熵的矩问题公式化方法，克服了MA分量需为固定或标量的约束（具体数值与实验结果在摘要中未提及，Not mentioned in abstract）。
conclusion: 通过引入基于运输熵的新型矩问题，成功打破了以往VARMA谱估计对MA分量的强加限制，为更广泛类别的VARMA过程提供了更为灵活通用的谱密度估计框架。

title: Mixed-integer dual network problems are solvable in strongly polynomial time
authors: Giacomo Zambelli
abstract: In this paper we show that mixed-integer linear programming is solvable in strongly polynomial time if the constraint matrix is totally unimodular with at most two nonzero entries in every row. This is done by reducing the problem to an instance of minimization of an $L$-convex function.
zh_title: 混合整数对偶网络问题可在强多项式时间内求解
translation: 在本文中，我们证明了如果约束矩阵是全单模的且每行至多包含两个非零元素，则混合整数线性规划问题可在强多项式时间内求解。这是通过将该问题规约为一个L-凸函数极小化问题来实现的。
tldr: 论文证明了约束矩阵为全单模且每行至多有两个非零元的混合整数线性规划问题可在强多项式时间内求解。
ai_comments: 该研究的重要意义在于将运筹学中的经典混合整数线性规划问题与离散凸分析（L-凸函数极小化）紧密结合，为具有全单模网络结构的混合整数问题建立了强多项式时间算法的理论保证，展示了离散凸分析解决组合优化复杂度问题的强大潜力。
motivation: 探究具有特定矩阵结构（全单模且行稀疏）的混合整数线性规划问题是否存在强多项式时间求解算法。
method: 将该混合整数规划问题规约为最小化一个 $L$-凸函数（L-convex function）的优化问题。
results: 证明了当约束矩阵为全单模且每行至多包含两个非零元时，混合整数线性规划问题可在强多项式时间内求解。
conclusion: 混合整数对偶网络问题（具有全单模且每行至多两个非零元的约束矩阵）可在强多项式时间内求解。

title: Thermodynamics of words
authors: Klaus M. Frahm, Dima L. Shepelyansky
abstract: We introduce the word thermalization hypothesis according to which in a literary work there are effective interactions between words that drive them to thermalization where their word frequency distribution is the same as for the phenomenon of Rayleigh-Jeans (RJ) thermalization and condensation. In this concept, the different words play a role of classical oscillators (particles) and their word frequencies, or related tokens, are analogous to certain filling factors over energy state levels. The thermalization process is characterized by the conservation of total system energy, or total number of words/tokens, and total probability norm, or total number of different words. We apply this approach to analyze 16 literary works, including Bible, complete works of Shakespeare, and data from American National Corpus. We show that for these cases the effective system energy is very low and thus there is the RJ condensation phenomenon with a big fraction of total probability concentrated at the lowest energy states corresponding to a big fraction of rare words appearing only once or twice in the whole text. Such a RJ condensation is observed for light propagation in multimode optical fibers and other physical systems. We relate the thermalization of words to the recently proposed wealth thermalization for households in world countries. The economy concepts of Lorenz and Pareto curves, and also Zipf curves, are applied to the word frequency distributions of the selected 16 cases and it is shown that the thermalization theory gives a strikingly good description of real data.
comment: 30 pages, 6 main figures, 14 appendix figures, journal style file and bbl file for references provided
translation: 我们提出了词汇热化假设。根据该假设，在文学作品中，词汇之间存在有效相互作用，促使它们趋于热化，其词频分布与瑞利-金斯（Rayleigh-Jeans, RJ）热化和凝聚现象中的分布相同。在该概念中，不同的词汇扮演着经典振子（粒子）的角色，其词频或相关标记（tokens）类似于跨能级状态的某些填充因子。热化过程的特征表现为系统总能量（即总词数/标记数）和总概率模长（即不同词汇的总数）守恒。我们应用该方法分析了16部文学作品，包括《圣经》、莎士比亚全集以及来自美国国家语料库的数据。我们表明，在这些案例中，系统的有效能量非常低，因此存在RJ凝聚现象，即总概率的很大一部分集中在最低能级状态，这对应于在整个文本中仅出现一两次的罕见词所占的极大比例。这种RJ凝聚现象同样在多模光纤的光传播及其他物理系统中被观察到。我们还将词汇的热化与最近提出的全球各国家庭财富热化联系起来。将洛伦兹曲线、帕累托曲线以及齐夫曲线等经济学概念应用于所选16个案例的词频分布中，结果表明热化理论对真实数据给出了惊人准确的描述。
tldr: 该论文提出词汇热化假设，将文本中的词频分布成功映射到统计物理中的瑞利-金斯热化与凝聚现象。
ai_comments: 该研究将统计物理中的瑞利-金斯热化与凝聚理论跨学科引入语言学和文本统计分析，为经典的齐夫定律提供了新颖的热力学物理机制解释。其局限在于仅基于统计类比与经验数据拟合，文本中单词之间深层次的语义与句法结构相互作用在热力学框架下的微观动力学机制仍有待深入探讨。
motivation: 探索文学作品中词汇分布的物理本质与规律，提出词汇间存在有效相互作用驱动其达到热平衡的假设，以提供解释词频分布现象的新物理视角。
method: 将文学作品中的不同词汇类比为经典振子（粒子），词频类比为能级填充因子，基于总词数（能量守恒）和不同词汇总数（几率守恒）建立热化模型，并结合洛伦兹曲线、帕累托曲线和齐夫曲线等经济学/统计学工具，对包括《圣经》、莎士比亚全集及美国国家语料库数据在内的16部文学作品进行分析。
results: 分析显示所选文学作品的有效系统能量极低，表现出瑞利-金斯凝聚现象，即大部分总几率集中在最低能级状态（对应于全篇仅出现一两次的罕见词）；该热化模型对16个案例的实际词频分布提供了高度契合的定量描述。
conclusion: 词汇热化理论能够极其出色地描述真实文学文本中的词频分布，表明文本中词汇分布遵循与物理系统类似的统计热力学规律。

title: Safe and Scalable Minimax Adaptive Control of Positive Systems
authors: Fethi Bencherki, David Ohlin, Tomas Meijer
abstract: This paper studies minimax adaptive control of positive linear systems with fixed unknown dynamics and nonnegative disturbances. We reformulate the problem by compressing the historical data into a vector and a positivity-induced consistency set containing the models compatible with the observations. Together with the physical state, these quantities form a sufficient information state and yield an exact reformulation as a standard minimax dynamic game. We allow the admissible input set to adapt to the current consistency set, ensuring positivity for every remaining feasible model. As inconsistent models are eliminated, the input set can expand, allowing less cautious control actions. For finite model sets, we derive an explicit solution to the Bellman inequality and construct a safe and stabilizing certainty-equivalence controller with robustness guarantees. The framework also accommodates structured classes of continuum model uncertainty whose consistency sets admit fixed, finite-dimensional representations, enabling scalable information-state updates.
zh_title: 正系统的安全且可扩展的极小极大自适应控制
translation: 本文研究了具有固定未知动态和非负扰动的正线性系统的极小极大自适应控制。我们通过将历史数据压缩为一个向量和一个由正性诱导的一致性集（包含与观测相兼容的模型）来重构该问题。这些量与物理状态共同构成了一个充分信息状态，并实现了向标准极小极大动态博弈的精确重构。我们允许容许输入集自适应于当前的一致性集，从而确保每一个剩余可行模型的正性。随着不一致模型的消除，输入集可以扩展，从而允许采用不那么保守的控制动作。对于有限模型集，我们推导出了贝尔曼不等式的显式解，并构建了具有鲁棒性保证的安全且镇定的确定性等价控制器。该框架还适用于一致性集允许固定有限维表示的结构化连续模型不确定性类别，从而实现了可扩展的信息状态更新。
tldr: 提出了一种针对未知正线性系统的极小极大自适应控制方法，通过在线更新一致性集与动态扩展输入集，实现了安全、鲁棒镇定且可扩展的控制。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地利用正系统的特性构造了基于历史数据压缩的一致性集和充分信息状态，不仅将自适应控制问题转化为极小极大动态博弈，还实现了容许输入集随模型在线剔除而自适应放宽，有效降低了保守性。此外，对于具有有限维表示的连续模型不确定性的支持，显著提升了算法在计算上的可扩展性。
motivation: 针对包含固定未知动态和非负扰动的正线性系统，解决在严格保证系统正性与安全性的前提下，如何降低控制保守性并实现可扩展的极小极大自适应控制。
method:
1. 将历史数据压缩为一个向量和一个正性诱导的一致性集，与物理状态共同构建充分信息状态，将问题精确重构为标准极小极大动态博弈；
2. 使容许输入集自适应于当前一致性集，随不一致模型的排除动态扩展输入集；
3. 针对有限模型集，推导贝尔曼不等式的显式解，并构建具备鲁棒保证的安全镇定确定性等价控制器；
4. 面向一致性集具备固定有限维表示的结构化连续模型不确定性，提供可扩展的信息状态更新方案。
results: 成功将问题转化为标准极小极大动态博弈；随着不一致模型的消除实现了输入集的扩展以采取更积极的控制；推导了有限模型集下贝尔曼不等式的显式解并构建了鲁棒镇定控制器；实现了连续模型不确定性下的可扩展信息状态更新。
conclusion: 该方法为含未知动态和非负扰动的正线性系统提供了一种既能严格保证系统正性与鲁棒镇定性，又能兼顾计算可扩展性和降低控制保守性的极小极大自适应控制框架。

title: Discrete-Time Stochastic Control Beyond i.i.d. Noise
authors: Reyajul Hasan Leon, Ali Devran Kara
abstract: We study discrete-time stochastic control problems where the noise driving the state dynamics is a stationary infinite-order chain rather than an i.i.d. sequence. We formulate the problem as a controlled Markov process by enlarging the state space to include the posterior distribution of the noise given the state-action history. Assuming that the sensitivity of the noise transition kernel to past noise values decays exponentially, we show that the expected total variation distance between the full-history and finite-memory noise filters decays at rate $\sqrt{N}ρ^{\sqrt{N}}$. We use this result to construct finite-memory control models and establish explicit near-optimality bounds for their policies. Finally, under suitable ergodicity conditions, we show that Q-learning converges to the optimal solution of the approximate model, so the same performance bounds apply to the learned policies.
zh_title: 超越独立同分布噪声的离散时间随机控制
translation: 我们研究了离散时间随机控制问题，其中驱动状态动态的噪声是平稳的无限阶链，而非独立同分布（i.i.d.）序列。我们通过扩大状态空间以纳入给定状态-动作历史的噪声后验分布，将该问题表述为一个受控马尔可夫过程。假设噪声转移核对历史噪声值的敏感性呈指数衰减，我们证明了全历史与有限记忆噪声滤波器之间的期望全变差距离以 $\sqrt{N}\rho^{\sqrt{N}}$ 的速率衰减。我们利用这一结果构建了有限记忆控制模型，并为其策略建立了明确的近似最优性界限。最后，在适当的遍历性条件下，我们证明了Q-learning收敛到该近似模型的最优解，因此相同的性能界限同样适用于学得的策略。
tldr: 本文研究了由无限阶相关噪声驱动的离散时间随机控制问题，提出了具有明确理论性能界的有限记忆近似模型，并证明了Q-learning在其中的收敛性。
ai_comments: 该论文的重要创新在于突破了传统随机控制对系统噪声为独立同分布（i.i.d.）序列的强依赖，推广至无限阶记忆的复杂相关噪声。作者给出了滤波误差以 $\sqrt{N}\rho^{\sqrt{N}}$ 快速衰减的严谨理论保证，并为RL算法（Q-learning）在非i.i.d.噪声下的收敛性提供了理论支撑。潜在局限是其依赖于转移敏感度指数衰减等理论假设，在具有重尾或极强长程相关性的实际物理系统中可能受限。
motivation: 传统的离散时间随机控制通常假设驱动状态动态的噪声是独立同分布（i.i.d.）的，无法直接刻画和处理具有长期依赖与非马尔可夫特性的时间相关噪声。
method: 通过将状态空间扩充以纳入基于状态-动作历史的噪声后验分布，将非i.i.d.噪声驱动的系统表述为受控马尔可夫过程；在噪声转移核敏感度指数衰减假设下，利用截断历史构建有限记忆滤波和有限记忆控制模型，并应用Q-learning进行策略学习。
results: 证明了全历史与有限记忆噪声滤波器之间的期望全变差距离以 $\sqrt{N}\rho^{\sqrt{N}}$ 的速率衰减；为有限记忆控制策略推导了明确的近似最优性界；证明了在遍历性条件下Q-learning能够收敛到近似模型的最优解，并继承相应的性能界。
conclusion: 具有无限阶历史依赖噪声的随机控制问题可以通过有限记忆滤波有效近似，且对应的近似控制模型及通过Q-learning学得的策略具有可证明的近似最优性性能界。

title: Asymptotically good codes from Siegel modular varieties
authors: Yota Maeda
abstract: We construct asymptotically good codes by evaluating Siegel modular forms at superspecial points on congruence towers of Siegel modular varieties. For every genus $g\ge2$ and every fixed weight $w\ge g+1$, the construction gives such a family in sufficiently large characteristic, over a finite field which is independent of the level of the tower. The towers can be chosen so that this field is $\mathbb{F}_{p^2}$. We give an explicit lower bound for the asymptotic rate. The lower bound for the relative minimum distance follows from the Pieri formula on the space of flags in the Hodge bundle and an intersection argument along its strata. We also prove that, for $p\ge5$ and $0\le w\le p+1$, the kernel of evaluation in every genus consists precisely of the multiples of the ordinary Hasse invariant. For $g=2,3$, the geometry of the supersingular locus gives explicit bounds for the relative minimum distance and recovery sets whose sizes are bounded independently of the level.
translation: 我们通过在Siegel模簇同余塔的超特殊点上对Siegel模形式求值，构造了渐近好码。对于任意亏格 $g\ge2$ 和任意固定权 $w\ge g+1$，该构造在充分大的特征下给出了这样的码族，其定义在独立于塔水平的有限域上。塔的选择可使得该有限域为 $\mathbb{F}_{p^2}$。我们给出了渐近码率的显式下界。相对最小距离的下界由Hodge丛中旗空间上的Pieri公式以及沿其层的相交论证得出。我们还证明了对于 $p\ge5$ 且 $0\le w\le p+1$，在每个亏格中求值的核恰好由普通Hasse不变量的倍数组成。对于 $g=2,3$，超奇异轨迹的几何性质给出了相对最小距离的显式界，以及大小与水平无关的恢复集。
tldr: 本文通过在Siegel模簇同余塔的超特殊点上求值模形式，成功构造了一类渐近好代数几何码，并给出了码率与最小距离的显式界。
ai_comments: 本研究将代数几何码的构造从经典的代数曲线（如模曲线）推广到高维的Siegel模簇上，创新性地结合了Hodge丛的旗流形上的Pieri公式与超特殊点的几何性质，成功突破了高维簇构造渐近好码的技术难点。局限性在于要求特征充分大，且部分显式距离界主要集中在低亏格（g=2, 3）情形。
motivation: 利用高维代数几何对象（特别是高亏格Siegel模簇及其同余塔）构造具有优良渐近性质的代数几何纠错码。
method: 通过在Siegel模簇同余塔的超特殊点上对固定权重的Siegel模形式进行求值来构造编码；利用Hodge丛上旗空间中的Pieri公式及沿其层的相交理论推导相对最小距离下界；利用超奇异轨迹的几何性质研究低亏格（g=2,3）下的显式界与恢复集。
results: 对于任意亏格g>=2和固定权w>=g+1，在充分大特征下构造出定义在独立于塔水平的有限域（如F_{p^2}）上的渐近好码族；给出了渐近信息率的显式下界；证明了当p>=5且0<=w<=p+1时，求值核恰好由普通Hasse不变量的倍数构成；对g=2,3给出了相对最小距离的显式界及大小与水平无关的恢复集。
conclusion: 通过在Siegel模簇全纯塔的超特殊点上求值模形式，可以成功构造出有限域（如F_{p^2}）上的渐近好代数几何码，且其信息率与相对最小距离均具有理论保证。

title: Secure Information Flow in Quantum Programs
authors: Zhicheng Zhang, Mingsheng Ying, Lirong Xia
abstract:
Information-flow security aims to prevent the leakage of confidential information through program execution. This problem becomes fundamentally subtler for quantum programs, because their states may involve superposition and entanglement, and their executions may involve intricate interactions between classical and quantum variables. This paper develops semantic foundations and verification methods for secure information flow in quantum programs. We formulate two notions of information-flow security. The first is a noninterference-based definition that naturally generalizes its classical counterpart. The second is a simulation-based definition that explicitly models an attacker, providing a clear operational interpretation of security. We prove that these two notions are equivalent.
  To verify the information-flow security of quantum programs, we develop a proof framework based on quantum Hoare logic. A key challenge is that the standard self-composition technique, which expresses information-flow security in Hoare logic by composing a program with a renamed copy of itself, fails in the quantum setting due to an obstruction analogous to the no-cloning theorem. To overcome this challenge, we introduce self-conjugation, a novel technique that leverages the deferred measurement principle and properties of unitary operations. We demonstrate our framework on examples drawn from the quantum one-time pad, quantum error correction, and anonymous entanglement generation.
zh_title: 量子程序中的安全信息流
translation: 信息流安全旨在防止通过程序执行泄露机密信息。由于量子程序的状态可能包含叠加和纠缠，且其执行可能涉及经典变量与量子变量之间错综复杂的交互，这一问题在量子程序中变得从根本上更加微妙。本文构建了量子程序中安全信息流的语义基础与验证方法。我们提出了两种信息流安全的概念：第一种是基于无干扰的定义，它自然地推广了其经典对应物；第二种是基于模拟的定义，它显式地对攻击者进行建模，从而为安全性提供了清晰的操作解释。我们证明了这两种概念是等价的。为了验证量子程序的信息流安全性，我们开发了一个基于量子霍尔逻辑的证明框架。一个核心挑战在于，通过将程序与其重命名副本复合以在霍尔逻辑中表达信息流安全的标准自身复合（self-composition）技术，由于类似于不可克隆定理的障碍而在量子场景中失效。为克服这一挑战，我们引入了自共轭（self-conjugation）这一新技术，该技术利用了延迟测量原理和酉操作的性质。我们在来自量子一次一密、量子纠错和匿名纠缠生成的实例上展示了我们的框架。
tldr: 本文提出了量子程序安全信息流的等价语义模型，并引入“自共轭”技术构建了基于量子霍尔逻辑的形式化验证框架。
ai_comments: 本工作的重要性和创新性在于首次针对量子程序建立了严谨的信息流安全语义基础，尤其是创新性地提出了“自共轭”技术，优雅地绕过了量子不可克隆定理对经典验证手段的限制；其局限在于摘要中未提及该方法在更大规模量子程序或含噪声中尺度量子（NISQ）环境下的自动化验证效率和可扩展性。
motivation: 量子程序的状态包含叠加态与纠缠态，且经典变量与量子变量间存在复杂交互，导致机密信息泄漏的防范更为微妙；同时经典信息流安全的标准验证技术因类似量子不可克隆定理的阻碍而无法直接适用于量子程序。
method: 1. 形式化了两种安全概念：基于无干扰（noninterference）的定义和基于模拟器（simulation-based）的定义，并证明两者等价；2. 构建了基于量子霍尔逻辑（Quantum Hoare Logic）的验证框架；3. 提出自共轭（self-conjugation）技术，结合延迟测量原理与酉操作性质，解决了经典自身复合方法在量子系统中的失效难题。
results: 证明了两种量子信息流安全定义在语义上等价，并通过所提出的自共轭和量子霍尔逻辑框架，成功在量子一次一密（Quantum One-time Pad）、量子纠错（QEC）和匿名纠缠生成等典型实例中完成了安全性质验证。
conclusion: 本文建立了量子程序信息流安全的语义基础，证明了两种安全模型的一致性，并通过创新的自共轭技术提供了行之有效的量子程序安全形式化验证框架。

title: Neural network scaling and generalization for 3D strain fields in heterogeneous materials
authors: Lucas Fourel, Paul Devianne, Marine Debouvry, Tristan Destruhaut, Russell Gunn, Ashwini Gupta, Lori Graham-Brady, Jean-François Molinari
abstract: Computational homogenization and coupled multiscale simulations of heterogeneous materials require repeated solution of mechanical fields on Representative Volume Elements, which becomes prohibitively expensive for high-resolution three-dimensional microstructures. Machine-learning surrogates can accelerate these computations, yet most existing approaches predict fields for fixed macroscopic loadings and provide limited guidance on how to scale network architectures for high-resolution 3D tensor-field prediction. This work presents a U-Net surrogate trained to predict the full 36-component strain localization tensor field in voxelized concrete mesostructures at resolutions up to $256^3$. Training localization tensors are generated with an FFT-based linear elastic solver, and an extensive hyperparameter optimization is performed to derive scaling rules and an accuracy-speed trade-off analysis. The results show that only network width and depth need to be scaled with problem complexity, while several conventional U-Net design choices, such as doubling channels after downsampling, are suboptimal for this problem. The final neural network achieves a Mean Absolute Error of 1.118% on both the validation and the held-out test sets, and an inference speedup of approximately 8.7x over the FFT-based solver on an Nvidia H100 GPU. Generalization experiments reveal transfer across aggregate volume fractions and highlight the importance of training on diverse morphologies. To safeguard reliability, a Maximum Mean Discrepancy metric computed on internal feature maps is proposed for detecting out-of-distribution microstructures without costly reference computations.
zh_title: 异质材料中三维应变场的神经网络扩展与泛化
translation: 异质材料的计算均匀化与耦合多尺度模拟需要在代表性体积单元上反复求解力学场，这对于高分辨率三维微观结构而言计算成本极为高昂。机器学习代理模型可以加速这些计算，但大多数现有方法仅针对固定宏观载荷预测场，并且在如何为高分辨率3D张量场预测扩展网络架构方面提供的指导十分有限。本文提出了一个U-Net代理模型，用于预测分辨率高达256^3的体素化混凝土细观结构中的完整36分量应变局部化张量场。利用基于FFT的线弹性求解器生成训练局部化张量，并进行了广泛的超参数优化，以得出缩放规则和精度-速度权衡分析。结果表明，仅需随问题复杂度缩放网络宽度和深度，而一些常规的U-Net设计选择（如在下采样后将通道数加倍）在该问题中并非最优。最终的神经网络在验证集和保留测试集上均取得了1.118%的平均绝对误差，且在Nvidia H100 GPU上相较于基于FFT的求解器实现了约8.7倍的推理加速。泛化实验揭示了模型跨骨料体积分数的迁移能力，并强调了在多样化形态上进行训练的重要性。为确保可靠性，本文提出了一种在内部特征图上计算的最大均值差异（MMD）度量，无需昂贵的参考计算即可检测分布外微观结构。
tldr: 本文提出了一种可扩展的U-Net代理模型，能以8.7倍的加速比高精度预测256^3分辨率混凝土细观结构的全36分量3D应变局部化张量场，并引入内部特征图MMD度量进行分布外检测。
ai_comments: 该研究的重要创新在于突破了传统代理模型仅针对固定载荷预测的限制，直接预测包含全36个分量的3D应变局部化张量场，并针对高分辨率网格系统性探讨了U-Net的缩放规律，推翻了下采样后通道倍增的传统设定。此外，引入基于特征图的MMD进行轻量化分布外检测，显著提升了工程实用性。局限性在于目前数据和模型仍建立在线弹性本构假设下，未涉及材料非线性及损伤演化。
motivation: 异质材料的计算均匀化和多尺度模拟需要反复求解代表性体积单元（RVE）上的力学场，对于高分辨率3D微观结构计算开销极大。现有机器学习代理模型大多仅预测特定宏观载荷下的场，且对高分辨率3D张量场预测的网络架构缩放缺乏指导。
method: 构建了一个U-Net代理模型，用于在最高达256^3分辨率的体素化混凝土细观结构上预测全部36个分量的应变局部化张量场。采用基于FFT的线弹性求解器生成训练数据，通过广泛的超参数优化探索架构缩放规则与精度-速度权衡；并提出利用内部特征图计算的最大均值差异（MMD）度量来检测分布外微观结构。
results: 发现仅需随问题复杂度缩放网络宽度和深度，而传统的下采样后通道翻倍等U-Net设计在此场景下为次优选择；网络在验证集与保留测试集上的平均绝对误差（MAE）均为1.118%，在Nvidia H100 GPU上比FFT求解器加速约8.7倍；泛化实验证实了跨骨料体积分数的迁移性，且MMD度量可在无需参考计算的情况下成功识别分布外结构。
conclusion: 通过对网络宽度与深度进行针对性扩展，U-Net代理模型能够高效且高精度地预测高分辨率3D应变局部化张量场；结合基于内部特征图的MMD分布外检测，为高保真材料多尺度模拟提供了一种兼具计算效率与工程可靠性的加速范式。

title: You Can Have It All: Small sparse induced-universal graphs for minor-closed classes
authors: Vida Dujmović, Cyril Gavoille, Gwenaël Joret, Piotr Micek, Pat Morin, David R. Wood
abstract:
We show that, for every fixed proper minor-closed graph class $\mathcal{G}$ and every positive integer $n$, there exists a graph $U_n$ with $n^{1+o(1)}$ vertices and edges such that every $n$-vertex graph in $\mathcal{G}$ is isomorphic to an induced subgraph of $U_n$.
  This result generalizes and unifies the results of Dujmović et al. (J. ACM 2021) on induced-universal graphs and the results of Esperet, Joret, and Morin (J. London Math. Soc. 2023) on sparse induced-universal graphs from planar graphs to all proper minor-closed graph classes. It simultaneously improves the previous bounds for the number of vertices in induced-universal graphs (previously $O(n^2)$ obtained as a corollary of a result of DeVos et al. (J. Comb. Theory, Ser. {B} 2004) and a result of Gavoille and Labourel (ESA 2007)) and the number of edges in subgraph-universal graphs (previously $O(n^{3/2})$ by Babai et al. (Theory and Practice of Combinatorics 1982)).
comment: Extends the results in arXiv:2605.06616 to produce induced-universal graphs with $n^{1+o(1)}$ edges and vertices
zh_title: 鱼与熊掌兼得：面向真子式闭合类的小型稀疏导出泛图
translation: 我们证明了，对于每一个固定的真子式闭合图类 $\mathcal{G}$ 以及每一个正整数 $n$，都存在一个具有 $n^{1+o(1)}$ 个顶点和边的图 $U_n$，使得 $\mathcal{G}$ 中的每一个 $n$ 阶图都同构于 $U_n$ 的一个导出子图。这一结果推广并统一了 Dujmović 等人（J. ACM 2021）关于导出泛图的结果，以及 Esperet、Joret 和 Morin（J. London Math. Soc. 2023）关于稀疏导出泛图的结果，将结论从平面图推广到所有真子式闭合图类。同时，该结果改进了以往导出泛图中顶点数的界（此前为由 DeVos 等人（J. Comb. Theory, Ser. B 2004）和 Gavoille 与 Labourel（ESA 2007）的结果推得的 $O(n^2)$），以及子图泛图中边数的界（此前为 Babai 等人（Theory and Practice of Combinatorics 1982）给出的 $O(n^{3/2})$）。
keywords: 子式闭合图类 (Minor-closed graph classes)
tldr: 证明了对任意真子式闭合图类均存在顶点和边数均为 $n^{1+o(1)}$ 的导出泛图，将平面图泛图理论推广至一般子式闭合类并大幅刷新了界限。
ai_comments: 该研究在结构图论和极值图论领域具有显著的重要性。它不仅将前人针对平面图取得的前沿成果成功推广至所有真子式闭合图类，而且同时在顶点数和边数两项指标上打破了数十年来多项式阶的界限（从 $O(n^2)$ 和 $O(n^{3/2})$ 优化至近线性的 $n^{1+o(1)}$），实现了兼具“紧致”与“稀疏”的最优性质。
motivation: 寻求规模更小、更稀疏的导出泛图，解决先前对于真子式闭合图类在顶点数（$O(n^2)$）和边数（$O(n^{3/2})$）上的界限瓶颈，并将平面图上的泛图结果推广至所有真子式闭合图类。
results: 证明了对于任意固定的真子式闭合图类 $\mathcal{G}$ 和任意正整数 $n$，存在一个顶点数和边数均为 $n^{1+o(1)}$ 的图 $U_n$，使得 $\mathcal{G}$ 中任意 $n$ 顶点的图都同构于 $U_n$ 的导出子图；同时大幅改进了此前导出泛图顶点数（$O(n^2)$）以及子图泛图边数（$O(n^{3/2})$）的界。
conclusion: 成功证实了对于所有真子式闭合图类，均存在大小和边数都达到近线性规模 $n^{1+o(1)}$ 的稀疏导出泛图，统一并推广了该领域的现有成果。

title: On Federated Averaging with Partial Participation under a General Variance Condition
authors: Ziming Wang, Kun Huang, Karl Henrik Johansson, Shi Pu
abstract: In this paper, we study the convergence of Federated Averaging (FedAvg) with partial participation under a general variance condition. In each communication round, the server samples $S$ of the $n$ clients uniformly at random without replacement. The stochastic gradients are assumed to satisfy the so-called ABC condition, which allows their variance to grow with the local objective gaps. For smooth nonconvex objectives, we establish a finite-time stationarity bound in terms of the heterogeneity measure $σ_f^\star:=f^\star-\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n f_i^\star$ and the client sampling factor $I_S:=(n-S)/(n-1)$. Here, $f^\star$ and $f_i^\star$ denote the infima of the global average objective and client $i$'s local objective, respectively. The bound exhibits a linear speedup in the number of sampled clients $S$ and recovers the full-participation result when $S=n$. Under diminishing stepsizes, we further prove that the gradient norm converges to zero both in expectation and almost surely. Notably, compared with existing analyses of FedAvg with partial participation, our results require no additional data heterogeneity assumption such as bounded gradient dissimilarity (BGD), and the sampling-induced term in our bound is not amplified by the number of local updates at the leading order. The importance of removing the BGD assumption is illustrated by an example that is smooth and lower bounded but violates BGD, yet is covered by our analysis.
zh_title: 通用方差条件下具有部分参与的联邦平均算法研究
translation: 在本文中，我们研究了在通用方差条件下具有部分参与的联邦平均算法（FedAvg）的收敛性。在每个通信轮次中，服务器从 $n$ 个客户端中均匀随机且无放回地采样 $S$ 个客户端。假设随机梯度满足所谓的ABC条件，该条件允许其方差随着局部目标函数差距而增长。对于平滑非凸目标，我们根据异质性度量 $σ_f^\star:=f^\star-\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n f_i^\star$ 和客户端采样因子 $I_S:=(n-S)/(n-1)$ 建立了有限时间平稳性界。其中，$f^\star$ 和 $f_i^\star$ 分别表示全局平均目标函数和客户端 $i$ 的局部目标函数的下确界。该界展示了关于采样客户端数量 $S$ 的线性加速，并在 $S=n$ 时恢复为全参与的结果。在递减步长下，我们进一步证明了梯度范数在期望意义下和几乎必然意义下均收敛至零。值得注意的是，与现有的部分参与FedAvg分析相比，我们的结果不需要诸如梯度相异度有界（BGD）等额外的数据异质性假设，并且在我们的界中，由采样引起的项在主导阶上不会被局部更新的次数所放大。通过一个平滑且有下界但违反BGD、却被我们分析所涵盖的例子，说明了消除BGD假设的重要性。
tldr: 本文在更通用的ABC方差条件下证明了部分参与FedAvg算法的收敛性与线性加速，成功去除了有界梯度相异度（BGD）假设。
ai_comments: 该研究的重要价值在于摆脱了以往文献中常见且过于苛刻的“有界梯度相异度（BGD）”假设，引入了更符合实际的ABC通用方差条件。同时，证明了采样项在主导阶上不随局部迭代步数放大，并给出几乎必然收敛性，理论分析非常扎实且具有普适性。局限在于目前主要局限于客户端均匀无放回采样的设定。
motivation: 现有的部分参与FedAvg理论分析往往依赖于较强的额外数据异质性假设（如有界梯度相异度BGD），且所采用的方差假设较为受限，限制了理论在复杂非独立同分布场景中的有效性。
method: 在平滑非凸目标和随机梯度满足ABC通用方差条件下，对每轮无放回均匀随机采样 $S$ 个客户端的FedAvg算法进行收敛性分析，引入异质性度量 $\sigma_f^\star$ 和采样因子 $I_S$ 构建分析框架。
results: 建立了平滑非凸条件下的有限时间平稳性界，实现了采样客户端数 $S$ 的线性加速并在 $S=n$ 时退化为全参与结果；在递减步长下证明了梯度范数在期望和几乎必然意义下收敛到零；完全移除了BGD假设，且采样误差项在主导阶上不随局部更新步数放大。
conclusion: 在通用方差条件下，部分参与的FedAvg算法无需依赖有界梯度相异度（BGD）强假设即可实现平滑非凸优化的严格收敛，且具备线性采样加速特性。

title: Quantum-Assisted Counterfactual Regret Minimization for Bounded-Payoff Imperfect-Information Games
authors: Gabriel Maresch, Erik Schulze, Jnan Yalla
abstract: Imperfect-information games with a graded-reward structure present significant computational challenges for equilibrium computation, since the payoff expectations must be estimated across exponentially large strategy spaces. Counterfactual Regret Minimization over the years has proven effective for approximating Nash equilibria, but Monte Carlo variants create a large overhead of sampling costs when the counterfactual values are estimated from sampled game-tree trajectories. We propose a novel Quantum-Assisted Counterfactual Regret Minimization, a framework that uses Quantum Amplitude Estimation to reduce the computational complexity of the regret updates in bounded-payoff imperfect-information games, while preserving the convergence of its classical counterpart. We give a theoretical analysis of the resulting exploitability bound, discuss NISQ-compatible amplitude-estimation variants, the structure of their resource requirements, and outline what is needed to validate the potential advantage empirically.
zh_title: 面向有界收益不完全信息博弈的量子辅助反事实遗憾最小化
translation: 具有分级奖励结构的不完全信息博弈给均衡计算带来了显著的计算挑战，因为收益期望必须在呈指数级庞大的策略空间中进行估计。多年来，反事实遗憾最小化（CFR）已被证明在近似纳什均衡方面非常有效，但当从采样的博弈树轨迹中估计反事实价值时，其蒙特卡洛变体会产生巨大的采样开销。我们提出了一种新颖的量子辅助反事实遗憾最小化框架，该框架利用量子振幅估计来降低有界收益不完全信息博弈中遗憾更新的计算复杂度，同时保持其经典对应算法的收敛性。我们对所得的可利用度界限进行了理论分析，讨论了兼容NISQ的振幅估计变体及其资源需求结构，并概述了在经验上验证该潜在优势所需的条件。
tldr: 提出了一种利用量子振幅估计加速反事实遗憾最小化（CFR）更新的框架，在保持经典算法收敛性的同时降低了计算复杂度。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将量子计算（量子振幅估计，QAE）与博弈论经典算法（反事实遗憾最小化，CFR）相结合，为缓解蒙特卡洛采样的高昂开销提供了新的理论加速途径，同时考虑了当前NISQ硬件的兼容性。其局限在于摘要并未提供具体的经验实证或真机实验结果，实际的量子加速优势仍停留在理论界限分析层面，落地效果尚待验证。
motivation: 在具有分级奖励结构的不完全信息博弈中估计收益期望需要遍历指数级策略空间；经典蒙特卡洛反事实遗憾最小化（MCCFR）在从采样轨迹估计反事实价值时存在极大的采样计算开销。
method: 提出了一种量子辅助反事实遗憾最小化（Quantum-Assisted Counterfactual Regret Minimization）框架，利用量子振幅估计（Quantum Amplitude Estimation, QAE）来降低遗憾更新的计算复杂度，并针对NISQ设备设计了兼容的振幅估计变体及分析其资源需求。
results: 给出了算法可利用度界限（exploitability bound）的理论分析，探讨了兼容NISQ设备的振幅估计变体与资源需求结构，并梳理了经验验证其潜在优势所需的前提条件。
conclusion: 量子辅助反事实遗憾最小化框架能够在保持经典算法收敛性的同时，降低有界收益不完全信息博弈中遗憾更新的计算复杂度，为博弈均衡求解提供了理论上的量子加速潜力。

title: From Worst-Case to Smoothed Complexity in Continuous Optimization
authors: Daniel Cortild, Coralia Cartis
abstract: Worst-case complexity bounds often fail to reflect the practical performance of optimization algorithms, while average-case complexity heavily relies on the distribution of the input. In this work, we develop a smoothed-analysis framework for classical continuous optimization algorithms by studying their behaviour on random perturbations of arbitrary functions. Our main contribution is to apply methods suited for non-degenerate functions to perturbations of degenerate functions, thereby recovering the faster best-known rates for the non-degenerate class. We derive smoothed complexity guarantees for several standard methods, including (Accelerated) Gradient Descent, Conjugate Gradient, and Newton-type methods, under various settings including nonconvex ones, and show that these bounds can substantially improve upon their worst-case guarantees, bringing them closer to the practical behaviour of the respective methods.
zh_title: 从最坏情况到连续优化中的平滑复杂度
translation: 最坏情况复杂度界限通常无法反映优化算法的实际性能，而平均情况复杂度又严重依赖于输入分布。在这项工作中，我们通过研究经典连续优化算法在任意函数的随机扰动上的行为，开发了一个平滑分析框架。我们的主要贡献是将适用于非退化函数的方法应用于退化函数的扰动，从而恢复非退化函数类已知的更快收敛速率。我们推导了几种标准方法在包括非凸设置在内的多种情境下的平滑复杂度保证，这些方法包括（加速）梯度下降、共轭梯度和牛顿型方法，并表明这些界限可以显著优于它们的最坏情况保证，使其更接近各自方法的实际行为表现。
tldr: 本文提出了连续优化算法的平滑分析框架，证明了在对函数施加随机扰动后，梯度下降和牛顿法等经典算法的收敛速度显著优于最坏情况界限。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新之处在于将理论计算机科学中经典的平滑分析思想系统地拓展到了连续优化领域，通过研究退化函数的随机扰动，成功解释了实际中算法往往比理论最坏情况运行得更快的现象。该研究涵盖了从一阶加速算法到二阶牛顿法等多种核心算法，理论价值重大；其潜在局限在于摘要未详细说明具体的扰动分布假设及其对实际问题建模的普适程度。
motivation: 优化算法的最坏情况复杂度界往往过于悲观、无法反映其实际优异表现，而平均情况复杂度又过度依赖对输入分布的预设假设。
method: 建立了一个针对连续优化算法的平滑分析（Smoothed Analysis）框架，通过研究算法在任意函数的随机扰动下的表现，将适用于非退化函数的方法和分析技术应用到退化函数的扰动上。
results: 为包括（加速）梯度下降、共轭梯度法以及牛顿型方法在内的多种经典优化算法（涵盖非凸环境）推导出了平滑复杂度保证，恢复了非退化情况下的最优已知收敛速率，显著改进了传统的最坏情况理论界。
conclusion: 通过平滑分析框架，可以为经典连续优化算法提供显著优于最坏情况的复杂度理论保证，使其理论界限更加契合实际应用中的良好表现。

title: Bounding and Approximating Kostka Numbers
authors: Jonathan Leake, Zirou Zhang
abstract: Kostka numbers, the coefficients of Schur polynomials, count semistandard Young tableaux of prescribed shape and weight. We give a deterministic algorithm for approximating Kostka numbers within a simply exponential factor in the number of variables and the size of the partition. Our approach combines Gurvits capacity bounds for log-concave polynomials with an algorithm for approximating the Gurvits capacity of a Schur polynomial. For a Schur polynomial in $n$ variables indexed by $λ$, we show that the logarithm of the capacity associated with any nonzero coefficient can be approximated to additive error $ε$ in time polynomial in $n$, $|λ|$, and $\log(1/ε)$. The analysis establishes an explicit bounded optimization region and efficient approximate first-order oracles, and handles boundary weights through a factorization into smaller Schur polynomials.
zh_title: 界定与近似 Kostka 数
translation: Kostka 数作为 Schur 多项式的系数，用于计数具有指定形状和权重的半标准 Young 表。我们提出了一种确定性算法，用于在变量数量和分拆大小的单指数因子内近似 Kostka 数。我们的方法将对数凹多项式的 Gurvits 容量界与用于近似 Schur 多项式 Gurvits 容量的算法相结合。对于由 $λ$ 索引的 $n$ 变量 Schur 多项式，我们证明了与任何非零系数相关的容量的对数可以在关于 $n$、$|λ|$ 和 $\log(1/ε)$ 的多项式时间内被近似到加性误差 $ε$。该分析建立了一个显式的有界优化区域和高效的近似一阶预言机，并通过因式分解为较小的 Schur 多项式来处理边界权重。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合 Gurvits 容量界限与多项式时间容量近似的确定性算法，可在单指数因子内有效近似 Kostka 数。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将代数组合学与凸优化及对数凹多项式分析相结合，通过构造一阶预言机和建立有界优化区域，成功实现了对 Schur 多项式 Gurvits 容量的多项式时间算法近似，为计算组合学中极具挑战的 Kostka 数界定和近似提供了全新的确定性算法框架。
motivation: Kostka 数是 Schur 多项式的系数，用于计算指定形状和权重的半标准 Young 表数量，针对其计算和近似问题需要高效的界定与算法解决方案。
method: 该方法将对数凹多项式的 Gurvits 容量界限与用于近似 Schur 多项式 Gurvits 容量的算法相结合；分析中建立了显式的有界优化区域和高效的近似一阶预言机（first-order oracles），并通过分解为较小的 Schur 多项式来处理边界权重。
results: 给出了一个在变量数和分拆大小的单指数因子内近似 Kostka 数的确定性算法；对于由 $λ$ 索引的 $n$ 变量 Schur 多项式，可在关于 $n$、$|λ|$ 和 $\log(1/ε)$ 的多项式时间内将非零系数相关容量的对数近似到加性误差 $ε$。

title: Compositional random forest
authors: Khaled Masoumifard, Stephan van der Westhuizen, Sugnet Gardner-Lubbe
abstract: Compositional data have been analysed in the literature from three main points of view: directly on the simplex, in log-ratio coordinates, and as directional data on the unit sphere. In this paper, we construct a random forest framework for compositional responses that accommodates all three. Random forests are ensembles of decision trees, and the split criterion determines how each tree grows. We use the log-likelihood gain as the split criterion and consider distributions defined on the different spaces in which compositions can be represented. The Dirichlet likelihood has been studied in the literature, but its covariance is fixed by its mean up to a single scalar, and its maximum likelihood estimator has no closed form. To obtain more flexible criteria, we use two well-known transformations. First, the square-root transformation maps compositions onto the unit sphere, where existing directional distributions require numerical estimation. We introduce a tangent-normal (TN) distribution, which shares its parameters with the Kent distribution, and construct a split criterion whose gain is computed from additive sufficient statistics: the shape parameters are maximised out in closed form, up to an exponentially small truncation constant, so that no parameter is estimated iteratively. Second, the log-ratio transformation maps compositions to Euclidean space, where the multivariate logistic-normal distribution has a flexible covariance and a closed-form maximum log-likelihood, also based on additive sufficient statistics. Both criteria respond to a shift of the mean, measured relative to the covariance, and to a change in the covariance itself. In simulations, the most accurate forest depended on the covariance structure of the composition. The TN forest was the most accurate in two of the three designs.
translation: 成分数据在文献中主要通过三个视角进行分析：直接在单纯形上、在对数比坐标中以及作为单位球面上的方向数据。在本文中，我们针对成分响应变量构建了一个能够包容这三者的随机森林框架。随机森林是决策树的集成，分裂准则决定了每棵树的生长方式。我们使用对数似然增益作为分裂准则，并考虑定义在可表示成分的不同空间上的分布。Dirichlet似然在文献中已得到研究，但其协方差受均值约束仅差一个标量常数，且其极大似然估计没有闭式解。为了获得更灵活的准则，我们使用了两种广为人知的变换。首先，平方根变换将成分映射到单位球面上，而现有的方向分布需要数值估计。我们引入了一种正切正态（TN）分布，该分布与Kent分布共享参数，并构建了一个利用可加充分统计量计算增益的分裂准则：形状参数在闭式下被最大化消除（仅相差一个指数级小的截断常数），因此无需迭代估计任何参数。其次，对数比变换将成分映射到欧氏空间，其中多元逻辑正态分布具有灵活的协方差和基于可加充分统计量的闭式极大对数似然。这两种准则均能对相对于协方差测量的均值漂移以及协方差本身的变化做出响应。在模拟中，最准确的森林取决于成分的协方差结构。TN森林在三种设计中的两种均表现最为优越。
tldr: 提出了一种适用于成分数据的随机森林框架，引入新型正切正态分布并结合对数比变换，实现了高效、灵活且无需数值迭代的分裂准则。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于将成分数据分析的三种几何视角统一到随机森林框架中，并针对单位球面上参数估计难的问题提出了正切正态（TN）分布及其解析分裂准则，大大提高了计算效率；局限在于TN分布的分裂增益在最大化时存在指数级截断常数的近似，且现实复杂高维数据下的表现仍待进一步验证。
motivation: 成分数据在单纯形上的现有Dirichlet似然模型协方差灵活性差且无闭式极大似然估计，而在单位球面上现有的方向分布又需要耗时的数值估计。因此需要构建一种兼顾计算效率（闭式解）和协方差灵活性的成分响应随机森林框架。
method: 以对数似然增益作为分裂准则构建成分随机森林：1）利用平方根变换将成分映射到单位球面，提出与Kent分布共享参数的正切正态（TN）分布，基于可加充分统计量实现无迭代参数闭式最大化；2）利用对数比变换映射到欧氏空间，采用多元逻辑正态分布并基于可加充分统计量计算闭式极大对数似然。两种准则均能灵敏捕捉均值位移及协方差变化。
results: 在模拟实验中，预测精度最高的森林模型取决于成分数据的协方差结构；其中TN随机森林在三种实验设计中的两种均取得了最高的准确率。
conclusion: 对于成分响应变量，最佳的随机森林分裂准则取决于成分数据的协方差结构，所提出的基于正切正态分布的森林模型在多数模拟情形中表现出最优的准确率。

title: Characterizing Fixed-Treewidth Planar Graphs
authors: Laura Merker, Samuel Schneider, Torsten Ueckerdt
abstract: We give the first inductive characterization of planar graphs of treewidth $k$ for each $k \geq 3$. Our definition generalizes the well-known inductive definition of planar $3$-trees and the recent definition of so-called planar quasi-$4$-trees [Förster, 2024]. As a key step, which may be of independent interest, we show that every planar triangulation $G$ of treewidth $k$ admits a tree decomposition of width $k$ where each adhesion set induces a cycle in $G$. As an application of planar quasi-$4$-trees, we show that planar graphs of treewidth at most $4$ have vertex arboricity at most $2$. That is, the vertex-set of every planar graph of treewidth at most $4$ can be partitioned into two sets that each induce a forest.
zh_title: 固定树宽平面图的特征刻画
translation: 我们首次给出了对任意 $k \geq 3$ 的树宽为 $k$ 的平面图的归纳特征刻画。我们的定义推广了著名的平面 3-树的归纳定义以及近期关于所谓平面拟 4-树（planar quasi-4-trees）的定义 [Förster, 2024]。作为可能具有独立研究价值的关键步骤，我们证明了每个树宽为 $k$ 的平面三角剖分图 $G$ 都存在一个宽度为 $k$ 的树分解，其中每个粘合集（adhesion set）都在 $G$ 中诱导出一个圈。作为平面拟 4-树的一个应用，我们证明了树宽至多为 4 的平面图的顶点树度（vertex arboricity）至多为 2。也就是说，每个树宽至多为 4 的平面图的顶点集都可以划分为两个分别诱导出森林的集合。
tldr: 本文首次给出了任意固定树宽 $k \ge 3$ 的平面图的归纳特征刻画，并证明了树宽至多为 4 的平面图的顶点树度至多为 2。
ai_comments: 本研究在图论与图结构理论方面具有重要创新，首次克服了以往仅能处理较小固定树宽的限制，提出了针对任意 $k \ge 3$ 的树宽平面图的通用归纳刻画。文中证明的“粘合集均诱导圈的树分解”技术不仅是核心突破，而且具有独立的结构研究价值。此外，通过解决树宽至多为 4 的平面图的顶点树度问题，展现了该结构理论的实际应用潜力。
motivation: 旨在推广经典的平面 3-树以及近期提出的平面拟 4-树的归纳定义，解决对任意固定树宽 $k \ge 3$ 的平面图进行一般性归纳特征刻画的问题。
method: 通过证明每个树宽为 $k$ 的平面三角剖分图均存在粘合集（adhesion set）诱导成圈的宽度为 $k$ 的树分解，以此作为核心步骤构建了任意 $k \ge 3$ 时的归纳定义，并利用平面拟 4-树性质对顶点集进行诱导森林划分。
results: 1. 首次给出了对任意 $k \ge 3$ 的树宽为 $k$ 的平面图的归纳特征刻画；2. 证明了树宽为 $k$ 的平面三角剖分图存在粘合集诱导成圈的特殊树分解；3. 证明了树宽至多为 4 的平面图的顶点树度至多为 2（顶点集可划分为两个均诱导森林的子集）。
conclusion: 成功建立了固定树宽平面图的普适性归纳特征刻画体系，并证明了树宽至多为 4 的平面图具有至多为 2 的顶点树度。

title: Achieving Robust Channel Estimation Neural Networks on Doppler effects by Designed Training Data
authors: Dianxin Luan, John Thompson
abstract: Channel estimation is crucial in wireless communication systems. Many existing works train and test their models using the same or similar channel. However, practical channels are infinitely diverse and time-variant while data-driven algorithms often degrade on new and previously unseen channels. This prohibits the practical implementation of neural networks for channel estimation, particularly in high speed scenarios characterized by rapidly channel profile changes and very high Doppler shifts.
