method: 提出一种统一事件感知、事件预测与事件调节的事件中心MPC框架；针对包含脉冲神经元基线控制器的扫描反射镜系统，设定实现规定过零时间、扫描范围并最小化机械能传递的控制目标；采用基于采样的算法求解优化问题，无需显式的事件到事件预测模型。
results: 摘要中未提及（Not mentioned in abstract）。
conclusion: 通过将预测优化建立在事件基础之上，该框架为模型预测控制（MPC）的设计及其与神经形态控制的融合开辟了新的研究方向。

title: Direct Trajectory Optimization for Inference-Time Alignment of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
authors: Huixuan Zhang, Li Lin, Junzhe Zhang, Xiaojun Wan
abstract: Alignment of text-to-image diffusion models with reward functions is a key challenge in controllable generation. Existing approaches typically rely on optimizing model inputs or fine-tuning denoising networks, which requires computationally expensive backpropagation through large denoising models. In this work, we propose Direct Trajectory Optimization (DTO), a training-free framework that performs alignment by directly optimizing the sampling trajectory of diffusion models. Specifically, DTO treats intermediate denoising scores and sampled noise as the optimization variables, eliminating the need for gradients through the denoising network. To mitigate the out-of-distribution problem, we introduce Reward-Optimized Score Guidance, which interpolates between the optimized scores and the pretrained model predictions to stabilize sampling, while providing a provable theoretical guarantee of reward improvement under constrained distributions. Empirically, DTO improves alignment performance across three diffusion models on two benchmarks, outperforming existing inference-time alignment methods while maintaining high efficiency. These results suggest that trajectory-level optimization is a promising direction for efficient and effective diffusion model alignment.
zh_title: 用于文本到图像扩散模型推理时对齐的直接轨迹优化
translation: 将文本到图像扩散模型与奖励函数对齐是可控生成中的关键挑战。现有方法通常依赖于优化模型输入或微调去噪网络，这需要通过庞大的去噪模型进行计算成本高昂的反向传播。在这项工作中，我们提出了直接轨迹优化（DTO），这是一种无需训练的框架，通过直接优化扩散模型的采样轨迹来实现对齐。具体而言，DTO将中间去噪分数和采样噪声视为优化变量，消除了通过去噪网络计算梯度的需求。为了缓解分布外（OOD）问题，我们引入了奖励优化分数引导（Reward-Optimized Score Guidance），在优化后的分数与预训练模型预测之间进行插值以稳定采样，同时在约束分布下为奖励提升提供了可证明的理论保证。实验表明，DTO在两个基准测试上的三个扩散模型中均提升了对齐性能，在保持高效率的同时超越了现有的推理时对齐方法。这些结果表明，轨迹级优化是实现高效且有效的扩散模型对齐的一个极具前景的方向。
tldr: 提出了一种无训练的直接轨迹优化（DTO）方法，通过直接优化采样轨迹而非反向传播网络，实现了高效且具理论保障的扩散模型推理时对齐。
ai_comments: 该方法的核心创新在于将优化变量直接设定在采样轨迹的中间分数和噪声上，避开了对大模型网络参数的昂贵反向传播，兼具理论保障（奖励提升）与高效率，为无训练（training-free）的测试时模型对齐提供了新颖且实用的技术路线。
motivation: 现有的文本到图像扩散模型对齐方法通常依赖于优化模型输入或微调去噪网络，这需要穿过庞大去噪模型进行计算成本极高的反向传播。
method: 提出直接轨迹优化（DTO）的无训练框架，将中间去噪分数和采样噪声作为优化变量，无需通过去噪网络进行梯度反向传播；并引入奖励优化分数引导（Reward-Optimized Score Guidance），在优化分数与预训练模型预测之间插值以稳定采样，并在约束分布下提供奖励提升的理论保证。
results: 在两个基准测试和三个扩散模型上的实验表明，DTO提升了对齐性能，在保持高效性的同时超越了现有的推理时对齐方法。
conclusion: 轨迹级优化是实现高效且有效的扩散模型对齐的一个极具前景的研究方向。

title: When to Trust Adaptation: Contextual Fusion for Transferable Vision-Language Prompting
authors: Zhenyuan Chen, Wenshuo Tao, Zhuo Huang, Shuo Chen, Ming-Ming Cheng, Xiang Li
abstract: When a vision-language model encounters a new class or domain, how much should it trust its learned prompts? Because source adaptation can correct pretrained errors on some target images while disturbing valid predictions on others, we introduce Contextual Adaptive Fusion (CAF), which retains four prediction branches by pairing frozen and prompted visual and textual representations. To arbitrate when branches disagree on an image, CAF combines each branch's predictive confidence with how frequently the branches favor its proposed class across the unlabeled target collection, placing greater trust in predictions that are locally confident yet less dominated by collection-wide frequency bias. The fusion coefficients are learned once on source data and remain fixed at inference. Trained on ImageNet, CAF achieves 69.96% average accuracy across ten cross-dataset benchmarks (1.92 percentage points above ManiPT) and remains highly competitive across four ImageNet variants, setting a new best of 52.21% on ImageNet-S. In base-to-novel transfer across eleven datasets, CAF further reaches 79.77% novel-class accuracy and an 82.81% harmonic mean. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenyuanchenai/CAF.
zh_title: 何时信任自适应：用于可迁移视觉-语言提示的上下文融合
translation: 当视觉-语言模型遇到新的类别或领域时，它应该在多大程度上信任其学习到的提示？由于源域自适应可以纠正某些目标图像上的预训练错误，却可能干扰另一些图像上的有效预测，为此我们提出了上下文自适应融合（CAF）。CAF通过配对冻结与提示后的视觉和文本表征，保留了四个预测分支。当这些分支在某张图像上出现分歧时，CAF结合了每个分支的预测置信度以及在整个无标签目标集合中各分支偏好该提议类别的频率进行仲裁，从而对局部置信度高且较少被全集合频率偏差主导的预测给予更高信任。融合系数在源数据上一次性学习完成，并在推理时保持固定。在ImageNet上训练的CAF在十个跨数据集基准测试中取得了69.96%的平均准确率（比ManiPT高出1.92个百分点），并在四个ImageNet变体上极具竞争力，在ImageNet-S上创下了52.21%的最佳成绩。在跨十一个数据集的基类到新类迁移中，CAF的新类准确率进一步达到79.77%，调和平均值达到82.81%。代码已开源：https://github.com/zhenyuanchenai/CAF。
tldr: CAF通过构建四分支冻结与提示表征，并结合局部置信度与全局频率偏好进行上下文自适应融合，显著增强了提示学习在跨域和新类上的迁移能力。
ai_comments: 创新性：CAF通过解耦并组合冻结与提示后的视觉/文本表征，形成四分支预测，巧妙地结合了局部预测置信度与无标签目标集合的类别频率偏差来进行自适应加权融合，有效缓解了提示学习在域迁移中的过拟合与性能破坏。局限性：在推理时需要访问整个无标签目标集合以计算集合层面的类别频率偏好，这可能限制其在完全流式（streaming）或单样本在线推理场景下的应用。
motivation: 当视觉-语言模型面对新类别或新领域时，源域提示学习可能会修正部分目标图像的预训练错误，但同时也可能破坏对其他图像原有的有效预测，缺乏一种机制来判断何时该信任学习到的提示。
method: 提出上下文自适应融合（CAF）：1. 保留四个预测分支，分别配对冻结与提示学习后的视觉及文本表征；2. 当分支间产生分歧时，结合每个分支的预测置信度以及分支在无标签目标集合中偏好该提议类别的整体频率进行仲裁，更信任局部置信且受集合频率偏差影响较小的预测；3. 融合系数仅在源数据上学习一次并在推理时保持固定。
results: 在ImageNet上训练后，CAF在10个跨数据集基准上取得了69.96%的平均准确率（较ManiPT高出1.92个百分点）；在4个ImageNet变体上保持极强竞争力，在ImageNet-S上达到创纪录的52.21%；在11个数据集的基类到新类迁移任务中，CAF的新类准确率达到79.77%，调和平均值达到82.81%。
conclusion: CAF通过上下文自适应融合机制，成功平衡了预训练模型的通用泛化能力与源域适配提示的特定优势，显著提升了视觉-语言模型跨数据集和跨域迁移的鲁棒性。

title: Can Hindsight Critics Guide Delayed Actors?
authors: Francisco M. López, Francisco Cruz
abstract: Sensory delays create temporal misalignments between the state of the environment and the observations available to an agent, turning Markovian control problems into partially observable ones. In this work, we inquire whether such misalignments can be mitigated during training by using hindsight to recover aligned state-action transitions. We introduce Hindsight Critics, an asymmetric extension of the Soft Actor-Critic for reinforcement learning under partial observability. The critics are trained on hindsight-aligned transitions whereas the actor learns from the resulting privileged value estimates despite only having access to delayed observations. Comparisons against delay-aware and unaware baselines on the DelayBench suite show that Hindsight Critics can partially compensate for observation delays without requiring modifications to the agent's observations during deployment.
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Accepted for publication at the AJCAI2026 conference. Cite as: "López, F. M., & Cruz, F. (2026). Can Hindsight Critics Guide Delayed Actors?. In Australasian Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (pp. 1-10). Cham: Springer International Publishing."
zh_title: 事后评论家能够指导延迟行动者吗？
translation: 感知延迟会在环境状态与智能体可获得的观测之间造成时间上的不对齐，从而将马尔可夫控制问题转化为部分可观测问题。在这项工作中，我们探讨了在训练期间是否可以通过利用事后信息恢复对齐的状态-动作转移来缓解这种不对齐。我们提出了 Hindsight Critics（事后评论家），这是一种针对部分可观测环境下强化学习的 Soft Actor-Critic 的非对称扩展。Critic 在事后对齐的转移上进行训练，而 Actor 尽管只能获取延迟观测，但仍从由此产生的特权价值估计中学习。在 DelayBench 测试集上与感知延迟和不感知延迟的基线对比表明，Hindsight Critics 能够在部署期间无需对智能体观测进行修改的情况下，部分补偿观测延迟。
tldr: 通过构建非对称的 Hindsight Critics，在训练中利用事后对齐的状态信息估计价值，从而在无需修改部署观测的前提下有效指导存在感知延迟的 Actor。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将非对称Actor-Critic架构（即特权Critic）与事后对齐机制结合，用于解决强化学习中的感知延迟问题。其重要优势在于完全保留了部署阶段的原始延迟观测约束，无需在推理时引入额外的预测或对齐模块；局限性在于摘要指出其仅能“部分补偿”观测延迟，对于极长延迟或高动态环境的效果及理论保证仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 感知延迟会导致环境状态与智能体可获取的观测之间发生时间不对齐，从而使原本的马尔可夫控制问题退化为部分可观测问题，阻碍了强化学习算法的有效学习。
method: 提出了 Hindsight Critics 方法，作为 Soft Actor-Critic 的非对称扩展。在训练阶段，Critic 学习利用事后对齐的无延迟状态-动作转移，而 Actor 则在仅能访问延迟观测的情况下，借助 Critic 提供的特权价值估计进行策略更新。
results: 在 DelayBench 基准测试上与感知延迟（delay-aware）和不感知延迟（unaware）基线对比，实验结果表明 Hindsight Critics 能够部分补偿观测延迟带来的性能损失，且部署时无需修改智能体的观测机制。
conclusion: 事后评论家（Hindsight Critics）能够利用训练期间事后对齐的特权信息指导受延迟限制的行动者，在无需修改部署期观测的前提下有效缓解观察延迟对策略性能的不利影响。

title: Fade to... Red? Scheduling Coloured Noise Exploration Supports Efficient Robot Learning with Reduced Movement Jerk
authors: Francisco M. López, Francisco Cruz
abstract: Exploration in deep reinforcement learning (RL) for continuous control is commonly driven by temporally uncorrelated Gaussian (white) action noise, which leads to jerky motions with locally constrained exploration. In contrast, temporally correlated coloured noise, particularly pink noise, has been shown to support more efficient exploration in RL. Motivated by these findings, we inquire whether scheduling changes to the noise colour over the course of training can outperform white noise for continuous control robotics. We perform a systematic study of 49 linear schedules between white and red noise, together with generalised state-dependent exploration (gSDE), on four sparse-reward manipulation tasks with a Fetch arm and a Shadow Dexterous Hand. We find that the noise colour at the end of training does not affect learning efficiency or end performance, whereas fading towards red noise halves the jerk of exploration in every task. Balancing learning efficiency, end performance and smoothness, red noise emerges as the preferred strategy: it learns as efficiently as pink noise with almost 2-fold less movement jerk. We therefore recommend exploration schedulers that fade towards red noise as the default for off-policy robot learning.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the ACRA 2026 conference. Cite as: "López, F. M., and Cruz, F. (2026). Fade to... Red? Scheduling Coloured Noise Exploration Supports Efficient Robot Learning with Reduced Movement Jerk. In Proceedings of the Australasian Conference on Robotics and Automation (ACRA). Australian Robotics and Automation Association (ARAA)."
zh_title: 渐变至……红噪声？调度有色噪声探索支持高效且低加加速度的机器人学习
translation: 在用于连续控制的深度强化学习（RL）中，探索通常由时间上不相关的高斯（白）动作噪声驱动，这会导致运动抖动且探索局限于局部。相比之下，具有时间相关性的有色噪声（尤其是粉红噪声）已被证明能支持RL中更高效的探索。受此启发，我们探究了在训练过程中对噪声颜色进行调度变化是否能超越白噪声在连续控制机器人中的表现。我们结合广义状态相关探索（gSDE），在Fetch机械臂和Shadow灵巧手的四个稀疏奖励操作任务上，对白噪声和红噪声之间的49种线性调度方案进行了系统性研究。我们发现，训练结束时的噪声颜色不会影响学习效率或最终性能，而向红噪声渐变可使每项任务中的探索加加速度（jerk）减半。在平衡学习效率、最终性能与平滑度时，红噪声成为首选策略：其学习效率与粉红噪声相当，但运动抖动降低了近两倍。因此，我们建议将向红噪声渐变的探索调度器作为异策略机器人学习的默认方案。
tldr: 在机器人连续控制强化学习中，采用逐渐向红噪声过渡的探索调度策略，既能保持高探索效率，又能减少近50%的运动抖动。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将噪声频谱特性（噪声颜色）的动态调度引入到机器人连续控制强化学习的动作探索中。其重要价值在于直接解决了传统白噪声导致的高频抖动（高jerk）对物理机器人的磨损问题，在不牺牲稀疏奖励探索效率的前提下大幅提升了动作平滑性。局限性在于目前实验仅在特定机械臂和灵巧手的仿真任务上进行了线性调度评估，尚未在更广泛的非线性调度或真实实体机器人上进行零样本迁移验证。
motivation: 连续控制强化学习常用的无时间自相关高斯白噪声会导致运动剧烈抖动且探索受限于局部，而时间相关的有色噪声虽能提升探索效率，但尚不明确在训练过程中动态调度噪声颜色是否能在连续控制机器人任务中取得更优效果。
method: 结合广义状态相关探索（gSDE），在Fetch机械臂和Shadow灵巧手的4个稀疏奖励操作任务上，对白噪声与红噪声之间的49种线性调度策略进行了系统性实验研究。
results: 训练结束时的噪声颜色对学习效率和最终性能均无显著影响；在所有任务中，向红噪声渐变均能将探索抖动（jerk）减半；红噪声的学习效率与粉红噪声相当，但运动抖动降低了近两倍。
conclusion: 向红噪声渐变的探索策略在保持高学习效率和最终任务表现的同时，能够将探索动作的抖动减少约一半，平衡了探索效率与动作平滑度，建议作为异策略（off-policy）机器人强化学习的默认探索方案。

title: OASIS: Optimization-Aware Subgoal Inference with Safety Constraints for Autonomous Mobile Robot Navigation
authors: Arian Hajizadeh, Javad Pourrafi Arabani, Negar Shenavar, Sana Bashiri, Seyed Majid Esmailzadeh
abstract: Navigation in dynamic environments requires mobile robots to make progress toward their goals while respecting motion limits and avoiding surrounding obstacles. Learned subgoal policies can guide model predictive control beyond its local prediction horizon, but a geometrically suitable subgoal does not necessarily lead to a successfully solved control problem. This paper proposes OASIS, a hierarchical navigation framework that incorporates recent optimization outcomes into reinforcement learning-based subgoal generation. A high-level policy trained using Soft Actor--Critic generates local subgoals, while a nonlinear model predictive controller tracks them subject to motion limits, geometric collision-avoidance constraints, and embedded high-order control barrier function constraints. The outcomes of controller optimizations over each subgoal interval are summarized and provided to the policy at its next decision, without requiring additional optimization calls. The framework is evaluated in five navigation scenarios with static and moving obstacles, including dense interactions and sensing uncertainty. Comparisons with hierarchical and direct-goal control variants show that OASIS achieves the highest aggregate navigation success. Matched comparisons across three training seeds further show a consistent success advantage over the otherwise identical hierarchy without optimization-status input. The selected-policy comparison also shows fewer primary optimization failures with similar mean controller time.
zh_title: OASIS：用于自主移动机器人导航的带安全约束的优化感知子目标推断
translation: 动态环境中的导航要求移动机器人在遵循运动限制并避开周围障碍物的同时向目标前进。学习得到的子目标策略可以引导模型预测控制超越其局部预测时域，但在几何上合适的子目标并不一定能导致控制问题被成功求解。本文提出了OASIS，这是一种将近期优化结果纳入基于强化学习的子目标生成过程的分层导航框架。利用Soft Actor-Critic训练的高层策略负责生成局部子目标，而非线性模型预测控制器则在受运动限制、几何避障约束和内嵌高阶控制屏障函数约束的前提下跟踪这些子目标。控制器在每个子目标区间内的优化结果会被汇总并在下一次决策时提供给高层策略，无需引入额外的优化调用。该框架在包含静态和移动障碍物、密集交互以及传感不确定性的五种导航场景中进行了评估。与分层控制及直接目标控制变体的对比表明，OASIS取得了最高的综合导航成功率。跨三个训练种子的配对比较进一步表明，相比于未输入优化状态的相同分层结构，OASIS具有一致的成功率优势。所选策略的对比还显示，其主要优化失败更少，且平均控制器耗时相近。
tldr: 本文提出了OASIS分层导航框架，将底层非线性MPC的优化状态反馈给高层强化学习子目标生成器，在安全约束下有效降低了优化失败率并显著提升了机器人导航成功率。
ai_comments: 该论文的核心创新在于提出了“优化感知（Optimization-Aware）”的子目标推断机制，成功弥合了强化学习高层几何规划与非线性MPC底层数值优化之间的可行性鸿沟。此外，方法通过直接复用已有控制步的求解状态反馈给高层，避免了额外的优化计算负担，兼顾了控制安全性（结合HOCBF）与实时性，为分层机器人导航系统提供了极具价值的设计思路。
motivation: 学习得到的子目标策略虽可引导模型预测控制（MPC）突破局部预测视界，但在几何上合适的子目标并不一定能被底层控制器成功求解，导致高层规划与底层控制优化可行性之间存在脱节。
method: 提出了分层导航框架OASIS：高层采用Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）训练的强化学习策略生成局部子目标；低层采用非线性模型预测控制器（NMPC）在运动学限制、几何避障约束及高阶控制屏障函数（HOCBF）约束下跟踪子目标；同时将控制器在子目标区间的优化求解结果进行汇总，作为高层策略下一次决策的输入，且无需额外的优化调用。
results: 在包含静态与动态障碍物、密集交互及传感不确定性的5种场景中，OASIS均取得了最高的综合导航成功率；相比未输入优化状态的同构分层基线，在多个随机种子下展现出一致的优势；在控制器平均耗时相近的情况下，显著降低了主要优化失败的发生率。
conclusion: 将底层控制器的优化求解状态显式反馈给高层强化学习策略，能够有效弥合高层规划与底层控制可行性之间的脱节，在复杂且动态的环境中显著提升自主移动机器人导航的成功率和控制可靠性。

title: XposedMIA: Exploiting Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) for One-Shot Membership Inference Attacks
authors: Omar Hamdache, Serdar Kara, Kıvanç Kuzey Dikici, Abdullah Çağlar Öksüz, Anisa Halimi, Erman Ayday, Sinem Sav
abstract: Machine learning (ML) services increasingly expose explainability outputs alongside model predictions. While such explanations are intended to improve transparency, they may also reveal information about the underlying training data. In this work, we show that the local surrogate geometry employed by Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) can be repurposed as a proxy for a sample's distance to the model's decision boundary. We extend this boundary-distance view to tabular counterfactual explanations and, for the first time, to visual counterfactual explanations for image classifiers. We present XposedMIA, a one-shot, explanation-based black-box membership inference attack (MIA) framework that converts the returned explanation into a proxy for the queried sample's distance to the model decision boundary. After a one-time calibration step on a small labeled calibration set of as few as 30 samples, our attack requires only a single query for each target sample. Unlike prior label-only attacks requiring iterative queries or shadow training, our method relies solely on the predicted label and its accompanying explanation. Our evaluation indicates that XposedMIA achieves high effectiveness, with success rates of up to 0.95 using only a single query per target, revealing that releasing explanations introduces an additional channel for membership leakage.
zh_title: XposedMIA：利用可解释人工智能进行单次查询成员推断攻击
translation: 机器学习（ML）服务越来越多地在给出模型预测的同时提供可解释性输出。虽然此类解释旨在提高透明度，但它们也可能泄露有关底层训练数据的信息。在这项工作中，我们证明了局部可解释模型无关解释（LIME）所采用的局部代理几何结构可以被重新用作衡量样本到模型决策边界距离的代理。我们将这种边界距离视角扩展到了表格反事实解释，并首次扩展到了针对图像分类器的视觉反事实解释。我们提出了XposedMIA，一个基于解释的单次查询黑盒成员推断攻击（MIA）框架，该框架将返回的解释转换为被查询样本到模型决策边界距离的代理。在仅需少至30个样本的小型标注校准集上进行一次性校准后，我们的攻击对每个目标样本仅需要一次查询。与先前需要迭代查询或影子训练的仅基于标签的攻击不同，我们的方法仅依赖于预测标签及其伴随的解释。我们的评估表明，XposedMIA取得了很高的有效性，在对每个目标仅使用一次查询的情况下成功率高达0.95，这表明发布模型解释为成员信息泄露引入了额外的渠道。
tldr: 利用模型提供的可解释性输出（如LIME和反事实解释）作为决策边界距离的代理，仅需一次查询即可实施高效的黑盒成员推断攻击。
ai_comments: 该论文的重要意义在于揭示了可解释性人工智能（XAI）带来的隐私反噬风险。其创新点在于将多种解释机制（如LIME的局部代理几何、表格及图像的对抗反事实解释）转化为样本到决策边界距离的代理，仅需极小样本校准即可实现高效的单次查询黑盒成员推断，无需影子模型训练或大量迭代查询，攻击门槛极低。局限性在于攻击效果可能高度依赖于底层XAI解释方法的具体实现及其稳定性。
motivation: 机器学习服务在输出预测的同时越来越普遍地提供可解释性输出以提高透明度，但这可能会泄露底层训练数据的敏感信息。
method: 提出了XposedMIA框架：利用LIME的局部代理几何结构作为样本到模型决策边界距离的代理指标，并将该视角推广到表格反事实解释以及图像分类器的视觉反事实解释中。该方法仅依赖预测标签和解释输出，在利用仅需30个样本的小型校准集进行一次性校准后，对每个目标样本仅需进行一次查询即可实施黑盒成员推断。
results: 实验评估表明，XposedMIA具有很高的有效性，在对每个目标样本仅进行单次查询的条件下，攻击成功率高达0.95。
conclusion: 提供模型解释会为成员信息泄露开辟额外的攻击渠道，表明在部署可解释性AI时必须认真权衡透明度与隐私安全。

title: PA-SaR: Perception-Aware Learning, Control, and Coordination for Multi-Robot Search and Rescue
authors: Jokūbas Dimša, Maria Grouev, Filip Keerberg, Nicolas Laplagne, Tigo Schutgens, Sven Schoonebeek, Anahita Jamshidnejad
abstract: Autonomous SaR requires robots to explore unknown or partially known environments, avoid hazards, coordinate team activities, and guide discovered victims to safety. Improving individual capabilities of robots does not necessarily improve mission outcomes: safer motion can restrict the exploration behavior, faster discovery can increase the rescue demand, and effective guidance depends on victim responses. We introduce PA-SaR, a mathematical and architectural framework for coordinating heterogeneous local control, learning-based exploration, supervisory task allocation, and adaptive approach-lead victim guidance around mission-level objectives. PA- SaR distinguishes environmental ground-truth, robot-specific perceptions, and simulated victim behavior. This provides a common basis for integrating complementary mechanisms and analyzing their interactions across mission stages. We demonstrate the framework through single- and multi-robot simulation studies incorporating model-predictive and learning-based exploration, perception-based safety shielding, event-driven task allocation, and adaptive victim guidance. The results show trade-offs between collision avoidance and search completion, indicate that supervisory allocation improves search completion beyond information sharing alone, and demonstrate that increased exploration does not necessarily yield more rescues. Adaptive guidance increases rescues relative to continuous leading, without a detected improvement in mean or final victim trust or a reduction in mortality. These findings support evaluating local control, team coordination, and evacuation as related but distinct aspects of autonomous SaR within the considered simulation environments.
zh_title: PA-SaR：面向多机器人搜索与救援的感知感知学习、控制与协调
translation: 自主搜索与救援（SaR）要求机器人在未知或部分已知环境中进行探索、规避危险、协调团队行动并引导被发现的受害者前往安全地带。然而，提升机器人的单项能力并不必然改善整体任务成效：更安全的运动可能会限制探索行为，更快的发现速度可能增加救援负荷，而有效的引导则依赖于受害者的反应。为此，我们提出了PA-SaR，这是一个数学和架构框架，围绕任务级目标协调异构局部控制、基于学习的探索、监督式任务分配以及自适应接近-引导受害者机制。PA-SaR明确区分了环境真实状态、机器人特定感知与模拟受害者行为，为集成互补机制及分析跨任务阶段的交互提供了统一基础。我们在单机器人和多机器人仿真实验中对该框架进行了验证，实验涵盖了模型预测与基于学习的探索、基于感知的安全屏蔽、事件驱动的任务分配以及自适应受害者引导。结果表明，碰撞规避与搜索完成度之间存在权衡；监督式任务分配相比单纯的信息共享能进一步提高搜索完成度；探索强度的提升并不必然带来救援人数的增加；相对于持续领航，自适应引导增加了被救援人数，但未检测到对受害者平均或最终信任度的提升，亦未降低死亡率。这些发现支持在所考虑的仿真环境中，将局部控制、团队协调和人员疏散视为自主搜索与救援中相互关联但各自独立的维度来进行评估。
tldr: 论文提出了PA-SaR框架，统一协调多机器人的局部控制、学习探索、任务分配与受害者自适应引导，揭示并权衡了搜救任务中的安全、探索与救援成功率之间的制约关系。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一个统一的数学与架构框架（PA-SaR），不仅涵盖低层局部安全控制和学习驱动的探索，还整合了高层监督任务分配以及考虑受害者反应的自适应疏散引导。其重要性在于揭示了搜救任务中局部能力与全局任务收益之间并非简单的正相关关系（例如更强的探索不一定带来更多救援）。局限性在于目前仅在仿真环境中进行了验证，尚未在真实物理环境中检验复杂感知噪声和受害者行为对系统有效性的影响。
motivation: 自主搜救不仅需要机器人探索未知环境并避障，还需要团队协作和引导受害者；然而，单独提升机器人的个体能力并不必然改善整体搜救结果（如更安全的运动可能限制探索、更快的发现会增加救援负荷、引导效果受受害者行为影响），需要统筹分析局部与全局机制的交互作用。
method: 提出了PA-SaR数学与系统架构框架，该框架明确区分环境真实状态、机器人特定感知和受害者模拟行为，以此统筹结合了基于学习的探索、模型预测控制、基于感知的安全屏蔽、事件驱动的监督任务分配以及自适应接近-引导受害者机制，使异构控制和多阶段机制紧密配合任务级目标。
results: 单/多机器人仿真实验表明：避障与搜索完成度之间存在权衡；监督式任务分配相比仅共享信息显著提升了搜索完成度；过度增加探索并不必然提高救援人数；相比持续领航，自适应引导增加了获救人数，但未显著提升受害者的平均或最终信任度，也未降低死亡率。
conclusion: 研究结果表明，在自主搜救任务中，局部控制、团队协调和人员疏散应当被视为相互关联但各自独立的维度进行综合评估与权衡。

title: Maximum Probability of Independence in Transitive Matroids
authors: Mladen Kovačević
abstract: Let $M$ be a matroid on a finite ground set $E$, and suppose that the automorphism group of $M$ acts transitively on $E$. We show the following: if $X_1,\ldots,X_K$ are sampled independently from a distribution $p$ on $E$, then the probability that the samples are distinct and that $\{X_1,\ldots,X_K\}$ is an independent set in $M$ is quasi-concave in $p$ and maximized when $p$ is uniform. For $2\le K\le\rank(M)$, we characterize all maximizers by uniform total mass on the parallel classes and, in particular, show that the maximizer is unique and has global quadratic stability when $M$ is simple. As a corollary, for a random $K\times N$ matrix over a finite field with i.i.d.\ rows, uniform sampling from the nonzero vectors maximizes the probability of full row rank. Finally, we show that uniform sampling maximizes $\Prob\big(\rank_M(X_1,\ldots,X_L)\ge r\big)$, and hence also $\E\rank_M(X_1,\ldots,X_L)$, for every $L, r$.

title: Do we really need the Rademacher complexities?
authors: Daniel Bartl, Shahar Mendelson
abstract:
We study the fundamental problem of learning with respect to the squared loss in a convex class. In the subgaussian setting, the sharpest known sample complexity bounds are characterised via fixed points associated with the limiting gaussian process. In more general settings (for example, heavier-tailed scenarios) the state-of-the-art bounds rely on localised Rademacher complexities, which are often difficult to control and can be considerably larger than their limiting gaussian counterparts.
  We show that if one has access to coarse information on the covariance structure of the underlying class, it is possible to derive an upper bound on the sample complexity that matches the state-of-the-art rates in the gaussian setting---even in heavy-tailed regimes. As a consequence, under rather minimal assumptions, learning problems that share the same $L_2$-structure---even those involving heavy-tailed distributions---admit the same upper bound on the sample complexity as if the problem were fully gaussian. This constitutes the first universality result for general convex learning problems.
  The proof is based on a novel learning procedure, and its performance is studied by combining optimal mean estimation techniques for real-valued random variables with Talagrand's generic chaining method.
zh_title: 我们真的需要Rademacher复杂度吗？
translation:
我们研究了在凸类中关于平方损失学习的基本问题。在次高斯设定下，最尖锐的已知样本复杂度界限是通过与极限高斯过程相关的固定点来特征化的。在更一般的设定（例如重尾场景）中，最先进的界限依赖于局域Rademacher复杂度，这通常很难控制，并且可能比它们的极限高斯对应物大得多。
我们证明，如果能够获得底层类协方差结构的粗略信息，就可以推导出与高斯设定下的最优速率相匹配的样本复杂度上界——即使在重尾区间也是如此。因此，在相当微弱的假设下，共享相同$L_2$结构的学习问题——甚至是那些涉及重尾分布的问题——与完全是高斯分布的问题一样，承认相同的样本复杂度上界。这构成了针对一般凸学习问题的首个普适性结果。
证明基于一种新颖的学习程序，其性能通过将实值随机变量的最优均值估计技术与Talagrand的通用链式方法结合来进行研究。
tldr: 本文证明了通过利用协方差结构的粗略信息，一般凸学习问题（甚至在厚尾分布下）也能达到与高斯设定相同的最优样本复杂度，从而对传统的局域Rademacher复杂度方法提出了替代和补充。
ai_comments: 该论文首次针对一般凸学习问题建立了普适性结果，证明了在具有相同$L_2$结构的情况下，即使在厚尾分布下也可以达到与高斯情形相同的样本复杂度界限，突破了传统对局域Rademacher复杂度的依赖。
motivation: 传统的厚尾等一般性设置下的尖锐样本复杂度界限严重依赖于局域Rademacher复杂度，而这些复杂度通常很难控制且往往比对应的极限高斯界限更大。本文旨在探讨是否真的必须依赖Rademacher复杂度，并寻求更优的样本复杂度刻画方式。
method: 结合了针对实随机变量的最优均值估计技术与Talagrand的通用链式方法（generic chaining method），并设计了一种新的学习过程。
results: 在能够获取底层类协方差结构粗略信息的前提下，推导出了与高斯设置下状态最优速率相匹配的样本复杂度上界，即使在厚尾区间也成立，从而建立了第一个关于一般凸学习问题的普适性结果。
conclusion: 通过利用底层类的协方差结构和新颖的学习程序，即使在厚尾情形下，也可以实现与高斯设定相匹配的样本复杂度上界，从而在某种程度上表明在某些设定下不需要过度依赖Rademacher复杂度。

title: When Does Sliced Inference Pay Off? Resolution, Tiling and Dense Fusion for Small Object Detection
authors: Stefan Becker, Jens Bayer, David Münch, Wolfgang Hübner
abstract: Sliced inference such as SAHI is the standard remedy for small objects in high-resolution imagery, but its gains are usually measured against low-resolution baselines. We revisit sliced inference with scale as the explicit variable and ask when tiling actually pays off. We compare seven dense detectors from four families on VisDrone and DOTA, under pre-specified hypotheses, calibration-only tuning and a single evaluation on held-out test data. Two findings emerge. First, much of the benefit attributed to slicing is a resolution effect: on VisDrone, a single pass trained at a higher resolution outperforms tiling with box fusion (merging decoded boxes) for every detector that could be trained at that resolution, and at equal compute a higher resolution helps more than a larger model. Second, tiles carry complementary information that box fusion wastes. We introduce SCAHI (Slicing with Coverage-Aware Hyper Inference), which accumulates the dense outputs of all passes with weights that give every image position the same total coverage, and reads objects off a peak grid fine enough to keep crowded neighbours apart. On identical passes, SCAHI outperforms box fusion for every YOLO detector on both datasets and matches it for FCOS. On DOTA, whose images far exceed the resolution a single pass can be trained at, tiles with SCAHI beat the best single pass for every detector, by 4.3 to 5.6 mAP50 at 2048 px, and replacing only SAHI's merge step by SCAHI adds 2.3 to 4.0 mAP50. An ablation attributes the gain to the border weighting and the resolution of the peak grid. Source code is available at https://github.com/beckerio/scahi.
zh_title: 切片推理何时见效？小目标检测的分辨率、分块与密集融合
translation: 诸如SAHI之类的切片推理是高分辨率图像中小目标检测的标准补救措施，但其收益通常是与低分辨率基线相比测得的。我们以尺度作为显式变量重新审视了切片推理，并探讨了分块何时真正发挥作用。在预先指定的假设、仅校准调优以及对留存测试数据进行单次评估的条件下，我们在VisDrone和DOTA数据集上比较了来自四个系列的七个密集检测器。得出两个发现。首先，归因于切片的许多收益其实是一种分辨率效应：在VisDrone上，对于每一个能够在该分辨率下训练的检测器，以更高分辨率训练的单次处理都优于带有边界框融合（合并解码框）的分块，并且在相同计算量下，更高的分辨率比更大的模型更有帮助。其次，图块包含边界框融合所浪费的互补信息。我们引入了SCAHI（Slicing with Coverage-Aware Hyper Inference），它以赋予每个图像位置相同总覆盖率的权重累积所有通道的密集输出，并从足够精细以保持拥挤邻居分离的峰值网格中读取对象。在相同的通道下，SCAHI在两个数据集上对每个YOLO检测器均优于边界框融合，并与FCOS相匹配。在DOTA数据集上，由于其图像远远超出了单次处理可以训练的分辨率，带有SCAHI的分块在2048像素下比每个检测器的最佳单次处理高出4.3到5.6 mAP50，并且仅用SCAHI替代SAHI的合并步骤就增加了2.3到4.0 mAP50。消融实验将这些增益归因于边界加权和峰值网格的分辨率。源代码可在https://github.com/beckerio/scahi获取。
tldr: 本文重新评估了小目标检测中的切片推理，发现其优势部分源于分辨率提升，并提出了SCAHI方法以更好地利用切片互补信息，显著提升了高分辨率图像的目标检测性能。
ai_comments: 该论文深入剖析了切片推理在小目标检测中的实际效用，指出传统切片方法的优势很大程度上归因于分辨率效应，并创新性地提出了SCAHI方法，有效解决了传统边界框融合算法丢失互补信息的问题，对高分辨率图像小目标检测具有重要的理论与实践指导意义。
motivation: 切片推理（如SAHI）通常与低分辨率基线进行比较，作者旨在重新审视切片推理，明确切片分块（tiling）在小目标检测中究竟在何种情况下真正发挥作用。
method: 以尺度为显式变量，在VisDrone和DOTA数据集上对比了来自四个系列的七个密集检测器；提出SCAHI（Slicing with Coverage-Aware Hyper Inference），通过累积稠密输出并采用覆盖率感知权重及精细的峰值网格来替代传统的边界框融合。
results: 在VisDrone数据集上，更高分辨率的单次处理优于带框融合的切片推理；在DOTA数据集上，采用SCAHI的切片方法比最佳单次处理高出4.3到5.6 mAP50，且仅替换SAHI的融合步骤即可提升2.3到4.0 mAP50。
conclusion: 切片推理的优势部分源于分辨率提升，但在超高分辨率图像中，通过改进融合策略（如SCAHI）进行切片推理能带来显著的性能提升。

title: MNN-Pocket-0.3B Technical Report
authors: MNN Team
abstract: This technical report presents MNN-Pocket-0.3B, a compact 300M-parameter dense language model designed for efficient on-device deployment and supporting context lengths of up to 32K tokens. With an INT4 deployment footprint of only 173 MB and decoding throughput of up to 466 tokens/s on iPad Pro M5 (Metal), it can be seamlessly integrated into applications on edge devices such as smartphones and smart glasses. MNN-Pocket-0.3B is developed through the co-design of its architecture, data, training pipeline, and inference system. Hardware-aware architecture selection and dependency-aware vocabulary pruning balance model capability with on-device memory and compute constraints. A four-stage pre-training pipeline covering approximately 4.1 trillion high-quality Chinese and English tokens equips the model with broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities. This is followed by a three-stage post-training pipeline comprising instruction fine-tuning, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and quantization-aware training. Finally, hardware-specific optimizations in the MNN inference engine enable fast, memory-efficient inference and long-context processing. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that MNN-Pocket-0.3B achieves frontier-level performance among models of comparable size, with particularly strong results in Chinese and English knowledge and reasoning, mathematics, coding, and instruction following. It consistently outperforms similarly sized open-source models and even surpasses several 0.5B-parameter models on instruction-following benchmarks. We release MNN-Pocket-0.3B with open weights and ready-to-use MNN deployment packages. We hope it will provide a practical foundation for capable, responsive, and memory-efficient edge applications while advancing research and development in on-device language models.
translation: 本技术报告介绍了 MNN-Pocket-0.3B，这是一款专为高效端侧部署设计的紧凑型 3 亿参数稠密语言模型，支持高达 32K 词元的上下文长度。该模型在 INT4 量化下的部署体积仅为 173 MB，在 iPad Pro M5（Metal）上的解码吞吐量可达 466 tokens/s，能够无缝集成到智能手机和智能眼镜等边缘设备的应用中。MNN-Pocket-0.3B 通过对其架构、数据、训练流水线和推理系统的协同设计开发而成。硬件感知架构选择与依赖感知词表剪枝有效平衡了模型能力与端侧内存及算力约束。覆盖约 4.1 万亿高质量中英文词元的四阶段预训练流水线赋予了模型广泛的知识和推理能力。随后，模型经过了由指令微调、多教师在线策略蒸馏和量化感知训练组成的三阶段后训练流程。最后，MNN 推理引擎针对硬件的专属优化实现了快速、内存高效的推理和长上下文处理。广泛的评估表明，MNN-Pocket-0.3B 在同等尺寸模型中取得了前沿水平的性能，尤其在中英文知识与推理、数学、代码编写和指令遵循方面表现强劲。它持续超越同等尺寸的开源模型，甚至在指令遵循基准测试中优于多个 0.5B 参数模型。我们开源了 MNN-Pocket-0.3B 权重以及开箱即用的 MNN 部署包，希望为功能强大、响应敏捷且内存高效的边缘应用提供实用基础，同时推动端侧语言模型的研究与发展。
tldr: MNN-Pocket-0.3B 是一款专为端侧设备打造的 3 亿参数稠密语言模型，支持 32K 长上下文且 INT4 仅占 173MB 内存，综合性能超越同尺寸甚至部分 0.5B 模型。
ai_comments: 该工作的创新与重要性在于实现了算法、训练与端侧推理系统（MNN）的深度软硬协同设计，在仅 300M 参数量和 173MB（INT4）的极端资源约束下支持 32K 上下文并实现了卓越的推理速度与性能，打通了端侧部署的全链路闭环。局限在于该模型参数规模极小，在应对极其复杂的多步骤通用推理任务时可能仍受限于模型容量本身。
motivation: 旨在解决智能手机、智能眼镜等边缘设备严苛的计算与内存资源约束，打造一款兼顾高性能、长上下文支持（32K）与超低资源开销的高效端侧小参数语言模型。
method: 采用模型架构、数据、训练流程与推理系统的全栈协同设计：利用硬件感知架构选择与依赖感知词表剪枝平衡性能与资源开销；采用约 4.1 万亿中英文词元进行四阶段预训练；通过指令微调、多教师在线策略蒸馏与量化感知训练进行三阶段后训练；借助 MNN 推理引擎进行硬件专属优化。
results: MNN-Pocket-0.3B 的 INT4 部署体积仅 173 MB，在 iPad Pro M5 (Metal) 上解码吞吐量达 466 tokens/s；在同尺寸模型中达到前沿表现，全面超越同规模开源模型，并在指令遵循等评测中超越了部分 0.5B 参数模型。
conclusion: 研究团队开源了 MNN-Pocket-0.3B 的模型权重及开箱即用的 MNN 部署包，为构建功能强大、响应迅速且内存高效的边缘端 AI 应用提供了切实可行的基础方案，并推动了端侧语言模型领域的发展。

title: On Stochastic Continuous-Time Linear System Identification for Adaptive Stabilization
authors: Reza Sadeghi Hafshejani, Mohamad Kazem Shirani Faradonbeh
abstract: System identification studies the canonical problem of reliably learning system-dynamics from state and input trajectories. One of its important applications consists of estimating a feedback gain matrix that can stabilize an unknown system. This paper focuses on the analysis of such adaptive stabilization schemes for multivariate linear time-invariant state-space models. The system instability practically renders trajectories short, i.e., the observed data is notably limited. So, it is crucial to tightly consider effects of \emph{all} involved quantities including length and number of trajectories, dimension, controllability Gramian, and signal-to-noise ratio. We put forward a simple, practical, and reliable relationship between the chance that adaptive stabilization (based on system identification) fails to stabilize the system, in terms of all the above-mentioned quantities. Our findings show that despite exponential effects of all other quantities on failure probability, such effects do not hold for signal-to-noise ratio. More specifically, this study shows that the strength of the excitation signal helps stabilization only \emph{logarithmically}; a very important phenomenon that we explain under the term \emph{signal saturation}.

title: Polarization Aware Deep Learning Framework for SAR Despeckling
authors: Gianpaolo Passarello, Sergio Vitale, Hossein Aghababei, Giampaolo Ferraioli, Vito Pascazio
abstract: Speckle is an inherent characteristic of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery that complicates image interpretation and the extraction of reliable information. Although deep-learning-based despeckling methods have demonstrated promising performance, their applicability across different polarimetric configurations is often limited by the need for specialized architectures or separate training procedures. This paper presents a unified deep-learning framework for despeckling single-, dual-, and full-polarization SAR data using a single trained convolutional neural network. The proposed approach adopts a common nine-channel representation of the polarimetric covariance matrix and a polarization-aware masking strategy to accommodate different configurations without modifying the network architecture. Qualitative and quantitative comparison on three different scenes from different sensors demonstrate competitive performance across the considered experiments and support the feasibility of a unified, polarization-flexible approach to SAR despeckling across different polarimetric configurations.

title: Beyond the Mean Gap: What Transferred-Angle QAOA Retains on a Superconducting Processor
authors: Sanim Yousuf Fahim, Mohammad Arif Hossain
abstract: Hardware executions of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) are often validated by comparing the device's mean cost with a simulation, a check that can miss what matters for optimization. Under global depolarization, the mean normalized gap and the floor-corrected probability of every set of bitstrings, the optimum included, retain the same fraction of their noiseless improvement over uniform sampling. We test this prediction with depth-2, transferred-angle QAOA circuits for binary subproblems of an alternating-direction decomposition on the IBM Heron processor \texttt{ibm\_marrakesh}, with and without dynamical decoupling and twirling. At 12 qubits, the main-family circuits retained 29\% to 46\% of their mean-gap improvement but only 5\% to 15\% of their probability of the optimum, lower on at least nine of ten instances per run. Near-optimal bitstrings were lost about as much as the optimum, whereas the avoidance of poor bitstrings was retained best. In the first submission, a device-matched noise model reproduced the pattern but overestimated the retention of the optimum five- to eightfold. On a rugged planted family, the device found the optimum in 62\% of 768-shot blocks (noiseless: 98\%), within the range of local heuristics. Validations of optimization circuits should report retention of the optimum and of near-optimal sets.

title: Spectral-Convolutional Factorized Transformer for Joint Multipath Parameter Estimation: Applications to mmWave Positioning and Radio SLAM
authors: Yaya Etiabi, Wessam Ajib, Halima Elbiaze
abstract: Future 6G wireless networks are expected to evolve toward AI-native systems that support intelligent, environment-aware services, including positioning and mapping. Current research has already integrated AI into several aspects of communication, particularly wireless channel estimation. However, most learning-based channel estimators focus on communication-oriented objectives rather than explicitly estimating multipath parameters such as delay, angle of arrival (AoA), and angle of departure (AoD). These parameters provide essential geometric information for downstream tasks including positioning and radio simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). In this work, we propose a Spectral-Convolutional Factorized Transformer (SCFT) for joint multipath component (MPC) estimation from noisy complex channel estimates and physical beam-pair descriptors. SCFT combines local spectral convolution, permutation-equivariant beam-set attention, and a query-based Transformer decoder to detect and classify line-of-sight and non-line-of-sight paths and estimate their observed delays, AoAs, and AoDs. Experiments on realistic ray-tracing data show that SCFT reduces the generalized optimal sub-pattern assignment error by 13.1% compared with ResNet, the strongest competing baseline. We further demonstrate this advantage in independent snapshot positioning and radio SLAM, where SCFT reduces position RMSE by 18.5% and 65.0%, respectively, relative to ResNet. These findings highlight the importance of explicitly recovering multipath geometry, as improvements in MPC estimation can translate into substantial gains in downstream tasks.

title: Thickness-Field-Excited Bimorph Piezoelectric Micromachined Ultrasonic Transducer in Submicrometer Thin-Film Lithium Niobate
authors: Vakhtang Chulukhadze, Jiajun Huang, Zihuan Liu, Will Leskowitz, Tzu-Hsuan Hsu, Yuchen Ma, Udit Rawat, Yao Yu, Bichoy Bahr, Neal A. Hall, Ruochen Lu
abstract: This work presents the first demonstration of a submicrometer-thick thickness-field-excited (TFE) lithium niobate (LN) flexural-mode piezoelectric micromachined ultrasonic transducer (PMUT). A 670-nm-thick bilayer periodically poled piezoelectric film (P3F) 128Y LN is used to demonstrate a suspended membrane with an area of 0.25 mm$^{2}$, achieving a low resonance frequency of 33.4 kHz for airborne transduction. Its electrical measurements reveal an extracted effective electromechanical coupling efficiency ($k_{\mathrm{eff}}^{2}$) of 3% and a moderate static capacitance $C_0$ of 17 pF. Meanwhile, mechanical measurements using a laser Doppler vibrometer (LDV) yield a high quasi-static peak out-of-plane displacement ($ξ_{\mathrm{static}}$) of 145 nm/V and a high corresponding open-circuit sensitivity ($S_{\mathrm{OC}}$) of 1.4 mV/Pa in the audio band. The fabricated device is compared with state-of-the-art (SoA) airborne piezoelectric transducers with sub-100-kHz resonance frequencies, underscoring the potential of the TFE P3F LN transducer platform by simultaneously demonstrating strong actuation capability while featuring high sensitivity.

title: SNIF: a Self-Navigator Intelligent Filter correcting off-center and spin-history artifacts in quasi-random radial MRI
authors: Tanguy Boucneau, Brice Fernandez, Peder Larson, Luc Darrasse, Xavier Ma{î}tre
abstract: For self-navigation and self-gating in MRI, self-navigators are extracted from the complex values of the k-space center, called DC-signal, through a temporal frequency analysis. However, this signal often carries artifacts. This paper introduces a Self-Navigator Intelligent Filter (SNIF) that models the physical origin of the k-space center artifacts to properly estimate them and thus more accurately remove them. The artifact affecting the DC-signal $S_{DC}$ generally has two main origins: the jitter of the k-space center (''off-center artifact'') and the cumulative history of the spins (''spin-history artifact''). Both add noise-like artifacts to the signal. The off-center effect can be modeled as a perturbative signal $S_0$ and the spin-history effect as a convolution kernel $h$ so that the measured DC-signal is $S_{DC} = S_m + S_0 \star h$, where $S_m$ is the motion-related component which effectively contains the expected self-navigators. Methods to compute $h$ and $S_0$ were developed, which gives the possibility to extract $S_m$ from $S_{DC}$. They were implemented and evaluated on thoracic UTE datasets acquired on a healthy volunteer. Qualitative visual comparison and quantitative spectral analysis of the DC-signal before and after SNIF demonstrate that the method improves both the accuracy and the precision of the extracted respiratory and cardiac self-navigators. By considering the physical origin of the DC-signal artifacts, SNIF makes both respiratory and cardiac self-navigators more sensitive to motion, which supports finer MRI motion tracking.
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures; supplementary material (93 pages): DC-signal spectra for every reception channel

title: Design and Over-the-Air Evaluation of a Digital Twin-Driven Site-Specific Neural Receiver for 5G NR on NVIDIA DGX Spark
authors: Qiuyuan Chen, Chengyang Yao, Liuchang Zhuo, Yuquan Sun, Cunhua Pan, Hong Ren, Jiangzhou Wang
abstract: We design and evaluate a site-specific neural receiver for the 5G New Radio (NR) uplink. A corridor digital twin built from a radar scan and refined manually provides 28,671 ray-traced channel records for training an eight-round convolutional graph neural network with pilot-aware inputs and auxiliary channel supervision. The GPU on NVIDIA DGX Spark evaluates time--frequency convolutions in parallel across the received grid to accelerate inference. The receiver uses the standard NR uplink waveform and reference signals and feeds soft bits to the existing transport-block decoder. In over-the-air tests with NI USRP B210 radios under common radio settings, the site-trained receiver achieves the highest mean uplink rate at all five positions. At a non-line-of-sight corner, it reaches 16.2 Mb/s, compared with 4.1 Mb/s for the conventional receiver and 2.4 Mb/s for the 3GPP-trained neural receiver. These results demonstrate the feasibility of integrating neural reception into the 5G NR physical layer and show its potential for AI-RAN deployments.

title: Stability Analysis of Single- and Multi-Snapshot ESPRIT
authors: Wenchong Huang, Ping Liu
abstract: Spectral estimation seeks to recover unknown frequencies from $T$ snapshots, each consisting of $Ω+1$ noisy Fourier measurements. Super-resolution refers to the recovery of frequencies whose minimum separation $Δ$ is smaller than $1/Ω$. We establish state-of-the-art stability bounds for single- and multi-snapshot ESPRIT when the frequencies form well-separated clumps, with the largest clump containing $n^\star$ frequencies. In particular, for single-snapshot ESPRIT, our error bound scales as $$ \mathcal{O}(Ω^{-1}\mathrm{SRF}^{2n^\star-2}\cdot\mathrm{Noise}), $$ where $\mathrm{SRF}:=(ΩΔ)^{-1}$ denotes the super-resolution factor, provided that the noise level satisfies $\mathrm{Noise}\lesssim(ΩΔ)^{2n^\star-2}$. In comparison with the minimax bounds [arXiv:1904.09186] and the computational resolution limits [arXiv:2003.02917, arXiv:2211.15208], our result shows that single-snapshot ESPRIT achieves the optimal stability scaling in the super-resolution regime. For multi-snapshot ESPRIT, we establish error bounds under both deterministic noise and Gaussian white noise, attaining the best-known SRF dependence under weaker conditions. Numerical experiments corroborate the theoretical error bounds.

title: Residual-Closed-Loop SAGE-Brent Estimation for Unknown-Order Wideband Underwater Acoustic Channels
authors: Wenxu Bi, Peng Chen, Wei Wang
abstract: Grid mismatch in wideband channel estimation leaves structured cancellation residuals after strong-path subtraction. These residuals generate spurious correlation peaks or mask weak arrivals, turning continuous parameter errors into path-count errors. We propose RC-SAGE-Brent, a residual-closed-loop estimator that jointly refines continuous delay-scale parameters and corrects the unknown-order path set. Within each feedback cycle, ambiguity-constrained alternating Brent searches suppress strong-path cancellation residuals. Candidate validation, resolution-constrained pruning, and full-domain residual redetection then revise the active path set. For linear frequency modulation (LFM) probes, an observable signal-to-residual ratio adaptively scales the model-order penalty to mitigate overestimation caused by delay-scale coupling. Theoretical analysis links off-grid parameter errors to local cancellation-residual curvature and weak-path detectability. Factorial ablations, paired comparisons against standard sparse and off-grid estimators, and measured channel replay demonstrate improved path-set recovery and waveform reconstruction while delineating the operational boundaries of the method.
comment: 31 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Includes supplementary materials (Tables S1-S5)

title: A Faster and Efficient Indoor User Localization Using Bistatic MIMO Radar
authors: Shadab Anjum, Sourav Banerjee, Neel Kanth Kundu
abstract: Indoor user localization is essential for applications such as asset tracking, robotic navigation, and smart-building automation where satellite-based positioning is unavailable. Bistatic MIMO radar exploits bistatic range measurements and geometric diversity from distributed antennas, but low-SNR conditions make the resulting estimation ill-conditioned. We formulate indoor localization as a Tikhonov-regularized nonlinear least-squares problem and solve it with a damped Gauss-Newton (DGN) algorithm, in which each iteration reduces to a closed-form 3x3 linear solve followed by an Armijo backtracking line search. Simulations show accuracy on par with, and runtime far faster than, an SDP-based benchmark.

title: RaGCD: Reliability-Aware 2D-3D Multimodal Generalized Category Discovery
authors: Junyong Liu
abstract: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to recognize known categories while discovering novel ones from partially labeled data. Existing GCD studies primarily focus on unimodal observations or image-text interactions, leaving the complementarity between visual appearance and explicit 3D geometry underexplored. To exploit complementary visual appearance and spatial geometry, we investigate GCD with paired images and point clouds. However, the relative reliability of these modalities varies across samples, so unreliable evidence can compromise both multimodal fusion and cross-modal knowledge transfer. This challenge is particularly pronounced for novel categories, where labeled supervision is unavailable. To address it, we propose RaGCD, a reliability-aware framework for 2D-3D multimodal GCD. Specifically, Reliability-aware Modality Allocation (RMA) combines prediction-derived reliability cues with modality-specific features to adaptively allocate image and point-cloud contributions at the channel level. Reliability-conditioned Alignment (RCA) further reweights feature-level and prediction-level alignment and selects reliable observations for prototype-level alignment, regulating cross-modal interaction according to sample reliability. Extensive experiments on ModelNet40, Washington RGB-D, and ShapeNet-ViPC demonstrate that RaGCD outperforms the compared methods in overall and novel-category clustering accuracy. Ablation studies support the complementary roles of RMA and RCA, while controlled corruption experiments show that modality allocation shifts toward the less corrupted modality. These results support the effectiveness of reliability-aware interaction for category discovery from paired appearance and geometry.

title: Application of the Phase Correction Method in Tracking Modules of Navigation Receivers
authors: Kudryavtsev I.A., Shafran S.V., Balmasova M.A
abstract: One of the problems of the tracking modules is their significant inertia in case of narrow bandwidth, which is desirable to mitigate signal noise. The paper describes a method of phase correction, improving accuracy and dynamic characteristics of the tracking process in GNSS receivers. The pivotal idea of the method supposes correction of the phase deviation between the received signal and its local copy at the end of every integration period. This correction is performed directly over the phase accumulator of a DDS system. This approach reduces inertial effects crucially. Application of phase correction method with narrow filter bandwidth is much more efficient when FLL-assisted PLL tracking is used. It is shown that in this case a separate FLL discriminator is not needed, and the resulting filter structure can be significantly simplified.
comment: 15 pages, 17 figures. The paper is accepted for publication in the journal "Radiotechnika" (Radio engineering)

title: DialInstruct-TTS: Interactive Expressive Speech Generation via Multi-Turn Dialogue with Fine-Grained Temporal Control
authors: Wangzixi Zhou, Bagus Tris Atmaja, Sakriani Sakti
abstract: Existing instruction-based TTS systems primarily support one-shot, utterance-level control, where a single instruction determines the speaking style of an entire utterance. As a result, even minor refinements require rewriting the instruction and regenerating the full utterance, limiting fine-grained interactive control. We propose DialInstruct-TTS, an interactive multi-turn expressive TTS framework that enables users to iteratively refine generated speech through natural-language dialogue until the desired style is achieved. At each dialogue turn, a Qwen-based planner integrates the dialogue history and latest user instruction into a complete TemporalPlan, while a temporal acoustic control module provides fine-grained control over emotion, speaking rate, volume, and phonation. Reference-latent revision preserves non-target regions across turns, allowing users to modify only the requested attributes or temporal spans while retaining previously satisfactory speech. Subjective evaluations demonstrate improved global instruction following, accurate local style realization, and effective non-target preservation. Compared with conventional one-shot interaction requiring full instruction restatement and utterance regeneration, DialInstruct-TTS substantially improves perceived convenience and interaction comfort. Audio samples are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/w/eacl-demo-17C5/.

title: Joint Air Corridor and BS Coverage Planning for Large-Scale High-Density Low-Altitude Aerial Networks via Channel Knowledge Maps
authors: Jiaxuan Li, Yilong Chen, Yuan Guo, Fan Liu, Jie Xu
abstract: This paper studies the joint air corridor and base station (BS) coverage planning problem for high-density low-altitude aerial networks supported by terrestrial cellular infrastructures. In the considered system, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) operate within a structured air corridor planned over a grid-based airspace, and each BS serves selected corridor grid cells by sharing its communication resources among all UAVs therein. Each BS's traffic load depends on both the number of covered corridor cells and the UAV density, thereby affecting the communication rate available to each UAV. We exploit the channel knowledge map (CKM) to characterize the channel gains between BSs and candidate airspace cells and evaluate desired signals and inter-cell interference for environment-aware offline planning. Based on CKM, we jointly optimize the corridor layout and BS coverage to minimize a weighted objective balancing corridor length and the supportable average UAV density along the entire corridor, subject to minimum communication rate requirements for all UAVs along the air corridor. The joint design is formulated as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP), which can be optimally solved using off-the-shelf solvers. For large maps, we develop a scalable suboptimal algorithm based on Lagrangian relaxation and A* search. Specifically, we incorporate BS resource constraints into A* corridor search via Lagrangian relaxation, and then jointly optimize BS coverage and UAV density along the generated corridors under the original rate constraints. Numerical results demonstrate the benefits of the proposed joint design in supporting high-density UAV operations and show that the proposed algorithm obtains high-quality solutions with substantially reduced computation time.
zh_title: 基于信道知识图谱的大规模高密度低空空中网络联合空中走廊与基站覆盖规划
translation: 本文研究了由地面蜂窝基础设施支持的高密度低空空中网络的联合空中走廊和基站（BS）覆盖规划问题。在所考虑的系统中，无人机（UAV）在基于网格规划的结构化空中走廊内运行，每个BS通过共享其通信资源来为其服务的走廊网格单元中的所有UAV提供服务。每个BS的流量负载取决于被覆盖的走廊单元数量和UAV密度，从而影响每个UAV可用的通信速率。我们利用信道知识图谱（CKM）来表征BS与候选 airspace 单元之间的信道增益，并评估用于环境感知离线规划的期望信号和蜂窝间干扰。基于CKM，我们联合优化走廊布局和BS覆盖，以最小化平衡走廊长度和整条走廊上可支持的平均UAV密度的加权目标，同时满足沿空中走廊所有UAV的最低通信速率要求。联合设计被表征为混合整数线性规划（MILP），可以使用现成的求解器进行最优求解。对于大地图，我们开发了一种基于拉格朗日松弛和A*搜索的可扩展次优算法。具体而言，我们通过拉格朗日松弛将BS资源约束纳入A*走廊搜索中，然后在原始速率约束下联合优化生成的走廊沿线的BS覆盖和UAV密度。数值结果证明了所提出的联合设计在支持高密度UAV运行方面的优势，并表明所提出的算法在显著减少计算时间的同时获得了高质量的解。
tldr: 本文研究了低空无人机网络中空中走廊与基站覆盖的联合规划问题，利用信道知识图谱和优化算法实现了高效的大规模网络部署。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将信道知识图谱（CKM）引入低空空中走廊与基站覆盖的联合规划中，并利用拉格朗日松弛和A*搜索解决了大规模场景下的计算瓶颈，对于未来高密度无人机网络的部署具有重要的理论与实际意义。
motivation: 为了支持高密度、大规模的低空无人机网络的安全高效运行，需要解决空中走廊布局与地面基站覆盖的联合规划问题，以平衡走廊长度、支持的无人机密度和通信速率要求。
method: 将问题建模为混合整数线性规划（MILP），利用现成求解器求解；针对大规模地图，开发了基于拉格朗日松弛和A*搜索的可扩展次优算法。
results: 数值结果表明，所提出的联合设计能够有效支持高密度无人机运行，且所开发的算法在大幅减少计算时间的同时获得了高质量的解。
conclusion: 本文提出的基于CKM的联合规划方法与可扩展的次优算法能够有效支持高密度无人机网络的部署，在保证通信速率的前提下优化走廊布局与基站覆盖。

title: Passive ladder-network representation of the radiation impedance of a spherical cap on a rigid sphere
authors: Ronald M. Aarts
abstract: A loudspeaker in a closed box is modeled as a rigid sphere with an axially moving cap. For an axisymmetric cone-velocity profile, its radiation impedance is written as a network. Each spherical-harmonic mode has an impedance rational in frequency, realized exactly as a finite passive ladder of masses and compliances terminated in a resistance. Ideal transformers set by Legendre coefficients couple these ladders; truncated modes reduce to a residual mass. Despite the different geometry, the impedance resembles that of a baffled piston but, at equal volume velocity, has half its low-frequency resistance and about three quarters of its radiation mass.
comment: 13 pages (preprint format), 3 figures. Submitted to JASA Express Letters

title: Dual-Parabola Interpolator: A Low-Bias Peak Estimator for Distributed Radar Synchronization
authors: Matteo Pardi, Giulio Meucci, Francesco Mancuso, Anna Lisa Saverino, Amerigo Capria
abstract: Coherent distributed radar processing requires accurate wireless synchronization. Two-way time transfer (TWTT) obtains reception timestamps from sampled matched-filter peaks, but interpolation bias limits accuracy even when noise is reduced by higher signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) or averaging. Three-point parabolic interpolation is attractive for its simple, explicit formula; reducing its bias generally requires more elaborate fitting, such as higher-order polynomials, or a model tailored to a particular peak shape. A practical alternative should retain this simplicity and interpretability while approaching the low bias of more flexible fits. We propose the Dual-Parabola Interpolator (DPI), which combines two parabolic estimates from five amplitude samples near the matched-filter peak. An adaptive weight cancels the leading interpolation error without requiring a waveform-specific peak model or a correction table. Simulations over flat and standardized multipath channels show bias comparable to a five-point quartic fit, with essentially the same standard deviation as the other interpolators and an execution cost close to a three-point parabolic fit. This combination is useful for TWTT in urban or other multipath settings, where channel distortion prevents reliance on a nominal peak shape.
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures. Submitted for peer review as a conference paper

title: Finite Blocklength Performance Analysis of Uplink RSMA with Practical Imperfections
authors: Farjam Karim, Nurul Huda Mahmood, Arthur Sousa de Sena, Deepak Kumar, Matti Latva-aho
abstract: Future generations of wireless networks will support massive communication and hyper-reliable low-latency communications, which are fundamental to large-scale Internet of Things (IoT) deployments with stringent performance requirements. To support such diverse and demanding requirements, robust and flexible multiple access schemes are essential. In this work, we develop a comprehensive analytical framework for evaluating uplink rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) in the finite blocklength regime under realistic non-ideal conditions. Specifically, we derive closed-form expressions for the block error rate (BLER) and goodput, accounting for imperfect channel state information at the receiver (CSIR), imperfect successive interference cancellation (SIC), and hardware impairments. To reflect practical wireless environments, we model the channel using Nakagami-m fading model. Our analysis shows that at lower transmit power levels, imperfect CSIR is the dominant performance-limiting factor, whereas hardware impairments and imperfect SIC become more significant in degrading system performance as the transmit power increases. To further understand the system behavior, we derive asymptotic BLER expressions. We also analyze the impact of rate allocation, demonstrating its critical role in ensuring fairness and reliability. Monte Carlo simulations validate our analytical expressions. Notably, our results show that uplink RSMA significantly outperforms NOMA even when RSMA operates under harsh imperfect CSIR. This superiority establishes RSMA as a robust and efficient candidate for future wireless networks in practical, constrained environments

title: ESDCodec: Ultra-Low Bitrate Speech Codec with Enhanced Semantic Disentanglement and Subband Decoding
authors: Nan Xu, Kecan Mao, Xin Gu, Yi Zhao, Zhi Gong
abstract: Despite recent advances in neural speech codecs, achieving highfidelity speech reconstruction at low bitrates remains a formidable challenge. To address this limitation, we propose ESDCodec, a speech codec that integrates a thoroughly enhanced semantic quantizer and a conditioned decoder network. Specifically, we employ a randomly initialized and frozen codebook, followed by a lightweight projector, to encode semantic details entirely within a linear space while enhancing codebook utilization. To further improve perceptual quality, we design a condition network that explicitly injects prior subband knowledge into the upsampling decoder. Taking the de-quantized feature as input, this network predicts subband signals, thereby providing fine-grained guidance for waveform reconstruction. Extensive experimental results show that ESDCodec achieves superior reconstruction performance at an ultra-low bitrate of 0.85kbps. For LLM-based speech generation tasks, ESDCodec also consistently outperforms existing codec models.

title: CFAR Detection on Non-Coherently Integrated Angular Maps for mmWave Radio SLAM
authors: Paolo Tosi, Ossi Kaltiokallio, Marcus Henninger, Silvio Mandelli, Mikko Valkama
abstract: Reliable multipath detection is essential for millimeter-wave simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), where propagation paths reflecting off the environment provide geometric constraints beyond the dominant line-of-sight component. This paper develops constant false alarm rate (CFAR)-based detectors for beam-swept bistatic integrated sensing and communications (ISAC). Starting from conventional CFAR on the I/Q datacube, we derive a modified detector for non-coherently integrated angular power maps, where the post-integration noise statistics differ from those assumed by standard cell-averaging CFAR. To improve practicality, we introduce a multi-cell cell-under-test formulation and a plus-shaped training window that reduces computational cost while accounting for sidelobe structure. The proposed methods are evaluated on experimental 60 GHz indoor measurements using a snapshot-SLAM estimator. Compared with a singular value decomposition (SVD)-based detector, the proposed CFAR approaches reduce the overall positioning RMSE from 0.30 m to 0.24-0.26 m, with the largest improvement in non-line-of-sight snapshots. The multi-cell non-coherent detector further lowers the computational complexity without degrading positioning accuracy, demonstrating its suitability for practical multipath radio-SLAM.
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

title: Wideband Channel Measurements in the Lower FR3 Band (6-12 GHz) for Industrial Environments
authors: Faizan Rauf, Adam Umra, Oways Alsoloh, Aydin Sezgin
abstract: The upper mid-band, also known as Frequency Range 3 (FR3), spans 7.125-24.25 GHz and is a key candidate band for sixth-generation (6G) wireless communications. However, channel measurements in industrial environments remain scarce, and the 3GPP indoor-factory (InF) channel model, developed for omnidirectional antennas, has yet to be validated across the FR3 band. This paper presents a wideband channel measurement campaign in an industrial production hall, covering 135 line-of-sight (LOS) positions at 1-18 m and 30 non-line-of-sight (NLOS) positions behind an industrial robot at 2.5-16.5 m across 6-12 GHz. In LOS, the path-loss exponent ranged from 1.87 to 2.12, and the close-in fits agreed with the 3GPP InF-LOS model to within approximately 2 dB. However, shadow fading was only 1.4-1.7 dB, compared with the model's 4.3 dB. In NLOS, the robot caused an excess loss that increased from 10.3 to 13.0 dB between 6.5 and 11.5 GHz, consistent with diffraction. Blocking the direct path raised the mean directional delay spread from approximately 5 to 25 ns, close to omnidirectional values. These results indicate that the 3GPP InF model captures mean LOS path loss well but overestimates the variability of beam-aligned FR3 links, and that blockage loss in FR3 is frequency dependent. The dataset and processing code are publicly available.

title: Spectral-Domain Information Geometry of Stationary Covariance Models: Gaussian and Elliptical Extensions
authors: Shu Yang, Dongying Li, Wenxian Yu
abstract:
This paper develops an information-geometric framework for stationary covariance structures. We begin with the infinite-dimensional setting, where stationary covariance structures can be characterized without finite-window boundary effects. By formulating the covariance structure as a bilinear form on a suitable class of test functions, we establish its spectral representation and show how finite-dimensional Toeplitz covariance matrices arise as restrictions to nested observation subspaces. For zero-mean proper complex Gaussian wide-sense stationary (WSS) processes, we show that the normalized finite-dimensional Fisher information converges to a spectral-domain metric. In logarithmic spectral coordinates, this metric becomes the standard $L^2$ inner product, yielding an explicit Fisher--Rao distance that is also recovered as the asymptotic normalized affine-invariant Riemannian distance between Toeplitz covariance matrices.
  We then extend the framework to elliptical observation models by separating global covariance scale from shape. The shape Fisher information is orthogonal to radial nuisance directions and is characterized by a dimension- and radial-model-dependent coefficient. We derive a condition under which this coefficient converges to its Gaussian value as the observation dimension tends to infinity. The resulting limiting spectral-shape geometry is the centered $L^2$ geometry of log-spectra and is invariant to positive rescaling. Numerical experiments illustrate the theoretical convergence results and the recovery of the Gaussian shape coefficient.

title: Denoising Multiuser Interference Enabled Iterative AI Receiver
authors: Xiangzhao Qin, Sha Hu, Jing Qian, Hao Wang
abstract: When interfering users transmit finite-alphabet symbols, the aggregate of multiuser interference and thermal noise in a multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) receiver is generally non-Gaussian. Its covariance alone does not specify the likelihood required for Bayesian detection. Conventional minimum mean-square error interference rejection combining (MMSE-IRC) is optimal among linear estimators with known second-order statistics, but it does not generally attain the Bayesian MMSE estimate in this setting. In this article, we propose an iterative artificial intelligence (AI) receiver that jointly refines interference cancellation, channel estimation, and desired-user detection. At each iteration, an interference denoising network reconstructs the received interference from the residual observation, covariance information, and uncertainty in the desired-user soft decisions. After cancellation, the preceding soft decisions support successive interference cancellation among desired-user streams and yield least squares (LS) channel estimates at data positions. A channel estimation network refines these estimates using the preceding channel estimate. Finally, MMSE-IRC preprocessing provides an effective channel matrix and soft symbol estimates to a Transformer-ResNet-PIC detector, which produces symbol probabilities for the next iteration. We also relate these structured detector inputs to the likelihood gradient of a relaxed Bayesian detection problem. The resulting receiver uses soft decisions to couple the three processing stages across iterations. Link-level simulations show that denoising multiuser interference enables the proposed iterative AI receiver to approach the attainable theoretical performance bound. The proposed receiver substantially outperforms the conventional quasi-ML receiver based on LMMSE channel estimation and MMSE-IRC preprocessing.

title: Sparse Range-Doppler Profile Recovery in Colored Interference for Adaptive Radar
authors: Tao Wang, Augusto Aubry, Antonio De Maio, Junli Liang
abstract: Range-Doppler profile (RDP) recovery is a fundamental task in adaptive radar signal processing, whose performance can be severely degraded by Doppler grid mismatch and colored interference. This article develops a unified sparsity-aware framework for on-grid and off-grid RDP recovery in the presence of correlated clutter with unknown spectral properties. The problem is formulated within a regularized maximum likelihood framework by exploiting both primary and secondary data, where the sparse RDP and interference covariance are jointly inferred, while Doppler frequency displacements are additionally estimated in the off-grid case to mitigate basis mismatch. Both covariance-adaptive one-step formulations and their sample-covariance-matrix-based two-step alternatives are developed within the mentioned framework. The resulting challenging nonconvex optimization problems are efficiently tackled by a majorization-minimization (MM) algorithm for the on-grid case and an MM-minimum block improvement (MBI) approach for the off-grid counterpart. Furthermore, Bayesian information criterion (BIC)-based refinement strategies are introduced to improve RDP recovery and Doppler frequency displacement estimation. Numerical results under colored interference demonstrate the superior recovery performance of the proposed methods over representative benchmarks.

title: Cross-Spectral Analysis of Bivariate Graph Signals
authors: Kyusoon Kim, Hee-Seok Oh
abstract: With the advancements in technology and monitoring tools, we often encounter multivariate graph signals, which can be seen as the realizations of multivariate graph processes, and revealing the relationship between their constituent quantities is one of the important problems. To address this issue, we propose a cross-spectral analysis tool for bivariate graph signals. The main goal of this study is to extend the scope of spectral analysis of graph signals to multivariate graph signals. In this study, we define joint weak stationarity graph processes and introduce graph cross-spectral density and coherence for multivariate graph processes. We propose several estimators for the cross-spectral density and investigate the theoretical properties of the proposed estimators. Furthermore, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed estimators through numerical experiments, including simulation studies and a real data application. Finally, as an interesting extension, we discuss robust spectral analysis of graph signals in the presence of outliers.

title: Prediction Inference for Hybrid Models on Realized Volatility Forecasting
authors: Kyle Parrella, Kejin Wu
abstract: GARCH-LSTM hybrid models have become increasingly popular in the volatility forecasting literature. To date, these models have almost exclusively focused on point estimation and accuracy measures such as RMSE and MAPE, while failing to assess the uncertainty of these point estimates. We approach this gap in two ways. First, we extend the existing GARCH-LSTM model by modeling the conditional mean with an ARMA structure. Second, we develop a forward bootstrap algorithm to build multi-step-ahead prediction intervals for future realized volatility. In order to address the notorious undercoverage of prediction intervals, we implement two solutions. One draws bootstrap innovations from the empirical residual distribution to mimic the fat-tail property of financial series. The other utilizes principles from conformal prediction to systematically extend the prediction interval length. We evaluate the methods in simulations with heavy-tailed and time-varying GARCH processes and in rolling-window forecasts of four U.S. stock indices from 2020 to 2025. The ARMA-based hybrid gives the lowest point-forecast errors in most settings, and combining both remedies with the mean-based hybrid yields intervals closest to the nominal level among competing methods.

title: Deceleration without identification: testing a power-law trend in Bitcoin prices under persistent noise
authors: Carlos Baquero, Raquel Menezes
abstract: Plotted against time since its first block on logarithmic axes, the price of Bitcoin lies close to a straight line, and a power law in time has been proposed as its long-run trend. A good fit is weak evidence: when deviations from a trend are as persistent as a random walk, regressions on time find trends and high $R^2$ where none exist. We first bound what fifteen years of weekly prices can reveal, then test only what is answerable. Using a few low-frequency averages, invariant to the noise scale and calibrated over a declared family of persistent deviations with a four-year cycle and declining volatility, we test constant drift in expected log price against an added log-age term. The procedure was fixed, validated and publicly hashed before it was applied once. Constant drift is rejected under this family at nominal 5%, and a log-age coefficient of 5.7, close to the published exponent, is not rejected. The rejection does not survive allowing persistence beyond a random walk, and a Gompertz curve with a ceiling fits about as well as the power law. Whether deviations revert to the trend cannot be decided. Registered forecasts for 2027-2030 will be scored by future prices.
comment: 25 pages, 6 figures. Pre-registered protocol and forecasts: https://osf.io/2rdty. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23218897

title: DynamAuction: A Reinforcement Learning Environment for Repeated Auctions with Dynamic Value
authors: Eugénie Patard, Corentin Pla, Benjamin Heymann, Patrick Loiseau
abstract: A buyer who repeatedly participates in auctions for related items often faces a dynamic value problem: what they win today changes what tomorrow's items are worth. Despite the empirical importance of such effects, especially in display advertising, the algorithmic literature on repeated auctions has largely focused on the learning problem, by treating each opportunity as a contextual bandit, while sidestepping the planning problem induced by the dependence of current value on past wins. We introduce DynamAuction, a synthetic environment for single-buyer sequential bidding. The reward from each win depends on the buyer's history of previous wins, summarized through a carry-over state. The environment supports first- and second-price auctions, non-homogeneous Poisson arrivals, delayed feedback, saturation, and recency effects. We also introduce a new class of Model Predictive Control (MPC) algorithms. On our benchmark scenario, these MPC policies outperform off-the-shelf deep RL baselines (PPO, SAC, TD3) as well as a tuned shading baseline. We release DynamAuction to support RL research on repeated auctions.

title: Reconciling District Prediction Markets and Seat-Count Buckets in U.S. Midterm Elections
authors: Michael Tan, Han Xiao
abstract: The prediction market platform Kalshi offers individual markets for the winner in each U.S. congressional district and an aggregate market for the total number of Democratic House seats. We develop an applied statistical framework for reconciling these two market layers, since the aggregate seat count is determined by the collection of individual district outcomes. The framework combines a latent-Gaussian dependence structure with a log-odds adjustment to district probabilities and a power adjustment to aggregate seat-count probabilities, with parameters estimated by divergence minimization. Applied to a July 30, 2026 snapshot, the three-parameter primary model achieves close reconciliation, with forward and reverse KL divergences both approximately 0.0013, while yielding a positive latent national correlation, a negative district log-odds shift, and flattening of the aggregate target distribution. Daily analysis of 236 dates from January through August 2026 reveals two relatively stable periods separated by a spring transition period exhibiting substantial volatility in both parameter and divergence values. The framework provides a diagnostic approach for assessing cross-market consistency in hierarchically structured prediction or financial markets.

title: How much can a human being lift? A Bayesian latent capability model for Olympic weightlifting
authors: Manuele Leonelli
abstract: Estimates of the limits of human performance are usually built on record books, on the premise that a record is the best an athlete could do. In Olympic weightlifting the premise fails, because the competitor declares the weight before each of three attempts per lift and only the heaviest successful attempt is recorded, so a record is a lower bound, chosen by the athlete, on a maximal capability never observed. We treat the maximal lift of each competitor on each competition day as a latent variable, of which every attempt is a trial and every declared weight a measurement. Its distribution at a given bodyweight follows an extreme value mixture model with an estimated threshold, and an athlete-specific random effect links the competitions of each athlete. The model is fitted to the 117,892 attempts of 5,040 athletes in 141 international competitions between 2017 and 2026. The upper tail of capability is bounded, with posterior probability above 0.999 for men, 0.96 for the women's snatch and 0.94 for the women's clean and jerk. At 110 kilograms of bodyweight the men's ceiling lies one to three per cent above the heaviest lifts, against twelve and sixteen per cent for women at 86 kilograms. The record book alone places the men's ceiling six and twelve kilograms higher, because the best lift of a day ending on a success overstates capability.

title: Probabilistic Upscaling of the Interfacial Transition Zone Behaviour in Concrete
authors: Leon Riccius, Iuri B.C.M. Rocha, Erik Schlangen, Frans P. van der Meer
abstract: The stiffness and cracking behaviour of concrete are influenced by the interfacial transition zone (ITZ), the thin shell of paste that surrounds each aggregate. Yet the ITZ's mechanical properties are poorly characterized and are usually assigned to mesoscale models through ad hoc reduction factors. Because the ITZ is only tens of micrometres thick, its stiffness must be inferred indirectly from micromechanical tests, and the resulting estimates vary widely between studies and are rarely reported with a quantified uncertainty. We present a workflow that calibrates a homogenized ITZ model against the surface displacements of several micro-cantilever bending specimens and returns its stiffness descriptors as posterior distributions rather than single values. The calibration is posed as a Bayesian inverse problem with a model-discrepancy term, sampled with a surrogate-assisted Bouncy Particle sampler, the first application of this sampler to a real-world engineering problem. We compare a pooled model, which fits one descriptor vector to all specimens, with a hierarchical model that treats the specimens as draws from a common population and is sampled with a local extension of the sampler. The hierarchical model separates the estimation uncertainty from the aggregate-to-aggregate material variability, where only the former shrinks as more data are added. Propagated through a representative volume element of several aggregates, its predictive yields broader distributions of the mesoscale stress and strain and a wider spread variety of maximum von Mises stress locations. The calibration places the ITZ thickness above the 30 μm to 80 μm commonly assumed in the literature.

title: Global Trends and Heterogeneity in Modified Adjusted Net Savings
authors: Xin Xiao
abstract: Modified adjusted net savings is a derived weak sustainability indicator obtained by subtracting education expenditure from adjusted net savings (ANS). Because ANS equals net national savings plus education expenditure minus natural-resource depletion and carbon dioxide damage, MANS isolates the savings and depletion components and is useful when education expenditure would otherwise dominate cross-country comparisons. This study documents the global distribution, long-run trends, and cross-country heterogeneity of MANS excluding particulate emission damage over 1990-2021. The accounting base is the World Bank World Development Indicators series NY.ADJ.SVNX.CD, and MANS is constructed by subtracting education expenditure from this series. We combine global maps, aggregate time series, country-level heatmaps, distributional statistics, and income group comparisons. The results show that global MANS has increased substantially in aggregate, but its evolution as a share of nominal GDP has been more volatile and uneven across countries. Per capita MANS and global MANS totals remain concentrated in high-income and large economies, whereas low-income and lower-middle-income groups display persistently lower and more volatile outcomes. Country rankings are highly persistent, and some populous countries exhibit pronounced fluctuations associated with natural-resource dependence and structural change. The study provides a reproducible descriptive benchmark for monitoring sustainable development and highlights the need to interpret MANS in current US dollars alongside income-group and country-specific contexts. The findings are relevant for macroeconomic policy, natural-capital accounting, and the design of sustainability-oriented investment strategies.

title: Causal Learning with Invalid Instruments for High-dimensional Imaging Responses
authors: Yiting Wang, Chunlin Li, Shan Yu, Lily Wang
abstract: Large-scale neuroimaging studies provide high-dimensional imaging phenotypes for understanding brain-related diseases and their causal relations with biological risk factors. While instrumental variable (IV) methods can address unmeasured confounding in such observational data, existing IV methods face significant limitations when applied to high-dimensional imaging data, particularly in handling large-scale data and leveraging the intrinsic spatial structure of images. To address these challenges, we propose High-dimensional Functional-imaging Instrumental Variable Estimation (Hi-FIVE), a novel framework for estimating spatially varying causal effects when a majority of the candidate instruments may be locally invalid. We first establish identifiability conditions under which the spatial continuity of the causal effect surface propagates identification from regions where valid instruments form a plurality into regions where they do not, provided that invalid-IV effects switch on non-smoothly. Motivated by this result, Hi-FIVE combines penalized multivariate splines over triangulations for the causal surface and region-wise penalties for spatially localized invalid-IV effects, under an anchor constraint that keeps at least one relevant instrument valid on every simplex. A distributed algorithm parallelizes the computation over simplices for two- and three-dimensional images. We study the asymptotic properties of Hi-FIVE, establish consistency and pointwise asymptotic normality, and construct bootstrap-calibrated simultaneous confidence regions whose finite-sample coverage is evaluated through simulations. Hi-FIVE is illustrated with an analysis of the effect of phosphorylated tau on FDG-PET imaging in the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, interpreted under the stated IV assumptions.

title: Economics of Selection in Ranking & Selection: Neither Fixed-Precision nor Fixed-Budget
authors: Stephen E. Chick, Zaile Li, L. Jeff Hong
abstract: Ranking and selection (R&S) has evolved tremendously over the last several decades, with applications in agriculture, discrete optimization with computer simulation, clinical trial design, and other areas.
