ai_comments: 该论文针对现实中常见的有界时间序列（如有界波动率、比例等），提出了B-GARCH模型。其创新点在于从理论和模型设计上直接保证了条件方差和预测分布严格处于紧区间内，解决了传统GARCH模型由于支撑集不匹配导致的边界违背问题，具有很强的实用价值和严谨的理论基础。
motivation: 传统的GARCH模型适用于实数域（R）数据，用于有界数据（如已实现相关性、失业率等）时会产生支撑集不匹配问题，导致预测值突破自然边界（边界违背），而现有的非线性变换方法又会导致可解释性问题和估计偏差，因此需要一种能严格保持有界支撑集的新型GARCH模型。
method: 提出了B-GARCH（Bounded GARCH）框架，确保动态条件方差方程和参数约束严格保持过程的有界支撑集；建立了其严格平稳性和遍历性等基本概率性质；采用条件最大似然估计法进行参数估计，并推导了估计量的渐近一致性和渐近正态性。
results: 蒙特卡洛模拟验证了估计器在有限样本下的性能；对VNQ和TLT ETF月度已实现相关性的实证应用表明，B-GARCH模型能有效捕获波动率聚集，同时完全消除了传统GARCH模型的边界违背问题。
conclusion: B-GARCH模型成功解决了有界时间序列的条件异方差建模问题，在理论上证明了其平稳性和渐近性质，并通过模拟和实证分析证明了其优越性。

title: Necessary and sufficient conditions for the martingale property of stochastic exponentials driven by multi-dimensional diffusions
authors: Erhan Bayraktar, Hao Xing
abstract: We give necessary and sufficient coefficient conditions for stochastic exponentials driven by multidimensional diffusions to be true martingales. The classical reduction to non-exit of the diffusion with Girsanov-shifted drift separates the analysis into smooth boundary points, infinity, and nonsmooth boundary pieces. On smooth domains, under regularity and non-explosion hypotheses, martingality is equivalent to nonpositivity of the shifted Fichera drift, provided an explicit local condition holds where that drift vanishes and the stochastic integrand is unbounded. At infinity, Feller's test gives exact criteria when a scalar function of the diffusion reduces to a one-dimensional diffusion up to a time change with rate bounded above and away from zero. General radial and projection tests supply sufficient conditions. Applications give explicit necessary and sufficient conditions for inverse-CIR and $4/2$ models with correlated factors and singular stochastic integrands, including critical equality cases. The coupled non-affine examples go beyond direct scalar Feller tests and affine Riccati criteria, and exhibit boundary exits not decided by tests at infinity. Further exact criteria cover logarithmic boundary singularities, weighted distances, and an absorbed factor. The martingale conditions also yield uniqueness criteria for associated valuation equations.
comment: Keywords: Stochastic exponential; true martingale; strict local martingale; multi-dimensional diffusion; Fichera drift; Feller's test; Khasminskii's criterion; stochastic volatility; affine and Wishart processes; uniqueness for degenerate parabolic equations
zh_title: 多维扩散驱动的鞅性质的必要和充分条件
translation: 我们给出了多维扩散驱动的随机指数成为真正鞅的必要和充分系数条件。经典的约化到具有Girsanov移位漂移的扩散的非退出问题，将分析分为光滑边界点、无穷远和非光滑边界块。在光滑域上，在正则性和非爆炸假设下，鞅性质等价于移位后的Fichera漂移的非正性，前提是当该漂移消失且随机被积函数无界时，一个显式的局部条件成立。在无穷远，当扩散的一个标量函数约化为一个一维扩散（经过时间变换，且速率有界且远离零）时，Feller检验给出了精确的标准。一般的径向和投影检验提供了充分条件。应用给出了具有相关因子和奇异随机积分（包括临界等式情况）的逆CIR和4/2模型的显式必要和充分条件。耦合的非仿射例子超出了直接的标量Feller检验和仿射Riccati判据，并表现出无穷远检验无法决定的边界退出。进一步的精确标准涵盖了对数边界奇点、加权距离和一个吸收因子。鞅条件也产生了相关的评估方程的唯一性判据。
tldr: 该论文给出了多维扩散驱动的随机指数成为鞅的系数条件，并将分析分为光滑边界点、无穷远和非光滑边界块。在光滑域上，鞅性质等价于漂移的非正性，在无穷远，鞅性质等价于一维扩散的非退出。论文还提供了逆CIR和4/2模型等应用的显式条件，并讨论了相关因子、奇异随机积分以及临界等式情况。
ai_comments: 该论文在理解多维扩散驱动的随机指数的鞅性质方面取得了重要进展。通过严谨的数学分析，论文不仅给出了理论上的必要和充分条件，还将这些条件应用于具体的金融模型，具有重要的理论和实践意义。然而，论文中涉及的数学概念和推导较为复杂，可能需要专业背景的读者才能完全理解。
motivation: 该论文旨在确定多维扩散驱动的随机指数成为鞅的必要和充分条件。
method: 论文采用Girsanov变换将问题转化为具有漂移的扩散的非退出问题，并将分析分解为光滑边界点、无穷远和非光滑边界块。在光滑域上，通过分析移位后的Fichera漂移的非正性来确定鞅性质。在无穷远，利用Feller检验和径向/投影检验来获得鞅性质的判据。论文还考虑了相关因子、奇异随机积分以及临界等式情况。
results: 论文得出了多维扩散驱动的随机指数成为鞅的必要和充分系数条件。在光滑域上，鞅性质等价于移位Fichera漂移的非正性；在无穷远，鞅性质等价于一维扩散的非退出。论文还为逆CIR和4/2模型等提供了显式条件。
conclusion: 该研究为多维扩散驱动的随机指数的鞅性质提供了全面的必要和充分条件，并将这些条件应用于具体的金融模型，同时还讨论了与相关偏微分方程相关的唯一性判据。

title: On consistency of optimal portfolio choice for state-dependent exponential utilities
authors: Edoardo Berton, Marzia De Donno, Marco Maggis
abstract: In a complete Brownian market, we characterize consistency across investment horizons for state-dependent exponential utilities. We show that consistency is equivalent to an explicit relation between the drift and diffusion of risk tolerance and a deterministic absolutely continuous function. Within this family, the forward performance property selects a unique coefficient. More generally, under the stated admissibility conditions, a forward performance is consistent, whereas consistency alone does not imply the forward performance property.
zh_title: 关于状态依赖指数效用最优投资组合选择的一致性
translation: 在一个完备的布朗市场中，我们刻画了状态依赖指数效用在不同投资期限之间的一致性。我们证明了这种一致性等价于风险容忍度的漂移和扩散与一个确定性绝对连续函数之间的显式关系。在这个函数族中，向前绩效性质选择了一个唯一的系数。更一般地，在规定的允许性条件下，向前绩效是具有一致性的，然而仅有一致性并不能蕴含向前绩效性质。
tldr: 本文研究了状态依赖指数效用下最优投资组合选择的跨期一致性，证明了其与风险容忍度显式关系等价，并厘清了其与向前绩效性质的联系。
ai_comments: 该论文在状态依赖指数效用的框架下，深入探讨了最优投资组合选择在投资期限上的时间一致性问题，通过建立风险容忍度漂移与扩散之间的显式关系，为金融数学中的向前绩效理论（forward performance）提供了重要的理论补充。
motivation: 探究在完备布朗市场中，状态依赖指数效用函数在不同投资期限（investment horizons）下保持最优投资组合选择一致性的充要条件及其与向前绩效（forward performance）之间的内在联系。
method: 在完备布朗市场中，通过数学推导和特征刻画方法，分析状态依赖指数效用在不同投资期限下的持久一致性，并检验其与向前绩效性质的关系。
results: 研究表明，一致性等价于风险容忍度的漂移和扩散与一个确定性绝对连续函数之间的显式关系。在此类函数中，向前绩效性质可唯一确定一个系数；在允许性条件下，向前绩效总是具有一致性，但一致性并不必然蕴含向前绩效性质。
conclusion: 在完备布朗市场中，状态依赖指数效用的投资期限一致性等价于风险容忍度与确定性函数之间的特定显式关系，且向前绩效性质能够唯一确定该系数，但一致性本身并不能反推出向前绩效性质。

title: Why financial prices exhibit Brownian motion despite predictable order flow: An exactly solvable nonlinear price impact model
authors: Yuki Sato, Shunta Fujiwara, Kiyoshi Kanazawa
abstract: In econophysics, there are two enigmatic empirical laws of financial market microstructure: (i) the market-order flow has predictable persistence due to metaorder splitting by institutional investors, as formulated by the Lillo--Mike--Farmer model. However, this phenomenon seems paradoxical given the diffusive and unpredictable price dynamics. (ii) The price impact $I(Q_{\rm tot})$ of a large metaorder $Q_{\rm tot}$ follows the square-root law, $I(Q_{\rm tot})\propto \sqrt{Q_{\rm tot}}$. In this Letter, we reveal why price dynamics follows Brownian motion despite predictable order flow by unifying these enigmas via an exactly solvable model. We generalize the Lillo--Mike--Farmer model to nonlinear price-impact dynamics, which is mapped to a solvable Lévy-walk model. Our exact solution shows that the price dynamics remains diffusive under the square-root law, even under persistent order flow, reflecting the finite variance of metaorder impact; our model is thus a minimal representative of the universality class of nonlinear price-impact models with finite-variance metaorder impact. This work illustrates the crucial role of the square-root law in mitigating price movements by large metaorders, leading to Brownian price dynamics, consistent with the efficient market hypothesis over long timescales.
zh_title: 为什么尽管订单流具有可预测性，金融价格仍表现为布朗运动：一个精确可解的非线性价格冲击模型
translation: 在经济物理学中，金融市场微观结构有两个神秘的经验定律：(i) 由于机构投资者的大单拆分，市场订单流具有可预测的持久性，正如 Lillo-Mike-Farmer 模型所阐述的那样。然而，鉴于扩散且不可预测的价格动态，这种现象似乎是悖论式的。(ii) 一个大单 $Q_{\rm tot}$ 的价格冲击 $I(Q_{\rm tot})$ 遵循平方根律，即 $I(Q_{\rm tot})\propto \sqrt{Q_{\rm tot}}$。在本快报中，我们通过一个精确可解的模型将这些谜题统一起来，揭示了为什么尽管订单流具有可预测性，价格动态仍遵循布朗运动。我们将 Lillo-Mike-Farmer 模型推广到非线性价格冲击动力学，并将其映射到一个可解的 Lévy-walk 模型。我们的精确解表明，在平方根律下，即使在持续的订单流下，价格动力学仍然保持扩散状态，这反映了大单冲击的有限方差；因此，我们的模型是具有有限方差大单冲击的非线性价格冲击模型普适类的极简代表。这项工作阐明了平方根律在减轻由大单引发的价格变动、导致布朗价格动态方面的关键作用，这与长期时间尺度上的有效市场假说相一致。
tldr: 该论文通过构建一个精确可解的模型，证明了大单冲击的平方根律解释了为什么具有可预测持久性的订单流仍能导致布朗运动的价格动态。
ai_comments: 该论文通过一个精确可解的非线性价格冲击模型，成功解释了金融价格呈现布朗运动而订单流具有可预测持久性这一长期存在的金融物理学悖论，揭示了平方根律在维持市场有效性中的关键作用。
motivation: 旨在解决金融市场微观结构中的一个悖论：一方面机构投资者的拆单行为导致市场订单流具有可预测的持久性，另一方面价格动态却表现为扩散且不可预测的布朗运动。
method: 将Lillo--Mike--Farmer模型推广到非线性价格冲击动力学，并将其映射到一个可解的Lévy-walk模型中进行精确求解。
results: 精确解表明，在平方根律（即有限方差的大单冲击）下，即使存在持久的订单流，价格动力学仍然保持扩散状态，与长期有效市场假说一致。
conclusion: 该研究通过将Lillo-Mike-Farmer模型推广并映射到Lévy-walk模型，证明了平方根律导致的有限方差大单冲击是金融价格保持布朗运动的根本原因，从而统一了金融市场微观结构的两个经验定律。

title: A Rough Instantaneous Squared VIX Model for Term Structure and Option Pricing
authors: Tianfeng Yang, Wen Su, Blanka Horvath
abstract: The VIX term structure provides forward-looking measures of market uncertainty across horizons, while VIX options allow investors to hedge volatility risk. This paper proposes a rough instantaneous squared VIX (RISVIX) model by introducing fractional memory into the conventional Markovian framework. We derive an explicit representation of the VIX term structure governed by Mittag--Leffler decay and a semi-closed-form pricing formula for VIX options based on an affine Fourier--Laplace transform. These results support a two-step calibration procedure that estimates memory, mean reversion, and date-specific initial states from VIX term-structure indices before calibrating the remaining distributional parameters to VIX option prices. Using daily VIX term-structure indices and VIX option quotes from January 2018 to June 2025, we find that RISVIX improves upon the Markovian benchmark in fitting the VIX term structure, with larger gains during elevated-volatility periods and for its slope and curvature. RISVIX also improves out-of-sample option pricing, reducing MSE and MAE by 13.06\% and 6.33\%, respectively, with larger gains at shorter maturities and in high-VIX states. These findings suggest that the gains from fractional memory are particularly pronounced when volatility is elevated and can be obtained within a tractable direct model of VIX derivatives. Comparisons with additional benchmarks from the recent literature also show improvements to varying degrees in both VIX term-structure fitting and option pricing.
zh_title: 一种用于期限结构和期权定价的粗糙瞬时平方VIX模型
translation: VIX期限结构提供了跨期限的市场不确定性前瞻性度量，而VIX期权则允许投资者对冲波动率风险。本文通过将分数阶记忆引入传统的马尔可夫框架，提出了一种粗糙瞬时平方VIX（RISVIX）模型。我们推导出了由Mittag-Leffler衰减控制的VIX期限结构的显式表示，以及基于仿射傅里叶-拉普拉斯变换的VIX期权半闭式定价公式。这些结果支持了一个两步校准程序，该程序首先从VIX期限结构指数中估计记忆、均值回归和特定日期的初始状态，然后将剩余的分布参数校准到VIX期权价格。使用2018年1月至2025年6日的每日VIX期限结构指数和VIX期权报价，我们发现RISVIX在拟合VIX期限结构方面优于马尔可夫基准模型，在波动率上升期以及期限结构的斜率和曲率上增幅更大。RISVIX还改善了样本外的期权定价，将MSE和MAE分别降低了13.06%和6.33%，其中在较短期限和高VIX状态下的增益更大。这些发现表明，当波动率升高时，分数阶记忆带来的收益尤为明显，并且可以在易处理的VIX衍生品直接模型中获得。与近期文献中其他基准的比较也表明，在VIX期限结构拟合和期权定价方面均有不同程度的改进。
tldr: 本文提出了一种包含分数阶记忆的RISVIX模型，显著提升了VIX期限结构拟合和期权定价（特别是高波动率和短期期权）的准确性。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入分数阶记忆（fractional memory），成功构建了粗糙瞬时平方VIX（RISVIX）模型。这一模型不仅在数学上推导出了优雅的解析/半闭式表达（Mittag-Leffler衰减和仿射傅里叶-拉普拉斯变换），在实证上也显著提升了VIX期限结构拟合和期权定价的精度，特别是在高波动率时期和短期到期日表现突出，具有很高的学术与应用价值。
motivation: 现有的马尔可夫框架在捕捉VIX期限结构和期权定价方面存在局限，为了更好地刻画市场的不确定性和波动率风险，需要引入能够反映粗糙性和记忆性的框架。
method: 提出粗糙瞬时平方VIX（RISVIX）模型，引入分数阶记忆；利用Mittag-Leffler衰减推导VIX期限结构的显式表示；基于仿射傅里叶-拉普拉斯变换推导VIX期权的半闭式定价公式；并设计了两步校准程序。
results: 实证结果表明，与马尔可夫基准模型相比，RISVIX模型能更好地拟合VIX期限结构（尤其在波动率较高时期以及斜率和曲率上表现更优）；在样本外期权定价中，均方误差（MSE）和平均绝对误差（MAE）分别降低了13.06%和6.33%，在短期和高VIX状态下改善更明显。
conclusion: RISVIX模型通过引入分数阶记忆，有效提升了VIX期限结构拟合和期权定价的精度，特别是在高波动率时期和短期期权上表现显著。

title: VAR-Q: Tuning-free KV Cache Quantization for Visual Autoregressive Image and Video Generation
authors: Boxun Xu, Jiaji Lu, Yuxuan Yin, Zihu Wang, Ziyue Liu, Yu Wang, Zirui Liu, Peng Li
abstract: Visual autoregressive generation spans two dominant paradigms: next-scale prediction for images and video, and next-frame prediction for video. Both decode block-by-block rather than token-by-token, yielding KV caches whose statistics diverge from those of language models. At scale, KV memory exceeds the weights and limits large-scale deployment caused by a large amount of visual tokens. Our analysis of these caches reveals three findings. First, a small set of massive-value channels carries the functional load: ablating these outlier channels collapses generation, whereas ablating a matched set of inlier channels leaves quality intact. Second, the outliers organize along two axes, feature and block, with magnitudes persistent within each cell and shifting across cells. Third, this structure arises from two independent mechanisms: projection bias and RoPE-induced scattering. Guided by these findings, we propose VAR-Q, a tuning-free KV-cache quantization framework that groups along the same two axes. The generation loop provides block boundaries for free, removing the need for outlier detection or calibration. Paired with bit-packing kernels for runtime memory reduction, VAR-Q delivers low-bit quantization across nine models spanning both paradigms, cutting KV memory by up to 78.5% with negligible quality degradation and enabling 6x larger inference batches.
comment: A preliminary version of this work was presented at the ICCV 2025 BiVision Workshop

title: Discourse Analysis of Legislative Bill Discussions
authors: Isaac Rudnick, Nipun Das, Foaad Khosmood
abstract: Legislative hearings are distinct communication events with their own human recognizable structure and logic, yet they have been analyzed as distinct phenomena beyond their transcripts. Understanding legislative hearings at a deeper level is a major step in analyzing the work and power relationships within democratic bodies. In this work, we present a novel end-to-end pipeline for parsing rhetorical structures from legislative committee hearings with the goal of improving legislative discourse analysis and democratic accountability. We also propose a rhetorical structure grammar and find that 55.21% of California state bill discussions in our dataset can be parsed with this grammar. We evaluate our pipeline with two utterance section classifiers on a random subset of over 2,000 annotated utterances corresponding to 100 hearings. We find that a logistic regression-based classifier with grammar-based output masking and utterance tag smoothing outperforms more complex models, achieving an F1 score of 52.8% against our ground truth discourse section labels.

title: CCDWIKI: Decoupling Case Formulation from Response Generation in Longitudinal CBT Dialogue
authors: Mingwen Zhang, Ruiyang Song, Qinying Wang, Yuchen Wang, Changsheng Ma, Minqiang Yang
abstract: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) demands more than empathic validation, requiring instead a structured formulation of the interplay among situations, automatic thoughts, emotions, and behaviors. Therapists formalize this interplay through a Cognitive Conceptualization Diagram, where maintaining longitudinal coherence necessitates continuous evidential adjudication to separate tentative hypotheses from established findings. Current dialogue systems track conversational history via retrieval or static profiles but lack the representational capacity to encode epistemic status. Consequently, provisional interpretations are often prematurely reified as established facts, inadvertently biasing downstream interventions. Addressing this limitation, CCDWiki is introduced as a plug-and-play advisor conceptualizing longitudinal therapy as evidence-grounded hypothesis adjudication. The approach encodes each clinical hypothesis as a mutable entry bound to corroborating and contradicting evidence. Across sessions, accumulating data strengthens supported entries, preserves provisional ones, and retracts contradicted assumptions. The resulting formulation distills into concise guidance for unmodified therapeutic language models. Experiments demonstrate substantial improvements in both conceptualization and intervention quality without requiring backbone retraining.

title: DS@GT ARC at CheckThat! 2026: A Verdict-Anchored Pipeline for Generating Fact-Checking Articles
authors: Hoang Thanh Thanh Truong, Shuyu Tian
abstract: Misinformation spreads faster than professional fact-checkers can manually verify it and write articles explaining their verdicts. This creates a need to automate the production of fact-checking articles. This paper details work done by the DS@GT ARC team for CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3 Fact-Checking Article Generation. We seek to generate a full fact-checking article from a claim, its original verdict, and a set of scraped source documents. Our team built a four-stage pipeline that cleans noisy evidence, retrieves and clusters relevant sources, generates the article by conditioning \texttt{Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct} on the original fact-checker verdict, and recovers inline citations through deterministic post-processing. We achieved a mean score of 0.428 and ranked 3rd out of 9 teams for the CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3, compared to a baseline mean score of 0.272. Our code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/checkthat-2026-task3.
comment: CLEF 2026 Working Notes, 21 - 24 September 2026, Jena, Germany

title: Human-like cross-language generalisation in deep neural speaker embeddings and its acoustic foundations
authors: Tianze Xu, Xiyang Li, Xiaoming Jiang, Volker Dellwo
abstract: Generalisability is a central question for deep neural networks, including the cross-language generalisation of speaker embeddings. This study examined whether deep neural speaker embeddings generalise across languages and how such generalisation relates to human perception and acoustic structure. Using Cantonese--English bilingual speech presented in within- and cross-language conditions, we derived similarity from 18 state-of-the-art models and compared it with human ratings and acoustic features using linear mixed models and representational similarity analysis. Embeddings exhibited cross-language generalisation that broadly paralleled human behaviour, reflecting accurate identity discrimination and sensitivity to language switching. This generalisation relied on largely shared acoustic cues with language-sensitive weighting, mirroring human patterns. Together, these findings provide converging evidence for human--machine alignment in cross-language voice similarity processing.
comment: This manuscript has been accepted for presentation at Interspeech 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/xiyangg12/wespeaker. The archived release is available on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20606535

title: Deterministic Network Interface Naming on Multi-NIC Linux Systems: A Boot-Time Convergence Approach
authors: Chetan Nigudgi
abstract: Network interface naming on multi-NIC Linux systems suffers from a well-documented race condition in systemd-udevd that has remained unsolved since 2017. When multiple network interfaces are present, parallel udev worker threads attempt to rename interfaces simultaneously, causing EEXIST failures when a target name is temporarily occupied by another interface awaiting its own rename. The upstream systemd project has classified this as "not-a-bug" and declines to implement a fix. The problem, previously cosmetic under NetworkManager, has become critical as the industry migrates to systemd-networkd, which matches interfaces by name rather than MAC address, turning a failed rename into a complete loss of network connectivity. This paper presents a boot-time convergence approach that combines systemd .link file declarations with a retry-based init service that detects and recovers from rename failures before dependent services start. Deployed across diverse multi-NIC hardware configurations, the solution achieves 100% deterministic interface naming. The approach is OS-agnostic and applicable to any systemd-based Linux distribution.

title: SRRM: A Retrieval-Reconstruction Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Context Memory in Small Language Models
authors: Christopher Alberto Hamonangan
abstract: Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed on consumer-grade hardware, yet their ability to preserve information across progressively longer contexts remains insufficiently understood. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate retrieval-oriented tasks, providing limited insight into whether successful retrieval reflects comprehensive long-context memory preservation. To address this limitation, this paper introduces Simple Retrieval-Reconstruction Memory (SRRM), a lightweight and fully reproducible benchmark that jointly evaluates Targeted Retrieval and Global Information Reconstruction. This study also proposes the Memory Preservation Ratio (MPR), a benchmark-level metric that quantifies the relationship between retrieval and reconstruction performance. SRRM was evaluated using a synthetic dataset on three Qwen2.5 models (0.5B, 1.5B, and 3B parameters) across context loads ranging from 10 to 100 factual statements. Experimental results show that reconstruction performance deteriorated substantially faster than retrieval accuracy as contextual information increased, indicating that retrieval alone is insufficient to characterize long-context memory preservation. Among the evaluated models, Qwen2.5-1.5B achieved the highest retrieval accuracy (86.7%), reconstruction performance (45.7%), and MPR (0.53), outperforming the larger Qwen2.5-3B model (72.2%, 18.5%, and 0.26, respectively). These findings demonstrate that increasing parameter count does not necessarily improve long-context memory preservation. Overall, SRRM provides a reproducible and extensible benchmark for systematically evaluating long-context memory while revealing complementary memory behaviors that remain hidden under retrieval-only evaluation frameworks.

title: AI-Driven SaaS Platform Integration: AI Express for Unified Generative AI Services with Pay-As-You-Go Credit Systems and Scalable Microservice Architecture
authors: Deepit Sapru
abstract: Generative AI is currently fragmented, with separate subscriptions required for text generation, image synthesis, and code assistance, leading to high costs and workflow disruptions. AI Express is a SaaS platform that consolidates these capabilities into a unified pay-as-you-go service. The platform provides a range of AI tools, including a Core Code Reviewer that evaluates GitHub repositories, a Text-to-Website generator that converts text into fully functional websites, script generation, grammar checking, data analysis, and watermark removal, all accessible through a single interface without requiring technical expertise.

title: Streaming OS Installation from Compressed Partitioned Images on Memory-Constrained Bare-Metal Hosts
authors: Chetan Nigudgi, Chip Cary
abstract: Bare-metal server provisioning systems typically decompress OS images into RAM before writing them to disk. When servers have insufficient RAM to hold the decompressed image (increasingly common as OS images grow due to AI/ML toolkits, GPU drivers, and firmware stacks), provisioning fails entirely. This paper presents a streaming installation technique that combines partial decompression for metadata extraction with pipeline-based disk writing, enabling OS installation on hosts where available RAM is less than the decompressed image size. The method decompresses only the first 30MB of a compressed image to extract the GPT partition table, calculates the target filesystem offset, then streams the full image through a kernel pipe buffer (64KB) directly to disk at the calculated offset, never storing the decompressed data in memory or on disk. Deployed across a production fleet of memory-constrained bare-metal servers, the technique achieves 100% provisioning success where the standard approach fails entirely.

title: Who May Overrule the Agent? Evidence-Gated Authority in LLM Review Institutions
authors: Fuad Ali
abstract: Multi-agent language-model systems often add a reviewer to improve an upstream agent's decision. Yet a reviewer can both repair errors and replace decisions that were already correct. We study this as a problem of institutional jurisdiction: conditional on the same proposal, task information, model, and review output, when is the reviewer authorized to make its recommendation binding? We compare broad override authority with an evidence gate that permits replacement only after the reviewer produces a mechanically valid record of a binding-constraint violation and a compliant repair. Across two locally run open-weight models, 96 spatial-policy tasks, and a 96-task portfolio-transfer benchmark, the gate sharply reduces corruption of correct proposals while retaining most repairs of violations. The directions of this tradeoff are partly implied by the rule; its magnitude depends on reviewer transitions and upstream proposal states. A prospective validation then gives the reviewer an explicit choice to retain, replace, or escalate. This eliminates correct-proposal corruption for Qwen, but Mistral still replaces all 48 correct proposals; Qwen also declines every welfare-only repair that Mistral frequently attempts. Thus interface design changes reviewer behavior but is not a model-independent safeguard. The result is not that restricted review is universally better. It is that reviewer competence, action interface, and binding jurisdiction jointly determine both the correction domain and the corruption surface.
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code, frozen outputs, and reproduction instructions: https://github.com/tofuadmiral/institutional-representation-abm

title: Agent Harness Awareness: Turning Verified Telemetry into Operational Control for Tool-Using Agents
authors: Manu Agrawal, Shrey Nagpal
abstract: Tool descriptions tell an agent what an action can do, but they do not necessarily reveal whether that action is healthy or suitable at the moment of use. Execution harnesses often possess this information through monitors, traces, and recent failures while the model choosing the next action does not. We call this gap operational blindness. We introduce Agent Harness Awareness, a trust-separated design in which the host supplies a small, fresh, verified state snapshot before a consequential action while retaining measurement, enforcement, evaluation, and final dispatch authority. We test its tools-and-network instance with ToolRoute, a controlled isolation benchmark that holds the task and candidate semantics constant and varies the operational information available to the model. In a 216-decision ablation across GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5, and Gemini 3.7 Flash, verified tool-health state reduced mean observable policy regret by 96.9% against a same-shape neutral control (4,252 ms to 131 ms) and raised single-dispatch completion from 69.4% to 95.8%. In a separate 27-decision end-to-end replication with live local TCP/HTTP execution, OpenTelemetry client spans, and Toxiproxy-injected faults, verified state reduced mean regret from 8,956 ms to 0 ms (zero excess observable operational cost) and completed the live action in 9/9 model-by-fault cases versus 5/9 for the neutral control. These studies establish the tools-and-network instance of Agent Harness Awareness: selected host telemetry materially improves pre-dispatch operational choice. Runtime state, hardware pressure, economics, retry-aware recovery, and heterogeneous selection remain open empirical extensions of the same architecture.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Resource Orchestration for Agentic AI Systems
authors: Masoud Shokrnezhad, Tarik Taleb
abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems powered by large language models (LLMs) execute as autonomous multi-step pipelines that dynamically invoke tools, integrate observations into memory, and iterate until a task is resolved or a resource budget is exhausted. Unlike classical workflows with fixed graphs, the aggregate compute, bandwidth, and end-to-end latency demands of such pipelines are unknown at dispatch time: they emerge at runtime from intermediate observations and stochastic token sampling, yielding heavy-tailed, multi-modal random variables. This unpredictability forces infrastructure orchestrators into a dilemma: under-provisioning risks mid-execution throttling and deadline violations, while over-provisioning wastes scarce edge or cloud capacity. Existing schedulers require a fully known pipeline graph, while edge resource-management methods rely on parametric or stationary demand models, and neither fits the unknown, non-stationary profiles of agentic pipelines. We formalize this setting as the uncertainty-aware agentic orchestration problem, where the goal is to reserve, at dispatch time, compute and bandwidth allocations that cover actual pipeline demands, and to verify that the pipeline can meet its deadline, each with a prescribed probability. We then propose Conformal Reservation for Orchestration (CRO), an online algorithm that translates a sliding window of past execution traces into dispatch-time resource allocations with finite-sample, distribution-free coverage guarantees via conformal prediction. Simulations over heterogeneous task mixes with multi-modal and heavy-tailed profiles show that CRO is the only evaluated method that simultaneously satisfies target probabilistic coverage across all risk levels while, among coverage-feasible methods, attaining the lowest over-reservation, roughly halving the resource waste of the Chebyshev-bound baseline.
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to IEEE MECOM 2026, Marrakech, Morocco, 2-4 November 2026

title: Same Origin, Different Verdicts: Text Production Conditions Confound Machine-Generated Text Detection in Russian
authors: Stanislav Kirichenko
abstract: Automated detection of machine-generated text is applied where the verdict carries a cost for the author, yet origin is a property of the production process, not an observable property of the text. The conditions under which a text is produced push it in the same direction in which a generative model is presumed to push it. This study measures the contribution of these conditions while origin is held fixed. The Russian-language corpus of 1882 documents comprises a machine part, generated by four generation channels (each backed by its own model family) across 45 tasks in three task modes, and an archival human part annotated for source regimentation level before the texts were read. The primary contrast is computed within the machine corpus: both halves of a pair are generated by the same model for the same task and differ only in task wording. Machine-likeness is measured by four operationalisations: an interpretable index with weights fixed before data collection, a trained classifier, a zero-shot metric on an open model, a judge model. The main result is disagreement between procedures: changing the task mode shifted the scores of all four, but three gave a negative shift, the judge a positive one, and none of the four intervals covers zero. The comparison plan and the specifications of procedures 2-4 were fixed after the result of procedure 1, before procedures 2-4 ran; the disagreement survived correction of a corpus defect and of the nested validation. A baseline on the source identifier alone reaches a median AUROC of 1.0000 on the thirteen group splits where it is defined, and removing emphasis markers flipped a confident machine verdict to human without changing the full text by a single character. The scores are properties of a specific measurement system and corpus: they reflect data collection, repetition, formatting, and preprocessing decisions as well as linguistic style.
comment: 65 pages, 6 figures, 24 tables. English translation of the frozen Russian manuscript; the Russian text is the source of record and is available with all data, code and run manifests at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21749574 (v1.0.1)

title: Challenge-Aware Knowledge Recruitment with Meta-Agent Supervision for Medical Multi-Agent Reasoning
authors: Riccardo Riccio, Haitz Sáez de Ocáriz Borde, Pietro Liò
abstract: Large language models perform strongly on standard medical QA but degrade on harder reasoning tasks, where multi-agent debate often fails to beat strong single-model prompting. We argue that a key limitation is that existing systems select experts and retrieve knowledge from the question alone, rather than from gaps that emerge during reasoning. We propose challenge-aware adaptive recruitment: an external CHALLENGER inspects the evolving reasoning trace and identifies specific factual or expertise gaps. These signals trigger targeted knowledge retrieval or mid-discussion specialist recruitment. On the MEDAGENTSBENCH hard subset (862 questions across nine biomedical datasets), upfront retrieval provides little benefit, while challenge-aware in-between retrieval performs better; on a multi-specialist backbone it improves accuracy on 8 of 9 datasets and adds 6 percentage points over Challenger Only. Ablations indicate benefits from both retrieval timing and gap-specific query signals, and a live web-search experiment shows that the timing advantage persists across retrieval backends. For specialist recruitment, self-triggered adaptation is unreliable, whereas Challenger-triggered recruitment raises GPT-4.1-mini MedQA accuracy from 46% to 54%, with positive direction on all tested generalization datasets. Naively combining retrieval and specialist recruitment degrades performance, highlighting the need to coordinate adaptive intervention channels. These results show that when and why external resources are recruited is a key design choice in multi-agent medical reasoning.

title: A Feasibility Condition for Confidence-Gated Tiered LLM Inference
authors: Sumit P. Ahuja
abstract: Tiered inference distributes large language model computation across a hierarchy of devices, from on-device and edge hardware to the datacenter, and is increasingly offered as the route to cheaper, lower-latency, and more private serving. Most such systems orchestrate frozen model checkpoints, and most decide what to resolve locally and what to escalate using a confidence signal produced by a forward-deployed model. We give a closed-form condition for when no threshold on that signal makes a tiered cascade worthwhile relative to sending every query to the backstop. Modeling the routing decision as a binary test and separating local from escalation cost through an architecture cost ratio $κ$, we derive a feasibility condition bracketed by a signal-free floor, below which a cascade is feasible at any signal quality, and a perfect-signal ceiling, above which none is. Read along the $κ$ axis the condition inverts: where local compute is billed, cost binds, matching a recent empirical finding; where it is sunk, on decentralized hardware, feasibility becomes unconditional and signal quality instead sets what the cascade achieves. We turn the condition into three design requirements that existing trained-in primitives satisfy only in isolation, and we propose, as future work, a co-designed architecture and a protocol to test it. The condition and the inversion hold independently of that architecture; they are the paper's contribution.

title: Ranking and Unranking Permutations in Heap's Order
authors: Yusheng Hu
abstract: Heap's algorithm is a permutation generation method with very low constant overhead. Its element-interchanging mechanism, however, prevents the standard factorial-base Lehmer code from being applied directly, and to our knowledge no explicit Rank/Unrank algorithm for the Heap order has been published. This paper describes the block structure of Heap's algorithm in terms of rearrangement operators: the net effect of a block-internal traversal is a tail-preserving operator and the block-boundary swap is a top-level swap operator, and together they yield a closed-form recurrence for the block transitions. On this basis a bottom-up Unrank algorithm and a top-down Rank algorithm are built from one and the same closed-form in-block mapping; both run in $O(n^3)$ time and $O(n)$ space and require no factorial-scale precomputed table. The supporting proofs use a synchronized strong induction on the dimension to establish the bijectivity of the trailing-element mapping, closed forms for the final arrangement and for the trailing sequence, the dichotomy of its cycle structure, and the reciprocity of Rank and Unrank. The Heap order is in fact the colex order of the mixed-radix code.

title: mmHand: Toward Pixel-Level-Accuracy Hand Localization Using a Single Commodity mmWave Device
authors: Xiaoyu Zhang, Zhengxiong Li, Chenhan Xu, Luchuan Song, Huining Li, Hongfei Xue, Yingxiao Wu, Wenyao Xu
abstract: The hand localization problem has been a longstanding focus due to its many applications. The task involves modeling the hand as a singular point and determining its position within a defined coordinate system. However, due to data modality limitations, existing hand localization technologies face several challenges. For example, vision-based localization raises privacy concerns, while wearable-based methods compromise user comfort. In this paper, we introduce mmHand, a new device-free, privacy-preserving dynamic hand localization system with pixel-level accuracy, using a single commodity mmWave device. We first propose a mmImage generation tool to fully extract spatial information from raw mmWave data and introduce a novel 2D image-format representation of mmWave data. Next, we design a framework that provides a new quality evaluation method and pixel space labeling for the mmWave data. Finally, we present a cross-modality spatial feature-enhanced model with high spatial feature extraction capabilities, which can accurately localize hand positions at the pixel level in the mmWave radar U-V pixel coordinate system. We evaluate the system with experiments on 12 subjects in three scenarios, and the results across four metrics demonstrate the effectiveness of our hand localization system.

title: When Does Sharing Work? Scaling a Shared SigLIP2 Across Image, Video, Audio, and Audio-Visual Representations
authors: Xiaofei Sun, Peng Wang, Huayao Liu, Xiaoxiao Xu, Jun Song, Deqing Li, Lin Qu
abstract: Contrastive pretraining has advanced image-text understanding, yet image, video, and audio encoders are still trained independently, with cross-modal alignment realized mainly through post-hoc binding to a frozen anchor space. We present Omni-Encoder, a general multimodal encoder that processes image, video, audio, and audio-visual inputs within a single SigLIP-2 Vision Transformer with fully shared parameters. Unlike anchor-centric binding or per-modality adapters, all modalities are optimized jointly end-to-end, and the framework is organized from input to training. A modality-native input stage first maps each signal into the shared embedding space, including a 1D-convolutional audio tokenizer that converts mel-spectrograms into tokens aligned with visual patches. A multimodal rotary position embedding parameterized by absolute timestamps then places visual frames and audio segments in a unified spatiotemporal coordinate system. Finally, alternating-modality training interleaves image, video, audio, and temporally aligned audio-visual batches and accumulates their gradients into one update, which we find central to stable joint optimization. Omni-Encoder achieves competitive results on 16 benchmarks across all four modalities with one shared parameter set, and joint training improves each modality over its separately trained counterpart. Code and models will be publicly released.

title: PEEK: One-Step-Look-Ahead Exposure Bias Correction for Diffusion Sampling
authors: Yunwei Bai, Ying Kiat Tan, Tsuhan Chen
abstract: Diffusion image generators are successful due to accurate denoising networks and strong numerical samplers. Yet the two components are not fully matched. During sampling, the denoiser predicts for the next step based on flawed input that differ much from the real data. This train-test gap, or exposure bias, caps image generation quality (i.e., blurry, lacking in details or awkward in shape). To mitigate the problem, we propose PEEK, a novel training-free deterministic sampler plugin. At each eligible denoising step, PEEK first performs a provisional one-step update, evaluates the denoiser once at the look-ahead state, and interpolates it with the one-step-later prediction to form the next noisy state. By taking the additional step, we obtain a generally more-image-like prediction from the higher-signal noisy state, mitigating the exposure bias. To optimize the interpolation positions, PEEK searches for an interpolation schedule search made efficient by the prefix and baseline noise-schedule-rebasing caches. On 8 pixel-space and latent-space diffusion models with unconditional, label-guided, and text-guided settings across various output resolutions, PEEK consistently improves over NFE-matched baselines, with FID improvements up to 49.3\% at minimal extra computation cost (e.g., the one-time-per-model calibration takes at most 2.2 minutes across our experiments.). Project website is at https://dachengruoque.github.io/PEEK-Video/.

title: Augmentation with Reinforcement Transformation for Low-textured Scientific Sketch Image Retrieval
authors: Zhiqiang Wang, Sheri L. Barton, Jennifer H. Johnson, Yi He, Xingquan Zhu
abstract: Low-textured sketch images are widely used in scientific applications, including wildlife conservation, archaeological illustration, and forensic composites. Learning from and retrieving such images is challenging because they lack detailed surface textures and visual variations commonly exploited by modern deep learning models. This paper proposes Augmentation with Reinforcement Transformation (ART) to fine-tune pretrained models to learn effective representations for accurate sketch image retrieval. Our key observation is that sketches are particularly sensitive to image transformations, such as rotation, flipping, zooming, and stretching. While some transformations preserve their structural integrity, others may introduce distortions that hinder representation learning. Instead of randomly choosing transformations to construct fine-tuning views, ART formulates augmentation selection as a multi-armed bandit (MAB) problem, where transformations are treated as arms and their effectiveness is continuously evaluated through rewards. This enables ART to adaptively construct reward-guided view banks before self-supervised fine-tuning; the subsequent representation loss does not feed back to ART. On Florida manatee sketches provided by Mote Marine Laboratory, ART achieves 71.40% average Top-1 accuracy for transformed-scar retrieval, compared with 68.83% for random augmentation selection, and 55.84% for location-aware sketch retrieval, compared with 18.18% for frozen CLIP.

title: Visual Forensic Detection of Fabricated Bangla News Photocards using Deep Learning
authors: Anindya Kundu, Kabya Mithun Saha, Md. Muhaiminul Islam, Fayek Ahmed, Aminul Kader Bulbul, Muhammad Ibrahim
abstract: In Bangladesh, much localized misinformation spreads as photocards: single-image news summaries that imitate the branding of well-known news organizations. Because the misleading message lives in the pixels rather than in machine-readable text, text-based fact-checking tools cannot see it. We recast photocard fake-news detection as visual image forgery detection. We build a dataset of 969 authentic and 1,077 fabricated Bangla photocards scraped from public Facebook pages: authentic cards from the verified pages of seventeen national television broadcasters, fabricated ones from pseudo-broadcaster pages, anonymous profiles, and public groups. Sixteen photometric and morphological transformations per image grow the corpus to 32,736 samples. A fully connected ANN reaches only about 52% accuracy, its loss stuck at ln(2) ~ 0.693, showing that flattening the image destroys the spatial cues forgery detection needs. A compact, fully batch-normalized four-block CNN with 489,954 parameters, about 1,644x smaller than the ANN, is evaluated with leakage-free stratified group five-fold cross-validation, which keeps every augmented version of a card in one fold. Under this protocol the CNN reaches 87.45% +/- 0.53% pooled accuracy from scratch and 88.75% +/- 1.55% when its classifier head is warm-started from the ANN. An ImageNet-pretrained YOLOv8n-cls backbone (1.44M parameters) fine-tuned on the same folds reaches 97.36% +/- 0.42%, marking the headroom above the compact model. We report per-class precision, recall, F1, and pooled confusion matrices, diagnose and fix a one-class collapse caused by an unnormalized classifier head, and give a manual error analysis and bias-variance diagnosis showing that the compact CNNs under-fit.

title: HippocamPEX: A Hippocampus-Inspired In-Silico Architecture for Context-Aware Sequence Prediction
authors: Md Abdullah al Kaiser, Keiland W. Cooper, Rouhan Noor, Ankur Singh, Zhishun Yang, Hamed Poursiami, Bhuvanesh Sathish Kayarabettu, Ziyi Liang, Babak Shahbaba, Maryam Parsa, Norbert J. Fortin, Akhilesh Jaiswal
abstract: The brain's hippocampus enables episodic memory - the ability to encode events within their context, organize them into sequences, and generate predictive representations to guide adaptive behavior. Modern computing architectures, however, are optimized for large-scale arithmetic and struggle with such context-dependent sequential prediction or "cognitive" tasks. To translate these capabilities into a mixed-signal architecture, we first derived a working model from the neuroscience literature distilling key hippocampal computations into engineering-friendly abstractions. We then leveraged converging advances in in-memory computing, neuromorphic computing, asynchronous circuits, and analog computing to design a mixed-signal hardware architecture implementing these computations, called HippocamPEX. Finally, we demonstrated that HippocamPEX reproduces characteristic representational dynamics of hippocampal subregions and performs robust context-specific sequence prediction through detailed activity and circuit simulations. By tightly coupling hardware design with neuroscience knowledge, this work establishes a pathway for artificial systems capable of rapid, adaptive, and context-aware decision-making, addressing a central gap between biological and conventional computing.

title: PointNDF: Cascaded Neural Displacement Fields for Point Cloud Denoising
authors: Michael Y. Wang, Pingping Cai
abstract: Point cloud denoising aims to recover clean geometry from noisy 3D observations while preserving both fine surface details and the underlying spatial distribution of the points. Many learning-based methods adopt a two-stage pipeline that first extracts point-wise features from the noisy input and subsequently predicts point-wise displacements via simple regressions. However, these approaches often lack robust feature guidance and distribution-aware geometric refinement, causing them to fail at maintaining optimal point uniformity and geometric quality. To address these limitations, we propose PointNDF, a denoising framework that combines patch-level geometric context with local displacement prediction. Specifically, a Point Transformer V3 (PTv3) encoder aggregates multiscale geometric information into a global patch descriptor. Rather than directly regressing an unconstrained displacement vector, a Neural Displacement Field (NDF) fuses this global patch descriptor with per-point neighborhood features. It then predicts each displacement through bounded-vector and scale factor branches, thereby achieving a superior, more uniform point distribution. Three cascaded NDF stages propagate local features and progressively refine the point positions. Experiments on PU-Net and ModelNet10 demonstrate competitive denoising accuracy and favorable inference efficiency. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/peridous/PointNDF.
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Accepted to MMM 2027 (33rd International Conference on Multimedia Modeling)

title: LLM-based NPCs in Video Games: A Systematic Mapping Study
authors: Dilan Mian, Jeremy Bradbury, Yann-Gaël Guéhéneuc, Fabio Petrillo, Cristiano Politowski
abstract: For decades, non-player characters (NPCs) have been driven by rule-based systems whose personalities and interactions are scripted before release. Large language models (LLMs) promise NPCs that converse openly, adapt to new situations, and behave in ways developers did not fully author, prompting a wave of research and commercial experimentation. Yet the field lacks a unified picture of what has been built, how well it works, and at what cost. We address this gap with a systematic mapping study of 377 papers from the academic literature, yielding 42 papers analysed against a main research question and ten sub-questions across four thematic axes. We provide the first quantitative characterisation of component adoption, latency, safety coverage, and reproducibility: short-term memory and world-state grounding are near-universal (60% and 69%), whereas long-term memory (31%), reflection (38%), and retrieval-augmented generation (14%) remain rare, and response times span 2.6 to 15 seconds. Finally, we identify six structural barriers to commercial adoption and offer evidence-based recommendations for developers and researchers.
comment: 12 pages. Accepted manuscript. Published in IEEE Transactions on Games (Early Access)
zh_title: 视频游戏中基于LLM的NPC：一项系统性映射研究
translation: 几十年来，非玩家角色（NPC）一直由基于规则的系统驱动，其个性和互动在发布前已设定。大型语言模型（LLM）有望实现开放对话、适应新情况且行为方式未完全由开发者编写的NPC，这引发了研究和商业实验的浪潮。然而，该领域缺乏对已构建内容、工作效果和成本的统一认识。我们通过对学术文献中的377篇论文进行系统性映射研究来弥补这一空白，最终分析了42篇论文，围绕一个主要研究问题和四个主题轴下的十个子问题进行分析。我们首次提供了组件采用、延迟、安全覆盖和可复现性的定量特征：短期记忆和世界状态基础接近普遍（60%和69%），而长期记忆（31%）、反思（38%）和检索增强生成（14%）仍然罕见，响应时间范围为2.6至15秒。最后，我们识别了阻碍商业采用的六个结构性障碍，并为开发者和研究人员提供了基于证据的建议。
tldr: 对377篇学术论文进行系统性映射研究，分析了42篇，首次量化了基于LLM的NPC组件采用情况、延迟、安全覆盖和可复现性，并指出了商业采用的六个结构性障碍。
ai_comments: 这项研究通过系统性映射为基于LLM的NPC领域提供了宝贵的概览，填补了现有知识空白。其量化分析揭示了当前技术采纳的现状和挑战，特别是对不同记忆和生成机制的使用情况以及响应延迟的分析，为未来的研究和商业开发指明了方向。识别商业采用障碍并提供建议，对于推动该技术落地具有重要意义。
motivation: 几十年来，非玩家角色（NPC）一直由基于规则的系统驱动，其个性和互动在发布前已设定。大型语言模型（LLM）有望实现开放对话、适应新情况且行为方式未完全由开发者编写的NPC，这引发了研究和商业实验的浪潮。然而，该领域缺乏对已构建内容、工作效果和成本的统一认识，本研究旨在弥补这一空白。
method: 通过对学术文献中的377篇论文进行系统性映射研究，最终分析了42篇论文，围绕一个主要研究问题和四个主题轴下的十个子问题进行分析。
results: 研究首次量化了组件采用情况、延迟、安全覆盖和可复现性：短期记忆和世界状态基础接近普遍（60%和69%），而长期记忆（31%）、反思（38%）和检索增强生成（14%）仍然罕见，响应时间范围为2.6至15秒。
conclusion: 研究识别了阻碍商业采用的六个结构性障碍，并为开发者和研究人员提供了基于证据的建议。

title: CAST-Bench: Tracing Every Sound to Its Source in Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation
authors: Yucong Liu, Qi Tian, Shuyuan Tu, Kaihang Pan, Weijie Kong, Chao Pan
abstract: Existing benchmarks for joint text-to-audio-video (T2AV) generation evaluate perceptual quality and audiovisual alignment, but balanced sound-source sam?pling and separate reporting by shot structure remain limited. This makes it dif?ficult to determine whether a specific sound is missing, attributed to the wrong source, or lost across shot transitions. To address this, we introduce CAST?BENCH, a benchmark designed to trace every generated sound back to its in?tended source in multi-shot audio-video generation. The core idea is to formu?late T2AV correctness as an audiovisual contract in which each requested sound must be emitted by the right source, synchronized with the corresponding visual action, and carry the right semantic content. Concretely, the benchmark orga?nizes 900 prompts into 9 sound-source categories, with 100 prompts per cate?gory, spanning speech, animals, instruments, ambient sounds, and other emitter types. The prompts include 439 single-shot and 461 multi-shot narratives, each derived from a structured specification that links every audio event to its emit?ter, subject, and temporal slot. The benchmark provides an 18-metric evaluation suite covering three dimensions: Visual Performance, Content Consistency, and Audio & Semantic Alignment. We further benchmark 12 representative gen?erators and find that visual quality is nearly saturated across leading systems, yet audio semantic scores still differ markedly. Across the nine shared mod?els, multi-shot prompts receive lower aggregate scores under the subset-specific scoring rules and yield different model rankings. Multi-person speech, con?sistent speaker identity across shots, and cross-shot event retention remain the main unresolved challenges. All prompts and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/yucong-liu/CAST-Bench-public.

title: On the most informative Boolean function under noise
authors: Dimiter Kramer, Mert Saglam
abstract: Let $X$ be a uniform random bit string and $Y$ be obtained by flipping each bit of $X$ independently with probability $p$. Let $C$ be a random bit obtained as a function of $Y$. We show that $\mathbf{I}(C:X)\le \mathbf{I}(Y_1:X)$ for all $p\in[0,1]$, which resolves a conjecture posed by Courtade and Kumar in 2013.
zh_title: 关于噪声下信息量最大的布尔函数
translation: 设$X$是一个均匀随机比特串，$Y$是通过以概率$p$独立翻转$X$的每个比特得到的。设$C$是作为$Y$的函数得到的随机比特。我们证明了对于所有$p \in [0,1]$，$\mathbf{I}(C:X)\le \mathbf{I}(Y_1:X)$，这解决了Courtade和Kumar在2013年提出的一个猜想。
tldr: 本文解决了Courtade和Kumar在2013年提出的一个猜想，证明了在噪声环境下，布尔函数C与原始比特串X之间的互信息I(C:X)总是小于或等于噪声比特串Y的单个比特Y_1与X之间的互信息I(Y_1:X)。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过解决一个长期存在的猜想，在信息论和布尔函数领域做出了重要贡献。其结果为理解噪声信道下信息传递的限制提供了新的理论基础，可能对编码理论和数据传输等领域有潜在影响。
motivation: 解决Courtade和Kumar于2013年提出的关于噪声下布尔函数互信息的一个猜想。
method: 通过数学证明，建立了$X$（均匀随机比特串）、$Y$（$X$经过独立比特翻转后的结果）和$C$（$Y$的函数）之间的互信息关系，并证明了不等式$\mathbf{I}(C:X)\le \mathbf{I}(Y_1:X)$。
conclusion: 成功解决了Courtade和Kumar在2013年提出的关于噪声下布尔函数的互信息猜想。

title: Unlocking Turing Tensor Cores: A Measured Throughput Account of From-Scratch Pre-training on a Single 22G RTX 2080 Ti
authors: Dezhou Shen
abstract: The RTX 2080 Ti (TU102) ships full second-generation Tensor Cores in hardware, yet the vendor throttles FP16 matrix multiplication at the driver level, leaving usable tensor throughput well below the hardware peak. turing-unlock lifts this restriction with a kernel module that, before the nvidia driver binds the device, writes the FP16 speed selectors (SS0=0x88888888, SS1=0x8) and releases the ACR mutex; published measurements report cuBLAS FP16 matmul throughput rising from 55.7 to 91.4 TFLOPS (about 1.6x). On the same 22G 2080 Ti and under the same from-scratch pre-training protocol as the companion memory ledger (five tiers of Chinese encoder-decoder models, 2,451 steps per tier, 16,384 tokens per step, seed 42), we obtain a before/after throughput account: the small tier (75.7M parameters, 512-wide, 8+8 layers, activation checkpointing on) improves in steady-state throughput from 6,480 to 7,246 tok/s (+11.8%) with wall time cut from 1.77h to 1.61h (9.0% saved); the tiny tier goes from 15,150 to 15,866 tok/s (+4.7%) with wall time savings of 3.8%; the three smaller tiers (pico-micro) gain at most +0.3%; per-tier peak memory stays bit-identical, and final quality metrics are bit-identical or consistent within 10^-3. We conclude that the unlock gain is a function of matrix size, rising monotonically with tier -- imperceptible for pico-micro, visible from tiny upward, and cashed out as a double-digit percentage at small -- and that it is a pure throughput gain that leaves training dynamics untouched.

title: Constraint-Preserving Flow Matching for Spectral Graph Generation
authors: Anita Yang, Ken-ichi Kawarabayashi, Yohan Jung
abstract: Spectral graph generation models graphs through the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of their Laplacians, providing a compact and continuous alternative to direct graph construction. However, these eigensystems must retain the structural properties of graph Laplacians. Existing approaches preserve eigenvector orthonormality but do not enforce the Laplacian nullspace constraint, potentially producing eigensystems inconsistent with Laplacian structure. To address this, we introduce Laplacian-Constrained Stiefel Flow Matching (LaSFM), which preserves the nullspace condition alongside eigenvector orthonormality and positive eigenvalues during generation. We characterize the underlying constrained Stiefel manifold and formulate flow matching on it. We further extend LaSFM to property-guided generation, steering samples toward desired graph properties while maintaining these constraints. Experiments demonstrate improved performance on both spectral and graph-level metrics, along with better alignment with target properties.
zh_title: 约束保持流匹配用于谱图生成
translation: 谱图生成模型通过图拉普拉斯矩阵的特征值和特征向量来建模图，提供了一种紧凑且连续的替代直接图构造的方法。然而，这些特征系统必须保留图拉普拉斯矩阵的结构特性。现有方法保留了特征向量的正交性，但没有强制执行拉普拉斯零空间约束，可能产生与拉普拉斯结构不一致的特征系统。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了拉普拉斯约束Stiefel流匹配 (LaSFM)，它在生成过程中同时保持零空间条件、特征向量正交性和正特征值。我们表征了底层的约束Stiefel流形，并在此流形上构建了流匹配。我们进一步将LaSFM扩展到属性引导生成，在保持这些约束的同时引导样本趋向所需的图属性。实验表明，在谱和图级别指标上均表现出改进的性能，并与目标属性更好地对齐。
tldr: 本文引入了拉普拉斯约束Stiefel流匹配 (LaSFM)，通过在生成过程中保持拉普拉斯零空间条件、特征向量正交性和正特征值，解决了现有谱图生成模型中未能强制执行拉普拉斯零空间约束的问题，从而提高了谱图和图级别指标的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入拉普拉斯零空间约束，解决了谱图生成领域的一个关键限制，增强了生成图的结构一致性。其在约束流形上构建流匹配的创新性方法以及对属性引导生成的扩展，为更精确和可控的图生成提供了新的途径。该工作对于需要生成具有特定谱性质和结构完整性的图的应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的谱图生成方法虽然保留了特征向量的正交性，但未能强制执行拉普拉斯零空间约束，这可能导致生成的特征系统与拉普拉斯结构不一致。
method: 本文提出了拉普拉斯约束Stiefel流匹配 (LaSFM)，它在生成过程中同时保持零空间条件、特征向量正交性和正特征值。该方法表征了底层的约束Stiefel流形，并在此流形上构建了流匹配。此外，LaSFM还扩展到属性引导生成，在保持约束的同时引导样本趋向所需的图属性。
results: 实验表明，该方法在谱和图级别指标上均表现出改进的性能，并与目标属性更好地对齐。
conclusion: LaSFM通过在谱图生成中强制执行拉普拉斯零空间约束，显著提高了生成模型的性能和与目标属性的一致性。

title: Learning Implicit Solves for Dynamic Simulations
authors: Chawit Kaewnuratchadasorn, Jiaji Wang, Xin Nie
abstract: High-fidelity simulation of dynamical systems is central to scientific discovery and engineering design, yet remains computationally demanding. Here we introduce the Implicit Neural Operator Solver (INOS), which learns the implicit solve and encodes a time integrator. INOS pretrains a neural operator from static equilibrium solutions and reuses it within Newmark-$β$ integration. At each time increment, the integrator forms an effective equilibrium problem, the pretrained neural operator infers the next-step solution field, and the Newmark relations advance the dynamic state. Numerical examples in linear and nonlinear elastodynamics demonstrate accurate full-field predictions without dynamic trajectory supervision. Comparative results show that INOS, evaluated zero-shot, achieves higher predictive accuracy than neural solver baselines trained on dynamic simulations. In addition, INOS delivers over 4,600$\times$ speedup in nonlinear simulations over sequential classical finite-element solvers. INOS natively accommodates changes in dynamic conditions and enables reuse of the pretrained operator across spatial and temporal discretizations. Further evaluation demonstrates a stable million-step rollout. These findings establish INOS as a reusable neural implicit solver for accurate, efficient, and robust dynamic modeling.
zh_title: 学习动态模拟的隐式求解
translation: 高保真动态系统模拟是科学发现和工程设计的核心，但计算要求很高。本文介绍了隐式神经算子求解器（INOS），它学习隐式求解并编码时间积分器。INOS从静态平衡解预训练一个神经算子，并在Newmark-β积分中重复使用。在每个时间增量中，积分器形成一个有效的平衡问题，预训练的神经算子推断下一步的解场，Newmark关系推进动态状态。线性和非线性弹性动力学中的数值示例表明，无需动态轨迹监督即可进行准确的全场预测。比较结果显示，INOS在零样本评估下，比在动态模拟上训练的神经求解器基线实现了更高的预测精度。此外，INOS在非线性模拟中比顺序经典有限元求解器提供了超过4,600倍的速度提升。INOS原生适应动态条件的变化，并支持预训练算子在空间和时间离散化之间的重用。进一步的评估显示了稳定的百万步滚动。这些发现确立了INOS作为一种可重用的神经隐式求解器，用于准确、高效和鲁棒的动态建模。
tldr: INOS是一种新的神经算子求解器，通过从静态平衡解预训练并结合Newmark-β积分，实现了对高保真动态模拟的准确、高效和鲁棒求解，比传统方法快4600倍。
ai_comments: INOS的创新之处在于其将神经算子与传统时间积分器（如Newmark-β）相结合，并通过从静态平衡解进行预训练来学习隐式求解，极大地提高了动态模拟的效率和准确性。其无需动态轨迹监督和高达4600倍的速度提升是其重要亮点，同时支持算子重用和百万步稳定滚动也展示了其强大的实用性。
motivation: 高保真动态系统模拟对科学发现和工程设计至关重要，但计算成本高昂。
method: 本文引入了隐式神经算子求解器（INOS），它学习隐式求解并编码时间积分器。INOS从静态平衡解预训练一个神经算子，并在Newmark-β积分中重复使用。在每个时间增量中，积分器形成一个有效的平衡问题，预训练的神经算子推断下一步的解场，Newmark关系推进动态状态。
results: INOS在线性和非线性弹性动力学示例中展示了准确的全场预测，无需动态轨迹监督。零样本评估结果显示，INOS比在动态模拟上训练的神经求解器基线具有更高的预测精度。此外，INOS在非线性模拟中比顺序经典有限元求解器提供了超过4,600倍的速度提升。INOS原生适应动态条件的变化，并支持预训练算子在空间和时间离散化之间的重用。进一步的评估显示了稳定的百万步滚动。
conclusion: INOS被确立为一种可重用的神经隐式求解器，用于准确、高效和鲁棒的动态建模。

title: Req-Space: A User Study of Interactive Visualisations for Requirements Review
authors: Risha Parveen, Navneet Arora, Zheying Zhang, Kalle Mäkelä, Pekka Abrahamsson
abstract: Requirements review involves identifying inconsistencies and assessing change implications across distributed specifications. Motivated by needs raised in industrial project workshops, we investigate Req-Space, an interactive prototype integrating semantic exploration and traceability visualisation to support human-led review. We conducted a fixed-order, two-phase study with 20 participants, including 11 with at least three years of software or IT experience. Participants reviewed a fictional 40-requirement software specification and a guest-checkout change request, first using source documents and then revisiting the same tasks with Req-Space. During the supported review, 17 participants recorded at least one additional source-supported item or pair. Of 69 assessable additional units, 58 (84.1%) were judged supported by the source materials. Seven decision rationales were judged stronger in Phase 2, including five without a change in the decision category. Participants generally found the visualisations helpful, although workload responses were mixed and some misinterpreted visual relationships. The findings suggest that visual support can facilitate requirements exploration and decision justification, provided relationship meanings and source context remain clear. The fixed study sequence prevents attributing the observed changes specifically to Req-Space.

zh_title: Req-Space：需求评审中交互式可视化的用户研究
translation: 需求评审涉及识别不一致性和评估分布式规范中的变更影响。受工业项目研讨会中提出的需求启发，我们研究了Req-Space，这是一个集成了语义探索和可追溯性可视化的交互式原型，旨在支持人工评审。我们对20名参与者（其中11名具有至少三年软件或IT经验）进行了一项固定顺序的两阶段研究。参与者首先使用源文档评审一个虚构的40项需求软件规范和一个访客结账变更请求，然后使用Req-Space重新执行相同的任务。在Req-Space支持的评审过程中，17名参与者记录了至少一项额外的源支持项或对。在69个可评估的额外单元中，58个（84.1%）被判断为有源材料支持。第二阶段有七个决策理由被认为更强，其中五个在决策类别未变的情况下得到加强。参与者普遍认为可视化有帮助，尽管工作量反馈不一，并且一些人误解了可视化关系。研究结果表明，可视化支持可以促进需求探索和决策理由的形成，前提是关系含义和来源上下文保持清晰。固定的研究顺序限制了将观察到的变化完全归因于Req-Space。
tldr: 本研究通过用户研究评估了Req-Space原型，一个集成语义探索和可追溯性可视化的工具，以支持人工需求评审。结果表明可视化支持可以促进需求探索和决策，但需确保关系和来源上下文清晰。
ai_comments: 该论文通过用户研究评估了一个交互式可视化工具Req-Space在需求评审中的应用。其创新点在于将语义探索和可追溯性可视化结合起来，以支持人工评审。研究结果表明可视化在促进需求探索和决策方面具有潜力，这对于提高软件开发过程中的需求质量至关重要。然而，论文也明确指出了其局限性，即固定研究顺序使得无法完全将观察到的改进归因于Req-Space，这提示未来的研究可以采用更严格的实验设计来验证其效果。
motivation: 需求评审涉及识别不一致性和评估分布式规范中的变更影响。本研究的动机源于工业项目研讨会中提出的需求。
method: 采用固定顺序的两阶段研究，有20名参与者（其中11名具有至少三年软件或IT经验）。参与者首先使用源文档评审一个虚构的40项需求软件规范和一个访客结账变更请求，然后使用Req-Space重新执行相同的任务。
results: 在Req-Space支持的评审中，17名参与者记录了至少一项额外的源支持项或对。在69个可评估的额外单元中，58个（84.1%）被判断为有源材料支持。第二阶段有七个决策理由被认为更强。参与者普遍认为可视化有帮助，但工作量反馈不一，部分人误解了可视化关系。
conclusion: 可视化支持可以促进需求探索和决策理由的形成，前提是关系含义和来源上下文保持清晰。固定研究顺序限制了将观察到的变化完全归因于Req-Space。

title: SurgTransfer: Multi-Step Latent Action Modeling for Action Transfer in Surgical World Model
authors: Saurabh Koju, Love Panta, Deepak Thapa, Rudra P. K. Poudel, Prajwal Ghimire, Angus Watson, Yash Raj Shrestha, Prashnna Kumar Gyawali, Binod Bhattarai
abstract: Surgical world models have the potential to provide intra-operative guidance, accelerate risk-free training and facilitate transfer of expert surgical maneuvers. However, the use of world models for transferring surgical expertise has been largely unexplored. Moreover, recent approaches in this domain have mainly relied on ground truth kinematics actions or expert annotations for specific tasks, limiting their applicability beyond the narrow range of tasks with ground-truth annotations. In contrast, existing works in the natural domain have shown promising results in learning latent actions solely from unlabeled videos and transferring the learned actions across contexts. We observe that this paradigm is short-sighted for the surgical domain, failing to capture the hierarchical and goal-directed structure of surgical procedures. Thus, we propose a novel multi-step action learning framework to learn context-invariant latent actions that are easily transferable across various surgical contexts. We perform extensive experiments on the publicly available datasets, SurgToolLoc-2022 and PitVis-2023, verifying our approach with both quantitative metrics and qualitative evaluation by surgical experts. We have published our code and the implementation details at https://github.com/bhattarailab/Surgical-Vision-World-Model.
zh_title: SurgTransfer: 手术世界模型中动作迁移的多步潜在动作建模
translation: 手术世界模型有潜力提供术中指导、加速无风险训练并促进专家手术操作的迁移。然而，将世界模型用于转移手术专业知识的探索还很不足。此外，该领域最近的方法主要依赖于地面真实运动学动作或针对特定任务的专家标注，这限制了它们在超出具有地面真实标注的狭窄任务范围之外的适用性。相比之下，自然领域中现有工作已显示出仅从无标签视频中学习潜在动作并跨上下文迁移所学动作的良好前景。我们观察到这种范式对手术领域来说是短视的，未能捕捉手术过程的层次性和目标导向结构。因此，我们提出了一种新颖的多步动作学习框架，以学习上下文不变的潜在动作，这些动作易于在各种手术环境中迁移。我们在公开数据集SurgToolLoc-2022和PitVis-2023上进行了广泛实验，通过定量指标和手术专家的定性评估验证了我们的方法。我们已在https://github.com/bhattarailab/Surgical-Vision-World-Model上发布了我们的代码和实现细节。
tldr: SurgTransfer提出了一个多步潜在动作学习框架，旨在解决手术世界模型中动作迁移的挑战，通过学习上下文不变的潜在动作，实现手术专业知识在不同场景间的有效迁移，克服了对地面真实数据或专家标注的依赖。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将多步潜在动作建模引入手术世界模型，解决了当前方法对标注数据的高度依赖和未能捕捉手术过程复杂性的问题。通过学习上下文不变的潜在动作，极大地拓宽了手术技能迁移的适用范围，对提升术中指导、加速训练和实现手术自动化具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有手术世界模型在转移手术专业知识方面的探索不足；现有方法依赖地面真实运动学动作或专家标注，限制了其适用性；自然领域的方法虽能从无标签视频学习潜在动作，但未能捕捉手术过程的层次性和目标导向结构。
method: 提出了一种新颖的多步动作学习框架（SurgTransfer），用于学习上下文不变的潜在动作，使其易于在各种手术环境中迁移。
results: 在公开数据集SurgToolLoc-2022和PitVis-2023上进行了广泛实验，通过定量指标和手术专家的定性评估验证了该方法。
conclusion: 该方法成功地实现了上下文不变的潜在动作学习和在不同手术场景中的迁移，为手术世界模型提供了有效且适用性更广的动作迁移解决方案。

title: Matched but Not Better: An Equivalence-Tested Benchmark of Quantum Machine Learning on Six Clinical Datasets and the QML-Health-READY Reporting Framework
authors: Mohammed Siraj B, Gousia Habib, Ruban S
abstract: Background: Quantum machine learning (QML) is promoted for clinical prediction, but comparisons with classical models are rarely paired or tested for equivalence. Methods: We compared a quantum-kernel support vector machine (QSVM; 4 qubits, tuned bandwidth) and a variational quantum classifier (VQC) with five tuned classical models across six public clinical datasets. All models used identical four-component inputs and 25 cross-validation splits. Paired AUROC differences were assessed using a corrected resampled t-test, Holm-adjusted equivalence tests (margins: +/-0.02 and +/-0.05), and random-effects pooling. Ablation, noise, finite-shot, and implementation-fault analyses were conducted. We propose QML-Health-READY, an eight-domain reporting framework. Results: Neither quantum model significantly outperformed any classical comparator. Pooled across datasets, QSVM differed from the kernel-matched radial basis function (RBF) SVM by -0.006 AUROC (95% CI: -0.017 to +0.004), equivalent to +/-0.02. VQC differed from the best classical model by -0.007 (95% CI: -0.019 to +0.004). QSVM was equivalent to RBF SVM within +/-0.05 in four of six datasets but was significantly worse than the best classical model on NHANES 2017-18 (-0.076). A classically trivial product-state kernel performed as well as the entangling kernel. With depolarizing noise (p = 0.01) and 1,024 shots per kernel entry, QSVM AUROC decreased by 0.054 (95% CI: 0.036 to 0.071). Untuned bandwidth produced near-chance AUROC (0.48-0.59). Conclusions: Correctly configured quantum classifiers approached but did not exceed tuned classical models. Finite-shot estimation, rather than gate noise, was their main practical cost, while configuration errors could reverse conclusions. QML-Health-READY defines reporting requirements for credible claims.
zh_title: 匹配但并未更好：六个临床数据集上量子机器学习的等效性测试基准与QML-Health-READY报告框架
translation: 背景：量子机器学习（QML）被宣传用于临床预测，但与经典模型的比较很少进行配对或等效性检验。方法：我们将量子核支持向量机（QSVM；4个量子比特，经调优带宽）和变分量子分类器（VQC）与六个公共临床数据集上的五个调优经典模型进行了比较。所有模型使用相同的四分量输入和25个交叉验证折。采用修正的重采样t检验、Holm调整等效性检验（边界：+/-0.02和+/-0.05）以及随机效应汇集来评估成对的AUROC差异。进行了消融、噪声、有限次测量和实现错误分析。我们提出了QML-Health-READY，一个八领域的报告框架。结果：没有一个量子模型显著优于任何经典比较模型。跨数据集汇总后，QSVM与核匹配的径向基函数（RBF）SVM相差-0.006 AUROC（95% CI：-0.017至+0.004），等效于+/-0.02。VQC与最佳经典模型的差值为-0.007（95% CI：-0.019至+0.004）。QSVM在六个数据集中的四个数据集上与RBF SVM在+/-0.05范围内等效，但在NHANES 2017-18数据集上明显逊于最佳经典模型（-0.076）。经典微不足道的乘积态核表现与纠缠核一样好。在退极化噪声（p = 0.01）和每个核条目1,024次测量的条件下，QSVM AUROC下降了0.054（95% CI：0.036至0.071）。未调优的带宽产生了接近随机猜测的AUROC（0.48-0.59）。结论：正确配置的量子分类器接近但未超过调优的经典模型。有限次测量估计（而非门噪声）是其实际的主要成本，而配置错误可能会颠覆结论。QML-Health-READY定义了做出可信声明的报告要求。
tldr: 量子机器学习模型在临床预测中的表现并不优于调优后的经典模型，研究强调了严谨的基准测试和QML-Health-READY报告框架的重要性。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过严格的配对和等效性测试，对比了量子机器学习模型与传统模型在临床数据集上的表现，揭示了当前QML在临床预测中的实际性能，并提出了重要的报告框架，对规范该领域的未来研究具有很高的价值。
motivation: 量子机器学习（QML）常被宣传用于临床预测，但目前与经典模型的对比很少进行配对或等效性检验，缺乏严谨的基准测试和透明的报告规范。
method: 研究对比了量子核支持向量机（QSVM）和变分量子分类器（VQC）与五种经过调优的经典模型在六个公共临床数据集上的表现。所有模型均采用相同的四分量输入和25个交叉验证折。通过修正的重采样t检验、Holm调整的等效性检验以及随机效应汇集来评估成对的AUROC差异，同时进行了消融、噪声、有限次测量和实现错误分析。
results: 两个量子模型均未显著优于任何经典比较模型。QSVM与核匹配的径向基函数（RBF）SVM相差-0.006 AUROC。在存在退极化噪声和1024次测量的条件下，QSVM的AUROC下降了0.054。未经调优的带宽会导致接近随机猜测的AUROC（0.48-0.59）。
conclusion: 配置正确的量子分类器在性能上可以接近但无法超越经过调优的经典模型。有限次测量（finite-shot estimation）是其主要的实际代价，配置错误会导致结论完全相反。作者最后提出了QML-Health-READY报告框架以规范可信声明。

title: LIBRA: Programmatic Induction of Executable Tool Libraries
authors: Zekai Li, Zhenke Liu, Yonghao Li, Junhan Liu, Xulong Xiao, Jiapeng Zhang
abstract: Large language model agents increasingly retrieve tools from large catalogs, yet most retrievers rank each tool independently by request similarity. For multi tool tasks, this recovers the goal matching tool while omitting prerequisite tools required by the workflow.We introduce LIBRA, a framework for Library Induction by Runtime Assembly that turns a flat tool catalog into an executable tool library. An LLM proposes per tool contracts of candidate invocations, reusable outputs and state changes, and success conditions; LIBRA then tests these compositions in a sandbox and retains the relations supported at runtime. Constructed before user queries, the library requires no dependency annotations, tool use trajectories, or task specific training, and supports both one-shot and agentic retrieval. On AppWorld, BFCL, and SciToolEval, LIBRA improves one-shot Recall and NDCG over the same dense retriever by 7.9 and 3.7 percentage points on average. Within ToolReAGt, it yields corresponding gains of 4.5 and 2.9 points after ten retrieval iterations.
comment: Introduces LIBRA, a query-agnostic tool library built via execution-validated prerequisites in a sandbox. Demonstrates consistent performance gains across three benchmarks while discussing sandbox dependencies and library construction trade-offs
zh_title: LIBRA：可执行工具库的程序化归纳
translation: 大型语言模型代理越来越多地从大型目录中检索工具，然而大多数检索器通过请求相似性独立地对每个工具进行排名。对于多工具任务，这会恢复目标匹配工具，但却遗漏了工作流所需的先决工具。我们引入了LIBRA，一个通过运行时组装进行库归纳的框架，它将平面工具目录转化为可执行工具库。LLM会提出候选调用、可重用输出和状态变化以及成功条件的每个工具契约；然后，LIBRA在沙盒中测试这些组合，并保留运行时支持的关系。该库在用户查询之前构建，无需依赖注释、工具使用轨迹或特定任务训练，并支持单次和代理式检索。在AppWorld、BFCL和SciToolEval数据集上，LIBRA在单次检索的召回率和NDCG方面比相同的密集检索器平均提高了7.9和3.7个百分点。在ToolReAGt中，经过十次检索迭代后，它带来了4.5和2.9个百分点的相应提升。
tldr: LIBRA是一个通过运行时组装将平面工具目录转换为可执行工具库的框架，它通过LLM提出工具契约并在沙盒中测试组合来构建工具关系，无需预先标注，显著提高了多工具任务的检索性能。
ai_comments: LIBRA的创新之处在于其程序化归纳工具库的方法，通过运行时测试而非静态标注来识别工具间的依赖关系，这大大降低了构建复杂工具库的门槛。其无需预训练和依赖注释的特点，使其在实际应用中具有很高的灵活性和可扩展性。该工作对于提升LLM代理在复杂多步骤任务中的规划和执行能力具有重要意义。
motivation: 大型语言模型代理在从大型目录中检索工具时，通常独立地对每个工具进行排名，这导致在多工具任务中，虽然能找到目标匹配工具，但却遗漏了工作流所需的先决工具。
method: LIBRA（通过运行时组装进行库归纳）框架将平面工具目录转化为可执行工具库。它通过LLM提出每个工具的调用契约、可重用输出、状态变化和成功条件；然后，LIBRA在沙盒中测试这些组合，并保留运行时支持的关系。该库在用户查询之前构建，无需依赖注释、工具使用轨迹或特定任务训练，并支持单次和代理式检索。
results: 在AppWorld、BFCL和SciToolEval数据集上，LIBRA在单次检索的召回率和NDCG方面平均分别提高了7.9和3.7个百分点。在ToolReAGt中，经过十次检索迭代后，它带来了4.5和2.9个百分点的相应提升。
conclusion: LIBRA通过程序化地归纳可执行工具库，有效解决了LLM代理在多工具任务中检索先决工具的挑战，显著提升了检索性能，且无需预先标注或训练。

title: Jev with Foresight: Safe Language-Guided Autonomous Driving via a Language World Model
authors: Yansong Qu, Jiancong Chen, Samuel Labi
abstract: Large language models understand passengers' driving commands, but as driving agents they reason in generated text for seconds and must infer each action's consequences implicitly from the scene. We present Jev-AD, which pairs Jev, a typed decision model that answers predefined questions with probabilities, not generated text, with a language world model that predicts for every candidate action how nearby vehicles move over the next two seconds. Code turns these predictions into foreseen consequences, which Jev compares instead of inferring them from coordinates. In simulated highway merging (500 car-episodes), this foresight lowers the same decision model's collision rate from 26.0% to 2.4% at 0.25 seconds per decision, and Jev-AD achieves the passenger's intent in 93% of free-form command trials. In 500 replayed real-world NGSIM episodes, foresight lowers the collision rate from 48.2% to 2.8%, and the world model, learned from this traffic, foresees 93% of dangerous actions. Project page: https://ys-qu.github.io/jev-ad-website.
zh_title: 具有预见性的Jev：通过语言世界模型实现安全的语言引导自动驾驶
translation: 大型语言模型理解乘客的驾驶指令，但作为驾驶代理，它们在生成的文本中推理需要数秒，并且必须从场景中隐式推断每个动作的后果。我们提出了Jev-AD，它将Jev（一个通过概率而非生成文本回答预定义问题的类型化决策模型）与一个语言世界模型相结合。该世界模型预测每个候选动作在未来两秒内附近车辆的移动情况。代码将这些预测转化为可预见的后果，Jev直接比较这些后果，而不是从坐标中推断。在模拟高速公路合流中（500次车辆事件），这种预见性在0.25秒/决策的速度下，将相同决策模型的碰撞率从26.0%降低到2.4%，并且Jev-AD在93%的自由形式指令试验中实现了乘客意图。在500次重放的真实世界NGIM事件中，预见性将碰撞率从48.2%降低到2.8%，并且从交通数据中学习到的世界模型预见了93%的危险动作。项目页面：https://ys-qu.github.io/jev-ad-website。
tldr: Jev-AD结合了决策模型Jev和语言世界模型，通过预测未来两秒的车辆行为，将自动驾驶的碰撞率显著降低，并能有效实现乘客意图。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于将一个明确的、概率性的决策模型（Jev）与一个能预测未来动态的语言世界模型相结合，从而为自动驾驶提供了“预见性”。这种方法有效地解决了传统LLM在驾驶中推理慢和后果推断不准确的痛点，通过量化未来风险显著提升了驾驶安全性。其在碰撞率上的显著降低是其重要性的体现，为语言引导的自动驾驶提供了一条更安全、更高效的路径。
motivation: 现有的基于大型语言模型的自动驾驶代理在推理时生成文本，耗时数秒，并且必须从场景中隐式推断每个动作的后果，这限制了其安全性和效率。
method: 本文提出了Jev-AD，它将一个回答预定义问题并给出概率的类型化决策模型Jev，与一个语言世界模型相结合。该语言世界模型能预测每个候选动作在未来两秒内附近车辆的移动情况。代码将这些预测转化为可预见的后果，Jev直接比较这些后果，而不是从坐标中推断。
results: 在模拟高速公路合流中（500次车辆事件），在0.25秒/决策的速度下，预见性将相同决策模型的碰撞率从26.0%降低到2.4%，Jev-AD在93%的自由形式指令试验中实现了乘客意图。在500次重放的真实世界NGSIM事件中，预见性将碰撞率从48.2%降低到2.8%，并且从交通数据中学习到的世界模型预见了93%的危险动作。
conclusion: 通过将类型化决策模型Jev与预测车辆未来行为的语言世界模型相结合，Jev-AD显著提高了语言引导自动驾驶的安全性和对乘客意图的实现能力，尤其是在降低碰撞率方面表现出色。

title: From Tokens to Trajectories: Parameter-Efficient Continuous Adaptation of Unified Multimodal Models
authors: Gayatri Deshmukh, Onkar Susladkar, Adheesh Juvekar, Halil Kilicoglu, Ismini Lourentzou
abstract: While discrete tokenization in Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) establishes strong semantic reasoning, it introduces a strict quantization bottleneck that degrades fine-grained visual details, often resulting in structurally accurate but artifact-heavy images. We introduce FlowShift, a parameter-efficient post-training framework that bypasses this bottleneck by converting pre-trained discrete UMMs into continuous rectified-flow generators. Instead of discarding the backbone's semantic priors, FlowShift replaces discrete visual interfaces with continuous latent projections and applies LoRA to the attention layers. To efficiently boost visual quality without semantic drift, we propose Dual-Objective Velocity Vector Distillation (DOVD), which aligns the model with a high-fidelity continuous teacher and ground-truth continuous trajectories. This approach drastically improves perceptual quality while preserving prompt adherence and reasoning. When applied to leading discrete UMMs, FlowShift significantly improves COCO-30K FID and aesthetic scores, while retaining over 99.5% of multimodal understanding capabilities. Ablations confirm DOVD drives generation quality. Ultimately, FlowShift achieves high-fidelity continuous generation without sacrificing pre-trained semantic grounding.
zh_title: 从离散标记到连续轨迹：统一多模态模型参数高效的连续适应
translation: 虽然统一多模态模型（UMMs）中的离散标记化建立了强大的语义推理能力，但它引入了一个严格的量化瓶颈，会降低精细的视觉细节，常常导致图像在结构上准确但充满伪影。我们引入了FlowShift，一个参数高效的后训练框架，通过将预训练的离散UMMs转换为连续整流流生成器来绕过这个瓶颈。FlowShift没有抛弃骨干网络的语义先验，而是用连续潜在投影替换了离散视觉接口，并对注意力层应用了LoRA。为了在不产生语义漂移的情况下高效提升视觉质量，我们提出了双目标速度矢量蒸馏（DOVD），它使模型与高保真连续教师和真实连续轨迹对齐。这种方法大幅提高了感知质量，同时保留了提示依从性和推理能力。当应用于领先的离散UMMs时，FlowShift显著改善了COCO-30K FID和美学分数，同时保留了超过99.5%的多模态理解能力。消融实验证实DOVD驱动了生成质量。最终，FlowShift在不牺牲预训练语义基础的情况下，实现了高保真度的连续生成。
tldr: FlowShift是一个参数高效的后训练框架，它将预训练的离散统一多模态模型转换为连续整流流生成器，通过绕过离散标记化的瓶颈，显著提高了图像的感知质量，同时保留了多模态理解能力。
ai_comments: FlowShift的创新之处在于其巧妙地绕过了离散标记化的瓶颈，通过连续适应的方式将离散UMMs转化为连续流生成器，实现了视觉质量的显著提升而没有牺牲语义能力。参数高效的LoRA应用和双目标蒸馏策略（DOVD）是其成功的关键，使得模型在保持预训练语义基础的同时，能够生成更精细、无伪影的图像。这对于提升多模态模型的生成能力具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有统一多模态模型中的离散标记化引入了严格的量化瓶颈，损害了精细的视觉细节，导致图像在结构上准确但充满伪影。
method: 引入了FlowShift框架，它将预训练的离散统一多模态模型转换为连续整流流生成器。FlowShift用连续潜在投影替换离散视觉接口，并对注意力层应用LoRA。为高效提升视觉质量而不产生语义漂移，提出了双目标速度矢量蒸馏（DOVD），使模型与高保真连续教师和真实连续轨迹对齐。
results: FlowShift显著改善了COCO-30K FID和美学分数，同时保留了超过99.5%的多模态理解能力。它大幅提高了感知质量，同时保持了提示依从性和推理能力。消融实验证实DOVD驱动了生成质量。
conclusion: FlowShift在不牺牲预训练语义基础的情况下，实现了高保真度的连续生成。

title: SO(3)-Equivariant Learning on CAD Boundary Representations
authors: Matteo Ballegeer, Dries F. Benoit
abstract: Learning on boundary representations (B-reps) requires robustness to the pose of a part, since CAD models are not stored in a canonical orientation. Existing B-rep networks either operate on world-frame coordinates and normals, and thus degrade under rotation, or encode each face in a local reference frame. Local frames yield invariance, but reduce inter-face messages to scalars and discard the relative orientation of adjacent faces. We propose SO3brep, an SO(3)-equivariant graph neural network on the B-rep face-adjacency graph. Node features are computed in local frames and mapped into a shared frame by Wigner D-matrices. Clebsch-Gordan tensor products couple these features with the directions between adjacent faces, so that relative orientation is preserved throughout message passing and the output remains SE(3)-invariant. Across three face-segmentation and two classification benchmarks with randomly rotated test parts, SO3brep achieves the highest accuracy among the compared B-rep networks and equivariant point cloud networks, with the fewest parameters. Its advantage is largest with few labeled parts, a setting typical of industrial CAD. Code is available at https://github.com/UGent-CVAMO/so3brep.
zh_title: CAD边界表示上的SO(3)等变学习
translation: CAD边界表示 (B-reps) 上的学习需要对零件姿态的鲁棒性，因为CAD模型并非以规范方向存储。现有的B-rep网络要么在世界坐标系和法线方向上操作，因此在旋转下性能下降；要么在局部参考系中编码每个面。局部参考系带来了不变性，但将面间消息简化为标量，并丢弃了相邻面之间的相对方向。我们提出了SO3brep，一个在B-rep面邻接图上的SO(3)等变图神经网络。节点特征在局部坐标系中计算，并通过Wigner D-矩阵映射到共享坐标系。Clebsch-Gordan张量积将这些特征与相邻面之间的方向耦合，从而在整个消息传递过程中保留相对方向，并且输出保持SE(3)不变性。在三个面分割和两个分类基准测试中，使用随机旋转的测试零件，SO3brep在所有比较的B-rep网络和等变点云网络中均取得了最高准确性，且参数量最少。其优势在标记零件较少的情况下（工业CAD的典型设置）最为显著。代码可在 https://github.com/UGent-CVAMO/so3brep 获取。
tldr: SO3brep是一种SO(3)等变图神经网络，用于CAD B-rep，通过保留相邻面的相对方向，在旋转下表现出更高的准确性和更少的参数，尤其在数据稀缺的工业CAD场景中优势明显。
ai_comments: 这项研究通过引入SO(3)等变性，巧妙地解决了CAD B-rep数据在姿态变化下的鲁棒性问题以及现有局部框架方法丢失相对方向信息的局限性。Wigner D-矩阵和Clebsch-Gordan张量积的应用是其核心创新点，使得网络能够有效处理三维旋转，并在保持几何关系的同时进行特征学习。其在参数效率和数据稀缺场景下的优异表现，对工业CAD领域的实际应用具有重要意义。
motivation: CAD模型通常不以规范方向存储，导致边界表示（B-reps）学习需要对零件姿态具有鲁棒性。现有B-rep网络要么在旋转下性能下降，要么通过局部参考系编码面时，将面间消息简化为标量并丢弃了相邻面的相对方向。
method: 提出SO3brep，一个在B-rep面邻接图上的SO(3)等变图神经网络。它在局部坐标系中计算节点特征，并通过Wigner D-矩阵映射到共享坐标系。Clebsch-Gordan张量积将这些特征与相邻面之间的方向耦合，以在消息传递过程中保留相对方向，并确保输出保持SE(3)不变性。
results: 在三个面分割和两个分类基准测试中（包含随机旋转的测试零件），SO3brep在所有比较的B-rep网络和等变点云网络中取得了最高准确性，且参数量最少。其优势在标记零件较少的情况下（工业CAD典型设置）最为显著。
conclusion: SO3brep通过创新的SO(3)等变机制，有效解决了CAD B-rep学习中姿态鲁棒性和相对方向信息丢失的问题，在性能和效率上均优于现有方法，特别适用于数据稀缺的工业应用场景。

title: A Fully Polynomial Approximation Algorithm for the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick Model
authors: Dylan Herman, Shouvanik Chakrabarti, Junhyung Lyle Kim, Guneykan Ozgul
abstract: Montanari's incremental approximate message passing (IAMP) algorithm [FOCS 2019; SIAM J. Comput., 2025] and the zero-temperature formulation of El Alaoui, Montanari and Sellke (AMS) [Ann. Probab., 2021] find a $(1-\varepsilon)$ approximation to the maximum Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) energy in $C(\varepsilon)N^2$ operations for fixed accuracy, with probability tending to one as $N\to\infty$, under their respective full-support and access-model assumptions. However, it was unknown whether this approximation could be achieved with work polynomial in both $N$ and $1/\varepsilon$, together with quantitative guarantees at finite dimension. Under the same assumptions as AMS, we introduce grouped IAMP with exact Gaussian query outputs (GEG-IAMP), which is the first SK approximation algorithm with total work polynomial in $N$ and $1/\varepsilon$ and a finite-size guarantee above a dimension threshold polynomial in $1/\varepsilon$ and $\log(1/α)$. More precisely, for every $α\in(0,1/2)$, it returns a $(1-\varepsilon)$ approximation with probability at least $1-α$ whenever $N\ge \mathsf{K}\varepsilon^{-2}\log^2(e/\varepsilon)\log(\mathsf{K}/α)$, using $O(N^2/\varepsilon)$ work and $O(N^2)$ storage. GEG-IAMP replaces the Onsager correction by Reeves's coupling construction [arXiv:2508.10782] and groups Euler-Maruyama steps into $O(1/\varepsilon)$ matrix-vector products. We also prove a relative guarantee for AMS IAMP with $O(N^2\varepsilon^{-3}\log^2(e/\varepsilon))$ work but a sufficient dimension exponential in inverse accuracy.
