By returning a fixed configuration below its dimension threshold, GEG-IAMP also provides an asymptotic fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme (AFPRAS), with an additive error independent of dimension.
zh_title: Sherrington-Kirkpatrick模型的完全多项式近似算法
translation: Montanari的增量近似消息传递（IAMP）算法[FOCS 2019; SIAM J. Comput., 2025]以及El Alaoui、Montanari和Sellke（AMS）的零温度公式[Ann. Probab., 2021]在各自的完全支持和访问模型假设下，以C(ε)N^2次操作找到了最大Sherrington-Kirkpatrick（SK）能量的(1-ε)近似值，在固定精度下，当N→∞时，概率趋于1。然而，是否能以N和1/ε的多项式工作量实现这种近似，并提供有限维度的定量保证，这一点尚不清楚。在与AMS相同的假设下，我们引入了具有精确高斯查询输出的分组IAMP（GEG-IAMP），这是第一个SK近似算法，其总工作量是N和1/ε的多项式，并且在高于1/ε和log(1/α)的多项式维数阈值时具有有限尺寸保证。更精确地说，对于每个α∈(0,1/2)，当N≥Kε^(-2)log^2(e/ε)log(K/α)时，它以至少1-α的概率返回一个(1-ε)近似值，使用O(N^2/ε)的工作量和O(N^2)的存储。GEG-IAMP用Reeves的耦合构造[arXiv:2508.10782]取代了Onsager修正，并将Euler-Maruyama步骤分组为O(1/ε)个矩阵向量乘积。我们还证明了AMS IAMP的相对保证，其工作量为O(N^2ε^(-3)log^2(e/ε)，但足够的维数与逆精度呈指数关系。通过在其维数阈值以下返回一个固定配置，GEG-IAMP还提供了一个渐近完全多项式随机近似方案（AFPRAS），其加性误差与维数无关。
tldr: 该论文介绍了GEG-IAMP，这是第一个Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) 近似算法，其工作量在N和1/ε上均为多项式，并提供有限尺寸保证，解决了先前方法的局限性。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过提出GEG-IAMP算法，在Sherrington-Kirkpatrick模型近似算法领域做出了重要贡献。它首次实现了在N和1/ε上均为多项式的工作量，并提供了有限尺寸的定量保证，解决了长期以来关于此类近似方案计算复杂性和实际适用性的开放问题。GEG-IAMP的引入及其理论保证代表了自旋玻璃理论和近似算法领域的一个显著进步。
motivation: Montanari的IAMP算法和AMS的零温度公式虽然能实现最大SK能量的(1-ε)近似，但其工作量是否能在N和1/ε上均为多项式，并提供有限维度下的定量保证，这一点尚不清楚。本研究旨在填补这一空白。
method: 本文引入了“具有精确高斯查询输出的分组IAMP（GEG-IAMP）”算法。该方法用Reeves的耦合构造取代了Onsager修正，并将Euler-Maruyama步骤分组为O(1/ε)个矩阵向量乘积。
results: GEG-IAMP是第一个SK近似算法，其总工作量在N和1/ε上均为多项式，并在高于1/ε和log(1/α)的多项式维数阈值时具有有限尺寸保证。对于每个α∈(0,1/2)，当N≥Kε^(-2)log^2(e/ε)log(K/α)时，它以至少1-α的概率返回一个(1-ε)近似值，使用O(N^2/ε)的工作量和O(N^2)的存储。此外，GEG-IAMP还提供了一个渐近完全多项式随机近似方案（AFPRAS），其加性误差与维数无关。
conclusion: GEG-IAMP算法首次为Sherrington-Kirkpatrick模型提供了一个在N和1/ε上均具有多项式工作量的近似算法，并带有有限尺寸的定量保证，同时提供了一个AFPRAS。

title: Towards Robust Long-Lived Agents: Benchmarking Experience Lifecycles in Evolving Environments
authors: Shijue Huang, Hangyu Guo, Hengheng Zhang, Guo An, Zhitao He, Qi Tian, Yiren Feng
abstract: As agents become more capable, they are moving beyond one-off tasks toward sustained assistance across successive user goals. Such assistance requires agents to discover how unfamiliar environments work, reuse what they learn across tasks, and keep that experience current as environments evolve. Existing benchmarks increasingly study experience reuse and adaptation, but provide limited insight into which parts of accumulated experience agents revise, retain, or lose. To address this gap, we introduce ReScopeBench, a benchmark for the experience lifecycle across 18 interactive environments. It distinguishes structural experience about how an environment is organized and accessed from rule experience about reusable principles and constraints that guide decisions across tasks. To study how experience is acquired, reused, and revised, we propose an experience-first construction approach. It builds task streams around shared experience and introduces silent environmental changes. We evaluate task performance and track changes in saved experience throughout each stream. Across 20 models, we find that retained experience improves task performance, but agents struggle to keep it current as environments change. Even when the required experience is correctly recorded, agents do not always complete tasks successfully. These findings identify selective maintenance and effective use as complementary challenges for long-lived agents.
zh_title: 迈向强大的长寿代理：在演进环境中基准化经验生命周期
translation: 随着代理变得越来越强大，它们正在从一次性任务转向跨连续用户目标的持续协助。这种协助要求代理发现不熟悉环境的工作方式，跨任务重用所学知识，并随着环境演变保持这些经验的更新。现有基准越来越多地研究经验重用和适应，但对于代理修订、保留或丢失哪些累积经验的部分提供有限的洞察。为了弥补这一空白，我们引入了ReScopeBench，这是一个针对18个交互式环境中经验生命周期的基准。它将关于环境组织和访问的结构经验与指导跨任务决策的可重用原则和约束的规则经验区分开来。为了研究经验是如何获取、重用和修订的，我们提出了一种经验优先的构建方法。它围绕共享经验构建任务流并引入无声的环境变化。我们评估了任务性能并跟踪了整个任务流中保存经验的变化。在20个模型中，我们发现保留的经验可以提高任务性能，但代理难以随着环境变化保持经验的更新。即使所需经验被正确记录，代理也并非总能成功完成任务。这些发现将选择性维护和有效利用确定为长寿代理的互补挑战。
tldr: 引入ReScopeBench基准，研究在不断变化的环境中，长寿代理如何获取、重用和修订经验。发现保留的经验能提高性能，但代理难以保持经验更新，且即使经验正确也并非总能成功完成任务。
ai_comments: 这项研究通过引入ReScopeBench基准，为长寿代理在动态环境中的经验管理提供了一个新颖且重要的研究框架。其创新之处在于区分了结构经验和规则经验，并提出了经验优先的构建方法来模拟经验生命周期。研究结果揭示了现有代理在经验更新和有效利用方面的核心局限性，为未来开发更鲁棒、更适应性强的长寿代理指明了方向。该基准对于推动强化学习和持续学习领域的发展具有重要意义。
motivation: 随着代理能力增强，它们正从一次性任务转向持续协助，这要求代理能够发现新环境的工作方式、跨任务重用所学知识，并随着环境演变保持经验的更新。现有基准在经验重用和适应性方面研究有限，缺乏对代理如何修订、保留或丢失累积经验的深入了解。
method: 本文引入了ReScopeBench，一个针对18个交互式环境中经验生命周期的基准。它将关于环境组织和访问的“结构经验”与指导跨任务决策的“规则经验”区分开来。为研究经验的获取、重用和修订，作者提出了一种“经验优先的构建方法”，该方法围绕共享经验构建任务流并引入无声的环境变化。通过评估任务性能和跟踪整个任务流中保存经验的变化来完成研究。
results: 在20个模型中，研究发现：1. 保留的经验可以提高任务性能。2. 代理难以随着环境变化保持经验的更新。3. 即使所需经验被正确记录，代理也并非总能成功完成任务。
conclusion: 这些发现表明，选择性维护和有效利用是长寿代理面临的互补挑战。

title: Agentic Behavior Engineering: A Design-by-Contract Methodology for Specifying, Verifying, and Governing Enterprise AI Agents
authors: Yang Song
abstract: Enterprise teams that deploy large language model (LLM) agents inherit a maintenance problem that traditional testing does not address. The model is non-deterministic, but the larger risk is that most of what changes an agent's behavior (a retired model version, a revised policy, an upstream schema change, a prompt edit meant to fix one case) originates outside the owning team and is discovered as a production defect rather than caught as a regression. This paper presents Agentic Behavior Engineering (ABE), a platform-agnostic methodology that treats observable agent behavior, rather than the prompt or the model, as the version-controlled engineering artifact. ABE adapts Design by Contract to non-deterministic systems. A specification-only behavior contract with stable rule identifiers states what the agent must do, must not do, and when it must abstain for lack of evidence; a lightweight scenario library turns each rule into concrete situations; and every engineering artifact (tests, runtime policies, telemetry) references the contract in one direction only, so that specification and implementation can change independently without drifting apart. The method organizes the work into five responsibilities (Specify, Ground, Control, Verify, Observe), treats missing evidence and a verified negative as different things, enforces authority outside the model, gates releases on per-scenario pass^k reliability rather than aggregate accuracy, and classifies every production run against the contract so that each finding routes to the asset that must change. We illustrate the method with an executable capacity-allocation boundary suite and a constructed worked example of a product-review approval workflow.
comment: 30 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Expanded version of the author's practitioner guide "Agentic behavior engineering" in the Microsoft Azure Architecture Center (CC BY 4.0): https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/architecture/ai-ml/guide/agentic-behavior-engineering
zh_title: 代理行为工程：一种用于规范、验证和管理企业AI代理的契约式设计方法
translation: 部署大型语言模型（LLM）代理的企业团队面临传统测试无法解决的维护问题。模型是非确定性的，但更大的风险在于，改变代理行为的大部分因素（已停用的模型版本、修订的策略、上游模式变更、旨在修复某个案例的提示编辑）源于团队外部，并以生产缺陷而非回归问题的形式被发现。本文提出了代理行为工程（ABE），一种平台无关的方法论，它将可观察的代理行为而非提示或模型，视为版本控制的工程产物。ABE将契约式设计应用于非确定性系统。一个具有稳定规则标识符的仅规范行为契约说明代理必须做什么、不能做什么以及何时因缺乏证据必须回避；一个轻量级场景库将每条规则转化为具体情况；以及所有工程产物（测试、运行时策略、遥测）仅单向引用契约，使得规范和实现可以独立变更而不偏离。该方法将工作组织成五个职责（指定、落地、控制、验证、观察），区分了缺失证据和已验证的负面情况，在模型外部强制执行权限，基于每个场景的pass^k可靠性而非聚合准确性来控制发布，并根据契约对每次生产运行进行分类，以便将每个发现路由到必须更改的资产。我们通过一个可执行的容量分配边界套件和一个构建的产品审查批准工作流的示例来说明该方法。
tldr: 企业LLM代理因非确定性和外部变化而面临维护问题。本论文提出了代理行为工程（ABE），一种契约式设计方法，将可观察的代理行为作为版本控制的工程产物，以规范、验证和管理企业AI代理。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将契约式设计（Design by Contract）理念应用于非确定性的LLM代理，并将关注点从模型和提示转移到可观察的代理行为上。这对于管理企业AI的复杂性和外部依赖性至关重要。其重要性在于提供了一种结构化、可验证的代理治理方法，有望显著提高生产环境中AI系统的可靠性和可维护性。
motivation: 部署大型语言模型（LLM）代理的企业团队面临传统测试无法解决的维护问题。模型是非确定性的，但更大的风险在于，改变代理行为的大部分因素（已停用的模型版本、修订的策略、上游模式变更、旨在修复某个案例的提示编辑）源于团队外部，并以生产缺陷而非回归问题的形式被发现。
method: 本文提出了代理行为工程（ABE），一种平台无关的方法论，它将可观察的代理行为而非提示或模型，视为版本控制的工程产物。ABE将契约式设计（Design by Contract）应用于非确定性系统。它包括：具有稳定规则标识符的仅规范行为契约，说明代理必须做什么、不能做什么以及何时因缺乏证据必须回避；一个轻量级场景库，将每条规则转化为具体情况；以及所有工程产物（测试、运行时策略、遥测）仅单向引用契约，使得规范和实现可以独立变更而不偏离。该方法将工作组织成五个职责（指定、落地、控制、验证、观察），区分了缺失证据和已验证的负面情况，在模型外部强制执行权限，基于每个场景的pass^k可靠性而非聚合准确性来控制发布，并根据契约对每次生产运行进行分类，以便将每个发现路由到必须更改的资产。
results: 该方法通过一个可执行的容量分配边界套件和一个构建的产品审查批准工作流的示例进行说明。
conclusion: 本论文提出了代理行为工程（ABE），一种平台无关的方法论，通过将可观察的代理行为视为版本控制的工程产物，并将契约式设计应用于非确定性系统，从而解决企业LLM代理的维护挑战，并提供一种规范、验证和管理企业AI代理的结构化方法。

title: Can Large Language Models Review the Scientific Literature? A Test Against a 102-Article Benchmark
authors: Abdullah Al Kalbani, David M. Schultz, Alexandra K. Anderson-Frey, Zhonghua Zheng, Catherine McGuire
abstract:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support scientific literature reviews, yet evaluations often examine individual tasks rather than the review process as a whole. We assess six AI tools across four stages: finding relevant articles, interpreting them, synthesizing across them, and proposing future research. The benchmark is a published review of the Spanish plume weather pattern and its 102-article corpus.
  In the initial searches, five tools collectively identified 57 articles, with the best individual tool finding 42. Institutional library access increased discovery from 42 to 82 articles for Codex and from 15 to 79 for Claude Code. Given the complete corpus of 102 PDFs, three tools correctly identified all 18 articles discussing the Spanish plume substantially, but incorrectly classified 40% to 79% of the 84 passing mentions as substantial. The same three tools produced syntheses evaluated blindly by two domain experts. Although largely accurate, the syntheses provided limited insight and sometimes contained unsupported claims, quotation errors, and exaggerated statements of consensus. Finally, all three tools proposed research directions broader than the Spanish plume literature, although two approached questions identified in the benchmark review.
  No single tool performed best across all tasks. We provide eight recommendations for researchers using AI tools in literature reviews. Our findings suggest that LLMs can assist with discovering and interpreting scientific literature, particularly when institutional access is available, but cannot replace expert judgment in evaluating evidence or synthesizing research.
comment: 34 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Data, prompts, analysis scripts and results: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23849039 (GitHub: https://github.com/abx40/spanish-plume-llm-literature-review)
zh_title: 大语言模型能否评审科学文献？基于102篇论文基准的测试
translation:
大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于支持科学文献综述，然而评估往往侧重于单个任务而非整个综述流程。我们评估了六个AI工具在四个阶段的表现：查找相关文章、解释文章、跨文章综合以及提出未来研究。基准测试采用了一篇已发表的关于西班牙羽状天气模式及其102篇文章文集的综述。
在初始搜索中，五个工具总共识别出57篇文章，其中表现最好的单个工具找到了42篇。对于Codex和Claude Code，机构图书馆权限将文献发现量分别从42篇增加到82篇、从15篇增加到79篇。给定完整的102篇PDF文集，三个工具正确识别了所有18篇实质性讨论西班牙羽状模式的文章，但错误地将84篇泛泛提及的文章中的40%至79%归类为实质性讨论。这三个工具还生成了由两位领域专家进行盲法评估的综合报告。尽管大体准确，但这些综合报告提供的见解有限，有时包含无根据的声明、引用错误以及对共识的夸大陈述。最后，所有三个工具提出的研究方向都比西班牙羽状文献更广泛，尽管其中两个探讨了基准综述中确定的问题。
没有单一工具在所有任务中表现最好。我们为在文献综述中使用AI工具的研究人员提出了八项建议。我们的研究结果表明，LLMs可以协助发现和解释科学文献（特别是在获得机构访问权限时），但不能取代专家在评估证据或综合研究方面的判断。
tldr: 大语言模型可以辅助科学文献的检索和初步解释，特别是结合机构权限时，但无法替代专家进行严格的证据评估和研究综合。
ai_comments: 该论文对大型语言模型在科学文献综述全流程中的应用进行了全面且严格的基准测试，揭示了AI在文献检索和初步解释方面的潜力，以及在证据评估和综合分析方面的局限性，为未来AI辅助科研工具的开发和使用提供了重要的实践参考。
motivation: 尽管大语言模型越来越多地被用于支持科学文献综述，但以往的评估大多局限于单个任务，而缺乏对整个文献综述流程的系统性评估。
method: 使用包含102篇文献的已发表气象学综述作为基准，评估了六个AI工具在文献发现、解释、综合和未来研究提案四个阶段的表现，并由两位领域专家对AI生成的综述进行了盲法评估。
results: 五个工具在初始搜索中共找到57篇文献（最佳工具42篇），接入机构数据库后大幅提升至82篇；面对完整102篇PDF时，工具能找出所有实质性讨论文献，但将40%-79%的泛泛提及误判为实质性讨论；综合分析基本准确但缺乏深度，且存在无依据声明、引用错误和夸大共识等问题；研究方向提案偏宽泛。无单款工具在所有任务上都表现最佳。
conclusion: 大语言模型可以作为科研人员在文献检索和解释方面的有效辅助工具（特别是在结合机构数据库访问权限时），但目前仍无法取代专家在证据评估和研究综合方面的主观判断。

title: The Power and Limits of Money Burning in Bilateral Trade
authors: Moshe Babaioff, Noam Nisan, Ariel Shaulker
abstract:
We study the power of money burning in bilateral trade. In this problem, a seller owns an indivisible item, a buyer would like to acquire it, and each of these two traders has a private value for the item and the values are sampled from independent distributions. We ask whether the traders can benefit from a mechanism that burns money, that is, one that charges the buyer more than it pays the seller, so that neither trader enjoys the difference (money burnt is a loss for the traders). Is it possible that the traders will ever be better off if the trade mechanism can burn money?
  For Bayesian incentive-compatible mechanisms and for deterministic dominant-strategy incentive-compatible (DSIC) mechanisms, it is known that money burning is always a waste and can only hurt the traders. Maybe surprisingly, we show that once a DSIC mechanism can use randomization, money burning can significantly benefit the traders, and the gain of each of them can be arbitrarily large. In contrast, we show that the power of DSIC randomized mechanisms that burn money is still very limited in the sense that they cannot guarantee any constant fraction of the first-best gains-from-trade.
zh_title: 双边贸易中烧钱的力量与局限性
translation:
我们研究了双边贸易中烧钱的威力。在此问题中，一个卖方拥有一个不可分割的物品，一个买方想要获取它，这两个交易者对该物品都有私有价值，且这些价值从独立分布中抽样。我们探讨交易者是否能从一个会“烧钱”的机制中受益，即该机制向买方收取的费用多于支付给卖方的费用，从而使任何一方都无法享用差额（烧钱对交易者而言是损失）。如果贸易机制能够烧钱，交易者是否有可能变得更好？
对于贝叶斯激励相容机制和确定性占优策略激励相容（DSIC）机制，已知烧钱始终是一种浪费，只会损害交易者的利益。也许令人惊讶的是，我们表明，一旦DSIC机制能够使用随机化，烧钱就可以显著使交易者受益，并且他们各自的收益可以任意大。相比之下，我们表明允许烧钱的DSIC随机机制的力量仍然非常有限，因为它们无法保证任何常数比例的第一最优贸易收益。
tldr: 随机DSIC机制下的“烧钱”可以显著提升双边贸易中交易者的效用，但仍无法保证实现高比例的第一最优贸易收益。
ai_comments: 该论文揭示了在双边贸易中，随机占优策略激励相容（DSIC）机制下“烧钱”的惊人威力及其局限性，对机制设计理论具有重要贡献。
motivation: 探讨在双边贸易中，允许烧钱（即买方支付的金额大于卖方收到的金额）的机制是否以及何时能够使双方受益。
method: 通过理论分析，研究贝叶斯激励相容、确定性DSIC以及随机DSIC机制在双边贸易中引入烧钱（money burning）时的表现和效果。
results: 对于贝叶斯激励相容和确定性DSIC机制，烧钱总是无益的；但对于随机DSIC机制，烧钱可以显著使双方受益，且收益可以任意大，不过它仍无法保证任何常数比例的第一最优贸易收益。
conclusion: 虽然随机DSIC机制下的烧钱可以带来无限的效用提升，但它无法保证任何常数比例的第一最优贸易收益。

title: Objective-Conditioned Active Preference Learning for Multi-Objective Alignment
authors: Duc Anh Vu, Thong Nguyen, Hoang Pham, Ponhvoan Srey, Luu Anh Tuan
abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with several objectives, such as helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty, typically relies on preference judgment for each objective, growing the annotation cost linearly with the number of objectives. Active preference learning can reduce this cost by selecting the comparisons whose labels are expected to change the policy most. Existing remedies either lack an objective-aware query selection mechanism for the multi-objective setting or regard conflicting preferences as harmful, therefore excluding them from the training data. We introduce OGC-DPO (Objective-conditioned Gradient Coverage DPO), an active learning framework that treats each (response pair, objective) combination as a separate query and measures its informativeness through the policy's own implicit gradient, without relying on an external reward model. OGC-DPO then selects the queries that most expand each objective's gradient coverage. Empirical experiments across varying numbers of objectives demonstrate the effectiveness of OGC-DPO over existing active preference learning methods under the same annotation cost. Further analysis demonstrates that informative conflicts, rather than being uniformly harmful, provide a useful policy training signal.
zh_title: 面向多目标对齐的目标条件主动偏好学习
translation: 将大语言模型（LLM）与帮助性、无害性和诚实性等多个目标进行对齐，通常依赖于对每个目标的偏好判断，这使得标注成本随目标数量呈线性增长。主动偏好学习可以通过选择其标签预期对策略改变最大的比较来降低这一成本。现有的解决方法要么在多目标设置中缺乏目标感知的查询选择机制，要么将冲突的偏好视为有害的，从而将其从训练数据中排除。我们引入了OGC-DPO（条件目标梯度覆盖DPO），这是一个主动学习框架，它将每个（响应对，目标）组合视为一个独立的查询，并通过策略自身的隐式梯度来衡量其信息量，而无需依赖外部奖励模型。然后，OGC-DPO选择最能扩展每个目标梯度覆盖范围的查询。在不同目标数量下的经验实验证明了在相同标注成本下，OGC-DPO优于现有主动偏好学习方法的有效性。进一步的分析表明，信息性冲突并非完全有害，而是提供了一种有用的策略训练信号。
tldr: 提出OGC-DPO框架，通过目标条件的主动偏好学习和梯度覆盖机制，降低多目标对齐的标注成本并有效利用偏好冲突。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将主动偏好学习引入多目标对齐中，提出OGC-DPO框架，不仅能有效减少多目标对齐的标注成本，还揭示了冲突偏好对策略训练的积极作用。
motivation: 将大语言模型与多个目标进行对齐时，传统的偏好判断会导致标注成本随目标数量线性增长，而现有的主动偏好学习方法缺乏多目标感知的查询选择机制，且错误地排除了冲突偏好。
method: 提出OGC-DPO（Objective-conditioned Gradient Coverage DPO）框架，将每个（响应对，目标）组合视为独立查询，利用策略自身的隐式梯度衡量信息量，选择最大化扩展每个目标梯度覆盖范围的查询。
results: 在不同数量目标的实验中，OGC-DPO在相同的标注成本下表现出优于现有主动偏好学习方法的有效性，且分析表明信息性冲突为策略训练提供了有用的信号。
conclusion: OGC-DPO是一个高效的用于大模型多目标对齐的主动偏好学习框架，在控制标注成本的同时提升了对齐效果，并证明了信息性冲突在训练中的价值。

title: Hybrid LLM-Deterministic Pipelines for Enterprise-Scale Code Migration at Bloomberg
authors: Mario Corchero, David Williams, Laszlo Kiss Kollar, Haowen Liu, Shivam Bairoliya, Gala Malbasic, Serkan Kirbas, Federica Sarro
abstract: Large organizations carry a long tail of infrastructure migrations that are worth doing but rarely urgent enough to compete with feature work, because each one costs significant engineering time per repository. This paper reports on our industrial experience from Automated Uplift, a multi-month initiative applying LLM-assisted migration pipelines across thousands of Bloomberg repositories. We examine two distinct production campaigns: a heterogeneous Python packaging migration (approx. 1,900 candidate repositories) and a uniform C++ build system migration (approx. 6,700 candidate repositories). Together, these campaigns generated 2,333 pull requests, resulting in 729 successful migrations. We detail our hybrid architectural solution which maximizes deterministic processing, confines the LLM to bounded file transformations within a pre-computed context, and incorporates runtime production telemetry (such as execution logs and usage traces). Our findings show that generating migrations turned out to be the easier part; the bottleneck was the cost, for owning teams, of reviewing, testing, and deploying them. These costs were lowered when changes could be verified directly in the pipeline before opening a PR (as with C++ compilation and test validation), and when the population was uniform enough for fixes to carry over from one repository to the next. We conclude by distilling our experience and findings into actionable, transferable patterns for architecting hybrid LLM-deterministic pipelines and scaling code migrations across the enterprise
zh_title: 彭博社企业级代码迁移的混合大模型-确定性管线实践
translation: 大型组织通常堆积着大量值得去做但因耗费大量工程时间而难以与功能开发竞争的基础设施迁移任务。本文报告了我们在自动化提升（Automated Uplift）方面的工业经验，这是一项在彭博社数千个代码仓库中应用LLM辅助迁移管线的多月计划。我们检查了两项不同的生产活动：异构Python打包迁移（约1,900个候选仓库）和统一的C++构建系统迁移（约6,700个候选仓库）。这些活动共生成了2,333个合并请求，成功完成了729个仓库的迁移。我们详细介绍了我们的混合架构解决方案，该方案最大化了确定性处理，将LLM限制在预计算上下文中的有界文件转换内，并结合了运行时生产遥测技术（如执行日志和使用轨迹）。我们的研究结果表明，生成迁移反而是较容易的部分；真正的瓶颈在于所有者团队对这些迁移进行审查、测试和部署的成本。当更改能够在开启PR之前直接在管线中进行验证（如C++编译和测试验证），并且群体足够统一以便修复方案能够在仓库间复用时，这些成本得以降低。最后，我们将经验和发现提炼为可操作的、可迁移的模式，用于构建混合LLM-确定性管线并在企业中扩展代码迁移。
tldr: 本文探讨了彭博社利用大语言模型和确定性管线相结合的混合架构，在数千个代码仓库中成功实施企业级代码迁移的经验与瓶颈。
ai_comments: 本文展示了大型企业（如彭博社）在实际生产环境中运用大语言模型与确定性管线结合进行大规模代码迁移的宝贵经验。创新点在于将LLM限制在预计算上下文的有界文件转换中，并利用运行时遥测技术。研究发现，代码生成本身并非最大瓶颈，所有者团队对代码的审查、测试和部署成本才是关键，这为未来企业级自动化运维提供了重要的设计参考。
motivation: 大型组织存在大量基础设施迁移工作，但由于每个仓库都需要消耗大量工程时间，导致其优先级往往低于功能开发。为了解决这一长期痛点，彭博社开展了应用LLM辅助迁移管线的工业级实践。
method: 采用混合架构解决方案，最大化确定性处理，将LLM限制在预计算上下文的有界文件转换中，并结合运行时生产遥测数据（如执行日志和使用轨迹）。
results: 通过两项生产活动（Python打包迁移和C++构建系统迁移），共生成2,333个Pull Request，成功完成729个仓库的迁移。研究发现生成迁移较容易，真正的瓶颈在于所有者团队审查、测试和部署的成本。
conclusion: 本文总结的经验和发现被提炼为可操作、可迁移的模式，有助于企业构建混合型LLM-确定性管线并扩展企业级代码迁移。

title: Ctrl-F: Force as an Interface for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
authors: Mengjie Zhao, Yuxin Chen, Yiyang Shao, Chuye Hong, Jiakang Chen, Koushil Sreenath, Masayoshi Tomizuka
abstract: Humanoid motion tracking has scaled to general policies that reproduce diverse human motion, but the resulting behavior is in free-space: the tracker knows where the body should be, not how it should interact with the environment. Other work makes the object part of the objective, yet abstracts that interaction to contact or geometry, which leaves the demanding cases under-explored. We argue that force is a natural command channel between motion imitation and object interaction, one that specifies not just where to make contact but how hard. We present Ctrl-F, a hierarchical motion-force framework that augments motion tracking with an explicit force command, a 3-D force at each designated contact body such as a hand or a foot. The hierarchical framework comprises: (1) A unified motion-force controller tracks the reference motion while applying the commanded force to the world. (2) A high-level force planner that issues a force command online based on object state and proprioception observations. In simulation and on hardware, Ctrl-F completes loco-manipulation that demands large, sustained interaction force and adjusts its command online as the load changes, both out of reach of a force-blind tracker. On hardware, Ctrl-F demonstrates hand-based dragging, pushing, and lifting, as well as foot-based kicking, successfully manipulating boxes weighing up to 20kg in pushing and kicking tasks where the force-blind baseline fails, while adapting online to additional loads introduced mid-task.
zh_title: Ctrl-F：将力作为人形机器人移动操作（Loco-Manipulation）接口
translation: 人形机器人运动追踪已经扩展到能够复制各种人类动作的通用策略，但由此产生的行为是在自由空间中的：追踪器知道身体应该在哪里，而不知道它应该如何与环境交互。其他工作将物体纳入目标，但将交互抽象为接触或几何形状，这使得高要求的案例尚未得到充分探索。我们认为力是运动模仿和物体交互之间自然的命令通道，它不仅指定在哪里进行接触，还指定用力的大小。我们提出了 Ctrl-F，这是一个分层的运动-力框架，它通过显式力命令（即手或脚等每个指定接触体上的 3-D 力）来增强运动追踪。该分层框架包括：(1) 一个统一的运动-力控制器，在追踪参考运动的同时向世界施加所命令的力。(2) 一个高级力规划器，根据物体状态和本体感觉观测在线发布力指令。在仿真和硬件上，Ctrl-F 完成了需要大量、持续交互力的移动操作（loco-manipulation），并随着负载的变化在线调整其指令，这是力盲追踪器无法触及的。在硬件上，Ctrl-F 展示了基于手的拖拽、推和抬起，以及基于脚的踢击，在推和踢击任务中成功操纵重达 20kg 的箱子（这是力盲基线失败的任务），同时适应了任务中途引入的额外负载。
tldr: 提出 Ctrl-F 层次化框架，将显式力指令引入人形机器人运动追踪中，成功实现了高达 20kg 重物的高负荷移动操作。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将显式力控制引入人形机器人的运动追踪中，解决了传统“力盲”追踪器无法处理高负荷交互的痛点，通过分层架构实现了复杂环境下的loco-manipulation。
motivation: 现有的人形机器人运动追踪主要在自由空间中进行，缺乏对环境交互力的感知和控制，而将物体作为目标的抽象方法又无法处理高负荷、严苛的交互情况，因此需要将“力”作为运动模仿与物体交互之间的自然命令通道。
method: 提出了 Ctrl-F 这一分层运动-力框架：（1）统一的运动-力控制器，用于在追踪参考运动的同时向世界施加指定力；（2）高级力 planner，根据物体状态和本体感觉在线下达力指令。
results: Ctrl-F 在仿真和硬件上均成功完成了需要大且持续交互力的 loco-manipulation 任务，能够在负载变化时在线调整指令，并在硬件上实现了高达 20kg 箱子的拖拽、推动、搬运以及踢击等任务。
conclusion: Ctrl-F 框架通过结合运动与显式力指令，成功使人形机器人在仿真和真实硬件上完成了高负荷、需在线调整的 loco-manipulation 任务。

title: Improved lower bounds on the approximability of Multiway Cut using Sherali-Adams relaxations
authors: Joshua Brakensiek, Neng Huang, Aaron Potechin, Uri Zwick
abstract:
The Multiway Cut problem is among the most well-studied problems in the area of combinatorial approximation algorithms. The currently best approximation ratio for the problem is 1.2787, obtained recently by the authors (2026). The best lower bound on the approximation ratio that can be achieved for the problem in polynomial time, under the Unique Games Conjecture (UGC), is 1.20016, obtained by Bérczi, Chandrasekaran, Király, and Madan (2020), building on and slightly improving a bound of $\frac65=1.2$, obtained by Angelidakis, Makarychev, and Manurangsi (2017) by introducing the important framework of non-opposite multiway cuts.
  We obtain a substantially improved lower bound of 1.22232 on the approximation ratio of the Multiway Cut problem. Manokaran, Naor, Raghavendra, and Schwartz (2008) showed that under UGC, the approximation ratio of Multiway Cut is equal to the integrality ratio of a simple LP relaxation, known as the CKR relaxation, introduced by Călinescu, Karloff, and Rabani (2000). Thus, stronger LP relaxations are not required for obtaining an optimal approximation algorithm for the problem. We show, however, that relying on the framework of Angelidakis, Makarychev, and Manurangsi (2017), stronger LP relaxations from the Sherali-Adams hierarchy for non-opposite multiway cuts can be used to obtain improved integrality ratios for the CKR relaxation, and hence improved lower bounds on the approximation ratio of the Multiway Cut problem. One of the novel features of our analysis is considering a continuous limit of discrete LPs defined on a simplex.
  Our proof of the new 1.22232 bound is completely analytic. We also present strong numerical evidence that suggests that our techniques can be used to improve the lower bound to at least 1.23003.
zh_title: 使用Sherali-Adams松弛改进多路切割问题可近似性的下界
translation:
多路切割问题是组合近似算法领域研究最深入的问题之一。该问题目前最好的近似比是1.2787，由作者最近获得（2026年）。在唯一游戏猜想（UGC）下，多项式时间内能达到的最佳近似比下界是1.20016，由Bérczi、Chandrasekaran、Király和Madan（2020年）获得，他们在此前由Angelidakis、Makarychev和Manurangsi（2017年）通过引入非对立多路割的重要框架所得到的6/5 = 1.2的界的基础上进行了微调。
我们获得了多路切割问题近似比的显著改进下界1.22232。Manokaran、Naor、Raghavendra和Schwartz（2008年）表明，在UGC下，多路切割的近似比等于由Călinescu、Karloff和Rabani（2000年）引入的称为CKR松弛的简单LP松弛的整性间隙。因此，获得该问题的最优近似算法并不需要更强的LP松弛。然而，我们表明，依托Angelidakis、Makarychev和Manurangsi（2017年）的框架，来自Sherali-Adams层级的更强LP松弛可用于非对立多路割，从而获得CKR松弛改进的整性间隙，进而得到多路切割问题近似比的改进下界。我们分析的一个创新特点是考虑了定义在单纯形上的离散LP的连续极限。
我们对新的1.22232界的证明完全是解析的。我们还提供了强有力的数值证据，表明我们的技术可以用来将下界提高到至少1.23003。
tldr: 本文利用Sherali-Adams线性规划松弛，将多路切割问题在唯一游戏猜想下的近似比下界从1.20016大幅提升至1.22232。
ai_comments: 本文通过引入Sherali-Adams层级和非对立多路割框架，并结合连续极限分析方法，显著提升了多路切割问题在唯一游戏猜想（UGC）下的不可近似性下界。这一工作不仅推进了我们对该经典组合优化问题近似复杂度的理解，也展示了解析方法和连续极限在分析复杂线性规划松弛方面的威力。
motivation: 为了提高多路切割问题（Multiway Cut）在唯一游戏猜想（UGC）下的近似比下界，超越以往基于基础CKR线性规划松弛的结果。
method: 利用Sherali-Adams线性规划松弛层级结合非对立多路割框架，并通过对定义在单纯形上的离散LP进行连续极限分析，完全通过解析方法推导下界，同时辅以数值证据。
results: 得到了多路切割问题近似比的一个显著改进下界 1.22232，并且数值证据表明该技术有望将下界进一步提升至至少 1.23003。
conclusion: 本文通过Sherali-Adams线性规划松弛获得了多路切割问题1.22232的改进下界，并且数值证据表明该技术有望进一步提升至1.23003。

title: SlackBench: Benchmarking Agents on Collaborative Projects Grounded in Real Code Repositories
authors: Mingxuan Li, Huanzhi Mao, Ruitao Zheng, Jarod Stanbury James, Yunze Li, Natanya Anderson, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Alex Dimakis
abstract:
AI Agents are becoming digital coworkers that can browse the web, write code, run experiments, and assist humans over extended horizons. Yet existing benchmarks fall short of real knowledge work: many rely on synthetic data or isolated tasks, missing the complex, multi-party dynamics of collaborative projects, where critical information is scattered across conversations, code, and evolving decisions. Even simple workplace questions may require locating relevant channels and direct messages, recovering context from long discussions, inspecting repository state, reconciling stale or conflicting evidence, and synthesizing across sources.
  We introduce SlackBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on realistic research and engineering workflows that require joint reasoning over workplace communication and evolving repository state. Grounded in privacy-preserving reenactments of real academic research projects, SlackBench provides reproducible environments with realistic multi-party dialogue, evolving decisions, and corresponding code changes grounded in GitHub repositories and Google Docs. It contains 140 queries spanning heterogeneous-source agentic search, abstention on unanswerable or false-premise questions, goal-directed summarization, and circumstance inference over long conversations. These tasks are not reducible to static corpus question answering: agents must determine which conversations matter, traverse threads, inspect repository state, and synthesize evidence across communication and code artifacts. Across 33 frontier models and agent harnesses, the best system scores around 80% and most agents score below 66%, highlighting substantial headroom for improvement. SlackBench thus provides an extensible framework for evaluating agents in collaborative work environments. The SlackBench dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuanzhiMao/SlackBench .
zh_title: SlackBench：在真实代码库协作项目上基准测试代理能力
translation:
人工智能代理正在成为数字同事，能够浏览网页、编写代码、运行 experiments 并长期协助人类。然而，现有的基准测试远未能达到真实知识工作的要求：许多测试依赖于合成数据或孤立任务，错失了协作项目中复杂的多方动态，其中关键信息分散在对话、代码和不断演变的决策中。甚至简单的工作场所问题也可能需要定位相关频道和私信、从长期的讨论中恢复上下文、检查代码库状态、调和陈旧或冲突的证据，并跨来源进行综合。
我们推出了 SlackBench，这是一个用于评估代理在真实研究和工程工作流上表现的基准测试，这些工作流需要对工作场所通信和不断演变的代码库状态进行联合推理。SlackBench 基于真实学术研究项目的隐私保护重演，提供了具有真实多方对话、演变决策以及 GitHub 仓库和 Google Docs 中对应代码变更的可复现环境。它包含 140 个查询，跨越了异构源代理搜索、对无法回答或错误前提问题的拒绝、目标导向的摘要以及对长对话的情境推理。这些任务不能简化为静态语料库问答：代理必须确定哪些对话重要、遍历线程、检查代码库状态，并跨通信和代码人工制品综合证据。在 33 个前沿模型和代理框架中，最好的系统得分约为 80%，大多数代理得分低于 66%，这突显了改进的大量空间。因此，SlackBench 为在协作工作环境中评估代理提供了一个可扩展的框架。SlackBench 数据集可在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuanzhiMao/SlackBench 获取。
tldr: SlackBench 是一个新型基准测试，用于评估 AI 代理在结合工作场所沟通与代码演进的真实协作项目中的综合推理能力。
ai_comments: SlackBench 填补了现有 AI 代理基准测试在真实协作项目（结合工作场所沟通与代码演进）方面的空白，具有高度的实际应用价值和挑战性。其局限性在于主要基于特定的学术研究项目，未来可以扩展到更多行业。
motivation: 现有 AI 代理基准测试多依赖合成数据或孤立任务，缺乏真实知识工作中复杂的、多方参与的协作项目动态（关键信息分散在对话、代码和演进的决策中），无法有效评估代理在工作场所沟通与代码演进交织环境下的综合推理能力。
method: 引入 SlackBench 基准测试，基于真实学术研究项目的隐私保护重演，提供包含多方对话、演进决策以及 GitHub 和 Google Docs 中代码变更的可复现环境，包含 140 个涵盖多源搜索、拒绝回答、摘要和情境推理的查询任务。
results: 在对 33 个前沿模型和代理框架的测试中，表现最好的系统得分约为 80%，大多数代理得分低于 66%，表明现有系统在处理此类复杂协作任务时仍有很大的提升空间。
conclusion: SlackBench 是一个有效的基准测试框架，用于评估 AI 代理在协作工作环境中的综合推理能力，现有模型在此基准上表现仍有较大提升空间。

title: Where models of minimal height are hard to find: cubic rational maps with a multiple fixed point
authors: Elira Shaska
abstract: Given a rational point of the moduli space of cubic rational maps, we seek a map in its class with the smallest integer coefficients. A recent algorithm (Shaska, arXiv:2610.33990) combines an exact descent and minimisation of the resultant with a reduction and a local search; it is nearly exact where the minimal height is known. Beyond that range, a certified deeper search shows that the instances in which a smaller model lies beyond its reach are not random: a classifier predicts them from the six invariants of the point, and asking what it relies on leads to an exact algebraic surface, the maps with a triple fixed point. Invariant theory and the stability hypothesis of reduction theory (Hutz and Stoll, 2019) then identify the larger locus that contains it: the hypersurface $ξ_1^3=6ξ_2^2$ of maps with a multiple fixed point, on which the fixed-point quartic is not stable. It holds most of the hard instances. On it the two invariants of the fixed-point quartic are $(ξ_1,ξ_2)=(6m^2,6m^3)$ for an integer $m\ge0$; we parametrise the integer points of the surface, and show that on its generic part the sign of $ξ_5$ is the sign of the cubic coefficient at the parabolic fixed point. A covariant defined on the locus, added to the reduction, resolves only a minority of the hard instances: they appear to be mainly a matter of the search's reach. These findings lead to a certified structured search that never returns a larger model than the original algorithm and finds most of the smaller models within reach, also at heights not used to design it, at a small multiple of its running time.
comment: 38 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/LiraCurri/minmodels
zh_title: 寻找极小高度模型之难处：具有多重不动点的三次有理映射
translation: 给定三次有理映射模空间的一个有理点，我们寻求在其同值类中具有最小整数系数的映射。最近的一个算法（Shaska, arXiv:2610.33990）结合了精确下降、结式最小化与约化和局部搜索；在已知最小高度的范围内它几乎是精确的。超出该范围，经验证的更深搜索表明，超出其范围的较小模型所在的实例并不是随机的：分类器根据该点的六个 invariants 预测它们，而探究其依赖基础则导向了一个精确的代数曲面，即具有三重不动点的映射。不变量理论与约化理论的稳定性假设（Hutz和Stoll, 2019）随后识别出了包含它的更大轨迹：具有多重不动点的映射超曲面 $\xi_1^3=6\xi_2^2$，在其上不动点四次式是不稳定的。它包含了大多数困难实例。在其上，不动点四次式的两个 invariants 对于某个整数 $m\ge0$ 为 $(\xi_1,\xi_2)=(6m^2,6m^3)$；我们参数化了该曲面的整点，并证明在其一般部分上，$\xi_5$ 的符号即为抛物不动点处三次项系数的符号。定义在该轨迹上并加入约化的一个协变式仅解决了少数困难实例：它们主要似乎是搜索范围的问题。这些发现导向了一种经认证的结构化搜索，它绝不返回比原算法更大的模型，并且在较短的运行时间内能找到范围内的大多数较小模型，这也适用于设计时未使用的iehts。
tldr: 本文揭示了三次有理映射高度极小化算法中困难实例的代数本质，并提出了一种改进的结构化搜索算法。
ai_comments: 该论文巧妙地结合了算术动力系统、不变量理论和机器学习分类器，深入探讨了三次有理映射模空间中寻找极小高度模型时的“困难实例”成因，并提出了有效的改进搜索算法。
motivation: 现有的寻找具有最小整系数的立方有理映射算法在某些超出已知高度范围的实例中表现不佳（即难以找到极小高度模型），作者旨在探究这些“困难实例”并非随机分布的深层原因，并改进搜索算法。
method: 结合了精确下降、结式最小化、约化与局部搜索的算法，利用分类器分析困难实例，并基于不变量理论和约化理论识别出困难实例所在的代数曲面及超曲面，进而设计出结构化搜索算法。
results: 确定了容纳大多数困难实例的超曲面（具有多重不动点的映射，其上不动点四次式不稳定），参数化了该曲面的整点，并设计了一种新的结构化搜索算法，该算法在耗时略增的情况下能够找到更多较小的模型且不产生更大的模型。
conclusion: 本文通过几何与代数手段揭示了高度极小化算法中困难实例的本质是一个特定的代数曲面（具有多重不动点的映射），并基于此开发了更加高效且保持精度的结构化搜索算法。

title: TSFM Meets LLM: Context as Covariates
authors: Hemanth Ram, Sai Shankar Narasimhan, Shubhankar Agarwal, Sandeep Chinchali
abstract: Textual information is ubiquitous in real-world time series datasets, appearing as news, reports, and annotations that hold key predictive signals not deducible from numerical history alone. Large Language Models (LLMs) interpret text but lack numerical precision, while Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) are quantitatively accurate but cannot reason about the effects of text. Moreover, the lack of large-scale paired multimodal datasets limits progress in bridging this gap. In this work, we address this challenge by providing a scalable approach for generating realistic multimodal datasets by annotating real-world time series with LLMs. Building on this, we propose Context as Covariates (CoCo), a forecasting framework in which an LLM distills its textual reasoning into numerically grounded forecast and confidence covariates that guide a TSFM backbone, thereby exploiting the strengths of both LLMs and TSFMs. We align the two models in stages, first fine-tuning the LLM via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a reward tied to covariate-induced improvement in forecasting performance, and then fine-tuning the TSFM on covariates generated by the aligned LLM. Our experiments show that models trained on our synthetic multimodal corpus generalize to real benchmarks spanning finance, economics, weather, traffic, and security. Notably, CoCo with Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as the LLM and Chronos2 as the TSFM achieves up to 12% MAE improvement over state-of-the-art TSFMs and LLM forecasters, such as GPT-4o. Code, checkpoints, and the evaluation datasets are publicly available.
zh_title: 时间序列基础模型邂逅大语言模型：上下文即协变量
translation: 文本信息在现实世界的时间序列数据集中无处不在，通常以新闻、报告和注释的形式出现，其中包含无法仅从数值历史中推断出的关键预测信号。大语言模型（LLM）擅长解释文本但缺乏数值精度，而时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在数量上精确却无法推理文本的影响。此外，缺乏大规模成对多模态数据集限制了该领域的进展。在这项工作中，我们通过提出一种使用 LLM 为真实世界时间序列添加注释以生成现实多模态数据集的可扩展方法来应对这一挑战。在此基础上，我们提出了 Context as Covariates (CoCo) 预测框架，在该框架中，LLM 将其文本推理提炼为数值基础的预测和置信度协变量，以此引导 TSFM 主干网络，从而充分发挥 LLM 和 TSFM 的优势。我们分阶段对齐这两个模型：首先通过群组相对策略优化（GRPO）对 LLM 进行微调，其奖励与协变量带来的预测性能提升挂钩；然后使用对齐后的 LLM 生成的协变量对 TSFM 进行微调。我们的实验表明，在我们的合成多模态语料库上训练的模型能够泛化到涵盖金融、经济、天气、交通和安全的真实基准。值得注意的是，以 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 作为 LLM、Chronos2 作为 TSFM 的 CoCo 框架，其平均绝对误差（MAE）比最先进的 TSFM 和诸如 GPT-4o 等 LLM 预测器提高了高达 12%。代码、检查点和评估数据集已公开发布。
tldr: 本文提出了 CoCo 框架，利用大语言模型将文本转换为数值协变量来指导时间序列基础模型，有效融合了两者优势，在多个基准测试中取得了显著的预测精度提升。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出将大语言模型（LLM）的文本推理能力转化为数值型协变量，供时间序列基础模型（TSFM）使用，并采用两阶段对齐和强化学习（GRPO）策略，有效解决了多模态时间序列中缺乏大规模成对数据的痛点。该方法在多个真实世界基准上取得了显著的性能提升。
motivation: 现实世界中的时间序列常伴随文本信息，而现有的 LLM 缺乏数值精度，TSFM 无法推理文本效果，且缺乏大规模成对多模态数据集限制了该领域的发展。为此，需要开发一个可扩展的方法来生成现实的多模态数据集，并有效结合 LLM 与 TSFM 的优势。
method: 提出 Context as Covariates (CoCo) 框架，包含两个阶段：首先利用 LLM 将文本推理蒸馏为数值预测和置信度协变量，并通过基于预测性能改进的群组相对策略优化（GRPO）对 LLM 进行微调；然后使用对齐后的 LLM 生成的协变量来微调 TSFM 主干网络。
results: 在金融、经济、天气、交通和安全等真实基准测试中，使用该合成多模态数据集训练的模型表现出良好的泛化能力；采用 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 作为 LLM、Chronos2 作为 TSFM 的 CoCo 框架，相比最先进的 TSFM 和如 GPT-4o 等 LLM 预测器，平均绝对误差（MAE）提升了高达 12%。
conclusion: 该文提出的 CoCo 框架成功结合了 LLM 的文本推理优势与 TSFM 的数值预测精度，通过上下文协变量和分阶段对齐，显著提升了多模态时间序列预测的性能，并在金融、天气等多个领域的基准测试中展现出优越的泛化能力。

title: When to Ask, When to Answer: Strategic Clarification for Ambiguous Reference Resolution in Dialogue
authors: Ibrahim Khebour, Nikhil Krishnaswamy
abstract: For humans, referential disambiguation is a collaborative process involving clarification questions asked when they will meaningfully change the outcome. However, large language models (LLMs) have been shown to be biased toward premature answering, preferring definite single-turn responses over more clarification exchanges. In this paper, we study the problem of "strategic clarification" -- asking clarification questions in a reference game when their answers will narrow the set of candidate referents. We construct a controlled test environment from the SIMMC 2.1 dataset that records how many questions each ambiguous reference needs to be successfully resolved, and examine how baseline LLM behavior and common post-training methods ask clarifying questions vs. attempt to answer the referent. We also propose BACE (Belief-Aware Critic with Epistemic tracking), a lightweight action chooser method on top of a frozen LM backbone, and show that BACE more consistently chooses the optimal number of clarifying questions than methods such as GRPO and ArCHer.
zh_title: 何时提问，何时回答：对话中模糊指称消解的战略性澄清
translation: 对人类而言，指称消解是一个协作过程，当澄清问题能够有意义地改变结果时才会提出。然而，大语言模型（LLM）已被证明对过早回答存在偏见，更倾向于确定的单轮回答，而不是更多的澄清交流。在本文中，我们研究了“战略性澄清”问题——即在指称博弈中，当问题的回答能够缩小候选指称范围时提出澄清问题。我们从 SIMMC 2.1 数据集中构建了一个受控测试环境，记录成功解决每个模糊指称所需的提问数量，并检验了基线 LLM 行为以及常用的后训练方法是如何提出澄清问题与试图回答指称的。我们还提出了 BACE（基于认知追踪的信念感知批评家），这是一种建立在冻结语言模型主干之上的轻量级动作选择方法，并证明与 GRPO 和 ArCHer 等方法相比，BACE 能更持续地选择最优数量的澄清问题。
tldr: 本文针对大语言模型在对话中倾向于过早回答模糊指称的问题，提出了 BACE 方法，能够像人类一样策略性地选择何时提问澄清、何时给出答案。
ai_comments: 该论文切中了大语言模型在对话中倾向于过早回答而缺乏主动澄清的痛点，提出了创新的信念感知批评家方法 BACE，在平衡提问与回答的策略性上表现优于多种对齐方法，具有很高的实用价值和学术启发意义。
motivation: 人类在面对指异性指称时会通过协作性的澄清问题来缩小候选范围，但大语言模型存在偏向过早回答、缺乏多轮澄清交互的缺陷，因此需要研究如何在对话中进行“战略性澄清”。
method: 基于 SIMMC 2.1 数据集构建了受控测试环境，检验基线大语言模型和常用后训练方法的表现；并提出了 BACE（Belief-Aware Critic with Epistemic tracking）这一构建在冻结语言模型主干之上的轻量级动作选择方法。
results: 实验表明，相比于 GRPO 和 ArCHer 等方法，BACE 能够更稳定地为消解模糊指称选择最优数量的澄清问题。
conclusion: BACE 能够有效引导大语言模型在指称消解任务中进行战略性澄清，克服了模型过早回答的倾向，实现了最优提问次数的更稳定选择。

title: From Activation to Intervention: Interpreting Sparse Visual Features through Reconstruction
authors: Jianyang Gu, Jacob Beattie, Mridul Khurana, Julia Chae, Xi Xiao, Cheng Zhang, Anuj Karpatne, Wei-Lun Chao, Sara Beery, Tanya Berger-Wolf
abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose visual representations into individual features, offering a promising basis for explaining model behavior. Interpreting these features typically relies on images or pixel regions that most strongly activate them. However, this evidence becomes ambiguous when multiple features with different semantics frequently activate in the same locations, such as texture and color in the same patterns. We propose Reconstructive SAE Intervention (RecSAEI), a framework that shifts feature explanation from passive observation to active visual reconstruction. By intervening on representations along SAE decoder directions and reconstructing the visual output, we provide direct evidence of a feature's semantic meaning. We demonstrate that our method successfully disambiguates feature meanings across multiple datasets and vision encoders. Furthermore, our framework grounds [CLS] SAE interventions in a sparse set of patch SAE decoder directions. Beyond stable target response, this attribution also exposes the compositional relationship between elementary visual patterns and high-level semantics. Our results advocate for intervention reconstruction as an essential complementary signal for explaining neural networks.
comment: Demo and code available at https://imageomics.github.io/RecSAEI
zh_title: 从激活到干预：通过重建解释稀疏视觉特征
translation: 稀疏自编码器（SAEs）将视觉表征分解为各个特征，为解释模型行为提供了有前景的基础。解释这些特征通常依赖于最强烈激活它们的图像或像素区域。然而，当具有不同语义的多个特征频繁在相同位置（例如同一模式中的纹理和颜色）激活时，这种证据就会变得模糊。我们提出了重建式SAE干预（RecSAEI）框架，将特征解释从被动观察转变为主动视觉重建。通过对SAE解码器方向的表征进行干预并重建视觉输出，我们为特征的语义含义提供了直接证据。我们证明了我们的方法成功消除了跨多个数据集和视觉编码器的特征含义歧义。此外，我们的框架将[CLS] SAE干预基础化为一组稀疏的补丁SAE解码器方向。除了稳定的目标响应之外，这种归因还揭示了基本视觉模式与高级语义之间的组合关系。我们的结果表明，干预重建是解释神经网络必不可少的互补信号。
tldr: 提出了一种名为RecSAEI的框架，通过主动的视觉重建和干预来准确解释深度视觉模型的稀疏特征，解决了传统被动观察方法的语义模糊问题。
ai_comments: 该论文通过将稀疏自编码器（SAE）的特征解释从被动的观察转向主动的视觉重建（RecSAEI），有效解决了多特征在相干位置激活时的语义模糊性问题，为深度学习可解释性研究提供了一种有力且创新的干预重建互补信号。
motivation: 基于图像或像素区域的传统特征解释方法，在多个具有不同语义的特征（如同一模式中的纹理和颜色）频繁在相同位置激活时会变得模糊，因此需要一种主动的视觉重建方法来提供直接证据。
method: 提出了重建式SAE干预（RecSAEI）框架，通过沿SAE解码器方向对表征进行干预并重建视觉输出，从而直接验证特征的语义含义，并将[CLS] SAE干预归因于稀疏的一组补丁SAE解码器方向。
results: 实验表明，该方法成功消除了多个数据集和视觉编码器中特征含义的歧义，并将[CLS] SAE干预基础化，同时揭示了基本视觉模式与高级语义之间的组合关系。
conclusion: 干预重建（RecSAEI）为解释视觉神经网络中的稀疏特征提供了一种有效的、超越被动观察的互补信号，能够成功消除特征歧义并揭示基本视觉模式与高级语义之间的组合关系。

title: The Confidence Score: a New Measure on Kernels
authors: Elizabeth Hofer, Martin v. Mohrenschildt
abstract: Across a wide range of applications, kernel measures are used to tune hyperparameters, select among candidate kernels, and assess the suitability of kernels for specific learning tasks. For classification, kernel measures are used to predict which kernels may produce accurate kernel classifiers. Many existing kernel measures, such as alignment to the ideal kernel, are designed to reward kernels which captures all samples from the same class as similar. While effective in many settings, this requirement is unnecessarily restrictive for classification, where classes may exhibit substantial internal structure. In this work, the "Confidence Score", a new kernel measure, is proposed. Unlike alignment-to-the-ideal kernel measures, the Confidence Score measures the alignment between an encoding of the ground truth and that ground truth projected by the kernel, allowing kernels that preserve intra-class structure to achieve high scores. Through experiments, it is demonstrated that the Confidence Score exhibits a higher correlation with classification accuracy across a variety of kernels on both real-world and synthetic datasets, compared to select other kernel measures.
zh_title: 置信度得分：一种核函数的新度量标准
translation: 在广泛的应用中，核度量被用于调整超参数、在候选核之间进行选择以及评估核对特定学习任务的适用性。对于分类任务，核度量被用来预测哪些核可以产生准确的核分类器。许多现有的核度量，例如与理想核的对齐度，旨在奖励那些将来自同一类的所有样本捕获为相似的核。虽然这在许多情况下是有效的，但这一要求对于分类任务来说是不必要的限制，因为分类任务的类可能表现出大量的内部结构。在这项工作中，提出了一种新的核度量——“置信度得分”。与理想核对齐度量不同，“置信度得分”测量地面真实值的编码与由核投影的地面真实值之间的对齐度，允许保留类内结构的核获得高分。通过实验证明，与选择的其他核度量相比，“置信度得分”在真实世界和合成数据集的各种核上表现出与分类准确率更高的相关性。
tldr: 提出了一种名为“置信度得分”的新核度量，它允许保留类内结构，并在分类任务中展现出比传统方法更高的准确率相关性。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种名为“置信度得分”的新核度量方法，创新性地允许核函数保留类内结构，突破了传统理想核对齐方法要求同类样本必须全部相似的过度限制。实验证明其与分类准确率具有更高的相关性，在核函数选择和超参数调优中具有重要的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的许多核度量（如与理想核的对齐度）要求将同一类的所有样本都视为相似的，这对于具有复杂内部结构的分类任务来说过于严格和有限制性，因此需要一种新的核度量来更好地适应这类任务。
method: 提出了一种名为“置信度得分”（Confidence Score）的新核度量方法，该方法通过测量真实标签编码与经核投影后的真实标签之间的对齐程度来评估核函数，并进行了真实世界和合成数据集上的实验验证。
results: 实验表明，与现有的其他核度量相比，“置信度得分”在各种真实世界和合成数据集的各种核函数上，与分类准确率表现出更高的相关性。
conclusion: 本文提出的“置信度得分”是一种有效的核度量标准，它能够更好地适应具有复杂类内结构的分类任务，在与现有核度量的对比中表现出更高的分类准确率相关性。

title: MA-SafeDiffuser: Safe Multi-Agent Planning with Diffusion Probabilistic Models
authors: Kiran Ravish, Ankita Kushwaha, Preeti, Pawan Kumar
abstract: We propose MA-SafeDiffuser, a multi-agent extension of SafeDiffuser that equips diffusion-based trajectory planners with finite-time diffusion invariance guarantees for joint-agent safety specifications. Building on the single-agent construction that embeds control barrier function (CBF) constraints into reverse-diffusion updates, we: (i) formalize joint safe sets as intersections of per-agent and pairwise barrier sets; (ii) derive centralized and decentralized (communication-aware) constrained denoising procedures with provable invariance under mild assumptions; (iii) address local-trap and deadlock phenomena via time-varying specifications and liveness CBFs; and (iv) develop a lightweight benchmarking suite including a multi-agent Maze2D domain. Empirically, MA-SafeDiffuser reduces violation counts relative to unconstrained diffusion baselines, while retaining planning quality. We provide algorithms, proofs, and reference implementations.
comment: Accepted at AAMAS 2026. 14 pages, including supplementary material
zh_title: MA-SafeDiffuser：基于扩散概率的安全多智能体规划
translation: 我们提出了 MA-SafeDiffuser，它是 SafeDiffuser 的多智能体扩展，为基于扩散的轨迹规划器配备了针对联合智能体安全规范的有限时间扩散不变性保证。基于将控制屏障函数 (CBF) 约束嵌入到逆向扩散更新中的单智能体结构，我们：(i) 将联合安全集形式化为每个智能体和成对屏障集的交集；(ii) 在温和假设下推导出去中心化（通信感知）的具有可证明不变性的受约束去噪过程；(iii) 通过时变规范和活性 CBF 解决局部陷入和死锁现象；以及 (iv) 开发了一个包含多智能体 Maze2D 域的轻量级基准测试套件。从经验来看，与无约束扩散基线相比，MA-SafeDiffuser 减少了违反次数，同时保留了规划质量。我们提供了算法、证明和参考实现。
tldr: MA-SafeDiffuser是一种新型的多智能体扩散轨迹规划器，它利用控制屏障函数（CBF）约束保证了联合安全性，显著减少了安全违规并克服了死锁问题。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将扩散概率模型与控制屏障函数（CBF）相结合，解决了多智能体规划中的联合安全性、局部陷入和死锁问题，同时提供了集中式和去中心化两种通信感知方案，具有很高的理论价值和实际应用潜力。
motivation: 现有的扩散基轨迹规划器在多智能体场景中缺乏对联合安全规范的有限时间扩散不变性保证，容易产生安全违规、局部陷入和死锁现象。
method: 提出MA-SafeDiffuser，将联合安全集形式化为智能体及成对屏障集的交集；推导具有可证明不变性的集中式和去中心化（通信感知）约束去噪过程；通过时变规范和活性CBF解决局部陷入和死锁现象；并开发了轻量级基准测试套件。
results: 实验表明，与无约束的扩散基线相比，MA-SafeDiffuser在保持规划质量的同时显著减少了安全违规次数。
conclusion: MA-SafeDiffuser成功将有限时间扩散不变性保证嵌入到多智能体扩散轨迹规划中，在确保联合安全的同时保持了良好的规划质量。

title: ProofStudio: Five Proof Assistants in the Browser
authors: Yutaka Nagashima
abstract: Recent advances in AI-assisted proof automation are extending the use of proof assistants in software verification and mathematics. However, greater proof automation does not remove users' responsibility to assess whether formal statements capture their intended requirements, making education in formal specification and reasoning essential. To lower the installation and learning barriers associated with mature proof assistants, we present ProofStudio, a browser-based environment integrating Isabelle/HOL, Lean, Rocq, HOL4, and HOL Light with corresponding worked examples, preconfigured proof search, and contextual AI assistance. With ProofStudio, users can explore formal specifications and proofs across five systems without local installation, inspecting native prover feedback and experimenting with automation through a common interface.
comment: The tool is available at: https://proofstudio.org/

title: Data-Driven Stochastic LQR Control with Probabilistic Guarantees and Uncertainty Refinement
authors: Amir Modares, Charalambous Themistoklis, Hamidreza Modares
abstract: This paper presents a probabilistic framework for the direct, data-driven synthesis of the stochastic linear- quadratic output-feedback control for linear systems sub- ject to process and measurement noise. Using delayed input-output measurements, we derive a lifted parameter- ization together with an equivalent lifted linear quadratic cost, enabling controller synthesis without explicitly identi- fying the lifted dynamics. Two complementary closed-loop formulations, based on trajectory and covariance represen- tations, are then developed, whose uncertainties depend only on the realized but unknown lifted noise. We char- acterize the relative performance of the two formulations in finite-data regimes. High-probability uncertainty bounds are developed for realized noises, leading to a convex optimization solution to the problem, whose feasibility cer- tifies probabilistic mean-square stability (p-MSS) and per- formance guarantees. To reduce conservatism, Gaussian zonotopes are used to refine uncertainty sets by elimi- nating noise realizations inconsistent with measured data, and a novel intersection rule enables the consistent fusion of data-driven and physics-informed information. These components are integrated into an adaptive framework that unifies indirect (identification-based) and direct (control- oriented) data-driven linear-quadratic output-feedback con- trol. Unlike existing direct data-driven LQR methods that verify stability a posteriori, our by-construction approach achieves robust stability alongside reduced conservatism and superior performance. Simulation results show that the proposed controller approaches the ideal optimal solution while outperforming existing data-driven methods under noisy measurements.
zh_title: 数据驱动的随机LQR控制，具有概率保证和不确定性细化
translation: 本文提出了一种用于线性系统随机线性二次输出反馈控制的概率框架，该系统受过程和测量噪声的影响。利用延迟的输入-输出测量，我们推导出一个提升的参数化以及一个等效的提升的线性二次成本，从而能够在不显式识别提升的动力学的情况下合成控制器。然后，开发了两种互补的闭环公式，基于轨迹和协方差表示，其不确定性仅取决于已实现的但未知的提升噪声。我们描述了两种公式在有限数据情况下的相对性能。开发了已实现噪声的高概率不确定性界限，从而为问题提供了一个凸优化解决方案，其可行性证明了概率均方稳定性（p-MSS）和性能保证。为了减少保守性，使用高斯区域体通过消除与测量数据不一致的噪声实现来细化不确定性集，并且一种新颖的交集规则能够将数据驱动和物理信息相结合。这些组件被集成到一个自适应框架中，该框架统一了间接（基于辨识）和直接（面向控制）的数据驱动线性二次输出反馈控制。与现有的事后验证稳定性的直接数据驱动LQR方法不同，我们的构造方法实现了鲁棒稳定性，同时降低了保守性并提高了性能。仿真结果表明，所提出的控制器在有噪声测量的情况下，接近理想的最优解决方案，并优于现有的数据驱动方法。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种数据驱动的随机LQR控制框架，无需显式识别系统动力学，即可在有噪声的情况下合成具有概率保证的控制器，并通过不确定性细化减少保守性并提高性能。
ai_comments: 该研究在数据驱动控制领域取得了重要进展，特别是在处理随机性和不确定性方面。通过概率框架和不确定性细化技术，该方法在保证稳定性和性能的同时，有效降低了保守性。与现有方法相比，其“构造即稳定”的特性是一个显著的优势。然而，实际应用中计算复杂性和对数据质量的敏感性可能需要进一步研究。
motivation: 现有数据驱动的LQR方法通常在事后验证稳定性，而本研究旨在通过一种内置方法，在数据驱动的同时实现鲁棒稳定性和降低保守性。
method: 提出了一种概率框架，使用延迟的输入-输出测量数据，推导出提升的参数化和等效的提升的线性二次成本，从而无需显式识别提升的动力学即可合成控制器。开发了两种互补的闭环公式（基于轨迹和协方差表示），并利用高概率不确定性界限和高斯区域体来细化不确定性集，以减少保守性。将这些组件集成到一个统一间接和直接数据驱动控制的自适应框架中。
results: 所提出的控制器在模拟中接近理想的最优解，并且在有噪声测量的情况下优于现有的数据驱动方法。该方法通过构造实现鲁棒稳定性，并具有较低的保守性和优越的性能。
conclusion: 该研究成功开发了一种数据驱动的随机LQR控制方法，该方法通过概率保证和不确定性细化，在无需显式系统辨识的情况下，实现了鲁棒稳定性、降低了保守性并提高了性能，在模拟结果中得到了验证。

title: Rewrite, Then Veto: Rewriter-Agnostic Edit Gating for LLM-Based Post-OCR Correction
authors: Jorge Ramón Fonseca Cacho
abstract: LLMs can repair noisy OCR transcripts of historical documents, but they also change text that was already correct. We propose EditVeto, a veto gate placed after a full-context LLM rewrite. The rewrite is character-aligned to the OCR input, its differences are split into blocks, and a 0.6B-parameter gate keeps or reverts each block. An oracle analysis motivates the design: given the true error locations, per-span generation is worse than no correction, whereas vetoing a full rewrite's edits helps. Trained on rewrites by two Qwen3 models and evaluated, frozen, on the eight HIPE-OCRepair-2026 test sets, the gate improves all five rewriters tested, two of them unseen in training: weighted cMER falls by 0.0026-0.0044 and the preference score rises by 0.15-0.25 (paired bootstrap, p ~ 0.0002 each). On published competition outputs it lowers cMER for three of four teams but raises it for the winning run (0.0050 to 0.0065). In a second, disclosed test look, a retrained gate still improves LoRA-tuned rewriters (cMER -0.0011 to -0.0021), and an ensemble of their gated edits reaches a cMER of 0.0069 and a preference score of 0.928, mostly through fine-tuning and pooling rather than gating. Built only on public models and data, it is behind the winner (0.0050) and tied with the second-ranked run (0.0071), both from the only team using domain pre-training, and ahead of all other published runs. A third, secondary look shows the unchanged gate improving zero-shot Qwen3.8-27B (cMER 0.0114 to 0.0108) but only the preference score of its LoRA-tuned version.
comment: 26 pages, 3 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/SniperJF/ocr-edit-gate-release; models: https://huggingface.co/SJF7

title: Recasting Visual Language Models as EEG Foundation Models for Clinical Neurodiagnostics
authors: Xin Zhou, Elena Sergeeva, Nan Bi, Wenyu Song, Lijun Yin, Hao Deng
abstract: Historically automated electroencephalography (EEG) systems was done using task-specific supervised models trained on purposely annotated data. A more recent modeling paradigm relies on creating a unified representation, or a 'foundation model', for multiple modality-specific tasks through large-scale domain-specific pretraining on the unannotated EEG signal. The quality of this unified representation directly depends on the availability of the modality-specific datasets. At the same time, generalist Vision Language Models (VLMs) exhibit broad few-shot learning capacities as well as good fine-tuning adaptability to different visual and language tasks. Can VLMs learn how to read and interpret EEG visually, emulating to a degree the way human clinicians inspect the EEG patterns? In this work we make a case that they can: we show that generalist VLMs without large-scale EEG pretraining perform competitively across a collection of clinical neuro-diagnostic tasks, can adapt to different tasks in a few-shot learning setting better than specialist foundation models, and exhibit better performance with model scaling when modality-specific models fail to exhibit.
zh_title: 将视觉语言模型重新塑造为临床神经诊断的脑电图基础模型
translation: 历史上，自动脑电图（EEG）系统通常使用在专门标注数据上训练的任务特定监督模型。最近的一种建模范式依赖于通过对未标注的EEG信号进行大规模领域特定预训练，为多个模态特定任务创建一个统一的表示，即“基础模型”。这种统一表示的质量直接取决于模态特定数据集的可用性。与此同时，通用视觉语言模型（VLMs）展现出广泛的少样本学习能力，以及对不同视觉和语言任务的良好微调适应性。VLM能否学会视觉化地阅读和解释EEG，在某种程度上模仿人类临床医生检查EEG模式的方式？在这项工作中，我们证明了它们可以：我们表明，没有经过大规模EEG预训练的通用VLM在一系列临床神经诊断任务中表现出极具竞争力的性能，在少样本学习设置下比专业基础模型更好地适应不同任务，并且在模态特定模型失效时，随着模型规模的扩大展现出更好的性能。
tldr: 本文展示了无需大规模领域预训练的通用视觉语言模型（VLMs）可以作为高效的EEG基础模型，用于临床神经诊断，展现出优秀的少样本学习和规模扩展能力。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将通用视觉语言模型（VLMs）应用于脑电图（EEG）临床诊断，无需进行大规模的领域特定EEG预训练，就能展现出色的少样本学习能力和可扩展性，为医疗多模态AI开辟了新途径。
motivation: 传统的EEG自动化系统依赖于任务特定模型或大规模领域特定的EEG预训练，受限于标注数据的可用性。而通用视觉语言模型（VLMs）具有强大的少样本学习和微调适应能力，启发作者探索是否可以利用VLM通过视觉方式来读取和解释EEG。
method: 将通用视觉语言模型（VLMs）直接应用于EEG的视觉化阅读和解释，而不依赖大规模的领域特定EEG预训练，并评估其在多项临床神经诊断任务上的表现。
results: 无需大规模EEG预训练的通用VLMs在多项临床神经诊断任务中表现出竞争力，在少样本学习设置下优于专业基础模型，并且随着模型规模扩大性能表现更好，克服了模态特定模型规模效应的瓶颈。
conclusion: 通用视觉语言模型能够被有效转化为临床神经诊断的脑电图基础模型，在无需领域特定预训练的情况下展现出优于专业基础模型的性能。

title: FedSharp: Byzantine Robust Decentralized Federated Learning Under Noisy Channel
authors: Ojaswi Sinha, Amin Farajzadeh, Animesh Yadav, Melike Erol-Kantarci
abstract: Decentralized federated learning (DFL) eliminates the central aggregation server but remains vulnerable to data heterogeneity, Byzantine attacks, and channel noise. We show that noise accumulates as models propagate across nodes, becoming increasingly significant as the learning rate decays. Moreover, accumulated noise enables Byzantine attackers to exploit loss-based model selection by mimicking honest model averages. To address these challenges, we propose screened, hop-aware, ranked, proximal averaging, a robust DFL framework (FedSharp). In this approach, each node maintains models from its 2b predecessors, ensuring at least b honest candidates when at most b nodes are Byzantine. FedSharp screens suspicious models using coordinate-wise median deviations, averages the b lowest-loss candidates to reduce fresh channel-noise variance by a factor of b, and applies noise-adaptive gradient-norm regularization and proximal training to mitigate accumulated noise and non-IID drift. Experiments on a 100-node ring with 33 Byzantine nodes show that FedSharp achieves 93.5-94.9% accuracy on MNIST, compared with 29.4-38.1% for a state-of-the-art single-model-selection benchmark, and 32.8-48.8% on CIFAR-10, compared with 10.0-30.5%, across Gaussian and hidden attacks under IID and non-IID data. On MNIST, FedSharp also achieves accuracy within approximately one percentage point of the benchmark operating without channel noise.
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, submitted for possible publication

title: Iterated creation, grading, and revision of data science projects by language models
authors: Rohan Alexander
abstract: We evaluate the extent to which agentic AI models can complete an end-to-end data science project, and how this improves with feedback. A 'writer' model with specific tools creates a complete data science project including downloading, cleaning, and analyzing a dataset, and writing a short paper about it. The project is executed and a 'grader' model evaluates it. The writer can then revise its submission, and this repeats for a total of three rounds. We consider seven models from five developers: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, and Z.AI. Each model is both a writer and a grader, so there are 49 writer-grader pairs and we run each pair three times. Of the 147 initial submissions, 107 run and render, and the average score increases from 59 per cent to 76 per cent after the final round of feedback. By writer the extent of the increase ranges from 3 percentage points for Anthropic's Opus 5.5 to 46 percentage points for Anthropic's Haiku 4.5, and by grader it ranges from 13 percentage points for Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash to 32 percentage points for Anthropic's Haiku 4.5. When a model grades its own writing the score tends to be about 9 percentage points higher than the average of what the other models give it. About half of the difference that we see from round to round is within the grader's own noise. Feedback generally results in the highest marks, but even just having the chance to revise, or having the additional budget, in terms of time or tool calls, without any feedback, results in considerable increases for some of the models but not for others. We find that how much such a loop helps depends on which model plays which role, but weaker models generally do not improve stronger models.

title: Energy-efficient End-to-End Communication System with Spiking Neural Networks
authors: Pooja Plavilayil Anil, Te-Chuan Chiu, Nguyen Van Huynh
abstract: 2030 is expected to witness the first commercial 6G systems. However, traditional modular communication architectures cannot meet the latency, optimisation, and integration requirements demanded by various sub-millisecond, data-intensive emerging 6G applications. End-to-end (E2E) communication addresses these limitations by replacing traditional processing blocks with neural networks. Nevertheless, conventional artificial neural networks (ANNs) in E2E systems use dense computation. This results in substantial energy consumption and computational resource requirements, which may not be feasible in resource constrained devices. This paper addresses the aforementioned challenge by developing a spiking neural network (SNN) encoder that targets lower encoder inference energy while maintaining communication reliability. In particular, the SNN encoder combines sparse spike activity, sinusoidal temporal modulation, and weighted temporal aggregation to map one-hot encoded messages to distinguishable transmit signals. The model is evaluated across antenna configurations and SNN timesteps to investigate the bit error rate (BER)-energy trade-off. The simulation results show that the SNN encoder achieves comparable BER under suitable timestep selections, while reducing the average estimated encoder energy by 68.93%, 52.20%, and 35.69% for SNN timesteps 2, 3, and 4, respectively, across five antenna configurations. These findings highlight the potential of the proposed SNN encoder for energy-efficient E2E communication systems.

title: Whose Transparency is it Anyway? Understanding Generative AI Transparency Needs and Gaps Across Stakeholders
authors: Genevieve Smith, Sahiba Chopra, Natalia Luka, Min Kyung Lee
abstract: Transparency has become a central principle in AI governance, yet there is little agreement about what transparency means, for whom, and in what contexts. Drawing on interpretive flexibility within the Social Construction of Technology, this paper examines how different stakeholders understand and experience transparency in generative AI. This study draws from a global survey of 400 end-users, AI builders, and policymakers, complemented by a structured focus group with end-users, grounding the quantitative findings in qualitative insights from the group most underserved by current transparency practice. We present three key findings. First, all three groups share similar understandings of what transparency means and what it should afford, centered on ensuring accuracy and privacy. Second, gaps between the importance of transparency features and their perceived availability are substantially larger for end-users than builders, revealing how power shapes what gets built and who it serves. Only 28% of end-users report that current transparency practices reflect their needs very well, compared to 53% of builders and 49% of policymakers. Third, transparency is situationally constructed, priorities shift with context and task structure, with role-specific frames activating when context demands them and receding when it does not. We argue that meaningful AI transparency requires moving beyond a one-size-fits-all solution, including current emphases on AI disclosure and static documentation, toward pluralistic transparency infrastructures that reflect the needs of diverse users and stakeholders.

title: VirtualTrialHarness: Coordinating Agentic Operationalization of Virtual Trial Protocols Across Complex Clinical Schemas
authors: Pengze Li, Jingna Feng, Yue Yu, Yining Wu, Xinyue Hu, Jie Lin, Avanti Bhandarkar, Cui Tao
abstract: Virtual trials use routinely collected clinical data to evaluate treatment strategies, but translating a study protocol into an executable analysis requires determining how clinical concepts and study requirements should be represented in the available data and applied consistently across the workflow. These decisions depend on local data representations and operational conventions and can involve source selection, patient and encounter identity, linkage, and temporal interpretation. Here we introduce VirtualTrialHarness (VTHarness), an agent framework that coordinates virtual-trial operationalization by selecting reusable procedural skills for each workflow stage and uses explicit contracts to maintain consistent study decisions across stages. We also introduce VTBenchmark for evaluating source selection and cohort construction. Across three complex synthetic environments, VTHarness successfully produced all required cohort outputs matching the references in 95.1% of workflows after requirement clarification, compared with 60.4% using retrieval from the same procedural corpus. Procedural skills improved source recovery across three language models and increased source overlap with analyst code in 13 Mayo Clinic cases. Site-specific adaptation enabled reference-matched cohort execution across eight MIMIC-IV tasks. Within the Mayo Clinic Virtual Trials Program, the framework supported investigator review of cohort construction and endpoint analysis. These findings support coordinating procedural guidance with workflow decisions to improve virtual-trial implementation across complex clinical schemas.

title: Towards Efficient Whole Page Ranking with One-Pass Inference
authors: Qi Xu, Zhigang Hua, Zijie Lei, Yan Xie, Jizhe Zhang, Lynn Lu, Delun Du, Sha Hua, Ren Mao, Ke Pan, Haomin Yu, Sandeep Pandey, Luke Simon
abstract:
Whole-page ranking jointly optimizes advertisements and organic content to balance business outcomes and user engagement under complex layout and business constraints. Existing non-autoregressive (NAR) approaches enable efficient page generation but typically score candidate items independently of previously selected items, limiting their ability to capture order-dependent interactions. Autoregressive (AR) methods address this limitation through sequential conditioning, but incur substantial inference overhead that challenges large-scale deployment. Bridging this quality-efficiency gap remains a challenge in industrial whole-page ranking.
  We propose Multi-Item Scoring (MIS), a prefix-aware NAR-style framework that incorporates sequential context into efficient multi-item scoring. MIS integrates global candidate interactions, localized prefix conditioning, and position-aware scoring within a shared representation architecture. By computing reusable representations once per request and performing lightweight prefix-conditioned scoring during constrained beam search, MIS captures important sequential dependencies without repeated full-model inference.
  Experiments on KuaiRand-1K and RL4RS demonstrate that MIS approaches the generation quality of an autoregressive CGA baseline while achieving 4.07x and 3.54x faster CPU decoding, respectively. In a randomized evaluation on a large-scale social-video platform, MIS improves the realization metric by 0.104% and watch time by 0.058%, while reducing ranking-service CPU consumption by 9.73%. These results demonstrate that prefix-aware multi-item scoring can narrow the quality gap between NAR and AR generation while retaining the efficiency required for industrial scalability.

title: Support Vector Machines Directly Minimise KL Divergence
authors: Ivan Silajev
abstract: Support vector machines (SVMs) are fundamentally grounded in geometric margin maximisation and currently lack a mainstream probabilistic interpretation. This keeps them theoretically isolated from probabilistic machine learning models that are naturally comparable and combinable. In this paper, we bridge this gap by proving that the dual objectives of both support vector classification and support vector regression are exact, constrained Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence minimisation tasks between two Gaussian measures. We further show that this same divergence formulation recovers the exact objective function for kernel ridge regression when domain constraints are removed and $L^2$ regularisation is applied. By demonstrating that SVM duals directly minimise relative entropy, our results provide a unified information-theoretic model for standard kernel machines and lay the foundation for unifying broader kernel-based algorithms under probability theory.
comment: 14 pages, 1 table, v2 includes section on optimal solution

title: AGORA: Reliability-Aware Aggregation of LLM Judges via Item-Response Theory
authors: Junhyung Ahn
abstract: LLM-as-a-judge is a common substitute for costly human evaluation, and aggregating several judges is the standard remedy for any single judge's bias. Judge pools mix judges of very different reliability, while the human-labeled sets that validate them hold a few hundred items or fewer. In this regime the per-item mean weights weak judges as heavily as strong ones, and confusion-table models such as Dawid-Skene must estimate a per-judge error table from too few items. We propose AGORA (Aggregation Of Reliability-weighted Assessments), an item-response-theory aggregator that places every item on one latent quality scale and describes each judge by a sensitivity parameter and ordered rating thresholds, so judge reliability is learned from all items jointly and without human labels. Across three benchmarks, AGORA matches or exceeds Dawid-Skene on large evaluation sets, and its advantage widens as the set shrinks toward a few hundred items. It remains accurate as pools grow more uneven, a label-free dispersion statistic indicates in advance when trust weighting helps, and its learned trust weights track per-judge human validity.

title: Easy Multi-Precision Acceleration via Vectorization
authors: Chansup Byun, Piotr Luszczek, Jeremy Kepner, LaToya Anderson, William Arcand, David Bestor, William Bergeron, Alex Bonn, Daniel Burrill, Vijay Gadepally, Michael Houle, Matthew Hubbell, Hayden Jananthan, Michael Jones, Lauren Milechin, Julie Mullen, Andrew Prout, Albert Reuther, Antonio Rosa, Charles Yee, Peter Michaleas
abstract: High level programming languages and accelerators are powerful enablers for a wide range of applications. Accelerators offer significant performance via diverse numeric precision and increased memory bandwidth and capacity. These enable new algorithms to be explored. Construction of these algorithms can be enabled by the ready accessibility of these performance features in high-level languages. Achieving scalable vertical (within a compute node), precision (over various numeric precisions), and temporal (over different generations of hardware) performance while retaining productivity requires effective abstractions. Vectorized coding that expresses operations as high-level matrix mathematics has historically been an important method for achieving portable performance. This paper examines the performance availability across a wide range of precisions and hardware using simple vectorized coding techniques applied to several example programs that highlight bandwidth, real and complex matrix multiplication, and 2D convolution. The systems evaluated span nearly a decade of computing hardware, enabling direct comparison of performance gains over this period. This work demonstrates that near hardware peak performance is readily accessible from high-level programming environments. In particular for memory bandwidth, real and complex matrix multiplication in double/single/half precision, and 2D convolutions using the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). Furthermore, algorithms that trade decreased compute intensity for increased memory intensity have significant potential.

title: How Finely Can Vision-Language Models See Biology? Bio-VQA: A Benchmark for Taxonomic, Morphological, Spatial and Individual Reasoning
authors: S M Rayeed, Qian Ma, Charles V. Stewart, Yao Ma
abstract: In biodiversity monitoring, a single image raises several questions: which taxon, how many, which trait, and whether the individual has been seen before. Vision-language models (VLMs) could answer all of these from the image, but their ability is largely untested in biology, as existing benchmarks focus mostly on species identification within a few taxonomic groups. We present Bio-VQA, the largest biological visual question answering (VQA) benchmark and the only one to span four aspects of biological visual understanding: hierarchical taxonomic reasoning, fine-grained attribute grounding, quantitative spatial reasoning, and individual re-identification. Bio-VQA contains 1.86M questions over 217K images from 11 public datasets, and extends right-or-wrong scoring to graded scoring, so a near-miss counts for more than a distant one. Evaluating 18 open-weight models from 3.75B to 38.4B parameters, we find that general visual capabilities do not transfer to biological organisms: the best model counts animals exactly on 41.7% of images with 2 to 10 individuals, less than half its accuracy on everyday objects at the same counts. Taxonomic accuracy falls to one sixth, from 0.72 at phylum to 0.12 at scientific name, and scaling helps mostly at coarse ranks. The gap to a domain specialist widens accordingly, from 0.731 against BioCLIP-2's 0.874 at class (1.2x) to 0.269 against 0.544 at scientific name (2x). On trait size measurement, 15 of the 18 models do no better than an image-blind baseline that predicts one fixed number for every specimen, and on re-identification, 17 of the 18 models fall below chance under adversarial conditions. These failures persist across a tenfold range of model size. We hope Bio-VQA becomes a standard test of how well VLM capabilities transfer to the biological domain.
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027, 8 pages main paper; 4 figures, 4 tables

title: Discarded or Unreachable? Diagnosing and Repairing Spatial Relation Failure in Vision--Language Similarity
authors: Mahdi Mostajabdaveh, Zirui Zhou
abstract: Contrastive vision-language models score left/right relations near chance, but the symptom has two causes that call for opposite repairs: the relation may survive in the pooled embedding yet be unreachable by native image-text similarity, or pooling may discard it while the dense features retain it. On clean two object photographs, across ten encoders, the lateral polarity is linearly decodable from the flip odd component of the pooled vector at 0.77-0.99, yet a search over a million captions leaves nine of the ten at chance under native scoring: an access failure. On controlled C4 orbits, where the relation is the only thing that varies, pooling keeps the arrangement axis at 0.998-1.000 and loses its polarity, which the patch grid retains: a pooling failure. Both sit downstream of the dense features, so one readout covers both. Our zero parameter, query conditioned spatial moment recomputes the geometry from the patch grid and stores it as a vector beside the native embedding. On a 118,287 image index it raises left/right pairwise accuracy against reversed geometry negatives from 0.51-0.53 to 0.81-0.96 and conditional R@1 among 21 category matched candidates from 0.05 to 0.37-0.75, at under a millisecond per batched query, while reproducing the native ranking exactly for queries that name no relation.
comment: Code, stimulus generators, and all result files: https://github.com/mahdims/vl-spatial-moment

title: Lesion Overlap Ranks PET Segmentation Models but Does Not Certify Patient-Level Tumor Burden
authors: Tushar Kataria, Gerald Sabin, Ponnuswamy Sadayappan, Shireen Y. Elhabian
abstract: Metabolic tumor volume (MTV) summarizes whole-body PET disease burden for prognostic stratification and treatment assessment. Automated MTV is useful only if its estimate is reliable for the individual patient, yet segmentation models are usually evaluated with overlap metrics such as Dice rather than burden error. We examined whether overlap metrics identify unreliable MTV estimates using 1,014 autoPET FDG PET/CT studies. We evaluated LesionTracer predictions held out from fine-tuning, compared five selected released models on 489 tumor-positive patients, and examined the findings in 597 PSMA studies. Across the five FDG models, ranking by higher mean Dice gave the same order as ranking by lower mean relative MTV error ($ρ=-1.00$, exact $p=0.017$). At the patient level, however, out-of-fold Dice tracked relative MTV error strongly ($ρ=-0.75$), yet 82 of 489 patients (16.8\%) fell on opposite sides of the Dice 0.80 and MTV-error 25\% thresholds. Within the training-exposed released models, correlations ranged from $-0.47$ to $-0.74$ over narrower, high-Dice ranges. Out of fold, opposing false-positive and false-negative volumes cancelled about one third of spatial error in net MTV. In 236 of 489 patients, each of the five models missed at least one lesion, though not necessarily the same lesion. Thus, agreement in average model rankings did not establish the reliability of individual MTV estimates or reveal shared lesion misses. PET segmentation benchmarks should report patient-level MTV error and missed-lesion counts alongside Dice and other overlap metrics.

title: MESA: An Evaluation Framework for Compositional, Semantic, and Spatial Generalization in Robotics
authors: Albert Wilcox, Frank Chang, Nhi Nguyen, Aishani Chakraborty, Jeremy A. Collins, Vaibhav Saxena, Benjamin Joffe, Siddharth Karamcheti, Animesh Garg
abstract: Despite growing interest in foundation models for robotic manipulation, systematic evaluation of their capabilities remains elusive. Existing benchmarks are either narrow and saturated, offering little signal on SOTA methods, broadly scoped, providing diversity at the cost of controlled experimentation, or require training on large, messy open-source datasets. We introduce MESA, an evaluation framework designed for precise, reproducible measurement of language-conditioned policy generalization. MESA provides five evaluation suites that isolate in-distribution performance and four distinct axes of generalization: spatial configuration, object instance, object category, and subtask composition, enabling researchers to diagnose where and why policies fail, not just whether they fail. To populate these suites at scale, we develop MESA-Gen, a pipeline for task and demonstration generation built by improving MimicGen. We instantiate the framework on two platforms and release both: the single-arm MESA suite, and BiMESA, the first large-scale benchmark for bimanual generalization. We evaluate seven baseline methods spanning diffusion policies, VLM-based approaches, and pretrained VLAs, finding that the strongest model achieves only 52% on MESA and 49% on BiMESA, providing meaningful signal while leaving ample room for progress. MESA rankings are broadly consistent with RoboArena scores, suggesting that MESA captures method-level differences relevant beyond simulation. Project website: https://pairlab.github.io/MESA.
comment: 51 pages, 12 figures, including appendices. Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL), 2026. Project website: https://pairlab.github.io/MESA

title: ELA: End-to-End Latent Action Policy Learning from Video Demonstrations
authors: Cheng-Chun Hsu, Peter Stone
abstract: Robot imitation learning is limited by the scarcity of action-labeled data, while action-free demonstrations such as videos are abundant. Recent latent-action methods learn action-relevant representations from observation transitions, but they do not optimize latent actions for downstream control, leading to latent representations that are difficult for policies to model and difficult to accurately decode into continuous robot actions. This paper introduces ELA, an end-to-end framework for learning from video demonstrations via latent actions jointly optimized for policy learning and action decoding. ELA jointly trains a latent action model, latent action policy, and action decoder, enabling policies to leverage abundant video data with only a handful of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that ELA consistently outperforms prior latent action baselines. Moreover, it integrates seamlessly with existing imitation learning methods through lightweight 4M-parameter action decoders, requiring no changes to policy architectures or training objectives. Additional materials can be found on: https://end2end-latent-action.github.io/

title: Just the Facts: How Dialogues with AI Reduce Conspiracy Beliefs
authors: Thomas H. Costello, Gordon Pennycook, David G. Rand
abstract: Personalized dialogues with AI substantially reduce conspiracy beliefs. To identify why, we conducted two experiments with U.S. adults recruited online (total N = 2,193) that removed possible causes one at a time. The debunking effect was robust to disclosing the AI's persuasive goal, framing the exchange as a debate, instructing the AI to inform rather than persuade, halving its response length, altering how beliefs were measured, and replacing the dialogue with a single tailored message. Only instructing the AI to persuade without factual evidence and arguments substantially reduced the debunking effect. Content analyses of the AI's output and participants' own accounts linked larger reductions in conspiracy beliefs to factual argumentation rather than rapport, storytelling, or appeals to empathy. AI dialogues appear to reduce conspiracy beliefs primarily by supplying relevant, well-reasoned counterevidence. Our results suggest that humans might be similarly effective if they could supply comparable evidence.

title: ChangeJEPA: Predict Before You Compare for Remote Sensing Change Detection
authors: Buddhi Wijenayake, Dhananjaya Jayasundara, Vishal M. Patel
abstract: Remote sensing change detection is typically formulated as Siamese feature comparison, where two images are encoded independently and a decoder determines which discrepancies correspond to meaningful change. This is challenging because the encoders preserve both true scene changes and nuisance variations such as illumination, seasonal, radiometric, and geometric differences. We introduce ChangeJEPA, a bitemporal joint-embedding predictive architecture that reformulates change detection as latent post-state prediction. Given a pre-change image and partial post-change evidence, ChangeJEPA predicts the full post-change representation under two complementary conditions: a prior hypothesis derived from the pre-change scene and an updated hypothesis conditioned on observed post-change context. A joint-embedding predictive loss aligns both hypotheses with the target latent representation, encouraging semantic consistency while suppressing transient appearance variations. Change is then inferred from the disagreement among the pre-change representation, the observed post-change target, and the predicted latent states, capturing complementary evidence of change, prior surprise, contextual update, and prediction reliability. Across SYSU-CD, LEVIR-CD+, and CDD, ChangeJEPA consistently outperforms its decoder matched Siamese baseline by up to 1.51 IoU points and achieves the best IoU and F1-score on all three benchmarks, demonstrating the advantage of latent post-state prediction over direct feature comparison. Page: https://buddhi19.github.io/ChangeJEPA

title: A First Closed-Form Robin Parameter for Optimized Schwarz Waveform Relaxation as a Function of Iteration Count, Overlap, and Time Window Length
authors: Alejandro Alfonso Rodriguez, Martin J. Gander, Felix Kwok
abstract:
Schwarz waveform relaxation (SWR) is a parallel-in-time iterative method for the solution of evolution problems and belongs to the class of Parallel-in-Time algorithms that have received increasing attention over the past three decades. For parabolic problems, SWR converges linearly over long time intervals and exhibits superlinear convergence on short time intervals. Since the introduction of optimized variants (OSWR) nearly three decades ago, determining the optimized Robin parameter when OSWR is applied on bounded time windows has remained an open problem.
  We introduce here a new analytical approach that, for the first time, yields a closed-form expression for the optimal Robin parameter in the transmission conditions for the one-dimensional heat equation with two overlapping subdomains.
