On a broad European suite of 11 sources excluded from training, covering 9 task groups and 27 languages, a development set that also guided model selection, the 27B model reaches 87.5% accuracy with a pooled expected calibration error of 0.016, and 0.035 when weighted per source. Post-hoc analyses of these single-seed results give three findings. First, miscalibration is structured by task rather than language: on parallel reading and topic items in 26 languages the confidence gap varies about as much as sampling noise, while across sources it spans -0.07 to +0.09, with knowledge tasks overconfident and acceptability judgements underconfident at all three sizes, so one fitted temperature cannot correct both. Second, the share of decisions that can be automated at a 5% error budget follows chance-corrected skill (Spearman 0.97 over 33 source and model pairs) more closely than raw accuracy (0.91). Third, reach beyond the training languages is set by the base model: across 210 languages, changing the training run moved scores by at most about 2 points within a size, while languages outside the base's documented list trail by 23 to 28 points at every size. On English public suites Zuse is behind Jev and Kev, including Kev models on the same bases. We also report two pitfalls in building multi-source training data: label-word collision between topic schemes, and an injection augmentation that taught a shortcut. Zuse can be tried at https://bineric.com/zuse.

title: Rubric Curriculum RL: Exploiting the Generation-Verification Gap in Non-Verifiable Domains
authors: Sumeet Ramesh Motwani, Tejas Krishnan, Alistair Letcher, Charles London, Suhaas Bhat, Huitian Jiao, Philip Torr, Riashat Islam, Christopher Summerfield, Jakob Foerster, Christian Schroeder de Witt, Qilong Gu, Shital Shah
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has led to significant gains in math and code generation. Extending these gains to open-ended domains remains challenging: ground-truth verification is unavailable, human annotation is expensive, and learned reward models are prone to reward hacking. The generation-verification gap, where judging good outputs is easier than producing them, offers a potential path to improvement. However, rubric-based judges are often imprecise and stationary, so policies can overfit or reward hack them. We introduce Rubric Curriculum RL (RcRL), which exploits this gap without new data, human annotations, or stronger teacher models. We combine pairwise preferences over rollouts with a curriculum over rubric criteria, yielding a more discriminative signal than absolute scoring and a non-stationary objective. Whereas baselines plateau within a few hundred steps, RcRL preserves output entropy and keeps improving past 1000 steps. On creative writing, RcRL achieves a 70.5% human win rate against the base model, with gains across benchmarks and judges. On HealthBench, RcRL improves over the base model by 14.6% (full set) and 25.4% (consensus subset), outperforming all training baselines, including instance-specific rubrics.
zh_title: 评分标准课程RL：在不可验证领域中利用生成-验证差距
translation: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在数学和代码生成方面取得了显著进展。将这些进展推广到开放式领域仍然具有挑战性：缺乏真实性验证，人工标注成本高昂，以及学习到的奖励模型容易出现奖励作弊。生成-验证差距（即判断良好输出比生成它们更容易）提供了一条潜在的改进途径。然而，基于评分标准的评估器通常不精确且是静态的，因此策略可能会过拟合或对它们进行奖励作弊。我们引入了Rubric Curriculum RL（RcRL），它在没有新数据、人工标注或更强教师模型的情况下利用了这一差距。我们将对轨迹的成对偏好与评分标准课程相结合，产生了比绝对评分更具判别力的信号和非静态的目标。基线模型在几百步内就停滞不前，而RcRL保持了输出熵并持续改进超过1000步。在创意写作方面，RcRL相对于基础模型取得了70.5%的人类胜率，并在各项基准和评估器上均有提升。在HealthBench上，RcRL相对于基础模型改进了14.6%（完整集）和25.4%（共识子集），优于所有训练基线，包括特定实例的评分标准。
tldr: Rubric Curriculum RL (RcRL) 是一种新的强化学习方法，通过结合对轨迹的成对偏好和评分标准课程，利用生成-验证差距，无需新数据、人工标注或更强的教师模型。它在创意写作和HealthBench上均取得了显著改进，超越了基线模型。
ai_comments: RcRL的创新之处在于其无需额外数据、人工标注或更强教师模型，便能有效利用生成-验证差距来提升强化学习在非可验证领域中的表现。通过引入成对偏好和评分标准课程，它成功克服了静态评分标准易导致过拟合和奖励作弊的局限性，为开放式生成任务的RL训练提供了新的思路和强大的解决方案。其在保持输出熵和长期改进方面的表现尤其值得关注，表明了其在复杂任务中的鲁棒性。
motivation: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在数学和代码生成中取得了显著进展，但将其推广到开放式领域仍面临挑战：缺乏真实性验证、人工标注昂贵以及学习到的奖励模型容易出现奖励作弊。此外，现有的基于评分标准的评估器通常不精确且是静态的，导致策略可能过拟合或对评估器进行奖励作弊。
method: 本文引入了Rubric Curriculum RL (RcRL) 方法。它通过结合对轨迹的成对偏好和评分标准课程来利用生成-验证差距。这种方法提供了比绝对评分更具判别力的信号和非静态的目标，无需新的数据、人工标注或更强的教师模型。
results: 与基线模型在几百步内就停滞不前不同，RcRL在超过1000步后仍能保持输出熵并持续改进。在创意写作任务中，RcRL相对于基础模型取得了70.5%的人类胜率。在HealthBench上，RcRL相对于基础模型在完整数据集上改进了14.6%，在共识子集上改进了25.4%，优于所有训练基线，包括特定实例的评分标准。
conclusion: RcRL通过结合成对偏好和评分标准课程，有效地利用了生成-验证差距，在无需额外数据或教师模型的情况下，显著提升了强化学习在不可验证的开放式领域中的性能和鲁棒性。

title: Transversal Passivity: Dissipation Relative to Input and Output Manifolds
authors: Feng-Yu Yue, Daniel Zelazo
abstract: This paper introduces transversal passivity, a local dissipation property for regulating input and output signals to prescribed manifolds. Its supply rate is built from the transverse port errors induced by nearest-point projections, so that motion along the manifolds is not penalized. We give a necessary condition and a constructive sufficient condition for the property and relate it to existing passivity notions. For feedback interconnections through negative-adjoint linear channels, power conservation no longer cancels the transverse supply. The residual is governed by compatibility defects that depend only on the channels and the prescribed manifolds, so it can be assessed before any closed-loop analysis, and it falls into a hierarchy of exact compatibility, quadratic cancellation, and nonzero quadratic residuals. Since transversal storages are only positive semidefinite, port convergence is obtained by combining compact confinement, for instance by conserved quantities, with a dissipation margin, and we identify a geometric obstruction under which no quadratic margin is available near the feasible states. A federated learning case study with heterogeneous data shows that port convergence can be certified even though no server target is compatible with the interconnection, and that the obstruction arises for a natural choice of target.
zh_title: 横向无源性：相对于输入和输出流形的耗散
translation: 本文引入了横向无源性，这是一种用于将输入和输出信号调节到预定流形的局部耗散特性。其供给率是由最近点投影引起的横向端口误差构建的，因此不会惩罚沿流形的运动。我们给出了该特性的必要条件和构造性充分条件，并将其与现有的无源性概念联系起来。对于通过负伴随线性通道的反馈互连，功率守恒不再抵消横向供给。残余由仅取决于通道和预定流形的兼容性缺陷决定，因此可以在任何闭环分析之前进行评估，并且它属于精确兼容性、二次抵消和非零二次残余的层次结构。由于横向储能仅是半正定的，因此通过将紧凑限制（例如通过守恒量）与耗散裕度相结合来获得端口收敛，并且我们识别出一种几何障碍，在这种障碍下，在可行状态附近没有二次裕度可用。一个具有异构数据的联邦学习案例研究表明，即使服务器目标与互连不兼容，端口收敛也可以被证明，并且在自然目标选择下会出现这种障碍。
tldr: 本文介绍了横向无源性，一种用于将输入输出信号调节到预设流形的局部耗散特性，并提供了其条件、与现有概念的关系、在反馈互连中的行为，以及通过联邦学习案例展示了其应用和局限性。
ai_comments: 这篇论文引入了一个新颖的“横向无源性”概念，扩展了传统无源性的范畴，使其能够处理信号向预设流形调节的问题。其创新点在于供给率的构建方式，以及对反馈互连中残余耗散的深入分析和分类。识别几何障碍对于理解其局限性至关重要。联邦学习的案例研究展示了该理论在实际异构系统中的潜在应用价值，特别是在处理兼容性问题时。这为复杂系统的控制和分析提供了一个新的工具。
motivation: 引入一种新的局部耗散特性——横向无源性，以调节输入和输出信号到预设流形，并解决现有无源性概念在特定反馈互连中不适用的问题。
method: 引入横向无源性概念，其供给率基于横向端口误差构建；给出了必要的和构造性的充分条件；将其与现有无源性概念联系起来；分析了其在负伴随线性通道反馈互连中的行为；通过结合紧凑限制和耗散裕度实现端口收敛；识别了几何障碍；并通过联邦学习案例研究验证。
results:
1. 引入了横向无源性，一种针对输入输出信号到预设流形的局部耗散特性。
2. 提供了横向无源性的必要条件和构造性充分条件。
3. 将其与现有无源性概念联系起来。
4. 发现负伴随线性通道反馈互连中，功率守恒不再抵消横向供给，残余由兼容性缺陷决定。
5. 残余分为精确兼容性、二次抵消和非零二次残余的层次结构。
6. 通过结合紧凑限制和耗散裕度可以实现端口收敛。
7. 识别了在可行状态附近没有二次裕度的几何障碍。
8. 联邦学习案例研究表明，即使服务器目标与互连不兼容，端口收敛也能被证明，且在自然目标选择下会出现障碍。
conclusion: 横向无源性提供了一种调节信号到预设流形的新方法，其在反馈互连中的行为和端口收敛条件已被分析和验证，尽管存在几何障碍，但在联邦学习等应用中仍能有效认证端口收敛。

title: CAPE-JEPA - Cross-modal Adversarial Probabilistic Embedding JEPA
authors: Aniket Junghare, Biplab Banerjee
abstract: Cross-modal remote sensing image retrieval (RS-CMIR) requires representations that are simultaneously modality-invariant and semantically discriminative, despite the profound physical gap between heterogeneous sensors such as Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and multispectral imagery. Recent JEPA-based Predictive self-supervised approaches such as X-JEPA formulate cross-modal alignment as a deterministic latent forecasting task, implicitly assuming uniform patch predictability and leaving cross-modal distributional alignment unaddressed. We propose CAPE-JEPA, a probabilistic cross-modal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture with three contributions: (i) a cross-attentional Gaussian predictor outputting per-patch parameters (mu, sigma^2) conditioned on opposite-modality context, trained via negative log-likelihood to model inherent cross-sensor prediction uncertainty; (ii) adversarial distributional regularization combining unimodal isotropic Gaussian regularization with a novel cross-modal adversarial variant that aligns modality distributions via worst-case Epps-Pulley characteristic function tests without explicit sample pairing; and (iii) in-training contrastive learning with attention-pooled heads for scene-level discriminative grounding. Evaluated on BigEarthNet-14K (BEN-14K) and fMoW across SAR, multispectral, and RGB modalities, CAPE-JEPA surpasses X-JEPA by up to 13.74 points on BEN-14K and 15.59 points on fMoW, outperforming all baselines including SkySense and CROMA across both unimodal and cross-modal directions while using fewer parameters (407.30M vs. 432.72M).
comment: Accepted for publication at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
zh_title: CAPE-JEPA - 跨模态对抗概率嵌入JEPA
translation: 跨模态遥感图像检索（RS-CMIR）需要同时具有模态不变性和语义区分性的表示，尽管合成孔径雷达（SAR）和多光谱图像等异构传感器之间存在深刻的物理鸿沟。近期基于JEPA的预测自监督方法，例如X-JEPA，将跨模态对齐表述为确定性潜在预测任务，隐含地假设补丁的可预测性一致，并且未解决跨模态分布对齐问题。我们提出了CAPE-JEPA，一种概率跨模态联合嵌入预测架构，具有三项贡献：(i) 一个交叉注意力高斯预测器，根据对侧模态上下文输出每个补丁的参数（均值、方差），通过负对数似然进行训练，以模拟固有的跨传感器预测不确定性；(ii) 对抗性分布正则化，结合单模态各向同性高斯正则化和一种新颖的跨模态对抗变体，通过最坏情况的Epps-Pulley特征函数测试（无需显式样本配对）对齐模态分布；(iii) 训练中的对比学习，利用注意力池化头部进行场景级判别性接地。在BigEarthNet-14K (BEN-14K) 和fMoW数据集上，对SAR、多光谱和RGB模态进行评估，CAPE-JEPA在BEN-14K上比X-JEPA性能提高高达13.74点，在fMoW上提高15.59点，优于包括SkySense和CROMA在内的所有基线，无论是在单模态还是跨模态方向，同时使用的参数更少（407.30M vs. 432.72M）。
tldr: CAPE-JEPA提出了一种概率跨模态联合嵌入预测架构，通过高斯预测器、对抗性分布正则化和对比学习，解决了遥感图像跨模态检索中的不确定性和分布对齐问题。它在BEN-14K和fMoW数据集上显著优于现有方法。
ai_comments: CAPE-JEPA的创新之处在于其将概率建模引入跨模态联合嵌入预测，明确解决了跨传感器预测的不确定性。通过结合对抗性分布正则化实现无样本配对的模态分布对齐，以及利用对比学习增强判别性，该方法在理论和实践上都取得了重要进展。其在多模态遥感数据上的卓越性能和更低的参数量凸显了其在遥感图像检索领域的潜力。
motivation: 跨模态遥感图像检索（RS-CMIR）需要模态不变且语义区分的表示，以应对合成孔径雷达（SAR）和多光谱图像等异构传感器之间深刻的物理鸿沟。现有的基于JEPA的预测自监督方法（如X-JEPA）将跨模态对齐视为确定性潜在预测任务，隐含地假设补丁的可预测性一致，并且未解决跨模态分布对齐问题。
method: 本文提出了CAPE-JEPA，一种概率跨模态联合嵌入预测架构，包含三项贡献：(i) 一个交叉注意力高斯预测器，根据对侧模态上下文输出每个补丁的参数（均值、方差），并通过负对数似然进行训练，以模拟固有的跨传感器预测不确定性；(ii) 对抗性分布正则化，结合单模态各向同性高斯正则化和一种新颖的跨模态对抗变体，通过最坏情况的Epps-Pulley特征函数测试（无需显式样本配对）对齐模态分布；(iii) 训练中的对比学习，利用注意力池化头部进行场景级判别性接地。
results: CAPE-JEPA在BigEarthNet-14K (BEN-14K) 数据集上比X-JEPA性能提高高达13.74点，在fMoW数据集上提高15.59点。它在SAR、多光谱和RGB模态的单模态和跨模态方向上均优于包括SkySense和CROMA在内的所有基线，同时使用的参数更少（407.30M vs. 432.72M）。
conclusion: CAPE-JEPA通过其概率预测、对抗性分布正则化和对比学习机制，有效解决了跨模态遥感图像检索中的模态间隙和预测不确定性问题，并在多个数据集和模态上取得了显著优于现有SOTA方法的性能。

title: A Polynomial Erdős-Pósa bound for Eulerian digraphs
authors: Esther Galby, Roohani Sharma, Bart van der Steenhoven
abstract:
In [Combinatorica 1996], Reed, Robertson, Seymour and Thomas proved Younger's conjecture dating back to 1973 that states that directed cycles have the Erdős-Pósa property. Specifically, they showed that every directed graph $D$ contains either $k$ arc-disjoint cycles or a set of at most $f(k)$ arcs that intersect every directed cycle. The function $f$, depending only on $k$, is however notoriously large--in fact, not even elementary. The first improvement on this function was only very recently provided by Hatzel, Kreutzer, Milani, and Muzi [FOCS 2024] who showed that $f$ can be taken to be an exponential tower of height $8$.
  In this work, we improve this function to $O(k^4)$ in the case where the digraph is Eulerian. This also answers an open question by Wahlström [Springer Monographs in Mathematics 2018] who asked explicitly when Eulerian digraphs have a polynomial Erdős-Pósa property.
  The only other known result about Erdős-Pósa on Eulerian digraphs is a result from Seymour [Combinatorica 1996] who showed that $f(k)=k$ when the Eulerian digraph admits a linkless embedding in 3-space, and such an equality is not possible for general Eulerian digraphs. We also complement our positive result, by showing that the result of Seymour cannot be extended to give a linear bound ($O(k)$) on general Eulerian digraphs, by showing that even on Eulerian digraphs the lower bound for the Erdős-Pósa property is $Ω(k \log k)$.
zh_title: 欧拉有向图的多项式Erdős-Pósa界
translation:
在[Combinatorica 1996]中，Reed、Robertson、Seymour和Thomas证明了Younger早在1973年提出的猜想，即有向环具有Erdős-Pósa性质。具体而言，他们证明了每个有向图$D$包含$k$个弧不相交的环，或者一个至多包含$f(k)$条弧的集合，该集合与每个有向环相交。然而，仅取决于$k$的函数$f$是出了名的大——事实上，甚至不是初等的。该函数的第一个改进直到最近才由Hatzel、Kreutzer、Milani和Muzi在[FOCS 2024]中提供，他们表明$f$可以取为高度为8的指数塔。
在这项工作中，我们将欧拉有向图的该函数改进为$O(k^4)$。这也回答了Wahlström在[Springer Monographs in Mathematics 2018]中明确提出的关于欧拉有向图何时具有多项式Erdős-Pósa性质的开放问题。
关于欧拉有向图上Erdős-Pósa性质的唯一其他已知结果是Seymour在[Combinatorica 1996]中的一个结果，他表明当欧拉有向图允许在三维空间中进行无链接嵌入时，$f(k)=k$，并且这种等式对于一般欧拉有向图是不可能的。我们还通过证明即使在欧拉有向图上，Erdős-Pósa性质的下界也是$Ω(k 	ext{ log } k)$，从而补充了我们的积极结果，表明Seymour的结果不能扩展到一般欧拉有向图的线性界（$O(k)$）。
tldr: 之前的有向环Erdős-Pósa界函数值巨大，本文将欧拉有向图的界提高到$O(k^4)$，并给出了$Ω(k 	ext{ log } k)$的下界。
ai_comments: 这篇论文在图论领域具有重要的理论意义。它显著改进了有向环Erdős-Pósa性质的界限，特别是将欧拉有向图的界从指数塔级别降低到多项式级别，这是一个巨大的突破。同时，对Wahlström开放问题的回答以及对下界的精确刻画，都表明了其在理论上的创新性和重要性。
motivation: Reed, Robertson, Seymour和Thomas在1996年证明了有向环具有Erdős-Pósa性质，但其函数$f(k)$值非常大，甚至是不可初等的。最近Hatzel等人将其改进为高度为8的指数塔。本文的动机是进一步改进欧拉有向图的这一函数界，并回答Wahlström关于欧拉有向图何时具有多项式Erdős-Pósa性质的开放问题。
method: 本文通过理论证明，在欧拉有向图的情况下，将Erdős-Pósa性质的函数$f(k)$的界从指数塔高度8显著改进为多项式$O(k^4)$。此外，还通过理论分析给出了欧拉有向图下Erdős-Pósa性质的下界。
results: 本文将欧拉有向图的Erdős-Pósa性质的函数$f(k)$的界改进为$O(k^4)$。同时，证明了Erdős-Pósa性质在欧拉有向图上的下界是$Ω(k 	ext{ log } k)$，这表明Seymour的线性界限无法推广到一般的欧拉有向图。
conclusion: 本文为欧拉有向图提供了多项式Erdős-Pósa界，具体为$O(k^4)$，成功回答了Wahlström提出的开放问题。此外，通过建立$Ω(k 	ext{ log } k)$的下界，补充了现有研究，并证明了Seymour的线性界无法推广到一般欧拉有向图。

title: HarnessFlow: MCTS-Guided Harness Optimization for LLM Agents
authors: Zhi Hong, Qianlong Wang, Hongchen Wei, Aidan Wu, Daohong Ying, Mingze Kong, Bei Liu, Chong Luo
abstract: The performance of large language model (LLM) agents depends on both the underlying model and the harness that governs interaction with tools and the environment. Yet harness design remains largely manual, and automating it requires navigating an open-ended search space through costly end-to-end evaluations. We introduce HarnessFlow, a framework for optimizing complete executable harnesses under a limited candidate-evaluation budget, with the model and task environment held fixed. HarnessFlow organizes candidates and their evaluation histories in a refinement tree, using a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based policy to balance exploitation and exploration. A coding agent refines selected harnesses using archived code, execution feedback, and a library of reusable harness mechanisms. With 15 refinement attempts per benchmark, HarnessFlow achieves the highest mean test scores among the compared methods on six benchmarks spanning agentic tasks, coding, and web interaction. The optimized harnesses achieve an average score of 69.48%, outperforming the initial harnesses and Meta-Harness by 10.89 and 3.95 percentage points, respectively, while incurring lower average per-task execution costs than hand-engineered baselines. These results suggest that structured harness search offers a promising route toward automating the design of capable and efficient LLM agents.
translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理的性能取决于底层模型以及管理与工具和环境交互的缰绳。然而，缰绳设计在很大程度上仍然是手动的，自动化它需要通过昂贵的端到端评估来导航一个开放式的搜索空间。我们引入了HarnessFlow，这是一个在有限的候选评估预算下优化完整可执行缰绳的框架，其中模型和任务环境保持不变。HarnessFlow在一个细化树中组织候选缰绳及其评估历史，使用基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的策略来平衡利用和探索。一个编码代理利用存档代码、执行反馈和可重用缰绳机制库来改进选定的缰绳。在每个基准测试进行15次细化尝试后，HarnessFlow在涵盖代理任务、编码和网络交互的六个基准测试中，在所有比较方法中取得了最高的平均测试分数。优化后的缰绳平均得分69.48%，分别比初始缰绳和Meta-Harness高出10.89和3.95个百分点，同时比手工设计的基线产生更低的平均每任务执行成本。这些结果表明，结构化的缰绳搜索为自动化设计有能力且高效的LLM代理提供了一条有前景的途径。
tldr: HarnessFlow是一个利用MCTS和编码代理来自动化优化LLM代理缰绳的框架，在多个基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升和成本降低。
ai_comments: 这篇论文提出了一种新颖的自动化LLM代理缰绳优化方法HarnessFlow，通过结合MCTS的搜索能力和编码代理的精炼能力，有效解决了手动设计缰绳的痛点。其创新性在于将LLM代理的“缰绳”视为可优化的代码实体，并引入了结构化的搜索策略。该方法在性能提升和成本降低方面表现出色，为未来LLM代理的自动化设计提供了重要思路。
motivation: LLM代理的性能受限于手动设计的缰绳，其优化是一个开放式的搜索空间，需要昂贵的端到端评估。自动化缰绳设计是提升LLM代理能力的关键挑战。
method: HarnessFlow框架通过MCTS策略组织候选缰绳及其评估历史，平衡探索与利用。一个编码代理利用存档代码、执行反馈和可重用机制库来改进选定的缰绳。
results: 在15次优化尝试下，HarnessFlow在六个基准测试（涵盖代理任务、编码和网络交互）中取得了最高的平均测试分数。优化后的缰绳平均得分69.48%，分别比初始缰绳和Meta-Harness高出10.89和3.95个百分点，同时任务执行成本低于手工设计的基线。
conclusion: 结构化的缰绳搜索为自动化设计有能力且高效的LLM代理提供了一条有前景的途径。

title: Learning Noise Optimization for Reward Alignment in Few-Step Generative Models
authors: Hongeun Kim, Jeongsol Kim, Jong Chul Ye
abstract: Reward alignment for diffusion- and flow-based generative models is often formulated over stochastic trajectories, making it less suitable for few-step deterministic generators. Initial noise optimization provides a trajectory-free alternative, but existing gradient-free methods require costly per-sample search at inference. We introduce LeNO (Learning Noise Optimization), which amortizes reward-guided initial noise optimization into a learned residual transport while keeping the pretrained generator frozen. LeNO learns an anchor-conditioned distribution over noise corrections using Local GRPO and scalar rewards, eliminating iterative test-time optimization. For Gaussian initial noise with norm-preserving projection, we derive a tractable upper bound on the KL divergence between the corrected noise distribution and the original prior, providing a principled regularization objective. We evaluate LeNO on few-step text-to-image and protein structure generation, including expensive black-box designability rewards. Across both domains, LeNO improves target rewards with a single noise correction at inference while largely preserving generation quality and diversity.
zh_title: 学习噪声优化以实现少步生成模型中的奖励对齐
translation: 扩散和基于流的生成模型的奖励对齐通常是在随机轨迹上制定的，这使得它不太适合少步确定性生成器。初始噪声优化提供了一种无轨迹的替代方案，但现有的无梯度方法在推理时需要昂贵的逐样本搜索。我们引入了LeNO（学习噪声优化），它将奖励引导的初始噪声优化摊销为一个学习到的残差传输，同时保持预训练的生成器冻结。LeNO使用局部GRPO和标量奖励学习锚点条件下的噪声校正分布，从而消除了迭代的测试时优化。对于具有范数保持投影的高斯初始噪声，我们推导了校正噪声分布与原始先验之间KL散度的可处理上限，提供了一个有原则的正则化目标。我们在少步文本到图像和蛋白质结构生成（包括昂贵的黑盒可设计性奖励）上评估了LeNO。在这两个领域中，LeNO在推理时通过单次噪声校正提高了目标奖励，同时在很大程度上保持了生成质量和多样性。
tldr: LeNO通过学习噪声优化，在少步生成模型中实现奖励对齐，避免了昂贵的推理时搜索，并保持了生成质量和多样性。
ai_comments: LeNO为少步生成模型中的奖励对齐问题提供了一个创新且实用的解决方案。它将迭代且昂贵的优化过程转化为高效的学习过程，并且能够与冻结的生成器和黑盒奖励协同工作，这使其具有高度的实用性。基于KL散度的有原则的正则化目标也增强了方法的理论基础。
motivation: 现有针对扩散和流基生成模型的奖励对齐方法通常基于随机轨迹，不适用于少步确定性生成器。虽然初始噪声优化提供了一种无轨迹替代方案，但现有的无梯度方法在推理时需要昂贵的逐样本搜索。
method: 本文提出了LeNO（学习噪声优化），它将奖励引导的初始噪声优化摊销为一个学习到的残差传输，同时保持预训练的生成器冻结。LeNO使用局部GRPO和标量奖励学习锚点条件下的噪声校正分布，从而消除了迭代的测试时优化。对于具有范数保持投影的高斯初始噪声，LeNO推导了校正噪声分布与原始先验之间KL散度的可处理上限，提供了一个有原则的正则化目标。
results: LeNO在少步文本到图像生成和蛋白质结构生成（包括昂贵的黑盒可设计性奖励）上进行了评估。在两个领域中，LeNO在推理时通过单次噪声校正提高了目标奖励，同时在很大程度上保持了生成质量和多样性。
conclusion: LeNO通过学习高效的噪声优化过程，成功解决了少步确定性生成模型中的奖励对齐挑战，在提高目标奖励的同时，有效地保持了生成质量和多样性。

title: CrossPressor: Scalable Cross-View Fusion for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
authors: Yuxi Hu, Wenhao Dong, Jun Zhang, Friedrich Fraundorfer
abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) becomes increasingly difficult to scale to long multi-view sequences. Anchor-based compression methods such as ZPressor alleviate representation growth by decoding Gaussians only from a compact set of anchor feature maps, but keeping these anchors fixed forces each one to aggregate an increasing number of support views. We identify this representation--fusion mismatch and introduce \textbf{CrossPressor}, a training-free method for scalable anchor-based fusion. CrossPressor preserves all decoder-facing anchor queries while constraining the view-growing support sequence through coverage-cycled evidence routing, distributing retained spatial evidence across support views and fusion layers while keeping all support views represented. Routing before K/V projection, together with joint context packing, further reduces support-side fusion cost without retraining. CrossPressor maintains reconstruction quality close to dense fusion while achieving up to $26.12\times$ faster cross-view fusion and $1.43\times$ end-to-end acceleration on long input sequences. Our project page is at: https://yuhsihu.github.io/CrossPressor.
zh_title: CrossPressor：用于前馈式3D高斯泼溅的可扩展跨视角融合
translation: 前馈式3D高斯泼溅（3D-GS）在扩展到长多视角序列时变得越来越困难。诸如ZPressor之类的基于锚点的压缩方法通过仅从一组紧凑的锚点特征图中解码高斯来缓解表示增长，但保持这些锚点固定迫使每个锚点聚合越来越多的支持视图。我们识别出了这种表示与融合的不匹配，并引入了CrossPressor，这是一种用于可扩展基于锚点融合的无训练方法。CrossPressor保留了所有面向解码器的锚点查询，同时通过覆盖循环证据路由约束视图增长的支持序列，在支持视图和融合层之间分布保留的空间证据，同时保持所有支持视图都被表示。在K/V投影之前进行路由，连同联合上下文打包，进一步降低了支持侧的融合成本而无需重新训练。CrossPressor在长输入序列上实现了接近密集融合的重建质量，同时达到了高达26.12倍的更快跨视角融合和1.43倍的端到端加速。
tldr: 提出了一种用于前馈式3D高斯泼溅的无需训练跨视角融合方法CrossPressor，通过证据路由和上下文打包解决了长序列扩展瓶颈，大幅提升了处理速度。
ai_comments: 本文针对前馈式3D高斯泼溅在处理长多媒体序列时面临的表示-融合不匹配问题，提出了一种无需训练的跨视角融合方法CrossPressor。其核心创新在于覆盖循环证据路由和联合上下文打包，在保持重建质量的同时大幅提升了计算效率，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的基于锚点的压缩方法在处理长多视角序列时，固定的锚点被迫聚合越来越多的支持视图，导致了表示与融合之间的不匹配，难以扩展。
method: 提出CrossPressor方法，引入覆盖循环证据路由来约束视角增长的支持序列，在K/V投影前进行路由，并结合联合上下文打包技术，无需重新训练即可减少支持侧的融合成本。
results: 在保持接近密集融合重建质量的同时，实现了高达26.12倍的跨视角加速和1.43倍的长输入序列端到端加速。
conclusion: CrossPressor成功解决了前馈式3D高斯泼溅在长序列处理中的可扩展性瓶颈，实现了重建质量与计算效率的双赢。

title: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Personalized Reasoning of Vision-Language Models
authors: Dohyun Kim, Junyong Lhim, Kwanyong Park
abstract: People often make decisions by holistically reasoning over heterogeneous forms of personal information. In this paper, we study the relatively underexplored capability of multimodal personalized reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). To this end, we introduce \texttt{MPRBench}, a novel and comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate personalized reasoning across a wide range of tasks and real-world challenges. \texttt{MPRBench} consists of 12 sub-tasks and additionally supports interpretable analysis of representative error cases. Through extensive experiments, we find that current personalized MLLMs still struggle with personalized reasoning due to several key challenges, including inaccurate recognition of personalized concepts and sensitivity to irrelevant personal information. We hope that MPRBench will stimulate further research on personalized reasoning in MLLMs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/kkdh15/MPRBench
zh_title: 一个用于评估视觉-语言模型多模态个性化推理的系统基准
translation: 人们通常通过对异构形式的个人信息进行整体推理来做出决策。在本文中，我们研究了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中相对未被充分探索的多模态个性化推理能力。为此，我们引入了MPRBench，这是一个新颖且全面的基准，专门设计用于评估跨广泛任务和现实世界挑战的个性化推理。MPRBench包含12个子任务，并额外支持对代表性错误案例进行可解释的分析。通过广泛的实验，我们发现当前个性化的MLLMs在个性化推理方面仍然存在困难，主要原因包括对个性化概念的识别不准确以及对不相关个人信息的敏感性。我们希望MPRBench能刺激MLLMs在个性化推理方面的进一步研究。代码和数据可在https://github.com/kkdh15/MPRBench获取。
tldr: 本文提出了MPRBench，一个新颖全面的基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在多模态个性化推理方面的能力。实验发现，当前MLLMs在此方面仍面临挑战。
ai_comments: 本文通过引入MPRBench，填补了评估多模态大语言模型个性化推理能力方面的空白，具有重要的研究价值。该基准的全面性和对错误案例的可解释分析有助于深入理解当前模型的局限性，并为未来研究指明方向。其创新性在于系统地构建了一个针对特定、复杂推理能力的评估工具。
motivation: 人们经常通过对异构形式的个人信息进行整体推理来做出决策。本文研究了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中相对未被充分探索的多模态个性化推理能力。
method: 研究人员引入了MPRBench，这是一个新颖且全面的基准，专门设计用于评估跨广泛任务和现实世界挑战的个性化推理。MPRBench包含12个子任务，并支持对代表性错误案例进行可解释的分析。
results: 通过广泛的实验，研究发现当前个性化的MLLMs在个性化推理方面仍然存在困难，主要原因包括对个性化概念的识别不准确以及对不相关个人信息的敏感性。
conclusion: MPRBench有望刺激MLLMs在个性化推理方面的进一步研究。

title: Analysis of Local Open-Weight LLM Agents on Vulnerability-Reproduction Tasks
authors: Jorge García-Carrasco, Javier Sanchis, Álvaro Navarro, Alejandro Maté, Juan Trujillo
abstract: Open-weight language models that fit on a single consumer GPU are becoming capable on a growing range of tasks, and they matter because they can run locally without sending the code to a hosted service. Vulnerability reproduction, turning a vulnerability description into an input that crashes the vulnerable build, is a natural target for them, since it is an automated analysis task closer to test generation than to code comprehension and it runs against a build that must be executed rather than read. In order to assess whether current models can perform it, we evaluate twelve configurations of local models, spanning three generations, two architectures and three quantization levels, on ten CyberGym vulnerability-reproduction tasks, three runs each under one harness, and release the full artefact. We show that every configuration, down to the 4B model, solves most of the six easier tasks, and configurations separate only on the remaining four. For the harder tasks, the 27B model is required. Quantization did not change what the models solved in any matched pair, but it changed how fast they got there, and the mixture of experts reached the same scores in less wall clock. We also examine the agent trajectories. Almost every run we examined, including those that fail, names the vulnerable function and states the correct hypothesis, and what separates a solved task from an unsolved one is whether that hypothesis becomes a working input.
comment: 35 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Preprint of a manuscript under review at the Journal of Systems and Software (Elsevier). Artefact: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/10888
zh_title: 本地开源大模型代理在漏洞复现任务上的分析
translation: 适合在单张消费级 GPU 上运行的开源语言模型在越来越多的任务上正变得越来越有能力，它们之所以重要，是因为它们可以在本地运行，而无需将代码发送到托管服务。漏洞复现——将漏洞描述转化为导致易受攻击的版本崩溃的输入——是它们的一个自然目标，因为这是一项自动化分析任务，更接近测试生成而不是代码理解，并且它是针对必须执行而不是阅读的版本运行的。为了评估当前模型是否能够执行此任务，我们评估了 12 种本地模型配置（跨越三个世代、两种架构和三个量化级别）在 10 个 CyberGym 漏洞复现任务上的表现（在一个测试框架下每项任务运行三次），并发布了完整的工件。我们表明，每种配置（小至 4B 模型）都能解决六个较简单任务中的大部分，而配置仅在其余四个任务上拉开差距。对于较难的任务，需要 27B 模型。量化并未改变模型在任何匹配对中解决的问题，但它改变了它们达到该结果的速度，混合专家模型在更短的墙钟时间内达到了相同的分数。我们还检查了代理的轨迹。我们检查的几乎每一次运行（包括失败的运行）都命名了易受攻击的函数并陈述了正确的假设，区分已解决任务和未解决任务的是该假设是否变成了一个可工作的输入。
tldr: 本地开源大模型能够执行漏洞复现任务，其中4B及以上模型可解决简单任务，27B模型则是攻克复杂任务的关键，而量化仅影响速度不影响结果。
ai_comments: 本研究评估了本地开源大模型在漏洞复现任务上的表现，揭示了模型规模、量化水平和架构对任务成功率的影响，为本地化安全自动化分析提供了宝贵的实证依据与基准。
motivation: 随着可在单张消费级GPU上运行的开源大模型能力不断提升，由于其本地运行无需将代码发送至托管服务的优势，研究其在漏洞复现这一自动化分析任务上的表现显得尤为重要。
method: 评估了12种本地模型配置（涵盖3个世代、2种架构和3个量化水平）在10个CyberGym漏洞复现任务上的表现，并对代理的执行轨迹进行了详细分析。
results: 所有配置（小至4B模型）都能解决6个较容易的任务中的大部分；27B模型则是解决较难任务所必需的；量化不影响模型解决问题的能力，但会影响速度；混合专家模型以更少的时间达到了相同的得分；几乎所有运行（包括失败的）都能正确识别漏洞函数并提出假设，成败关键在于假设是否能转化为有效输入。
conclusion: 本地开源大模型具备执行漏洞复现的能力，其中4B模型可解决多数简单任务，而27B模型对于更复杂的任务是必不可少的；量化主要影响执行速度而非解决能力，而混合专家架构在墙钟时间上更具优势。

title: CLEAR: Structured Specifications for Controllable Long-Horizon ML Research Engineering
authors: Xin Liu, Hongru Song, Ruqing Zhang, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly being used to automate machine learning (ML) research workflows, ranging from code development and experiment execution to research reproduction and scientific discovery. Recent systems demonstrate that LLMs can perform substantial portions of ML research engineering with limited human intervention. These advances suggest a shift from automating individual research tasks toward automating long-horizon workflows that transform research artifacts into executable ML systems. However, ML research engineering remains substantially more difficult than isolated code generation. A research artifact typically specifies a system only implicitly through a mixture of natural-language descriptions, equations, pseudo-code, implementation details, datasets, and evaluation protocols. An agent must first infer the intended computational structure, translate it into executable components, coordinate their dependencies, and repeatedly diagnose and repair failures during execution. Consequently, the quality of the final system depends not only on code generation, but also on whether the agent can maintain a consistent representation of what should be implemented throughout this long-horizon process.
zh_title: CLEAR：可控长周期机器学习研究工程的结构化规范
translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理正越来越多地用于自动化机器学习（ML）研究工作流，范围从代码开发和实验执行到研究复现和科学发现。最近的系统表明，LLM可以在有限的人工干预下完成ML研究工程的很大一部分。这些进展表明，自动化正从单个研究任务转向自动化将研究产物转化为可执行ML系统的长周期工作流。然而，ML研究工程仍然比孤立的代码生成困难得多。研究产物通常通过自然语言描述、方程、伪代码、实现细节、数据集和评估协议的混合形式，隐式地指定一个系统。代理必须首先推断预期的计算结构，将其转化为可执行组件，协调它们的依赖关系，并在执行过程中反复诊断和修复故障。因此，最终系统的质量不仅取决于代码生成，还取决于代理在整个长周期过程中是否能保持对“应实现什么”的一致表示。
tldr: LLM代理在自动化ML研究工程中面临挑战，因为研究产物规范模糊，需要代理在长周期过程中保持一致的系统表示。
ai_comments: 这篇论文标题暗示将提出一个名为CLEAR的结构化规范，以解决LLM代理在自动化长周期ML研究工程中面临的挑战。抽象清晰地阐述了现有方法的局限性，即研究产物缺乏明确的、可供代理直接理解的计算结构规范。这揭示了在推动LLM代理实现更复杂、更自主的ML研究方面，规范化和一致性表示的关键作用。
motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）代理在自动化机器学习（ML）研究工作流方面取得了进展，但ML研究工程比孤立的代码生成要困难得多。研究产物通常通过自然语言描述、方程、伪代码、实现细节等隐式地指定系统，这导致代理难以推断计算结构、协调依赖关系并诊断修复故障。因此，需要代理在整个长周期过程中保持一致的表示。

title: Beyond Identity Creation: Bilinear Sybil Cost in Identities and Time
authors: Homayoun Maleki, Nekane Sainz, Jon Legarda, Igor Santos-Grueiro
abstract: Sybil defenses price the creation of an identity, yet influence goes, again and again, to active identities. We study the cost of maintaining influence. A defense has a bilinear Sybil cost with ratio $A$ if keeping $s$ identities active for $T$ periods costs at least $sT/A$ honest units: the average cost per identity-window is at least $1/A$ times an honest participant's cost. Recurrence alone does not guarantee this cost. The cost can be carried over from earlier periods, shared among many identities, or be negligible when fast hardware does the work of thousands of honest devices. We give four sufficient conditions for a defense that checks every identity each period to achieve bilinear Sybil cost: identity binding, freshness, a shared deadline, and sequential, non-batchable work. They yield two guarantees: a bilinear total cost, with $A$ the speed advantage of the adversary's fastest hardware, and, because the work must be fresh and finished by a common deadline, a bound on the identities active in a period by the processors running at that time. We prove that none of the four follows from the other three. A verifiable delay function on an identity-bound input meets all four without payments, with $A$ of 2 to 8 for CPUs and about 28 for a hypothetical ASIC, against $10^3$ to $10^7$ for hash puzzles. We measure one active identity per core per period against about 80,000 under a signed heartbeat, no gain from batching up to 1,000 identities, and rejection of all tested attacks.
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures. Main paper followed by the supplementary material. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security
zh_title: 超越身份创建：身份与时间中的双线性女巫攻击成本
translation: 女巫攻击防御机制对身份的创建进行定价，然而影响力却一次又一次地流向活跃身份。我们研究了维持影响力的成本。如果防御机制具有比率为 $A$ 的双线性女巫攻击成本，那么保持 $s$ 个身份活跃 $T$ 个周期至少需要 $sT/A$ 个诚实单位：每个身份窗口的平均成本至少是诚实参与者成本的 $1/A$ 倍。仅仅重复性并不能保证这种成本。成本可以从早期周期结转，在许多身份之间共享，或者当快速硬件完成数千个诚实设备的工作时变得微不足道。我们提出了防御机制在每个周期检查每个身份以实现双线性女巫攻击成本的四个充分条件：身份绑定、新鲜度、共享截止日期和顺序的、不可批处理的工作。它们产生了两个保证：一个双线性总成本，其中 $A$ 是对手最快硬件的速度优势，并且由于工作必须是新鲜的并在共同截止日期前完成，活跃身份的数量受限于在那个时间运行的处理器。我们证明这四个条件中的任何一个都不能由其他三个推导出来。一个基于身份绑定输入的可验证延迟函数在无需支付的情况下满足所有四个条件，对于CPU， $A$ 为2到8，对于假设的ASIC， $A$ 约为28，而哈希难题的 $A$ 值在 $10^3$ 到 $10^7$ 之间。我们测量到每个核心每个周期一个活跃身份，而签名心跳机制下约为80,000个；批处理多达1,000个身份没有增益；所有测试攻击均被拒绝。
tldr: 本文研究了维持在线身份影响力的成本，并提出了实现双线性女巫攻击成本的四个条件，通过可验证延迟函数实现了高效且抗攻击的Sybil防御。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将女巫攻击防御的焦点从“身份创建成本”转移到“维持活跃身份影响力的成本”，提出了“双线性女巫攻击成本”这一新颖的概念。其提出的四个充分条件为设计更鲁棒的Sybil防御机制提供了清晰的指导原则。特别值得关注的是，通过结合可验证延迟函数，该方案在不依赖支付的情况下，实现了对攻击者效率的显著限制，并在实际测量中展现出强大的防御能力，对去中心化系统的安全性和公平性具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的女巫攻击防御机制只关注身份的创建成本，但影响力却持续流向活跃身份。本文旨在研究维持活跃身份影响力的成本，以更有效地防御女巫攻击。
method: 提出了“双线性女巫攻击成本”的概念，并识别了实现这种成本的四个充分条件：身份绑定、新鲜度、共享截止日期和顺序的、不可批处理的工作。通过可验证延迟函数（VDF）在身份绑定输入上实现了这四个条件，并进行了测量和攻击测试。
results: 实现了双线性总成本，其中A为对手最快硬件的速度优势。由于工作必须是新鲜的并在共同截止日期前完成，因此活跃身份的数量受限于同时运行的处理器。证明了这四个条件是相互独立的。使用VDF实现了在CPU上A为2到8，ASIC上A约为28的效率，远优于哈希难题（$10^3$到$10^7$）。测量结果显示每个核心每个周期一个活跃身份，而签名心跳机制下约为80,000个；批处理1,000个身份无增益；所有测试攻击均被拒绝。
conclusion: 通过引入双线性女巫攻击成本并满足其四个充分条件，可以有效提高女巫攻击的防御能力，尤其通过可验证延迟函数实现了一种无需支付且高效的防御机制，显著限制了攻击者的活跃身份数量。

title: SonoDyno: A Sonic Dynamometer for Engine Speed and Load Estimation from Audio
authors: Robin Doerfler, Beat Rossmy
abstract: Controllable engine sound synthesis, Active Sound Design and engine order analysis all build on the relationship between the sound of an engine and its momentary operating state: its speed and its load. Recordings of engine sound are abundant in archives, sample packs and online video, yet they rarely carry time-aligned annotations of that state, which limits their applicability to controllable engine sound generation. We present SonoDyno, which estimates the engine speed, the cylinder count and an engine-normalized load intensity from a microphone signal alone, with no tachometer, no bus access and no prior knowledge of the engine configuration. A convolutional scorer of 124,302 parameters reads the harmonic order energy of each frame at three time-frequency resolutions to jointly score cylinder count and speed, and a decoder imposes the rotational dynamics of the engine on the speed trajectory. A second head estimates the load intensity, the position of the torque between the engine's drag floor at 0 and its full-load ceiling at 1, from the order levels at the decoded speed. On recordings of engines it has never heard, with microphone position, engine type and cylinder count unknown, SonoDyno places 93 to 97% of the frames within 2% of the true speed, identifies the cylinder count with 80% accuracy and confuses the octave on fewer than 2% of the frames. On an unseen engine of a known type, the load intensity has a mean absolute error of 0.12, and the sign of the torque, driving or braking, is right on 91% of the frames. General pitch trackers fall behind even when the harmonic order of each engine is supplied: on our validation recordings and at a tolerance of 5%, the best of them places 62% of the frames within the tolerance, against 96% for SonoDyno.
comment: 17 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing
zh_title: SonoDyno：用于从音频中估计发动机转速和负载的声学测功机
translation: 可控发动机声音合成、主动声音设计和发动机阶次分析都建立在发动机声音与其瞬时工作状态（转速和负载）之间的关系之上。档案、采样包和在线视频中的发动机声音录音非常丰富，但它们很少带有该状态的时间对齐标注，这限制了它们在可控发动机声音生成中的应用。我们提出了 SonoDyno，它仅通过麦克风信号即可估计发动机转速、气缸数和发动机归一化负载强度，无需转速计、总线访问和发动机配置的先验知识。一个拥有 124,302 个参数的卷积评分器在三个时频分辨率下读取每一帧的谐波阶次能量，以联合评分气缸数和转速，解码器则将发动机的旋转动力学强加于转速轨迹上。第二个头部根据解码转速下的阶次水平估计负载强度（即介于 0 的拖曳底限和 1 的满载顶限之间的扭矩位置）。在它从未听过的发动机录音中，麦克风位置、发动机类型和气缸数均未知，SonoDyno 将 93% 到 97% 的帧置于真实转速的 2% 以内，以 80% 的准确率识别气缸数，并且在不到 2% 的帧上混淆了八度音阶。在已知类型的未见发动机上，负载强度的平均绝对误差为 0.12，且在 91% 的帧上扭矩（驱动或制动）的正负号是正确的。即使提供了每个发动机的谐波阶次，通用的音高追踪器也落后了：在我们的验证录音中，在 5% 的容差下，其中最好的追踪器将 62% 的帧置于容差范围内，而 SonoDyno 则达到了 96%。
tldr: SonoDyno 是一种仅凭音频即可高精度估计未知发动机转速、气缸数和负载强度的深度学习模型。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的方法 SonoDyno，仅凭音频即可实现对发动机转速、气缸数和负载强度的精确估计。无需转速计或总线访问，且对未见过的发动机具有很强的泛化能力，在主动声音设计和引擎声音合成领域具有重要的应用价值。
motivation: 尽管档案、采样包和在线视频中存在大量的发动机声音录音，但它们很少带有对发动机瞬时工作状态（转速和负载）的时间对齐标注，这限制了它们在可控发动机声音生成中的应用。为此需要开发一种仅通过音频即可估计转速和负载的方法。
method: 利用具有 124,302 个参数的卷积评分器，在三个时频分辨率下读取每一帧的谐波阶数能量，联合评分气缸数和转速；通过解码器施加发动机旋转动力学来修正转速轨迹；第二个头部根据解码转速下的阶数水平估计负载强度。
results: 在未见过的发动机录音上，SonoDyno 将 93% 到 97% 的帧的转速误差控制在 2% 以内，气缸数识别准确率达 80%，八度音阶混淆率低于 2%。在已知类型的未见发动机上，负载强度的平均绝对误差为 0.12，扭矩正负号判断准确率为 91%，性能远超传统音高追踪器。
conclusion: SonoDyno 能够仅通过麦克风信号准确估计未见过发动机的转速、气缸数和负载强度，性能显著优于传统音高追踪器。

title: Learning Pseudo-Riemannian Manifolds for Heterophilic Graphs via Graph Signature
authors: Yun Young Choi, Asung Kil, Sun Woo Park, Minho Lee, Seokhwan Kim
abstract: Several widely used families of Graph Neural Networks carry a positive-definite geometric prior. Graph convolution read as heat diffusion needs a positive semi-definite operator, hyperbolic models place features on positive-definite Riemannian manifolds, and dot-product and GAT-style attention scores use positive-definite inner products. On heterophilic graphs, where edges often signify dissimilarity or structural repulsion, that prior is a mismatch: no positive-definite form can assign a negative squared distance to a direction the labels separate. To measure the mismatch, we introduce the Graph Signature Index ($s_{\mathcal{G}}$), the inertia of a class-compatibility matrix built from label topology alone, and we prove that no value of the edge or node homophily index in $(0,1)$ rules out a negative eigenvalue. We then propose the Pseudo-Riemannian Attention Network (PRAT), whose attention logit is a signed squared pseudo-distance under a learnable diagonal metric initialized from $s_{\mathcal{G}}$. The design is diagnose-then-learn: the signature supplies a sign structure that unconstrained training keeps outside near-zero directions, and the projection learns the rest of the metric around it. Across fifteen node-classification benchmarks PRAT outperforms or matches the strongest heterophily-adapted models. A controlled ablation ties that performance to the sign structure itself: with architecture and protocol fixed, forbidding the metric to be indefinite costs accuracy on the graphs $s_{\mathcal{G}}$ marks as indefinite and leaves the others unchanged.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 41 pages, including appendix
zh_title: 通过图签名学习异质图的伪黎曼流形
translation:
**论文题目：** 通过图签名学习异质图的伪黎曼流形
**摘要翻译：** 几种广泛使用的图神经网络家族带有正定几何先验。作为热扩散的图卷积需要一个半正定算子，双曲模型将特征置于正定黎曼流形上，而点积和GAT风格的注意力分数使用正定内积。在异质图上，边通常表示不相似性或结构排斥，这种先验是不匹配的：没有正定形式可以为标签分离的方向分配负平方距离。为了衡量这种不匹配，我们引入了图签名指数（$s_{\mathcal{G}}$），它是仅根据标签拓扑构建的类兼容性矩阵的惯性，并且我们证明了在(0,1)范围内的边或节点同质性指数值都不能排除负特征值。然后，我们提出了伪黎曼注意力网络（PRAT），其注意力logit是在可学习对角度量下的有符号平方伪距离，该度量从$s_{\mathcal{G}}$初始化。该设计是先诊断后学习：签名提供了一个符号结构，非受限训练将其保持在接近零的方向之外，并且投影学习其周围的其余度量。在十五个节点分类基准测试中，PRAT的性能优于或与最强的异质性适应模型相匹配。一项受控的消融实验将这种性能与符号结构本身联系起来：在架构和协议固定的情况下，禁止度量为不定型会导致$s_{\mathcal{G}}$标记为不定型的图上准确性下降，而其他图保持不变。
tldr: 现有GNNs在异质图上表现不佳，因为它们隐含正定几何先验。本文引入图签名指数($s_{\mathcal{G}}$)来量化这种不匹配，并提出伪黎曼注意力网络(PRAT)，通过学习伪黎曼度量来解决异质性问题，在多个基准测试中表现优异。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于认识到传统GNNs的正定几何先验在异质图上的局限性，并引入了伪黎曼几何来解决这一问题。通过图签名指数($s_{\mathcal{G}}$)来诊断图的几何特性并初始化模型，这种“诊断-学习”范式非常新颖。实验结果强有力地支持了伪黎曼度量中符号结构的重要性，为异质图学习提供了新的视角和有效的解决方案。
motivation: 现有的图神经网络（GNNs）家族（如图卷积、双曲模型、GAT）普遍带有正定几何先验。然而，在异质图（边表示不相似或排斥）中，这种正定先验是不匹配的，因为正定形式无法为标签分离的方向分配负平方距离。因此，需要一种新的方法来处理异质图的几何结构。
method: 1. 引入图签名指数($s_{\mathcal{G}}$)，它是仅根据标签拓扑构建的类兼容性矩阵的惯性，用于量化几何先验与异质图的不匹配程度。2. 证明了在同质性指数为(0,1)的情况下，负特征值出现的可能性。3. 提出伪黎曼注意力网络（PRAT），其注意力logit是在可学习对角度量下的有符号平方伪距离，该度量从$s_{\mathcal{G}}$初始化。4. PRAT的设计遵循“诊断-学习”范式：签名提供符号结构，然后训练学习其余度量。
results: 1. 在十五个节点分类基准测试中，PRAT的性能优于或与最强的异质性适应模型相匹配。2. 对度量进行限制，使其不能是不定型的（即强制为正定），会导致在$s_{\mathcal{G}}$标记为不定型的图上准确性下降，而在其他图上保持不变，这表明性能与符号结构本身相关。
conclusion: PRAT通过引入伪黎曼几何和图签名指数，有效解决了传统GNN在异质图上几何先验不匹配的问题，并在多个基准测试中取得了SOTA或相当的性能，证明了伪黎曼度量中符号结构的重要性。

title: NextGAN: Towards Simple and Scalable GAN Training for Image and Video Generation
authors: Xinhao Lou, Dongye Xie, Peng Sun, Chenyi Zhuang, Kaicheng Yu, Tao Lin
abstract: Adversarial training enables one- and few-step image and video generation, but conventional adversarial losses supervise critic values without directly specifying the gradients used to update the generator. We present NEXTGAN, which trains a scalar critic by regressing its input gradient onto displacements between independently paired reference and generated features at interpolated locations in frozen representation spaces. For a fixed generator, this regression is equivalent to an adversarial objective with a gradient-energy penalty, while the generator retains the standard potential-based GAN update. The same objective adapts pre-trained image and video generators with up to 14B parameters, without auxiliary losses, online teacher scores, or trajectories. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$, NEXTGAN achieves one-step FIDs of 2.87 with pixel-space JiT-B and 1.54 with latent-space DiT-XL/1; its adversarial form further reaches 1.36. For text-to-video generation, a single trained Wan2.1-1.3B model supports one-, two-, and four-step sampling, achieving the highest VBench total scores among the compared 1.3B methods at one and two steps. At two steps, NEXTGAN scores 83.13, exceeding rCM and AnyFlow by 1.25 and 0.47 points, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/LINs-lab/NextGAN.git.
zh_title: NextGAN：面向图像和视频生成的简单且可扩展的GAN训练方法
translation: 对抗训练能够实现一步和少步的图像与视频生成，但常规的对抗损失只监督critic的值，而没有直接指定用于更新生成器的梯度。我们提出了NEXTGAN，它通过将标量子critic的输入梯度回归到冻结表示空间中插值位置的独立配对参考特征与生成特征之间的位移，来训练一个标量子critic。对于固定的生成器，这种回归等价于带有梯度能量惩罚的对抗目标，而生成器则保留标准的基于势能的GAN更新。该目标无需辅助损失、在线教师分数或轨迹，即可适配具有高达14B参数的预训练图像和视频生成器。在ImageNet 256x256上，NEXTGAN使用像素空间的JiT-B实现了2.87的一步FID，使用潜空间的DiT-XL/1实现了1.54的FID；其对抗形式进一步达到了1.36。对于文本到视频生成，单个训练好的Wan2.1-1.3B模型支持一、二和四步采样，在一步和二步测试中达到了所比较的1.3B方法中最高的VBench总分。在两步测试中，NEXTGAN得分为83.13，分别比rCM和AnyFlow高出1.25和0.47分。代码开源于 https://github.com/LINs-lab/NextGAN.git。
tldr: NextGAN提出了一种基于梯度回归的新型对抗训练方法，无需辅助损失即可高效适配高达14B参数的预训练图像和视频生成模型，实现业界领先的一步/少步生成性能。
ai_comments: NextGAN通过将标量子critic的输入梯度回归到冻结表示空间中插值位置的参考特征与生成特征之间的位移，提出了一种简单且可扩展的GAN训练方法。该方法无需辅助损失、在线教师分数或轨迹，就能适配高达14B参数的预训练图文生成模型，在图像和视频生成任务中均取得了优异的一步/多步生成效果。
motivation: 常规的对抗性损失仅监督critic的值，而没有直接指定用于更新生成器的梯度，这限制了GAN在一步和少步生成中的简单性和可扩展性。
method: 训练一个标量子critic，通过将其输入梯度回归到冻结表示空间中独立配对的参考特征与生成特征在插值位置上的位移来实现；同时保留标准基于势能的GAN更新用于生成器。
results: 在ImageNet 256x256上，NextGAN在一步生成中取得了2.87（pixel-space JiT-B）和1.54（latent-space DiT-XL/1）的FID，其对抗形式达到1.36；在文本到视频生成中，单个Wan2.1-1.3B模型支持1、2、4步采样，在1步和2步下取得了相比同类1.3B方法更高的VBench总分（2步下达到83.13）。
conclusion: NextGAN提供了一种简单、可扩展且高效的对抗训练方法，能够成功将大规模预训练的图像和视频生成模型转化为高质量的一步或少步生成器，并在多个基准测试中展现出SOTA的性能。

title: Consistency Learning and Distillation for One-Step MIMO-OFDM Channel Estimation
authors: Fredrik Nguyen, Qiwen Wang
abstract: Iterative neural channel estimators can improve recovery under pilot contamination, but repeated network evaluations increase inference cost. This paper develops observation-anchored consistency and Consistency Mid-Training (CMT) estimators for one-step channel estimation in multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems. Both estimators refine pilot-derived least-squares channel estimates in the delay-beam domain. Consistency learning couples endpoint predictions along noisy-to-clean paths. CMT then refines a compact consistency-trained student to predict a flow-matching teacher's endpoint from intermediate trajectory states. Across the evaluated SNR range, the compact CMT student reduces uncoded symbol error rate (SER) by 9.6-20.2% relative to the one-step flow-matching baseline (0.44-0.98 dB in logarithmic SER reduction), while using 74.5% fewer parameters and 73.0% fewer network multiply-accumulates.
zh_title: 一步式MIMO-OFDM信道估计的一致性学习与蒸馏
translation: 迭代神经网络信道估计器可以在导频污染下改善恢复性能，但重复的网络评估会增加推理成本。本文开发了用于多输入多输出正交频分复用（MIMO-OFDM）系统一步式信道估计的观察锚定一致性（observation-anchored consistency）和一致性中训练（CMT）估计器。这两种估计器都在延迟-波束域细化了导频导出的最小二乘信道估计。一致性学习将噪声到干净路径上的端点预测进行耦合。CMT随后精炼了一个紧凑的一致性训练学生模型，以从中间轨迹状态预测流匹配教师模型的端点。在评估的信噪比范围内，紧凑的CMT学生模型相对于一步式流匹配基线，将未编码符号错误率（SER）降低了9.6-20.2%（对数SER降低0.44-0.98 dB），同时使用的参数减少了74.5%，网络乘加运算减少了73.0%。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于一致性学习和蒸馏（CMT）的单步MIMO-OFDM信道估计器，它显著降低了符号错误率，同时大幅减少了模型参数和计算量。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入一致性学习和蒸馏技术，在不牺牲性能的前提下，大幅降低了MIMO-OFDM信道估计的计算复杂度和模型规模，具有重要的实际应用价值。其创新点在于将一致性概念应用于一步式信道估计，并通过学生-教师模型蒸馏实现了模型紧凑化，有效解决了实时通信系统中资源受限的问题。
motivation: 迭代神经网络信道估计器在导频污染下能改善恢复性能，但重复的网络评估会增加推理成本。
method: 本文开发了观察锚定一致性（observation-anchored consistency）和一致性中训练（CMT）估计器，用于一步式MIMO-OFDM信道估计。这两种估计器都在延迟-波束域细化了导频导出的最小二乘信道估计。一致性学习将噪声到干净路径上的端点预测进行耦合。CMT随后精炼了一个紧凑的一致性训练学生模型，以从中间轨迹状态预测流匹配教师模型的端点。
results: 在评估的信噪比范围内，紧凑的CMT学生模型相对于一步式流匹配基线，将未编码符号错误率（SER）降低了9.6-20.2%（对数SER降低0.44-0.98 dB），同时使用的参数减少了74.5%，网络乘加运算减少了73.0%。
conclusion: 本文提出的紧凑型CMT学生模型在MIMO-OFDM信道估计中实现了显著的性能提升，同时大幅降低了计算复杂度和模型规模，有效解决了迭代估计器推理成本高的问题。

title: Quo Vadis, Driving Scene Reconstruction? Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Densification
authors: Dung Do Tien, Kien Nguyen Do Trung, Kiet Dang Vu, Trung Thai Tran, Duc Dung Nguyen
abstract: While recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting methods enable efficient driving-scene reconstruction from surround-view images, their reliance on a single observation fundamentally hinders novel-view synthesis. Regions occluded in the input can become visible from novel viewpoints, leaving the reconstructed Gaussians under-constrained and incomplete. Moving beyond image-space inpainting for rendered views, we introduce OccSplat, a feed-forward framework whose core contribution is Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Densification, explicitly targeting missing scene geometry rather than missing pixels. By predicting new Gaussian primitives for unsupported regions, OccSplat completes the scene directly in the 3D representation. Specifically, OccSplat first identifies occluded regions that lack Gaussian support through Gaussian Occlusion Mapping. Gaussian Occlusion Completion then generates new primitives for these regions. The predicted primitives are integrated into the original representation to improve novel-view synthesis while retaining feed-forward inference without per-scene optimization. Experiments on the nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that OccSplat improves on the compared methods and yields particularly large gains in occluded regions, leading to more accurate and visually coherent driving-scene reconstruction.
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Computer Vision for Developing Countries (CV4DC), ACCV 2026 (Proceedings Track)
zh_title: 自动驾驶场景重建何去何从？遮挡感知的高斯致密化
translation: 尽管最近的前馈式3D高斯散射方法能够利用环视图像进行高效的驾驶场景重建，但它们对单一观测的依赖从根本上阻碍了新视点合成。输入中被遮挡的区域在新的视点下可能会变得可见，这使得重建的高斯图元受约束不足且不完整。超越渲染视图的图像空间修补，我们引入了OccSplat，这是一个前馈框架，其核心贡献是遮挡感知高斯致密化，明确针对缺失的场景几何体而非缺失的像素。通过为不受支持的区域预测新的高斯图元，OccSplat直接在3D表示中补全场景。具体而言，OccSplat首先通过高斯遮挡映射识别缺乏高斯支持的遮挡区域。然后，高斯遮挡补全为这些区域生成新的图元。预测的图元被整合到原始表示中，以改善新视点合成，同时保留无需每场景优化的前馈推理。在nuScenes基准测试上的实验表明，OccSplat改进了对比方法，并在遮挡区域取得了特别大的增益，从而实现了更准确、视觉更连贯的驾驶场景重建。
tldr: 本文提出OccSplat，一种用于自动驾驶场景重建的遮挡感知高斯致密化前馈框架，通过直接在3D空间预测遮挡区域的高斯图元，显著提升了新视点合成的质量。
ai_comments: 该论文针对前馈式3D高斯散射在自动驾驶场景重建中由于遮挡导致的3D几何缺失问题，创新性地提出了遮挡感知的高斯致密化方法（OccSplat），直接在3D空间中补全缺失的几何体，显著提升了新视点合成的质量，且保持了无需每场景优化的前馈推理优势。
motivation: 现有的前馈式3D高斯散射方法由于依赖单一观测，无法有效处理新视点下可见的遮挡区域，导致重建的高斯图元受约束不足且不完整，而图像空间修补无法根本解决3D几何缺失问题。
method: 提出OccSplat前馈框架，核心包含高斯遮挡映射（Gaussian Occlusion Mapping）以识别缺乏高斯支持的遮挡区域，以及高斯遮挡Completion（Gaussian Occlusion Completion）为这些区域生成新的图元，将其整合到原始表知识中。
results: 在nuScenes基准测试上的实验表明，OccSplat超越了对比方法，在遮挡区域取得了巨大提升，实现了更准确、视觉更连贯的驾驶场景重建。
conclusion: OccSplat通过高斯遮挡映射与补全技术，有效解决驾驶场景重建中的遮挡问题，实现了高精度、视觉连贯的3D场景重构与新视点合成。

title: Evaluating Human-LLM Alignment on Visualization Preference
authors: Tanmay Bakshi, Chenglong Wang, Simra Shahid
abstract: There are often multiple valid visualizations, spanning different chart types, visual encodings, and aesthetic choices, that can all support a user's goal of analyzing a dataset. Determining which of these candidate visualizations is most appropriate, however, remains challenging. Prior work has leveraged expert-curated taxonomies to guide visualization design and subsequent quality evaluation, a practical evaluation model must also account for human-centric factors. Latest visualization tools integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate and refine visualizations, using LLM-as-a-judge to provide design feedback. Without a deeper understanding of whether, and in what ways, human and LLM perceptions of visualizations align, there is a real risk of deploying low-quality agents that do not reflect human judgment. We study this question through a pilot experiment - we formulate the problem as a preference task over curated chart pairs and compare the judgments of state-of-the-art vision models with those of a panel of human annotators. We establish a cautionary tale: such judges risk filtering out informative, compelling displays. We find that frontier models collapse human subjectivity, a rich signal that reveals contrasting design choices, into near-deterministic verdicts.
zh_title: 评估人机大模型在可视化偏好上的一致性
translation: 对于支持用户分析数据集的目标，通常存在多种有效的可视化方式，涵盖不同的图表类型、视觉编码和美学选择。然而，确定这些候选可视化中哪一种最合适仍然具有挑战性。先前的工作利用专家策划的分类法来指导可视化设计和随后的质量评估，但实际的评估模型还必须考虑以人为中心的因素。最新的可视化工具集成了大语言模型（LLMs）来生成和优化可视化，并使用LLM作为裁判来提供设计反馈。如果没有深入理解人类和LLM对可视化的感知是否以及在哪些方面保持一致，就会真正存在部署不反映人类判断的低质量智能体的风险。我们通过一项试点实验研究了这个问题——我们将该问题表述为策划图表对的偏好任务，并比较了最先进的视觉模型与一组人类注释者的判断。我们得出一个警示：此类裁判存在过滤掉信息丰富、引人注目的图表的风险。我们发现，前沿模型将人类的主观性（这是一种揭示对比设计选择的丰富信号）折叠为近乎确定性的裁决。
tldr: 本研究发现当前的大模型在判断可视化图表偏好时无法很好地对齐人类，倾向于将人类丰富的主观选择简化为确定性结论，盲目使用LLM评估图表质量存在较大风险。
ai_comments: 该论文揭示了当前大语言模型在可视化偏好判断上与人类主观性的巨大差距，强调了在可视化设计中引入人类中心因素的重要性，对未来开发对齐人类价值观的AI智能体具有重要的警示作用。
motivation: 由于最新的可视化工具广泛集成大语言模型并采用LLM-as-a-judge机制提供设计反馈，但目前缺乏对人类与LLM在可视化感知上是否对齐以及如何对齐的深入理解，这可能导致部署无法反映人类判断的低质量智能体。
method: 通过一项试点实验，将问题构建为精心挑选的图表对的偏好任务，并对比了最先进的视觉模型与人类注释者小组的判断结果。
results: 实验表明，前沿视觉模型往往会将人类关于不同设计选择的丰富主观信号转化为近乎确定性的判定，存在过滤掉信息丰富且引人注目的图表的风险。
conclusion: 前沿多模态大模型在可视化偏好判断上无法很好地对齐人类，它们倾向于将人类丰富的主观偏好简化为确定性结论，因此直接使用LLM-as-a-judge评估可视化质量存在风险，可能过滤掉优秀的设计。

title: DyPSI: Dynamic Physics Sensing via Joint Field and Sensor-Trajectory Generation
authors: Yizhou Zhang, Panqi Chen, Lei Cheng, Ting Zhang, Jianlong Li, Jianfeng Shi, Shikai Fang
abstract: Physics sensing in evolving environments requires reconstructing dense spatiotemporal fields from sparse observations while adapting where future observations should be collected. Existing reconstruction and sensor-placement methods have made substantial progress, but they typically rely on static sensing assumptions: they either use a single layout across all frames or optimize placements independently at each frame, which limits their ability to produce temporally coherent sensing trajectories. We introduce DyPSI, a dynamic physics sensing framework that formulates this problem as the joint generation of future fields and sensor trajectories conditioned on historical observations. DyPSI lifts discrete sensor coordinates into continuous Sensor Position Fields, encodes fields and sensing configurations with a shared Functional Tucker representation, and trains a joint diffusion model to generate future fields and sensing trajectories simultaneously in the resulting latent space. A Gaussian-process temporal kernel correlates the perturbation injected during diffusion training, biasing the denoiser toward temporally smooth recoveries, and we further provide an analysis linking the EDM training objective to a sequence-aggregated A-optimality criterion and a kernel-induced bound on discrete trajectory variation. Experiments on turbulent flow, GLORYS12 sea-surface temperature, and 3D car aerodynamics show that DyPSI consistently outperforms static and frame-wise placement strategies, with substantial error reduction under tight sensor budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/mengqi132/DyPSI.
zh_title: DyPSI：通过联合场与传感器轨迹生成的动态物理传感
translation: 演化环境中的物理传感需要从稀疏观测中重建稠密的时空场，同时适应未来观测的采集位置。现有的重建和传感器放置方法取得了实质性进展，但它们通常依赖于静态传感假设：它们要么在所有帧中使用单一布局，要么在每一帧独立优化放置，这限制了它们产生具有时间连贯性的传感轨迹的能力。我们介绍了DyPSI，这是一个动态物理传感框架，它将该问题构想为以历史观测为条件的未来场和传感器轨迹的联合生成。DyPSI将离散传感器坐标提升为连续的传感器位置场，用共享的函数型Tucker表示对场和传感配置进行编码，并训练一个联合扩散模型，在所得的潜在空间中同时生成未来场和传感器轨迹。高斯过程时间核关联了扩散训练期间注入的扰动，使去噪器偏向于时间平滑的恢复，并且我们进一步提供了将EDM训练目标与序列聚合A-最优性准则以及核诱导的离散轨迹变分界限相联系的分析。在湍流、GLORYS12海面温度和3D汽车空气动力学上的实验表明，DyPSI在严格的传感器预算下，其性能始终优于静态和逐帧放置策略，并大幅降低了误差。代码可在https://github.com/mengqi132/DyPSI获取。
tldr: DyPSI是一个利用扩散模型联合生成未来物理场和连续传感器轨迹的动态传感框架，有效解决了时空演化环境下的稀疏观测重建问题。
ai_comments: DyPSI引入了一种创新的动态物理传感框架，将连续传感器位置场与函数型Tucker表示相结合，通过联合扩散模型同时生成未来场和传感器轨迹，在时空连续性和资源受限下表现出色。
motivation: 现有重建和传感器部署方法通常依赖静态传感假设，使用单一布局或独立优化每帧布局，无法产生具有时间连贯性的传感轨迹以适应不断演化的环境。
method: 将离散传感器坐标提升为连续的传感器位置场，使用共享的函数型Tucker表示编码场和传感配置，训练联合扩散模型在潜在空间中同时生成未来场和传感器轨迹，并引入高斯过程时间核以确保时间平滑性。
results: 在湍流、GLORYS12海面温度和3D汽车空气动力学等实验中，DyPSI在严格的传感器预算下表现优于静态和逐帧放置策略，显著降低了重建误差。
conclusion: DyPSI框架通过联合生成未来场与传感器轨迹，有效克服了传统静态或独立帧优化方法的局限性，在多个复杂物理环境测试中取得了显著的误差降低和优异的性能。

title: Clear Human Web: Where a Person Vouches for Every Client
authors: Lorenzo Porcelli
abstract: The web cannot tell whether a request comes from a person or from a program. Sites have checked the network address and puzzles in its place, and both have given way: automated traffic exceeds human traffic, and puzzles are solved for pay and by agents. This paper proposes the Clear Human Web, the part of the public web that sites open only to clients a person vouches for. A person's wallet presents their person identification data (PID) to one issuer, the only party that registers as a relying party, and receives a bounded number of blind-signed tokens, proofs of personhood that carry no attribute. The browser spends one token at each site that runs the gate, and the site learns that a valid token of a trusted issuer was spent, and nothing else. No field is added to the PID, no protocol is introduced, no site registers, and the publisher of a site holds the same proof as its readers. We define the Clear Human Web through five properties and seven adversaries, and state which properties the construction satisfies against each adversary. The identities a person can hold on one site in an epoch are bounded to k. The bound holds once the wallet limits a person to one pseudonym at the issuer. In the optimum k = 1, and a zero-knowledge proof of PID possession and a pseudonym per site replace the tokens.
zh_title: 清晰人类网络：每个人为每个客户端担保的地方
translation: 互联网无法区分请求是来自人类还是程序。网站曾检查网络地址和验证码，但两者都已失效：自动化流量超过了人类流量，验证码也通过付费和代理被破解。本文提出了“清晰人类网络”（Clear Human Web），即公共网络中只对由真人担保的客户端开放的部分。人的数字钱包向一个发行方（唯一注册为依赖方的实体）出示其个人身份数据（PID），并接收数量有限的、不携带任何属性的盲签名代币作为人格证明。浏览器在每个运行该网关的网站上消耗一个代币，网站得知消耗了来自受信任发行方的有效代币，除此之外别无所知。PID中未添加任何字段，未引入新协议，无需网站注册，网站发布者与读者持有相同的证明。我们通过五个属性和七个对抗者定义了清晰人类网络，并说明了该结构针对每个对抗者所满足的属性。一个人在一个时期内在某个网站上可以拥有的身份被限制在 $k$ 个。一旦钱包将每个人限制在发行方处只有一个化名，该界限即成立。在最优的 $k=1$ 情况下，PID拥有的零知识证明和每个网站一个化名取代了代币。
tldr: 提出了一种名为 Clear Human Web 的网络架构，利用盲签名代币和身份验证机制，在不侵犯隐私的前提下确保网络流量来自真人担保的客户端。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的“清晰人类网络”概念，通过盲签名代币和身份验证机制来区分真人与自动化程序，同时严格保护用户隐私，具有很高的实用价值和安全性。
motivation: 当前的互联网无法区分请求是来自人类还是自动化程序，传统的网络地址检查和验证码等机制已失效，自动化流量远超人类流量且验证码易被破解，因此需要一种新的架构来确保网络客户端由真人担保。
method: 使用数字钱包向唯一发行方出示个人身份数据（PID），获取无属性的盲签名代币；浏览器在支持该机制的网站上消耗代币，网站仅能验证代币有效性而无法获取其他信息；或通过零知识证明和每个网站一个化名来实现最优的 $k=1$ 方案。
results: 论文定义了 Clear Human Web 的五个属性和七个对抗者，并证明了该结构在对抗这些威胁时的有效性，同时将一个人在单个网站一个时期内的身份数量限制在 $k$ 个以内（最优时 $k=1$）。
conclusion: Clear Human Web 通过限制每个人在特定时期的身份数量和使用盲签名代币，在保护用户隐私的前提下有效解决了公共网络中真人与自动化流量无法区分的问题。

title: Building a Method: Challenges and Lessons from Developing an Impact Evaluation Framework for Public Investment in Open Source Software
authors: Laia Domenech Burin
abstract: Modern societies and institutions depend on an invisible layer of open digital infrastructure: foundational, openly accessible digital technologies that support a broad range of social and economic activities. Open source software is a core component of this infrastructure, underpinning everyday technologies and critical systems in various critical sectors. As open source software becomes increasingly recognised, funded, and governed as open digital infrastructure, policymakers face growing demands for accountability, transparency, and credible evidence of impact. However, methods for evaluating public investment in open source software remain underdeveloped, with no widely accepted methodological standard. This paper describes the Sovereign Tech Agency's transition from qualitative reporting and funding-recipient self-assessment towards a mixed-methods approach that incorporates quantitative, goal-oriented evaluation to inform funding decisions. Drawing on the development of this framework, it examines its initial design, the practical and structural challenges encountered, and the responses adopted. The work identifies three central challenges: evaluation indicators must reflect heterogeneous project goals and contexts; quantitative assessment relies on fragmented and fragile data infrastructure; and observed changes before, during, and after investment do not establish causal attribution without additional research designs. The paper argues that evaluating investment in open source software is not only a methodological task but also a governance practice, dependent on sustainable open research infrastructure, community knowledge, and ongoing methodological refinement.
comment: Working paper presented at the Open Technology Research Symposium 2026
zh_title: 构建方法：开发公共投资开源软件影响力评估框架的挑战与经验教训
translation: 现代社会和机构依赖于一层不可见的开放数字基础设施：即支持广泛社会和经济活动的基础性、开放获取的数字技术。开源软件是该基础设施的核心组成部分，支撑着各个关键领域的日常技术和关键系统。随着开源软件作为开放数字基础设施越来越得到认可、资助和治理，政策制定者面临着对问责制、透明度和可靠影响力证据的不断增长的需求。然而，评估开源软件公共投资的方法仍不成熟，且没有广泛接受的方法论标准。本文描述了主权科技基金会（Sovereign Tech Agency）从定性报告和受资助者自我评估向混合方法（结合了量化的、目标导向的评估以指导资助决策）的过渡。结合该框架的发展，本文考察了其最初的设计、遇到的实际和结构性挑战以及采取的应对措施。这项工作确定了三个核心挑战：评估指标必须反映异质的项目目标和背景；定量评估依赖于碎片化且脆弱的数据基础设施；如果没有额外的研究设计，投资前、中、后观察到的变化无法建立因果归因。本文认为，评估对开源软件的投资不仅是一项方法论任务，也是一种治理实践，它依赖于可持续的开放研究基础设施、社区知识和持续的方法论完善。
tldr: 本文探讨了公共资金资助开源软件的影响力评估框架构建，分析了实践中的三大挑战（指标多样性、数据碎片化、因果关系确认），并强调评估是关乎社区与治理的重要实践。
ai_comments: 该论文深入探讨了公共资金资助开源软件的评估框架构建，指出了当前开源基础设施评估中缺乏统一标准的痛点，并总结了主权科技基金会（Sovereign Tech Agency）在实践中的经验与挑战，对于公共政策制定和开源生态治理具有重要的参考价值。
motivation: 随着开源软件被日益公认为核心数字基础设施，政策制定者面临着对问责制、透明度和可靠影响力证据的增长需求，然而目前评估公共投资的方法尚不成熟，缺乏广泛认可的方法论标准。
method: 描述了主权科技基金会（Sovereign Tech Agency）从定性报告和资助对象自我评估向混合方法（结合定量、目标导向评估）的转变，并分析了其初始设计、实践挑战及应对措施。
results: 识别了三大核心挑战：评估指标必须反映异质的项目目标和背景；定量评估依赖于碎片化且脆弱的数据基础设施；投资前、中、后观察到的变化在没有额外研究设计的情况下无法建立因果归因。
conclusion: 评估开源软件的公共投资不仅是一项方法论任务，更是一种治理实践，依赖于可持续的开放研究基础设施、社区知识和持续的方法论改进。

title: MonoLaDN: Language-Guided DeNoising for Monocular 3D Object Detection
authors: Kiet Dang Vu, Cao Le Minh Khoa, Nguyen Viet Tri Pham, An Nguyen Gia, Tam Le Thuc Ho, Duc Dung Nguyen
abstract: Monocular 3D object detection offers a low-cost route to 3D perception, but it remains fundamentally ill-posed, since depth must be inferred from a single view. Recent transformer-based detectors learn geometry purely from image features and 3D box annotations, lacking the high-level semantic priors that vision-language models (VLMs) acquire from large-scale pretraining. VLMs offer such priors, but deploying one directly as a detector is impractical due to its heavy inference cost. We propose MonoLaDN, a language-guided denoising framework that transfers the geometric reasoning of a VLM into a monocular 3D detector while keeping the deployed model purely vision-based. During training, a frozen VLM produces structured reasoning about each object's occlusion, depth, dimension, and angle from the image and its ground-truth boxes. We encode this reasoning into queries, perturb them with noise, and train the detector to reconstruct the clean reasoning. Reconstructing the corrupted reasoning forces the detector's depth-guided features to internalize the VLM's geometric priors, so this knowledge remains available even after the reasoning path is discarded at inference, adding no latency or parameters to the deployed model. Experiments on KITTI 3D and nuScenes show that MonoLaDN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art detectors and generalizes well to new domains.
zh_title: MonoLaDN：用于单目3D目标检测的语言引导去噪方法
translation: 单目3D目标检测提供了一条低成本的3D感知途径，但由于必须从单视图推断深度，它仍然从根本上说是不适定的。最近基于Transformer的检测器纯粹从图像特征和3D边界框标注中学习几何图形，缺乏视觉语言模型（VLM）从大规模预训练中获得的高级语义先验。VLM提供了这些先验，但由于其高昂的推理成本，直接将其部署为检测器是不切实际的。我们提出了MonoLaDN，这是一个语言引导的去噪框架，它将VLM的几何推理能力迁移到单目3D检测器中，同时保持部署的模型纯粹基于视觉。在训练期间，冻结的VLM根据图像及其真实边界框产生关于每个物体的遮挡、深度、维度和角度的结构化推理。我们将这种推理编码为查询，用噪声对其进行扰动，并训练检测器来重建干净的推理。重建损坏的推理迫使检测器的深度引导特征内化VLM的几何先验，因此即使在推理时丢弃推理路径后，这些知识仍然可用，从而不会为部署的模型增加延迟或参数。在KITTI 3D和nuScenes上的实验表明，MonoLaDN consistently（持续地）优于最先进的检测器，并且很好地泛化到新域。
tldr: 通过在训练时引入视觉语言模型的几何推理进行去噪学习，MonoLaDN在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升了单目3D目标检测的准确度。
ai_comments: 该论文巧妙地利用视觉语言模型（VLM）的大规模预训练语义和几何先验来辅助单目3D目标检测，同时通过“训练时引导、推理时丢弃”的去噪框架避免了VLM高昂的推理成本，具有很高的实用价值和创新性。
motivation: 单目3D目标检测由于缺乏深度信息而本质上是一个不适定问题，当前的纯视觉Transformer检测器缺乏视觉语言模型（VLM）在大规模预训练中获得的丰富高级语义和几何先验，而直接部署VLM作为检测器又面临过高的推理成本。
method: 提出MonoLaDN框架，在训练阶段利用冻结的VLM生成关于物体遮挡、深度、尺寸和角度的结构化推理，将其编码为查询并通过噪声扰动，训练单目检测器去重构这些干净的推理，从而将VLM的几何先验内化到检测器的特征中；推理阶段则丢弃该推理路径，保持纯视觉检测。
results: 在KITTI 3D和nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，MonoLaDN持续超越当前的先进检测器，并具备良好的跨域泛化能力。
conclusion: MonoLaDN成功将VLM的几何推理能力迁移到单目3D检测器中，在不增加推理延迟和参数的情况下显著提升了检测精度和泛化能力。

title: Optimal stability estimates and preasymptotic error analysis of the CIP-FEM for the Helmholtz equation with uniaxial perfectly matched layers
authors: Silin Wen, Yu Du
abstract: We study the uniaxial perfectly matched layer (UPML) problem for the Helmholtz equation in two and three dimensions and establish wavenumber-explicit stability estimates at high wavenumbers. For the full-space UPML problem, we prove the optimal stability estimate with the inf-sup constant satisfying $μ_\infty\eqsim k^{-1}$ for sufficiently large $k$ if the absorption function $σ\in W^{1,\infty}$ is a piecewise-power function of order at least one for which $\|σ'\|_{L^\infty(\{t:0<σ(t)\leqδ_*\})}\leq \varepsilon_*$, where $\varepsilon_*$ and $δ_*$ depend only on the PML parameters. Using this stability estimate, we obtain the optimal inf-sup estimate $μ_L\eqsim k^{-1}$ for the truncated UPML problem. These estimates further yield preasymptotic error estimates for a linear continuous interior penalty finite element method (CIP-FEM). Numerical simulations confirmed the theoretical predictions and demonstrated the effectiveness of CIP-FEM under high-wavenumber conditions.
zh_title: 带有单轴完美匹配层的亥姆霍兹方程CIP-FEM的最优稳定性估计与预渐近误差分析
translation: 我们研究了二维和三维空间中亥姆霍兹方程的单轴完美匹配层（UPML）问题，并在高波数下建立了波数显式的稳定性估计。对于全空间UPML问题，如果吸收函数 $\sigma \in W^{1,\infty}$ 是至少一阶的分段幂函数，且满足一定条件，我们证明了当波数 $k$ 足够大时，inf-sup常数满足 $\mu_\infty \eqsim k^{-1}$ 的最优稳定性估计。利用此稳定性估计，我们得到了截断UPML问题的最优inf-sup估计 $\mu_L \eqsim k^{-1}$。这些估计进一步给出了线性连续内部罚有限元法（CIP-FEM）的预渐近误差估计。数值模拟证实了理论预测，并展示了CIP-FEM在高波数条件下的有效性。
tldr: 本文研究了高频亥姆霍兹方程UPML问题的最优稳定性，并证明了CIP-FEM方法的有效性与预渐近误差估计。
ai_comments: 本文针对带有单轴完美匹配层（UPML）的高频亥姆霍兹方程，建立了波数显式的最优稳定性估计，并进一步推导了连续内部罚有限元法（CIP-FEM）的预渐近误差估计。这对于高频波动方程的数值求解和理论分析具有重要意义。
motivation: 为了解决高频亥姆霍兹方程在无界区域求解时的波传播模拟问题，特别是在采用单轴完美匹配层（UPML）截断时的数值稳定性和误差分析问题。
method: 通过理论分析建立全空间及截断UPML问题的波数显式稳定性估计（inf-sup估计），并在此基础上进行线性连续内部罚有限元法（CIP-FEM）的预渐近误差分析。
results: 证明了全空间及截断UPML问题在足够大波数下具有最优的inf-sup常数 $\mu \eqsim k^{-1}$，并得出了CIP-FEM的预渐近误差估计，数值模拟验证了理论预测。
conclusion: 本文成功建立了高频亥姆霍兹方程UPML问题的最优稳定性估计，并证明了CIP-FEM方法在高波数条件下的有效性。

title: A.S.E 2.0: Understanding How Repository Context Impacts the Security of LLM-Generated Code
authors: Jiongchi Yu, Keke Lian, Junqing Wang, Zhikang Fan, Zhaoxuan Li, Yongheng Huang, Ziming Zhao, Dong Zhang
abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agents construct a repository context before generating code. For security-sensitive code, this context decides whether the model sees the project's safeguards (e.g., authorization checks) or insecure code to imitate. However, context construction is designed almost exclusively for functional correctness, and secure-code benchmarks treat the context as fixed, so how repository context affects the security of generated code remains unclear. We construct CASE-Bench, a benchmark of 145 repository-level tasks from real CVEs in 51 projects. Each task runs in Docker, has functional tests and a proof-of-concept exploit validated in both directions, and is annotated with the repository code that enforces or undermines its security. Using CASE-Bench, we compare 13 context construction methods and six controls with six LLMs, edit single context elements, and analyze coding-agent trajectories. We find that (1) functionality-oriented context raises the functional pass rate by up to 8.2 percentage points (pp) but the secure pass rate by at most 3.7 pp, (2) withholding a safeguard lowers the secure pass rate by up to 8.1 pp, while one inserted insecure exemplar raises correct-but-exploitable code by 6.3 pp, and (3) coding agents observe the relevant safeguard in only 27-36% of trajectories. These findings inform security-aware context construction and secure-code evaluation.
zh_title: A.S.E 2.0：理解代码库上下文如何影响LLM生成代码的安全性
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）编码助手和智能体在生成代码之前会构建代码库上下文。对于安全敏感的代码，该上下文决定了模型是看到项目的安全防护（例如授权检查）还是模仿不安全的代码。然而，上下文构建几乎完全是为了功能正确性而设计的，且安全代码基准将上下文视为固定的，因此代码库上下文如何影响生成代码的安全性仍不清楚。我们构建了CASE-Bench，这是一个包含来自51个项目中真实CVE的145个代码库级任务的基准。每个任务都在Docker中运行，具备功能测试和双向验证的概念证明（PoC）漏洞利用，并标注了强制执行或破坏其安全性的代码库代码。利用CASE-Bench，我们对比了13种上下文构建方法、6种控制措施以及6种LLM，编辑了单个上下文元素，并分析了编码智能体的轨迹。我们发现：（1）功能导向的上下文将功能通过率提高了最多8.2个百分点，但安全通过率最多仅提高3.7个百分点；（2）扣除安全防护措施会使安全通过率降低最多8.1个百分点，而插入一个不安全的示例会使正确但可利用的代码增加6.3个百分点；（3）编码智能体仅在27-36%的轨迹中观察到了相关的安全防护。这些发现为安全感知的上下文构建和安全代码评估提供了参考。
tldr: 论文通过新基准研究发现，大语言模型的代码库上下文构建严重影响生成代码的安全性，功能导向的上下文未能充分保障安全性，甚至可能引入漏洞。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地构建了代码库级别的安全基准CASE-Bench，深入探讨了代码库上下文对大语言模型生成代码安全性的双向影响，填补了该领域的空白，对未来面向安全的上下文构建和代码评估具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的代码库上下文构建主要针对功能正确性，安全代码基准将上下文视为固定，导致代码库上下文如何影响LLM生成代码的安全性尚不明确。
method: 构建了包含145个来自真实CVE的项目级任务基准CASE-Bench（包含Docker环境、功能测试和双向验证的PoC漏洞利用）；评估了13种上下文构建方法、6种控制措施以及6种LLM；编辑单个上下文元素并分析了编码智能体的轨迹。
results: 1) 功能导向的上下文能将功能通过率提高最多8.2个百分点，但安全通过率最多仅提高3.7个百分点；2) 扣除安全防护措施会使安全通过率降低最多8.1个百分点，而插入一个不安全的示例会使正确但可利用的代码增加6.3个百分点；3) 编码智能体在仅27-36%的轨迹中观察到了相关的安全防护。
conclusion: 功能导向的上下文构建虽然能提高代码功能正确性，但对安全性帮助有限，甚至可能引入漏洞。论文强调了开发安全感知上下文构建方法和安全代码评估机制的必要性。

title: Corridor-Based Monitoring and Emergency Braking Decision for Automated Vehicle Safety
authors: Junnan Pan, Vladislav Nenchev, Mohak Mansharamani, Prodromos Sotiriadis, Ferdinand Englberger
abstract: This paper addresses emergency-braking decisions for a redundant safety channel in automated vehicles. The channel is responsible for identifying hazards from sensor data and determining whether braking is necessary, given the constrained computational resources of embedded hardware. We present an emergency-braking approach that uses a predicted motion corridor to filter \ac{lidar} measurements and then decide whether the ego vehicle must brake. \ac{pmcm} constructs a curvature-aware boundary from the planned path and vehicle geometry so that the monitored region contains the full swept body on both straight and curved paths. \ac{gdeta} then decides whether the ego vehicle must command an emergency brake for objects inside this boundary, scoring geometric occupancy and temporal urgency independently. Hard gates permit braking when either source is conclusive; soft-OR arbitration combines partial evidence when neither gate is active. Consecutive-scan confirmation reduces sensitivity to transient measurement noise. Corridor coverage is evaluated in controlled collision simulations and recorded campus driving. Braking decisions are evaluated in Monte Carlo simulations of lead-vehicle braking and transverse-crossing encounters.
comment: Submitted to a Springer Nature journal for peer review as an extended version of a paper presented at VEHITS, for consideration in the Special Issue
zh_title: 自动驾驶安全基于走廊的监测与紧急制动决策
translation: 本文探讨了自动驾驶汽车中冗余安全通道的紧急制动决策问题。该通道负责在嵌入式硬件受限的计算资源下，从传感器数据中识别危险并决定是否有必要进行制动。我们提出了一种紧急制动方法，该方法使用预测的运动走廊来过滤激光雷达测量值，然后决定自车是否必须制动。PMCM从规划的路径和车辆几何形状构建一个考虑曲率的边界，以便监测区域在直道和弯道上都包含完整的扫过车体。随后，GDETA根据边界内的物体独立评分几何占用率和时间紧迫性，以决定自车是否必须发出紧急制动指令。硬门限允许在任一来源具有决定性时进行制动；当两个门限都不活跃时，软OR仲裁组合部分证据。连续扫描确认减少了对瞬态测量噪声的敏感性。走廊覆盖率在受控碰撞仿真和记录的校园驾驶中进行了评估。制动决策在领先车辆制动和横向穿行遭遇的蒙特卡洛仿真中进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对自动驾驶车辆冗余安全通道的走廊式激光雷达监测与双准则紧急制动决策方案，有效平衡了计算资源与安全性。
ai_comments: 本文提出了一种针对自动驾驶冗余安全通道的走廊式监测与紧急制动决策方法，创新点在于结合了几何占用率和时间紧迫性的独立评分与软硬门限仲裁机制，并通过连续扫描确认降低了噪声敏感性，对嵌入式硬件的有限计算资源具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 为了解决自动驾驶汽车中冗余安全通道在受嵌入式硬件计算资源约束下，如何准确识别危险并决定是否进行紧急制动的问题。
method: 提出了一种使用预测运动走廊（PMCM）过滤激光雷达测量数据的方法，并利用几何深度与时间紧急度评估算法（GDETA）独立评分，通过硬门限和软OR仲裁机制结合证据，同时采用连续扫描确认来减少瞬态测量噪声。
results: 走廊覆盖率在受控碰撞仿真和实际校园驾驶记录中得到了评估，制动决策则在前方车辆制动和横向穿行场景的蒙特卡洛仿真中进行了评估，结果验证了该方法的有效性。
conclusion: 该方法通过基于预测运动走廊的激光雷达数据过滤和双准则制动决策，有效提升了自动驾驶车辆在复杂场景下的安全性和冗余通道的可靠性。

title: Multi-Resident Data Association in Smart Homes via MDP Modeling and Behavior Cloning
authors: Xi Chen, Julien Cumin, Fano Ramparany, Dominique Vaufreydaz
abstract: Ambient sensors offer a privacy-preserving solution for activity recognition in smart homes, yet they face a critical challenge in multi-resident environments known as Data Association, which aims to identify the resident triggering a specific anonymous sensor event. Existing approaches fundamentally fail to maintain global consistency by often yielding conflicting associations for silent residents. Additionally, these methods frequently suffer from severe trajectory fragmentation caused by the ontological mismatch of applying continuous physical motion models to discrete logical behaviors. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework that reformulates data association as a sequential decision-making task within a Markov Decision Process (MDP). We solve the defined MDP via Behavior Cloning (BC) to avoid complex reward engineering by directly learning from expert demonstrations. We instantiate the policy using two complementary architectures, including a lightweight Transformer that treats association as a multi-label classification task over linearized event histories, and a fine-tuned Large Language Model (LLM) that reformulates the problem as conditional text generation to leverage pre-trained semantic knowledge. Extensive evaluations on three diverse datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, particularly in resolving concurrent multi-resident events. Furthermore, the LLM-based policy shows preliminary cross-environment transfer potential under benchmark settings, while its robustness in real deployments still requires further validation.
zh_title: 基于MDP建模与行为克隆的智能家居多居民数据关联
translation: 环境传感器为智能家居中的活动识别提供了一种保护隐私的解决方案，但它们在多居民环境中面临着一个被称为数据关联的严峻挑战，该挑战旨在识别触发特定匿名传感器事件的居民。现有方法从根本上无法保持全局一致性，经常对静默居民产生冲突的关联。此外，由于将连续物理运动模型应用于离散逻辑行为的本体论不匹配，这些方法经常遭受严重的轨迹碎片化。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，将数据关联重新表述为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中的序列决策任务。我们通过行为克隆（BC）求解定义的MDP，通过直接从专家演示中学习来避免复杂的奖励工程。我们使用两种互补的架构来实例化该策略：一种是将关联视为线性化事件历史上的多标签分类任务的轻量级Transformer，另一种是将问题重新表述为条件文本生成以利用预训练语义知识的微调大语言模型（LLM）。在三个不同数据集上的广泛评估表明，我们的方法显著优于最先进的基线，特别是在解决并发多居民事件方面。此外，基于LLM的策略在基准设置下显示出初步的跨环境迁移潜力，但其在实际部署中的鲁棒性仍需进一步验证。
tldr: 论文提出了一种基于马尔可夫决策过程和行为克隆的智能家居多居民数据关联新框架，利用Transformer和LLM策略有效解决了数据关联中的全局一致性和轨迹碎片化难题。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将多居民智能家居数据关联问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并利用行为克隆（BC）进行求解，避免了复杂的奖励设计。同时结合了轻量级Transformer和大语言模型（LLM），在解决并发事件和保持全局一致性方面表现出显著优势。
motivation: 现有的多居民智能家居数据关联方法无法保持全局一致性，且由于将连续物理运动模型应用于离散逻辑行为而导致严重的轨迹碎片化问题，因此需要一种新的框架来解决这些局限性。
method: 将数据关联重新表述为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中的序列决策任务，通过行为克隆（BC）从专家演示中直接学习；并实例化了两种架构：轻量级Transformer（多标签分类）和微调的大语言模型（条件文本生成）。
results: 在三个不同数据集上的广泛评估表明，该方法显著优于最新的基线方法，特别是在解决并发多居民事件方面；基于LLM的策略在基准设置下还表现出初步的跨环境迁移潜力。
conclusion: 该论文提出的基于MDP和行为克隆的新框架有效解决了智能家居中的多居民数据关联问题，在多个数据集上显著优于现有基线方法，并展现出一定的跨环境迁移潜力。

title: The Split Protocol Decides the Result: Re-Evaluating Encrypted Traffic Classification
authors: Mayan Sharma, Kriti Saini, Devansh Behl
abstract:
Encrypted traffic classifiers are routinely reported at 95-99% accuracy. We show that on one of two public corpora, the same model and code score macro-F1 0.992 under the evaluation protocol standard in the literature and 0.567 under a protocol that keeps flows from one packet capture on one side of the split. Nothing changes but the partition (gap 0.426 over eight seeds, p = 0.008 after Holm-Bonferroni correction).
  The inflation is not a property of random splitting as such. On a month of backbone QUIC traffic, we evaluate five split protocols at eight seeds each: random, temporal and client-disjoint splitting are statistically indistinguishable from session-disjoint, while server-disjoint splitting costs 0.192 macro-F1 (d = 17.0, p = 0.008). Which axis matters depends on how the corpus was collected, in a way invisible from its label space.
  We give a diagnostic that identifies the right axis before any model is trained: single-identifier probes. A decision tree on the capture identifier alone reaches 0.983 under a random split and exactly 0.000 under session-disjoint splitting.
  Under this evaluation, a metric-trained flow embedding leads four deep baselines but does not beat gradient-boosted trees on twenty packet sizes. Five of our own pre-registered architectural claims fail: distance-based rejection of unknown applications beats softmax thresholding, but ablating every metric objective makes rejection better, because class separation correlates at r = -0.88 with rejection quality. Few-shot enrollment is flat within a corpus but, across corpora, five labelled flows per class recover 91% of the deficit left by failed zero-shot transfer.
  All splits, results, code and negative findings are released.
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables Code and data splits: https://github.com/Mayan10/Flowconx
zh_title: 划分协议决定结果：加密流量分类的重新评估
translation:
加密流量分类器的准确率通常被报道在95-99%之间。我们发现，在两个公共语料库之一上，相同的模型和代码在文献中标准的评估协议下得出的宏观F1分数为0.992，而在将来自一个数据包捕获的流保持在划分一侧的协议下得出的分数为0.567。除了划分方式之外，没有任何改变（经过8个随机种子测试，差距达0.426，Holm-Bonferroni校正后p = 0.008）。
这种性能膨胀并不是随机划分本身的属性。在一个月的骨干网QUIC流量上，我们以8个随机种子评估了五种划分协议：随机划分、时间划分和客户端不相交划分在统计上与会话不相交划分无异，而服务端不相交划分则损失了0.192的宏观F1（d = 17.0，p = 0.008）。哪个维度重要取决于语料库的收集方式，而这在其标签空间中是不可见的。
我们提供了一种在训练任何模型之前就能识别正确维度的诊断方法：单标识符探测。仅基于捕获标识符的决策树在随机划分下达到0.983的准确率，而在会话不相交划分下正好为0.000。
在此评估下，度量训练的流嵌入优于四个深度基线，但在二十个数据包大小上打不过梯度提升树。我们自己预注册的五个架构声明中有五个失效：基于距离的未知应用拒绝优于softmax阈值，但消融每一个度量目标会使拒绝效果更好，因为类分离与拒绝质量呈r = -0.88的负相关。少样本注册在一个语料库内部表现平平，但在跨语料库时，每个类五个标记流恢复了零样本迁移失败所遗留缺陷的91%。
所有的划分、结果、代码和负面发现均已开源。
tldr: 加密流量分类中高达99%的准确率往往是由不当的数据划分协议导致的虚高，作者通过新协议和诊断工具揭示了这一现象并进行了重新评估。
ai_comments: 该论文深入剖析了加密流量分类中评估协议对实验结果的决定性影响，揭示了数据划分方式如何导致准确率虚高，并提出了单标识符探测等实用的诊断方法，具有重要的实证价值和对未来研究的警示意义。
motivation: 当前加密流量分类器在文献中经常报告高达95-99%的准确率，但作者怀疑这些高性能可能归因于不当的评估协议（即数据划分方式），而非模型本身的泛化能力。
method: 在两个公共语料库和骨干网QUIC流量上，使用多种划分协议测试相同模型；提出单标识符探测（single-identifier probes）作为诊断工具；对比了深度学习基线、梯度提升树及提出的度量训练流嵌入方法。
results: 不当的划分协议会导致高达0.426的F1分数虚高；单标识符探测能有效诊断划分带来的偏见；传统梯度提升树在特定特征下不逊于复杂的深度学习模型；多项预注册的架构改进被证明无效。
conclusion: 加密流量分类的评估严重依赖于数据划分协议。恰当的划分协议（如session/client/temporal-disjoint）和诊断工具（如单标识符探测）对于避免性能虚高和实现真实场景下的泛化至关重要。

title: Beyond Scene Shortcuts: Action-Centric Video-Text Alignment for Fine-Grained Action Understanding
authors: Zhiliang Zhu, Jiazheng Huang, Dawei Zhao
abstract: Fine-grained action understanding requires vision-language models to ground what an agent does, how it acts, and why it acts in spatio-temporal evidence. However, richer supervision can backfire: fine-tuned models may generate detailed action descriptions grounded in static scenes and salient objects rather than motion, a failure we call Environment-Grounded Action Hallucination (EGAH). To mitigate EGAH, we propose Staged Attention Rectification and Reinforcement (STARR), an action-centric video-text alignment framework that breaks scene-action shortcuts through Action-Environment Dissociation and reinforces action-focused grounding with an Attention Consistency Reward within Group Relative Policy Optimization. We further construct FineActionR&R, combining temporally localized captions with hierarchical and temporal-causal reasoning data. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, FineActionVLM-R1 improves average MotionBench accuracy by 3.01 percentage points over its base model and achieves 91.50% on HAU-MCQ-Bench. Qualitative comparisons further indicate more faithful fine-grained action descriptions with fewer environment-induced hallucinations.
zh_title: 超越场景捷径：面向细粒度动作理解的以动作核心的视频-文本对齐
translation: 细粒度动作理解要求视觉语言模型在时空证据中准确 grounding 代理做了什么、如何行动以及为何行动。然而，更丰富的监督可能会适得其反：微调后的模型可能会生成基于静态场景和显著物体而非运动的详细动作描述，我们将这种失败称为环境引导的动作幻觉（EGAH）。为了缓解EGAH，我们提出了阶段性注意力纠正与强化（STARR），这是一个以动作核心的视频-文本对齐框架，通过动作-环境解耦打破场景-动作捷径，并在群相对策略优化中使用注意力一致性奖励来强化以动作聚焦的 grounding。我们进一步构建了FineActionR&R，它将时间局部化字幕与分层和时序因果推理数据相结合。基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B构建的FineActionVLM-R1将MotionBench的平均准确率比基础模型提高了3.01个百分点，并在HAU-MCQ-Bench上达到了91.50%。定性比较进一步表明，它能够生成更忠实的细粒度动作描述，且受环境诱发的幻觉更少。
tldr: 本文提出了STARR框架和FineActionR&R数据集，通过动作-环境解耦与强化学习解决了视频大模型中的动作幻觉问题，显著提升了细粒度动作理解能力。
ai_comments: 该论文针对多模态大模型在细粒度动作理解中容易依赖环境背景而非运动本身的缺陷（环境引导的动作幻觉，EGAH），提出了STARR框架和FineActionR&R数据集，有效提升了模型对动作的时空定位与推理能力。方法设计兼顾了解耦与强化学习奖励，具有较强的创新性和实用价值。
motivation: 细粒度动作理解要求视觉语言模型在时空证据上精准定位动作内容，但现有的丰富监督往往导致微调模型依赖静态场景和显著物体而非运动本身，产生“环境引导的动作幻觉（EGAH）”。
method: 提出Staged Attention Rectification and Reinforcement (STARR)框架，通过动作-环境解耦打破场景-动作捷径，并利用群相对策略优化中的注意力一致性奖励来强化动作聚焦的定位；同时构建了包含时序定位字幕及层次化、时序因果推理数据的FineActionR&R数据集。
results: 基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B构建的FineActionVLM-R1在MotionBench上的平均准确率比基础模型提升了3.01个百分点，在HAU-MCQ-Bench上达到了91.50%的准确率，且定性比较显示其环境引起的幻觉更少。
conclusion: 通过STARR框架和FineActionR&R数据集，成功解决了多模态模型中的动作幻觉问题，显著提升了细粒度动作理解的准确性。

title: An Engineering Reading of the Bounded Halting Problem and Observable Properties of a Universal Machine
authors: Sergey Salishev
abstract: The halting problem asks whether a program eventually halts, with unrestricted resources. Engineering systems instead certify bounded halting: given a program, an input, and a step budget T, decide whether the program halts within T steps. This paper studies two of its uses. First, it defines an exact finite-budget problem, placing the simulated program and the checker on the same unit-cost timescale, so the checker can be embedded in an adversarial program. A diagonal argument with explicit additive overhead shows that no fixed deterministic checker decides every instance within any fixed fraction of T below one, for large T. In the nondeterministic case, T bounds the branch depth allowed for a stable observable decision. Second, bounded-halting instances give adversarial tests for finitary universality, since a universal model must support arbitrary finite computations as T grows. The tests check resource growth with T, the absence of a fixed deliberation bound, and later access to intermediate data. They separate a fixed model with extendable external resources, a model family that grows with T, and a larger system built around a fixed component. For machine-learning systems, this identifies the resource growth a universality claim assumes and whether it fails for deployed models.

title: The Exact Memory-Rate Tradeoff for Three-User Secure Coded Caching
authors: Han Fang, Nan Liu, Wei Kang
abstract: We determine the exact zero-error memory-rate tradeoff for secure coded caching with three users and any number $N\ge2$ of independent files. Each user recovers its requested file, while its cache and the broadcast jointly reveal no information about the complete tuple of unrequested files. For $N\ge4$, two converse inequalities establish the optimality of the known achievable points and the memory-sharing segments between them. For $N=3$, two additional bounds identify a new corner at $(M,R)=(3/2,2)$, where memory and rate are measured in file units. An explicit linear code over $\mathbb{F}_3$ attains this corner and reduces the rate by one quarter of a file relative to memory sharing between the known points. The converse links the information held by cache pairs and triples to delivery under repeated and distinct requests. Its equality conditions guide the construction: users cancel the keys to recover their requested files, while uniform masking protects the complete tuple of unrequested files.

title: When Does Risk-Controlled Throughput Forecasting Actually Control Risk? A Reproduction Study on LEO Satellite Link
authors: Mayan Sharma, Kriti Saini, Devansh Behl, Suganya R, S. Vijayaragavan
abstract: Risk-budgeted throughput forecasting converts a point forecast of LEO satellite capacity into a conservative bound whose overestimation rate is held at a user-specified budget, so that admission control can act on it safely. We reproduce the state of the art, BG-CFQS, on the three Starlink traces its authors used and on an independent fourth dataset, and report four findings. First, its risk guarantee is reproducible but conditional on the calibration split: under a random split we recover every published quantity, including risk-pass on 3 of 3 datasets, but under a contiguous temporal split, which is what a deployed terminal faces, it holds on 1 of 3. Second, independent of any split, the method cannot serve a risk budget below 0.15, the low end of its candidate quantile set. On all four datasets the achieved rate is identical at budgets of 0.05, 0.10 and 0.15, overshooting by 1.4x to 3.7x at the tightest. Third, static conformal calibration cannot improve a ranking, only shift an operating point; we confirm this exactly on latency spike detection, where online calibration improves AUPRC by up to 51%. Fourth, group-conditional online recalibration splits into two mechanisms. The online part replicates: it tracks the budget within 1% from 0.05 to 0.35, where static calibration is 16 to 21% off. The group-conditional part does not: on three of four datasets, conditioning on any available covariate, including measured serving-satellite geometry, is worse than not conditioning, and our attempt to predict which datasets benefit failed. What is new here is empirical, not algorithmic: we claim the findings, not the methods.
zh_title: 当风险受控的吞吐量预测能够真正控制风险时？一项关于 LEO 卫星链路的重现研究
