zh_title: 语义自洽性：通过语义加权增强语言模型推理
translation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在许多任务上的性能得到了迅速提升，但它们在推理任务上往往仍有不足。随着LLMs越来越广泛地集成到各种现实世界的任务中，提升其推理能力对于其在处理细微、复杂问题时的有效性至关重要。Wang等人的自洽性框架表明，在进行多数表决之前采样多个推理过程（rationales），可以可靠地提升模型在各种闭卷答案推理任务中的性能。基于该框架的标准方法聚合了这些推理过程的最终决策，但未能利用详细步骤推理路径中包含的语义信息。我们的工作引入了语义自洽性，通过在多数表决前不仅纳入这些推理过程的最终决策，还纳入并分析它们的推理路径，从而改进了这一方法。这些方法不仅提高了推理路径的可靠性，还使模型在复杂的推理任务上具有更稳健的性能。
tldr: 本文提出语义自洽性方法，通过结合推理路径的语义信息与最终决策，显著提升了大型语言模型在复杂推理任务上的推理能力与稳健性。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的语义自洽性方法，克服了传统多数表决忽略中间推理路径语义信息的缺陷，对于提升大型语言模型在复杂推理任务中的可靠性和稳健性具有重要意义。
motivation: 尽管大型语言模型在许多任务上表现出色但在推理任务上仍显不足，且现有的自洽性框架（如Wang等人提出的方法）仅聚合最终决策，未能充分利用逐步推理路径中的语义信息。
method: 引入语义自洽性（Semantic Self-Consistency）方法，在进行多数表决前，不仅考虑最终决策，还纳入并分析推理路径中的语义信息。
results: 实验或研究表明，该方法不仅提高了推理路径的可靠性，还使模型在复杂推理任务上表现出更强的稳健性。
conclusion: 通过结合推理路径的语义信息与最终决策，语义自洽性框架有效提升了大型语言模型在复杂推理任务中的性能和可靠性。

title: AI Ethics by Design: Implementing Customizable Guardrails for Responsible AI Development
authors: Kristina Šekrst, Jeremy McHugh, Jonathan Rodriguez Cefalu
abstract: This paper explores the development of an ethical guardrail framework for AI systems, emphasizing the importance of customizable guardrails that align with diverse user values and underlying ethics. We address the challenges of AI ethics by proposing a structure that integrates rules, policies, and AI assistants to ensure responsible AI behavior, while comparing the proposed framework to the existing state-of-the-art guardrails. By focusing on practical mechanisms for implementing ethical standards, we aim to enhance transparency, user autonomy, and continuous improvement in AI systems. Our approach accommodates ethical pluralism, offering a flexible and adaptable solution for the evolving landscape of AI governance. The paper concludes with strategies for resolving conflicts between ethical directives, underscoring the present and future need for robust, nuanced and context-aware AI systems.
zh_title: 设计中的AI伦理：为负责任的AI开发实现可定制的防护栏
translation: 本文探讨了AI系统道德防护栏框架的开发，强调了与不同用户价值观和潜在伦理相一致的可定制防护栏的重要性。我们通过提出一个整合规则、政策和AI助手的结构来应对AI伦理的挑战，以确保负责任的AI行为，同时将提出的框架与现有最先进的防护栏进行了比较。通过聚焦于实现伦理标准的实用机制，我们旨在增强AI系统的透明度、用户自主性和持续改进能力。我们的方法适应了伦理多元主义，为不断演变的AI治理格局提供了一个灵活且适应性强的解决方案。最后，本文总结了解决伦理指令冲突的策略，强调了当前和未来对稳健、细致且具上下文感知能力的AI系统的需求。
tldr: 提出了一种用于AI开发的可定制道德防护栏框架，以适应多样化的伦理价值并提升AI系统的透明度和治理能力。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种通过设计融入AI伦理的框架，强调了可定制的防护栏（guardrails）以适应多样化的用户价值观，对于负责任的AI治理具有较强的实用价值。
motivation: 为了应对AI伦理挑战，开发一个能够适应多样化用户价值观和底层伦理的道德防护栏框架，以增强AI系统的透明度、用户自主性和持续改进能力。
method: 提出了一种集成规则、政策和AI助手的结构框架，将其与现有最先进的防护栏进行对比，并探讨了解决伦理指令冲突的策略。
results: 构建了一个能够容纳伦理多元主义、灵活且适应性强的AI治理解决方案，为实现负责任的AI开发提供了实用的机制。
conclusion: 该论文通过提出一个集成规则、政策和AI助手的可定制防护栏框架，有效应对了AI伦理和治理中的复杂挑战，并为解决伦理指令冲突提供了策略。

title: Heterogeneous Graph Attention Network With Multimodal Feature Selection for Cancer Multiomics Integration
authors: Sina Tabakhi, Charlotte Vandermeulen, Ian Sudbery, Haiping Lu
abstract: The increase in high-dimensional multiomics data demands advanced integration models to capture the complexity of human diseases. Graph-based deep learning integration models, despite their promise, struggle with small patient cohorts and high-dimensional features, often applying independent feature selection without modeling relationships among omics. Furthermore, conventional graph-based omics models focus on homogeneous graphs, lacking multiple types of nodes and edges to capture diverse structures. We introduce a Heterogeneous Graph ATtention network for omics integration (HeteroGATomics) to improve cancer diagnosis. HeteroGATomics performs multimodal feature selection through a multi-agent system, creating dedicated networks of feature and patient similarity for each omics modality. These networks are then combined into one heterogeneous graph for learning holistic omics-specific representations and integrating predictions across modalities. Experiments on three cancer multiomics datasets show that HeteroGATomics outperforms baseline methods across most evaluation metrics in cancer diagnosis. External validation on an independent breast cancer cohort further demonstrates its generalizability, where HeteroGATomics outperforms graph-based multiomics integration methods across evaluation metrics. Moreover, HeteroGATomics enhances interpretability by identifying important biomarkers contributing to the diagnosis outcomes.
zh_title: 基于多模态特征选择的异构图注意力网络用于癌症多组学整合
translation: 高维多omics数据的增加需要先进的整合模型来捕捉人类疾病的复杂性。尽管基于图的深度学习整合模型很有前景，但它们在处理小患者队列和高维特征时往往力不从心，且通常在不建模omics间关系的情况下应用独立的特征选择。此外，传统的基于omics的图模型侧重于同质图，缺乏多种类型的节点和边来捕获不同的结构。我们引入了一种用于omics整合的异构图注意力网络（HeteroGATomics）以改善癌症诊断。HeteroGATomics通过多智能体系统执行多模态特征选择，为每个omics模态创建专用的特征和患者相似性网络。然后，这些网络被组合成一个异构图，用于学习整体的omics特定表示并跨模态整合预测。在三个癌症多omics数据集上的实验表明，HeteroGATomics在癌症诊断的大多数评估指标上优于基线方法。在一个独立乳腺癌队列上的外部验证进一步证明了其泛化能力，其中HeteroGATomics在评估指标上优于基于图的多omics整合方法。此外，HeteroGATomics通过识别有助于诊断结果的重要生物标志物增强了可解释性。
tldr: 提出了一种名为 HeteroGATomics 的异构图注意力网络，通过多模态特征选择整合癌症多组学数据，显著提升了癌症诊断性能和可解释性。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将异构图注意力网络与多智能体特征选择相结合，解决了多组学数据整合中特征维度高、样本量小的难题，同时具备良好的可解释性。
motivation: 现有的基于图的深度学习多组学整合模型在面对小样本队列和高维特征时表现不佳，通常采用独立的特征选择而未对组学间的关系进行建模，且传统的组学模型主要关注缺乏多样化节点和边结构的同质图。
method: 提出了一种名为 HeteroGATomics 的异构图注意力网络，利用多智能体系统进行多模态特征选择，为每种组学模态构建特征和患者相似性专用网络，并将其组合成一个异构图来学习整体的组学特定表示并在模态间整合预测结果。
results: 在三个癌症多组学数据集上的实验表明，HeteroGATomics 在大多数癌症诊断评估指标上优于基线方法；在独立乳腺癌队列上的外部验证也证明了其良好的泛化能力，同时该方法还能通过识别重要的生物标志物来增强可解释性。
conclusion: HeteroGATomics 为癌症多组学整合提供了一个强大且可解释的异构图深度学习框架，有效提升了癌症诊断的准确性和泛化能力。

title: Towards Optimal Multi-draft Speculative Decoding
authors: Zhengmian Hu, Tong Zheng, Vignesh Viswanathan, Ziyi Chen, Ryan A. Rossi, Yihan Wu, Dinesh Manocha, Heng Huang
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become an indispensable part of natural language processing tasks. However, autoregressive sampling has become an efficiency bottleneck. Multi-Draft Speculative Decoding (MDSD) is a recent approach where, when generating each token, a small draft model generates multiple drafts, and the target LLM verifies them in parallel, ensuring that the final output conforms to the target model distribution. The two main design choices in MDSD are the draft sampling method and the verification algorithm. For a fixed draft sampling method, the optimal acceptance rate is a solution to an optimal transport problem, but the complexity of this problem makes it difficult to solve for the optimal acceptance rate and measure the gap between existing verification algorithms and the theoretical upper bound. This paper discusses the dual of the optimal transport problem, providing a way to efficiently compute the optimal acceptance rate. For the first time, we measure the theoretical upper bound of MDSD efficiency for vocabulary sizes in the thousands and quantify the gap between existing verification algorithms and this bound. We also compare different draft sampling methods based on their optimal acceptance rates. Our results show that the draft sampling method strongly influences the optimal acceptance rate, with sampling without replacement outperforming sampling with replacement. Additionally, existing verification algorithms do not reach the theoretical upper bound for both without replacement and with replacement sampling. Our findings suggest that carefully designed draft sampling methods can potentially improve the optimal acceptance rate and enable the development of verification algorithms that closely match the theoretical upper bound.
zh_title: 迈向最优多草稿推测解码
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已成为自然语言处理任务不可或缺的一部分。然而，自回归采样已成为效率瓶颈。多草稿推测解码（MDSD）是一种新方法，在该方法中，生成每个token时，小型草稿模型生成多个草稿，目标LLM并行验证这些草稿，以确保最终输出符合目标模型分布。MDSD的两个主要设计选择是草稿采样方法和验证算法。对于固定的草稿采样方法，最优接受率是最优传输问题的解，但该问题的复杂度使得求解最优接受率以及衡量现有验证算法与理论上限之间的差距变得困难。本文讨论了最优传输问题的对偶性，提供了一种高效计算最优接受率的方法。我们首次在数千词表规模下测量了MDSD效率的理论上限，并量化了现有验证算法与该上限之间的差距。我们还根据最优接受率比较了不同的草稿采样方法。我们的结果表明，草稿采样方法对最优接受率有强烈影响，无放回采样的表现优于有放回采样。此外，现有的验证算法在无放回和有放回采样中均未达到理论上限。我们的研究结果表明，精心设计的草稿采样方法有望提高最优接受率，并促进能够紧密匹配理论上限的验证算法的开发。
tldr: 本文通过研究最优传输问题的对偶性，首次高效计算了多草稿推测解码在千级词表下的效率理论上限，并量化了现有算法的差距。
ai_comments: 该论文通过对多草稿推测解码（MDSD）的最优传输问题建立对偶性，首次实现了大规模词表下MDSD效率理论上限的高效计算。其发现对指导未来更优的草稿采样方法和验证算法设计具有重要意义。
motivation: 多草稿推测解码（MDSD）中计算最优接受率的最优传输问题复杂度极高，导致难以求解最优接受率并衡量现有验证算法与理论上限之间的差距。
method: 通过探讨多草稿推测解码中与固定草稿采样方法相关最优传输问题的对偶性，高效计算最优接受率，并在数千词表规模下衡量理论上限。
results: 首次计算出数千词表规模下MDSD效率的理论上限，量化了现有验证算法与该上限的差距，并发现无放回采样的性能优于有放回采样。
conclusion: 草稿采样方法对最优接受率有强烈影响（无放回采样优于有放回采样），且现有验证算法均未达到理论上限，这为未来更优算法的设计指明了方向。

title: Design of an Underwater Vehicle With Orientation-Adjustable Thrusters and Adaptive Tracking Control
authors: Yifei Wang, Shihan Kong, Zhanhua Xin, Kaiwei Zhu, Junzhi Yu
abstract: Unmanned underwater vehicles (UUVs) are essential for marine exploration and research. However, conventional designs often struggle with limited maneuverability in complex and dynamic underwater environments. This paper presents an orientation-adjustable thruster UUV (OAT-UUV) with vector thrusters, enabling full six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) motion. and composite maneuvers. To overcome challenges associated with uncertain model parameters and environmental disturbances, a vision-based tracking control system based on a novel feedforward adaptive model predictive controller (FF-AMPC) is proposed to achieve robust object tracking, which integrates realtime state feedback with adaptive parameter updating. Extensive experiments, including closed-loop tracking and composite motion tests in real-world environment, have been conducted. The obtained results demonstrate that the orientation-adjustable propulsion design significantly improves the underwater maneuverability, while the FF-AMPC controller achieves a 49.1% hovering improvement compared to conventional controller.
zh_title: 具有方向可调推进器及自适应跟踪控制的水下机器人设计
translation: 水下无人航行器（UUV）对于海洋探测和研究至关重要。然而，传统设计在复杂多变的水下环境中往往面临机动性受限的问题。本文提出了一种采用矢量推进器的方向可调推进器UUV（OAT-UUV），可实现完整的六自由度（6-DOF）运动和复合机动。为了克服模型参数不确定性和环境干扰带来的挑战，提出了一种基于新型前馈自适应模型预测控制器（FF-AMPC）的视觉跟踪控制系统，以实现鲁棒的目标跟踪，该系统集成了实时状态反馈与自适应参数 updating（更新）。在真实环境中进行了包括闭环跟踪和复合运动测试在内的大量实验。所得结果表明，方向可调推进设计显著改善了水下机动性，同时FF-AMPC控制器与传统控制器相比，悬停性能提升了49.1%。
tldr: 本文设计了一种具备六自由度全向运动的新型水下机器人（OAT-UUV），并提出了一种前馈自适应模型预测控制（FF-AMPC）算法，实现了高鲁棒性的视觉跟踪，悬停性能提升了49.1%。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地设计了一种带有方向可调推进器的水下机器人（OAT-UUV），实现了6自由度全向运动，并提出了前馈自适应模型预测控制（FF-AMPC）算法，显著提升了水下运动的机动性和目标跟踪的鲁棒性。其在真实环境中的广泛实验验证了方法的有效性。
motivation: 传统的水下无人航行器（UUV）在复杂多变的水下环境中往往存在机动性受限的问题，无法满足日益复杂的海洋探测和研究需求。
method: 提出了一种方向可调推进器水下机器人（OAT-UUV）硬件设计，并开发了一种基于新颖的前馈自适应模型预测控制器（FF-AMPC）的视觉跟踪控制系统，集成了实时状态反馈与自适应参数更新。
results: 真实环境中的实验结果表明，方向可调推进设计显著提高了水下机动性，且FF-AMPC控制器相比传统控制器实现了49.1%的悬停性能提升。
conclusion: 该论文提出的OAT-UUV及FF-AMPC控制系统显著提升了水下机器人的机动性和视觉跟踪精度，悬停性能较传统控制器提升了49.1%。

title: How to Define the Quality of Data? A Feature-Based Literature Survey
authors: Markus Matoni, Arno Kesper, Gabriele Taentzer
abstract: Data is generated in almost every digital interaction, and using it effectively requires high quality. But what exactly is data quality? The literature offers many, widely diverging answers. This article presents a systematic literature review that screened more than 8,700 records on data quality and identified 35 providing original, dimension-based definitions. Using feature-oriented domain analysis, a feature model of these heterogeneous definitions is derived and used to classify all identified publications. The classification reveals a heterogeneous landscape: despite an ISO standard and a few highly cited quasi-standards, no consensus exists on which quality dimensions to consider or how to define them. As definitions increasingly emerge for specific domains, contexts of use, and new types of data, the respective communities need to deliberately converge on how data quality is defined in their field.
zh_title: 如何定义数据质量？基于特征的文献综述
translation: 数据几乎产生于每一次数字交互中，有效利用数据需要高质量的数据支持。但究竟什么是数据质量？文献提供了许多广泛分歧的答案。本文呈现了一项系统性文献综述，筛选了8700多条关于数据质量的记录，并识别出35个提供原创的、基于维度的定义的文献。利用特征导向的领域分析，推导出一个异构定义的特征模型，并将其用于对所有识别出的出版物进行分类。分类结果揭示了一个异构的景观：尽管有一个ISO标准和少数被高度引用的准标准，但在考虑哪些质量维度或如何定义它们方面，并不存在共识。随着针对特定领域、使用场景和新型数据定义的不断涌现，各个社团需要在其领域内刻意就如何定义数据质量达成一致。
tldr: 通过系统综述8700多条记录，本文发现学术界对数据质量的定义缺乏统一共识，并构建了特征模型对异构定义进行分类。
ai_comments: 该论文通过系统性文献综述和特征导向的领域分析，揭示了数据质量定义在学术界的多样性和缺乏共识的现状，对理解和规范数据质量评估具有重要价值。
motivation: 当前文献中关于“什么是数据质量”存在许多广泛分歧的答案，缺乏统一的定义和共识，因此需要系统梳理现有的数据质量定义。
method: 进行系统性文献综述，筛选了8700多条记录并识别出35个原始的基于维度的定义，运用特征导向的领域分析构建了特征模型并对文献进行分类。
results: 识别出35个原始的数据质量定义并建立特征模型，发现尽管存在ISO标准和少数高引文献，但在考虑哪些质量维度以及如何定义它们方面并没有达成共识。
conclusion: 文献中缺乏统一的数据质量定义，各领域需要针对自身特点和使用场景刻意推进数据质量定义的趋同与统一。

title: DAT: Dynamic Alpha Tuning for Hybrid Retrieval in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Hsin-Ling Hsu, Jerry Wang, Jengnan Tzeng
abstract: Hybrid retrieval techniques in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems enhance information retrieval by combining dense and sparse (e.g., BM25-based) retrieval methods. However, existing approaches struggle with adaptability, as fixed weighting schemes fail to adjust to different queries. To address this, we propose DAT (Dynamic Alpha Tuning), a novel hybrid retrieval framework that dynamically balances dense retrieval and BM25 for each query. DAT leverages a large language model (LLM) to evaluate the effectiveness of the top-1 results from both retrieval methods, assigning an effectiveness score to each. It then calibrates the optimal weighting factor through effectiveness score normalization, ensuring a more adaptive and query-aware weighting between the two approaches. Empirical results show that DAT consistently significantly outperforms fixed-weighting hybrid retrieval methods across various evaluation metrics. Even on smaller models, DAT delivers strong performance, highlighting its efficiency and adaptability.
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. v2 adds Frontier-DAT (Section 7 and Appendix B), which replaces weight prediction with selection over executable retrieval outcomes
zh_title: DAT：检索增强生成中用于混合检索的动态Alpha调整
translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统中的混合检索技术通过结合稠密和稀疏（例如基于BM25的）检索方法来增强信息检索。然而，现有方法在适应性方面存在不足，因为固定权重方案无法针对不同的查询进行调整。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 DAT（动态Alpha调整），这是一个新颖的混合检索框架，能够为每个查询动态平衡稠密检索和BM25。DAT 利用大语言模型（LLM）来评估这两种检索方法中top-1结果的有效性，并为每个结果分配一个有效性分数。然后，它通过有效性分数归一化来校准最优权重因子，从而确保两种方法之间具有更高适应性和查询感知能力的权重分配。实验结果表明，在各种评估指标上，DAT 始终且显著优于固定权重的混合检索方法。即使在较小的模型上，DAT 也能提供强劲的性能，突显了其高效性和适应性。
tldr: 提出了一种名为 DAT 的混合检索框架，利用大语言模型动态调整稠密检索和BM25的权重，从而显著提升RAG系统的检索适应性和性能。
ai_comments: DAT 提出了一种利用大语言模型评估检索结果有效性并动态调整混合检索权重的方法，创新性地解决了RAG中固定权重无法适应不同查询的问题，具有高效和实用价值。
motivation: 现有的RAG混合检索方法采用固定的权重方案，无法根据不同的查询进行自适应调整，导致检索性能受限。
method: 提出 DAT 框架，利用大语言模型评估稠密检索和BM25检索的top-1结果的有效性，并通过有效性分数归一化来动态校准最佳权重因子。
results: 实验结果表明，在各项评估指标上，DAT 始终且显著优于固定权重的混合检索方法，且在较小模型上也能表现出强劲的性能。
conclusion: DAT 框架通过大语言模型动态调整稠密检索和BM25的权重，显著提升了RAG系统中混合检索的适应性和检索性能。

title: Algorithms for the Shortest Vector Problem in $2$-dimensional Lattices, Revisited
authors: Lihao Zhao, Chengliang Tian, Jingguo Bi, Guangwu Xu, Jia Yu
abstract: Efficiently solving the Shortest Vector Problem (SVP) in two-dimensional lattices holds practical significance in cryptography and computational geometry. While simpler than its high-dimensional counterpart, two-dimensional SVP motivates scalable solutions for high-dimensional lattices and benefits applications like sequence cipher cryptanalysis involving large integers. In this work, we first propose a novel definition of reduced bases and develop an efficient adaptive lattice reduction algorithm \textbf{CrossEuc} that strategically applies the Euclidean algorithm across dimensions. Building on this framework, we introduce \textbf{HVec}, a vectorized generalization of the Half-GCD algorithm originally defined for integers, which can efficiently halve the bit-length of two vectors and may have independent interest. By iteratively invoking \textbf{HVec}, our optimized algorithm \textbf{HVecSBP} achieves a reduced basis in $O(\log n M(n) )$ time for arbitrary input bases with bit-length $n$, where $M(n)$ denotes the cost of multiplying two $n$-bit integers. Compared to existing algorithms, our design is applicable to general forms of input lattices, eliminating the cost of pre-converting input bases to Hermite Normal Form (HNF). The comprehensive experimental results demonstrate that for the input lattice bases in HNF, the optimized algorithm \textbf{HVecSBP} achieves at least a $13.5\times$ efficiency improvement compared to existing methods. For general-form input lattice bases, converting them to HNF before applying \textbf{HVecSBP} offers only marginal advantages in extreme cases where the two basis vectors are nearly degenerate. However, as the linear dependency between input basis vectors decreases, directly employing \textbf{HVecSBP} yields increasingly significant efficiency gains, outperforming hybrid approaches that rely on prior \textbf{HNF} conversion.
zh_title: 二维格最短向量问题算法的再探讨
translation: 高效求解二维格上的最短向量问题（SVP）在密码学和计算几何中具有实际意义。虽然二维SVP比高维对应问题更简单，但它为高维格的可扩展解决方案提供了动力，并有利于涉及大整数的序列密码密码分析等应用。在这项工作中，我们首先提出了约化基的新定义，并开发了一种高效的自适应格约化算法 **CrossEuc**，该算法在各个维度上策略性地应用了欧几里得算法。在此框架的基础上，我们引入了 **HVec**，这是最初为整数定义的 Half-GCD 算法的向量化推广，它可以有效地将两个向量的位长减半，可能具有独立的研究价值。通过迭代调用 **HVec**，我们的优化算法 **HVecSBP** 能够在 $O(\log n M(n) )$ 时间内为位长为 $n$ 的任意输入基获得约化基，其中 $M(n)$ 表示两个 $n$ 位整数相乘的成本。与现有算法相比，我们的设计适用于通用形式的输入格，消除了将输入基预先转换为 Hermite Normal Form (HNF) 的成本。全面的实验结果表明，对于 HNF 中的输入格基，与现有方法相比，优化算法 **HVecSBP** 实现了至少 $13.5$ 倍的效率提升。对于一般形式的输入格基，在两个基向量几乎退化的极端情况下，在应用 **HVecSBP** 之前将其转换为 HNF 仅提供微弱的优势。然而，随着输入基向量之间的线性相关性降低，直接使用 **HVecSBP** 会产生越来越显著的效率增益，优于依赖先前 **HNF** 转换的混合方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种用于二维格最短向量问题（SVP）的高效算法HVecSBP，无需HNF预处理，即可实现比现有方法至少13.5倍的效率提升。
ai_comments: 该论文重新审视并改进了二维格的最短向量问题（SVP）算法。创新点在于提出了新的约化基定义、自适应格约化算法CrossEuc以及向量化的Half-GCD算法HVec，显著提升了算法效率，且无需将输入基预转换为Hermite Normal Form（HNF），具有很高的理论价值和实用性。
motivation: 高效求解二维格上的最短向量问题（SVP）在密码学和计算几何中具有实际意义，且能为高维格的可扩展解决方案提供动力并支持序列密码密码分析等应用。现有算法通常需要将输入基预先转换为Hermite Normal Form（HNF），带来了额外的计算开销。
method: 提出了一种新颖的约化基定义和自适应格约化算法CrossEuc；引入了针对整数Half-GCD算法的向量化推广HVec，用于将两个向量的位长减半；通过迭代调用HVec构建了优化算法HVecSBP。
results: 对于HNF形式的输入格子基，优化算法HVecSBP相比现有方法至少实现了13.5倍的效率提升；对于一般形式的输入格子基，直接采用HVecSBP在输入向量线性相关性降低时，表现出越来越显著的效率增益。
conclusion: 本文提出的HVecSBP算法在处理二维格的最短向量问题时展现出极高的效率，特别是在处理一般形式的输入基时，直接应用该算法比依赖HNF预处理的方法具有更显著的性能优势。

title: Matching with Choice: Menu Design for Patient--Provider Assignment
authors: Naveen Raman, Holly Wiberg
abstract: High-quality matches between patients and primary care providers improve downstream health outcomes, yet provider turnover breaks these matches and forces patients to be reassigned. Health systems facing this problem must decide not only which providers to recommend, but how much choice to offer. Direct assignment avoids competition for scarce provider capacity but relies on noisy estimates of patient preferences; broader choice allows patients to correct these estimates using private information but can create costly coordination failures. We study this tradeoff through the design of fixed, personalized menus from which patients choose providers. We show that constructing the optimal menu is NP-hard and establish an information-theoretic lower bound. We find that offering each patient a single provider matches this bound up to a constant factor, while unrestricted choice can perform arbitrarily poorly. However, we show that additional choice improves on single-provider assignment when the system cannot reliably distinguish among a patient's alternatives. We formalize this tradeoff through two forms of loss: menu loss, which arises when menus offer too few options, and coordination loss, which arises when scarce capacity is exposed to too much choice. Motivated by this decomposition, we develop the Scenario-Averaged Marginals (SAM) algorithm, which tailors menus based on provider shadow prices so choice is offered only when utility exceeds the capacity cost. We identify sufficient conditions which SAM's regret matches the lower bound, namely when patients have valuable alternatives and offered menus don't create competition for scarce capacity. In a semi-synthetic environment calibrated to a provider network using Medicare data, SAM improves total utility by up to 19% over single-provider assignment as preference uncertainty grows, while improving utility for the least-served ZIP codes.
zh_title: 带选择的匹配：患者-医生分配的菜单设计
translation: 患者和初级保健医生之间的高质量匹配可以改善下游健康结果，然而医生流动打破了这些匹配并迫使患者重新分配。面对这一问题的医疗系统不仅必须决定推荐哪些医生，还要决定提供多少选择。直接分配避免了对稀缺医生容量的竞争，但依赖于对患者偏好的噪声估计；更广泛的选择允许患者利用私人信息纠正这些估计，但可能导致代价高昂的协调失败。我们通过设计固定、个性化的菜单来研究这种权衡，患者可以从中选择医生。我们证明了构建最优菜单是NP困难的，并建立了信息论下界。我们发现，为每个患者提供单一医生在常数因子内匹配了这一界限，而不受限制的选择表现可能会任意差。然而，我们表明，当系统无法可靠地区分患者的替代方案时，额外的选择可以改善单一医生分配。我们通过两种形式的损失将这种权衡形式化：菜单损失（当菜单提供的选项太少时产生）和协调损失（当稀缺容量暴露于太多选择时产生）。受这种分解的启发，我们开发了情景平均边缘（SAM）算法，该算法根据医生的影子价格定制菜单，因此仅在效用超过容量成本时才提供选择。我们确定了SAM的遗憾匹配下界的充分条件，即当患者有有价值的替代方案且提供的菜单没有对稀缺容量造成竞争时。在使用Medicare数据校准的半合成环境中，随着偏好不确定性的增长，SAM比单医生分配的总效用提高了多达19%，同时改善了服务最少ZIP代码的效用。
tldr: 通过设计个性化菜单平衡选择自由度与容量稀缺，所提出的SAM算法显著提升了医患匹配的总效用并照顾了弱势群体。
ai_comments: 该论文在医疗资源分配和双边匹配领域引入了菜单设计的视角，兼顾了患者偏好不确定性与医生资源稀缺性，理论与实证结合紧密。
motivation: 解决医护人员流动导致的患者重新分配问题，探讨在面对患者偏好信息噪声与医生容量稀缺时，应该为患者提供多大程度的选择空间（即菜单设计）。
method: 提出并研究了固定个性化菜单设计的理论模型，证明了其NP困难性，建立了信息论下界，并开发了基于影子价格的情景平均边缘（SAM）算法。
results: 研究发现，提供单一提供者在常数因子内匹配了下界，而无限制选择表现可能任意差；当系统无法可靠区分备选时，适度增加选择可提升效用。SAM算法在模拟实验中比单提供者分配方案提升了高达19%的总效用，并改善了医疗服务匮乏地区的效用。
conclusion: 通过引入SAM算法，论文成功平衡了菜单损失与协调损失，在理论上接近最优界，并在半合成数据中验证了其在提升总效用和改善弱势群体待遇方面的有效性。

title: Scalable and adaptive prediction bands with kernel sum-of-squares
authors: Louis Allain, S{é}bastien da Veiga, Brian Staber
abstract: Conformal Prediction (CP) is a popular framework for constructing prediction bands with valid coverage in finite samples, while being free of any distributional assumption. A well-known limitation of conformal prediction is the lack of adaptivity, although several works introduced practically efficient alternate procedures. In this work, we build upon recent ideas that rely on recasting the CP problem as a statistical learning problem, directly targeting coverage and adaptivity. This statistical learning problem is based on reproducible kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHS) and kernel sum-of-squares (SoS) methods. First, we extend previous results with a general representer theorem and exhibit the dual formulation of the learning problem. Crucially, such dual formulation can be solved efficiently by accelerated gradient methods with several hundreds or thousands of samples, unlike previous strategies based on off-the-shelf semidefinite programming algorithms. Second, we introduce a new hyperparameter tuning strategy tailored specifically to target adaptivity through bounds on test-conditional coverage. This strategy, based on the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC), is introduced here to tune kernel lengthscales in our framework, but has broader applicability since it could be used in any CP algorithm where the score function is learned. Finally, extensive experiments are conducted to show how our method compares to related work. All figures can be reproduced with the accompanying code at \href{https://www.gitlab.com/drti/ksos-bands}{gitlab.com/drti/ksos-bands}.
zh_title: 基于核平方和的可扩展自适应预测带
translation: 保形预测（CP）是一种流行的框架，用于构建在有限样本下具有有效覆盖且不受任何分布假设限制的预测带。CP的一个众所周知的局限性是缺乏自适应性，尽管几项工作引入了实际高效的替代程序。在这项工作中，我们基于最近的想法，将CP问题重新构建为一个统计学习问题，直接针对覆盖率和自适应性。这个统计学习问题基于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）和核平方和（SoS）方法。首先，我们通过一个通用的代表定理扩展了先前的结果，并展示了该学习问题的对偶形式。至关重要的是，这种对偶形式可以通过加速梯度法高效求解，适用于数百或数千个样本，这与先前基于现成半定规划算法的策略不同。其次，我们引入了一种新的超参数调优策略，专门旨在通过测试条件覆盖率的界限来实现自适应性。这种基于希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（HSIC）的策略在这里被引入以调整我们框架中的核长度尺度，但它具有更广泛的适用性，因为它可以用在任何学习了得分函数的CP算法中。最后，进行了广泛的实验，以展示我们的方法与相关工作的对比情况。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于核平方和与HSIC调参的高效自适应保形预测带构建方法，显著提升了计算可扩展性与条件覆盖率。
ai_comments: 该论文将保形预测转化为基于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）和核平方和（SoS）的统计学习问题，通过对偶公式和加速梯度法提高了计算可扩展性，并利用HSIC提出了针对条件覆盖率的超参数调权策略，具有很强的创新性和实用价值。
motivation: 传统的保形预测（CP）方法虽然具有有限样本下的有效覆盖保证且无需分布假设，但缺乏自适应性；现有的改进方法在计算效率和条件覆盖率的平衡上仍有不足，需要更具可扩展且自适应的预测带构建方法。
method: 将CP问题转化为基于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）和核平方和（SoS）的统计学习问题；推导了通用代表定理及对偶公式，并利用加速梯度法高效求解；提出了基于希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（HSIC）的超参数调优策略以保证条件覆盖率。
results: 通过对偶公式与加速梯度法的结合，该方法能够高效处理数百甚至数千个样本，超越了传统的半定规划算法；通过HSIC调参策略有效地提高了预测带的条件覆盖自适应性，并通过广泛的实验验证了其优越性。
conclusion: 本文提出的基于核平方和的可扩展自适应预测带方法，在计算效率和条件覆盖率的自适应性上均取得了显著提升。

title: Spatio-Temporal Similarity Volume Aggregation for Open-Vocabulary Action Recognition
authors: Yerim So, Jiyeong Kim, Jiwon Yoon, Dongbo Min
abstract: Recent Open-Vocabulary Action Recognition (OVAR) methods typically aggregate visual features into a global representation before computing text alignment, a process that obscures local patch information and fine-grained spatio-temporal cues. We propose Similarity Volume Aggregation (SimVA), a framework that constructs a dense 4D spatio-temporal similarity volume from patch-level visual-text similarities. SimVA constructs a spatio-temporal similarity volume over local video tokens and action classes, and employs class sampling to ensure similarity aggregation scalable to large vocabularies. The similarity volume is refined by spatial aggregation, which contextualizes local similarity patterns to improve intra-frame consistency. Motion-aware modulation further injects inter-frame variation cues, highlighting dynamically changing regions. Mamba-based temporal aggregation then models the evolution of class-conditioned similarity patterns across frames. By maintaining dense visual-text correspondence, SimVA effectively transfers CLIP to video action recognition, achieving competitive performance across zero-shot, few-shot, and base-to-novel benchmarks.

title: Scalable Exact Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering via Sparse Geographic Distance Graphs
authors: Victor Maus, Vinicius Pozzobon Borin
abstract: Exact hierarchical agglomerative clustering (HAC) of large spatial datasets is limited in practice by the $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ time and memory required for the full pairwise distance matrix. We present GSHAC (Geographically Sparse Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering), a system that makes exact HAC feasible at scales of millions of geographic features on a commodity workstation. GSHAC replaces the distance matrix with a sparse geographic distance graph containing only pairs within a user-specified geodesic bound $h_{\max}$, constructed in $\mathcal{O}(n \cdot k)$ time via spatial indexing, where $k$ is the mean number of neighbors within $h_{\max}$. Connected components of this graph define independent subproblems, and we prove that the resulting assignments are exact for all standard linkage methods at any cut height $h \le h_{\max}$. For single linkage, an MST-based path keeps memory at $\mathcal{O}(n_k + m_k)$ per component. Applied to a global mining inventory ($n = 261{,}073$), the system completes in 12 s (109 MiB peak HAC memory) versus $\approx 545$ GiB for the dense baseline. On a 2-million-point GeoNames sample, all tested thresholds completed in under 3 minutes with peak memory under 3 GiB. We provide a scikit-learn-compatible implementation for direct integration into GIS workflows.

title: Block Diagram Analysis of an Amplitude-Frequency Design Principle in Biological Oscillators
authors: Sidhanta Mohanty, Shaunak Sen
abstract: An important design principle for biological oscillators divides oscillators into two types: fixed frequency, variable amplitude and fixed amplitude, variable frequency. Because of the interplay of nonlinearity and feedback, both positive and negative, analytical investigations of this design principle are primarily based on numerical simulations of ordinary differential equations. To enhance the qualitative and quantitative characterization of this design principle, we adapted and developed a block diagram modeling framework. We showed how the observed amplitude-frequency characteristics could be obtained from the block diagram models of both the types of oscillators. We obtained explicit constraints on the positive feedback and negative feedback strengths for the oscillations to exist. We represented both types of oscillators in a single unifying, control-theoretic framework that connects both the types of oscillators under a single theoretical model. These results contribute to a systems and control perspective on oscillations in biology and related contexts.

title: The Price of Partial Information with Switching Costs: A Complete Characterization for Feedback Graphs
authors: Nicolò Cesa-Bianchi, Tommaso Cesari, Roberto Colomboni, Emmanuel Esposito, Federico Fusco, Tomer Koren
abstract: We study how switching costs affect minimax regret under partial feedback. Which features of the feedback preserve the $\sqrt T$ rate, and which force the $T^{2/3}$ rate? We address this question in the framework of feedback graphs, which interpolate between full information and bandits: playing an action reveals the losses of its out-neighbors in a known directed graph. Prior work on feedback graphs with switching costs gave algorithms with regret of order $T^{2/3}$, but matching lower bounds only for restricted classes of graphs, leaving the question open. We establish a complete characterization of the minimax regret with switching costs for all feedback graphs: $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt T)$ if the graph is strongly revealing, meaning that every pair of distinct actions has an endpoint that observes the losses of both; $\widetildeΘ(γ^{1/3}T^{2/3})$ for every other observable graph, where $γ$ is the domination number; and linear otherwise. In particular, tournaments, in which every action observes its own loss and each pair of actions is joined by one directed edge, sit at the phase transition: they behave like full information, but deleting the edge of any pair forces the rate $T^{2/3}$. Hence an action that observes all losses is neither necessary nor sufficient for the rate $\sqrt T$. Our algorithm TournamentSteering for the strongly revealing case rests on a new principle: each observed comparison of two actions serves both to estimate losses and to steer play, and the loss reduction from steering pays for the variance of the estimates. For every strongly revealing graph, distributing the comparisons among observing actions keeps this variance, and hence the regret, polylogarithmic in the number of actions, by an argument similar to the greedy construction of logarithmic dominating sets in tournaments.
comment: 70 pages. Substantially expanded version: extends the two-action apple-tasting result to a complete characterization for all feedback graphs. Title and author list updated. Accompanying Lean formalization covers the mathematical results, excluding computational complexity claims

title: SimuScene: Simulation-Ready Compositional 3D Scene Reconstruction from a Single Image
authors: Inhee Lee, Sangwon Baik, Sungjoo Kim, Hyeonwoo Kim, Hyunsoo Cha, Hanbyul Joo
abstract: Reconstructing interactive, simulation-ready 3D scenes from a single image is a critical bottleneck for robotic manipulation. While recent single-image lifters recover plausible per-object shapes, composing them yields scenes that collapse under physical simulation due to interpenetrating, hovering, or sinking objects. Existing physics-aware compositional reconstruction methods mainly address this as a post-hoc layout correction, leaving the underlying geometric errors unresolved. To address this, we introduce SimuScene, a compositional 3D reconstruction pipeline that puts physics in the loop of shape and layout estimation. Rather than using physics merely for layout cleanup, we utilize the physics engine as a diagnostic measurement tool during the generative process itself. By diagnostically simulating reconstructed objects under gravity, we convert penetration and support failures into quantitative correction signals that drive amodal shape resampling, with gravity-axis stretching as a lightweight correction for minor errors. This physics-informed feedback loop mitigates accumulated reconstruction errors and produces a stable, simulation-ready compositional 3D scene. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on physical stability and geometric alignment benchmarks. We further highlight SimuScene's utility by deploying reconstructed environments in humanoid control and robot-arm manipulation tasks.

title: An Open Book, On Whose Terms? Power Dynamics in Sensor-Derived, LLM-Generated Summaries Sharing Between Older Adults and Remote Families
authors: Jiachen Li, Reina Szeyi Chan, Shihan Fu, Zijian Wang, Akshat Choube, Yingtian Shi, Rosemarie Santa Gonzalez, Thomas Ploetz, Agata Rozga, Xiang Zhi Tan, Elizabeth Mynatt, Varun Mishra
abstract: As older adults (OAs) increasingly favor aging in place, remote family members (RFMs) need meaningful awareness of their loved ones without intrusive monitoring. Large language models can provide rich interpretations of non-intrusive sensing data, yet recent work has largely emphasized technical accuracy over how families use or benefit from this information. We conducted formative interviews with 12 RFMs and 2 OAs, followed by a three-month deployment case study with one OA-RFM dyad. Our system provided daily AI-generated summaries of multimodal sensing data, which we iteratively refined with both parties using a research-through-design approach. Although the summaries integrated well into the dyad's daily routine, sustaining over 90% engagement, their lived experience revealed evolving tensions around agency, reassurance, privacy, trust, and communication, shaped by sensor limitations and existing communication misalignments. Our findings inform the design of future AI-mediated sharing systems that account for real-world sensing constraints and complex family care dynamics.

title: Hermite Brings a Laptop: Analyzing Frieze-Jerrum Rounding Yields Improved Approximations for Clustering Problems
authors: David García-Soriano, Atsushi Miyauchi
abstract:
The Frieze-Jerrum rounding is a standard tool for rounding SDP relaxations of graph partitioning and clustering problems, assigning nodes to at most $k$ clusters using $k$ independent Gaussian vectors. Its analysis hinges on the collision probability $P_k(ρ)$ that two nodes whose SDP vectors have inner product $ρ$ are assigned to the same cluster. No tractable closed form for $P_k$ is known for $k\geq 4$, making it difficult to certify approximation guarantees and hindering the systematic search for better algorithms.
  We develop a Hermite-coefficient certification framework to derive accurate and tractable bounds on $P_k$. Using the Hermite expansion of Gaussian noise stability, we express $P_k$ as a power series with nonnegative coefficients, reduce these coefficients to one-dimensional Gaussian integrals, and certify finitely many of them, yielding rigorous bounds on $P_k$ over the entire correlation range. Our framework yields strengthened polynomial-time approximations for several clustering problems. For MaxAgree Correlation Clustering, we derive a $0.7818$-approximation, the first improvement in two decades over the $0.7666$ ratio of Swamy (2004). We also improve the best known ratios for the variant with at most $K$ clusters, MaxAgree$[K]$ (e.g., from $0.77$ to $0.8151$ for $K=3$). For Max $K$-Cut we resolve, via a structural property of the Hermite expansion, a conjecture of de Klerk et al. (2004) characterizing the Frieze--Jerrum approximation ratio for every $K\ge3$; we show that this ratio is tight, and determine it to within $10^{-6}$ accuracy for $K\le16$. Finally, we reduce the additive approximation error for modularity maximization from $0.42084$ (Kawase et al., 2021) to $0.3790$.
  On the hardness side, we show that approximating Maxagree within $0.802+ε$ is Unique Games-hard via a construction in Gaussian space analyzed by Borell's inequality.
zh_title: Hermite 带来一台笔记本电脑：分析 Frieze-Jerrum 取整法，为聚类问题带来改进的近似结果
translation:
Frieze-Jerrum 取整法是用于图划分和聚类问题的 SDP 松弛的标准工具，它使用 k 个独立的 Gaussian 向量将节点分配到最多 k 个簇。其分析依赖于两个 SDP 向量内积为 ρ 的节点被分配到同一簇的碰撞概率 $P_k(\rho)$。对于 $k\geq 4$，目前尚无 $P_k$ 的可处理闭合形式，这使得难以证明近似保证并阻碍了系统性地寻找更好算法。
我们开发了一个 Hermite 系数认证框架来推导 $P_k$ 的精确和可处理的界限。利用高斯噪声稳定性的 Hermite 展开，我们将 $P_k$ 表示为具有非负系数的幂级数，将这些系数简化为一维高斯积分，并认证其中有限个，从而在整个相关范围内给出 $P_k$ 的严格界限。我们的框架为几个聚类问题带来了更强的多项式时间近似。对于 MaxAgree Correlation Clustering，我们导出了 0.7818 的近似值，这是近二十年来首次超越 Swamy (2004) 的 0.7666 比例。我们还改进了最多 K 个簇的变体 MaxAgree[K] 的最佳已知比例（例如，K=3 时从 0.77 提高到 0.8151）。对于 Max K-Cut，我们通过 Hermite 展开的一个结构特性，解决了 de Klerk et al. (2004) 关于表征每个 K≥3 的 Frieze-Jerrum 近似比的猜想；我们证明了该比例是紧密的，并确定了 K≤16 时精度在 $10^{-6}$ 以内。最后，我们将模块化最大化的附加近似误差从 0.42084 (Kawase et al., 2021) 降低到 0.3790。
在硬度方面，我们通过 Borell 不等式分析的高斯空间中的构造，表明将 Maxagree 近似到 0.802+ε 是 Unique Games-hard 的。
tldr: 本文通过开发 Hermite 系数认证框架，显著改进了 Frieze-Jerrum 取整法的分析，从而为多个聚类问题提供了更优的近似算法。
ai_comments: 这项工作通过引入 Hermite 系数认证框架，为 Frieze-Jerrum 取整法的分析带来了突破性进展，解决了长期存在的 $P_k$ 闭合形式问题。其创新之处在于将高斯噪声稳定性与 Hermite 展开相结合，从而能够系统地改进多个经典聚类问题的近似比，其中一些结果是二十年来的首次改进。对 Max K-Cut 猜想的解决以及硬度结果的提出，进一步证明了该框架的强大和通用性。
motivation: Frieze-Jerrum 取整法中的碰撞概率 $P_k(\rho)$ 对于 $k\geq 4$ 没有可处理的闭合形式，这导致难以证明近似保证并阻碍了系统性地寻找更好算法。
method: 开发了一个 Hermite 系数认证框架来推导 $P_k$ 的精确和可处理的界限。该框架利用高斯噪声稳定性的 Hermite 展开，将 $P_k$ 表示为具有非负系数的幂级数，将这些系数简化为一维高斯积分，并认证其中有限个，从而在整个相关范围内给出 $P_k$ 的严格界限。
results: 为 MaxAgree Correlation Clustering 导出了 0.7818 的近似值，这是二十年来首次改进。改进了 MaxAgree[K] 变体的最佳已知比例（例如，K=3 时从 0.77 提高到 0.8151）。通过 Hermite 展开的结构特性，解决了 Max K-Cut 中关于 Frieze-Jerrum 近似比的猜想，并确定了其紧致性，对于 K≤16 精度在 $10^{-6}$ 以内。将模块化最大化的附加近似误差从 0.42084 降低到 0.3790。在硬度方面，通过高斯空间中的构造，表明将 Maxagree 近似到 0.802+ε 是 Unique Games-hard 的。
