zh_title: 使用割查询寻找并验证加权最小割
translation:
我们研究了具有任意非负边权的无向图中最小割的确定性和非确定性割查询复杂度。对于非确定性情况，我们证明了每个n顶点图都有一个O(n\log^2(2n))查询复杂度的精确全局最小割证书，使得在相同顶点集上对这些查询结果一致的任何其他非负加权图都具有相同的最小割值。一个关键要素是仅用O(n)次割查询来验证最大s-t流值的方法。
对于确定性情况，我们给出了一个使用O(n^{3/2}\log^3(2n)(\log\log(2n))^2)次割查询精确寻找全局最小割的算法。此前，对于任意非负加权图，没有已知的O(n^{2-\varepsilon})确定性界。该算法遵循Karger的两重尊重树方法。关键的新要素是输入图G的弱骨架的确定性构造：一个显式加权图H，其中G的每个最小割都是一个5/4近似最小割。
tldr: 本文解决了加权图最小割的割查询复杂度问题，给出了O(n)级别的非确定性证书和O(n^{3/2})级别的确定性查找算法。
ai_comments: 该论文在图论的割查询复杂度（cut query complexity）方面取得了突破性进展，首次给出了针对赋权图的亚二次确定性割查询算法，以及高效的非确定性证书。这对于理解网络割的内在复杂性具有重要理论价值。
motivation: 研究无向加权图中寻找和验证最小割所需的割查询复杂度，突破以往对于任意非负加权图缺乏亚二次确定性上界的局限。
method: 对于非确定性情况，通过O(n)次割查询构造最大s-t流值的证书；对于确定性情况，结合Karger的两重尊重树方法与确定性弱骨架图（weak skeleton）的构造算法。
results: 证明了每个n顶点图都有一个O(n log^2(2n))查询复杂度的精确全局最小割证书；给出了一个使用O(n^{3/2} log^3(2n) (log log(2n))^2)次查询的确定性算法来寻找精确全局最小割。
conclusion: 论文通过提出新的最大流值证书和弱骨架图构造方法，显著改进了加权图最小割在确定性和非确定性割查询复杂度上的理论界。

title: CAREFUL-Bench: Effect-Aware, Judge-Free Evaluation of Multi-Turn LLM Function Calling
authors: Alexander Kovalenko, Artem Redchych
abstract: The multi-turn checker of the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) checks only the final state of a simulated service, never the calls that produced it. Extra calls cost nothing, no function doc says what a function does, and the scripted user never answers a proposal, so a model that asks before deleting or paying fails the turn; 322 of the 734 reference turns in the base category act destructively without confirmation. We add effect information to BFCL without replacing it. Effect declarations for all 128 functions are inferred by executing each function in BFCL's own simulators and diffing the state; the remaining judgment, which writes are destructive, is made by four annotators, two humans and two language models (Fleiss' kappa = 0.75), and adjudicated. A judge-free replay scorer re-scores any logged BFCL run, reproduces BFCL's results on all 800 reference trajectories, and reports, alongside the official score, unrequested destructive calls, duplicate writes, redundant reads, surplus steps and their token cost. A confirmation-aware protocol adds a deterministic user that answers proposals. On 11 open models the effect-aware score preserves the official ranking (rho = 0.99) but changes the gaps: the leader loses 14.0 points to unrequested destructive calls, and surplus steps account for 2-28% of all input tokens. Effect hints in the function docs produce no measurable change for any of eight models, consistent with their advisory status in the Model Context Protocol. A user that answers recovers up to four points for the models that ask and none for the rest, with every comparison paired on the same conversations. The gains come from clarifying questions rather than requests for permission: of the 712 conversations that require a destructive call, no model completes more than 6 with every such call confirmed, a difference the official score does not record.
zh_title: CAREFUL-Bench：多轮大语言模型函数调用中具备效应感知与无需裁判的评测
translation: 伯克利函数调用排行榜（BFCL）的多轮检查器仅检查模拟服务的最终状态，从不检查产生该状态的调用。额外的调用没有任何成本，没有函数文档说明函数的作用，且脚本化用户从不回答提议，因此在删除或支付前进行询问的模型在测试中会失败；基础类别中的734个参考轮次中有322个在没有确认的情况下进行了破坏性操作。我们在不替换BFCL的前提下向其添加了效应信息。所有128个函数的效应声明是通过在BFCL自身的模拟器中执行每个函数并对比状态差异推断出来的；其余关于哪些写入是破坏性的判断由四名标注员（两名人类和两名大语言模型，Fleiss' kappa = 0.75）做出并经仲裁确认。一个无需裁判的重放 scorer 可以重新给任何记录在案的BFCL运行评分，在所有800个参考轨迹上重现BFCL的结果，并在官方分数之外报告未经请求的破坏性调用、重复写入、冗余读取、多余步骤及其Token成本。一个确认感知的协议添加了一个能够回答提议的确定性用户。在11个开源模型上，效应感知分数保持了官方排名（rho = 0.99）但改变了差距：领先模型因未经请求的破坏性调用损失了14.0分，多余步骤占所有输入Token的2%-28%。函数文档中的效应提示对所测试的8个模型中的任何一个都没有产生可测量的变化，这与它们在模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol）中的咨询地位相一致。会回答的用户为那些会询问的模型恢复了多达四分，而对其他模型则毫无帮助，每个比较都在相同的对话上进行配对。这些收益来自于澄清性问题而不是对许可的请求：在需要破坏性调用的712个对话中，没有一个模型能完成超过6个且每次此类调用都经过确认，这是一个官方分数未曾记录的差异。
tldr: 提出了一种效应感知、无需裁判的多轮大语言模型函数调用评测框架，揭示了现有基准测试无法检测模型未经确认的破坏性操作和效率低下的问题。
ai_comments: 该论文针对现有大语言模型多轮函数调用评测（如BFCL）只检查最终状态、忽略调用过程及副作用的缺陷，提出了CAREFUL-Bench评测框架。其创新点在于引入了效应感知（effect-aware）和无裁判（judge-free）的重放评分机制，能够精准捕捉破坏性调用、重复写入及冗余读取等隐藏问题，为多轮函数调用的安全性和效率评估提供了重要工具。
motivation: 现有的多轮函数调用排行榜（如BFCL）仅检查模拟服务的最终状态，忽略了产生该状态的具体调用过程，导致模型在面对诸如未经确认而执行破坏性操作（如删除或付款）时无法被正确惩罚。
method: 通过在BFCL的模拟器中执行函数并通过状态差异推断出所有128个函数的效应声明，结合人类与大模型标注确定破坏性写入；开发了一个无需裁判的重放评分器（judge-free replay scorer），可重新对BFCL运行进行评分，并引入了确认感知的交互协议。
results: 在11个开源模型上的测试表明，效应感知评分虽然保持了官方排名（rho=0.99），但调整了分差（如领先模型因未经请求的破坏性调用损失14分）；冗余步骤占总输入Token的2%-28%；没有模型能在所有需要破坏性调用的对话中正确完成确认。
conclusion: CAREFUL-Bench有效地揭示了当前大模型在多轮函数调用中的潜在破坏性行为和效率低下问题，表明仅依赖最终状态的评测会掩盖模型在安全交互和Token消耗方面的严重缺陷。

title: Auto-Research Agent on MSA Organization to Improve Protein-Protein Complex Structure Prediction
authors: Zilu Zhang, Jing Bao, Lifeng Qiao, Sheng Xu, Qiantai Feng, Siqi Sun, Yang Yang
abstract: Protein-complex structure prediction with AlphaFold 3 depends on MSA content, depth, and cross-chain pairing. Current pipelines apply uniform recipes, typically maximizing depth and pairing by species, yet even whether cross-chain pairing helps AF3 remains contested. We show that the value of both depth and pairing is strongly target-dependent, so no single recipe is optimal across interfaces. We introduce an autonomous agent that treats a frozen AF3 as a black-box experimental instrument. For each target, the agent formulates biological hypotheses, analyzes and reorganizes the MSA, and iteratively refines sequence selection and pairing using predictor label-free signals alone. On 1{,}015 protein--protein interfaces from three benchmarks released after AF3's training cutoff, the agent improves overall interface DockQ over AF3's default pipeline and fixed MSA recipes on every benchmark, while using on average 60\% fewer MSA sequences than the default. Gains are largest for inter-species heteromers, where species-based pairing is unreliable: mean DockQ increases from 0.465 to 0.612 on FoldBench and from 0.482 to 0.562 on HD439. The improvements arise from both sequence construction and pairing policy, including deliberate non-pairing. These results recast MSA design as a target-specific problem and show that an autonomous agent can adapt it at test time through biological reasoning and self-directed, confidence-guided experimentation.
zh_title: 基于MSA组织的自动研究智能体以改进蛋白质-蛋白质复合物结构预测
translation: 使用AlphaFold 3进行蛋白质复合物结构预测取决于MSA的内容、深度和跨链配对。当前的流程应用统一的配方，通常通过物种最大化深度和配对，然而跨链配对对AF3是否有帮助仍然存在争议。我们发现深度和配对的价值都强力依赖于目标，因此没有单一的配方在所有界面上都是最优的。我们引入了一个自主智能体，将冻结的AF3视为黑盒实验仪器。对于每个目标，该智能体提出生物学假设，分析并重组MSA，仅使用预测器的无标签信号迭代精炼序列选择和配对。在AF3训练截止日期之后发布的三个基准测试的1,015个蛋白质-蛋白质界面上，该智能体在每个基准上都提高了整体接口DockQ，超越了AF3的默认流程和固定MSA配方，同时平均使用了比默认少60%的MSA序列。对于物种间异源多聚体（基于物种的配对不可靠的地方），增益最大：FoldBench上的平均DockQ从0.465增加到0.612，HD439上从0.482增加到0.562。这些改进源于序列构建和配对策略（包括刻意的非配对）。这些结果将MSA设计重新塑造为一个针对特定目标的问题，并表明自主智能体可以通过生物学推理和自我指导、置信度引导的实验在测试时进行调整。
keywords: 蛋白质-蛋白质复合物预测
tldr: 提出了一种针对蛋白质复合物结构预测的自主MSA优化智能体，利用AI推理和实验在测试时动态调整MSA，显著提升了AlphaFold 3的预测精度并减少了序列消耗。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地引入了基于多序列比对（MSA）组织的自主科研智能体，将固定配方转变为针对特定目标的自适应设计，不仅显著提升了AlphaFold 3在蛋白质复合物结构预测上的准确性，还大幅减少了所需的MSA序列数量，具有重要的理论和实际应用价值。
motivation: 当前的蛋白质复合物结构预测流程（如AlphaFold 3）依赖于均匀的MSA配方（最大化深度和按物种配对），但MSA深度和配对的价值具有强烈的靶标依赖性，且跨链配对对AF3的作用仍存争议，因此需要一种能针对不同界面进行自适应优化的方法。
method: 引入了一个自主智能体，将冻结的AF3视为黑盒实验仪器；针对每个目标，智能体自主形成生物学假设、分析和重组MSA，并仅使用预测器的无标签信号迭代优化序列选择和配对策略。
results: 在训练截止日期后发布的三个基准测试的1,015个蛋白质-蛋白质界面上，该智能体在每个基准上都提高了整体接口DockQ，同时平均使用的MSA序列比默认管道少60%。在物种间异源多聚体上的提升最大，FoldBench上的平均DockQ从0.465提高到0.612，HD439上从0.482提高到0.562。
conclusion: 通过将MSA设计视为目标相关的问题并利用自主智能体在测试时进行自适应调整，可以显著提高蛋白质-蛋白质复合物结构的预测精度并减少计算资源。

title: Axion 1.0: Open Agent Foundation Models, Simplified
authors: Yuqi Jia, Yunjie Tian, Jiayu Zheng, Yijun Liang, Jingchen Sun, Mengyu Zhao, Di Fu
abstract: We introduce Axion 1.0, a fully open agent foundation model that combines strong and broad agentic capabilities with a remarkably simple training recipe. Axion 1.0 is trained in only three stages: two lightweight supervised fine-tuning stages followed by reinforcement learning, without dedicated mid-training, direct preference optimization (DPO), or on-policy distillation (OPD). The first SFT stage develops strong self-contained reasoning through model-aware data construction, where we synthesize challenging problems and adversarially strengthen them based on the base model's own successful solution strategies. The second stage extends these capabilities to tool-dependent reasoning through a scalable pipeline for constructing diverse and automatically verifiable tasks grounded in real-world data sources and deterministic computation. Finally, reinforcement learning further strengthens long-horizon reasoning and interaction with external tools and environments. Despite this compact training recipe, Axion 1.0 achieves strong performance across a broad suite of agentic benchmarks and is competitive with leading commercial models on several of them. Equally importantly, Axion 1.0 is open beyond model weights: we release the complete recipe, including data construction, generation, filtering, verification, prompts, and training code, enabling the entire development process to be reproduced and extended. Axion 1.0 demonstrates that strong agent foundation models can be both open and simple, offering a practical and reproducible path toward advancing open agentic intelligence.
zh_title: Axion 1.0：开源智能体基础模型，化繁为简
translation: 我们介绍了 Axion 1.0，这是一个完全开源的智能体基础模型，它将强大而广泛的智能体能力与异常简单的训练配方结合在一起。Axion 1.0 仅通过三个阶段进行训练：两个轻量级的监督微调阶段，随后是强化学习，没有经过专门的中期训练、直接偏好优化（DPO）或在线策略蒸馏（OPD）。第一阶段 SFT 通过模型感知的数据构建来开发强大的自包含推理，在此阶段我们合成具有挑战性的问题，并根据基础模型自身的成功求解策略对其进行对抗性强化。第二阶段将这些能力扩展到依赖工具的推理，通过一个可扩展的管道构建多样化且自动可验证的任务，这些任务基于真实世界的数据源和确定性计算。最后，强化学习进一步增强了长远推理以及与外部工具和环境的交互。尽管训练配方紧凑，Axion 1.0 在广泛的智能体基准测试中仍取得了优异的性能，并在其中的几个基准上与领先的商业模型具有竞争力。同样重要的是，Axion 1.0 不仅开源了模型权重：我们还发布了完整的训练配方，包括数据构建、生成、过滤、验证、提示词和训练代码，从而使整个开发过程能够被复制和扩展。Axion 1.0 证明了强大的智能体基础模型既可以开源又可以简单，为推进开源智能体智能提供了一条实用且可复现的途径。
tldr: Axion 1.0 是一个采用极其简单且完全开源的三阶段训练配方（SFT + RL）的智能体基础模型，性能可媲美领先的商业模型。
ai_comments: Axion 1.0 的创新之处在于其精简的三阶段训练范式（SFT+RL），摒弃了复杂的中间训练和偏好对齐技术，同时实现了完全开源（包括数据、代码和训练配方），为开源智能体领域提供了极具价值的复现基准。
motivation: 当前的智能体基础模型通常依赖复杂繁琐的训练配方，且往往缺乏完全的开源透明度，因此需要探索一种既强大又简单、完全可复现的开源智能体基础模型训练方法。
method: 采用了由三个阶段组成的精简训练方法：两个轻量级的监督微调阶段（分别用于发展自主推理和基于工具的推理，辅以模型感知的数据构建和可验证任务管道），随后是用于增强长远推理及环境交互的强化学习。
results: 在广泛的智能体基准测试中展现出强大的性能，并在其中几个基准上与领先的商业模型具有竞争力。
conclusion: Axion 1.0 证明了构建强大且广泛的智能体基础模型可以采用非常简单且完全开源的训练配方，为开源智能体技术的发展提供了一条实用且可复现的途径。

title: The Cost of Mismatch: Noise Amplification in Zeroth-Order Reinforcement Learning
authors: Lianmin Chen, Junbin Qiu, Chenxing Wei, Yao Shu, Kun He
abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization has emerged as a promising approach for memory-efficient large language model (LLM) post-training, yet its reliability in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) remains largely unexplored. Motivated by the distinct data regimes of on-policy RL and fixed-data optimization, we develop a generic variance-theoretic framework to investigate what limits the reliability of ZO gradient estimation. Our analysis reveals that estimation reliability is structurally determined by whether the two finite-difference evaluations are performed on matched data. On-policy reinforcement learning (RL) under the mismatched-data regime produces a $1/μ^2$ oracle-noise amplification that sets an irreducible noise floor as the perturbation scale $μ$ decreases, whereas Boltzmann Targeted SFT (BOLT) under the matched-data regime eliminates this amplification via noise cancellation. We further derive convergence guarantees with explicit constants that cleanly separate the two regimes. These results motivate the ZO-BOLT algorithm, which builds on BOLT's matched-data advantage for reliable ZO optimization of an RLVR-aligned objective. Controlled perturbation-scale sweeps and matched-versus-mismatched end-to-end comparisons validate the predicted effect of data matching. Experiments across three models and two mathematical reasoning benchmarks further show that ZO-BOLT consistently improves over the pretrained baseline while retaining a near-inference memory footprint. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianmin-chen/the_cost_of_mismatch.
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Poster). Code is available at https://github.com/lianmin-chen/the_cost_of_mismatch
zh_title: 失配的代价：零阶强化学习中的噪声放大
translation: 零阶（ZO）优化已成为一种用于内存高效的大语言模型（LLM）后训练的有前景的方法，但其在带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中的可靠性在很大程度上仍未得到探索。受在线强化学习和固定数据优化不同数据机制的启发，我们开发了一个通用的方差理论框架来研究限制ZO梯度估计可靠性的因素。我们的分析表明，估计的可靠性由两次有限差分评估是否在匹配数据上执行结构性地决定。在不匹配数据机制下的在线强化学习产生了 $1/\mu^2$ 的预言机噪声放大，随着扰动尺度 $\mu$ 的减小，这设定了一个不可约的噪声底限，而在匹配数据机制下的Boltzmann Targeted SFT（BOLT）通过噪声抵消消除了这种放大。我们进一步推导出了带有显式常数的收敛保证，清晰地区分了这两种机制。这些结果促成了ZO-BOLT算法，该算法建立在BOLT的匹配数据优势之上，用于对RLVR对齐的目标进行可靠的ZO优化。受控的扰动尺度扫描以及匹配与不匹配的端到端比较验证了预测的数据匹配效果。在三个模型和两个数学推理基准上的实验进一步表明，ZO-BOLT在保持接近推理的内存占用的同时，始终优于预训练基线。代码已在 https://github.com/lianmin-chen/the_cost_of_mismatch 公开。
tldr: 本文揭示了零阶强化学习中数据失配会导致严重的噪声放大，并提出了通过数据匹配实现高效可靠优化的ZO-BOLT算法。
ai_comments: 本文揭示了零阶强化学习中数据匹配与否对梯度估计稳定性的决定性影响，并提出了ZO-BOLT算法，在保证低显存占用的同时显著提升了数学推理能力，对大模型的高效微调具有重要意义。
motivation: 探究零阶优化在带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中的可靠性限制，并理解匹配数据与不匹配数据对梯度估计的影响。
method: 开发了一个通用的方差理论框架来研究零阶梯度估计的局限性，并据此提出了利用匹配数据优势的ZO-BOLT算法。
results: 分析表明不匹配数据会导致 $1/\mu^2$ 的噪声放大并形成不可消除的噪声底限，而匹配数据（如BOLT）通过噪声抵消消除了这种放大；实验证明ZO-BOLT算法在三个模型和两个数学基准上持续改进了性能并保持了接近推理的内存占用。
conclusion: 数据匹配是消除零阶强化学习中噪声放大的关键，由此提出的ZO-BOLT算法在保持低内存占用的同时有效提升了大模型的推理性能。

title: An Axiomatic Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Jianhong Wang, Yang Li, Samuel Kaski, Jonathan Lawry
abstract: Open multi-agent systems, where only a subset of agents are controllable, are central to real-world domains such as smart grids, yet lack a principled foundation for reinforcement learning algorithm design. We study this setting through n-agent ad hoc teamwork (NAHT), a recent framework for learning in open multi-agent environments. We propose an axiomatic framework that derives value function learning from the Shapley axioms (Efficiency, Symmetry and Linearity), treating them as structural constraints rather than heuristic design choices. This formulation builds on a novel NAHT decomposition, which characterises the fundamental difference between open and fully controllable multi-agent systems, and establishes a cooperative game-theoretic foundation for learning. We further show that enforcing these axioms on learning individual value functions recovers the Shapley value for Dec-POMDPs, providing a principled bridge between reinforcement learning and classical cooperative game theory. Building on this framework, we introduce Shapley Machines and Banzhaf Machines, two generic algorithmic templates that can be instantiated with standard reinforcement learning methods. When applied to strong base algorithms such as IPPO and POAM, our methods consistently improve learning efficiency and generalisation to unseen agent types and conventions across NAHT benchmark tasks. The code of experiments is published on https://github.com/hsvgbkhgbv/axiomatic-rl-naht.
zh_title: 开放式多智能体系统中强化学习的公理化框架
translation: 开放式多智能体系统（其中只有一部分智能体可控）是智能电网等现实世界领域的核心，但缺乏用于强化学习算法设计的原则性基础。我们通过n-agent ad hoc teamwork（NAHT）研究了这一设置，这是最近在开放式多智能体环境中进行学习的框架。我们提出了一个公理化框架，该框架从Shapley公理（效率、对称性和线性）推导价值函数学习，将其视为结构性约束而不是启发式设计选择。该公式建立在一种新颖的NAHT分解之上，该分解表征了开放式和完全可控多智能体系统之间的根本差异，并为学习建立了合作博弈论基础。我们进一步表明，在学习个体价值函数时强制执行这些公理可以恢复Dec-POMDP的Shapley值，从而在强化学习和经典合作博弈论之间提供了一个原则性的桥梁。基于该框架，我们引入了Shapley Machines和Banzhaf Machines，这两种通用的算法模板可以用标准的强化学习方法进行实例化。当应用于IPPO和POAM等强基础算法时，我们的方法在NAHT基准任务中持续提高了学习效率以及对未见过的智能体类型和惯例的泛化能力。实验代码已发布在https://github.com/hsvgbkhgbv/axiomatic-rl-naht。
keywords: 纳什均衡/价值函数分解
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Shapley公理的强化学习公理化框架，用于解决开放式多智能体系统中的学习问题，并显著提高了算法的泛化和学习效率。
ai_comments: 本文从博弈论中的Shapley公理出发，为开放式多智能体系统（NAHT）中的强化学习提供了严谨的公理化框架，将启发式设计转化为结构性约束，桥接了强化学习与经典合作博弈论，具有重要的理论和应用价值。
motivation: 开放式多智能体系统在现实世界（如智能电网）中至关重要，但缺乏用于强化学习算法设计的原则性基础。
method: 提出一个公理化框架，基于Shapley公理（效率、对称性和线性）推导价值函数学习，利用新颖的NAHT分解将强化学习与合作博弈论联系起来，并推出了Shapley Machines和Banzhaf Machines两种通用算法模板。
results: 在NAHT基准任务中，将该方法应用于IPPO和POAM等强基准算法，能够持续提高学习效率以及对未见过的智能体类型和惯例的泛化能力。
conclusion: 本文提出的公理化框架、Shapley Machines和Banzhaf Machines能够有效提升开放式多智能体系统中的学习效率和泛化能力。

title: TaoMate-FVSR: Audio-Guided Facial Video Restoration
authors: Xinyang Li, Zeran Xu, Jingna Sun, Qijun Gan, Chenwei Zhang, Meiguang Jin, Junfeng Ma
abstract: Low-quality facial videos suffer from missing fine details, while AI-generated videos may additionally contain implausible teeth and lip movements that do not match the speech. Restoring the mouth region is particularly challenging: enhancing existing details can preserve structural errors, whereas regenerating them risks changing facial identity and articulation. We propose an audio-guided facial video restoration framework that reconstructs unreliable mouth details and aligns lip movements with the speech while preserving facial identity and temporal consistency. Built on a video diffusion transformer, our framework mixes input video latents with noise to retain useful source information while allowing corrupted details to be regenerated. Audio guides lip movements, reference images constrain facial appearance, and previously generated frames promote temporal consistency. We train the model in two stages, first learning visual restoration from degraded images and videos, then learning audio-guided lip correction from degraded dubbed videos. The resulting model supports both restoration with the original audio and visual dubbing with replacement audio. On talking-head restoration benchmarks, our method achieves the lowest LPIPS and DISTS and the best lip synchronization scores among the evaluated restoration baselines. Qualitative results on AI-generated videos further show improvements in facial detail and mouth-region appearance, including clearer tooth boundaries and lip contours.
zh_title: TaoMate-FVSR：音频引导的面部视频恢复
translation: 低质量的面部视频缺乏精细的细节，而人工智能生成的视频可能还会包含与语音不匹配的不合理牙齿和唇部运动。恢复嘴部区域尤其具有挑战性：增强现有细节会保留结构错误，而重新生成则有改变面部身份和发音的风险。我们提出了一种音频引导的面部视频恢复框架，该框架可以重建不可靠的嘴部细节，使唇部运动与语音对齐，同时保持面部身份和时间一致性。我们的框架建立在视频扩散Transformer之上，将输入视频隐变量与噪声混合，以保留有用的源信息，同时允许重新生成受损的细节。音频引导唇部运动，参考图像约束面部外观，先前生成的帧促进时间一致性。我们分两个阶段训练模型，首先从退化的图像和视频中学习视觉恢复，然后从退化的配音视频中学习音频引导的唇部校正。生成的模型既支持使用原始音频进行恢复，也支持使用替换音频进行视觉配音。在说话人头（talking-head）恢复基准测试中，我们的方法在评估的恢复基线中实现了最低的LPIPS和DISTS以及最佳的唇同步得分。对AI生成视频的定性结果进一步显示了面部细节和嘴部区域外观的改善，包括更清晰的牙齿边界和唇部轮廓。
tldr: 提出了一种名为TaoMate-FVSR的音频引导面部视频恢复框架，利用视频扩散Transformer有效恢复丢失的口部细节并实现精准的唇音同步。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将音频引导引入面部视频恢复中，既解决了低质量视频细节丢失的问题，又修复了AI生成视频中常见的口型不匹配与伪影，在保持面部身份和时间一致性方面表现优异。
motivation: 低质量面部视频缺乏精细细节，而AI生成视频常出现牙齿和唇部运动与语音不匹配的问题。修复口部区域极具挑战性：增强现有细节会保留结构错误，而重新生成则存在改变面部身份和发音的风险。
method: 基于视频扩散Transformer构建框架，将输入视频隐变量与噪声混合以保留源信息并再生损坏细节；利用音频引导口型、参考图像约束面部外观、先前生成的帧促进时间一致性；采用两阶段训练策略（先学习视觉恢复，再学习音频引导的口型校正）。
results: 在talking-head恢复基准测试中，该方法在评估的恢复基线中取得了最低的LPIPS和DISTS以及最佳的唇同步得分；定性结果表明其显著改善了面部细节和口部区域外观，如更清晰的牙齿边界和唇部轮廓。
conclusion: TaoMate-FVSR框架能够有效修复低质或AI生成面部视频的口部区域，实现高质量的音频引导面部视频恢复与配音。

title: DeliverBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Delivering Realistic Multi-Stage Professional Projects
authors: Yumou Liu, Mingju Chen, Zhoufutu Wen, Qianyu Yang, Zijie Wang, Sihan Chen, Yeqian Liu, Chenghao Yang, Tiliang Duan, Qiyu Cai, Yanglihong Xiao, Jiayun Dong, Jianlan Ma, Shenhao Miao, Yuhan Cao, Lu Xu, Que Shen, Tian Gao, Ziyu Liang, Eric Yang, Ge Zhang, Jianpeng Jiao, Xuanhe Zhou, Fan Wu
abstract: LLM agents are judged by what they deliver, and in professional work what gets delivered is a project, not a task. A project pays off only if the whole package holds, and one weak part can limit the value of the rest. Yet existing benchmarks mostly test agents on one task at a time, leaving a gap between the capability we measure and the outcome that makes agents useful. To address this gap, we introduce DeliverBench, which tests whether agents can carry a project from brief to final delivery. Its 11 projects, spanning financial due diligence, legal contract drafting, and drug safety reporting, are reconstructed with 13 domain experts from real materials and chain 150 subtasks through 2-15 rounds of new materials and client feedback. Because no reference outputs are injected, agents inherit their own errors from one task to the next. Expert rubrics then score every checkpoint as well as the final package. Across seven model-harness systems, even the best system scores only 65.0 out of 100 on final delivery and passes 50.0% of subtasks at a 90-point threshold. The failures are often failures of carrying work forward: in one audit project, all seven systems addressed the review findings, but only one preserved traceability. Together, these results suggest that task-level capability does not simply compose into delivery, which also depends on keeping the work coherent as it evolves.
zh_title: DeliverBench：评估AI代理交付真实多阶段专业项目能力的基准
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）代理的价值取决于其交付成果，而在专业工作中交付的是项目而非任务。只有整个项目包都成立时，项目才有回报，任何一个薄弱环节都会限制其余部分的价值。然而，现有的基准测试大多一次只测试代理一项任务，这在我们所衡量的能力与使代理真正发挥作用的实际成果之间留下了鸿沟。为了弥补这一差距，我们推出了 DeliverBench，它用于测试代理能否将项目从简报推进到最终交付。其11个项目涵盖了财务尽职调查、法律合同起草和药物安全报告，是由13位领域专家利用真实材料重建的，通过2-15轮的新材料和客户反馈串联了150个子任务。由于没有注入参考输出，代理会将前一个任务的错误延续到下一个任务中。随后，专家评分标准会对每个检查点以及最终的交付包进行打分。在七个模型-套件系统中，即使是最好的系统在最终交付上也仅获得了65.0分（满分100分），在90分阈值下仅通过了50.0%的子任务。失败往往在于无法将工作向前推进：例如在一个审计项目中，所有七个系统都解决了审查发现的问题，但只有一个系统保持了可追溯性。总之，这些结果表明，任务级别的能力并不能简单地组合成项目交付能力，项目交付还取决于在工作演进过程中保持工作的一致性。
tldr: 提出了 DeliverBench 基准来测试AI代理交付复杂多阶段专业项目的能力，发现现有顶尖系统在此类任务上的表现仍有很大提升空间。
ai_comments: 该论文指出了现有大模型评估多局限于单任务，创新性地提出了面向真实多阶段专业项目交付的基准 DeliverBench，通过链式子任务和无参考输出注入的机制，更真实地反映了AI代理在实际工作中的表现，对未来多智能体及复杂项目管理研究具有重要价值。
motivation: 现有基准测试大多一次测试一个任务，这与专业工作中交付一个完整项目的现实存在差距，因为项目只有整体成立才有价值，且一个弱点就会限制其余部分的价值。
method: 引入 DeliverBench 基准，包含由领域专家从真实材料重建的11个项目，通过2-15轮新材料和客户反馈串联150个子任务；不注入参考输出，使代理将自身的错误从一个任务继承到下一个任务，并使用专家评分标准对每个检查点及最终成果进行打分。
results: 在测试的七个模型-套件系统中，表现最好的系统在最终交付上的得分也仅为 65.0/100，在 90 分阈值下仅通过了 50.0% 的子任务。主要失败原因在于无法将工作有效推进并保持一致性和可追溯性。
conclusion: 任务级别的能力并不简单等同于项目交付能力，项目交付还需要学会在任务演进过程中保持工作的一致性和可追溯性。

title: Clinician-AI Collaboration in Endovascular Neurointerventions: In-Vitro User Study of Copilot Assistance Modes for Robotic Navigation Across the Autonomy Spectrum
authors: Nikola Fischer, Harry Robertshaw, S.M.Hadi Sadati, Xingyu Chen, Weiyuan Deng, Benjamin Jackson, Michael Adofo Kwakye, Sara Sciacca, Naga Kandasamy, Parthiban Balasundaram, Sahan Guruge, Charles Cummins, Joe Leyon, Nasr Abdelsalam, Matthew Benger, Andrew Falzon, Alejandro Granados, Christos Bergeles, Thomas Booth
abstract: Mechanical thrombectomy (MT) is an effective treatment for acute ischemic stroke, yet access remains limited by the availability of neurointerventional expertise. Telerobotic and AI-assisted systems may help address this challenge, but it remains unclear how clinicians interact with different levels of autonomy and how autonomous navigation systems perform in realistic environments. This work introduces Copilot Assistance Modes (CAMs), a framework for clinician-AI collaboration in robotic endovascular navigation spanning the autonomy spectrum from manual operation to full autonomy. In the first in-vitro user study comparing clinician-AI collaboration strategies, 11 experts and two students evaluated six navigation modes in a patient-specific vascular phantom. Objective performance metrics were combined with subjective assessments, including workload and usability. Autonomous performance was additionally evaluated both in silico and in vitro to investigate sim-to-real transfer. Hands-on manual navigation achieved the strongest overall performance (100% success). While fully autonomous navigation achieved 81% success in simulation, performance dropped to 23% in vitro. In contrast, several clinician-AI shared-autonomy modes achieved success rates of 92-97%, approximately four times higher than full autonomy and comparable to direct robotic control (95%), demonstrating mitigation of sim-to-real domain shift through clinician-AI collaboration. Among the evaluated AI-driven approaches, user-directed task delegation and rotational shared control demonstrated the most favorable balance between performance and clinician acceptance. These findings suggest that effective clinician-AI collaboration and allocation of control authority may currently be more important for reliable robotic neurointerventional navigation than increasing autonomy alone.
zh_title: 内ovascular神经介入中的临床医生与AI协作：跨自主性谱系用于机器人导航的副驾驶辅助模式的体外用户研究
translation: 机械取栓（MT）是治疗急性缺血性卒中的有效方法，但由于缺乏神经介入专业知识，其应用仍然受限。远程机器人和AI辅助系统可能有助于解决这一挑战，但目前尚不清楚临床医生如何与不同水平的自主性进行交互，以及自主导航系统在真实环境中的表现如何。本研究引入了副驾驶辅助模式（CAMs），这是一个用于机器人血管内导航中临床医生-AI协作的框架，跨越了从手动操作到完全自主的自主性谱系。在首个比较临床医生-AI协作策略的体外用户研究中，11名专家和2名学生在患者特异性血管体模中评估了6种导航模式。客观性能指标与主观评估（包括工作量和可用性）相结合。此外，还在计算机模拟和体外评估了自主性能，以研究仿真到现实的转移。亲自动手的手动导航实现了最强的整体性能（100%成功）。虽然全自主导航在模拟中取得了81%的成功率，但在体外性能下降到23%。相比之下，几种临床医生-AI共享自主模式取得了92-97%的成功率，约为全自主的大约四倍，且与直接机器人控制（95%）相当，这表明通过临床医生-AI协作可以减轻仿真到现实的域偏移。在评估的AI驱动方法中，用户导向的任务委派和旋转共享控制表现出性能和临床医生接受度之间最有利的平衡。这些发现表明，与单纯增加自主性相比，有效的临床医生-AI协作和控制权的分配对于可靠的机器人神经介入导航目前更为重要。
tldr: 在神经介入机器人导航中，临床医生与AI的共享自主权模式比单纯追求完全自主更能有效克服环境差异，实现高成功率和高临床接受度。
ai_comments: 该研究通过在体外和计算机模拟实验中评估神经介入机器人的不同自主性模式，揭示了人机协同（共享自主权）在弥合“仿真到现实”鸿沟方面的重要作用，对未来医疗机器人设计具有重要指导意义。
motivation: 尽管机械取栓是治疗急性缺血性卒中的有效方法，但神经介入专业知识的缺乏限制了其普及。虽然远程机器人和AI辅助系统有望解决这一挑战，但目前尚不清楚临床医生如何与不同级别的自主性进行交互，以及自主导航系统在真实环境中的表现如何。
method: 提出了“副驾驶辅助模式（CAMs）”框架，涵盖从手动操作到完全自主的整个自主性谱系；进行了包含11名专家和2名学生的体外用户研究，评估了患者特定血管体模中的6种导航模式，并进行了计算机模拟与体外实验的对比。
results: 手动导航成功率最高（100%），全自主导航在仿真中成功率为81%但在体外降至23%。相比之下，临床医生-AI共享自主模式达到了92-97%的成功率，约为全自主的四倍，且与直接机器人控制（95%）相当。用户导向的任务委派和旋转共享控制表现出最佳的性能与临床接受度平衡。
conclusion: 有效的临床医生-AI协作和控制权分配对于可靠的机器人神经介入导航比单纯提高自主性更为重要。

title: SNAP: Semantic Navigation Among Pedestrians
authors: Jakob Wolfram, Pascal Roth, Fan Yang, Cesar Cadena, Marco Hutter
abstract: Navigating crowded urban environments requires robots to avoid pedestrians while adhering to social norms such as remaining on sidewalks. Existing approaches typically address either crowd avoidance or semantic path planning in isolation. We propose a reinforcement learning (RL) navigation policy that jointly reasons about semantic terrain and dynamic obstacles from a single semantically annotated bird's-eye-view (BEV) map, without relying on explicit human-state estimation. Our policy outperforms established crowd-navigation and semantic-aware baselines and transfers zero-shot to a legged robot, demonstrating socially compliant navigation in highly dynamic real-world scenarios.
translation: 在拥挤的城市环境中导航需要机器人在避开行人的同时遵守社交规范，例如停留在人行道上。现有的方法通常将人群避让或语义路径规划孤立地处理。我们提出了一种强化学习（RL）导航策略，该策略通过单一的带有语义注释的鸟瞰图（BEV）共同推理语义地形和动态障碍物，而不依赖于显式的人体状态估计。我们的策略优于已建立的人群导航和语义感知基线，并以零样本方式转移到四足机器人上，展示了高度动态真实世界场景中的社交合规导航。
tldr: 提出了一种基于强化学习的语义导航策略SNAP，结合了语义地形与行人避让，并成功在真实四足机器人上实现零样本部署。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将语义地形推理与动态人群避让结合在统一的强化学习框架中，利用单一的BEV地图且无需显式的人体状态估计，实现了Sim-to-Real的零样本迁移，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的导航方法通常将人群避让与语义路径规划割裂开来，无法很好地同时满足在拥挤且受社交规范约束的城市环境中导航的需求。
method: 提出了一种强化学习（RL）导航策略，通过单一的带有语义注释的鸟瞰图（BEV）同时进行语义地形和动态障碍物的推理，且不依赖显式的人体状态估计。
results: 该策略在性能上优于现有的人群导航和语义感知基线，并且能够零样本迁移到四足机器人上，展示了在高度动态的真实世界场景中的社交合规导航能力。
conclusion: 提出的SNAP策略成功实现了复杂城市环境下的社交合规导航，并在真实四足机器人上得到了有效验证。

title: CoLa3D: Composable Latent 3D Decomposition
authors: Xudong Cai, Yongcai Wang, Deying Li, Chuanxia Zheng
abstract: We introduce CoLa3D, a simple and effective model for composable 3D scene decomposition that, given a single whole-scene latent from either a single image or an existing scene mesh as input, directly outputs a set of object meshes with consistent spatial layout that can be assembled back into a coherent scene. CoLa3D introduces a novel paradigm for 3D scene decomposition within a shared whole-scene latent, unlike alternatives that perform per-object generation in canonical spaces and then glue the objects back together with fragile pose and scale estimation. The network is a lightweight, flexible, and scalable query-based transformer that accepts various types of queries, including 2D masks, 3D points, and learnable queries, and learns to decompose the scene into objects in a compact latent space. On both synthetic and real-world datasets, CoLa3D achieves state-of-the-art performance on composable 3D scene decomposition, substantially improving global scene-level consistency and object-level quality while running 2 times faster and using less than 1% of SAM 3D's training data. Visible depth on par with MoGe2 further confirms that latent decomposition preserves accurate visible scene geometry while producing physically complete, decomposable object meshes.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://master-cai.github.io/CoLa3D/
zh_title: CoLa3D：可组合的潜在3D场景分解
translation: 我们介绍了CoLa3D，这是一个简单且高效的可组合3D场景分解模型。给定来自单张图像或现有场景网格的单个全景潜在表示作为输入，它直接输出一组具有一致空间布局的物体网格，这些网格可以重新组装成一个连贯的场景。CoLa3D在共享的全景潜在空间内引入了一种新颖的3D场景分解范式，这与那些在规范空间中执行逐个物体生成然后通过脆弱的姿态和尺度估计将物体拼凑在一起的替代方法不同。该网络是一个轻量、灵活且可扩展的基于查询的Transformer，它接受各种类型的查询（包括2D掩码、3D点和可学习查询），并学会在紧凑的潜在空间中将场景分解为物体。在合成数据集和真实数据集上，CoLa3D在可组合3D场景分解方面取得了最先进的性能，大幅提升了全局场景级一致性和物体级质量，同时运行速度快2倍，且使用的训练数据不到SAM 3D的1%。与MoGe2相当的可视深度进一步证实，潜在分解在生成物理完整、可分解的物体网格的同时，保留了准确可见的场景几何形状。
tldr: CoLa3D是一个高效的可组合3D场景分解模型，能够在紧凑的潜在空间中直接将全场景表征分解为具有一致空间布局的高质量物体网格。
ai_comments: CoLa3D提出了一种新颖的在共享全景潜在空间中进行3D场景分解的范式，避免了传统方法中繁琐的姿态和尺度估计。该模型轻量高效，支持多种查询方式，在效率和性能上均取得了显著突破。
motivation: 现有的3D场景分解方法通常在规范空间中进行逐个物体的生成，然后通过脆弱的姿态和尺度估计将物体拼接在一起，缺乏全局一致性且过程繁琐。为此，需要一种更高效、更具全局一致性的3D场景分解范式。
method: 提出了一种轻量、灵活且可扩展的基于查询的Transformer网络，接受2D掩码、3D点和可学习查询等多种类型的查询，在紧凑的潜在空间中将场景分解为物体。
results: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上均实现了最先进的性能，显著提升了全局场景级一致性和物体级质量，运行速度快2倍，且训练数据少于SAM 3D的1%。
conclusion: CoLa3D是一种简单而有效的可组合3D场景分解模型，能够在保持全局一致性的同时高效生成高质量的完整物体网格，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Connected Dominating Sets in Triangulations
authors: Prosenjit Bose, Vida Dujmović, Hussein Houdrouge, Pat Morin, Saeed Odak
abstract: A dominating set of a graph $G$ is \emph{connected} if it induces a connected graph in $G$. For planar triangulations, it has been known since 1990 that every $n$-vertex triangulation with $n\ge4$ admits a connected dominating set of size at most $n/2 - 1$, and no improvement to this bound was known for over three decades. We break this longstanding barrier by showing that every $n$-vertex triangulation has a connected dominating set of size at most $10n/21$. Equivalently, every triangulation admits a spanning tree with at least $11n/21$ leaves. This result has graph drawing applications, establishing a bound for one-bend free sets and improving the known bound for simultaneous planar embeddings. The connected dominating set results extend readily to show that an $n$-vertex triangulation of a surface of Euler genus $g$ has a connected dominating set of size at most $10n/21+O(\sqrt{gn})$.
comment: Updated version with several corrections and improvements. Most notably, the use of potential functions rather than linear programs to bound the sizes of dominating sets
zh_title: 三角剖分中的连通控制集
translation: 图$G$的控制集如果其在$G$中诱导出一个连通图，则称其为连通控制集。对于平面三角剖分，自1990年以来人们已知每个顶点数$n \ge 4$的$n$顶点三角剖分都承认一个大小至多为$n/2 - 1$的连通控制集，且在三十多年里这一界限一直没有被改进。我们通过证明每个$n$顶点三角剖分都有一个大小至多为$10n/21$的连通控制集，打破了这一长期的障碍。等价地，每个三角剖分都承认一个具有至少$11n/21$个叶子的生成树。这一结果具有图绘制应用，为单弯曲自由集（one-bend free sets）建立了一个界限，并改进了同时平面嵌入（simultaneous planar embeddings）的已知界限。连通控制集的结果可以很容易地推广，以表明Euler亏格为$g$的曲面上的$n$顶点三角剖分具有大小至多为$10n/21 + O(\sqrt{gn})$的连通控制集。
tldr: 打破了三角剖分连通控制集大小保持三十多年的上界，证明了其上界至多为10n/21。
ai_comments: 该论文突破了平面三角剖分中长达30余年的连通控制集大小界限（n/2-1），将上界改进为10n/21，具有重要的理论意义，并在图绘制等领域有直接应用。
motivation: 平面三角剖分的连通控制集大小上界（n/2-1）在过去三十多年中一直没有得到改进，作者旨在打破这一长期存在的障碍。
method: 通过理论证明和构造性分析，给出了三角剖分中连通控制集的新上界，并将其扩展到了高亏格曲面。
results: 证明了每个n个顶点的三角剖分都有一个大小至多为10n/21的连通控制集（等价于存在至少有11n/21个叶子的生成树），并将该结果推广到Euler亏格为g的曲面三角剖分。
conclusion: 论文成功改进了平面及有界亏格曲面上三角剖分的连通控制集上界，并将其转化为生成树叶子节点数的下界，解决了长期未决的问题。

title: NitiBench+: A Temporal Thai Legal Question Answering Benchmark Across 17 Domains
authors: Pawitsapak Akarajaradwong, Sarana Nutanong, Chompakorn Chaksangchaichot
abstract: Law changes over time. A court decides a case under the law in force on that day, and legal QA benchmarks grade answers against today's law. We checked 156,650 decisions of four Thai courts. Up to 67% of them cite law that has since been amended or repealed. We introduce NitiBench+, the sequel of our NitiBench, a Thai legal QA benchmark with 1,670 items across 17 domains, built from decisions of three courts. For each cited section it holds both the text in force on the decision date and the current text, and its retrieval corpus holds every dated version of every Thai statute section. Answers are graded on the Thai Bar Council rubric, the Bar-standard score, and on the overlap between the cited sections and the court's. The report has two parts. Part I measures the cost of the wrong text on 13 open-weight models. Reading the current text of amended law drops the Bar-standard score by 0.25 and missing repealed law drops it by 0.79. The penalty comes from rule changes, 0.45 on the 428 rule-changed items and none on the 331 wording-only items, and Citation F1 does not see it. The text in force is the fair setting. Part II benchmarks today's models on that setting. A public leaderboard ranks 26 models on a held-out test split of 500 items stratified by domain, with a validation split of the same shape released for public use, from memory alone, with the court's sections provided, and as a retrieval agent over the law in force, with the cost per item and the hallucinated citations. The best model scores 7.78 out of 10 and the best open-weight model 6.39. Without a search tool only five open-weight models recall any Thai law, and with it twenty of the 26 models gain and six lose. Leaderboard will take new models as they are released. Legal benchmarks must track dates, and on the right text today's models still leave a wide gap on Thai law.
zh_title: NitiBench+：跨越17个领域的泰国时态法律问答基准
translation: 法律随时间而改变。法院根据当日生效的法律对案件进行裁决，而法律问答基准则是根据今天的法律来评分。我们检查了四个泰国法院的156,650份判决，其中高达67%的判决引用了此后已被修改或废除的法律。我们推出了NitiBench+（NitiBench的后续版本），这是一个包含来自三个法院、跨越17个领域的1,670个项目的泰国法律QA基准。对于引用的每一条法律，它既保留了裁决日生效的文本，也保留了当前的文本，其检索语料库包含了每个泰国法规条款的所有历史版本。答案根据泰国律师协会评分标准、律师标准分数以及引用的条款与法院引用的条款之间的重叠度进行评分。报告分为两部分。第一部分衡量了错误文本对13个开放权重模型的影响。阅读修改后法律的当前文本会使律师标准分数下降0.25，而遗漏废除的法律会使其下降0.79。这种惩罚来自规则的变化（在428个规则变更的项目中有0.45的下降，而在331个仅措辞变更的项目中没有下降），并且引用F1值无法检测到这一点。生效文本才是公平的设置。第二部分在这一设置下对当今的模型进行了基准测试。一个公共排行榜根据按领域分层的500个项目的留出测试集对26个模型进行了排名，同时发布了相同形状的验证集供公众使用（包括纯记忆、提供法院条款、以及作为检索代理访问生效的法律，并记录了每个项目的成本和幻觉引用）。表现最好的模型得分为10分中的7.78分，最佳开源模型为6.39分。在没有搜索工具的情况下，只有五个开源模型能回忆起任何泰国法律；有了搜索工具，26个模型中有20个得分上升，6个下降。排行榜将随着新模型的发布而不断更新。法律基准必须跟踪日期，而在正确的文本设置下，当今的模型在泰国法律方面仍然存在巨大差距。
tldr: 本文提出了NitiBench+，一个首创的考虑时间维度的泰国法律问答基准，并揭示了当前大模型在处理时效性法律时的性能差距。
ai_comments: 该论文指出了法律随时间变化的动态性对法律问答基准的重要影响，填补了泰国法律时态问答基准的空白，并量化了使用错误法律文本带来的性能下降，具有很高的实用价值和创新性。
motivation: 现有的法律问答基准通常根据今天的法律来评分，但法院审判时依据的是当天的法律，而高达67%的泰国法院判决引用了已被修改或废除的法律，因此需要一个考虑时间维度的法律QA基准。
method: 构建包含1,670个条目（覆盖17个领域）的NitiBench+基准，提供判决时的有效法律文本与当前文本，利用泰国律师协会评分标准进行评估，并在多种设置下对26个模型进行了测试。
results: 研究发现使用当前文本或缺失废除法条会导致评分显著下降；最佳模型得分为7.78/10，最佳开源模型为6.39，模型在泰国法律任务上仍有很大提升空间。
conclusion: 法律基准必须考虑时间维度，而当前的开源及闭源模型在处理泰国法律时仍存在较大差距。

title: Data-Efficient Kernel Methods for Learning Differential Equations and Their Solution Operators: Algorithms and Error Analysis
authors: Bamdad Hosseini, Alexander Hsu, Yasamin Jalalian, Juan Felipe Osorio Ramirez, Houman Owhadi
abstract: We introduce a novel kernel-based framework for learning differential equations and their solution maps. The framework is efficient in its data requirements in terms of the number of observed states and the amount of data available per state. Our formulation also allows us to employ efficient Gauss-Newton-type optimization algorithms in the training procedure to improve accuracy and speed of the training procedure. We also support our algorithm with rigorous theoretical guarantees in the form of quantitative worst-case error bounds for the learned equation that can be extended to the subsequent solution operators under smoothness assumptions. Numerical benchmarks demonstrate significant improvements in computational complexity and robustness while achieving one to two orders of magnitude improvements in terms of accuracy compared to certain state-of-the-art algorithms.
zh_title: 用于学习微分方程及其解算 Data-Efficient 核方法：算法与误差分析
translation: 我们引入了一个新颖的基于核的框架，用于学习微分方程及其解映射。该框架在观测状态数量和每个状态可用数据量方面的数据需求非常高效。我们的公式还允许在训练过程中采用高效的高斯-牛顿型优化算法，以提高训练过程的准确性和速度。我们还通过严格的理论保证支持我们的算法，这些理论保证以为所学方程的定量最坏情况误差界的形式给出，并且在平滑性假设下可以扩展到后续的解算子。数值基准测试证明了计算复杂度和鲁棒性的显着改善，同时与某些最先进的算法相比，在准确性方面实现了1到2个数量级的提升。
tldr: 提出一种数据高效的核方法框架，用于学习微分方程及其解算子，具有高训练速度、严格的理论误差保证和卓越的实验精度。
ai_comments: 该论文在学习微分方程及其解算子方面做出了重要贡献，通过引入新颖的基于核的方法，不仅在数据效率和计算复杂度上表现优异，还提供了严格的理论误差保证，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。
motivation: 为了克服现有方法在学习微分方程及解算子时对大量数据的依赖以及训练效率和鲁棒性不足的问题，开发一种数据高效且理论基础扎实的算法。
method: 提出了一种新颖的基于核的框架来学习微分方程及其解映射，并采用高效的高斯-牛顿型优化算法进行训练，同时进行了严格的理论误差分析。
results: 数值基准测试表明，与某些最先进的算法相比，该方法在计算复杂度和鲁棒性上有显著改善，同时精度提升了一到两个数量级。
conclusion: 该基于核的框架在学习微分方程及解算子方面兼具高效的数据利用率、快速的优化算法和严格的理论保证，数值实验证明其性能超越了多种最先进的算法。

title: Contextful Arrows via Wreath Products
authors: Matteo Capucci, David Jaz Myers
abstract:
We introduce contextads and the Ctx construction, unifying various structures and constructions in category theory dealing with context and contextful arrows---comonads and their Kleisli construction, actegories and their Para construction, adequate triples and their Span construction. Contextads are defined in terms of Lack--Street wreaths, suitably categorified for pseudomonads in a tricategory of spans in a 2-category with display maps. The associated wreath product provides the Ctx construction, and by its universal property we conclude trifunctoriality. This abstract approach lets us work up to structure, and thus swiftly prove that, under very mild assumptions, a contextad equipped colaxly with a 2-algebraic structure produces a similarly structured double category of contextful arrows.
  We also explore the role contextads might play qua dependently graded comonads in organizing contextful computation in functional programming. We show that many side-effects monads can be dually captured by dependently graded comonads, and gesture towards a general result on the `transposability' of parametric right adjoint monads to dependently graded comonads.
comment: 120 pages, used to be titled "Contextads as Wreaths; Kleisli, Para, and Span Constructions as Wreath Products". The page count increased for formatting reasons, content is mostly the same up to some fixes and twiddles
zh_title: 通过圈积实现的上下文箭头
translation:
我们引入了contextads和Ctx构造，统一了范畴论中处理上下文和上下文箭头的各种结构与构造——余子单子及其Kleisli构造、作用范畴（actegories）及其Para构造、充分三元组（adequate triples）及其Span构造。Contextads是通过Lack--Street圈积定义的，并针对带有显示映射的2-范畴中span三范畴中的拟单子进行了适当的范畴化。相关的圈积提供了Ctx构造，根据其泛性质我们得出其具有三函子性（trifunctoriality）。这种抽象方法使我们能够在结构上进行操作，从而迅速证明：在非常温和的假设下，以colax方式配备2-代数结构的contextad会产生一个具有类似结构的上下文箭头的双范畴。
我们还探讨了contextads在函数式编程中组织上下文计算时，作为依赖分级余子单子可能扮演的角色。我们表明，许多副作用单子可以对偶地被依赖分级余子单子捕获，并指向了关于参数化右伴随单子可“转置”为依赖分级余子单子的一般结果。
tldr: 本文利用圈积（wreath products）在范畴论中统一了各种上下文结构，并探讨其在函数式编程上下文计算中的应用。
ai_comments: 该论文通过范畴论中的圈积（wreath products）和Lack-Street圈积，巧妙地统一了多种处理上下文和上下文箭头的结构（如余子单子、Para结构和Span结构），在函数式编程的依赖分级余子单子（dependently graded comonads）应用方面展现了深刻的理论价值和潜力。
motivation: 为了统一范畴论中处理上下文和上下文箭头的各种现存结构与构造（如余子单子、Para、Span），并通过抽象方法在函数式编程中组织上下文计算。
method: 利用Lack-Street圈积、拟单子（pseudomonads）在带显示映射的2-范畴中的span三范畴，以及其泛性质导出了Ctx构造的 trifunctoriality。
results: 证明了在极度温和的假设下，配备了colax 2-代数结构的contextad可以产生具有相似结构的上下文箭头双范畴，并展示了其在函数式编程中对副作用单子的对偶捕获。
conclusion: 引入了contextads和Ctx结构，统一了范畴论中处理上下文的多种结构，并为其在函数式编程中的应用提供了理论基础。

title: Bounded Discrete Bridges
authors: Pierre Nicodeme
abstract: In 2010 Banderier and Nicodeme consider the height of bounded discrete bridges and conclude to a limiting Rayleigh distribution. This result is correct although their proof is partly erroneous. They make asymptotic simplifications based upon dominance properties of the roots of the kernel of the walk within a disk centered at the origin, but these dominance properties apply only upon a positive real segment. However the very good agreement of simulations with their asymptotic expansion of the probability distribution in case of Łukasiewicz bridges let us think that their proof could be corrected. This is the scope of the present article which provides a proof using the dominance property only in its domain of validity. We also consider the case of periodic walks, a topic not considered in Banderier-Nicodeme2010..
comment: 43 pages, 6 figures including 11 PDF files (1 of them Maple worksheet) Introduction (4 pages) added, sections 5.2.1 and 5.2.2, remarks 6 and 7 pushed to appendix
translation: 在2010年，Banderier和Nicodeme研究了有界离散桥的高度，并得出其渐近分布为瑞利分布的结论。这一结论是正确的，尽管他们的证明部分存在错误。他们基于随机游走核的根在原点为中心盘内的显赫（主导）性质做了渐近简化，但这些主导性质仅在正实数段上适用。然而，模拟结果与他们在Łukasiewicz桥情况下概率分布的渐近展开式高度吻合，这让我们认为他们的证明是可以被修正的。本文的范围正是提供一个仅在其有效域内使用主导性质的证明。我们还考虑了周期性随机游走的情况，这是Banderier-Nicodeme（2010）未曾考虑的主题。
tldr: 本文修正了有界离散桥高度渐近分布的一个含有瑕疵的著名证明，并将其推广至周期性随机游走。

motivation: Banderier和Nicodeme（2010）在研究有界离散桥高度时得出了正确的瑞利分布极限，但其证明过程在将根的主导性质应用于整个圆盘时存在错误，本文旨在修正这一证明。
method: 使用核根的主导性质在其严格的有效域内进行渐近分析，并将其推广至周期性随机游走。

title: Optimality of the $D_4$ lattice quantizer
authors: Tianle Liu
abstract: We prove that the root lattice $D_4$ uniquely minimizes the normalized second moment among four-dimensional lattices, up to similarity. The minimum is $13/(120\sqrt{2})$. The proof reduces the problem to polynomial inequalities on three secondary cones. We derive the second-moment formulas geometrically and give explicit polynomial certificates that can be checked by coefficient comparison. We also derive a lower bound for lattice quantizers in every dimension at least two from the number of Voronoi facets, using a comparison with circular cones and concavity in the solid angle. This bound strictly improves the sphere bound and recovers the hexagonal value in dimension two.
comment: Simplified the proof of four-dimensional optimality, with explicit polynomial certificates now included in the paper. Main results unchanged

title: Cyclotomic polynomials with trinomial irreducible factors over finite fields
authors: Li Zhu, Hongfeng Wu
abstract: We classify the pairs $(q,n)$, where $q$ is a prime power, $n>1$, and $\gcd(n,q)=1$, for which every irreducible factor of $Φ_n(x)$ over $\F_q$ has exactly three nonzero terms. The positive support exponents of these factors have a common greatest common divisor, which gives a unique reduction by a power substitution. The reduced degree is two in odd characteristic and belongs to $\{2,3,4\}$ in characteristic two; the cubic and quartic cases arise by scalar substitution from the layers of orders $7$ and $15$. This yields necessary and sufficient arithmetic conditions on $(q,n)$ and explicit factorizations. Among the classified families, precisely those arising from quartic bases have a divisor layer containing an irreducible factor with more than three terms.

title: TransfoRhythm: A Transformer Architecture Conductive to Blood Pressure Estimation via Solo PPG Signal Capturing
authors: Amir Arjomand, Amin Boudesh, Farnoush Bayatmakou, Kenneth B. Kent, Arash Mohammadi
abstract: Recent statistics indicate that approximately 1.3 billion individuals worldwide suffer from hypertension, a leading cause of premature death globally. Blood Pressure (BP) serves as a critical health indicator for accurate and timely diagnosis and/or treatment of hypertension. Traditional BP measurement methods rely on cuff-based approaches, which lack real-time, continuous, and reliable BP estimates, crucial for the timely diagnosis/treatment of hypertension. Driven by recent advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), there has been a surge of interest in developing data-driven and cuff-less BP estimation solutions. In this context, current literature predominantly focuses on coupling Electrocardiography (ECG) and Photoplethysmography (PPG) sensors, though this approach is constrained by reliance on multiple sensor types. An alternative, utilizing standalone PPG signals, presents challenges due to the absence of auxiliary sensors (ECG), requiring the use of morphological features while addressing motion artifacts and high-frequency noise. To address these issues, the paper introduces the TransfoRhythm framework, a Transformer-based DNN architecture built upon the recently released physiological database, MIMIC-IV. Leveraging the Multi-Head Attention (MHA) mechanism, TransfoRhythm identifies dependencies and similarities across data segments, forming a robust framework for cuff-less BP estimation solely using PPG signals. To our knowledge, this paper represents the first study to apply the MIMIC IV dataset for cuff-less BP estimation. TransfoRhythm achieves highly accurate results with a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of [2.21, 1.84] and a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of [1.37, 1.06] for systolic and diastolic blood pressures, respectively.
zh_title: TransfoRhythm：一种利用单一PPG信号采集进行血压估计的Transformer架构
translation: 近期统计数据显示，全球约有13亿人患有高血压，这是全球早死的主要原因。血压（BP）是准确及时诊断和/或治疗高血压的关键健康指标。传统的血压测量方法依赖于袖带式方法，缺乏实时、连续且可靠的血压估计，而这对于高血压的及时诊断/治疗至关重要。在人工智能（AI）和深度神经网络（DNNs）近期进展的推动下，开发数据驱动的无袖带血压估计方案引起了人们的极大兴趣。在此背景下，当前文献主要集中于将心电图（ECG）和光电容积脉搏波（PPG）传感器相结合，尽管这种方法受限于对多种传感器类型的依赖。另一种利用独立PPG信号的方法由于缺乏辅助传感器（ECG）而面临挑战，需要利用形态学特征，同时解决运动伪影和高频噪声问题。为了解决这些问题，本文引入了TransfoRhythm框架，这是一个基于Transformer的DNN架构，建立在最近发布的生理数据库MIMIC-IV之上。利用多头注意力（MHA）机制，TransfoRhythm识别数据段之间的依赖关系和相似性，形成一个仅使用PPG信号进行无袖带血压估计的强大框架。据我们所知，本文代表了第一项将MIMIC-IV数据集应用于无袖带血压估计的研究。TransfoRhythm取得了高准确度的结果，收缩压和舒张压的均方根误差（RMSE）分别为[2.21, 1.84]，平均绝对误差（MAE）分别为[1.37, 1.06]。
tldr: 本文提出了TransfoRhythm，首个基于MIMIC-IV数据集的、仅使用单PPG信号进行高精度无袖带血压估计的Transformer框架。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出仅基于单光电容积脉搏波（PPG）信号进行无袖带血压估计的TransfoRhythm框架，并首次将MIMIC-IV数据库应用于该任务中，利用多头注意力机制有效克服了缺乏ECG辅助信号带来的挑战，在精度上取得了优异的成果。
motivation: 传统的基于袖带的血压测量方法无法提供实时、连续和可靠的血压估计。虽然现有的AI无袖带方案多采用ECG和PPG双传感器，但存在局限性；而使用单一PPG信号则面临缺乏辅助传感器、需要处理形态学特征及运动伪影和高频噪声的挑战。因此，需要开发一个仅依赖单PPG信号且高效准确的无袖带血压估计框架。

title: A Neuroprosthetic SoC Featuring Rapid Local Sensory Feedback with On-Chip Unsupervised Multi-Class Spike Sorting
authors: Bowen Liu, Yuhan Hou, Yu Huang, Jianxiong Xu, Hao You, Ashley Hung, Naize Yang, Junyu Ma, Laura Kondrataviciute, Suneil K. Kalia, Andrew G. Richardson, Roman Genov, Xilin Liu
abstract: This letter presents a 65 nm neuroprosthetic system-on-chip (SoC) featuring a rapid feedback pathway from motor recording to sensory stimulation. To enable low-latency sensory mapping modulated by individual-neuron firing rates, the SoC integrates a mixed-signal unsupervised spike-sorting module with stimulation-artifact rejection, a programmable sliding-window firing-rate calculator, and a closed-loop controller for adapting stimulation parameters. The spike-sorting module combines event-driven analog feature extraction with Manhattan-distance-based digital clustering while consuming 1.6 $μ$W/channel. On the Quiroga Difficult-1 benchmark, it achieves 94.58% three-class accuracy, with only a 0.4% reduction when stimulation artifacts are introduced at 20% of the spike count. The closed-loop controller supports polynomial and logarithmic mapping functions and incorporates Mitchell's approximation for power saving. The SoC is fully characterized on the bench and in vivo.
comment: 4 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Author's accepted manuscript. Accepted for publication in IEEE Solid-State Circuits Letters

title: Mission Capability-Aware UAV Swarm Coordination for Autonomous Disaster Response
authors: Mudassar Shakeel, Taha Mahmood, Ahmed Naeem, Muhammad Hamza Jehangir, El Mehdi Amhoud, Syed Ali Hassan
abstract: This paper proposes an artificial intelligence (AI) driven mission capability aware unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm coordination framework for autonomous post disaster search and rescue. An integrated sensing and communication enabled master high altitude platform station senses the disaster environment, detects victims and hazards, and constructs adaptive rescue regions based on spatially varying mission demands. A mission capability requirement (MCR) quantifies regional capability demand, while a normalized mission capability score (MCS) characterizes the real time capability of individual UAVs. A capability-aware assignment mechanism matches UAV capabilities to regional requirements while minimizing deployment distance. An MCS based reallocation mechanism dynamically transfers UAVs from capability surplus to capability deficient regions while preserving donor sufficiency. A hierarchical deep reinforcement learning framework with proximal policy optimization performs high-level region selection, while MCR MCS matching enables feasible UAV level reallocation. Finally, joint trajectory optimization considers travel time, distance, propulsion energy, operational capability, obstacle avoidance, and inter UAV collision avoidance. Theoretical analysis and simulations demonstrate improved mission capability satisfaction, resource efficiency, and disaster response performance

title: Seeing Why: Exact Evidence Maps for Quantum and Optical Image Classifiers
authors: Teerawat Tongloy, Rangsan Jomtarak
abstract: When an image classifier decides, we can usually only estimate why. For quantum and all-optical classifiers that act linearly on amplitude-encoded pictures up to the measurement, with no trained classical network before or after them, each class's Born probability above its no-information share, $P_g - b_g$, splits exactly into contributions of the encoded amplitudes, shown as Born evidence maps (BEM) over the picture. The split itself follows from known results on quadratic forms: with the transmitted light held fixed, it is what Integrated Gradients from a zero baseline and the Shapley value give. What we add is a way to measure it on the hardware that classifies, from class probabilities on a quantum chip or from camera frames on a lens bench, with no gradient circuit and no light sent backwards; a $g\times g$ map takes $1 + 2g^2$ runs. Deleting the 5% of pixels with the highest evidence drops accuracy from 73% to 9%, as occlusion does with 1,024 extra runs per picture, whereas gradient saliency removes much less. The classifiers share one architecture, a Fourier-plane mask followed by a brickwall circuit on qubits or by phase plates on a lens bench, read by a fixed Born headroom readout with no trained parameter; centring each picture on its own mean lets dark features count as much as bright ones. In simulation, four phase plates at a single wavelength reach 72.3% on Caltech-10 colour photographs. On IBM's ibm_kingston, with the mask applied before approximate loading, 300 test pictures were classified at 37.7% against 10% by chance (56.3% in exact simulation), and $2\times2$ maps of ten correctly classified pictures, one per class chosen by a stated rule, measured on the chip, agreed with the exact ones ($r = 0.77$). The maps also revealed a shortcut in the data; as the trim that removed it was chosen on test pictures, the Caltech-10 results are exploratory.
comment: 38 pages, 13 figures, 16 tables. title: GTAC: A Graph-Transformer Actor-Critic for Carrier-Aware MU-MIMO User Grouping
authors: Yan Huang, Charles Santhosam Lourdu Raja, Rajesh Gadiyar
abstract: Achieving higher spectral efficiency (SE) in 5G and future 6G networks requires efficient massive multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) grouping under coupled physical-layer constraints and strict scheduling deadlines. Motivated by industry efforts in AI-native RAN, we propose Graph-Transformer Actor-Critic (GTAC), a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) architecture for carrier-aware MU-MIMO user grouping. The objective is to maximize the long-term proportional-fair (PF) utility of the cell subject to constraints from the practical stack protocol. GTAC comprises a shared actor--critic encoder with spatial-edge-biased attention mechanism, a pointer decoder actor that generates grouping decisions, and a multi-stage transformer critic that estimates the carrier-wide state-value during training. Training begins by cloning a teacher policy that cannot meet real-time deployment deadlines, followed by critic warmup and two-stage reinforcement learning using proximal policy optimization (PPO), first on a narrow, power-matched carrier and then on the full carrier with a Kullback--Leibler (KL) policy anchor. After two-stage PPO, the best GTAC policy outperforms the non-real-time teacher by 11.6% in carrier SE, while exceeding its PF utility and preserving the cell-edge throughput. A CUDA implementation of GTAC achieves a 69.6 us inference latency on an RTX PRO 4500 GPU, below the targeted 100 us inference budget in practical systems.

title: Beyond TR 38.811 for 6G NTN Channel Models
authors: Kuan-Po Chiu, Aaron Jacob Buck, Sumit Roy
abstract: As the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) expands 6G non-terrestrial network (NTN) to S, Ku, and Ka bands for integration with existing terrestrial cellular networks, the necessary satellite channel model for link and network performance evaluation remains tied to TR 38.811, last revised in 2020. We identify issues on multiple fronts: inappropriate parameter specifications based on very limited site-specific environments considered, omission of satellite-induced Doppler spread and directional antenna effects and lack of a transparent channel model generation procedure. To address these limitations, we re-derive the channel parameters using ray tracing (RT) over urban and rural environments based on ITU-R building statistics. Our results show that TR 38.811 substantially overestimates the K-factor at low elevations and predicts a decreasing trend with elevation, which is inconsistent with RT. The Ka-band clutter loss (CL) also exceeds the RT estimates by more than 15 dB in urban cases. It also underestimates rural delay spread (DS) at low elevations and predicts an elevation trend inconsistent with RT. We further quantify the previously neglected satellite-induced Doppler spread. Finally, we demonstrate that the conventional TR 38.811 channel generator significantly underestimates the K-factor in the presence of directional antenna (beamforming), while our modified generator substantially reduces this discrepancy.

title: RFShape: An IQ-Pretrained Wireless Foundation Model for Heterogeneous IQ & CIR Representations
authors: Mohammad Cheraghinia, Sebbe Van Der Smissen, Jaron Fontaine, Delia Rico, Eli De Poorter, Adnan Shahid
abstract: In wireless systems, foundation models have been proposed as alternative artificial intelligence models to replace task-specific models with a shared pretrained model that can be reused across many downstream applications (source separation, interference detection, localization, etc.). These wireless foundation models promise to reuse learned representations across diverse tasks, but choosing a foundation model also means choosing its input representation. For example, a model pretrained on spectrograms expects spectrograms, while one pretrained on in-phase/quadrature (IQ) samples expects IQ, limiting which pretrained model can be used for a given downstream problem. To remedy this, we present RFShape, a 7.4 M-parameter foundation model that breaks this coupling by adapting how a signal is presented to a shared pretrained encoder. RFShape is pretrained solely on synthetic IQ waveforms, without real captures, labels, or channel impulse responses (CIRs), and uses deterministic representation operators to support heterogeneous downstream inputs. Across ten tasks and nine datasets unseen during pretraining, the same encoder supports classification, ranging-error regression, and two-dimensional positioning. Representation selection alone increases 23-class radar recognition from 23.0% to 69.5% and short-range technology recognition from 70.8% to 97.1%. RFShape also outperforms CIR-pretrained ultra-wideband baselines by up to 12.7 percentage points for (N)LOS classification despite never observing CIRs during pretraining. These results show that foundation-model reuse need not be limited by the representation or modality seen during pretraining, and adapting how a signal is presented can extend a single pretrained encoder across heterogeneous wireless tasks.

title: Simulation-Driven Approach for Occlusion-Based Non-Line-Of-Sight Detection Using a Low-Cost Flash LiDAR
authors: Peizhao Qiu, Emmanuel A Olowe, Zhenya Zang, Istvan Gyongy, Danial Chitnis
abstract: Non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging aims to sense objects outside the direct line of sight. While most previous work focuses on the canonical around-the-corner configuration, this work considers a more challenging occlusion-based NLOS setting in which targets are hidden by scene geometry. To avoid the challenge of collecting large real-world datasets, we have developed a photon-based Monte Carlo simulator to generate diverse synthetic training data and validate against experimental data. We trained an AI model to identify multi-bounce photon patterns associated with hidden targets. The model achieves an Average Precision (AP) of 0.91 on synthetic test data and, when transferred directly to 180 real measurements acquired with a TMF8829 SPAD flash LiDAR, achieves 86.67% accuracy and an AP of 0.95. These results show that simulated transient data can support hidden-target detection with a low-cost commercial sensor and provide an initial step toward more general occlusion-based NLOS sensing and, ultimately, hidden-scene reconstruction.

title: Positioning and Radiation Efficiency Degrees of Freedom in Cascaded Pinching-Antenna Arrays
authors: Ozgur Ergul
abstract: In a pinching-antenna system (PASS), a single source feeds multiple pinches, resulting in a cascade that couples their radiated powers. A shared radiated-power limit, such as the interference power constraint in an underlay cognitive radio network, couples them again. We study such a network where PASS serves the secondary users. First, we formulate the joint optimization problem of the two degrees of freedom (DoF), pinch positions and radiation efficiencies, and characterize the single-link optimum analytically. Then, rather than proposing one method, we present the results for a grid of schemes whose two axes are the two DoF. Under an order-free attribution, positioning is worth 1.34 times radiation efficiency, and the two are near-perfect substitutes. We also show that substitutability is due to the constraint and not the cascade, since relaxing the constraint by 20 dB removes 97% of their interaction. At the joint reference, not knowing the primary receiver (PR) location costs 6.23 bit/s/Hz, more than twice the 2.87 that optimizing both DoF is worth. Instantaneous fading information adds a further 0.29 bit/s/Hz. Allocating efficiencies at equally spaced positions reaches 98% of the joint reference at about three orders of magnitude less computation.
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to the IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications

title: ELiCv2: Learned LiDAR Geometry Compression under Real-Time Embedded Constraints
authors: Soowoong Kim, Junsik Kim, Gun Bang, Jinsoo Choi
abstract: Improving learned LiDAR compression increasingly relies on heavier inference, making it harder to meet the constraints of real-time embedded systems. We present ELiCv2, which removes two sources of redundant computation in progressive coding. Its discrete entropy interface selects a precomputed integer CDF instead of materializing one from a per-voxel distribution, while its occupancy-driven kernel-map builder derives finer-level sparse-convolution kernel-maps directly from the decoded hierarchy, eliminating coordinate-based neighbor search. ELiCv2 reinvests the recovered computation budget in lightweight ego-motion-aware temporal conditioning that gathers local occupancy context from the aligned previous reconstruction. On four LiDAR datasets and an NVIDIA Jetson Thor, ELiCv2 achieves a mean BD-rate reduction of 30.97% over G-PCC with channel width C=32 while sustaining the 20Hz nuScenes capture rate. Increasing the channel width to C=64 improves the mean reduction to 35.22%.
zh_title: ELiCv2：面向实时嵌入式约束的学习型LiDAR几何压缩
translation: 提高学习型LiDAR压缩的性能越来越依赖于更繁重的推理，这使得满足实时嵌入式系统的约束变得更加困难。我们提出了ELiCv2，它去除了渐进式编码中两个来源的冗余计算。其离散熵接口选择预计算的整数CDF，而不是从每个体素的分布中实时生成；其占用驱动的核映射构建器直接从解码的层级结构派生更细级别的稀疏卷积核映射，消除了基于坐标的邻居搜索。ELiCv2将恢复的计算预算重新投入到轻量级的自身运动感知时间条件中，从对齐的前一个重建中收集局部占用上下文。在四个LiDAR数据集和一个NVIDIA Jetson Thor上，当通道宽度C=32时，ELiCv2相比G-PCC实现了平均30.97%的BD-rate减少，同时维持了nuScenes的20Hz采集帧率。将通道宽度增加到C=64时，平均减少率提高到35.22%。
tldr: ELiCv2通过消除冗余计算和引入轻量级时间条件，在嵌入式系统上实现了高效且满足实时要求的LiDAR点云几何压缩。
ai_comments: 该论文在端侧实时LiDAR几何压缩领域做出了重要改进，通过去除冗余计算（离散熵接口和占用驱动的核映射构建器）并引入轻量级的时间条件机制，在保证嵌入式系统实时性的同时显著提升了压缩性能。
motivation: 现有的学习型LiDAR压缩方法日益依赖繁重的推理，难以满足实时嵌入式系统的约束条件。
method: 提出ELiCv2，移除渐进式编码中的两处冗余计算：使用离散熵接口选择预计算的整数CDF，并采用占用驱动的核映射构建器直接由解码层级推导稀疏卷积核映射；同时引入轻量级的自身运动感知时间条件机制。

conclusion: ELiCv2成功在实时嵌入式系统约束下实现了高效的LiDAR几何压缩，兼顾了低延迟和高性能。

title: Toward Generalized LEO Channel Prediction: A Rapid Adaptation Time-Frequency Mamba Framework
authors: Yunxin Geng, Yun Zhao, Weiwei Jiang, Shengfeng Wang, Haotian Liu, Zhiqing Wei
abstract: Accurate channel state information (CSI) prediction is pivotal for enhancing system capacity in low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite-terrestrial communications within the sixth-generation vision of global ubiquitous connectivity. However, the extreme mobility of LEO satellites, coupled with significant propagation delays, induces severe channel aging. Existing deep learning (DL) methods often struggle with non-stationary dynamics or generalize poorly across diverse global geographies. To address these challenges, we design the Evo-TFMamba, which is an evolutionary framework integrating time-frequency selective Mamba blocks with meta-learning for generalized CSI prediction. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed Evo-TFMamba performs adaptive prediction according to the geographic coverage of LEO satellites. Meanwhile, it significantly enhances the model's generalization ability, particularly when faced with unseen channel environments in LEO satellite communication.
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures, IEEE Global Communications Conference (GLOBECOM) 2026
zh_title: 迈向广义低地球轨道信道预测：一个快速自适应时频 Mamba 框架
translation: 准确的信道状态信息（CSI）预测对于在第六代全球泛在连接愿景下的低地球轨道（LEO）卫星与地面通信中提高系统容量至关重要。然而，LEO 卫星的极端移动性以及显著的传播延迟会导致严重的信道老化。现有的深度学习（DL）方法在处理非平稳动态或跨越不同全球地理区域的泛化能力方面常常面临挑战。为了应对这些挑战，我们设计了 Evo-TFMamba，这是一个进化框架，集成了时频选择性 Mamba 模块和元学习，用于广义 CSI 预测。实验结果表明，所提出的 Evo-TFMamba 能够根据 LEO 卫星的地理覆盖范围进行自适应预测。同时，它显著提高了模型的泛化能力，特别是在面对 LEO 卫星通信中未知的信道环境时。
tldr: 该研究提出了 Evo-TFMamba 框架，通过结合时频选择性 Mamba 模块和元学习，实现了 LEO 卫星通信中广义 CSI 的快速自适应预测，解决了传统深度学习方法在处理非平稳动态和跨地域泛化能力方面的不足。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的 Evo-TFMamba 框架，将 Mamba 架构与元学习相结合，以解决 LEO 卫星通信中 CSI 预测的泛化能力和自适应性问题。其在处理非平稳动态和跨地域泛化方面的能力值得关注，为未来 LEO 通信系统的设计提供了有价值的见解。
motivation: LEO 卫星通信中，卫星的极高移动性和显著的传播延迟导致严重的信道老化，现有深度学习方法难以处理非平稳动态或跨地域泛化能力差。
method: 设计了一个名为 Evo-TFMamba 的进化框架，该框架集成了时频选择性 Mamba 模块和元学习，用于广义 CSI 预测。
results: 实验结果表明，Evo-TFMamba 能够根据 LEO 卫星的地理覆盖范围进行自适应预测，并显著提高了模型在 LEO 卫星通信中面对未知信道环境时的泛化能力。
conclusion: Evo-TFMamba 框架能够有效地解决 LEO 卫星通信中 CSI 预测的挑战，通过自适应和泛化能力的提升，为实现全球泛在连接提供了支持。

title: Reconfigurable Antenna-Enhanced ISAC: A Unified Perspective on Electromagnetic Adaptation
authors: Peilan Wang, Lei Xie, Meidong Mei, Jun Fang, Yihong Su, Hongbin Li
abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables sensing and communication (S&C) functions to share time, frequency, and hardware resources, offering an efficient paradigm for next-generation wireless systems. However, conventional fixed-configuration antenna (FCA) architectures provide limited flexibility in adapting the physical electromagnetic (EM) response of the end-to-end wireless link. This article develops a unified EM-adaptation perspective on reconfigurable antenna (RA)-enhanced ISAC systems. We distinguish transceiver-side (TSc-side) and environment-side (Env-side) RA deployments and identify five fundamental EM reconfiguration dimensions: position, orientation, radiation pattern, polarization, and frequency response. Building on this framework, we examine how these dimensions customize communication channels, actively control target information mapping for sensing, and reshape the interplay between S&C, particularly by improving compatibility between S&C requirements under shared resources. Two case studies illustrate how TSc-side and Env-side EM reconfiguration can improve spatial selectivity and the achievable S&C performance tradeoff. Finally, we discuss several promising directions for advancing RA-enhanced ISAC systems, including fundamental performance limits, low-overhead black-box optimization, and artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled semantic ISAC.
zh_title: 可重构天线增强的集成感知与通信：电磁自适应的统一视角
translation: 集成感知与通信（ISAC）使感知与通信（S&C）功能能够共享时间、频率和硬件资源，为下一代无线系统提供了一种高效的范例。然而，传统的固定配置天线（FCA）架构在适应端到端无线链路的物理电磁响应方面灵活性有限。本文开发了一种面向可重构天线（RA）增强的ISAC系统的统一电磁自适应视角。我们区分了收发端（TSc端）和环境端（Env端）的RA部署，并确定了五个基本的电磁重构维度：位置、方向、辐射方向图、极化和频率响应。在此框架的基础上，我们研究了这些维度如何定制通信信道，主动控制传感器的目标信息映射，并重塑S&C之间的相互作用，特别是通过改善共享资源下S&C需求之间的兼容性。两个案例研究说明了TSc端和Env端的电磁重构如何改善空间选择性以及可实现的S&C性能权衡。最后，我们讨论了RA增强的ISAC系统的几个有前景的发展方向，包括基本性能极限、低开销黑盒优化以及人工智能（AI）赋能的语义ISAC。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的电磁自适应视角，用于增强集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统，通过使用可重构天线（RA）来克服传统固定配置天线（FCA）的局限性。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的电磁自适应视角，用于增强ISAC系统，通过可重构天线（RA）克服了传统固定配置天线（FCA）的局限性。该研究的创新性在于将电磁自适应作为统一框架，并区分了收发端和环境端的RA部署，明确了五个关键的电磁重构维度。这为ISAC系统的设计和优化提供了新的思路和方法。然而，该研究可能在实际部署的复杂性和成本方面存在挑战，并且对AI赋能的语义ISAC的讨论仍处于初步阶段。
motivation: 传统的固定配置天线（FCA）在适应无线链路的物理电磁响应方面灵活性有限，阻碍了ISAC系统的效率。
method: 论文提出了一种统一的电磁自适应视角，用于可重构天线（RA）增强的ISAC系统。区分了收发端（TSc端）和环境端（Env端）的RA部署，并确定了五个基本的电磁重构维度：位置、方向、辐射方向图、极化和频率响应。通过这两个维度来定制通信信道，主动控制传感器的目标信息映射，并重塑S&C之间的相互作用。
results: 通过两个案例研究，说明了TSc端和Env端的电磁重构可以改善空间选择性以及可实现的S&C性能权衡。
conclusion: 可重构天线（RA）通过其电磁自适应能力，为ISAC系统提供了克服传统固定配置天线（FCA）局限性的有效途径，并在通信和传感性能之间取得更好的权衡。未来的研究方向包括基本性能极限、低开销黑盒优化以及人工智能（AI）赋能的语义ISAC。

title: Attendance-guided speaker enrollment across meetings
authors: Minjae Lee, Hee-Soo Heo, Youngki Kwon, Bong-Jin Lee
abstract: Speaker-aware applications rely on enrolled voice profiles, yet collecting enrollment speech from every participant is impractical. Meeting archives provide an alternative source of enrollment speech, comprising recordings of recurring participants paired with expected attendance lists. We investigate whether expected attendance lists can be cross-referenced with diarized anonymous speaker clusters to identify reliable enrollment speech for recurring participants. The resulting task, multi-participant automatic enrollment, must accommodate two types of attendance noise: a listed participant may not speak, and a speaker may be unlisted. To this end, we introduce a benchmark for the task: a synthetic corpus calibrated to an in-house meeting corpus, paired with a contamination-sensitive evaluation protocol. The reference method we introduce scores cross-session cluster chains against expected-attendance patterns and abstains when the evidence is insufficient. We quantify the reference method's benchmark performance as a trade-off between enrollment success and contamination. Applying synthetic-development thresholds unchanged to real meetings exposes a synthetic-to-real gap that remains an open challenge. We will release the benchmark generator and evaluation code.
zh_title: 会议期间的考勤辅助说话人注册
translation: 说话人识别应用依赖于注册的语音配置文件，但从每个参与者那里收集注册语音是不切实际的。会议档案提供了注册语音的替代来源，包括经常出现的参与者的录音以及预期的出勤名单。我们研究了预期的出勤名单是否可以与经过日记化处理的匿名说话人聚类进行交叉引用，以识别经常出现的参与者的可靠注册语音。由此产生的任务，即多参与者自动注册，必须适应两种类型的出勤噪音：列出的参与者可能不会发言，而发言者可能未被列出。为此，我们为该任务引入了一个基准：一个与内部会议语料库校准的合成语料库，以及一个污染敏感的评估协议。我们引入的参考方法将跨会话聚类链与预期出勤模式进行评分，并在证据不足时弃权。我们将参考方法的基准性能量化为注册成功率和污染率之间的权衡。将合成开发阈值不加改变地应用于真实会议会暴露合成到真实的差距，这仍然是一个开放的挑战。我们将发布基准生成器和评估代码。
tldr: 无法为每个与会者收集语音信息，因此研究人员提出一种利用会议记录和出勤名单来识别可靠的注册语音的方法，并构建了一个基准测试集和评估协议来衡量该方法的性能。
ai_comments: 这项研究提出了一个有趣且实用的解决方案，用于解决说话人注册语音获取的实际问题。通过利用现有的会议记录和出勤信息，该研究为说话人识别应用提供了一种更便捷的语音注册方式。然而，合成数据与真实数据之间的差距是一个需要关注的挑战，未来的研究可以进一步探索如何缩小这一差距，例如通过更真实的模拟或迁移学习技术。
motivation: 为需要注册语音配置文件的说话人识别应用收集语音信息不切实际，尤其是在会议场景下。
method: 利用出勤名单交叉引用会议记录中的说话人聚类，以识别可靠的注册语音。提出了一种新的基准测试任务（多参与者自动注册），并构建了一个合成语料库和一个评估协议，以应对出勤噪音（例如，列出的参与者未发言，或有未列出的发言者）。
results: 提出的参考方法在基准测试中的性能表现为注册成功率和错误率之间的权衡。将针对合成数据训练的阈值直接应用于真实会议数据会暴露合成数据与真实数据之间的差距。
conclusion: 虽然提出的方法在基准测试中表现出一定的潜力，但合成数据与真实数据之间的差距仍然是一个需要解决的挑战。研究人员将发布基准生成器和评估代码。

title: Directional Statistics in Signal Processing: A Geometry Driven Overview of Models, Learning, and Applications
authors: Anders S. Olsen, Kanti V. Mardia, Dimitri Van De Ville, Morten Mørup
abstract: Many signal-processing objects are defined by periodicity, normalization, sign or global-phase ambiguity, basis invariance, or positive-semidefinite constraints and therefore cannot be modeled faithfully in ordinary Euclidean space. This paper develops a geometry driven framework for directional statistics in signal processing, connecting signal representations to their natural manifolds or quotient spaces and to probability models compatible with their invariances. After reviewing instances of directional statistics in the signal processing literature, we review circular, toroidal, spherical, projective, Stiefel, Grassmann, and covariance-valued distributions, emphasizing their statistical assumptions, computational requirements, and dimensional limitations relevant to signal processing. We describe various modeling and estimation strategies, including analytical and gradient-based maximum likelihood, structured low-rank parameterizations, mixtures and hidden Markov models (HMMs), score-based and contrastive estimation, and geometry-aware K-means. To exemplify the consequences of geometry-aware modeling, we study multivariate phase coherence in synthetic data and functional neuroimaging, comparing toroidal phase vectors to projective, Grassmann, and positive-semidefinite representations. We also study speaker separation in a car environment, showing that directional representations outperform a standard Euclidean model. These examples demonstrate that when the geometric representation, statistical distribution, inference method, and computational regime are considered together, they have the potential to lead to improved models across a broad range of signal processing applications.
zh_title: 信号处理中的定向统计学：模型、学习和应用中的几何驱动概述
translation: 许多信号处理对象由于具有周期性、归一化、符号或全局相位模糊性、基不变性或半正定约束，因此无法在普通的欧几里得空间中进行精确建模。本文为信号处理中的定向统计学开发了一个由几何驱动的框架，将信号表示与其自然流形或商空间以及与其不变性兼容的概率模型联系起来。在回顾了信号处理文献中的定向统计学实例后，我们回顾了圆形、环形、球面、射影、Stiefel、Grassmann 和协方差值的分布，强调了它们与信号处理相关的统计假设、计算要求和维度限制。我们描述了各种建模和估计策略，包括解析和基于梯度的最大似然估计、结构化低秩参数化、混合模型和隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）、基于分数的估计和对比度估计以及几何感知的 K-均值。为了例证几何感知建模的后果，我们研究了合成数据和功能性神经成像中的多变量相位相干性，并将环形相位向量与射影、Grassmann 和半正定表示进行了比较。我们还研究了汽车环境中的声源分离，表明定向表示优于标准的欧几里得模型。这些例子表明，当几何表示、统计分布、推理方法和计算方案一起考虑时，它们有潜力在广泛的信号处理应用中改进模型。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于几何的定向统计框架，用于信号处理，将信号表示与其自然流形或商空间以及兼容的概率模型联系起来。它回顾了各种分布、建模和估计策略，并通过多变量相位相干性和声源分离的例子展示了其在信号处理应用中的优势。
ai_comments: 该论文提供了一个全面的、由几何驱动的框架，用于解决信号处理中许多传统方法难以处理的数据。其优点在于将几何结构、统计模型和计算方法相结合，以实现更优越的性能。然而，该框架的计算复杂性和对领域特定知识的需求可能是其在某些实际应用中的局限性。
motivation: 许多信号处理对象（如具有周期性、归一化、符号或全局相位模糊性、基不变性或半正定约束的对象）无法在普通的欧几里得空间中进行精确建模。
method: 该论文开发了一个基于几何的定向统计框架，将信号表示与其自然流形或商空间以及兼容的概率模型联系起来。它回顾了各种分布（如圆形、环形、球面、射影、Stiefel、Grassmann 和协方差值分布）、建模和估计策略（如最大似然估计、基于梯度的估计、低秩参数化、混合模型、隐马尔可夫模型、基于分数的估计、对比度估计和 K-均值聚类）。论文通过多变量相位相干性和声源分离的例子来展示几何感知建模的优势。
results: 研究表明，将几何表示、统计分布、推理方法和计算方案结合起来，可以改进各种信号处理应用中的模型。具体而言，在多变量相位相干性和声源分离的例子中，基于几何的表示优于标准的欧几里得模型。
conclusion: 当几何表示、统计分布、推理方法和计算方案协同工作时，它们有潜力在广泛的信号处理应用中改进模型。

title: Cross-Codec Robustness in Speech Watermarking
authors: Olli-Pekka Pauna, Xin Wang, Lauri Juvela
abstract: Generative speech models synthesize audio that is difficult to distinguish from human recordings. Synthetic speech can be watermarked as a proactive disclosure method, but watermarking models remain vulnerable to resynthesis attacks using neural audio codecs. This article investigates speech watermarking robustness across neural codec and digital signal processing attacks, when specific neural codecs are used for channel augmentation during training. We also present a novel zero-bit watermarking system that uses Descript Audio Codec as the generator. Our results demonstrate that the choice of augmentation codec significantly influences robustness generalization. Experiments show that augmentation with low-bitrate, high-quality neural codecs-Mimi and SNAC-results in promising robustness against unseen neural codecs and traditional attacks with limited quality impact.
zh_title: 跨编解码器的语音水印鲁棒性
translation: 生成语音模型可以合成难以与真人录音区分的音频。合成语音可以作为一种主动披露方法进行水印处理，但水印模型仍然容易受到使用神经音频编解码器的再合成攻击。本文研究了当使用特定的神经编解码器在训练期间进行通道增强时，语音在神经编解码器和数字信号处理攻击下的水印鲁棒性。我们还提出了一种使用Descript Audio Codec作为生成器的新型零比特水印系统。我们的结果表明，增强编解码器的选择对鲁棒性泛化有显著影响。实验表明，使用低比特率、高质量的神经编解码器-Mimi和SNAC-进行增强，可以提供有希望的对未见过的神经编解码器和传统攻击的鲁棒性，同时对质量的影响有限。
tldr: 在语音水印中，使用特定神经编解码器进行训练可以提高对各种攻击的鲁棒性，特别是低比特率、高质量的编解码器。零比特水印系统也得到了验证。
ai_comments: 这项研究解决了生成语音安全领域的一个关键问题，即提高语音水印对神经编解码器攻击的鲁棒性。通过引入通道增强和零比特水印系统，为开发更安全的合成语音技术提供了有前景的解决方案。然而，未来研究可以进一步探索不同类型编解码器组合的影响，以及评估在更广泛的攻击场景下的性能。
motivation: 现有的语音水印模型容易受到神经音频编解码器再合成攻击的影响，需要提高其鲁棒性。
method: 研究了在训练中使用特定神经编解码器进行通道增强时，语音水印在神经编解码器和数字信号处理攻击下的鲁棒性。提出了一种使用Descript Audio Codec作为生成器的零比特水印系统。
results: 使用低比特率、高质量的神经编解码器（Mimi和SNAC）进行增强训练，可以提高对未见过的神经编解码器和传统攻击的鲁棒性，同时对音频质量影响有限。编解码器的选择对鲁棒性泛化有显著影响。
conclusion: 通过在训练中集成特定的神经编解码器进行通道增强，可以显著提高语音水印的鲁棒性，尤其是在使用低比特率、高质量的编解码器时。这为开发更安全的语音合成模型提供了新的途径。

title: Movable Antenna Aided Robust Wireless Transmission: From Model-Based Optimization to Scalable Reinforcement Learning
authors: Jinshuo Zhang, Yafei Wang, Hongwei Hou, Wenjin Wang, Shi Jin, Symeon Chatzinotas, Björn Ottersten
abstract: This paper investigates robust joint antenna positioning and precoding for multiuser movable antenna (MA) systems under imperfect channel state information (CSI). First, we identify the mismatch between the spatial statistics of densely sampled MA channels and the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) basis used for conventional robust precoding. To address this, we develop a novel discrete prolate spheroidal sequence (DPSS)-based a posteriori channel model. By exploiting the spatial covariance structure of MA channels, this model is better suited to modeling MA channel uncertainty. Building on this model, we develop an efficient iterative algorithm for robust joint antenna positioning and precoding to maximize the expected sum rate. By transforming the coupled optimization of antenna positioning and precoding at each iteration into direct comparisons of closed-form scores, we design a low-complexity position replacement scheme that effectively reuses matrix computations across candidate sets. To further improve efficiency and scalability, we exploit the inherent tensor equivariance (TE) of the problem to develop a reinforcement learning framework. To explicitly account for channel uncertainty, we develop novel pairwise user-interaction and CSI-conditioned equivariant attention mechanisms to encode channel statistics and adaptively fuse them with the available CSI. We further introduce distance-biased spatial attention to incorporate the geometry of candidate positions into attention weighting, thereby enhancing spatial feature learning. Simulation results show that the proposed methods improve sum-rate performance while reducing online runtime under imperfect CSI. These methods also achieve near-optimal performance under perfect CSI, closely matching the exhaustive-search method. Moreover, the learning framework generalizes across different numbers of users and MAs without retraining.

zh_title: 可移动天线辅助的鲁棒无线传输：从基于模型优化到可扩展强化学习
translation: 本文研究了多用户可移动天线（MA）系统在不完美信道状态信息（CSI）下的鲁棒联合天线定位和预编码。首先，我们发现密集采样MA信道在空间统计方面与用于常规鲁棒预编码的离散傅里叶变换（DFT）基之间存在不匹配。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种新颖的基于离散长球序列（DPSS）的后验信道模型。通过利用MA信道的空间协方差结构，该模型更能适应MA信道不确定性的建模。在此模型的基础上，我们开发了一种高效的迭代算法，用于鲁棒的联合天线定位和预编码，以最大化期望和速率。通过将每次迭代中耦合的天线定位和预编码优化转化为闭式分数项的直接比较，我们设计了一种低复杂度的位置替换方案，该方案可以有效地跨候选集重用矩阵计算。为了进一步提高效率和可扩展性，我们利用问题的固有张量等变性（TE）来开发一种强化学习框架。为了显式考虑信道不确定性，我们开发了新颖的成对用户交互和CSI条件等变注意力机制，以编码信道统计信息并将其与可用CSI自适应地融合。我们进一步引入了距离偏置的空间注意力机制，将候选位置的几何形状纳入注意力权重，从而增强了空间特征学习。仿真结果表明，在不完美CSI下，所提出的方法提高了和速率性能，同时减少了在线运行时间。在完美CSI下，这些方法也取得了接近最优的性能，与穷举搜索方法非常接近。此外，学习框架在没有重新训练的情况下，可以泛化到不同数量的用户和MA。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的方法来优化多用户可移动天线（MA）系统中天线的位置和预编码，以在信道状态信息（CSI）不完美的情况下提高鲁棒性。他们开发了一种基于离散傅里叶变换（DFT）的信道模型，并设计了一种迭代算法来优化天线位置和预编码。为了提高效率和可扩展性，他们还开发了一种基于强化学习的框架，该框架可以处理信道不确定性并具有良好的泛化能力。仿真结果表明，该方法在提高和降低运行时性能方面优于现有方法。
ai_comments: 这项研究在可移动天线（MA）系统的鲁棒无线传输领域取得了显著进展，特别是在处理不完美的信道状态信息（CSI）方面。其创新之处在于开发了一种新的基于DPSS的信道模型，解决了现有方法的局限性，并设计了一种高效的迭代算法。更重要的是，研究者成功地将强化学习（RL）与张量等变性（TE）相结合，创建了一个可扩展且泛化的解决方案，能够处理复杂的信道不确定性。这种将模型驱动的优化与数据驱动的RL相结合的方法，为未来MA系统设计提供了有价值的见解。然而，该研究的实际部署可能还需要考虑硬件实现复杂性、实时计算资源以及在更广泛的动态环境中的鲁棒性。
motivation: 现有鲁棒预编码方法在处理多用户可移动天线（MA）系统中的不完美信道状态信息（CSI）时，存在空间统计与离散傅里叶变换（DFT）基之间的不匹配问题。
method: 1. 开发了一种新的基于离散傅里叶变换（DFT）的后验信道模型，以更好地模拟MA信道不确定性。 2. 设计了一种高效的迭代算法，用于鲁棒的联合天线定位和预编码，以最大化期望和速率。 3. 利用张量等变性（TE）开发了一种强化学习框架，并引入了新颖的成对用户交互和CSI条件等变注意力机制，以及距离偏置空间注意力机制，以显式处理信道不确定性并提高效率和可扩展性。
results: 所提出的方法在不完美CSI下提高了和速率性能，并减少了在线运行时间。在完美CSI下，这些方法也取得了接近最优的性能，与穷举搜索方法非常接近。此外，学习框架在没有重新训练的情况下，可以泛化到不同数量的用户和MA。
conclusion: 该论文提出了一种创新的、可扩展的方法，通过联合优化天线定位和预编码来解决MA系统中的鲁棒无线传输问题，并在不完美CSI下实现了显著的性能提升和效率改进。

title: Deep Plug-and-Play Proximal Distance Algorithm for Robust Principal Component Analysis
authors: Guanhua Liu, Mingjie Shao, Wenxuan Sun, Zhi Liu, Yanlong Zhao
abstract: Robust Principal Component Analysis (RPCA) is essential in signal processing, with applications in hyperspectral imaging, face recognition, and video background modeling. Traditional RPCA methods often suffer from insufficient utilization of data priors and struggle to capture complex image structures. Conversely, advanced deep denoisers like DnCNN, FFDNet, and DRUNet excel at leveraging image data priors but lack physical model constraints and demonstrate poor robustness against structured noise in RPCA tasks. This paper proposes a novel Plug-and-Play (PnP) method for multi-channel RPCA, integrating both the physical generative model and cutting-edge deep priors. Extensive experiments on RGB and hyperspectral datasets show that PnP-PDA achieves better quantitative performance than conventional RPCA methods and state-of-the-art methods, including deep denoisers and tensor RPCA approaches, while preserving visual details.
zh_title: 面向鲁棒主成分分析的深度即插即用近邻距离算法
translation: 鲁棒主成分分析（RPCA）在信号处理中至关重要，应用于高光谱成像、人脸识别和视频背景建模。传统的RPCA方法往往未能充分利用数据先验，并且难以捕捉复杂的图像结构。相反，像DnCNN、FFDNet和DRUNet这样的先进深度去噪器在利用图像数据先验方面表现出色，但缺乏物理模型约束，并且在RPCA任务中对结构化噪声表现出较差的鲁棒性。本文提出了一种新颖的多通道RPCA即插即用（PnP）方法，该方法集成了物理生成模型和前沿的深度先验。在RGB和高光谱数据集上的大量实验表明，PnP-PDA在定量性能和视觉细节保留方面均优于传统RPCA方法、深度去噪器和张量RPCA方法等最先进的方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的即插即用（PnP）方法，用于多通道鲁棒主成分分析（RPCA），该方法结合了物理生成模型和先进的深度先验知识，并在实验中证明其性能优于现有方法。
ai_comments: 该研究有效地融合了物理模型和深度学习方法，为RPCA领域带来了新的解决方案。其在处理结构化噪声和复杂图像结构方面的优势值得关注，但其在不同类型噪声和数据集上的泛化能力以及计算复杂度仍需进一步研究。
motivation: 传统RPCA方法未能充分利用数据先验并捕捉复杂的图像结构，而先进的深度去噪器虽然擅长利用图像数据先验，但缺乏物理模型约束，在RPCA任务中对结构化噪声的鲁棒性较差。
method: 提出了一种新的多通道RPCA的即插即用（PnP）方法，该方法整合了物理生成模型和先进的深度先验。
results: 在RGB和高光谱数据集上的大量实验表明，PnP-PDA在定量性能和视觉细节保留方面均优于传统RPCA方法、深度去噪器和张量RPCA方法等最先进的方法。
conclusion: 所提出的PnP-PDA方法能够有效地结合物理模型和深度先验，在RPCA任务中实现优越的性能。

title: Noise Parameter Identification in Ensemble of Atomic Clocks
authors: Jindrich Dunik, Oliver Kost, Ladislav Kral, Ivo Puncochar, Ondrej Daniel, Simona Circiu, Bernardino Quaranta
abstract: The paper introduces a parameter identification framework for atomic clock ensembles, where individual clocks are represented by second-order linear stochastic state-space model. The proposed procedure relies exclusively on differential measurements, namely the pairwise phase differences between a designated pivot clock and the remaining ensemble members. The identification targets key parameters for each clock: white and random-walk frequency noise variances, constant frequency drift, and (co)variance of the measurement noise. To identify these parameters, two distinct identification methods are proposed. Their estimation accuracy is rigorously demonstrated via numerical simulations and validated using empirical data from atomic hydrogen maser (AHM) clocks at ESTEC Timing Laboratory.
