Across 25 matched seed-pairs on Qwen3-0.6B to 4B with AdamW and Muon, Fair Cast is ahead on 18, tied on 6 and behind on 1, with a mean gain of 6.1 points; on zebra puzzles it reaches 0.57 +/- 0.16 over four runs where round-to-nearest collapses to 0.33 +/- 0.10. It also makes the saved fp32 checkpoint agree with the served model, and it exposes the implicit lag of round-to-nearest as a regularizer that can be restored explicitly when a task needs it.

title: Single-Annotation, Multi-Hypothesis Segmentation with Semantic-Spatial Residual Banks
authors: Armin Dadras, Robert Sablatnig, Franziska Proksa, Markus Seidl
abstract: Multi-rater segmentation datasets show that a single image can admit several valid masks, yet most training sets expose only one annotation per image. We study single-annotation multi-hypothesis segmentation: each training image exposes one fixed mask, while the model must return a finite bank that covers held-out human annotations at test time. Our experiments reveal a representation tradeoff. Banks learned directly from images recover variations in local boundaries and extent but lose structural hypotheses, whereas frozen semantic features preserve structural grouping but underrepresent spatial variation. We introduce the Semantic-Spatial Residual Bank (SSRB), which freezes a semantic bank trained with balanced assignments and learns a residual from the image for each hypothesis. Across five medical endpoints, SSRB improves coverage of held-out masks at $K=8$ over a Probabilistic U-Net under the same one-mask constraint. On LIDC and LIDC-hard, it also produces substantially more distinct useful masks. On BSDS, it preserves the semantic bank's performance in grouping regions. Its advantage grows as more masks are returned, showing that residuals learned for corresponding heads improve coverage of local annotation variation while preserving how regions are grouped.

title: BABA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Patient-Advocacy Agents
authors: Shriram Vasudevan, Videet Mehta, Connor Sweeney
abstract: An LLM agent that helps a patient get care must do two things. It must reach the correct outcome, and it must follow the necessary procedure. For example, the agent must get the patient's permission before it shares the patient's records. We introduce BABA-Bench, a benchmark of 47 interactive worlds. We built each world from a de-identified, real patient advocacy case that expert advocates reviewed. In each world, the agent must find hidden information and coordinate insurers, clinics, suppliers, pharmacies, and community organizations. The engine checks each action at the time the agent does it. It checks if the agent has permission, if the agent has evidence for the action, and if the action is prohibited. We evaluated 14 frontier models with three runs on each world, for a total of 1,974 runs. Agents often reached the correct outcome by an invalid route. Of the 921 runs that reached all required outcomes, 254 (28%) did not follow the necessary procedure. Claude Opus 5 reached all required outcomes in 81.6% of its runs, but only 52.5% of its runs passed all checks. When we gave two models a verified route, their pass rates increased from 29.8% to 91.5% and from 44.0% to 97.2%. For these models, the main problem is to find a route, not to execute it.

title: Where, When, and How Many Bits? Scaling Laws for SGD with Stochastic Rounding
authors: Zhichao Wang, Michael W. Mahoney
abstract: Low-precision training reduces computation but introduces additional rounding error. We theoretically study how stochastic rounding (SR) affects prediction risk as model size, training time, and precision change. We consider a two-layer linear network with a fixed random first layer, trained by mini-batch SGD on fresh Gaussian data with power-law spectra. At each SGD step, the features used in forward and backward computations are rounded independently. We prove matched upper and lower bounds on prediction error for the final model and for uniform parameter averaging, with general learning-rate and precision schedules chosen before training. For fixed precisions and constant learning rates with parameter averaging, we derive how the smallest prediction error decreases with compute, and we identify model sizes and training times that achieve this optimal-compute scaling. Rounding only the forward features preserves the compute scaling of exact arithmetic, while rounding backward features changes it. Averaging parameters can change which computation needs higher precision and when higher precision is useful. Our results also give bit requirements for a given accuracy tolerance and show how backward rounding can change learning-rate schedule design. At a fixed compute budget, lower precision can improve prediction when the benefit of a larger model or longer training outweighs the additional SR-induced error. Model simulations illustrate these tradeoffs, and experiments with an MLP and a small transformer examine rounding choices beyond the theoretical model.

title: Grounding Image Composition with Label-Conditioned Visual Evidence
authors: Armin Dadras, Tingyu Lin, Robert Sablatnig, Franziska Proksa, Markus Seidl
abstract: Image composition labels such as center, diagonal, or rule of thirds describe visual structure rather than object categories. KU-PCP provides image-level labels and class-specific geometric elements, but does not show which visible regions people associate with each of its nine classes. We introduce KU-PCP Elements (KU-PCPE), a label-conditioned region-evidence benchmark for photographic composition. Given an image and a label already judged applicable, the task is to segment the visible regions that explain why the label applies. KU-PCPE contains 4,093 single-annotator training masks and a 1,327-task expert test split with three masks per image-label task. The annotations also include exploratory segment-versus-line ratings that describe whether region or semantic-guideline evidence better explains the label. A held-out expert reaches .867 Dice against the other experts, while the strongest deployable model reaches .664, a proposal oracle .672, and the best vision-language model (VLM) proposal selector .395. KU-PCPE exposes the gap between recognizing a composition label and grounding the human-aligned visual evidence that makes it plausible in a particular image.
zh_title: 基于标签条件视觉证据的图像构图基础
translation: 图像构图标签，例如“中心构图”、“对角线构图”或“三分法则”，描述的是视觉结构而非物体类别。KU-PCP提供了图像级标签和特定类别的几何元素，但没有显示人们将哪些可见区域与它的九个类别中的每一个关联起来。我们引入了KU-PCP元素（KU-PCPE），这是一个用于摄影构图的标签条件区域证据基准。给定一幅图像和一个已被判断适用的标签，任务是分割解释该标签适用的可见区域。KU-PCPE包含4,093个单标注者训练掩码和一个包含1,327个任务的专家测试集，每个图像-标签任务有三个掩码。标注还包括探索性的“区域与线条”评分，用于描述是区域证据还是语义指导证据更好地解释了标签。一个被保留的专家在与其他专家的对比中达到了0.867的Dice系数，而最强的可部署模型达到了0.664，一个提案预言机达到了0.672，最佳的视觉-语言模型（VLM）提案选择器达到了0.395。KU-PCPE揭示了识别构图标签与将使之在特定图像中合理的人类对齐视觉证据进行“落地”之间的差距。
tldr: 本文引入了KU-PCP Elements (KU-PCPE)，这是一个用于摄影构图的标签条件区域证据基准。其主要任务是分割出解释构图标签为何适用于图像的可见区域，并揭示了识别构图标签与定位人类对齐视觉证据之间的差距。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入KU-PCPE数据集，创新性地解决了图像构图理解中“标签与视觉证据关联”的关键问题，填补了现有研究的空白。它不仅提供了一个新的、严格的基准来评估模型对构图标签深层语义的理解能力，而且通过量化不同模型与人类专家之间的差距，明确指出了当前机器视觉在理解艺术和美学元素方面的局限性。特别是其对“区域与线条”证据的探索，为理解人类如何感知和解释构图提供了新的视角。该工作对于推动机器对图像美学和构图原则的理解具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的KU-PCP数据集提供了图像级标签和特定类别的几何元素，但未能明确指出人们将哪些可见区域与每种构图类别相关联，这导致难以理解构图标签背后的具体视觉基础。
method: 本文引入了KU-PCP Elements (KU-PCPE) 数据集，这是一个标签条件区域证据基准，用于解决图像构图的视觉证据落地问题。任务是给定一幅图像和已判断适用的构图标签，模型需要分割出解释该标签适用的可见区域。KU-PCPE包含4,093个单标注者训练掩码，以及一个包含1,327个任务的专家测试集，其中每个图像-标签任务有三个掩码。标注还包括探索性的“区域与线条”评分，以描述区域证据或语义指导证据是否更好地解释了标签。
results: 在KU-PCPE基准上，一个被保留的专家与其他专家之间的Dice系数达到0.867。最强的可部署模型达到了0.664，一个提案预言机达到了0.672，而最佳的视觉-语言模型（VLM）提案选择器仅达到0.395。这些结果揭示了识别构图标签与定位使其在特定图像中合理的人类对齐视觉证据之间存在显著差距。
conclusion: KU-PCPE基准揭示了在识别图像构图标签与将这些标签与人类对齐的视觉证据进行关联（即“落地”）之间存在显著差距。

title: EDU-Jev Training System-One Decision Models for Education
authors: Jiazheng Li, Yulan He
abstract: Many automated decisions in education involve choosing from a fixed set of options: assigning a rubric score, checking whether an answer meets a marking criterion, or identifying the first wrong step in a solution. Generative language models are increasingly used to make these decisions, but their responses require parsing, longer outputs increase inference costs, and confidence expressed in words does not necessarily reflect the probability of being correct. We present EDU-Jev, a family of single-pass ("System One") decision models at 0.8B, 2B and 4B parameters. Given an assessment context and a question with predefined answer options, the model returns a probability distribution over those options without generating text. A pointer head scores a marker for each option, ensuring the predictions are restricted to the allowed choices. Training uses a single supervised stage with soft cross-entropy against the available target label distributions; calibration is assessed empirically. Across twelve education benchmarks, EDU-Jev 4B achieves an average accuracy of 67.6%, exceeding the strongest of five commercial decision APIs by 9.4 percentage points and the best open 4B decision model by 18.7 points. On four cross-domain education sets, it matches the strongest API, which remains ahead on general decision-making and reasoning tasks. The 2B model processes about 150 decisions per second on a single H100 GPU.
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Work in progress
zh_title: EDU-Jev：训练面向教育的“系统一”决策模型
translation: 教育领域的许多自动化决策涉及从固定选项中进行选择：如分配评分准则得分、检查答案是否符合批改标准，或识别解题过程中的第一个错误步骤。生成式语言模型越来越多地被用于做出这些决策，但其输出需要解析，较长的输出会增加推理成本，而且用文字表达的置信度并不一定反映正确的概率。我们提出了 EDU-Jev，这是一个具有 0.8B、2B 和 4B 参数规模的单次前向（“系统一”）决策模型家族。在给定评估上下文和包含预定义答案选项的问题时，该模型返回这些选项的概率分布，而无需生成文本。指针头为每个选项标记评分，确保预测严格限制在允许的选项范围内。训练采用单一监督阶段，针对可用的目标标签分布使用软交叉熵进行优化；校准效果则通过实证进行评估。在 12 个教育基准测试中，EDU-Jev 4B 实现了 67.6% 的平均准确率，比 5 个商业决策 API 中最强的一款高出 9.4 个百分点，比最强的开源 4B 决策模型高出 18.7 个百分点。在 4 个跨领域教育数据集上，其表现追平了最强的商业 API（该 API 在通用决策和推理任务上仍保持领先）。2B 模型在单块 H100 GPU 上每秒可处理约 150 次决策。
tldr: 针对教育固定选项决策任务，提出了无需文本生成的单次前向EDU-Jev模型，准确率超越商业API且推理速度极快。
ai_comments: 该研究针对教育领域中大量属于固定选项判别的决策任务，摒弃了昂贵且容易产生解析偏差的自回归生成方式，创新性地采用“系统一”（单次前向传播）直接输出概率分布的架构，大幅提升了推理吞吐量（2B模型达150次决策/秒）并改善了校准度。其局限在于通用决策与复杂推理能力仍落后于顶尖商业API，且主要适用于预定义选项的封闭式判断场景。
motivation: 教育领域的许多自动化决策（如评分准则、答案批改标准核对、解题步骤错因定位）本质上属于从固定选项集合中做选择。传统的生成式语言模型需要对输出文本进行解析、长文本输出导致推理成本高昂，且用文字表达的置信度往往无法真实反映判断的正确概率。
method: 提出了EDU-Jev模型家族（0.8B、2B、4B参数规模），采用单次前向传递（系统一）直接输出预定义选项的概率分布而无需生成文本。架构上利用指针头（pointer head）为每个选项标记评分以约束预测范围；训练上采用单阶段监督学习，使用软交叉熵（soft cross-entropy）拟合目标标签分布，并对置信度校准进行实证评估。
results: 在12个教育基准上，EDU-Jev 4B达到67.6%的平均准确率，比测试的5个商业决策API中表现最好的高出9.4个百分点，比开源最强4B决策模型高出18.7个百分点；在4个跨领域教育数据集上追平最强商业API（商业API在通用决策和推理任务上仍保持领先）；EDU-Jev 2B模型在单块H100 GPU上每秒可处理约150次决策。
conclusion: EDU-Jev证明了轻量级、无文本生成的单次前向决策模型在教育垂直任务中不仅能够大幅降低计算与解析开销，还能在准确率上超越更大型的通用商业决策API，为低延迟、高可靠的教育自动化评估提供了极具实用价值的解决方案。

title: Optimization Techniques for Solving the Minimum Red--Blue Separating Set Problem with an Application to Human--AI Text Separation
authors: Marko Djukanović, Staša Vujičić Stanković, Žiga Zebec, Christian Blum
abstract: We study the so-called Minimum Red''Blue Separating Set Problem (MRBSSP) which arises from computational geometry. In particular, we propose a compact Set-Cover ILP formulation, safe preprocessing rules, a Greedy Randomized Adaptive Search Procedure (GRASP), and two exact approaches: one is based on Logic-Based Benders Decomposition (LBBD) approach, and the second represents a novel Branch-and-Benders-Cut (BBC) approach. These two exact approaches are compared to ILP--alongside GRASP and the Variable Neighborhood Search (VNS) from literature. Experiments on 250 random graphs with up to 500 vertices reveal complementary strengths: ILP yields the best feasible solutions, LBBD provides the strongest lower bounds and smallest mean optimality gap, and BBC certifies optimality most frequently. We further introduce an NLP application distinguishing human- and AI-generated texts through vocabulary-based graph features. On 42 instances, BBC achieves the smallest mean optimality gap, certifying 16 optima, while GRASP outperforms VNS. Structural analysis of optimal vocabulary separators identifies 113 mandatory and 151 replaceable features across 272 tests, highlighting substantial variability among optimal solutions. Overall, our results demonstrate the effectiveness of complementary optimization strategies and the interpretability of optimal vocabulary-based discrimination.
zh_title: 优化解决最小红蓝分离集问题的技术及其在人机文本分离中的应用
translation: 我们研究了计算几何中出现的所谓最小红蓝分离集问题（MRBSSP）。具体来说，我们提出了一个紧凑的集合覆盖整数线性规划（ILP）公式、安全预处理规则、一种贪婪随机自适应搜索过程（GRASP），以及两种精确方法：一种是基于逻辑Benders分解（LBBD）方法，第二种代表了一种新颖的分支Benders割（BBC）方法。这两种精确方法与ILP以及文献中的GRASP和变邻域搜索（VNS）进行了比较。在多达500个顶点的250个随机图上的实验揭示了互补的优势：ILP产生最佳可行解，LBBD提供最强的下界和最小的平均最优性差距，而BBC最频繁地证明最优性。我们进一步引入了一个NLP应用，通过基于词汇的图特征来区分人类和AI生成的文本。在42个实例上，BBC实现了最小的平均最优性差距，证明了16个最优解，而GRASP优于VNS。对最优词汇分离器的结构分析确定了272项测试中的113个强制特征和151个可替换特征，突出了最优解之间的显著变异性。总的来说，我们的结果证明了互补优化策略的有效性以及基于最优词汇判别的可解释性。
tldr: 本文研究并提出了多种优化技术（ILP, GRASP, LBBD, BBC）来解决最小红蓝分离集问题，并将其应用于区分人类和AI生成的文本，实验结果展示了这些方法的互补性和有效性。
ai_comments: 该研究通过提出多种互补的优化技术（包括启发式和精确方法）来解决最小红蓝分离集问题，展示了其在理论和实践中的重要性。特别值得注意的是，其将MRBSSP应用于区分人机生成文本这一前沿且具有挑战性的NLP任务，通过构建基于词汇的图特征，为文本归属识别提供了一种新颖且可解释的优化方法。不同方法在性能上的互补性也为实际应用提供了灵活的选择。
motivation: 研究计算几何中出现的最小红蓝分离集问题（MRBSSP），并将其应用于通过基于词汇的图特征区分人类和AI生成的文本。
method: 提出了紧凑的集合覆盖整数线性规划（ILP）公式、安全预处理规则、贪婪随机自适应搜索过程（GRASP），以及两种精确方法：基于逻辑Benders分解（LBBD）方法和新的分支Benders割（BBC）方法。这些方法与文献中的ILP、GRASP和变邻域搜索（VNS）进行了比较。
results: 在包含多达500个顶点的250个随机图上的实验表明：ILP产生最佳可行解，LBBD提供最强下界和最小平均最优性差距，BBC最频繁地证明最优性。在42个NLP实例上，BBC实现了最小平均最优性差距，证明了16个最优解，而GRASP优于VNS。对最优词汇分离器的结构分析确定了272项测试中的113个强制特征和151个可替换特征，突出了最优解之间的显著变异性。
conclusion: 研究结果证明了互补优化策略的有效性以及基于最优词汇的判别方法的解释性。

title: CIRCE Divines LLM Task Complexity from Constraint Structure
authors: Chenhao Hong, Jiakai Xu, Kaushiki Singh, Yusen Zhang, Eugene Wu
abstract:
Estimating whether a problem is too complex for a large language model (LLM) before the model attempts it can guide model routing, how to allocate test-time compute, and suggest the need for new tools to aid the agent. While existing estimators rely on the problem text, LLM-annotated task difficulty labels, or signals obtained after a model attempts to solve the problem, such as its hidden states, none explicitly leverage the constraint structure inherent in the problem: the variables to assign and how the constraints over them interact.
  We introduce CIRCE, which extracts a problem's structure by using a cheap LLM to construct a Constraint Intermediate Representation that deterministically compiles into the constraint graph. Across seven reasoning benchmarks (including SAT, logic, and math) and four LLMs, even a randomly initialized GNN encoder improves predictions of LLM response correctness, reducing negative log-likelihood from 0.465 to 0.423 and increasing AUROC from 0.691 to 0.727 relative to the strongest baseline for each metric.
zh_title: CIRCE：从约束结构中预测大语言模型的任务复杂度
translation: 在大语言模型（LLM）尝试解决问题之前，预估该问题对其而言是否过于复杂，可以指导模型路由、合理分配测试时计算资源，并提示是否需要新工具来辅助智能体。现有的预估方法往往依赖于问题文本、LLM 标注的任务难度标签，或者模型尝试求解后获取的信号（如其隐藏状态），但都没有显式地利用问题中固有的约束结构——即待赋值的变量以及变量间约束是如何相互作用的。我们提出了 CIRCE，它通过使用廉价的 LLM 构建一个约束中间表示（Constraint Intermediate Representation），该表示可以确定性地编译为约束图，从而提取出问题的结构。在涵盖 SAT、逻辑和数学等 7 个推理基准以及 4 个 LLM 的实验中，即使是随机初始化的 GNN 编码器也能改善对 LLM 回答正确性的预测，相较于各指标的最强基准，负对数似然从 0.465 降低至 0.423，AUROC 从 0.691 提升至 0.727。
tldr: CIRCE 通过将复杂推理问题转化为约束图并结合 GNN，在模型解答前即可高精度预测 LLM 的任务复杂度与正确率。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于摆脱了以往仅依赖文本表层特征或模型推理后隐状态的评估模式，抓住逻辑推理任务的核心本质——约束满足结构，通过低成本LLM将自然语言编译为显式约束图。令人瞩目的是，即便仅采用随机初始化的GNN也能取得超越强基线的性能，充分证明了约束拓扑结构本身包含强大的任务复杂度先验信息。潜在局限可能在于其依赖低成本LLM生成约束中间表示的质量，在形式化较弱或常识性复杂的任务上的鲁棒性仍有待观察。
motivation: 在 LLM 尝试解决问题之前提前预估任务复杂度，能够有效指导模型路由、优化测试时计算资源分配以及决策是否引入外部工具；而现有预测方法仅依赖问题文本、模型自标注难度或解题后的隐状态，未能显式利用问题中固有的变量及其约束交互结构。
method: 提出了 CIRCE 方法：利用低成本 LLM 将问题解析并构建为“约束中间表示”（Constraint Intermediate Representation, CIR），再将其确定性编译为约束图，随后采用图神经网络（GNN）编码器（实验中即使随机初始化也有效）对图结构进行编码，进而预测 LLM 求解该任务的正确性。
results: 在涵盖 SAT、逻辑和数学等 7 个推理基准以及 4 个 LLM 的评测中，即便仅使用随机初始化的 GNN 编码器，CIRCE 也能显著改善对 LLM 回答正确性的预测能力；与各指标的最强基线相比，负对数似然（NLL）从 0.465 降低至 0.423，AUROC 从 0.691 提高至 0.727。
conclusion: 显式利用问题内在的变量交互和约束结构（编译为约束图），能够显著提升在模型求解前预测LLM任务复杂度与正确率的精度。

title: Verifying Text-to-SQL Queries under Changing Business Semantics
authors: Genliang Zhu, Xiaobo Chen, Ziyuan Wang, Chu Wang
abstract: In text-to-SQL and AI-agent analytics, successful SQL execution does not establish semantic correctness under changing business definitions. We study revalidation of fixed queries after changes to refund attribution, tax treatment, eligible populations and exchange-rate dates. An executable verification profile binds the requested revision and knowledge cutoff to legal counterexample data and exact monetary comparison. A preregistered confirmation on 32 newly authored revision families and two local producer bundles retains 192 query-definition cells: 144 nonconforming, 36 finite-suite agreeing and 12 unresolved. Of the nonconforming cells, 63 agree on the current snapshot. At an eight-ledger budget, obligation-guided checking detects 137 discrepancies versus 127 for generic ordering, a paired difference of 6.9 percentage points (family bootstrap 95% interval [2.1, 13.6]; exact family sign-flip p=0.0156). Every ledger arm rejects zero of the 36 agreeing cells. Current-obligation and equal-weight scoring match the guided result, identifying coverage rather than revision-specific priority as the observed source of benefit. Controlled assays, a natural-query pilot and repeated samples provide separate mechanism and robustness evidence. A legal discrepancy refutes conformance; agreement remains restricted to the recorded suite. The study establishes an auditable business-semantic revalidation profile within its authored schema and local-model scope.
zh_title: 业务语义变更下的Text-to-SQL查询验证
translation: 在Text-to-SQL和AI智能体分析中，当业务定义发生变化时，SQL成功执行并不能证明其语义正确。我们研究了在退款归属、税务处理、合格人群和汇率日期等变更后，对固定查询的重新验证问题。一种可执行的验证配置文件将所请求的修订和知识截止时间与合法的反例数据及精确货币比较绑定在一起。在对32个新编写的修订族和两个本地生成包进行的预注册确认中，保留了192个查询-定义单元：144个不符合项、36个有限套件一致项和12个未解决项。在不符合的单元中，有63个在当前快照上表现一致。在8账本预算下，义务引导检查检测出137个差异，而通用排序检测出127个，配对差异为6.9个百分点（修订族Bootstrap 95%置信区间为[2.1, 13.6]；精确族符号翻转p=0.0156）。每个账本分支对36个一致单元的拒绝数均为0。当前义务评分和等权重评分与引导结果相匹配，表明覆盖范围而非特定于修订的优先级是观察到的收益来源。受控测试、自然查询试点和重复抽样提供了机制与鲁棒性的独立证据。合法的差异能够否定一致性；而一致性仍局限于已记录的测试套件。该研究在其构建的模式和本地模型范围内建立了一个可审计的业务语义重验证配置文件。
tldr: 本文提出了一种可执行验证方案，利用合法反例数据与义务引导检查，高效重验证业务规则变更下的Text-to-SQL查询语义正确性。
ai_comments: 该研究极具实际应用价值，敏锐地指出了当前Text-to-SQL在企业落地中的痛点——SQL虽能成功运行，但业务规则（如税率、退款口径等）发生漂移时会导致静默错误。其提出的可审计重验证框架与反例驱动检测方法兼具实用性与严谨性。局限在于目前的实验验证仍受限于特定设计的模式与测试套件范围，测试套件内的一致无法严格推论全局语义等价。
motivation: 在Text-to-SQL和AI智能体分析场景中，SQL成功执行并不意味着业务定义变更后依然保持语义正确。当退款归属、税务处理、合格人群与汇率日期等业务规则改变时，亟需对已有固定查询进行重新验证。
method: 提出了一种可执行验证配置文件（executable verification profile），将业务修订请求和知识截止时间与合法的反例数据及精确货币比较相结合；采用义务引导检查（obligation-guided checking）机制，并在32个新修订族及本地生成包构建的192个查询-定义单元上进行预注册评估。
results: 在192个查询-定义单元中（144个不符合、36个有限套件一致、12个未解决），有63个不符合单元在当前快照上表面一致。在8账本预算下，义务引导检查检测出137个差异，较通用排序的127个显著提升6.9个百分点（p=0.0156），且对36个一致单元的误拒率为0；分析证实收益来源主要为测试覆盖率而非修订特定的优先级。
conclusion: 合法的差异能够证伪查询的合规性，而验证一致性仍局限于已记录的测试套件。该研究在其构建的模式与本地模型范围内，成功建立了一套可审计的业务语义重验证机制。

title: Evaluating Structural and SAT Attack Resilience in Cryptographic Dynamic Logic Locking via Keystream Capping
authors: Nahush Tambe, Naseeruddin Lodge, Vineet Chadalavada, Fareena Saqib
abstract: Untrusted third-party entities throughout the semiconductor supply chain expose proprietary hardware intellectual property to reverse engineering, piracy, and overproduction. While logic locking counters this threat by embedding key-dependent logic, conventional static key-gates remain vulnerable to both oracle-guided SAT attacks and structural removal attacks due to their time-invariant netlist signatures. Dynamic schemes such as STREAMLOCK mitigate oracle attacks by continuously masking signals with cryptographic keystream, achieving near 50\% Hamming distance output corruption under incorrect keys with low hardware overhead. However, confining key-gates to primary outputs leaves internal combinational cones vulnerable to single-tap structural bypasses. This work extends dynamic logic locking by distributing key-gates within internal paths prioritized via fault-propagation analysis. The original and internally-hardened architectures are evaluated against structural removal attacks and a bounded, unrolling-based SAT-style attack across three ISCAS'85 benchmarks. Distributing masking internally raises the uninformed attacker's brute-force search space from 6 candidate node subsets to over $10^{45}$ for the largest benchmark. Crucially, empirical analysis reveals that topological relocation alone does not prevent algebraic key extraction when wide circuits expose numerous keystream bits per clock cycle. To eliminate this leak, a keystream-bit reuse cap is introduced to restrict per-cycle exposure independent of circuit width. Under this constraint, SAT-solver tractability encounters an immediate computational cliff, transitioning sharply from rapid under-constrained solving to timeout thresholds without disclosing the secret key. Integrating fault-aware internal placement with keystream reuse capping delivers joint resilience against structural bypasses and bounded SAT attacks.
zh_title: 通过密钥流上限评估密码学动态逻辑锁定中的结构与SAT攻击抗性
translation: 半导体供应链中的不可信第三方实体使专有硬件知识产权（IP）面临逆向工程、盗版和过度生产的威胁。虽然逻辑锁定技术通过嵌入密钥依赖逻辑来应对这一威胁，但传统的静态密钥门因其时不变的网表特征，仍易受到基于预言机指导的SAT攻击和结构移除攻击。诸如STREAMLOCK等动态方案通过使用密码学密钥流持续掩码信号来缓解预言机攻击，在低硬件开销下使错误密钥产生接近50%汉明距离的输出破坏。然而，仅将密钥门限制在主输出端会使内部组合逻辑锥面临单抽头结构旁路的威胁。本研究通过故障传播分析对内部路径进行优先级排序并分布式部署密钥门，对动态逻辑锁定进行了扩展。在三个ISCAS'85基准测试上，对原始架构与内部加固架构针对结构移除攻击以及基于有界展开的SAT式攻击进行了评估。在内部署掩码使无先验知识攻击者的暴力搜索空间在最大基准电路上从6个候选节点子集大幅提升至超过10^45。更重要的是，实证分析表明，当宽电路在每个时钟周期暴露过多密钥流比特时，仅靠拓扑重定位无法阻止代数密钥提取。为消除此类泄露，本文引入了密钥流比特重用上限，独立于电路位宽限制每周期的暴露量。在此约束下，SAT求解器的易解性遭遇了断崖式的计算瓶颈，从快速的欠约束求解急剧转变为超时状态且不泄露密钥。将故障感知的内部放置与密钥流重用上限相结合，实现了抵御结构旁路和有界SAT攻击的双重弹性。
tldr: 本文结合故障感知内部密钥门放置与密钥流重用上限技术，有效解决了动态逻辑锁定的结构旁路和SAT代数提取漏洞。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于揭示了动态逻辑锁定中仅靠拓扑重定位无法防御代数密钥提取的缺陷，并提出了“密钥流重用上限（keystream-bit reuse cap）”这一轻量且有效的约束机制；其重要性体现在实现了结构旁路防御与抗SAT攻击的兼顾；局限性在于测试仅在三个ISCAS'85基准电路上进行，且防御的是有界展开SAT攻击，对更大规模现代电路和高级攻击形式的泛化能力仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 传统静态逻辑锁定易受SAT和结构移除攻击；现有的动态逻辑锁定方案（如STREAMLOCK）虽然能利用密码学密钥流动态掩码抵御预言机攻击，但若仅将密钥门限制在主输出端，内部逻辑仍易受单抽头结构旁路攻击；此外，位宽较大的电路每个周期会暴露过多密钥流比特，导致代数密钥提取仍然可行。
method: 1. 利用故障传播分析（fault-propagation analysis）优先在内部路径中分布放置密钥门，以加固内部组合逻辑锥；2. 引入密钥流比特重用上限（keystream-bit reuse cap），限制每个时钟周期暴露的密钥流比特数，使其与电路位宽解耦；3. 在三个ISCAS'85基准电路上，针对结构移除攻击和基于有界展开的SAT式攻击进行安全评估。
results: 1. 内部分布式掩码将最大基准测试中攻击者的穷举搜索空间从6个候选节点子集激增至超过10^45；2. 仅进行拓扑重定位无法防止宽电路中的代数密钥提取；3. 引入密钥流重用上限后，SAT求解器遭遇显著的计算断崖，求解过程直接从欠约束快速求解骤变至超时阈值，且未泄露密钥。
conclusion: 将基于故障感知的内部密钥门放置与密钥流重用上限机制相结合，能够同时实现对结构旁路攻击和有界展开SAT攻击的有效防御。

title: Payroll Fraud Detection in Synthetic HR/ERP Graphs: An Inductive Comparison of Rules, Path Features, and Graph Neural Networks
authors: Xiaobo Chen, Genliang Zhu, Ziyuan Wang, Chu Wang
abstract: Payroll-fraud screening requires finding hidden employee--payee links while distinguishing suspicious relationships from legitimate ones. We formulate this problem as inductive link prediction and entity ranking on synthetic human-resources and enterprise resource planning (HR/ERP) graphs, with unseen organizations and a matched benign twin for every planted case. An original study on 24 held-out organizations and a prospectively frozen extension compare analyst rules, explicit path features and graph neural networks (GNNs). A tuned gradient-boosted model on chained-join features achieved the highest overall link average precision (AP; 0.823), above the GraIL-style GNN (0.663); its 4-hop AP was 0.646 versus 0.272. Thus, the observed multi-hop gain is not specific to GNNs. On a new synthetic cohort with 2.0% positive entities, chained-join boosting again led (AP 0.798); the relational entity GNN also exceeded record-aware rules (0.707 versus 0.504). At a 2% review budget, their precision was 0.695 versus 0.602. Under 40% failed identifier joins, the entity GNN ranked above chained-join boosting (AP 0.712 versus 0.683, descriptively). Structure-only auditing exposed a shortcut in the initial generator; matched twins reduced the audited twin-pool AUROC to 0.493--0.514. These results separate multi-hop candidate discovery, record-based discrimination and review prioritization within an explicit synthetic evaluation design. Code and data are available from the authors on request.
zh_title: 合成HR/ERP图中的薪资欺诈检测：规则、路径特征与图神经网络的归纳式对比研究
translation: 薪资欺诈筛查需要发现隐藏的员工—收款人链接，同时将可疑关系与合法关系区分开来。我们将该问题形式化为合成人力资源与企业资源计划（HR/ERP）图上的归纳式链接预测和实体排序，测试集包含未见过的组织，且为每个植入欺诈案例匹配了良性孪生对照。通过对24个保留组织的原生研究以及前瞻性冻结扩展，我们对比了分析师规则、显式路径特征和图神经网络（GNN）。基于链式连接特征微调的梯度提升模型取得了最高的整体链接平均精度（AP；0.823），高于GraIL类GNN（0.663）；其4跳AP为0.646，相比之下GNN为0.272。因此，观察到的多跳增益并非GNN所独有。在一个正例实体占比2.0%的新合成队列中，链式连接提升模型再次领先（AP 0.798）；关系实体GNN也优于感知记录的规则（0.707对比0.504）。在2%的审核预算下，两者的精确率分别为0.695和0.602。在40%标识符连接失败的情况下，实体GNN排序优于链式连接提升模型（描述性分析中AP为0.712对比0.683）。仅基于结构的审计揭示了初始生成器中的捷径；配对孪生使审计孪生池的AUROC降至0.493–0.514。这些结果在显式的合成评估设计中，将多跳候选发现、基于记录的辨别与审核优先级排序有效区分开来。代码和数据可按要求向作者索取。
tldr: 对比规则、显式路径特征与GNN在企业图薪资欺诈检测中的表现，发现显式路径特征模型整体表现最优，但GNN在连接缺失时鲁棒性更强。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地使用合成HR/ERP图并引入配对良性孪生（matched twins）消除了图生成器中的结构捷径，严谨地对比了传统路径特征（如梯度提升树链式连接）与GNN在归纳链接预测和实体排序中的表现，揭示了多跳推理收益并非GNN独有，对实际企业欺诈检测系统的模型选型具有重要参考价值。
motivation: 薪资欺诈筛查需要发现隐藏的“员工-收款人”关联，同时区分可疑关系与合法关系；需要在未见过的组织图结构中进行归纳推理。
method: 将问题建模为合成HR/ERP图上的归纳式链接预测与实体排序任务，并引入配对良性孪生案例；对比了分析师规则、显式路径特征（基于链式连接特征的微调梯度提升模型）以及图神经网络（GraIL类GNN、关系实体GNN）。
results: 链式连接梯度提升模型在整体链接AP（0.823 vs GNN 0.663）及4跳AP（0.646 vs 0.272）上均大幅领先；在2.0%正样本的新队列中，其AP达到0.798，而关系实体GNN（0.707）优于规则（0.504）；在40%标识符连接失效时，实体GNN更具鲁棒性（AP 0.712 vs 0.683）；结构审计和良性孪生消除了生成器捷径。
conclusion: 多跳收益并非GNN所独有，梯度提升树结合链式连接特征在多数指标上优于GNN，但在标识符连接大量失败时实体GNN表现更优；该基准设计成功解耦了多跳候选发现、基于记录的辨别和审核优先级排序。

title: AIFaultBench: A Reproducible Benchmark of Real-World Faults in AI Software Systems
authors: Mehil B Shah, Mohammad Masudur Rahman, Foutse Khomh
abstract: AI-based software systems remain difficult to debug because their failures can involve interactions among code, models, data, dependencies, hardware, and execution environments. Existing benchmarks cover specific classes of AI systems, while concerns about fault realism and reproducibility highlight the need for documented execution conditions and evidence. We present AIFaultBench, a benchmark of 770 real-world bugs from 105 AI-based software repositories across 76 organizations. It covers six classes of AI systems: machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, systems based on large language models, agentic AI, and AI tooling and infrastructure. Each bug record connects the original report and affected codebase to structured metadata, environment setup scripts, a reproduction trigger, and investigation evidence. We reproduced 652 bugs (84.7%) under the recorded execution conditions and documented the outcomes of the remaining 118 attempts. Through its broad coverage, documented reproduction evidence, and common structure, AIFaultBench supports empirical studies of AI faults, debugging tool evaluation, practical failure investigation, and teaching with real-world examples.

zh_title: AIFaultBench：一个可复现的AI软件系统真实世界故障基准
translation: 基于人工智能的软件系统仍然难以调试，因为它们的故障可能涉及代码、模型、数据、依赖项、硬件和执行环境之间的相互作用。现有的基准测试涵盖了特定类别的AI系统，而对故障真实性和可复现性的担忧凸显了对记录的执行条件和证据的需求。我们提出了AIFaultBench，这是一个包含来自76个组织的105个基于AI的软件仓库中的770个真实世界bug的基准。它涵盖了六类AI系统：机器学习、深度学习、强化学习、基于大语言模型的系统、智能体AI以及AI工具和基础设施。每个bug记录都将原始报告和受影响的代码库连接到结构化元数据、环境设置脚本、复现触发器和调查证据。我们在记录的执行条件下复现了652个bug（84.7%），并记录了其余118次尝试的结果。通过其广泛的覆盖范围、记录的复现证据和共同的结构，AIFaultBench支持对AI故障的实证研究、调试工具评估、实际故障调查以及用真实世界的例子进行教学。
tldr: AIFaultBench是一个包含770个真实世界AI软件故障的全面、可复现基准，涵盖6大类AI系统，为AI调试研究和工具评估提供了重要支持。
ai_comments: 该论文填补了AI软件系统缺乏全面、真实、可复现故障基准的空白，具有很高的实用价值和学术研究意义，支持了经验研究、调试工具评估以及教学等多个场景。
motivation: 现有的AI系统基准仅涵盖特定类别，且真实故障的真实性和可复现性存在不足，缺乏记录明确的执行条件和证据，导致AI软件系统难以调试。
method: 构建了一个包含770个来自105个AI软件仓库的真实故障的基准库（AIFaultBench），涵盖6大类AI系统，并为每个故障提供结构化元数据、环境设置脚本、复现触发器和调查证据。
results: 成功在记录的执行条件下复现了652个bug（占84.7%），并记录了其余118次尝试的结果。
conclusion: AIFaultBench是一个全面、可复现的真实AI软件系统故障基准，通过提供结构化元数据和复现脚本，有效促进了AI故障的研究、调试工具评估和实际故障调查。

title: RepGen: Reproducing Deep Learning Bugs through Context-Aware Code Generation and Verification
authors: Mehil B Shah, Mohammad Masudur Rahman, Foutse Khomh
abstract: Reproducing deep learning (DL) bugs is challenging because failures can involve source code, models, data, dependencies, and execution environments. Incomplete bug reports further complicate reproduction by omitting essential details. We present RepGen, an open-source tool for reproducing DL bugs through context-aware code generation and iterative verification. Given a bug report and repository, RepGen explores the codebase to build a learning-enhanced context, develop a reproduction plan, and generate candidate scripts. It refines candidates using static checks and LLM feedback to improve their correctness and relevance. When enabled, the tool prepares the execution environment, runs the script, and assesses its output against the reported failure. RepGen provides an interactive command-line interface supporting local and hosted LLMs, configurable execution budgets, and inspectable artifacts, along with a GitHub Action for automated issue processing. The underlying approach reproduced 85 of 106 real-world DL bugs (80.19%). A controlled study with 27 developers showed a 23.35% improvement in reproduction success and a 56.8% reduction in reproduction time.
comment: Under Review - ICSE 2027 Tool Demonstration and Data Showcase Track
zh_title: RepGen：通过上下文感知代码生成和验证复现深度学习错误
translation: 复现深度学习（DL）错误具有挑战性，因为故障可能涉及源代码、模型、数据、依赖项和执行环境。不完整的错误报告由于遗漏了基本细节，进一步使复现复杂化。我们提出了RepGen，一个开源工具，通过上下文感知代码生成和迭代验证来复现DL错误。给定一个错误报告和代码仓库，RepGen会探索代码库以构建学习增强的上下文，制定复现计划，并生成候选脚本。它使用静态检查和LLM反馈来优化候选脚本的正确性和相关性。启用后，该工具会准备执行环境，运行脚本，并根据报告的故障评估其输出。RepGen提供了一个支持本地和托管LLM、可配置执行预算和可检查工件的交互式命令行界面，以及一个用于自动化问题处理的GitHub Action。其底层方法复现了106个真实世界DL错误中的85个（80.19%）。一项针对27名开发人员的对照研究显示，复现成功率提高了23.35%，复现时间减少了56.8%。
tldr: RepGen是一个开源工具，它通过上下文感知代码生成和迭代验证来复现深度学习错误。它能探索代码库，生成候选脚本，并通过静态检查和LLM反馈进行优化。该工具成功复现了80.19%的真实世界深度学习错误，并显著提高了开发人员的复现成功率和效率。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的方法，利用上下文感知代码生成和LLM反馈来自动化深度学习错误的复现过程。其重要性在于解决了DL开发中一个关键且耗时的问题，即错误复现的复杂性。通过提供一个开源工具和GitHub Action，RepGen有望显著提高DL社区的调试效率。结合LLM进行代码生成和优化是其主要的创新点。
motivation: 复现深度学习（DL）错误具有挑战性，因为故障可能涉及源代码、模型、数据、依赖项和执行环境。此外，不完整的错误报告由于遗漏了基本细节，进一步使复现复杂化。
method: RepGen通过上下文感知代码生成和迭代验证来复现DL错误。它首先探索代码库以构建学习增强的上下文，然后制定复现计划并生成候选脚本。RepGen使用静态检查和LLM反馈来改进候选脚本的正确性和相关性。该工具还可以准备执行环境，运行脚本，并根据报告的故障评估其输出。它提供交互式命令行界面和GitHub Action。
results: RepGen成功复现了106个真实世界DL错误中的85个（80.19%）。一项针对27名开发人员的对照研究显示，复现成功率提高了23.35%，复现时间减少了56.8%。
conclusion: RepGen作为一种通过上下文感知代码生成和迭代验证来复现深度学习错误的工具，在真实世界错误复现和提高开发人员效率方面表现出显著的有效性。

title: Robust edge multiscale space based hybrid Schwarz preconditioner for high-frequency Helmholtz problems
authors: Shubin Fu, Shihua Gong, Guanglian Li, Yulei Liao
abstract: We develop a novel hybrid Schwarz method, termed the robust edge multiscale space based hybrid Schwarz method (REMs-HS), for the efficient solution of high-frequency Helmholtz problems. The method combines a one-level restricted additive Schwarz preconditioner with impedance transmission conditions (RAS-imp) and an edge multiscale (EMs) coarse solver in a multiplicative way. A key ingredient of our construction is a modified impedance boundary condition (mIBC), which is imposed both on the subdomain problems and on the local problems that generate the EMs coarse space. Compared with the original impedance boundary condition, the mIBC makes the proposed method both stable and inexpensive theoretically. We prove that the resulting REMs-HS preconditioner gives rise to a uniform convergent fixed-point iteration for large wavenumbers. Moreover, the required resolution conditions are substantially relaxed. Only a mild condition on the level parameter $\ell$ of the hierarchical coarse basis $\ell>\frac{1}{2}\log_2 k$ is needed, which is markedly weaker than the conditions in previous analyses. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate the robustness of the proposed method for Helmholtz problems with large wavenumbers.
zh_title: 基于稳健边多尺度空间的高频Helmholtz问题混合Schwarz预条件子
translation: 我们开发了一种新型混合Schwarz方法，称为基于稳健边多尺度空间的混合Schwarz方法（REMs-HS），用于高效求解高频Helmholtz问题。该方法将具有阻抗传输条件的单层限制性加性Schwarz预条件子（RAS-imp）与边多尺度（EMs）粗求解器以乘性方式结合。我们构建的关键要素是一种修正阻抗边界条件（mIBC），它同时施加于子域问题以及生成EMs粗空间的局部问题上。与原始阻抗边界条件相比，mIBC在理论上使所提出的方法既稳定又低计算成本。我们证明了所得REMs-HS预条件子对于大波数能够产生一致收敛的不动点迭代。此外，所需的网格分辨率条件显著放宽。分层粗基底的层级参数 $\ell$ 仅需满足温和条件 $\ell>\frac{1}{2}\log_2 k$，这明显弱于以往分析中的条件。大量的数值实验展示了所提方法在求解大波数Helmholtz问题时的稳健性。
tldr: 提出了一种融合修正阻抗边界条件与边多尺度粗求解器的新型混合Schwarz预条件子，成功实现了大波数Helmholtz问题的一致收敛且显著降低了分辨率要求。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于引入了修正阻抗边界条件（mIBC），并将其有机融入边多尺度粗空间的构建与子域问题中，从而在乘性混合Schwarz框架下实现了大波数下的一致收敛性。理论上将分辨率条件大幅放宽至仅需 $\ell > \frac{1}{2}\log_2 k$，是一项显著的理论突破；局限在于摘要未详细展示三维复杂非均匀介质中的扩展性及具体并行计算规模。
motivation: 针对高频Helmholtz问题求解困难的挑战，旨在克服传统阻抗边界条件在稳定性和计算成本方面的限制，并显著放宽粗网格离散解析度的苛刻要求。
method: 提出了基于稳健边多尺度空间的混合Schwarz方法（REMs-HS）。该方法采用乘性方式结合带有阻抗传输条件的单层限制性加性Schwarz预条件子（RAS-imp）与边多尺度（EMs）粗求解器，并在子域问题及生成EMs粗空间的局部问题中均施加了修正阻抗边界条件（mIBC）。
results: 证明了REMs-HS预条件子在大波数下可诱导出一致收敛的不动点迭代；粗基底层级参数只需满足较弱的温和条件 $\ell > \frac{1}{2}\log_2 k$；数值实验验证了该方法在大波数下具有极高的稳健性。
conclusion: REMs-HS方法在理论上稳定且计算成本低，大幅放宽了解析度约束条件，能够在大波数Helmholtz问题中实现一致收敛，是一种高效且稳健的预条件子技术。

title: Local Budget Benefits, Population Commitment, and Solver Performance: A DGO Case Study with Controlled DE Transfer
authors: Shiqi Li
abstract: An evaluated candidate can improve a local search step, alter the population used by later steps, and affect a solver's final result. We distinguish these three questions using Da Gou Gun Optimization (DGO), a population optimizer designed for this study. Its JQ100 configuration evaluates an interpolation candidate during a two-sided probe. We define local budget value, population commitment effects and complete-policy performance, and give an exact example in which a locally better commitment leads to a worse continuation. Short-horizon matched comparisons favor interpolation on eligible quadratic states. Paired continuations yield mixed effect estimates, with primary group intervals spanning zero. Complete-policy comparisons favor JQ100 over the tested classical references in aggregate; a matched-start comparison has favorable means but intervals spanning parity. On 24 boxed BBOB functions, target-truncated geometric-mean error ratios favor JQ100 over the tested classical policies and favor L-SHADE and CMA-ES over JQ100 under the stated initialization and stopping rules. Local evaluation gains, commitment effects and solver competitiveness therefore require separate comparisons.
zh_title: 局部预算效益、种群承诺和求解器性能：一项受控差分进化的DGO案例研究
translation: 一个被评估的候选解可以改善局部搜索步骤，改变后续步骤使用的种群，并影响求解器的最终结果。我们使用Da Gou Gun优化（DGO）——一个为此研究设计的种群优化器——来区分这三个问题。其JQ100配置在双向探测期间评估一个插值候选解。我们定义了局部预算价值、种群承诺效应和完整策略性能，并给出了一个精确的例子，其中局部更好的承诺导致了更差的延续。短时间范围的匹配比较在符合条件的二次状态上倾向于插值。配对的延续产生了混合效应估计，主要组区间跨越零。完整策略比较总体上倾向于JQ100优于测试的经典参考方法；匹配起始比较具有有利的均值但区间跨越了平价。在24个盒式BBOB函数上，目标截断几何平均误差率显示JQ100优于测试的经典策略，但在既定的初始化和停止规则下，L-SHADE和CMA-ES优于JQ100。因此，局部评估增益、承诺效应和求解器竞争力需要单独进行比较。
tldr: 本研究使用Da Gou Gun优化（DGO）框架，通过定义局部预算价值、种群承诺效应和完整策略性能，区分了评估候选解对局部搜索、种群和最终结果的影响。研究发现局部评估增益、承诺效应和求解器竞争力需要单独比较，且DGO的JQ100配置在某些情况下表现良好，但在24个BBOB函数上，L-SHADE和CMA-ES表现优于JQ100。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入一个专门设计的优化器DGO，细致地探讨了局部优化决策如何影响全局搜索过程和最终性能，这对于理解复杂优化算法的行为具有重要意义。它清晰地指明了局部效益、种群演化和整体性能之间可能存在的复杂甚至矛盾的关系，这为未来优化算法的设计和分析提供了新的视角和挑战。论文的创新点在于提出了“局部预算价值”、“种群承诺效应”和“完整策略性能”等概念来量化这些影响。
motivation: 研究的动机是为了区分评估候选解如何影响局部搜索步骤、后续步骤使用的种群以及求解器的最终结果。
method: 本研究使用专门设计的种群优化器Da Gou Gun Optimization (DGO)，特别是其JQ100配置，在双向探测期间评估插值候选解。研究定义了局部预算价值、种群承诺效应和完整策略性能。实验包括短时间范围的匹配比较、配对的延续比较以及在24个盒式BBOB函数上的完整策略比较。
results: 研究发现，局部更好的承诺可能导致更差的后续结果。短时间范围的匹配比较在符合条件的二次状态上倾向于插值。配对的延续产生了混合效应估计。完整策略比较总体上倾向于JQ100优于测试的经典参考方法，但在匹配起始比较中，均值有利但区间跨越了平价。在24个盒式BBOB函数上，目标截断几何平均误差率显示JQ100优于测试的经典策略，但在既定的初始化和停止规则下，L-SHADE和CMA-ES优于JQ100。
conclusion: 局部评估增益、承诺效应和求解器竞争力需要单独进行比较。

title: QUAL: Quantile Alignment Improves Zero-Shot Time-Series Foundation Models
authors: Junhyeok Kang, Sangjun Han, Jun Seo, Seunghan Lee, Jaehoon Lee, Dongwan Kang, Minjae Kim, Sungdong Yoo, Tae Yoon Lim, Hwanil Choi, Soonyoung Lee, Wonbin Ahn
abstract: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) provide zero-shot forecasts for unseen series, but their accuracy varies across datasets. Combining several models can reduce this variability, yet zero-shot deployment provides no target labels for selecting or weighting them. We find that a model pool is useful not only as a final ensemble, but also as a probability reference for transforming each member forecast. Aligning quantiles through this pool-relative reference improves every member forecast in aggregate. Motivated by this finding, we propose QUAL (Quantile alignment), a simple label-free framework for improving and combining diverse TSFMs. QUAL first produces aligned member forecasts, then applies Huber aggregation and rearrangement to obtain a robust combined forecast without training or model modification. On GIFT-Eval, quantile alignment reduces average member MASE and CRPS by 7.4% and 9.8%. The full framework remains robust when weak forecasters enter a candidate pool whose quality cannot be verified in advance. Code is available at https://github.com/junhyeokkang/QUAL.
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems: From Forecasting to World Modeling
zh_title: QUAL：分位数对齐提升零样本时间序列基础模型
translation: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）为未见序列提供零样本预测，但其准确性因数据集而异。组合多个模型可以减少这种变异性，然而零样本部署不提供用于选择或加权它们的目标标签。我们发现，模型池不仅可以用作最终的集成，还可以用作转换每个成员预测的概率参考。通过该池相对参考对齐分位数，可以在总体上改善每个成员的预测。受此发现的启发，我们提出了QUAL（Quantile alignment），一个简单且无标签的框架，用于改进和组合多样化的TSFMs。QUAL首先产生对齐的成员预测，然后应用Huber聚合和重排以获得稳健的组合预测，而无需训练或模型修改。在GIFT-Eval上，分位数对齐使平均成员MASE和CRPS分别减少了7.4%和9.8%。当无法预先验证质量的弱预测器进入候选池时，整个框架仍然保持稳健。代码可在 https://github.com/junhyeokkang/QUAL 获取。
tldr: 提出了一种名为QUAL的无标签分位数对齐框架，无需训练即可显著提升并组合多个零样本时间序列基础模型的预测性能。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将模型池作为概率参考来进行分位数对齐，从而在无标签的情况下显著提升了零样本时间序列基础模型的预测准确性和鲁棒性，且无需训练或模型修改，实用价值高。
motivation: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在不同数据集上的零样本预测准确性存在差异，且零样本部署缺乏目标标签来选择或加权组合模型，作者希望解决如何利用模型池来无标签地改善和组合多样化的TSFMs这一问题。
method: 提出QUAL（Quantile alignment）框架，首先通过模型池作为概率参考产生对齐的成员预测，然后应用Huber聚合和重排（rearrangement）技术来获得稳健的组合预测，无需训练或模型修改。
results: 在GIFT-Eval数据集上，分位数对齐将平均成员MASE和CRPS分别降低了7.4%和9.8%，且即使引入无法预先验证质量的弱预测器，整个框架依然保持鲁棒性。
conclusion: 提出了一种基于分位数对齐的无标签框架QUAL，能有效提升并组合多样化的时间序列基础模型，显著降低MASE和CRPS误差，具备强大的鲁棒性。

title: Flash Word : ESL Listening Support with Subtitle Skimming
authors: Yuzu Saijo, Jun Rekimoto
abstract: Listening to English audio with English subtitles is thought to be effective for ESL students to improve listening comprehension skills. However, for those who learn English as a second language it can be hard to finish English subtitles. Also they are unlikely to focus on listening while being busy reading subtitles. We propose Flash Word, a subtitling system which generates and presents shortened intralingual subtitles for English audio by detecting keywords from the script. Flash Word extracts keywords from scripts using an existing algorithm, and shows them one at a time like a flashcard. The system calculates when the keywords are being pronounced and aligns them correctly. Flash Word aims to enable ESL students to focus better on listening by minimising the cost of reading subtitles.
zh_title: Flash Word：通过字幕速览辅助ESL英语听力
translation: 听英语音频配合英文字幕被认为对ESL学生提高听力理解技能很有效。然而，对于那些将英语作为第二语言的学习者来说，可能很难读完英文字幕。此外，他们在忙于阅读字幕时也不太可能专注于听力。我们提出了 Flash Word，这是一种字幕系统，它通过从脚本中检测关键词，为英语音频生成并展示精简的语内字幕。Flash Word 利用现有算法从脚本中提取关键词，并像闪卡一样一次只显示一个关键词。该系统能够计算关键词何时被发音并进行正确定齐。Flash Word 旨在通过最小化阅读字幕的成本，使ESL学生能够更好地专注于听力。
tldr: Flash Word 通过提取关键词并以闪卡形式与音频发音精准对齐，简化英文字幕，从而帮助ESL学生专注于听力训练。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将闪卡机制引入视频/音频字幕呈现中，通过关键词速览替代完整句子字幕，切中了ESL学习者在阅读字幕与听力注意力分配之间的痛点；但摘要中未报告用户研究或量化评估结果，其实际教学效果和学习者接受度仍有待验证。
motivation: 听英语音频配英文字幕虽有助于ESL学习者提升听力，但学习者往往阅读速度跟不上，且忙于阅读完整字幕容易分散注意力，无法专心进行听力训练。
method: 提出 Flash Word 字幕系统：利用现有算法从音频脚本中提取关键词，计算关键词的发音时间点并实现精准时间对齐，最终以类似闪卡的形式一次仅展示一个关键词。
conclusion: Flash Word 旨在通过最大程度地减少阅读字幕带来的视觉与认知负担，使ESL学习者能够更加专注于英语听力本身。

title: MUON-RT Reusing the Teacher's Trajectory for Momentum-Free Muon for LLM Self-Distillation
authors: Aryan Das, Vinay Kumar Verma, Aakansha Mishra
abstract: Self-distillation methods for large language models with an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher already retain a history of student updates. Muon nevertheless stores a separate momentum buffer, increasing persistent training memory. We propose Muon with Reused Teacher (Muon-RT), which reuses the teacher-student displacement to eliminate momentum buffers for hidden weight matrices. We show that this displacement encodes an exponentially weighted history of applied updates and smooths temporally uncorrelated noise under a local model. Muon-RT removes its radial component, normalizes it spectrally, and mixes it with the current gradient after Newton-Schulz (NS) orthogonalization. Under explicit regularity and alignment assumptions, we establish linear contraction of an expected objective-gap bound toward a residual error level. With Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Muon-RT improves average accuracy over AdamW by 2.6 points with 42% less persistent memory, and over momentum Muon by 5.4 points with 27% less persistent memory. With Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) on Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, it improves average accuracy over AdamW by 2.0 points.

title: Optimal climate policy in incomplete electricity markets
authors: Emil Dimanchev, Steven A. Gabriel, Stein-Erik Fleten, Filippo Pecci, Magnus Korpas
abstract: Incomplete long-term contracting in electricity markets can expose investors and consumers to inefficient levels of risk. This paper investigates how incompleteness impacts the optimal choice of climate policy. We develop a game-theoretic model of optimal policy-making in anticipation of how electricity market agents react to a given policy when gas prices and demand are uncertain and contracting is incomplete. In illustrative experiments, we observe that renewable subsidies and carbon prices induce an insurance co-benefit when markets are incomplete. This is because, relative to a complete market benchmark, incompleteness shifts investment from renewables toward gas and exposes consumers to uninsured risk from inter-annual volatility in electricity prices. By incentivizing investment in renewables, subsidies and carbon prices indirectly counteract these distortions. Consequently, incompleteness increases the optimal subsidy and carbon price levels in our experiments. Renewable subsidies exhibit a stronger insurance effect than carbon pricing, as the latter leads to more investment in gas with carbon capture and storage and more volatile electricity prices. While carbon pricing is more economically efficient than subsidies in complete markets, incompleteness shrinks its efficiency advantage and even leads to cases where subsidies are more economically efficient.
zh_title: 不完全电力市场中的最优气候政策
translation: 电力市场中长期契约的不完全性会使投资者和消费者暴露于低效率的风险水平中。本文研究了市场不完全性如何影响最优气候政策的选择。我们开发了一个博弈论模型，用于研究在天然气价格和需求不确定且契约不完全的情况下，政策制定者如何预测电力市场主体对给定政策的反应。在算例实验中，我们观察到当市场不完全时，可再生能源补贴和碳价会产生一种保险协同效益。这是因为，相对于完全市场的基准，不完全性将投资从可再生能源转向天然气，并使消费者面临电力价格年际波动带来的未投保风险。通过激励对可再生能源的投资，补贴和碳价间接地抵消了这些扭曲。因此，在我们的实验中，不完全性提高了最优的补贴和碳价水平。可再生能源补贴表现出比碳价更强的保险效应，因为后者导致更多对带碳捕集与封存（CCS）的天然气的投资以及更具波动的电价。虽然在完全市场中碳价比补贴更具经济效率，但市场的不完全性缩小了碳价的效率优势，甚至导致在某些情况下补贴更具经济效率。
tldr: 本文研究发现，电力市场中长期契约的不完全性会增加最优的碳价和可再生能源补贴水平，因为这些政策能够为规避市场风险提供“保险”作用。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将电力市场的不完全契约与气候政策优化结合，通过博弈论模型揭示了碳价和可再生能源补贴在不完全市场中具有非预期的保险协同效益，对理解现实世界中的能源政策设计具有重要意义。
motivation: 电力市场中长期契约的不完全性会导致投资者和消费者面临低效率的风险暴露，本文旨在研究这种不完全性如何影响最优气候政策的选择。
method: 开发了一个博弈论模型，模拟在天然气价格和需求不确定以及长期契约不完全的情况下，电力市场主体对特定气候政策的反应，并进行了算例实验。
results: 不完全性促使可再生能源补贴和碳价水平提高，因为它们能产生保险协同效益；可再生能源补贴表现出比碳价更强的保险效应，在不完全市场中碳价的效率优势缩小，补贴甚至可能更高效。
conclusion: 在不完全电力市场中，由于契约缺失带来的风险溢价扭曲了投资，这使得最优的碳价和补贴水平显著提高；可再生能源补贴的保险效益更强，甚至在某些情况下其经济效率可能超越碳价。

title: Differential rank preservation manifold learning
authors: Henry Han, Luyu Niu, Diane Li, Jiacun Wang
abstract: Manifold learning methods like t-SNE and UMAP preserve local neighborhoods, but they do not preserve the ranking of the neighbors inside them. Two embeddings can return the same neighbor set while disagreeing on which point is closest. This loss of order degrades downstream applications that value the order in the embedding. We propose Smooth Rank t-SNE (SR-tSNE), which adds a differentiable rank term to the standard t-SNE loss. To enable efficient training, this term uses a sigmoid rank approximation to explicitly force a point's true high-dimensional neighbors to outrank unrelated intruders and retain their original order. We also introduce Ordinal DLP (O-DLP), an extension of the Degree of Locality Preservation (DLP) metric that credits a neighbor only when it returns at its original rank. Across eight benchmarks spanning image, text, speech, remote-sensing and single-cell data, SR-tSNE outperforms 12 baselines in rank preservation and neighborhood overlap. Ablation studies demonstrate our rank term alone boosts O-DLP by 5% to 28%, a gain not achievable using standard pairwise loss. This advantage transfers to downstream applications. SR-tSNE achieves the best label-transfer performance across seven vision datasets. For cell-type discovery across six single-cell datasets, it ranks first in 17 of 18 dataset-metric combinations, whether clustering resolution is selected with or without cell-type labels. In intraday trading, SR-tSNE achieves higher returns, lower risk, and lower turnover than the baselines. To our knowledge, SR-tSNE is the first t-SNE-family method with explicit order preservation.
translation: 像t-SNE和UMAP这样的流形学习方法能够保持局部邻域，但无法保持邻域内部邻居的排序。两个嵌入可能返回相同的邻域集合，却在“哪个点最近”上存在分歧。这种顺序的丢失会削弱依赖嵌入空间中顺序信息的下游应用性能。为此，我们提出了平滑排序t-SNE（SR-tSNE），它在标准t-SNE损失中加入了一个可微分的排序项。为了实现高效训练，该项利用Sigmoid排序近似，显式迫使点的高维真实邻居排在无关干扰点之前并保持其原始顺序。我们还引入了序数DLP（O-DLP），这是局部保持度（DLP）指标的扩展，仅当邻居以其原始排名返回时才计入得分。在涵盖图像、文本、语音、遥感和单细胞数据的八个基准测试中，SR-tSNE在排序保持和邻域重叠方面均优于12种基线方法。消融研究表明，仅我们的排序项就能将O-DLP提高5%到28%，这一增益是使用标准成对损失无法实现的。该优势成功迁移到了下游应用中：SR-tSNE在七个视觉数据集中取得了最佳的标签迁移性能；在六个单细胞数据集的细胞类型发现中，无论聚类分辨率是否使用细胞类型标签进行选择，它在18个数据集-指标组合中的17个中均排名第一；在日内交易中，SR-tSNE相较基线实现了更高的收益、更低的风险和更低的换手率。据我们所知，SR-tSNE是首个具有显式顺序保持能力的t-SNE家族方法。
tldr: SR-tSNE通过在t-SNE中引入可微排序损失项，首次实现了显式保持局部邻域内样本的相对顺序，显著提升了降维质量及下游任务表现。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于敏锐地指出了现有流形学习算法（如t-SNE、UMAP）虽能保留邻域但无法保留邻域内相对排序（Rank）的缺陷，并通过引入可微分的Sigmoid近似保秩损失项与配套评估指标O-DLP，成功填补了这一空白。实验覆盖广泛且下游效果显著。局限性在于摘要未提及计算开销和大规模数据下的伸缩性变化。
motivation: 现有的t-SNE和UMAP等流形学习方法只能保留局部邻域集合，却无法保持邻域内部邻居的相对排序，这种相对顺序的丢失会损害依赖低维空间精确顺序关系的下游应用。
method: 提出Smooth Rank t-SNE（SR-tSNE），在标准t-SNE损失函数中加入可微分的排序项；利用Sigmoid函数进行可微分秩近似，迫升高维真实邻居的排序并保留其原始顺序；此外还提出了配套的序数局部保持度（O-DLP）评估指标。
results: 在涵盖图像、文本、语音、遥感和单细胞数据的8个基准测试中，SR-tSNE在保秩和邻域重叠度上超越了12种基线方法；消融实验显示保秩项使O-DLP提升了5%至28%；在7个视觉数据集的标签迁移、6个单细胞数据集的细胞类型发现（18个指标组合中17个位列第一）以及日内交易任务中均取得了最佳性能。
conclusion: SR-tSNE是首个具备显式邻域顺序保持能力的t-SNE家族流形学习方法，显著提升了依赖局部排序的各类下游任务表现。

title: An Empirical Study on Learning Rooftop Solar Potential from Satellite Imagery Directly Without Explicit Geometry
authors: Joshua Lee
abstract: Rooftop solar potential estimation often relies on LiDAR, digital surface models (DSMs), or pipelines that explicitly reconstruct roof geometry before estimating solar potential. We propose Direct Rooftop Solar Prediction (DRSP), an end-to-end formulation that maps satellite imagery and coarse regional sunlight information directly to application-level solar outputs. DRSP neither requires explicit geometric representations as input nor predicts roof orientation, slope, height, DSMs, or other geometric quantities as intermediate outputs, and therefore requires no geometric intermediate supervision. To enable large-scale study of this formulation, we develop a programmatic data-curation pipeline that converts per-panel information from the Google Solar API into usable-rooftop masks and spatial solar-energy targets, yielding two geographically distinct datasets containing approximately 60K rooftops from the U.S. Midwest and 87K from Texas. We demonstrate the feasibility of DRSP and systematically characterize the effects of geographic training distribution, model depth, image resolution, regional sunlight conditioning, and heatmap regression objectives. Overall, our results suggest that useful rooftop-scale solar information can be learned directly from 2D imagery without explicit geometric intermediate representations, offering a simpler path toward large-scale solar assessment. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/joshualee124/direct_rooftop_solar_prediction.
zh_title: 无需显式几何结构直接从卫星图像学习屋顶太阳能潜力的实证研究
translation: 屋顶太阳能潜力估计通常依赖于LiDAR、数字表面模型（DSMs）或在估计太阳能潜力之前显式重建屋顶几何形状的管道。我们提出了直接屋顶太阳能预测（DRSP），这是一种端到端的公式化方法，将卫星图像和粗略的区域阳光信息直接映射到应用级太阳能输出。DRSP既不需要显式几何表示作为输入，也不预测屋顶方向、坡度、高度、DSM或其他几何量作为中间输出，因此不需要几何中间监督。为了实现该公式的大规模研究，我们开发了一个程序化数据整理管道，将来自Google Solar API的每块面板信息转换为可用屋顶掩码和空间太阳能能量目标，产生了两个地理上不同的数据集，包含来自美国中西部的约6万个屋顶和德克萨斯州的8.7万个屋顶。我们证明了DRSP的可行性，并系统地描述了地理训练分布、模型深度、图像分辨率、区域阳光条件和热图回归目标的影响。总的来说，我们的结果表明，可以直接从2D图像中学习有用的屋顶级太阳能信息，而无需显式几何中间表示，从而为大规模太阳能评估提供了一条更简单的途径。我们的代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/joshualee124/direct_rooftop_solar_prediction 获取。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需显式几何重建的端到端深度学习方法，直接通过卫星图像预测屋顶太阳能潜力，简化了大规模太阳能评估流程。
ai_comments: 该论文打破了传统依赖LiDAR、数字表面模型（DSM）或复杂几何重建管道的常规方法，提出了端到端的直接屋顶太阳能预测（DRSP）框架。通过利用Google Solar API进行大规模数据整理，验证了从2D卫星图像中直接学习太阳能潜力的可行性，为大规模可再生能源评估提供了一条更简单、高效的路径。
motivation: 传统的屋顶太阳能潜力估计通常依赖于LiDAR、数字表面模型（DSMs）或复杂的几何重建管道，这些方法需要显式重建屋顶几何形状或预测中间几何量，过程繁琐且成本高昂，因此需要探索一种更简单的端到端大规模太阳能评估方法。
method: 提出了直接屋顶太阳能预测（DRSP）的端到端框架，直接将卫星图像和区域阳光信息映射为太阳能输出，无需显式几何重建或中间几何监督；开发了自动化数据整理管道，从Google Solar API中提取可用屋顶掩码和空间太阳能目标，构建了包含美国中西部（约6万个屋顶）和德克萨斯州（约8.7万个屋顶）的大规模数据集。
results: 验证了DRSP的可行性，并系统地分析了地理训练分布、模型深度、图像分辨率、区域阳光条件以及热图回归目标对模型性能的影响，证明了可以从2D图像中直接学习有用的屋顶级太阳能信息。
conclusion: 本研究证明了无需显式几何中间表征，直接从2D卫星图像中学习屋顶级太阳能潜力是完全可行的，为大规模太阳能评估提供了一种更简单且有效的途径。

title: Memory and Recall of Color Images Using Neural Networks-1 - The Cue-Ball Model based on the Associative Memory Mechanism -
authors: Hiroshi Inazawa
abstract: This paper presents a neural network model for storing and recalling color images of different sizes using the Cue BallRecall Net systems [1,2,3,4,5]. The Cue Ball system consists of a Recall Net composed of multiple memory neurons each responsible for memorizing a single, distinct memory and a large number of neurons that represent image patterns. The images used in this study [6] consist of ten images(see Appendix). The pixel values of these images were converted into digital values and used for subsequent processing. Accordingly, the Cue Ball contains ten Cue neurons, corresponding to the ten images stored in memory. The number of pixels varies among the images, and therefore, the number of Recall neurons comprising the Recall Net also varies accordingly. In this study, the number of Recall neurons was prepared between 106,134 and 360,000, depending on the number of pixels in each image. In this simulation, after the connection weights (wjip, vijp) had been learned, we have used the learning and recall algorithms to investigate whether the Cue neuron which had memorized a specific image could be identified by the Recall Net when that a memorized image has been presented. Therefore, the most important simulation result is which Cue neuron responds when a memorized image is presented to the Recall Net. If the Cue neuron that memorizes the presented image responds, its output can be used to obtain the corresponding image data. By adding a BMP header to the resulting image data, the original memorized image can be accurately recalled.
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 1 table ------- Please note that I retired from the university mentioned in the paper at the end of March 2025. This information is included in the paper as a footnote. If there are any issues, please feel free to contact me. Thank you for your kind attention
zh_title: 利用神经网络进行彩色图像的记忆与回忆-1 —— 基于联想记忆机制的Cue-Ball模型
translation: 本文介绍了一种利用Cue Ball-Recall Net系统存储和回忆不同尺寸彩色图像的神经网络模型。Cue Ball系统由一个Recall Net构成，该网络包括分别负责存储单一独立记忆的多个记忆神经元，以及大量表征图像模式的神经元。本研究使用的图像包含10张图片，这些图片的像素值被转换为数字值以用于后续处理。相应地，Cue Ball中包含对应于记忆中存储的10张图像的10个Cue神经元。各图像的像素数量不同，因此构成Recall Net的Recall神经元数量也随之变化；在本研究中，根据每张图像的像素数，Recall神经元的数量设置在106,134到360,000之间。在本次仿真中，完成连接权重（wjip, vijp）的学习后，我们利用学习和回忆算法，研究当呈现已记忆的图像时，Recall Net是否能够识别出记忆该特定图像的Cue神经元。因此，最重要的仿真结果是当已记忆图像呈现给Recall Net时哪一个Cue神经元会产生响应。如果存储所呈现图像的Cue神经元做出响应，其输出即可用于获取相应的图像数据。通过向生成的图像数据中添加BMP文件头，即可准确地回忆起最初记忆的图像。
tldr: 提出了一种基于联想记忆机制的Cue-Ball神经网络，可对不同尺寸的彩色图像进行有效存储并在输入对应图像时精准回忆与重构。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种基于联想记忆机制实现彩色图像存储与提取的新模型，通过动态适配不同尺寸的像素量展示了联想网络的能力。然而，实验仅评估了10张图像，样本量较小，且摘要中未说明模型在面对噪声、部分缺失输入或未知图像时的泛化与容错能力。
motivation: 针对不同尺寸彩色图像的存储与高精度回忆需求，构建一种基于联想记忆机制的神经网络模型。
method: 基于Cue Ball-Recall Net系统，网络由负责表征图像模式的大量Recall神经元（数量根据图像像素动态设置为106,134至360,000个）和负责记忆特定图像的10个Cue神经元组成；通过学习连接权重（wjip, vijp）后，利用学习与回忆算法在输入图像时激活特定Cue神经元以恢复图像数据。
results: 在学习连接权重后，当向网络呈现已记忆的图像时，对应记忆该图像的Cue神经元能够被准确识别并响应，通过为其输出数据添加BMP文件头，可以精确复原存储的原始图像。
conclusion: 当向Recall Net输入已记忆的图像时，对应的Cue神经元能够成功响应，进而利用其输出并结合BMP头文件完整且准确地重构出原始彩色图像。

title: Calibration of Large Model Quantization based on HiFloat4 Format
authors: Jing Huang, Yu Cheng, Ziwei Yu, Lan Zhao, Sitan Li, Guangxiu Yao, Xin Wang, Yuanyong Luo, Hengyi Liang, Ting Li, Bo Liu, Hu Liu, Michael Bi Mi, Heng Liao
abstract: Quantization of Large Language Models (LLMs) has be- coming increasingly important for reducing the computa- tional costs and resource requirements for practical deploy- ment.Growinginterestinthisareahasmotivatedthecommu- nity to move beyond 8-bit quantization towards 4-bit preci- sion, leading to the development of customized 4-bit formats such as MXFP4 and NVFP4. Recently, HiFloat4 (HiF4) has emerged as a competitive alternative which adopts a Block Floating-Point(BFP)formatwithathree-levelscalinghierar- chy, thereby achieving a significantly larger dynamic range. While quantization can substantially reduce memory usage and accelerate inference, it frequently introduces accuracy degradation. Calibration is therefore essential for narrowing theperformancegapbetweenlow-precisionquantizedmodels and their full-precision counterparts. Nevertheless, existing calibration methods are mainly designed and validated us- ing integer-precision formats, such as INT4, lacking support for HiF4 due to its hierarchical BFP structure. In this paper, weinvestigatethreecalibrationapproaches,namelyHiGPTQ, HiAutoRound, and HiFlatQuant, to further enhance model quantizationbasedontheHiF4format.Extensiveexperiments demonstratethatallthreeproposedapproachesimproveinfer- ence accuracy compared with direct HiF4 conversion, reduc- ing the gap between HiF4 and BF16 to less than 1% and out- performing the state-of-the-art NVFP4 format across various models and downstream tasks.
zh_title: 基于HiFloat4格式的大模型量化校准
translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）的量化对于降低计算成本和实际部署的资源需求变得越来越重要。对这一领域日益增长的兴趣促使社区超越8比特量化，转向4比特精度，从而催生了MXFP4和NVFP4等定制4比特格式的开发。最近，HiFloat4（HiF4）作为一种具有三级缩放层次的块浮点（BFP）格式脱颖而出，成为一种有竞争力的替代方案，从而实现了显著更大的动态范围。虽然量化可以大幅减少内存使用并加速推理，但它经常引入精度下降。因此，校准对于缩小低精度量化模型与其全精度对应模型之间的性能差距至关重要。然而，现有校准方法主要使用整数精度格式（如INT4）进行设计和验证，由于其分层BFP结构，缺乏对HiF4的支持。在本文中，我们研究了HiGPTQ、HiAutoRound和HiFlatQuant三种校准方法，以进一步增强基于HiF4格式的模型量化。大量的实验表明，与直接的HiF4转换相比，所有三种提出的方法都提高了推理精度，将HiF4与BF16之间的差距缩小到不足1%，并且在各种模型和下游任务上均优于最先进的NVFP4格式。
tldr: 本文研究了三种针对HiFloat4格式的校准方法，显著提高了大模型量化后的推理精度，并超越了现有SOTA方法。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于首次针对HiFloat4这一新型4比特量化格式，提出了专用的校准方法，解决了其分层块浮点结构带来的校准难题。这对于推动大模型在资源受限环境下的高效部署具有重要意义，尤其是在4比特量化成为主流趋势的背景下。研究成果显著提升了HiF4量化模型的精度，使其更具竞争力。
motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）的量化对于降低计算成本和资源需求至关关重要。随着4比特量化成为趋势，HiFloat4（HiF4）作为一种具有更大动态范围的竞争性4比特格式出现。然而，量化通常会导致精度下降，需要校准。现有校准方法主要针对整数精度格式（如INT4），缺乏对HiF4这种分层块浮点（BFP）结构的支持。
method: 本文研究了三种校准方法，即HiGPTQ、HiAutoRound和HiFlatQuant，以进一步增强基于HiF4格式的模型量化。
results: 实验表明，所有三种提出的方法都提高了推理精度，将HiF4与BF16之间的差距缩小到不足1%，并且在各种模型和下游任务上均优于最先进的NVFP4格式。
conclusion: 本文提出的HiGPTQ、HiAutoRound和HiFlatQuant三种校准方法能有效提升基于HiFloat4格式的大模型量化精度，使其性能接近全精度模型并超越现有SOTA方法。

title: Language Models Show a "Women-Are-Wonderful" Effect in Blame Attribution That is Not Just Leniency
authors: Anika Sharma, Snehalkumar 'Neil' S. Gaikwad, Snigdha Chaturvedi, Shashank Srivastava
abstract: This paper investigates the Women-Are-Wonderful (WaW) effect in language-model blame attribution: a favorable bias in which women receive more positive evaluations than men. Using 11,270 interpersonal conflicts from r/AmItheAsshole, we construct matched counterfactuals that vary the gender of the person being judged (the original poster) and the person affected (the counter-party). Across four language models, gender changes a minority of verdicts, but those changes consistently favor women. The effect is strongly role-dependent. Making the original poster a woman reduces the odds of blame by 9--52%, while making the counter-party a woman multiplies them by 2.7--9.2X. Counter-party WaW also varies across conflict types, strengthening in communication and relationship conflicts and weakening in family conflicts. Exploratory probes suggest that counter-party gender can shift judgments of sympathy, reasonableness, harm and protection. WaW is therefore not just leniency toward women being judged: models also judge conduct more harshly when it affects a woman.
zh_title: 语言模型在责备归因中表现出“女性更美好”效应，且不仅限于宽容
translation: 本文调查了语言模型责备归因中的“女性更美好”（WaW）效应：即女性获得比男性更积极评价的有利偏见。通过使用来自r/AmItheAsshole的11,270个的人际冲突，我们构建了改变被判断人（原帖作者）和受影响人（对抗方）性别的匹配反事实。在四个语言模型中，性别改变了少数判决，但这些改变一致地偏向女性。该效应高度依赖于角色。将原帖作者设为女性可使被责备的几率降低9-52%，而将对抗方设为女性则将其增加2.7-9.2倍。对抗方的WaW效应也随冲突类型而变化，在沟通和关系冲突中增强，在家庭冲突中减弱。探索性探针表明，对抗方的性别可以改变对同理心、合理性、伤害和保护的判断。因此，WaW不仅仅是对被判断女性的宽容：模型在行为影响女性时也会对其做出更严厉的评判。
tldr: 研究发现大语言模型在人际冲突判决中存在“女性更美好”效应，女性发帖人更少受责备，而女性对抗方受影响时模型评判更严厉。
ai_comments: 该论文利用大规模真实冲突数据（r/AmItheAsshole）和反事实测试，揭示了语言模型在归因责备时存在的“女性更美好”效应（WaW效应）。创新之处在于细致地区分了当事人角色（发帖人与对抗方）对偏见的不同影响，并探讨了同理心、合理性等潜在机制，对理解和消除AI中的性别偏见具有重要价值。
motivation: 探究语言模型在责备归因中是否存在“女性更美好”（WaW）效应，即女性是否会受到比男性更具优势的评价，以及这种偏见背后的机制（如角色依赖性和冲突类型差异）。
method: 利用来自r/AmItheAsshole的11,270个网民人际冲突案例，构建性别反事实语料，在四个大语言模型上测试并量化性别对判决、同理心、合理性及伤害感知的影响。
results: 性别改变了少数判决但始终对女性有利。女性发帖人获得责备的几率降低9%–52%，而女性对抗方则使责备几率增加2.7–9.2倍。对抗方的WaW效应因冲突类型而异，并在同理心、合理性等方面影响判断。
conclusion: 语言模型在责备归因中表现出显著的“女性更美好”效应，该效应不仅表现为对女性发帖人的宽容，更表现为当女性作为对抗方时模型的严厉评判。这一偏见受角色和冲突类型的高度影响。

title: Predicting Human-Gain Curves under Local Proxy Optimization from Repeated Ratings
authors: Moonwon Choi, Kisung Nam, Seunggeun Lee
abstract: Optimizing a proxy objective can improve human-perceived quality, but the resulting gain can vary with optimization strength. Average proxy-human correlation alone does not reveal how human-perceived quality changes as optimization strength increases. We propose PACE (Proxy Alignment and Curvature Expansion), a pre-optimization diagnostic that uses repeated human ratings to predict the human-gain curve induced by a fixed proxy. The method models proxy optimization as a KL-regularized exponential tilt. At KL radius $d$, the local gain is approximated by $A\sqrt{d}+Bd$, where $A$ measures first-order proxy-human alignment and $B$ captures the leading second-order correction along the proxy-optimization path. We estimate $A$ and $B$ from repeated human ratings on calibration items and test the resulting gain-curve prediction on held-out evaluation items. Across SummEval, analysis-eligible WMT MQM clusters, an OpenMEVA-MAGS ROC/WP repeated-rating slice, and a GPT-4o judge proxy experiment, PACE consistently reduces held-out gain-prediction error relative to $A$-only, zero-gain, and reliability-only baselines. With the same pre-pool information, it is competitive with flexible proxy-conditional calibration, and a LoRA-DPO experiment provides a modest bridge to actual optimization. Transfer experiments across datasets and evaluation slices show that source coefficients are useful priors, but target calibration further improves prediction. The resulting diagnostic is local and one-sided: it characterizes gentle optimization along the positive tilt branch of a fixed item pool.
comment: 10-page main paper, 65 pages including references and supplementary material. Accepted as a Spotlight at NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/pacifiic/local-proxy-diagnostics
zh_title: 从重复评分中预测局部代理优化下的人类增益曲线
translation:
标题：从重复评分中预测局部代理优化下的人类增益曲线
摘要：优化代理目标可以改善人类感知质量，但由此产生的增益可能随优化强度而变化。仅凭平均代理-人类相关性无法揭示随着优化强度增加，人类感知质量如何变化。我们提出了PACE（代理对齐和曲率扩展），这是一种预优化诊断方法，它使用重复的人类评分来预测由固定代理引起的人类增益曲线。该方法将代理优化建模为KL正则化的指数倾斜。在KL半径$d$下，局部增益近似为$A\sqrt{d}+Bd$，其中$A$衡量一阶代理-人类对齐，而$B$捕获沿代理优化路径的领先二阶修正。我们从校准项上的重复人类评分估计$A$和$B$，并在留出评估项上测试由此产生的增益曲线预测。在SummEval、符合分析条件的WMT MQM集群、OpenMEVA-MAGS ROC/WP重复评分切片以及GPT-4o评判代理实验中，PACE相对于A-only、零增益和仅可靠性基线，始终减少了留出增益预测误差。在相同的预池信息下，它与灵活的代理条件校准具有竞争力，并且LoRA-DPO实验提供了与实际优化的适度连接。跨数据集和评估切片的迁移实验表明，源系数是有用的先验，但目标校准进一步改善了预测。由此产生的诊断是局部和单侧的：它描述了固定项目池正倾斜分支上的温和优化。
tldr: 提出PACE方法，利用重复人类评分预测代理优化导致的人类增益曲线，优于基线方法。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个量化代理优化对人类感知质量影响的诊断工具PACE，通过引入二阶修正项$B$来更精确地预测增益曲线，超越了传统仅依赖平均相关性的方法。其重要性在于能够帮助研究者在实际优化前更好地理解和预测优化效果，从而指导模型开发。一个潜在的局限性是其诊断是“局部和单侧的”，仅适用于固定项目池的正倾斜分支上的“温和优化”，可能不适用于更激进或不同类型的优化场景。
motivation: 优化代理目标可以改善人类感知质量，但由此产生的增益会随优化强度变化，而平均代理-人类相关性无法揭示这种变化。因此，需要一种预优化诊断工具来预测增益曲线。
method: 提出PACE（代理对齐和曲率扩展）方法，它是一种预优化诊断工具，使用重复人类评分来预测由固定代理引起的人类增益曲线。该方法将代理优化建模为KL正则化的指数倾斜，局部增益近似为$A\sqrt{d}+Bd$，其中$A$衡量一阶代理-人类对齐，$B$捕获二阶修正。通过校准项上的重复人类评分估计$A$和$B$，并在留出评估项上测试预测效果。
results: PACE在SummEval、WMT MQM、OpenMEVA-MAGS ROC/WP和GPT-4o评判代理实验中，相对于A-only、零增益和仅可靠性基线，一致地减少了留出增益预测误差。它与灵活的代理条件校准具有竞争力，且LoRA-DPO实验提供了与实际优化的适度连接。跨数据集和评估切片的迁移实验表明源系数是有用的先验，但目标校准进一步改善了预测。
conclusion: PACE是一种有效的局部单侧诊断工具，能够预测在固定项目池的正倾斜分支上温和优化下的人类增益曲线。

title: Confident Fools or Careful Searchers? A Behavioural Study of When LLMs Search Beyond Their Static Internal Memory
authors: Nipun D. Pathirage, Kwan Srijomkwan
abstract: Agentic LLM assistants must repeatedly decide whether to answer from memory or to call a tool such as web search. Unnecessary searches cost latency and money; missing ones yield confident but unsupported answers. Prior work mostly measures verbalised confidence or trains new adaptive-retrieval methods, and rarely audits the search decisions that deployed products actually make. We introduce a benchmark of 400 multiple-choice questions that combines widely known inside-knowledge (IK) questions, which should be answered directly, with outside-knowledge (OK) questions about facts from news published after the models' training cut-offs (to our knowledge), which should trigger search or, without tools, abstention. Each item offers an abstain option, and two action-level scores, NAS and KIS, reward searching on OK questions and restraint on IK questions. Across five commercial LLMs with and without their vendors' web search, GPT-5 mini and Grok 4 Fast search on over 90% of OK but only 1% of IK questions, whereas Mistral Small searches on just 20% of OK questions, often abstaining instead of using its tool; one product's search indicator proved unusable. Searching is partly triggered by explicit temporal cues: on uncued OK questions, the NAS of the two selective models falls from about 0.72 to 0.57--0.58. The scores thus measure the search triggering of specific products, not metacognition in a strict sense.

title: MotorSense: A Video-EMG Dataset of Motoric Representations for Action Understanding
authors: Eadom Dessalene, Michael Maynord, Amir-Hossein Shahidzadeh, Botao He, Yasamin Tabatabaee, Ruoshi Liu, Ruohan Gao, Paul Pu Liang, Yiannis Aloimonos
abstract: Computer vision models learn hand action only from its visual consequences, without access to the underlying embodied motor signals. We address this absence with MotorSense, the first large-scale paired egocentric video and surface electromyography (EMG) dataset. MotorSense pairs bimanual EMG bands with egocentric video and yields synchronized video, bimanual EMG and IMU, and audio across 100 hours of unscripted manipulation. EMG offers a powerful scalable alternative to manual annotation: it captures finger movement, hand configuration, and the forces exerted between hand and environment as a dense signal free of occlusion and labeler bias, whereas manual annotation is costly, subjective, and unreliable under occlusion. We use MotorSense to learn sensorimotor alignment, producing an organization of action that is shared across the visual and motoric spaces, through cross-modal pre-training between video and EMG. The resultant vision models are then transferred to downstream tasks that benefit from sensorimotor alignment: in this case, action recognition, 3D hand reconstruction, and 3D contact reconstruction. We further demonstrate a generative application in which EMG motor signals are used to condition a video diffusion model, yielding videos of fine-grained hand manipulation. Across four action-centric computer vision tasks and eight popular video datasets, we demonstrate that sensorimotor alignment provides a stronger foundation for visual representation learning than conventional self-supervised learning methods over video, outperforming every baseline across all tasks and datasets evaluated.

title: When Should AI Agents Ask? Clarification Requests Under Limited Human Attention
authors: Hanzhao Wang, Shengjie Liu, Zhengchao Wang
abstract: AI agents increasingly carry out delegated tasks in parallel, with one person overseeing several of them at once. In practice, an agent often lacks information its task requires, such as an unstated preference, constraint, or specification. It can ask the human to clarify, or it can search for the information itself, for example in past records, which takes time and effort and may fail. In this paper, we study how to coordinate these decisions across several agents that share one human with limited attention. We build a stylized model in which each agent can search, ask, or continue the parts of its task that do not depend on the missing information, and we formulate the problem as a dynamic program. We first show that whether an agent should ask depends on more than its own uncertainty: an agent with other work to do can be better off asking earlier, and which question the human should answer first depends on all waiting questions, so no ranking computed agent by agent is optimal. We then propose the Pairwise Coordination Policy (PCP), which uses exact one- and two-task problems to estimate how pairs of tasks delay each other when they share the human. Theoretically, PCP is exactly optimal when at most two requirements remain unresolved and costs at most twice the optimum when every unresolved requirement must be resolved by the human. We evaluate PCP on 864 synthetic cases and in a case study with LLM agents. On the synthetic benchmark, PCP's mean gap to optimal cost is 0.07%, and it reduces cost by an average of 18-31% relative to three standard rules for when to ask. In the LLM case study, agents completed every task correctly, and PCP achieved the lowest mean cost in all tested settings.

title: One Verdict Is Not Enough: Regression Testing Learned World Models and Their Test Harnesses
authors: Junyu Huo, Zihao Wan, Ziqi Mao, Gouri Ginde
abstract: Learned world models ship as software components whose model versions, preprocessing, and test harnesses change between releases. Work on model updates already counts per-sample regressions, or negative flips, that an accuracy check hides. Two problems remain: a test can pass under one configuration and fail under another, and a harness fault can produce erroneous scores and wrong verdicts without a crash. We present TetraState, a regression-testing protocol for paired possible/impossible video tests. Each test runs under four fixed model-native configurations; its number of correct verdicts assigns one of four outcome classes. Inconclusive tests and failed executions are reported separately alongside the verdict rate. Revisions are compared by per-test outcome transitions, and the harness is versioned as part of the system under test. On all 506 IntPhys 2 Main tests and two heterogeneous systems, Cosmos 3 Nano and V-JEPA 2, two V-JEPA 2 harness revisions move modal accuracy by only 0.2 and 2.6 points yet change 11 and 214 test labels; in the second, accuracy rises although fewer tests are judged correctly, and 43 regressions keep the modal verdict, so a modal-verdict flip check misses them. These results outline a research agenda on configuration-level regression oracles for learned components.

title: The Competitive Ratio of Online Budgeted Allocation is Strictly Smaller than $1-1/e$
authors: Debmalya Panigrahi, Ian Zhang
abstract: A well-known conjecture in online algorithms is that the (randomized) competitive ratio of online budgeted allocation is $1-1/e$. We refute this conjecture and show that every randomized online algorithm has competitive ratio at most $1 - 1/e - \varepsilon$ for a (small) absolute constant $\varepsilon > 0$.

title: CompoSET: A Controlled Single-Edit Benchmark for Vision-Language Compositionality
authors: Laure Delisle, Pietro Perona
abstract: Vision-language compositionality is the ability to identify which properties, relations, quantities, and states bind to which entities in both an image and a caption, and to match those bindings across modalities. Existing benchmarks evaluate this ability through image-text matching: a model ranks candidate image-caption match similarities and succeeds when the correct match comes on top. In such datasets, paired images differ by more than a single binding: scene, layout, and content all differ, with 97% of pixels changing on average. Such pairs do not isolate compositionality: results are confounded by global image differences. We introduce Compositional Single-EdiT (CompoSET), a benchmark dataset in which each base image-caption pair has an edited counterpart, or foil, that preserves the scene but differs by a single controlled edit, such as color, count, spatial relation, or object state. Base and foil images preserve naturalistic scene complexity yet are visually near-identical: only 8% of pixels change on average. Our dataset has many foils per base scene (~22) in order to separate scene difficulty from edit difficulty, a distinction one-foil-per-base benchmarks cannot make. CompoSET contains 1,776 instances across 80 naturalistic scenes, spanning 16 edit types in 4 semantic categories, with captions at 3 verbosity levels. We test 22 dual-encoder VLMs and find that all models perform at or below chance level on CompoSET, despite scoring well on prior benchmarks. This suggests that apparent progress under prior image-text matching protocols may be an artifact arising from confounds in benchmark design, and that compositional understanding in dual-encoder VLMs is far from solved. CompoSET addresses the confounds and offers a better controlled benchmark to measure future progress.
comment: Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/CompoSET/CompoSET | Code: https://github.com/laure-delisle/CompoSET | 9 pages main text, 38 pages total
zh_title: CompoSET：用于视觉-语言组合性的受控单一编辑基准
translation: 视觉-语言组合性是指在图像和标题中识别哪些属性、关系、数量和状态绑定到哪些实体，并跨模态匹配这些绑定的能力。现有的基准通过图像-文本匹配来评估这种能力：模型对候选的图文匹配相似度进行排序，当正确的匹配排在首位时即为成功。在此类数据集中，配对的图像不仅仅是一个绑定的差异：场景、布局和内容都有所不同，平均97%的像素会发生改变。这样的配对无法隔离组合性：结果被全局图像的差异所混淆。我们引入了Compositional Single-EdiT (CompoSET)，这是一个基准数据集，其中每个基础图文-标题对都有一个经过编辑的对应副本（foil），它保留了场景但仅通过单一的受控编辑（如颜色、数量、空间关系或对象状态）而有所不同。基础图像和foil图像保留了自然场景的复杂性，但在视觉上几乎完全相同：平均只有8%的像素发生变化。我们的数据集每个基础场景有多个foil（约22个），以便将场景难度与编辑难度区分开来，这是每个基础场景只有一个foil的基准所无法做到的。CompoSET在80个自然场景中包含1,776个实例，跨越4个语义类别中的16种编辑类型，标题具有3种冗长级别。我们测试了22个双编码器VLM，发现所有模型在CompoSET上的表现都在随机水平或以下，尽管它们在先前的基准上得分很高。这表明在先前的图像-文本匹配协议下表现出的表面进展可能是由基准设计中的混淆所产生的伪影，并且双编码器VLM中的组合理解远未解决。CompoSET解决了这些混淆，并提供了一个控制得更好的基准来衡量未来的进展。
tldr: 为了解决现有视觉-语言基准测试中存在的全局图像差异混淆，本文提出了CompoSET（一个控制单一编辑的基准），并发现当前所有主流的双编码器VLM在此基准上表现均不佳。

title: When Disclosure Is Compulsory: Evaluating Ride-Hailing Rebalancing Policies with Self-Interested LLM Driver Agents
authors: Xinyu Wang, Andres Fielbaum
abstract: The EU Platform Work Directive, to be transposed by December 2026, requires ride-hailing platforms to state in plain language the main parameters of their automated decisions and how a worker's behaviour affects them. Such rules are exactly what a large language model (LLM) can read, so drivers will be able to let one decide for them. We compare two main families of rebalancing policy once their rules are public: a reactive policy (R) that sends idle drivers to cover requests just lost, and an anticipatory policy (A) that plans moves on a demand forecast. Each driver is an LLM agent maximizing its own net income, given no rules (N) or the rules at the directive's level of detail (L). We test two LLMs, Claude Haiku 5.5 and Jev, which understand the rules equally well, in a three-zone model and in Manhattan. With the rules disclosed, drivers follow the platform more closely: in Manhattan, the share of relocation offers they decline falls from about four in five to one in four under both policies. Yet the effects differ by policy. For the platform, disclosure costs R 3.7% of its profit in Manhattan, as R now pays for moves drivers used to make for free, while A's profit is unchanged; the two policies, which tie on profit under full compliance, end 6.1% apart. For drivers, disclosure raises income in the small model under both policies and LLMs; for users, it raises the service rate there by 10 to 18 percentage points. In Manhattan, self-interested drivers also make A a win-win-win against full compliance, raising driver income, platform profit and service rate by 10 to 12% each. Rebalancing policies that perform equally well under full compliance can thus show opposite results under mandatory disclosure. The study offers a framework to evaluate such policies under the new requirement and is, to our knowledge, the first to do so with LLM agents.

title: Language Non-Invariance in the Ideological Evaluation of Large Language Models
authors: Eduardo Levy Yeyati, César Ciappa, Milagros Onofri
abstract: Recent multilingual studies show that political evaluations of large language models (LLMs) can vary across languages. This paper examines how robust this non-invariance is to questionnaire translation, surface wording, stochastic model variation, and instrument choice, and how much it matters for cross-model comparison. Using the Political Compass, the analysis compares the positions of five LLMs, GPT-3.5, GPT-4o, GPT-5.2, Qwen-2.5, and Mistral Large, on its economic and social axes in English, Spanish, and French, with repeated stochastic draws. Additional exercises use independent Spanish and French translations, paraphrased versions in all three languages, and an alternative ideological instrument. Measured ideological positions are not language-invariant: relative to English, between four and five of the ten pairwise model rankings reverse in Spanish or French, depending on the language and axis. The broad cross-language pattern persists under independent translations, indicating that it is not solely an artifact of the official questionnaire versions. Yet the magnitude of particular shifts, and in some cases their sign, remains sensitive to wording and instrument choice. The evidence therefore supports a measurement interpretation: ideological audits recover language- and instrument-conditioned outcomes rather than a language-free political attribute. Because a single provider serves distinct linguistic constituencies through a common product, without users observing what other constituencies receive, this lack of comparability also bears on political accountability and cross-model comparisons.

title: TalentRL: Strategy-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Hierarchical Skill Routing
authors: Huancheng Chen, Xiaodi Sun, Zhaoqiong Huang, Michelle Chang, Jingwen Lu
abstract: Natural-language skills enable large language model (LLM) agents to reuse procedures across tasks, yet most systems retrieve individual skills from a flat SkillBank without explicitly modeling the high-level strategy that governs their selection and use. We introduce TalentRL, a strategy-guided reinforcement learning framework for hierarchical routing over procedural memory. Coarse-grained talents represent recurring strategies for skill use, while fine-grained skills provide executable procedures. For each task, the policy model selects a talent that guides execution and softly prioritizes its associated skills during similarity-based retrieval. However, since task outcomes depend jointly on talent selection, retrieved skill context, and downstream execution, terminal rewards alone cannot isolate the contribution of the routing decision. TalentRL therefore trains talent routing with reward contrasts between rollouts of the same task under matched interventions on the talent-conditioned context, and optimizes downstream execution with group-relative advantages. Across seven open-domain and multi-hop question-answering benchmarks, talent-aware supervised fine-tuning improves average success rate by 7.53%, 6.71%, and 9.21% over the corresponding zero-shot baselines for Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B, respectively. Reinforcement learning further improves these SFT checkpoints by 7.58% to 9.32%, and TalentRL achieves the highest average success rate among all compared methods on all three backbones. On the agentic benchmarks ALFWorld and WebShop, TalentRL achieves the highest ALFWorld success rate (99.3%) and the highest WebShop score (90.7) among all compared methods.

title: ZenKO: Guided and Iterative Quantum-Classical Method for Molecular Electronic Structure using Sample-Based Quantum Diagonalization
authors: Aditya Ranjan, Devesh Tiwari
abstract: The electronic structure of molecules is foundational for scientific advancement, however determining it remains challenging due to the growth of the molecular Hilbert space with system size. Recent approaches address this by using quantum circuits to sample candidate configurations and sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD) to compute the ground state. We propose ZenKO, a novel gradient-based, iterative SQD method that employs a hybrid quantum-classical approach. ZenKO decomposes configuration selection into discovery, validation, and refinement, enabling targeted subspace expansion and guided exploration. Our evaluation demonstrates that, across $H_2O$, $H_{10}$, and $N_2$ molecules, ZenKO improves ground-state accuracy compared to prior iterative methods, while significantly reducing classical cost.

title: On the Communication-Sensing Tradeoff in DMT-Optimal Space-time-Coded ISAC Systems
authors: Wei-Chen Chen, Yu-Chih Huang, Ming-Chun Lee
abstract: Integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) has been extensively studied from the perspective of communication-sensing performance tradeoffs. In MIMO communication systems, the diversity-multiplexing tradeoff (DMT) fundamentally characterizes the tradeoff between communication reliability and multiplexing gain, and DMT-optimal space-time codes achieve this optimal tradeoff without instantaneous channel state information at the transmitter (CSIT), making them particularly attractive for ISAC scenarios where accurate CSIT is difficult to acquire or maintain. In this work, we propose an analytical framework for characterizing the sensing behavior and communication-sensing gain tradeoff of DMT-optimal space-time codes in ISAC systems. Under a single-target detection model, we propose the sensing diversity order as the high-SNR sensing reliability metric. We further show that a class of DMT-optimal space-time codes, exemplified by Perfect codes, eliminates sensing blind spots for all nonzero codewords, thereby achieving joint DMT-sensing-diversity (DMTS) optimality. Furthermore, using the Perfect code as a representative DMT-optimal construction, we show that its isotropic average transmit covariance limits the achievable sensing gain when the target angular region is narrow. We therefore develop a full-rank spatial precoding framework and a low-complexity surrogate precoder that preserve joint DMTS optimality while shaping the transmit beampattern. Simulation results show that, for a target angular region of $θ\in[-π/10,π/10]$, the proposed design achieves approximately 3 dB sensing-gain improvement over the unprecoded Perfect code.

title: HyperRepair: Recovering Forgotten General Capabilities of Fine-Tuned Language Models
