title: AC-SMPC: Differentiable Actor--Critic MPC with State Constraints for Safe and Fast Robot Navigation
authors: Chaoran Wu, Jiayu Fan, Qichen Tan, Yuyi Liu, Jin Wang
abstract: Achieving safe navigation in confined dynamic environments remains a challenging problem, as robots must balance navigation efficiency with safety. Existing actor--critic MPC architectures typically employ differentiable MPC layers, but this way cannot readily accommodate explicit state constraints, making it intractable to involve collision avoidance within learning-based planning. To address this issue, we propose an actor--critic model predictive control framework with state constraints. We first use vertices to represent the robot and obstacles, and half-spaces to represent the workspace. Based on these, the nonlinear robot dynamics is locally linearized and the hyperplane-based collision avoidance constraints are convexified into the differentiable MPC layer, and then the actor exploits closed-loop feedback to adjust the MPC objective parameters that shape local motion behavior, while the critic evaluates long-term task performance. We further relax the convexified constraints with bounded and penalized slack variables to form an elastic quadratic program, accommodating cases where the local constraint approximations cannot be satisfied simultaneously. Simulation tests and experiments, involving dynamic collision avoidance for multi-robot in narrow cases, illustrate the advantages of the proposed framework in adaptively adjusting the learned policy and improving navigation efficiency over existing approaches while maintaining the motion safety.

title: KV-Cache Patching: Tracing How and Where Fine-Tuned Behaviors Arise
authors: Jonas Loos, Oliver Eberle
abstract: Fine-tuning a language model changes how it responds, but where is this fine-tuned behavior instantiated? To better understand this, we evaluate whether the change in model behavior arises only during the generation of the answer tokens where the change manifests, or whether altered processing of previous tokens causes it via the attention mechanism. For this, we patch the KV cache from a LoRA fine-tuned model into the unmodified base model, and vice versa. Our results show that for some behaviors, like responding in German or emergent misalignment, patching the KV cache can indeed transfer them from the fine-tuned to the base model. Correspondingly, patching the KV cache from base to fine-tune can partially or fully remove fine-tuned behavior. Furthermore, we find that the effect of patching grows with how much of the KV cache is patched and concentrates at a few pivotal positions, with system-prompt and chat-template tokens having disproportionate influence.
comment: Interpretability as a Science Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://jonasloos.github.io/kv-patching

title: Spectral Haar Binarizer: Compact Boolean Contrast Representations for Hyperspectral Classification
authors: Michał Romaszewski, Przemysław Głomb
abstract: Tsetlin Machines offer an interpretable, hardware-friendly alternative to conventional machine learning models, but applying them to continuous hyperspectral measurements requires converting spectral signals into Boolean representations. Standard binarisation methods typically discretise each spectral band independently, potentially discarding important relationships between neighbouring wavelengths. In this paper, we introduce the Spectral Haar Binarizer (SHB), a contrast-based spectral representation method that constructs Boolean predicates from differences between selected spectral intervals. Inspired by Haar-like contrast features, the method uses an AdaBoost-style selection procedure to obtain a compact set of discriminative spectral predicates. We evaluate SHB on five heterogeneous hyperspectral datasets covering forensic blood detection, agricultural and urban remote sensing, and rainforest tree-species classification. Across binary and multiclass tasks, SHB consistently outperforms standard per-band binarisation strategies and provides the strongest or near-strongest results across classifiers. In binary tasks, TM-SHB achieves the best average performance, while RF-SHB is strongest in multiclass settings. Bayesian and rank-based analyses confirm that SHB's advantage is robust across datasets and not driven by isolated cases. The results show that representing continuous hyperspectral measurements is a central processing step for efficient classification. That contrast-based Boolean features provide an effective bridge between information-rich sensor measurements and compact, logic-based processing.

title: KEEPER: Learning Control-Sufficient Textual Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
authors: Jinkyeong Choi, Chaebin Jeong, Junsung Jeon, Donghyeon Park
abstract: Recursive textual memory can carry earlier errors into later updates, yet task performance alone does not establish memory reliability. We define self-consistency bias as the persistence of incorrect claims already present in the incoming memory. We present KEEPER, a comparative analysis of four auxiliary objectives along information-content and update-sensitivity axes within a shared recursive interface, examining how supervision targets relate to agent performance. Among evaluated conditions, reward-related prediction achieve the highest task performance before and after offline reinforcement learning, outperforming joint supervision. A claim-level analysis of one baseline trajectory documents error persistence despite corrective observations. Together, these analyses motivate evaluating error persistence and valid-information retention alongside task outcomes.

title: A well-balanced path-conservative discontinuous Galerkin method with generalized hydrostatic reconstruction for non-conservative balance laws
authors: Ruilin Fan, Yinhua Xia, Yan Xu
abstract: We propose a high-order well-balanced path-conservative discontinuous Galerkin method for one-dimensional balance laws with non-conservative products. Generalized hydrostatic reconstruction at cell interfaces couples effective numerical fluxes with Dal Maso-LeFloch-Murat path integrals, while a cellwise reference-equilibrium decomposition cancels projection-induced residuals in the volume discretization. Under explicit assumptions on equilibrium recovery, admissibility, paths, and boundary data, the spatial discretization is path conservative, and prescribed rest and moving equilibria are exactly preserved by both the semi-discrete scheme and its fully discrete SSP-RK approximation. The framework is applied to the two-layer shallow water equations and a blood-flow model with spatially varying vessel properties. Numerical experiments confirm the designed order of accuracy and round-off-level preservation of smooth and discontinuous equilibria, demonstrate accurate resolution of small perturbations, and show that the interface treatment captures shocks and stationary material contacts without visible spurious oscillations.

title: Improved Approximation Guarantees for Periodic-Review Stochastic Inventory Control
authors: Danny Segev
abstract:
In periodic-review stochastic inventory control, replenishment policies must balance holding and backlogging costs while responding to uncertain demands and evolving forecasts that may be arbitrarily correlated and nonstationary. In this general information setting, Levi, P{á}l, Roundy, and Shmoys (Mathematics of Operations Research 2007) established that the fully adaptive optimum can be approximated within factor $2$, which had remained the best-known performance guarantee since then. Their marginal cost accounting and dual-balancing framework made this comparison possible without computing optimal decisions across future trajectories, opening a broad research program on approximation algorithms for stochastic inventory systems.
  We break this long-standing barrier for periodic-review stochastic inventory control, showing how to compete against the fully adaptive benchmark within factor $\frac{ e }{ e-1 } \approx 1.582$ while retaining general demand correlations and evolving forecasts. We attain these advances by discovering a structural connection between marginal inventory accounting and weighted stopping problems, where each unit's conditional holding charge forms a supermartingale, while postponing its order incurs a history-dependent backlog charge. To leverage the random thresholding approach of Ma and Tzamos (ICML 2023) in this context, we develop a potential-function analysis, leading to an $\frac{ e }{ e-1 }$-approximation with respect to any unit's stopping problem. Subsequently, our common-threshold policy coordinates these marginal decisions into a global replenishment policy without additional loss.

title: EvoMCP: Co-evolving MCP agents and training data
authors: Xuanang Gao, Kepeng Lin, Xinyan Shi, Yong Deng, Shuheng Shen, Changhua Meng, Xiaofeng Wu, Jie Yang, Wei Liu
abstract: Supervised fine-tuning of Model Context Protocol (MCP) agents is typically conducted on a static data distribution, which fails to adapt to the student's evolving capabilities and leaves newly exposed weaknesses insufficiently addressed. To address these challenges, we propose \method, an agent--data mutual evolution framework that enables MCP agents to improve through a closed loop of task evolution, trajectory evolution, and supervised fine-tuning. Specifically, \method\ assesses the student's established capabilities and capability gaps from rollout feedback to identify learning targets. Task evolution then translates these targets into executable tasks by adapting the instructions and observable environment states of compatible verified seed tasks while keeping their verifiers aligned. To provide reliable and efficient demonstrations for these tasks, trajectory evolution uses reusable skills to recover failed teacher rollouts and refine successful ones. The resulting task--trajectory pairs are used to fine-tune the student, while accepted tasks seed subsequent evolution. To close the loop, we re-evaluate the updated student and use its feedback to guide the next round of data evolution. Experiments on Toolathlon, MCPMark, and MCP-Atlas demonstrate consistent improvements over the initial student, yielding absolute gains of 16.5\%, 10.2\%, and 12.6\%, respectively. Project page: https://github.com/xagao/EvoMCP.

title: Sparse Text Diffusion under Dual Budgets: Context Connectivity and Expert Activation
authors: Alexandros Christoforos, Chadbourne Davis, Paul Raj
abstract: Long-context diffusion repeatedly pays for both token interaction and feed-forward computation. We formulate these costs as two separate budgets: the edges available to an attention graph and the experts activated for each token. This view connects local, dilated, and global attention with conditional expert computation without assuming that sparsity alone preserves document-level information. We specify normalized masked attention, distinguish denoising depth from sampling iterations, and derive graph and compute bounds. A reported sparse-expert configuration, denoted DualBudget, is analyzed across scientific summarization, multi-hop question answering, dialogue, and sentence-pair prediction. All supplied table measurements are retained. The length study shows gains over the listed baselines through 16K, together with measurable degradation as length increases. Ablations reveal mixed changes across the three reported scores, while the cost record indicates a 20% reduction relative to DiffuSeq under an unspecified timing convention. The analysis separates these observations from unmeasured claims about training speed, absorbing states, global coherence, and deployment memory.

title: VariaFlow: Uncertainty-Aware Flow Matching for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
authors: Arnela Hadzic, Martin Urschler, Cosmin I. Bercea
abstract: Reconstruction-based anomaly detection no longer fails at reconstruction. Generative models produce high-quality pseudo-healthy reconstructions, and the remaining difficulty is the step of scoring residuals. The residual between a scan and its reconstruction has two indistinguishable sources, genuine pathology and the anatomical variation that separates one healthy brain from another. Scoring against a single reconstruction treats both as anomalous, inflating false positives where healthy anatomy varies most while small or subtle lesions are lost in the surrounding reconstruction error. We identify the missing quantity as the predictive variance, how much a healthy reconstruction can vary at each location. We introduce VariaFlow, which estimates this variance from an ensemble of mask-guided restorations under an unconditional flow matching prior, each started from a different noise initialization, and which normalizes the residual by the resulting standard deviation. Few-step flow matching keeps the ensemble computationally affordable, and restoring at two spatial scales captures lesions of different size. Across three brain MRI datasets spanning stroke and tumor, VariaFlow is trained once on healthy anatomy and generalizes across all three, attaining the highest AUROC (0.94, 0.80, 0.78) on each and the highest AUPRC on both cross-domain datasets, exceeding the strongest baseline by 37% and 50%. Under domain shift, the same baseline drops by up to 52% in AUPRC, whereas VariaFlow stays more stable and achieves the best small-lesion Dice on all three datasets.

title: Multi-Test Nation Bias Benchmarking of LLMs with Explicit Unbiased Baselines
authors: Jonghyeon Choi, Yeonjun Choi, Beakcheol Jang
abstract: While prior work has highlighted that systematic nation-level bias in large language models (LLMs) can pose operational risks for international relations (IR) applications, many existing evaluations still lack a clearly specified unbiased reference (ground truth), limiting fully quantitative and cross-setting measurement. Using an expanded corpus of 722 official UN Security Council (UNSC) records, we measure nation-level bias with five complementary tests, thereby extending prior approaches to cover a broader set of bias expression channels: opinion ranking (WOW), association sorting (AK+-), vote simulation (PVS), opposition attribution (F-Oppose), and framing (Headliner). To enable grounded bias evaluation, we explicitly define an unbiased status for each test; in particular, for WOW and AK+- where ground truth is difficult to specify, we propose an action-based pseudo unbiased status derived from observable voting behavior to construct a quantifiable baseline. Benchmarking 4 LLMs (GPT-4o-mini, Llama 3.3-70B, Mistral-22B-Small, and Qwen3-30B) across the five permanent members of the UNSC, we find a test-agnostic macro-pattern: relative to the reference baselines defined for each test, model outputs lean toward the opposition (red) side for China and Russia and toward the supportive (blue) side for the U.K., the U.S., and France. These results underscore the need to audit IR-facing LLM deployments with grounded, multi-test benchmarks tied to explicit reference points.
comment: Published in Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics (TACL), 2026. 17 pages. Equal contribution: Jonghyeon Choi and Yeonjun Choi

title: VoxLution: Evolving Voxels for High-Fidelity 3D Scene Generation
authors: Daoyi Gao, Xinyi Zhang, Alexey Bokhovkin, Lei Li, Angela Dai
abstract: High-resolution 3D indoor scene generation is crucial for immersive applications such as virtual reality, spatial computing, and robotics simulation. We introduce VoxLution, a coarse-to-fine transformer-based approach that generates high-fidelity indoor scenes with rich details, overcoming the overly smooth geometry typical of existing generative models. First, we generate a low-resolution spatial layout; then, based on this structural information, we progressively refine the scene geometry locally in chunks. Key to our approach is formulating 3D super-resolution as a sequence modeling problem over multi-resolution sparse voxel grids. To achieve this, we introduce a training-free, resolution-invariant tokenization scheme that compactly encodes the geometric information of eight octants into a single decimal number. We formulate the transformer sequence to include multiple resolutions, allowing the coarse layout to guide the generation of fine local details. To ensure coherence across local chunks, we incorporate adjacent chunk boundary information directly into the transformer sequencing. VoxLution achieves scene generation at a finer voxel resolution than existing baselines, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks with 59.6% lower FPD and 51.1% lower FID on 3D-FRONT, and 70.5% lower FPD and 73.8% lower FID on Scannet++.

title: Altered Visual Hand Feedback in Virtual Reality: An Exploratory Study in Essential Tremor
authors: Alejandro Pascual-Valdunciel, Marcos Sacristán-Moraleda, Verónica Giménez de Béjar, Julián Benito-León, Juan Marín-Lahoz, Jaime Ibañez, Daniel Martin
abstract: Pathological tremor is the most prevalent movement disorder worldwide, characterized by involuntary muscular oscillations within a frequency of 3 to 12 Hz. Despite extensive research, the underlying mechanisms that generate and modulate tremor are not yet understood, and treatments are usually insufficient. While it is known that visual feedback is an important afferent pathway, little is known about the impact of altering the hand's visual representation on tremor expression. With the development of immersive technologies, VR poses an excellent tool to study how alterations to the representation of the hands affect tremor. In this work, we study this through two complementary experiments. In the first one, we show that a consumer-level hand-tracking system substantially attenuates tremor-band movements without preventing successful task completion. In the second one, with eight patients with essential tremor, we observe task-dependent differences in physical tremor between VR and the real world, with several patients exhibiting lower tremor-band activity in both hand kinematics and muscle oscillations, particularly during reaching tasks. Our findings represent an initial step toward validating the use of VR as an experimental tool for the research and treatment of pathological tremor, while highlighting strong user- and task-dependent effects.

title: BDNet: Fast-slow thinking is all you need
authors: Chenzhi Zheng, Zhuoran Zheng
abstract: We present BDNet, a hierarchical image-classification backbone built around fast image features and slow statistical references. Its baseline deformation operator (BDO) transforms the deviation of a feature from a stage-specific reference through a low-rank projection and a learned channel scale. Rather than computing pairwise token similarity, the branch operates directly on baseline-relative residuals with complexity linear in the token count. Each of four reference buffers accumulates detached stage statistics during training and remains frozen at inference. A four-stage pyramid with depths $(2,2,6,2)$ and widths $(96,192,384,768)$ yields a 20.70M-parameter classifier at $224\times224$ resolution. We organize an ImageNet-1K study around clean classification, eight controlled ablations, and Gaussian-noise, contrast, and brightness perturbations. The central hypothesis is that a slow reference can improve the robustness of a compact representation while retaining a simple tensor implementation. We distinguish this training-time statistical mechanism from input-dependent attention and make its linear inference behavior explicit.
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, this manuscript is an early draft

title: PCD: Predictive Coding Dynamics for Irregularly Sampled Time Series
authors: Tianrui Gou, Jiayangmei Xu, Xingzhou Zhang, Lei Sha
abstract: Dynamic systems evolve continuously over time, whereas observations in real scenarios are often sparse, irregular, and asynchronous. Accurate prediction therefore requires inferring latent state evolution between observations, as future values depend on partially observed trajectories. We propose Predictive Coding Dynamics (PCD), a residual feedback mechanism for irregular continuous dynamic models. PCD maintains previous reconstructions, predicts observed entries from them, and incorporates masked signed residuals into state recognition through an energy penalty. The mechanism is implemented with ODE-RNN and Latent ODE, supporting event-based hidden updates and latent state recognition. Experiments on forecasting and trajectory recovery tasks show that PCD improves continuous dynamic backbones under sparse and irregular sampling. The results further indicate that predictive error feedback improves latent state estimation when observations constrain the current trajectory. These results suggest that PCD provides a residual feedback framework that jointly supports trajectory generation, observation consistency checking, and state refinement in continuous-time series modeling. The source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PCD-for-paper-92F1/.
comment: 15 pages. Supplementary material (2 pages) available as an ancillary file

title: HiState: Hierarchical Prefix Cache Management for Hybrid LLM Serving in Agentic Workloads
authors: Zaifeng Pan, Lucas Wang, Xinwei Qiang, Yanbo Zhou, Chang Chen, Zhengding Hu, Yue Guan, Yufei Ding
abstract: Hybrid large language models combine full-attention and recurrent linear layers to reduce inference costs. Prefix caching can further reduce redundant computation across requests, but a recurrent checkpoint cannot recover an earlier state corresponding to a shorter prefix. Existing hybrid prefix caching systems retain checkpoints at selected boundaries to support common reuse patterns in conventional conversations. However, agent workloads modify and revisit earlier contexts, exposing reusable prefixes whose checkpoints were never saved or have already been evicted. A straightforward approach is to retain more checkpoints to reduce recomputation, but their cumulative footprint can displace reusable prefixes from other sessions and cause additional cache misses. To address these problems, we present HiState, a prefix cache management system for hybrid models serving agent workloads. Our key observation is that prefix reuse accesses all matching key-value (KV) entries but only one recurrent checkpoint, regardless of how many checkpoints are retained. This asymmetry allows HiState to retain historical checkpoints on SSD while prioritizing fast memory for KV entries: each hit retrieves only one checkpoint whose size is independent of context length. Within this hierarchy, we propose adaptive interval control to balance checkpoint storage against recomputation, and unified eviction to coordinate checkpoint sparsification with reclamation of stale trajectories. We implement HiState on top of vLLM and evaluate it on two public coding-agent trace datasets and controlled microbenchmarks. On real agent traces, HiState achieves up to 5.73x and 5.44x speedups in p99 TTFT over vLLM-Marconi and SGLang-HiCache, respectively.

title: Specification-Guided Generation for Large Language Models
authors: Alessandro Previti, Konstantinos Vandikas, Mario Alviano, Mats Carlsson, Albin Larsson Forsberg, Alexandros Nikou, Athanasios Karapantelakis, Aneta Vulgarakis
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate structured outputs, but existing constrained-decoding methods mainly enforce syntax and cannot directly enforce satisfaction of a formal specification. We introduce a neuro-symbolic, specification-guided decoding framework that combines LLM generation with symbolic reasoning. At each step, the framework refines the decoding grammar by filtering out values that cannot be extended to an output satisfying the specification. We present a forward-only variant that guarantees specification satisfaction by construction, and a backtracking variant that revises earlier feasible choices when their downstream consequences leave only values that the LLM itself judges unsuitable. The framework is model-agnostic, requires no retraining, and builds on existing grammar-constrained decoding mechanisms. Experiments on configuration and constraint-solving benchmarks show that the forward-only variant reliably produces specification-compliant outputs while reducing repeated LLM inference compared with rejection sampling and incurring modest symbolic-reasoning overhead. The backtracking variant further reduces cases in which the model is forced to select values that it has itself judged unsuitable, thereby substantially improving adherence to the LLM's stated interpretation of the prompt.

title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Transformer Encoders for Audio-Image-Symbolic Music Retrieval
authors: Eliseo Fuentes-Martinez, Antonio Hidalgo-Centeno, Jorge Calvo-Zaragoza, Antonio Javier Gallego
abstract: Score-based multimodal music retrieval requires representations that are both discriminative within each modality and compatible across audio recordings, sheet music images, and symbolic scores. This paper investigates the effectiveness of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) for adapting pretrained music encoders and examines whether modality-specific improvements translate into better multimodal representations. We compare full fine-tuning, LoRA, and QLoRA across nine pretrained audio, image, and symbolic score encoders on TriScore and the Musical Theme Dataset. Encoders are first evaluated and selected through supervised unimodal classification, using frozen-encoder linear probing as a reference. We then introduce a controlled 2x2 design crossing encoder adaptation with task-specific shared projection, comparing frozen and adapted representations before and after projection. LoRA or QLoRA is selected in 14 of 18 modality-target combinations, frequently matching or outperforming full fine-tuning while optimizing substantially fewer parameters. However, these unimodal gains do not transfer uniformly to multimodal classification. Adaptation and projection are complementary for composer classification on TriScore, largely redundant for TriScore instrument and the Musical Theme Dataset instrument and ensemble tasks, and partially interfering for composer classification on the Musical Theme Dataset. The final adapted-and-projected title representation on TriScore supports piece-level retrieval, reaching average Top-5 and Top-10 accuracies of 55.32 and 64.68, respectively. Cross-modal exclusion and neighborhood analyses further reveal strong modality-specific local structure in the projected spaces. Overall, PEFT provides an effective and computationally efficient alternative to full fine-tuning, but improved unimodal discrimination alone does not guarantee better multimodal organization.

title: Infinite ResNets are Gaussian Mean ODEs
authors: Louis-Pierre Chaintron, Lénaïc Chizat, Javier Maass
abstract: Understanding the training dynamics of deep neural networks in large-scale limits is a question both of foundational and of practical importance. Prior works have obtained such descriptions through dynamical mean field theory (DMFT), yielding a system of non-Markovian dynamics that are challenging to analyze and that obscure the optimization structure of the original dynamics. In this paper, we obtain instead a simple description of the large-scale limit training dynamics for ResNets in standard shape scalings and in the $1/\text{depth}$ branch scaling that allows maximal (local) feature updates. For a model trained with gradient descent (GD) from a random initialization, the limit dynamics is simply GD on a Neural Mean ODE with Gaussian initial weights. Our analysis covers population or empirical risk GD in the joint limit of large width, depth and embedding, input, and output dimensions. We obtain approximation scaling laws that depend on the shape of the ResNet and the covariance spectrum of the data. We also illustrate the flexibility of our approach by discussing Mixture of Expert models, where likewise the limit admits an intuitive (nested) Mean ODE description.

title: New bounds for online coloring three-colorable graphs
authors: Yaqiao Li
abstract:
We prove new lower and upper bounds for online coloring of three-colorable graphs, improving classical bounds of Vishwanathan [FOCS'1990] that have stood for more than three decades. For the lower bound against deterministic algorithms, we improve Vishwanathan's $Ω(\log^2n)$ to \(\exp\!\bigl(Ω((\log n)^{1/3}(\log\log n)^{2/3})\bigr)\). For the upper bound of randomized algorithms, we give a randomized algorithm that achieves $O(\sqrt{n})$ improving Vishwanathan's $O(\sqrt{n \log n})$.
  Technically, for the lower bound construction, we introduce the language of $t$-fold coloring for simpler description of recursive construction, and the notion of post-degree for future control, and use the flexibility of two-sided colors of bipartite graph, constructed using the independent set amplification method of Vishwanathan, as building blocks to ensure three-colorability. The randomized algorithm integrates, in a new way, some of the ideas in offline coloring of Wigderson and Blum with ideas of Vishwanathan in the online setting, such as the degree control from Wigderson, the offline-monochromatic class from Blum, and the anchor-sampling from Vishwanathan and the CBIP algorithm by Lov{á}sz, Saks and Trotter.

title: Steiner Tree Parameterized by Multiway Cut: Single-Exponential Time and Polynomial Space
authors: Lukas Van de Voorde, Brecht Verbeken, Vincent Ginis
abstract: In the Steiner Tree problem, the goal is to find a minimum-weight tree containing a given set of terminals in an edge-weighted graph. Given a multiway cut of size $s$, we propose a deterministic algorithm running in $2^{O(s)}\operatorname{poly}(n,b)$ time and polynomial space ($n$ vertices, non-negative $b$-bit integer weights). A multiway cut for the terminals is a set of vertices whose deletion leaves at most one terminal in each connected component. This result answers a question of Jansen and Swennenhuis (ESA 2024). Building on their component decomposition, we show that it suffices to connect the selected cut vertices together with $O(s)$ additional terminals and attach the remaining terminals by shortest paths. We use colour coding to optimize over the choice of these additional terminals.

title: Enhancing Sentiment Classification on Small Datasets through Data Augmentation and Transfer Learning
authors: Mahmoud S. Mayaleh, Samer A. Mayaleh
abstract: Small-scale sentiment classification often suffers from data scarcity, which limits the generalization ability of the models. This study evaluates and compares the effectiveness of three data augmentation strategies: Easy Data Augmentation (EDA), back-translation, and contextual token substitution (nlpaug-style), with both traditional machine learning classifiers (Logistic Regression, Random Forest) and transformer-based models (BERT). We perform a comprehensive empirical comparison with low-resource sentiment datasets by summarizing the results of recent studies and performing targeted head-to-head experiments. Our findings indicate that all augmentation methods improve performance. Contextual augmentation yields the most consistent gains for BERT models, while EDA and back-translation provide greater benefits for traditional classifiers. These insights help guide the selection of data augmentation techniques tailored to model type and dataset size, filling a critical gap in research on data augmentation for sentiment classification on small datasets.

title: KITE: Retrieval as a Decision Procedure for Long-Term Conversational Memory
authors: Feng Li, Kailun Tan, Zhibo Zhou, Youxiang Wang, Lejun Liu, Huaigu Li, Fei Du, Huilong An
abstract: Many long-term memory systems for LLM agents are built around embedding-based retrieval. Al- though effective for semantic matching, similarity ranking alone does not establish whether re- trieved memories satisfy the conditions implied by a question. In this paper, we introduce KITE (Knowledge-Indexed Temporal Evidence), a vector-free framework that formulates memory re- trieval as an explicit decision procedure. KITE organizes multi-session conversations as structured knowledge indexed by a governed topic vocabulary, which evolves through controlled expansion and consolidation. At query time, questions are compiled into inspectable retrieval plans over the same knowledge index that guides memory construction. The plans are then executed through fixed lookup and ranking operations, while sparse lexical retrieval recovers surface details omitted from the structured representation. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S show that KITE achieves 93.5% and 86.0% accuracy while using only about 1.6k reader-context tokens per ques- tion. These results demonstrate that conversational memory can move beyond similarity ranking by unifying memory construction and query compilation around a governed index, turning retrieval into an inspectable decision procedure for determining which evidence satisfies the question.
zh_title: KITE：将检索作为长期对话记忆决策程序的框架
translation: 许多大语言模型（LLM）智能体的长期记忆系统都建立在基于嵌入的检索之上。尽管这在语义匹配方面很有效，但仅凭相似度排序并不能确定检索到的记忆是否满足问题所隐含的条件。在本文中，我们提出了KITE（基于知识索引的时序证据），这是一个无向量框架，将记忆检索形式化为明确的决策过程。KITE将多会话对话组织为由受控主题词表索引的结构化知识，该词表通过受控扩展和整合不断演进。在查询时，问题会被编译为在指导记忆构建的同一知识索引上的可检查检索计划。随后，这些计划通过固定的查找和排序操作来执行，同时利用稀疏词汇检索来恢复结构化表示中遗漏的表面细节。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上的实验表明，KITE在每个问题仅使用约1.6k个读取上下文标记的情况下，分别达到了93.5%和86.0%的准确率。这些结果表明，通过围绕受控索引统一记忆构建和查询编译，对话记忆可以超越相似度排序，将检索转变为用于确定哪些证据满足问题的可检查决策过程。
tldr: KITE提出了一种无向量的长期对话记忆检索框架，通过将记忆构建与查询编译统一为基于受控索引的可检查决策过程，以超低Token开销实现了高准确率。
ai_comments: 该工作创新性地摒弃了主流的稠密向量嵌入检索范式，转而将记忆检索建模为可解释、可验证的程序化决策过程。其最大亮点在于将记忆构建与查询编译在统一的受控索引下对齐，不仅逻辑可解释性强，而且在仅消耗约1.6k token的极低开销下取得了优异性能。潜在局限可能在于受控主题词表的演化与整合质量对LLM的结构化解析能力依赖较高。
motivation: 现有LLM智能体的长期记忆系统大多依赖基于向量嵌入的相似度检索，但单纯的相似度排序无法严格验证检索到的记忆是否满足问题所隐含的具体约束与条件。
method: 提出无向量的KITE框架：1. 将多轮对话组织为由受控主题词表索引的结构化知识，并通过受控扩展与整合进行演化；2. 查询时将问题编译为针对该知识索引的可检查检索计划；3. 通过固定的查找和排序操作执行检索计划，并辅以稀疏词汇检索补充结构化表示中遗漏的表面细节。
results: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S基准测试中，KITE分别取得了93.5%和86.0%的准确率，且每个问题仅使用约1.6k个读取上下文tokens。
conclusion: 研究表明，通过将记忆构建与查询编译统一在受控索引周围，长期对话记忆检索可以超越单纯的相似度排序，转化为一种明确且可检查的证据满足性决策过程。

title: Koopman Greedy Spiking Control for Nonlinear Systems under Firing-Rate Limits
authors: Nader Meskin
abstract: Neuromorphic controllers interact with physical systems through fixed-amplitude spikes whose timing conveys control information. Existing Lyapunov-based greedy spiking controllers guarantee stability but are restricted to linear systems and neglect firing-rate limits. We extend greedy spiking control to nonlinear systems using Koopman operator theory. For observable dictionaries invariant under differentiation along the input direction, spike-induced state translations admit an exact linear representation in lifted coordinates, enabling exact modeling of spiking jump dynamics. This allows firing decisions to be formulated as comparisons of quadratic Lyapunov functions in the lifted space. We prove practical stability of a clocked, rate-limited controller with an explicit ultimate bound and develop a data-driven design based on Koopman eigenfunctions learned from unforced data by generator-based regression. The weights of the Lyapunov function are synthesized by a linear program that enforces a sampled relaxation of the rate-limited control-Lyapunov condition. Applied to an inverted pendulum, the learned eigenfunctions recover the system energy, and the proposed controller achieves swing-up and stabilization from nearly all initial conditions despite severe actuation limits.
zh_title: 面向限放电率非线性系统的Koopman贪婪脉冲控制
translation: 神经形态控制器通过固定幅度的脉冲与物理系统交互，脉冲的时序传递控制信息。现有的基于Lyapunov的贪婪脉冲控制器能够保证稳定性，但仅限于线性系统，并忽略了放电率限制。我们利用Koopman算子理论将贪婪脉冲控制扩展到非线性系统。对于在输入方向上微分不变的可观测字典，脉冲诱导的状态转换在提升坐标中具有精确的线性表示，从而能够精确建模脉冲跳跃动力学。这使得放电决策可以被公式化为提升空间中二次Lyapunov函数的比较。我们证明了带有时钟、限放电率控制器的实际稳定性，并具有明确的最终界限，并开发了一种基于Koopman特征函数的学习驱动设计，这些特征函数通过生成器回归从无力数据中学习。Lyapunov函数的权重通过一个强制执行限放电率控制-Lyapunov条件采样松弛的线性规划来合成。应用于倒立摆时，学习到的特征函数恢复了系统能量，并且尽管存在严重的执行限制，所提出的控制器仍能从几乎所有初始条件实现摆起和稳定。
tldr: 该研究将贪婪脉冲控制扩展到非线性系统，通过Koopman算子理论克服了现有方法的局限性，并考虑了放电率限制，实现了实际稳定性。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于，通过将Koopman算子理论与基于Lyapunov的贪婪控制相结合，优雅地将脉冲控制扩展到非线性系统，并明确解决了放电率限制等实际约束。用于学习Koopman特征函数的数据驱动方法进一步增强了其适用性。在倒立摆上展示的成功突出了其在实际神经形态控制应用中的潜力。
motivation: 现有的基于Lyapunov的贪婪脉冲控制器虽然能保证稳定性，但仅限于线性系统，并且忽略了神经形态控制器中关键的放电率限制。
method: 该论文利用Koopman算子理论将贪婪脉冲控制扩展到非线性系统。通过在提升坐标中实现脉冲诱导状态转换的精确线性表示，从而精确建模脉冲跳跃动力学。放电决策被表述为提升空间中二次Lyapunov函数的比较。文章证明了带有时钟、限放电率控制器的实际稳定性，并提出了基于Koopman特征函数的学习驱动设计，这些特征函数通过生成器回归从无力数据中学习。Lyapunov函数权重通过一个强制执行限放电率控制-Lyapunov条件采样松弛的线性规划来合成。
results: 所提出的控制器实现了时钟式、限放电率控制器的实际稳定性，并具有明确的最终界限。在倒立摆上的应用表明，学习到的特征函数能够恢复系统能量，并且尽管存在严重的执行限制，该控制器仍能从几乎所有初始条件实现摆起和稳定。
conclusion: 该论文成功开发了一种针对限放电率非线性系统的Koopman贪婪脉冲控制器，证明了其在实现实际稳定性和鲁棒控制（如倒立摆的摆起和稳定）方面的有效性，即使在存在显著执行约束的情况下。

title: MemX: Memory-Aware Automatic Parallelism for Cross-Vendor Heterogeneous GPU Training
authors: Lin Meng, Yuzhong Sun, Jie Zhu
abstract: Cross-vendor heterogeneous GPU clusters are increasingly used for large-scale model training. However, their GPUs differ substantially in compute power, memory capacity, and interconnect characteristics. Existing automatic parallelism training systems usually minimize iteration time while treating memory as a hard constraint, almost failing in resolving the compute--memory asymmetry of cross-vendor clusters regardless correlation between memory and throughput. In this paper, we present MemX, a new memory-aware automatic parallelism system that jointly optimizes iteration time, peak memory usage, and cross-GPU memory balance. MemX consists of a weighted-product objective function, heterogeneous recomputation strategies, a minimal-set profiler, interpolation-based data augmentation, a dual-output XGBoost predictor, and a hash-signature prediction cache, in order to accelerate search of large-scale auto-parallel best configurations at lower cost. We implement MemX on Megatron-LM and evaluate it against four automatic parallelism baselines on two heterogeneous clusters. MemX achieves the lowest prediction Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 12.17% and is the only method that identifies the real Top-1 configuration under both time-based and memory-balance rankings. In terms of search cost and search space, MemX searches 31,240 configurations in 26.5 seconds, while an end-to-end profiling baseline is extrapolated to require about 17 days at the same scale. The simulation study that extends the measured 20-GPU data to 40-GPU and 60-GPU clusters further illustrates the effectiveness of MemX at larger scales.
zh_title: MemX：面向跨厂商异构GPU训练的显存感知自动并行系统
translation: 跨厂商异构GPU集群正越来越多地用于大规模模型训练。然而，这些GPU在计算能力、显存容量和互连特性方面存在显著差异。现有的自动并行训练系统通常将显存作为硬约束来最小化迭代时间，几乎无法解决跨厂商集群的算力-显存不对称性，也没有考虑显存与吞吐量之间的相关性。在本文中，我们提出了MemX，一种全新的内存感知自动并行系统，可联合优化迭代时间、峰值显存占用和跨GPU显存均衡。MemX由加权积目标函数、异构重计算策略、最小集性能分析器、基于插值的数据增强、双输出XGBoost预测器和哈希签名预测缓存组成，旨在以更低的成本加速大规模自动并行最优配置的搜索。我们在Megatron-LM上实现了MemX，并在两个异构集群上针对四个自动并行基线进行了评估。MemX实现了最低的12.17%预测平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE），并且是唯一在基于时间的排名和显存平衡排名下均识别出真实Top-1配置的方法。在搜索成本和搜索空间方面，MemX在26.5秒内搜索了31,240种配置，而端到端性能分析基线在相同规模下推断需要大约17天。将实测的20-GPU数据扩展到40-GPU和60-GPU集群的仿真研究进一步证明了MemX在更大规模下的有效性。
tldr: MemX是一种面向跨厂商异构GPU大模型训练的显存感知自动并行系统，通过联合优化迭代时间与显存均衡，以极低的时间成本高精度搜索出最优并行配置。
ai_comments: 该论文聚焦于当前大模型训练中非常实际且具有挑战性的跨厂商异构GPU集群场景。其创新点在于突破了传统自动并行仅将显存作为硬约束的局限，提出了将计算时间与显存平衡协同优化的思路，并设计了轻量级预测框架，将超大搜索空间的遍历耗时从数天级压缩到秒级，工程实用价值和扩展潜力显著。
motivation: 跨厂商异构GPU在算力、显存容量和互连特性上存在显著差异，而现有自动并行系统通常只最小化迭代时间并将显存作为硬约束，无法有效解决算力-显存的不对称性，也忽视了显存与吞吐量之间的内在关联。
method: MemX联合优化迭代时间、峰值显存使用和跨GPU显存均衡；其核心组件包括加权积目标函数、异构重计算策略、最小集性能分析器（minimal-set profiler）、基于插值的数据增强、双输出XGBoost预测器以及哈希签名预测缓存。
results: 在Megatron-LM及两个异构集群上的评测显示，MemX实现了12.17%的最低预测MAPE，是唯一在时间与显存均衡指标下均找到真实Top-1配置的方法；仅耗时26.5秒完成31,240种配置的搜索（对比端到端分析基线需约17天）；在40/60卡仿真中亦表现出优异的可扩展性。
conclusion: MemX通过多目标联合优化和轻量化搜索预测机制，成功解决了跨厂商异构GPU集群中算力与显存的不对称难题，大幅降低了最优配置搜索开销，并展示了向更大规模集群扩展的良好有效性。

title: TACO: Trajectory-Aware Curvature Observation for Memorization Localization and Mitigation in Diffusion Models
authors: Ruxi Gu, Zilei Wang, Wei Wang
abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models can reproduce memorized training content within localized image regions, making precise localization essential for targeted mitigation. However, curvature observations at a single denoising state can contain transient responses, while spatially uniform mitigation may disrupt prompt-relevant content. We present Trajectory-Aware Curvature Observation (TACO), a unified framework for local memorization detection and mitigation in diffusion models. Our empirical analysis reveals that memorization-related curvature becomes pronounced during late-stage denoising and persists at consistent spatial locations across neighboring states. Motivated by these observations, TACO aggregates prompt-dependent curvature responses along the late denoising trajectory and applies latent-guided spatial refinement to improve spatial coherence. The resulting memorization map serves both as a localization signal and as a spatial control signal for mitigation. Specifically, TACO uses this map to steer existing inference-time interventions toward memorization-related regions through spatial reweighting and localized guidance correction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TACO consistently outperforms competing localization methods, and improves the Pareto trade-off between memorization suppression, semantic alignment, and perceptual quality. These results establish trajectory-aware spatial analysis as an effective link between memorization localization and targeted mitigation.
zh_title: TACO：用于扩散模型记忆定位与缓解的轨迹感知曲率观测
translation: 文生图扩散模型会在局部图像区域复现所记忆的训练内容，这使得精准定位对于针对性缓解至关重要。然而，单个去噪状态下的曲率观测可能包含瞬态响应，而空间均匀的缓解措施则可能破坏与提示词相关的内容。我们提出了轨迹感知曲率观测（TACO），这是一个用于扩散模型局部记忆检测与缓解的统一框架。我们的实证分析表明，与记忆相关的曲率在去噪后期变得显著，并在相邻状态的相同空间位置持续存在。受这些观察的启发，TACO沿后期去噪轨迹聚合依赖于提示词的曲率响应，并应用潜变量引导的空间细化来提高空间连贯性。由此生成的记忆图既可用作定位信号，也可用作缓解的微调空间控制信号。具体而言，TACO利用该图通过空间重加权和局部引导校正，将现有的推理期干预引导至与记忆相关的区域。大量实验表明，TACO持续优于竞品定位方法，并改善了记忆抑制、语义对齐和感知质量之间的帕累托权衡。这些结果确立了轨迹感知空间分析作为记忆定位与针对性缓解之间有效纽带的地位。
tldr: TACO通过聚合去噪后期的曲率轨迹并进行空间细化，精准定位扩散模型复现的记忆区域，并通过局部引导干预在不损失生成质量的前提下缓解记忆问题。
ai_comments: TACO创新性地挖掘了去噪后期曲率在时间轨迹上的持久性与空间一致性，克服了单步检测存在瞬态噪声的局限。通过将检测到的记忆图直接用于空间重加权与局部引导，在有效缓解记忆复制的同时最大程度保留了非记忆区域的语义与质量，为扩散模型的版权保护与安全对齐提供了精细化解决方案。
motivation: 扩散模型常在局部图像区域复现训练集的记忆内容。然而，在单一步骤去噪状态下观察曲率容易受到瞬态响应干扰，而全局均匀的缓解策略又会破坏与提示词相关的正常生成内容，因而需要精准的局部定位以实现靶向缓解。
method: 提出TACO框架，沿着去噪后期轨迹聚合依赖于提示词的曲率响应，并结合潜变量引导的空间细化来生成连贯的记忆图；进而利用该图通过空间重加权和局部引导校正来引导现有的推理期干预手段，实现对记忆区域的针对性缓解。
results: 实验表明，TACO在定位性能上显著超越现有基线方法，并在记忆抑制、语义对齐和感知质量之间取得了更优的帕累托权衡（Pareto trade-off）。
conclusion: 轨迹感知空间分析为扩散模型中记忆现象的精准定位与靶向缓解之间建立了有效联系。

title: DAPS: Dependency-Aware Premise Selection for LLM Theorem Proving
authors: Zixuan Chen, Wenyuan Jiang, Junling Wang, Mrinmaya Sachan, Yinya Huang
abstract: LLM-based theorem proving in Lean 4 has advanced rapidly, but provers are difficult to leverage newly contributed lemmas, because retrieval skews toward popular foundational lemmas, leaving the right premises buried among hundreds of thousands of candidates. Existing neural selectors rank candidates by semantic similarity, with three intrinsic limitations: frequency-skewed retrieval, isolated pairwise ranking, and degradation on out-of-distribution queries such as competition problems and informal language. Given that mathematics is structured by dependencies rather than similarities, we restore this signal to both the training data and the model. We curate two underused dependency resources. We conduct the first systematic mining of 53 Lean Blueprint projects, a previously untapped corpus of 3,805 manually curated informal+formal nodes that capture rare, research-level premises absent from Mathlib4. We further pair it with the extraction of comprehensive, typed, multi-level Mathlib4 dependencies. We then introduce DAPS, a dependency-aware premise selector with a structural neighborhood encoder, a group-level contrastive objective, and a Mathlib-then-Blueprint adaptation procedure. DAPS reaches mean Recall@32 of 89.25 on Mathlib4-Heldout (+11.41 over the strong selector LeanHammer), and maintains this lead on two out-of-distribution benchmarks. Further experiments demonstrate that DAPS premises improve theorem proving on miniF2F and IMO-ProofBench. Project page: https://daps-eth.github.io/.
zh_title: DAPS：面向LLM定理证明的依赖感知前提选择
translation: LLM在Lean 4中的定理证明发展迅速，但证明器难以利用新贡献的引理，因为检索偏向流行的基础引理，使得正确的前提被埋藏在数十万个候选词中。现有的神经选择器通过语义相似性对候选词进行排名，存在三个内在局限性：频率偏斜检索、孤立的成对排名以及在分布外查询（如竞赛问题和非正式语言）上的性能下降。鉴于数学是由依赖关系而非相似性构建的，我们将这一信号恢复到训练数据和模型中。我们整理了两个未充分利用的依赖资源。我们首次系统性地挖掘了53个Lean Blueprint项目，这是一个以前未被利用的语料库，包含3,805个手动整理的非正式+正式节点，捕获了Mathlib4中缺失的稀有、研究级前提。我们进一步将其与全面的、类型化的、多级Mathlib4依赖提取相结合。然后，我们引入了DAPS，一个依赖感知前提选择器，具有结构化邻域编码器、组级对比目标和Mathlib-then-Blueprint适应程序。DAPS在Mathlib4-Heldout上达到了89.25的平均Recall@32（比强大的选择器LeanHammer高出11.41），并在两个分布外基准上保持了这一领先优势。进一步的实验表明，DAPS的前提改进了miniF2F和IMO-ProofBench上的定理证明。项目页面：https://daps-eth.github.io/。
tldr: DAPS通过整合数学依赖信号和新的训练数据，显著提升了LLM在Lean 4定理证明中前提选择的召回率和泛化能力。
ai_comments: DAPS的创新之处在于其将数学固有的依赖结构重新引入到前提选择中，而非仅仅依赖语义相似性。通过挖掘未充分利用的Lean Blueprint项目作为稀有、研究级前提的语料库，并结合多级Mathlib4依赖，DAPS有效地解决了现有方法在处理长尾和OOD问题上的局限性。其结构化编码器和对比学习目标也提升了模型的泛化能力，对LLM驱动的定理证明领域具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有基于LLM的定理证明器难以利用新的引理，因为检索偏向常用基础引理，导致正确前提被淹没。现有神经选择器存在频率偏斜、孤立配对排名以及对OOD查询性能下降的局限性。
method: 该研究通过以下方式恢复依赖信号：1) 整理了两个未充分利用的依赖资源：系统性挖掘53个Lean Blueprint项目（包含3,805个非正式+正式节点）和提取全面的、类型化的、多级Mathlib4依赖。2) 引入DAPS，一个依赖感知前提选择器，包含结构化邻域编码器、组级对比目标和Mathlib-then-Blueprint适应程序。
results: DAPS在Mathlib4-Heldout上的平均Recall@32达到89.25（比LeanHammer提升11.41），并在两个分布外基准上保持领先。进一步实验表明，DAPS的前提改进了miniF2F和IMO-ProofBench上的定理证明。
conclusion: DAPS通过整合数学依赖信号和创新的训练及模型方法，显著提升了LLM定理证明中前提选择的准确性和泛化能力，尤其是在处理稀有和研究级前提方面。

title: Scalable Audio-LLM System for Speech MOS Evaluation: A Diagnostic Case Study and Adaptation Roadmap
authors: Dimitrios Kokkinis, Panagiotis Kakoulidis, Nikolaos Ellinas, Chrysovalanti Lymperi, Alexandra Vioni, Georgios Vardaxoglou, Iakovi Alexiou, Myrsini Christidou, Jeasung Lee, Gunu Jho, Inchul Hwang, Pirros Tsiakoulis, Aimilios Chalamandaris
abstract: The continuous deployment of enterprise voice systems creates a critical operational bottleneck: evaluating the acoustic quality of synthetic speech across high-volume production updates. While human Mean Opinion Score (MOS) remains the quality gold standard, it introduces severe operational costs and turn-around delays that make continuous integration infeasible. In this work, we present a system design case study for a scalable, low-cost and offline evaluation pipeline capable of scoring large batches of synthetic speech at marginal cost. First, we use Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct in a zero-shot setting for granular MOS estimation, noticing perceptual blind spots and inherent biases. Then, we analyze SOMOS dataset and construct a diagnostic benchmark that operationalizes two prosodic dimensions associated with human naturalness ratings. Finally, we adapt Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct through a parameter-efficient finetuning (LoRA) on the task of MOS evaluation, observing improvements over base model and widely used neural baselines like UTMOS and establishing a practical blueprint for enterprise-grade speech quality assurance.
zh_title: 可扩展的音频-LLM系统用于语音MOS评估：诊断性案例研究与适应路线图
translation: 企业语音系统的持续部署造成了一个关键的运营瓶颈：在高产量生产更新中评估合成语音的声学质量。尽管人类平均意见得分（MOS）仍然是质量的黄金标准，但它带来了严重的运营成本和周转延迟，使得持续集成变得不可行。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个可扩展、低成本、离线评估管道的系统设计案例研究，该管道能够以边际成本对大量合成语音进行评分。首先，我们使用Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct在零样本设置中进行细粒度MOS估计，注意到感知盲点和固有偏差。然后，我们分析了SOMOS数据集并构建了一个诊断基准，该基准将与人类自然度评分相关的两个韵律维度操作化。最后，我们通过参数高效微调（LoRA）在MOS评估任务上调整了Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct，观察到其相对于基础模型和UTMOS等广泛使用的神经基线有所改进，并为企业级语音质量保证建立了实用的蓝图。
tldr: 本文提出一个可扩展、低成本的音频-LLM系统，通过对Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct进行微调，用于合成语音的MOS评估，解决了人工MOS的局限性，并优于现有的神经基线。
ai_comments: 本文提出了一种创新方法，通过自动化语音质量评估来取代昂贵且耗时的人工MOS评估。利用大型语言模型（Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct）并结合诊断基准进行微调，是一种强大的研究方法。在零样本设置中识别出的“感知盲点和固有偏差”突出了针对特定任务进行精心调整的重要性。建立“企业级语音质量保证的实用蓝图”表明其在实际应用中具有显著的价值和成本节约潜力。采用参数高效微调（LoRA）也是资源受限环境下的实用选择。
motivation: 企业语音系统持续部署中评估合成语音声学质量是关键运营瓶颈。人类平均意见得分（MOS）虽然是黄金标准，但成本高昂、周转延迟严重，导致无法实现持续集成。
method: 首先，在零样本设置下使用Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct进行细粒度MOS估计，并分析其感知盲点和固有偏差。其次，分析SOMOS数据集并构建一个诊断基准，操作化与人类自然度相关的两个韵律维度。最后，通过参数高效微调（LoRA）在MOS评估任务上调整Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct。
results: 零样本设置下Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct存在感知盲点和固有偏差。经过LoRA微调后的Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct在MOS评估任务上优于基础模型和UTMOS等广泛使用的神经基线。建立了企业级语音质量保证的实用蓝图。
conclusion: 本研究提出了一个可扩展、低成本、离线的评估管道，利用经过调整的音频-LLM（Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct）进行合成语音的MOS评估，为企业语音质量保证提供了实用的解决方案，克服了人工MOS的局限性。

title: DeepWeave: Weaving Neural and Symbolic Evidence for ML-Based Network Intrusion Detection System
authors: Raoul Saad, Enkeleda Bardhi, Andrea Agiollo, Fernando Kuipers
abstract: Machine learning-based network intrusion detection systems can recognize complex traffic patterns, but often require substantial labelled attack data, degrade under deployment shift, and provide limited evidence for analysts. We present DeepWeave, a probabilistic neuro-symbolic Network Intrusion Detection System (NIDS) that makes logic an integral part of detection. DeepWeave automatically constructs and validates interpretable rules, represents neural predictions as probabilistic predicates, and reconciles both evidence sources through explicit coupling policies over packet-, flow-, and hybrid-views. The resulting proofs provide intrinsic explanations for rule-supported alerts. Across multiple datasets, DeepWeave improves low-data detection, false-positive control, transferability, and robustness. With only 50 labelled packet observations per attack class, it improves macro-F1 from 0.632 to 0.924 and reduces the attack false-positive rate from 0.075 to 0.008 over the matched neural baseline. Its proofs are also more stable than post-hoc neural attributions, while batched inference keeps probabilistic reasoning practical. These results demonstrate label-efficient, adaptable, and inspectable neuro-symbolic intrusion detection.
zh_title: DeepWeave：为基于机器学习的网络入侵检测系统编织神经与符号证据
translation: 基于机器学习的网络入侵检测系统能够识别复杂的流量模式，但通常需要大量的标记攻击数据，在部署偏移下性能会下降，并且为分析人员提供的证据有限。我们提出了DeepWeave，这是一个将逻辑作为检测不可或缺部分的概率神经符号网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）。DeepWeave能够自动构建和验证可解释的规则，将神经预测表示为概率谓词，并通过对数据包、流以及混合视图的显式耦合策略来调和这两种证据来源。由此产生的证明为规则支持的警报提供了内在的解释。在多个数据集上，DeepWeave改善了低数据下的检测、误报控制、可迁移性和鲁棒性。在每个攻击类别仅有50个标记数据包观测值的情况下，它将宏F1值从0.632提高到0.924，并将匹配的神经基线的攻击误报率从0.075降低到0.008。其证明也比事后神经归因更稳定，同时批处理推理保持了概率推理的实用性。这些结果证明了标签高效、适应性强且可检查的神经符号入侵检测。
tldr: DeepWeave结合了神经网络和符号逻辑，在仅需极少标记数据的情况下显著提升了网络入侵检测系统的准确性、鲁棒性和可解释性。
ai_comments: DeepWeave创新性地将神经网络与符号逻辑结合，有效解决了传统基于机器学习的NIDS在小样本、分布偏移和可解释性方面的痛点，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。
motivation: 基于机器学习的网络入侵检测系统虽然能识别复杂流量模式，但通常需要大量标记数据，在部署偏移下性能下降，且缺乏给分析人员的直观证据。
method: 提出了DeepWeave，一个概率神经符号网络入侵检测系统，它能自动构建和验证可解释规则，将神经网络预测表示为概率谓词，并通过显式耦合策略在数据包、流以及混合视图上调和神经与符号两类证据。
results: 在多个数据集上，DeepWeave在仅使用每个攻击类50个标记样本的情况下，将宏F1分数从0.632提升至0.924，将攻击误报率从0.075降至0.008，同时提供了比事后神经归因更稳定的证明。
conclusion: DeepWeave通过深度融合神经推理与符号逻辑，实现了标签高效、具备强鲁棒性和可解释性的网络入侵检测，是神经符号AI在安全领域应用的一个成功范例。

title: Report on Stability Analysis of Islanded Power Systems with Grid-Forming Converters
authors: Anup Joshi, Luis A. Garcia-Reyes, Qingyuan Gong, Xavier Guillaud, Javier Renedo, Dirk Van Hertem
abstract:
Islanded power systems are inherently challenging to operate due to limited interconnection, low inertia, and weak short-circuit strength. As renewable and inverter-based resources replace synchronous machines, these challenges worsen, causing faster frequency deviations, greater voltage volatility, and higher risk of instability. This report summarizes the differences between islanded and interconnected systems and reviews key stability issues in islanded grids: frequency stability, converter-driven interactions, voltage stability, large-disturbance behavior, and small-signal dynamics.
  Grid-forming (GFM) voltage source converters are a promising solution because they can establish voltage and frequency, emulate synchronous machine behavior, and provide grid strength, virtual inertia, fast frequency response, voltage regulation, and black-start capability. The report examines relevant GFM control strategies and evaluates their capabilities in weak, low-inertia islanded grids.
  Challenges remain, particularly interoperability, control coordination among multiple inverter-based resources, lack of standardized grid code requirements, and coordination of protection devices. Successful deployment requires advances in interoperability, harmonized grid codes, and grid planning that considers the unique features of islanded systems, along with clear GFM functionality requirements.
  Finally, a case study illustrates the stability-enhancing capability of GFM converters in weak grids through small-signal stability analysis. Overall, GFM technology is a key enabler of reliable, renewable-dominant island power systems, but broader adoption depends on continued technical and regulatory development.

zh_title: 含构网型变流器的孤岛电力系统稳定性分析报告
translation:
孤岛电力系统由于互联有限、惯性低和短路强度弱，操作固有挑战。随着可再生能源和基于逆变器的资源取代同步发电机，这些挑战加剧，导致更快的频率偏差、更大的电压波动和更高的不稳定风险。本报告总结了孤岛系统与互联系统之间的差异，并回顾了孤岛电网中的关键稳定性问题：频率稳定性、变流器驱动的交互、电压稳定性、大扰动行为和小信号动态。
构网型（GFM）电压源变流器是一种有前景的解决方案，因为它们能够建立电压和频率，模拟同步发电机行为，并提供电网强度、虚拟惯性、快速频率响应、电压调节和黑启动能力。本报告研究了相关的GFM控制策略，并评估了它们在弱惯量孤岛电网中的能力。
挑战依然存在，特别是互操作性、多个基于逆变器资源之间的控制协调、缺乏标准化的电网规范要求以及保护设备的协调。成功的部署需要互操作性、协调的电网规范以及考虑孤岛系统独特特征的电网规划方面的进展，以及明确的GFM功能要求。
最后，一个案例研究通过小信号稳定性分析说明了GFM变流器在弱电网中的稳定性增强能力。总的来说，GFM技术是实现可靠的、以可再生能源为主的孤岛电力系统的关键推动因素，但更广泛的采用取决于持续的技术和监管发展。
tldr: 本报告分析了孤岛电力系统在可再生能源整合后面临的稳定性挑战，并探讨了构网型变流器作为解决方案的潜力，同时指出了仍需解决的互操作性、控制协调和标准制定等问题。
ai_comments: 该报告清晰地阐述了孤岛电力系统在可再生能源转型中的关键挑战，并突出了构网型变流器作为核心解决方案的重要性。其创新点在于系统性地回顾了GFM技术的能力和面临的实际部署障碍。报告的价值在于为电力系统工程师和政策制定者提供了对未来孤岛电网发展方向的深刻见解，强调了技术进步与监管框架同步发展的重要性。
motivation: 孤岛电力系统由于互联有限、惯性低和短路强度弱，操作固有挑战。随着可再生能源和基于逆变器的资源取代同步发电机，这些挑战加剧，导致更快的频率偏差、更大的电压波动和更高的不稳定风险，因此需要研究解决方案来增强其稳定性。
method: 本报告总结了孤岛系统与互联系统之间的差异，回顾了孤岛电网中的关键稳定性问题（频率稳定性、变流器驱动的交互、电压稳定性、大扰动行为和小信号动态）。它还研究了相关的构网型（GFM）控制策略，评估了它们在弱惯量孤岛电网中的能力，并通过一个案例研究（小信号稳定性分析）说明了GFM变流器在弱电网中的稳定性增强能力。
results: 构网型（GFM）电压源变流器是一种有前景的解决方案，它们能够建立电压和频率，模拟同步发电机行为，并提供电网强度、虚拟惯性、快速频率响应、电压调节和黑启动能力。案例研究表明GFM变流器在弱电网中具有增强稳定性的能力。然而，挑战依然存在，特别是互操作性、多个基于逆变器资源之间的控制协调、缺乏标准化的电网规范要求以及保护设备的协调。
conclusion: 构网型技术是实现可靠的、以可再生能源为主的孤岛电力系统的关键推动因素。但其更广泛的采用取决于持续的技术和监管发展，包括互操作性、协调的电网规范和考虑孤岛系统独特特征的电网规划。

title: FOCUS: First-Order Control Using Optimal Transport Supervision for Imitation from Observations
authors: João A. Cândido Ramos, Lionel Blondé, Hugues Vinzant, Jacopo Castellini, Alexandros Kalousis
abstract: Imitation learning from observations must recover behavior from state-only demonstrations without known temporal correspondence. Differentiable simulators provide pathwise policy gradients, but differentiating through long, contact-rich trajectories can make optimization unstable. We introduce FOCUS, which combines local optimal-transport alignment with short-horizon differentiable actor-critic learning. FOCUS matches agent rollout windows to multiple sampled expert segments using a soft best-of-$K$ objective that emphasizes locally compatible matches. The resulting transport-based costs provide differentiable imitation rewards, while a learned critic bootstraps value beyond the rollout horizon. FOCUS requires neither temporally aligned trajectories nor expert-aligned initialization or teacher forcing. Across contact-rich locomotion tasks in DFlex, including a musculoskeletal humanoid controlled by 152 muscle activations, FOCUS improves sample efficiency and training stability over adversarial imitation-from-observation methods and prior differentiable imitation baselines.
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Physical Understanding for Decision-Making
zh_title: FOCUS：利用最优传输监督的基于观测模仿的一阶控制
translation: 仅通过观测进行的模仿学习必须在没有已知时间对应关系的情况下，从纯状态演示中恢复行为。可微分仿真器提供了路径策略梯度，但通过长且充满接触的轨迹进行微分会使优化变得不稳定。我们介绍了 FOCUS，它将局部最优传输对齐与短期可微分演员-评论家学习结合起来。FOCUS 使用强调局部兼容匹配的软 best-of-K 目标，将智能体 rollout 窗口与多个采样的专家片段进行匹配。由此产生基于传输的成本提供了可微分的模仿奖励，而学习到的评论家则在 rollout 视野之外进行价值自举。FOCUS 既不需要时间对齐的轨迹，也不需要专家对齐的初始化或教师强迫。在 DFlex 中跨越接触丰富的运动任务（包括由 152 个肌肉激活控制的肌肉骨骼人形机器人），与对抗式基于观测的模仿方法和先前的可微分模仿基线相比，FOCUS 提高了样本效率和训练稳定性。
tldr: 本文提出了 FOCUS，一种结合最优传输对齐与可微分演员-评论家的模仿学习方法，无需时间对齐即可高效稳定地解决复杂的接触丰富控制任务。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将最优传输理论与短期可微分演员-评论家算法相结合，解决了仅靠观测进行模仿学习中长期轨迹优化不稳定和缺乏时间对应关系的难题，在复杂的接触丰富型 locomotion 任务上展现出色的样本效率和训练稳定性。
motivation: 模仿学习通常缺乏时间对应关系，而可微分模拟器在通过长且充满接触的轨迹进行微分时会导致优化不稳定，因此需要一种既能对齐轨迹又能保证训练稳定性的方法。
method: 引入 FOCUS 方法，结合局部最优传输对齐与短期可微分演员-评论家学习；利用软 best-of-K 目标将智能体轨迹窗口与多个采样的专家片段进行匹配，提供可微分模仿奖励，并利用学习到的评论家进行价值自举。
results: 在 DFlex 的复杂接触丰富运动任务（包括由 152 个肌肉激活控制的肌肉骨骼人形机器人）中，FOCUS 相比对抗式基于观测的模仿方法和先前的可微分模仿基线，提升了样本效率和训练稳定性。
conclusion: FOCUS 是一种有效且鲁棒的基于观测的模仿学习方法，能够无需时间对齐或专家对齐初始化，稳定地解决复杂的接触丰富控制任务。

title: Self-Localization of Distributed Microphone Arrays Using One Source and Acoustic Reflections
authors: Thomas Guffroy, Jean-Daniel Pascal Prieto, Cédric Foy, Antoine Deleforge
abstract: We present a method to estimate the relative position and orientation of two non-coplanar microphone arrays using a room impulse response (RIR) from a single source. The approach exploits early acoustic reflections, retrieved by each array in the form of a 3D image-source point cloud, using a recently-proposed image-source localization technique. The task is then reduced to aligning the two unlabeled point clouds, which is made difficult by their inherent symmetries and by spurious, missing and noisy estimates. To this aim we introduce ARCTIC, a point-cloud registration algorithm that performs a ranked search over congruent triangles anchored on the true source. Simulated and real experiments show that ARCTIC strongly outperforms two baselines, achieving mean angular and radial self-localization errors below 5 and 10 cm across 36 real RIRs measured in 6 different rooms.
zh_title: 利用单个声源和声学反射的分布式麦克风阵列自定位
translation: 我们提出了一种利用单个声源的房间脉冲响应（RIR）来估计两个非共面麦克风阵列相对位置和方向的方法。该方法利用每个阵列通过最近提出的图像源定位技术检索到的3D图像源点云形式的早期声学反射。任务随后简化为对齐两个未标记的点云，这因其固有的对称性以及虚假、缺失和噪声估计而变得困难。为此，我们引入了ARCTIC，一种点云配准算法，它通过锚定在真实声源上的全等三角形进行排序搜索。模拟和真实实验表明，ARCTIC显著优于两种基线方法，在6个不同房间测量的36个真实RIR中，平均角度和径向自定位误差分别低于5厘米和10厘米。
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用单个声源和早期声学反射来估计两个非共面麦克风阵列相对位置和方向的方法，并引入了ARCTIC算法来对齐点云，实验证明其性能优于基线方法。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于利用早期声学反射进行分布式麦克风阵列的自定位，并提出了ARCTIC算法来有效处理点云对齐中的对称性、噪声和缺失数据问题。这种方法在无需额外硬件的情况下，为多麦克风系统在复杂环境中的部署和校准提供了新的思路，具有重要的实际应用价值。
motivation: 现有技术难以估计分布式麦克风阵列的相对位置和方向，尤其是在存在点云固有点对称性、虚假、缺失和噪声估计的情况下。因此，需要一种有效的方法来解决麦克风阵列的自定位问题。
method: 该方法利用单个声源的房间脉冲响应（RIR）中的早期声学反射。每个阵列通过图像源定位技术检索3D图像源点云。然后，通过对齐两个未标记的点云来完成定位任务。为此，研究人员引入了ARCTIC算法，这是一种点云配准算法，通过锚定在真实声源上的全等三角形进行排序搜索。
results: ARCTIC算法在模拟和真实实验中表现出显著优于两种基线方法。在6个不同房间测量的36个真实RIR中，平均角度自定位误差低于5厘米，径向自定位误差低于10厘米。
conclusion: 本文提出的ARCTIC算法能够有效利用声学反射实现分布式麦克风阵列的精确自定位，在复杂环境下表现出优越的性能。

title: Numerical methods for nonlinear stochastic differential equations driven by subdiffusion
authors: Qian Guo, Wei Liu, Ruchun Zuo
abstract: Stochastic differential equations (SDEs) driven by subdiffusion see great applications in anomalous transport and asset price dynamics. Trusted numerical methods are essential for their application in practice. In this paper, for SDEs driven by subdiffusion with superlinear coefficients, we propose a brand-new explicit numerical method. The sharp convergence rate is proved with new techniques. The potential application of the proposed method in numerically solving a generalized Fokker-Planck equation is also illustrated. Numerical simulations are provided to demonstrate the theoretical results.
zh_title: 由次扩散驱动的非线性随机微分方程的数值方法
translation: 由次扩散驱动的随机微分方程（SDEs）在反常输运和资产价格动力学中有着广泛的应用。可靠的数值方法对于其实际应用至关重要。在本文中，针对具有超线性系数的次扩散驱动SDEs，我们提出了一种全新的显式数值方法。利用新技术证明了其尖锐的收敛阶。同时阐明了该方法在数值求解广义Fokker-Planck方程中的潜在应用。最后提供了数值模拟来验证理论结果。
tldr: 本文为由次扩散驱动且具有超线性系数的随机微分方程提出了一种新的显式数值方法，证明了其收敛阶，并通过模拟验证了其有效性。
ai_comments: 该论文针对由次扩散驱动且具有超线性系数的随机微分方程，提出了一种全新的显式数值方法，并运用新技术证明了其尖锐的收敛阶，具有较强的理论价值和实际应用潜力。
motivation: 由次扩散驱动的随机微分方程（SDEs）在反常输运和资产价格动力学中有着广泛的应用，而可靠的数值方法对于其实际应用至关重要，特别是针对具有超线性系数的情况。
method: 提出了一种针对超线性系数次扩散驱动SDEs的全新显式数值方法，并利用新技术证明了其尖锐的收敛率。
results: 证明了所提显式数值方法的尖锐收敛阶，通过数值模拟验证了理论结果，并展示了其在数值求解广义Fokker-Planck方程中的潜在应用。
conclusion: 提出了一种适用于超线性系数次扩散驱动SDEs的显式数值方法，证明了其尖锐的收敛阶，并通过数值模拟验证了理论结果，同时展示了其在求解广义Fokker-Planck方程中的应用。

title: ARPEGE: Dataset and Methods to Estimate Acoustic and Geometric Parameters of Rooms from Sound
authors: Jean-Daniel Pascal Prieto, Prerak Srivastava, Cédric Foy, Antoine Deleforge
abstract: Can one hear the walls of a room? To foster audio signal processing research around this question we release ARPEGE, a dataset containing hundreds of ambisonic spherical-array room impulse responses recorded in 6 empty rooms, annotated by the relative positions of sources, microphones and all acoustic reflectors. The dataset includes multiple room sizes, surface materials, orientations and distances, as well as recordings of human speakers and handclaps. Two state-of-the-art methods on image source localization and blind room parameter estimation are demonstrated on the data. Initial code for re-simulating the measured room impulse responses is provided, a longer term goal being to digitally twin the dataset.
zh_title: ARPEGE：通过声音估计房间声学与几何参数的数据集与方法
translation: 人能“听”出房间的墙壁吗？为了推动围绕该问题的音频信号处理研究，我们发布了ARPEGE数据集。该数据集包含在6间空置房间中录制的数百条高阶立体声（Ambisonic）球形阵列房间脉冲响应，并标注了声源、麦克风以及所有声学反射面的相对位置。数据集涵盖了多种房间尺寸、表面材料、朝向和距离，以及人类说话者和拍手声的录音。我们在该数据上演示了两种关于镜像源定位和盲房间参数估计的前沿方法。此外，论文还提供了用于重新模拟测量房间脉冲响应的初始代码，其长期目标是对该数据集进行数字孪生建模。
tldr: 本文推出了ARPEGE数据集，包含6个房间中具有丰富几何与声学标注的球形阵列脉冲响应，用于支持通过声音推断房间几何与声学参数的研究。
ai_comments: 该工作通过发布具有精细几何与声学反射面标注的真实环境Ambisonic脉冲响应数据集，为通过声音推断物理空间参数（盲房间声学估计、镜像源定位等）提供了标准基准，对空间音频、虚拟现实以及房间数字孪生技术的发展具有重要促进作用。
motivation: 旨在探讨并推动“能否通过声音‘听’出房间的墙壁”这一音频信号处理课题的研究。
method: 构建并开源了ARPEGE数据集，采集了6间空房间中数百条球形阵列高保真立体声（Ambisonic）房间脉冲响应，标注了声源、麦克风及所有反射面的相对空间位置；包含不同房间尺寸、表面材质、方向与距离，以及真人说话和拍手录音；并在该数据上演示了两种基于镜像源定位和盲房间参数估计的SOTA方法，同时提供了重模拟测量脉冲响应的初始代码。
results: 成功在ARPEGE数据集上验证了镜像源定位和盲房间参数估计这两种前沿方法的有效性，并提供了用于重新模拟测量脉冲响应的初步代码以支持房间数字孪生。

title: Contact-based optimization for collision-free motion planning for a million robots
authors: Jan Kamm, Antonio Terpin, Raffaello D'Andrea
abstract: Multi-agent robotic systems have attracted growing interest in recent years, with applications ranging from coordinated drone shows to autonomous operations on land, in the air, and on water. At the planning level, robot motion is often modeled using double-integrator dynamics (with low-level controllers handling the physical dynamics during execution) with a minimum-energy objective subject to collision-avoidance constraints and limits on position, velocity, and acceleration. The complexity of the problem resides in the constraints, which couple the trajectories and make the optimization problem nonconvex. Existing numerical approaches typically discretize and optimize entire trajectories, which becomes expensive for large fleets. We exploit the structure of optimal trajectories by organizing optimization around contacts, at which robots reach the minimum allowed separation. We formulate a coupled algebraic system in contact variables and reconstruct trajectories analytically between contacts. Our algorithm, sequential contact insertion (SCI), starts from unconstrained trajectories, inserts contacts at separation violations, and jointly adjusts their times and states. Numerical experiments demonstrate planning for one million robots in minutes and thousands of robots in fractions of a second. On problems feasible for a fixed-grid sequential convex programming baseline, SCI achieves median speedups of several orders of magnitude at matching solution accuracy.
zh_title: 基于接触优化的百万机器人无碰撞运动规划
translation: 近年来，多智能体机器人系统备受关注，应用涵盖无人机编队表演以及陆地、空中和水上的自主作业。在规划层面，机器人的运动通常建模为双积分动力学（执行期间由底层控制器处理实际物理动力学），以最小能量为目标，并受限于防碰撞约束以及位置、速度和加速度限制。该问题的复杂性源于这些约束使得轨迹相互耦合，导致优化问题呈非凸性。现有的数值方法通常对整条轨迹进行离散化和优化，对于大规模集群而言计算成本极为昂贵。我们利用最优轨迹的结构，围绕机器人达到最小允许间距的“接触”来组织优化。我们在接触变量中构建了一个耦合代数系统，并在接触之间解析地重构轨迹。我们的算法称为顺序接触插入（SCI），它从无约束轨迹出发，在违反安全间距处插入接触点，并联合调整它们的时间和状态。数值实验表明，该算法可以在数分钟内完成100万个机器人的规划，并在几分之一秒内完成数千个机器人的规划。在固定网格顺序凸规划基线可行的问题上，SCI在保持相同求解精度的同时，实现了数个数量级的中位数加速。
tldr: 提出了一种围绕接触点优化且解析重构轨迹的新算法（SCI），仅需数分钟即可完成百万量级机器人的无碰撞运动规划。
ai_comments: 该论文在多机器人运动规划的计算可扩展性上取得了突破性创新。其核心亮点在于摆脱了传统方法对整条轨迹进行全网格离散化的重计算负担，巧妙地利用双积分动力学特性，仅在碰撞边界（接触点）构建代数优化并在期间解析重构轨迹，将规划规模推进到了惊人的百万量级。潜在局限性在于规划模型简化为双积分动力学，更复杂的真实环境障碍物和高阶非线性动力学适配情况在摘要中未予详述。
motivation: 传统的数值运动规划方法通常对整条轨迹进行离散化和全局优化，但在大规模机器人集群中，防碰撞约束引发的轨迹强耦合和非凸性使得计算复杂度极高、耗时极为昂贵。
method: 提出顺序接触插入（SCI）算法：利用最优轨迹结构，围绕智能体达到最小允许间距的“接触”点组织优化；建立关于接触变量的耦合代数系统，在接触点之间解析重构轨迹；算法从无约束轨迹出发，在间距冲突处插入接触点，并联合迭代优化接触的时间与状态。
results: 数值实验表明，该算法仅需数分钟即可完成100万个机器人的运动规划，数千个机器人的规划耗时不足一秒；在保证与固定网格顺序凸规划基线相同解精度的前提下，取得了数个数量级的中位数加速比。
conclusion: 通过围绕接触变量构建耦合代数系统并解析重构轨迹，顺序接触插入算法成功攻克了大规模多智能体协同规划的计算瓶颈，实现了前所未有的求解规模与计算效率。

title: An Efficient Randomized Hierarchical Tucker Decomposition
authors: Bram Leys, Karl Meerbergen, Nick Vannieuwenhoven, Mathijs Vivet
abstract: We introduce randomized algorithms for computing the hierarchical Tucker decomposition of high-order tensors. Unlike traditional algorithms performed in a sequential leaves-to-root direction, our algorithms traverse the dimension tree in a root-to-leaves direction, leveraging randomized sequential projections to accelerate the computation of intermediate subspaces. This strategy can reduce the computation time by an order of magnitude relative to prior randomized algorithms using the leaves-to-root direction, while guaranteeing quasi-optimal approximation. Although the theoretical error bound is slightly larger than for leaves-to-root methods, in all our experiments the practical error adheres to the classic bound. Our results highlight the method's potential for scalable tensor decompositions in high-dimensional data analysis.
comment: 28 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables, presented at GAMM ANLA 2025 and METT XI
zh_title: 一种高效的随机分层Tucker分解
translation: 我们为计算高阶张量的分层Tucker分解引入了随机算法。与在叶到根方向上执行的传统算法不同，我们的算法沿着根到叶的方向遍历维度树，利用随机的顺序投影来加速中间子空间的计算。与使用叶到根方向的先前随机算法相比，该策略可将计算时间减少一个数量级，同时保证了准最优近似。尽管理论误差界比叶到根方法略大，但在我们所有的实验中，实际误差都符合经典界限。我们的结果突显了该方法在हरूको维数据分析中进行可扩展张量分解的潜力。
tldr: 提出了一种新的从根到叶的随机分层Tucker分解算法，通过随机投影加速计算，相比现有算法计算速度快一个数量级，且近似误差接近最优。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的随机分层Tucker分解算法，通过改变计算方向（从根到叶）并引入随机投影，显著提高了计算效率，同时保持了良好的近似精度。这种方法对于处理大规模高维数据具有重要意义，是张量分解领域的一项有价值的贡献。
motivation: 现有的分层Tucker分解算法通常是自底向上（从叶到根）计算的，计算效率有待提高。
method: 提出了一种新的从根到叶（root-to-leaves）方向的分层Tucker分解算法，利用随机投影来加速中间子空间的计算。
results: 该方法将计算时间减少了一个数量级，同时保证了近似的质量，实验结果表明其近似误差与经典界限一致。
conclusion: 所提出的从根到叶的随机分层Tucker分解算法在计算效率和近似质量方面都表现出色，为高维数据分析中的大规模张量分解提供了有前景的方法。

title: A complete analytical characterization of optimal collision-free motion for two robots
authors: Jan Kamm, Antonio Terpin, Raffaello D'Andrea
abstract: Collision-free motion planning for multi-agent robotic systems remains an active research area because of the complexity of coordinating robot trajectories, with applications ranging from coordinated drone shows to autonomous operations on land, in the air, and on water. Importantly, the analytical difficulty of nonconvex collision-avoidance constraints has so far driven the development of exclusively numerical methods. We derive a complete analytical characterization of the optimal trajectories for two robots that start and end at rest, under double-integrator dynamics and a squared-acceleration objective. We prove that these trajectories belong to eight distinct contact families and determine which family applies for each configuration of initial and final positions. We analyze the geometrical properties of the optimal trajectories, provide a numerical algorithm for computing them, and discuss how these insights may improve the performance of existing numerical trajectory optimizers.
zh_title: 两台机器人最优无碰撞运动的完整解析刻画
translation: 多智能体机器人系统的无碰撞运动规划仍然是一个活跃的研究领域，因为协调机器人轨迹具有复杂性，其应用范围从协调无人机表演到陆地、空中和水上的自主操作。重要的是，非凸防撞约束的解析难度至今推动了纯数值方法的发展。我们推导了两个机器人在双积分动力学和平方加速度目标下，以静止状态开始和结束的最优轨迹的完整解析刻画。我们证明了这些轨迹属于八个不同的接触族，并确定了哪个族适用于初始和最终位置的每个配置。我们分析了几何性质，提供了计算它们的数值算法，并讨论了这些见解如何改善现有数值轨迹优化器的性能。
tldr: 本文首次推导出了双机器人在无碰撞条件和特定优化目标下最优运动轨迹的完整解析解，并将其分为八个接触族。
ai_comments: 该论文突破了以往纯数值方法的局限，首次对双机器人最优无碰撞运动给出了完整的解析刻画，对多智能体运动规划理论的发展具有重要意义。
motivation: 多智能体系统中的无碰撞运动规划由于非凸避碰约束的解析难度，目前几乎完全依赖于数值方法，缺乏完整的解析刻画。
method: 通过数学推导，证明最优轨迹属于八个不同的接触族，并确定了针对不同初始和最终位置配置的适用族，同时给出了数值计算算法。
results: 得出了两台静止起止、具有双积分动力学和平方加速度目标的机器人在最优无碰撞运动下的完整解析刻画，分析了几何性质，并提出了计算算法。
conclusion: 成功推导出了双机器人在满足无碰撞条件及二次加速度目标下的最优轨迹解析解，并将其划分为八个不同的接触族。

title: CEFR Level Assessment across Languages and Text Granularities
authors: Eugene Matsumura, Yuki Arase
abstract: Automatic assessment of textual CEFR levels is an important task in educational natural language processing. However, accurate CEFR level prediction remains challenging due to the naturally imbalanced distribution of CEFR levels and the ambiguous boundaries between adjacent levels. To address these challenges, we propose a unified training objective that combines focal loss with supervised contrastive learning. Focal loss mitigates class imbalance by emphasizing underrepresented and difficult examples, while supervised contrastive learning learns more discriminative representations by encouraging intra-class compactness and inter-class separation. We evaluate the proposed method on sentence- and document-level CEFR assessment in both monolingual and multilingual settings. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms strong baselines across all settings, establishing new state-of-the-art performance on multiple CEFR assessment benchmarks.
zh_title: 跨语言和不同文本粒度的CEFR等级评估
translation: 文本CEFR等级的自动评估是教育自然语言处理领域的一项重要任务。然而，由于CEFR等级天然的不平衡分布以及相邻等级之间模糊的边界，准确预测CEFR等级仍然极具挑战性。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种结合焦点损失与有监督对比学习的统一训练目标。焦点损失通过强调代表性不足和困难的样本来缓解类别不平衡，而有监督对比学习则通过促进类内紧凑和类间分离来学习更具区分性的表征。我们在单语言和多语言设置下的句子级和篇章级CEFR评估中对所提方法进行了评估。实验结果表明，我们的方法在所有设置中均持续优于强基线模型，在多个CEFR评估基准上取得了新的最先进性能。
tldr: 本文提出融合焦点损失与监督对比学习的训练方法，成功解决了跨语言及多粒度CEFR等级评估中的类别不均衡与边界模糊难题并达到SOTA。
ai_comments: 本研究精准抓住了教育NLP中CEFR等级评估的两个核心痛点：类别自然分布不平衡以及相邻等级间主观模糊性高。将Focal Loss（解决不平衡与困难样本）与有监督对比学习（拉大类间差异、聚拢类内特征）结合的思路非常契合该任务特性。此外，实验同时涵盖单语/多语以及句子/篇章多粒度，具有很高的实用价值和泛化验证性；潜在局限在于未提及是否结合序数回归（Ordinal Regression）的等级顺序先验。
motivation: 准确预测文本的CEFR等级极具挑战性，主要由于不同CEFR等级在自然语言中存在固有的类别分布不平衡，以及相邻等级之间存在模糊的界限。
method: 提出了一种结合焦点损失（Focal Loss）与有监督对比学习（Supervised Contrastive Learning）的统一训练目标。其中焦点损失通过着重关注欠代表和困难样本来缓解类别不平衡问题，有监督对比学习则通过促进类内紧凑与类间分离来学习更具区分度的特征表征。
results: 在单语言与多语言设置下的句子级和篇章级CEFR评估实验中，该方法在所有设定下均持续优于强基线模型，并在多个CEFR评估基准上取得了新的最先进（SOTA）性能。
conclusion: 实验证明，将焦点损失与有监督对比学习相结合的训练目标能有效应对CEFR等级评估中的类别不平衡和边界模糊挑战，在跨语言、跨文本粒度的多项基准上均达到了最先进性能。

title: Enhancing Knowledge Entity Relation Extraction in Abstracts and Full-text Content of Academic Articles Using Large Language Models
authors: Yingyi Zhang, Chengzhi Zhang
abstract: This study investigates the effectiveness of large pre-trained language models (LLMs) for knowledge entity relation extraction (KERE) from academic papers. Existing studies have examined individual types of LLM-based strategies and evaluated model performance using metrics such as precision and recall. To provide a broader evaluation, this study investigates multiple strategies, including closed-source LLM-based CoT prompting, LoRA-adapted open-source LLMs, LLM-enhanced small pre-trained language models (SLMs), and SLM-enhanced closed-source LLMs. In addition, this study introduces two strategies, namely SLM-enhanced open-source LLMs and closed-source LLM-enhanced open-source LLMs. These strategies are evaluated from multiple perspectives, including metrics, their ability to mitigate errors observed in SLMs, and potential directions for model optimization. This study manually constructs two annotated datasets in the NLP domain, covering Abstract and Full-Text datasets. Experimental results show that the LoRA-adapted T5 model achieves the highest macro F1 scores of 0.7408 and 0.7013 on the Abstract and Full-Text datasets, respectively. SLMs also benefit from LLM-generated entity descriptions under the LLM-enhanced SLM strategy. Error analysis further reveals that the effectiveness of LLM-based strategies in mitigating SLM errors varies across error types. Based on the identified limitations and error patterns of these strategies, several optimization directions are proposed. In addition, combining strategies with different error patterns further improves KERE performance.
zh_title: 使用大语言模型增强学术文章摘要和全文内容中的知识实体关系提取
translation: 本研究探讨了大预训练语言模型（LLMs）从学术论文中进行知识实体关系提取（KERE）的有效性。现有研究主要检查了基于LLM的个体类型策略，并使用精确率和召回率等指标评估模型性能。为了提供更广泛的评估，本研究调查了多种策略，包括闭源LLM的CoT提示、LoRA适配的开源LLM、LLM增强的小型预训练语言模型（SLMs）以及SLM增强的闭源LLM。此外，本研究引入了两种新策略，即SLM增强的开源LLM和闭源LLM增强的开源LLM。这些策略从多个角度进行了评估，包括评估指标、缓解SLM中观察到的错误的能力以及模型优化的潜在方向。本研究在NLP领域手动构建了两个标注数据集，涵盖摘要和全文数据集。实验结果表明，LoRA适配的T5模型在摘要和全文数据集上分别获得了0.7408和0.7013的最高Macro F1分数。在LLM增强的SLM策略下，SLM也受益于LLM生成的实体描述。错误分析进一步表明，基于LLM的策略在缓解SLM错误方面的有效性因错误类型而异。基于这些策略的局限性和错误模式，提出了几个优化方向。此外，结合具有不同错误模式的策略可进一步提高KERE性能。
tldr: 本文评估了多种基于大语言模型和小语言模型的学术论文实体关系提取策略，发现LoRA微调的T5模型表现最优，且多策略组合能进一步提升效果。
ai_comments: 该论文系统性地研究并比较了多种基于大语言模型（LLM）和小语言模型（SLM）的学术文献知识实体关系提取（KERE）策略，并创新性地提出了组合策略，具有很高的实用价值和理论指导意义。
motivation: 现有研究多关注单一类型的基于大语言模型（LLM）的策略，缺乏对多种策略在学术论文知识实体关系提取（KERE）中表现的全面评估与多视角分析。
method: 研究了闭源大模型CoT提示、LoRA微调开源大模型、大模型增强小模型等多种策略，并提出了小模型增强开源大模型及闭源大模型增强开源大模型的新策略，同时构建了NLP领域的摘要和全文两个标注数据集。
results: LoRA适配的T5模型在摘要和全文数据集上分别取得了0.7408和0.7013的最高Macro F1分数；结合不同错误模式的策略可进一步提升KERE性能。
conclusion: LoRA微调的T5模型在摘要和全文数据集上表现最佳，且通过结合不同策略和错误模式分析，可进一步提升KERE的性能。

title: SCRBench: Beyond Equivalence Checking for Semantic Change Reasoning in Code
authors: Omid Saghatchian, Ali Mahzoun, Khashayar Etemadi, Saeed Reza Kheradpisheh
abstract: Understanding how code changes affect program semantics is a core aspect of code reasoning in language models. It is commonly evaluated by asking whether two programs are semantically equivalent, but a yes/no answer does not reveal whether a model knows which code change caused a semantic difference, or which sequence of code changes produced the modified program. We study two tasks that ask these questions directly, diagnosing semantic change and reconstructing sequences of code changes, alongside detecting semantic equivalence. We build SCRBench, 67,658 Python program pairs generated by applying sequences of code changes that preserve or alter program semantics, and evaluate five language models on a stratified subset of 4,500 pairs. Detecting semantic equivalence exposes weaker models, whose accuracy declines as changes accumulate, but the strongest models remain near the ceiling. Diagnosing semantic change reveals weaknesses that equivalence accuracy hides: a model with 94.71% equivalence accuracy diagnoses only 54.44% of semantic changes. Reconstructing sequences of code changes is much harder: the best model reconstructs the exact sequence for only 39.27% of pairs, and no model exceeds 1.11% when five changes are applied. High equivalence accuracy therefore overestimates how well models reason about the semantic effects of code changes.
zh_title: SCRBench：超越等价性检查的代码语义变化推理
translation: 理解代码变化如何影响程序语义是语言模型中代码推理的核心方面。这通常通过询问两个程序是否语义等价来评估，但“是/否”的答案无法揭示模型是否知道哪个代码变化导致了语义差异，或者哪个代码变化序列产生了修改后的程序。我们研究了直接询问这些问题的两个任务：诊断语义变化和重建代码变化序列，以及检测语义等价性。我们构建了SCRBench，一个包含67,658个Python程序对的数据集，这些程序对通过应用保持或改变程序语义的代码变化序列生成。我们评估了五个语言模型在4,500个分层子集对上的表现。检测语义等价性任务暴露了较弱模型的不足，其准确率随着变化的积累而下降，但最强的模型仍接近上限。诊断语义变化任务揭示了等价性准确率所隐藏的弱点：一个具有94.71%等价性准确率的模型只能诊断54.44%的语义变化。重建代码变化序列的难度更大：最佳模型只能为39.27%的程序对重建出精确的序列，当应用五个变化时，没有模型超过1.11%。因此，高的等价性准确率高估了模型推理代码变化语义效果的能力。
tldr: 现有语义等价性检查无法完全评估语言模型对代码语义变化的理解。本文提出了两个新任务（诊断语义变化和重建代码变化序列）和数据集SCRBench，发现即使在等价性检查中表现好的模型，在这些新任务上也表现不佳，表明现有模型对代码语义变化的推理能力被高估了。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入更细粒度的评估任务和数据集SCRBench，揭示了当前语言模型在理解代码语义变化方面存在的深层局限性，即使它们在传统的语义等价性检查中表现良好。这对于未来代码理解模型的研究方向具有重要指导意义，强调了超越简单二元判断的必要性。
motivation: 现有方法通过语义等价性检查来评估语言模型对代码变化的理解，但这种“是/否”的答案无法揭示模型是否知道哪个代码变化导致了语义差异，或者哪些代码变化序列产生了修改后的程序。因此，需要更深入的任务来评估模型对代码语义变化的推理能力。
method: 本文提出了两个新任务：诊断语义变化和重建代码变化序列，与检测语义等价性并行评估。构建了SCRBench数据集，包含67,658个Python程序对，通过应用保持或改变程序语义的代码变化序列生成。在4,500个分层子集对上评估了五个语言模型。
results: 检测语义等价性任务暴露了较弱模型的缺陷，但最强模型仍接近上限。诊断语义变化任务揭示了等价性准确率所隐藏的弱点：一个具有94.71%等价性准确率的模型只能诊断54.44%的语义变化。重建代码变化序列任务难度更大：最佳模型只能为39.27%的程序对重建出精确的序列，当应用五个变化时，没有模型超过1.11%。高等价性准确率高估了模型推理代码变化语义效果的能力。
conclusion: 现有的语义等价性检查高估了语言模型对代码语义变化推理的能力。更细粒度的任务（如诊断语义变化和重建变化序列）揭示了模型在理解代码语义变化方面的显著局限性。

title: Digital sovereignty in professional translation workflows: a case study of migrating from Windows to Linux
authors: Michael Farrell
abstract: This study examines digital sovereignty in professional translation through a screening of computer-assisted translation tools and translation management systems, and a case study of migrating a translator's workstation from Windows to Linux. The framework combines three principles - Control, Continuity and Exit - with three practical requirements: native Linux operation, independence from mandatory external services, and independent access to essential data and resources. Drawing on documentary evidence and the limited number of responses received from providers, the ecosystem screening distinguishes Linux accessibility from operational independence: browser-based platforms may remain dependent on provider-controlled infrastructure. The migration case demonstrates the feasibility of reconstructing one professional workflow around a locally operable Linux core, using LoopCAT, LibreOffice and locally run TranslateGemma, alongside tools for optical character recognition, communication, credential management and backup. Selected cloud services remained available where needed. The findings suggest that digital sovereignty depends on how workflow dependencies are organized, rather than on individual applications or operating systems. It does not require technological isolation, but meaningful control over essential components, continuity of work and practical exit options. The framework is tailored to the case examined here and may require adaptation to other professional workflows.
comment: 14 pages, author-accepted version of a paper to be published in the proceedings of the 47th Translating & the Computer conference (Luxembourg) 8/10 December 2026
zh_title: 专业翻译工作流程中的数字主权：从Windows迁移到Linux的案例研究
translation: 本研究通过对计算机辅助翻译工具和翻译管理系统的筛选，以及将翻译人员工作站从Windows迁移到Linux的案例研究，探讨了专业翻译中的数字主权问题。该分析框架结合了三项原则——控制、连续性和退出，以及三项实践要求：原生Linux运行、独立于强制性外部服务、独立访问关键数据和资源。结合文献证据和从供应商处收到的有限回复，生态筛选区分了Linux上的“可访问性”与“操作独立性”：基于浏览器的平台可能仍然依赖于供应商控制的基础设施。迁移案例表明，围绕本地可运行的Linux核心（采用LoopCAT、LibreOffice和本地运行的TranslateGemma，辅以光学字符识别、通信、凭据管理和备份工具）重构专业工作流程是可行的。在需要时，选定的云服务仍然可用。研究结果表明，数字主权取决于工作流依赖关系的组织方式，而非个别应用程序或操作系统本身。它不需要技术孤立，而是需要对关键组件的实质性控制、工作的连续性以及切实可行的退出选项。该框架专为本研究所涉案例定制，在应用于其他专业工作流程时可能需要调整。
tldr: 本研究探讨了专业翻译中的数字主权，并通过将翻译工作站从Windows成功迁移至Linux的案例，证明了依托本地开源与离线工具重构自主可控工作流的可行性。
ai_comments: 本研究切入点新颖且具有极强的现实意义。在云端CAT/TMS和SaaS模式普及导致数据主权和供应商锁定（Vendor Lock-in）风险加剧的背景下，文章首次系统化地将“数字主权”概念引入专业翻译实践。提出的“控制、连续性、退出”分析框架兼具理论深度与实践指导价值。局限性在于研究主要基于单一翻译工作站的个案，对于高度依赖特定商业闭源生态（如SDL Trados）或复杂团队协作网络的大规模工作流，其迁移策略的普适性仍需进一步检验。
motivation: 探讨专业翻译中的数字主权问题，解决翻译人员过度依赖外部专有基础设施、特定商业软件及操作系统所带来的数据失控、业务中断和供应商锁定等风险。
method: 提出了融合三大原则（控制、连续性、退出）与三项实践要求（原生Linux运行、独立于强制性外部服务、独立访问关键资源）的评估框架；基于文档证据和供应商反馈对CAT及TMS工具生态进行筛选；并通过具体案例将翻译工作站从Windows迁移至Linux，以LoopCAT、LibreOffice、本地部署的TranslateGemma及辅助工具构建本地化核心工作流。
results: 生态筛选表明，Linux上的可访问性不等于操作独立性（基于浏览器的工具仍高度依赖供应商云端）；迁移案例验证了基于本地Linux核心重构专业翻译工作流的可行性，不仅能利用本地化工具满足核心需求，还能在必要时灵活保留特定云服务。
conclusion: 数字主权取决于工作流中依赖关系的组织方式，而非个别应用程序或操作系统本身。实现数字主权无需技术孤立，关键在于对核心组件拥有实质控制力、确保工作连续性，并具备切实可行的退出选项。

title: Poly Versus Polyval
authors: Kaushik Nath, Palash Sarkar
abstract: We revisit the basic construction of polynomial evaluation based hash function, which we call Poly, over binary extension fields over $GF(2^n)$, where $n=64k$ and $k\geq 2$. Unlike GHASH, the NIST standard polynomial evaluation based hash function for $n=128$, Poly does not perform the unnecessary bit reversals of each $n$-bit block, and consequently is faster than GHASH. Further, Poly differs from Polyval, -- a faster alternative to GHASH, -- in that Poly performs usual reduction, while Polyval performs Montgomery reduction. We identify suitable choices of the field representing irreducible polynomials which makes usual and Montgomery reductions efficient.
